codes.seriesName: E-family codes (E0–E9, EE, EU)

title.ur: Water pump ki hifazat ka trip

meaning.en: The unit locked out the water pump circuit used for drainage/dehumidification after detecting a pump or level-switch fault.
meaning.ur: Unit ne dehumidification aur pani nikalne wale circuit ko pump ya level switch ki kharabi ki wajah se band kar diya.

causes.en: Water pump motor failed or seized
causes.ur: Water pump motor band ho gaya ya jam gaya

causes.en: Liquid level switch open/short or abnormal resistance
causes.ur: Liquid level switch open/short ho gaya ya resistance gair-mamooli hai

causes.en: Loose or broken pump wiring / blocked inlet-outlet
causes.ur: Pump ki wiring dhili ya tooti hui hai, inlet-outlet band hai

solutions.en: Clean water inlet/outlet paths and clear the drain
solutions.ur: Pehle water inlet/outlet ke raaste saaf karein aur drain khali karein

solutions.en: Test and replace level-switch wiring or the switch itself
solutions.ur: Level switch ki wiring check karein, kharab ho to switch ya wiring badlein

solutions.en: Replace the pump; if fault persists, service controller main board
solutions.ur: Pump badlein; masla phir bhi rahe to controller main board service karein

codes.seriesName: E-family codes (E0–E9, EE, EU)

meaning.en: Discharge/high pressure exceeded the safe limit; system shut down to protect the compressor.
meaning.ur: Discharge/high pressure had se zyada hone ki wajah se system band ho gaya taake compressor ko hifazat mil sake.

causes.en: Dirty outdoor condenser or blocked airflow
causes.ur: Bahar ka condenser ganda hai ya airflow band hai

causes.en: Refrigerant overcharge or non-condensables
causes.ur: Refrigerant zyada bhar gaya ya us mein non-condensable gas hai

causes.en: Failed outdoor fan or stuck expansion device
causes.ur: Outdoor fan kharab hai ya expansion device atka hua hai

causes.en: Faulty high-pressure sensor/switch wiring
causes.ur: High-pressure sensor/switch ki wiring kharab hai

solutions.en: Clean condenser coils and filters; ensure 2–3 ft clearance around outdoor unit
solutions.ur: Condenser coils aur filters saaf karein; outdoor unit ke gird 2-3 foot ki jagah khuli rakhein

solutions.en: Have a technician verify charge and pressure-switch operation
solutions.ur: Technician se charge aur pressure-switch ka kaam verify karwayein

solutions.en: Replace fan motor, expansion valve, or pressure sensor as diagnosed
solutions.ur: Jaise diagnose ho, fan motor, expansion valve ya pressure sensor badlein

codes.blinkPattern: Running lamp family; blink count = N for code EN (general rule, count model-dependent)

codes.seriesName: E-family codes (E0–E9, EE, EU)

meaning.en: Evaporator temperature dropped below the freeze threshold in cool/dry mode; compressor and condenser fan paused.
meaning.ur: Cooling/dry mode mein evaporator ka temperature jam ki had se neeche gir gaya; compressor aur condenser fan ruk gaye.

causes.en: Clogged air filter or blocked return/supply grilles
causes.ur: Air filter ganda hai ya return/supply grilles band hain

causes.en: Low refrigerant or restricted airflow
causes.ur: Refrigerant kam hai ya airflow roka hua hai

causes.en: Faulty indoor temperature sensor
causes.ur: Indoor ka temperature sensor kharab hai

causes.en: Dirty evaporator coil
causes.ur: Evaporator coil gandi hai

solutions.en: Clean/replace filters and clear vents; allow ice to melt 2–3 hours
solutions.ur: Filters saaf ya badlein aur vents khali karein; barf ko 2-3 ghante mein pigalne dein

solutions.en: Restart; if code returns, check for leaks and sensor failure (technician)
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; code wapas aaye to technician se leak aur sensor check karwayein

notes.en: Protection may be normal self-clear behavior in mild cases. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official-adjacent.
notes.ur: Halki halat mein yeh protection apne aap theek bhi ho sakti hai (self-clear). Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official-adjacent.

codes.seriesName: E-family codes (E0–E9, EE, EU)

meaning.en: System pressure fell too low — often leak, low charge, or restricted suction side.
meaning.ur: System ka pressure bohat kam ho gaya — aam taur par refrigerant ki leak, kam charge ya suction side ka band hona.

causes.en: Refrigerant leak / undercharge
causes.ur: Refrigerant leak hai ya gas kam hai

causes.en: Dirty filter, fan, or evaporator
causes.ur: Filter, fan ya evaporator ganda hai

causes.en: Faulty low-pressure switch
causes.ur: Low-pressure switch kharab hai

causes.en: Can appear transiently during refrigerant-recovery mode (not always a fault)
causes.ur: Refrigerant-recovery mode mein waqti tor par bhi aa sakta hai (hamesha fault nahi)

solutions.en: Clean filter/fan/evaporator and outdoor fan
solutions.ur: Pehle filter, fan, evaporator aur outdoor fan saaf karein

solutions.en: Technician: leak search, repair, vacuum, and weighed recharge
solutions.ur: Technician leak dhoondein, repair karein, vacuum karein aur taul kar gas bharein

solutions.en: Check low-pressure switch and wiring
solutions.ur: Low-pressure switch aur uski wiring check karein

notes.en: Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official.
notes.ur: Is code ke sources multi-pk + official hain (per-code attribution).

codes.seriesName: E-family codes (E0–E9, EE, EU)

title.ur: Compressor discharge high temperature ki hifazat

meaning.en: Discharge gas temperature exceeded the protective limit (sources cite ~115 °C check point); after repeated trips the unit latches off until power cycle.
meaning.ur: Discharge gas ka temperature hifazati had se zyada ho gaya (manzil ~115 °C check point batati hain); baar baar trip hone par unit lock ho kar band ho jata hai aur power cycle ke baghair dobara nahi chalta.

causes.en: Low refrigerant or restricted flow
causes.ur: Refrigerant kam hai ya flow roka hua hai

causes.en: Dirty condenser / poor ventilation
causes.ur: Condenser ganda hai / ventilation theek nahi

causes.en: Faulty discharge sensor or compressor
causes.ur: Discharge sensor ya compressor kharab hai

causes.en: Reversing/mode issues in heat pump variants
causes.ur: Heat pump versions mein reversing/mode ka masla hai

solutions.en: Power off, clean outdoor unit, wait ~30 min, restart
solutions.ur: Power band karein, outdoor unit saaf karein, taqreeban 30 minute intezaar karein, phir start karein

solutions.en: Technician: verify sensor reading <115 °C, leak test, repair, recharge
solutions.ur: Technician sensor ki reading 115 degree C se kam verify kare, leak test kare, repair kare, phir gas bhare

solutions.en: Replace sensor or main board only after electrical checks
solutions.ur: Sirf electrical checks ke baad hi sensor ya main board badlein

codes.seriesName: E-family codes (E0–E9, EE, EU)

meaning.en: Line voltage too high, too low/unstable, or measured current exceeded the trip threshold; outdoor unit shuts down.
meaning.ur: Line voltage bohat zyada, bohat kam ya be-qarar hone par, ya measured current trip threshold se zyada hone par outdoor unit band ho gaya.

causes.en: Unstable mains or wrong-rated supply
causes.ur: Mains unstable hain ya supply ka rating ghalat hai

causes.en: Wiring/contactor faults
causes.ur: Wiring ya contactor mein kharabi hai

causes.en: Compressor electrical fault drawing excess current
causes.ur: Compressor ki electrical kharabi se current zyada lag raha hai

solutions.en: Verify dedicated circuit and stabilizer output; fix supply
solutions.ur: Pehle dedicated circuit aur stabilizer ka output verify karein, supply theek karwayein

solutions.en: Technician: inspect compressor windings, overcurrent sensor, board
solutions.ur: Technician compressor ki windings, overcurrent sensor aur board check kare

notes.ur: Official greecomfort ke mutabiq: overcurrent protection, high line voltage ya unstable low supply. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official.

codes.seriesName: E-family codes (E0–E9, EE, EU)

title.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit ke darmiyan communication kharab

meaning.en: The data link between indoor and outdoor control boards dropped or became unreadable; cooling/heating stops until link restored.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor board ke darmiyan data link toot gaya ya parhaya nahi ja raha; link theek hone tak cooling/heating band rahti hai.

causes.en: Loose, corroded, damaged, or miswired interconnect cable (most common after install/service)
causes.ur: Interconnect cable dhili, zang aayi, tooti ya ghalat lagi hui (install/service ke baad sabse zyada)

causes.en: Outdoor unit unpowered while indoor powered
causes.ur: Indoor chal raha ho aur outdoor unit ko power na ho

causes.en: PCB transmit/receive fault on either board
causes.ur: Kisi bhi board par PCB transmit/receive kharab hai

causes.en: Communication wires routed near high-voltage lines (interference)
causes.ur: Communication wires high-voltage lines ke bohot paas se gayi hain (interference)

solutions.en: Power both units off at breaker ~1 minute and restart together
solutions.ur: Breaker se dono units ka power taqreeban 1 minute band karein aur saath mein start karein

solutions.en: Confirm outdoor disconnect/breaker is on
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke outdoor disconnect/breaker on hai

solutions.en: Technician: inspect interconnect wiring and test both control boards
solutions.ur: Technician interconnect wiring check kare aur dono control boards test kare

codes.blinkPattern: Running lamp blinks for E-family (incl. E6) per airconditioningmanuals

notes.en: Very common inverter fault in PK service calls. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official + heatpumpanswers.

codes.seriesName: E-family codes (E0–E9, EE, EU)

meaning.en: Indoor and outdoor units disagree on operating mode (e.g., one in heat, one in cool), common on multi-split systems.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit ke operating mode aapas mein match nahi karte (misal ke tor par ek heat mein aur doosra cool mein); aam tor par yeh multi-split systems mein hota hai.

causes.en: Configuration/setting mismatch after power event
causes.ur: Power cut ke baad configuration/setting ka farq ho gaya

causes.en: Flow-switch or pump issue cited by some service notes
causes.ur: Kuch service notes mein flow-switch ya pump ka masla bataya gaya hai

causes.en: Loose control wiring
causes.ur: Control wiring dhili hai

solutions.en: Set both units to the same mode and power-cycle
solutions.ur: Dono units ko ek hi mode mein set karein aur power cycle karein

solutions.en: Check flow switch/pump on hydronic variants; fix wiring
solutions.ur: Hydronic versions mein flow switch/pump check karein; wiring theek karein

notes.en: Official: often homeowner-fixable. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official.
notes.ur: Official ke mutabiq: aksar ghar ka banda khud theek kar sakta hai. Per-code attribution: multi-pk + official.

codes.seriesName: E-family codes (E0–E9, EE, EU)

title.ur: Indoor fan ya high temperature ki hifazat (model ke mutabiq)

meaning.en: Depending on series: indoor fan motor or indoor circuit problem, or anti-high-temperature lockout.
meaning.ur: Series ke mutabiq: indoor fan motor ya indoor circuit ki kharabi, ya anti-high-temperature lockout.

causes.en: Faulty indoor fan motor or loose motor wiring
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor kharab hai ya motor ki wiring dhili hai

causes.en: Indoor main PCB fault
causes.ur: Indoor main PCB kharab hai

causes.en: Restricted airflow / high ambient causing thermal trip
causes.ur: Airflow band ya zyada ambient temperature ki wajah se thermal trip

solutions.en: Check and reseat indoor fan wiring; replace motor if dead
solutions.ur: Indoor fan ki wiring check karke theek se lagayein; motor dead ho to badlein

solutions.en: Improve ventilation and clean filters; restart after cooldown
solutions.ur: Ventilation behtar karein aur filters saaf karein; thanda hone par restart karein

solutions.en: Technician: replace indoor board if motor tests good
solutions.ur: Technician motor theek test ho to indoor board badlein

notes.ur: Sources ke darmiyan meaning ka conflict hai (fan vs anti-high-temp) — model check zaroori hai. Per-code attribution: multi-pk (meanings diverge).

codes.seriesName: E-family codes (E0–E9, EE, EU)

meaning.en: Water flow switch or condensate/drain condition fault; after repeated trips (e.g., 3×/60 min) manual power reset required.
meaning.ur: Water flow switch ya condensate/drain ki kharabi; baar baar trip hone par (misal ke tor par 60 minute mein 3 baar) power kat kar dobara on karna zaroori hai.

causes.en: Blocked drain pipe / full tray
causes.ur: Drain pipe band hai / tray bhar gayi hai

causes.en: Failed drain or condensate pump
causes.ur: Drain ya condensate pump kharab hai

causes.en: Faulty water flow switch or wiring
causes.ur: Water flow switch ya uski wiring kharab hai

solutions.en: Clear drain line and tray; level the unit
solutions.ur: Drain line aur tray khali karein; unit ko level karein

solutions.en: Test/replace pump and flow switch; board last resort
solutions.ur: Pump aur flow switch test karein ya badlein; board ka masla sirf tab dekhein jab doosra ilaaj kaam na aaye.

meaning.en: Control board failed to read/write stored configuration data in EEPROM.
meaning.ur: Control board EEPROM mein store ki gayi configuration data read/write nahi kar paya.

causes.en: Corrupted EEPROM contents
causes.ur: EEPROM ka data kharab (corrupt) ho gaya hai

causes.en: Failing memory chip on outdoor (or drive) board
causes.ur: Outdoor (ya drive) board par memory chip fail ho raha hai

solutions.en: Disconnect mains power for 2 minutes, then switch on again so the board re-reads the stored EEPROM configuration
solutions.ur: Mains power 2 minute ke liye band karein, phir on karein taake board EEPROM mein store configuration dobara read kare

solutions.en: If the code returns, a technician reads the EEPROM on the outdoor/drive board, reprograms the data, or replaces the memory chip
solutions.ur: Code wapas aaye to technician outdoor/drive board ka EEPROM parhe, data reprogram kare ya memory chip badle

notes.en: Lowercase `ee` sometimes = drive-board memory vs `EE` outdoor main PCB (aliases cover both). Per-code attribution: multi-pk + heatpumpanswers.
notes.ur: Chhota ee kabhi kabhi drive-board memory hai, aur EE outdoor main PCB (dono ke liye aliases maujood hain). Per-code attribution: multi-pk + heatpumpanswers.

meaning.ur: Intelligent power module bohat garm ho gaya; khud ko hifazat dene ke liye drive operating frequency kam kar deta hai.

causes.ur: Outdoor ki ventilation kamzor hai ya heat exchanger ganda hai

causes.ur: Thermal paste kamzor hai / IPM ke screws dhile hain (service level)

solutions.en: Clear outdoor airflow and clean coils; restart after cool-down
solutions.ur: Outdoor ki airflow khuli rakhein aur coils saaf karein; thanda hone ke baad restart karein

solutions.en: Technician: inspect IPM, thermal interface, drive board
solutions.ur: Technician IPM, thermal interface aur drive board check kare

codes.seriesName: Light-commercial inverter IDU after 2019 (cassette/ducted/floor)

meaning.en: Indoor / outdoor unit communication error
meaning.ur: Dono units ke darmiyan rabta toot gaya

causes.en: Loose, broken or wrongly landed wiring between indoor and outdoor units.
causes.ur: Indoor aur outdoor ke darmiyan wiring dheeli, tooti ya ghalat lagi hui ho

causes.en: Faulty indoor/outdoor control board or S-line driver.
causes.ur: Indoor/outdoor control board ya S-line driver kharab hona

solutions.en: Switch off power, wait one minute, check L/N/S/GND wiring and re-terminate securely.
solutions.ur: Power off karke aik minute ruken, L/N/S/GND wiring check karke mazboot se dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Power-cycle and verify outdoor PCB status LEDs; replace the faulty board if the link still fails.
solutions.ur: Power cycle karein aur outdoor PCB ke status LED check karein; agar rabta phir bhi na bane to kharab board tabdeel karein

codes.blinkPattern: Run=2 times; Timer=OFF

notes.en: Scope: Light-commercial inverter indoor unit post-2019 (cassette/ducted/floor-standing family), wired controller or LED display.
notes.ur: Yeh entries post-2019 light-commercial inverter indoor unit ke hain (cassette/ducted/floor-standing family), wired controller ya LED display par.

causes.en: Sensor connector loose, wire chafed, or sensor element open/shorted.
causes.ur: Sensor connector dheela, wire kati hui, ya sensor element open/short hona

meaning.ur: Outdoor fan ghair mamooli raftar par chalna ya phase error

causes.en: Indoor/outdoor fan motor stuck, obstructed, or Hall feedback missing.
causes.ur: Fan motor atka hua ya ruka hua, ya Hall feedback nahi aa raha

causes.en: Fan connector or PCB drive circuit fault.
causes.ur: Fan connector ya PCB drive circuit kharab hona

solutions.en: Power off, spin the fan by hand for binding, clear debris, and check connectors.
solutions.ur: Power off karke fan ko haath se ghumayein, debris saaf karein aur connectors check karein

solutions.en: Replace the fan motor if windings/feedback fail; otherwise replace the control board.
solutions.ur: Agar motor ki windings/feedback kharab ho to fan motor tabdeel karein, warna control board tabdeel karein

meaning.ur: Outdoor board ki main chip ko EEPROM se jawab nahi milna

causes.en: Memory chip data on the control board is corrupted or the chip is not seated.
causes.ur: Control board par memory chip ka data kharab hona ya chip sahi tareeqe se baithi na ho

causes.en: Board-level fault after power surges or interrupted supply.
causes.ur: Voltage ke achanak urne ya supply cutne ke baad board level ki kharabi.

codes.seriesName: TAC fixed-speed legacy (TAC-07…24 CS/CK/CHS)

title.ur: Kamre ke temperature sensor ki kharabi (legacy fixed-speed)

meaning.en: Room sensor fault shown on digital display; RUN lamp flashes once per cycle.
meaning.ur: Kamre ke sensor ka fault digital display par nazar aata hai; RUN lamp har cycle mein ek baar chalta hai.

causes.en: Sensor open/short
causes.ur: Sensor open ya short ho jaye

causes.en: loose plug
causes.ur: Plug dheela ho jaye

solutions.en: Switch off the AC at the mains and wait 5 minutes before opening the indoor panel.
solutions.ur: AC ka mains band kar ke panel kholne se pehle 5 minute intezar karein.

solutions.en: With power off, unplug the room-sensor connector on the indoor board, clean the pins and re-seat it firmly; after power returns the sensor should read room temperature normally.
solutions.ur: Power band karne ke baad indoor board se room-sensor connector nikal kar pins saaf karein aur mazbooti se dobara lagayein; power aane ke baad sensor kamre ka temperature theek parh le.

solutions.en: If the fault remains, measure the thermistor resistance with a multimeter at room temperature and compare it with the manual chart; replace the thermistor if it reads open or short.
solutions.ur: Masla rahe to multimeter se kamre ka temperature par thermistor ka resistance naapein aur manual ke chart se milayein; open ya short parhe to thermistor badlein.

codes.blinkPattern: RUN lamp once/cycle; digital display E1

notes.en: p22 table: lamp flash once/cycle ↔ E1. Per-code attribution: service_manual.

meaning.en: On TPH11, EP = high/low refrigerant pressure protection (vs compressor top-switch on single-split).
meaning.ur: TPH11 par EP ka matlab high/low refrigerant pressure protection hai (single-split par compressor top-switch).

causes.en: Pressure switch tripped
causes.ur: Pressure switch trip ho jaye

causes.en: Charge issues
causes.ur: Gas charge ka masla ho

causes.en: Condenser/evaporator problem
causes.ur: Condenser/evaporator mein masla ho

solutions.en: Switch the unit off and isolate power before reading pressures.
solutions.ur: Pressure lene se pehle unit band karke power isolate karein.

solutions.en: Read the operating pressures with gauges and compare them with the manual values; low or high pressure points to charge or condenser trouble.
solutions.ur: Gauge se operating pressures parhein aur manual ki values se milayein; pressure kam ya zyada ho to gas charge ya condenser ka masla hai.

solutions.en: Repair the leak or condenser problem, recharge correctly, and replace the pressure switch only if it is stuck.
solutions.ur: Leak ya condenser ka masla theek karein, gas sahi tarah charge karein, aur pressure switch sirf atka ho to badlein.

meaning.en: Outdoor liquid-line sensor open/short.
meaning.ur: Outdoor liquid-line sensor khula/short hai.

causes.en: Connector loose
causes.ur: Connector dheela ho jaye

causes.en: Thermistor failed
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab ho jaye

solutions.en: Turn off power before touching the liquid-line sensor.
solutions.ur: Liquid-line sensor ko haath lagane se pehle power band karein.

solutions.ur: Connector dobara lagayein aur chart ke mutabiq thermistor ka resistance naapein; open/short reading aaye to sensor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Replace the sensor if the reading is still out of range.
solutions.ur: Reading ab bhi range se bahar ho to sensor badlein.

solutions.ur: Agar circuit phir bhi open rahe to room temperature par sensor ki resistance naapein; reading range se bahar ho to indoor temperature sensor badlein, warna technician board input check kare.

title.en: Condenser inlet tube temperature sensor fault
title.ur: Condenser inlet tube ka temperature sensor kharab

meaning.en: Temperature sensor at condenser inlet tube loose, failed, or sampling abnormal (multi-split outdoor).
meaning.ur: Condenser ke inlet tube ka temperature sensor loose/kharab ya sampling abnormal hai (multi-split outdoor).

causes.en: Sensor wiring loose
causes.ur: Sensor ki wiring dheeli hai

causes.en: Sensor failure
causes.ur: Sensor kharab hai

causes.en: Sampling circuit abnormal
causes.ur: Sampling circuit theek nahi hai

solutions.en: Isolate the outdoor unit at the disconnect switch and remove the service cover before touching the sensor wiring.
solutions.ur: Sensor wiring chhoone se pehle outdoor unit ko disconnect switch se band karke service cover utaar dein.

solutions.en: Check the inlet tube sensor connector and cable for looseness or damage, reseat it, and watch whether the code clears after a power cycle.
solutions.ur: Inlet tube sensor ka connector aur cable ki tightness ya nuqs dekhein, dobara lagayein, aur power cycle ke baad code clear ho ya nahi dekhein.

solutions.en: If the code returns, measure the sensor resistance with a multeter and compare it with a known-good sensor; replace the inlet tube sensor if it reads out of range, otherwise technician checks the outdoor control board sampling circuit.
solutions.ur: Agar code wapas aaye to multimeter se sensor ki resistance naapein aur kisi known-good sensor se compare karein; reading range se bahar ho to inlet tube sensor badlein, warna technician outdoor control board ki sampling circuit check kare.

solutions.en: If it persists, contact an Authorised Service Center; clean filter and check fan.
solutions.ur: Agar masla jari rahe to Authorised Service Center se rabta karein, filter saaf karein aur fan check karein.

notes.en: Official wording: antifreeze protection.
notes.ur: Official lafz: antifreeze protection — indoor coil itna thanda ho jata hai ke unit apni cooling rok kar barf banne nahi deti.

meaning.en: Indoor requests conflict (e.g., another zone/heating-ready state while cooling start attempted).
meaning.ur: Indoor ki requests aapas mein takra rahi hain (misal ke taur par, koi doosra zone ya heating-ready halat, jab cooling start karne ki koshish ho).

causes.en: Simultaneous cool/heat demand in multi systems
causes.ur: Multi systems mein ek hi waqt cooling aur heating ki demand

causes.en: Outdoor not ready for the requested mode
causes.ur: Outdoor unit maangi gayi mode ke liye tayyar nahi

solutions.en: Power off the indoor units at the breaker first, then check the mode and setpoint on every remote/controller in the system - all of them must ask for the same mode.
solutions.ur: Sabse pehle breaker se indoor units ka power band karein, uske baad system ke har remote/controller ka mode aur setpoint check karein - sab ka mode ek hi hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Restore power and try cooling again; if the code returns, make sure the outdoor unit is not in heating-ready or defrost state and no zone is demanding heat at the same time.
solutions.ur: Power wapas on karein aur dobara cooling try karein; code wapas aaye to confirm karein ke outdoor unit heating-ready ya defrost state mein nahi hai aur koi zone sath mein heat demand nahi kar raha.

solutions.en: If the conflict stays, have the technician review the capacity/mode configuration on both boards and correct the zone settings.
solutions.ur: Agar yeh conflict barqarar rahe to technician se dono boards ki capacity/mode configuration check karwa kar zone settings theek karwayein.

solutions.en: Isolate power to the outdoor unit at the breaker before touching the sensor or its wiring.
solutions.ur: Sensor ya uski wiring chhoone se pehle breaker par outdoor unit ka power band kar dein.

solutions.en: Find the COND-OUT pipe sensor on the condenser outlet, unplug it and measure its resistance with a meter at room temperature; an open circuit or a reading far off the normal curve confirms a failed sensor, so replace it.
solutions.ur: Condenser outlet par COND-OUT pipe sensor dhoondein, usse nikal kar room temperature par meter se resistance nap lein; circuit khula ho ya reading normal curve se bahar ho to sensor fail ho chuka hai, ise badal dein.

solutions.en: If the sensor measures normal, clean corrosion from the connector at the outdoor board, reseat it and retest; replace the harness if the reading is still open or short.
solutions.ur: Agar sensor normal nap jaye to outdoor board ke connector se zang saaf karein, phir lagayein aur phir test karein; reading phir bhi open ya short ho to harness badal dein.

causes.ur: Heatsink sensor khula/short

meaning.en: Outlet pipe sensor open/short circuit.
meaning.ur: Outlet pipe sensor khula ya short circuit.

causes.en: Loose connector or failed thermistor
causes.ur: Connector loose ya thermistor kharab

causes.en: Corroded plug
causes.ur: plg par zng/nmy

solutions.en: Disconnect mains power, then reseat the outlet pipe sensor connector at both the sensor and PCB ends.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle bijli band karein, phir outlet pipe sensor ke connector ko dono taraf — sensor aur PCB — par dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance with a multimeter at room temperature and compare it with the known-good curve; if it reads open or short, replace the thermistor.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se kamre ke temperature par sensor ki resistance naapein aur theek curve se compare karein; open ya short nikle to thermistor badal dein.

solutions.en: Inspect the PCB socket for corrosion or dry joints, clean or repair it, then power on and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: PCB socket mein corrosion ya dry joints dekhein, saaf karke theek karein, phir power on karke confirm karein ke code clear ho gaya.

causes.ur: Slave cooling par hai aur master heating par (ya iska ulta)

meaning.en: EEPROM checksum mismatching on indoor PCB.
meaning.ur: Indoor PCB ka EEPROM checksum match nahi ho raha

causes.en: EEPROM loose in socket or dry joints
causes.ur: EEPROM socket mein loose ya dry joints

causes.en: Wrong PCB assembly
causes.ur: Galat PCB assembly

solutions.en: Disconnect power, open the indoor unit safely, and reseat the EEPROM chip fully in its socket.
solutions.ur: Bijli band karein, indoor unit kholte waqt ehtiyat karein aur EEPROM chip ko uske socket mein poori tarah dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Check the EEPROM socket and nearby solder joints under light for dry joints or cracks; reflow or repair them if found.
solutions.ur: Light mein EEPROM socket aur aas-paas ke solder joints dekhein ke dry ya toote hue to nahi; mil jaye to reflow ya repair karein.

solutions.en: If the checksum still fails, confirm the PCB assembly matches this model and replace the indoor PCB only as a last step.
solutions.ur: Agar checksum phir bhi fail ho, to PCB assembly ka model se match confirm karein aur aakhir mein zaroorat pade to indoor PCB badlein.

causes.ur: Hall feedback kharab (tez ghoomne ke baad ruk jata hai)

solutions.ur: Bijli band karke pahiya azad karein, phir windings aur motor ko di PCB power test karein

solutions.ur: 5-wire harness check karein (360V DC / 15V / 0-5V speed)

title.ur: IPM fault ya compressor ka overcurrent

meaning.en: Inverter DC overcurrent >14A; compressor or inverter PCB fault.
meaning.ur: Inverter DC current >14A; compressor ya inverter PCB kharab.

causes.en: Compressor short or to earth
causes.ur: Compressor short ho ya earth se juda ho

causes.en: Inverter PCB/IPM failure
causes.ur: Inverter PCB/IPM kharab hona

causes.en: Seized compressor
causes.ur: Compressor jam (seized)

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the supply, then check the compressor winding to earth with a megger; any leakage means the compressor is bad.
solutions.ur: Bijli band karke supply alag karein, phir megger se compressor winding ki earth checking karein; leakage nikle to compressor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Measure the compressor winding resistance with an ohmmeter for an open or shorted winding; replace the compressor if it fails this test.
solutions.ur: Ohmmeter se compressor ki winding resistance naapein ke open ya short to nahi; test fail ho to compressor badal dein.

solutions.en: If the windings are good, test the inverter PCB output stage and IPM, then replace the failed inverter module or PCB and retest before running.
solutions.ur: Winding theek ho to inverter PCB ka output stage aur IPM test karein; kharab inverter module ya PCB badlein aur chalane se pehle dobara test karein.

meaning.en: Pressure switch open circuit; LP <0.5 bar or HP >41 bar; latch after 5 trips/hour.
meaning.ur: Pressure switch open circuit; LP <0.5 bar ya HP >41 bar; 1 ghante mein 5 trips par latch

causes.en: Low charge or high pressure condition
causes.ur: Gas kam ya pressure zyada

causes.en: CN PRESS link missing
causes.ur: CN PRESS link gayab

solutions.en: Disconnect power and isolate the unit before checking the pressure switch and the LP/HP readings on the gauge.
solutions.ur: Pehle bijli band karke unit ko alag karein, phir pressure switch aur gauge par LP/HP readings check karein.

solutions.en: Find what is tripping the switch — low charge means leak-test and correct the charge, high pressure means clean the condenser coil and clear the airflow.
solutions.ur: Pata karein ke switch kyun trip ho raha hai — gas kam ho to leak test karke charge theek karein, pressure zyada ho to condenser coil saaf karke airflow khali karein.

solutions.en: If the CN PRESS link is missing, refit it, then reset the outdoor unit for 2 minutes and confirm the latch clears.
solutions.ur: Agar CN PRESS link gayab ho to dobara lagayein, phir outdoor unit ka 2 minute ka reset dein aur confirm karein ke latch clear ho gaya.

meaning.ur: Inverter compressor ke discharge sensor ka temperature zyada ho jana.

causes.en: Low refrigerant or blockage
causes.ur: gys km ya rkaot

causes.en: Poor condenser airflow
causes.ur: Condenser airflow kharab

solutions.en: Power off and let the unit cool down, then reset for 2 minutes before reading the discharge temperature again.
solutions.ur: Power off karke unit ko thanda hone dein, phir 2 minute ke liye reset rakhein aur dobara discharge temperature padhein.

solutions.en: Leak-test the system, correct the refrigerant charge and check the EEV if the charge or expansion is wrong.
solutions.ur: System ka leak test karein, refrigerant charge theek karein aur agar charge ya expansion ghalat ho to EEV check karein.

solutions.en: Do not run the unit long while the discharge is hot — clean the condenser airflow and stop before the compressor is damaged.
solutions.ur: Discharge garam ho to unit ko lamba na chalayein — condenser ki airflow saaf karein aur compressor kharab hone se pehle band kar dein.

meaning.en: Connected indoor capacity greater than outdoor allows.
meaning.ur: Lagaye hue indoor ki capacity outdoor ki ijazat se zyada hai

causes.en: Wrong IDU/ODU combination
causes.ur: Galat IDU/ODU combination

causes.en: Excess indoor units connected
causes.ur: Indoor unit zyada lag gaye

solutions.en: Disconnect power, then check the outdoor unit capacity plate and the connected indoor units against the combination chart in the manual.
solutions.ur: Pehle bijli band karein, phir outdoor unit ki capacity plate aur jude hue indoor units ko manual ke combination chart se compare karein.

solutions.en: Count the indoor units and their total capacity; if the total is above what the outdoor unit allows, switch off or remove the extra indoor units.
solutions.ur: Indoor units ki ginti karein aur un ki total capacity nikalein; total outdoor ki permission se zyada ho to extra indoor units band kar dein ya hatayein.

solutions.en: If the combination itself is wrong, reconfigure the address/settings to a supported IDU/ODU pair and restart the system.
solutions.ur: Agar combination hi ghalat ho to address/settings ko kisi supported IDU/ODU pair par set karein aur system ko dobara start karein.

meaning.ur: Outdoor condenser coil temperature zyada hai — coil se hawa ka aana kam

causes.en: Blocked coil (bags, dirt) or recirculating air
causes.ur: Coil par blockage (kura, gand) ya hawa ka wapas ghoomna

causes.en: Nitrogen/non-condensables in system
causes.ur: System mein nitrogen ya non-condensable gas

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the unit, then clear anything blocking the outdoor condenser coil and keep front-to-back airflow open so air is not recirculated.
solutions.ur: Bijli band karke unit alag karein, phir outdoor condenser coil ko rokne wali har cheez hata dein aur aage se peeche ki airflow khuli rakhein taake hawa dobara na ghoomay.

solutions.en: Wash the coil if it is clogged with dirt or bags, and make sure the unit is not sucking its own hot exhaust back in.
solutions.ur: Coil ganda ya blocked ho to use dhoyein ya wash karein, aur confirm karein ke unit apna garam exhaust wapas andar na le raha.

solutions.en: If non-condensables such as nitrogen are suspected, have the system vented and recharged by a technician, then recheck the coil temperature.
solutions.ur: Nitrogen waghera non-condensable ka shaq ho to system ko technician se vent karwa kar recharge karwayein, phir coil ka temperature dobara check karein.

causes.ur: Power supply glitch se bus corrupt

solutions.ur: Power reset karein; code wapas aaye to outdoor main PCB replace karein

solutions.en: Look for burn marks / damaged traces before replacing
solutions.ur: Badalne se pehle jalne ya tootne ke nishan dekhein

title.en: Indoor to outdoor communication error (ODU side)

meaning.en: Outdoor unit reports lost serial link to indoor — same physical fault as CH05, displayed as 53 on outdoor PCB.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit ko indoor se serial link toota hua mehsoos hota hai — CH05 jaisi hi physical fault, outdoor PCB par 53 dikhta hai

causes.en: Same as CH05: cable, terminals, PCB, or earth leakage on bus
causes.ur: CH05 jaisi hi: cable, terminal, PCB, ya bus par earth leakage

causes.en: IDU not powered while ODU is
causes.ur: ODU on hai magar IDU band hai

causes.en: Wrong interconnect polarity/terminals after rewire
causes.ur: Dobara wiring karne ke baad interconnect polarity/terminals galat

solutions.en: Diagnose as CH05 (see code 05)
solutions.ur: CH05 ki tarah diagnose karein (code 05 dekhein)

solutions.en: Confirm both units energized and comms wire on correct terminals
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke dono units on hain aur comms wire sahi terminals par hai

solutions.en: Measure 0-75 V DC fluctuating on outdoor terminals 2-3
solutions.ur: Outdoor terminals 2-3 par 0-75 V DC fluctuating napein

codes.blinkPattern: ODU red 5x / green 3x

notes.en: Multi sheet: CH05 indoor / 53 outdoor for same fault.
notes.ur: Multi sheet mein isi fault ke liye CH05 andar aur 53 bahar liya jata hai.

meaning.en: Outdoor 3-phase supply has a phase missing or phases reversed.
meaning.ur: Outdoor 3-phase supply mein koi phase missing hai ya phases reverse hain

causes.en: Utility phase lost or wrong phase rotation after wiring work
causes.ur: Wiring kaam ke baad utility ka phase gaya ya phase sequence galat

causes.en: Loose phase terminal
causes.ur: Phase terminal loose

causes.en: Breaker pole not making
causes.ur: Breaker ka pole theek se contact nahi banata

solutions.en: Check ~415V AC across red-blue, blue-yellow, red-yellow
solutions.ur: Red-blue, blue-yellow aur red-yellow par ~415V AC napein

solutions.en: If all present but reverse: power off, swap red and yellow cores, reset
solutions.ur: Agar sab maujood hon lekin reverse hon: power off karein, red aur yellow cores ki sarpak badlein, reset karein

solutions.en: Inform electrician if supply side phase wrong
solutions.ur: Supply side par phase galat ho to electrician ko bataayein

codes.blinkPattern: ODU red 5x / green 4x

notes.en: Official Guide: may appear after outage or electrical work; does not self-clear without power cycle.
notes.ur: Official Guide: bijli band hone ya electrical kaam ke baad aa sakta hai; power cycle kiye baghair khud clear nahi hota.

title.ur: Bahar ke PCB EEPROM ka checksum match nahi

meaning.en: Outdoor unit PCB EEPROM data checksum failed.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit PCB ke EEPROM ka data checksum fail ho gaya

causes.en: Wrong PCB assembly installed
causes.ur: Ghalat PCB assembly laga diya gaya

causes.en: Dry joints at EEPROM socket
causes.ur: EEPROM socket par dry solder joints hain

causes.en: EEPROM corrupted by surge
causes.ur: Surge se EEPROM corrupt

solutions.en: Confirm correct PCB; reseat EEPROM; check dry joints
solutions.ur: Sahi PCB confirm karein, EEPROM dobara lagayein aur dry joints check karein

solutions.en: Replace outdoor PCB if nothing found
solutions.ur: Kuch na mile to outdoor PCB badal dein

solutions.en: Investigate surge protection if recurring
solutions.ur: Baar bar aaye to surge protection check karein

title.en: High temperature protection (condenser coil high / overheat)
title.ur: Zyada temperature se protection (condenser coil high / overheat)

meaning.en: Cooling: outdoor condenser coil temperature high (sheet >65C). Heating: indoor overheat (official). May display as P4/P6/P7/P8/CH34 on some models.
meaning.ur: Cooling mein: outdoor condenser coil temperature zyada (sheet >65C). Heating mein: indoor overheat (official). Kuch models par P4/P6/P7/P8/CH34 bhi dikhta hai

causes.en: Blocked outdoor coil (bags, dirt) or recirculating hot air
causes.ur: Outdoor coil par blockage (kura, gand) ya garam hawa wapas ghoom rahi hai

causes.en: Enclosed balcony / no ventilation window / air guide missing
causes.ur: Band balcony / ventilation window nahi / air guide gayab

causes.en: Dirty indoor filter causing poor heat-mode airflow (heating case)
causes.ur: Heating mein gande indoor filter ki wajah se airflow kam

causes.en: Nitrogen or non-condensables in system
causes.ur: System mein nitrogen ya non-condensable gas

solutions.en: Clear space around ODU; open ventilation window; add air guide (LG: ~6-8C drop)
solutions.ur: ODU ke aas paas jagah khali karein; ventilation window kholein; air guide lagayein (LG: ~6-8C farq)

solutions.en: Clean outdoor coil and indoor filter
solutions.ur: Bahar ka coil aur andar ka filter saaf karein

solutions.en: Power cycle to clear (does not auto-clear per official); if persists call technician
solutions.ur: Clear karne ke liye power cycle karein (official ke mutabiq khud clear nahi hota); phir bhi rahe to technician bulayein

codes.blinkPattern: ODU red 6x / green 1x; remote may show CH61 or P4/P6/P7/P8/CH34

notes.en: Official Guide adds heating-mode indoor overheat interpretation and alias list.
notes.ur: Official Guide heating-mode mein andar ke overheat ka matlab aur alias ki list bhi add karta hai.

meaning.ur: Outdoor inverter ke heat-sink thermistor ki reading 85C se upar; unit band ho jata hai

causes.en: Debris blocking heat-sink fins
causes.ur: Heat-sink fins par gadda/blockage

causes.en: Heat-sink thermistor error (see code 65)
causes.ur: Heat-sink ka thermistor error (code 65 dekhein)

causes.en: Inverter cooling fan failure on Multi V style units
causes.ur: Multi V jaise units mein inverter cooling fan kharab

causes.en: Sustained high load / high ambient
causes.ur: Lamba waqt tak zyada load ya zyada ambient temperature

solutions.en: Power off; clean heat sink and outdoor coil
solutions.ur: Bijli band karein, heat sink aur bahar ka coil saaf karein

solutions.en: Verify heat-sink fan running; test thermistor (code 65)
solutions.ur: Heat-sink wala fan chal raha hai yeh verify karein, thermistor test karein (code 65)

solutions.en: Do not keep running hot — stop and service
solutions.ur: Garam chalate rahe band na karein — rok kar service karwaayein

codes.blinkPattern: ODU red 6x / green 2x

title.en: Condenser coil pipe temperature too low
title.ur: Condenser coil pipe ka temperature bahut kam

meaning.en: Condenser coil pipe thermistor reading abnormally low (possible sensor fault or freeze condition).
meaning.ur: Condenser coil pipe ka thermistor bohat kam reading de raha hai (sensor fault ya jam/freeze ho sakta hai)

causes.en: Thermistor open reading low / failed
causes.ur: Thermistor khula, reading kam / kharab

causes.en: Low ambient / unit running in extreme cold without control
causes.ur: Kam ambient / bahut sardi mein bina control ke chalna

causes.en: Refrigerant distribution issue
causes.ur: Refrigerant distribution masla

solutions.en: Test condenser pipe thermistor; replace if bad
solutions.ur: Condenser pipe sensor test karein; kharab ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Check operating mode and ambient; correct charge if liquid floodback suspected
solutions.ur: Operating mode aur ambient check karein; liquid floodback ka shak ho to charge theek karein

solutions.en: Inspect PCB input if sensor OK
solutions.ur: Sensor sahi ho to PCB input check karein

codes.blinkPattern: ODU red 6x / green 3x

meaning.en: Inverter PCB heat-sink thermistor open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Inverter PCB ke heat-sink ka thermistor khula ya short ho gaya hai

causes.en: Sensor plug loose on outdoor inverter PCB
causes.ur: Outdoor inverter PCB par sensor plug loose

causes.en: Thermistor failed
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab

causes.en: Connector heat damage
causes.ur: Garmi se connector kharab

solutions.en: Reseat; measure resistance vs ambient curve; replace sensor
solutions.ur: Dobara lagayein; ambient curve ke mqable resistance napein; zaroorat ho to sensor replace karein

solutions.en: Check PCB socket and harness
solutions.ur: PCB socket aur harness check karein

solutions.en: Clean heat sink while servicing
solutions.ur: sros ke sath hyt snk saf kary

title.ur: Bahar ka BLDC fan motor lock

meaning.en: Outdoor fan rotation not detected — fan motor or drive circuit problem.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan ki rotation detect nahi ho rahi — fan motor ya drive circuit masla

causes.en: Fan seized by debris or bearing failure
causes.ur: Gadda se fan jam ya bearing kharab

causes.en: Hall sensor / feedback fault (fast spin then stop)
causes.ur: Hall sensor / feedback kharab (tez ghoomne ke baad ruk jata hai)

causes.en: Motor winding open/short or PCB drive failure
causes.ur: Motor winding open/short ya PCB drive kharab

solutions.en: Power off; free outdoor fan; check windings and PCB output
solutions.ur: Bijli band karein, bahar ka fan azad karein, phir windings aur PCB output check karein

solutions.en: Check 5-wire DC fan harness and hall feedback (~12V feed)
solutions.ur: 5-tear wala DC fan harness aur hall feedback (~12V feed) check karein

solutions.en: Replace outdoor fan motor (driver integrated) or PCB
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor (driver integrated) ya PCB replace karein

codes.blinkPattern: ODU red 6x / green 7x

notes.en: Official alias EF; CH67/EF grouped as outdoor fan in official Guide.
notes.ur: Official alias EF hai; official Guide mein CH67/EF ko bahar ke fan ke tor par group kiya gaya hai.

title.ur: PFC ka fault (software) mein overcurrent peak

meaning.en: Inverter PCB input current over 48 A peak for 2 ms (PFC software protection).
meaning.ur: Inverter PCB ka input current 2 millisecond ke liye 48 A peak se upar gaya (PFC software protection)

causes.en: Overload operation: pipe restriction, restricted airflow, EEV defect, overcharge
causes.ur: Overload chalna: pipe mein rukawat, airflow kam, EEV kharab, zyada charge

causes.en: Compressor insulation or motor damage
causes.ur: Compressor insulation ya motor kharab

causes.en: Input voltage abnormal or power wiring abnormal
causes.ur: Input voltage ya power wiring galat

causes.en: Inverter PCB assembly damage
causes.ur: Inverter PCB assembly kharab ho gayi

solutions.en: Clear overload causes; verify mains and wiring
solutions.ur: Overload ki wajuhat theek karein; mains aur wiring check karein

solutions.en: Compressor insulation and inverter tests
solutions.ur: Compressor ki insulation aur inverter ke tests karein

solutions.en: Replace inverter PCB if fault remains
solutions.ur: Fault baqi rahe to inverter PCB replace karein

codes.blinkPattern: ODU red 7x / green 3x

title.en: Main outdoor PCB to fan PCB communication error
title.ur: Main outdoor PCB aur fan PCB ka communication error

meaning.en: Communication lost between outdoor main PCB and outdoor fan PCB.
meaning.ur: Outdoor main PCB aur outdoor fan PCB ke beech communication toot gaya hai

causes.en: Open/short of communication line between main and fan PCBs
causes.ur: Main aur fan PCBs ke beech communication line khula/short

causes.en: Communication cable plug loose
causes.ur: Communication cable ka plug loose

causes.en: Fan PCB not powered / communication LED off
causes.ur: Fan PCB bijli par nahi / communication LED band

solutions.en: Check open/short on comm line between boards
solutions.ur: Boards ke beech communication line par open/short check karein

solutions.en: Reseat communication cable plugs; confirm comm LED
solutions.ur: Communication cable ke plugs dobara lagayein, comm LED confirm karein

solutions.en: Replace fan PCB or main PCB after isolation
solutions.ur: Alag karke fan PCB ya main PCB replace karein

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.ur: External protection device activate ho gaya

meaning.en: A protection device wired to the terminal strip (or the indoor T1-T2 circuit) has operated and stopped the unit.
meaning.ur: Terminal strip par jude ya indoor T1-T2 circuit ke protection device ne chala kar unit rok diya hai.

causes.en: External protection device connected to the terminal strip is doing its job (its circuit is open).
causes.ur: Terminal strip par laga external protection device apna kaam kar raha hai (uski circuit khuli hai)

causes.en: T1-T2 of the indoor unit is activated (external thermostat/float circuit closed).
causes.ur: Indoor unit ka T1-T2 activate ho gaya hai (external thermostat/float circuit band hai).

solutions.en: Identify which external device is wired in and check why it tripped (float switch, external thermostat, safety stat).
solutions.ur: Dekhein kaun sa external device juda hai aur woh trip kyun hua (float switch, external thermostat, safety stat).

solutions.en: Reset the external device; if its circuit stays open, fix that device before restarting the AC.
solutions.ur: External device reset karein; agar uski circuit khuli rahe to AC dobara chalane se pehle us device ki kharabi theek karein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased from those causes. A0/E0 are the unified external/outdoor protection-device pair.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions unhi causes se parafrase kiye gaye hain. A0/E0 bahar aur outdoor protection device ka jora hai.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: The airflow swing flap (louver) motor did not operate correctly.
meaning.ur: Hawa ke swing flap (louver) motor ne sahi tarah kaam nahi kiya.

causes.en: Defective swing flap motor.
causes.ur: Swing flap motor kharab

causes.en: Defective connection cable, or the airflow-direction flap-cam is deformed/not engaging.
causes.ur: Connection cable kharab, ya airflow-direction flap-cam ki shape kharab hai ya sahi tarah fit nahi ho raha

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check the flap mechanism for jamming and free it; inspect the motor cable connection.
solutions.ur: Flap mechanism jam to nahi, check karein aur azad karein; motor cable ki connection bhi dekh lein.

solutions.en: Replace the swing flap motor, or the indoor PCB if the motor tests good.
solutions.ur: Swing flap motor badlein, ya motor theek nikle to indoor PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Applies to units with motorised swing flap (cassette/some splits).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh un units par lagta hai jin mein motorised swing flap ho (cassette aur kuch splits).

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.en: Power supply or AC input overcurrent malfunction
title.ur: Power supply ya AC input overcurrent kharabi

meaning.en: The supply voltage is wrong or an AC input overcurrent was detected.
meaning.ur: Supply voltage ghalat hai ya AC input mein zyada current detect kiya gaya

causes.en: Defective power supply voltage (too low/high, unstable).
causes.ur: Power supply voltage kharab hai (bahut kam ya zyada, be-kaar-sa).

causes.en: Defective connection on the signal line, or defective wiring.
causes.ur: Signal line par connection kharab ya wiring kharab

solutions.en: Measure the mains at the terminal board against the rated voltage; fix supply/stabiliser problems.
solutions.ur: Terminal board par mains voltage ko rated value se naaphein; supply/stabiliser ki masla hal karein.

solutions.en: Inspect and re-terminate the signal line and internal wiring.
solutions.ur: Signal line aur internal wiring check karke dobara terminate karein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. PK supply-voltage swings make this a plausible field code.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. PK mein supply voltage ke utaar-chadhaav ki wajah se yeh field code aam milta hai.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: The indoor electronic expansion valve (EXV) or its drive circuit is not working.
meaning.ur: Indoor electronic expansion valve (EXV) ya uska drive circuit kaam nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Defective wiring or relay cables to the EXV.
causes.ur: EXV tak ki wiring ya relay cables kharab

causes.en: Defective electronic expansion valve coil.
causes.ur: Electronic expansion valve ki coil kharab

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check and repair the EXV wiring/relay cables; verify coil resistance.
solutions.ur: EXV wiring/relay cables check karke theek karein; coil ka resistance bhi verify karein.

solutions.en: Replace the EXV coil/valve; replace the indoor PCB if the drive output is missing.
solutions.ur: EXV coil/valve badlein; drive output na ho to indoor PCB bhi badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Indoor-side counterpart of E9 (outdoor-side EXV coil).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions paraphrased likhi gayi hain. Yeh code E9 ka counterpart hai - E9 condenser unit ka EXV coil, aur yeh wall unit ka EXV.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: The electric heater (26WH thermostat) tripped because the heater overheated.
meaning.ur: Electric heater (26WH thermostat) trip ho gaya kyunke heater zyada garam ho gaya

causes.en: 26WH heater overheat thermostat is activated.
causes.ur: 26WH heater overheat thermostat faal hai

causes.en: Defective relay cables feeding the heater.
causes.ur: Heater ko chalane wale relay cables kharab

solutions.en: Check heater airflow and the 26WH thermostat; do not bypass it.
solutions.ur: Heater ka airflow aur 26WH thermostat check karein; use bypass na karein.

solutions.en: Replace defective heater relay cables and the heater element if it overheats repeatedly.
solutions.ur: Heater relay cables kharab hon to badlein, aur baar baar zyada garmi ho to heater element bhi badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Heat-pump units with electric heater option; PK heat-cool splits have no heater, so rarely seen in PK.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh heat-pump units ke liye hai jin mein electric heater option hota hai; PK ki heat-cool splits mein heater nahi hota, is liye PK mein kam milta hai.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: The humidifier system (optional accessory) reported a leak or control fault.
meaning.ur: Humidifier system (optional accessory) ne leak ya control fault kiya

causes.en: Humidifier unit (optional accessory) is leaking.
causes.ur: Humidifier unit (optional accessory) leak kar raha hai

causes.en: Defective drain piping (installed with upward slope, etc.).
causes.ur: Drain piping kharab (ooper ki taraf jhuki hui lagi ho, wagaira).

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Fix the drain piping slope and clear any blockage.
solutions.ur: Drain piping ka rukh (slope) theek kar lein aur blockage saaf kar lein.

solutions.en: Stop the leak in the humidifier unit; replace the indoor PCB only if the fault persists.
solutions.ur: Humidifier unit ki leak band karein; fault phir bhi rahe to hi indoor PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Humidifier is an optional accessory - not applicable to standard PK splits.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Humidifier optional accessory hai - aam PK splits par lagu nahi hota.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.ur: Capacity setting kharab hona (indoor unit PCB)

meaning.en: The indoor unit PCB does not know the configured capacity (capacity setting adaptor issue).
meaning.ur: Indoor unit PCB ko jo capacity set ki gayi hai uska pata nahi chalta (capacity setting adaptor ki masla).

causes.en: The capacity setting adaptor was not installed when the PCB was replaced.
causes.ur: PCB badalne waqt capacity setting adaptor nahi lagaya gaya

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Fit/correct the capacity setting adaptor for the model's capacity.
solutions.ur: Model ki capacity ke mutabiq capacity setting adaptor lagayein/theek karein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor unit PCB if the adaptor is correct and the error remains.
solutions.ur: Adaptor theek hai aur error phir bhi aata hai to indoor unit PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Typically appears right after a PCB swap during service.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh aksar service ke dauran PCB badalne ke foran baad aata hai.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.en: Transmission failure between indoor unit PCB and sub PCB
title.ur: Indoor unit PCB aur sub PCB ke darmiyan transmission nakami

meaning.en: The link between the indoor unit main PCB and its sub PCB is broken.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit main PCB aur uske sub PCB ka link toot gaya hai.

causes.en: Defective connector between the indoor unit PCB and sub PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB aur sub PCB ke darmiyan connector kharab

causes.en: Connector or harness between the two boards is loose, corroded or a bent pin breaks the link.
causes.ur: Dono boards ke darmiyan ka connector ya harness dhila hai, zang lage ya pin tedhi hone se rabta toot gayi

causes.en: The sub PCB has failed, so the main indoor board gets no reply from it.
causes.ur: Sub PCB hi kharab ho to main indoor board ko uska jawab nahi milta.

solutions.en: Reconnect and inspect the connector between the two boards.
solutions.ur: Dono boards ke darmiyan connector dobara lagayein aur check karein

solutions.en: Replace the sub PCB or main indoor PCB if the connection tests good.
solutions.ur: Connection theek nikle to sub PCB ya main indoor PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. The chart gives a single supposed cause for C1 (connector between the boards) - kept as-is. Seen on indoor units with a separate sub board.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions paraphrased likhi gayi hain. Chart mein C1 ke liye sirf ek hi wajah batayi gayi hai (dono board ke darmiyan ka connector) - waisa hi rakha gaya hai. Yeh alag sub board wali indoor units mein dekha gaya hai.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.en: Fan motor sensor or fan control driver malfunction
title.ur: Fan motor sensor ya fan control driver kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor fan motor sensor signal or the fan control driver is faulty.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor ka sensor signal ya fan control driver kharab hai.

causes.en: Defective fan PCB.
causes.ur: Fan PCB kharab

causes.en: Defective connection of the capacity setting adaptor.
causes.ur: Capacity setting adaptor ka connection kharab

causes.en: Field setting error.
causes.ur: Field setting ghalat

solutions.en: Reconnect the capacity setting adaptor and verify the field settings.
solutions.ur: Capacity setting adaptor dobara lagayein aur field setting verify kar lein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan PCB / fan control driver.
solutions.ur: Fan PCB ya fan control driver badal dein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased.

title.ur: Outdoor unit ka protection device activate ho gaya

meaning.ur: Outdoor unit PCB par jude protection device chal para

causes.ur: Protection device ke connector ka contact kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.

solutions.ur: Outdoor PCB par protection device ka connector check karke dobara laga dein.

notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions paraphrased likhi gayi hain. E0 protection device ka unified code hai jo condenser unit par lagta hai (A0 wall unit/terminal-strip side wala hai).

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: The low-pressure switch opened during operation.
meaning.ur: Low pressure switch chalanay ke doran khul gaya.

causes.en: Abnormal drop in low pressure (refrigerant shortage, blocked filter/drier, TXV issue).
causes.ur: Low pressure mein ghalti se kami (refrigerant ki kami, band filter/drier, TXV ki masla).

causes.en: Defective low pressure sensor, or its connector contact.
causes.ur: Low pressure sensor kharab ya uska connector contact kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check suction pressure and look for refrigerant shortage or line restrictions; repair leaks and recharge.
solutions.ur: Suction pressure check karein, refrigerant ki kami ya line mein restriction dhoondhein; leak theek karke dobara gas bharrein.

solutions.en: Verify the low pressure sensor signal and connector; replace sensor or outdoor PCB as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Low pressure sensor ka signal aur connector check karein; diagnosis ke mutabiq sensor ya outdoor PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. E4 = low pressure switch on Daikin (NOT indoor fan as some generic tables claim).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Daikin par E4 = low pressure switch hai (kuch generic tables isay indoor fan kehte hain, woh ghalat hai).

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: The electronic expansion valve (EXV) coil circuit is open or the coil is defective.
meaning.ur: Electronic expansion valve (EXV) ki coil ka circuit khuli hai ya coil kharab hai

causes.en: Disconnected connector on the electronic expansion valve.
causes.ur: Electronic expansion valve ka connector khula (disconnect) ho gaya

causes.en: Defective electronic expansion valve coil.
causes.ur: Electronic expansion valve ki coil kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit control PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ka control PCB kharab hai.

solutions.en: Reconnect the EXV connector and check coil continuity/resistance.
solutions.ur: EXV connector dobara lagayein aur coil ki continuity/resistance check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the EXV coil; replace the outdoor control PCB if the drive output is missing.
solutions.ur: EXV coil badlein; drive output na ho to outdoor control PCB bhi badlein

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Outdoor-side counterpart of A9.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh A9 ka outdoor-side wala version hai.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: The low-pressure switch itself is defective or its circuit is broken.
meaning.ur: Low pressure switch khud kharab hai ya uski circuit toot gayi hai.

causes.en: Defective low pressure switch.
causes.ur: Low pressure switch kharab

causes.en: Broken wire in the switch circuit.
causes.ur: Switch ki circuit mein wire tooti hai

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB, or bad connector contact.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab ya connector ka contact kharab

solutions.en: Test the low pressure switch and its wiring for continuity.
solutions.ur: Low pressure switch aur uski wiring ki continuity test karein.

solutions.en: Repair broken wires/reseat connectors; replace the switch, or outdoor PCB if the circuit is at fault.
solutions.ur: Tooti wire theek karein/connector dobara lagayein; switch badlein, ya circuit kharab ho to outdoor PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. H4 = switch/circuit fault; E4 = the switch actuated on pressure.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. H4 = switch ya circuit ki kharabi; E4 = pressure par khulne wala switch.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.ur: Compressor motor overload thermistor kharab hai

meaning.en: The compressor motor overload (OL) thermistor circuit is faulty.
meaning.ur: Compressor motor ke overload (OL) thermistor ka circuit kharab hai.

causes.en: Defect of the compressor motor overload thermistor.
causes.ur: Compressor motor overload thermistor mein kharabi hai.

causes.en: Defective connector contact.
causes.ur: Connector ka contact kharab

solutions.en: Check OL thermistor resistance and the connector seating.
solutions.ur: OL thermistor ka resistance aur connector ki fitting check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the OL thermistor/harness if it is off-spec.
solutions.ur: OL thermistor/harness ghalat nikle to badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Sensor-side counterpart of E5 (OL activation).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh E5 ka sensor-side wala version hai (OL activation).

causes.ur: Pressure sensor ka connector contact kharab

causes.en: Defective pressure sensor.
causes.ur: Pressure sensor kharab

solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein; sensor theek nikle to outdoor PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Computed (soft) sensor used on VRV-class controls.

meaning.en: A refrigerant-circuit thermistor (liquid pipe side) read out of range.

causes.en: Defective liquid pipe thermistor.

solutions.en: Check the thermistor connector and measure resistance against the chart.

meaning.en: The high-pressure sensor reported an invalid signal or is mis-wired.
meaning.ur: High pressure sensor ne ghalat signal diya ya uski wiring ghalat hai.

causes.ur: Connector ka contact kharab

causes.en: Low pressure sensor connected by mistake in place of the high pressure sensor.
causes.ur: Ghalti se high pressure sensor ki jagah low pressure sensor laga diya gaya.

solutions.ur: High pressure port par laga sensor hi sahi hai ya nahi, check karein; connector dobara laga dein.

solutions.en: Replace the high pressure sensor; replace the outdoor PCB if the sensor tests good.
solutions.ur: High pressure sensor badlein; sensor theek nikle to outdoor PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Common service trap: sensors swapped during replacement.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Service mein aam ghalti: sensors badalte waqt aapas mein badal diye gaye.

meaning.en: The low-pressure sensor reported an invalid signal or is mis-wired.
meaning.ur: Low pressure sensor ne ghalat signal diya ya uski wiring ghalat hai.

causes.en: Defective connector contact.
causes.ur: Connector ka contact kharab

causes.en: High pressure sensor connected by mistake in place of the low pressure sensor.
causes.ur: Ghalti se low pressure sensor ki jagah high pressure sensor laga diya gaya.

causes.en: Defective low pressure sensor, or defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Low pressure sensor kharab ya outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Verify the correct sensor is fitted on the low-pressure port; reseat the connector.
solutions.ur: Low pressure port par sahi sensor laga hai ya nahi, check karein; connector dobara laga dein.

solutions.en: Replace the low pressure sensor; replace the outdoor PCB if the sensor tests good.
solutions.ur: Low pressure sensor badlein; sensor theek nikle to outdoor PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions unhi se parafrase kiye gaye hain.

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: The inverter system (power transistor stage) reported a fault.
meaning.ur: Inverter system (power transistor stage) ne fault dikhaya hai.

causes.en: Shortage of power supply capacity.
causes.ur: Power supply ki capacity kam

causes.en: Defective power transistor.
causes.ur: Power transistor kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Confirm the mains supply can carry the unit's starting current (check voltage dip under load).
solutions.ur: Mains supply unit ka starting current utha sakti hai ya nahi, check karein (load ke dauran voltage dip bhi dekh lein).

solutions.en: Inspect the power transistor stage; replace the outdoor PCB/power module as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Power transistor stage check karein; diagnosis ke mutabiq outdoor PCB/power module badal dein

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Repairable at board level by HVAC electronics specialists (IPM/transistor swap).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh board level par HVAC electronics specialist theek kar sakte hain (IPM/transistor badal kar).

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: The inverter PCB self-check failed (blown fuse or board fault).
meaning.ur: Inverter PCB ka self-check nakam hua (fuse uth gaya ya board kharab).

causes.en: Defective compressor wiring, or defective outdoor unit fan motor loading the board.
causes.ur: Compressor wiring kharab, ya outdoor unit ka fan motor kharab aur board par load daal raha hai.

causes.en: Blown fuse on the inverter PCB.
causes.ur: Inverter PCB par fuse ura hua hai

causes.en: Defective inverter PCB or outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Inverter PCB ya outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Find why the fuse blew: megger the compressor windings and check the outdoor fan motor first.
solutions.ur: Dekhein fuse kyun utha: pehle compressor windings ka megger test karein aur outdoor fan motor check karein.

solutions.en: Repair the shorted component, then replace the blown fuse/inverter PCB.
solutions.ur: Short wala component theek karein, phir phata hua fuse/inverter PCB badal dein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Do not just replace the fuse - find the short first.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Sirf fuse mat badlein - pehle short ki wajah dhoondein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: An instantaneous overcurrent was detected on the inverter AC output.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke AC output par foran zyada current detect kiya gaya

causes.en: Compressor start-up failure (mechanical lock).
causes.ur: Compressor start-up nahi hua (mechanical lock).

causes.en: Refrigerant overcharge, or shortage of power supply capacity.
causes.ur: Refrigerant zyada bhara hua, ya power supply ki capacity kam

causes.en: Defective compressor, defective inverter PCB, or defective inverter unit.
causes.ur: Compressor kharab, inverter PCB kharab ya inverter unit kharab

solutions.en: Verify charge level and supply capacity; try a controlled restart only after checking the compressor is not locked.
solutions.ur: Gas ki qadar aur supply capacity check karein; compressor jam to nahi hai, yeh dekh kar hi controlled restart karein.

solutions.en: If the compressor is mechanically seized, replace it; otherwise replace the inverter PCB.
solutions.ur: Agar compressor mechanically jam ho gaya hai to use badlein; warna inverter PCB badlein

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Distinct from L5 (DC output overcurrent) and L8 (sustained overcurrent).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh L5 (DC output overcurrent) aur L8 (lagataar overcurrent) se alag hai.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: Sustained overcurrent flowing to the inverter compressor was detected.
meaning.ur: Inverter compressor ki taraf lagatar zyada current behne ka pata chala

causes.en: Compressor overloaded, or wiring disconnection inside the compressor coil.
causes.ur: Compressor par zyada load, ya compressor coil ke andar wiring toot gayi

causes.en: Disconnected compressor wiring (terminal).
causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring (terminal) khuli ho gayi

causes.en: Defective inverter PCB.
causes.ur: Inverter PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check compressor terminal connections and winding resistance (also megger to earth).
solutions.ur: Compressor ke terminal connections aur winding resistance check karein (earth par megger bhi karein).

solutions.en: Repair wiring; replace the compressor if windings are shorted to earth, or the inverter PCB if the compressor tests good.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek karein; windings earth se short hon to compressor badlein, ya compressor theek nikle to inverter PCB badlein

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions unhi se parafrase kiye gaye hain.

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.ur: Inverter compressor start nahi hota (stall prevention)

meaning.en: The compressor failed to start; stall prevention stopped the attempt.
meaning.ur: Compressor start nahi hua; stall prevention ne yeh koshish rok di.

causes.en: Stop valve not opened.
causes.ur: Stop valve khuli nahi

causes.en: Defective compressor, or error in the wire connections to the compressor.
causes.ur: Compressor kharab, ya compressor ke wire connections mein ghalti

causes.en: Large differential pressure before compressor start; defective inverter PCB.
causes.ur: Compressor start se pehle bohat zyada pressure ka farq, ya inverter PCB kharab

solutions.en: Open the stop valves fully and equalise pressure before retrying.
solutions.ur: Dobara koshish se pehle stop valves poori tarah kholein aur pressure barabar karein.

solutions.en: Check compressor wiring; replace the compressor or inverter PCB as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Compressor wiring check karein; diagnosis ke mutabiq compressor ya inverter PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. A classic after-installation code when valves were left closed.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Installation ke baad aam code, jab valves band rehne diye gaye hon.

meaning.ur: Inverter power transistor ka check nakam raha.

causes.en: Defective power transistor.
causes.ur: Power transistor kharab

causes.en: Defective compressor.
causes.ur: Compressor kharab

causes.en: Defective inverter PCB.
causes.ur: Inverter PCB kharab

solutions.en: Test the power transistor module and the compressor windings before replacing parts.
solutions.ur: Parts badalne se pehle power transistor module aur compressor windings test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the defective power transistor/board; replace the compressor if it shorted the stage.
solutions.ur: Kharab power transistor/board badlein; compressor ne stage ko short kar diya ho to compressor bhi badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Board-level repair territory (IPM/power module).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh board level ki repair hai (IPM/power module).

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.en: Transmission malfunction between control and inverter PCB
title.ur: Control PCB aur inverter PCB ke darmiyan transmission kharabi

meaning.en: Communication between the control PCB and the inverter PCB was lost or corrupted.
meaning.ur: Control PCB aur inverter PCB ke darmiyan rabta khatam ya kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Defective connection between the inverter PCB and the control PCB.
causes.ur: Inverter PCB aur control PCB ke darmiyan connection kharab

causes.en: External factors such as electrical noise.

causes.ur: Inverter compressor kharab ya control PCB (transmission block) kharab

solutions.en: Re-terminate and inspect the harness between the two boards; keep signal wires away from noisy power wiring.
solutions.ur: Dono board ke darmiyan harness dobara terminate karke check karein; signal wires ko shor dene wali power wiring se door rakhein.

solutions.en: Replace the faulty board (control or inverter) as the diagnosis indicates.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabiq kharab board (control ya inverter) badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Often clears after harness reseating (noise event).
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Aksar harness dobara theek se lagane se theek ho jata hai (noise ki wajah se aaya tha).
