title.en: Power voltage imbalance / open phase (inverter PCB)
title.ur: Voltage imbalance ya open phase (inverter PCB)

meaning.en: The supply has an open phase or unbalanced phases, or the main-circuit capacitor is faulty.
meaning.ur: Supply mein koi phase khuli hai ya phases unbalanced hain, ya main circuit ka capacitor kharab hai

causes.en: Open phase or interphase voltage imbalance in the power supply.
causes.ur: Power supply mein phase khuli ya phases ke darmiyan voltage ka imbalance

causes.en: Defective capacitor in the main circuit.
causes.ur: Main circuit ka capacitor kharab

causes.en: Defective wiring in the main circuit, or defective inverter PCB.
causes.ur: Main circuit ki wiring kharab ya inverter PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check all three phases at the supply and repair the utility/wiring fault (open phase).
solutions.ur: Supply par teenon phases check karein aur utility/wiring ki kharabi (khuli phase) theek karein.

solutions.en: Replace the main-circuit capacitor; inspect main circuit wiring.
solutions.ur: Main circuit ka capacitor badal dein; main circuit ki wiring check karein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. In PK 3-phase supplies this is a real field risk - check supply before the unit.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. PK mein 3-phase supply par yeh asal field khatra hai - unit se pehle supply check karein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.ur: Switch box ke andar thermistor kharabi

meaning.en: A thermistor inside the outdoor switch (electrical) box read out of range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor switch (electrical) box ke andar lage thermistor ki reading had se bahar hai.

causes.en: Defective connection of the thermistor.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connection kharab

causes.en: Defective reactor thermistor.
causes.ur: Reactor thermistor kharab

solutions.en: Check the thermistor plug and lead routing inside the switch box.
solutions.ur: Switch box ke andar thermistor ka plug aur lead ka rasta check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the reactor thermistor if its resistance is off-spec.
solutions.ur: Reactor thermistor ki resistance ghalat nikle to use badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions unhi se parafrase kiye gaye hain.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: The outdoor supply has a reverse phase or an open (missing) phase.
meaning.ur: Outdoor supply mein phase ulti hai ya koi phase khuli (ghayab) hai

causes.en: Power supply reverse phase.
causes.ur: Power supply ki phase ulti

causes.en: Open T phase.
causes.ur: T phase khuli

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB (A1P).
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB (A1P) kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check phase sequence and fuses at the outdoor disconnect; correct the supply rotation.
solutions.ur: Outdoor disconnect par phase ki tarteeb aur fuses check karein; supply ki phase sequence theek karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor PCB (A1P) only if the supply is confirmed correct.
solutions.ur: Sirf tab outdoor PCB (A1P) badlein jab supply theek hone ki tasdeeq ho jaye

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Reverse phase can damage the compressor - stop the unit until corrected.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Reverse phase compressor ko nuqsan de sakta hai - theek hone tak unit band rakhein.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.en: Transmission fault: indoor unit to remote controller
title.ur: Indoor unit aur remote controller ke darmiyan transmission fault

meaning.en: The indoor unit and its remote controller cannot exchange signals correctly.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit aur uska remote controller aapas mein signal theek se nahi bacha sakte.

causes.en: Transmission error between the indoor unit and the remote controller.
causes.ur: Indoor unit aur remote controller ke darmiyan transmission error

causes.en: Two main remote controllers connected (only one main remote allowed).
causes.ur: Do main remote controllers jude hain (sirf ek main remote ki ijazat hai).

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB, defective remote controller PCB, or noise.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab, remote controller PCB kharab, ya shor

solutions.en: Check the remote wiring polarity/terminals; remove the duplicate main remote if fitted.
solutions.ur: Remote ki wiring polarity/terminals check karein; doosra main remote laga ho to use hata dein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle both units; replace the remote or indoor PCB if the error persists.
solutions.ur: Dono units ka power cycle karein; error uske baad bhi rahe to remote ya indoor PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. The 'two main remotes' cause is a classic wiring mistake.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. 'Do main remotes' wali wajah wiring ki classic ghalti hai.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.ur: Indoor units ke darmiyan transmission kharabi

meaning.en: Communication between indoor units (multi-split/centralised setups) failed.
meaning.ur: Indoor units (multi-split/centralised setup) ke darmiyan communication nakam hua.

causes.en: Faulty wiring between the indoor units.
causes.ur: Indoor units ke darmiyan wiring kharab

causes.en: External factor such as electrical noise.
causes.ur: Electrical noise jaisa external factor

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check inter-indoor transmission wiring for breaks/shorts and separate it from power wiring.
solutions.ur: Indoor units ke aapas transmission wiring mein kata ya short check karein aur use power wiring se alag rakhein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor unit PCB if the wiring tests good.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek nikle to indoor unit PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Multi-split / VRV indoor-branch systems only.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Sirf multi-split / VRV indoor-branch systems par.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.en: Transmission fault: outdoor units or control adaptor
title.ur: Outdoor units ya control adaptor ke darmiyan transmission fault

meaning.en: Communication between outdoor units, or between the outdoor unit and its external control adaptor, failed.
meaning.ur: Outdoor units ke aapas, ya outdoor unit aur uske external control adaptor ke darmiyan rabta khatam ya kharab ho gayi

causes.en: Connection error in transmission wiring between outdoor units.
causes.ur: Outdoor units ke darmiyan transmission wiring mein connection ki ghalti

causes.en: Connection error between the outdoor unit and the external control adaptor/storage unit.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit aur external control adaptor/storage unit ke darmiyan connection ki ghalti

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check and re-terminate the outdoor-to-outdoor / adaptor transmission wiring.
solutions.ur: Outdoor se outdoor / adaptor ki transmission wiring check karke dobara terminate karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor unit PCB if the wiring is sound.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek ho to outdoor unit PCB badlein

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Multi-outdoor (VRV/branch) installations.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Multi-outdoor (VRV/branch) installations ke liye.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.ur: Remote controllers ke darmiyan transmission kharabi

meaning.en: Communication between main and sub remote controllers failed.
meaning.ur: Main aur sub remote controllers ke darmiyan communication nakam hua.

causes.en: Transmission error between the main and sub remote controller.
causes.ur: Main aur sub remote controller ke darmiyan transmission error

causes.en: Faulty connection between sub remote controllers.
causes.ur: Sub remote controllers ke darmiyan connection kharab

causes.en: Defective remote controller PCB.
causes.ur: Remote controller PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check the remote-to-remote wiring and terminations.
solutions.ur: Remote se remote wali wiring aur terminations check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the faulty remote controller if the wiring is good.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek ho to kharab remote controller badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Only on systems with sub remotes.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Sirf un systems par jin mein sub remotes hon.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: Communication with another indoor/outdoor system (branch/refrigerant system No.2 side) failed.
meaning.ur: Kisi doosre system ke units se (branch/refrigerant system No.2 side) communication nakam hua.

causes.en: Transmission error between other indoor and outdoor units.
causes.ur: Doosre system ke units ke darmiyan transmission error

causes.en: Defective electronic expansion valve of the other indoor unit.
causes.ur: Doosre indoor unit ka electronic expansion valve kharab

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB of the other indoor unit, or improper transmission wiring.
causes.ur: Doosre indoor unit ka PCB kharab ya transmission wiring ghalat

solutions.en: Check transmission wiring between indoor and outdoor units for correct connections.
solutions.ur: Wall aur condenser units ke darmiyan transmission wiring ke connections check karein.

solutions.en: Service the other system's indoor unit (EXV/PCB) as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabiq doosre system ke wall unit (EXV/PCB) ki servicing karein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Multi-system (System No.2) codes.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Multi-system (System No.2) ke codes hain.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.en: Centralised control equipment address setting malfunction
title.ur: Centralised control equipment address setting kharab

meaning.en: The centralised control equipment address is duplicated or wrongly set.
meaning.ur: Centralised control equipment ka address dobara aa gaya ya ghalat set kiya gaya hai

causes.en: Address duplication of centralised control equipment.
causes.ur: Centralised control equipment ka address dobara ho gaya

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Re-assign unique addresses to every controller on the bus.
solutions.ur: Bus par har controller ko alag address dobara dein

solutions.en: Replace the indoor unit PCB if addressing is confirmed correct.
solutions.ur: Addressing theek hai yeh verify kar lein, phir indoor unit PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Centralised/VRV control layer - shown on the central controller.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Yeh Centralised/VRV control layer ka code hai - central controller par nazar aata hai.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

title.en: Indoor unit to centralised control transmission fault
title.ur: Indoor unit aur centralised control ke darmiyan transmission fault

meaning.en: The link to optional centralised-control equipment is broken (or the main-controller setting connector is disconnected).
meaning.ur: Optional centralised control equipment ka link toot gaya hai (ya main controller ki setting ka connector khula hai).

causes.en: Transmission error between optional controllers for centralised control and the indoor unit.
causes.ur: Centralised control ke optional controllers aur indoor unit ke darmiyan transmission error

causes.en: Connector for setting the main controller disconnected (or independent/combined changeover switch).
causes.ur: Main controller ki setting ka connector khul gaya hua hai (ya independent/combined changeover switch).

causes.en: Defective PCB for the central remote controller, or defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Central remote controller ka PCB kharab ya indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reconnect the main-controller setting connector and check the changeover switch position.
solutions.ur: Main controller ki setting ka connector dobara lagayein aur changeover switch ki position check karein.

solutions.en: Check bus wiring to the central controller; replace the central remote or indoor PCB as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Central controller tak bus wiring check karein; diagnosis ke mutabiq central remote ya indoor PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Centralised/VRV control layer.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. Centralised/VRV control layer ka code hai.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: SM-TS3 Simple Self-Diagnosis malfunction codes (Sky Air / RA, global)

meaning.en: Communication with an accessory device failed.
meaning.ur: Kisi accessory device se rabta nakaam ho gaya

causes.en: Defect in the accessory device itself.
causes.ur: Accessory device khud kharab hai

causes.en: Faulty wiring to the accessory device.
causes.ur: Accessory device tak ki wiring kharab

solutions.en: Check power and signal wiring to the accessory device; test the device independently.
solutions.ur: Accessory device ki power aur signal wiring check karein; device ko alag se test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the defective accessory device or repair its wiring.
solutions.ur: Kharab accessory device badlein ya uski wiring theek karein

notes.en: SM-TS3 lists causes only; solutions paraphrased. Accessory/option devices on VRV/Sky Air systems.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein sirf causes diye gaye hain, solutions parafrase hain. VRV/Sky Air systems ke accessory/option devices ke liye.

source.title: Daikin SM-TS3 List of Error Codes

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: No malfunction is stored; the unit is operating normally.
meaning.ur: Koi kharabi store nahi hai; unit aam tor par chal raha hai

causes.en: Self-diagnosis mode entered with no fault latched.
causes.ur: Khud ki diagnosis mode mein daakhil hue, magar koi fault latch nahi hua

causes.en: Previously active fault has cleared after reset.
causes.ur: Pehle se chal raha fault reset ke baad khatam ho gaya

solutions.en: No action required; exit the code-display mode.
solutions.ur: Koi karrey ki zaroorat nahi; code display mode se bahar nikal jayein.

solutions.en: If the unit still misbehaves, run normal troubleshooting.
solutions.ur: Agar unit ab bhi ghalat behaviour dikhaye to aam troubleshooting karein

notes.en: 00 = normal in every official RAC list (SM-TS3, FTXC-C OM, India/regional pages).
notes.ur: Har official RAC list mein 00 = normal hi hai (SM-TS3, FTXC-C OM, India/regional pages).

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: The system detected insufficient refrigerant charge (low gas / leak condition).
meaning.ur: System ne refrigerant ki miqdar kam payi (gas kam ya leak ki surat-e-haal)

causes.en: Refrigerant leak or undercharge after installation/service.
causes.ur: Installation ya service ke baad refrigerant leak ya kam charge

causes.en: Stop valves left closed, or relevant thermistors disconnected.
causes.ur: Stop valves band chhor diye gaye, ya zaruri thermistors disconnect kar diye gaye.

causes.en: Defective electronic expansion valve or weak compressor performance.
causes.ur: Electronic expansion valve kharab ya compressor ka performance kamzor

solutions.en: Open all stop valves; refit any disconnected thermistors.
solutions.ur: Pehle tamam stop valves kholein; khule hue thermistors dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Leak-test the circuit, repair leaks, evacuate and charge the specified amount.
solutions.ur: Circuit ka leak test karein, leak theek karein, hawa nikaal kar mujarraba miqdar refrigerant bharrein

solutions.en: If error repeats: check expansion valve, thermistors, then outdoor PCB / compressor.
solutions.ur: Agar error dobara aaye: pehle expansion valve aur thermistors check karein, phir outdoor PCB / compressor.

notes.en: Also listed on all official RAC remote tables (India, FTXC-C, web-manual).
notes.ur: Yeh sab official RAC remote tables par bhi listed hai (India, FTXC-C, web-manual).

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

title.ur: Voltage giri ya main circuit mein zyada voltage

meaning.en: Supply voltage dropped below or rose above the allowed window, or the detection circuit flagged it.
meaning.ur: Supply voltage mujarraba se neeche gir gaya ya us se upar chala gaya, ya detection circuit ne ise pakad liya

causes.en: Mains voltage not within specification, momentary dips or power failures.
causes.ur: Mains voltage specification ke andar nahi, lamhi ke liye giray ya bijli gayi

causes.en: Electrical noise, short inside fan-motor winding, or disconnected compressor harness.
causes.ur: Electrical noise, fan motor ki winding ke andar short, ya compressor harness disconnect

causes.en: Faulty DC/over-voltage detection circuit on outdoor or indoor PCB.
causes.ur: Condenser unit ya wall unit ke PCB par DC/over-voltage detection circuit kharab.

solutions.en: Verify mains is within rated range; fix supply/stabiliser issues.
solutions.ur: Mains rated range ke andar hai ya nahi check karein; supply/stabiliser ki masla hal karein

solutions.en: Power-cycle once the supply is stable; if it recurs, inspect detection circuitry and replace faulty PCB.
solutions.ur: Supply mustaqil ho jaye to power cycle karein; dobara aaye to detection circuit dekh kar kharab PCB badlein.

notes.en: PK grid voltage swings make this a common first-check code.
notes.ur: PK ki grid voltage ke utaar-chadhaav ki wajah se yeh pehle check karne wala aam code hai.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

title.en: Signal transmission error between indoor and outdoor units
title.ur: Wall unit aur condenser unit ke darmiyan signal transmission error

meaning.en: Communication between indoor and outdoor units was lost or corrupted.
meaning.ur: Wall unit aur condenser unit ke darmiyan communication khatam ya kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Wiring error or break in the interconnect cable (F1/F2, wire No. 3).
causes.ur: Interconnect cable (F1/F2, wire No. 3) mein wiring ki ghalti ya kata hua hissa

causes.en: Outdoor unit power OFF, reduced supply voltage, or disturbed supply waveform.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ki power off, supply voltage kam, ya supply ki waveform bigdi

causes.en: Defective indoor or outdoor PCB; short inside outdoor fan-motor winding.
causes.ur: Wall unit ya condenser unit ka PCB kharab; condenser unit ke fan motor ki winding mein short

solutions.en: Check inter-unit wiring polarity/continuity and repair breaks.
solutions.ur: Units ke darmiyan wiring ki polarity/continuity check karke kata hua hissa theek karein.

solutions.en: Confirm outdoor unit is powered; reset both units after power is stable.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ko power mila hai yeh tasdeeq karein; power mustaqil hone par dono units reset karein

solutions.en: If wiring is good, replace defective indoor/outdoor PCB after checks.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek ho to checks ke baad kharab wall ya condenser unit PCB badlein.

notes.en: Highest-frequency PK service call per general technician chatter; also on every official list.
notes.ur: Technicians ki baat-cheet ke mutabiq PK mein sabse zyada aane wali service call hai; har official list par bhi maujood hai.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

title.ur: Wall aur condenser unit ka combination masla (voltage/mismatch)

meaning.en: The connected indoor and outdoor units are incompatible or wired/powered incorrectly.
meaning.ur: Jo wall aur condenser unit jude hain woh aapas mein match nahi karte ya wiring/power ghalat hai.

causes.en: Wrong models interconnected.
causes.ur: Yeh ghalat models jode gaye hain.

causes.en: Wrong connecting-wire routing or wrong PCB fitted.
causes.ur: Connecting wire ka rasta ghalat ya ghalat PCB lagaya gaya

causes.en: Defective indoor or outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Wall ya condenser unit ka PCB kharab

solutions.en: Verify model compatibility against the installation manual pairing table.
solutions.ur: Installation manual ki pairing table se model ki compatibility check karein

solutions.en: Correct the inter-unit wiring and replace any wrong/defective PCB.
solutions.ur: Inter-unit wiring theek karein aur ghalat/kharab PCB badal dein.

notes.en: Regional official pages word this as 'indoor-outdoor unit combination fault'.
notes.ur: Regional official pages par isay 'unit combination fault' likha gaya hai, yaani wall aur condenser unit ki combination na mile.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: The indoor unit control board failed its internal self-check.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit ka control board apna self-check nahi kar paya.

causes.en: Mismatched indoor/outdoor model combination.
causes.ur: Wall aur condenser unit ke model ka combination match nahi karta

causes.en: Loose/disconnected connectors or reduced supply voltage.
causes.ur: Connector dhile ya khule hue, ya supply voltage kam

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Confirm compatible pairing; reseat terminal-board connectors.
solutions.ur: Pairing ke mutabiq tasdeeq karein; terminal board ke connector phir se lagayein.

solutions.en: Check rated voltage at the board; if error repeats, replace the indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Board par rated voltage check karein; error phir aaye to indoor PCB badlein.

notes.en: SM-TS3 adds 'external factor (noise)' as a trigger.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein 'external factor (noise)' ko bhi trigger ke tor par shamil kiya gaya hai.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

title.ur: Cooling mein jam par protection / heating peak-cut control

meaning.en: The unit halted because the indoor heat exchanger went below 0°C in cooling (or above the heating peak-cut limit).
meaning.ur: Cooling mein indoor heat exchanger 0°C se neeche chala gaya (ya heating peak-cut limit se upar), is liye unit ruk gayi.

causes.en: Short-circuited airflow or clogged indoor air filter.
causes.ur: Airflow band (short) ya indoor ka air filter ghad gaya

causes.en: Dust build-up on the indoor heat exchanger.
causes.ur: Indoor heat exchanger par dhool jama ho gayi

causes.en: Defective indoor heat exchanger thermistor or indoor PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor heat exchanger thermistor ya indoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Clear obstructions, wash the filter, and clean the indoor heat exchanger.
solutions.ur: Rokawat hataein, filter dhoyein aur indoor heat exchanger saaf karein.

solutions.en: Let the coil thaw, then restart; if it repeats, replace the thermistor or indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Coil ka frost (barf) khilne dein, phir restart karein; phir bhi aaye to thermistor ya indoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Regional pages shorten this to 'high pressure control or freeze-up protector'.
notes.ur: Regional pages par isay chhota kar ke 'high pressure control or freeze-up protector' likha gaya hai.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: Indoor fan speed feedback stayed far below the commanded speed.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan ka speed feedback commanded speed se kaafi neeche reh gaya

causes.en: Noticeable drop in supply voltage.
causes.ur: Supply voltage mein nazar aani wala kami

causes.en: Winding short/broken wire inside the fan motor or its lead wires.
causes.ur: Fan motor ya uski lead wires ke andar winding short ya wire tooti hai

causes.en: Defective fan capacitor or indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Fan capacitor ya indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check voltage within ±10% of rated; spin the fan by hand for jamming.
solutions.ur: Voltage rated ke ±10% ke andar hai ya nahi check karein; fan ko haath se ghumayein ke jam to nahi.

solutions.en: Verify motor supplies (310–340 VDC, 15 VDC control); replace motor or indoor PCB as indicated.
solutions.ur: Motor ke supply (310–340 VDC, 15 VDC control) naap lein; masle ke mutabiq motor ya indoor PCB badlein.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: The indoor coil temperature sensor read out of range (open/short).
meaning.ur: Indoor coil ke temperature sensor ki reading had se bahar hai (khuli/short).

causes.en: Thermistor connector not seated.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connector theek se baitha nahi

causes.en: Defective indoor heat exchanger thermistor.
causes.ur: Indoor heat exchanger thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reseat the connector and re-check.
solutions.ur: Connector dobara baitha karein aur dobara check karein

solutions.en: Measure thermistor resistance against the characteristic chart; replace if off.
solutions.ur: Thermistor ka resistance characteristic chart se naaphein; ghalat nikle to badlein

solutions.en: If sensor and wiring are good, replace the indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Sensor aur wiring theek ho to indoor PCB badlein

notes.en: FTXC-C wording: 'Indoor heat exchanger (1) thermistor short / open'.
notes.ur: FTXC-C ki wording yeh hai: 'Indoor heat exchanger (1) thermistor short / open'.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: The indoor room-temperature sensor read out of range.
meaning.ur: Indoor ka room temperature sensor ghalat reading de raha hai

causes.en: Thermistor connector not seated.
causes.ur: Thermistor connector theek se baitha nahi

causes.en: Defective room/suction-air thermistor.
causes.ur: Room/suction air ka thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Indoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reconnect the sensor plug and verify reading.
solutions.ur: Sensor ka plug dobara lagayein aur reading check karein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor if resistance is off-spec; otherwise replace indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Resistance ghalat nikle to thermistor badlein, warna indoor PCB badlein

notes.en: FTXC-C: 'Indoor room thermistor short / open'.
notes.ur: FTXC-C mein yeh likha hai: 'Indoor room thermistor short / open'.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: The outdoor unit control board failed its internal check.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit ka control board apna internal check nahi kar paya.

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

causes.en: Broken harness between PCBs.
causes.ur: Do PCB ke darmiyan harness toota/khula

causes.en: Noise, momentary voltage fall, or momentary power failure.
causes.ur: Noise, lamhi ke liye voltage girna, ya lamhi ke liye bijli chali jana

solutions.en: Inspect and refit inter-board harnesses.
solutions.ur: Board ke darmiyan harness check karke phir se laga dein

solutions.en: Reset after stable power; replace outdoor PCB if the fault persists.
solutions.ur: Power mustaqil hone ke baad reset karein; fault uske baad bhi rahe to outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Third-party pages that call E1 'high pressure' are wrong (quarantined).
notes.ur: Jo third-party pages E1 ko 'high pressure' kehte hain woh ghalat hain (unhe quarantine kiya gaya hai).

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: The compressor overload protector tripped or its circuit was interrupted.
meaning.ur: Compressor ke overload protector ne trip kiya ya uski circuit mein rukaawat aa gayi

causes.en: OL device terminals disconnected, OL defective, or OL harness broken.
causes.ur: OL device ke terminals khule hue, OL kharab, ya OL harness toota

causes.en: Discharge-pipe thermistor disconnected/defective; connector S40 loose.
causes.ur: Discharge-pipe thermistor khula/kharab hai; connector S40 dhila hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant shortage, moisture in circuit, closed stop valve, or defective EXV / four-way valve coil / outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Refrigerant ki kami, circuit mein namak, band stop valve, ya kharab EXV / four-way valve coil / outdoor PCB

solutions.en: Check OL continuity and connectors; repair or replace the OL harness/device.
solutions.ur: OL ki continuity aur connector check karein; OL harness/device theek karein ya badlein

solutions.en: Open stop valves, leak/moisture-test and recharge if gas is low.
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein, leak/namak test karein aur gas kam ho to dobara bharrein

solutions.en: Verify EXV and four-way valve coils; replace outdoor PCB if all else is good.
solutions.ur: EXV aur four-way valve ki coils check karein; baqi sab theek ho to outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: SM-TS3 phrase: 'inverter compressor motor or overheat lock'.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 ka phrase yeh hai: 'inverter compressor motor or overheat lock'.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: The compressor failed to start or is mechanically locked.
meaning.ur: Compressor start nahi hua ya mechanically jam gaya hai

causes.en: Compressor mechanically locked.
causes.ur: Compressor mechanically jam gaya

causes.en: Compressor harness disconnected.
causes.ur: Compressor harness khula/disconnect ho gaya

solutions.en: Inspect and reconnect/replace the compressor harness.
solutions.ur: Compressor harness check karke dobara lagayein ya badlein

solutions.en: Verify power module output; replace the compressor if it will not free.
solutions.ur: Power module ka output check karein; compressor khul na raha ho to badlein

notes.en: SM-TS3 also lists 'stop valve not opened' and defective control PCB for STD-compressor overcurrent/lock variants.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 STD-compressor overcurrent/lock variants ke liye 'stop valve not opened' aur kharab control PCB ko bhi list karta hai.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: The outdoor fan motor is not rotating as commanded.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan motor command ke mutabiq nahi ghoom raha

causes.en: Fan-motor connector disconnected.
causes.ur: Fan motor ka connector disconnect ho gaya

causes.en: Foreign object stuck in the fan.
causes.ur: Fan mein koi ajnabi cheez phansi hui hai.

causes.en: Defective outdoor fan motor or outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor ya outdoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Clear debris and spin the fan freely; reconnect the motor plug.
solutions.ur: Debris hata kar fan ko azaad ghumayein; motor plug dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor fan motor, or the outdoor PCB if drive output is missing.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor badlein, ya drive output na ho to outdoor PCB badlein

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: Input current exceeded the allowed limit at the outdoor unit.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit par input current mujarraba se zyada ho gaya

causes.en: Power-supply voltage out of specification; outdoor temperature out of operating range.
causes.ur: Power supply voltage specification ke bahar; outdoor temperature bhi operating range se bahar

causes.en: Short circuit in the drive/compressor circuit.
causes.ur: Drive/compressor circuit mein short

causes.en: Defective outdoor PCB, compressor, or power module.
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB, compressor ya power module kharab

solutions.en: Verify supply voltage and ambient conditions are within ratings.
solutions.ur: Supply voltage aur mahol ki conditions ratings ke andar hain ya nahi check karein

solutions.en: Megger/short-test compressor and inverter wiring; repair shorts.
solutions.ur: Compressor aur inverter wiring ka megger/short test karein; short theek karein

solutions.en: Replace the power module, compressor, or outdoor PCB as diagnosed.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabiq power module, compressor ya outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Regional official pages list E8 as 'OVERCURRENT INPUT'.
notes.ur: Regional official pages E8 ko 'OVERCURRENT INPUT' kehta hain.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: The four-way reversing valve did not operate or its circuit is faulty.
meaning.ur: Four-way reversing valve ne kaam nahi kiya ya uski circuit kharab hai

causes.en: Four-way valve coil disconnected or coil/valve/harness defective.
causes.ur: Four-way valve ki coil khuli ya coil/valve/harness kharab

causes.en: Refrigerant shortage, moisture in circuit, or closed stop valve.
causes.ur: Refrigerant ki kami, circuit mein namak, ya band stop valve

causes.en: Defective outdoor PCB or associated thermistor.
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB ya us se juri hui thermistor kharab

solutions.en: Check coil continuity and reconnect/replace the coil or valve.
solutions.ur: Coil ki continuity check karein aur coil ya valve dobara lagayein/badlein

solutions.en: Open stop valves; leak-test and recharge; replace outdoor PCB if needed.
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein; leak test karke gas bharrein; zarurat ho to outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: FTXC-C calls it '4 way valve error'.
notes.ur: FTXC-C isay '4 way valve error' kehta hai.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: Compressor discharge temperature rose past the safety limit and the unit stopped.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki discharge temperature safety limit se upar chali gayi aur unit ruk gayi

causes.en: Defective discharge-pipe thermistor (or outdoor heat-exchanger / outdoor-air thermistor).
causes.ur: Discharge pipe thermistor kharab (ya outdoor heat exchanger / outdoor air ka thermistor)

causes.en: Refrigerant shortage, closed stop valve, or defective expansion valve/coil.
causes.ur: Refrigerant ki kami, band stop valve, ya kharab expansion valve/coil

causes.en: Defective four-way valve, moisture in refrigerant, or outdoor PCB fault.
causes.ur: Four-way valve kharab, refrigerant mein namak, ya outdoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Check/replace the discharge thermistor; confirm sensors read sanely.
solutions.ur: Discharge thermistor check/badlein; sensors ki readings theek hain ya nahi confirm karein

solutions.en: Open stop valves, clean the circuit, leak-test and recharge to spec.
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein, circuit saaf karein, leak test karke zaruri miqdar ke mutabiq gas bharrein

solutions.en: Verify EXV operation; replace four-way valve or outdoor PCB as required.
solutions.ur: EXV ka kaam check karein; zarurat ke mutabiq four-way valve ya outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: On RAC remotes F3 is one of the first codes in the ARC433B cycle.
notes.ur: RAC remotes par F3 ARC433B cycle ke pehle codes mein se ek hai.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: High-pressure protection activated during cooling operation.
meaning.ur: Cooling ke doran high pressure protection active hua

causes.en: Insufficient clearance around the outdoor unit or dirty outdoor heat exchanger.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ke aas paas jagah kam ya outdoor heat exchanger gandi

causes.en: Defective outdoor fan motor or closed stop valve.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor kharab ya stop valve band

causes.en: Defective EXV/coil, outdoor heat-exchanger thermistor, or outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: EXV/coil, outdoor heat exchanger thermistor ya outdoor PCB kharab

solutions.en: Restore required clearance and wash the outdoor condenser.
solutions.ur: Zaroori khaali jagah bana kar outdoor condenser dhoyein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor fan motor; open stop valves.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor badal dein aur stop valves kholein.

solutions.en: Check EXV and thermistors; replace outdoor PCB if all are healthy.
solutions.ur: EXV aur thermistor check karein; sab theek hon to outdoor PCB badlein

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: A compressor-related sensor signal (position/feedback family) was invalid.
meaning.ur: Compressor se juray sensor ka signal (position/feedback family) ghalat tha

causes.en: Broken or disconnected sensor harness.
causes.ur: Sensor harness tooti ya disconnect ho gayi

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Trace and repair/replace the sensor harness.
solutions.ur: Sensor harness ko dhoond kar theek karein ya badlein

solutions.en: If harness is sound, replace the outdoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Harness theek ho to outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: SM-TS3 H0 = 'malfunction of sensor system of compressor'.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein H0 ka matlab hai 'malfunction of sensor system of compressor'.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: Rotor position feedback from the compressor is faulty, so operation halted.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki rotor position ka feedback kharab hai, is liye chalna rok diya gaya

causes.en: Start-up attempted with stop valve closed; supply voltage out of range.
causes.ur: Stop valve band hone par unit ko chalaane ki koshish; supply voltage had se bahar

causes.en: Disconnection of the compressor relay cable.
causes.ur: Compressor relay cable disconnect

causes.en: Defective compressor or outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Compressor ya outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Open the stop valves fully before restarting.
solutions.ur: Dobara chalane se pehle stop valves poori tarah kholein

solutions.en: Check supply voltage and relay-cable connections.
solutions.ur: Supply voltage aur relay-cable connections check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the compressor or outdoor PCB per diagnosis.
solutions.ur: Diagnosis ke mutabiq compressor ya outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Regional pages: 'operation halt due to faulty position detection sensor'.
notes.ur: Regional pages par likha hai: 'operation halt due to faulty position detection sensor'.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: The compressor current-sensing (CT) circuit reported an invalid value.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki current-sensing (CT) circuit ne ghalat value batayi.

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB (CT circuit).
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB (CT circuit) kharab hai.

causes.en: SM-TS3 also points to defective power transistor, reactor, or faulty inverter wiring.
causes.ur: SM-TS3 mein yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke power transistor, reactor ya inverter wiring kharab ho sakti hai

solutions.en: Inspect inverter wiring, reactor and power transistor connections.
solutions.ur: Inverter ki wiring, reactor aur power transistor connections check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor PCB if the CT circuit remains faulty.
solutions.ur: CT circuit kharab rahe to outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Service manual marks H8 as 35/42 class only.
notes.ur: Service manual mein H8 sirf 35/42 class ke liye marked hai.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: The outdoor-air temperature sensor read out of range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor air ke temperature sensor ki reading had se bahar hai

causes.en: Thermistor connector not properly connected.
causes.ur: Thermistor connector theek se nahi laga hua

causes.en: Defective outdoor-air thermistor.
causes.ur: Outdoor air ka thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reseat the thermistor connector and retest.
solutions.ur: Thermistor connector dobara laga kar dobara test karein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor if resistance is off; otherwise replace outdoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Resistance ghalat ho to thermistor badlein, warna outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: FTXC-C: 'Outdoor air thermistor short/open'.
notes.ur: FTXC-C mein yeh likha hai: 'Outdoor air thermistor short/open'.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

meaning.en: The compressor discharge-pipe temperature sensor read out of range.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki discharge pipe temperature sensor ghalat reading de rahi hai

causes.en: Thermistor connector not connected.
causes.ur: Thermistor connector nahi laga hua

causes.en: Defective discharge pipe thermistor.
causes.ur: Discharge pipe thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reconnect and verify the sensor resistance vs temperature chart.
solutions.ur: Dobara lagayein aur sensor ka resistance temperature chart se check karein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor; replace outdoor PCB only if sensor tests OK.
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein; outdoor PCB sirf tab badlein jab sensor theek nikle

notes.en: FTXC-C adds 'misplaced' (sensor not seated in pocket).
notes.ur: FTXC-C mein 'misplaced' bhi shamil hai (sensor pocket mein baitha nahi hai).

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

title.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger thermistor kharab hai

meaning.en: The outdoor coil temperature sensor read out of range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil ke temperature sensor ki reading had se bahar hai

causes.en: Thermistor connector not connected.
causes.ur: Thermistor connector nahi laga hua

causes.en: Defective outdoor heat exchanger thermistor.
causes.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger thermistor kharab hai.

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reseat the connector; check resistance against the chart.
solutions.ur: Connector dobara lagayein; chart ke mutabiq resistance check karein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor or, if it tests good, the outdoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein, ya woh theek nikle to outdoor PCB badlein

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

title.ur: Electrical parts box ki temperature barhna

meaning.ur: Outdoor electrical parts box ke andar ki temperature bohat zyada ho gayi

causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor kharab ya short circuit ki wajah se zyada garmi

causes.en: Defective radiation-fin thermistor or disconnected connector.
causes.ur: Radiation fin thermistor kharab ya connector disconnect

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor fan motor; find and clear the short.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan motor badlein; short dhoond kar khatam karein

solutions.en: Check fin thermistor/connector; replace outdoor PCB if needed.
solutions.ur: Fin thermistor/connector check karein; zarurat ho to outdoor PCB badlein

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

codes.seriesName: Split inverter K-Series service manual codes (FTXS35-50K2V1B / RXS)

title.ur: Inverter radiation fin (heatsink) ki temperature barhna

meaning.en: The inverter heatsink overheated.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka heatsink zyada garam ho gaya

causes.en: Defective outdoor fan motor or short circuit.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor kharab ya short circuit

causes.en: Defective radiation fin thermistor or loose connector.
causes.ur: Radiation fin thermistor kharab ya connector dhila

causes.en: Silicon grease not applied properly after outdoor PCB replacement.
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB badalne ke baad silicon grease theek se nahi lagayi gayi

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Restore outdoor fan operation and clear airflow around the heatsink.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan chalana theek karein aur heatsink ke aas paas se hawa ka raasta saaf karein

solutions.en: Re-apply proper silicon grease / replace fin thermistor; replace PCB if required.
solutions.ur: Sahi silicon grease lagayein ya fin thermistor badlein; zarurat ho to PCB badlein

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

meaning.en: Inverter output current spiked beyond the safe limit.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke output current muhafaz ki had se upar chala gaya

causes.ur: Kharab installation ya ghalat supply voltage

causes.en: Closed stop valve, wrong internal wiring, or defective power module.

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB or compressor.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB ya compressor kharab

solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein; andarooni wiring aur supply voltage theek karein.

solutions.en: Replace the power module; megger the compressor windings.
solutions.ur: Power module badlein; compressor windings ka megger test karein

solutions.en: Replace the compressor or outdoor PCB if the fault persists.
solutions.ur: Fault phir bhi rahe to compressor ya outdoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Regional pages: 'OUTPUT OVERCURRENT'; FTXC-C: 'IPM error / IGBT error'.
notes.ur: Regional pages par 'OUTPUT OVERCURRENT' likha hai; FTXC-C mein 'IPM error / IGBT error'.

source.title: Daikin Service Manual SiBE041213E

notes.en: Present on all official RAC lists (India, FTXC-C, web-manual, SM-TS3).

meaning.ur: Drain/level sensing system ne fault dikhaya hai (pump wali units mein).

title.en: Operation halt due to compressor internal temperature
title.ur: Compressor ki andar ki temperature ki wajah se chalna ruka

meaning.en: The unit stopped because the compressor's internal temperature rose above the allowed limit.
meaning.ur: Unit ruk gaya kyunke compressor ki andar ki temperature mujarraba se upar chali gayi

causes.en: Compressor internal temperature exceeded the permitted threshold (sustained heavy load or poor heat rejection).
causes.ur: Compressor ki andar ki temperature ijazat ki had se upar chali gayi (lagatar bhaari load ya garmi nikalne mein kami)

causes.en: Conditions that overheat the compressor, such as low refrigerant, blocked condenser, or very hot ambient.
causes.ur: Compressor ko zyada garam karne wale hal, jaise refrigerant kam hona, condenser band hona, ya bahut tez garmi

solutions.en: Switch the unit off, let the compressor cool, remove airflow restrictions (filter/condenser), then restart.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, compressor ko thanda hone dein, airflow ki raaste ki harkat hatayein (filter/condenser), phir restart karein

solutions.en: If the code returns, have a technician check refrigerant charge and compressor windings before running again.
solutions.ur: Agar code dobara aaye to technician se refrigerant charge aur compressor windings check karwa lein, phir chalaayein

notes.en: FTXC-C OM lists F8 as '-' (not defined for that model); wording taken from RA web-manual and FTXF user reference guide. No official cause list is published for F8 - causes are paraphrased.
notes.ur: FTXC-C OM mein F8 '-' (us model ke liye defined nahi) ke tor par listed hai; wording RA web-manual aur FTXF user reference guide se li gayi hai. F8 ke liye koi official cause list shuda hui nahi hai - causes parafrase ki gayi hain.

source.title: DAIKIN web-manual (RA) troubleshooting / Error codes

codes.seriesName: R32 split FTXC-C user manual + ARC remote codes (PK-sold Sensira class)

title.ur: Heat exchanger zyada garam ho gaya

meaning.en: The indoor heat exchanger temperature went above the safe limit and the unit stopped.
meaning.ur: Indoor heat exchanger ki temperature safe limit se upar chali gayi aur unit ruk gayi

causes.en: Reduced airflow across the indoor coil (clogged filter, dirty heat exchanger, blocked return air).
causes.ur: Indoor coil par airflow kam ho gaya (filter ghad hua, heat exchanger mila hua, return air band)

causes.en: Heat exchanger thermistor reading wrongly high (open/short or out of its characteristic range).
causes.ur: Heat exchanger thermistor ki reading ghalat mein zyada hai (khuli/short ya us ki characteristic range se bahar)

solutions.en: Clean the filter and indoor coil, confirm the fan runs at full speed, then restart.
solutions.ur: Filter aur indoor coil saaf karein, fan poori speed par chalta hai yeh confirm karein, phir restart karein

solutions.en: Measure the thermistor against the resistance-temperature chart and replace it if it is off-spec.
solutions.ur: Thermistor ko resistance-temperature chart ke mutabiq naap lein aur ghalat nikle to badlein

notes.en: The OM gives only the code name; no official cause list found. FA is position 34 in the ARC433B 33-code cycle (SM-TS3 how-to-check) and in the FTXS-K remote cycle.
notes.ur: OM mein sirf code ka naam diya hai; koi official cause list nahi mili. FA ARC433B 33-code cycle (SM-TS3 how-to-check) aur FTXS-K remote cycle mein position 34 par hai.

source.title: FTXC-C Operation manual (Error code definition)

codes.seriesName: R32 split FTXC-C user manual + ARC remote codes (PK-sold Sensira class)

meaning.en: The high-pressure protection switch circuit is faulty (stuck open, broken wire, or bad contact).
meaning.ur: High pressure protection switch ka circuit kharab hai (khula atak hua, wire tooti, ya contact kharab)

causes.en: Defective high pressure switch.
causes.ur: High pressure switch kharab

causes.en: Broken wire or defective connector contact in the HPS circuit.
causes.ur: HPS circuit mein wire tooti ya connector ka contact kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Test switch continuity and reseat or repair the connector wiring.
solutions.ur: Switch ki continuity test karein aur connector wiring dobara lagayein ya theek karein

solutions.en: Replace the HPS if it fails the test; replace the outdoor PCB only if the circuit itself is at fault.
solutions.ur: Test mein HPS kharab nikle to use badlein; outdoor PCB sirf tab badlein jab ghalti circuit mein khud ho

notes.en: Meaning from FTXC-C OM ('High pressure switch error'); causes from SM-TS3 H3 row. Distinct from E3, which is the actuation of the same switch.
notes.ur: Meaning FTXC-C OM se li gayi hai ('High pressure switch error'); causes SM-TS3 H3 row se hain. Yeh E3 se alag hai, jo usi switch ke khulne ka code hai.

codes.seriesName: R32 split FTXC-C user manual + ARC remote codes (PK-sold Sensira class)

title.ur: Liquid pipe thermistor short ya open

meaning.en: The liquid pipe (refrigerant circuit) temperature sensor read open or short.
meaning.ur: Liquid pipe (refrigerant circuit) ka temperature sensor khula ya short hai

causes.en: Defective connector contact on the thermistor.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connector contact kharab

causes.en: Defective liquid pipe thermistor.
causes.ur: Liquid pipe thermistor kharab

causes.en: Defective outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit PCB kharab

solutions.en: Reseat the connector and measure resistance against the temperature chart.
solutions.ur: Connector dobara baitha karein aur temperature chart ke mutabiq resistance naaphein

solutions.en: Replace the thermistor; replace the outdoor PCB only if the sensor tests good.
solutions.ur: Thermistor badlein; outdoor PCB sirf tab badlein jab sensor theek nikle

notes.en: Causes from SM-TS3 J8 row; FTXC-C OM provides the name only. Also on web-manual RA list.
notes.ur: Causes SM-TS3 J8 row se li gayi hain; FTXC-C OM sirf naam deta hai. Yeh web-manual RA list par bhi hai.

codes.seriesName: R32 split FTXC-C user manual + ARC remote codes (PK-sold Sensira class)

title.en: Transmission error / check operation not executed
title.ur: Transmission error / check operation nahi chala

meaning.en: Either a signal transmission fault is flagged, or the periodic check (inspection) operation has not been run.
meaning.ur: Ya to signal transmission fault flag hua hai, ya periodic check (inspection) operation nahi chalaya gaya

causes.en: Check operation has not been executed for the required period (SM-TS3).
causes.ur: Zaroori arse tak check operation nahi chalaya gaya (SM-TS3).

causes.en: Transmission error on the remote-controller / unit signal path (FTXC-C naming).
causes.ur: Remote controller / unit ke signal path par transmission error (FTXC-C naming)

solutions.en: Run the check/inspection operation exactly as described in the manual and clear the code.
solutions.ur: Manual mein bataye tareeqe se check/inspection operation chalayein aur code khatam karein

solutions.en: If a real transmission fault remains, inspect the controller and inter-unit wiring for shorts, breaks and noise.
solutions.ur: Agar asli transmission fault baqi rahe to controller aur inter-unit wiring ko short, kata hua hissa aur shor ke liye check karein

notes.en: SM-TS3 U3 cause list contains only 'check operation is not executed'; FTXC-C OM names the code 'Transmission error'. Both official wordings kept.
notes.ur: SM-TS3 mein U3 ki cause list mein sirf 'check operation is not executed' hai; FTXC-C OM is code ko 'Transmission error' kehta hai. Dono official wordings rakhi gayi hain.

codes.seriesName: R32 split FTXC-C user manual + ARC remote codes (PK-sold Sensira class)

title.en: Piping & wiring installation mismatch / system not set
title.ur: Piping aur wiring ki installation ka mismatch / system set nahi hua

meaning.en: Piping/wiring does not match the commissioned system setting, the check operation was not executed, or the gas charge is insufficient.
meaning.ur: Piping/wiring commissioned system setting se match nahi karti, check operation nahi chalaya gaya, ya gas ki qadar kam hai.

causes.en: Improper connection of transmission wiring between indoor-outdoor and outdoor-outdoor units.
causes.ur: Wall unit-se-condenser unit aur condenser unit-se-condenser unit ke darmiyan transmission wiring ka connection ghalat hai

causes.en: Failure to execute the check operation after installation.
causes.ur: Installation ke baad check operation nahi chalaya gaya

causes.en: Wrong wiring or insufficient refrigerant gas (FTXC-C wording); defective indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Ghalat wiring ya kam refrigerant gas (FTXC-C ke alfaz yahi hain); kharab indoor unit PCB

solutions.en: Verify inter-unit piping and wiring against the installation manual and correct it.
solutions.ur: Installation manual ke mutabiq inter-unit piping aur wiring check karke ghalti theek karein

solutions.en: Run the check operation; leak-test and recharge if the gas is low.
solutions.ur: Check operation chalayein; gas kam ho to leak test karke dobara bharrein

solutions.en: Replace the indoor unit PCB only if the fault persists after wiring and charge are confirmed good.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur gas the hone ke baad bhi fault raha to indoor unit PCB badlein

notes.en: FTXC-C OM wording combined with SM-TS3 UF causes ('System is not set yet' / failure to execute check operation).
notes.ur: FTXC-C OM ki wording ko SM-TS3 UF causes ke sath milaya gaya hai ('System is not set yet' / check operation na chalna).

source.title: FTXC-C Operation manual (Error code definition)

codes.seriesName: R32 split FTXC-C user manual + ARC remote codes (PK-sold Sensira class)

meaning.en: On multi-split RAC remotes: antifreeze protection operated in another indoor room. On SM-TS3 lines: system malfunction such as a closed stop valve or improper transmission wiring.
meaning.ur: Multi-split RAC remotes par: doosre indoor kamre mein antifreeze protection chala hai. SM-TS3 lines par: system kharabi, jaise band stop valve ya ghalat transmission wiring.

causes.en: Stop valve is not opened.
causes.ur: Stop valve khuli nahi hai

causes.en: Improper connection of transmission wiring between indoor-outdoor and outdoor-outdoor units.
causes.ur: Wall unit-se-condenser unit aur condenser unit-se-condenser unit ke darmiyan transmission wiring ka connection ghalat hai

causes.en: Antifreeze condition in another indoor room (restricted airflow); defective indoor or outdoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: Doosre indoor kamre mein antifreeze ho gaya (airflow kam), ya indoor ya outdoor unit ka PCB kharab.

solutions.en: Fully open the stop valves and verify the inter-unit transmission wiring.
solutions.ur: Stop valves poori tarah kholein aur units ke darmiyan transmission wiring ki tasdeeq karein.

solutions.en: Clean filters and restore airflow in every indoor unit, then restart.
solutions.ur: Har indoor unit ke filter saaf karke airflow theek karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor/outdoor PCB if the code persists with wiring and airflow confirmed good.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur airflow theek hone ke baad bhi code aaye to wall ya condenser unit PCB badlein

notes.en: Two official wordings exist for UH: FTXC-C OM 'Antifreeze (other rooms)' (RAC multi-split) and SM-TS3 'Malfunction of system' (VRV/RA) - both recorded.
notes.ur: UH ke liye do official wordings hain: FTXC-C OM 'Antifreeze (other rooms)' (RAC multi-split) aur SM-TS3 'Malfunction of system' (VRV/RA) - dono record kar li gayi hain.

codes.seriesName: R32 split FTXC-C user manual + ARC remote codes (PK-sold Sensira class)

meaning.en: The optional electrical dust-collecting air cleaner reported a fault.
meaning.ur: Optional electrical dust-collecting air cleaner ne fault bataya hai

causes.en: Defect of the dust collecting element (dirty, shorted or misplaced collector).
causes.ur: Dust collecting element mein kharabi (ganda, short ya galat jagah par)

causes.en: Stained insulator part.
causes.ur: Insulator part par dagh lage hue hain.

causes.en: Defect of the high voltage power supply unit; defect of indoor unit PCB.
causes.ur: High voltage power supply unit kharab hai; indoor unit PCB bhi kharab hai.

solutions.en: Clean or replace the dust collecting element and wipe the insulator.
solutions.ur: Dust collecting element saaf karein ya badlein aur insulator bhi saaf kar lein

solutions.en: Check the high voltage power supply output; replace the indoor PCB if the fault remains.
solutions.ur: High voltage power supply ka output check karein; fault uske baad bhi rahe to indoor PCB badlein

notes.en: Only on models fitted with the optional electrical air cleaner (FTXC-C OM lists AH; causes from SM-TS3 AH row; also ARC433B cycle position 33).
notes.ur: Sirf un models par jo optional electrical air cleaner ke sath aate hain (FTXC-C OM mein AH listed hai; causes SM-TS3 AH row se hain; ARC433B cycle position 33 par bhi).

codes.seriesName: airHome LD301 outdoor-unit LED blink map (300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH)

title.en: No power supply to the outdoor board
title.ur: Outdoor board ko power supply nahi mil rahi

meaning.en: The LD301 indicator stays dark instead of blinking, which the source records as a no-power-supply condition rather than a coded fault.
meaning.ur: LD301 indicator blink karne ke bajaye band rehta hai, jise source ne coded fault ke bajaye no power supply ki halat likhi hai

causes.en: Mains supply absent at the outdoor unit — breaker tripped, fuse blown, or supply wiring open.
causes.ur: Outdoor unit par mains supply nahi hai — breaker trip ho chuka hai, fuse ura ho gaya hai, ya supply wiring khuli hai

causes.en: Loose supply terminal, failed outdoor PCB power section, or a protective device holding the board off.
causes.ur: Supply terminal dheela, outdoor PCB ka power section kharab, ya kisi protective device ki wajah se board off rehta hai

solutions.en: Check voltage at the outdoor terminals and at the incoming supply; reset the breaker/replace the fuse if open.
solutions.ur: Outdoor terminals aur aane wali supply par voltage check karein; breaker reset karein, agar fuse khula ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Repair supply wiring and tighten terminals; if voltage is present but the LED stays off, inspect the outdoor PCB power section.
solutions.ur: Supply wiring theek karein aur terminals kassain; voltage mojod ho uske bawajood LED off rahe to outdoor PCB ka power section dekhein

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: off (no blinking)

notes.en: Source states airHome 300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH LD301 service manuals. PK sells airHome 200/200X/400 — confirm the model.
notes.ur: Source airHome 300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH LD301 service manuals se liya gaya hai. Pakistan mein airHome 200/200X/400 bikta hai — apna model confirm karein.

codes.seriesName: airHome LD301 outdoor-unit LED blink map (300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH)

meaning.en: The outdoor board cut the compressor because the inrush/peak current limit was reached.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ne compressor rok diya kyunke inrush/peak current ki limit cross ho gayi

causes.en: Compressor inrush too high — weak run capacitor, poor supply, or compressor binding.
causes.ur: Compressor ka inrush zyada hai — run capacitor kamzor, supply kamzor, ya compressor jam kar na chalne ki wajah se

causes.en: Peak-current detection threshold disturbed by an outdoor PCB fault or wrong settings.
causes.ur: Peak current ki detection threshold outdoor PCB ki kharabi ya ghalat settings se bigad gayi

solutions.en: Check the run capacitor and supply voltage at the outdoor unit, and free the compressor if it is locked.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit par run capacitor aur supply voltage check karein, aur compressor locked ho to azad karein

solutions.en: Measure running current against nameplate; if current is normal, inspect the outdoor inverter PCB.
solutions.ur: Chalta current ko nameplate se compare karke napen; current normal ho to outdoor inverter PCB check karein

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 2 blinks, pause, repeat

notes.en: Source wording: peak current cut in Wall-Mounted Split / Inverter Split / Single-Split rows.
notes.ur: Source ki wording yahan Wall-Mounted Split / Inverter Split / Single-Split rows mein 'peak current cut' hai.

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

codes.seriesName: airHome LD301 outdoor-unit LED blink map (300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH)

title.ur: Low speed par ghoomne mein kharabi

meaning.en: The compressor or outdoor fan is not holding its minimum speed and the board cut operation.
meaning.ur: Compressor ya outdoor fan apni minimum speed par nahi rakh raha aur board ne operation rok diya

causes.en: Refrigerant undercharge/overcharge or a restriction producing abnormal running conditions.
causes.ur: Refrigerant km ya zyada charge, ya koi rokawat — in par run karne ki halat ghair mamooli ho jati hai

causes.en: Inverter drive or motor winding problem preventing stable low-speed operation.
causes.ur: Inverter drive ya motor winding ka masla, jis ki wajah se unit stable low speed par nahi chl pati

solutions.en: Check system pressures/charge and clean the condenser; verify the outdoor fan turns freely.
solutions.ur: System ke pressures aur charge check karein, condenser saaf karein; outdoor fan ki azaad rotation ki tasdeiq karein

solutions.en: If charge and airflow are correct, test the inverter drive and motor windings, replacing the faulty part.
solutions.ur: Charge aur airflow theek hon to inverter drive aur motor windings test karein aur kharab part badal dein

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 3 blinks, pause, repeat

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

codes.seriesName: airHome LD301 outdoor-unit LED blink map (300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH)

meaning.en: The inverter's power-switching stage reported a failure and the unit shut down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke power switching stage ne failure report ki aur unit band ho gaya

causes.en: Inverter/IGBT drive fault, damaged snubber or gate-drive components on the outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Inverter drive fault, outdoor PCB par snubber ya driver ke parts kharab

causes.en: Loose DC-bus power connections or a shorted compressor winding stressing the switching stage.
causes.ur: DC bus ke power connections dheele ya compressor winding short ho jane se switching stage par load barh gaya

solutions.en: Inspect the outdoor inverter PCB for burnt drive components and check all power terminals for tightness.
solutions.ur: Outdoor inverter PCB par zale lagay huay drive components check karein aur tamam power terminals ki kash-shi check karein

solutions.en: Megger the compressor windings and replace the outdoor inverter PCB if the switching fault persists.
solutions.ur: Compressor ki windings ko megger se check karein aur agar switching kharabi bar bar aaye to outdoor inverter PCB badal dein

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 4 blinks, pause, repeat

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

codes.seriesName: airHome LD301 outdoor-unit LED blink map (300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH)

title.ur: Overload ki lower limit par cut

meaning.en: The overload protection cut in at its lower limit, i.e. the unit tripped on overload earlier than the normal setting would allow.
meaning.ur: Overload protection apni lower limit par hi cut ho gayi, yani unit normal setting se pehle hi overload par trip ho gayi

causes.en: High head pressure from a fouled condenser, blocked airflow or a condenser fan problem.
causes.ur: Ganda condenser, band airflow ya condenser fan ke masle se head pressure zyada ho gaya

causes.en: Overload protection settings/components out of spec, or an overcharged system.
causes.ur: Overload protection ki settings ya parts ghalat par hain, ya system mein refrigerant zyada charge hai

solutions.en: Clean the condenser, verify the outdoor fan runs at speed, and clear anything blocking airflow.
solutions.ur: Condenser saaf karein, outdoor fan ki poori speed verify karein, aur airflow rokne wali har cheez hatayein

solutions.en: Recover and weigh the refrigerant charge against nameplate; replace the overload device if it trips with normal current.
solutions.ur: Refrigerant charge nikal kar nameplate ke mutabiq waze kar ke tol lein; current normal hone par bhi overload device trip kare to use badal dein

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 5 blinks, pause, repeat

codes.seriesName: airHome LD301 outdoor-unit LED blink map (300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH)

meaning.en: Compressor temperature climbed above the allowed value and the board cut out.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki temperature allowed value se upar chali gayi aur board ne operation cut kar diya

causes.en: Low refrigerant charge, pipe clogging, or a failed discharge/pipe thermistor.
causes.ur: Refrigerant charge kam, pipe ka rakaav, ya discharge/pipe ka thermistor kharab

causes.en: Poor heat rejection — dirty condenser, slow outdoor fan, or high ambient with blocked airflow.
causes.ur: Heat rejection kamzor — ganda condenser, slow outdoor fan, ya band airflow ke saath ambient temperature zyada

solutions.en: Leak-test, evacuate and recharge to specification; clean the condenser and confirm fan operation.
solutions.ur: Leak test karein, evacuate karke specification ke mutabiq recharge karein; condenser saaf karein aur fan ka kaam confirm karein

solutions.en: Measure the discharge/pipe thermistors and replace the one reading out of range.
solutions.ur: Discharge aur pipe ke thermistors ko naap lein, aur range se bahar reading wale ko badal dein

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 6 blinks, pause, repeat

notes.en: Related to, but not the same scheme as, alarm code 08 (discharge-gas temperature) in the SET FREE series.
notes.ur: Yeh alarm code 08 (discharge-gas temperature, SET FREE series) se milta hai, lekin scheme bilkul woh nahi.

codes.seriesName: airHome LD301 outdoor-unit LED blink map (300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH)

meaning.en: A thermistor used by the outdoor board is reading outside its valid range.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board jo thermistor istemal karta hai wo apni valid range ke bilkul ulat parh raha hai

causes.en: Thermistor open-circuit or short-circuit from moisture, age or physical damage.
causes.ur: Nami, umar ya physical damage ki wajah se thermistor open-circuit ya short-circuit ho gaya

causes.en: Loose thermistor connector or damaged harness between sensor and board.
causes.ur: Thermistor ka connector dheela ya sensor aur board ke darmiyan harness kharab

solutions.en: Measure each outdoor thermistor against the service-manual resistance curve at known temperatures.
solutions.ur: Har outdoor thermistor ko maloom temperature par service manual ki resistance curve se compare kar ke napen

solutions.en: Refit or replace the out-of-range sensor; if all are in range, check the outdoor PCB input stage.
solutions.ur: Range se bahar reading wale sensor ko dobara lagayein ya badal dein; sab range mein hon to outdoor PCB ka input stage check karein

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 7 blinks, pause, repeat

notes.en: The source does not say which thermistor; identify by measuring all outdoor sensors.
notes.ur: Source mein nahi likha ke kaunsa thermistor hai; tamam outdoor sensors ko naap kar identify kar lein.

codes.seriesName: airHome LD301 outdoor-unit LED blink map (300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH)

meaning.en: Signals between the outdoor board and the other unit/controller are not being received.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board aur doosre unit/controller ke darmiyan ka signal receive nahi ho raha

causes.en: Inter-unit or controller wiring open, short or loosely terminated.
causes.ur: Inter-unit ya controller ki wiring khuli, short ya dheele terminal se lagi hui hai

causes.en: Grounding/noise problem or a failed communication circuit on either PCB.
causes.ur: Grounding ya noise ka masla, ya kisi aik PCB ka communication circuit kharab

solutions.en: Check continuity and polarity of the communication wiring at both ends and re-terminate.
solutions.ur: Communication wiring ki continuity aur polarity dono saron par check karke dobara terminate karein

solutions.en: Keep communication cable away from power cable; if wiring is sound, replace the faulty PCB.
solutions.ur: Communication cable ko power cable se door rakhein; wiring theek nikle to kharab PCB badal dein

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 9 blinks, pause, repeat

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

codes.seriesName: airHome LD301 outdoor-unit LED blink map (300 CH / 400 DJ / 500 GH)

meaning.en: The supply voltage seen by the outdoor board is outside the allowed window.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ko jo supply voltage mil rahi hai wo allowed range se door hai

causes.en: Local grid voltage too low/high, brownouts, or a wrongly sized supply.
causes.ur: Local grid voltage bohat kam ya zyada, voltage mein kami, ya supply ka size ghalat

causes.en: Loose supply terminals or a voltage-sense circuit fault on the outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Supply terminals dheele, ya outdoor PCB par voltage sensing circuit kharab

solutions.en: Measure voltage at the outdoor terminals during the fault and compare with the rating plate.
solutions.ur: Kharabi ke doran outdoor terminals par voltage nap kar rating plate se compare karein

solutions.en: Tighten terminals, correct the supply, and fit a stabiliser where the local supply swings.
solutions.ur: Terminals kass lein, supply theek karein, aur jahan local supply mein atar-chirah aati ho wahan stabiliser lagayein

codes.blinkPattern: Outdoor LD301 LED: 10 blinks, pause, repeat

notes.en: Very common first check in Pakistan where supply voltage swings are frequent. A live Urdu/Hindi video covers 10-time blinking (youtube.com/watch?v=rxR3Ziq9MJ0) — procedure only, no separate table.
notes.ur: Pakistan mein supply voltage ki swings aam hain, is liye yeh sabse pehla check hai. Ek live Urdu/Hindi video 10-time blinking par hai (youtube.com/watch?v=rxR3Ziq9MJ0) — sirf procedure hai, alag table nahi.

source.title: Hitachi airHome LD301 blink table (snowflakeaircon mirror)

title.ur: Fan lock se fan ruk gaya

meaning.en: The outdoor fan is locked or not feedback-confirmed, so the board stopped the unit.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan locked hai ya feedback confirm nahi hua, is liye board ne unit rok di

causes.en: Fan blade obstructed, bearing seized, or fan motor winding failed.
causes.ur: Fan blade mein rakaav, bearing jam, ya fan motor ki winding kharab

causes.en: Fan motor connector loose or the outdoor PCB not driving the motor.
causes.ur: Fan motor ka connector dheela ya outdoor PCB motor ko drive nahi kar raha

solutions.en: Disconnect power, spin the fan by hand and clear any obstruction; replace a seized motor.
solutions.ur: Power disconnect karein, fan ko haath se ghumayein aur rakaav hatayein; motor jam ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Check the motor connector and windings; if the motor is good, check the outdoor PCB fan output.
solutions.ur: Motor ka connector aur windings check karein; motor theek ho to outdoor PCB ka fan output check karein

meaning.en: The board could not read its stored configuration/parameters from the EEPROM.
meaning.ur: Board apne stored configuration/parameters ko EEPROM se parh nahi saka

causes.en: EEPROM data corrupted after a power interruption or an electrical transient.
causes.ur: Power break ya electrical transient ke baad EEPROM ka data kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Board replaced without writing the correct model parameters, or a failed EEPROM device.
causes.ur: Board tabbadla gaya magar sahi model parameters likhe gaye hi nahi, ya EEPROM device kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Power-cycle once; if the error returns, re-program the board parameters for the model.
solutions.ur: Aik dafa power cycle karein; error wapas aaye to board ke parameters model ke mutabiq wapas program karein

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor PCB if the EEPROM cannot be re-read after reprogramming.
solutions.ur: Agar dobara program karne ke baad bhi EEPROM read na ho to outdoor PCB badal dein

meaning.en: The DC bus voltage inside the inverter is outside its working range.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar DC bus ki voltage apne kaam ke range se bahar hai

causes.en: Rectifier, PFC or DC-link capacitor fault, or a supply sag feeding the DC bus.
causes.ur: Rectifier, PFC ya DC link capacitor kharab, ya supply kamzor hone se DC bus ki voltage gir gayi

causes.en: Overload pulling the DC bus down, or a short on the inverter output stage.
causes.ur: Overload ki wajah se DC bus ki voltage girna, ya inverter output stage par short

solutions.en: Measure the DC bus with the unit running and inspect the DC-link capacitors and rectifier.
solutions.ur: Unit ko chalate hue DC bus naapein aur DC-link capacitors aur rectifier ko check karein.

solutions.en: Check the mains supply feeding the board; replace the inverter PCB if the bus stays abnormal with good supply.
solutions.ur: Board ko chalane wali mains supply check karein; supply theek hone par bhi DC bus kharab rahe to inverter PCB badal dein

meaning.en: A protection circuit on the outdoor board reported an abnormal condition; the source groups it under a generic circuit-abnormal state.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board ka koi protection circuit abnormal condition report kar raha hai; source isay aam circuit abnormal state ke hisaab se report karta hai

causes.en: Protection circuit (overcurrent, undervoltage or thermal) tripping on the outdoor PCB.
causes.ur: Outdoor PCB par protection circuit (overcurrent, undervoltage ya thermal) trip ho gaya

causes.en: Aged or damaged outdoor PCB with leakage in the detection network.
causes.ur: Purana ya kharab outdoor PCB, jis mein detection network ki leakage hai

solutions.en: Identify which protection input tripped per the model's service manual and correct that circuit's cause.
solutions.ur: Model ke service manual se dekhein ke kaunsa protection input trip hua hai, phir us circuit ki wajah theek karein

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor PCB if the abnormal state repeats with all inputs normal.
solutions.ur: Agar tamam inputs theek hone par bhi kharabi baar baar aaye to outdoor PCB badal dein

title.ur: Band hone ke doran zyada load

meaning.en: The unit detected a high-load/high-pressure condition while it was supposed to be stopped.
meaning.ur: Unit ko band hona chahiye tha, phir bhi us ne zyada load/pressure ki halat detect kar li

causes.en: High standing pressure from non-condensables, overcharge, or a valve not seating while off.
causes.ur: Ghair mumine gas, zyada charge, ya band hone par valve theek se baith na jane ki wajah se standing pressure zyada hai

causes.en: Check valves/EEV leaking by, or the unit being restarted into a loaded circuit.
causes.ur: Check valve ya EEV se gas nikal rahi hai, ya loaded circuit mein unit dobara start kar di gayi

solutions.en: Record standing pressure with the unit off and compare with the specification.
solutions.ur: Unit band hone par standing pressure likhein aur specification se compare karein

solutions.en: Recover and recharge correctly, replace leaking check valves/EEV, and clear non-condensables.
solutions.ur: Gas wapas le kar sahi tareeqe se recharge karein, leak karne wale check valve/EEV badlein, aur non-condensable gasses nikaal dein

meaning.en: An indoor-unit safety device opened and cut out the compressor; the remote shows ABNML with the unit ID and code 01.
meaning.ur: Indoor unit ka safety device khul gaya aur compressor ko band kar diya; remote par ABNML ke saath unit ID aur code 01 nazar aata hai

causes.en: Indoor freeze/thermal protection or float device opened on the indoor circuit.
causes.ur: Indoor circuit par freeze/thermal protection ya float device khul gaya

causes.en: Device wiring loose, or the protection device itself failed.
causes.ur: Device ki wiring dheeli hai, ya protection device khud kharab ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Find which indoor safety device opened, clear its cause (water, airflow, temperature) and reset.
solutions.ur: Dekhein kaun sa indoor safety device khula, us ki wajah (paani, airflow, temperature) hatayein aur reset karein

solutions.en: Verify device continuity and its harness; replace a failed device before restarting.
solutions.ur: Device ki continuity aur us ka harness check karein; dobara chalane se pehle kharab device badal dein

notes.ur: Yeh heat-pump table se hai. 01 ki cooling-only wali variant publish nahi hui. Usi chapter ke do aur Scribd copies maujood hain (515729911, 998800254) — sab ek hi source se bane hain, is liye confidence mein dobara count nahi kiye gaye.
