meaning.ur: Outdoor unit ka safety device khul gaya aur compressor ko band kar diya (ABNML + unit ID + 02 ke tor par)

causes.en: Outdoor high/low pressure switch, overload or another outdoor protection device opened.
causes.ur: Outdoor high/low pressure switch, overload ya koi doosra outdoor protection device khul gaya

causes.en: Dirty condenser, blocked airflow, overcharge, or a failed protection device.
causes.ur: Ganda condenser, band airflow, zyada charge ya koi protection device kharab

solutions.en: Check which outdoor protection device is open (meter across the device) and clear its cause.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke kaunsa outdoor protection device khuli hui hai (device ke aar par meter lagayein) aur us ki wajah theek karein

solutions.en: Clean the condenser, verify fan and charge, then reset with the Run/Stop button.
solutions.ur: Condenser saaf karein, fan aur charge check karein, phir Run/Stop button se reset karein

title.en: Transmission between indoor and outdoor units

meaning.en: Signal transmission between the indoor and outdoor units failed, so the remote latches ABNML 03.
meaning.ur: Dono units ke darmiyan signal transmission nakam hui, is liye remote par ABNML 03 latch ho jata hai

causes.en: Inter-unit cable open/short, or loose terminal connections at either unit.
causes.ur: Inter-unit cable khuli ya short, ya kisi aik unit par terminal connections dheele hain

causes.en: Indoor or outdoor communication PCB fault, or strong electrical noise on the line.
causes.ur: Kamre wale ya bahar wale unit ki communication PCB kharab, ya line par bohat zyada electrical shor

solutions.en: Check inter-unit wiring continuity and re-tighten both terminal boxes.
solutions.ur: Inter-unit wiring ki continuity check karein aur dono terminal boxes dobara kassain

solutions.en: Keep communication wiring away from power wiring; replace the faulty PCB if wiring tests good.
solutions.ur: Communication wiring ko power wiring se door rakhein; wiring theek nikle to kharab PCB badal dein

meaning.en: The three-phase supply phase sequence is reversed, or an open phase is present.
meaning.ur: Teen phase supply ki tar palat hui hai, ya koi phase khuli hui hai

causes.en: Phases landed in the wrong order at the outdoor unit after supply or wiring work.
causes.ur: Supply ya wiring ke kaam ke baad outdoor unit par phases ghalat order mein lage gaye

causes.en: One phase missing (open phase) or a loose supply link.
causes.ur: Aik phase ghaayab (open phase) hai, ya supply link dheela hai

solutions.en: Check phase sequence at the outdoor terminals with a phase-sequence meter and swap any two phases.
solutions.ur: Phase sequence meter se outdoor terminals par phase sequence check karein aur kisi bhi do phases swap kar dein

solutions.en: Verify all three phases are present and tight before restarting the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit dobara chalane se pehle teenon phases ki mojoodgi aur tightness check karein

notes.en: Agrees with the SET FREE / air365 row for 05 (power-supply phase abnormality). Three-phase hazard - treated as danger.
notes.ur: Yeh SET FREE / air365 ke 05 (power-supply phase abnormality) se agree karta hai. Three-phase khatra hai — isay khatre ki tarah treat kiya jata hai.

meaning.en: Compressor discharge/gas temperature exceeded the safe value and the unit shut down.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki discharge/gas temperature safe value se zyada ho gayi aur unit band ho gaya

causes.en: Low refrigerant charge, pipe clogging, or a failed discharge thermistor.
causes.ur: Refrigerant charge kam, pipe ka rakaav, ya discharge ka thermistor kharab

causes.en: Dirty condenser or slow outdoor fan causing poor heat rejection at high ambient.
causes.ur: Ganda condenser ya slow outdoor fan ki wajah se high ambient par heat rejection kamzor ho raha hai

solutions.en: Leak-test, evacuate and recharge to specification; clean the condenser and confirm fan speed.
solutions.ur: Leak test karein, evacuate karke specification ke mutabiq recharge karein; condenser saaf karein aur fan ki speed check karein

solutions.en: Measure the discharge thermistor and replace it if out of specification; otherwise service the compressor.
solutions.ur: Discharge thermistor napen; specification se bahar ho to badal dein, warna compressor ki marammat karein

causes.ur: Nami, umar ya physical damage ki wajah se thermistor open/short ho gaya

causes.ur: Sensor ka connector dheela ya sensor ka harness kharab

solutions.ur: Room temperature par sensor ki resistance napen aur service manual ki value se compare karein

solutions.en: Refit the connector or replace the thermistor; if it still reads wrong, check the control board input.

solutions.ur: Sensor ki resistance aur connector check karein; open/short dikhane wala sensor badal dein

solutions.en: After refitting, run the unit and confirm the displayed temperature follows reality.

meaning.ur: Indoor ka freeze protection sensor khul gaya, short ho gaya ya range se bahar parh raha hai aur unit rok raha hai

causes.en: Sensor open/short, loose connector or damaged harness.
causes.ur: Sensor open/short, connector dheela ya harness kharab

causes.en: Actual evaporator freeze-up from low airflow (dirty filter/fan) feeding a genuine freeze condition.
causes.ur: Kam airflow (ganda filter/fan) ki wajah se evaporator par freeze-up ho gaya

solutions.en: Test the thermistor value and replace it if open/short; refit the connector.
solutions.ur: Thermistor ki value test karein; open/short ho to badal dein aur connector dobara lagayein

solutions.ur: Sensor theek ho to filter saaf karein aur reset se pehle evaporator par airflow check karein

causes.ur: Sensor compressor ki shell par theek se nahi baitha, jis se ghalat reading aati hai

causes.ur: Control supply par over-voltage/under-voltage, surge se nuqsan ya kharab hota relay

causes.ur: Outdoor PCB par paani ya dust ka asar

solutions.ur: PCB ko jaan kar jale hue tracks, phoolay hue capacitors aur trip ho chuke protection devices dekhein

solutions.ur: Power off karein, board ko saaf aur sukha karein, supply voltage check karein aur nuqsan ho to board badal dein

causes.ur: Ganda condenser ya kam airflow ki wajah se cooling ke doran head pressure barh gaya

causes.ur: Zyada charge, ghair mumine gas, kamzor capacitor ya compressor ki winding kharab hoti ja rahi hai

solutions.en: Clean the condenser, verify fan operation and measure head pressure/amp draw.
solutions.ur: Condenser saaf karein, fan ka kaam check karein aur head pressure/amp draw naapein.

solutions.ur: Charge theek karein ya kamzor run capacitor/compressor ko jaisa mila hai waisa hi badal dein

causes.ur: Heating mein outdoor coil par kam airflow (jama hua coil, gande fins, band fan)

causes.ur: Charge kam ya leak, ya compressor high discharge temperature par lambi der chal raha hai

solutions.en: Clear the outdoor coil and fan, then check charge and discharge temperature.
solutions.ur: Pehle outdoor coil aur fan saaf karein, phir charge aur discharge temperature check karein.

meaning.en: The indoor LED blinks once per cycle: on heat-pump machines the refrigeration circuit is flagged (coil-temperature sensing / 4-way valve side).
meaning.ur: Indoor LED aik baar blink karta hai: heat-pump machines par refrigeration circuit ko flag kiya gaya hai (coil temperature sensing ya 4-way valve ki taraf)

causes.en: Coil temperature sensor position or fitment incorrect, or the sensor reading open/short.
causes.ur: Coil temperature sensor ki position ya fitment ghalat, ya sensor ki reading open/short hai

causes.en: 4-way reversing valve coil not switching or its wiring faulty; indoor PCB misreading the sensor.
causes.ur: 4-way reversing valve ka coil switch nahi ho raha ya us ki wiring kharab; indoor PCB sensor ki reading ghalat parh raha hai

solutions.en: Refit the coil temperature sensor in the correct position and confirm its connector is seated.
solutions.ur: Coil temperature sensor ko sahi position par dobara lagayein aur us ka connector baitha hua hai, is ki tasdeiq karein

solutions.en: Check the 4-way valve coil and its drive; if the LED still blinks once, replace the indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: 4-way valve ka coil aur us ka drive check karein; LED phir bhi aik baar blink kare to indoor PCB badal dein

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor timer/fault LED: 1 blink, pause, repeat

notes.en: Source marks this as heat-pump-only. Do not apply to cool-only machines.
notes.ur: Source ise heat-pump-only batata hai. Cool-only machines par ise lagu na karein.

source.title: Hitachi AC Error Code Guide - section 6.0 (Scribd copy)

codes.seriesName: Residential indoor timer/fault LED blink-count map

meaning.en: Two blinks mean the unit is in force-cooling / service-test mode, which is triggered by the temporary push button on the display board — it is a mode, not a refrigerant fault.
meaning.ur: Do blinks ka matlab hai unit force cooling ya service test mode mein hai, jo display board ke temporary push button se chalta hai — yeh aik mode hai, refrigerant kharabi nahi

causes.en: Temporary switch on the display sticker being pressed continuously because the front cover is fitted incorrectly.
causes.ur: Front cover ghalat lagne ki wajah se display sticker ka temporary switch baar baar daba hua hai

causes.en: Display-board push button stuck or its continuity permanent (button or display PCB defective).
causes.ur: Display board ka button atka hua hai ya us ki continuity permanent hai (button ya display PCB kharab)

solutions.en: Remove the front cover and refit it properly so the temporary switch releases.
solutions.ur: Front cover nikaal kar theek se dobara lagayein taake temporary switch azaad ho jaye

solutions.en: Power OFF, open the display PCB and check the push-button continuity with a multimeter without pressing it; replace the display PCB if it reads closed.
solutions.ur: Power OFF karke display kholein aur button ko dabae baghair multimeter se continuity check karein; band parhe to display PCB badal dein

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor timer/fault LED: 2 blinks, pause, repeat

notes.en: is_fault false because force cooling is an intentional service mode; customers often report it as a fault.
notes.ur: is_fault ki value off rakhi gayi hai kyunke force cooling aik jaan boojh kar service mode hai; customers ise aksar kharabi ki tarah report karte hain

source.title: Hitachi AC Error Code Guide - section 6.0 (Scribd copy)

codes.seriesName: Residential indoor timer/fault LED blink-count map

title.ur: Dono units ke darmiyan communication kharabi

meaning.en: Three blinks mean the indoor and outdoor units are not exchanging signals correctly.
meaning.ur: Teen blinks ka matlab hai ke dono unit sahi tarah signal exchange nahi kar rahe

causes.en: Loose or wrongly landed A/B/C conductors at the indoor or outdoor terminal box.
causes.ur: Kamre ya bahar wali unit ke terminal box mein A/B/C conductors dheele ya ghalat lage huay hain

causes.en: Open/short or damaged inter-unit cable, or a defective indoor PCB communication circuit.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan cable kata ya short, ya kharab, ya indoor PCB ki communication circuit kharab

solutions.en: Re-check and re-tighten the A, B, C terminal connections at both ends against the wiring diagram.
solutions.ur: Wiring diagram ke mutabiq dono saron par A, B, C terminal connections dobara check kar ke kassain

solutions.en: Test/replace the inter-unit cable; if wiring is good, replace the indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Yon ke darmiyan cable test karke badlein; wiring theek ho to indoor PCB badal dein

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor timer/fault LED: 3 blinks, pause, repeat

notes.en: Corroborated in practice by live Urdu/Hindi technician videos on 3-time blinking (e.g. youtube.com/watch?v=LQE_UL0AkvE, rFdhjUYAu18) — those videos give procedure only, no separate table.
notes.ur: Isay live Urdu/Hindi technician videos ne 3-time blinking par amali tor par confirm kiya hai (youtube.com/watch?v=LQE_UL0AkvE, rFdhjUYAu18) — un videos mein sirf procedure hai, alag table nahi.

source.title: Hitachi AC Error Code Guide - section 6.0 (Scribd copy)

codes.seriesName: Residential indoor timer/fault LED blink-count map

meaning.en: Four blinks mean the fault is on the outdoor unit; the indoor LED is only pointing you to the outdoor board, which stores the actual sub-code.
meaning.ur: Chaar blinks ka matlab kharabi outdoor unit par hai; indoor LED sirf us ke board ki taraf ishara karta hai jahan asli code save hota hai

causes.en: Any outdoor-unit protection trip (high pressure, discharge temperature, inverter or fan fault) reported through the indoor LED.
causes.ur: Bahar wali unit ka koi bhi protection trip (high pressure, discharge temperature, inverter ya fan kharabi) jo kamre wale LED ke zariye dikhaya gaya hai

causes.en: Indoor PCB interpreting the outdoor status incorrectly (cable/PCB fault giving a false 4-blink).
causes.ur: Kamre wala PCB bahar wali unit ki status ko ghalat samajh raha hai (cable/PCB kharabi se 4 blink ghalat aa raha hai)

solutions.en: Go to the outdoor unit, open the service panel and read the LED/alarm code displayed there.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ke paas ja kar service panel kholein aur wahan ka LED/alarm code parhein

solutions.en: Diagnose using the outdoor board's own code table for the installed model, then clear the alarm after repair.
solutions.ur: Lgaye gaye model ke outdoor board ki apni code table se diagnosis karein, phir theek karne ke baad alarm clear karein

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor timer/fault LED: 4 blinks, pause, repeat

notes.en: Pointer code only — the underlying fault must be read at the outdoor unit.
notes.ur: Sirf pointer code hai — asal fault outdoor unit par read hona chahiye.

source.title: Hitachi AC Error Code Guide - section 6.0 (Scribd copy)

codes.seriesName: Residential indoor timer/fault LED blink-count map

title.ur: Power relay ke contacts chipak jane ki kharabi

meaning.en: Five blinks indicate the power relay on the control board has welded contacts, so the board cannot disconnect the load it is supposed to control.
meaning.ur: 5 blinks ka matlab control board ke power relay ke contacts weld ho chuke hain, is liye board us load ko disconnect nahi kar pata

causes.en: Relay contacts welded after an overcurrent, inrush or a low-quality/aged relay.
causes.ur: Overcurrent, inrush ya kam quality wale purane relay ki wajah se relay ke contacts chipak gaye

causes.en: Compressor output/neutral circuit fault keeping the load permanently energised.
causes.ur: Compressor output/neutral circuit ki kharabi, jis ki wajah se load hamesha energised rehta hai

solutions.en: Verify the compressor output neutral and the relay driver; replace the indoor/relay PCB (relay is not serviced separately).
solutions.ur: Compressor output neutral aur relay driver check karein aur indoor/relay PCB badal dein (relay alag se nahi badalta)

solutions.en: After PCB replacement, confirm the load switches off with the command and check the supply for repeated surges.
solutions.ur: PCB badalne ke baad yaqeen kar lein ke command par load band hota hai aur supply mein bar bar surge na hon

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor timer/fault LED: 5 blinks, pause, repeat

notes.en: Safety-relevant: a welded relay can leave the compressor energised — do not leave the unit energised while waiting for parts.
notes.ur: Safety ke liye ahem: welded relay compressor ko energised chhor sakta hai — parts ka intezaar karte waqt unit ko energised na chhor dein.

source.title: Hitachi AC Error Code Guide - section 6.0 (Scribd copy)

codes.seriesName: Residential indoor timer/fault LED blink-count map

meaning.en: Nine blinks mean one of the room/pipe sensors is out of range (open or short) or its connector is not seated.
meaning.ur: 9 blinks ka matlab hai ke room/pipe me se koi sensor range se bahar (open ya short) hai, ya us ka connector theek se nahi laga

causes.en: Room or heat-exchanger thermistor open-circuit or short-circuit.
causes.ur: Room ya heat exchanger ka thermistor open-circuit ya short-circuit hai

causes.en: Loose/damaged sensor connector or harness, or a failed input channel on the indoor PCB.
causes.ur: Sensor ka connector ya harness dheela ya kharab, ya indoor PCB ka input channel kharab

solutions.en: Measure each sensor's resistance at room temperature and compare with the service-manual curve; refit loose connectors.
solutions.ur: Har sensor ki resistance room temperature par napen aur service manual ki curve se compare karein; dheele connectors dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Replace any sensor that reads open/short; if all sensors are good, replace the indoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Open/short dikhane wala koi bhi sensor badal dein; sab sensors theek hon to indoor PCB badal dein

codes.blinkPattern: Indoor timer/fault LED: 9 blinks, pause, repeat

notes.en: The published residential blink list contains only no-blink/1/2/3/4/5/9 — other counts are not defined by this chapter.
notes.ur: Publish hui residential blink list mein sirf no-blink/1/2/3/4/5/9 hai — doosre counts is chapter se define nahi kiye gaye.

meaning.en: The controller lost the expected communication on that link, so the system stops until the link is restored.
meaning.ur: Controller ko us link par expected communication nahi mili, is liye link theek hone tak system band rehta hai

causes.en: Incorrect wiring, broken wire, or loose terminals.
causes.ur: Wiring ghalat, wire tooti hui, ya terminals dheele

causes.en: The controller lost the expected communication on that link, so the system stops until the link is restored.
causes.ur: Controller ko us link par expected communication nahi mili, is liye link theek hone tak system band rehta hai

solutions.en: Check the communication cable, connectors and fuse at both ends of the link.
solutions.ur: Link ke dono saron par communication cable, connectors aur fuse check karein

solutions.en: If wiring and supply are good, replace the faulty indoor, outdoor or inverter PCB.
solutions.ur: Agar wiring aur supply theek hon to kharab kamre wala, bahar wala ya inverter PCB badal dein

title.ur: Indoor unit ka float switch protection on ho gaya

meaning.en: Water is not draining from the unit and the float safety switch has activated.
meaning.ur: Unit se paani nahi nikal raha aur float safety switch on ho gaya

causes.en: High water level in the drain pan, drain-pipe or drain-pan abnormality, or float-switch activation.
causes.ur: Drain pan mein paani ki level zyada, drain pipe ya drain pan ki kharabi, ya float switch on hua

causes.en: Water is not draining from the unit and the float safety switch has activated.
causes.ur: Unit se paani nahi nikal raha aur float safety switch on ho gaya

solutions.en: Clear the drain pan and drain pipe and free the float switch.
solutions.ur: Drain pan aur drain pipe saaf kariye aur float switch ko azaad kariye

solutions.en: Confirm the float switch resets freely, then restart the unit.
solutions.ur: Tasdeeq karein ke float switch azaadi se apne aap restart ho jata hai, phir unit dobara chalayein

notes.en: Corroborated by the official Hitachi RPI-FSN3 operation manual alarm table. Same number differs elsewhere: residential ABNML 01 is an indoor safety device; LD301 blink 01 is not used. Confirm the reporting unit. Model scope: SET FREE / air365 Max VRF systems on a wired controller, not residential split blink codes.
notes.ur: Official Hitachi RPI-FSN3 operation manual alarm table ise confirm karti hai. causes.ur: Refrigerant charge zyada hai

causes.en: Indoor expansion valve stuck open in cooling, or outdoor expansion valve stuck open in heating, or short cycling of air.

solutions.ur: Agar expansion valve band na ho to use badal dein ya dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Confirm the supported remote for the unit model.
solutions.ur: Unit model ke liye supported remote ki tasdeiq karein

solutions.en: Fit the correct remote or update the unit setting.
solutions.ur: Sahi remote lagayein ya unit ki setting update karein

notes.en: New in this service-manual generation, absent from the SET FREE / air365 table used earlier in this file.
notes.ur: Is service-manual generation mein naya code hai; is file mein phele wali SET FREE / air365 table mein maujood nahi.

codes.seriesName: Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A wired-controller alarm codes (SMGB0136)

title.ur: Indoor unit number ki setting mein ghalti

meaning.en: Too many indoor units are connected to one system for the addressing scheme.
meaning.ur: Addressing scheme ke liye aik system par bohat zyada indoor units jude huay hain

causes.en: 17 or more non H-LINK II units connected to one system.
causes.ur: Aik system par 17 ya zyada non H-LINK II units connected hain

causes.en: Unit numbers assigned beyond the allowed range.
causes.ur: Allowed range se bahar unit numbers de diye gaye hain

solutions.en: Split the system or re-address units within the allowed range.
solutions.ur: System ko taqseem karein ya units ko allowed range mein dobara address karein

solutions.en: Check the H-LINK topology against the design.
solutions.ur: H-LINK topology ko design ke mutabiq check karein

notes.en: A third-party Hitachi code page also documents B5 with this meaning.
notes.ur: Teesri party ki Hitachi code page par bhi B5 isi meaning ke saath documented hai.

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

codes.seriesName: Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A wired-controller alarm codes (SMGB0136)

title.en: Indoor PCB to fan controller communication fault
title.ur: Indoor PCB se fan controller ki communication kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor board cannot communicate with the indoor fan controller.
meaning.ur: Indoor board indoor fan controller se baat nahi kar pa raha

causes.en: Communication failure between the boards.
causes.ur: Boards ke darmiyan communication nakaam hai

causes.en: Communication cable disconnected or abnormally connected.
causes.ur: Communication cable disconnect ho gayi ya ghalat tareeke se lagi hai

solutions.en: Check and re-seat the communication cable.
solutions.ur: Communication cable check kar ke dobara lagayein

solutions.en: Replace the indoor PCB or fan controller if the link stays down.
solutions.ur: Rabta barqar na rahe to indoor PCB ya fan controller badal dein

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

codes.seriesName: Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A wired-controller alarm codes (SMGB0136)

title.ur: Do fan board ki transmission kharabi

meaning.en: Transmission between the indoor board and the two-fan PCB is abnormal.
meaning.ur: Indoor board aur do fan PCB ke darmiyan transmission kharabi hai

causes.en: Link between indoor and the two-fan PCB broken.
causes.ur: Indoor aur do fan PCB ka rabta toota hua hai

causes.en: Fan PCB or wiring failure.
causes.ur: Fan PCB ya wiring kharab hai

solutions.en: Check the connection harness between the boards.
solutions.ur: Do board ke darmiyan connection harness check karein

solutions.en: Replace the two-fan PCB if the link stays down.
solutions.ur: Agar link bar bar girta rahe to do fan wali PCB badal dein

notes.en: Dual-fan indoor models only.
notes.ur: Sirf dual-fan indoor models ke liye hai.

meaning.en: The number of connected sub-PCBs is wrong.
meaning.ur: Connected sub-PCBs ki tadad ghalat hai

causes.en: Sub-PCB missing or an extra board detected.
causes.ur: Sub PCB mojood nahi ya aik azaf board detect ho gaya

causes.en: Wiring or detection fault on the expansion boards.
causes.ur: Expansion boards par wiring ya detection ki kharabi

solutions.en: Count the installed sub-PCBs and check their connectors.
solutions.ur: Lagaye huay sub PCB ki tadaad ginen aur un ke connectors check karein

solutions.en: Correct the hardware fitment and clear the alarm.
solutions.ur: Hardware ki fitting theek karein aur alarm clear karein

notes.en: New in this service-manual generation, absent from the SET FREE / air365 table used earlier in this file.
notes.ur: Is service-manual generation mein naya code hai; is file mein phele wali SET FREE / air365 table mein maujood nahi.

codes.seriesName: Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A wired-controller alarm codes (SMGB0136)

meaning.en: The system locked out after repeat compressor-related alarms and this alarm cannot be cleared from the wired controller.
meaning.ur: Compressor se juray huay alarms baar baar aane par system lock ho gaya, aur yeh alarm wired controller se clear nahi hota

causes.en: Alarms 02, 07, 08, 39, 43, 44, 45 or 47 occurred three times within six hours.
causes.ur: 6 ghante mein 02, 07, 08, 39, 43, 44, 45 ya 47 alarm teen bar a chuke hain

causes.en: An unresolved protection condition keeps re-triggering.
causes.ur: Jis ki wajah pata nahi chali protection baar baar dobara trigger ho rahi hai

solutions.en: Find and clear the underlying protection cause before resetting.
solutions.ur: Reset se pehle asal protection ki wajah dhoond kar theek karein

solutions.en: Replace the faulty outdoor component that keeps tripping the alarm.
solutions.ur: Alarm ko baar baar trip karne wala kharab outdoor hissa badal dein

notes.en: Trigger list in this manual is 02, 07, 08, 39, 43 to 45 and 47; the SET FREE / air365 table in this file lists 02, 07, 08, 45 and 47 only.
notes.ur: Is manual ki trigger list 02, 07, 08, 39, 43 se 45 aur 47 hai; is file ki SET FREE / air365 table sirf 02, 07, 08, 45 aur 47 leti hai.

source.title: Hitachi SERVICE MANUAL Utopia / IVX / Prime R32 & R410A (SMGB0136), 10.2.2.1

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.en: Serial communication error / panel communication error
title.ur: Serial communication kharab / panel communication kharab

meaning.en: Communication between the control board, fan board, inverter board or a cleaning-unit board has failed.
meaning.ur: Control board, fan board, inverter board ya cleaning unit board ke darmiyan communication kharab ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Wire breakage or contact failure of connectors CN4A/CN4B (fan board CN80), or CN4/CN2 (INV board)
causes.ur: CN4A/CN4B (fan board CN80) ya CN4/CN2 (INV board) connectors ki wire tooti hui ho ya contact na ban raha ho.

causes.en: Electrical interference causing irregular LED blink, or a loose power/communication wire to the cleaning-unit board
causes.ur: Electrical interference ki wajah se LED blink irregular ho, ya cleaning-unit board ki power/communication wire dhili ho.

solutions.en: Check the listed connectors and cables, then power off and power back on
solutions.ur: Pehle diye gaye connectors aur cables check karein, phir power off karke dobara power on karein.

solutions.en: If the error persists, replace the implicated board (cleaning-unit board or indoor unit board / INV board)
solutions.ur: Agar error khatam na ho to yeh wala board badlein: cleaning-unit board ya indoor unit board / INV board.

notes.en: S8 documents the same code as City Multi '403 — comms fault between boards'. Parenthesised values are preliminary codes.
notes.ur: S8 mein isi code ko City Multi '403 — boards ke darmiyan comms fault' ke tor par document kiya hai. Bracket ke andar diye gaye values preliminary codes hain.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.ur: Discharge temperature bohat zyada badh jana

meaning.en: Discharge temperature has exceeded the limit (110°C+) — typically short of refrigerant or a discharge thermistor problem.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature limit (110°C+) se zyada ho gayi hai — aam tor par refrigerant kam ya discharge thermistor ki kharabi.

causes.en: Short of refrigerant / gas leak, or service valve not fully open
causes.ur: Refrigerant/gas kam ho ya leak ho, ya service valve puri tarah khula na ho.

causes.en: Defective discharge thermistor TH4, or indoor/outdoor LEV not operating
causes.ur: Discharge thermistor TH4 kharab ho, ya indoor/outdoor LEV theek se kaam na kar raha ho.

causes.en: Outdoor fan problem or abnormal operating conditions
causes.ur: Outdoor fan mein masla ho ya operating conditions gair mamooli hon.

solutions.en: Check the refrigerant charge, confirm the service valve is fully open and inspect the outdoor fan
solutions.ur: Pehle refrigerant charge check karein, service valve puri tarah khula hona confirm karein aur outdoor fan ko dekhein.

solutions.en: Check indoor and outdoor LEV operation and measure thermistor TH4
solutions.ur: Indoor aur outdoor LEV ka kaam check karein aur thermistor TH4 ki resistance naapiye.

notes.en: S8: 'Discharge temperature has exceeded 110°C or more. Short of refrigerant.' Maps to Mr. Slim U2.
notes.ur: S8: 'Discharge temperature 110°C ya us se zyada ho gaya. Refrigerant kam hai.' Is ka matlab Mr. Slim U2 hai.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

meaning.en: The low pressure sensor read less than 1 bar immediately before start-up.
meaning.ur: Start hone se foran pehle low pressure sensor ne 1 bar se kam parya karha.

causes.en: Low charge / gas leak
causes.ur: Gas kam ho ya leak ho.

causes.en: Blocked filter, closed valve or a faulty low-pressure sensor
causes.ur: Filter band ho, valve band ho ya low-pressure sensor kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check the low-pressure sensor reading against gauge pressure and repair any leak
solutions.ur: Low-pressure sensor ki reading gauge pressure se compare karein aur leak ko theek karein.

solutions.en: Check filters, valves and the sensor wiring before re-starting
solutions.ur: Dobara start karne se pehle filters, valves aur sensor ki wiring check karein.

notes.en: Present in V4 and S8 (R22/R407c columns).
notes.ur: Yeh V4 aur S8 (R22/R407c columns) mein maujood hai.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

meaning.en: System high pressure exceeds the limit (S8: >29 bar R407c, >38 bar R410A) or the high-pressure sensor disagrees with gauge pressure.
meaning.ur: System ka high pressure limit se zyada ho gaya hai (S8: >29 bar R407c, >38 bar R410A) ya high pressure sensor ki parya gauge pressure se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Dirty/blocked outdoor heat exchanger or faulty outdoor fan
causes.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger ganda/band ho ya outdoor fan kharab ho.

causes.en: Stop valve not fully open, SV1a or LEV2 problem, indoor short air cycle
causes.ur: Stop valve puri tarah khula na ho, SV1a ya LEV2 ka masla ho, ya indoor mein short air cycle ho.

causes.en: Defective high-pressure sensor or its input circuit
causes.ur: High-pressure sensor kharab ho ya us ki input circuit kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check the outdoor fan, clean the heat exchanger and confirm the service valves are fully open
solutions.ur: Pehle outdoor fan check karein, heat exchanger saaf karein aur confirm karein ke service valves puri tarah khule hain.

solutions.en: Compare the high-pressure sensor reading with gauge pressure and check LEV2 / SV1a
solutions.ur: High-pressure sensor ki reading gauge pressure se milayein aur LEV2 / SV1a check karein.

notes.en: V4 check list also references thermistors TH3/TH7 and input voltage at TB1.
notes.ur: V4 check list mein thermistor TH3/TH7 aur TB1 par input voltage ka zikr bhi hai.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.en: Refrigerant overcharge / abnormal low compressor superheat

meaning.en: The system is overcharged, giving abnormally low compressor superheat.
meaning.ur: System mein refrigerant zyada bhara hai, jis se compressor ka superheat abnormal low ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Excessive refrigerant charge
causes.ur: Refrigerant charge zyada ho jana.

causes.en: LEV1/LEV2 or indoor LEV not metering correctly
causes.ur: LEV1/LEV2 ya indoor LEV theek se refrigerant meter na kar raha ho.

causes.en: Twinning-pipe kit fitted incorrectly
causes.ur: Twinning-pipe kit galat tareeqe se lagi ho.

solutions.en: Recover refrigerant to the specified charge and check LEV1/LEV2 operation
solutions.ur: Refrigerant ko specified charge tak wapas lein aur LEV1/LEV2 ka kaam check karein.

solutions.en: Verify the twinning-pipe kit against the installation manual
solutions.ur: Twinning-pipe kit ko installation manual se compare karke verify karein.

notes.en: S8 wording: 'System overcharge. Abnormal low compressor superheat — discharge thermistor TH4'.
notes.ur: S8 ka alfaz: 'System overcharge hai. Compressor ki superheat abnormal tor par low — discharge thermistor TH4'.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.en: Drain pump fault / water level in drip tray while cooling
title.ur: Drain pump kharab / cooling ke dauran drip tray mein pani ka level

meaning.en: Water level was detected in the drip tray during cooling operation while the drain pump should be removing it.
meaning.ur: Cooling ke dauran drip tray mein pani ka level mila, jabke drain pump ko yeh nikalna chahiye tha.

causes.en: Drain pump not working, no power to it, or blocked drain
causes.ur: Drain pump chal na raha ho, us mein power na aa rahi ho, ya drain block ho.

causes.en: Temperature sensor circuit fault (open/closed) or float switch stuck
causes.ur: Temperature sensor circuit kharab ho (open/closed) ya float switch atka ho jaye.

causes.en: Valve leak on the indoor unit
causes.ur: Indoor unit ki valve leak kar rahi ho.

solutions.en: Check the drain pump operation, supply and the drain path for blockage
solutions.ur: Drain pump ka kaam, supply aur drain path ko blockage ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: Check the float switch resistance with the switch open and closed, and check the indoor unit valves for leaks
solutions.ur: Float switch ko khula aur band karke us ki resistance check karein, aur indoor unit valves mein leak ke liye dekhein.

notes.en: S8 also documents 2503 (float-sensor variant) and 2500 (lack of water flow on a water circuit).
notes.ur: S8 mein yeh dono bhi document kiye gaye hain: 2503 (float-sensor variant) aur 2500 (water circuit mein flow ki kami).

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.ur: Power ka ek phase missing ho gaya hai

meaning.en: One phase is missing at the power supply terminal block.
meaning.ur: Power supply ke terminal block mein se ek phase mojood nahi hai.

causes.en: Incoming supply missing a phase, blown fuse, or noise-filter/wiring fault
causes.ur: Aane wali supply mein ek phase missing ho, fuse uda ho, ya noise-filter/wiring mein kharabi ho.

causes.en: Low voltage at CN3 / CNAC (below 198 V) or a short/earth fault on the control board
causes.ur: CN3 / CNAC par voltage low ho (198 V se neeche), ya control board par short/earth fault ho.

solutions.en: Check input voltage at TB1 and at CN3/CNAC (must be ≥198 V); check the F01 fuse on the control board
solutions.ur: TB1 aur CN3/CNAC par input voltage check karein (kam se kam 198 V hona chahiye); control board ka F01 fuse bhi check karein.

solutions.en: Check wiring between noise-filter board CN3/CN2 and control board CNAC, and the INV board SC-L1/L2/L3 wiring
solutions.ur: Noise-filter board CN3/CN2 aur control board CNAC ke darmiyan wiring check karein, aur INV board ki SC-L1/L2/L3 wiring bhi dekhein.

notes.en: New in V4 (20250819r1) — not present in V3. Very relevant to PK 3-phase supply quality.
notes.ur: Yeh V4 (20250819r1) mein naya hai — V3 mein nahi tha. PK ki 3-phase supply quality ke liye bohat ahem hai.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

meaning.en: The transmission-line power supply circuit is faulty on one or more outdoor units.
meaning.ur: Transmission line power supply ka circuit ek ya zyada outdoor units par kharab hai.

causes.en: Fault in the transmission power supply circuit on an outdoor unit
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ke transmission power supply circuit mein kharabi ho.

causes.en: Wiring fault, high current or incorrect voltage on the transmission line / M-Net board
causes.ur: Transmission line / M-Net board par wiring kharab ho, current zyada ho ya voltage theek na ho.

solutions.en: Check the transmission power supply circuit on every outdoor unit in the refrigerant circuit
solutions.ur: Refrigerant circuit ke har outdoor unit par transmission power supply circuit check karein.

solutions.en: Check transmission line wiring and voltage, and the M-Net board
solutions.ur: Transmission line ki wiring aur voltage check karein, aur M-Net board ko bhi dekhein.

notes.en: New in V4. S8 documents 4106 as a City Multi transmission power supply fault (R410A column).
notes.ur: V4 mein naya hai. S8 ne 4106 ko City Multi ka transmission power supply fault bataya hai (R410A column).

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.ur: Fan ke chalne ki status pakadne mein ghalti

meaning.en: The unit cannot confirm that its fan is running as commanded.
meaning.ur: Unit yeh confirm nahi kar pa raha keh fan command ke mutabiq chal raha hai.

causes.en: Coil or wiring of the auxiliary relay on CN28 is faulty
causes.ur: CN28 par lage auxiliary relay ki coil ya wiring kharab ho.

causes.en: Connector not properly connected, or the control-board fuse is open
causes.ur: Connector theek se laga na ho, ya control-board ka fuse khula (blown) ho.

causes.en: Fan motor not operating in test-run mode
causes.ur: Fan motor test-run mode mein chal na raha ho.

solutions.en: Check the CN28 connector and the control-circuit fuse
solutions.ur: CN28 connector aur control-circuit fuse check karein.

solutions.en: Run the unit in test-run mode; if the fan still does not run, replace the fan motor
solutions.ur: Unit ko test-run mode mein chalayein; agar phir bhi fan chal na raha to fan motor badlein.

notes.en: New in V4; applies to the indoor/damper side fan detection.
notes.ur: V4 mein naya hai; yeh indoor/damper side ki fan detection par lagu hota hai.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.ur: RPM ki ghalti / motor ki ghalti

meaning.en: The motor's reported RPM does not match the command, or the motor has failed.
meaning.ur: Motor ka report kiya hua RPM command se match nahi karta, ya motor kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Motor or solenoid switch fault
causes.ur: Motor ya solenoid switch mein kharabi ho.

causes.en: Board fault
causes.ur: Board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check the motor and the solenoid switch
solutions.ur: Motor aur solenoid switch ko check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the board if the motor tests good
solutions.ur: Agar motor ki test theek aaye to board badlein.

notes.en: New in V4. S8 also has 4116 'Fan motor abnormal — relates to indoor unit or Lossnay'.
notes.ur: V4 mein naya hai. S8 mein bhi 4116 hai 'Fan motor abnormal — indoor unit ya Lossnay se related'.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

meaning.en: A function-setting switch or connector on the control board is set incorrectly.
meaning.ur: Control board par function setting wala switch ya connector ghalat tarah se set kiya gaya hai.

causes.en: SW6-1 setting on the control board is wrong
causes.ur: Control board par SW6-1 ki setting galat hai.

causes.en: Something is connected to connector CNAF that should not be
causes.ur: CNAF connector par koi aisi cheez lagi hai jo nahi lagni chahiye.

solutions.en: Correct SW6-1 and confirm nothing is plugged into CNAF
solutions.ur: SW6-1 theek karein aur confirm karein ke CNAF par kuch laga na ho.

solutions.en: Replace the control board if both checks pass and the error remains
solutions.ur: Agar dono checks theek ho jayein aur error phir bhi rahe to control board badlein.

notes.en: New in V4.
notes.ur: Yeh code V4 mein naya shamil kiya gaya hai.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.en: Electric system not operating due to damper abnormality
title.ur: Damper ki kharabi ki wajah se electric system nahi chal raha

meaning.en: A damper (lock motor ML1/ML2 or damper motor MV2) is obstructed or its limit switches are faulty.
meaning.ur: Damper (lock motor ML1/ML2 ya damper motor MV2) mein rokawat hai ya us ke limit switches kharab hain.

causes.en: Something physically obstructing the damper's opening/closing movement
causes.ur: Damper ke khulne aur band hone mein koi cheez atki ho.

causes.en: Damper lock motor or damper motor winding out of specification (ML1/ML2 235–255 Ω, MV2 282–306 Ω)
causes.ur: Damper lock motor ya damper motor ki winding specification se bahar ho (ML1/ML2 235–255 Ω, MV2 282–306 Ω).

causes.en: Damper limit switch or indoor electronic control P.C. board fault
causes.ur: Damper limit switch ya indoor electronic control P.C. board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Remove the obstruction, power off and measure ML1/ML2 and MV2 resistance against the specified ranges
solutions.ur: Pehle rukawat hata dein, power off karein aur ML1/ML2 aur MV2 ki resistance specified range se naapein.

solutions.en: Measure CN1X1/CN1Y1 voltages (0 V/5 V logic) during open and close to identify a bad limit switch versus a bad board
solutions.ur: Damper khulne aur band hone ke doran CN1X1/CN1Y1 voltages naapein (0 V/5 V logic) — is se pata chalega ke limit switch kharab hai ya board.

notes.en: New in V4 with full measurement procedure — ducted/cassette PK installs with motorised dampers.
notes.ur: V4 mein poore measurement procedure ke sath naya hai — PK ki ducted/cassette installs jin mein motorised dampers lage hain.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.en: Bus voltage drop / rise / startup fault
title.ur: Bus voltage upar-neeche ya startup par kam hona

meaning.en: Inverter bus voltage has dropped or risen outside limits, the control power supply failed, or a logic error occurred.
meaning.ur: Inverter bus voltage limit se bahar gir gaya ya barh gaya, control power supply kharab ho gayi, ya logic error aa gaya.

causes.en: Mains supply out of range (V4 checks L1-L2, L2-L3, L1-L3 ≤342 V across all phases)
causes.ur: Mains supply range se bahar ho (V4 mein L1-L2, L2-L3, L1-L3 sabhi phases par ≤342 V check kiya jata hai).

causes.en: Faulty inverter board (4220), fan board (4225/4226), noise filter or control board
causes.ur: Inverter board (4220), fan board (4225/4226), noise filter ya control board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Measure the three-phase supply and correct it (fit/verify a stabiliser or transformer where the mains swings)
solutions.ur: Three-phase supply naapein aur theek karein (jahan mains upar-neeche ho, stabiliser ya transformer lagayein/verify karein).

solutions.en: Check inverter board, noise filter, fan board and control board; replace INV board for 4220 and fan board for 4225/4226 if the fault recurs
solutions.ur: Inverter board, noise filter, fan board aur control board check karein; agar fault wapas aaye to 4220 ke liye INV board aur 4225/4226 ke liye fan board badlein.

notes.en: S8 gives thresholds: 'less than 289 Vdc detected — check mains supply' (4220) and 300 Vdc at CNVdc (4225).
notes.ur: S8 ke thresholds: '289 Vdc se kam mile — mains supply check karein' (4220) aur CNVdc par 300 Vdc (4225).

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.ur: Heatsink zyada garm hone ki protection

meaning.en: The inverter heatsink temperature has exceeded the protection limit.
meaning.ur: Inverter heatsink ki temperature protection limit se zyada ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Blocked heat-sink cooling air passage
causes.ur: Heat sink ki cooling air passage band ho gayi ho, hawa na guzre.

causes.en: Fan inverter board or outdoor unit fan failure
causes.ur: Fan inverter board kharab ho ya outdoor unit fan band ho jaye.

causes.en: Improper installation of the INV board IGBT, or a failed thermistor
causes.ur: INV board IGBT theek se install na hua ho, ya thermistor fail ho jaye.

solutions.en: Clear the air passage around the heat sink and check the outdoor fan
solutions.ur: Heat sink ke ird-gird ki air passage saaf karein aur outdoor fan check karein.

solutions.en: Check the fan inverter board and the IGBT mounting; replace the thermistor/board if readings are wrong
solutions.ur: Fan inverter board aur IGBT ki fitting check karein; agar readings galat hon to thermistor/board badlein.

notes.en: S8 threshold: 'High temperature (85°C) on heat sink on inverter'.
notes.ur: S8 ka threshold: 'Inverter ke heat sink par high temperature (85°C)'.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

meaning.en: High current has persisted beyond the allowed time, or a model-selection switch setting is wrong.
meaning.ur: High current ki condition ijazat time se zyada der rahi, ya model selection switch ki setting ghalat hai.

causes.en: Heat-sink cooling air passage blocked
causes.ur: Heat sink ki cooling air passage block ho gayi ho.

causes.en: Power supply voltage at or above 342 V
causes.ur: Power supply voltage 342 V ya us se zyada ho.

causes.en: Wrong model-selection dip switch setting (SW5-3…SW5-8) or inverter/compressor fault
causes.ur: Model-selection dip switch setting galat ho (SW5-3…SW5-8), ya inverter/compressor mein masla ho.

solutions.en: Clear the heat-sink airflow and verify the supply voltage
solutions.ur: Heat sink ki airflow saaf karein aur supply voltage verify karein.

solutions.en: Re-check SW5-3…SW5-8 model selection, then test the inverter and compressor
solutions.ur: SW5-3…SW5-8 model selection dobara check karein, phir inverter aur compressor test karein.

notes.en: S8: 'Over current protection. If high current is detected for more than 10 minutes'.
notes.ur: S8: 'Over current protection. Agar high current 10 minute se zyada detect ho.'

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.en: IPM error / short-circuit or instantaneous overcurrent
title.ur: IPM error / short circuit ya foran overcurrent

meaning.en: The inverter power module reports an IPM error, a ground fault, a shorted motor or an instantaneous overcurrent.
meaning.ur: Inverter power module IPM error, ground fault, motor ka short ya foran overcurrent ki khabar de raha hai.

causes.en: Compressor wiring loose, disconnected or shorted to earth
causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring dhili ho, khuli ho ya earth se short ho jaye.

causes.en: Defective compressor, defective outdoor power circuit board or fan inverter board
causes.ur: Compressor kharab ho, outdoor power circuit board kharab ho ya fan inverter board kharab ho.

causes.en: Wrong model-selection dip switch setting (SW5-3…SW5-8)
causes.ur: Model-selection dip switch setting galat ho (SW5-3…SW5-8).

solutions.en: Check inverter, compressor and IGBT; tighten and verify compressor wiring
solutions.ur: Inverter, compressor aur IGBT check karein; compressor ki wiring ko kassi karke theek se verify karein.

solutions.en: Verify the SW5-3…SW5-8 model selection and replace the failed board/compressor after isolation
solutions.ur: SW5-3…SW5-8 model selection verify karein aur power isolate karne ke baad kharab board/compressor badlein.

notes.en: 4250/4255/4256 are grouped by V4 under 'Backup operation' with a shared check procedure. A PK technician video exists for City Multi 4350 (preliminary of 4250).
notes.ur: V4 mein 4250/4255/4256 ko 'Backup operation' ke tehat ek sath rakha gaya hai jis mein shared check procedure hai. City Multi 4350 (4250 ka preliminary) par PK technician ki video bhi maujood hai.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.en: Temperature sensor fault — indoor unit thermistors
title.ur: Temperature sensor kharab — indoor unit ke thermistors

meaning.en: An indoor thermistor (TH21 return air, TH22 pipe, TH23 gas-side pipe, TH24 outside temperature) is open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Indoor ka koi thermistor (TH21 return air, TH22 pipe, TH23 gas side pipe, TH24 outside temperature) open ya short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Thermistor disconnected from its holder or from the board
causes.ur: Thermistor apne holder se ya board se alag ho jaye.

causes.en: Thermistor characteristic defect or pinched/damaged lead wire
causes.ur: Thermistor ki characteristic kharab ho ya lead wire chubri/damaged ho.

solutions.en: Check the thermistor resistance: 0°C 15 kΩ, 10°C 9.7 kΩ, 20°C 6.4 kΩ, 30°C 4.3 kΩ, 40°C 3.1 kΩ
solutions.ur: Thermistor ki resistance check karein: 0°C par 15 kΩ, 10°C par 9.7 kΩ, 20°C par 6.4 kΩ, 30°C par 4.3 kΩ, 40°C par 3.1 kΩ.

solutions.en: Check connector contact and the lead wire; if no fault is found, the indoor board has failed
solutions.ur: Connector ka contact aur lead wire check karein; agar koi kharabi na mile to indoor board fail ho chuka hai.

notes.en: 5101–5104 are indoor-side; 5102/5103/5106/5107/5115 also cover outdoor thermistors (TH2/TH3/TH4/TH6/TH7/TH15). Always read the fault-code address to know which unit.
notes.ur: 5101–5104 indoor side ke hain; 5102/5103/5106/5107/5115 outdoor thermistors (TH2/TH3/TH4/TH6/TH7/TH15) par bhi aate hain. Kis unit ka masla hai yeh janne ke liye hamesha fault-code address parhein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

meaning.en: The inverter heatsink temperature thermistor THHS is open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Heatsink temperature thermistor THHS open ya short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: THHS thermistor disconnected or failed
causes.ur: THHS thermistor khud juda ho gaya ho ya fail ho jaye.

causes.en: Inverter board fault
causes.ur: Inverter board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check the THHS thermistor resistance and its connector
solutions.ur: THHS thermistor ki resistance aur us ka connector check karein.

solutions.en: If the fault recurs when the unit is put back into operation, replace the INV board
solutions.ur: Agar unit ko dobara chalane par fault wapas aaye to INV board badlein.

notes.en: S8 lists 5110 as 'TH10 open/short circuit' in the R22/R407c columns and 'THHS' in the PWFY table — read the unit context.
notes.ur: S8 mein 5110 ko R22/R407c columns mein 'TH10 open/short circuit' aur PWFY table mein 'THHS' likha hai — unit ka context parhein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

meaning.en: The high-pressure sensor reading disagrees with gauge pressure or the sensor/circuit has failed.
meaning.ur: High pressure sensor ki parya gauge pressure se match nahi karti, ya sensor/circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Defective high-pressure sensor (63HS1)
causes.ur: High-pressure sensor (63HS1) kharab ho.

causes.en: Pressure drop from gas leak, or connector/input-circuit fault
causes.ur: Gas leak ki wajah se pressure girta ho, ya connector/input circuit mein kharabi ho.

solutions.en: Compare the sensor reading with gauge pressure and check the connector
solutions.ur: Sensor ki reading gauge pressure se compare karein aur connector check karein.

solutions.en: Repair any leak and verify the input circuit on the outdoor controller board
solutions.ur: Jo bhi leak ho use theek karein aur outdoor controller board par input circuit verify karein.

notes.en: Also documented by S8 (5201 pressure sensor fault at outdoor unit / BC box).
notes.ur: S8 ne bhi isay document kiya hai (5201 — outdoor unit / BC box par pressure sensor fault).

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.en: ACCT sensor / current sensor circuit fault
title.ur: ACCT sensor / current sensor ka circuit kharab

meaning.en: The ACCT current sensor or its circuit is faulty, or its connector is open/loose.
meaning.ur: ACCT current sensor ya us ka circuit kharab hai, ya us ka connector open/loose hai.

causes.en: Open-circuited IPM / loose ACCT connector (CNCT2 on the INV board)
causes.ur: IPM open circuit ho, ya ACCT connector dhila ho (INV board par CNCT2).

causes.en: Faulty ACCT wiring or sensor
causes.ur: ACCT ki wiring ya sensor kharab ho.

causes.en: Inverter/compressor fault
causes.ur: Inverter/compressor mein masla ho.

solutions.en: Check connector CNCT2 and the output wire for proper connection
solutions.ur: CNCT2 connector aur output wire ko theek se juda hona check karein.

solutions.en: Check inverter and compressor; replace the INV board if the problem persists after resuming operation
solutions.ur: Inverter aur compressor check karein; operation dobara shuru karne ke baad bhi masla rahe to INV board badlein.

notes.en: S8 adds the bench value: 'should read 280 ohms between pins 1 & 2 and across pins 3 & 4' for 4245.
notes.ur: S8 mein 4245 ke liye bench value bhi di gayi hai: 'pins 1 & 2 ke darmiyan aur pins 3 & 4 par 280 ohms aana chahiye'.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

meaning.en: Two or more units on the system carry the same address.
meaning.ur: System par do ya zyada units ka address aik hi hai.

causes.en: Duplicated addressing after commissioning or a board swap
causes.ur: Commissioning ya board change ke baad address duplicate ho jaye.

causes.en: Noise interference on indoor/outdoor connectors
causes.ur: Indoor/outdoor connectors par noise interference ho.

solutions.en: Re-assign unique addresses to the conflicting units and power-cycle
solutions.ur: Conflict wali units ko unique addresses dein aur unit ka power cycle karein.

solutions.en: If the units run normally the error may be accidental — clear it and re-read
solutions.ur: Agar units theek se chal rahe hon to yeh error galti ka ho sakta hai — isay clear karke dobara parhein.

notes.en: Same condition as Mr. Slim A-control A0.
notes.ur: Yeh condition Mr. Slim A-control A0 jaisi hi hai.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.ur: Line par koi jawab nahi mila

meaning.en: A unit on the transmission line did not acknowledge — the addressed controller did not respond.
meaning.ur: Transmission line par kisi unit ne jawab nahi diya — jise address diya gaya tha us controller ne jawab nahi diya.

causes.en: Address switch changed while powered, or the addressed unit does not exist
causes.ur: Power on rehte hue address switch badal gaya ho, ya diya gaya address kisi unit par mojood hi na ho.

causes.en: Transmission voltage/signal drop: farthest unit >200 m, remote-controller line >12 m, wrong wire type/diameter (<1.25 mm²), too many units
causes.ur: Transmission voltage/signal girna: sab se door wali unit >200 m, remote-controller line >12 m, wire ka type/diameter galat (<1.25 mm²), units bohat zyada.

causes.en: Noise or lightning surge, or a defective controller
causes.ur: Noise ya lightning surge ho, ya controller kharab ho.

solutions.en: Turn the units off for 5 or more minutes, then on again and re-read the code
solutions.ur: Units ko 5 ya zyada minute band rakhein, phir on karein aur code dobara parhein.

solutions.en: Check transmission line voltage (~25 V), wire type (CVVS/CPEVS/MVVS) and diameter ≥1.25 mm², and confirm addresses/connectors (CN2M) are correct
solutions.ur: Transmission line voltage (~25 V), wire type (CVVS/CPEVS/MVVS) aur diameter ≥1.25 mm² check karein, aur addresses/connectors (CN2M) sahi hain yeh confirm karein.

notes.en: V4 splits 6607 by cause: outdoor side, indoor side, remote-controller side, Fresh Master side, Lossnay side and 'controller not recognised'.
notes.ur: V4 mein 6607 ko wajah ke hisab se toda gaya hai: outdoor side, indoor side, remote-controller side, Fresh Master side, Lossnay side aur 'controller not recognised'.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.ur: Line se koi jawab nahi aaya

meaning.en: Continuous failure to receive a response frame — typically noise or an out-of-spec transmission line.
meaning.ur: Jawab frame milna barqarar nahi raha — aam tor par noayz ya transmission line ki specification se bahar hone ki wajah se.

causes.en: Continuous transmission failure caused by noise
causes.ur: Noise ki wajah se transmission lagatar fail hota hai.

causes.en: Line length/diameter/type out of specification
causes.ur: Line ki length/diameter/type specification se bahar ho.

causes.en: Accidental malfunction of the error-source controller
causes.ur: Galti se error-source controller ne theek se kaam karna band kar diya ho.

solutions.en: Power off for 5 minutes and re-read the code
solutions.ur: 5 minute ke liye power off rakhein aur code dobara parhein.

solutions.en: Verify farthest end <200 m, remote line <12 m, wire ≥1.25 mm², shielded type; remove noise sources
solutions.ur: Sab se door wala end <200 m, remote line <12 m, wire ≥1.25 mm², shielded type ho yeh verify karein; noise ke sources hata dein.

notes.en: V4 states plainly: 'Noise is the most possible cause of the error 6608'.
notes.ur: V4 saaf kehta hai: 'Error 6608 ki sab se mumkin wajah noise hai'.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

meaning.en: The sum of the connected indoor units' capacity codes exceeds the outdoor unit's allowed total.
meaning.ur: Lage hue indoor units ki capacity codes ka jama outdoor unit ki ijazat se zyada ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Qj total (capacity code total) of connected indoor units exceeds the limit
causes.ur: Jude hue indoor units ka Qj total (capacity code total) limit se zyada ho jaye.

causes.en: Wrong capacity code (SW2) on an indoor board
causes.ur: Indoor board par capacity code (SW2) galat ho.

causes.en: Wrong outdoor model-selection dip switch setting
causes.ur: Outdoor ka model-selection dip switch setting galat ho.

solutions.en: Check the Qj total and correct SW2 capacity codes on the indoor boards
solutions.ur: Qj total check karein aur indoor boards par SW2 ke capacity codes theek karein.

solutions.en: Re-check the outdoor SW5-3…SW5-8 model selection and confirm TB3 connections between OC and OS
solutions.ur: Outdoor SW5-3…SW5-8 model selection dobara check karein aur OC aur OS ke darmiyan TB3 connections confirm karein.

notes.en: S8 threshold wording: 'R2 150% index exceeded / Y 130% index exceeded'.
notes.ur: S8 ka threshold: 'R2 150% index exceed / Y 130% index exceed kar gaya'.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes

title.ur: Lage hue units ki tadaad ghalat hai

meaning.en: More indoor units and branch boxes are connected than the outdoor unit allows.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit ki ijazat se zyada indoor units aur branch boxes lage hue hain.

causes.en: More than the limit connected (V4/PUMY: up to 12 indoor units and 2 branch boxes, at least 1 indoor unit)
causes.ur: Limit se zyada units jude hue hain (V4/PUMY: 12 indoor units aur 2 branch boxes tak, kam se kam 1 indoor unit).

causes.en: Transmission line for TB7 accidentally wired to TB3, or M-Net voltage lost (short/break)
causes.ur: TB7 ki transmission line galti se TB3 par lagi ho, ya M-Net voltage gayab ho (short/break).

solutions.en: Reduce the connection count within the limits and verify TB3/TB7 wiring on the outdoor unit
solutions.ur: Connection ki tadaad limit ke andar kar dein aur outdoor unit par TB3/TB7 wiring verify karein.

solutions.en: Check the outdoor model-selection switch (SW5-7) and the transmission line for shorts or breaks
solutions.ur: Outdoor model-selection switch (SW5-7) aur transmission line ko short/break ke liye check karein.

notes.en: S8 wording: 'Error in number of connected units — loss of M-Net voltage, no power to BC, wrong SW5 setting'.
notes.ur: S8 ka alfaz: 'Connected units ki tadaad mein error — M-Net voltage gayab, BC ko power na, SW5 setting galat'.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases)

meaning.en: Communication between the outdoor controller board and the outdoor power board has failed.
meaning.ur: Outdoor controller board aur outdoor power board ke darmiyan communication kharab ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Wire breakage or contact failure of connector CN2 or CN4
causes.ur: CN2 ya CN4 connector ki wire tooti hui ho ya contact na ban raha ho.

causes.en: Malfunction of the power-board communication circuit on the outdoor controller board
causes.ur: Outdoor controller board par power-board communication circuit theek se kaam na kare.

causes.en: Malfunction of the communication circuit on the outdoor power board
causes.ur: Outdoor power board par communication circuit kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check and re-seat connectors CN2 and CN4
solutions.ur: CN2 aur CN4 connectors check karein aur dobara theek se lagayein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle and re-read; replace the outdoor controller or outdoor power board if the fault persists
solutions.ur: Power cycle dein aur code dobara parhein; agar fault barqarar rahe to outdoor controller ya outdoor power board badlein.

notes.en: PUMY shows the 2-digit alias Ed on the check display.
notes.ur: PUMY check display par 2-digit alias Ed dikhata hai.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases)

meaning.en: Compressor/discharge temperature is out of range — stop valve, refrigerant shortage, thermistor or LEV related.
meaning.ur: Compressor/discharge temperature range se bahar hai — stop valve, refrigerant kam, thermistor ya LEV se related.

causes.en: Malfunction of the stop valve, or overheated operation from refrigerant shortage
causes.ur: Stop valve kharab ho, ya refrigerant ki kami ki wajah se unit overheat ho kar chale.

causes.en: Defective thermistor, defective outdoor controller board, or LEV performance failure
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab ho, outdoor controller board kharab ho, ya LEV theek se kaam na kare.

causes.en: Clogged refrigerant system, or liquid accumulation in the compressor while indoor units are OFF
causes.ur: Refrigerant system block ho, ya indoor units band hone par compressor mein liquid jama ho jaye.

solutions.en: Open the stop valves, check the refrigerant circuit/charge and inspect LEV operation
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein, refrigerant circuit/charge check karein aur LEV ke kaam ko dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure the thermistors and replace the defective outdoor controller or indoor controller board as indicated
solutions.ur: Har thermistor ki resistance naapein aur jo outdoor controller ya indoor controller board kharab ho use badlein.

notes.en: V4 gives 8 numbered causes for this code — the fullest single entry in the City Multi set.
notes.ur: V4 mein is code ke liye 8 numbered causes diye gaye hain — City Multi set mein sab se poori entry.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases)

meaning.en: High pressure is out of range or the high-pressure detection circuit is faulty.
meaning.ur: High pressure range se bahar hai ya high pressure detection circuit kharab hai.

causes.en: Stop valve not fully open, clogged/broken pipe, or locked outdoor fan motor
causes.ur: Stop valve puri tarah khula na ho, pipe block/toota ho, ya outdoor fan motor atka ho jaye.

causes.en: Dirty outdoor heat exchanger, indoor short air cycle, clogged filter or locked indoor fan
causes.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger ganda ho, indoor mein short air cycle ho, filter block ho ya indoor fan atka ho.

causes.en: Defective high-pressure sensor or its input circuit, indoor LEV or SV1 performance failure
causes.ur: High-pressure sensor ya uski input circuit kharab ho, ya indoor LEV/SV1 theek se kaam na kare.

solutions.en: Open the service valves, clean the heat exchangers/filters and confirm both fans run
solutions.ur: Service valves kholein, heat exchangers/filters saaf karein aur confirm karein ke dono fans chal rahe hain.

solutions.en: Compare the high-pressure sensor with gauge pressure and check LEV/SV1 operation
solutions.ur: High-pressure sensor ko gauge pressure se compare karein aur LEV/SV1 ka kaam check karein.

notes.en: V4 lists 17 numbered causes — by far the most detailed high-pressure entry available.
notes.ur: V4 mein 17 numbered causes diye gaye hain — high-pressure ke liye yeh sab se tafseeli entry hai.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases)

title.en: Superheat due to low discharge temperature
title.ur: Discharge temperature kam hone ki wajah se superheat

meaning.en: Discharge temperature is too low, giving abnormal superheat.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature bohat kam hai, jis se superheat abnormal ho gaya hai.

causes.en: TH4 disconnected, loose or its holder defective
causes.ur: TH4 khud juda ho, dhila ho ya uska holder kharab ho.

causes.en: LEV coil or LEV connector disconnected
causes.ur: LEV coil ya LEV connector khud juda ho gaya ho.

causes.en: LEV performance failure
causes.ur: LEV theek se kaam na kare.

solutions.en: Check and re-seat TH4 and its holder, then measure resistance
solutions.ur: TH4 aur uske holder ko check karke dobara theek se lagayein, phir resistance naapein.

solutions.en: Check the LEV coil/connector and LEV operation; correct refrigerant charge if needed
solutions.ur: LEV coil/connector aur LEV ka kaam check karein; agar zaroorat ho to refrigerant charge theek karein.

notes.en: Equivalent of Mr. Slim U7.
notes.ur: Yeh code Mr. Slim U7 ke barabar hai.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases)

title.en: Refrigerant shortage / closed valve in cooling mode
title.ur: gys km hai ya oalo bnd hai

meaning.en: There is not enough refrigerant, or a liquid/gas valve is closed while cooling.
meaning.ur: Refrigerant kam hai, ya cooling ke dauran liquid/gas valve band ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Outdoor liquid/gas valve is closed
causes.ur: Outdoor liquid/gas valve band ho.

causes.en: Outdoor LEV (LEV-A) blocked
causes.ur: Outdoor LEV (LEV-A) block ho jaye.

causes.en: Gas leakage or shortage, defective thermistor or 63HS
causes.ur: Gas leak ya kami ho, thermistor kharab ho ya 63HS kharab ho.

solutions.en: Fully open the outdoor liquid and gas valves and confirm flow
solutions.ur: Outdoor liquid aur gas valves puri tarah kholein aur flow confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check LEV-A for blockage, leak-test and re-gas, then verify the thermistors and 63HS
solutions.ur: LEV-A mein blockage ke liye check karein, leak-test karke dobara gas bharein, phir thermistors aur 63HS verify karein.

notes.en: Two variants in V4: '<1601> (U2) refrigerant shortage' and '<1501> (U2) closed valve in cooling mode'.
notes.ur: V4 mein do versions hain: '<1601> (U2) refrigerant shortage' aur '<1501> (U2) cooling mode mein valve band'.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases)

title.en: Freeze protection of branch box or indoor unit
title.ur: Branch box ya indoor unit ki freeze protection

meaning.en: Freeze protection has operated at the branch box or indoor unit, indicating a refrigerant distribution problem.
meaning.ur: Branch box ya indoor unit par freeze protection chali hai, jo refrigerant ki distribution mein kharabi dikhati hai.

causes.en: Wrong piping connection between indoor unit and branch box
causes.ur: Indoor unit aur branch box ke darmiyan piping connection galat ho.

causes.en: Mis-wiring between indoor unit and branch box
causes.ur: Indoor unit aur branch box ke darmiyan wiring galat ho.

causes.en: Mis-wired or malfunctioning LEV in the branch box or indoor unit
causes.ur: Branch box ya indoor unit mein LEV galat laga ho ya theek se kaam na kare.

solutions.en: Verify the piping connections and wiring between the indoor unit and branch box
solutions.ur: Indoor unit aur branch box ke darmiyan piping connections aur wiring verify karein.

solutions.en: Check LEV wiring and operation in the branch box/indoor unit
solutions.ur: Branch box/indoor unit mein LEV ki wiring aur kaam check karein.

notes.en: 2-digit alias is P6 (same as Mr. Slim freeze/overheat). Present in V3; keep V3 as secondary reference.
notes.ur: 2-digit alias P6 hai (Mr. Slim freeze/overheat jaisa hi). Yeh V3 mein bhi hai; V3 ko secondary reference rakhein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases) [S4]

codes.seriesName: City Multi VRF outdoor PUMY-CP YKM/YBM 4-digit codes (+ 2-digit aliases)

title.ur: Heating mode mein 4-way valve ki kharabi

meaning.en: The 4-way reversing valve is not switching correctly during heating.
meaning.ur: 4-way reversing valve heating ke dauran theek se switch nahi ho raha.

causes.en: 4-way valve failure
causes.ur: 4-way valve kharab ho jaye.

causes.en: Disconnection or failure of the 4-way valve coil
causes.ur: 4-way valve coil khud juda ho jaye ya fail ho jaye.

causes.en: Clogged drain pipe, loose connectors or defective outdoor power circuit board
causes.ur: Drain pipe block ho, connectors dhile hon ya outdoor power circuit board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check the 4-way valve coil resistance and its connectors

solutions.en: Inspect the input circuit on the outdoor multi controller board and the outdoor power board
solutions.ur: Outdoor multi controller board aur outdoor power board par input circuit ko dekhein.

notes.en: New in V4 (was 1580 in V3) — heating-mode reverse-cycle faults.
notes.ur: Yeh V4 mein naya hai (V3 mein yeh 1580 tha) — heating-mode reverse-cycle faults.

meaning.ur: Pani ka leakage ya pani flow na hone ki condition detect ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Water circuit flow problem (PWFY/heat-recovery contexts)
causes.ur: Water circuit ka flow masla ho (PWFY/heat-recovery cases mein).

causes.ur: Drain path mein rukawat ho ya indoor side par pump ka masla ho.

solutions.en: Inspect the drainage and water circuit for blockages and confirm pump operation
solutions.ur: Drainage aur water circuit ko blockage ke liye dekhein aur pump ka kaam confirm karein.

solutions.ur: Fault clear karein aur dobara chalayein; reset karne se pehle pani baqi ho to check karein.

notes.en: S8 documents 2500 as 'Detecting lack of water flow on a water circuit' (R22/R410A columns) — confidence medium because the V4 entry is terse.
notes.ur: S8 mein 2500 ko 'water circuit mein flow ki kami ka pata lagana' (R22/R410A columns) likha hai — confidence medium hai kyunke V4 entry chhoti hai.

causes.ur: Drain pump fail ho jaye ya drain/tray block ho.

causes.ur: CN4F par float switch circuit kharab ho (open/closed).

solutions.en: Check the drain pump, clear the drain and clean the filter
solutions.ur: Drain pump check karein, drain kholein aur filter saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check the float switch connector CN4F and its open/closed resistance
solutions.ur: Float switch connector CN4F aur uski open/closed resistance check karein.

notes.en: 2-digit alias P5. S8 also documents 2503 (float sensor variant).
notes.ur: 2-digit alias P5 hai. S8 mein 2503 (float sensor wala version) bhi document hai.

meaning.ur: Compressor lock ho gaya hai aur start nahi ho sakta, is liye us ka kaam ruk gaya.

causes.en: Closed stop valve or decreased supply voltage
causes.ur: Stop valve band ho ya supply voltage kam ho jaye.

causes.en: Looseness, disconnection or reversed compressor wiring
causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring dhili ho, khuli ho ya ulti lage ho jaye.

causes.en: Incorrect DIP-SW model selection, defective compressor or defective outdoor power board
causes.ur: DIP-SW model selection galat ho, compressor kharab ho ya outdoor power board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Open the stop valves, check the supply voltage and verify the compressor wiring
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein, supply voltage check karein aur compressor ki wiring verify karein.

solutions.en: Check the SW5 model-selection switches; test compressor windings and the outdoor power board
solutions.ur: SW5 model-selection switches check karein; compressor ki windings aur outdoor power board test karein.

notes.en: 2-digit alias UF — same physical condition as Mr. Slim UF.
notes.ur: 2-digit alias UF — yeh wahi physical condition hai jo Mr. Slim UF mein hoti hai.

meaning.ur: Indoor fan command ke mutabiq nahi chal raha.

causes.en: Indoor fan motor failure or obstruction
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor fail ho jaye ya koi rukawat ho.

causes.en: Wiring/connector fault or indoor board fault
causes.ur: Wiring/connector mein masla ho ya indoor board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check the indoor fan motor, connector and airflow obstruction
solutions.ur: Indoor fan motor, connector aur airflow mein rukawat check karein.

notes.en: 2-digit alias Pb — same as Mr. Slim PB.
notes.ur: 2-digit alias Pb — bilkul wahi hai jo Mr. Slim PB hai.

title.ur: Compressor overcurrent ya 12 VDC supply kharab

meaning.en: Overcurrent at the compressor, or the 12 VDC supply on the power board has failed.
meaning.ur: Compressor par zyada current, ya power board ki 12 VDC supply kharab hai.

causes.en: Closed outdoor stop valve or decreased supply voltage
causes.ur: Outdoor stop valve band ho ya supply voltage kam ho jaye.

causes.en: Loose/disconnected/reversed compressor wiring, malfunction of indoor/outdoor fan
causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring dhili/ulti ho, ya indoor/outdoor fan theek se kaam na kare.

causes.en: Model-selection error on board replacement, defective compressor or outdoor power board
causes.ur: Board change karne par model-selection galat ho jaye, compressor kharab ho ya outdoor power board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Open the stop valves, check the supply voltage and re-terminate the compressor wiring
solutions.ur: Stop valves kholein, supply voltage check karein aur compressor ki wiring dobara theek se lagayein.

solutions.en: Verify the model-selection settings, then test the fans, compressor and outdoor power board
solutions.ur: Model-selection settings verify karein, phir fans, compressor aur outdoor power board test karein.

notes.en: 9 numbered causes in V4.
notes.ur: V4 mein is ke 9 numbered causes hain.
