meaning.ur: Parallel units ka current share barabar nahi.

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Uneven load share or loose parallel current link
causes.ur: Load share barabar nahi ya parallel current link dhila hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking parallel links and load distribution.
solutions.ur: Parallel links aur load distribution check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check the parallel cable connections and that the load is spread evenly; re-seat any loose link.
solutions.ur: Parallel cable ki connections check karein aur load barabar banta ho; koi link dhili ho to dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure each unit's output current with a clamp meter; a unit that still does not share must go to a technician.
solutions.ur: Har unit ka output current clamp meter se naap lein; jo unit share nahi kar rahi use technician ko dikhayein.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

codes.seriesName: Elego hybrid IP21/IP65/IP66 (6–15KW, Oyster, ELO-VI)

meaning.en: Parallel CAN comms fail.
meaning.ur: Parallel CAN fail.

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Loose or damaged CAN communication cable between units
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan CAN cable dhili ya kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before touching the CAN or parallel communication cable.
solutions.ur: CAN ya parallel communication cable chunein se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check both ends of the cable for loose plugs, damage or wrong daisy-chain order and re-seat them.
solutions.ur: Care ke dono kone loose, kharab ya ghalat order mein lage hain check karein aur dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Power cycle the whole parallel system together; if the CAN fault stays, a technician or repair centre is required.
solutions.ur: Poora parallel system saath mein ek baar restart karein; CAN fault bani rahe to technician/repair centre zaroori.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

codes.seriesName: Elego hybrid IP21/IP65/IP66 (6–15KW, Oyster, ELO-VI)

meaning.en: Master lost.
meaning.ur: Master gayab.

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Master unit powered off or communication cable disconnected
causes.ur: Master unit band ho ya communication cable khuli ho

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking the parallel wiring.
solutions.ur: Parallel wiring check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the master unit is powered on and its communication cable is seated; re-seat or replace the link cable.
solutions.ur: Master unit on hai aur uski communication cable lagi hai confirm karein; link cable dobara lagayein ya badlein.

solutions.en: Start the master first and then the slaves; if the master is still not seen, send the system to a technician.
solutions.ur: Pehle master start karein phir slaves; master phir bhi nazar na aaye to system technician ko bhejein.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

codes.seriesName: Elego hybrid IP21/IP65/IP66 (6–15KW, Oyster, ELO-VI)

meaning.en: Parallel sync lost.
meaning.ur: Parallel sync khula.

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Parallel communication interrupted or units started in wrong order
causes.ur: Parallel communication toot gayi ya units ghalat order mein shuru huin

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking the parallel connections.
solutions.ur: Parallel connections check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check the communication cables and that all units are powered from the same supply; re-seat loose plugs.
solutions.ur: Communication cables check karein aur sab units ek hi supply se chal rahe hon; loose plugs dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Power up the whole system in one go; if sync is lost again, a technician checks the parallel board.
solutions.ur: Poora system ek saath start karein; sync dobara toot jaye to technician parallel board check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

codes.seriesName: Elego hybrid IP21/IP65/IP66 (6–15KW, Oyster, ELO-VI)

meaning.en: Units see different battery V.
meaning.ur: Units alag battery V dekh rahe.

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Loose battery terminals or different battery bank at each unit
causes.ur: Battery terminals dhile ya har unit ki battery bank alag hai

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and disconnect the battery before measuring anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi naapne se pehle power off karein, AC isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage at each unit's battery terminals with a multimeter; all units should read the same bus voltage.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se har unit ke battery terminals par voltage naap lein; sab units par same bus voltage aana chahiye.

solutions.en: Tighten and clean loose or corroded battery connections; if readings still differ, a technician checks the battery sense wiring.
solutions.ur: Dhile ya zang lage battery connections kassein aur saaf karein; reading phir bhi alag aaye to technician battery sense wiring check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

codes.seriesName: Elego hybrid IP21/IP65/IP66 (6–15KW, Oyster, ELO-VI)

meaning.en: Units see different grid.
meaning.ur: Units alag grid dekh rahe.

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Units fed from different or unstable AC supplies
causes.ur: Alag ya unstable AC supply par chal rahe hain

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the AC supply before measuring the input.
solutions.ur: Input naapne se pehle power off karke AC supply isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure the AC input voltage at each unit with a multimeter; every unit should see the same supply.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se har unit par AC input voltage naap lein; har unit ko wahi supply nazar aani chahiye.

solutions.en: Check input breaker and terminal tightness; if the supplies differ, correct the wiring or call the utility or technician.
solutions.ur: Input breaker aur terminals ki quality check karein; supply alag ho to wiring theek karwayein ya utility/technician ko bulayein.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

codes.seriesName: Elego hybrid IP21/IP65/IP66 (6–15KW, Oyster, ELO-VI)

meaning.en: Output current unbalanced.
meaning.ur: Output ka current barabar nahi.

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Uneven load distribution across parallel units
causes.ur: Parallel units par load barabar nahi banta

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking the output wiring.
solutions.ur: Output wiring check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure the output current of each unit with a clamp meter; the load should be shared equally.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se har unit ka output current naap lein; load barabar banna chahiye.

solutions.en: Rebalance the load across the units; if it stays unbalanced, a technician checks the output board and relay.
solutions.ur: Load ko units mein dobara barabar baant dein; phir bhi unbalance rahe to technician output board aur relay check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

codes.seriesName: Elego hybrid IP21/IP65/IP66 (6–15KW, Oyster, ELO-VI)

meaning.en: Menu #28 mismatch across units.
meaning.ur: Units mein menu #28 alag.

causes.en: Parallel/setup issue
causes.ur: Parallel ya setup ka masla

causes.en: Output mode menu set differently on the units
causes.ur: Units par output mode ki setting alag alag hai

solutions.en: Note the current value of menu #28 shown on each unit before changing anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch badalne se pehle har unit par menu #28 ki maujuda value note karein.

solutions.en: Set menu #28 to the same value on all units; a different output mode setting triggers this fault.
solutions.ur: Sab units par menu #28 ek hi value par set karein; alag output mode setting is fault ko chala deti hai.

solutions.en: Save, then power cycle the whole system; if the fault remains, a technician checks the parallel settings.
solutions.ur: Save karein, phir poora system restart karein; fault bani rahe to technician parallel settings check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

codes.seriesName: Elego hybrid IP21/IP65/IP66 (6–15KW, Oyster, ELO-VI)

meaning.en: Fan fault on Elego base reference list.
meaning.ur: Elego base reference list par fan fault.

causes.en: Fan
causes.ur: Pankha kharab hai

causes.en: Fan connector loose or fan supply wire broken
causes.ur: Fan ka connector dhila ya supply wire tooti hui hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC; treat DC terminals as live even with the breakers off.
solutions.ur: Power off karke AC isolate karein; breakers off hone par bhi DC terminals ko live maan lein.

solutions.en: Spin the fan by hand — a jammed fan or broken blade must be replaced, and the fan connector should be checked.
solutions.ur: Fan ko haath se ghuma kar dekhein; fan atka ya blade toota ho to badlein, aur fan ka connector bhi check karein.

solutions.en: If the fan is free, a technician measures the fan supply on the board and replaces the fan if it fails.
solutions.ur: Fan azaad ho to technician board par fan ka supply naap le aur fan fail ho to use badal de.

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

codes.seriesName: Elego hybrid IP21/IP65/IP66 (6–15KW, Oyster, ELO-VI)

meaning.en: Same base family as Xavier.
meaning.ur: Xavier jaisi base family.

causes.en: Short
causes.ur: Short circuit hai

causes.en: Output wiring shorted or load insulation damaged
causes.ur: Output wiring mein short hai ya load ki insulation kharab hai

solutions.en: Treat DC terminals as live even with breakers off
solutions.ur: Breakers off hone par bhi DC terminals ko live maan lein

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — technician/repair centre required
solutions.ur: Power off; baar baar restart na karein — technician/repair centre zaroori

source.title: Crown Micro Elego 6KW IP65 manual (ManualsLib mirror p34/p49)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

meaning.en: Fan locked while off.
meaning.ur: Inverter off par fan atka.

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Fan blade jammed by dust or a wire touching it
causes.ur: Fan ka blade dust ya wire se atka hua hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC; treat DC terminals as live until the array and battery are disconnected.
solutions.ur: Power off karke AC isolate karein; panel aur battery disconnect hone tak DC terminals ko live maan lein.

solutions.en: Turn the fan blade by hand and clear dust or a wire touching it; replace the fan if it is jammed or broken.
solutions.ur: Fan blade ko haath se ghuma kar dust ya phansa hua wire hatayein; fan atka ya toota ho to badlein.

solutions.en: Check the fan connector, then power on and retest; if it locks again the technician replaces the fan.
solutions.ur: Fan connector check karein, phir on karke dobara check karein; dobara atka to technician fan replace kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 3KW user manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

title.en: Over temperature or NTC not connected

meaning.en: Internal >100°C or temp sensor loose/bad.
meaning.ur: Andar >100°C ya temp sensor dhila/kharab.

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Temperature sensor (NTC) loose or failed
causes.ur: Temp sensor (NTC) dhila ya kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and let the unit cool for 10 minutes before opening it.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, AC isolate karein aur kholein se pehle unit ko 10 minute thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: Power cycle: AC off → 2–5 min → on (DC isolated for DC work)
solutions.ur: Power cycle: AC off → 2–5 minute → on (DC work ke liye DC isolate)

solutions.en: Clean vents and heatsink and re-seat the temperature sensor plug; if it still runs hot the sensor is replaced.
solutions.ur: Vents aur heatsink saaf karein aur temp sensor ka plug dobara lagayein; phir bhi garmi rahe to sensor replace karein.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 3KW user manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

meaning.en: Battery over-charge / high.
meaning.ur: Battery over-charge / zyada.

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Charger output too high or battery cells failing
causes.ur: Charger ka output zyada hai ya battery cells kharab ho rahe hain

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and disconnect the battery before any measurement.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi naap se pehle power off karein, AC isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a multimeter — well above the normal charge level means over-charge; check the charger output.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery voltage naap lein — normal charge level se kaafi zyada ho to over-charge hai; charger ka output check karein.

solutions.en: Stop charging if the voltage is high and have a technician check the charge circuit and relay, then retest.
solutions.ur: Voltage zyada ho to charging rok dein aur technician se charge circuit aur relay check karwayein, phir dobara check karein.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 3KW user manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

meaning.en: Battery below cut-off.
meaning.ur: Battery cut-off se neeche.

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged or weak with age
causes.ur: Battery geheri discharge ho gayi ya umar se kamzor ho gayi

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking the battery wiring.
solutions.ur: Battery wiring check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery resting voltage with a multimeter and charge it fully, then power on and retest.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery ki resting voltage naap lein aur use mukammal charge karein, phir on karke dobara check karein.

solutions.en: If voltage drops fast under load the battery is weak and must be replaced; also clean and tighten the terminals.
solutions.ur: Load par voltage jaldi gir jaye to battery kamzor hai aur use badalna chahiye; terminals bhi saaf karke kassein.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 3KW user manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

meaning.en: Short or converter >120°C.
meaning.ur: Short ya converter >120°C.

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Output short circuit or converter overheating
causes.ur: Output mein short circuit hai ya converter zyada garm ho raha hai

solutions.en: Power off at once, isolate AC and DC, and treat DC terminals as live even with breakers off.
solutions.ur: Foran power off karein, AC aur DC isolate karein, aur breakers off hone par bhi DC terminals ko live maan lein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the load and check the output wiring for short or burn marks with the supply isolated.
solutions.ur: Supply isolate karke load disconnect karein aur output wiring par short ya jale hue nishan check karein.

solutions.en: If no external short is found the converter is overheating — a technician checks cooling and internal parts before restart.
solutions.ur: Bahar koi short na mila to converter zyada garm ho raha hai — restart se pehle technician cooling aur andar ke parts check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 3KW user manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

meaning.en: Output outside window.
meaning.ur: Output window se bahar.

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Load too heavy or output feedback faulty
causes.ur: Load zyada hai ya output feedback kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before probing the output terminals.
solutions.ur: Output terminals probe karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: After a safe restart, measure output voltage and frequency with a multimeter and compare them with the manual's normal window.
solutions.ur: Safe restart ke baad multimeter se output voltage aur frequency naap kar manual ke normal window se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the output stays out of range, check the load type and settings; a persistent fault goes to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Output range se bahar rahe to load ki qism aur settings check karein; fault lagu rahe to repair centre jayein.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 3KW user manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

meaning.en: Load ≥105–110% timer expired.
meaning.ur: Load ≥105–110% timer khatam.

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Load kept above 105–110% for too long
causes.ur: Load 105–110% se zyada der tak laga raha

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC, then remove the heavy load from the output.
solutions.ur: Power off karke AC isolate karein, phir output se bhaari load utarein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter, keep it below the inverter rating and power on again to retest.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load naap lein, inverter rating se kam rakhein aur phir on karke dobara check karein.

solutions.en: If the overload returns on a light load, a technician checks the output board and relay.
solutions.ur: Halka load par bhi overload wapas aaye to technician output board aur relay check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 3KW user manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

title.en: Bus voltage too high / internal failed

meaning.en: Bus over-voltage or internal group.
meaning.ur: Bus over-voltage ya internal group.

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Input or grid voltage too high, or internal group failure
causes.ur: Input ya grid voltage zyada hai, ya internal group fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and DC before probing; the DC bus stays charged for some time after power off.
solutions.ur: Probe karne se pehle power off karein, AC aur DC isolate karein; DC bus power off ke baad der tak charge rehta hai.

solutions.en: A technician checks the DC bus with a multimeter after safe discharge, and the input voltage feeding it.
solutions.ur: Technician safe discharge ke baad multimeter se DC bus naap le aur usko dene wali input voltage bhi check kare.

solutions.en: High grid or PV input often causes bus over-voltage; internal failure needs the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Grid ya PV input zyada hone se bus over-voltage aata hai; andar ki failure ke liye repair centre zaroori.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 4KW manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

meaning.en: Soft-start failed.
meaning.ur: Soft-start fail.

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Weak battery or pre-charge circuit not working
causes.ur: Battery kamzor hai ya pre-charge circuit kaam nahi kar raha

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and DC and do not switch on again and again.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, AC aur DC isolate karein aur baar baar on na karein.

solutions.en: Measure input voltage and battery voltage with a multimeter before one retry — both must be in normal range.
solutions.ur: Ek baar try se pehle multimeter se input voltage aur battery voltage naap lein — dono normal range mein hone chahiye.

solutions.en: If soft start still fails, a technician checks the pre-charge circuit and relay; a repair centre may be needed.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi soft start fail ho to technician pre-charge circuit aur relay check kare; zaroorat par repair centre lage.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 4KW manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

meaning.en: PV input over-current (3.6/4/5.6KW tables; not on 3KW).
meaning.ur: PV over-current (3.6/4/5.6KW; 3KW par nahi).

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: PV string sized too big for this model's input limit
causes.ur: Is model ke liye PV string bohot bari hai

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and cover or disconnect the PV strings — the PV input stays live in daylight.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, AC isolate karein aur PV strings ko cover ya disconnect karein — din ke waqt PV input live rehta hai.

solutions.en: Check the PV string size against the model's table in the manual and reduce panels in series if it is over the limit.
solutions.ur: PV string ka size manual ki apni table se compare karein aur limit zyada ho to series mein panels kam karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the PV input wiring for shorts; if the current is still high, a technician checks the charge stage.
solutions.ur: PV input wiring mein short check karein; current phir bhi zyada rahe to technician charge stage check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 3.6/5.6KW manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

meaning.en: Temp sensor fault (Xavier 3KVA TS only).
meaning.ur: Temp sensor ka masla — sirf Xavier 3KVA TS model par.

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Temp sensor plug loose or sensor circuit open
causes.ur: Temp sensor ka plug dhila ya sensor circuit khula hai

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and let the unit cool before opening the panel.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, AC isolate karein aur panel kholne se pehle unit ko thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the temperature sensor plug and check that the sensor wiring is not loose or broken.
solutions.ur: Temp sensor ka plug dobara lagayein aur sensor ki wiring dhili ya tooti to nahi hai check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the sensor with a multimeter — an open or very high reading means the sensor is bad and is replaced.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se sensor naap lein — open ya bohot zyada reading aaye to sensor kharab hai aur use badal dein.

source.title: Xavier 3KVA troubleshooting (ManualsLib p30)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

meaning.en: Over-current/surge.
meaning.ur: Current zyada ho gaya ya surge aa gaya.

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Heavy load or voltage surge on the supply
causes.ur: Load zyada hai ya supply par voltage surge aaya

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and disconnect the load before checking.
solutions.ur: Check karne se pehle power off karein, AC isolate karein aur load disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter and look for storm or surge conditions on the supply.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load naap lein aur supply par toofan ya surge ki halat dekhein.

solutions.en: Remove extra load and restart; if it trips again, a technician checks the output stage.
solutions.ur: Extra load hata kar restart karein; dobara trip ho to technician output stage check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 4KW manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

meaning.en: Bus under-voltage.
meaning.ur: Bus ka voltage kam hai.

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Input supply low or battery voltage dropped
causes.ur: Input supply kam hai ya battery voltage gir gaya

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and DC before probing the bus.
solutions.ur: Bus probe karne se pehle power off karein, AC aur DC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure input and battery voltage with a multimeter — a low battery or low input pulls the bus down.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se input aur battery voltage naap lein — battery kam ho ya input kam ho to bus neeche gir jata hai.

solutions.en: Charge or replace a weak battery or fix the supply; if the bus stays low, a technician checks the input stage.
solutions.ur: Kamzor battery charge karein ya badlein, ya supply theek karwayein; bus phir bhi kam rahe to technician input stage check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 4KW manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

meaning.en: Internal group — repair centre.
meaning.ur: Internal group ka masla — repair centre le jayein.

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Internal component failure on the main board
causes.ur: Main board par internal component fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Power off, isolate AC and DC and do not keep restarting the unit.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, AC aur DC isolate karein aur unit ko baar baar restart na karein.

solutions.en: With the supply isolated, look and smell for burnt parts, loose connectors or a blown fuse.
solutions.ur: Supply isolate karke dekhein aur smell karein — jale hue parts, dhile connectors ya fuse phata hua to nahi hai.

solutions.en: Internal component failure is not a field fix — send the unit to a repair centre.
solutions.ur: Internal component ka fault mukammal theek nahi hota — unit ko repair centre bhejein.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 4KW manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

meaning.en: Output unbalanced (official Crown wording — SolarNevs DC-offset claim loses).
meaning.ur: Output unbalanced (official Crown).

causes.en: See manual troubleshooting
causes.ur: Manual troubleshooting dekhein

causes.en: Uneven load across the output lines
causes.ur: Output lines par load barabar nahi

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before checking the output wiring.
solutions.ur: Output wiring check karne se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure each output line with a multimeter or clamp meter — the readings should be balanced.
solutions.ur: Har output line ko multimeter ya clamp meter se naap lein — readings barabar honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Balance the load and check the output wiring; if it stays unbalanced, a technician checks the output board.
solutions.ur: Load barabar baant dein aur output wiring check karein; phir bhi unbalance rahe to technician output board check kare.

source.title: Crown Micro Xavier 4KW manual (official PDF)

codes.seriesName: Xavier hybrid/off-grid (1.2–5.6KVA + 3/3.6/4/5.6KW)

causes.ur: Fan ki wiring khuli ho ya connector dhila ho

causes.ur: Fan capacitor ya motor kharab ho

solutions.en: Switch off the AC supply and isolate the unit before touching the fan.
solutions.ur: Fan ko touch karne se pehle AC supply band karke unit ko isolate karein.

solutions.en: Spin the fan blade by hand; if it is stuck by dust or a worn bearing, clear the dust and free it.
solutions.ur: Fan blade haath se ghumaayein, agar dust ya kharab bearing se atka ho toh saaf karke azaad karein.

solutions.en: If the fan still does not run, replace the fan or its capacitor, then restore supply and confirm the fault clears.
solutions.ur: Fan phir bhi na chale toh fan ya uska capacitor badlein, phir supply wapas karke confirm karein ke fault khatam ho gaya.

causes.ur: Feedback ya metering circuit reading ghalat de raha ho

solutions.ur: Kisi bhi probing se pehle AC aur battery supply hata kar DC bus ko discharge hone dein.

solutions.ur: Check karein ke input voltage range mein hai aur metering/feedback wiring sahi hai, ghalat reading bus ko zyada bana deti hai.

solutions.en: Restore supply and retry; if soft start fails again, the precharge relay or control board is faulty — technician required.
solutions.ur: Supply wapas karke phir try karein, soft start dobara fail ho toh precharge relay ya control board kharab hai — technician zaroori.

meaning.en: Cooling fan locked.
meaning.ur: Cooling fan atka.

causes.en: Dust/bearing
causes.ur: Dhool jama hona ya bearing kharab hona

causes.en: Fan bearings worn out from dust and long use.
causes.ur: Dhool aur lambi use se fan ki bearing ghis jana.

causes.en: Fan connector loose or the fan wire broken.
causes.ur: Fan ka connector dhila ho jana ya fan ki taar toot jana.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC and PV supply and wait about 5 minutes before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle AC aur PV supply band karke 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Remove the cover, blow the dust out of the fan and spin the blade by hand; if it is stiff, noisy or the bearing is worn, replace the fan.
solutions.ur: Cover kholein, fan ki dhool nikaal dein aur pankha haath se ghumayein; pankha azaadi se na ghoome, awaaz kare ya bearing ghis jaye to fan badal dein.

solutions.en: Refit the cover, restore power and run the inverter to confirm the fan turns freely and the fault does not come back.
solutions.ur: Cover wapas lagayein, power on karein aur inverter chalakar confirm karein ke pankha theek ghum raha hai aur fault dobara nahi aaraha.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter and let it cool down before touching any part.
solutions.ur: Pehle inverter band karein aur thanda hone dein, phir kisi bhi part ko haath na lagayein.

solutions.ur: Vent saaf karein, heatsink se dhool hataayein aur confirm karein ke cooling fan asani se ghum raha hai.

solutions.en: Restore power and check that the temperature falls and the fault clears; if it comes back, have the unit checked by a technician.
solutions.ur: Power wapas on karein aur dekhein ke temperature kam ho raha hai aur fault khatam ho raha hai; wapas aaye to technician se unit check karwaein.

causes.ur: Grid voltage allowed window se bahar chala jana.

causes.en: Loose output connection or a faulty output relay.
causes.ur: Output connection dhila ho jana ya output relay kharab ho jana.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and do not keep restarting it; treat the DC side as live until it is isolated.

solutions.en: Check the input/output terminals and wiring for looseness or damage; if the voltage is still outside the window, stop and send the unit to a repair centre.

solutions.ur: Clamp meter se total load check karein aur rating se neeche rakhein; motor aur bhaari appliance ek ek karke chalayein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and confirm it keeps running without the overload timer tripping again.

meaning.en: Output below window.
meaning.ur: Output window se neeche.

causes.en: Grid/output
causes.ur: Grid ya output voltage kam hona

causes.en: Grid voltage below the allowed window.
causes.ur: Grid voltage allowed window se neeche chala jana.

causes.en: Weak or loose output connection.
causes.ur: Output connection kamzor ya dhila ho jana.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate the supply; do not keep restarting it.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein aur supply alag karlein; baar baar restart na karein.

solutions.en: After isolation, measure the grid and output voltage with a meter and check the input/output terminals, wiring and grid connection for looseness or damage.
solutions.ur: Alag karne ke baad, meter se grid aur output voltage naapein aur input/output terminal, wiring aur grid connection ko dhilapan ya nuksan ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: If the output stays below the window, stop and hand the unit to a technician or repair centre.
solutions.ur: Output phir bhi window se neeche rahe to ruk jayein aur unit technician ya repair centre dein.

meaning.en: Insulation impedance detection failed.
meaning.ur: Insulation impedance detection fail

causes.en: Insulation impedance detection failed.
causes.ur: Insulation impedance detection fail

causes.en: Moisture or dirt on the DC cables and PV modules lowers the insulation resistance.
causes.ur: DC taarein aur PV module par nami ya gandagi insulation resistance kam kar deti hai.

causes.en: Damaged or chewed cable insulation lets current leak to earth.
causes.ur: Damaged ya chuhe ne kaati hui cable insulation se current zameen mein leak hota hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate the AC and PV supply before checking any cable.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi taar check karne se pehle inverter band karke AC aur PV supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Check that the wire insulation is intact — look for cuts, burns or moisture on the AC and PV wiring and tighten the terminals.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke taaron ki insulation sahi hai — AC aur PV wiring par cut, jalan ya nami na ho aur sab terminal tight hon.

solutions.en: Dry and repair any damaged insulation, then restart; if the fault stays, the unit needs a technician.
solutions.ur: Insulation damage ho to use sukha karke theek karein, phir restart karein; fault rahe to unit ko technician ke paas bhej dein.

causes.ur: Electric meter mein power nahi

causes.en: Meter supply wiring is loose or the meter fuse is blown.
causes.ur: Meter ki supply wiring dhili hai ya meter ka fuse udd gaya hai.

causes.en: Meter communication wiring fault or wrong meter model setting.
causes.ur: Meter ki communication wiring mein fault hai ya meter model ki ghalat setting hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter before checking the meter wiring.
solutions.ur: Meter ki wiring check karne se pehle inverter band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the status of the meter and its supply, and confirm the meter communication line is connected and undamaged.
solutions.ur: Meter ki haalat aur uski supply check karein, aur confirm karein ke communication line lagi hui aur sahi hai.

solutions.en: Reconnect or replace the meter supply or wiring, then restart the inverter and confirm the meter is read again.
solutions.ur: Meter ki supply ya wiring dobara lagayein ya badlein, phir inverter restart karein aur confirm karein ke meter phir se padha ja raha hai.

causes.ur: Remote se band

causes.en: A remote shutdown command was sent from the app or monitoring system.
causes.ur: App ya monitoring system se remote shutdown command bheji gayi hai.

causes.en: Timer or scheduled shutdown is active in the settings.
causes.ur: Settings mein timer ya schedule shutdown chalu hai.

solutions.en: Check first that nobody switched the unit off from the remote or app.
solutions.ur: Pehle check karein ke kisi ne remote ya app se unit band to nahi ki.

solutions.en: Turn the unit back on from the remote and wait; if it stays off, restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Remote se unit dobara on karein aur intezaar karein; band hi rahe to inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: If the unit switches off again by itself, check the remote wiring and the control board.
solutions.ur: Unit phir se apne aap band ho to remote ki wiring aur control board check karein.

meaning.en: Frequency configuration mismatch.
meaning.ur: Frequency configuration match nahi

causes.en: Frequency configuration mismatch.
causes.ur: Frequency configuration match nahi

causes.en: Grid frequency setting in the menu does not match the local grid frequency.
causes.ur: Menu mein grid frequency ki setting local grid frequency se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Grid frequency standard was changed after a firmware update or site change.
causes.ur: Firmware update ya site change ke baad grid frequency standard badal diya gaya.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter before opening the settings.
solutions.ur: Settings kholne se pehle inverter band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check in the menu that the configured frequency matches the local grid frequency, and measure the grid frequency with a meter to confirm.
solutions.ur: Menu mein check karein ke configured frequency local grid frequency se match karti hai, aur meter se grid frequency naap kar confirm karein.

solutions.en: Set the correct frequency, save and restart; if the fault remains, that setting may not suit this model.
solutions.ur: Sahi frequency set karke save karein aur restart karein; fault rahe to shayad yeh setting is model par lagu nahi hoti.

meaning.en: Arc fault.
meaning.ur: Arc fault

causes.en: Arc fault.
causes.ur: Arc fault

causes.en: Loose MC4 connectors or loose terminal joints spark an arc.
causes.ur: MC4 connector ya terminal joint dhile honay se arc banta hai.

causes.en: Cracked PV module or damaged DC cable insulation causes arcing.
causes.ur: PV module ka crack ya DC cable insulation damage hone se arc banta hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate the AC and DC supply immediately; an arc fault is a fire risk.
solutions.ur: Inverter foran band karke AC aur DC supply alag kar dein; arc fault ki wajah se aag lag sakti hai.

solutions.en: Look and listen for a burning smell, black marks or loose terminals on the output and DC wiring, and tighten or replace what is damaged.
solutions.ur: Output aur DC wiring par jalan ki boo, kaalay nishan ya dhile terminal dekhein-sunein, aur damage cheez tight ya badal kar dein.

solutions.en: Wait a while after the check and restart; if the alarm returns, stop and send the unit in for repair.
solutions.ur: Check ke baad thori der intezaar karke restart karein; alarm wapas aaye to ruk jayein aur unit repair ke liye bhejein.

meaning.en: 1.05 times overload.
meaning.ur: EPS overload 1.05 guna

causes.en: 1.05 times overload.
causes.ur: EPS overload 1.05 guna

causes.en: EPS load exceeds 1.05 times the rated capacity.
causes.ur: EPS load rated capacity se 1.05 guna zyada hai.

causes.en: Too many appliances are switched on at the same time on the EPS output.
causes.ur: EPS output par ek saath bohat zyada appliance chalu hain.

solutions.en: Turn off high-power loads before restarting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karne se pehle bhaari load band kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter and keep it below the EPS rating; start heavy appliances one at a time.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load naapein aur EPS rating se neeche rakhein; bhaari appliance ek ek karke chalayein.

solutions.en: Restart and confirm the inverter keeps running without the overload alarm again.
solutions.ur: Restart karein aur confirm karein ke inverter dobara overload ki wajah se band nahi hota.

causes.ur: EPS overload 1.25 guna

causes.en: EPS load exceeds 1.25 times the rated capacity.
causes.ur: EPS load rated capacity se 1.25 guna zyada hai.

causes.en: A motor or compressor on the EPS draws a heavy running current.
causes.ur: EPS par laga motor ya compressor bhaari running current khinchta hai.

solutions.en: Turn off high-power loads before restarting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karne se pehle bhaari load band kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter; at 1.25 times overload the load must be cut well below the EPS rating.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load naapein; 1.25 guna overload par load ko EPS rating se kaafi neeche karna parega.

solutions.en: Restart and confirm the inverter runs normally without the overload alarm.
solutions.ur: Restart karein aur confirm karein ke inverter overload ke baghair normally chal raha hai.

causes.ur: EPS overload 1.5 guna

causes.en: EPS load exceeds 1.5 times the rated capacity.
causes.ur: EPS load rated capacity se 1.5 guna zyada hai.

solutions.en: Turn off high-power loads before restarting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karne se pehle bhaari load band kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter; at 1.5 times overload remove the extra load completely before retrying.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load naapein; 1.5 guna overload par dobara try karne se pehle extra load mukammal hata dein.

solutions.en: Restart and confirm the inverter runs normally without the overload alarm.
solutions.ur: Restart karein aur confirm karein ke inverter overload ke baghair normally chal raha hai.

meaning.en: Overload self-locking.
meaning.ur: EPS overload self-lock

causes.en: Overload self-locking.
causes.ur: EPS overload self-lock

causes.en: EPS was overloaded repeatedly and the protection locked.
causes.ur: EPS par baar baar overload hua aur protection lock ho gayi.

causes.en: A motor or high inrush appliance draws a large starting current on EPS.
causes.ur: Motor ya high inrush appliance EPS par bohat zyada starting current khinchta hai.

solutions.en: Turn off the high-power load, the PV, the battery and the AC power before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi chhoone se pehle bhaari load, PV, battery aur AC power band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the connected load against the inverter rating with a clamp meter and remove anything extra.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se lagay huay load ki inverter rating se nisbat dekhein aur extra cheez utaar dein.

solutions.en: Restore power step by step and restart the inverter; if it locks again, the unit needs service.
solutions.ur: Power qadam ba qadam on karke inverter restart karein; dobara lock ho to unit ki service zaroori hai.

causes.ur: PV connection configuration ghalat

causes.en: PV string count or connection type configured in the menu is wrong.
causes.ur: Menu mein PV string ki tadaad ya connection type ghalat set ki gayi hai.

causes.en: Panel model or quantity changed on site but the settings were not updated.
causes.ur: Site par panel model ya tadaad badli gayi lekin setting update nahi ki.

solutions.en: Turn off the PV and battery and restart the inverter before checking the connections.
solutions.ur: Connection check karne se pehle PV aur battery band karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the PV connection matches the configuration in the menu and that every string plug is tight and undamaged.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke PV connection menu ki configuration se match karta hai aur har string plug tight aur damage free hai.

solutions.en: Correct any mismatch, save the setting and restart; if the fault stays, contact service.
solutions.ur: Koi ghulat theek karke setting save karein aur restart karein; fault rahe to service se rabta karein.

solutions.ur: Thori der intezaar karke inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke woh normal ho jata hai, aur terminal par DC aur grid maujood hain — check karein.

solutions.en: If the start-up state fails again, the control board needs technician or repair centre inspection.

solutions.en: Measure the battery output voltage with a meter and confirm it is inside the normal range for that battery type.
solutions.ur: Meter se battery output voltage naapein aur confirm karein ke woh battery type ke mutabiq normal range mein hai.

causes.en: BMS battery failure.
causes.ur: BMS battery cell fault

causes.en: One cell has drifted out of range or gone weak.
causes.ur: Koi cell range se bahar chala gaya hai ya kamzor ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Cell sampling wire is loose so the BMS reads a wrong value.
causes.ur: Cell sampling wire dhili hai is liye BMS ghalat value padh raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate the battery before any test.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi test se pehle inverter band karke battery alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the cell status and BMS display on the battery and note which cell reports the fault.

meaning.ur: Inverter ka phase lock fail ho jana.

causes.en: Inverter phase-locked failure.
causes.ur: Inverter phase-locked failure

causes.en: Grid voltage or frequency is unstable so the PLL cannot lock.
causes.ur: Grid voltage ya frequency unstable hai is liye PLL lock nahi ho raha.

causes.en: Grid waveform is distorted by other equipment on site.
causes.ur: Site par doosre equipment ki wajah se grid waveform distorted hai.

solutions.en: Power off and wait; do not keep restarting while the inverter cannot lock to the grid.
solutions.ur: Power band karke intezaar karein; inverter grid se lock na kar paye to baar baar restart na karein.

solutions.en: Measure the grid voltage and frequency with a meter and confirm both are normal at the input terminals.
solutions.ur: Meter se grid voltage aur frequency naapein aur input terminal par dono normal hon — confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check the input terminals and wiring for looseness, then restart; if it still cannot lock, call a technician.
solutions.ur: Input terminal aur wiring dhilapan ke liye check karein, phir restart karein; phir bhi lock na ho to technician bulayein.

causes.ur: Relay ke contact jal gaye ya aapas mein chipak gaye.

solutions.ur: Relay check karne se pehle inverter band karke supply alag kar dein.

solutions.ur: Start par relay ki click awaaz sunke dekhein aur meter se relay wiring aur contact check karein.

solutions.ur: Relay atka ho ya na chale to technician se replace karwana hoga.

causes.ur: Start par relay coil ko pickup voltage nahi milta.

solutions.ur: Coil ko voltage aa bhi raha ho aur relay pick na kare to relay badlein — technician ka kaam hai — phir dobara test karein.

causes.ur: Bhaari ya ruk ruk kar wale load se overcurrent baar baar aa raha hai.

causes.ur: Grid ya load mein ups neeze current ko baar baar limit se upar dhakel raha hai.

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the supply; repeated overcurrent must not be restarted many times.
solutions.ur: Power band karke supply alag karlein; overcurrent baar baar aane par use kai baar restart na karein.

solutions.ur: Thori der intezaar karke, phir clamp meter se confirm karein ke load par inverter current normal range mein rehta hai.

solutions.en: If the current is high or the alarm keeps coming, reduce the load and send the unit in for repair.

causes.en: Relay contacts welded together from a high current surge.

causes.ur: Relay ka spring kamzor ho gaya hai is liye release nahi hota.

solutions.en: Power off and isolate the battery before checking the relay.
solutions.ur: Relay check karne se pehle power band karke battery alag kar dein.

solutions.ur: Meter se main positive relay check karein; atki hui relay band honay ke baad bhi conduct karti rehti hai.

causes.ur: Grid profile ya firmware region ghalat standard par set ho jana.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter before changing any setting.
solutions.ur: Koi setting badalne se pehle inverter band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the export/power limit setting against the local standard and confirm the grid profile chosen in the menu.
solutions.ur: Export ya power limit setting ko local standard se compare karein aur menu mein chuna gaya grid profile confirm karein.

meaning.en: Software overcurrent protection
meaning.ur: Software overcurrent protection chal jati hai.

causes.en: Software overcurrent protection
causes.ur: Load current software limit se zyada hona

causes.en: Output short or a heavy load pulling high current.
causes.ur: Output short ho jana ya bhaari load zyada current khinche.

causes.en: Current sensing circuit reading higher than the actual current.
causes.ur: Current sensing circuit asal se zyada reading de raha ho.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV and grid, and reconnect only after checking the output for shorts.
solutions.ur: PV aur grid alag kar dein aur output mein short check kiye hi phir se connect karein.

solutions.en: Measure the load current with a clamp meter and confirm it is inside the inverter rating; remove any heavy load.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load current naapein aur rating ke andar confirm karein; bhaari load utaar dein.

solutions.en: Reconnect power and wait to see if the inverter returns to normal; if it trips again, call a technician.
solutions.ur: Power wapas lagayein aur dekhein ke inverter normal ho jata hai; dobara trip ho to technician bulayein.

meaning.ur: Load ka current bohat zyada hona.

causes.en: Over current fault
causes.ur: Load ka current allowed se zyada hona

causes.en: Sudden surge from motors or inductive loads.
causes.ur: Motor ya inductive load ka achanak surge aana.

causes.en: Wiring shorted or a loose joint heating up.
causes.ur: Wiring short ho jana ya dhila joint garam ho jana.

solutions.en: Switch off and isolate the supply before checking the wiring.
solutions.ur: Wiring check karne se pehle band karke supply alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV and grid, wait about 10 seconds, then use a meter to check the output wiring and joints for shorts or looseness.
solutions.ur: PV aur grid alag karke 10 second intezaar karein, phir meter se output wiring aur joint mein short ya dhilapan check karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect and restart; if the fault returns, reduce the load and have the unit inspected.
solutions.ur: Connect karke restart karein; fault wapas aaye to load kam karke unit check karwaein.

causes.ur: Residual ya over current bohat zyada hona

causes.en: Leakage to earth through wet or damaged wiring.
causes.ur: Gili ya damaged wiring se earth mein leakage hona.

causes.en: DC switch or output breaker not fully closed.
causes.ur: DC switch ya output breaker theek se band na hona.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and switch off the AC before touching any terminal.
solutions.ur: Terminal chhoone se pehle DC switch kholein aur AC band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check the output and earth wiring for leakage or moisture, tighten every connection and measure insulation with a meter if you have one.
solutions.ur: Output aur earth wiring mein leakage ya nami check karein, har connection tight karein aur meter ho to insulation naapein.

solutions.en: Close the DC switch and restart the inverter; if the protection trips again, stop and call a technician.
solutions.ur: DC switch band karke inverter restart karein; protection dobara trip ho to ruk jayein aur technician bulayein.

meaning.ur: Grid lost / mains gayab

causes.en: Grid lost
causes.ur: Grid lost / mains gayab

causes.en: Utility power cut or the mains breaker tripped.
causes.ur: Utility ka power cut ho jana ya mains breaker trip ho jana.

causes.en: Grid input cable loose at the terminal.
causes.ur: Grid input cable terminal par dhili ho jana.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting; with the supply off, first check the mains cable and breaker.
solutions.ur: Baar baar restart na karein; supply band karke pehle mains cable aur breaker check karein.

solutions.en: Tighten the grid input terminals and use a meter to confirm the utility is actually supplying power.
solutions.ur: Grid input terminal tight karein aur meter se confirm karein ke utility waqai power de rahi hai.

solutions.en: The system reconnects on its own once the utility is normal; if it stays off, contact the utility or a technician.
solutions.ur: Utility normal hote hi system khud connect ho jata hai; band rahe to utility ya technician se rabta karein.

causes.ur: Isolation (ISO) fault

causes.ur: PV aur output wiring par nami ya dhool hona.

causes.en: Damaged insulation letting leakage current escape.
causes.ur: Insulation damage hona jis se leakage current bahar nikle.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC and isolate the PV before checking insulation.
solutions.ur: Insulation check karne se pehle AC band karein aur PV alag kar dein.

solutions.en: Inspect the PV and output wiring, connectors and inverter terminals for moisture, dust or damaged insulation.
solutions.ur: PV aur output wiring, connector aur inverter terminal mein nami, dhool ya insulation damage check karein.

solutions.en: Dry and repair the wiring, then restart; if the fault remains, the unit needs service.
solutions.ur: Wiring ko sukha karke theek karein aur restart karein; fault rahe to unit ki service zaroori hai.

meaning.ur: Inverter ka temperature allowed se zyada hona.

causes.en: Over temperature
causes.ur: Vent block hona ya ambient temperature bohat zyada hona

causes.en: Cooling fan stopped or the heatsink is full of dust.
causes.ur: Cooling fan band ho jana ya heatsink dhool se bhari ho jana.

causes.en: Heavy load running long and heating the unit.
causes.ur: Lambi der bhaari load chalne se unit garam ho jana.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and let it cool before working on it.
solutions.ur: Kaam se pehle inverter band karke thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: Clear the vents, remove dust from the heatsink and confirm the cooling fan runs when powered.
solutions.ur: Vent saaf karein, heatsink ki dhool hataayein aur power par fan chalne ko confirm karein.

solutions.en: Restore power and watch the temperature; if it climbs again, reduce the load or call a technician.
solutions.ur: Power wapas on karein aur temperature dekhein; phir barhe to load kam karein ya technician bulayein.

causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat kam hona

causes.ur: Ambient temperature allowed start temperature se neeche ho jana.

causes.en: Temperature sensor reading wrongly low.
causes.ur: Temperature sensor ghalat kam reading de raha ho.

solutions.en: When the temperature is back in the normal range, restart the inverter; if the fault stays, have the sensor checked.
solutions.ur: Temperature normal range mein aane par inverter restart karein; fault rahe to sensor check karwaein.

causes.ur: Kamzor generator ya grid inverter ko power de raha ho.

solutions.ur: Unit band kar dein aur thanda hone dein, jab tak check karein AC supply alag hi rakhein.

solutions.ur: Heatsink se dhag saaf karein, cooling fan chal raha hai aur vents band nahi hain yeh confirm karein.

meaning.en: Cooling fan locked.
meaning.ur: Cooling fan atka.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Cooling fan blocked by dust or a foreign object
causes.ur: Cooling fan mein dhag ya bahir ki koi cheez atki hui hai

causes.en: Fan wiring open or fan motor seized
causes.ur: Pankha ki wiring khuli hai ya fan motor ne jam kar diya hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before touching the cooling fan.
solutions.ur: Power band karein aur cooling fan chune se pehle AC aur DC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Spin the cooling fan by hand and check its connector for loose pins or burnt marks.
solutions.ur: Cooling fan haath se ghuma kar dekhein aur uske connector par dhile pin ya jalne ke nishaan check karein.

solutions.en: Clean the fan and heatsink; if the fan still does not spin free or the motor reads open on a meter, replace it and retest after restoring supply.
solutions.ur: Fan aur heatsink saaf karein; phir bhi fan azaad na ghoomay ya meter par motor open aaye to fan badlein aur supply wapas lagane ke baad dobara check karein.

meaning.en: Converter over-temp.
meaning.ur: Converter zyada garm ho gaya.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Cooling fan slow or heatsink choked with dust
causes.ur: Cooling fan slow chal raha hai ya heatsink dhag se band hai

causes.en: Heavy load or hot ambient for a long time raised temperature
causes.ur: Lambi der tak zyada load ya garam mausam ki wajah se garmi barh gayi

solutions.en: Turn the unit off and let it cool down, keeping AC supply isolated while you check.
solutions.ur: Unit band kar dein aur thanda hone dein, jab tak check karein AC supply alag hi rakhein.

solutions.en: Clean dust from the heatsink, confirm the cooling fan runs and the air vents are not blocked.
solutions.ur: Heatsink se dhag saaf karein, cooling fan chal raha hai aur vents band nahi hain yeh confirm karein.

solutions.en: If the fan or sensor fails on test, replace it; avoid heavy load until temperature is normal, then restart and retest.
solutions.ur: Test mein fan ya sensor kharab mile to badlein; temperature normal hone tak zyada load na dein, phir restart karke dobara check karein.

meaning.en: Battery over-charge.
meaning.ur: Battery zyada charge ho gayi.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Charger float/absorption voltage set too high for this battery
causes.ur: Charger ka float/absorption voltage is battery ke liye bohat zyada set hai

causes.en: Battery sulphated or charger not cutting off at full charge
causes.ur: Battery sulphated ho gayi ya charger full charge par cut-off nahi kar raha

solutions.en: Stop charging now — switch off the inverter and isolate AC supply, and keep batteries away from sparks.
solutions.ur: Abhi charging band karein — inverter off karein aur AC supply alag kar lein, battery ke paas spark na dein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a meter and compare it with the charger float/absorption setting in the menu.
solutions.ur: Battery ka voltage meter se naapein aur menu mein charger ki float/absorption setting se compare karein.

solutions.en: If charger output is too high or a battery cell is dead, have the charger or battery checked and replaced, then retest.
solutions.ur: Charger ka output bohat zyada hai ya koi cell dead hai to charger ya battery check ya replace karwayein, phir dobara check karein.

meaning.en: Battery below cut-off.
meaning.ur: Battery cut-off se neeche.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged or old and weak
causes.ur: Battery bilkul discharge ho gayi hai ya purani aur kamzor hai

causes.en: Loose battery terminals or thin long cables causing voltage drop
causes.ur: Battery ke terminal dhile hain ya patli lambi taar ki wajah se voltage gir raha hai

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate DC before checking any battery wiring.
solutions.ur: Battery wiring check karne se pehle inverter band karein aur DC alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure battery resting voltage with a meter and tighten and clean the terminals and cable lugs.
solutions.ur: Battery ka resting voltage meter se naapein aur terminal/cable lugs ko kassi kar saaf karein.

solutions.en: Charge the batteries from a known supply; if an old battery will not hold charge, replace it and retest.
solutions.ur: Battery ko kisi ache source se charge karein; purani battery charge na rok sake to badal kar dobara check karein.

meaning.en: AC output shorted.
meaning.ur: AC output short.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Output wiring shorted to neutral or to body earth
causes.ur: Output ki taar neutral ya body earth se short ho gayi hai

causes.en: Connected load has an internal short or is wet/damaged
causes.ur: Lage hue load ke andar short hai ya woh geela/kharab hai

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate AC supply before touching any output wiring.
solutions.ur: Output ki taar chune se pehle inverter band karein aur AC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the load and use a meter to check the output wiring for a short to neutral or body earth.
solutions.ur: Load utaar kar meter se output wiring ka neutral ya body earth ke saath short check karein.

solutions.en: Repair the shorted wiring or replace the faulty appliance, then restore supply and confirm normal output on the meter.
solutions.ur: Short wali wiring theek karein ya kharab appliance badlein, phir supply wapas laga kar meter par output normal hai yeh confirm karein.

meaning.en: Output outside window.
meaning.ur: Output window se bahar.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Voltage sense/feedback path on the PCB faulty
causes.ur: PCB par voltage sense ya feedback path kharab hai

causes.en: Unbalanced load or loose output wiring
causes.ur: Load barabar nahi hai ya output ki wiring dhili hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before probing the output.
solutions.ur: Output check karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage and confirm the load is balanced and the output wiring is tight.
solutions.ur: Output voltage naapein aur load barabar hai aur output wiring kassi hai yeh confirm karein.

solutions.en: Correct the wiring or load; if the reading still wanders outside the window, have the voltage sense circuit on the PCB checked.
solutions.ur: Wiring ya load theek karein; reading phir bhi window ke bahar jaati rahe to PCB par voltage sense circuit check karwayein.

meaning.en: Load ≥110% timer expired.
meaning.ur: Load ≥110% timer khatam.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Connected load more than the inverter rating
causes.ur: Laga hua load inverter ki rating se zyada hai

causes.en: Motor or compressor drawing high starting current
causes.ur: Motor ya compressor start par bohat zyada current le raha hai

solutions.en: Turn off the inverter and isolate AC supply, then disconnect heavy loads.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein, AC supply alag kar dein aur bhaari load utaar dein.

solutions.en: Compare the total connected load with the inverter rating and remove extra appliances one by one.
solutions.ur: Kul load ko inverter ki rating se compare karein aur ek ek karke extra appliances utaarte jayein.

solutions.en: Start again only when the load is within rating; if a motor draws high starting current, reduce the load or have the unit checked.
solutions.ur: Load rating ke andar ho tabhi dobara on karein; motor zyada starting current le raha hai to load kam karein ya unit check karwayein.

meaning.en: DC bus over-voltage.
meaning.ur: DC bus par voltage zyada ho gaya.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: High PV input or grid feed pushing the bus voltage up
causes.ur: PV input ya grid se zyada aane par bus voltage barh gaya

causes.en: Load suddenly removed while the bus was charging
causes.ur: Bus charge hote waqt load achanak hat gaya

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before probing the DC bus.
solutions.ur: DC bus check karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC dono alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Let the bus discharge, then measure PV input and battery voltage and check the settings for high PV input.
solutions.ur: Bus ko discharge hone dein, phir PV input aur battery voltage naapein aur setting mein zyada PV input check karein.

solutions.en: Bring PV input within the limit or fix the load-dump situation, then power up and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: PV input limit ke andar karein ya load achanak hatne ki situation theek karein, phir power on karke code khatam hua yeh dekhein.

meaning.ur: Soft-start fail.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: DC bus not reaching start voltage — weak battery or high load
causes.ur: DC bus ka start voltage nahi ban raha — battery kamzor hai ya load zyada hai

causes.en: Pre-charge circuit or main relay faulty
causes.ur: Pre-charge circuit ya main relay kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before any further testing.
solutions.ur: Aage koi bhi test karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC dono alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure battery and DC bus voltage at power-on and check the pre-charge circuit and main relay.
solutions.ur: On karte waqt battery aur DC bus voltage naapein aur pre-charge circuit aur main relay check karein.

solutions.en: Charge or replace a weak battery and repair the pre-charge circuit or relay if faulty, then power up and confirm soft start completes.
solutions.ur: Kamzor battery charge ya replace karein aur kharab pre-charge circuit ya relay theek karein, phir power on karke soft start mukammal hua yeh confirm karein.

meaning.en: PV input over-current.
meaning.ur: PV input ka current zyada hai.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: PV strings paralleled beyond the input rating
causes.ur: PV strings input rating se zyada parallel kar di gayi hain

causes.en: PV input wiring shorted or MPPT stage faulty
causes.ur: PV input ki taaron mein short hai ya MPPT stage kharab hai

solutions.en: Isolate the PV supply (cover the panels or open the PV breaker) before opening the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter kholne se pehle PV supply alag karein (panels par cover lagayein ya PV breaker kholein).

solutions.en: Count the parallel strings against the input rating and meter-check PV current and wiring for a short.
solutions.ur: Parallel strings ko input rating se compare karein aur PV current aur wiring ka short meter se check karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the strings within rating or repair shorted wiring; if the fault remains, have the MPPT input stage checked.
solutions.ur: Strings rating ke andar karein ya short wali wiring theek karein; fault rahe to MPPT input stage check karwayein.

meaning.ur: String Voc zyada.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: String open-circuit voltage above the inverter limit
causes.ur: String ka open-circuit voltage inverter ki limit se zyada hai

causes.en: Too many panels in series for this model
causes.ur: Is model ke liye series mein bohat zyada panels lage hue hain

solutions.en: Isolate the PV supply and cover the panels before checking string wiring.
solutions.ur: String wiring check karne se pehle PV supply alag karein aur panels par cover lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure string open-circuit voltage with a meter and compare it with the inverter limit given in the manual.
solutions.ur: String ka open-circuit voltage meter se naapein aur manual mein di gayi inverter limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce panels in series to within the limit; if voltage still reads high, check the PV input sensing before powering up.
solutions.ur: Series mein panels limit ke andar karein; voltage phir bhi zyada aaye to power on karne se pehle PV input sensing check karein.

meaning.ur: Battery charge ka current zyada ho gaya.

causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Charge current limit set too high in the settings
causes.ur: Setting mein charge current limit bohat zyada set hai

causes.en: Weak battery pulling too much current or charger stage faulty
causes.ur: Kamzor battery bohat zyada current le raha hai ya charger ka stage kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC before probing the charging path.
solutions.ur: Charging wala rasta check karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Check the charge current limit in the settings and measure the actual charging current with a clamp or meter.
solutions.ur: Setting mein charge current limit check karein aur asal charging current clamp ya meter se naapein.

solutions.en: If current stays high with a healthy battery, have the charging stage on the PCB checked or repaired, then retest.
solutions.ur: Achi battery ke baad bhi current zyada rahe to PCB ka charging stage check ya repair karwayein, phir dobara check karein.

causes.ur: Load ka inrush ya surge set limit se zyada tha

causes.en: Current sensor reading high or a short developing on output
causes.ur: Current sensor zyada reading de raha hai ya output mein short ban raha hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before any further testing.
solutions.ur: Aage koi bhi test karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC dono alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the load, check the output wiring for a short and measure current with a meter when restarting.
solutions.ur: Load utaar kar output wiring mein short check karein aur restart par current meter se naapein.

solutions.en: Remove the overloaded or shorted load or repair the wiring; if the trip repeats with no load, have the power section checked.
solutions.ur: Zyada load ya short wala load utaarein ya wiring theek karein; load ke bawajood trip dobara ho to power section check karwayein.

causes.ur: Battery kamzor ya discharge hai ya battery taarein dhili hain

causes.ur: Input supply nahi aa rahi ya pre-charge circuit kharab hai

causes.ur: Output relay pick nahi kar raha ya uske contacts kharab ya chipak gaye hain

meaning.en: Power feedback protection — parallel/setup fault.
meaning.ur: Power feedback protection chal gayi — parallel/setup setting ka masla.

causes.en: Parallel/setup
causes.ur: Parallel/setup ka masla — setting match nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Grid and inverter output out of phase, parallel setting wrong
causes.ur: Grid aur inverter ka output phase mein alag hai, parallel setting ghalat hai

causes.en: Backup/grid feed present while the inverter is feeding, setup conflict
causes.ur: Inverter feed karte waqt grid/backup bhi aa raha hai, setting mein conflict hai

solutions.en: Switch off all parallel units and isolate AC supply before changing any settings.
solutions.ur: Koi setting badalne se pehle sab parallel units band karein aur AC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Check that feed direction and parallel settings match on every unit in the menu.
solutions.ur: Menu mein feed direction aur parallel setting har unit par same hai yeh check karein.

solutions.en: Correct the settings and parallel wiring, then power up the master first and confirm the fault clears.
solutions.ur: Setting aur parallel wiring theek karein, phir pehle master unit on karke fault khatam hua yeh confirm karein.

causes.en: One unit updated while the others were not
causes.ur: Ek unit update ho gayi, baaki units update nahi hui

solutions.en: Power off all units before checking or updating any firmware.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi firmware check ya update karne se pehle sab units band karein.

solutions.en: Check the firmware version of each unit in the menu and note where they differ.
solutions.ur: Har unit ka menu mein firmware version dekhein aur kahan alag hai yeh note karein.

solutions.en: Update all units to the same firmware version (technician job), then power up and confirm the units run together.
solutions.ur: Sab units ko ek hi firmware version par update karwayein (technician ka kaam), phir power on karke units saath chal rahi hain yeh confirm karein.

meaning.en: Current sharing fault — parallel/setup fault.
meaning.ur: Current share karne mein masla — parallel/setup setting ka masla.

causes.en: Parallel/setup
causes.ur: Parallel/setup ka masla — setting match nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Parallel cable loose so one unit is not sharing the load
causes.ur: Parallel ki taar dhili hai, ek unit load share nahi kar rahi

causes.en: Units of different capacity or one unit tripped out
causes.ur: Units ki capacity alag hai ya ek unit trip ho gayi hai

solutions.en: Switch off all units and isolate AC supply before checking the parallel cables.
solutions.ur: Parallel cable check karne se pehle sab units band karein aur AC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Check the parallel cable at both ends and meter-check continuity, and confirm all units have the same capacity.
solutions.ur: Parallel cable ke dono kone check karein aur continuity meter se naapein, saath hi sab units ki capacity same hai yeh dekhein.

solutions.en: Retighten or replace the parallel cable and match the capacities, then power up and confirm the load is shared.
solutions.ur: Parallel cable dobara kassi karein ya badlein aur capacity match karein, phir power on karke load share ho raha hai yeh confirm karein.

solutions.ur: Menu ki koi setting badalne se pehle units band kar dein.

solutions.en: Compare the output voltage and frequency settings on every unit in the menu.
solutions.ur: Menu mein har unit ka output voltage aur frequency setting compare karein.

solutions.en: Make the settings identical on all units and save, then power up and confirm the fault clears.

causes.en: CAN wiring damaged or CAN terminating resistor missing
causes.ur: CAN wiring kharab hai ya CAN terminating resistor nahi laga

meaning.en: Cooling fan locked.
meaning.ur: Cooling fan atka.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Cooling fan blocked by dust or a foreign object
causes.ur: Cooling fan mein dhag ya bahir ki koi cheez atki hui hai

causes.en: Fan wiring open or fan motor seized
causes.ur: Pankha ki wiring khuli hai ya fan motor ne jam kar diya hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before touching the cooling fan.
solutions.ur: Power band karein aur cooling fan chune se pehle AC aur DC supply alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Spin the cooling fan by hand and check its connector for loose pins or burnt marks.
solutions.ur: Cooling fan haath se ghuma kar dekhein aur uske connector par dhile pin ya jalne ke nishaan check karein.

solutions.en: Clean the fan and heatsink; if the fan still does not spin free or the motor reads open on a meter, replace it and retest after restoring supply.
solutions.ur: Fan aur heatsink saaf karein; phir bhi fan azaad na ghoomay ya meter par motor open aaye to fan badlein aur supply wapas lagane ke baad dobara check karein.

meaning.en: Converter over-temp.
meaning.ur: Converter zyada garm ho gaya.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Cooling fan slow or heatsink choked with dust
causes.ur: Cooling fan slow chal raha hai ya heatsink dhag se band hai

causes.en: Heavy load or hot ambient for a long time raised temperature
causes.ur: Lambi der tak zyada load ya garam mausam ki wajah se garmi barh gayi

solutions.en: Turn the unit off and let it cool down, keeping AC supply isolated while you check.
solutions.ur: Unit band kar dein aur thanda hone dein, jab tak check karein AC supply alag hi rakhein.

solutions.en: Clean dust from the heatsink, confirm the cooling fan runs and the air vents are not blocked.
solutions.ur: Heatsink se dhag saaf karein, cooling fan chal raha hai aur vents band nahi hain yeh confirm karein.

solutions.en: If the fan or sensor fails on test, replace it; avoid heavy load until temperature is normal, then restart and retest.
solutions.ur: Test mein fan ya sensor kharab mile to badlein; temperature normal hone tak zyada load na dein, phir restart karke dobara check karein.

meaning.ur: Battery zyada charge ho gayi.

causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: Charger float/absorption voltage set too high for this battery
causes.ur: Charger ka float/absorption voltage is battery ke liye bohat zyada set hai

causes.en: Battery sulphated or charger not cutting off at full charge
causes.ur: Battery sulphated ho gayi ya charger full charge par cut-off nahi kar raha

solutions.en: Stop charging now — switch off the inverter and isolate AC supply, and keep batteries away from sparks.
solutions.ur: Abhi charging band karein — inverter off karein aur AC supply alag kar lein, battery ke paas spark na dein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a meter and compare it with the charger float/absorption setting in the menu.
solutions.ur: Battery ka voltage meter se naapein aur menu mein charger ki float/absorption setting se compare karein.

solutions.en: If charger output is too high or a battery cell is dead, have the charger or battery checked and replaced, then retest.
solutions.ur: Charger ka output bohat zyada hai ya koi cell dead hai to charger ya battery check ya replace karwayein, phir dobara check karein.

causes.ur: Battery bilkul discharge ho gayi hai ya purani aur kamzor hai

causes.ur: Battery ke terminal dhile hain ya patli lambi taar ki wajah se voltage gir raha hai

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and isolate DC before checking any battery wiring.
solutions.ur: Battery wiring check karne se pehle inverter band karein aur DC alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure battery resting voltage with a meter and tighten and clean the terminals and cable lugs.
solutions.ur: Battery ka resting voltage meter se naapein aur terminal/cable lugs ko kassi kar saaf karein.

solutions.en: Charge the batteries from a known supply; if an old battery will not hold charge, replace it and retest.
solutions.ur: Battery ko kisi ache source se charge karein; purani battery charge na rok sake to badal kar dobara check karein.

causes.ur: Lage hue load ke andar short hai ya woh geela/kharab hai

solutions.en: Turn off the inverter and isolate AC supply, then disconnect heavy loads.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein, AC supply alag kar dein aur bhaari load utaar dein.

solutions.en: Compare the total connected load with the inverter rating and remove extra appliances one by one.
solutions.ur: Kul load ko inverter ki rating se compare karein aur ek ek karke extra appliances utaarte jayein.

solutions.en: Start again only when the load is within rating; if a motor draws high starting current, reduce the load or have the unit checked.
solutions.ur: Load rating ke andar ho tabhi dobara on karein; motor zyada starting current le raha hai to load kam karein ya unit check karwayein.

causes.en: High PV input or grid feed pushing the bus voltage up
causes.ur: PV input ya grid se zyada aane par bus voltage barh gaya

causes.en: Load suddenly removed while the bus was charging
causes.ur: Bus charge hote waqt load achanak hat gaya

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before probing the DC bus.
solutions.ur: DC bus check karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC dono alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Let the bus discharge, then measure PV input and battery voltage and check the settings for high PV input.
solutions.ur: Bus ko discharge hone dein, phir PV input aur battery voltage naapein aur setting mein zyada PV input check karein.

solutions.en: Bring PV input within the limit or fix the load-dump situation, then power up and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: PV input limit ke andar karein ya load achanak hatne ki situation theek karein, phir power on karke code khatam hua yeh dekhein.

causes.ur: DC bus ka start voltage nahi ban raha — battery kamzor hai ya load zyada hai

causes.en: Pre-charge circuit or main relay faulty
causes.ur: Pre-charge circuit ya main relay kharab hai

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC and DC supply before any further testing.
solutions.ur: Aage koi bhi test karne se pehle power band karein aur AC aur DC dono alag kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure battery and DC bus voltage at power-on and check the pre-charge circuit and main relay.
solutions.ur: On karte waqt battery aur DC bus voltage naapein aur pre-charge circuit aur main relay check karein.

solutions.en: Charge or replace a weak battery and repair the pre-charge circuit or relay if faulty, then power up and confirm soft start completes.
solutions.ur: Kamzor battery charge ya replace karein aur kharab pre-charge circuit ya relay theek karein, phir power on karke soft start mukammal hua yeh confirm karein.

causes.en: See manual
causes.ur: Manual dekhein

causes.en: PV strings paralleled beyond the input rating
causes.ur: PV strings input rating se zyada parallel kar di gayi hain

causes.en: PV input wiring shorted or MPPT stage faulty
causes.ur: PV input ki taaron mein short hai ya MPPT stage kharab hai

solutions.en: Isolate the PV supply (cover the panels or open the PV breaker) before opening the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter kholne se pehle PV supply alag karein (panels par cover lagayein ya PV breaker kholein).

solutions.en: Count the parallel strings against the input rating and meter-check PV current and wiring for a short.
solutions.ur: Parallel strings ko input rating se compare karein aur PV current aur wiring ka short meter se check karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the strings within rating or repair shorted wiring; if the fault remains, have the MPPT input stage checked.
solutions.ur: Strings rating ke andar karein ya short wali wiring theek karein; fault rahe to MPPT input stage check karwayein.

solutions.en: Measure string open-circuit voltage with a meter and compare it with the inverter limit given in the manual.
solutions.ur: String ka open-circuit voltage meter se naapein aur manual mein di gayi inverter limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce panels in series to within the limit; if voltage still reads high, check the PV input sensing before powering up.
solutions.ur: Series mein panels limit ke andar karein; voltage phir bhi zyada aaye to power on karne se pehle PV input sensing check karein.
