meaning.en: The intelligent power module failed; P0 or P9 shows first and then changes to E9.
meaning.ur: Intelligent power module kharab ho gaya; pehle P0 ya P9 nazar aata hai phir E9 ban jata hai.

causes.en: Compressor connection is wrong or the compressor is faulty.
causes.ur: Compressor ki connection ghalat hai ya compressor kharab hai.

causes.en: IPM is not fixed tightly to the radiator fins or silicone is uneven.
causes.ur: IPM radiator fins par mazbooti se nahi laga ya silicone barabar nahi hai.

causes.en: System pressure is too low or too high.
causes.ur: System pressure bohat kam ya bohat zyada hai.

solutions.en: Check compressor wiring order (red, white, blue on U, V, W) and refit.
solutions.ur: Compressor ki wiring order (U, V, W par red, white, blue) check karke wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: Re-screw the IPM onto the fins with even silicone and check ventilation.
solutions.ur: IPM ko barabar silicone ke sath fins par kas kar lagayein aur hawa check karein.

solutions.en: Correct the refrigerant charge, then replace the IPM if the fault stays.
solutions.ur: Gas charge theek karein, fault rahe to IPM badlein.

notes.en: Manual sequence: unit first displays P0 or P9, then changes to E9. P0 and P9 also have their own chart/troubleshooting rows, so they stay separate entries and are not listed as aliases here.
notes.ur: Manual ke mutabiq pehle P0 ya P9 nazar aata hai phir E9 ban jata hai. P0 aur P9 ke chart/troubleshooting mein apni alag rows hain, is liye wo alag entries rakhi gayi hain aur yahan alias nahi.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display E9)

codes.seriesName: Sharp PSR series display codes (E and P)

title.ur: Outdoor fan motor (DC) kharab ho gayi

meaning.en: The outdoor DC fan motor did not start or lost feedback.
meaning.ur: Outdoor DC fan motor start nahi hui ya feedback kho diya.

causes.en: Outdoor fan motor or its connector has failed.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor ya uska connector kharab hai.

causes.en: Fan drive circuit on the outdoor board is faulty.
causes.ur: Outdoor board par fan drive circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Power off and check that the fan blade spins freely.
solutions.ur: Power band karke fan blade free ghoomta hai ya nahi dekhein.

solutions.en: Check the fan motor connector and replace the motor if open.
solutions.ur: Fan motor ka connector check karein, open ho to motor badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if the motor tests fine.
solutions.ur: Motor sahi nikle to outdoor power source board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart (indoor failure codes)

codes.seriesName: Sharp PSR series display codes (E and P)

meaning.en: The board could not read compressor current correctly through its current sensor.
meaning.ur: Board ne current sensor ke zariye compressor ka current theek se padha nahi.

causes.en: Current sensor on the outdoor power board has failed.
causes.ur: Outdoor power board par current sensor fail ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant leak has led to abnormal running current.
causes.ur: Gas leak ki wajah se running current abnormal ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check for refrigerant leakage and repair the leak point.
solutions.ur: Gas leak check karke leak wali jagah theek karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if there is no leak.
solutions.ur: Leak na ho to outdoor power source board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display EA)

codes.seriesName: Sharp PSR series display codes (E and P)

meaning.en: Stored data on the board's EEPROM could not be read or verified.
meaning.ur: Board ke EEPROM par save data padha ya verify nahi hua.

causes.en: EEPROM chip failed.
causes.ur: EEPROM chip fail ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Data corrupted after a power interruption.
causes.ur: Power cut ke baad data kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Power cycle from the breaker for 10 seconds and retest.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 second power cycle karke dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the board if the code does not clear.
solutions.ur: Code clear na ho to board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display EE)

codes.seriesName: Sharp PSR series display codes (E and P)

title.ur: Compressor top ka temperature switch kharab

meaning.en: The shell temperature switch on top of the compressor operated or its circuit is open.
meaning.ur: Compressor ke upar wala shell temperature switch operate ho gaya ya uski line khuli hai.

causes.en: CN3 switch wires are not plugged into the outdoor board.
causes.ur: CN3 switch ki wires outdoor board par nahi lagi hain.

causes.en: Compressor is genuinely overheating (low gas, poor ventilation).
causes.ur: Compressor sach mein overheat ho raha hai (gas kam, hawa kam).

causes.en: The top temperature switch itself has failed.
causes.ur: Upar wala temperature switch hi kharab hai.

solutions.en: Refit CN3 and check the U, V, W wiring order (red, white, blue).
solutions.ur: CN3 wapas lagayein aur U, V, W ka order (red, white, blue) check karein.

solutions.en: Add refrigerant if pressure is low and clear anything blocking outdoor airflow.
solutions.ur: Pressure kam ho to gas bharayein aur outdoor ki hawa ki rukawat hataayein.

solutions.en: Replace the shell temperature switch, then the outdoor board if needed.
solutions.ur: Shell temperature switch badlein, zaroorat ho to outdoor board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display EP)

codes.seriesName: Sharp PSR series display codes (E and P)

meaning.en: The outdoor board cannot sense the mains voltage through its sampling circuit.
meaning.ur: Outdoor board apne sampling circuit se mains voltage sense nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Voltage sampling circuit on the outdoor power board has failed.
causes.ur: Outdoor power board ka voltage sampling circuit fail ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Supply is outside the protector range.
causes.ur: Supply protector range se bahar hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the supply is within the unit's protector range.
solutions.ur: Supply unit ki protector range ke andar hai, confirm karein.

solutions.en: Replace the voltage sampling circuit on the outdoor power source board.
solutions.ur: Outdoor power source board ka voltage sampling circuit badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Troubleshooting Guide (Display EU)

codes.seriesName: Sharp PSR series display codes (E and P)

meaning.en: The outdoor intake (ambient) temperature sensor reading is abnormal.
meaning.ur: Outdoor intake (ambient) temperature sensor ki reading ghalat hai.

causes.en: Sensor open, shorted or drifted.
causes.ur: Sensor open, short ya drift ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Connector not seated on the outdoor board.
causes.ur: Connector outdoor board par laga nahi.

solutions.en: Check the connector and measure the sensor at 25C / 5k.
solutions.ur: Connector check karein aur sensor ko 25C / 5k par naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the intake temperature sensor, then the outdoor board.
solutions.ur: Intake temperature sensor badlein, phir outdoor board badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart (indoor failure codes)

codes.seriesName: Sharp PSR series display codes (E and P)

title.ur: Module protection on ho gaya (hardware control)

meaning.en: Hardware-level module protection fired; the display then changes to E9.
meaning.ur: Hardware level protection chal gayi; display phir E9 ban jata hai.

causes.en: IPM or compressor problem detected by hardware.
causes.ur: Hardware ne IPM ya compressor ka masla pakda.

causes.en: Restart just after stop while the system is not stable.
causes.ur: System stable hone se pehle hi restart kar diya.

solutions.en: Wait a while and start the air conditioner again.
solutions.ur: Thodi der ruk kar air conditioner dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: If it repeats, inspect compressor wiring and replace the IPM.
solutions.ur: Dohraye to compressor ki wiring dekhein aur IPM badlein.

source.title: Sharp AY-X9PSR Service Manual, Ch.6 Chart (protection code)

codes.seriesName: Sharp PSR series display codes (E and P)

meaning.en: Supply voltage went outside 160-260V AC, so the unit protected itself.
meaning.ur: Supply voltage 160-260V AC se bahar chala gaya, is liye unit ne khud ko bachaya.

causes.en: Mains sag or surge in the local supply.
causes.ur: Local supply mein voltage ka girna ya surge.

causes.en: Outdoor power source board cannot read the voltage correctly.
causes.ur: Outdoor power source board voltage theek se padh nahi raha.

solutions.en: Test the supply; outside 160-260V AC the unit will trip by design.
solutions.ur: Supply test karein; 160-260V AC se bahar ho to unit design ke mutabik trip karegi.

solutions.en: Test L to N at the outdoor unit as well.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit par L se N ka voltage bhi test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor power source board if the supply is normal.
solutions.ur: Supply normal ho to outdoor power source board badlein.

solutions.ur: Kharab outdoor fan motor badlein.

solutions.ur: Fan circuit sahi ho to outdoor power source board badlein.

causes.ur: Outdoor unit ka air inlet/outlet block hai.

causes.ur: System mein gas kam hai.

causes.ur: Exhaust temperature sensor drift, short ya open ho gaya (25C / 20k).

solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ki hawa ki rukawat hataayein.

solutions.ur: System kam ho to gas bharayein.

solutions.ur: Exhaust temperature sensor badlein, phir outdoor control board badlein.

meaning.ur: Cooling ke dauran allowed band se bahar subcooling ho gayi, protection ne unit rok di.

causes.ur: Indoor unit ka air inlet/outlet block hai.

causes.ur: Gas kam hai.

causes.ur: Exhaust ya room/pipe sensor drift ho gaya (25C / 5k).

solutions.en: Clear the indoor unit airflow path.
solutions.ur: Indoor unit ka hawa ka raasta kholein.

solutions.en: Add refrigerant to the specified charge.
solutions.ur: Murawwat ke mutabik gas bharayein.

solutions.ur: Reading ghalat ho to room (IRT) aur indoor pipe (IPT) sensors badlein.

causes.ur: Outdoor ki hawa block hai.

causes.ur: Indoor exchange temperature thermistor drift ya open ho gaya.

solutions.ur: Indoor exchange temperature thermistor (IPT) ko badal dein

meaning.ur: Bahar ka temperature working range se bahar hai (cooling mein -1C se neeche, heating mein 33C se upar).

causes.ur: Asal limit aa gayi, design ke mutabiq protection hai.

causes.ur: Outdoor intake sensor drift, open ya short ho gaya (25C / 5k).

solutions.ur: Mausam range se bahar ho to koi repair nahi chahiye.

solutions.ur: Outdoor intake sensor (CN1) naapein, kharab ho to badlein.

solutions.ur: Sensor sahi ho to outdoor power source board badlein.

meaning.ur: Software drive protection chal gayi, aksar restart ke foran baad, phir display E9 ban jata hai.

causes.en: Compressor started immediately after a stop while the system was not stable.
causes.ur: System stable hone se pehle compressor ne foran restart le liya.

causes.en: IPM or compressor connection problem.
causes.ur: IPM ya compressor ki connection ka masla hai.

solutions.en: Wait longer before switching the unit on again and retry.
solutions.ur: Unit ko dobara chalane se pehle thoda intezaar karein aur try karein.

solutions.en: If P9 keeps changing to E9, check compressor wiring and replace the IPM.
solutions.ur: P9 baar baar E9 ban jaye to compressor ki wiring check karein aur IPM badlein.

causes.ur: Heating ke dauran normal defrost cycle.

title.ur: Kam ambient temperature ki wajah se protection

meaning.en: It is too cold outside for the unit to run, so it has locked out to protect the compressor and oil.
meaning.ur: Bahar itni sardi hai ke unit chalna safe nahi lagti, compressor aur oil ki hifazat ke liye lock ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature has fallen below the unit's minimum operating limit.
causes.ur: Bahar ka temperature unit ki minimum limit se neeche chala gaya hai.

causes.en: The thermistor has drifted out of range or failed outright.
causes.ur: Thermistor kharab ho gaya hai ya uski reading ghalat aa rahi hai.

solutions.en: Wait for the ambient to rise; if it appears in mild weather, get the unit checked.
solutions.ur: Ambient ke barhne ka intezar karein; mausam saada mein aaye to unit check karwayein.

solutions.en: Check the sensor plug and lead, then measure the thermistor and replace it if out of range.
solutions.ur: Sensor ka plug aur wire check karein, thermistor napein, ghalat ho to badlein.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

codes.seriesName: Carrier Comfort 22 ductless (45MHHAQ)

meaning.en: The display shows dashes because two indoor units are asking the one outdoor unit for opposite modes.
meaning.ur: Display dashes is liye dikhata hai ke do indoor units usi outdoor unit se ulat mode maang rahe hain.

causes.en: Two indoor units are calling for opposite modes - one heating, one cooling.
causes.ur: Do indoor units ulat mode maang rahe hain - ek heating, ek cooling.

causes.en: Indoor and outdoor units are from different platform or revision levels.
causes.ur: Indoor aur outdoor unit alag platform/revision ke hain.

solutions.en: Set every indoor unit to the same mode, or let the master unit decide the mode.
solutions.ur: Har indoor unit ko ek hi mode par rakhein, ya mode master unit par chhoonein.

solutions.en: Switch all indoor units off, then start them together in one mode.
solutions.ur: Sab indoor units band karein, phir ek hi mode mein ek sath start karein.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

notes.en: A blank or dashed display is the manual's own way of reporting the mode clash, not a dead display.
notes.ur: Khali ya dashed display manual ka tarika hai mode clash dikhane ka, display marna nahi hai.

meaning.en: The unit is melting frost off the outdoor coil while heating; the manual states DF is not an error code.
meaning.ur: Heating ke dauran unit outdoor coil se barf pighal rahi hai; manual ke mutabiq DF error code nahi hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature has fallen below the unit's minimum operating limit.
causes.ur: Bahar ka temperature unit ki minimum limit se neeche chala gaya hai.

causes.ur: Kamre ka load unit se zyada hai (khuli khirkiyan, dhoop, zyada log).

solutions.ur: Unit band karein, 5 minute ruk kar remote se dobara start karein.

solutions.ur: Sirf bahar se outdoor unit ke rukhawat hata dein aur khula space dein.

notes.en: Normal status display, listed in the error table only so technicians do not confuse it with a fault.
notes.ur: Normal status display, sirf is liye error table mein hai taake technician ise fault na samajhein.

codes.seriesName: Carrier Elite hi-wall (42LUVH / Elite N and N-1)

meaning.en: The indoor board cannot read its stored parameters, so it will not start normally.
meaning.ur: Indoor board apne saved parameters parh nahi pata, is liye normal start nahi karti.

causes.en: Board memory data was corrupted after a power dip or surge.
causes.ur: Power fluctuation se board ki memory (EEPROM) data kharab ho gayi.

causes.en: A connector on the board has worked loose or gone green with moisture.
causes.ur: Board ka connector dheeli ho gaya hai ya nami se green ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for 10 minutes, switch back on and run the unit once.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

solutions.en: After the reset, ask the technician to check the EEPROM chip seating on the board.
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad technician se EEPROM chip ki seating check karwayein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

codes.seriesName: Carrier Elite hi-wall (42LUVH / Elite N and N-1)

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor boards have lost contact, so the unit locks out until the link is back.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor boards ka contact chala gaya hai, is liye link wapas aane tak unit lock ho jati hai.

causes.en: Indoor to outdoor wiring (L, N, S) is loose, rat-bitten or landed wrongly.
causes.ur: Indoor se outdoor ki wiring (L, N, S) dheeli, chuha kata hui ya ghalat lagi hai.

causes.en: Communication circuit on the indoor or outdoor board has failed.
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor board ka communication circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Power cycle both units together; communication faults often clear after one clean restart.
solutions.ur: Dono units ka ek sath power cycle karein; communication fault aksar ek saaf restart se theek ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Power off, then re-check and retighten the indoor-outdoor terminals (L, N, S, earth).
solutions.ur: Power band karke indoor-outdoor terminals (L, N, S, earth) dobara check aur tight karein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

notes.en: The N-1 chart's own first step is a one-minute power off before any wiring check, and the code returns if the link stays broken.
notes.ur: N-1 chart ka pehla qadam wiring check se pehle ek minute power off hai, aur link toota rehne par code wapas aata hai.

source.title: Carrier Elite 42LUVH055N / 065N / 075N - Indoor Unit Error Display (Carrier AU fault-code library)

codes.seriesName: Carrier Elite hi-wall (42LUVH / Elite N and N-1)

meaning.en: The board cannot see the mains zero-crossing signal, which it needs to time the compressor drive.
meaning.ur: Board ko mains ka zero-crossing signal nahi milta, jo compressor drive ke waqt ke liye zaroori hai.

causes.en: The control board itself is faulty.
causes.ur: Control board hi kharab hai.

causes.en: Mains voltage is too high, too low or unstable for the electronics.
causes.ur: Mains voltage electronics ke liye zyada/kam ya unstable hai.

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for 10 minutes, switch back on and run the unit once.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

solutions.en: Check mains voltage at the terminals; run again only when the supply is normal.
solutions.ur: Terminal par mains voltage check karein; supply normal hone par hi dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

notes.en: Both charts treat this as a main control board fault, so a clean power cycle that does not clear it means a board swap.
notes.ur: Dono chart ise main control board ka fault mante hain, is liye saaf power cycle ke baad na hate to board badalna hoga.

source.title: Carrier Elite 42LUVH055N / 065N / 075N - Indoor Unit Error Display (Carrier AU fault-code library)

codes.seriesName: Carrier Elite hi-wall (42LUVH / Elite N and N-1)

title.en: Indoor fan speed out of control
title.ur: Indoor fan ki speed control se bahar

meaning.en: The indoor fan is not running at the speed the board commands.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan jo speed board ne kahi wo nahi chal raha.

causes.en: Indoor fan motor is weak, jammed or the blade is rubbing the scroll.
causes.ur: Indoor fan motor kamzor hai, atka hua hai ya blade ragad raha hai.

causes.en: Dirty filter or choked coil is starving the fan of airflow.
causes.ur: Ganda filter ya ganda coil ki wajah se hawa nahi ban rahi.

solutions.en: Clean the filters and both heat exchangers, then retry the unit.
solutions.ur: Filter aur dono heat exchanger saaf karke dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Switch off power and free the fan blade by hand; replace the motor if it is tight or noisy.
solutions.ur: Power band karke haath se fan blade azadayin; motor tight/shor ho to badlein.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

notes.en: The N chart writes this simply as 'fan speed out of control'; the N-1 chart adds that it is the indoor fan.
notes.ur: N chart ise sirf 'fan speed out of control' likh kar kehta hai; N-1 chart batata hai ke ye indoor fan hai.

solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

solutions.en: If the wiring and sensors test fine, the main board needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Wiring aur sensor theek nikle to main board badalna hoga.

meaning.en: The outdoor fan is not doing what the board asks - the N-1 chart words the same fault as outdoor fan speed out of control.
meaning.ur: Outdoor fan board ke mutabiq nahi kar raha - N-1 chart isi fault ko 'outdoor fan speed control se bahar' kehta hai.

causes.en: Outdoor fan motor is stuck, weak or one blade is broken.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan motor atka hua, kamzor hai ya blade toota hua hai.

causes.en: Outdoor fan cannot move air because the coil or grille is choked.
causes.ur: Coil ya grille band hone ki wajah se outdoor fan hawa nahi hata pa raha.

solutions.en: From outside only, clear anything blocking the outdoor unit and give it room to breathe.
solutions.ur: Sirf bahar se outdoor unit ke rukhawat hata dein aur khula space dein.

solutions.en: Technician to check the outdoor fan motor and blade, and replace what is faulty.
solutions.ur: Technician outdoor fan motor aur blade check kare aur kharab cheez badle.

solutions.en: Do not keep restarting - if the code returns, stop and book a technician.
solutions.ur: Bar bar restart na karein - code wapas aaye to rokein aur technician bulayein.

notes.en: N chart calls it 'outdoor unit fan protection', N-1 chart calls it 'outdoor fan speed has been out of control' - same fan, two wordings.
notes.ur: N chart ise 'outdoor unit fan protection' aur N-1 chart 'outdoor fan speed control se bahar' kehta hai - ek hi fan, do lafz.

codes.seriesName: Carrier Elite hi-wall (42LUVH / Elite N and N-1)

meaning.en: The inverter power module has shut down on an electrical or over-current fault.
meaning.ur: Inverter power module electrical ya over-current fault par band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Inverter/IPM has tripped on over-current, usually from a short in the compressor or drive.
causes.ur: Inverter/IPM over-current par trip hua, aksar compressor ya drive mein short se.

causes.en: Compressor is not picking up speed - weak starting gear or a seized rotor.
causes.ur: Compressor speed nahi pakad raha - starting gear kamzor ya rotor jam hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and leave it off; repeated resets on an IPM trip can kill the compressor.
solutions.ur: Band karke waise hi chhor dein; IPM trip par bar bar reset se compressor kharab ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: Technician to check compressor winding, amp draw and starting gear before any restart.
solutions.ur: Technician compressor ki winding, ampere aur starting gear check kare, phir hi restart karein.

solutions.en: Leave the outdoor cabinet closed; anything behind the panel is technician work.
solutions.ur: Outdoor cabinet na kholein; panel ke piche ka kaam technician ka hai.

notes.en: The N-1 chart misprints IPM as 'IBM' and calls it IGBT over-strong current protection; Ample Air flags the same misprint.
notes.ur: N-1 chart IPM ki jagah 'IBM' likha karata hai aur IGBT over-strong current protection kehta hai; Ample Air bhi isi misprint ko batata hai.

title.en: Over voltage or low voltage protection
title.ur: Over voltage ya low voltage protection

meaning.en: The supply voltage went outside the safe window, high or low, and the unit shut down.
meaning.ur: Supply voltage safe range se bahar chali gayi, zyada ya kam, aur unit band ho gayi.

causes.en: Mains voltage is too high, too low or unstable for the electronics.
causes.ur: Mains voltage electronics ke liye zyada/kam ya unstable hai.

causes.en: Three-phase supply is missing a phase or the phase order is reversed.
causes.ur: Teen-phase supply mein phase missing hai ya phase order ulti hai.

solutions.en: Check mains voltage at the terminals; run again only when the supply is normal.
solutions.ur: Terminal par mains voltage check karein; supply normal hone par hi dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Put the unit behind a proper voltage stabilizer/protector and retest.
solutions.ur: Unit ke aage sahi stabilizer/protector lagayein aur dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Power off at the breaker for 10 minutes, switch back on and run the unit once.
solutions.ur: Breaker se 10 minute power off karein, phir on karke unit ek baar chalayein.

source.title: Carrier Elite 42LUVH055N / 065N / 075N - Indoor Unit Error Display (Carrier AU fault-code library)

codes.seriesName: Carrier Elite hi-wall (42LUVH / Elite N and N-1)

meaning.en: The top of the compressor has overheated, so the unit has stopped it before damage.
meaning.ur: Compressor ka top overheat ho gaya hai, is liye unit ne nuqsan se pehle band kar diya.

causes.en: Compressor is running hot from low gas, a dirty coil or a heavy load.
causes.ur: Gas kam, coil ganda ya load zyada hone se compressor garam ho raha hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant charge is low because the circuit has leaked.
causes.ur: Circuit mein gas leak hone ki wajah se charge kam hai.

causes.en: Indoor or outdoor heat exchanger is choked with dust and cannot breathe.
causes.ur: Indoor ya outdoor heat exchanger dust se band hai, unit saans nahi le pa rahi.

solutions.en: Service the unit: clean filters and coils, then check running pressures and amps.
solutions.ur: Unit ka service karein: filter/coil saaf karein, phir pressure aur ampere check karein.

solutions.en: Have the circuit pressure-tested for leaks, then vacuum and re-gas to spec.
solutions.ur: Circuit ka leak test karwayein, phir vacuum karke specification ke mutabiq gas bharwayein.

solutions.en: Technician to check compressor winding, amp draw and starting gear before any restart.
solutions.ur: Technician compressor ki winding, ampere aur starting gear check kare, phir hi restart karein.

notes.en: The N-1 diagnosis flowchart for this code walks charge, circuit blockage and compressor checks, so gas work is on the table.
notes.ur: Is code ke N-1 flowchart mein charge, circuit blockage aur compressor checks hain, is liye gas ka kaam mumkin hai.

codes.seriesName: Carrier Multi Split Ductless (38GVM / 40GVM)

title.en: Low charge or refrigeration system blockage

meaning.en: The board sees a charge or blockage problem - either the circuit has leaked low or something is choked.
meaning.ur: Board ko gas ya blockage ka masla nazar aata hai - ya circuit leak kar ke kam hua ya kuch block hai.

causes.en: Refrigerant charge is low because the circuit has leaked.
causes.ur: Circuit mein gas leak hone ki wajah se charge kam hai.

causes.en: Filter drier, capillary or EXV is choked, so pressures run away.
causes.ur: Filter drier, capillary ya EXV block ho gaya hai, pressure balaa se nikal raha hai.

solutions.en: Have the circuit pressure-tested for leaks, then vacuum and re-gas to spec.
solutions.ur: Circuit ka leak test karwayein, phir vacuum karke specification ke mutabiq gas bharwayein.

solutions.en: Technician to check pressures, replace the blocked filter drier and clear the EXV.

meaning.en: The inverter's internal voltage reference has drifted, so measurements are untrustworthy.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka internal voltage reference bekar chala hai, is liye readings par bharosa nahi.

causes.en: Reference voltage circuit on the control board has drifted
causes.ur: Control board ka reference voltage circuit bekar chala hai

causes.en: Auxiliary supply out of tolerance feeding the reference
causes.ur: Reference ko chalane wali auxiliary supply tolerance se bahar

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, wait for the DC bus to discharge, then reboot the inverter.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke DC bus discharge hone tak wait karein, phir inverter reboot karein.

solutions.en: Measure the auxiliary supply rails against the board's own markings before assuming a board fault.
solutions.ur: Board fault maan ne se pehle board ke apne markings ke against auxiliary supply rails measure karein.

solutions.en: If the code survives a reboot, contact Growatt to claim warranty - Growatt's own guide treats it as a warranty item.
solutions.ur: Agar code reboot ke baad bhi rahe to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein - Growatt ka apna guide isay warranty item kehta hai.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

codes.seriesName: Legacy TL-series grey-body inverters (Gen 1, 1xx error codes)

title.ur: Processor aapas mein baat nahi kar rahe (101 / 102 / 121)

meaning.en: The master processor cannot receive data from the slave processor - Growatt groups 101, 102 and 121 as one communication fault.
meaning.ur: Master processor slave processor se data nahi le sakta - Growatt 101, 102 aur 121 ko aik hi communication fault ke tor par group karta hai.

causes.en: Control board internal processor bus fault
causes.ur: Control board ka internal processor bus fault

causes.en: Internal harness or processor solder joint failure
causes.ur: Internal harness ya processor solder joint fail

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reboot the inverter once.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke inverter ek baar reboot karein.

solutions.en: If it returns, follow Growatt's guide: reboot then claim warranty through Growatt service.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to Growatt ke guide ke mutabiq karein: reboot karke Growatt service se warranty claim karein.

solutions.en: Before claiming, note the exact time the code appears - recurring codes on a cold morning point to a marginal processor.
solutions.ur: Claim karne se pehle note karein ke code kab aata hai - subah ke waqt baar baar aane wala code marginal processor ki taraf ishara karta hai.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

codes.seriesName: Legacy TL-series grey-body inverters (Gen 1, 1xx error codes)

meaning.en: The neutral conductor is carrying voltage, which points to a reversed or damaged connection.
meaning.ur: Neutral conductor par voltage aa raha hai, jo ulatay ya damaged connection ki taraf ishara karta hai.

causes.en: N and L conductors connected in reverse at the inverter
causes.ur: Inverter par N aur L conductors ulat se lage hain

causes.en: Inverter terminal block damaged, or neutral conductor open upstream
causes.ur: Inverter terminal block damaged, ya neutral conductor upstream se khul gaya hai

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker and isolate, then test the N line and the L line for reversal.
solutions.ur: AC breaker band karke isolate karein, phir N line aur L line ka reversal test karein.

solutions.en: Check the inverter terminals for damage, and measure N-to-PE voltage with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Inverter terminals par damage check karein, aur multimeter se N se PE voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: If a damaged spot is found, contact Growatt for a warranty replacement of the terminal block.
solutions.ur: Agar damaged spot mil jaye to terminal block ki warranty replacement ke liye Growatt se rabta karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

codes.seriesName: Legacy TL-series grey-body inverters (Gen 1, 1xx error codes)

meaning.en: Failure reading or writing the EEPROM settings memory.
meaning.ur: EEPROM settings memory parhne ya likhne mein failure.

causes.en: EEPROM chip or its solder joint on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par EEPROM chip ya uska solder joint

causes.en: Power interruption during a settings write
causes.ur: Settings write ke dauran power chala jana

solutions.en: Reboot the inverter after disconnecting AC and PV.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV disconnect kar ke inverter reboot karein.

solutions.en: Note whether the fault only appears in the morning - a marginal EEPROM chip does exactly that.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke fault sirf subah aata hai ya nahi - marginal EEPROM chip aise hi karta hai.

solutions.en: If sustained after reboot, contact Growatt to claim warranty.
solutions.ur: Reboot ke baad bhi barqarar rahe to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

codes.seriesName: Legacy TL-series grey-body inverters (Gen 1, 1xx error codes)

meaning.en: The grid connection relay circuit is not operating correctly.
meaning.ur: Grid connection relay circuit theek se operate nahi ho raha.

causes.en: Relay coil, contacts or its driver circuit faulty
causes.ur: Relay coil, contacts ya uska driver circuit faulty

causes.en: Relay failed after an arc or over-voltage event
causes.ur: Arc ya over-voltage event ke baad relay fail

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then listen for the relay click when the AC breaker is toggled.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke AC breaker toggle karte waqt relay ki click check karein.

solutions.en: Reboot the inverter once; a single click with a cleared code means an interlock event.
solutions.ur: Inverter ek baar reboot karein; sirf ek click aur code clear ho jaye to interlock event hai.

solutions.en: If the relay never clicks, contact Growatt to claim warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar relay kabhi click na kare to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

codes.seriesName: Legacy TL-series grey-body inverters (Gen 1, 1xx error codes)

title.ur: Init model fault - dip switches ghalat hain

meaning.en: The dip switches underneath the inverter do not match the model, so initialisation fails.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke neeche ke dip switches model se match nahi karte, is liye initialisation fail hai.

causes.en: Dip switch block moved during service or transport
causes.ur: Service ya transport ke doraan dip switch block hila diya gaya

causes.en: Wrong dip switch combination fitted for the installed model
causes.ur: Installed model ke liye ghalat dip switch combination laga hua

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then read the dip switches underneath the inverter.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke inverter ke neeche dip switches padhein.

solutions.en: Set the dip switches per section 1.2.1 of Growatt's own guide, and re-check each position.
solutions.ur: Growatt ke apne guide ke section 1.2.1 ke mutabiq dip switches set karein, aur har position dobara check karein.

solutions.en: If the code persists with correct switches, contact Growatt to claim warranty.
solutions.ur: Sahi switches ke saath bhi code rahe to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

meaning.ur: Ground fault detection device kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: GFCI board damaged by surge or repeated leakage trips
causes.ur: Surge ya baar baar leakage trips se GFCI board kharab

causes.en: Undetected earth fault in the array still energising the device
causes.ur: Array mein abhi bhi undetected earth fault mojood hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then measure array insulation resistance before assuming a board fault.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke board fault maan ne se pehle array ki insulation resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the GFCI board for scorch marks or a burnt smell.
solutions.ur: GFCI board par burnt nishaan ya burnt smell dekhein.

solutions.en: Reboot the inverter; if the fault remains, contact Growatt to claim warranty.
solutions.ur: Inverter reboot karein; fault bacha rahe to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

codes.seriesName: Legacy TL-series grey-body inverters (Gen 1, 1xx error codes)

title.ur: HCT fault - hall current transformer ka masla

meaning.en: The hall-effect current transformer or its circuit is reporting a fault.
meaning.ur: Hall-effect current transformer ya uska circuit fault report kar raha hai.

causes.en: Hall current sensor failed or its connector loose
causes.ur: Hall current sensor fail ya uska connector loose

causes.en: Sensor wiring harness damaged near the fan or heatsink
causes.ur: Sensor wiring harness fan ya heatsink ke paas damaged

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then reseat the HCT connector at the control board.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke control board par HCT connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Compare current readings with a clamp meter; a HCT reading far from clamp-meter truth means the sensor is dead.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se current readings compare karein; agar HCT reading clamp meter se bohat door ho to sensor dead hai.

solutions.en: Reboot the inverter; if the fault persists, contact Growatt to claim warranty.
solutions.ur: Inverter reboot karein; fault bacha rahe to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

codes.seriesName: Legacy TL-series grey-body inverters (Gen 1, 1xx error codes)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage is abnormal, commonly from ageing capacitors or a failing power circuit.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage abnormal hai, aksar aging capacitors ya failing power circuit ki wajah se.

causes.en: DC bus capacitors ageing, giving excessive ripple
causes.ur: DC bus capacitors aging ho kar bohat zyada ripple de rahe hain

causes.en: Failure in the power circuit that charges the bus
causes.ur: Bus ko charge karne wali power circuit mein failure

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then wait 5 minutes for the bus to discharge safely.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke 5 minute wait karein taake bus mehfooz taur par discharge ho.

solutions.en: Reboot the inverter and watch whether the code returns at every start or only under load.
solutions.ur: Inverter reboot karke dekhein ke code har start par aata hai ya sirf load ke saath.

solutions.en: If it returns immediately, contact Growatt to claim warranty - Growatt's guide routes all 1xx codes to warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar foran wapas aaye to Growatt se rabta karke warranty claim karein - Growatt ka guide tamam 1xx codes ko warranty par bhejta hai.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide for Growatt Inverters (Growatt New Energy Australia Pty Ltd)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

title.en: DC arc abnormal (arcing on PV side)
title.ur: DC arc abnormal (PV side par arcing)

meaning.en: An arc has been detected on the DC / PV side and the unit has locked out.
meaning.ur: DC / PV side par arc detect hua aur unit lock out ho gaya.

causes.en: Arcing at a PV terminal due to a loose or burnt connector
causes.ur: Loose ya burnt connector ki wajah se PV terminal par arcing

causes.en: Damaged module or cable insulation
causes.ur: Module ya cable insulation damaged

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check the panel terminal wiring after shutdown.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke shutdown ke baad panel terminal wiring check karein.

solutions.en: Look for heat discolouration or a burnt smell at every DC terminal and re-crimp it.
solutions.ur: Har DC terminal par garmi ke rang ya burnt smell dekhein aur use dobara crimp karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the message persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; message bacha rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

meaning.en: Measured leakage current is above the permitted level, so the inverter has stopped.
meaning.ur: Measured leakage permitted level se zyada hai, is liye inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Array insulation breakdown or a wet junction box
causes.ur: Array insulation breakdown ya geela junction box

causes.en: GFCI module or SPD damaged
causes.ur: GFCI module ya SPD damaged

solutions.en: Isolate PV and AC, then measure insulation resistance to earth with a megohmmeter.
solutions.ur: PV aur AC isolate karke megohmmeter se earth ke taraf insulation resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Split the array string by string to find the leaking path.
solutions.ur: Array ko string by string baant kar leaking path dhoondein.

solutions.en: Restart the machine; if the fault information persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Machine restart karein; fault information bachi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

meaning.en: PV input voltage is above what the inverter will accept on this body.
meaning.ur: PV input voltage is body par inverter ki sehat se zyada hai.

causes.en: Too many modules per string for the local minimum temperature
causes.ur: Local minimum temperature ke liye string mein modules zyada hain

causes.en: Two strings paralleled in error
causes.ur: Do strings galti se parallel ho gaye

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC switch immediately and confirm the voltage.
solutions.ur: DC switch foran disconnect karke voltage confirm karein.

solutions.en: After the normal voltage is restored, if the message still exists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Normal voltage restore hone ke baad bhi message rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Recalculate string length from the module Voc at the coldest expected temperature.
solutions.ur: Sab se thande expected temperature par module Voc se string ki lambai dobara calculate karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

title.ur: Panel ki insulation resistance kam hai

meaning.en: The PV array insulation resistance to earth is below the required value.
meaning.ur: PV array ki earth ke taraf insulation resistance required value se neeche hai.

causes.en: Damaged module backsheet or cable insulation chafed on the frame
causes.ur: Module backsheet damaged ya cable insulation frame par rub hua

causes.en: Water ingress in the junction box or combiner
causes.ur: Junction box ya combiner mein paani aa gaya

solutions.en: After shutting down, check whether the panel shell is reliably grounded.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad check karein ke panel shell mazboot se grounded hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure insulation resistance per string with a megohmmeter to find the affected string.
solutions.ur: Har string ki insulation resistance megohmmeter se measure karke affected string dhoondein.

solutions.en: Replace the damaged module or cable, and re-test before reconnecting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Damaged module ya cable badlein, aur dobara lagane se pehle dobara test karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

meaning.en: Grid voltage is abnormal and has not returned to the allowable range.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage abnormal hai aur allowable range mein wapas nahi aayi.

causes.en: Grid sag from a large motor starting, or an upstream fault
causes.ur: Bade motor ki starting se grid sag, ya upstream fault

causes.en: Transformer tap or voltage set-point wrong for the site
causes.ur: Transformer tap ya voltage set-point site ke liye ghalat

solutions.en: Check the grid voltage with a true-RMS meter at the AC terminals.
solutions.ur: AC terminals par true-RMS meter se grid voltage check karein.

solutions.en: If the grid voltage has recovered to the allowable range and the message persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar grid voltage allowable range mein wapas aa gayi aur message bacha to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

meaning.en: The mains terminal wiring is wrong, so the inverter cannot operate.
meaning.ur: Mains terminal wiring ghalat hai, is liye inverter operate nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Phase sequence or N/PE conductors wrongly connected
causes.ur: Phase sequence ya N/PE conductors ghalat se lage hain

causes.en: Loose or overheated mains terminal lug
causes.ur: Mains terminal lug loose ya overheated

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check the mains terminal connections.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke mains terminal connections check karein.

solutions.en: Re-torque the mains terminals and check for heat discolouration on the lugs.
solutions.ur: Mains terminals dobara torque karein aur lugs par garmi ke rang dekhein.

solutions.en: If the fault message still exists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar fault message phir bhi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

meaning.en: The inverter sees no mains input after grid connection checks.
meaning.ur: Grid connection checks ke baad inverter ko koi mains input nahi dikhta.

causes.en: AC breaker open or upstream fuse blown
causes.ur: AC breaker open ya upstream fuse uth gaya

causes.en: AC side line disconnected
causes.ur: AC side line disconnect ho gayi

solutions.en: Check the AC side line connection after shutdown.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad AC side line connection check karein.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the mains terminal to confirm the supply is present.
solutions.ur: Mains terminal par grid voltage measure karke confirm karein ke supply mojood hai.

solutions.en: If the fault message still exists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar fault message phir bhi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

title.ur: Zero ground detection anomaly - zameen fault

meaning.en: The earth / ground loop has been disturbed, so the zero-ground detection circuit has flagged it.
meaning.ur: Earth / ground loop bigda hua hai, is liye zero-ground detection circuit ne ise flag kiya.

causes.en: Ground wire not connected reliably between inverter and earth
causes.ur: Inverter aur earth ke darmiyan ground wire mazboot se nahi lagi

causes.en: N-PE impedance out of limit in the distribution board
causes.ur: Distribution board mein N-PE impedance limit se bahar

solutions.en: Check the ground wire after shutting down to ensure it is connected reliably.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad ground wire check karein ke mazboot se lagi hai.

solutions.en: Measure earth continuity and the N-to-PE voltage with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se earth continuity aur N se PE voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: If the fault message still exists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar fault message phir bhi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

meaning.en: Grid frequency is outside the specified range.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency specified range se bahar hai.

causes.en: Generator supply with a drifting frequency
causes.ur: Generator supply jis ki frequency drift kar rahi ho

causes.en: Weak grid with frequency swings
causes.ur: Kamzor grid jismein frequency swing karti hai

solutions.en: Detect the grid frequency with a meter and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Meter se grid frequency detect karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: If the frequency is within range and the message persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar frequency range mein hai aur message bacha rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

meaning.en: Output load exceeded the inverter rating and the overload protection shut it down.
meaning.ur: Output load inverter rating se cross kar gaya aur overload protection ne band kar diya.

causes.en: Connected load above the inverter rated power
causes.ur: Connected load inverter rated power se zyada hai

causes.en: Load step or motor inrush on start
causes.ur: Load step ya start par motor ka inrush

solutions.en: Check the output load and reduce the load power.
solutions.ur: Output load check karke load power kam karein.

solutions.en: Measure actual per-phase current with a clamp meter to confirm which leg is overloaded.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se asal per-phase current measure karke confirm karein kaun sa leg overloaded hai.

solutions.en: If the fault information persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar fault information bachi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

meaning.en: The insulation-resistance measurement channels disagree, so the result is not trusted.
meaning.ur: Insulation-resistance measurement channels aapas mein match nahi karte, is liye result par bharosa nahi.

causes.en: Insulation detection circuit drifted, often after moisture
causes.ur: Insulation detection circuit bekar chala hai, aksar nam ke baad

causes.en: Loose connector on the insulation measurement board
causes.ur: Insulation measurement board par connector loose

solutions.en: Restart the machine and note whether the fault is consistent or intermittent.
solutions.ur: Machine restart karke note karein ke fault consistent hai ya intermittent.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then use an external megohmmeter to get a true insulation reading.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke bahar ke megohmmeter se asal insulation reading lein.

solutions.en: If the external reading is good but the code stays, the internal circuit needs replacing - contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar bahar ki reading theek hai aur code bacha rahe to internal circuit badalna parega - manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

meaning.en: The low-voltage auxiliary supply feeding the control electronics is out of specification.
meaning.ur: Control electronics ko chalane wali low-voltage auxiliary supply specification se bahar hai.

causes.en: Auxiliary SMPS failing on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par auxiliary SMPS fail ho raha hai

causes.en: Fuse or supply rail opened after a surge event
causes.ur: Surge event ke baad fuse ya supply rail khul gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then wait 5 minutes for the bus to discharge.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke 5 minute wait karein taake bus discharge ho.

solutions.en: Restart the machine; if the fault persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Machine restart karein; fault bacha rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)
aliases: Abnormal battery reverse connection protection tube

title.ur: Battery reverse-connection protection tube abnormal hai

meaning.en: The reverse-polarity protection device in the battery connection has failed or tripped abnormally.
meaning.ur: Battery connection ka reverse-polarity protection device fail ya abnormal trigger hua.

causes.en: Battery connected with reversed polarity, blowing the protection device
causes.ur: Battery reversed polarity se lagi aur protection device uth gaya

causes.en: Protection fuse/relay stuck or failed without a real polarity error
causes.ur: Asal polarity error ke baghair protection fuse/relay jam ya fail

solutions.en: Isolate the battery completely, then check polarity with a multimeter on the battery cable ends.
solutions.ur: Battery poori tarah isolate karke multimeter se battery cable ends par polarity check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm BAT+ and BAT- match the inverter marking before reconnecting anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi dobara lagane se pehle confirm karein ke BAT+ aur BAT- inverter ke marking se match karte hain.

solutions.en: Restart the machine; if the fault message still exists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Machine restart karein; fault message phir bhi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

meaning.en: The two battery-voltage measurement paths disagree, so the reading is not trusted.
meaning.ur: Do battery-voltage measurement paths aapas mein match nahi karte, is liye reading par bharosa nahi.

causes.en: Voltage sense wire loose or corroded at the battery terminal
causes.ur: Battery terminal par voltage sense wire loose ya corroded

causes.en: Sampling divider or reference drifted on the board
causes.ur: Board par sampling divider ya reference bekar chala hai

solutions.en: Isolate the battery and reseat the voltage sense wires at both the battery and the inverter.
solutions.ur: Battery isolate karke voltage sense wires battery aur inverter dono taraf dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a multimeter and compare it against the app reading.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery voltage measure karke app reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the paths never agree, the control board sensing circuit must be replaced - contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar paths kabhi match na hon to control board ka sensing circuit badalna parega - manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

meaning.en: The cooling fan is not working, so the inverter derates instead of stopping.
meaning.ur: Cooling fan kaam nahi kar raha, is liye inverter band hone ke bajaye power kam karta hai.

causes.en: Fan connector loose after shutdown work
causes.ur: Shutdown kaam ke baad fan connector loose

causes.en: Fan motor failed or blades blocked
causes.ur: Fan motor fail ya blades block

solutions.en: Check the fan wiring after shutdown and reseat the connector.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad fan wiring check karke connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Spin the fan by hand to confirm it turns freely, then check for dust on the blades.
solutions.ur: Fan ko haath se ghumakar confirm karein ke azaad ghoomta hai, phir blades par dhool dekhein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan if it is seized or noisy.
solutions.ur: Fan jam ho ya shor kare to use badal dein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

meaning.en: Panel input voltage is above the set limit; output is restricted until it comes back.
meaning.ur: Panel input voltage set limit se upar hai; wapas aane tak output restricted rahega.

causes.en: Cold weather raising string Voc above the threshold
causes.ur: Thande mausam se string ka Voc threshold se upar chala gaya

causes.en: Upper voltage threshold set too low
causes.ur: Upper voltage threshold bohat kam set hai

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC switch immediately and confirm the voltage.
solutions.ur: DC switch foran disconnect karke voltage confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check the panel input and count the modules against the string Voc calculation.
solutions.ur: Panel input check karke string Voc calculation ke against modules gin lein.

solutions.en: After the normal voltage is restored, if the message persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Normal voltage restore hone ke baad bhi message rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

title.ur: Current transformer open hai / connected nahi

meaning.en: The inverter gets no current-transformer signal, so it cannot do export limiting.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko current-transformer ka signal nahi mil raha, is liye export limiting nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: CT secondary lead not connected or CT not clipped onto the conductor
causes.ur: CT secondary lead nahi lagi ya CT conductor par nahi laga

causes.en: RS485 link to the CT/meter broken
causes.ur: CT/meter ka RS485 link toota hua

solutions.en: After shutdown, check whether the current transformer is connected well.
solutions.ur: Shutdown ke baad check karein ke current transformer theek se laga hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Confirm the CT arrow faces the load and S1/S2 go to the right meter terminals.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke CT ka arrow load ki taraf hai aur S1/S2 sahi meter terminals par lage hain.

solutions.en: If the message persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar message bacha rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MID 15-50KTL3-XL2 / X2 (three-phase commercial string, OLED + touch)

title.en: Control board and comm board firmware mismatch (warning 405)
title.ur: Control board aur comm board firmware mismatch (warning 405)

meaning.en: The control board and the communication board are running different firmware releases.
meaning.ur: Control board aur communication board alag alag firmware releases par chal rahe hain.

causes.en: A partial firmware update left the two boards on different versions
causes.ur: Partial firmware update ki wajah se dono boards alag versions par reh gaye

causes.en: Comm board replaced without matching firmware
causes.ur: Comm board badla gaya aur matching firmware nahi lagaya

solutions.en: Check the firmware version of both boards and record them.
solutions.ur: Dono boards ka firmware version check karke note karein.

solutions.en: Update both boards to the same released firmware pair from the Growatt download centre.
solutions.ur: Dono boards ko Growatt download centre se ek hi released firmware pair par update karein.

solutions.en: If the message persists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar message bacha rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MID 33-50KTL3-X2 User Manual EN (GR-UM-247-A-01)

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

title.en: Residual I high (leakage current too high)
title.ur: Residual I high (leakage current bohat zyada)

meaning.en: Residual current has gone above the limit, so the inverter stopped.
meaning.ur: Residual current limit se upar chala gaya, is liye inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Insulation breakdown in the PV array or cabling
causes.ur: PV array ya cabling mein insulation breakdown

causes.en: Water in a junction box or DC isolator
causes.ur: Junction box ya DC isolator mein paani

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then measure array insulation resistance to earth with a megohmmeter.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke megohmmeter se array ki earth ke taraf insulation resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV strings one by one to find the leaking one.
solutions.ur: PV strings ko ek-ek karke disconnect karke leaking string dhoondein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the error message still exists, contact Growatt.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; error message phir bhi rahe to Growatt se rabta karein.

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

meaning.en: DC input voltage is above the maximum tolerable value for this unit.
meaning.ur: DC input voltage is unit ke maximum tolerable value se upar hai.

causes.en: String Voc too high in cold ambient conditions
causes.ur: Thande mausam mein string ka Voc bohat zyada

causes.en: String voltage rise from a partial disconnect on one string
causes.ur: Kisi string ka partial disconnect hone se voltage barh gaya

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC switch immediately.
solutions.ur: DC switch foran disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Check the voltage of each PV string with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se har PV string ka voltage check karein.

solutions.en: If the PV string voltage is lower than 550 V, contact Growatt.
solutions.ur: Agar PV string voltage 550 V se kam hai to Growatt se rabta karein.

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

meaning.en: Insulation between the PV array and ground has fallen below the threshold; this manual gives explicit impedance limits.
meaning.ur: PV array aur ground ke darmiyan insulation threshold se neeche gir gaya; is manual mein impedance limits diye gaye hain.

causes.en: Panel enclosure not grounded properly, or inverter ground not solid
causes.ur: Panel enclosure theek se grounded nahi, ya inverter ground mazboot nahi

causes.en: DC breaker has got wet, or cable insulation is damaged
causes.ur: DC breaker geela ho gaya, ya cable insulation damaged hai

solutions.en: Check if the panel enclosure is grounded properly, then check that the inverter ground is solid.
solutions.ur: Pehle panel enclosure theek grounded hai ya nahi check karein, phir inverter ground mazboot hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check if the DC breaker has got wet and inspect it for water ingress.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke DC breaker geela to nahi ho gaya aur usmein paani ke nishaan dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure PV(+) to PV(-) to ground impedance - the manual requires more than 25 kOhm (550 kOhm per VDE 0126).
solutions.ur: PV(+) se PV(-) aur ground ke darmiyan impedance measure karein - manual ke mutabiq 25 kOhm se zyada (VDE 0126 ke mutabiq 550 kOhm) hona chahiye.

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

title.en: AC V outrange (utility grid voltage out of range)
title.ur: AC V outrange (grid voltage range se bahar)

meaning.en: Utility grid voltage is outside the permissible range, so grid connection is blocked.
meaning.ur: Utility grid voltage permissible range se bahar hai, is liye grid connection block hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage out of the local standard window
causes.ur: Grid voltage local standard window se bahar hai

causes.en: Neutral or ground wire loose in the AC wiring
causes.ur: AC wiring mein neutral ya ground wire loose hai

solutions.en: Switch off the DC switch first.
solutions.ur: Pehle DC switch band karein.

solutions.en: Check AC wiring, especially neutral and the ground wire, and re-torque the terminals.
solutions.ur: AC wiring check karein, khaas kar neutral aur ground wire, aur terminals dobara torque karein.

solutions.en: Check grid voltage against the local grid standard, then restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Grid voltage ko local grid standard se check karke inverter restart karein.

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

title.ur: PE abnormal (N aur PE ka voltage 30 V se upar)

meaning.en: Voltage between neutral and PE is above 30 V, so the inverter has shut down.
meaning.ur: Neutral aur PE ke darmiyan voltage 30 V se upar hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: PE conductor open, so neutral floats through the load
causes.ur: PE conductor khul gaya hai, is liye neutral load ke zariye float kar raha hai

causes.en: Neutral and PE swapped at the AC terminal
causes.ur: AC terminal par neutral aur PE swap ho gaye hain

solutions.en: Switch off the DC switch, then check AC wiring, especially neutral and ground wire.
solutions.ur: DC switch band karke AC wiring check karein, khaas kar neutral aur ground wire.

solutions.en: Measure the voltage of neutral to PE; anything above 30 V is a fault condition.
solutions.ur: Neutral se PE voltage measure karein; 30 V se upar koi bhi reading fault condition hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the error message still exists, contact the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; error message phir bhi rahe to manufacturer se rabta karein.

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

meaning.en: The inverter's pre-connection auto test did not pass, so it will not connect.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka connection se pehle ka auto test pass nahi hua, is liye woh connect nahi hoga.

causes.en: Grid conditions not settled when the test ran
causes.ur: Test chalne ke waqt grid conditions settle nahi hue

causes.en: PV insulation or AFCI self-test failing the same test
causes.ur: PV insulation ya AFCI self-test bhi isi test mein fail ho raha hai

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and repeat the auto test.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke auto test dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Check PV isolation and PE continuity before repeating, so a real earth fault is not mistaken for a test failure.
solutions.ur: Dobara chalane se pehle PV isolation aur PE continuity check karein taake asal earth fault ko test failure na samajhein.

solutions.en: If the problem still exists, contact Growatt.
solutions.ur: Agar masla phir bhi hai to Growatt se rabta karein.

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

title.ur: DSP ka M3 se communication abnormal hai

meaning.en: The DSP on the control board and the M3 communication board are not exchanging data.
meaning.ur: Control board ka DSP aur M3 communication board aapas mein data exchange nahi kar rahe.

causes.en: DSP and M3 firmware versions do not match
causes.ur: DSP aur M3 firmware versions match nahi karte

causes.en: Communication ribbon cable or connector loose
causes.ur: Communication ribbon cable ya connector loose

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the DSP-to-M3 ribbon connector.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke DSP se M3 ribbon connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Update the DSP and M3 firmware to a matched pair.
solutions.ur: DSP aur M3 firmware ko matched pair par update karein.

solutions.en: Change the DSP board or M3 board if the problem persists, then claim Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar masla bacha rahe to DSP board ya M3 board badlein, phir Growatt warranty claim karein.

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

meaning.en: Settings memory cannot be read or written.
meaning.ur: Settings memory parh ya likh nahi sakta.

causes.en: EEPROM chip or its solder joint on the M3 board
causes.ur: M3 board par EEPROM chip ya uska solder joint

causes.en: Power loss during a settings write
causes.ur: Settings write ke dauran power chala jana

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, wait 5 minutes, then restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke 5 minute wait karein, phir inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Note whether the error appears only in the morning - a marginal chip behaves that way.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke error sirf subah aata hai ya nahi - marginal chip aise hi behave karta hai.

solutions.en: If the fault is sustained, the M3 board must be replaced - claim Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar fault barqarar rahe to M3 board badalna parega - Growatt warranty claim karein.

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)
aliases: DSP and redundant M3 data mismatch

title.en: DSP and redundant M3 sampled data not the same
title.ur: DSP aur redundant M3 ka data same nahi hai

meaning.en: The DSP and the redundant M3 board are sampling the same signals and getting different answers.
meaning.ur: DSP aur redundant M3 board wahi signals sample karke alag jawab de rahe hain.

causes.en: One sampling channel has drifted
causes.ur: Kisi aik sampling channel bekar chala hai

causes.en: Redundant wiring harness between DSP and M3 has a poor connection
causes.ur: DSP aur M3 ke darmiyan redundant wiring harness ka connection kharab hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the redundancy harness connectors.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke redundancy harness connectors dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and check whether the code is consistent or intermittent.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke check karein ke code consistent hai ya intermittent.

solutions.en: If the channels never agree, the M3 board must be replaced - claim Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar channels kabhi match na hon to M3 board badalna parega - Growatt warranty claim karein.

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

meaning.en: The ground fault circuit interrupter has reported a fault condition.
meaning.ur: Ground fault circuit interrupter ne fault condition report kiya.

causes.en: GFCI module damaged by a surge or repeated leakage trips
causes.ur: Surge ya baar baar leakage trips se GFCI module kharab

causes.en: Real earth fault still present in the array
causes.ur: Array mein asal earth fault abhi bhi mojood hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then measure the array insulation resistance to rule out a real earth fault.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke asal earth fault rule out karne ke liye array ki insulation resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and see whether the code clears.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke dekhein ke code clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the code returns with good insulation, the power board must be replaced - claim Growatt warranty.
solutions.ur: Agar insulation theek hone par bhi code wapas aaye to power board badalna parega - Growatt warranty claim karein.

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

title.en: FAULT LED solid red - arc fault
title.ur: FAULT LED lal bar lal - arc fault

meaning.en: Solid red FAULT LED with the buzzer sounding means an arc fault is present.
meaning.ur: Solid red FAULT LED aur buzzer bolna matlab arc fault mojood hai.

causes.en: Real arc at a PV connector, module or DC cable
causes.ur: PV connector, module ya DC cable par asal arc

causes.en: A tripped AFCI that has not been reset
causes.ur: AFCI trip ho gaya aur reset nahi hua

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then inspect every DC connector for heat damage.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke har DC connector par garmi ke nishaan dekhein.

solutions.en: Press the internal arc reset button for 3-5 seconds to clear the arc fault.
solutions.ur: Arc fault clear karne ke liye andar wale arc reset button ko 3-5 second tak dabayein.

solutions.en: After shutdown, check the panel terminal wiring before restarting.
solutions.ur: Restart se pehle shutdown ke baad panel terminal wiring check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED red steady on + buzzer sounding

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

title.en: FAULT LED blinking 1s on/1s off - warning
title.ur: FAULT LED 1s on/1s off blink - warning

meaning.en: A blinking red FAULT LED means a warning condition - the inverter usually derates rather than stops.
meaning.ur: Blinking red FAULT LED ka matlab warning condition hai - inverter aam tor par band hone ke bajaye power kam karta hai.

causes.en: Any of the §11.4.3 warning codes, e.g. meter abnormal or EEPROM abnormal
causes.ur: §11.4.3 ke kisi bhi warning code ka haal, jaise meter abnormal ya EEPROM abnormal

causes.en: WiFi / 4G communication loss reported elsewhere
causes.ur: WiFi / 4G communication loss kisi aur jagah report hua

solutions.en: Read the exact warning on the LED screen or the ShinePhone app before acting.
solutions.ur: Koi kaam karne se pehle LED screen ya ShinePhone app par exact warning padhein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter once; most warnings clear on restart.
solutions.ur: Inverter ek baar restart karein; zyada tar warnings restart par clear ho jate hain.

solutions.en: If the same warning keeps returning, note it and follow that code's own procedure.
solutions.ur: Agar wahi warning baar baar aata rahe to use note karein aur usi code ka procedure follow karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED red blink 1s on / 1s off

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

title.en: BAT LED fast blink - battery in fault mode
title.ur: BAT LED tez blink - battery fault mode mein hai

meaning.en: The battery side has latched a fault; the inverter may be running on PV or grid only.
meaning.ur: Battery side ne fault latch kar liya hai; inverter sirf PV ya grid par chal raha ho sakta hai.

causes.en: Battery BMS has latched a fault such as over/under voltage or over-temperature
causes.ur: Battery BMS ne over/under voltage ya over-temperature jaisa fault latch kar liya hai

causes.en: Battery communication to the inverter has dropped
causes.ur: Battery ka inverter se communication gir gaya hai

solutions.en: Check battery terminal voltage with a multimeter before touching connections.
solutions.ur: Connections chhoone se pehle multimeter se battery terminal voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle the battery (many ARO-type packs have a reset button) and confirm it wakes up.
solutions.ur: Battery ko power-cycle karein (bohat se ARO packs mein reset button hota hai) aur confirm karein ke woh jaag jati hai.

solutions.en: If the battery still faults, read the BMS's own fault code before replacing anything.
solutions.ur: Agar battery phir bhi fault de rahi hai to kuch bhi badalne se pehle BMS ka apna fault code padhein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED green blink 0.5s on / 0.5s off

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

title.en: Inverter does not communicate with meter
title.ur: Inverter meter se communicate nahi kar raha

meaning.en: The inverter and the energy meter are not talking over RS485, so export control is unavailable.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur energy meter RS485 par baat nahi kar rahe, is liye export control available nahi.

causes.en: Meter not powered, or RS485 cable loose
causes.ur: Meter powered nahi, ya RS485 cable loose hai

causes.en: Meter address or baud rate not matching the inverter setting
causes.ur: Meter ka address ya baud rate inverter setting se match nahi karta

solutions.en: Check if the meter is on - look for its own status LED.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke meter on hai ya nahi - uska apna status LED dekhein.

solutions.en: Check that the inverter-to-meter connection is normal and the RS485 cable is seated at both ends.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke inverter se meter ka connection normal hai aur RS485 cable dono taraf baitha hua hai.

solutions.en: Compare the meter's address and baud rate against the inverter's communication settings.
solutions.ur: Meter ka address aur baud rate inverter ki communication settings se compare karein.

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US (single-phase hybrid, 4-LED status)

title.ur: EEPROM mein ghalti - memory ka masla (warning 404)

meaning.en: The M3 board reports a memory abnormality as a warning rather than a hard fault.
meaning.ur: M3 board memory abnormality ko hard fault ke bajaye warning ke tor par report karta hai.

causes.en: Marginal EEPROM chip or a bad I2C solder joint
causes.ur: Marginal EEPROM chip ya kharab I2C solder joint

causes.en: Power interruption while writing settings
causes.ur: Settings likhte waqt power chala jana

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and see whether the warning clears.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke dekhein ke warning clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the warning persists, contact Growatt customer service to replace the M3 board.
solutions.ur: Agar warning bacha rahe to Growatt customer service se M3 board badalwane ka request karein.

solutions.en: Before any firmware update, fully power the unit down as Growatt's warranty terms require.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi firmware update karne se pehle unit ko poori tarah power down karein, jaise Growatt ke warranty terms kehti hain.

source.title: MIN 3000-11400TL-XH-US User Manual EN

codes.seriesName: MOD 3-15KTL3-X (three-phase string, 2 MPPT)

meaning.en: The AFCI arc-fault detector has tripped on the DC side. A tripped AFCI can only be cleared manually.
meaning.ur: DC side par AFCI ne arc detect kar ke apne aap band kar diya. Isay sirf manual tareeqe se reset karna hota hai.

causes.en: A real arc at a PV connector, module or DC cable
causes.ur: PV connector, module ya DC cable par asal arc

causes.en: Loose or burnt MC4 connector, or damaged DC insulation
causes.ur: Loose ya burnt MC4 connector, ya DC insulation damaged

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and wait 5 minutes before touching anything.
solutions.ur: DC switch off karein aur 5 minute wait karein, phir haath lagayein.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, check the DC input voltage first (0 V expected).
solutions.ur: Multimeter se pehle DC input voltage check karein (0 V aana chahiye).

solutions.en: Inspect every MC4 pair and DC cable for heat marks, and re-crimp any loose connector.
solutions.ur: Har MC4 pair aur DC cable par garmi ke nishaan dekhein, aur loose connector dobara crimp karein.

source.title: MOD 3-15KTL3-X User Manual EN (GR-UM-212-A-02)

codes.seriesName: MOD 3-15KTL3-X (three-phase string, 2 MPPT)

meaning.en: The residual-current device measured leakage current above the permitted limit.
meaning.ur: Residual current device ne leakage current ki limit cross kar li.

causes.en: Moisture in PV connectors or junction boxes
causes.ur: PV connectors ya junction boxes mein nam

causes.en: Damaged cable insulation to PE, or poor panel-frame earthing
causes.ur: PE ke taraf cable insulation damaged, ya panel frame earthing kharab

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then measure PV+ to PE and PV- to PE insulation resistance with a megohmmeter.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, phir megohmmeter se PV+ se PE aur PV- se PE ka insulation resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV strings one by one to find the leaking string.
solutions.ur: PV strings ko ek-ek karke disconnect karein taake leaking string pata chale.

solutions.en: Clean and dry the affected connectors, and re-torque the frame and PE earth lugs.
solutions.ur: Affected connectors ko saaf aur khushk karein, aur frame aur PE earth lugs dobara torque karein.

source.title: MOD 3-15KTL3-X User Manual EN (GR-UM-212-A-02)

codes.seriesName: MOD 3-15KTL3-X (three-phase string, 2 MPPT)

title.ur: DC input voltage maximum se zyada

meaning.en: PV string open-circuit voltage has gone above the inverter's maximum tolerable DC voltage.
meaning.ur: PV string ka open-circuit voltage inverter ke maximum DC voltage se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: String designed too long for the ambient minimum temperature (Voc rises in cold weather)
causes.ur: String minimum temperature ke liye lambi banayi gayi hai, thand mein Voc barh jata hai
