solutions.en: Check each battery's status: measure its voltage and SOC and write them down for every unit.
solutions.ur: Har battery ka status check karein: uska voltage aur SOC naalein aur har unit ka likh lein.

solutions.en: With DC off, compare the battery type, capacity, charge current and float voltage settings across all units and make them identical.
solutions.ur: DC off karke sab units ka battery type, capacity, charge current aur float voltage setting compare karein aur sab ko aik jaisa kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure each battery's internal resistance or ask for its BMS history to find a failed cell.
solutions.ur: Har battery ki internal resistance naalein ya failed cell dhoondne ke liye BMS ki history mangwayein.

solutions.en: If one pack is clearly worse, isolate that unit and service or replace that battery only — do not mix packs with different capacities.
solutions.ur: Agar aik pack saaf tor par kharab ho to us unit ko alag kar ke sirf wohi battery service ya replace karein — alag capacity ke packs aik saath na lagayein.

solutions.en: Fault clears and stays away: if not, contact Deye as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Fault clear ho jaye to theek hai; na hatne par manual ke mutabiq Deye se rabta karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

codes.seriesName: SUN-5/6/8/10/12K-SG04LP3-EU (three-phase 48V low-voltage hybrid)

meaning.en: Grid frequency is outside the specification range, so the inverter stops.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency specification range se bahar hai, is liye inverter band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Actual grid frequency is out of the specification range.
causes.ur: Asal grid frequency specification range se bahar hai.

causes.en: AC cables are not firmly or correctly connected.
causes.ur: AC cables mazboot ya sahi tarah se connected nahi hain.

causes.en: Genset supply with an unstable governor, or a wrong 50/60 Hz grid type setting.
causes.ur: Unstable governor wala genset supply, ya 50 ya 60 Hz ki galat grid type setting.

solutions.en: Check the frequency with a clamp meter or multimeter in frequency mode at the AC input.
solutions.ur: AC input par clamp meter ya multimeter ko frequency mode mein set karke frequency check karein.

solutions.en: Compare the reading against the frequency range in the manual specification.
solutions.ur: Reading ko manual specification ke frequency range se compare karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the grid type / frequency setting matches the actual supply.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke grid type aur frequency ki setting asal supply se match karti hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and re-tighten all AC cable terminals, then restart once the frequency is in range.
solutions.ur: Power off karke sab AC cable terminals dobara tighten karein, phir frequency range mein aane par restart karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

codes.seriesName: SUN-5/6/8/10/12K-SG04LP3-EU (three-phase 48V low-voltage hybrid)

meaning.en: Grid frequency is below the specification range, so the inverter stops.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency specification range se neeche hai, is liye inverter band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Weak grid is dragging frequency below the window.
causes.ur: Kamzor grid frequency ko window se neeche gira raha hai.

causes.en: AC cables are not firmly or correctly connected.
causes.ur: AC cables mazboot ya sahi tarah se connected nahi hain.

causes.en: Genset running too slow, or 50/60 Hz grid type set against the real supply.
causes.ur: Genset bohat dheere chal raha hai, ya asal supply ke khilaf 50 ya 60 Hz grid type set hai.

solutions.en: Measure the frequency at the AC input and compare it with the manual's specification range.
solutions.ur: AC input par frequency naalein aur manual ki specification range se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check the grid type / frequency setting and set it to the real supply frequency.
solutions.ur: Grid type aur frequency setting check karein aur use asal supply frequency par set karein.

solutions.en: If a genset feeds the inverter, adjust its speed and let the frequency settle before restart.
solutions.ur: Agar genset inverter ko power de raha ho to uski speed theek karein aur restart se pehle frequency settle hone dein.

solutions.en: Re-tighten the AC cable terminals and restart when the grid recovers.
solutions.ur: AC cable terminals dobara tighten karein aur grid theek hone par restart karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

codes.seriesName: SUN-5/6/8/10/12K-SG04LP3-EU (three-phase 48V low-voltage hybrid)
aliases: DC busbar voltage is too high

title.en: DC busbar voltage is too high
title.ur: DC busbar voltage bohat zyada hai

meaning.en: The DC busbar voltage is above the limit. Deye tells you to check battery voltage and the PV input voltage range.
meaning.ur: DC busbar voltage limit se upar hai. Deye kehta hai ke battery voltage aur PV input voltage ka range check karein.

causes.en: Battery voltage is above the allowed DC window for this model.
causes.ur: Battery voltage is model ke ijazat shuda DC range se upar hai.

causes.en: PV string voltage is above the maximum DC input, e.g. too many modules in series for cold conditions.
causes.ur: PV string ka voltage maximum DC input se upar hai, jaise thand mein modules ki series tadaad zyada ho.

causes.en: Battery type or float voltage is set higher than the battery can safely hold.
causes.ur: Battery type ya float voltage battery se zyada set hai jo battery safely hold kar sakta hai.

causes.en: PV input voltage detection has drifted and the unit is over-charging the bus.
causes.ur: PV input voltage detection drift kar gaya hai aur unit bus ko zyada charge kar raha hai.

solutions.en: With AC and DC off, measure the battery terminal voltage on a multimeter and compare it with the manual's DC window.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC off karke multimeter se battery terminal voltage naalein aur manual ke DC range se compare karein.

solutions.en: Measure the PV string open-circuit voltage and confirm it is within the allowed PV input range on cold mornings.
solutions.ur: PV string ki open-circuit voltage naalein aur confirm karein ke thand ke subah bhi ye ijazat shuda PV input range mein hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of PV modules in series if the cold-morning Voc exceeds the limit.
solutions.ur: Agar thand ki subah Voc limit cross kare to series mein modules ki tadaad kam karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery type and float/charge voltage settings in the LCD match the fitted battery.
solutions.ur: LCD mein battery type aur float ya charge voltage setting check karein ke lagay huay battery se match karti hai.

solutions.en: If measured voltages are inside the window, the busbar voltage detection circuit needs service.
solutions.ur: Nikalay huay voltages range ke andar hon to busbar voltage detection circuit ko service chahiye.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

codes.seriesName: SUN-5/6/8/10/12K-SG04LP3-EU (three-phase 48V low-voltage hybrid)
aliases: DC busbar voltage is too low

title.en: DC busbar voltage is too low
title.ur: DC busbar voltage bohat kam hai

meaning.en: The DC busbar voltage is below the limit. Deye tells you to check the battery voltage and to charge from PV or grid.
meaning.ur: DC busbar voltage limit se neeche hai. Deye kehta hai ke battery voltage check karein aur PV ya grid se charge karein.

causes.en: Battery voltage has dropped below the allowed window, usually deep discharge.
causes.ur: Battery voltage ijazat shuda window se neeche gir gaya hai, aam tor par gehri discharge.

causes.en: PV input voltage is too low to charge, e.g. early morning or shaded array.
causes.ur: PV input voltage charge karne ke liye bohat kam hai, jaise subah jaldi ya array par parda.

causes.en: Battery fuse, connector or BMS contact is open.
causes.ur: Battery fuse, connector ya BMS ka contact khula hua hai.

causes.en: Charge current setting is too low, so the bus never recovers.
causes.ur: Charge current setting bohat kam hai, is liye bus kabhi recover nahi hota.

solutions.en: Check whether the battery voltage is too low, using a multimeter on the battery terminals.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery terminals par voltage check karein ke battery voltage bohat kam to nahi hai.

solutions.en: If the battery is too low, charge it with PV or grid exactly as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage kam ho to manual ke mutabiq use PV ya grid se charge karein.

solutions.en: Open the AC and DC switches and check the battery fuse, connector seating and BMS contact.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC switch khol ke battery fuse, connector ki seating aur BMS contact check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the charge current and float voltage settings are not set too low for the battery.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke charge current aur float voltage ki setting battery ke liye bohat kam to nahi rakhi gayi.

solutions.en: Battery charged but the bus stays low: the busbar voltage sampling wiring is faulty.
solutions.ur: Battery charge ho jaye phir bhi bus kam rahe to busbar voltage sampling wiring kharab hai.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

codes.seriesName: SUN-5/6/8/10/12K-SG04LP3-EU (three-phase 48V low-voltage hybrid)

meaning.en: Communication between the hybrid inverter and the battery BMS is lost while BMS_Err-Stop is active.
meaning.ur: BMS_Err-Stop active hone ke dauran hybrid inverter aur battery BMS ka communication nahi hai.

causes.en: BMS_Err-Stop is enabled and the BMS has dropped the CAN link.
causes.ur: BMS_Err-Stop on hai aur BMS ne CAN link chhor diya hai.

causes.en: Comms cable is loose, reversed or on the wrong pins.
causes.ur: Comms cable loose, ulti ya galat pins par hai.

causes.en: BMS is asleep, on low SOC, or has latched its own fault.
causes.ur: BMS so raha hai, low SOC par hai ya apna fault latch kar chuka hai.

causes.en: Battery protocol or type setting does not match the fitted BMS.
causes.ur: Battery protocol ya type ki setting lagay huay BMS se match nahi karti.

solutions.en: Check the comms cable seating and pinout at both the inverter and the BMS, then re-seat it.
solutions.ur: Inverter aur BMS dono taraf comms cable ki seating aur pinout check karke use dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Confirm the BMS is powered, awake and not stopped on its own low voltage or SOC limit.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke BMS power on, jaag hua aur apne low voltage ya SOC limit par band nahi hua.

solutions.en: Set the battery type and protocol on the LCD to the exact model fitted.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery type aur protocol woh exact model set karein jo lagaya hua hai.

solutions.en: If you do not want this stop behaviour, disable BMS_Err-Stop on the LCD — only after the pack is proven good.
solutions.ur: Agar ye stop behaviour nahi chahiye to LCD se BMS_Err-Stop disable karein, magar sirf tab jab pack theek sabit ho.

solutions.en: Fault persists: the BMS module or its CAN transceiver is faulty and needs replacement.
solutions.ur: Fault phir bhi rahe to BMS module ya uska CAN transceiver kharab hai aur replacement chahiye.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

codes.seriesName: SUN-5/6/8/10/12K-SG04LP3-EU (three-phase 48V low-voltage hybrid)

title.ur: DRMs0_stop, demand response ne band kiya

meaning.en: The DRM port has commanded the inverter to stop. Deye states the DRM function is for the Australia market only.
meaning.ur: DRM port ne inverter ko band karne ka command diya hai. Deye kehta hai ke DRM function sirf Australia market ke liye hai.

causes.en: The utility or a demand response device has asserted the DRM pin.
causes.ur: Utility ya kisi demand response device ne DRM pin assert kar diya hai.

causes.en: The DRM wiring on the DRS/D com port is shorted or connected to the wrong pin.
causes.ur: DRS ya D com port par DRM wiring short ho gayi hai ya galat pin se juri hai.

causes.en: The DRM function is left enabled on a non-Australian installation with a floating or live DRS pin.
causes.ur: Non-Australian installation par DRM function chala chhuda hai aur DRS pin floating ya live hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the DRM function is active on the unit; the manual makes this step 2.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke DRM function unit par active hai ya nahi, manual isay step 2 batata hai.

solutions.en: At the DRS port, measure voltage to ground with a multimeter; a live DRS/D pin is what commands the stop.
solutions.ur: DRS port par multimeter se ground ke qeemat voltage naalein; live DRS ya D pin hi stop ka command deta hai.

solutions.en: If the site is not in Australia, disable DRM in the settings and disconnect the DRS wires, then confirm the pin is dead.
solutions.ur: Agar site Australia mein nahi hai to settings mein DRM disable karein aur DRS wires disconnect karke confirm karein ke pin dead hai.

solutions.en: Restart the system; if it still cannot return to normal contact Deye as the manual says.
solutions.ur: System restart karein; phir bhi normal par na aaye to manual ke mutabiq Deye se rabta karein.

notes.en: In Pakistan this code almost always means a mis-wired or floating DRS pin on the comms connector, not an actual utility demand response event.
notes.ur: Pakistan mein ye code aksar DRS pin ki galat wiring ya floating pin ka matlab hota hai, asal utility demand response event ka nahi.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

codes.seriesName: SUN-5/6/8/10/12K-SG04LP3-EU (three-phase 48V low-voltage hybrid)

title.ur: ARC fault, PV mein arc detect hua

meaning.en: The PV arc fault function has tripped. Clear the cable fault, then clear the alarm on the inverter.
meaning.ur: PV arc fault function trigger ho gaya hai. Cable ka fault theek karein, phir inverter par alarm clear karein.

causes.en: DC connector not fully mated, so contacts arc under load.
causes.ur: DC connector poora fit nahi hai, is liye load ke neeche contacts arc karte hain.

causes.en: Burnt or badly crimped DC plug.
causes.ur: Jala hua ya kharab crimp kiya hua DC plug.

causes.en: PV cable insulation damaged by UV, heat or rodents.
causes.ur: UV, garmi ya chuhe se PV cable ki insulation kharab hui.

solutions.en: Check the PV module cable connections and clear the fault on the cable side first.
solutions.ur: Pehle PV module cable ke connections check karke us taraf ka fault theek karein.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch, confirm DC is dead, then pull and inspect every MC4 pair by hand.
solutions.ur: DC switch khol ke DC dead confirm karein, phir har MC4 pair haath se nikal kar check karein.

solutions.en: Replace any connector that is loose, heat damaged or wrongly crimped.
solutions.ur: Loose, garmi se kharab ya galat crimp wala connector replace kar dein.

solutions.en: After the cable fault is gone, clear the fault and seek Deye help if it will not clear.
solutions.ur: Cable fault khatam hone ke baad fault clear karein aur na hatne par Deye se madad lein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

codes.seriesName: SUN-5/6/8/10/12K-SG04LP3-EU (three-phase 48V low-voltage hybrid)

title.ur: Heat sink bohat garm ho gaya

meaning.en: The heat sink is too hot, so the inverter shut down. Deye asks you to check the ambient temperature and restart after 10 minutes.
meaning.ur: Heat sink bohat garm hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya. Deye kehta hai ke aam temperature check karein aur 10 minute baad restart karein.

causes.en: Working environment temperature is too high for the installation.
causes.ur: Installation ki jagah ka working environment temperature bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Fan is faulty or its cable is not connected, so no forced cooling.
causes.ur: Fan kharab hai ya uska cable connected nahi, is liye forced cooling nahi hai.

causes.en: Heat sink is choked with dust or the unit is boxed in with no airflow.
causes.ur: Heat sink dhool se band hai ya unit aisa band hai ke hawa nahi aati.

solutions.en: Check whether the work environment temperature is too high; measure it where the unit is installed.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke work environment temperature zyada to nahi hai; jahan unit laga hai wahan temperature naalein.

solutions.en: Turn the inverter off for 10 minutes and restart, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq inverter ko 10 minute ke liye band karke restart karein.

solutions.en: With the unit off, check the fan connector and confirm the fan spins freely.
solutions.ur: Unit off karke fan connector check karein aur confirm karein ke fan azaad chalta hai.

solutions.en: Vacuum the heat sink fins and keep the manual's clearance around the unit for airflow.
solutions.ur: Heat sink ki fins vacuum karein aur unit ke aas paas manual ki clearance hawa ke liye rakhein.

solutions.en: Still tripping in a cool ventilated space: the NTC temperature sensor or the fan itself is faulty.
solutions.ur: Thande aur hawa wale kamre mein bhi aaye to NTC temperature sensor ya fan kharab hai.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-12K-SG04LP3-EU User Manual (instructions_sun-5-12k-sg04lp3-eu_240203_en)

codes.seriesName: EH / EH Plus single-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: No grid power, or the AC line / AC switch is disconnected, so the inverter is not exporting.
meaning.ur: Grid power nahi hai ya AC line / AC switch disconnect hai, is liye inverter export nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Grid power outage.
causes.ur: Grid power chali gayi.

causes.en: AC line or AC switch disconnected.
causes.ur: AC line ya AC switch disconnect hai.

solutions.en: The alarm clears by itself once grid power is restored.
solutions.ur: Grid power aane par alarm khud ba khud clear ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Check the AC line and AC switch for a loose or tripped connection.
solutions.ur: AC line aur AC switch ka dhila ya trip hua connection check karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

codes.seriesName: EH / EH Plus single-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: PV string or battery port insulation to protective earth is too low; the manual states above 80kOhm is normal.
meaning.ur: PV string ya battery port ka protective earth se insulation bohat kam hai, manual ke mutabiq 80kOhm se upar normal hai.

causes.en: PV string shorted to protective earth.
causes.ur: PV string protective earth se short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Long-term humid environment with poor line-to-ground insulation.
causes.ur: Nam mahaul aur line-to-ground insulation kamzor hai.

causes.en: Low line-to-ground insulation resistance at the battery port.
causes.ur: Battery port par line-to-ground insulation resistance kam hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC isolator, then measure each string to PE; over 80kOhm is normal.
solutions.ur: DC isolator kholein, phir har string ko PE se measure karein, 80kOhm se upar normal hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect strings one by one to isolate the leaking string.
solutions.ur: Strings ko aik aik disconnect karke leaking string ko alag karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the inverter protective earth wire is connected.
solutions.ur: Inverter ka protective earth wire laga hua hai ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: In genuinely wet conditions only, reset the Insulation Resistance Protection Point in the app.
solutions.ur: Sirf asal mein geelay mahaul mein app se Insulation Resistance Protection Point reset karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

codes.seriesName: EH / EH Plus single-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: The relay self-test found a problem: relay shorted, relay sampling circuit abnormal, or AC side wiring loose or shorted.
meaning.ur: Relay self-test ne masla paya: relay short hai, relay sampling circuit abnormal hai ya AC side wiring dhili/shorted hai.

causes.en: Relay fault such as a relay short circuit.
causes.ur: Relay short circuit jaisa fault.

causes.en: Relay sampling circuit abnormality.
causes.ur: Relay sampling circuit ki kharabi.

causes.en: AC side wiring abnormal, loose connection or short circuit.
causes.ur: AC side wiring abnormal, dhili connection ya short circuit.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, wait 5 minutes, then re-energise before deeper checks.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC isolate karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir dobara on karein.

solutions.en: With AC isolated, inspect and re-torque the AC output terminals for a loose conductor.
solutions.ur: AC isolate kar ke AC output terminals ki tightening check karein.

solutions.en: Test the relay contacts for continuity and check the coil voltage on energising.
solutions.ur: Relay contacts ki continuity test karein aur energize hone par coil voltage check karein.

notes.en: On SDT-G3 the same number F32 means 'Inverter Internal Failure', so the two manuals must not be merged.
notes.ur: SDT-G3 par isi number F32 ka matlab 'Inverter Internal Failure' hai, is liye dono manuals merge nahi karne.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

codes.seriesName: EH / EH Plus single-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: An arc or bad connection was detected on the DC side within strings 1 to 16, usually from a loose or damaged terminal.
meaning.ur: Strings 1 se 16 mein DC side par arc ya kharab connection mila, aam tor par dhile ya damaged terminal ki wajah se.

causes.en: Loose DC side connection terminals.
causes.ur: DC side ke connection terminals dhile hain.

causes.en: Poor contact at the DC side terminals.
causes.ur: DC side terminals par poor contact hai.

causes.en: Damaged DC cable core causing poor contact.
causes.ur: DC cable ka core damaged hai jis se contact kharab hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC isolator and confirm the DC arcs are dead before any inspection.
solutions.ur: DC isolator kholein aur inspect karne se pehle confirm karein ke DC arcs band hain.

solutions.en: Read the string voltage and current after reconnect; an abnormal drop or zero means the affected string.
solutions.ur: Reconnect karne ke baad string ka voltage aur current dekhein, girtan ya zero ka matlab usi string mein masla hai.

solutions.en: Re-crimp the affected MC4 connector with the correct tool and replace any heat-damaged connector.
solutions.ur: Matlab wali MC4 connector sahi tool se dobara crimp karein aur garmi se kharab connector replace karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

codes.seriesName: EH / EH Plus single-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

title.ur: Residual current baar baar trip, band (F52)

meaning.en: North American rules require no automatic recovery after multiple residual current faults, so the unit needs manual recovery or a 24h wait.
meaning.ur: North American rules ke mutabiq baar baar residual current fault ke baad auto recovery nahi hota, is liye manual recovery ya 24 ghante ka intezaar chahiye.

causes.en: Multiple residual current events on the PV string.
causes.ur: PV string par baar baar residual current event hue hain.

causes.en: PV string ground impedance too low.
causes.ur: PV string ka ground impedance bohat kam hai.

solutions.en: Isolate DC and locate the leakage path before attempting a reset.
solutions.ur: Reset se pehle DC isolate karke leakage ka asal rasta dhoondein.

solutions.en: Measure PV string to PE impedance; it must be comfortably above the protection point.
solutions.ur: PV string se PE impedance measure karein, ye protection point se kaafi upar hona chahiye.

solutions.en: After the fix, clear the fault per the local utility procedure or allow the 24h wait.
solutions.ur: Theek karne ke baad local utility ke tareeqe se fault clear karein ya 24 ghante ka intezaar dein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

codes.seriesName: EH / EH Plus single-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: Back-up side load is above the inverter output, so the inverter can no longer sustain the overload.
meaning.ur: Back-up side ka load inverter output se zyada hai, is liye inverter overload nahi sambhal sakta.

causes.en: Back-up load above rated output.
causes.ur: Back-up load rated output se zyada hai.

causes.en: Inductive motor starting current on back-up.
causes.ur: Back-up par motor ka starting current.

solutions.en: Turn off some off-grid loads to reduce the inverter off-grid output power.
solutions.ur: Kuch off-grid loads band karke inverter ki off-grid output power kam karein.

solutions.en: Add up the back-up load in watts and compare with the back-up rated power.
solutions.ur: Back-up load ko watts mein jama karke rated power se compare karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

codes.seriesName: EH / EH Plus single-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: On the off-grid side the inverter output overvoltage could damage connected loads, so the unit reacted.
meaning.ur: Off-grid side par inverter output overvoltage se loads kharab ho sakte hain, is liye unit ne protect kiya.

causes.en: Caused by load switching.
causes.ur: Load switching ki wajah se hua.

causes.en: Back-up output voltage rise into the load's non-tolerated band.
causes.ur: Back-up output voltage load ki tolerance se upar chala gaya.

solutions.en: If it only happens on load switching, ignore it; it is normal transient behaviour.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf load switch karne par aaye to ignore karein, ye normal transient behaviour hai.

solutions.en: Measure the back-up output voltage with an AC meter during the switch-on surge.
solutions.ur: Switch-on surge ke dauran AC meter se back-up output voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: If frequent, move surge-heavy loads off back-up and raise the inverter's switching margin.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aaye to surge wale loads back-up se hatayein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

codes.seriesName: EH / EH Plus single-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: The AC terminal is over temperature, attributed to poor ventilation, high ambient or an abnormal internal fan.
meaning.ur: AC terminal ka temperature zyada hai, wajah poor ventilation, high ambient ya internal fan ki kharabi hai.

causes.en: Inverter installation location lacks ventilation.
causes.ur: Jahan inverter laga hai wahan ventilation kam hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature too high.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Internal fan operation abnormal.
causes.ur: Internal fan theek nahi chal raha.

solutions.en: Check the ventilation at the installation point and the ambient temperature there.
solutions.ur: Installation jagah ki ventilation aur wahan ka ambient temperature check karein.

solutions.en: Improve airflow around the unit; keep 300mm+ clearance as per the manual.
solutions.ur: Unit ke aas paas airflow behtar karein, manual ke mutabiq 300mm se zyada gap rakhein.

solutions.en: If both are normal, the internal fan is likely at fault - replace it.
solutions.ur: Agar dono normal hain to internal fan kharab hai, use replace karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

codes.seriesName: EH / EH Plus single-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: The battery precharge circuit is faulty, commonly a burnt precharge resistor, so the bus never reaches battery voltage.
meaning.ur: Battery precharge circuit kharab hai, aam tor par precharge resistor jal chuka hai, is liye bus battery voltage tak nahi pohanchta.

causes.en: Precharge resistor burnt or precharge circuit fault.
causes.ur: Precharge resistor jal chuka hai ya precharge circuit fault hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage does not match the bus voltage.
causes.ur: Battery voltage bus voltage se match nahi karti.

solutions.en: Power the battery on alone with the inverter off and compare battery voltage with the DC bus voltage.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karke sirf battery on karein aur battery voltage se DC bus voltage compare karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the precharge resistor for charring and the battery contactor for pitting.
solutions.ur: Precharge resistor par kaale nishaan aur battery contactor par pitting check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the burnt precharge resistor at the same resistance and wattage.
solutions.ur: Jale hue precharge resistor ko usi resistance aur wattage se replace karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

codes.seriesName: EH / EH Plus single-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

title.ur: PV access mode ki setting ghalat (F122)

meaning.en: The configured PV access mode (AAAA, AACC, ABCD) does not match the real MPPT wiring, so the inverter refuses to run.
meaning.ur: Set kiya gaya PV access mode (AAAA, AACC, ABCD) asal MPPT wiring se match nahi karta, is liye inverter nahi chalta.

causes.en: Actual PV access mode does not match the device setting.
causes.ur: Asal PV access mode device ki setting se match nahi karta.

causes.en: APP or screen still set to AAAA after an MPPT was split.
causes.ur: MPPT split karne ke baad bhi APP ya screen AAAA par hai.

solutions.en: Write down which PV channels share a string.
solutions.ur: Likh lein ke kaun se PV channels aik hi string share karte hain.

solutions.en: Set the PV access mode in the app or on screen to match, then isolate PV and AC and restart.
solutions.ur: App ya screen par PV access mode usi tarah set karein, phir PV aur AC isolate karke restart karein.

solutions.en: If the setting already matches and the code persists, escalate to GoodWe service.
solutions.ur: Agar setting pehle se match karti hai aur phir bhi code aata hai to GoodWe service ko baat karein.

source.title: GW EH User Manual, section 9.4 Inverter Fault

codes.seriesName: EHB named messages (battery hybrid GW5000/6500/8600/0010-EHB)

title.ur: AFCI Fault (EHB) - arc fault module ne arc pakda

meaning.en: The arc fault module either failed its self-test or detected an arc at the inverter's PV terminals.
meaning.ur: Arc fault module ka self-test fail hua ya inverter ke PV terminals par arc detect hua.

causes.en: AFCI self-test abnormal.
causes.ur: AFCI self-test abnormal hai.

causes.en: An arc occurs on the PV terminals of the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter ke PV terminals par arc ho raha hai.

solutions.en: If it is the first occurrence, clear the arc fault in the app and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar pehli baar ho to app se arc fault clear karke inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Open the DC isolator and inspect every PV connector and cable for looseness, heat damage or a broken core.
solutions.ur: DC isolator kholein aur har PV connector aur cable ki dhili jagah, garmi ka nuqsan ya toota core check karein.

solutions.en: Unplug and reconnect all DC wiring, replacing any damaged cable, then restart.
solutions.ur: Tamam DC wiring unplug karke dobara lagayein, damaged cable replace karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: If it still trips, leave the DC isolated and contact after-sales - do not keep re-energising.
solutions.ur: Agar phir bhi trip ho to DC isolate chhor kar after-sales se rabta karein, baar baar on na karein.

source.title: GW EHB User Manual, section 8.1 Error Message

codes.seriesName: EHB named messages (battery hybrid GW5000/6500/8600/0010-EHB)

title.ur: GFCI Device Check Failure (EHB) - GFCi kharab

meaning.en: The ground fault current interrupter device inside the inverter failed its self-check.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar ka GFCI device apna self-check pass nahi kar saka.

causes.en: GFCI device failure.
causes.ur: GFCI device kharab hai.

causes.en: External magnetic field disturbing the GFCI self-check.
causes.ur: External magnetic field GFCI self-check ko disturb kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and see whether the fault returns.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke fault wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Move steel structures, motors and transformers away from the unit and its DC cables.
solutions.ur: Steel structures, motors aur transformers ko unit aur DC cables se door karein.

solutions.en: If it returns, contact after-sales - the GFCI device itself has failed.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to after-sales se rabta karein, khud GFCI device kharab hai.

source.title: GW EHB User Manual, section 8.1 Error Message

codes.seriesName: EHB named messages (battery hybrid GW5000/6500/8600/0010-EHB)

title.ur: AC HCT Check Failure (EHB) - sensor kharab

meaning.en: The inverter's AC Hall current sensor self-check failed, indicating a hardware current sensor problem.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke AC Hall current sensor ka self-check fail hua, is ka matlab hardware current sensor mein masla hai.

causes.en: Inverter hardware current sensor failure.
causes.ur: Inverter ke hardware current sensor kharab hai.

causes.en: Strong external magnetic field around the unit.
causes.ur: Unit ke gird bohat strong external magnetic field.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and confirm whether the code is intermittent or latched.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke code intermittent hai ya latched.

solutions.en: Remove external magnetic sources near the AC cable entry.
solutions.ur: AC cable entry ke paas se magnetic sources hatayein.

solutions.en: If it returns every time, the current sensor has failed - send to after-sales.
solutions.ur: Agar har baar wapas aaye to current sensor kharab hai, after-sales ko bhejein.

source.title: GW EHB User Manual, section 8.1 Error Message

codes.seriesName: EHB named messages (battery hybrid GW5000/6500/8600/0010-EHB)

title.ur: PV Over Voltage (EHB) - PV voltage zyada

meaning.en: The open-circuit voltage of a PV string is higher than the inverter's maximum DC input voltage.
meaning.ur: Kisi PV string ka open-circuit voltage inverter ke maximum DC input voltage se zyada hai.

causes.en: PV string Voc higher than the max DC input voltage of the inverter.
causes.ur: PV string ka Voc inverter ke max DC input voltage se zyada hai.

causes.en: Too many modules in series, so Voc rises further in cold conditions.
causes.ur: Series mein modules zyada hain, thande mausam mein Voc aur barh jata hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC isolator and measure each string's Voc with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: DC isolator kholein aur har string ka Voc multimeter se measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare with the max DC input voltage printed on the inverter label.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke label par likhe max DC input voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of series panels until cold-morning Voc is inside the limit.
solutions.ur: Series panels ki sankhya kam karein jab tak thande subah ki Voc limit ke andar na aa jaye.

source.title: GW EHB User Manual, section 8.1 Error Message

codes.seriesName: EHB named messages (battery hybrid GW5000/6500/8600/0010-EHB)

meaning.en: Ground insulation impedance of the PV string is too low, tripping the inverter's isolation monitor.
meaning.ur: PV string ka ground insulation impedance bohat kam hai, is liye inverter ka isolation monitor trigger ho gaya.

causes.en: PV string shorted to protective earth.
causes.ur: PV string protective earth se short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: DC cable insulation damaged.
causes.ur: DC cable ka insulation damaged hai.

causes.en: Heavy humidity in the early morning or after rain.
causes.ur: Subah jaldi ya barsaat ke baad bohat zyada humidity.

solutions.en: Use a multimeter to check resistance between earth and the inverter frame; it should be close to zero.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se earth aur inverter frame ke darmiyan resistance check karein, zero ke qareeb hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Measure resistance from PV1+/PV2+/PV3+/PV4+/BAT+/PV- to earth and compare to the manual's table in 2.4.2.
solutions.ur: PV1+/PV2+/PV3+/PV4+/BAT+/PV- se earth tak resistance measure karke manual ke 2.4.2 table se compare karein.

solutions.en: If below the minimum, disconnect strings one by one and repair the leaking string's connectors.
solutions.ur: Agar minimum se neeche ho to strings aik aik disconnect karke leaking string ke connectors theek karein.

solutions.en: If humidity is genuinely high, log the weather with each event before condemning any part.
solutions.ur: Agar humidity asal mein zyada hai to koi bhi part kharab kehne se pehle har event ke saath weather note karein.

source.title: GW EHB User Manual, section 8.1 Error Message

codes.seriesName: EHB named messages (battery hybrid GW5000/6500/8600/0010-EHB)

meaning.en: Relay self-test failed, tied to N and PE not being connected well on the AC side.
meaning.ur: Relay self-test fail hua, is ki wajah AC side par N aur PE ka theek na lagna hai.

causes.en: Neutral and ground cables not connected well on the AC side.
causes.ur: AC side par neutral aur ground cables theek se nahi lage.

causes.en: Occasional relay self-test failure.
causes.ur: Kabhi kabhi relay self-test fail hota hai.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, check for voltage between N and PE on the AC side; normally below 10V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se AC side par N aur PE ke darmiyan voltage check karein, aam tor par 10V se kam.

solutions.en: If above 10V, re-terminate N and PE at the AC terminal block.
solutions.ur: Agar 10V se zyada ho to AC terminal block par N aur PE dobara terminate karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and confirm the self-test now passes.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke confirm karein ke self-test ab pass ho gaya.

source.title: GW EHB User Manual, section 8.1 Error Message

codes.seriesName: ES Series named messages (PV Master era, GW3648D-ES / GW5048D-ES)

title.ur: Utility Loss - grid power chala gaya

meaning.en: Public grid power is not available, or the on-grid connection has failed, so the inverter has shut down export.
meaning.ur: Public grid power mojood nahi ya on-grid connection fail ho gayi, is liye inverter ne export band kar diya.

causes.en: Inverter does not detect the connection of the grid.
causes.ur: Inverter grid ka connection detect nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Public grid power lost.
causes.ur: Public grid power chali gayi.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, confirm AC side has voltage and grid power is available.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se confirm karein ke AC side par voltage hai aur grid power mojood hai.

solutions.en: Check the AC cables are connected tightly and well.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke AC cables tight aur theek se lage hain.

solutions.en: If all is well, turn the AC breaker off and back on after 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Agar sab theek hai to AC breaker band karke 5 minute baad dobara on karein.

source.title: GW ES Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.2, section 4.1 Error Messages

codes.seriesName: ES Series named messages (PV Master era, GW3648D-ES / GW5048D-ES)

title.ur: VAC Failure - grid voltage range se bahar

meaning.en: Measured grid voltage is outside the range required by the configured safety country, so the inverter disconnected.
meaning.ur: Set hua safety country ki required range se grid voltage bahar hai, is liye inverter disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: AC voltage beyond the normal range required by the safety country.
causes.ur: Safety country ki required normal range se AC voltage bahar hai.

causes.en: Safety country setting is wrong for the site.
causes.ur: Site ke liye safety country setting ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the safety country setting in the app matches the local grid standard.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke app mein safety country setting local grid standard se match karti hai.

solutions.en: Measure AC voltage between L and N, and again on the AC breaker side, and compare.
solutions.ur: L aur N ke darmiyan AC voltage measure karein, phir AC breaker side par bhi, dono compare karein.

solutions.en: If voltage is high, check the AC cable size and run length against the manual.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage high ho to manual ke mutabiq AC cable size aur length check karein.

solutions.en: If voltage is low, check the AC connection and ensure the cable jacket is not crushed into the terminal.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage low ho to AC connection check karein aur cable ka jacket terminal mein na pasa ho.

source.title: GW ES Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.2, section 4.1 Error Messages

codes.seriesName: ES Series named messages (PV Master era, GW3648D-ES / GW5048D-ES)

title.ur: FAC Failure - grid frequency range se bahar

meaning.en: Grid frequency is outside the range required by the safety country, so the inverter disconnected.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency safety country ki required range se bahar hai, is liye inverter disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Grid frequency beyond the normal range required by the safety country.
causes.ur: Grid frequency safety country ki normal required range se bahar hai.

causes.en: Occasional grid frequency instability.
causes.ur: Kabhi kabhi grid frequency unstable hoti hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the safety country setting is correct.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke safety country setting theek hai.

solutions.en: Read Fac on the inverter display and compare it with a clamp meter reading.
solutions.ur: Inverter display par Fac parhein aur clamp meter ki reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: If FAC Failure appears only occasionally and clears, treat it as grid instability, not a fault.
solutions.ur: Agar FAC Failure sirf kabhi kabhi aaye aur clear ho jaye to isay grid instability samajhein, fault nahi.

source.title: GW ES Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.2, section 4.1 Error Messages

codes.seriesName: ES Series named messages (PV Master era, GW3648D-ES / GW5048D-ES)

title.ur: Over Temperature - unit garm ho gaya

meaning.en: Internal inverter temperature is too high for the working environment, so the unit shut down to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Working environment ke liye inverter ka internal temperature bohat zyada hai, is liye unit ne apne aap ko bachane ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: Working environment leads to a high internal temperature.
causes.ur: Working environment ki wajah se internal temperature high ho gaya.

causes.en: Indoor installation in a hot unventilated room or in direct sun.
causes.ur: Garm aur be-hawa room mein ya direct dhoop mein indoor installation.

solutions.en: Try to decrease the surrounding temperature - ventilate the room or shade the unit.
solutions.ur: Surrounding temperature kam karne ki koshish karein, room ventilate karein ya unit ko shadow dein.

solutions.en: Make sure the installation complies with the manual's clearance requirements.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke installation manual ki clearance requirements poora karta hai.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off for 15 minutes, then start it up again.
solutions.ur: Inverter 15 minute ke liye band karke dobara on karein.

source.title: GW ES Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.2, section 4.1 Error Messages

codes.seriesName: ES Series named messages (PV Master era, GW3648D-ES / GW5048D-ES)

title.ur: Isolation Failure - insulation kam ho gayi

meaning.en: Ground insulation impedance of the PV string is too low, so the inverter's isolation monitor tripped.
meaning.ur: PV string ka ground insulation impedance bohat kam hai, is liye inverter ka isolation monitor trigger ho gaya.

causes.en: PV panels not grounded well.
causes.ur: PV panels theek se grounded nahi hain.

causes.en: DC cable is broken.
causes.ur: DC cable tooti hui hai.

causes.en: PV panels are aged, or ambient humidity is comparatively heavy.
causes.ur: PV panels purane ho chuke hain ya ambient humidity bohat zyada hai.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, check resistance between earth and the inverter frame; it should be close to zero.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se earth aur inverter frame ke darmiyan resistance check karein, zero ke qareeb hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Measure resistance from PV1+/PV2+/PV3+/PV4+/BAT+/PV- to earth and compare to the manual's minimum table.
solutions.ur: PV1+/PV2+/PV3+/PV4+/BAT+/PV- se earth tak resistance measure karke manual ki minimum table se compare karein.

solutions.en: If below the minimum, disconnect strings one by one to find the leaking string and re-terminate its connectors.
solutions.ur: Agar minimum se neeche ho to strings ko aik aik disconnect karke leaking string dhoondein aur us ke connectors dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Note whether it only happens at dawn or in rain - high humidity alone can cause a legitimate trip.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke kya ye sirf fajr ya barsaat mein hota hai, sirf zyada humidity bhi asli trip karwa sakti hai.

source.title: GW ES Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.2, section 4.1 Error Messages

codes.seriesName: ES Series named messages (PV Master era, GW3648D-ES / GW5048D-ES)

meaning.en: Ground leakage current is too high, usually because the AC side neutral and ground are not connected well.
meaning.ur: Ground leakage current bohat zyada hai, aam tor par is liye ke AC side neutral aur ground theek se nahi lage.

causes.en: Neutral cable on the AC side is not connected well.
causes.ur: AC side ka neutral cable theek se nahi laga.

causes.en: Ambient humidity comparatively heavy.
causes.ur: Ambient humidity comparatively zyada hai.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, measure voltage between earth and the inverter frame; it should be close to 0V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se earth aur inverter frame ke darmiyan voltage measure karein, 0V ke qareeb hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If a voltage is present, re-terminate neutral and PE at the AC terminal block.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage maujood ho to AC terminal block par neutral aur PE dobara terminate karein.

solutions.en: If it only occurs at dawn or in rain and recovers, that is normal humidity behaviour.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf fajr ya barsaat mein aaye aur theek ho jaye to ye normal humidity behaviour hai.

source.title: GW ES Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.2, section 4.1 Error Messages

codes.seriesName: ES-US / SBP-US North America (bare integer codes 1-35)

title.ur: Utility Loss - grid power chala gaya (1)

meaning.en: Grid power has failed, or the AC cable is disconnected or the AC breaker is off.
meaning.ur: Grid power chali gayi, ya AC cable disconnect hai ya AC breaker off hai.

causes.en: Utility grid power fails.
causes.ur: Grid power supply fail ho gayi.

causes.en: AC cable disconnected or the AC breaker is off.
causes.ur: AC cable disconnect hai ya AC breaker off hai.

solutions.en: The alarm clears automatically once grid power returns.
solutions.ur: Grid power aane par alarm khud ba khud clear ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Check the AC breaker is ON and the AC cable terminations are tight.
solutions.ur: AC breaker ON hai aur AC cable ke connections tight hain ya nahi check karein.

notes.en: On SDT-G3 and EH the same condition is F01; on UT the bare integer 1 means SPI Comm Fail. Never merge.
notes.ur: SDT-G3 aur EH par yehi halaat F01 hai; UT par bare integer 1 ka matlab SPI Comm Fail hai. Kabhi merge na karein.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: ES-US / SBP-US North America (bare integer codes 1-35)

meaning.en: Grid voltage is out of the permissible range or stayed high beyond the HVRT requirement, so the unit disconnected.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage permissible range se bahar hai ya HVRT requirement se zyada der high raha, is liye unit disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Grid voltage exceeds the permissible range.
causes.ur: Grid voltage permissible range se zyada hai.

causes.en: High-voltage duration exceeds the HVRT requirement.
causes.ur: High voltage ki duration HVRT requirement se zyada rahi.

solutions.en: Occasional trips clear themselves once the grid is normal.
solutions.ur: Kabhi kabhi aane wale trips grid normal hote hi khud clear ho jate hain.

solutions.en: Check the grid voltage against the permissible range; contact the power company if it is out of range.
solutions.ur: Grid voltage permissible range se compare karein, range se bahar ho to power company ko contact karein.

solutions.en: Only with the power company's consent, change the overvoltage threshold or HVRT.
solutions.ur: Sirf power company ki ijazat se overvoltage threshold ya HVRT badlein.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: ES-US / SBP-US North America (bare integer codes 1-35)

meaning.en: Grid voltage is below the permissible range or stayed low beyond the LVRT requirement.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage permissible range se neeche hai ya LVRT requirement se zyada der low raha.

causes.en: Grid voltage lower than the permissible range.
causes.ur: Grid voltage permissible range se kam hai.

causes.en: Low-voltage duration exceeds the LVRT requirement.
causes.ur: Low voltage ki duration LVRT requirement se zyada rahi.

solutions.en: Let it self-recover; a one-off is usually a temporary grid abnormality.
solutions.ur: Khud recover hone dein, aik baar ka issue aam tor par grid ki temporary abnormality hoti hai.

solutions.en: Measure voltage at the AC breaker as well as the inverter, and compare the two readings.
solutions.ur: AC breaker aur inverter dono par voltage measure karke dono readings compare karein.

solutions.en: Check for a long or undersized AC run causing voltage drop under load.
solutions.ur: Lamba ya chhota AC cable load ke saath voltage drop kar raha hai ya nahi check karein.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: ES-US / SBP-US North America (bare integer codes 1-35)

meaning.en: The 30mA residual current channel saw an abnormal value, usually insulation leakage from the PV side.
meaning.ur: 30mA residual current channel ne abnormal value dekha, aam tor par PV side se insulation leakage ki wajah se.

causes.en: PV string insulation impedance to ground falls while running.
causes.ur: Chalne ke daurat PV string ka ground se insulation impedance gir jata hai.

causes.en: Moisture in DC connectors or cable damage.
causes.ur: DC connectors mein paani ya cable damage.

solutions.en: Note whether it correlates with wet weather; wet-morning trips are common and often benign.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke kya ye geelay mausam se correlate karta hai, geelay mausam ki subah trip aam hai aur aksar halat hota hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC isolator and measure each string to PE; find and dry out the offending string.
solutions.ur: DC isolator kholein aur har string ko PE se measure karein, masoom string dhoond kar use sukha dein.

solutions.en: If it is frequent, contact the dealer rather than repeatedly resetting.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aaye to baar baar reset karne ke bajaye dealer se rabta karein.

notes.en: Codes 12, 13, 14 and 15 on this unit are the 30mA, 60mA, 150mA and gradual-change GFCI stages. On the EMEA ESS app the same bare number 12 means Internal Fan Failure.
notes.ur: Is unit par 12, 13, 14 aur 15 GFCI ke 30mA, 60mA, 150mA aur gradual change stages hain. EMEA ESS app par 12 ka matlab Internal Fan Failure hai.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: ES-US / SBP-US North America (bare integer codes 1-35)

meaning.en: PV string to PE resistance fell below the trip level; the manual's acceptance value is above 50kOhm.
meaning.ur: PV string se PE ka resistance trip level se neeche gir gaya, manual ke mutabiq 50kOhm se upar hona chahiye.

causes.en: PV string shorted to PE.
causes.ur: PV string PE se short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Moist environment with poorly insulated cable to ground.
causes.ur: Nam mahaul aur ground ke mutabiq kamzor insulation wali cable.

solutions.en: Isolate DC and measure PV string to PE; it must read above 50kOhm.
solutions.ur: DC isolate karke PV string se PE measure karein, 50kOhm se upar hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If it fails, disconnect strings one at a time to find the shorted string.
solutions.ur: Test fail ho to strings ko aik aik disconnect karke shorted string dhoondein.

solutions.en: Check the PE cable of the inverter is connected properly.
solutions.ur: Inverter ka PE cable theek se laga hua hai ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: If the reading is only low on rainy days, reset the ISO setting in the app.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf barsaat ke din reading kam ho to app se ISO setting reset karein.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: ES-US / SBP-US North America (bare integer codes 1-35)

meaning.en: The relay self-test failed because of a relay fault, an abnormal control circuit, or abnormal AC cable connection.
meaning.ur: Relay self-test fail hua kyunke relay kharab hai, control circuit abnormal hai ya AC cable connection abnormal hai.

causes.en: Relay abnormal or short-circuited.
causes.ur: Relay abnormal hai ya short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Control circuit abnormal.
causes.ur: Control circuit abnormal hai.

causes.en: AC cable connection loose or short-circuited.
causes.ur: AC cable connection dhili hai ya short ho gayi hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect AC output and DC input, wait 5 minutes, then reconnect before investigating further.
solutions.ur: AC output aur DC input disconnect karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir dobara connect karein.

solutions.en: With AC isolated, re-torque the AC output terminals and look for heat discoloration.
solutions.ur: AC isolate karke AC output terminals ki tightening karein aur garmi ke nishaan dekhein.

solutions.en: Test relay contact continuity and coil supply, then replace the relay if failed.
solutions.ur: Relay contact ki continuity aur coil supply test karein, phir relay kharab ho to replace karein.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: ES-US / SBP-US North America (bare integer codes 1-35)

meaning.en: An arc was detected on the DC side, typically from a DC terminal that is not firmly connected or a broken DC cable.
meaning.ur: DC side par arc detect hua, aam tor par dhale DC terminal ya tooti DC cable ki wajah se.

causes.en: The DC terminal is not firmly connected.
causes.ur: DC terminal dheela band nahi hai.

causes.en: The DC cable is broken.
causes.ur: DC cable tooti hui hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC isolator and confirm the DC side is dead before any inspection.
solutions.ur: DC isolator kholein aur inspect karne se pehle confirm karein ke DC side dead hai.

solutions.en: Follow the Quick Installation Guide and re-check every DC connection for tightness and correct polarity.
solutions.ur: Quick Installation Guide follow karke har DC connection ki tightness aur polarity dobara check karein.

solutions.en: Replace any connector showing heat damage, melting or a loose crimp.
solutions.ur: Garmi se kharab, pighle hua ya dhila crimp wala connector replace karein.

source.title: GW ES-US, SBP-US User Manual V1.3-2026-04-09, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS battery / BMS alarm table (bare integers 1-17)

meaning.en: The battery pack is running too hot, most often because it is being pushed beyond its rating.
meaning.ur: Battery pack bohat garm chal raha hai, aam tor par is liye ke us ki rating se zyada load daala ja raha hai.

causes.en: Battery overloaded by charge or discharge demand.
causes.ur: Charge ya discharge demand ki wajah se battery overloaded hai.

causes.en: Poor battery cabinet ventilation.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet ki ventilation kamzor hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the charge and discharge power in the app and watch the temperature fall.
solutions.ur: App par charge aur discharge power kam karein aur temperature girte dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure battery temperature with an IR thermometer and compare with the BMS reading.
solutions.ur: IR thermometer se battery temperature measure karke BMS reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery cabinet is not in direct sun and has airflow on all sides.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery cabinet direct dhoop mein nahi aur charon taraf airflow hai.

solutions.en: If the problem persists, contact the after-sales service.
solutions.ur: Agar masla barqarar rahe to after-sales service se rabta karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 5.1 Battery Faults

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS battery / BMS alarm table (bare integers 1-17)

meaning.en: Ambient is too cold for the battery to run, so the BMS blocks charge or discharge.
meaning.ur: Battery chalne ke liye ambient bohat thanda hai, is liye BMS charge ya discharge rok deta hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature below the battery's permitted range.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature battery ki allowed range se neeche hai.

causes.en: Battery cabinet exposed to cold airflow or a night-time temperature drop below the pack's permitted minimum.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet thande hawa ya raat ke temperature girne ke mutabiq pack ki minimum limit se neeche jaa raha hai.

solutions.en: Check ambient at the battery cabinet with a thermometer; in winter expect protection, not damage.
solutions.ur: Thermometer se battery cabinet ka ambient check karein, sarshaat mein protection normal hai nuqsan nahi.

solutions.en: Keep the cabinet away from cold airflow and improve enclosure insulation.
solutions.ur: Cabinet ko thande hawa se door rakhein aur enclosure ki insulation behtar karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery chemistry's low-temperature charge limit before enabling charging again.
solutions.ur: Dobara charge enable karne se pehle battery chemistry ka low-temperature charge limit confirm karein.

notes.en: Never charge a lithium pack below its permitted low-temperature limit - plating is irreversible.
notes.ur: Lithium pack ko us ki low-temperature limit se neeche kabhi charge na karein, plating permanent nuqsan hai.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 5.1 Battery Faults

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS battery / BMS alarm table (bare integers 1-17)

title.ur: Battery cells ke voltage mein farq (3)

meaning.en: Individual cell voltages inside the pack have drifted apart beyond the permitted spread.
meaning.ur: Pack ke andar mukhtalif cells ke voltage ki farq allowed se zyada ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Cell imbalance from ageing or a single weak cell.
causes.ur: Bhaaran ya kisi aik kamzor cell ki wajah se cell imbalance.

causes.en: Cell voltage sensing line fault.
causes.ur: Cell voltage sensing line ka fault.

solutions.en: Read per-cell voltages from the BMS in the app and find the outlier cell.
solutions.ur: App se BMS ki per-cell voltage readings parhein aur koi aik unusual cell dhoondein.

solutions.en: If the spread is small, run the pack's balancing/charge-refresh cycle per the battery manual.
solutions.ur: Agar farq kam ho to battery manual ke mutabiq pack ka balancing ya charge refresh cycle chalayein.

solutions.en: Inspect the cell voltage sense harness connectors for a loose pin.
solutions.ur: Cell voltage sense harness ke connectors mein dhila pin check karein.

solutions.en: If it persists, contact the after-sales service - cells are not field-serviceable.
solutions.ur: Agar masla rahe to after-sales service se rabta karein, cells field level par repair nahi hote.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 5.1 Battery Faults

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS battery / BMS alarm table (bare integers 1-17)

title.ur: Battery ka SOC neeche gir gaya (7)

meaning.en: State of charge has fallen below the usable minimum, so the inverter will not discharge the pack further.
meaning.ur: State of charge minimum se neeche gir chuka hai, is liye inverter pack aur discharge nahi karega.

causes.en: SOC fell below the configured depth-of-discharge limit.
causes.ur: SOC configured depth-of-discharge limit se neeche gir gaya.

causes.en: PV has not been producing enough to recharge the pack.
causes.ur: PV itna generate nahi kar raha ke pack recharge ho sake.

solutions.en: Confirm PV is actually producing by reading live PV power in the app.
solutions.ur: App se live PV power parh ke confirm karein ke PV actually generate kar raha hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check the SOC lower limit and the I-DOD setting in the app are what you intended.
solutions.ur: App par SOC lower limit aur I-DOD setting check karein ke jo aap chahte hain wahi hai.

solutions.en: If PV works properly but the fault persists, contact the after-sales service.
solutions.ur: Agar PV theek chal raha hai phir bhi masla rahe to after-sales service se rabta karein.

notes.en: GoodWe packs also stop discharging below roughly 20% SOC and only resume after a recharge hysteresis, so a low SOC is often protection rather than a fault.
notes.ur: GoodWe packs bhi taqreeban 20% SOC se neeche discharge band kar dete hain aur recharge ke baad hi dobara chalte hain, is liye low SOC aksar protection hai fault nahi.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 5.1 Battery Faults

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS battery / BMS alarm table (bare integers 1-17)

meaning.en: The inverter is not getting valid data from the BMS, so it will not charge or discharge the pack.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko BMS se valid data nahi mil raha, is liye woh pack charge ya discharge nahi karega.

causes.en: Battery communication cable loose, damaged or wrong pinout.
causes.ur: Battery communication cable dhili, damaged ya ghalat pinout wali hai.

causes.en: Battery not switched on.
causes.ur: Battery on nahi hai.

causes.en: Incompatible firmware on the battery or the inverter.
causes.ur: Battery ya inverter par incompatible firmware hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery is switched on and its own status LEDs show a healthy state.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke battery on hai aur us ke status LEDs healthy state dikha rahe hain.

solutions.en: With power off, re-seat both ends of the BMS CAN cable and check the polarity and pinout.
solutions.ur: Power off karke BMS CAN cable ke dono ends dobara lagayein aur polarity aur pinout check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery model selected in the app matches the installed pack; a mismatch blocks comms.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke app mein select kiya hua battery model installed pack se match karta hai, mismatch par comms band ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Update the battery and inverter firmware to the versions the supplier specifies.
solutions.ur: Battery aur inverter ka firmware supplier ki bataye versions tak update karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 5.1 Battery Faults

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS battery / BMS alarm table (bare integers 1-17)

meaning.en: The battery management system itself has reported a fault, so the pack is taken out of service.
meaning.ur: Battery management system ne khud fault report kiya hai, is liye pack service se bahar ho gaya hai.

causes.en: BMS module internal fault or BMS system-level fault.
causes.ur: BMS module ka internal fault ya BMS system level ka fault.

causes.en: Cell voltage sensing line abnormal.
causes.ur: Cell voltage sensing line abnormal hai.

solutions.en: Read the BMS status bit and the reported cell voltages in the app before anything else.
solutions.ur: Pehle app se BMS status bit aur reported cell voltages parhein.

solutions.en: Power down completely, then power up again and check whether the BMS fault is latched.
solutions.ur: Puri tarah power down karke dobara power up karein aur dekhein ke BMS fault latch hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: Inspect the BMS CAN harness and connectors for water, corrosion or a loose pin.
solutions.ur: BMS CAN harness aur connectors mein paani, zang ya dhila pin check karein.

solutions.en: If it returns after all of the above, the BMS module must be replaced - contact after-sales.
solutions.ur: Agar upar ke sab steps ke baad bhi wapas aaye to BMS module replace karna hoga, after-sales se rabta karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 5.1 Battery Faults

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS app error codes (2-digit codes on SolarGo / PV Master, EM / ET / BT)

title.ur: AC HCT check fail - current sensor (01)

meaning.en: The AC current Hall sensor self-check failed, from an external magnetic field or an internal component fault.
meaning.ur: AC current Hall sensor ka self-check fail hua, wajah koi external magnetic field ya internal component fault hai.

causes.en: Intermittent fault caused by an external magnetic field.
causes.ur: External magnetic field ki wajah se intermittent fault.

causes.en: An internal component is faulty.
causes.ur: Koi internal component kharab hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and see if the code returns; a one-off is an intermittent fault.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke code wapas aata hai ya nahi, aik baar aana intermittent fault hai.

solutions.en: Keep steel, a transformer or a large motor away from the AC cable run and the inverter.
solutions.ur: Steel, transformer ya bada motor AC cable aur inverter se door rakhein.

solutions.en: If it returns, contact the service centre for board-level repair.
solutions.ur: Agar dobara aaye to board level repair ke liye service centre se rabta karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS app error codes (2-digit codes on SolarGo / PV Master, EM / ET / BT)

meaning.en: Grid-side failure family: no grid power, AC not connected, or AC breaker not working. The guide lists 09, 17 and 29 together.
meaning.ur: Grid side ki failure family: grid power nahi, AC connect nahi, ya AC breaker kaam nahi kar raha. Guide mein 09, 17 aur 29 ek saath hain.

causes.en: Grid power failure.
causes.ur: Grid power fail ho gayi.

causes.en: AC is not connected well.
causes.ur: AC theek se connect nahi hai.

causes.en: AC breaker fails.
causes.ur: AC breaker kharab hai.

causes.en: Grid is not connected.
causes.ur: Grid connect nahi hai.

solutions.en: Make sure grid power is actually available at the site.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke site par grid power mojood hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, check the AC terminals have the correct voltage.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se check karein ke AC terminals par sahi voltage hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check all terminations throughout the AC path are tight.
solutions.ur: AC path ke tamam terminations tight hain ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: Turn the AC breaker off, wait 5 minutes, then turn it on again.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir dobara on karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS app error codes (2-digit codes on SolarGo / PV Master, EM / ET / BT)

meaning.en: Neutral and ground are not bonded correctly at the AC terminals, or PV panel leakage to ground is high, or the utility ground was lost.
meaning.ur: AC terminals par neutral aur ground theek se bonded nahi, ya PV panel ka ground se leakage zyada hai, ya utility ka ground chala gaya.

causes.en: Neutral and ground cables not well connected on AC terminals.
causes.ur: AC terminals par neutral aur ground cables theek se nahi lage.

causes.en: Solar panel leakage current to ground in humid conditions.
causes.ur: Nam mahaul mein solar panel ka ground se leakage current.

causes.en: Utility ground loss.
causes.ur: Utility ka ground chala gaya.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, measure voltage between earth and the inverter frame; it should be close to 0V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se earth aur inverter frame ke darmiyan voltage measure karein, 0V ke qareeb hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Confirm N and PE are properly terminated at the AC terminal block.
solutions.ur: AC terminal block par N aur PE theek se terminate hain ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: If it only shows on rainy days, it is PV panel leakage - re-check the string insulation.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf barsaat ke din aaye to PV panel leakage hai, string insulation dobara check karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS app error codes (2-digit codes on SolarGo / PV Master, EM / ET / BT)
aliases: Internal Fan Failure (Back-Up Over Load for ES)

title.ur: Internal fan kharab ya back-up overload (12)

meaning.en: On ES the same code means the back-up loads exceed the inverter output; on other lines it means the internal fan is blocked or its cable is loose.
meaning.ur: ES par yehi code ka matlab hai back-up load inverter output se zyada hai; doosri lines par matlab internal fan band hai ya us ka cable dhila hai.

causes.en: On ES, back-up loads exceed the inverter maximum output.
causes.ur: ES par back-up load inverter ke maximum output se zyada hai.

causes.en: Internal fan is blocked by something.
causes.ur: Kisi cheez se internal fan block hai.

causes.en: Fan cable not connected well in the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter mein fan cable theek se nahi lagi.

solutions.en: Reduce the loads on the back-up output and restart.
solutions.ur: Back-up output par load kam karke restart karein.

solutions.en: Open the unit and check nothing is obstructing the fan impeller.
solutions.ur: Unit kholein aur check karein ke fan impeller mein koi cheez nahi atki hui.

solutions.en: Re-seat the fan cable connector at the control board.
solutions.ur: Control board par fan cable connector dobara lagayein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS app error codes (2-digit codes on SolarGo / PV Master, EM / ET / BT)

meaning.en: Ambient around the inverter has been too hot for long enough, or the airflow is obstructed.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke aas paas ka ambient bohat der tak garm raha, ya airflow mein rok hai.

causes.en: Air temperature around the inverter too high for an extended period.
causes.ur: Inverter ke aas paas ka temperature lambi der tak zyada raha.

causes.en: Installation location does not give enough airflow for cooling.
causes.ur: Installation jagah cooling ke liye kaafi airflow nahi de rahi.

causes.en: Obstruction of airflow around the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter ke aas paas airflow mein rok hai.

solutions.en: Try to reduce the surrounding temperature - shade the unit, improve room ventilation.
solutions.ur: Surrounding temperature kam karne ki koshish karein, unit ko shadow dein, room ventilation behtar karein.

solutions.en: Ensure the installation complies with the manual and there is clearance for the cooling system.
solutions.ur: Ensure karein ke installation manual ke mutabiq hai aur cooling system ke liye jagah hai.

solutions.en: Clear any obstruction from the cooling fins.
solutions.ur: Cooling fins mein koi rok hua ho to saaf kar dein.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off for 15 minutes, then switch it on again.
solutions.ur: Inverter 15 minute ke liye band karke dobara on karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS app error codes (2-digit codes on SolarGo / PV Master, EM / ET / BT)

meaning.en: The open-circuit voltage of a PV string is above the inverter's maximum DC input voltage.
meaning.ur: Kisi PV string ka open-circuit voltage inverter ke maximum DC input voltage se zyada hai.

causes.en: Total open-circuit voltage of the string exceeds max DC input voltage.
causes.ur: String ka total open-circuit voltage max DC input voltage se zyada hai.

causes.en: Too many modules in series for cold-morning Voc rise.
causes.ur: Series mein modules zyada hain, thande subah Voc barh jata hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and measure each string's Voc with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: DC switch off karke har string ka Voc multimeter se measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare the reading against the inverter's max DC input voltage printed on the label.
solutions.ur: Reading ko inverter ke label par likhe max DC input voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of series modules so cold-morning Voc stays below the limit.
solutions.ur: Series modules ki sankhya kam karein taake thande subah ki Voc limit se neeche rahe.

solutions.en: Use the EZ designer temperature-coefficient calculation to verify the string design.
solutions.ur: String design verify karne ke liye EZ designer ka temperature coefficient calculation use karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS app error codes (2-digit codes on SolarGo / PV Master, EM / ET / BT)

meaning.en: The relay self-test found a fault; the guide points at N/PE bonding at the AC terminals or utility ground loss.
meaning.ur: Relay self-test ne fault paya, guide AC terminals par N/PE bonding ya utility ground loss ki taraf ishara karta hai.

causes.en: Neutral and ground cables not well connected on AC terminals.
causes.ur: AC terminals par neutral aur ground cables theek se nahi lage.

causes.en: Utility ground loss.
causes.ur: Utility ka ground chala gaya.

solutions.en: Measure voltage between ground and neutral on the grid; it must be under 10V.
solutions.ur: Grid par ground aur neutral ke darmiyan voltage measure karein, 10V se kam hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Measure resistance between ground and neutral on the backup output; it must be under 10 ohm.
solutions.ur: Backup output par ground aur neutral ke darmiyan resistance measure karein, 10 ohm se kam hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Re-terminate the N and PE conductors at the AC terminal and retest.
solutions.ur: AC terminal par N aur PE conductors dobara terminate karke dobara test karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS app error codes (2-digit codes on SolarGo / PV Master, EM / ET / BT)

meaning.en: The battery activation/licence code configured in the app is not correct for the fitted battery.
meaning.ur: App mein set kiya hua battery activation/licence code fitted battery ke liye theek nahi hai.

causes.en: Battery activation code incorrect.
causes.ur: Battery activation code ghalat hai.

causes.en: Battery type selected in the app does not match the installed pack (listed in the same guide's battery-communication fault list).
causes.ur: App mein select kiya hua battery type installed pack se match nahi karta, ye bhi isi guide ki battery communication fault list mein hai.

solutions.en: Check the battery model selected in the app matches the battery physically installed.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke app mein select kiya hua battery model asal mein lagi battery se match karta hai.

solutions.en: Read the battery protocol code and serial from the battery and re-enter them in the app.
solutions.ur: Battery se protocol code aur serial parhein aur app mein dohra daal karein.

solutions.en: Contact the service centre for the correct licence string for that battery pack.
solutions.ur: Us battery pack ke liye sahi licence string ke liye service centre se rabta karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS app error codes (2-digit codes on SolarGo / PV Master, EM / ET / BT)

meaning.en: The control board storage chip could not be read or written, so stored settings may be lost.
meaning.ur: Control board ka storage chip read ya write nahi ho raha, is liye stored settings kho sakte hain.

causes.en: Intermittent fault caused by an external magnetic field.
causes.ur: External magnetic field ki wajah se intermittent fault.

causes.en: Control board storage chip read/write failure.
causes.ur: Control board ke storage chip ki read/write failure.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and check whether the error returns.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke error wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Update the inverter DSP firmware locally from the app.
solutions.ur: App se inverter ka DSP firmware locally update karein.

solutions.en: Back up and note all settings before a firmware update, then contact the service centre if it persists.
solutions.ur: Firmware update se pehle tamam settings note kar lein, phir agar masla rahe to service centre se rabta karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

codes.seriesName: ET Series / ET Plus+ named messages (PV Master era)

meaning.en: The inverter detected that the L2 and L3 phase angles are reversed, so it refuses to connect to the grid.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne dekha ke L2 aur L3 ke phase angles ultay hain, is liye grid se connect nahi hota.

causes.en: L2 and L3 on-grid cables connected in reverse order.
causes.ur: On-grid ke L2 aur L3 cables ulat order mein lage hain.

causes.en: Phase angle detection error in the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter mein phase angle detection error.

solutions.en: Isolate AC fully and confirm dead before touching the phase cables.
solutions.ur: AC poori tarah isolate karke phase cables chhoone se pehle dead hona confirm karein.

solutions.en: Swap L2 and L3 at the inverter AC terminals.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminals par L2 aur L3 ko aik doosre se badal dein.

solutions.en: Re-check terminal tightness and phase sequence, then re-energise.
solutions.ur: Terminals ki tightening aur phase sequence dobara check karke dobara on karein.

notes.en: On EMEA firmware the same symptom appears as app codes 14ETU or 27ETU (Phase order / Phase angle failure).
notes.ur: EMEA firmware par yehi symptom app codes 14ETU ya 27ETU (Phase order / Phase angle failure) ke roop mein aata hai.

source.title: GW ET Series | ET Plus Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.1, section 4.1 Error Messages

codes.seriesName: ET Series / ET Plus+ named messages (PV Master era)

title.ur: PV/BAT Overvoltage - PV ya battery voltage zyada

meaning.en: Either the PV string open-circuit voltage or the battery pack voltage is above the inverter's maximum input, so the unit stops.
meaning.ur: Ya PV string ka open-circuit voltage ya battery pack ka voltage inverter ke maximum input se upar hai, is liye unit ruk jata hai.

causes.en: PV string Voc higher than the inverter's max PV input voltage.
causes.ur: PV string ka Voc inverter ke max PV input voltage se zyada hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage higher than the inverter's max BAT input voltage.
causes.ur: Battery voltage inverter ke max BAT input voltage se zyada hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the PV string Voc is below the max PV input voltage on the label.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke PV string ka Voc label par likhe max PV input voltage se neeche hai.

solutions.en: If Voc is high, reduce the number of PV panels in series.
solutions.ur: Agar Voc zyada hai to series mein lage PV panels ki sankhya kam karein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery voltage and compare with the max battery input voltage; remove one pack if it is over.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage measure karke max battery input voltage se compare karein, agar zyada ho to aik pack nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Always switch the DC off before changing the string or battery configuration.
solutions.ur: String ya battery configuration badalne se pehle hamesha DC off karein.

source.title: GW ET Series | ET Plus Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.1, section 4.1 Error Messages

codes.seriesName: ET Series / ET Plus+ named messages (PV Master era)

meaning.en: On ET the isolation monitor measures the PV string and the battery both, so either side's low ground insulation trips it.
