meaning.ur: ET par isolation monitor PV string aur battery dono measure karta hai, is liye kisi bhi taraf ka kam ground insulation trip karwa deta hai.

causes.en: PV panels not grounded well or DC cable broken.
causes.ur: PV panels theek se grounded nahi ya DC cable tooti hui hai.

causes.en: PV panels aged or ambient humidity heavy.
causes.ur: PV panels purane ho chuke hain ya ambient humidity zyada hai.

solutions.en: Check earth to inverter frame resistance with a multimeter; it should be close to zero.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se earth se inverter frame ki resistance check karein, zero ke qareeb hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Measure each PV input to earth and the battery terminals to earth separately.
solutions.ur: Har PV input ko earth se aur battery terminals ko alag se earth se measure karein.

solutions.en: Isolate the battery first, then the PV strings, to identify which side is leaking.
solutions.ur: Pehle battery isolate karein, phir PV strings, taake pata chale kis taraf leak hai.

solutions.en: Re-terminate or replace the affected connector, then restart and confirm the reading.
solutions.ur: Matlab wala connector dobara lagayein ya replace karein, phir restart karke reading confirm karein.

source.title: GW ET Series | ET Plus Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.1, section 4.1 Error Messages

codes.seriesName: ET Series / ET Plus+ named messages (PV Master era)

meaning.en: The relay self-test failed, which the manual ties to N and PE not being connected well on the AC side.
meaning.ur: Relay self-test fail hua, manual isay AC side par N aur PE ke theek na lagne se jodta hai.

causes.en: Neutral and ground cables not connected well on the AC side.
causes.ur: AC side par neutral aur ground cables theek se nahi lage.

causes.en: Occasional relay self-test failure.
causes.ur: Kabhi kabhi relay self-test fail hota hai.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, check for voltage between N and PE on the AC side; normally below 10V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se AC side par N aur PE ke darmiyan voltage check karein, aam tor par 10V se kam.

solutions.en: If it reads above 10V, re-terminate N and PE and retest.
solutions.ur: Agar 10V se zyada ho to N aur PE dobara terminate karke dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Then restart the inverter and confirm the self-test passes.
solutions.ur: Phir inverter restart karke confirm karein ke self-test pass ho gaya.

source.title: GW ET Series | ET Plus Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.1, section 4.1 Error Messages

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS LED indicator legend (ET / ET PLUS+ / BT)

title.en: BATTERY LED blink 2 - battery low / SOC low
title.ur: BATTERY LED blink 2 - battery / SOC kam

meaning.en: The battery state of charge has dropped to a low level; the pack is close to its discharge cut-off.
meaning.ur: Battery ka state of charge low level par gir gaya hai, pack apni discharge cut-off ke qareeb hai.

causes.en: Normal battery discharge with insufficient PV recharge.
causes.ur: PV recharge kam hone ki wajah se normal battery discharge.

causes.en: Back-up load drawing more than the array can supply.
causes.ur: Back-up load array ke supply se zyada kha raha hai.

solutions.en: Read the live SOC in the app and check PV production is running normally.
solutions.ur: App se live SOC parhein aur check karein ke PV production theek chal rahi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Confirm the SOC lower limit and I-DOD are set as intended before the battery stops.
solutions.ur: Battery rukne se pehle confirm karein ke SOC lower limit aur I-DOD aap ke mutabiq set hain.

codes.blinkPattern: BATTERY LED double blink

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 03 Troubleshooting of the System (Via LED indicators on the Inverter)

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS LED indicator legend (ET / ET PLUS+ / BT)

title.en: COM LED blink 1 - BMS comms fail, meter OK
title.ur: COM LED blink 1 - BMS comms fail, meter theek hai

meaning.en: The inverter has lost communication with the battery BMS while the smart meter communication is still working.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne battery BMS se communication kho di hai jabke smart meter ki communication abhi theek chal rahi hai.

causes.en: BMS CAN cable loose, wrong pinout or damaged.
causes.ur: BMS CAN cable dhili, ghalat pinout wali ya damaged hai.

causes.en: Battery switched off or BMS not powered.
causes.ur: Battery off hai ya BMS ko power nahi mil rahi.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery is switched on and its status LEDs are healthy.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke battery on hai aur us ke status LEDs healthy hain.

solutions.en: With power off, re-seat both ends of the BMS CAN cable and verify the pinout.
solutions.ur: Power off karke BMS CAN cable ke dono ends dobara lagayein aur pinout verify karein.

solutions.en: Connect to SolarGo and read the BMS status; if it says NG, correct the wiring and settings.
solutions.ur: SolarGo se connect karke BMS status parhein, agar NG aaye to wiring aur settings theek karein.

codes.blinkPattern: COM LED single blink

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 03 Troubleshooting of the System (Via LED indicators on the Inverter)

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS LED indicator legend (ET / ET PLUS+ / BT)

title.en: COM LED blink 2 - BMS OK, meter comms fail
title.ur: COM LED blink 2 - BMS theek hai, meter comms fail

meaning.en: Battery BMS communication is fine but the smart meter communication has failed, so export limiting and load detection are blind.
meaning.ur: Battery BMS communication theek hai lekin smart meter ki communication fail ho gayi hai, is liye export limiting aur load detection kaam nahi kar rahe.

causes.en: Meter communication cable loose, damaged or wrong pinout.
causes.ur: Meter communication cable dhili, damaged ya ghalat pinout wali hai.

causes.en: No supply to the meter, or meter failed.
causes.ur: Meter ko supply nahi ya meter kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check the meter has supply on the same phase as the inverter and its COM LED is blinking.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke meter ko supply usi phase par hai jis par inverter hai aur us ka COM LED blink kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Replace the meter cable with a correctly pinned-out cable, ensuring it uses only the required 2 pins.
solutions.ur: Meter cable sahi pinout wale se replace karein, aur ye check karein ke sirf required 2 pins use ho rahe hain.

solutions.en: Run the meter test in the app once communication is restored.
solutions.ur: Communication aane ke baad app mein meter test chalayein.

codes.blinkPattern: COM LED double blink

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 03 Troubleshooting of the System (Via LED indicators on the Inverter)

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS LED indicator legend (ET / ET PLUS+ / BT)

title.en: COM LED off - BMS and meter comms both fail
title.ur: COM LED off - BMS aur meter dono comms fail

meaning.en: Neither the battery BMS nor the smart meter is communicating with the inverter.
meaning.ur: Battery BMS aur smart meter koi bhi inverter se communicate nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Both the BMS cable and the meter cable are disconnected or damaged.
causes.ur: BMS cable aur meter cable dono disconnect ya damaged hain.

causes.en: Both devices have no supply.
causes.ur: Dono devices ko supply nahi hai.

solutions.en: Check supply at the meter and at the battery, then re-seat both communication cables.
solutions.ur: Meter aur battery par supply check karein, phir dono communication cables dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Unplug the BMS cable; if meter communication returns, the two are sharing pins incorrectly.
solutions.ur: BMS cable nikaal dein, agar meter communication aa jaye to dono galat pins share kar rahe hain.

solutions.en: Reboot the battery, then the inverter, and confirm the COM LED settles to a known state.
solutions.ur: Battery phir inverter reboot karein aur confirm karein ke COM LED kisi jaan boojh wali state par aa jata hai.

codes.blinkPattern: COM LED off

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 03 Troubleshooting of the System (Via LED indicators on the Inverter)

codes.seriesName: EMEA ESS LED indicator legend (ET / ET PLUS+ / BT)

title.ur: FAULT LED blink 1 - back-up par load zyada

meaning.en: The back-up output is overloaded; the LED blink is GoodWe's own direct instruction to reduce the load.
meaning.ur: Back-up output overloaded hai, ye LED blink GoodWe ka apna direct instruction hai ke load kam karein.

causes.en: Total back-up load above the inverter's back-up rating.
causes.ur: Back-up ka total load inverter ki back-up rating se zyada hai.

causes.en: Inductive load starting spike on the back-up circuit.
causes.ur: Back-up circuit par inductive load ka starting spike.

solutions.en: Turn off the largest back-up loads until the LED stops blinking.
solutions.ur: Sabse bade back-up loads band karein jab tak LED blink karna na chhore.

solutions.en: Sum the running watts of connected appliances and compare with the back-up rated power.
solutions.ur: Lagaye hue appliances ka chalne wala wattage jama kar ke back-up rated power se compare karein.

solutions.en: Give motors and pumps a soft starter, or move them to the grid side.
solutions.ur: Motors aur pumps ko soft starter dein ya grid side shift karein.

codes.blinkPattern: FAULT LED single blink

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 03 Troubleshooting of the System (Via LED indicators on the Inverter)

codes.seriesName: ES / SBP Series (3.0-6.0kW) G2 LED legend

title.en: SOLAR LED blink 1 - input 1 active, 2 not
title.ur: SOLAR LED blink 1 - input 1 chal raha, 2 nahi

meaning.en: PV input 1 is producing but PV input 2 is not, so a fault or wiring issue is likely on the second MPPT.
meaning.ur: PV input 1 generate kar raha hai lekin PV input 2 nahi kar raha, is liye doosre MPPT par fault ya wiring masla hai.

causes.en: PV input 2 string not producing - loose connector, blown string fuse or shaded string.
causes.ur: PV input 2 ki string produce nahi kar rahi, dhila connector, phula string fuse ya shaded string.

causes.en: PV access mode set so that input 2 is unused.
causes.ur: PV access mode aisa set hai ke input 2 use nahi ho raha.

solutions.en: Read per-MPPT power in the app to confirm which input is at zero.
solutions.ur: App se har MPPT ki power parh ke confirm karein ke kaun sa input zero par hai.

solutions.en: Check the input 2 string fuse and all MC4 connectors for looseness or heat damage.
solutions.ur: Input 2 ki string fuse aur tamam MC4 connectors ki dhili jagah ya garmi ka nuqsan check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the PV access mode in the app matches the actual wiring before rewiring anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi rewire karne se pehle app mein PV access mode ko asal wiring se match karwayein.

codes.blinkPattern: SOLAR LED single blink

source.title: GW ES Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.2, section 01 Introduction - Indicators

codes.seriesName: ES / SBP Series (3.0-6.0kW) G2 LED legend

title.en: FAULT LED blink - back-up output overload
title.ur: FAULT LED blink - back-up output overloaded

meaning.en: The back-up output is overloaded; the guide's instruction is to reduce the load.
meaning.ur: Back-up output overloaded hai, guide ka instruction hai ke load kam karein.

causes.en: Back-up load above the inverter's back-up rated output.
causes.ur: Back-up load inverter ki back-up rated output se zyada hai.

causes.en: Several loads switched on at the same time.
causes.ur: Ek hi waqt par kai loads on ho gaye.

solutions.en: Switch off back-up loads one at a time and watch the FAULT LED settle.
solutions.ur: Back-up loads aik aik band karein aur FAULT LED ko settle hote dekhein.

solutions.en: Stagger motor and compressor start times so they do not all surge together.
solutions.ur: Motor aur compressor ke start times aik doosre se door rakhein taake sab ek saath surge na karein.

codes.blinkPattern: FAULT LED blinking

source.title: GW ES Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual V1.2, section 01 Introduction - Indicators

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: No utility grid power, or the AC line / AC switch is disconnected, so the inverter has stopped grid-tied export.
meaning.ur: Grid power nahi hai ya AC line / AC switch disconnect hai, is liye inverter grid se export nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Utility grid power failure.
causes.ur: Grid power supply chali gayi.

causes.en: AC line or AC switch disconnected.
causes.ur: AC line ya AC switch disconnect hai.

solutions.en: Wait for grid restoration; the alarm clears by itself.
solutions.ur: Grid aane ka intezaar karein, alarm khud ba khud hat jayega.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, confirm AC voltage is present at the inverter AC terminal.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter ke AC terminal par voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC breaker is ON and all AC terminations are tight.
solutions.ur: AC breaker ON hai aur AC connections tight hain, ye check karein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

title.ur: Grid par voltage zyada, protection chali (F02)

meaning.en: Grid voltage is above the allowable range, or has stayed high for longer than the HVRT setting, so the inverter disconnected.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage allowed range se upar hai ya HVRT setting se zyada der tak high raha, is liye inverter ne disconnect kiya.

causes.en: Grid voltage higher than the allowable range.
causes.ur: Grid voltage permitted range se zyada hai.

causes.en: High voltage lasted longer than the HVRT value.
causes.ur: High voltage HVRT value se zyada der tak raha.

solutions.en: Do nothing if it happens rarely; the inverter restarts when the grid normalises.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar nahi ho to kuch na karein, grid normal hote hi inverter khud chalega.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage with a clamp meter; if outside range, report to DISCO.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se grid voltage measure karein, range se bahar ho to DISCO ko report karein.

solutions.en: Only with DISCO consent, adjust the grid overvoltage protection point or HVRT.
solutions.ur: Sirf DISCO ki ijazat se grid overvoltage protection point ya HVRT change karein.

solutions.en: If it never clears, inspect the AC breaker and output cable terminations.
solutions.ur: Agar theek na ho to AC breaker aur output cables ke connections check karein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: Grid voltage is below the allowable range, or has stayed low for longer than the LVRT setting, so the inverter disconnected.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage permitted range se neeche hai ya LVRT se zyada der low raha, is liye inverter ne disconnect kiya.

causes.en: Grid voltage lower than the allowable range.
causes.ur: Grid voltage permitted range se kam hai.

causes.en: Low voltage duration exceeded the LVRT value.
causes.ur: Low voltage ki duration LVRT se zyada rahi.

solutions.en: Ignore a single occurrence; it is usually a short grid dip and it self-clears.
solutions.ur: Ek baar aaye to ignore karein, aam tor par grid ki chhoti dip hai aur khud clear ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage under load; long cable runs and heavy AC loads commonly cause it.
solutions.ur: Load ke saath grid voltage measure karein, lamba AC cable ya zyada load is ki wajah ban sakta hai.

solutions.en: Check the AC side breaker and output cables are properly connected.
solutions.ur: AC side breaker aur output cables ke connections check karein.

solutions.en: With DISCO consent only, change the undervoltage protection point / LVRT.
solutions.ur: Sirf DISCO ki ijazat se undervoltage protection point ya LVRT badlein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: The 10-minute moving average of grid voltage has exceeded the safety-regulation limit, so the inverter shut down.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage ka 10 minute ka average safety regulation limit se cross kar gaya, is liye inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: Sustained high grid voltage for over 10 minutes.
causes.ur: Grid voltage 10 minute se zyada der high raha.

causes.en: Local grid operating above the safety-regulation band.
causes.ur: Local grid safety regulation range se upar chala raha hai.

solutions.en: Record the grid voltage trend for 15-20 minutes before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch nahi chhoone se pehle 15-20 minute grid voltage ka trend note karein.

solutions.en: Check for a heavy local load causing sustained overvoltage; shift or reduce it.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke koi bada local load sustained overvoltage to nahi kar raha, use kam ya shift karein.

solutions.en: With DISCO consent, modify the 10min overvoltage protection point.
solutions.ur: DISCO ki ijazat se 10min overvoltage protection point badlein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: Measured grid frequency is higher than the local grid standard allows, so the inverter disconnected.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency local standard se zyada hai, is liye inverter disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Actual grid frequency above the local grid standard.
causes.ur: Actual grid frequency local grid standard se zyada hai.

causes.en: Generator running in parallel and pushing frequency up.
causes.ur: Generator saath chal raha ho aur frequency badha raha ho.

solutions.en: Read the frequency on the inverter display or app; it normally self-clears.
solutions.ur: Inverter display ya app par frequency dekhein, aam tor par khud clear ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Measure frequency with a clamp meter; if it stays high, contact the utility.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se frequency measure karein, agar high rahe to utility ko contact karein.

solutions.en: Check the safety country setting matches the local grid standard.
solutions.ur: Safety country setting apne local grid standard ke mutabiq hai ya nahi check karein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: The inverter saw the grid as disconnected but voltage was still held up by local loads, so it stopped exporting per safety rules.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne grid ko disconnected samjha lekin voltage loads ki wajah se qayem raha, is liye safety ke mutabiq export band kar diya.

causes.en: Grid disconnected while local loads held voltage up.
causes.ur: Grid disconnect hua lekin local loads voltage qayem rakhte rahe.

causes.en: Grid-tie stopped according to safety requirements.
causes.ur: Safety requirements ke mutabiq grid-tie band kar diya gaya.

solutions.en: If it happens only during outages, this is normal anti-islanding behaviour.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf outage ke dauran aaye to ye normal anti-islanding behaviour hai.

solutions.en: Check whether there is a generator or other source back-feeding the same bus.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke usi bus par generator ya koi doosra source to nahi hai.

solutions.en: Confirm all AC isolators and breakers are in a consistent position.
solutions.ur: Sab AC isolators aur breakers ki position theek hai ya nahi confirm karein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: PV string or battery port insulation to earth has dropped below the protection point; the manual gives 80kOhm as the normal reading.
meaning.ur: PV string ya battery port ka earth ke mutabiq insulation gir gaya hai; manual ke mutabiq 80kOhm se upar normal hai.

causes.en: PV string shorted to protective earth.
causes.ur: PV string protective earth se short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Long-term humid site with poor line-to-ground insulation.
causes.ur: Nam location par line-to-ground insulation behtar nahi hai.

causes.en: Low insulation resistance on the battery port lines to ground.
causes.ur: Battery port lines ka ground se insulation kam hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC isolator first, then measure PV/battery port to PE; above 80kOhm is normal.
solutions.ur: Pehle DC isolator off karein, phir PV/battery port se PE tak resistance measure karein, 80kOhm se upar normal hai.

solutions.en: Isolate strings one by one to find the offending string, then inspect that string's connectors and cable for water ingress.
solutions.ur: Strings ko ek-ek karke disconnect karke woh wala string dhoondein, phir us ke connectors aur cable mein paani ki dhalai check karein.

solutions.en: Verify the inverter protective earth wire is properly connected.
solutions.ur: Inverter ka protective earth wire theek se laga hua hai ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: Only if wet-weather readings are genuinely marginal, reset the Insulation Resistance Protection Point in the app.
solutions.ur: Sirf agar wet weather ki reading sach mein marginal ho to app se Insulation Resistance Protection Point reset karein.

notes.en: AU/NZ units also sound an internal buzzer for 1 minute, repeating every 30 minutes, and can email the alarm.
notes.ur: AU/NZ units mein buzzer 1 minute bajta hai aur har 30 minute dobara bajta hai, saath hi email bhi aa sakta hai.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: The inverter protective earth wire is not connected, or a grounded PV string output is feeding earth with no isolation transformer.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka protective earth wire nahi laga, ya grounded PV string ka output isolation transformer ke baghair earth mein leak kar raha hai.

causes.en: Inverter protective earth wire not connected.
causes.ur: Inverter ka protective earth wire nahi laga hua.

causes.en: Grounded PV string output with no isolation transformer on the inverter output side.
causes.ur: Grounded PV string output hai lekin inverter output side par isolation transformer nahi.

solutions.en: With all sources isolated, confirm the PE conductor is bonded to the inverter frame and sized to code.
solutions.ur: Sab sources isolate karke PE wire inverter frame se lagi hui hai aur code ke mutabiq size ki hai ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure earth-to-inverter-frame resistance; it should read close to zero.
solutions.ur: Earth aur inverter frame ke darmiyan resistance measure karein, zero ke qareeb aana chahiye.

solutions.en: If the PV array output is intentionally grounded, confirm an isolation transformer is fitted.
solutions.ur: Agar PV array ka output jaan boojh kar ground kiya gaya hai to isolation transformer laga hua hai ya nahi confirm karein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

title.ur: PV string ulat lagi hui hai (F40 / F98)

meaning.en: One or more PV strings are wired backwards; the reported code depends on how many strings the unit has (F40 vs F98).
meaning.ur: Ek ya zyada PV strings ulti lagi hain; code unit ki string count ke mutabiq F40 ya F98 aata hai.

causes.en: PV string connected with reversed polarity.
causes.ur: PV string ki polarity ulti lagi hui hai.

causes.en: Strings with different Voc landed on the same MPPT.
causes.ur: Alag Voc wale strings ek hi MPPT par lage hain.

solutions.en: Switch the DC isolator OFF before touching any string.
solutions.ur: String chhoone se pehle DC isolator OFF karein.

solutions.en: Measure each string Voc with a multimeter; a reversed string reads far lower or shows negative on a meter with polarity display.
solutions.ur: Har string ka Voc multimeter se measure karein, ulti string bohat kam reading degi ya polarity wale meter par negative dikhega.

solutions.en: Reconnect with correct polarity and confirm the string fuse holder is seated.
solutions.ur: Sahi polarity se dobara connect karein aur string fuse holder sahi se lage hua hai confirm karein.

notes.en: The manual lists this row as 'F40, F98' with n determined by the actual number of inverter strings.
notes.ur: Manual is row ko 'F40, F98' likhta hai jahan n inverter ki actual string count se tay hota hai.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

title.ur: Grid ka aik phase gum ho gaya (F44)

meaning.en: A single-phase voltage dip in the three-phase grid, so the inverter disconnected to stay within the safety band.
meaning.ur: Three phase grid mein kisi ek phase ka voltage gir gaya, is liye inverter safety range ke andar rehne ke liye disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Single-phase voltage dip in the grid.
causes.ur: Grid mein kisi aik phase ka voltage gira hua hai.

causes.en: Loose or burnt AC phase terminal.
causes.ur: AC phase terminal dhila ya jala hua hai.

solutions.en: A one-off dip self-clears; log repeated events before changing settings.
solutions.ur: Aik baar ki dip khud clear ho jati hai, baar baar aaye tabhi settings badlein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and torque-check all three phase terminals at the inverter and the AC breaker.
solutions.ur: AC isolate karke inverter aur AC breaker ke teenon phase terminals ki tightening check karein.

solutions.en: Measure phase-to-phase voltage on each leg; one leg far below the others means a supply or fuse problem upstream.
solutions.ur: Har leg par phase-to-phase voltage measure karein, aik leg doosron se kaafi neeche ho to upstream supply ya fuse mein masla hai.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

title.ur: GFCi baar baar trip hone par band (F52)

meaning.en: North American rules forbid auto-recovery after repeated residual current trips, so the unit locks out and needs manual reset or a 24h wait.
meaning.ur: North American rules ke mutabiq baar baar residual current trip hone par auto recovery nahi hota, is liye unit lock ho jata hai aur manual reset ya 24 ghante ka intezaar chahiye.

causes.en: Repeated GFCI/residual current trips on the PV side.
causes.ur: PV side par baar baar GFCI trips hue hain.

causes.en: PV string impedance to ground too low.
causes.ur: PV string ka ground se impedance bohat kam hai.

solutions.en: Do not keep cycling it; isolate DC and find the real leakage path first.
solutions.ur: Baar baar on/off na karein, pehle DC isolate karke asal leakage source dhoondein.

solutions.en: Measure PV string to PE impedance in dry conditions; well above 80kOhm is expected.
solutions.ur: Sukhon haalat mein PV string se PE impedance measure karein, 80kOhm se kaafi upar hona chahiye.

solutions.en: After the fault is fixed, let the unit sit for the stated 24h or clear it per the local utility procedure.
solutions.ur: Fault theek hone ke baad 24 ghante intezaar karein ya local utility ke tareeqe se clear karein.

notes.en: Only relevant on the North American safety-standard build; the manual's handling text for this row is copied from the GFCI impedance instruction.
notes.ur: Yeh sirf North American safety standard wale unit par lagta hai, manual ki handling text yahan GFCI impedance instruction se copy ki gayi hai.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: The loads on the back-up output exceed what the inverter can sustain, so it dropped the back-up circuit.
meaning.ur: Back-up output par lagaya hua load inverter ki capacity se zyada hai, is liye back-up circuit gir diya gaya.

causes.en: Back-up load switched on while already at peak.
causes.ur: Back-up load already peak par tha aur usi waqt naya load chalaya gaya.

causes.en: Motor or pump starting current on back-up.
causes.ur: Back-up par motor ya pump ka starting current.

causes.en: Battery discharge limit reached.
causes.ur: Battery ka discharge limit poori ho chuka hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the largest back-up loads one at a time and see when the fault clears.
solutions.ur: Back-up ke sabse bade loads ek-ek karke off karein aur dekhein fault kab clear hota hai.

solutions.en: Add up the running watts from each appliance and compare with the back-up rated power in the spec sheet.
solutions.ur: Har appliance ka chalne wala wattage jama karke back-up ki rated power se compare karein.

solutions.en: Move AC motors, pumps and air-conditioners to the grid side; run heavy loads one at a time.
solutions.ur: AC motors, pumps aur air-conditioners grid side par shift karein, bade loads aik aik chala kar chalayein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

title.ur: Parallel units ka CAN link kharab (F59)

meaning.en: In a multi-inverter parallel stack the CAN communication cable is loose or one slave unit is offline, so the group cannot sync.
meaning.ur: Parallel system mein CAN communication cable dhila hai ya koi slave unit offline hai, is liye group sync nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: Parallel communication cable not securely connected.
causes.ur: Parallel communication cable theek se nahi lagi.

causes.en: One unit in the stack is powered off or offline.
causes.ur: Stack mein koi aik unit band ya offline hai.

solutions.en: Power down and re-seat both ends of the parallel CAN cable at every unit.
solutions.ur: Power off karke har unit par parallel CAN cable ke dono ends dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Confirm every unit in the stack is powered on and showing normal on the display.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke stack ka har unit on hai aur display par normal dikha raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the CAN addressing on each unit is unique, then power up master first.
solutions.ur: Har unit ki CAN address unique hai ya nahi check karein, phir master ko pehle on karein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: The AC terminal area has exceeded its temperature limit, which the manual links to poor ventilation, high ambient or a failing internal fan.
meaning.ur: AC terminal ka temperature limit se cross kar gaya, manual isay poor ventilation, high ambient ya kharab internal fan se jodta hai.

causes.en: Inverter installed where ventilation is inadequate.
causes.ur: Inverter aise jagah lagai hai jahan ventilation kam hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature above the maximum allowable range.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature maximum allowable range se upar hai.

causes.en: Internal fan not running normally.
causes.ur: Internal fan theek nahi chal raha.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, wait 15 minutes, then check the AC terminal temperature reading before restarting.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC isolate karein, 15 minute intezaar karein, phir restart se pehle AC terminal temperature check karein.

solutions.en: Measure ambient air temperature at the unit; Pakistan summers regularly exceed the rating.
solutions.ur: Unit ke paas ka ambient temperature measure karein, Pakistan mein garmiyon mein ye rating se upar chala jata hai.

solutions.en: Fit a shade hood or move the unit out of direct sun and out of hot exhaust air.
solutions.ur: Shade hood lagayein ya unit ko direct dhoop aur garam hawa se nikal dein.

solutions.en: Listen for the internal fan; if it is silent, check the fan connector and the fan itself.
solutions.ur: Internal fan ki aaz sun lein, agar khamosh hai to fan connector aur fan khud check karein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: The battery precharge circuit failed, for example the precharge resistor has burnt, so the DC bus is not lifted to battery voltage.
meaning.ur: Battery precharge circuit kharab hai, maslan precharge resistor jal chuka hai, is liye DC bus battery voltage tak nahi uthta.

causes.en: Precharge resistor burnt out or precharge circuit fault.
causes.ur: Precharge resistor jal chuka hai ya precharge circuit mein fault hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage not matching the inverter DC bus voltage.
causes.ur: Battery voltage inverter ke DC bus voltage se match nahi kar rahi.

solutions.en: Switch the battery off, wait 5 minutes, then switch the battery on alone with the inverter off.
solutions.ur: Battery off karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir inverter band kar ke sirf battery on karein.

solutions.en: With a multimeter on DC, compare battery voltage against the inverter DC bus voltage; they must match.
solutions.ur: Multimeter DC par laga kar battery voltage aur inverter DC bus voltage compare karein, dono match hone chahiye.

solutions.en: Inspect the precharge resistor and the battery contactor for heat damage or pitting.
solutions.ur: Precharge resistor aur battery contactor mein garmi se nuqsan ya pitting check karein.

solutions.en: If they still mismatch, replace the precharge resistor or board per service procedure.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi mismatch ho to service procedure ke mutabiq precharge resistor ya board replace karein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

title.ur: PV access mode ki setting ghalat (F122)

meaning.en: The PV access mode set in the app or on screen (AAAA, AACC, ABCD) does not match how the MPPT inputs are actually wired.
meaning.ur: App ya screen par set kiya gaya PV access mode (AAAA, AACC, ABCD) asal MPPT wiring ke mutabiq nahi hai.

causes.en: Actual wiring differs from the configured access mode.
causes.ur: Asal wiring configured access mode se different hai.

causes.en: Mode left on AAAA or AACC after an MPPT was re-wired.
causes.ur: MPPT rewiring ke baad mode AAAA ya AACC par chala gaya.

solutions.en: List which MPPT inputs physically share a string before changing anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi change karne se pehle likh lein ke kaun se MPPT inputs aik hi string share karte hain.

solutions.en: Set the PV access mode in the app or on screen to match that wiring (AAAA, AACC or ABCD).
solutions.ur: App ya screen par PV access mode usi wiring ke mutabiq set karein (AAAA, AACC ya ABCD).

solutions.en: Isolate PV and AC, then restart so the new mode takes effect.
solutions.ur: PV aur AC isolate karke restart karein taake naya mode apply ho.

solutions.en: If the fault stays with the correct mode set, the mode-setting circuit is faulty - escalate to GoodWe.
solutions.ur: Agar sahi mode set karne par bhi fault rahe to mode-setting circuit kharab hai, GoodWe ko baat karein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: The smart meter is not talking to the inverter, which also blinds the export limit and anti-backfeed functions.
meaning.ur: Smart meter inverter se baat nahi kar raha, is liye export limit aur anti-backfeed bhi kaam nahi kar rahe.

causes.en: Meter not connected at all.
causes.ur: Meter bilkul nahi lagi hui.

causes.en: Incorrect wiring of the meter-to-inverter communication cable.
causes.ur: Meter se inverter ke communication cable ki wiring ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Check the meter has supply on the same phase as the inverter and that its COM LED is blinking.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke meter ko supply usi phase par hai jis par inverter hai aur us ka COM LED blink kar raha hai.

solutions.en: With power off, re-seat the RS485 cable and confirm the pinout matches the meter manual.
solutions.ur: Power off karke RS485 cable dobara lagayein aur pinout meter ke manual ke mutabiq check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the meter cable with a correctly pinned-out cable, then run the meter test in the app.
solutions.ur: Meter cable sahi pinout wale se replace karein, phir app mein meter test chalayein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: SDT-G3 three-phase hybrid (F01-F163 F-code scheme)

meaning.en: The rate of change of grid voltage phase does not comply with the local grid standard, so the inverter stopped.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage phase ka badlav local grid standard ke mutabiq nahi hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: Grid phase change rate outside local grid standard.
causes.ur: Grid phase change rate local grid standard se bahar hai.

causes.en: Heavy motor or welding load cycling on the same phase.
causes.ur: Usi phase par bada motor ya welding load on/off ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Note the frequency and voltage at the time it happens; a one-off clears itself.
solutions.ur: Jab aaye tab frequency aur voltage note karein, aik baar aane par khud clear hota hai.

solutions.en: If it repeats, log events and report the timestamps to the utility.
solutions.ur: Baar baar aaye to events log karein aur timestamps ke saath utility ko dein.

solutions.en: Move large motor and welding loads to a different phase where the consumer unit allows.
solutions.ur: Bade motor aur welding loads consumer unit ki ijazat ke mutabiq doosre phase par shift karein.

source.title: GW SDT-G3 User Manual V2.4 (2026-03-25), section 7.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: UT utility string inverter (bare integer codes 1-39)

meaning.en: The measured grid frequency is outside the allowed range for the configured safety country, so the unit stopped.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency configured safety country ki allowed range se bahar hai, is liye unit band ho gaya.

causes.en: Utility grid frequency is outside the allowed range.
causes.ur: Grid frequency allowed range se bahar hai.

causes.en: Wrong safety country configured for the site.
causes.ur: Site ke liye ghalat safety country set hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid frequency with a clamp meter and log it before touching settings.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se grid frequency measure kar ke settings chhoone se pehle note karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the configured safety country matches the actual grid standard.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke set hua safety country asal grid standard se match karta hai.

solutions.en: If frequency is genuinely out of range, report to the utility; do not widen limits on your own.
solutions.ur: Agar frequency asal mein range se bahar hai to utility ko report karein, limits apni marzi se na barhayein.

source.title: GW UT User Manual 1.6-2026-01-16, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: UT utility string inverter (bare integer codes 1-39)

title.ur: Insulation fail - string zameen se short (12)

meaning.en: PV string insulation to ground has failed, from a shorted string, a moist site or broken DC cable insulation.
meaning.ur: PV string ka ground se insulation fail ho gaya, string short hone, nam site ya DC cable insulation tootne ki wajah se.

causes.en: PV string short-circuited to ground.
causes.ur: PV string ground se short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Moist environment with circuit not well insulated to ground.
causes.ur: Nam mahaul aur circuit ka ground se insulation theek nahi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the PV input cables are broken.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke PV input cables tooti hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: Verify module frames and metal brackets are securely grounded.
solutions.ur: Module frames aur metal brackets theek se grounded hain ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: Verify the AC side is properly grounded and measure string-to-earth resistance per string.
solutions.ur: AC side theek se grounded hai ya nahi check karein aur har string ka earth se resistance measure karein.

source.title: GW UT User Manual 1.6-2026-01-16, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: UT utility string inverter (bare integer codes 1-39)

meaning.en: Arc fault protection triggered because a PV string terminal is loose or the DC cable is broken.
meaning.ur: Arc fault protection trigger hua kyunke PV string terminal dhila hai ya DC cable tooti hai.

causes.en: PV string terminal not firmly connected.
causes.ur: PV string terminal dheela band nahi hai.

causes.en: DC cable is broken.
causes.ur: DC cable tooti hui hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the DC side fully and confirm dead before inspection.
solutions.ur: DC side poori tarah isolate karke inspect karne se pehle dead hai ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check the PV module wiring against the user manual requirements.
solutions.ur: PV module ki wiring ko user manual ki requirements se compare karein.

solutions.en: Re-terminate loose connectors with the correct crimp tool; replace heat-damaged parts.
solutions.ur: Dhile connectors sahi crimp tool se dobara lagayein, garmi se kharab hisse replace karein.

source.title: GW UT User Manual 1.6-2026-01-16, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: UT utility string inverter (bare integer codes 1-39)

title.ur: Ground leakage current fail - earth leakage (19)

meaning.en: Input insulation resistance to ground dropped while the inverter was running, so leakage protection tripped.
meaning.ur: Inverter chalne ke daurat input ka ground se insulation resistance gir gaya, is liye leakage protection trigger hua.

causes.en: Input insulation resistance to ground decreases when running.
causes.ur: Chalne par input ka ground se insulation resistance gir jata hai.

causes.en: High humidity on rainy days.
causes.ur: Barsaat ke din bohat zyada humidity.

solutions.en: Check the installation working environment meets the manual's requirements.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke installation ka working environment manual ki requirements poora karta hai.

solutions.en: Verify all components and the AC side are properly grounded.
solutions.ur: Sab components aur AC side theek se grounded hain ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: If it only appears on wet days, log the weather with each event before replacing anything.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf geelay din aaye to kuch bhi replace karne se pehle har event ke saath weather note karein.

source.title: GW UT User Manual 1.6-2026-01-16, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: UT utility string inverter (bare integer codes 1-39)

meaning.en: The inverter was struck by lightning and the surge protective device has failed, so surge protection is no longer available.
meaning.ur: Inverter par lightning gira aur surge protective device kharab ho gaya, is liye surge protection ab nahi hai.

causes.en: Inverter struck by lightning.
causes.ur: Inverter par lightning gira.

causes.en: SPD device failed after the surge event.
causes.ur: Surge event ke baad SPD device fail ho gaya.

solutions.en: Improve the lightning protection facilities around the inverter first.
solutions.ur: Pehle inverter ke gird lightning protection facilities behtar karein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, wait 5 minutes, then re-energise to confirm the trip was surge-related.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC isolate karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir dobara on karke confirm karein ke trip surge ki wajah se tha.

solutions.en: Visually inspect and continuity-test the SPD, then replace the module.
solutions.ur: SPD visually inspect karein aur continuity test karein, phir module replace karein.

source.title: GW UT User Manual 1.6-2026-01-16, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: UT utility string inverter (bare integer codes 1-39)

meaning.en: The PV string open-circuit voltage is higher than the inverter maximum input voltage because too many modules were connected in series.
meaning.ur: PV string ka open-circuit voltage inverter ke maximum input voltage se zyada hai kyunke series mein zyada modules lage hue hain.

causes.en: Excess PV modules connected in series.
causes.ur: Series mein zyada PV modules lage hue hain.

causes.en: Actual string voltage higher than the value shown on the LCD.
causes.ur: Asal string voltage LCD par dikhne wali value se zyada hai.

solutions.en: Compare the string input voltage with the value displayed on the LCD.
solutions.ur: String ka input voltage LCD par dikhne wali value se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check the string voltage against the maximum input voltage requirement and reconfigure the string.
solutions.ur: String voltage ko maximum input voltage requirement se check karke string dobara arrange karein.

solutions.en: Never change the string while it is live; open the DC switch and confirm dead first.
solutions.ur: String ko live mein kabhi na badlein, pehle DC switch off karke dead hona confirm karein.

source.title: GW UT User Manual 1.6-2026-01-16, section 9.4 Troubleshooting

codes.seriesName: EPM / export power manager, smart meter and CT (RS485 Modbus, zero-export)

meaning.en: The EPM cannot see one or more inverters on the RS485 bus, so it cannot read grid power or command the inverters.
meaning.ur: EPM RS485 bus par ek ya zyada inverters nahi dekh sakta, is liye wo grid power nahi parh sakta aur inverters ko command nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: RS485 cable not connected at the EPM COM-INV port or at an inverter COMx port
causes.ur: RS485 cable EPM ke COM-INV port ya inverter ke COMx port par connected nahi

causes.en: A/B pair reversed somewhere in the run, or the cable is pinched or split
causes.ur: Run mein kahin A/B pair ulat diya gaya, ya cable pinch ya phata hua

causes.en: Inverter address not set to 1 (or duplicates on the bus), so the EPM sees no reply
causes.ur: Inverter ka address 1 par set nahi (ya bus par duplicate), is liye EPM ko koi reply nazar nahi aati

solutions.en: Measure the DC voltage between RS485A and RS485B at the EPM COM-INV port with the EPM powered; it should read roughly 0.5-5 Vdc.
solutions.ur: EPM power par hone ke waqt EPM ke COM-INV port par RS485A aur RS485B ke darmiyan DC voltage measure karein; taqreeban 0.5-5 Vdc aana chahiye.

solutions.en: Then unplug the cable from the EPM and measure the same 0.5-5 Vdc at the free end, then at each inverter COMx port one at a time, leaving all other COM ports empty.
solutions.ur: Phir cable EPM se nikaal kar usi free end par 0.5-5 Vdc measure karein, phir ek-ek karke har inverter ke COMx port par, baaki COM ports khali chhod kar.

solutions.en: On the EPM set menu > advanced settings (0010) > TRANSMIT > ON > press ENT so the readings settle, then set External EPM Set to 5G, EPM FailSafe to RUN and confirm the EPM address is 1 on every inverter.
solutions.ur: EPM par menu > advanced settings (0010) > TRANSMIT > ON > ENT dabayein taake readings settle hon, phir har inverter par External EPM Set 5G, EPM FailSafe RUN aur EPM ka address 1 confirm karein.

notes.en: Nothing will work if the RS485 communications is not working - the EPM cannot control the inverters at all. Test both ends of every cable run, because the EPM is normally one per site and the fault is often a single bad plug.
notes.ur: Agar RS485 communication kaam nahi kar rahi to kuch bhi kaam nahi karega - EPM inverters ko control hi nahi kar sakta. Har cable run ke dono taraf test karein, kyunke site par EPM aam tor par ek hi hota hai aur fault aksar ek kharab plug hota hai.

source.title: Solis official support KB: EPM - RS485 fail; LimByEPM; EPM Configuration and Validation Guide; Smart Meter Phase Rotation and CT Polarity Verification; plus the Solis master alarm table rows for 2010/2011/201A/2019/204B/204C

codes.seriesName: EPM / export power manager, smart meter and CT (RS485 Modbus, zero-export)

title.ur: Output EPM ki wajah se limited (LimByEPM)

meaning.en: The external or internal power-meter setting is holding the inverter output down, so the system shows LimByEPM instead of generating freely.
meaning.ur: External ya internal power-meter setting inverter ka output rok rakhti hai, is liye system azaad generate karne ke bajaye LimByEPM dikhata hai.

causes.en: External EPM Set is ON and its Fail Safe Set is ON, so the inverter is held off the grid
causes.ur: External EPM Set ON hai aur uska Fail Safe Set bhi ON hai, is liye inverter ko grid se rok rakha gaya hai

causes.en: Internal EPM Set is also ON even though no meter is fitted
causes.ur: Internal EPM Set bhi ON hai jabke koi meter lagi hi nahi

solutions.en: Go to Advanced Settings > External EPM Set > Fail Safe Set, change ON to OFF and press Enter.
solutions.ur: Advanced Settings > External EPM Set > Fail Safe Set mein jayein, ON ko OFF karein aur Enter dabayein.

solutions.en: Also make sure the Internal EPM Set is OFF - both settings must be off for the LimByEPM message to stop.
solutions.ur: Ye bhi confirm karein ke Internal EPM Set OFF hai - dono settings off hone par hi LimByEPM message band hoga.

solutions.en: If the EPM IS fitted and you want zero export, configure it properly instead: EPM address 1, Transmit OFF, RUN 3600, Backflow power set to the DISCO-approved export limit.
solutions.ur: Agar EPM lagi hui hai aur aap zero export chahte hain to usay theek tareeqe se configure karein: EPM address 1, Transmit OFF, RUN 3600, aur Backflow power DISCO ki approved export limit par set karein.

source.title: Solis official support KB: EPM - RS485 fail; LimByEPM; EPM Configuration and Validation Guide; Smart Meter Phase Rotation and CT Polarity Verification; plus the Solis master alarm table rows for 2010/2011/201A/2019/204B/204C

codes.seriesName: EPM / export power manager, smart meter and CT (RS485 Modbus, zero-export)

meaning.en: The inverter lost the meter and has gone into fail-safe, stopping generation so no uncontrolled power can flow back to the grid.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne meter kho diya aur fail-safe mein chala gaya, generation rok diya taake grid par koi uncontrolled power na jaaye.

causes.en: The communication line between the meter and the inverter is not normal
causes.ur: Meter aur inverter ke darmiyan communication line normal nahi hai

causes.en: CT clip loose, CT cable damaged, or the CT installed on the wrong conductor
causes.ur: CT clip loose, CT cable damaged, ya CT galat conductor par lagi hui

causes.en: Meter installed in 'load' position while the inverter setting expects 'grid' (or vice versa)
causes.ur: Meter 'load' position par lagi hai jabke inverter ka setting 'grid' expect karta hai (ya ulta)

solutions.en: Wait 5 minutes first - this fault can restore itself; only act if it persists.
solutions.ur: Pehle 5 minute intezaar karein - ye fault khud restore ho sakta hai; sirf tab kaam karein jab rehta rahe.

solutions.en: With power off, verify that the CT cable is intact and undamaged and that the CT clip is securely fastened and not loose.
solutions.ur: Power off karke confirm karein ke CT cable salamat aur undamaged hai aur CT clip securely fastened hai, loose nahi.

solutions.en: Confirm the CT installation position is correct - CTs must be on the main incoming utility cable at the point of common coupling, before any branching to site loads or the inverter.
solutions.ur: CT ki installation position sahi hai confirm karein - CTs main incoming utility cable par point of common coupling par honi chahiye, site loads ya inverter ki taraf kisi bhi branch se pehle.

solutions.en: Verify the installation location of the meter matches the actual setting; a mismatch between Meter in Grid and Meter in Load is a common cause.
solutions.ur: Meter ki installation location aur actual setting match karti hai yeh verify karein; Meter in Grid aur Meter in Load ke darmiyan mismatch aam waja hai.

source.title: Solis official support KB: EPM - RS485 fail; LimByEPM; EPM Configuration and Validation Guide; Smart Meter Phase Rotation and CT Polarity Verification; plus the Solis master alarm table rows for 2010/2011/201A/2019/204B/204C

codes.seriesName: EPM / export power manager, smart meter and CT (RS485 Modbus, zero-export)

title.en: CT or smart meter connection lost (CT_FAULT)
title.ur: CT ya smart meter ka connection kho gaya (CT_FAULT)

meaning.en: The CT on the inverter, or the CT on the smart meter, has lost connection, so the inverter cannot measure grid power direction.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka CT ya smart meter ka CT connection kho gaya, is liye inverter grid power ki direction measure nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: CT wiring loose, opened or with a poor earth reference
causes.ur: CT wiring loose, khuli ya earth reference kamzor

causes.en: CT installed with the wrong polarity, so import is read as export
causes.ur: CT galat polarity par lagi, is liye import ko export samajh liya jata hai

solutions.en: Establish a known 'pure import' state: with a standard PV system turn the PV inverter off and switch on heavy site loads such as water heaters; on a hybrid force a grid charge.
solutions.ur: Ek maloom 'pure import' halat banayein: standard PV system par PV inverter band karke bhaari site loads jaise water heater on karein; hybrid par grid charge force karein.

solutions.en: Read per-phase active power in kW: in a correct pure-import state every phase should read negative. If one phase reads positive while the others read negative, that CT is reversed.
solutions.ur: Har phase ka active power kW mein padhein: sahi pure-import halat mein har phase negative hona chahiye. Agar ek phase positive aur baaki negative parhein to wo CT reversed hai.

solutions.en: Correct a reversed CT by unclipping it and rotating it 180 degrees on the cable; the reading will switch sign immediately. Do not rely on the arrow on a wiring diagram alone - verify per meter model.
solutions.ur: Reversed CT ko theek karne ke liye use unclip karke cable par 180 degree ghumayein; reading foran badal jayegi. Wiring diagram ke arrow par bharosa na karein - meter model ke mutabiq verify karein.

solutions.en: If G100 is enabled, clear the alarm manually with the 'G100 Alarm Clear' setting in the LCD/APP or clear it remotely; if G100 is off, just repair the CT wiring.
solutions.ur: Agar G100 enabled hai to LCD/APP mein 'G100 Alarm Clear' setting se alarm manually clear karein ya remote clear karein; agar G100 off hai to sirf CT wiring repair karein.

notes.en: Before blaming CT polarity you MUST verify phase rotation: clamp all CTs onto the same physical phase conductor (at least 5 A, about 1 kW load) - only the matching voltage channel should then read true power and a correct power factor, while mismatched channels read about 50 % lower or negative.
notes.ur: CT polarity par dawa karne se pehle phase rotation verify karna ZAROORI hai: sab CTs ek hi physical phase conductor par lagao (kam az kam 5 A, yaqreeban 1 kW load) - phir sirf matching voltage channel hi asli power aur sahi power factor parhe, aur mismatched channels qareeb 50 % kam ya negative parhein.

source.title: Solis official support KB: EPM - RS485 fail; LimByEPM; EPM Configuration and Validation Guide; Smart Meter Phase Rotation and CT Polarity Verification; plus the Solis master alarm table rows for 2010/2011/201A/2019/204B/204C

codes.seriesName: EPM / export power manager, smart meter and CT (RS485 Modbus, zero-export)

meaning.en: The meter type configured in the inverter does not match the smart meter actually installed, so the meter interface cannot be read.
meaning.ur: Inverter mein set kiya gaya meter type lagay huay smart meter se match nahi karta, is liye meter interface parha nahi ja sakta.

causes.en: Meter Type left on 'No Meter' while a smart meter is actually connected
causes.ur: Smart meter lagi hone ke bawajood Meter Type 'No Meter' par chhor diya gaya

causes.en: Wrong meter model selected, e.g. a 1-phase meter option on a 3-phase install
causes.ur: Galat meter model selected, maslan 3-phase install par 1-phase meter option

solutions.en: Read the model number printed on the smart meter and compare it with the options in Meter Setting > Meter Type.
solutions.ur: Smart meter par likha model number padhein aur Meter Setting > Meter Type ke options se compare karein.

solutions.en: Select the meter option that exactly matches the installed meter, save and exit, then power cycle the inverter.
solutions.ur: Lage hue meter se bilkul match karne wala meter option select karke save aur exit karein, phir inverter power cycle karein.

solutions.en: If no meter is connected at the moment, select 'No Meter' so the meter communication fault alarm is shielded.
solutions.ur: Agar abhi koi meter connected nahi hai to 'No Meter' select kar dein taake meter communication fault ka alarm na aaye.

source.title: Solis official support KB: EPM - RS485 fail; LimByEPM; EPM Configuration and Validation Guide; Smart Meter Phase Rotation and CT Polarity Verification; plus the Solis master alarm table rows for 2010/2011/201A/2019/204B/204C

codes.seriesName: RHI-(3-6)K-48ES-5G (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: The RHI has not detected the 48 V pack, so it is running as a normal grid-tied PV inverter with no storage.
meaning.ur: RHI ne 48 V pack detect nahi kiya, is liye ye normal grid-tied PV inverter ki tarah bina storage ke chal raha hai.

causes.en: Battery power cable not connected, or the battery breaker/isolator is open
causes.ur: Battery power cable connected nahi, ya battery breaker ya isolator khula hai

causes.en: Battery output voltage outside the 42-58 V window the RHI expects
causes.ur: Battery output voltage RHI ke liye 42-58 V range se bahar hai

solutions.en: Check the wire of battery power is connected correctly or not: reseat both battery power lugs and tighten them.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery power wire sahi se connected hai ya nahi: dono battery power lugs dobara fit karke tighten karein.

solutions.en: Check the output voltage of the battery with a multimeter at the inverter end; the RHI expects roughly 42-58 V for a 48 V pack.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter ke taraf battery ka output voltage measure karein; 48 V pack ke liye RHI ko taqreeban 42-58 V chahiye.

solutions.en: If the pack is not being installed yet, set the battery select to 'No Battery' so the alarm is suppressed and the unit works like a normal grid-tied inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar pack abhi lagaya nahi ja raha to battery select ko 'No Battery' par kar dein taake alarm na aaye aur unit normal grid-tied inverter ki tarah chale.

source.title: Solis RHI(3-6)K-5G / RHI-(3.6)K-48ES-5G Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual ENX V1,5, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: RHI-(3-6)K-48ES-5G (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: Battery 1 voltage is above the configured overvoltage protection point, so the RHI stopped charge and discharge.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 ka voltage set kiye gaye overvoltage protection point se upar hai, is liye RHI ne charge aur discharge rok diya.

causes.en: Battery pack charged above the inverter's overvoltage protection setting
causes.ur: Battery pack inverter ke overvoltage protection setting se upar charge ho gaya

causes.en: Two packs on the 48 V bus imbalanced, so one pack sits high while the other sits low
causes.ur: 48 V bus par do packs unbalanced hain, ek high par hai aur doosra low par

causes.en: Battery aged so its resting voltage is higher than a new pack of the same SoC
causes.ur: Battery purani ho gayi is liye wisi SoC par uska resting voltage naye pack se zyada hai

solutions.en: Check the protect point for overvoltage sets correctly or not: read the battery overvoltage protection value in Advanced Settings > 0010 and compare it with the battery maker's maximum charge voltage.
solutions.ur: Overvoltage ke liye protection point sahi set hai ya nahi check karein: Advanced Settings > 0010 mein battery overvoltage protection value padhein aur battery maker ki maximum charge voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Measure each pack separately with a multimeter; if one pack reads noticeably higher, re-balance or isolate the packs before restarting.
solutions.ur: Har pack ko alag alag multimeter se measure karein; koi ek pack zyada padhe to packs ko dobara balance karein ya alag karein phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter once and confirm the code clears; if it returns on a full battery, the protection point or the pack is at fault.
solutions.ur: Inverter ek baar restart karke confirm karein ke code hat gaya; full battery par wapas aaye to protection point ya pack kharab hai.

notes.en: RHI names the battery-side code OV-Vbatt1 (with the digit 1) because the RHI can carry two battery channels; the S5-EH1P-L / S6-EH1P-L manuals print the same condition without the digit.
notes.ur: RHI battery-side code ko OV-Vbatt1 (digit 1 ke saath) kehta hai kyunke RHI do battery channels carry kar sakta hai; S5-EH1P-L / S6-EH1P-L manual wahi halat digit ke baghair print karte hain.

source.title: Solis RHI(3-6)K-5G / RHI-(3.6)K-48ES-5G Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual ENX V1,5, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: RHI-(3-6)K-48ES-5G (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

title.ur: Battery circuit ka hardware overvoltage fault (OV-Vbatt-H)

meaning.en: The battery circuit hardware overvoltage protection has tripped, so the RHI has locked out to protect the pack.
meaning.ur: Battery circuit ka hardware overvoltage protection trigger ho gaya, is liye RHI ne pack bachane ke liye lock out kar diya.

causes.en: Battery circuit 'jumps' - a loose or arcing battery connection under high charge current
causes.ur: Battery circuit mein 'jumps' - high charge current par battery connection loose ya arcing

causes.en: Battery pack internal cell imbalance or a failed BMS contactor
causes.ur: Battery pack mein internal cell imbalance ya BMS contactor fail

solutions.en: Check the circuit whether the battery circuit jumps: with the inverter off, inspect every battery connector and lug for heat marks, discolouration or looseness.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery circuit jump karta hai ya nahi: inverter off kar ke har battery connector aur lug par heat marks, rang badalna ya looseness dekhein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and the battery, then measure each pack's voltage at the inverter battery port; a pack well above its rating points to the pack, not the inverter.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke har pack ka voltage inverter battery port par measure karein; rating se zyada pack nikalay to masla pack ka hai, inverter ka nahi.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter. If it trips again with a healthy pack and clean connections, the pack BMS or contactor is faulty - RMA the battery.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein. Agar pack aur connections theek hone par bhi dobara trip kare to pack ka BMS ya contactor kharab hai - battery RMA karein.

source.title: Solis RHI(3-6)K-5G / RHI-(3.6)K-48ES-5G Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual ENX V1,5, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: RHI-(3-6)K-48ES-5G (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: The load connected to the backup port is above the inverter's rated backup output power, so the RHI shut that port down.
meaning.ur: Backup port se jula hua load inverter ki rated backup output power se zyada hai, is liye RHI ne wo port band kar diya.

causes.en: Backup load above the inverter's rated output power
causes.ur: Backup load inverter ki rated output power se zyada hai

causes.en: Large inrush from a motor or compressor on the backup circuit
causes.ur: Backup circuit par motor ya compressor ka bada inrush

solutions.en: Check the load of Backup port is over rating output power or not: add up the running watts of every backup appliance and compare with the RHI nameplate backup rating.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke backup port ka load rated output power se zyada hai ya nahi: har backup appliance ke running watts jama karke RHI nameplate ki backup rating se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load of Backup port, then restart inverter and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: Backup port ka load kam karein, phir inverter restart karke confirm karein ke code hat gaya.

solutions.en: If the alarm returns with a light load, measure the backup port voltage; an unstable backup voltage points to the inverter, not the load.
solutions.ur: Agar halki load par bhi alarm wapas aaye to backup port voltage measure karein; backup voltage unstable hai to masla inverter ka hai, load ka nahi.

source.title: Solis RHI(3-6)K-5G / RHI-(3.6)K-48ES-5G Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual ENX V1,5, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: RHI-(3-6)K-48ES-5G (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: The backup output voltage rose above the permitted window while running off-grid, so the RHI stopped.
meaning.ur: Off-grid chalte waqt backup output voltage permitted window se upar chala gaya, is liye RHI ruk gaya.

causes.en: Backup port wiring loose, so the measured backup voltage is false-high
causes.ur: Backup port wiring loose hai, is liye measured backup voltage ghalat high parha ja raha hai

causes.en: Generator connected to the same backup port, fighting the inverter output
causes.ur: Generator bhi isi backup port se connected hai aur inverter output se lad raha hai

causes.en: Direct sun on the cabinet and poor airflow while running hot
causes.ur: Cabinet par seedhi dhoop hai aur chalte waqt airflow kam hai

solutions.en: Switch off AC, PV and the battery, then check the backup port wiring: line, neutral and earth tight, and any generator correctly isolated through its changeover.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery off karke backup port wiring check karein: line, neutral aur earth tight, aur generator sahi changeover ke zariye isolate hua ho.

solutions.en: Measure the backup port voltage with a multimeter while the RHI runs on battery and compare it with the configured backup voltage.
solutions.ur: RHI battery par chalte waqt multimeter se backup port voltage measure karein aur set ki hui backup voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check inverter surrounding ventilation and whether sunshine is falling directly on the inverter in hot weather, then restart.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke aas-paas ventilation check karein aur dekhein ke garmi ke mausam mein dhoop seedhi lag rahi hai ya nahi, phir restart karein.

source.title: Solis RHI(3-6)K-5G / RHI-(3.6)K-48ES-5G Series Hybrid Inverter User Manual ENX V1,5, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: The inverter is running on PV only and has not detected a battery on the CAN port.
meaning.ur: Inverter sirf PV par chal raha hai aur CAN port par koi battery detect nahi kar paya.

causes.en: Battery power cable or CAN comms cable not plugged in, or the battery breaker is open
causes.ur: Battery power cable ya CAN comms cable plug nahi, ya battery breaker khula hai

causes.en: Battery SoC so low that the BMS has shut the pack down
causes.ur: Battery ka SOC itna kam ke BMS ne pack band kar diya

causes.en: Battery model not selected in Battery Setting, so the inverter expects a pack that is not there
causes.ur: Battery Setting mein battery model select nahi kiya, is liye inverter aisi pack ki shudaad karta hai jo maujood nahi

solutions.en: On Information page 1 read the battery voltage; if it shows 0 V the inverter sees nothing on the battery port.
solutions.ur: Information page 1 par battery voltage padhein; 0 V aaye to inverter battery port par kuch nahi dekh raha.

solutions.en: With the inverter off, measure the battery voltage at the plug with a multimeter and confirm the battery breaker on the battery or the DC side is closed.
solutions.ur: Inverter off karke multimeter se plug par battery voltage measure karein aur battery ya DC side ka breaker band hua hai confirm karein.

solutions.en: If the battery is intentionally absent, set Battery Setting > Battery Model to 'No Battery' so the alarm stops; if a pack is fitted, reseat the CAN plug and re-power the pack.
solutions.ur: Agar battery jaan boojh kar nahi hai to Battery Setting > Battery Model mein 'No Battery' kar dein taake alarm band ho; agar pack lage hai to CAN plug dobara fit karke pack dobara power karein.

notes.en: On S5/S6 the app/LCD string Batt_Comm_FAIL (2012) very often follows a CAN fault and ends up showing as No-Battery. Solis documents Batt_Comm_FAIL as 'previously CAN_Comm_FAIL' for Pylon US2000C/US3000C/US5000 packs.
notes.ur: S5/S6 par app/LCD string Batt_Comm_FAIL (2012) aksar CAN fault ke baad aata hai aur No-Battery ke tor par dikhta hai. Solis Pylon US2000C/US3000C/US5000 ke liye Batt_Comm_FAIL ko 'pehle CAN_Comm_FAIL tha' likhta hai.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: Pack voltage at the inverter terminals is below the undervoltage limit, so charging/discharging is blocked.
meaning.ur: Inverter terminal par pack voltage undervoltage limit se neeche hai, is liye charge/discharge block hai.

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged after a long grid outage or a load left on during backup
causes.ur: Lambi grid outage ya backup ke dauran load chhodne ke baad battery gehri tarah discharge ho gayi

causes.en: Battery pack aged, or the pack's own BMS cutting out early
causes.ur: Battery pack purani ho gayi, ya pack ka apna BMS jaldi cut out kar raha hai

causes.en: Undervoltage protection point set too high in the user settings
causes.ur: User settings mein undervoltage protection point bahut high set hai

solutions.en: Verify battery voltage is within range on Information page 1, then measure the same voltage at the inverter connection point with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Information page 1 par battery voltage range ke andar hai verify karein, phir multimeter se inverter connection point par wahi voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery breaker is closed and the BMS wake-up / power-on switch on the pack is on; deep-sleep packs need a wake signal.
solutions.ur: Battery breaker band hua hai aur pack ka BMS wake-up ya power-on switch on hai confirm karein; gehri neend wale pack ko wake signal chahiye.

solutions.en: If the readings are healthy, contact the battery manufacturer for service - the pack, not the inverter, is refusing the charge.
solutions.ur: Readings theek hon to battery manufacturer se service ke liye rabta karein - charge inverter nahi, pack mana kar raha hai.

notes.en: The official Solis library files OV-Vbatt under the energy-storage scope as 1053 and again as 105C with the same name and the same fix text.
notes.ur: Official Solis library OV-Vbatt ko energy-storage scope mein 1053 aur phir 105C ke tor par usi naam aur usi fix text ke saath rakhta hai.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: Pack voltage at the inverter terminals has risen above the overvoltage limit, so the BMS has stopped charge/discharge.
meaning.ur: Inverter terminal par pack voltage overvoltage limit se upar chala gaya, is liye BMS ne charge/discharge rok diya.

causes.en: Pack fully charged and sitting at maximum SOC while the BMS charge limit is already reached
causes.ur: Pack poori tarah charge ho kar maximum SOC par hai aur BMS ka charge limit pehle hi poori ho chuka hai

causes.en: Battery overvoltage protection point set too low in the user settings
causes.ur: User settings mein battery overvoltage protection point bahut low set hai

causes.en: Battery aged or cell imbalance pushing the pack voltage up
causes.ur: Battery purani ho gayi ya cell imbalance pack voltage upar le gaya

solutions.en: Read the battery voltage on Information page 1 and compare it with the pack's own BMS reading in SolisCloud.
solutions.ur: Information page 1 par battery voltage padhein aur usko SolisCloud mein pack ke BMS reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: Restart the system once and confirm whether the fault persists; a one-off after full charge is normal BMS behaviour.
solutions.ur: System ek baar restart karke dekhein ke fault rehta hai ya nahi; full charge ke baad ek baar aana normal BMS behaviour hai.

solutions.en: If it keeps coming back, raise the battery overvoltage protection point within the battery maker's stated window, then contact the battery vendor if it still trips.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aata rahe to battery maker ke bataye range mein battery overvoltage protection point barhayein, phir bhi trip kare to battery vendor se rabta karein.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: The battery-side hardware overvoltage protection has tripped on the internal VBUS rail.
meaning.ur: Battery side ka hardware overvoltage protection internal VBUS rail par trigger ho gaya.

causes.en: Battery voltage at full SOC when the pack suddenly drops out, so the inverter sees a step up
causes.ur: Pack full SOC par tha aur achanak gir gaya, is liye inverter par voltage step up dikha

causes.en: Battery circuit breaker tripping, or the battery pack itself faulty
causes.ur: Battery circuit breaker trip ho raha hai, ya battery pack khud kharab hai

solutions.en: Check whether the battery circuit breaker is tripping; watch it while the inverter is on the battery.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke battery circuit breaker trip to nahi ho raha; inverter battery par ho tab us par nazar rakhein.

solutions.en: Measure pack voltage directly with a multimeter and compare with SolisCloud BMS voltage; a large gap points to a wiring or BMS problem.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se pack voltage seedha measure karein aur SolisCloud ke BMS voltage se compare karein; bara farq wiring ya BMS ke masle ki nishani hai.

solutions.en: If the breaker is healthy and the pack still trips, the pack is faulty - have the battery vendor test it before condemning the inverter.
solutions.ur: Breaker theek hai phir bhi pack trip kare to pack kharab hai - inverter kharab karne se pehle battery vendor se test karwa lein.

notes.en: Solis's own FAQ says OV-BATT-H is a hardware over-voltage on the battery circuit that can be caused by high battery voltage at full SOC or by the battery switching off, and advises contacting service if it is frequent.
notes.ur: Solis ka apna FAQ kehta hai ke OV-BATT-H battery circuit ka hardware over-voltage hai jo full SOC par high battery voltage ya battery ke band hone se ho sakta hai, aur agar baar baar ho to service se rabta karein.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: The load on the backup port exceeded what the inverter can supply, so the unit shut that port down.
meaning.ur: Backup port par ka load inverter ki capacity se zyada ho gaya, is liye unit ne wo port band kar diya.

causes.en: Backup load power too large, or a large motor / compressor with a high inrush on start
causes.ur: Backup load power zyada, ya koi bada motor ya compressor jo start par high inrush leta hai

causes.en: Battery cannot deliver the required current because the BMS current limit is active or SOC is low
causes.ur: Battery required current de nahi sakta kyunke BMS current limit active hai ya SOC kam hai

solutions.en: List every appliance on the backup outlet with its running wattage, then compare the total with the inverter's backup rating on the nameplate.
solutions.ur: Backup outlet par lagi har appliance ki running wattage likhein aur uska jama kar nameplate par di hui backup rating se compare karein.

solutions.en: Switch off the biggest loads one at a time and see which one tips the inverter into Over-Load; that is the culprit.
solutions.ur: Sab se bhaari load ek-ek karke band karein aur dekhein kaun sa inverter ko Over-Load par le jata hai; wohi masla hai.

solutions.en: Move inductive loads (pumps, ACs, motors) off the backup port, then reduce the backup load and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inductive loads (pump, AC, motor) backup port se hatayein, phir backup load kam karke inverter restart karein.

notes.en: The official Solis library has two related codes: 1057 Overload and 105B Batt-Overload, and the 105B note says it was previously known as BAT-DOC. Both point at the backup/battery current path, not the PV side.
notes.ur: Official Solis library mein do related codes hain: 1057 Overload aur 105B Batt-Overload, aur 105B ki note kehti hai ke ise pehle BAT-Comm kehlaya jata tha. Dono backup/battery current path ko point karte hain, PV side ko nahi.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: While running as an off-grid backup supply the output voltage rose too high and the inverter stopped.
meaning.ur: Off-grid backup supply chalate waqt output voltage zyada ho gaya aur inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Off-grid switching event combined with a sudden load change on the backup port
causes.ur: Backup port par load ka achanak badalna aur off-grid switching ek saath ho gaye

causes.en: Backup voltage setting wrong, or a generator feeding the same backup port
causes.ur: Backup voltage setting ghalat, ya generator bhi isi backup port par power de raha hai

solutions.en: Switch AC and DC off, then check the backup port wiring: generator, loads and earth all correctly terminated and tight.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC off karke backup port wiring check karein: generator, loads aur earth sab sahi jagah aur tight lage hon.

solutions.en: Measure the backup port voltage with a multimeter while the inverter is on battery; compare it with the configured backup voltage.
solutions.ur: Inverter battery par ho tab multimeter se backup port voltage measure karein aur set ki hui backup voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Restart the system and confirm the fault clears; if a generator is connected, make sure it never runs in parallel with the inverter output.
solutions.ur: System restart karke confirm karein ke fault hat gaya; agar generator lagi hai to yeh confirm karein ke wo inverter output ke saath kabhi parallel na chale.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: The internal LLC converter on the backup path drew more current than allowed; on hybrid units this is a BACKUP-side fault, not a PV or grid fault.
meaning.ur: Backup path ka internal LLC converter allowed se zyada current kheencha; hybrid unit par ye BACKUP side ka fault hai, PV ya grid ka nahi.

causes.en: Backup load overloaded, or a large inrush from a motor starting on backup
causes.ur: Backup load overloaded, ya backup par chalte motor ka bada inrush

causes.en: LLC hardware itself degrading with age or after a surge
causes.ur: Umar ke saath ya surge ke baad LLC hardware degrade hona

solutions.en: Switch off AC, PV and the battery, then measure the DC bus with a multimeter before doing anything else.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery band karke kuch bhi karne se pehle multimeter se DC bus measure karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the backup load, restart once, and note whether the code returns immediately.
solutions.ur: Backup load kam karke ek baar restart karein aur note karein ke code foran wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the code returns on every start with a light load, stop restarting and send the unit for factory repair - this is an internal hardware failure.
