solutions.ur: Agar halki load par bhi har start par wapas aaye to baar baar restart band karein aur unit factory repair ke liye bhejein - ye internal hardware failure hai.

notes.en: Solis's FAQ says OV-ILLC is an overcurrent on the internal LLC circuit, often a transient during extreme overload, and to contact service if it is constant after the extreme condition is excluded. The official library records it as 1052 OV-LLC-I and notes it was previously called OV-ILLC.
notes.ur: Solis ke FAQ ke mutabiq OV-ILLC internal LLC circuit par overcurrent hai, aksar extreme overload ke waqt transient hota hai, aur extreme condition nikalne par bhi baar baar ho to service se rabta karein. Official library ise 1052 OV-LLC-I ke tor par rakhta hai aur kehti hai ke pehle isay OV-ILLC kehte the.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

title.en: CAN communication fail with battery (CAN Fail)
title.ur: Battery se CAN communication fail (CAN Fail)

meaning.en: The inverter cannot talk to the battery BMS over CAN, so it stops and reports no battery.
meaning.ur: Inverter battery BMS se CAN par baat nahi kar sakta, is liye ruk kar no battery report karta hai.

causes.en: CAN cable not seated in the inverter CAN port or the battery CAN port
causes.ur: CAN cable inverter CAN port ya battery CAN port mein fit nahi hai

causes.en: Wrong cable type: some batteries ship a special cable, and Pylon RJ45 pinout changed between WIOSCAN30RJ1 (new) and WIOSCAN35RJ3 (old)
causes.ur: Galat cable: kuch batteries ke saath khaas cable aata hai, aur Pylon ke RJ45 pinout WIOSCAN30RJ1 (naya) aur WIOSCAN35RJ3 (purana) mein badal chuka hai

causes.en: Battery off, or BMS asleep because the pack is too flat
causes.ur: Battery off hai, ya BMS so gaya kyunke pack bahut flat hai

solutions.en: Check the battery's own LED first: a RED LED shining or flashing means the pack is too flat, so charge the pack with an external charger until the LED is green again.
solutions.ur: Pehle battery ka apna LED dekhein: laal LED jal raha ya flash kar raha hai to pack bahut flat hai, is liye external charger se charge karein jab tak LED phir se sabz na ho.

solutions.en: Unplug and re-plug the CAN cable at both the inverter and the battery, then confirm you are using the cable the battery manufacturer specifies.
solutions.ur: Inverter aur battery dono taraf se CAN cable nikal kar dobara lagayein, phir confirm karein ke battery manufacturer wali cable use ho rahi hai.

solutions.en: Open SolisCloud battery monitoring and compare BMS Voltage with Battery Voltage, then measure the pack with a multimeter at the plug; a mismatch means a comms or pack fault, not an inverter fault.
solutions.ur: SolisCloud ke battery monitoring mein BMS Voltage aur Battery Voltage compare karein, phir plug par multimeter se pack measure karein; mismatch aaye to comms ya pack ka masla hai, inverter ka nahi.

notes.en: Solis's official CAN troubleshooting method is to build a test cable and measure the voltage directly at the inverter's CAN ports. Batt_Comm_FAIL is documented as 'previously CAN_Comm_FAIL'.
notes.ur: Solis ka official CAN troubleshooting tareeqa hai ke test cable banayein aur inverter ke CAN port par seedha voltage measure karein. Batt_Comm_FAIL ko 'pehle CAN_Comm_FAIL tha' likha gaya hai.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: The battery model configured in the inverter does not match the nameplate of the fitted pack, so the BMS protocol will not be used correctly.
meaning.ur: Inverter mein set kiya gaya battery model lagay huay pack ke nameplate se match nahi karta, is liye BMS protocol theek se use nahi hoga.

causes.en: Battery Setting > Battery Model still on 'No Battery' or on a different chemistry
causes.ur: Battery Setting > Battery Model abhi 'No Battery' par hai ya kisi aur chemistry par

causes.en: Pack replaced with a different brand without updating the setting
causes.ur: Pack ka brand badal kar lagaya gaya lekin setting update nahi ki gayi

solutions.en: Read the brand and model printed on the battery nameplate and write it down before touching the menu.
solutions.ur: Menu mein jane se pehle battery ke nameplate par likha brand aur model padh kar likh lein.

solutions.en: Go to Battery Setting > Battery Model and select the option that matches the nameplate exactly, then save and exit.
solutions.ur: Battery Setting > Battery Model mein jayein aur nameplate se bilkul match karne wala option select karein, phir save aur exit karein.

solutions.en: Power cycle the inverter and the pack; if the code persists the pack firmware may be outside the supported list - ask the battery vendor.
solutions.ur: Inverter aur pack ko power cycle karein; code phir bhi rahe to pack firmware supported list se bahar ho sakta hai - battery vendor se poochein.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: On the hybrid platform 1030 is an AC hardware overcurrent on phase a, b or c - it is NOT the grid-interference alarm of the on-grid inverters.
meaning.ur: Hybrid platform par 1030 AC hardware overcurrent hai (phase a, b ya c) - ye on-grid inverters wala grid-interference alarm nahi hai.

causes.en: Grid abnormal - voltage sag or distortion causing an AC current spike
causes.ur: Grid abnormal - voltage sag ya distortion se AC current spike hua

causes.en: AC cable connection loose or of the wrong size
causes.ur: AC cable connection loose ya galat size ka

causes.en: Backup load step causing a transient on the AC side
causes.ur: Backup load ka step AC side par transient ban gaya

solutions.en: Confirm the grid is abnormal by measuring L-N voltage and frequency at the inverter AC terminal while the fault shows.
solutions.ur: Fault dikhne ke waqt inverter AC terminal par L-N voltage aur frequency measure karke grid abnormal hai confirm karein.

solutions.en: Power off and check the AC cable connections and lug torque; a loose phase conductor raises contact resistance and spikes the current.
solutions.ur: Power off karke AC cable connections aur lug torque check karein; loose phase conductor contact resistance barhakar current spike karta hai.

solutions.en: Restart the system and confirm whether the code returns; if the grid and cabling are healthy the sampling circuit is at fault - RMA.
solutions.ur: System restart karke dekhein ke code wapas aata hai ya nahi; grid aur wiring theek hon to sampling circuit kharab hai - RMA.

notes.en: CONFLICT FLAG: the same hex 1030 on the on-grid S5-GR / S5-GR3P / S5-GC platform is GRID-INTF = grid interference (waveform distortion). Never reuse this meaning for an on-grid string inverter.
notes.ur: CONFLICT FLAG: wahi hex 1030 on-grid S5-GR / S5-GR3P / S5-GC platform par GRID-INTF = grid interference (waveform distortion) hai. Is matlab ko kabhi on-grid string inverter par dobara mat use karein.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: A second, stricter grid-disturbance check has tripped because the incoming waveform is badly distorted.
meaning.ur: Ek doosra, zyada sakht grid-disturbance check trigger hua kyunke aane wala waveform bahut distorted hai.

causes.en: Large non-linear or inductive loads switching on the same feeder
causes.ur: Usi feeder par bade non-linear ya inductive loads chal rahe hain

causes.en: Weak local transformer, or an AC cable with high impedance
causes.ur: Kamzor local transformer, ya high impedance wala AC cable

solutions.en: Confirm whether the grid is seriously distorted by measuring voltage and watching the LCD value flicker against a stable meter reading.
solutions.ur: Grid seriously distorted hai ya nahi confirm karein: voltage measure karein aur LCD value ki flickering ko meter ki stable reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: Switch other inverters and heavy loads off one at a time to identify the noisy device on the same phase.
solutions.ur: Doosre inverters aur bhaari loads ek-ek karke band karke usi phase par noisy device pehchan karein.

solutions.en: Check that the AC cable is reliably connected and correctly torqued at both ends before any further setting change.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi setting change karne se pehle confirm karein ke AC cable dono taraf se reliably connected aur sahi torque par hai.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

title.ur: Leakage current sensor ka self-check fail (1039)

meaning.en: The residual-current sensing circuit failed its own check, so the inverter cannot trust its leakage protection.
meaning.ur: Residual-current sensing circuit ka apna check fail ho gaya, is liye inverter apni leakage protection par bharosa nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Moisture in the AC junction box, the DC combiner or the backup panel
causes.ur: AC junction box, DC combiner ya backup panel mein paani

causes.en: A load on the site leaking to earth, so the sensor sees a real leak
causes.ur: Site par koi load earth par leak kar raha hai, is liye sensor ko asli leak nazar aa raha hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and the battery, then check every external wire for current leaking to earth with a clamp meter on the earth conductor.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke earth conductor par clamp meter lagakar har external wire ka earth leak check karein.

solutions.en: Verify the grounding conductor is solid and the inverter earth lug is tight, then re-check the earth reference.
solutions.ur: Grounding conductor solid hai aur inverter earth lug tight hai yeh verify karein, phir earth reference dobara check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm every wire is in good condition and not leaking to earth, and replace any cable or connector that fails a megohmmeter test at 1000 V.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke har wire theek halat mein hai aur earth par leak nahi kar rahi, aur jo cable ya connector 1000 V megohmmeter test mein fail ho use replace karein.

notes.en: The official Solis article 1039 advice differs by platform: the grid row says upgrade the software to the latest version, the energy-storage row says power off completely then restart, and both end in contacting the factory service.
notes.ur: Official Solis article 1039 ki advice platform ke mutabiq mukhtalif hai: grid row kehta hai software latest version par upgrade karein, energy-storage row kehta hai poori tarah power off karke restart karein, aur dono factory service par khatam hote hain.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: On the hybrid platform 1038 is a 12 V UNDERVOLTAGE trip on the control rail - not the '12V power supply fault' wording used by the on-grid manuals.
meaning.ur: Hybrid platform par 1038 control rail ka 12 V UNDERVOLTAGE trip hai - on-grid manual wala '12V power supply fault' wording yahan nahi hai.

causes.en: Current leaking to earth from a damaged cable, a wet connector or a poor earth
causes.ur: Kharab cable, geele connector ya kamzor earth se earth par current leak

causes.en: The 12 V auxiliary SMPS or its rectifier has failed after the leak pulled the rail down
causes.ur: Leak ne rail gira diya aur 12 V auxiliary SMPS ya uska rectifier fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and the battery, then check the earth continuity of every external wire with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke multimeter se har external wire ki earth continuity check karein.

solutions.en: Verify your grounding: the earth conductor must be solid and the inverter earth lug tight, with no paint or rust under the lug.
solutions.ur: Apna grounding verify karein: earth conductor solid honi chahiye aur inverter earth lug tight ho, lug ke neeche paint ya rust na ho.

solutions.en: Verify all wires are in good condition and not leaking current to ground, then replace the damaged cable or connector and retest before powering up.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke sab wires theek hain aur ground par leak nahi kar rahi, phir kharab cable ya connector replace karke power karne se pehle retest karein.

notes.en: CONFLICT FLAG: on the on-grid S5-GR / S5-GR3P / S5-GC manuals the identical hex 1038 is written '12Power-FAULT / 12V power supply fault'. Same number, different description, different platform.
notes.ur: CONFLICT FLAG: on-grid S5-GR / S5-GR3P / S5-GC manual mein wahi hex 1038 '12Power-FAULT / 12V power supply fault' likha hai. Number same, description alag, platform alag.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

title.ur: AFCI ne DC wiring mein arc detect kiya (ARC- FAULT 1041)

meaning.en: The arc-fault detection circuit has tripped, meaning it detected arcing in the PV DC wiring.
meaning.ur: Arc-fault detection circuit trigger ho gaya, matlab usne PV DC wiring mein arc detect kiya.

causes.en: Loose DC connection, so the inverter detects an arc in the DC circuit
causes.ur: DC connection loose, is liye inverter DC circuit mein arc detect kar leta hai

causes.en: PV panels cracked or damaged
causes.ur: PV panels cracked ya damaged hain

causes.en: Improper wire stripping, so insulation is captured inside the terminal
causes.ur: Wire stripping ghalat, is liye terminal ke andar insulation phas jata hai

solutions.en: Verify connections are tight within your PV system: torque every MC4 and check the crimp tool was used properly.
solutions.ur: Apne PV system ki connections tight hain verify karein: har MC4 ka torque check karein aur dekhein ke crimp tool sahi use hua.

solutions.en: Switch AC and DC off, then inspect every connector and cable for a blackened, melted or displaced contact.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC off karke har connector aur cable ko kala, pighla hua ya hat chuka contact ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Arc fault settings can be changed in Advanced Settings if further adjustment is needed, but only after the wiring fault is physically fixed.
solutions.ur: Agar aur adjustment chahiye to Arc fault settings Advanced Settings mein badle ja sakte hain, lekin pehle wiring ka fault physically theek karein.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

meaning.en: The AFCI module's self test did not pass, so arc protection cannot be trusted and the inverter stops.
meaning.ur: AFCI module ka self test pass nahi hua, is liye arc protection par bharosa nahi aur inverter ruk jata hai.

causes.en: AFCI board or its ribbon connector not seated after a service
causes.ur: Service ke baad AFCI board ya uska ribbon connector fit nahi hua

causes.en: AFCI comms to the main board intermittent
causes.ur: Main board se AFCI comms intermittent hai

solutions.en: Switch AC and DC off, wait 5 minutes, then power up once and see whether the self test passes.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC off karke 5 minute wait karein, phir ek baar power karke dekhein ke self test pass hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: With the power off, reseat the AFCI board and its communication ribbon to the main board.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke AFCI board aur uska main board se communication ribbon dobara fit karein.

solutions.en: If the self test still fails on a healthy AFCI board, request an AFCI module replacement from Solis service.
solutions.ur: Theek AFCI board par bhi self test fail ho to Solis service se AFCI module replacement maangein.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

title.ur: EPM ki wajah se output limited (LmtByEPM)

meaning.en: The inverter output is being held down by an external power manager or meter so that no power is exported.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output external power manager ya meter rok rakhta hai taake grid par power export na ho.

causes.en: External EPM is fitted and actively limiting backflow
causes.ur: External EPM lagi hai aur wo backflow ko actively limit kar rahi hai

causes.en: Inverter power control is capped, or a third-party device is commanding the inverter
causes.ur: Inverter power control capped hai, ya koi teesra device inverter ko command kar raha hai

solutions.en: Confirm whether the inverter is connected to an external EPM/meter to prevent reverse current.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke inverter external EPM/meter se connected hai ya nahi, taake reverse current na ho.

solutions.en: Confirm whether the inverter is being controlled by an external third-party device and check the power-control percentage.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke inverter kisi external third-party device se control ho raha hai ya nahi aur power-control percentage dekhein.

solutions.en: Verify the EPM settings and compare the meter reading; if no EPM is fitted, set Advanced Settings > External EPM Set > Fail Safe Set to OFF and Internal EPM Set to OFF.
solutions.ur: EPM settings verify karein aur meter reading se compare karein; agar koi EPM nahi lagi to Advanced Settings > External EPM Set > Fail Safe Set ko OFF aur Internal EPM Set ko OFF kar dein.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery)

title.ur: Garmi ki wajah se power khud kam (LmtByTemp)

meaning.en: The inverter has deliberately derated itself because the temperature is high. This is normal operation, not a fault.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne temperature zyada hone ki wajah se apni khud ki power kam ki hai. Ye normal chalna hai, fault nahi.

causes.en: High internal or ambient temperature, so the unit derates instead of tripping
causes.ur: Internal ya ambient temperature zyada hai, is liye unit trip karne ke bajaye power kam kar deta hai

solutions.en: No action needed - the device is in normal operation.
solutions.ur: Koi action nahi chahiye - device normal chal raha hai.

solutions.en: If output stays low, check the installation clearance and the ventilation around the cabinet, and keep direct sun off it.
solutions.ur: Agar output kam hi rehta hai to installation clearance aur cabinet ke aas-paas ventilation check karein, aur us par seedhi dhoop na aane dein.

source.title: Solis S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) Hybrid Inverter User Manual EUR V1,3, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GC(25-50)K / S5-GC(50-60)K (three-phase commercial string 25-60kW, AFCI)
codes.codeNorm: AFCI SELF-DETECTION MODEL WITH AFCI MODULE

meaning.en: The built-in arc-fault detection module failed its own power-on self test, so the inverter will not run with AFCI enabled.
meaning.ur: Built-in arc-fault detection module apna power-on self test fail kar chuka hai, is liye AFCI on par inverter chalega nahi.

causes.en: AFCI module board not seated or its ribbon cable unplugged
causes.ur: AFCI module board fit nahi hai ya uska ribbon cable nikal hua hai

causes.en: AFCI firmware version mismatch after a partial update
causes.ur: Adhoora update ke baad AFCI firmware version mismatch ho gaya

solutions.en: Switch AC and DC off, wait for the LEDs and LCD to go dark, then power up once and note whether the message returns.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC off karein, LEDs aur LCD band hone tak wait karein, phir ek baar power karke dekhein ke message wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: With power removed, reseat the AFCI board and its ribbon connector, then re-run the AFCI ON/OFF check in Advanced Settings > 0010 > Special Settings > AFCI Set.
solutions.ur: Power nikal kar AFCI board aur uska ribbon connector dobara fit karein, phir Advanced Settings > 0010 > Special Settings > AFCI Set mein AFCI ON/OFF check dobara karein.

solutions.en: If the AFCI module still fails its self test after a clean power cycle, the module itself is defective - request an RMA replacement.
solutions.ur: Clean power cycle ke baad bhi AFCI module apna self test fail kare to module hi kharab hai - RMA replacement maangein.

notes.en: The S5-GC manual prints this row as text only. The official Solis alarm library files the AFCI self-test as '1040 AFCI-Check / AFCI self-test failure' on hybrid platforms, so 1040 is listed as an alias but is not printed on the S5-GC LCD.
notes.ur: S5-GC manual mein ye row sirf text ke tor par hai. Official Solis alarm library hybrid platform par AFCI self-test ko '1040 AFCI-Check' ke tor par rakhta hai, is liye 1040 alias mein hai lekin S5-GC LCD par nahi chhota.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

codes.seriesName: S5-GC(25-50)K / S5-GC(50-60)K (three-phase commercial string 25-60kW, AFCI)
codes.codeNorm: ARCING PROTECTION MODEL WITH AFCI MODULE

title.ur: DC arc fault detect hua (Arcing protection)

meaning.en: The AFCI module sensed an arc in the DC circuit and locked the inverter out until the arc is removed.
meaning.ur: AFCI module ne DC circuit mein arc detect kiya aur arc hatne tak inverter ko lock kar diya.

causes.en: Loose or badly crimped MC4 connector, or DC cable pinched under the array
causes.ur: Loose ya khulon se crimped MC4 connector, ya array ke neeche pinch hua DC cable

causes.en: Damaged module backsheet, cracked panel glass or a connector with stripped-back insulation
causes.ur: Kharab module backsheet, cracked panel ka glass, ya insulation nikal chuki connector

solutions.en: Turn AC and DC off, then walk the whole string in daylight and look for a blackened, melted or loose MC4 pair.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC off karein, phir din mein poori string check karein aur kala, pighla hua ya loose MC4 pair dhoondein.

solutions.en: Discharge the DC side, then crimp every connector again with a proper crimp tool and confirm polarity is correct.
solutions.ur: DC side discharge karein, phir har connector ko proper crimp tool se dobara crimp karein aur polarity sahi hai confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure PV+ and PV- to earth with a multimeter; a reading that does not fall between 5 % and 95 % of one module Voc points to a damaged string.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se PV+ aur PV- ko earth ke against measure karein; jo reading ek module ke Voc ke 5 % se 95 % ke darmiyan na giray to kharab string ka pata chal jata hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow alarm LED flashing + arc message on LCD

notes.en: On the S5-GC the LCD shows the text 'Arcing protection'; the hex form 1041 ARC-FAULT is what the official Solis library and SolisCloud use for the same event.
notes.ur: S5-GC par LCD text 'Arcing protection' dikhata hai; hex form 1041 ARC-FAULT wohi event official Solis library aur SolisCloud mein use hota hai.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

codes.seriesName: S5-GC(25-50)K / S5-GC(50-60)K (three-phase commercial string 25-60kW, AFCI)

meaning.en: The inverter sees too much impedance between itself and the grid, usually a long or thin AC interconnect cable on a 25-60 kW unit.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur grid ke darmiyan impedance zyada hai, aksar 25-60 kW unit par lamba ya patla AC interconnect cable.

causes.en: AC interconnect cable undersized or longer than the inverter spec allows
causes.ur: AC interconnect cable chhota ya manual se zyada lamba hai

causes.en: Loose AC lugs at the inverter or the main panel adding contact resistance
causes.ur: Inverter ya main panel par AC lugs loose hain jis se contact resistance barh gaya

solutions.en: Measure L1-L2, L2-L3 and L3-L1 at the inverter and again at the main panel while the plant is at full output, and write down the difference.
solutions.ur: Plant poora output par hone ke waqt inverter par L1-L2, L2-L3 aur L3-L1 measure karein aur phir main panel par bhi, farq note karein.

solutions.en: If the drop across the run is high, fit a larger cross-section AC cable as the Solis cable specification requires.
solutions.ur: Agar run par drop zyada hai to Solis cable specification ke mutabiq bari cross-section AC cable lagayein.

solutions.en: Only widen the protection window through User-Define if the DISCO / utility allows it in writing.
solutions.ur: DISCO ya utility likhit ijazat de tabhi User-Define se protection window barhayein.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

codes.seriesName: S5-GC(25-50)K / S5-GC(50-60)K (three-phase commercial string 25-60kW, AFCI)

meaning.en: The screen is completely dead. On a three-phase S5-GC the DC input must be above 350 V for the unit to even start.
meaning.ur: Screen bilkul dead hai. Three-phase S5-GC par DC input start karne ke liye 350 V se upar hona chahiye.

causes.en: DC switch open, DCDB tripped, or the PV string disconnected
causes.ur: DC switch khula, DCDB trip, ya PV string disconnect

causes.en: PV+/- reversed so the unit never starts
causes.ur: PV+/- reverse hai is liye unit start hi nahi hota

solutions.en: Check the DC switch and the DCDB first, then measure each string Voc at the inverter DC terminals with the DC switch OFF.
solutions.ur: Pehle DC switch aur DCDB check karein, phir DC switch OFF karke har string ka Voc inverter DC terminal par measure karein.

solutions.en: Confirm polarity: on a three-phase unit every string must read above 350 V open-circuit.
solutions.ur: Polarity confirm karein: three-phase unit par har string ka open-circuit reading 350 V se upar honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Close the AC breaker and DCDB, then power up in the manual order (AC first, DC after 60 s) and watch all three LEDs.
solutions.ur: AC breaker aur DCDB band karein, phir manual ke order par power karein (pehle AC, 60 second baad DC) aur teenon LEDs dekhein.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

codes.uid: solis/solis-s5-gc/LCD show initializing all the time
codes.seriesName: S5-GC(25-50)K / S5-GC(50-60)K (three-phase commercial string 25-60kW, AFCI)
codes.code: LCD show initializing all the time
codes.codeNorm: LCD SHOW INITIALIZING ALL THE TIME
aliases: LCD show initializing all the time

title.ur: Initializing par atka hua, start nahi ho raha

meaning.en: The unit powers up but never leaves the initializing state, so the main screen stays blank.
meaning.ur: Unit power le leta hai lekin initializing state se bahar nahi nikalta, is liye main screen khaali rehta hai.

causes.en: Connector on the main board or the power board has come loose
causes.ur: Main board ya power board ka connector loose ho gaya

causes.en: DSP-to-power-board connector unseated after transport or a firmware update
causes.ur: Transport ya firmware update ke baad DSP-to-power-board connector fit nahi raha

solutions.en: Switch AC and DC off and wait a full 5 minutes for the bus to discharge before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi chhoone se pehle AC aur DC off karein aur bus discharge hone ke liye poore 5 minute wait karein.

solutions.en: With the power off, reseat every connector on the main board and power board, especially the DSP-to-power-board connector.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke main board aur power board ke har connector, khaas kar DSP-to-power-board connector, dobara fit karein.

solutions.en: Power up and check the OPERATION LED: solid ON means running, FLASHING means still initializing.
solutions.ur: Power karke OPERATION LED dekhein: solid ON ka matlab chal raha hai, FLASHING ka matlab abhi initialize ho raha hai.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

codes.seriesName: S5-GC(25-50)K / S5-GC(50-60)K (three-phase commercial string 25-60kW, AFCI)

meaning.en: The inverter detected a high ambient or heatsink temperature on a 25-60 kW cabinet and stopped.
meaning.ur: 25-60 kW cabinet par inverter ne ambient ya heatsink temperature zyada detect ki aur ruk gaya.

causes.en: Direct afternoon sun on the inverter cabinet
causes.ur: Dopahar ki dhoop seedhi inverter cabinet par gir rahi hai

causes.en: Blocked heatsink airflow from dust, mud or a soffit above
causes.ur: Heatsink ka airflow dhool, gadda ya upar ke chhat se band ho gaya

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature next to the cabinet with a thermometer and compare it with the internal temperature in Advanced Information > Running Status.
solutions.ur: Cabinet ke paas thermometer se ambient temperature measure karein aur Advanced Information > Running Status ke internal temperature se compare karein.

solutions.en: Clear dust from the heatsink and restore the clearance given in the installation section; keep direct sun off the cabinet.
solutions.ur: Heatsink ki dhool saaf karein aur installation section di hui clearance wapas rakhein; cabinet par seedhi dhoop na aane dein.

solutions.en: If ambient is under 60 °C and it still trips, the internal NTC sensor or the external fan is at fault - RMA.
solutions.ur: Agar ambient 60 °C se kam hai phir bhi trip kare to internal NTC sensor ya external fan kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

codes.seriesName: S5-GC(25-50)K / S5-GC(50-60)K (three-phase commercial string 25-60kW, AFCI)

meaning.en: In a multi-inverter 3-phase plant the master stopped answering on the parallel communication bus, so the group shut down.
meaning.ur: Multi-inverter 3-phase plant mein master ne parallel communication bus par jawab dena band kar diya, is liye poora group band ho gaya.

causes.en: Parallel communication cable loose, missing cores or unshielded
causes.ur: Parallel communication cable loose, kuch cores missing, ya unshielded

causes.en: DIP / address switches of two inverters set to the same value
causes.ur: Do inverters ke DIP ya address switches same value par set hain

solutions.en: Power down the whole group, then reseat the 8-core shielded parallel cable at both ends and confirm every core is continuous.
solutions.ur: Poore group ko power down karein, phir 8-core shielded parallel cable dono taraf se dobara fit karein aur har core ki continuity check karein.

solutions.en: Verify the DIP switch positions of every inverter, and make sure only one unit is set as master.
solutions.ur: Har inverter ke DIP switch ki position verify karein, aur confirm karein ke sirf ek unit master hai.

solutions.en: Power the group back up and confirm the alarm clears; if it returns immediately, replace the parallel cable with a known-good one.
solutions.ur: Group dobara power karein aur alarm hatne ki confirm karein; foran wapas aaye to parallel cable ko chalte hue cable se replace karein.

notes.en: In the official Solis library 1065 is filed twice: 'Only Grid Connection' = HeartbeatLose and 'Only Energy Storage' = HeartbeatLose. Same name, different status codes, so the numeric code alone is not safe to reuse across platforms.
notes.ur: Official Solis library mein 1065 do jagah hai: 'Only Grid Connection' = HeartbeatLose aur 'Only Energy Storage' = HeartbeatLose. Naam same hai lekin status code alag, is liye sirf number ko platform ke darmiyan reuse karna safe nahi.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

codes.seriesName: S5-GC(25-50)K / S5-GC(50-60)K (three-phase commercial string 25-60kW, AFCI)

title.ur: Do inverters ka address aapas mein same (1064 Addr-Conflict)

meaning.en: Two or more inverters in the parallel group are configured with the same address, so the master sees duplicate replies.
meaning.ur: Parallel group mein do ya zyada inverters ka address same hai, is liye master ko duplicate reply dikhti hai.

causes.en: Inverter cloned with the same address during a firmware reflash or a unit swap
causes.ur: Firmware reflash ya unit exchange ke waqt clone kiye gaye inverter ka address same reh gaya

causes.en: Address not reset after a master unit was replaced on site
causes.ur: Master unit badalne ke baad address reset nahi kiya gaya

solutions.en: Go to Settings on each inverter and read out the slave address one unit at a time, writing the value down.
solutions.ur: Har inverter par Settings mein jayein aur slave address ek-ek karke padhein, value note kar lein.

solutions.en: Give every unit a unique address, keeping address 1 for the master only, then power cycle the group.
solutions.ur: Har unit ko unique address dein, sirf master ka 1 rakhein, phir group ko power cycle karein.

solutions.en: Re-check the addresses after the restart; two units still reporting the same number means the address did not save.
solutions.ur: Restart ke baad address dobara check karein; do unit ka number aaj bhi same ho to address save nahi hua.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

codes.seriesName: S5-GC(25-50)K / S5-GC(50-60)K (three-phase commercial string 25-60kW, AFCI)

meaning.en: The internal CAN bus between the inverters in the group has dropped, so the group cannot run as one unit.
meaning.ur: Group ke inverters ke darmiyan internal CAN bus gir gaya, is liye group ek unit ke tor par nahi chal sakta.

causes.en: CAN / parallel signal connector not fully seated
causes.ur: CAN ya parallel signal connector puri tarah fit nahi hua

causes.en: Shield or earth of the communication cable broken, letting noise into the bus
causes.ur: Communication cable ka shield ya earth toota, is liye bus mein noise aa raha hai

solutions.en: Switch everything off, then push each CAN connector home with a firm click and check the earth of the communication cable.
solutions.ur: Sab kuch off karein, phir har CAN connector ko zor se click ke saath baithayein aur communication cable ki earth check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the resistance of the CAN_H and CAN_L wires end to end; both wires must read the same low resistance with no break.
solutions.ur: CAN_H aur CAN_L wire ki aakhir se aakhir resistance measure karein; dono wires ki low resistance same honi chahiye, koi break nahi.

solutions.en: If the wiring measures good, power up one unit at a time to find which unit is holding the bus down, then RMA that unit.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek nikle to ek-ek karke unit power karein aur dekhein kaun sa unit bus ko rok raha hai, phir us unit ka RMA karein.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

codes.seriesName: S5-GC(25-50)K / S5-GC(50-60)K (three-phase commercial string 25-60kW, AFCI)

meaning.en: The three-phase networking configuration is wrong: a phase is missing or one inverter is assigned to two phases.
meaning.ur: Three-phase networking configuration ghalat hai: koi phase missing hai ya ek inverter do phases par set hai.

causes.en: One phase of the three-phase networking system has no inverter assigned
causes.ur: Three-phase networking system ki ek phase par koi inverter assign nahi hai

causes.en: Phase assignment on an inverter changed without re-running the network setup
causes.ur: Phase assignment badal diya gaya lekin network setup dobara nahi chalaya gaya

solutions.en: Open Advanced Settings > 0010 on each inverter and write down which phases it is assigned to.
solutions.ur: Har inverter par Advanced Settings > 0010 kholein aur note karein ke usse kaun si phases di gayi hain.

solutions.en: Confirm with a phase rotation meter at the main panel that the grid is L1-L2-L3, then correct the per-inverter phase setting.
solutions.ur: Main panel par phase rotation meter se confirm karein ke grid L1-L2-L3 hai, phir per-inverter phase setting theek karein.

solutions.en: Look for a fault on any member inverter of the group, fix it, then fully power off the group and bring it back up.
solutions.ur: Group ke kisi member inverter ka fault dhoondein, theek karein, phir group ko poori tarah power off karke dobara chalayein.

notes.en: The official Solis library gives 106C the name 3P_CreateFail on the grid-connection scope and 3P_CreateFaACil on the energy-storage scope, so the same number has two spellings across platforms.
notes.ur: Official Solis library mein 106C ka naam grid-connection scope par 3P_CreateFail hai aur energy-storage scope par 3P_CreateFaACil, is liye ek hi number ke do roop hain.

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

codes.seriesName: S5-GC(25-50)K / S5-GC(50-60)K (three-phase commercial string 25-60kW, AFCI)

meaning.en: Solid ON means the inverter is supplying power; FLASHING means it is still initialising; OFF means it has stopped supplying.
meaning.ur: Solid ON ka matlab inverter power de raha hai; FLASHING ka matlab abhi initialize ho raha hai; OFF ka matlab power dena band kar chuka hai.

causes.en: Normal running state
causes.ur: Normal chalne ki halat

causes.en: Self-check / initialisation state after a power cycle
causes.ur: Power cycle ke baad self-check ya initialisation ki halat

solutions.en: No action needed when solid ON; read the LCD home screen for live power figures.
solutions.ur: Solid ON par koi action nahi; live power ke liye LCD home screen padhein.

solutions.en: If the LED has been FLASHING for more than 5 minutes, follow the initializing-fault procedure.
solutions.ur: Agar LED 5 minute se zyada FLASHING kar raha ho to initializing-fault wali procedure follow karein.

codes.blinkPattern: OPERATION LED solid ON = running, FLASHING = initialising, OFF = stopped

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

codes.seriesName: S5-GC(25-50)K / S5-GC(50-60)K (three-phase commercial string 25-60kW, AFCI)

meaning.en: ON means a fault or alarm condition has been detected. On the S5-GC the earth-fault case flashes the yellow alarm indicator and shows PVISO-PRO on the LCD.
meaning.ur: ON ka matlab fault ya alarm detect hua hai. S5-GC par earth-fault ki surat mein yellow alarm indicator flash karta hai aur LCD par PVISO-PRO aata hai.

causes.en: Any entry in the alarm log - the LED only signals, it does not identify the code
causes.ur: Alarm log mein koi bhi entry - LED sirf ishara karta hai, code nahi batata

causes.en: PV earth fault: the manual states the yellow alarm indicator flashes and PVISO-PRO shows on the LCD
causes.ur: PV earth fault: manual ke mutabiq yellow alarm indicator flash karta hai aur LCD par PVISO-PRO aata hai

solutions.en: Open Enter > Down > Advanced Information > password 0010 > Alarm Message to read the last 100 alarms with date and time.
solutions.ur: Enter > Down > Advanced Information > password 0010 > Alarm Message kholein aur date-time ke saath pichle 100 alarms padhein.

solutions.en: If the yellow alarm LED is flashing, treat it as a PV earth fault: isolate AC and PV before any insulation measurement.
solutions.ur: Agar yellow alarm LED flash kar raha ho to use PV earth fault samajhein: insulation measure karne se pehle AC aur PV isolate karein.

solutions.en: Write down the alarm text, the Information-menu readings and the inverter serial number before calling service.
solutions.ur: Service call karne se pehle alarm text, Information-menu readings aur inverter serial number likh lein.

codes.blinkPattern: ALARM LED solid ON = fault, flashing yellow = PV earth fault (PVISO-PRO)

source.title: Solis S5-GC(25-50)K Three Phase Inverter User Manual EUR V1.3, Table 9.1 Fault message and description + Table 3.1 Status Indicator Lights

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: Measured grid voltage is above the configured protection window, so the inverter stops exporting.
meaning.ur: Grid ka voltage set kiya hua limit se upar hai, is liye inverter ne export band kar diya.

causes.en: Long or undersized AC cable between inverter and main panel
causes.ur: Inverter aur main panel ke darmiyan lamba ya chhota AC cable

causes.en: Grid voltage really high during peak solar export hours
causes.ur: Dopahar mein zyada solar export ke waqt grid voltage sach mein high ho

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, then measure AC at the inverter terminals with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, phir multimeter se inverter ke AC terminal par voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare the multimeter reading with the voltage shown in the LCD Information menu; a mismatch means a bad sensing circuit.
solutions.ur: Multimeter reading aur LCD Information menu ka voltage compare karein; mismatch aaye to sensing circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: If voltage is genuinely high, get DISCO approval before widening the protection limit in Advanced Settings > Select Standard.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage sach mein high hai, to Advanced Settings > Select Standard mein limit barhane se pehle DISCO se ijazat lein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: Grid voltage has fallen below the lower protection limit, usually during a heavy load or a weak supply.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage lower limit se neeche gir gaya, aksar heavy load ya weak supply ki wajah se.

causes.en: Weak distribution transformer or long feeder from the pole
causes.ur: Weak distribution transformer ya pole se lamba feeder

causes.en: Large motor or compressor starting on the same phase
causes.ur: Usi phase par koi bada motor ya compressor start hona

solutions.en: Measure L1-N and L1-PE voltage at the inverter while the fault is active.
solutions.ur: Fault chal raha ho tab inverter par L1-N aur L1-PE voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: If the reading is normal but the LCD shows low voltage, the sensing circuit is faulty - RMA.
solutions.ur: Agar reading normal hai lekin LCD low voltage dikhata hai, to sensing circuit kharab hai - RMA.

solutions.en: Tighten the AC lugs and torque-check the terminal; a loose neutral raises resistance and drops measured voltage.
solutions.ur: AC lugs ko tighten karein aur terminal ka torque check karein; loose neutral resistance barhakar voltage gira deta hai.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: Grid frequency measured above the upper limit so the inverter disconnects from the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency upper limit se upar, is liye inverter grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Generator running in parallel with the grid and set slightly high
causes.ur: Grid ke saath parallel generator jo thoda high chalta hai

causes.en: Wrong grid standard selected for the local DISCO
causes.ur: Local DISCO ke liye galat grid standard selected

solutions.en: Check frequency with a multimeter or clamp meter at the AC terminals.
solutions.ur: AC terminal par multimeter ya clamp meter se frequency check karein.

solutions.en: Compare the LCD frequency reading with the meter; a mismatch points to the sensing circuit.
solutions.ur: LCD frequency reading aur meter compare karein; mismatch ho to sensing circuit ka masla hai.

solutions.en: Verify the grid code in Advanced Settings > Select Standard; do not change it without DISCO approval.
solutions.ur: Advanced Settings > Select Standard mein grid code verify karein; DISCO ki ijazat ke baghair na badlein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: Grid frequency is below the lower limit; the inverter waits and reconnects when frequency recovers.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency lower limit se neeche hai; frequency theek hone par inverter reconnect kar leta hai.

causes.en: Grid overloaded by many air conditioners and water pumps
causes.ur: Bahut se air conditioner aur water pump ki wajah se grid overloaded

causes.en: Weak local supply during peak evening load
causes.ur: Shaam ke peak load par weak local supply

solutions.en: Measure frequency at the inverter AC terminals with a meter that reads Hz.
solutions.ur: Hz read karne wale meter se inverter ke AC terminal par frequency measure karein.

solutions.en: Switch off heavy loads for 10 minutes and see if the inverter reconnects by itself.
solutions.ur: Bhaari loads 10 minute ke liye off karein aur dekhein ke inverter khud reconnect hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it never reconnects, check the grid code setting and the AC connection.
solutions.ur: Agar kabhi reconnect na ho, to grid code setting aur AC connection check karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

title.en: No grid voltage / inverter no power on LCD
title.ur: Grid voltage nahi / LCD par power nahi

meaning.en: The inverter senses no grid voltage, or has no power at all on the LCD.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko grid voltage hi nahi mil rahi, ya LCD par bilkul power nahi hai.

causes.en: AC MCB tripped or main isolator is off
causes.ur: AC MCB trip ho gaya ya main isolator off hai

causes.en: DC input voltage too low, or PV+/- reversed
causes.ur: DC input voltage bahut kam hai, ya PV+/- reverse hai

solutions.en: Check the AC breaker and isolator first, then measure L1-N and L1-PE at the inverter terminals.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC breaker aur isolator check karein, phir inverter terminal par L1-N aur L1-PE measure karein.

solutions.en: With DC switch OFF, measure string voltage - above 120 V on single phase - and confirm polarity is not reversed.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke string voltage measure karein - single phase par 120 V se upar - aur polarity reverse na ho.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch OFF until the screen blanks, then bring AC on first and DC after 60 seconds.
solutions.ur: Screen blank hone tak DC switch OFF rakhein, phir AC pehle aur 60 second baad DC on karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: PV string open-circuit voltage has gone above the inverter DC input limit.
meaning.ur: PV string ka open-circuit voltage inverter ki DC limit se upar chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Too many modules wired in series for cold-morning Voc
causes.ur: Series mein modules zyada hain, thande subah ka Voc un ke liye bahut zyada hai

causes.en: Inverter DC input voltage setting lower than the actual array Voc
causes.ur: Inverter ki DC input voltage setting array ke actual Voc se kam hai

solutions.en: DC switch OFF first, then measure Voc per string at the inverter DC terminals.
solutions.ur: Pehle DC switch OFF karein, phir inverter DC terminal par har string ka Voc measure karein.

solutions.en: Recalculate the string Voc at the lowest local temperature and reduce modules in series if needed.
solutions.ur: Local sab se kam temperature par string Voc dobara calculate karein aur zaroorat ho to series mein modules kam karein.

solutions.en: If the meter reads normal but the alarm persists, the DC sensing circuit is faulty - RMA.
solutions.ur: Agar meter normal reading de lekin alarm rehta rahe, to DC sensing circuit kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: The internal DC link voltage has risen above the limit, so the inverter shuts down.
meaning.ur: Internal DC link voltage limit se upar chala gaya, is liye inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: Inductor connection loose or the gate driver board has failed
causes.ur: Inductor ka connection loose hai ya gate driver board fail ho gaya

causes.en: Grid loss while the DC bus is still charged from PV
causes.ur: PV se DC bus charged hone ke baad grid chala gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV completely before opening the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter kholne se pehle AC aur PV dono isolate kar lein.

solutions.en: Measure DC and AC with a multimeter and compare against the LCD Information readings.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se DC aur AC measure karein aur LCD Information reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: With power off, check the inductor solder joints and the driver board; replace the driver board if the readings are healthy.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke inductor ke solder joints aur driver board check karein; readings theek hon to driver board replace karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage is too low to run the inverter.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage itna kam hai ke inverter nahi chal sakta.

causes.en: PV voltage too low for the minimum operating window
causes.ur: PV voltage minimum operating window se neeche hai

causes.en: Half-voltage sensing circuit or sample-and-hold board fault
causes.ur: Half-voltage sensing circuit ya sample-and-hold board ka fault

solutions.en: DC switch OFF and measure each string Voc; string should be above the minimum DC input voltage.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke har string ka Voc measure karein; string minimum DC input voltage se upar hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Compare the LCD bus reading with a multimeter; a big difference means RMA.
solutions.ur: LCD bus reading ko multimeter se compare karein; bara farq ho to RMA.

solutions.en: Check the half-voltage resistor divider and its connector on the sampling board.
solutions.ur: Sampling board par half-voltage resistor divider aur uska connector check karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: The AC waveform is too distorted, so the inverter shuts down to protect itself.
meaning.ur: AC waveform bahut kharab hai, is liye inverter apni protection ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: Non-linear loads on the same feeder producing high THD
causes.ur: Usi feeder par non-linear loads jo THD barha rahe hain

causes.en: Weak AC wiring or a loose earth connection
causes.ur: Kamzor AC wiring ya loose earth connection

solutions.en: Keep the DC switch OFF and measure AC voltage, then test the AC line for THD.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF rakhein aur AC voltage measure karein, phir AC line ka THD test karein.

solutions.en: Switch off other inverters on the same phase one by one to find the noisy device.
solutions.ur: Usi phase ke doosre inverters ek-ek karke band karein taake noisy device mil jaye.

solutions.en: Recheck the earth conductor and tighten the AC earth lug; if THD is normal, the power board is likely at fault.
solutions.ur: Earth conductor dobara check karein aur AC earth lug tighten karein; THD normal ho to power board kharab hai.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: Heatsink or internal temperature has crossed the limit, so the inverter derates and then stops.
meaning.ur: Heatsink ya internal temperature limit cross kar gaya, is liye inverter pehle power kam karta hai phir ruk jata hai.

causes.en: Direct afternoon sun falling on the inverter cabinet
causes.ur: Dopahar ki dhoop seedhi inverter cabinet par gir rahi hai

causes.en: Blocked heatsink fins from dust, mud or a soffit above
causes.ur: Heatsink ki fins dhool, gadda ya upar ke chhat se band ho gayi hain

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature at the inverter with a thermometer; compare with the LCD internal temperature.
solutions.ur: Thermometer se inverter ke paas ka ambient temperature measure karein aur LCD ke internal temperature se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check heatsink airflow and clear any dust buildup; do not blow compressed air into the electronics.
solutions.ur: Heatsink ka airflow check karein aur dhool saaf karein; electronics mein compressed air na maarein.

solutions.en: If ambient is within range and the alarm still trips, the internal NTC sensor or fan is faulty - RMA.
solutions.ur: Agar ambient range mein hai phir bhi alarm aata hai, to internal NTC sensor ya fan kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

title.ur: PV side ki insulation kharab, earth fault (PV ISO-PRO 01/02)

meaning.en: Insulation resistance on the PV side has fallen, so a DC earth fault is present and the inverter cannot generate.
meaning.ur: PV side ki insulation resistance gir gayi hai, matlab DC earth fault mojood hai aur inverter generate nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Panel frame or module laminate shorted to earth
causes.ur: Panel frame ya module laminate earth se short ho gaya

causes.en: Damaged cable insulation, a crushed conduit or a wet MC4 connector
causes.ur: Cable ki insulation kharab, daba hua conduit ya geela MC4 connector

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, then measure each string's positive and negative to earth with a megohmmeter at 1000 V.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke megohmmeter 1000 V par har string ki positive aur negative line ko earth ke against measure karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all DC inputs and reconnect them one string at a time to find the faulty string.
solutions.ur: Sab DC input disconnect karke ek-ek string karke dobara lagayein taake kharab string maloom ho.

solutions.en: Note the weather when the alarm appears; insulation drops in rain or fog, so test in the same conditions.
solutions.ur: Alarm aane waqt mausam note karein; baarish ya dhund mein insulation gir ti hai, isi waqt test karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow alarm LED flashing + code on LCD

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: Residual current on the AC or DC side exceeded the limit, so the inverter locked out.
meaning.ur: AC ya DC side par residual current limit cross kar gaya, is liye inverter lock ho gaya.

causes.en: Moisture ingress into the AC junction box or the DC combiner
causes.ur: AC junction box ya DC combiner mein paani ka ghusa hona

causes.en: Leaking RCD or a type-B filter capacitor failing
causes.ur: Leaking RCD ya type-B filter capacitor ka fail hona

solutions.en: Switch off AC and DC, then check the insulation of the AC cables and the inverter internal cabling.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC band karke AC cables aur inverter ki internal wiring ki insulation check karein.

solutions.en: Press the RCD TEST button on the board; if it does not trip, replace the RCD.
solutions.ur: Board ka RCD TEST button dabayein; agar trip na kare to RCD replace karein.

solutions.en: Measure leakage current with a clamp meter on the earth conductor while the system runs.
solutions.ur: System chalte hue earth conductor par clamp meter se leakage current measure karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: The grid relay failed the inverter's own power-on self test, so the inverter will not connect.
meaning.ur: Grid relay ne inverter ka apna power-on self test fail kiya, is liye inverter connect nahi hoga.

causes.en: Grid relay or contactor welded / failed mechanically
causes.ur: Grid relay ya contactor weld ho gaya ya mechanically fail

causes.en: Relay driver circuit or 12 V supply rail faulty
causes.ur: Relay driver circuit ya 12 V supply rail kharab

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then listen for a relay click when power is applied.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, phir power dete waqt relay ki click sunhein.

solutions.en: Measure the 12 V rail at the relay board; below 11 V the relay cannot pull in reliably.
solutions.ur: Relay board par 12 V rail measure karein; 11 V se kam ho to relay reliably pull in nahi hoga.

solutions.en: If the relay is healthy, replace the relay driver board - RMA.
solutions.ur: Relay theek ho to relay driver board replace karein - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: The DC component of the grid output current is too high, so the inverter disconnects.
meaning.ur: Grid output current ka DC component zyada hai, is liye inverter disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Distorted or unstable grid supply
causes.ur: Grid supply distorted ya unstable

causes.en: AC cable or earth connection loose, creating a leakage path
causes.ur: AC cable ya earth connection loose, jis se leakage path ban raha hai

solutions.en: Check the grid is normal, then confirm the AC cable is properly connected and torqued.
solutions.ur: Grid normal hai ya nahi check karein, phir AC cable ka connection aur torque confirm karein.

solutions.en: Restart the system and see whether the fault returns; record the time of each event.
solutions.ur: System restart karein aur dekhein ke fault wapas aata hai ya nahi; har event ka time note karein.

solutions.en: If it returns with a healthy grid, the current sampling circuit or power board is at fault - RMA.
solutions.ur: Agar healthy grid par wapas aaye, to current sampling circuit ya power board kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: The inverter's internal 12 V auxiliary rail has collapsed, usually after a current leak to earth.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka internal 12 V auxiliary rail gir gaya, aksar earth par current leak ke baad.

causes.en: Current leaking to earth from a damaged cable or a wet connector
causes.ur: Kharab cable ya geele connector se earth par current leak

causes.en: 12 V SMPS transformer or its rectifier has failed
causes.ur: 12 V SMPS transformer ya uska rectifier fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then check the earth continuity of every external wire.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke har external wire ki earth continuity check karein.

solutions.en: Verify the grounding conductor is solid and the inverter earth lug is tight.
solutions.ur: Grounding conductor solid hai aur inverter earth lug tight hai, yeh verify karein.

solutions.en: With power off, measure the 12 V rail at the control board; replace the SMPS module if it reads below 10 V.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke control board par 12 V rail measure karein; 10 V se kam ho to SMPS module replace karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: The DSP failed initialisation, so the inverter never reaches the normal state.
meaning.ur: DSP initialize nahi hua, is liye inverter normal state par nahi pohanchta.

causes.en: Master and slave DSP holding different calibration values
causes.ur: Master aur slave DSP ke calibration values alag hain

causes.en: DSP connector on the power board loose or the DSP itself failed
causes.ur: Power board par DSP connector loose hai ya DSP khud fail ho gaya

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, wait until all LEDs and the LCD go dark, then DC switch ON.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, sab LEDs aur LCD band hone tak wait karein, phir DC switch ON karein.

solutions.en: With power off, reseat the main board, power board and DSP-to-power-board connectors.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke main board, power board aur DSP-to-power-board connectors dobara fit karein.

solutions.en: If it repeats after a proper reset, the DSP or power board is defective - RMA.
solutions.ur: Theek reset ke baad bhi repeat ho to DSP ya power board kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

title.ur: DC input current zyada ya interference (DC-INTF)

meaning.en: DC input current is abnormal or interfered, so the inverter shuts down.
meaning.ur: DC input current abnormal ya interfered hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: A failing PV module or bypass diode causing a partial short
causes.ur: Koi PV module ya bypass diode kharab jis se partial short ho gaya

causes.en: Insulation fault on the DC side combined with a surge event
causes.ur: DC side par insulation fault ke saath surge event

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, then measure each string's positive and negative to earth to locate a ground fault.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke har string ki positive aur negative ko earth ke against measure kar ke ground fault dhoondein.

solutions.en: Run the system with one string at a time to identify the string causing the fault.
solutions.ur: System ko ek-ek string karke chalayein taake fault karne wali string mil jaye.

solutions.en: Measure string current in series with a clamp meter; a string far above its rating must be isolated.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter series mein lagakar string current measure karein; rating se bahut zyada wali string ko alag karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: Grid output current exceeded the limit, so the inverter stopped to protect the IGBT.
meaning.ur: Grid output current limit cross kar gaya, is liye inverter ne IGBT bachane ke liye ruk kar band kiya.

causes.en: AC breaker or cable undersized, or a loose AC connection
causes.ur: AC breaker ya cable chhota, ya AC connection loose

causes.en: Grid short circuit or a large motor start on the same phase
causes.ur: Grid par short circuit ya usi phase par bada motor start

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then measure the insulation of the AC cable to earth.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke AC cable ki earth ke against insulation measure karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC breaker rating and the cable size against the inverter nameplate current.
solutions.ur: AC breaker rating aur cable size ko inverter nameplate current se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the cable and breaker are correct, the current sampling or power board is at fault - RMA.
solutions.ur: Cable aur breaker theek hon to current sampling ya power board kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: The internal IGBT bridge drew more current than allowed; the inverter shut down.
meaning.ur: Internal IGBT bridge ne allowed se zyada current kheencha; inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: Grid transient or a load step on the AC side
causes.ur: AC side par grid transient ya load step

causes.en: IGBT or gate driver degrading with age
causes.ur: Umar ke saath IGBT ya gate driver degrade hona

solutions.en: Switch off AC and DC, then verify the DC string Voc and the AC cable before restarting.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC band karke restart se pehle DC string Voc aur AC cable verify karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and confirm whether the fault returns immediately.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karke dekhein ke fault foran wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it returns on every start, do not keep restarting - send for factory repair.
solutions.ur: Agar har start par wapas aaye, to baar baar restart na karein - factory repair ke liye bhejein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: The grid current control loop lost synchronism with the grid, so the inverter stopped.
meaning.ur: Grid current control loop grid se sync kho gaya, is liye inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Unstable or distorted grid voltage
causes.ur: Unstable ya distorted grid voltage

causes.en: Loose AC connection or wrong grid standard selected
causes.ur: Loose AC connection ya galat grid standard selected

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage and frequency at the inverter AC terminals.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminal par grid voltage aur frequency measure karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the AC cable terminals are tight and the earth is sound.
solutions.ur: AC cable terminals tight hain aur earth theek hai, yeh confirm karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the alarm repeats, contact the installer for an RMA.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; alarm repeat ho to installer se RMA ke liye rabta karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: The grid current sampling circuit failed; this is an internal component fault.
meaning.ur: Grid current sampling circuit fail ho gaya; yeh internal component fault hai.

causes.en: Current sensor or the sampling amplifier on the power board has failed
causes.ur: Power board par current sensor ya sampling amplifier fail ho gaya

causes.en: Harsh grid transients or a surge event damaging the sensing path
causes.ur: Teek grid transient ya surge event se sensing path kharab hua

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check all cable connectors on the power board are seated.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke power board ke sab cable connectors fit hain ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the current sensor output voltage against the service manual before condemning the board.
solutions.ur: Board kharab karne se pehle service manual ke mutabiq current sensor ki output voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: This is normally an RMA item - internal component failure.
solutions.ur: Ye aam tor par RMA item hai - internal component failure.

notes.en: Hex number for IG-AD is not published on the Solis support KB list, so no alias is given.
notes.ur: Solis support KB list mein IG-AD ka hex number nahi diya gaya, is liye alias nahi diya.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: Line and neutral are swapped at the AC input, so the inverter sees reversed polarity.
meaning.ur: AC input par line aur neutral swap hain, is liye inverter ko polarity ulti dikhai deti hai.

causes.en: Line and neutral connected in reverse at the AC terminal
causes.ur: AC terminal par line aur neutral ulte connect kiye gaye

causes.en: AC connector pushed in the wrong way during installation
causes.ur: Installation ke waqt AC connector ghalat taraf push ho gaya

solutions.en: AC switch OFF, then confirm which AC terminal feeds the neutral bar of the main panel.
solutions.ur: AC switch OFF karke dekhein ke AC terminal main panel ke neutral bar ko kaun sa wire deta hai.

solutions.en: Swap the two AC conductors at the inverter and re-tighten the lugs.
solutions.ur: Inverter par do AC conductors aapas mein badal dein aur lugs dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Restart and confirm the Reverse-GRID message clears.
solutions.ur: Restart karke confirm karein ke Reverse-GRID message hat gaya.

notes.en: This row appears only in the single-phase S5-GR1P manual Table 8.1, not in the three-phase table.
notes.ur: Ye row sirf single-phase S5-GR1P manual Table 8.1 mein hai, three-phase table mein nahi.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR1P (single-phase string 2.5-12kW)

meaning.en: One or more cooling fans are not spinning, so the inverter will overheat and shut down.
meaning.ur: Ek ya zyada cooling fan nahi chal rahe, is liye inverter garmi hoke band ho jayega.

causes.en: Fan bearing worn or the fan blades packed with dust
causes.ur: Fan ki bearing ghis chuki hai ya blades par dhool ki parat hai

causes.en: Fan supply cable disconnected from the fan board
causes.ur: Fan board se fan supply cable disconnect ho gaya

solutions.en: Go to Advanced Settings > Fan Test and run the test while watching every fan.
solutions.ur: Advanced Settings > Fan Test mein jayein aur har fan ko dekhte hue test chalayein.

solutions.en: Power off, then spin each fan by hand; a fan that spins by hand but not electrically has a failed bearing or driver.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke har fan ko haath se ghumayein; haath se ghoome lekin bijli se na chale to bearing ya driver fail hai.

solutions.en: Swap the dead fan with a known-good fan, retest, then fit the replacement.
solutions.ur: Kharab fan ko chalte hue fan se swap karke dobara test karein, phir naya fan lagayein.

source.title: Solis S5 Single Phase Inverter (2.5-6)K / S5-GR1P(7-10)K Installation and Operation Manual, Table 8.1

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

meaning.en: The inverter sees too much impedance between itself and the grid, usually because the interconnect cable is too long or too thin.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur grid ke darmiyan impedance zyada hai, aksar is liye ke interconnect cable lamba ya patla hai.

causes.en: AC interconnect cable undersized or longer than the inverter spec allows
causes.ur: AC interconnect cable chhota ya manual se zyada lamba hai

causes.en: Loose AC lugs adding contact resistance at the inverter or at the panel
causes.ur: Inverter ya panel par AC lugs loose hain jis se contact resistance barh gaya

solutions.en: Measure line-to-line voltage at the inverter and at the main panel and note the difference under load.
solutions.ur: Inverter aur main panel par line-to-line voltage measure karke load ke under ka farq note karein.

solutions.en: Fit a larger cross-section AC cable if the voltage drop under full output is high.
solutions.ur: Agar full output par voltage drop zyada ho to bari cross-section AC cable lagayein.

solutions.en: Only widen the protection limit using User-Define if the utility permits it.
solutions.ur: Utility ijazat de to hi User-Define se protection limit barhayein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

meaning.en: The three phases are not within the allowed voltage difference, so the inverter stops.
meaning.ur: Teen phases ka voltage farq allowed limit se upar hai, is liye inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Single-phase heavy load connected between two phases only
causes.ur: Sirf do phases ke darmiyan single-phase bhaari load lagi ho

causes.en: Phase sequence or a loose connection at the main panel
causes.ur: Main panel par phase sequence ya connection loose ho

solutions.en: Measure L1-L2, L2-L3 and L3-L1 under load and compare the three values.
solutions.ur: Load ke under L1-L2, L2-L3 aur L3-L1 measure karke teenon values compare karein.

solutions.en: Move single-phase loads so they are spread evenly across all three phases.
solutions.ur: Single-phase loads ko aise baant dein ke teenon phases par barabar hon.

solutions.en: Tighten all phase lugs at the main panel and re-check the phase sequence.
solutions.ur: Main panel par sab phase lugs tighten karein aur phase sequence dobara check karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

meaning.en: The measured phase angle between phases is outside the allowed 120 degree window.
meaning.ur: Phases ke darmiyan measured phase angle 120 degree ke allowed window se bahar hai.

causes.en: Two phases of one feeder connected with a phase swap
causes.ur: Ek feeder ke do phases aapas mein swap karke lagaye gaye

causes.en: Unbalanced phase conductors with different cable lengths
causes.ur: Alag lambai ke phase conductors se phase load unbalanced

solutions.en: Isolate the AC and confirm each inverter terminal matches its labelled phase L1, L2, L3.
solutions.ur: AC isolate karke confirm karein ke har inverter terminal uske labelled phase L1, L2, L3 se match karta hai.

solutions.en: At the main panel, verify the phase sequence L1-L2-L3 with a phase rotation meter.
solutions.ur: Main panel par phase rotation meter se sequence L1-L2-L3 verify karein.

solutions.en: Equalise the cable lengths and lug torque on all three phases, then restart.
solutions.ur: Teenon phases par cable lambai aur lug torque barabar karein, phir restart karein.

notes.en: Hex 101A comes from a single retailer table, not from the Solis support KB code list.
notes.ur: Hex 101A ek retailer table se aaya hai, Solis support KB ki code list se nahi.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

meaning.en: Line-to-line grid voltage is above the configured overvoltage window, so export stops.
meaning.ur: Line-to-line grid voltage set kiya hua overvoltage window se upar hai, is liye export ruk gaya.

causes.en: AC cable resistance too high for the run length
causes.ur: AC cable ki resistance run length ke liye zyada hai

causes.en: Grid actually high due to heavy export on the local transformer
causes.ur: Local transformer par zyada export ki wajah se grid sach mein high hai

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, then measure L1-L2, L2-L3, L3-L1 and each phase to earth at the inverter.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke inverter par L1-L2, L2-L3, L3-L1 aur har phase ko earth ke against measure karein.

solutions.en: Fit a larger grid cable if resistance is high, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq agar resistance zyada ho to bari grid cable lagayein.

solutions.en: Adjust the protection limit only if the electrical company / utility allows it.
solutions.ur: Protection limit tabhi adjust karein jab electrical company / utility ijazat de.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

meaning.en: Grid voltage below the lower protection limit; the inverter waits and reconnects when it recovers.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage lower protection limit se neeche; voltage theek hone par inverter reconnect kar leta hai.

causes.en: Weak transformer or long low-voltage feeder
causes.ur: Kamzor transformer ya lamba low-voltage feeder

causes.en: Large unbalanced single-phase load on one phase
causes.ur: Ek phase par bada unbalanced single-phase load

solutions.en: Measure all three line-to-line voltages at the inverter while the alarm is showing.
solutions.ur: Alarm chal raha ho tab inverter par teenon line-to-line voltages measure karein.

solutions.en: If the meter reads normal but the LCD shows low, suspect the voltage sensing circuit - RMA.
solutions.ur: Meter normal reading de lekin LCD kam dikhaye to voltage sensing circuit shak karein - RMA.

solutions.en: Use the User-Define function to widen the lower limit only with utility approval.
solutions.ur: Utility ki ijazat se hi User-Define function se lower limit barhayein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

meaning.en: The inverter detects no grid voltage on any phase, so it stays disconnected.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko kisi bhi phase par grid voltage nahi mil rahi, is liye woh disconnected rehta hai.

causes.en: AC MCB tripped, or the grid isolator is open
causes.ur: AC MCB trip hua, ya grid isolator khula hai

causes.en: One AC phase conductor open between inverter and panel
causes.ur: Inverter aur panel ke darmiyan koi ek AC phase conductor khula hai

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, then measure L1-L2, L1-L3, L2-L3, L1-GND, L2-GND, L3-GND at the AC terminals.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke AC terminal par L1-L2, L1-L3, L2-L3, L1-GND, L2-GND, L3-GND measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare the AC voltages shown in the Information menu with the multimeter; mismatch means RMA.
solutions.ur: Information menu ke AC voltages ko multimeter se compare karein; mismatch ho to RMA.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch off until the screen blanks, then switch AC on first and DC after 60 seconds.
solutions.ur: Screen blank hone tak DC switch off rakhein, phir AC pehle aur 60 second baad DC on karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage exceeded its limit, so the inverter stopped.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage apni limit cross kar gaya, is liye inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Inductor connection loose or the driver board has failed
causes.ur: Inductor connection loose hai ya driver board fail ho gaya

causes.en: Grid loss while the DC bus is still charged from the PV array
causes.ur: PV array se DC bus charged hone ke baad grid chala gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV completely before probing anything inside the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit ke andar kuch bhi check karne se pehle AC aur PV poori tarah isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure DC and AC with a multimeter and compare with the LCD Information values.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se DC aur AC measure karein aur LCD Information values se compare karein.

solutions.en: With power off, check the inverter inductor connection and the driver connection as the manual states.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke manual ke mutabiq inverter inductor connection aur driver connection check karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus is too low, so the inverter cannot start or keeps restarting.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus bahut kam hai, is liye inverter start nahi hota ya baar baar restart hota hai.

causes.en: PV array Voc too low for the inverter minimum window
causes.ur: PV array ka Voc inverter ki minimum window se kam hai

causes.en: Half-voltage sampling circuit fault
causes.ur: Half-voltage sampling circuit ka fault
