solutions.en: DC switch OFF, then measure the PV string Voc at the inverter DC terminals.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karke inverter DC terminal par PV string ka Voc measure karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the string count in series is inside the inverter DC input range for your local minimum temperature.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke series mein string count aapke local minimum temperature par inverter DC range mein hai.

solutions.en: If Voc is healthy, reseat the bus voltage sampling connector and RMA the unit.
solutions.ur: Voc theek ho to bus voltage sampling connector dobara fit karein aur unit RMA karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

meaning.en: The grid waveform is unstable or heavily distorted, so the inverter shut down.
meaning.ur: Grid waveform unstable ya bahut distorted hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya.

causes.en: Non-linear loads such as drives and UPS on the same feeder
causes.ur: Usi feeder par drives aur UPS jaise non-linear loads

causes.en: Weak AC wiring, a loose connection or a shipping-loose internal wire
causes.ur: Kamzor AC wiring, loose connection ya shipping ke waqt khula internal wire

solutions.en: With the DC switch OFF, measure AC voltage and test the AC line for total harmonic distortion.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF kar ke AC voltage measure karein aur AC line ka total harmonic distortion test karein.

solutions.en: With the DC switch ON, test the AC line again for THD at full output.
solutions.ur: DC switch ON kar ke full output par AC line ka THD dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Turn other inverters off one at a time to find the noisy unit, then reseat or replace the power board.
solutions.ur: Doosre inverters ek-ek karke band kar ke noisy unit dhoondein, phir power board dobara fit ya replace karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

title.en: Main to slave DSP comms failure (DSP-B-FAULT)
title.ur: Main se slave DSP comms fail (DSP-B-FAULT)

meaning.en: The main and slave DSP chips are not communicating, so the inverter cannot run.
meaning.ur: Main aur slave DSP aapas mein communicate nahi kar rahe, is liye inverter nahi chalta.

causes.en: DSP firmware missing, mismatched or corrupted
causes.ur: DSP firmware missing, mismatch ya corrupt ho gaya

causes.en: DSP hardware failure on the power board
causes.ur: Power board par DSP hardware fail

solutions.en: DC switch OFF, wait for the LCD to go dark, then DC switch ON to force a full re-init.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, LCD band hone tak wait karein, phir DC switch ON karke poori re-init force karein.

solutions.en: Check the DSP version under Advanced Information > Version and compare with the slave board.
solutions.ur: Advanced Information > Version mein DSP version check karke slave board se compare karein.

solutions.en: If versions differ, reflash both DSP boards; if the fault remains, RMA the unit.
solutions.ur: Versions alag hon to dono DSP boards dobara flash karein; fault rahe to unit RMA karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

meaning.en: The internal 12 V auxiliary supply has failed, so the control board cannot start.
meaning.ur: Internal 12 V auxiliary supply fail ho gaya, is liye control board start nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: Current leaking to earth from a damaged cable or wet connector
causes.ur: Kharab cable ya geele connector se earth par current leak

causes.en: 12 V SMPS module or its transformer has failed
causes.ur: 12 V SMPS module ya uska transformer fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then verify the grounding conductor and every wire for insulation.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke grounding conductor aur har wire ki insulation verify karein.

solutions.en: With power off, measure the 12 V rail on the control board; below 10 V the SMPS is the culprit.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke control board par 12 V rail measure karein; 10 V se kam ho to SMPS hi masla hai.

solutions.en: Replace the SMPS module, not the whole inverter, if readings confirm it.
solutions.ur: Readings confirm karein to poora inverter nahi, sirf SMPS module replace karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

meaning.en: The grid connection relay failed its self test, so the inverter will not connect to the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid connection relay ka self test fail ho gaya, is liye inverter grid se connect nahi hoga.

causes.en: Grid relay welded, mis-aligned or mechanically damaged
causes.ur: Grid relay weld ho gaya, mis-aligned hai ya mechanically damaged hai

causes.en: Relay coil driver or 12 V rail faulty
causes.ur: Relay coil driver ya 12 V rail kharab

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check the relay for pitting or a welded contact with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke multimeter se relay ki pitting ya welded contact check karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter once; if the alarm returns, do not keep power cycling.
solutions.ur: Inverter ek baar restart karein; alarm wapas aaye to baar baar power cycle na karein.

solutions.en: Replace the relay or the relay board, then contact the installer for an RMA if the relay is healthy.
solutions.ur: Relay ya relay board replace karein; relay theek ho to installer se RMA ke liye rabta karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

title.ur: PV isolation protection, yaani earth fault (PV ISO-PRO 01/02)

meaning.en: DC insulation resistance on the PV side is too low, so a ground fault is present and generation stops.
meaning.ur: PV side par DC insulation resistance bahut kam hai, matlab ground fault mojood hai aur generation ruk gaya.

causes.en: Panel frame, module backsheet or cable insulation contacting earth
causes.ur: Panel frame, module backsheet ya cable ki insulation earth ko chhu rahi hai

causes.en: Water inside the DC combiner or a wet MC4 connector
causes.ur: DC combiner mein paani ya geela MC4 connector

solutions.en: Remove all DC inputs, then reconnect and restart the inverter one string at a time.
solutions.ur: Sab DC input hatayein, phir ek-ek string karke dobara lagakar restart karein.

solutions.en: Identify the offending string and measure its insulation to earth with a megohmmeter at 1000 V.
solutions.ur: Kharab string pehchan kar 1000 V megohmmeter se uski earth ke against insulation measure karein.

solutions.en: Replace the damaged cable, connector or module, then retest before reconnecting the array.
solutions.ur: Kharab cable, connector ya module replace karke array dobara lagane se pehle retest karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow alarm LED flashing + code on LCD

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

title.ur: Leakage current protection (ILeak-PRO 01/02/03/04) - earth par current leak

meaning.en: Residual current on the AC or DC circuit went over the limit, so the inverter stopped.
meaning.ur: AC ya DC circuit par residual current limit cross kar gaya, is liye inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Moisture in the AC termination box or inside the DC combiner
causes.ur: AC termination box ya DC combiner ke andar paani

causes.en: A leaking RCD or a failing EMI filter capacitor
causes.ur: Leaking RCD ya EMI filter capacitor fail hona

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check the AC and DC connection terminations for water and tightness.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke AC aur DC connection terminations par paani aur tightness check karein.

solutions.en: Check the inverter internal cable connections with power removed.
solutions.ur: Power nikal kar inverter ki internal cable connections check karein.

solutions.en: Measure residual current with a clamp meter on the earth conductor to find the leaking circuit.
solutions.ur: Earth conductor par clamp meter se residual current measure karke leaking circuit dhoondein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

meaning.en: The inverter detected high ambient or heatsink temperature and shut down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne ambient ya heatsink temperature zyada detect ki aur band ho gaya.

causes.en: Direct sunlight on the inverter during hot weather
causes.ur: Garmi ke mausam mein inverter par seedhi dhoop

causes.en: Heatsink ventilation blocked by dust or a wall/soffit behind the unit
causes.ur: Heatsink ka ventilation dhool ya peeche deewar se block

solutions.en: Check the inverter surrounding ventilation and whether sunshine is hitting it directly.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke aas paas ka ventilation check karein aur dekhein ke dhoop seedhi lag rahi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Clean the heatsink and keep at least the clearance given in the installation section.
solutions.ur: Heatsink saaf karein aur installation section di hui minimum clearance rakhein.

solutions.en: If ambient is normal and it still trips, the NTC sensor or fan is faulty - RMA.
solutions.ur: Ambient normal ho aur phir bhi trip kare to NTC sensor ya fan kharab hai - RMA.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S5-GR3P (three-phase string 3-13kW / 20-60kW)

title.en: Screen off with DC applied - internal damage
title.ur: DC lagay huye screen off - internal damage

meaning.en: PV voltage is present but the screen is dead, which the manual treats as an internally damaged inverter.
meaning.ur: PV voltage mojood hai lekin screen dead hai, manual ke mutabiq ye internally damaged inverter hai.

causes.en: Failed power board or HMI board inside the inverter
causes.ur: Inverter ke andar power board ya HMI board fail

causes.en: Internal DC short drawing the array down
causes.ur: Internal DC short jo array ko voltage se gira raha hai

solutions.en: Do NOT pull the DC switch under load. Wait for irradiance to drop and confirm string current is below 0.5 A with a clamp meter first.
solutions.ur: Load ke under DC switch bilkul na kheenchein. Pehle irradiance kam hone ka intezaar karein aur clamp meter se string current 0.5 A se neeche confirm karein.

solutions.en: Only after the current is confirmed low, switch the DC off, then AC off, and remove the unit for service.
solutions.ur: Current kam confirm hone ke baad hi DC off karein, phir AC off karke unit service ke liye nikaalein.

solutions.en: Note that damage from wrong operation is not covered by the device warranty, so record the current reading before switching off.
solutions.ur: Yaad rakhein ke ghalat operation se hua nuqsaan warranty mein cover nahi hota, is liye switch off karne se pehle current reading note karein.

source.title: Solis S5 Three Phase Inverter S5-GR3P(3-13)K User Manual, Table 9.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S6-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery, new-DSP platform)

title.ur: Battery overvoltage detect hua (OV-Vbatt, S6-EH1P manual)

meaning.en: In the S6-EH1P manual OV-Vbatt is described as BATTERY OVERVOLTAGE. Verify the actual voltage before acting, because the S5-EH1P-L and S6-EH3P manuals describe this same name as battery UNDERvoltage.
meaning.ur: S6-EH1P manual mein OV-Vbatt ko BATTERY OVERVOLTAGE bataya gaya hai. Amal karne se pehle asli voltage verify karein, kyunke S5-EH1P-L aur S6-EH3P manual isi naam ko battery UNDERvoltage kehta hai.

causes.en: Pack fully charged and sitting at maximum SOC with the BMS charge limit already reached
causes.ur: Pack poori tarah charge ho kar maximum SOC par hai aur BMS ka charge limit pehle hi poori ho chuka hai

causes.en: Battery overvoltage protection point set too low in the user settings
causes.ur: User settings mein battery overvoltage protection point bahut low set hai

causes.en: Pack aged or cell imbalance pushing the resting voltage up
causes.ur: Pack purani ho gayi ya cell imbalance resting voltage upar le gaya

solutions.en: Verify battery voltage is within standards: read the battery voltage on Information page 1 and confirm it against the battery maker's maximum charge voltage.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage standards ke andar hai yeh verify karein: Information page 1 par battery voltage padhein aur battery maker ki maximum charge voltage se confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure the pack with a multimeter at the inverter connection point so you know which of the two Solis descriptions applies to your unit.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter connection point par pack measure karein taake pata chale ke aapke unit par Solis ki kaun si do descriptions mein se lagti hai.

solutions.en: Raise the battery overvoltage protection point inside the battery maker's stated window, then contact the battery vendor if the code keeps returning.
solutions.ur: Battery maker ke bataye window mein battery overvoltage protection point barhayein, phir code baar baar aaye to battery vendor se rabta karein.

notes.en: CONFLICT FLAG: the S6-EH1P(3-6)K-L-AU manual Table 8.1 says 'OV-Vbatt / Battery overvoltage detected' and 'UN-Vbatt / Battery undervoltage detected', while the S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) EUR manual and the S6-EH3P manual say the opposite pairing. Always trust the measured voltage, never the name alone.
notes.ur: CONFLICT FLAG: S6-EH1P(3-6)K-L-AU manual Table 8.1 kehta hai 'OV-Vbatt / Battery overvoltage detected' aur 'UN-Vbatt / Battery undervoltage detected', jabke S5-EH1P(3-6)K-L(-BE) EUR manual aur S6-EH3P manual ulta pairing kehte hain. Hamesha measured voltage par bharosa karein, sirf naam par nahi.

source.title: Solis S6-EH1P(3-6)K-L-AU User Manual V1,1, Section 3.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 4.12 Earth Fault Alarm, Section 6.4 APP Alarm page, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S6-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery, new-DSP platform)

title.ur: Battery undervoltage detect hua (UN-Vbatt, S6-EH1P manual)

meaning.en: In the S6-EH1P manual UN-Vbatt is described as BATTERY UNDERVOLTAGE. Measure the pack before acting because the S5-EH1P-L and S6-EH3P manuals use this name for battery overvoltage.
meaning.ur: S6-EH1P manual mein UN-Vbatt ko BATTERY UNDERVOLTAGE bataya gaya hai. Amal karne se pehle pack measure karein kyunke S5-EH1P-L aur S6-EH3P manual is naam ko battery overvoltage ke liye use karte hain.

causes.en: Pack deeply discharged after a long outage or a load left running on backup
causes.ur: Lambi outage ya backup par chhoda load ki wajah se pack gehri tarah discharge

causes.en: Pack aged, or the pack BMS cutting out early
causes.ur: Pack purani ho gayi, ya pack ka BMS jaldi cut out kar raha hai

solutions.en: Read the battery voltage on Information page 1 and compare it with a multimeter reading taken at the pack terminals.
solutions.ur: Information page 1 par battery voltage padhein aur pack terminals par liye multimeter reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery breaker is closed and the pack BMS has woken up; deep-sleep packs need a wake signal before they answer CAN.
solutions.ur: Battery breaker band hai aur pack BMS jaag chuka hai yeh confirm karein; gehri neend wale pack ko CAN jawab dene se pehle wake signal chahiye.

solutions.en: Restart the system and check if the fault persists; if it does, contact the manufacturer's customer service rather than raising the protection limit blindly.
solutions.ur: System restart karke dekhein ke fault rehta hai ya nahi; agar rahe to protection limit blind le kar barhane ke bajaye manufacturer ke customer service se rabta karein.

notes.en: Same CONFLICT as the OV-Vbatt entry above - the S6-EH1P manual's OV-Vbatt / UN-Vbatt descriptions are swapped relative to S5-EH1P-L and S6-EH3P.
notes.ur: OV-Vbatt wali entry jaisa hi CONFLICT: S6-EH1P manual ke OV-Vbatt / UN-Vbatt descriptions S5-EH1P-L aur S6-EH3P ke muqable mein swap hue hue hain.

source.title: Solis S6-EH1P(3-6)K-L-AU User Manual V1,1, Section 3.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 4.12 Earth Fault Alarm, Section 6.4 APP Alarm page, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S6-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery, new-DSP platform)

meaning.en: The residual current detector tripped at a defined level: 01 over 30 mA, 02 over 60 mA, 03 over 150 mA, 04 continuous leakage current.
meaning.ur: Residual current detector ek defined level par trigger hua: 01 30 mA se zyada, 02 60 mA se zyada, 03 150 mA se zyada, 04 continuous leakage current.

causes.en: Wet or humid weather, when the array's stray capacitance pushes leakage current up
causes.ur: Geela ya humid mausam, jab array ki stray capacitance leakage current barha deta hai

causes.en: Cable laid directly on a metal or tile roof with no conduit, so pooled water leaks current
causes.ur: Cable seedha metal ya tile roof par bina conduit lagi, is liye khara paani current leak karta hai

causes.en: Poor system grounding, so capacitive leakage is not drained to earth
causes.ur: System grounding kamzor, is liye capacitive leakage earth par nahi ja rahi

solutions.en: Check current leakage to ground with a clamp meter on the earth conductor while the inverter is running.
solutions.ur: Inverter chalte waqt earth conductor par clamp meter se current leakage to ground check karein.

solutions.en: Verify your grounding: check the earth conductor size and continuity, and confirm the inverter earth lug is tight and free of rust.
solutions.ur: Apna grounding verify karein: earth conductor ka size aur continuity check karein, aur confirm karein ke inverter earth lug tight hai aur rust se paak hai.

solutions.en: Verify all wires are in good condition and not leaking current to ground; reroute roof-laid cable through conduit and replace any cable that fails a 1000 V megohmmeter test.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke sab wires theek hain aur ground par leak nahi kar rahi; roof par lagi cable ko conduit se le jayein aur jo cable 1000 V megohmmeter test mein fail ho use replace karein.

notes.en: Solis's own I-Leak-Pro article notes that in wet weather leakage faults are more common than PV insulation faults, that the stray capacitance on rainy days is about 3 times that of sunny days, and that a fault only on rainy mornings that self-clears is a normal phenomenon that may be handled by raising the ILeak.-L threshold in Advanced settings > special settings > IgZero_COPM.Set.
notes.ur: Solis ka apna I-Leak-Pro article kehta hai ke gehle mausam mein leakage faults PV insulation faults se zyada aate hain, ke rainy days par stray capacitance sunny days ke qareeb 3 guna hota hai, aur ke sirf rainy subah hone wala jo khud clear ho jaye wo normal phenomenon hai jise Advanced settings > special settings > IgZero_COPM.Set mein ILeak.-L threshold barha kar handle kiya ja sakta hai.

source.title: Solis S6-EH1P(3-6)K-L-AU User Manual V1,1, Section 3.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 4.12 Earth Fault Alarm, Section 6.4 APP Alarm page, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S6-EH1P(3-6)K-L (single-phase hybrid + 48V battery, new-DSP platform)

title.ur: Power LED aur paanch LED ka layout (S6-EH1P)

meaning.en: On this model the Battery LED shows pack state with blue flash rates of 3 s (discharge) and 1.5 s (charge), and the Power LED shows normal / warning / alarm.
meaning.ur: Is model par Battery LED blue flash rate 3 s (discharge) aur 1.5 s (charge) se pack state dikhata hai, aur Power LED normal, warning ya alarm dikhata hai.

causes.en: Normal battery and inverter state indication
causes.ur: Normal battery aur inverter state indication

causes.en: PV earth fault: the yellow alarm indicator flashes and PVISO-PRO appears in the APP
causes.ur: PV earth fault: yellow alarm indicator flash karta hai aur APP mein PVISO-PRO aata hai

solutions.en: For a red Power LED, connect to the inverter with the Bluetooth tool and read the alarm code; the LED does not identify the fault by itself.
solutions.ur: Red Power LED par Bluetooth tool se inverter se connect karke alarm code padhein; LED akela fault nahi batata.

solutions.en: For a flashing yellow alarm indicator, isolate AC and PV before any insulation measurement - a PV earth fault can put lethal voltage on the array.
solutions.ur: Flashing yellow alarm indicator par koi bhi insulation measure karne se pehle AC aur PV isolate karein - PV earth fault array par lethal voltage de sakta hai.

solutions.en: Note that Battery/WiFi/Ethernet/Bluetooth indicators turn off after 1 minute to conserve power; short-press the Power indicator to wake them.
solutions.ur: Yeh yaad rakhein ke Battery/WiFi/Ethernet/Bluetooth indicators 1 minute baad power bachane ke liye band ho jate hain; Power indicator par short-press karke unhein jaganey dein.

codes.blinkPattern: Battery: blue flash 3s = discharging, blue flash 1.5s = charging, blue solid = idle, OFF = no battery. Power: blue solid = normal, yellow solid = warning, red solid or flash every 3s = alarm. Yellow alarm indicator flashing = PV earth fault (PVISO-PRO in the APP)

source.title: Solis S6-EH1P(3-6)K-L-AU User Manual V1,1, Section 3.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 4.12 Earth Fault Alarm, Section 6.4 APP Alarm page, Table 8.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S6-EH3P(5-10)K-H / (12-20)K-H / (29.9-50)K-H (three-phase hybrid + high-voltage battery)

title.ur: HeartbeatLose, yaani parallel link kho gaya (APP code 1065, grade EMGR)

meaning.en: The parallel communication heartbeat between S6-EH3P units is lost, so the redundant group shut down.
meaning.ur: S6-EH3P units ke darmiyan parallel communication heartbeat kho gaya, is liye redundant group band ho gaya.

causes.en: The connection between the parallel communication wire is not normal
causes.ur: Parallel communication wire ka connection normal nahi hai

causes.en: Master address not set to 1, or two units left set as master
causes.ur: Master ka address 1 par set nahi, ya do units master hi chhor diye gaye

solutions.en: Power down the group and check the parallel communication cable: shielded, 8-core, seated at both P-A and P-B terminals.
solutions.ur: Group power down karke parallel communication cable check karein: shielded, 8-core, P-A aur P-B dono terminals par fit.

solutions.en: Verify there is a master inverter in the parallel system and confirm its address is set to 1, then confirm the DIP switch settings of every unit.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke parallel system mein master inverter hai aur uska address 1 par set hai, phir har unit ke DIP switch settings confirm karein.

solutions.en: Restart the system and confirm whether the fault continues; if it does not clear, contact the manufacturer's customer service - do not keep power cycling.
solutions.ur: System restart karke dekhein ke fault rehta hai ya nahi; hat na aaye to manufacturer ke customer service se rabta karein - baar baar power cycle na karein.

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S6-EH3P(5-10)K-H / (12-20)K-H / (29.9-50)K-H (three-phase hybrid + high-voltage battery)

title.ur: Battery ka hardware overvoltage ya VBUS rail par protection (1051)

meaning.en: The high-voltage battery hardware overvoltage protection tripped, so the S6-EH3P has locked out.
meaning.ur: High-voltage battery ka hardware overvoltage protection trigger ho gaya, is liye S6-EH3P lock out ho gaya.

causes.en: Battery circuit breaker tripping under charge
causes.ur: Charge ke waqt battery circuit breaker trip ho raha hai

causes.en: Battery pack damaged or a cell overcharged in the 150-800 V pack
causes.ur: Battery pack damaged hai ya 150-800 V pack mein koi cell overcharge ho gaya

solutions.en: Check if the battery circuit breaker is tripping: watch the breaker while the unit is charging and note whether it trips at a repeatable SoC.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery circuit breaker trip to nahi ho raha: unit charge karte waqt breaker par nazar rakhein aur note karein ke kisi khaas SoC par repeat hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure the pack voltage at the inverter battery port with a multimeter and compare it with the BMS value in SolisCloud; a large gap points to wiring or BMS.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter battery port par pack voltage measure karein aur SolisCloud ke BMS value se compare karein; bara farq wiring ya BMS ka masla hai.

solutions.en: Check if the battery is damaged: if the breaker is healthy and the pack reads over-voltage, have the battery vendor test the pack before condemning the inverter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery damaged hai ya nahi: breaker theek hai aur pack over-voltage parha raha hai to inverter kharab karne se pehle battery vendor se pack test karwa lein.

notes.en: For the (29.9-50)K-H the battery range is 150-800 V with two battery inputs and CAN/RS485, so a battery overvoltage here is a HV event, not the 42-58 V event of the RHI / S5-EH1P-L.
notes.ur: (29.9-50)K-H mein battery range 150-800 V hai aur do battery inputs hain, CAN/RS485 ke saath, is liye yahan battery overvoltage ek HV event hai, RHI / S5-EH1P-L wale 42-58 V event nahi.

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S6-EH3P(5-10)K-H / (12-20)K-H / (29.9-50)K-H (three-phase hybrid + high-voltage battery)

title.ur: Volt-Watt ke tehat power limit lagay huay (LmtByVg)

meaning.en: Because the grid voltage is high, the inverter has automatically reduced output under the Volt-Watt response curve required by the local safety rules.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage zyada hone ki wajah se inverter ne local safety rules ke mutabiq Volt-Watt response curve ke tehat output khud kam kar diya.

causes.en: Local safety regulations require Volt-Watt when grid voltage is high
causes.ur: Local safety regulations grid voltage zyada hone par Volt-Watt maangte hain

causes.en: Factory test mode left enabled after commissioning
causes.ur: Commissioning ke baad factory test mode on chhor diya gaya

solutions.en: No action needed - this is a normal safety response to high grid voltage.
solutions.ur: Koi action nahi chahiye - grid voltage zyada hone par ye normal safety response hai.

solutions.en: If you need to close the mode: Main menu > Advanced Settings > Password 0010 > STD mode settings > Working Mode > Working mode: NULL > Save and exit.
solutions.ur: Agar mode band karna ho to: Main menu > Advanced Settings > Password 0010 > STD mode settings > Working Mode > Working mode: NULL > Save and exit.

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S6-EH3P(5-10)K-H / (12-20)K-H / (29.9-50)K-H (three-phase hybrid + high-voltage battery)
aliases: Off grid status to On grid status

title.en: Syncing from off-grid back to grid (StandbySynoch)
title.ur: Off-grid se grid par wapas sync ho raha hai (StandbySynoch)

meaning.en: The inverter is holding in standby and waiting for the grid to come back so it can resynchronise voltage, phase and frequency.
meaning.ur: Inverter standby mein hai aur grid aane ka intezaar kar raha hai taake voltage, phase aur frequency dobara match kar sake.

causes.en: Grid outage that has now ended
causes.ur: Grid ka outage jo ab khatam ho gaya

causes.en: Generator made the grid and the inverter is re-checking phase sequence
causes.ur: Generator ne grid chala diya aur inverter phase sequence dobara check kar raha hai

solutions.en: No action needed - the device is in normal operation while it resynchronises.
solutions.ur: Koi action nahi chahiye - device resync hone tak normal chal raha hai.

solutions.en: If it stays in StandbySynoch for more than a few minutes, measure grid voltage and frequency at the AC terminal to confirm the grid is inside the allowed window.
solutions.ur: Agar kai minute se zyada StandbySynoch par raha ho to AC terminal par grid voltage aur frequency measure karke confirm karein ke grid allowed window ke andar hai.

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S6-EH3P(5-10)K-H / (12-20)K-H / (29.9-50)K-H (three-phase hybrid + high-voltage battery)

title.ur: Grid se load par transfer ho raha hai (GridToLoad)

meaning.en: The inverter has detected a grid event and is switching its output from grid-tied mode to the load/backup path.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne grid par koi event detect kiya hai aur apna output grid-tied mode se load/backup path par switch kar raha hai.

causes.en: Grid loss, voltage sag or frequency excursion starting
causes.ur: Grid loss, voltage sag ya frequency excursion shuru hona

solutions.en: No action needed; the transfer is automatic.
solutions.ur: Koi action nahi chahiye; transfer automatic hai.

solutions.en: If the transfer fails or the unit trips on switch-over, check the generator input phase sequence matches the grid L1-L2-L3 order.
solutions.ur: Agar transfer fail ho ya switch-over par unit trip kare to generator input ka phase sequence grid ke L1-L2-L3 order se match karta hai check karein.

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S6-EH3P(5-10)K-H / (12-20)K-H / (29.9-50)K-H (three-phase hybrid + high-voltage battery)

title.ur: Battery LED se pata chalta hai pack charge, discharge, idle ya alarm mein hai

meaning.en: Colour and breathing direction of the Battery LED tell you which pack is charging, discharging, idle or in alarm.
meaning.ur: Battery LED ka rang aur breathing direction batata hai ke kaun sa pack charge ho raha hai, discharge ho raha hai, idle hai ya alarm mein hai.

causes.en: Normal battery state indication on the front panel
causes.ur: Front panel par battery ka normal halat dikhaya jana

causes.en: Battery 1 or 2 is in alarm when the LED turns yellow
causes.ur: LED yellow ho jaye to Battery 1 ya 2 alarm halat mein hai

solutions.en: Read the pack state in the app: with a yellow Battery LED, check each pack's SoC and BMS status on the APP alarm page.
solutions.ur: App mein pack state padhein: Battery LED yellow ho to APP alarm page par har pack ka SoC aur BMS status check karein.

solutions.en: If the LED is OFF while a pack is fitted, check that the battery breaker is closed and the battery model is not set to 'No Battery'.
solutions.ur: Agar pack lage hone par bhi LED OFF ho to battery breaker band hai aur battery model 'No Battery' par to nahi, yeh check karein.

solutions.en: Note that battery/WiFi/Ethernet/Bluetooth indicators turn off after 1 minute to save power; short-press the Power LED to wake them again.
solutions.ur: Yeh yaad rakhein ke battery/WiFi/Ethernet/Bluetooth indicators 1 minute baad power bachane ke liye band ho jate hain; dobara jaganey ke liye Power LED par short-press karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Blue breathing = Battery 1 charging; Green breathing = Battery 2 charging; Blue breathing in reverse = Battery 1 discharging; Green breathing in reverse = Battery 2 discharging; Blue solid = Battery 1 idle; Green solid = Battery 2 idle; Yellow solid = Battery 1 alarm; Yellow flashing = Battery 2 alarm; OFF = no battery

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: S6-EH3P(5-10)K-H / (12-20)K-H / (29.9-50)K-H (three-phase hybrid + high-voltage battery)

title.ur: Power LED se normal chalna, warning ya alarm pata chalta hai

meaning.en: Blue solid means the inverter is running normally, yellow solid is a warning, and red solid or red flashing every 3 s is an alarm you must read in the app.
meaning.ur: Blue solid ka matlab inverter normal chal raha hai, yellow solid warning hai, aur red solid ya har 3 second par red flashing alarm hai jo app mein padhna zaroori hai.

causes.en: Normal running state
causes.ur: Normal chalne ki halat

causes.en: Alarm present - the manual says to connect by Bluetooth tool to determine the alarm code
causes.ur: Alarm mojood - manual ke mutabiq Bluetooth tool se connect karke alarm code pata karein

solutions.en: If the LED is red, connect to the inverter with the Bluetooth tool and read the alarm code; the LED alone does not identify the fault.
solutions.ur: Agar LED red ho to Bluetooth tool se inverter se connect karke alarm code padhein; LED akela fault nahi batata.

solutions.en: The Power indicator stays on at lower brightness after the other LEDs sleep; short-press it to wake all indicators.
solutions.ur: Baaki LEDs sone ke baad Power indicator kam brightness par on rehta hai; sab indicators jaganey ke liye us par short-press karein.

solutions.en: If a Table 7.1 fault is showing, switch the inverter off and wait 5 minutes before restarting, per the manual note.
solutions.ur: Agar Table 7.1 ka koi fault aa raha ho to manual ke note ke mutabiq inverter band karke 5 minute wait karein phir restart karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Blue solid ON = normally operating; Yellow solid ON = warning; Red solid ON or flashing every 3s = alarm

source.title: Solis S6-EH3P(29.9-50)K-H-EU User Manual, Section 4.1 Intelligent LED Indicators, Section 5.6.4 Alarm, Table 7.1 Fault message and description

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - battery and EPS faults

title.ur: Battery voltage normal range se bahar

meaning.en: The battery terminal voltage seen by the inverter is outside its acceptable window.
meaning.ur: Inverter jo battery terminal voltage dekh raha hai woh uski ijazat window se bahar hai.

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged and unable to charge because PV output is too low.
causes.ur: Battery poori tarah discharge ho chuka hai aur charge nahi ho sakta kyunke PV output bohat kam hai.

causes.en: BMS has cut the pack, or the pack's cell group is imbalanced.
causes.ur: BMS ne pack cut kar diya, ya pack ke cells ka group imbalanced hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage window set too wide for the pack actually installed.
causes.ur: Battery voltage window installed pack ke liye bohat chota set kiya gaya hai.

causes.en: Faulty battery voltage sensing harness between inverter and pack.
causes.ur: Inverter aur pack ke darmiyan battery voltage sensing wiring kharabi hai.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage at the inverter's battery terminals with a multimeter and compare it to the pack's allowed range.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter ke battery terminals par voltage napen aur pack ki ijazat range se compare karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the pack's SOC in FoxCloud; a deeply discharged pack normally needs PV generation to recover, not a reset.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein pack ka SOC confirm karein; bohat discharge hua pack reset nahi, PV generation chahta hai.

solutions.en: Check every battery inter-pack communication and power connector for a pushed-back pin.
solutions.ur: Har battery inter-pack communication aur power connector mein pin piche dhakeli hui to check karein.

notes.en: If a BMS code such as 'BMS Lost' or 'Bms Ext Fault' is also on screen, treat the pack as the primary suspect - see Series 6.
notes.ur: Agar screen par 'BMS Lost' ya 'Bms Ext Fault' jaisa code bhi hai to pack ko hi pehla mamool maanein - Series 6 dekhein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - battery and EPS faults

meaning.en: The pack is too empty to support the requested discharge; the inverter limits or blocks output to protect the battery.
meaning.ur: Pack itni khali hai ke maangi gayi discharge ko support nahi kar sakti; inverter battery bachane ke liye output kam ya band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Sustained cloudy weather, or a load that outruns the PV array.
causes.ur: Lambi musamlat ke baadal, ya aisa load jo PV array se tez chal raha hai.

causes.en: Grid outage lasting long enough to drain the pack to its floor.
causes.ur: Grid outage itna lamba ke pack apni floor tak khaali ho gaya.

causes.en: Parallel battery pack not communicating, so only part of the stored energy is usable.
causes.ur: Parallel battery pack communicate nahi kar raha, is liye sirf mukhtasar stored energy hi istemal hoti hai.

solutions.en: Wait for the battery to recharge, as FoxESS states; reduce discretionary load to let PV surplus go to the pack.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS kahe battery ko recharge hone dein; gharelu load kam karein taake PV ka zyada hissa battery mein jaye.

solutions.en: Read the pack's SOC and the per-pack voltages in FoxCloud to confirm every parallel pack is being seen.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein pack ka SOC aur har pack ka voltage padhein taake confirm ho ke har parallel pack nazar aa raha hai.

solutions.en: If SOC is normal but the code persists, have the pack's BMS state-of-health read on site.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC normal hai lekin code qataar nahi hota to pack ka BMS state-of-health site par check karwayein.

notes.en: Common on Pakistani systems after a long load-shedding window. Frequently misreported by owners as 'inverter dead' when the unit is actually protecting the battery correctly.
notes.ur: Lambi load shedding ke baad Pakistan ke systems par ye aam hai. Log isay aksar 'inverter kharab' keh dete hain jabke unit asal mein battery bacha raha hai.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - battery and EPS faults

title.ur: Battery buck circuit ka MOSFET kharab

meaning.en: The MOSFET in the inverter's battery buck stage has failed, so the inverter cannot regulate battery current.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke battery buck stage ka MOSFET kharab ho gaya, is liye inverter battery current regulate nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Internal semiconductor failure, often from a prior over-current or thermal event.
causes.ur: Aam tor par semiconductor ki internal kharabi, jo aksar pichli over-current ya thermal event se hoti hai.

causes.en: Repeated battery over-current trips that stressed the stage.
causes.ur: Baar baar battery over-current trip hona jis ne stage ko stress diya.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely and leave the unit isolated.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect kar ke unit ko isolate hi chhor dein.

solutions.en: Do not attempt to power-cycle repeatedly; each attempt runs current through a failed device.
solutions.ur: Baar baar power-cycle na karein; har koshish failed device se current guzarta hai.

solutions.en: Log the fault code and serial number and raise a warranty/depot claim for the power board.
solutions.ur: Fault code aur serial number note karke power board ke liye warranty ya depot claim raise karein.

notes.en: Not a site-repairable item. Anything involving opening the inverter is licensed-electrician work.
notes.ur: Yeh site par theek nahi ho sakta. Inverter kholna kisi bhi licensed electrician ka kaam hai.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - battery and EPS faults

title.ur: Battery boost circuit ka MOSFET kharab

meaning.en: The MOSFET in the inverter's battery boost stage has failed, so the inverter cannot raise battery voltage to the bus.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke battery boost stage ka MOSFET kharab ho gaya, is liye inverter battery voltage bus tak nahi barha sakta.

causes.en: Internal semiconductor failure, commonly after a battery surge or short.
causes.ur: Internal semiconductor kharabi, jo aksar battery surge ya short ke baad hoti hai.

causes.en: The battery-side relay in the inverter has not closed, which the H3 manual lists as an alternative cause of this same code.
causes.ur: Inverter ka battery side relay close nahi hua - H3 manual isi code ki doosri wajah yahi batata hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely as FoxESS directs.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS kahe AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Have a technician confirm the battery-side relay actually closes when commanded, before condemning the MOSFET.
solutions.ur: Technician se confirm karwayein ke command par battery-side relay asal mein close hota hai, phir MOSFET ko blame karein.

solutions.en: Update master firmware before reassessment - the H3 manual states a Boost fault on master below 1.69 can be a firmware artefact.
solutions.ur: Dobara dekhne se pehle master firmware update karein - H3 manual kehta hai ke 1.69 se neeche master par Boost fault firmware ka artifact ho sakta hai.

notes.en: H3 adds an explicit firmware caveat to this code; H1's table does not. Keep the two model lines separate - see CONFLICTS.
notes.ur: H3 is code par firmware ki explicit shart add karta hai; H1 ki table nahi karti. Dono model lines alag rakhein - CONFLICTS dekhein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - battery and EPS faults

title.ur: Battery connection ki polarity ulti hai

meaning.en: The battery positive and negative conductors are connected the wrong way round.
meaning.ur: Battery ke positive aur negative conductor ulat de mein lage hue hain.

causes.en: Installer error at first commissioning.
causes.ur: Pehli commissioning par installer ki galti.

causes.en: Battery replaced or re-wired by a non-installer and polarity crossed.
causes.ur: Battery kisi non-installer ne badli ya rewired ki aur polarity badal gayi.

solutions.en: Open the battery DC isolator before touching any conductor.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi conductor ko haath lagane se pehle battery DC isolator kholein.

solutions.en: With the battery isolated and pack disconnected, confirm polarity with a multimeter on the inverter's battery port before reconnecting.
solutions.ur: Battery isolate aur pack disconnect kar ke, wapas lagane se pehle multimeter se inverter ke battery port par polarity confirm karein.

solutions.en: Never energise the battery port to 'test' polarity - the BMS or the pack will be damaged.
solutions.ur: Polarity 'test' karne ke liye battery port ko kabhi energize na karein - BMS ya pack kharab ho jayega.

notes.en: Do NOT alias 'Bat Relay Short Circuit' to this. FoxESS lists that string as its own separate row, meaning 'The battery relay keeps close' - a welded-stuck relay, not reversed polarity. It is a different fault with a different meaning. See foxess-h3-ac3-power-relay for the verified H3 wording.
notes.ur: 'Bat Relay Short Circuit' ko is code ka alias na banayein. FoxESS us string ko apni alag row mein likhta hai, matlab 'The battery relay keeps close' - yani relay jam gaya, polarity ulti nahi. Yeh alag fault hai, alag matlab hai. Verified H3 wording ke liye foxess-h3-ac3-power-relay dekhein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - battery and EPS faults

meaning.en: The load connected to the backup/EPS output exceeds the inverter's off-grid power limit.
meaning.ur: Backup/EPS output se juda load inverter ki off-grid power limit se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Motor-based load (pump, compressor, blower) with high inrush current on the EPS output.
causes.ur: Motor wala load (pump, compressor, blower) jis ka EPS output par inrush current zyada hai.

causes.en: Multiple high-starting appliances switching on together after a grid outage.
causes.ur: Grid outage ke baad ek saath kai high-inrush appliances on ho jana.

causes.en: EPS output wired with too small a cable, causing a voltage drop that counts as overload.
causes.ur: EPS output choti cable se jura ho, jis se voltage drop hokar overload ke tor par report hota hai.

solutions.en: List every EPS-connected load and sum the running power; keep it under the inverter's EPS rating.
solutions.ur: EPS se jude tamam loads likhein aur chalne wali power ka jama karein; usay inverter ki EPS rating se neeche rakhein.

solutions.en: Stagger large motor starts so they do not energise simultaneously.
solutions.ur: Bade motors ka start aise stagger karein ke wo ek saath on na hon.

solutions.en: If EPS trips under a load well within rating, check EPS cable size and the EPS connector for heat damage.
solutions.ur: Agar rating se andar wala load par EPS trip kare to EPS cable size aur EPS connector ka garm hone ka nuqsan check karein.

notes.en: Keep apart from 'Over Load Fault', which is the ON-grid equivalent. Owners routinely confuse the two; only this one has anything to do with backup output.
notes.ur: 'Over Load Fault' se alag rakhein - woh ON-grid wohi hai. Log dono ghalat karte hain; sirf ye backup output se related hai.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - battery and EPS faults

meaning.en: The relay that transfers the load between grid and EPS output has failed.
meaning.ur: Load ko grid aur EPS output ke darmiyan transfer karne wala relay kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Relay coil or contact failure after many transfer operations.
causes.ur: Bohat se transfer operations ke baad relay coil ya contact ki kharabi.

causes.en: Relay chattering during frequent grid outages, wearing the contacts.
causes.ur: Bari tarah se grid outages mein relay ka chatter karna, jis se contacts ghis jate hain.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely before any work on the EPS wiring.
solutions.ur: EPS wiring par kaam karne se pehle AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the relay clicks when a grid outage is simulated by switching the AC breaker off and on.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke AC breaker off-on karke grid outage simulate karne par relay click karta hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Persistent fault means the relay assembly needs replacement - log the code and raise a service claim.
solutions.ur: Code qataar na ho to relay assembly badalna hoga - code note karke service claim raise karein.

notes.en: On a grid-unstable supply like Pakistan's, transfer-relay wear is a known high-incidence item on older hybrid units.
notes.ur: Pakistan jaisi grid-unstable supply par purane hybrid units par transfer-relay ki wear aam baat hai.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - BMS, battery-pack and meter communication faults

meaning.en: The inverter cannot talk to the battery pack's BMS over the pack communication lead, so it has no state-of-charge or protection data.
meaning.ur: Inverter battery pack ke BMS se baat nahi kar pa raha, is liye usay SOC ya protection data nahi mil raha.

causes.en: The pack communication lead is unseated, has a pushed-back pin, or was made with the wrong connector.
causes.ur: Pack communication lead puri tarah nahi lagi, us mein pin pichi dhakeli hui hai, ya ghalat connector se bani gayi.

causes.en: The comms lead is the LV type on one end and FoxESS expects a shielded RJ-type on both - a frequent field mismatch on aftermarket packs.
causes.ur: Comms lead ek taraf LV type ki hai jabke FoxESS dono taraf shielded RJ type chahta hai - aftermarket packs par yeh field par aam mismatch hai.

causes.en: Pack has gone into its own deep sleep / protection and has stopped answering, even though the power leads are fine.
causes.ur: Pack apni hi deep sleep ya protection mein chala gaya aur jawab dena chhod gaya, halke power leads theek hain.

solutions.en: Open the battery isolator first, then reseat the communication lead at BOTH the inverter end and the pack end until it clicks.
solutions.ur: Pehle battery isolator kholein, phir communication lead inverter taraf aur pack taraf - dono jagah - click hone tak wapas baithayein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle the pack only: switch off the battery isolator, wait 60 seconds, restore it, and read FoxCloud for whether the pack appears again.
solutions.ur: Sirf pack ko power-cycle karein: battery isolator off karein, 60 second intezar karein, wapas on karein, aur FoxCloud mein dekhein ke pack dobara nazar aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: With power isolated, inspect every comms pin with a small screwdriver tip for a bent or pushed-back contact and reseat firmly.
solutions.ur: Power isolate kar ke, har comms pin ko choti screwdriver ke sirr se muda ya piche dhakeli hui check karein aur mazboot se baithayein.

notes.en: FoxESS's manual gives no separate remedy for 'BMS Lost' versus 'Bms Ext Fault' - both rows say exactly the same thing, check the BMS-to-inverter cable. Treat them as the same job. If the pack is a non-FoxESS brand, the comms protocol is the first thing to verify, not the cable.
notes.ur: FoxESS ki manual 'BMS Lost' aur 'Bms Ext Fault' ke liye alag hal nahi deti - dono rows bilkul wahi kehti hain ke BMS se inverter ka cable check karein. Dono ko aik hi kaam samjhein. Agar pack FoxESS ka nahi hai to sab se pehle comms protocol check karein, cable nahi.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - BMS, battery-pack and meter communication faults

title.ur: Battery BMS ka external fault aaya

meaning.en: The BMS has raised a fault condition of its own and is reporting it to the inverter, which passes it on.
meaning.ur: BMS ne apni koi fault condition uthayi hai aur inverter tak pohanchayi, jis ne wo aage barha di.

causes.en: Intermittent comms contact that drops the link just long enough for the BMS to flag a fault.
causes.ur: Aksar waqt ka comms contact jo link ko itni der ke liye gira deta hai ke BMS fault mark kar de.

causes.en: The BMS has tripped on over/under voltage, over-current or temperature and is latching that up to the inverter.
causes.ur: BMS over/under voltage, over-current ya temperature par trip kar chuka hai aur wo inverter tak latch kar raha hai.

causes.en: EMI on the comms pair because it was run alongside PV or AC power cabling instead of separated.
causes.ur: Comms pair par EMI kyunke isay PV ya AC power cabling ke saath saath chala diya gaya, alag nahi.

solutions.en: Check the BMS-to-inverter communication cable is correctly and well connected, exactly as FoxESS states, at both ends.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS kehta hai, BMS se inverter ka communication cable dono taraf se theek aur mazboot lagi hui check karein.

solutions.en: Read the pack's own BMS history in FoxCloud before touching the inverter; the specific BMS sub-code tells you whether it is voltage, current, temperature or a comms drop.
solutions.ur: Inverter chhune se pehle FoxCloud mein pack ke apne BMS ki history padhein; specific BMS sub-code batata hai ke masla voltage, current, temperature ya comms drop hai.

solutions.en: If the BMS sub-code is a hardware protection (cell imbalance, relay, sensor), take the pack to the supplier - FoxESS's own instruction for those rows is 'contact battery supplier'.
solutions.ur: Agar BMS sub-code hardware protection hai (cell imbalance, relay, sensor) to pack supplier ko dein - un rows ke liye FoxESS ka apna instruction hai 'contact battery supplier'.

notes.en: The H1 table prints this row's meaning identically to BMS Lost ('The communication between BMS and Inverter is interrupted'), which is arguably a manual typo, but FoxESS gives both the same remedy. Do not invent a separate fix path for it.
notes.ur: H1 table is row ka meaning bhi BMS Lost ke bilkul barabar likhti hai ('The communication between BMS and Inverter is interrupted'), jo shayad manual ka typo hai, lekin FoxESS dono ka wohi hal deta hai. Is ke liye alag tareeqa ghalat na banayein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - BMS, battery-pack and meter communication faults

title.ur: Battery packs ka aapas mein connection toot gaya

meaning.en: In a multi-pack install, the packs cannot talk to each other. FoxESS gives two causes: the DIP switch is in the wrong position, and the pack-to-pack comms cable is not well connected.
meaning.ur: Multi-pack install mein packs aapas mein baat nahi kar sakte. FoxESS do wajahein batata hai: DIP switch ghalat position par hai, aur pack-to-pack comms cable mazbot nahi lagi.

causes.en: DIP switch on a pack set to the wrong position - FoxESS names this first, and it is the correct answer far more often than the cable.
causes.ur: Kisi pack ka DIP switch ghalat position par - FoxESS isay pehle batata hai, aur cable se zyada aam tor par yehi asal jawab hota hai.

causes.en: The pack-to-pack communication cable is loose, has a pushed-back pin, or is the wrong length for the daisy chain.
causes.ur: Pack-to-pack communication cable loose hai, us mein pin pichi dhakeli hai, ya daisy chain ke liye galat lambi hai.

causes.en: Packs added to an existing install without re-setting their address/switch, so two packs claim the same address.
causes.ur: Maujooda install mein packs shamil kiye gaye lekin unka address/switch dobara set nahi kiya gaya, is liye do packs aik hi address le lete hain.

solutions.en: Move the DIP switch to the correct position, as FoxESS instructs - confirm the pack's own label/manual for the address table before moving it.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS kahe DIP switch ko theek position par le jayein - usay hilane se pehle pack ke apne label ya manual ki address table confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check if the communication cable between battery packs is correctly and well connected; reseat both ends with the battery isolator open.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery packs ke darmiyan communication cable theek aur mazboot lagi hai; battery isolator khol kar dono taraf wapas baithayein.

solutions.en: Isolate every pack in turn and power them up one at a time, so the address that is stealing the bus is identified by elimination.
solutions.ur: Har pack ko aik-ik kar ke isolate karein aur aik-ik kar ke power up karein, taake bus deenewali address pehchan liya ja sake.

notes.en: This is the single most useful FoxESS battery code for a Pakistani installer because the fix is a DIP switch, not a replacement. But FoxESS's H1 manual does not publish the address table - get it from the pack's own documentation before moving a switch.
notes.ur: Yeh FoxESS ka sab se kaam ka battery code hai Pakistan ke installer ke liye kyunke hal DIP switch hai, koi part badalna nahi. Lekin FoxESS ki H1 manual address table dhoondhti nahi - switch hilane se pehle usay pack ke apne documentation se lein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - BMS, battery-pack and meter communication faults

title.ur: Meter se inverter ka connection toot gaya

meaning.en: The inverter has lost the RS485 link to the electricity meter, so it cannot read import/export and will not do the export or zero-export function.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne meter se RS485 ka link kho diya, is liye woh import/export nahi parh sakta aur export ya zero-export ka kaam nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: RS485 cable loose, has a pushed-back pin, or is the wrong cable type - FoxESS's meter comms is polarity-sensitive.
causes.ur: RS485 cable loose hai, us mein pin pichi dhakeli hai, ya ghalat type ki hai - FoxESS ke meter comms mein polarity sensitive hai.

causes.en: A CT or voltage lead that has worked loose inside the meter, so the meter powers down or re-addresses.
causes.ur: Meter ke andar koi CT ya voltage lead dhil gayi ho, is liye meter band ho jata hai ya dobara address hota hai.

causes.en: The meter was swapped for a different model or make without re-addressing it for FoxESS Modbus.
causes.ur: Meter ko alag model ya make se badal diya gaya lekin usay FoxESS Modbus ke liye dobara address nahi kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Check if the communication cable between meter and inverter is correctly and well connected, as FoxESS states, at both the logger and meter ends.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS kehta hai, meter aur inverter ke darmiyan communication cable logger aur meter dono taraf se theek aur mazboot lagi hui check karein.

solutions.en: With AC off at the board, check the meter's own RS485 terminals are tight and confirm the A/B polarity matches the logger, not reversed.
solutions.ur: Board par se AC off kar ke, meter ke apne RS485 terminals mazboot hain check karein aur A/B polarity logger ke mutabiq hai, ulti nahi, confirm karein.

solutions.en: In FoxCloud, confirm the meter is still detected and reading; if it drops out intermittently, the cable run is the suspect, not the meter.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein confirm karein ke meter ab bhi detect ho raha hai aur reading le raha hai; agar waks waks girta hai to masla cable ki race ka hai, meter ka nahi.

notes.en: Do not chase this with inverter settings. On a Pakistani grid-tied install this code almost always means the export reading is wrong, not that generation has stopped - the unit keeps making power. The T-series has a separate 'Meter fault' row with a similar remedy; do not merge them.
notes.ur: Isay inverter settings se hal na karein. Pakistan ke grid-tied install par yeh code aksar matlab hoti hai ke export reading ghalat hai, ke generation band hui hai - unit biji bana raha hai. T-series ki alag 'Meter fault' row ka hal aisa hi hai; dono ko merge na karein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - output current, DC bus and PV input current

meaning.en: The inverter's own current supervision saw output current above the limit and shut down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka apna current supervision ne output current limit se upar dekha aur band kar diya.

causes.en: Sudden large load step or a shorted output branch on EPS or AC.
causes.ur: Achanak bada load step ya EPS/AC par koi short circuit wala branch.

causes.en: Inverter paralleled beyond its permitted unit count, so current sharing fails.
causes.ur: Inverter ijazat se zyada units mein parallel hai, is liye current sharing fail ho rahi hai.

causes.en: Current transformer / sampling hardware drift on an ageing unit.
causes.ur: Purane unit par current transformer ya sampling hardware mein drift.

solutions.en: Isolate fully: AC switch off, PV DC switch off, battery isolator off. Wait for the LCD to go dark.
solutions.ur: Poori tarah isolate karein: AC switch off, PV DC switch off, battery isolator off. LCD band hone tak intezar karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect one source at a time - battery first, then PV, then grid - and watch whether the code returns.
solutions.ur: Ek waqt mein ek source wapas karein - pehle battery, phir PV, phir grid - aur dekhein ke code wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it returns with no load connected, the unit needs service - do not keep cycling it.
solutions.ur: Agar koi load na hone par bhi wapas aaye to unit ko service chahiye - baar baar on/off na karein.

notes.en: An EPS over-load event frequently presents as this code rather than 'Eps Over Load' on some firmware.
notes.ur: Kuch firmware par EPS over-load ki event is code ki shakal mein aati hai, 'Eps Over Load' ki nahi.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - output current, DC bus and PV input current

meaning.en: A hardware comparator, not software, detected excessive output current. Usually a more serious condition than the SW variant.
meaning.ur: Software nahi, hardware comparator ne zyada output current detect kiya. Aam tor par SW variant se zyada serious halat.

causes.en: Power stage damage - IGBT/MOSFET or gate driver failure.
causes.ur: Power stage ka nuqsan - IGBT/MOSFET ya gate driver ki kharabi.

causes.en: Sustained overload or a dead short on the AC output that software did not catch first.
causes.ur: Mustaqil overload ya AC output par koi short jo software ne pehle nahi pakra.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely before any inspection.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi check karne se pehle AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect kar lein.

solutions.en: With power isolated, check DC bus capacitors for bulging and smell burnt components around the power stage.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke DC bus capacitors par swelling aur power stage ke aas paas burnt smell check karein.

solutions.en: Measure insulation resistance of all AC and PV wiring to earth; below roughly 100 kOhm indicates a leak.
solutions.ur: Tamam AC aur PV wiring ki earth ke sath insulation resistance measure karein; taqreeban 100 kOhm se neeche matlab leak hai.

notes.en: Distinguishing SW from HW matters commercially: HW Inv Cur on an in-warranty unit is a board-level claim, not a wiring claim.
notes.ur: SW aur HW ka farq tamam ke liye ahem hai: warranty ke andar HW Inv Cur board-level claim hai, wiring claim nahi.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - output current, DC bus and PV input current

title.en: DC component in AC output too high
title.ur: AC output mein DC component zyada

meaning.en: A DC offset in the inverter's AC output current exceeded the permitted limit.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke AC output current mein DC offset ijazat limit se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Output filter capacitor degraded, allowing DC to leak into the AC output.
causes.ur: Output filter capacitor kharaab hua, is liye AC output mein DC leak hone laga.

causes.en: Internal current-sensing offset or a failed sensing resistor.
causes.ur: Internal current-sensing offset ya sensing resistor ki kharabi.

causes.en: Damaged output stage producing half-wave-like asymmetry.
causes.ur: Output stage ka nuqsan jis se output aadho jaisa asymmetric ho gaya.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then power-cycle once as FoxESS directs.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect kar ke aik baar power-cycle karein jaise FoxESS kahe.

solutions.en: If it returns, disconnect the EPS load entirely and re-test to rule out an external DC-injecting load.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to EPS load poori tarah disconnect kar ke dobara test karein, taake external DC-inject karne wala load rule out ho jaye.

solutions.en: Persistent DCI Fault on an idle inverter means output filter or current sensing - a workshop job, not a site job.
solutions.ur: Idle inverter par baar baar DCI Fault aana matlab output filter ya current sensing ka masla - ye workshop ka kaam hai, site ka nahi.

notes.en: Do not confuse with R-series numeric 1034 'DC Component Current Fault' (verified in the R V1.4 and R G2 V1.5 tables) - same physics, different model line, and FoxESS gives it a 10-minute AC/DC switch-off restart instead of a plain reconnect. Never hand a Pakistani R-series owner the H1 string or vice versa.
notes.ur: R-series ke numeric 1034 'DC Component Current Fault' se confuse na karein (R V1.4 aur R G2 V1.5 ki table mein verify hua) - wahi physics, alag model line, aur FoxESS usay 10 minute ke AC/DC switch off karke restart kehta hai, sirf reconnect nahi. Pakistan ke R-series owner ko H1 ki string dein ya ulta, kabhi nahi.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - output current, DC bus and PV input current

title.en: DC bus voltage out of range (software)
title.ur: DC bus voltage range se bahar (software)

meaning.en: Software supervision saw the internal DC link voltage outside its safe window.
meaning.ur: Software supervision ne internal DC link voltage ko safe window se bahar dekha.

causes.en: Grid voltage at an extreme, so the bus cannot be held in the operating window.
causes.ur: Grid voltage bilkul extreme par, is liye bus ko operating window mein nahi rakh sakte.

causes.en: Loose or open N line at the GRID port on a single-phase install.
causes.ur: Single-phase install par GRID port mein N line loose ya khari hui.

causes.en: Firmware too old to handle the present grid conditions correctly.
causes.ur: Grid ki maujooda halaat sahi se handle karne ke liye firmware bohat purana.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reconnect in sequence as FoxESS directs.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect kar ke jaise FoxESS kahe us tarah se wapas sequence mein lagayein.

solutions.en: With power off, verify the neutral conductor is solidly landed at the GRID port and the PE is sound.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke verify karein ke neutral conductor GRID port par mazboot se laga hai aur PE theek hai.

solutions.en: Check available firmware and update from the app or the inverter's firmware menu.
solutions.ur: Maujooda firmware check karke app ya inverter ke firmware menu se update karein.

notes.en: IMPORTANT MODEL-LINE DIFFERENCE, now verified side by side: the H3 V1.0.4 row for the identical string adds 'Please check whether the N line is connected to the GRID port of the inverter' and 'at least ensure that the master is upgraded to 1.69 or above'. The H1 V1.6 row contains neither line - it is a bare disconnect/reconnect. Do not give a Pakistani H1 owner the H3 advice. See foxess-h3-ac3-power-relay and CONFLICTS.
notes.ur: IMPORTANT MODEL-LINE DIFFERENCE, ab dono side se verify: H3 V1.0.4 mein isi string ki row mein 'Please check whether the N line is connected to the GRID port of the inverter' aur 'master ko 1.69 ya us se upar upgrade karein' shamil hai. H1 V1.6 ki row mein dono nahi - woh sirf disconnect/reconnect hai. Pakistan ke H1 owner ko H3 wali mat nasihat na dein. foxess-h3-ac3-power-relay aur CONFLICTS dekhein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - output current, DC bus and PV input current

title.en: DC bus voltage out of range (hardware)
title.ur: DC bus voltage range se bahar (hardware)

meaning.en: A hardware comparator detected the DC link voltage outside its safe window, indicating a real over/under-voltage event on the bus.
meaning.ur: Hardware comparator ne DC link voltage safe window se bahar detect kiya - matlab bus par asal over/under-voltage event hua hai.

causes.en: Grid under-voltage dip pulling the bus down, or a surge pushing it up.
causes.ur: Grid under-voltage dip jo bus neeche kheench raha hai, ya surge jo upar push kar raha hai.

causes.en: Failed bus voltage sensing divider.
causes.ur: Bus voltage sensing divider ki kharabi.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery before opening anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Check PV string open-circuit voltage; a string too far above the inverter maximum forces the bus high.
solutions.ur: PV string ka open-circuit voltage check karein; string inverter ki maximum se upar ho to bus ko high le jata hai.

solutions.en: Inspect the bus for a bulged or vented capacitor, which is a replacement-not-repair item.
solutions.ur: Bus par bulging ya venting wala capacitor dekhein - use badalna hota hai, theek nahi karna.

notes.en: Often appears together with HW Inv Cur Fault on the same event - treat the pair as a power-stage investigation.
notes.ur: Aik hi event par ye HW Inv Cur Fault ke saath aata hai - dono ko power-stage investigation ki tarah dekhein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - output current, DC bus and PV input current

meaning.en: Software supervision saw PV input current above the limit, which points to a shading, mismatch or islanding-arc current condition on the array.
meaning.ur: Software supervision ne PV input current limit se upar dekha - is ka matlab array par shading, mismatch ya islanding-arc current ki halat hai.

causes.en: Partial shading or a bypassed/cracked module causing a current mismatch between parallel strings.
causes.ur: Aadha chhaaya ya bypass / toota hua module jis se parallel strings mein current mismatch ho raha hai.

causes.en: PV string wired with too few modules in parallel for the inverter's input current rating.
causes.ur: PV string mein parallel modules inverter ki input current rating se kam hue.

causes.en: A DC arc forming on a damaged connector under load.
causes.ur: Load ke under damaged connector par DC arc ban raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reconnect and re-check the code.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karke wapas lagayen aur code dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: String-by-string, measure each string's current against its neighbours in FoxCloud to find the mismatched one.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein har string ka current naap kar uske padosi strings se compare karein, taake mismatch wali string mil jaye.

solutions.en: With PV isolated, torque-check every MC4 connector and replace any that are discoloured, warm or not fully seated.
solutions.ur: PV isolate kar ke har MC4 connector ka torque check karein, aur jo rang badla, garm ya puri tarah nahi laga usay replace karein.

notes.en: In high-dust Pakistan environments, thermally degraded MC4 crimps are a leading real cause of this and of the HW variant.
notes.ur: Pakistan ke ghar-ghar mein dhool se MC4 crimps garm ho kar kharaab hote hain - is aur HW variant ki aam wajah yahi hai.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - output current, DC bus and PV input current

meaning.en: Software supervision saw battery charge or discharge current above the limit.
meaning.ur: Software supervision ne battery charge ya discharge current limit se upar dekha.

causes.en: Battery pack internal cell imbalance forcing high circulating current.
causes.ur: Battery pack mein cells ka imbalance jo high circulating current par majboor kar raha hai.

causes.en: Charge or discharge current set above the connected battery's rating in the app.
causes.ur: App mein charge ya discharge current connected battery ki rating se upar set kiya gaya.

causes.en: Damaged battery harness or a pack whose internal fuse has degraded.
causes.ur: Battery wiring kharabi ya pack ka internal fuse degrade ho gaya.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reconnect once as FoxESS directs.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karke jaise FoxESS kahe aik baar wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: In the app, compare max charge and max discharge current against the battery nameplate rating and set them equal or lower.
solutions.ur: App mein max charge aur max discharge current ko battery ke nameplate rating se compare karein aur unhein barabar ya kam set karein.

solutions.en: With battery isolated, check the pack's own DC fuse and the inter-pack communication lead seating.
solutions.ur: Battery isolate kar ke pack ka apna DC fuse aur inter-pack communication lead ki fitting check karein.

notes.en: If BMS-side codes are also present, the battery is the suspect - go to foxess-h1-ac1-g2-bms-comms before condemning the inverter.
notes.ur: Agar BMS side ke codes bhi aa rahe hain to battery hi mamool hai - inverter gherne se pehle foxess-h1-ac1-g2-bms-comms dekhein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - grid and AC monitoring faults

meaning.en: The inverter has lost the utility reference and isolated itself from the grid. Usually the AC side has actually opened.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne grid reference kho diya aur khud ko grid se alag kar liya. Aam tor par AC side khul chuka hota hai.

causes.en: Main AC MCB or RCD has tripped on the inverter feed.
causes.ur: Inverter feed ka main AC MCB ya RCD trip ho chuka hai.

causes.en: Utility outage, or loose/burnt AC terminal at the inverter or consumer unit.
causes.ur: Utility outage, ya inverter ya consumer unit par AC terminal loose ya burnt hai.

causes.en: MCB rating too small for the inverter - trips under high charge/force-charge current.
causes.ur: MCB rating inverter ke liye choti hai - high charge ya force-charge current par trip karti hai.

solutions.en: Check the grid MCB and RCD on the PV/solar board; reset if tripped. FoxESS wants a bi-directional 100 mA RCD, not 30 mA.
solutions.ur: PV/solar board par grid MCB aur RCD check karein, trip ho to reset karein. FoxESS ko bi-directional 100 mA RCD chahiye, 30 mA nahi.

solutions.en: Confirm MCB size against inverter rating: 3.7 kW = 20 A, 5/6/7 kW = 32 A, 8-10 kW = 64 A.
solutions.ur: Inverter rating ke hisaab se MCB size confirm karein: 3.7 kW = 20 A, 5/6/7 kW = 32 A, 8-10 kW = 64 A.

solutions.en: Torque-check and heat-check every AC terminal at the inverter and meter box; retighten or replace the burnt one.
solutions.ur: Inverter aur meter box ke har AC terminal ko torque aur heat ke liye check karein; burnt terminal ko tighten ya replace karein.

notes.en: Field guidance: 1 + 26 + 27 almost always appear together, and a repeat trip within a day means a real fault, not a nuisance trip. Do not keep resetting - escalate.
notes.ur: Field guidance: 1 + 26 + 27 aam tor par saath aate hain, aur ek din mein dobara trip hona asal fault hai. Bar bar reset na karein - installer ko bulayein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - grid and AC monitoring faults

meaning.en: Measured grid voltage is above or below the inverter's permitted window, so the inverter refuses to connect.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage inverter ki ijazat range se upar ya neeche hai, is liye inverter connect nahi ho raha.

causes.en: High export time grid voltage, typical of a long line or a substation transformer tap set too high.
causes.ur: Export ke waqt grid voltage high - lambi line ya substation transformer ka tap zyada par hona aam wajah hai.

causes.en: Severe grid dip from a large motor or generator starting on the same feeder.
causes.ur: Wahi feeder par kisi bade motor ya generator ke chalne se grid voltage gir gaya.

causes.en: Protection window set too narrow for a local grid that runs at the edge of tolerance.
causes.ur: Protection window aise grid ke liye chota set hai jo tolerance ke kinare par chalta hai.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid to settle; the unit reconnects on its own once voltage is back in range.
solutions.ur: Grid settle hone dein; voltage range mein aate hi unit khud reconnect ho jayega.

solutions.en: Log into FoxCloud and read the live RVolt trend; if it sits near the upper limit, log the peak value.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein login karke live RVolt trend dekhein; agar upar ki limit ke qareeb hai to peak value note kar lein.

solutions.en: If voltage is genuinely high, have the utility (in Pakistan, the DISCO feeder office) check and correct transformer tapping before touching inverter settings.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage wakai high hai, to inverter setting chhune se pehle utility se (Pakistan mein DISCO feeder office) check karwa kar transformer tapping theek karwayein.

notes.en: Widely reported on H1 in markets with long rural feeders. Peak readings around 250-255 V AC on a 230 V nominal supply are typical.
notes.ur: Lambi rural feeder wale ilaqa mein H1 par ye bohat aam hai. 230 V nominal par 250-255 V AC tak ke peak readings aam hain.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - grid and AC monitoring faults

meaning.en: Grid frequency is outside the permitted band, so the inverter has disconnected from the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency ijazat range se bahar hai, is liye inverter ne grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Utility frequency excursion, common during feeder load shedding or generator handover.
causes.ur: Utility frequency excursion - feeder load shedding ya generator handover ke waqt aam hai.

causes.en: Inverter running in parallel with a generator that is governing frequency poorly.
causes.ur: Inverter aise generator ke saath parallel chal raha hai jo frequency theek se control nahi kar raha.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid to return to nominal; the unit will reconnect automatically.
solutions.ur: Grid nominal par aane ka intezar karein; unit khud reconnect ho jayega.

solutions.en: Read live frequency in FoxCloud and note whether excursions coincide with generator running hours.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein live frequency padhein aur note karein ke excursion generator chalne ke waqt hote hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: If a generator is involved, adjust its governor and set the inverter grid-tie limits per the generator's own voltage/frequency window.
solutions.ur: Agar generator involved hai to uska governor adjust karein aur inverter ke grid-tie limits generator ke voltage/frequency window ke mutabiq set karein.

notes.en: Pakistan nominal supply is 230 V / 50 Hz; a sustained 50 Hz +/- 0.5 Hz excursion will trip this.
notes.ur: Pakistan nominal supply 230 V / 50 Hz hai; 50 Hz +/- 0.5 Hz ka mustaqil excursion is code ko trigger karega.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - grid and AC monitoring faults

title.en: 10-minute average grid voltage out of range
title.ur: 10 minute ka average grid voltage range se bahar

meaning.en: The rolling 10-minute average of grid voltage has been out of range. This is a sustained-condition protection, not a spike detector.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage ka chalta hua 10 minute ka average range se bahar chala gaya hai. Yeh mustaqil-condition protection hai, spike detector nahi.

causes.en: Sustained grid over-voltage, often with high PV export into an already-high feeder.
causes.ur: Grid ka mustaqil over-voltage - aksar already high feeder mein zyada PV export ke saath.

causes.en: Substation transformer tap set high and left uncorrected.
causes.ur: Substation transformer ka tap high set hai aur theek nahi kiya gaya.

causes.en: Protection limit set to the 253 V default while the local grid legitimately runs at 252-254 V.
causes.ur: Protection limit 253 V default par hai jabke local grid waqai 252-254 V par chalta hai.

solutions.en: Check the 10-minute average voltage in FoxCloud and record the peak before touching anything.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein 10 minute ka average voltage dekhein aur kuch bhi chhune se pehle peak note karein.

solutions.en: On H1, open Settings > On-Grid > Grid Para > 'Vac 10min Avg' (PIN 0-0-0-0) and raise the limit only after the utility has confirmed the voltage.
solutions.ur: H1 par Settings > On-Grid > Grid Para > 'Vac 10min Avg' kholein (PIN 0-0-0-0) aur limit sirf tab barhayen jab utility ne voltage confirm kar liya ho.

solutions.en: Ask the DISCO feeder office to log grid voltage and correct the substation transformer tap - the durable fix.
solutions.ur: DISCO feeder office se grid voltage log karwa kar substation transformer tap theek karwayein - yehi permanent hal hai.
