notes.en: FoxESS’s own remedy is only "wait, the system will reconnect" - the manual gives no menu path for this limit. An earlier pass of this job cited a legacy numeric code 28 and a Settings > On-Grid > Grid Para > Vac 10min Avg path from a forum post; that source was NOT re-fetched here, so neither is asserted. Treat the parameter path as unverified until a FoxESS document confirms it.
notes.ur: FoxESS ka apna hal sirf "intezar karein, system khud reconnect ho jayega" hai - manual is limit ka koi menu path nahi deta. Is kaam ke pichle pass ne ek forum post se legacy numeric code 28 aur Settings > On-Grid > Grid Para > Vac 10min Avg ka path liya tha; wo source is dafaan dobara fetch nahi hua, is liye hum us par bharosa nahi karte. FoxESS ke kisi document ke confirm karne tak is parameter path ko unverified samjhein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - insulation, residual current and earth faults

meaning.en: The inverter's insulation monitor measured a leakage path to earth and stopped. This is a damaged-insulation alarm, not a settings alarm.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka insulation monitor ne earth par leakage path naapa aur unit band kar di. Yeh kharabi-insulation ka alarm hai, settings ka nahi.

causes.en: Damaged or chafed cable insulation, classically where a PV cable runs through a metal roof edge, conduit or a hot cable tray.
causes.ur: Insulation damage ya ghis chuka cable - aam tor par jahan PV cable metal roof ke kinare, conduit ya garm cable tray se guzarta hai.

causes.en: Water ingress into a DC junction box, MC4 connector or the AC cable gland in monsoon season.
causes.ur: Barish ke mausam mein DC junction box, MC4 connector ya AC cable gland mein paani ka dakhil.

causes.en: Moisture on PV module surfaces after heavy dew or rain, which is normal and self-clears; a persistent alarm is not.
causes.ur: Bohat oos ya barish ke baad PV module ki sath par nami - yeh normal hai aur khud clear hota hai; lekin alarm bar qatam na ho to masla hai.

causes.en: A single module with a cracked backsheet or a failed junction box internally shorting to frame.
causes.ur: Aisa module jiska backsheet toota ho ya junction box kharab ho aur frame ke sath short kar raha ho.

solutions.en: Wait first and re-read the code after 15-30 minutes; FoxESS explicitly says to wait, because dew and damp mornings clear on their own.
solutions.ur: Pehle intezar karein aur 15-30 minute baad code dobara dekhein; FoxESS khud kehta hai intezar karein, kyunke oos aur nam subah khud clear ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and AC breaker, then split the array: disconnect one string at a time at the DC switch and re-test to find the leaking string, working down to individual MC4 pairs if needed - the offending pair will read normal when reconnected.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker kholein, phir array ko alag karein: DC switch par ek-ek string disconnect kar ke dobara test karein taake leak wali string mil jaye, zaroori ho to MC4 joriyon tak neeche jayein - kharab jora wapas lagne par normal par ayega.

solutions.en: If no string is at fault, have a megohmmeter test done: PV+ to earth and PV- to earth should read in the megaohm range on a dry day.
solutions.ur: Agar koi string ghalat na lage to megohmmeter test karwayein: PV+ se earth aur PV- se earth ko sukhe din mein megaohm range par padhna chahiye.

notes.en: FoxESS's H1 manual names this row 'Iso Fault' but its section 6 earth-fault note calls the on-screen code 'Isolation fault' - treat the two spellings as the same code. Do not confuse with the T-series 'ISO fault' (impedance > 100 kOhm) or R-series 1124.
notes.ur: FoxESS ki H1 manual is row ko 'Iso Fault' kehti hai lekin section 6 ki earth-fault note par on-screen code 'Isolation fault' aata hai - dono spelling ek hi code samjhein. T-series ke 'ISO fault' (impedance > 100 kOhm) ya R-series ke 1124 se confuse na karein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - insulation, residual current and earth faults

meaning.en: The measured residual current on the AC side exceeded the inverter's limit, so it stopped to protect people and the earth path.
meaning.ur: AC side par measured residual current inverter ki limit se upar chala gaya, is liye unit ne logo aur earth path ko bachane ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: Same wet-weather or chafed-insulation causes as Iso Fault; this is the measured consequence of the leak.
causes.ur: Iso Fault jaisi hi geeli mausam ya gis chuki insulation ki wajahein; yeh us leak ka measured natija hai.

causes.en: Leakage through an anti-islanding or RCD-type device fitted in the wrong place, or a filter capacitor in the inverter itself.
causes.ur: Galat jagah laga hua anti-islanding ya RCD device se leakage, ya inverter ke apne filter capacitor se leakage.

causes.en: An upstream 30 mA RCD instead of the bi-directional 100 mA RCD FoxESS requires, which nuisance-trips or confuses the leakage budget.
causes.ur: FoxESS ki requirement ke mutabiq bi-directional 100 mA RCD ke bajaye upstream 30 mA RCD, jo leakage budget ko confuse karta hai.

solutions.en: Wait and re-read the code, as FoxESS directs, before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi chhune se pehle, jaise FoxESS kahe, intezar karke code dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all loads at the distribution board one by one with the inverter still running; if the alarm clears, the leak is in a downstream appliance circuit.
solutions.ur: Inverter chalta rahe karte hue distribution board se loads ek-ek karke disconnect karein; agar alarm clear ho jaye to leak kisi downstream appliance circuit mein hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the earth/PE conductor is sound and bonded at the inverter, and confirm the RCD is the FoxESS-specified bi-directional 100 mA type.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke earth/PE conductor theek hai aur inverter par bond hai, aur RCD FoxESS ke mutabiq bi-directional 100 mA type ka hai.

notes.en: In Pakistan, dawn/dusk dew and a badly earthed consumer unit are the usual real causes. The manual gives no measurement value for this code, so do not quote one.
notes.ur: Pakistan mein subah/sham ki oos aur consumer unit ka kharab earthing hi aam asal wajahein hain. Manual is code ke liye koi measurement value nahi deta, is liye koi value na batayein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - insulation, residual current and earth faults

meaning.en: The residual-current sensing circuit itself (hardware, not insulation) reported a failure, so the inverter can no longer prove it is safe.
meaning.ur: Residual current sensing circuit khud (hardware, insulation nahi) ne kharabi batayi, is liye inverter ab saabit nahi kar sakta ke wo mehfooz hai.

causes.en: The current-sensing transformer or its conditioning electronics has drifted or failed with age and heat.
causes.ur: Current-sensing transformer ya us ki conditioning electronics umar aur garmi ke saath drift ya kharab ho gayi.

causes.en: A power surge or an earlier earth-fault event that damaged the sensing board.
causes.ur: Power surge ya pehle ka koi earth-fault event jis ne sensing board nuqsaan diya.

causes.en: Moisture or insects inside the enclosure reaching the sensing board.
causes.ur: Enclosure ke andar nami ya keede sensing board tak pahunche.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely, then reconnect once as FoxESS directs.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect kar ke, jaise FoxESS kahe, aik baar wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: Open the unit only with mains and battery both dead and confirm the sensing board has no burn marks or residue before quoting a board.
solutions.ur: Unit kholein, magar sirf tab jab mains aur battery dono murda ho, aur board quote karne se pehle sensing board par burn marks ya residue check karein.

solutions.en: If it returns on an idle, dry, unloaded unit, raise a service claim with the code and serial number - this is not a wiring fault.
solutions.ur: Agar yeh khali, sukhe aur bina load ke unit par wapas aaye to code aur serial number ke saath service claim raise karein - yeh wiring fault nahi.

notes.en: Distinguish from Res Cur Fault: Res Cur Fault is a real leakage current in the installation, Res Cur HW Fault is the detector failing. Swap the inverter only after you have cleared the installation.
notes.ur: Res Cur Fault se farq karein: Res Cur Fault installation mein asal leakage current hai, Res Cur HW Fault detector ki kharabi hai. Installation saaf kiye bagair inverter mat badlein.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) - insulation, residual current and earth faults

meaning.en: The inverter measured an abnormal voltage between neutral and protective earth, or lost a proper ground reference.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne neutral aur protective earth ke darmiyan abnormal voltage naapa, ya theek ground reference kho di.

causes.en: Neutral and PE are not both correctly landed at the inverter's AC terminal, or PE is open.
causes.ur: Inverter ke AC terminal par neutral aur PE dono theek se nahi lage, ya PE khari hui hai.

causes.en: Neutral and PE are shorted together somewhere in the distribution board, which is common in improvised Pakistani wiring.
causes.ur: Distribution board mein kahin neutral aur PE aapas mein short ho gaye hain - Pakistan ke improvised wiring mein ye aam hai.

causes.en: Reversed or mis-landed conductors at the AC terminal after a rewire by a non-installer.
causes.ur: Kisi non-installer ke rewire ke baad AC terminal par conductors ulat ya ghalat lagi hui.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker, open the PV DC switch and the battery isolator, and confirm the inverter is fully dead before touching the earth bar.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karein, PV DC switch aur battery isolator kholein, aur earth bar chhune se pehle confirm karein ke inverter poori tarah murda hai.

solutions.en: Measure AC voltage between neutral and PE at the inverter; it should read near zero volts while the grid is live.
solutions.ur: Inverter par neutral aur PE ke darmiyan AC voltage napen; grid live hone ke bawajood yeqreeban zero volts ka hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Check AC wiring end to end: land PE and N separately on the inverter's own terminals, and re-torque every AC terminal.
solutions.ur: AC wiring aakhir tak check karein: PE aur N ko inverter ke apne terminals par alag alag lagayein, aur har AC terminal dobara torque karein.

notes.en: The T-series 'Ground fault' gives the same two checks (neutral-to-PE voltage, then AC wiring) but adds a PV DC switch-off step; keep the two separate. Neutral-PE shorting is a fire risk, not just a nuisance alarm.
notes.ur: T-series ka 'Ground fault' wahi do checks deta hai (neutral se PE voltage, phir AC wiring) lekin PV DC switch off ka step bhi add karta hai; dono alag rakhein. Neutral-PE short aag ka khatra hai, sirf pareshani ka alarm nahi.

source.title: H1(G2)/AC1(G2) Series User Manual V1.6, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: H3/AC3 (three-phase hybrid) - grid and phase-synchronising faults

meaning.en: The H3 has lost the grid reference on all three phases and isolated itself. On a three-phase unit this can be a single-phase dropout, not a total outage.
meaning.ur: H3 ne teenon phases par se grid reference kho diya aur khud ko alag kar liya. Three-phase unit par yeh ek phase ka dropout bhi ho sakta hai, poora outage nahi.

causes.en: Only one phase lost - a tripped 3-pole/4-pole MCB with one pole failed, or one phase conductor open in the board or at the inverter.
causes.ur: Sirf ek phase gaya - 3-pole/4-pole MCB ka aik pole kharab, ya board ya inverter par aik phase conductor khari hui.

causes.en: Total utility outage, or a loose/burnt AC terminal at the inverter or consumer unit.
causes.ur: Poora utility outage, ya inverter ya consumer unit par AC terminal loose ya burnt.

causes.en: Neutral missing or loose on a three-phase 4-wire supply, which can make the inverter lose its reference.
causes.ur: Teenon phase wale 4-wire supply par neutral missing ya loose, jis se inverter ka reference chala jata hai.

solutions.en: Check all three poles of the PV/solar board MCB individually, not just the main lever, and reset any that have tripped.
solutions.ur: PV/solar board ke MCB ke teenon poles ko alag alag check karein, sirf main lever nahi, aur jo trip hua ho reset karein.

solutions.en: With power isolated, continuity-test each phase and the neutral from the consumer unit to the inverter's GRID port; find and re-land the open one.
solutions.ur: Power isolate kar ke, consumer unit se inverter ke GRID port tak har phase aur neutral ki continuity test karein; khari hui wali dhundh kar dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Watch FoxCloud for how long the fault lasts; a sub-second dropout that repeats is a loose connection, not an outage.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein dekhein ke fault kitni der raha; aik second se bhi kam ka dobara dohra hona loose connection hai, outage nahi.

notes.en: FoxESS requires a bi-directional RCD on grid-tied ports; for a three-phase H1/H3 install that is typically a 4-pole device. Confirm the device rating against the H3 manual before swapping anything.
notes.ur: FoxESS grid-tied ports par bi-directional RCD maangta hai; teenon phase wale H1/H3 install par yeh aam tor par 4-pole hota hai. Kuch bhi badalne se pehle H3 manual ke mutabiq device ki rating confirm karein.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: H3/AC3 (three-phase hybrid) - grid and phase-synchronising faults

meaning.en: Measured grid voltage is outside the inverter's permitted window, so the H3 refuses to connect. On a three-phase unit this is checked and reported per phase.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage inverter ki ijazat window se bahar hai, is liye H3 connect nahi ho raha. Three-phase unit par yeh har phase ke liye alag check aur report hota hai.

causes.en: High export-time grid voltage, typical of a long line or a substation transformer tap set too high.
causes.ur: Export ke waqt grid voltage high - lambi line ya substation transformer ka tap zyada par hona aam wajah hai.

causes.en: One phase sagging under an unbalanced load while the other two sit normal - very common on Pakistani three-phase feeders with uneven phase loading.
causes.ur: Unbalanced load ke under aik phase gir raha hai jabke baaki do normal hain - Pakistan ke three-phase feeders par uneven phase loading ke saath yeh bohat aam hai.

causes.en: Severe dip from a large motor or generator starting on the same feeder.
causes.ur: Wahi feeder par kisi bade motor ya generator ke chalne se grid voltage gir gaya.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid to settle; the unit reconnects on its own once voltage is back in range, as FoxESS states.
solutions.ur: Grid settle hone dein; jaise FoxESS kahe voltage range mein aate hi unit khud reconnect ho jayega.

solutions.en: Clamp a multimeter on EACH phase in turn at the inverter's AC terminal and record all three readings - do not judge on one phase.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminal par ek-ek phase par clamp multimeter lagayein aur teenon readings note karein - aik phase par faisla na karein.

solutions.en: If one phase is persistently lower, redistribute the load across phases at the board, starting with the heaviest single-phase loads.
solutions.ur: Agar aik phase baar baar kam rehti hai to board par load ko phases mein baant lein, sab se bhaari single-phase loads se shuru karein.

notes.en: Pakistan's nominal three-phase supply is 415/230 V at 50 Hz. A persistent single-phase sag is usually a distribution problem, not an inverter problem - escalate to the DISCO feeder office with the three recorded readings.
notes.ur: Pakistan ki nominal three-phase supply 415/230 V 50 Hz hai. Aik phase ka mustaqal girna aam tor par distribution ka masla hai, inverter ka nahi - teenon recorded readings ke saath DISCO feeder office ko batayein.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: H3/AC3 (three-phase hybrid) - grid and phase-synchronising faults

meaning.en: Grid frequency is outside the permitted band, so the H3 has disconnected from the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency ijazat range se bahar hai, is liye H3 grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Utility frequency excursion, common during feeder load shedding or generator handover.
causes.ur: Utility frequency excursion - feeder load shedding ya generator handover ke waqt aam hai.

causes.en: Inverter running in parallel with a generator that is governing frequency poorly.
causes.ur: Inverter aise generator ke saath parallel chal raha hai jo frequency theek se control nahi kar raha.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid to return to nominal; the unit will reconnect automatically.
solutions.ur: Grid nominal par aane ka intezar karein; unit khud reconnect ho jayega.

solutions.en: Read live frequency in FoxCloud and note whether the excursions coincide with generator running hours.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein live frequency padhein aur note karein ke excursion generator chalne ke waqt hote hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: If a generator is involved, adjust its governor and set the inverter's grid-tie limits per the generator's own voltage/frequency window.
solutions.ur: Agar generator involved hai to uska governor adjust karein aur inverter ke grid-tie limits generator ke voltage/frequency window ke mutabiq set karein.

notes.en: Same remedy text as H1 and KH/KA, but keep it on the H3 series: a three-phase technician must also confirm all three phase conductors are present before blaming frequency.
notes.ur: H1 aur KH/KA jaisa hi remedy text, lekin H3 series par hi rakhein: three-phase wale technician ko frequency par blame karne se pehle teenon phase conductors ki maujoodgi bhi confirm karni hogi.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: H3/AC3 (three-phase hybrid) - grid and phase-synchronising faults

title.en: Three-phase unit fed from a single-phase AC
title.ur: Teenon phase wala unit aik phase AC se chal raha hai

meaning.en: The phase-locked loop could not lock onto a balanced three-phase reference within its time limit, which in practice means the inverter is being fed or is seeing only a single phase.
meaning.ur: Phase-locked loop apni time limit mein balanced teenon-phase reference par lock nahi kar paya, jis ka amli matlab hai ke inverter ko sirf aik phase di ja rahi hai ya woh sirf aik phase dekh raha hai.

causes.en: Installer error: a three-phase H3 wired to a single-phase supply, or only one of three phases landed at the GRID port.
causes.ur: Installer ki galti: teenon-phase H3 ko single-phase supply se jora gaya, ya GRID port par teenon mein se sirf aik phase laga.

causes.en: Two of the three phase conductors open between the consumer unit and the inverter, leaving one phase alive.
causes.ur: Consumer unit aur inverter ke darmiyan teenon phase conductors mein se do khari hui, sirf aik phase zinda.

causes.en: Severe phase unbalance or a missing neutral on a 4-wire supply so the PLL reference is not a clean sinusoid.
causes.ur: 4-wire supply par bhaari phase unbalance ya missing neutral, jis se PLL reference saaf sinusoidal nahi banta.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then confirm with a meter that all three phases AND the neutral are present at the inverter's GRID port.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir multimeter se confirm karein ke inverter ke GRID port par teenon phases aur neutral mojood hain.

solutions.en: If the site genuinely has single-phase supply, this model is the wrong unit - do not attempt to make it run; the correct part is a single-phase hybrid.
solutions.ur: Agar site par waqai single-phase supply hai to yeh model ghalat unit hai - isay chalane ki koshish na karein; theek part single-phase hybrid hai.

solutions.en: Once all phases are restored, let the unit reconnect on its own as FoxESS directs before touching any settings.
solutions.ur: Jab teenon phases wapas aa jayen, jaise FoxESS kahe settings chhune se pehle unit ko khud reconnect hone dein.

notes.en: H3-ONLY code - the string PLL_ OverTime does not appear in the H1, KH/KA or T tables. The trailing underscore in 'PLL_ OverTime' is as printed; make the lookup tolerant of PLL OverTime and PLL_OverTime.
notes.ur: Yeh sirf H3 ka code hai - 'PLL_ OverTime' string H1, KH/KA ya T ki table mein nahi hai. 'PLL_ OverTime' mein aakhir ki underscore jaisa chhapa gaya hai; lookup ko PLL OverTime aur PLL_OverTime dono ke liye tolerant rakhein.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: H3/AC3 (three-phase hybrid) - grid and phase-synchronising faults

title.en: 10-minute average grid voltage out of range
title.ur: 10 minute ka average grid voltage range se bahar

meaning.en: The rolling 10-minute average of grid voltage has been out of range. A sustained-condition protection, not a spike detector.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage ka chalta hua 10 minute ka average range se bahar chala gaya hai. Yeh mustaqil-condition protection hai, spike detector nahi.

causes.en: Sustained grid over-voltage, often with high PV export into an already-high feeder.
causes.ur: Grid ka mustaqil over-voltage - aksar already high feeder mein zyada PV export ke saath.

causes.en: Substation transformer tap set high and left uncorrected.
causes.ur: Substation transformer ka tap high set hai aur theek nahi kiya gaya.

causes.en: One phase dragging the average while the other two are high during unbalanced export.
causes.ur: Unbalanced export ke dauraan aik phase average ko neeche kheench rahi hai jabke baaki do high hain.

solutions.en: Check the 10-minute average voltage in FoxCloud and record the peak before touching anything.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein 10 minute ka average voltage dekhein aur kuch bhi chhune se pehle peak note karein.

solutions.en: Measure each phase's 10-minute average separately, because one bad phase can trip a protection that looks like a whole-inverter problem.
solutions.ur: Har phase ka 10 minute ka average alag alag napen, kyunke aik kharab phase wohi protection chala sakta hai jo poore inverter ka masla lagta hai.

solutions.en: Ask the DISCO feeder office to log grid voltage and correct the substation transformer tap - the durable fix.
solutions.ur: DISCO feeder office se grid voltage log karwa kar substation transformer tap theek karwayein - yehi permanent hal hai.

notes.en: The H3 manual's row for this code gives the same bare 'system will reconnect' remedy as H1 - it does NOT document any front-panel menu path for the limit. Do not quote an unverified settings path for this model.
notes.ur: H3 manual mein is code ki row H1 jaisa hi khulasa 'system will reconnect' hal deti hai - is limit ka koi front-panel menu path ismein likha nahi hai. Is model ke liye unverified settings path na batayein.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: H3/AC3 (three-phase hybrid) - power stage, bus and relay faults

title.en: DC bus voltage out of range (software, H3)
title.ur: DC bus voltage range se bahar (software, H3)

meaning.en: Software supervision saw the internal DC link voltage outside its safe window. On the H3 this alarm is also a prompt to verify the neutral and the master firmware, which the H1 table does not ask for.
meaning.ur: Software supervision ne internal DC link voltage ko safe window se bahar dekha. H3 par yeh alarm neutral aur master firmware check karne ka bhi ishara hai, jo H1 ki table nahi maangti.

causes.en: N line not connected to the GRID port - the H3 manual names this explicitly and it is the first thing to check on this model.
causes.ur: GRID port par N line nahi lagi - H3 manual yeh saaf-saaf batata hai aur is model par sab se pehle yahi check karein.

causes.en: Grid voltage at an extreme, so the bus cannot be held in the operating window.
causes.ur: Grid voltage bilkul extreme par, is liye bus ko operating window mein nahi rakh sakte.

causes.en: Master firmware below 1.69 - the H3 manual states this code requires master 1.69 or above.
causes.ur: Master firmware 1.69 se neeche - H3 manual kehta hai ke is code ke liye master 1.69 ya us se upar chahiye.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then with the power dead confirm the neutral conductor is solidly landed at the inverter's GRID port and the PE is sound.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir power murda kar ke confirm karein ke neutral conductor inverter ke GRID port par mazboot se laga hai aur PE theek hai.

solutions.en: Check the master firmware version in the app and update to the latest; FoxESS requires master 1.69 or above for this code.
solutions.ur: App mein master firmware version check kar ke latest par update karein; is code ke liye FoxESS ko master 1.69 ya us se upar chahiye.

solutions.en: Reconnect PV, grid and battery as FoxESS directs, and if the code returns with the neutral confirmed and firmware current, treat it as a bus/sensing fault - a workshop item.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS kahe PV, grid aur battery wapas lagayein, aur agar neutral confirm aur firmware current hone par bhi code wapas aaye to isay bus/sensing fault samjhein - ye workshop ka kaam hai.

notes.en: H3-ONLY REMEDY DIFFERENCE vs H1/AC1 and KH/KA. Do not merge with foxess-h1-ac1-g2-current, which documents the identical string with the plain disconnect/reconnect remedy and no neutral or firmware instruction.
notes.ur: H1/AC1 aur KH/KA ke muqable H3-ONLY remedy ka farq. isay foxess-h1-ac1-g2-current se merge na karein, jahan yehi string sirf disconnect/reconnect remedy ke saath hai, na neutral na firmware instruction.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: H3/AC3 (three-phase hybrid) - power stage, bus and relay faults

meaning.en: The H3's current supervision saw output current above the limit and shut down. On the H3 the manual also requires the master firmware to be checked and upgraded first.
meaning.ur: H3 ka current supervision ne output current limit se upar dekha aur band kar diya. H3 par manual yeh bhi maangta hai ke pehle master firmware check aur update kiya jaye.

causes.en: Master firmware below 1.69 - the H3 manual attaches this requirement to the row, the H1 row has no such line.
causes.ur: Master firmware 1.69 se neeche - H3 manual yeh shart is row se latka deta hai, H1 ki row mein aisi koi line nahi.

causes.en: Sudden large load step, or several single-phase loads switching on together on one phase of a three-phase supply.
causes.ur: Achanak bada load step, ya teenon-phase supply ki aik phase par kai single-phase loads ek saath on ho jana.

causes.en: Inverter paralleled beyond its permitted unit count, so current sharing between units fails.
causes.ur: Inverter ijazat se zyada units mein parallel, is liye units ke darmiyan current sharing fail.

solutions.en: Check the master firmware version and upgrade to the latest, ensuring at least master 1.69, before any other action - FoxESS puts this first for this code on H3.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi doosre qadam se pehle master firmware version check karke latest par update karein, kam az kam master 1.69 - H3 par FoxESS is code ke liye yeh sab se pehle rakhta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate fully: AC switch off, PV DC switch off, battery isolator off, then reconnect one source at a time - battery, then PV, then grid.
solutions.ur: Poori tarah isolate karein: AC switch off, PV DC switch off, battery isolator off, phir ek waqt mein ek source wapas karein - pehle battery, phir PV, phir grid.

solutions.en: If it returns with no load connected, do not keep cycling the unit - log the code and serial number and raise a service claim.
solutions.ur: Agar koi load na hone par bhi wapas aaye to unit baar baar on/off na karein - code aur serial number note karke service claim raise karein.

notes.en: H3-ONLY REMEDY DIFFERENCE: the master 1.69 line appears only in the H3 table. The KH/KA and H1 tables give the bare disconnect/reconnect for this string.
notes.ur: H3-ONLY remedy ka farq: master 1.69 wali line sirf H3 ki table mein hai. KH/KA aur H1 ki tables is string ke liye sirf disconnect/reconnect deti hain.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: H3/AC3 (three-phase hybrid) - power stage, bus and relay faults

title.en: Battery boost MOSFET or battery-side relay fault (H3)
title.ur: Battery boost MOSFET ya battery-side relay fault (H3)

meaning.en: Either the battery boost circuit MOSFET has failed, or the relay on the battery side of the inverter has not closed. FoxESS's H3 row states both as alternatives.
meaning.ur: Ya battery boost circuit ka MOSFET kharab hai, ya inverter ke battery side ka relay close nahi hua. FoxESS ki H3 row dono ko mutabaqat ke tor par likhti hai.

causes.en: The battery-side relay in the inverter has not closed - named by the H3 manual as an alternative to a failed MOSFET.
causes.ur: Inverter ka battery side relay close nahi hua - H3 manual isay failed MOSFET ke mutabaqat ke tor par likhta hai.

causes.en: Internal semiconductor failure of the boost MOSFET, commonly after a battery surge or short.
causes.ur: Boost MOSFET ki internal semiconductor kharabi, jo aksar battery surge ya short ke baad hoti hai.

causes.en: Master firmware below 1.69, which the H3 manual says can make a Boost fault appear.
causes.ur: Master firmware 1.69 se neeche, jis ke baare mein H3 manual kehta hai ke is se Boost fault aa sakta hai.

solutions.en: Check the master firmware and update to at least 1.69 first, as the H3 manual directs, then re-read the code.
solutions.ur: Pehle H3 manual ke mutabiq master firmware check kar ke kam az kam 1.69 par update karein, phir code dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then have a technician confirm the battery-side relay actually closes when commanded before condemning the MOSFET.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir MOSFET ko blame karne se pehle technician se confirm karwayein ke command par battery-side relay asal mein close hota hai.

solutions.en: If the relay closes and the code remains on master 1.69 or above, log code and serial and raise a power-board warranty claim - not a site repair.
solutions.ur: Agar relay close ho jata hai aur master 1.69 ya us se upar par bhi code qatam nahi hota to code aur serial note karke power-board warranty claim raise karein - ye site repair nahi.

notes.en: H3-ONLY: the 'relay on the battery side is not closed' alternative and the master 1.69 requirement are absent from the H1 V1.6 and KH/KA rows, which say only 'The battery boost circuit mosfet is fail'.
notes.ur: H3-ONLY: 'relay on the battery side is not closed' ka mutabaqat aur master 1.69 ki shart H1 V1.6 aur KH/KA ki rows mein nahi hain, wahan sirf 'The battery boost circuit mosfet is fail' likha hai.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: H3/AC3 (three-phase hybrid) - power stage, bus and relay faults

meaning.en: A hardware comparator detected excessive PV input current. On the H3 the manual additionally instructs the technician to check PV polarity.
meaning.ur: Hardware comparator ne zyada PV input current detect kiya. H3 par manual electrician ko PV polarity check karne ka aur instruction deta hai.

causes.en: PV positive and negative connected incorrectly on the affected MPPT - named by the H3 manual as part of this row.
causes.ur: Affected MPPT par PV positive aur negative ghalat tarah se lage - H3 manual isay is row ka hissa batata hai.

causes.en: Shading, a cracked or bypassed module, or current mismatch between the parallel strings on one MPPT.
causes.ur: Shading, toota ya bypassed module, ya aik MPPT ke parallel strings ke darmiyan current mismatch.

causes.en: A DC arc or a degraded, heat-affected MC4 crimp on a string under load.
causes.ur: Load ke under kisi string par DC arc ya garmi se kharab MC4 crimp.

solutions.en: Check whether PV positive and negative are connected, exactly as the H3 manual instructs, before anything else on this model.
solutions.ur: Is model par sab se pehle, jaise H3 manual kahe, check karein ke PV positive aur negative connected hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: With the PV DC switch off, torque-check every MC4 on the affected MPPT and replace any that are discoloured, warm or not fully seated.
solutions.ur: PV DC switch off kar ke, affected MPPT ke har MC4 ka torque check karein aur jo rang badla, garm ya puri tarah nahi lage usay replace karein.

solutions.en: Measure each string's current in FoxCloud against its neighbours to identify the mismatched string, then torque-check only that string's connectors.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein har string ka current uske padosi se compare kar ke mismatch wali string pehchanein, phir sirf usi string ke connectors ka torque check karein.

notes.en: H3-ONLY ADDITION: the polarity line appears in the H3 row only; H1 V1.6 and KH/KA give just disconnect/reconnect. Note the H3 also lists PvCon Dir Fault separately for outright reversal, so polarity here means mis-wiring within a string rather than a fully reversed string.
notes.ur: H3-ONLY addition: polarity wali line sirf H3 ki row mein hai; H1 V1.6 aur KH/KA sirf disconnect/reconnect dete hain. Note karein ke H3 mein poora reversal ke liye PvCon Dir Fault alag hai, is liye yahan polarity ka matlab string ke andar ghalat wiring hai, poori string ulatna nahi.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: H3/AC3 (three-phase hybrid) - power stage, bus and relay faults

title.en: Grid relay stuck open or closed (H3)
title.ur: Grid relay khuli ya bandi atki hui (H3)

meaning.en: The grid-side relay has failed to reach a commanded state - FoxESS's H3 row reads 'The grid relay keeps open or close', covering both failure directions in one code.
meaning.ur: Grid side ka relay command ki hui halat par nahi pohanch saka - H3 ki row kehti hai 'The grid relay keeps open or close', dono taraf ki failure aik code mein cover karti hai.

causes.en: Grid relay contact welded closed, so the inverter cannot disconnect from the grid - the more dangerous direction.
causes.ur: Grid relay ka contact weld ho kar band pada hai, is liye inverter grid se disconnect nahi ho sakta - yeh zyada khatarnaak raasta hai.

causes.en: Grid relay coil failed or contacts worn so it never closes, and the inverter cannot export.
causes.ur: Grid relay ki coil kharab ya contacts gis chuke hain is liye woh kabhi close nahi hota, aur inverter export nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Relay chattering during frequent grid outages, wearing the contacts.
causes.ur: Bari tarah se grid outages mein relay ka chatter karna, jis se contacts ghis jate hain.

causes.en: A blown DC-side control fuse in the relay drive circuit.
causes.ur: Relay drive circuit mein DC side ka control fuse udd gaya.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely before opening the enclosure - a welded grid relay means the AC side may be live from the grid.
solutions.ur: Enclosure kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect karein - weld hua grid relay matlab AC side grid se live ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the relay actually transfers: with the unit isolated, have a technician check the relay contacts for continuity closed and full separation open.
solutions.ur: Relay ke wazeeray se confirm karein: unit isolate kar ke, technician se relay contacts ki continuity band par aur poori separation khuli par check karwayein.

solutions.en: If the relay will not transfer, log the code and serial number and raise a service claim for the relay assembly - this is not a site-repairable item.
solutions.ur: Agar relay transfer hi nahi karega to code aur serial number note karke relay assembly ke liye service claim raise karein - ye site par theek nahi ho sakta.

notes.en: H3-ONLY GROUPING. H1/AC1 and KH/KA split the same physical problem into FOUR codes with per-relay wording: 'Main Relay Open' (the grid relay keeps open), 'S1 Close Fault', 'S2 Close Fault', 'M1 Close Fault', 'M2 Close Fault' (the grid relay S1/S2/M1/M2 keep close). None of those five strings appear anywhere in the H3 text. A Pakistani H3 owner will never see 'S1 Close Fault'.
notes.ur: H3-ONLY grouping. H1/AC1 aur KH/KA wohi maslay ko CHAAR codes mein torate hain: 'Main Relay Open' (grid relay keeps open), 'S1 Close Fault', 'S2 Close Fault', 'M1 Close Fault', 'M2 Close Fault' (grid relay S1/S2/M1/M2 keep close). In paanchon strings mein se koi bhi H3 ke text mein nahi hai. Pakistan ke H3 owner ko 'S1 Close Fault' kabhi nazar nahi aayega.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: H3/AC3 (three-phase hybrid) - power stage, bus and relay faults

meaning.en: The battery relay inside the inverter did not close, so the pack is electrically disconnected from the unit even though it is connected and charged.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka battery relay close nahi hua, is liye pack unit se electrically juda hua hai halke woh lagna hua aur charged bhi hai.

causes.en: Relay coil or driver failed, so the relay never receives or obeys the close command.
causes.ur: Relay ki coil ya driver kharab, is liye relay ko close command milta hi nahi ya obey nahi karta.

causes.en: The BMS has not permitted a close because the pack is outside its voltage or temperature window.
causes.ur: BMS ne close ki ijazat nahi di kyunke pack apne voltage ya temperature window se bahar hai.

causes.en: The battery voltage is too low or too high for the inverter to safely close onto the pack.
causes.ur: Battery voltage itna kam ya zyada hai ke inverter pack par mehfoozana close hi nahi kar sakta.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reconnect as FoxESS directs and re-read the code after 60 seconds.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect kar ke jaise FoxESS kahe wapas lagayein aur 60 second baad code dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage at the inverter's battery terminals and confirm it sits inside the range the manual lists before condemning the relay.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke battery terminals par battery voltage napen aur confirm karein ke woh manual mein likhi range mein hai, phir relay par blame karein.

solutions.en: Read the pack SOC and any BMS code in FoxCloud; if a BMS code is present the pack, not the relay, is holding the line open.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein pack ka SOC aur koi BMS code padhein; agar BMS code mojood hai to relay nahi, pack line ko khuli rok kar baitha hai.

notes.en: Verified present on H1 V1.6, KH/KA (both copies) and H3 V1.0.4, with the identical wording 'The battery relay keeps open' and identical remedy. An earlier draft in this file wrongly claimed H1 does not list it - that was incorrect and is corrected in the Series 3 notes.
notes.ur: H1 V1.6, KH/KA (dono copies) aur H3 V1.0.4 par verify hua, wohi wording 'The battery relay keeps open' aur wohi remedy ke saath. Is file ke pichle draft ne ghalat kaha tha ke H1 isay nahi likhta - ghalti thi aur Series 3 ke notes mein theek kar di gayi hai.

source.title: H3/AC3 Series User Manual V1.0.4 (2025-01-07), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - battery pack mismatch and pack hardware faults

title.ur: Battery pack ki capacity/type mismatch hai

meaning.en: Packs of different capacity or type are paralleled in the same system, so the BMSes cannot be balanced by the inverter.
meaning.ur: Aik hi system mein alag alag capacity ya type ke packs parallel lage hain, is liye BMSes ko inverter balance nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: A second pack of a different capacity or a different model added to an existing install, which is the normal cause in Pakistan.
causes.ur: Maujooda install mein alag capacity ya alag model ka doosra pack shamil kiya gaya - Pakistan mein yehi aam wajah hai.

causes.en: A failed pack was replaced with a different type and the old one was not removed from the parallel chain.
causes.ur: Kharab pack ki jagah alag type ka lagaya gaya aur purana pack parallel chain se nahi nikala gaya.

causes.en: Mixed chemistry packs paralleled, which the BMS cannot manage even at the same nominal capacity.
causes.ur: Alag chemistry ke packs parallel lage, jinhein BMS wahi nominal capacity par bhi manage nahi kar sakta.

solutions.en: Read every pack's model and rated capacity in FoxCloud and list them; KH/KA's instruction is 'Please contact our service department', so have this list ready for that call.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein har pack ka model aur rated capacity likhein; KH/KA ka instruction hai 'Please contact our service department', is liye yeh list us call ke liye tayyar rakhein.

solutions.en: Isolate the battery and remove packs one at a time, powering up the remainder to prove which pack is the odd one out.
solutions.ur: Battery isolate kar ke packs aik-ik kar ke nikalein, baqi ko power up kar ke sabit karein ke kaun sa pack mukhtalif hai.

solutions.en: Run the system only on packs of identical model and capacity until the mismatched pack is replaced - do not mix capacities to gain headroom.
solutions.ur: Mukhtalif pack badalne tak system ko sirf bilkul aik jaise model aur capacity wale packs par chalayein - capacity jorr kar headroom lene ki koshish na karein.

notes.en: This is one of the most common real battery complaints on KH/KA in Pakistan and it is 100% a purchasing/install problem, not a fault of the inverter. The manual offers no field test at all for it.
notes.ur: Yeh KH/KA par Pakistan mein sab se aam asal battery shikayat hai aur yeh 100% khareed ya install ka masla hai, inverter ka fault bilkul nahi. Manual is ke liye koi field test deta hi nahi.

source.title: KH/KA Series User Manual (AU, 2025-10-21), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - battery pack mismatch and pack hardware faults

title.ur: Battery packs ke software versions alag hain

meaning.en: The slave packs in the parallel chain are running different BMS firmware versions from each other.
meaning.ur: Parallel chain ke slave packs aik doosre se alag alag BMS firmware versions par chal rahe hain.

causes.en: A pack was added later and shipped with a newer BMS firmware than the packs already installed.
causes.ur: Baad mein pack shamil kiya gaya aur us ka BMS firmware maujooda packs se naya tha.

causes.en: A pack's firmware update was interrupted, leaving it on a different version from its siblings.
causes.ur: Kisi pack ka firmware update adhoora reh gaya, is liye woh apne bhaiyon se alag version par hai.

solutions.en: Read each pack's BMS firmware version in FoxCloud and write down every pack that differs from the majority.
solutions.ur: FoxCloud mein har pack ka BMS firmware version padhein aur aksariyat se alag har pack note kar lein.

solutions.en: Update the differing pack's BMS firmware through the app or the supplier's update tool, one pack at a time with the rest of the chain isolated.
solutions.ur: Alag pack ka BMS firmware app ya supplier ke update tool se update karein, aik pack aik waqt, baqi chain isolate kar ke.

solutions.en: Do not parallel packs with mixed versions to 'see if it works' - if it does work the packs will be permanently unbalanced, so get the versions matched first.
solutions.ur: Mixed versions wale packs parallel kar ke 'dekhte hain chalta hai ya nahi' na karein - agar chal jaye to packs hamesha ke liye unbalanced rahein ge, is liye pehle versions match karein.

notes.en: Distinct from 'Bms M&S Unmatch' on the same table, which is the MASTER-versus-SLAVE version mismatch. Both are version problems but they are different comparisons and both must be cleared.
notes.ur: Yehi table ke 'Bms M&S Unmatch' se mukhtalif hai, jo MASTER aur SLAVE ke darmiyan version mismatch hai. Dono version ke masle hain lekin alag alag comparison hain, aur dono clear karne zaroori hain.

source.title: KH/KA Series User Manual (AU, 2025-10-21), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - battery pack mismatch and pack hardware faults

title.ur: Battery cells alag alag manufacturers ke hain

meaning.en: The cells inside the paralleled packs were made by different manufacturers, so their cell characteristics cannot be balanced.
meaning.ur: Parallel lage packs ke andar ke cells alag alag manufacturers ke banaye gaye hain, is liye un ki cell characteristics balance nahi ho saktin.

causes.en: Packs sourced from different production batches or suppliers with different cell makers - common when packs are bought over time.
causes.ur: Alag alag batches ya suppliers se liye packs jin ke cell makers alag hain - waqt ke saath packs khareedne par yeh aam hai.

causes.en: An aftermarket or re-potted pack mixed in with genuine FoxESS ECS packs.
causes.ur: Asli FoxESS ECS packs ke saath koi aftermarket ya dobara pot kiya hua pack mila diya gaya.

solutions.en: Check the cell manufacturer printed on each pack's label and list them; do not rely on the inverter to identify which pack is at fault.
solutions.ur: Har pack ke label par likha cell manufacturer check kar ke list banayein; ye mat samjhein ke inverter khud identify kar lega ke kaun sa pack kharab hai.

solutions.en: Separate the packs by manufacturer and run only same-manufacturer packs until the mixed pack is removed or replaced.
solutions.ur: Packs ko manufacturer ke hisaab se alag karein aur sirf aik hi manufacturer ke packs chalayein jab tak mixed pack nahi nikal jaata ya badal nahi jaata.

solutions.en: If the packs cannot be identified by label, have the supplier open and read the cell date codes and maker codes rather than guessing from behaviour.
solutions.ur: Agar label se packs pehchan na aa jayen to supplier se kholwa kar cell date codes aur maker codes parwayein, behaviour se andaza lagane ke bajaye.

notes.en: This is the 'hidden' one for Pakistani installers because all four packs look identical from the outside. The inverter will report this before any cell damage occurs, so treat it as a stop-and-quarantine condition, not a nuisance.
notes.ur: Yeh Pakistan ke installer ke liye 'chhupi hui' masla hai kyunke chaaron packs bahar se bilkul aik jaise lagte hain. Koi cell nuqsaan hone se pehle inverter yeh report kar deta hai, is liye isay nuisance nahi, rok kar alag karne ki halat samjhein.

source.title: KH/KA Series User Manual (AU, 2025-10-21), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - battery pack mismatch and pack hardware faults

title.ur: Battery cell ki capacities alag hain

meaning.en: Cells inside the pack have unequal capacities, so the pack cannot deliver a balanced pack voltage and the BMS limits the pack.
meaning.ur: Pack ke andar cells ki capacities barabar nahi hain, is liye pack balanced pack voltage nahi de sakta aur BMS pack ko limit kar deta hai.

causes.en: Normal end-of-life divergence between cells after many charge cycles, the most common real cause.
causes.ur: Bohat se charge cycles ke baad cells mein aam taur par umar ke aakhir ka farq - sab se aam asal wajah.

causes.en: One or more cells with high internal resistance from a past deep discharge or heat event.
causes.ur: Pichle gehle discharge ya garmi ke baad kuch cells ka internal resistance barh gaya.

causes.en: Pack stored at low SOC for months before installation, so cells have drifted apart before first use.
causes.ur: Pack install hone se pehle mahinon tak low SOC par raha, is liye pehle use se hi cells alag ho chuke hain.

solutions.en: Follow the KH/KA instruction and contact FoxESS service - the manual offers no balancing routine for this code at all.
solutions.ur: KH/KA ka instruction follow karke FoxESS service se rabta karein - manual is code ke liye bilkul koi balancing tareeqa nahi deta.

solutions.en: Before the call, leave the pack on float charge with PV generating until SOC reaches 100% and stays there, then re-read the code; a pack that recovers was only out of balance.
solutions.ur: Call se pehle, PV generate karte hue pack ko float charge par chhodein jab tak SOC 100% tak pohanch kar wahan theek na rahe, phir code dobara dekhein; jis pack ka theek hua woh sirf imbalance tha.

solutions.en: If the imbalance returns after a full charge, the pack has a failed cell - do not keep cycling it, as that drives the good cells into over-voltage.
solutions.ur: Agar poori charge ke baad imbalance wapas aaye to pack mein koi cell kharab hai - baar baar use na chalayein, us se acche cells over-voltage mein chale jate hain.

notes.en: Dangerous in a Pakistani summer context: continuing to cycle an imbalanced pack over-cooks the good cells and can lead to thermal runaway. Treat a repeat code as a stop condition.
notes.ur: Pakistan ke garmi ke maujhaam mein yeh khatarnaak hai: imbalance wali pack ko chalate rehne se acche cells garm ho kar over-heat karte hain aur thermal runaway ho sakta hai. Baar baar aane wale code ko rokne ki halat samjhein.

source.title: KH/KA Series User Manual (AU, 2025-10-21), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - battery pack mismatch and pack hardware faults

meaning.en: The pack's own BMS has latched a hardware-level protection - this is the pack protecting itself, and the inverter is only relaying the message.
meaning.ur: Pack ka apna BMS hardware-level protection par latch ho gaya hai - yeh pack khud apni hifazat kar raha hai, inverter sirf message pohanch raha hai.

causes.en: Pack contactor or internal relay has welded or failed, so the BMS cut the pack out.
causes.ur: Pack ka contactor ya internal relay weld ya kharab ho gaya, is liye BMS ne pack kaat diya.

causes.en: A fuse inside the pack has blown on an over-current event.
causes.ur: Kisi over-current event par pack ke andar ka fuse udd gaya.

causes.en: A sensing channel has failed, so the BMS cannot trust its own measurements and latches protectively.
causes.ur: Koi sensing channel kharab ho gaya, is liye BMS apne par readings par bharosa nahi karke protectively latch kar deta hai.

solutions.en: Contact FoxESS service, exactly as the KH/KA table instructs ('Please contact our service department') - this code is explicitly an escalation item, not a field fix.
solutions.ur: KH/KA table jaise kahe ('Please contact our service department') FoxESS service se rabta karein - is code ko saaf-saaf escalation ka maal kaha gaya hai, field ka hal nahi.

solutions.en: Open the battery isolator and, if FoxESS service asks, confirm which protection is latched by reading the pack's own BMS history in FoxCloud.
solutions.ur: Battery isolator kholein, aur FoxESS service ke poochne par FoxCloud mein pack ka apna BMS history parh kar confirm karein ke kaun si protection latch hai.

solutions.en: Do not repeatedly force-charge or deep-discharge the pack to 'clear' a hardware protection; with a welded contactor that is how packs are destroyed.
solutions.ur: Hardware protection 'clear' karne ke liye baar baar force-charge ya deep-discharge na karein; weld hua contactor ho to us tarah packs tabah hote hain.

notes.en: Distinct from 'Bms HW Protect' being confused with the inverter's own 'HW Bat Cur Fault' or 'HW Bus Vol Fault'. This code is on the BATTERY side. The inverter-side hardware codes are in foxess-h1-ac1-g2-current and mean something completely different.
notes.ur: 'Bms HW Protect' ko inverter ke apne 'HW Bat Cur Fault' ya 'HW Bus Vol Fault' se confuse na karein. Yeh code BATTERY side ka hai. Inverter side ke hardware codes foxess-h1-ac1-g2-current mein hain aur bilkul alag baat hain.

source.title: KH/KA Series User Manual (AU, 2025-10-21), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - battery pack mismatch and pack hardware faults

meaning.en: The pack's BMS detected an insulation fault inside the battery pack itself, not in the PV array or the AC wiring.
meaning.ur: Pack ke BMS ne battery pack ke andar insulation fault detect kiya, PV array ya AC wiring mein nahi.

causes.en: Moisture or electrolyte ingress inside the pack from a leak, a cracked cell or a failed seal.
causes.ur: Pack ke andar kisi leak, toote cell ya failed seal se nami ya electrolyte ka dakhil.

causes.en: Cell internal short to the case, usually after deep discharge damage or an impact.
causes.ur: Cell ka case ke sath internal short - aam tor par gehle discharge ke nuqsaan ya kisi impact ke baad.

causes.en: Damage to the pack's internal wiring or busbar insulation from a rough installation.
causes.ur: Rough installation se pack ki internal wiring ya busbar insulation ka nuqsaan.

solutions.en: Open the battery isolator and leave it open; this is a live-safety condition, not a nuisance alarm, and the pack should not be reconnected.
solutions.ur: Battery isolator kholein aur khuli chhor dein; yeh live-safety ki halat hai, nuisance alarm nahi, aur pack dobara nahi jona chahiye.

solutions.en: Contact FoxESS service, as the KH/KA table instructs - the phrase is 'Please contact our service department', not the battery supplier wording used on H1/H3.
solutions.ur: KH/KA table jaise kahe FoxESS service se rabta karein - wording hai 'Please contact our service department', woh nahi jo H1/H3 par battery supplier ka hai.

solutions.en: Do not attempt an insulation test on the pack yourself; the pack must be opened or returned by someone qualified, and opening a battery pack is hazardous.
solutions.ur: Pack par khud insulation test na karein; pack kisi qualified ke zariye kholwana ya wapas karna hoga, aur battery pack kholna khatarnaak kaam hai.

notes.en: DO NOT confuse with the inverter's own 'Iso Fault' (foxess-h1-ac1-g2-insulation) or the T-series 'ISO fault'. Those are PV/AC insulation measured by the INVERTER. Bms Insul Fault is inside the BATTERY. A technician who applies the inverter insulation procedure to this code will get a wrong and unsafe answer.
notes.ur: Inverter ke apne 'Iso Fault' (foxess-h1-ac1-g2-insulation) ya T-series ke 'ISO fault' se confuse na karein. Woh PV/AC insulation hai jo INVERTER naapta hai. Bms Insul Fault BATTERY ke andar hai. Jo technician is code par inverter wala insulation tareeqa lagaye ga uska jawab ghalat aur khatarnaak hoga.

source.title: KH/KA Series User Manual (AU, 2025-10-21), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - parallel-system relay and sampling-consistency faults

title.en: Grid relay stayed open on KH/KA
title.ur: KH/KA par grid relay khuli hi rahi

meaning.en: The main grid relay inside the inverter did not reach the closed state, so the unit cannot tie into the grid.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka main grid relay closed halat par nahi pohanch saka, is liye unit grid se nahi jud sakta.

causes.en: Grid relay contact welded open, or the relay coil/driver has failed so it never closes.
causes.ur: Grid relay ka contact weld hua hai aur khula pada hai, ya relay ki coil/driver kharab hai is liye woh kabhi close nahi hota.

causes.en: The relay drive circuit's DC control fuse has blown.
causes.ur: Relay drive circuit ka DC control fuse udd gaya hai.

causes.en: Relay wear from chattering through repeated grid outages, common on an unstable supply.
causes.ur: Baar baar grid outages mein relay ka chattering aur us se wear, jo unstable supply par aam hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely, then reconnect in the order FoxESS states and re-read the code.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect karein, phir jaise FoxESS kahe wapas lagayein aur code dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: With power dead, check the relay drive fuse and the relay coil supply at the board; a blown fuse here is a five-minute fix.
solutions.ur: Power murda kar ke, board par relay drive fuse aur relay coil supply check karein; yahan udd hua fuse paanch minute ka kaam hai.

solutions.en: If the relay will not close, log code and serial number and raise a service claim for the relay assembly - not a site repair.
solutions.ur: Agar relay close hi na ho to code aur serial number note karke relay assembly ke liye service claim raise karein - ye site repair nahi.

notes.en: DOES NOT EXIST ON H3. The H3 manual has no 'Main Relay Open' string; a three-phase H3 with a grid relay problem reports 'Grid Relay Fault' instead. Give H3 owners that string, never this one.
notes.ur: H3 par yeh mojood hi nahi hai. H3 manual mein 'Main Relay Open' string nahi hai; teenon-phase H3 mein grid relay ka masla 'Grid Relay Fault' batata hai. H3 owner ko wohi string dein, ye nahi.

source.title: KH/KA Series User Manual (AU, 2025-10-21), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - parallel-system relay and sampling-consistency faults

title.ur: Grid relay S1 band hi pada

meaning.en: The grid relay designated S1 in the inverter is stuck in the closed position instead of opening when commanded.
meaning.ur: Inverter mein S1 ke naam se jaane wala grid relay command par khulne ke bajaye band hi pada reh gaya hai.

causes.en: S1 relay contacts welded closed - a genuine safety fault because the inverter cannot isolate from the grid.
causes.ur: S1 relay ke contacts weld hokar band pade hain - yeh asli safety fault hai kyunke inverter grid se alag nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: S1 relay driver or coil failed in the closed-output state.
causes.ur: S1 relay ka driver ya coil band output ki halat mein kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Mechanical binding of the relay armature from dust, humidity or insect ingress in the enclosure.
causes.ur: Enclosure mein dhool, nami ya keedon se relay ki armature mein mechanical binding.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely and confirm the inverter is dead before opening it; a welded S1 means AC may still be energised.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect karke confirm karein ke inverter murda hai, phir kholein; weld hua S1 matlab AC ab bhi energised ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: With power dead, check the S1 relay contacts for continuity when the relay is commanded open - a continuous reading means welded.
solutions.ur: Power murda kar ke, relay ko khulne ka command de kar S1 relay contacts ki continuity check karein - mustaqil reading matlab weld hai.

solutions.en: Replace the relay assembly rather than the single relay if two or more of S1/S2/M1/M2 report together, and log all codes for the claim.
solutions.ur: Agar S1/S2/M1/M2 mein se do ya zyada aik saath report karein to aik relay ke bajaye relay assembly badlein, aur claim ke liye tamam codes note karein.

notes.en: S1/S2 are the two phase-side grid relays and M1/M2 the corresponding main-side relays on KH/KA's internal switching. FoxESS does not publish which physical relay is which in the alarm table - confirm the layout from the unit's wiring diagram before ordering a part.
notes.ur: KH/KA ke andar S1/S2 phase-side grid relays hain aur M1/M2 un ke mutabiq main-side relays. FoxESS alarm table mein yeh nahi batata ke kaun sa physical relay kaun sa hai - part mangwane se pehle unit ke wiring diagram se layout confirm karein.

source.title: KH/KA Series User Manual (AU, 2025-10-21), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - parallel-system relay and sampling-consistency faults

title.ur: Grid relay S2 band hi pada

meaning.en: The grid relay designated S2 in the inverter is stuck in the closed position instead of opening when commanded.
meaning.ur: Inverter mein S2 ke naam se jaane wala grid relay command par khulne ke bajaye band hi pada reh gaya hai.

causes.en: S2 relay contacts welded closed, so the inverter cannot isolate from the grid.
causes.ur: S2 relay ke contacts weld hokar band pade hain, is liye inverter grid se alag nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: S2 relay driver or coil failed in the closed-output state.
causes.ur: S2 relay ka driver ya coil band output ki halat mein kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Relay armature binding from dust, humidity or insects inside the enclosure.
causes.ur: Enclosure ke andar dhool, nami ya keedon se relay ki armature binding.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely and confirm the inverter is dead before opening the enclosure.
solutions.ur: Enclosure kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect karke confirm karein ke inverter murda hai.

solutions.en: With power dead and S2 commanded open, measure continuity across the S2 contacts; a continuous reading confirms a welded contact.
solutions.ur: Power murda kar ke, S2 ko khulne ka command de kar S2 contacts ke aar paas continuity napen; mustaqil reading welded contact confirm karti hai.

solutions.en: If S1 and S2 both report, treat the relay assembly as one unit and quote both codes on the service claim.
solutions.ur: Agar S1 aur S2 dono report karein to relay assembly ko aik hi unit samjhein aur service claim par dono codes likhein.

notes.en: S1 and S2 are the same failure mode on two different relays. Do not send a technician to diagnose 'S2' as a new fault - ask immediately whether S1 also reported, because that changes the answer from 'replace a relay' to 'replace the assembly'.
notes.ur: S1 aur S2 do alag relays par wohi failure mode hain. Technician ko 'S2' ko naya fault samajh kar diagnose karne na bhejein - turant poochhein ke S1 ne bhi report kiya tha ya nahi, kyunke is se jawab 'relay badlein' se 'assembly badlein' ho jata hai.

source.title: KH/KA Series User Manual (AU, 2025-10-21), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - parallel-system relay and sampling-consistency faults

title.ur: Grid relay M1 band hi pada

meaning.en: The main-side grid relay designated M1 is stuck closed instead of opening when commanded.
meaning.ur: Main-side ka grid relay M1 command par khulne ke bajaye band hi pada reh gaya hai.

causes.en: M1 relay contacts welded closed.
causes.ur: M1 relay ke contacts weld hokar band pade hain.

causes.en: M1 relay driver or coil failed in the closed-output state.
causes.ur: M1 relay ka driver ya coil band output ki halat mein kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Relay armature binding from dust, humidity or insects inside the enclosure.
causes.ur: Enclosure ke andar dhool, nami ya keedon se relay armature binding.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely and confirm the inverter is dead before opening the enclosure.
solutions.ur: Enclosure kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect karke confirm karein ke inverter murda hai.

solutions.en: With power dead and M1 commanded open, measure continuity across the M1 contacts to distinguish a welded contact from a driver failure.
solutions.ur: Power murda kar ke, M1 ko khulne ka command de kar M1 contacts ke aar paas continuity napen, taake welded contact aur driver failure mein farq ho sake.

solutions.en: If the contacts are healthy, the driver is the fault - log the code and raise a service claim rather than swapping relays blindly.
solutions.ur: Agar contacts theek hain to driver kharab hai - relay ko andheray mein badalne ke bajaye code note karke service claim raise karein.

notes.en: M1 and M2 are the main-side counterparts of S1 and S2. FoxESS's KH/KA table gives all four the identical remedy, so the manual alone cannot tell you whether the contact or the driver has failed - the continuity test above is the discriminator.
notes.ur: M1 aur M2 S1 aur S2 ke main-side counterparts hain. FoxESS ki KH/KA table chaaron ko bilkul wohi remedy deti hai, is liye manual se yeh nahi pata chalta ke contact kharab hai ya driver - upar wala continuity test hi farq karne wala hai.

source.title: KH/KA Series User Manual (AU, 2025-10-21), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - parallel-system relay and sampling-consistency faults

title.ur: Grid relay M2 band hi pada

meaning.en: The main-side grid relay designated M2 is stuck closed instead of opening when commanded.
meaning.ur: Main-side ka grid relay M2 command par khulne ke bajaye band hi pada reh gaya hai.

causes.en: M2 relay contacts welded closed.
causes.ur: M2 relay ke contacts weld hokar band pade hain.

causes.en: M2 relay driver or coil failed in the closed-output state.
causes.ur: M2 relay ka driver ya coil band output ki halat mein kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Relay armature binding from dust, humidity or insects inside the enclosure.
causes.ur: Enclosure ke andar dhool, nami ya keedon se relay armature binding.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery completely and confirm the inverter is dead before opening the enclosure.
solutions.ur: Enclosure kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery poori tarah disconnect karke confirm karein ke inverter murda hai.

solutions.en: With power dead and M2 commanded open, measure continuity across the M2 contacts; continuous means welded, open means the driver or coil.
solutions.ur: Power murda kar ke, M2 ko khulne ka command de kar M2 contacts ke aar paas continuity napen; mustaqil matlab weld, khuli matlab driver ya coil.

solutions.en: Log the code and serial number and raise a service claim for whichever part the test implicates - do not replace relays in pairs without evidence.
solutions.ur: Code aur serial number note karke jis part ko test implicate kare usi ke liye service claim raise karein - bina saboot ke relays joray mein na badlein.

notes.en: If all four of S1, S2, M1 and M2 report at once, the likely single cause is the relay driver board supply, not four failed relays. Check that supply before quoting parts.
notes.ur: Agar S1, S2, M1 aur M2 chaaron aik saath report karein to aik hi wajah relay driver board ki supply hai, chaar relays ke kharab hona nahi. Parts quote karne se pehle wo supply check karein.

source.title: KH/KA Series User Manual (AU, 2025-10-21), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: KH/KA (single-phase hybrid) - parallel-system relay and sampling-consistency faults

title.ur: Units ke darmiyan DC-component sample ka mismatch

meaning.en: In a parallel KH/KA system, the master and slave units are measuring different DC-component values in the output current, so the inverter refuses to run.
meaning.ur: Parallel KH/KA system mein master aur slave units output current mein mukhtalif DC-component values naap rahe hain, is liye inverter chalna mana kar deta hai.

causes.en: One unit's current-sensing channel has drifted, so it genuinely sees a different DC offset from the others.
causes.ur: Aik unit ka current-sensing channel drift ho gaya hai, is liye woh doosron se asal mein mukhtalif DC offset dekhta hai.

causes.en: The CAN link between units is degraded, so the sampled values the units compare are stale or corrupt.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan CAN link kharaab hai, is liye jo sampled values compare kiye jate hain woh purane ya corrupt hain.

causes.en: Units at different firmware versions, so their sampling and thresholds differ.
causes.ur: Units alag alag firmware versions par hain, is liye un ka sampling aur threshold alag hain.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reconnect as FoxESS directs and re-read the code before touching anything inside.
solutions.ur: Andar kuch chhune se pehle AC, PV aur battery disconnect kar ke jaise FoxESS kahe wapas lagayein aur code dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: Check every CAN link between paralleled units: reseat both ends and confirm the cable is the shielded type run away from AC power cabling.
solutions.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan har CAN link check karein: dono taraf wapas baithayein aur cable shielded type ka hai yeh confirm karein, woh AC power wiring se door chala hua ho.

solutions.en: Confirm all paralleled units report the same firmware version in the app; update any that differ, then re-test.
solutions.ur: App mein confirm karein ke tamam parallel units aik hi firmware version bata rahe hain; jo alag hon unhein update kar ke dobara test karein.

notes.en: The KH/KA table has FOUR sibling consistency codes with identical remedies: 'The grid voltage sample value between master and slave is not consistent' (GridV Cons Fault), 'The grid frequency sample value...' (GridF Cons Fault), 'The dci sample value...' (Dci Cons Fault) and 'The residual current sample value...' (Rc Cons Fault). Only Dci is expanded here for budget reasons. H3 HAS NONE of them.
notes.ur: KH/KA table mein CHAAR sibling consistency codes hain jin ki remedies bilkul wohi hain: 'The grid voltage sample value between master and slave is not consistent' (GridV Cons Fault), 'The grid frequency sample value...' (GridF Cons Fault), 'The dci sample value...' (Dci Cons Fault) aur 'The residual current sample value...' (Rc Cons Fault). Sirf Dci yahan budget ki wajah se expand kiya gaya hai. H3 mein in mein se koi bhi nahi hai.

source.title: KH/KA Series User Manual (AU, 2025-10-21), section 9.1 Alarm List

codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 - LED indicator panel states (status, not faults)

title.en: R: red alarm LED steady on
title.ur: R: laal alarm LED chala hua

meaning.en: The red alarm LED is lit steadily, which the manual defines simply as 'An alarm is generated'. It tells you a fault exists but not which one.
meaning.ur: Laal alarm LED chala hua hai, jise manual bilkul 'An alarm is generated' define karta hai. Yeh batata hai ke fault maujood hai, kaun sa nahi.

causes.en: Any active entry in the 8.2 alarm list - the LED is a single shared indicator, not per-code.
causes.ur: 8.2 alarm list ka koi bhi active entry - yeh LED aik hi shared indicator hai, har code ka apna nahi.

causes.en: On a unit with no app or logger access, the technician simply has no way to identify the code from the panel alone.
causes.ur: Aisi unit par jahan app ya logger ki dastrasht nahi hai, technician ko sirf panel se code pehchanne ka koi tareeqa hi nahi milta.

solutions.en: Read the fault code from the inverter's information panel or the app before doing anything - the LED gives no code number.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi karne se pehle inverter ke information panel ya app se fault code parhein - LED koi code number nahi deta.

solutions.en: If no app or logger is fitted, connect one temporarily or use the inverter's own display; do not start disconnecting strings on the strength of the red LED alone.
solutions.ur: Agar koi app ya logger nahi laga to aik waqt ke liye wapas laga dein ya inverter ka apna display istemal karein; sirf laal LED ke bharose par strings khulna shuru na karein.

solutions.en: Once the numeric code is known, look it up in the R-Series 8.2 table rather than guessing - 1030, 1035, 1065 and 1124 all light the same LED.
solutions.ur: Jab numeric code pata chal jaye to usay R-Series ki 8.2 table mein dekhein, andaza na lagayein - 1030, 1035, 1124 aur 1170 sab aik hi LED jalate hain.

codes.blinkPattern: Alarm LED red, steady on (no blink)

notes.en: The H1, KH/KA and H3 manuals mention a RED LED only once each, in the section 6 note that an earth-fault alarm lights it. There is no published LED status table on those lines, so a Pakistani hybrid owner cannot use this series.
notes.ur: H1, KH/KA aur H3 manuals laal LED ka zikr sirf aik baar karte hain - section 6 ki note mein ke earth-fault alarm isay jalata hai. Un lines par koi LED status table publish nahi hai, is liye Pakistan ke hybrid owner is series ka istemal nahi kar sakte.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 3.4 LED Indicator Panel (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.uid: foxess/foxess-r-led-status/LED B (Grid indicator, light blue) OFF
codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 - LED indicator panel states (status, not faults)
codes.code: LED B (Grid indicator, light blue) OFF
codes.codeNorm: LED B GRID INDICATOR LIGHT BLUE OFF
aliases: LED B (Grid indicator, light blue) OFF

title.en: R: grid LED off - grid voltage not in range
title.ur: R: grid LED band - grid voltage range mein nahi

meaning.en: The manual defines LED B Off as 'Grid voltage is not in normal range. The solar inverter is not in grid-tied mode.' This is a status, not an alarm code.
meaning.ur: Manual LED B Off ko define karta hai 'Grid voltage is not in normal range. The solar inverter is not in grid-tied mode.' Yeh status hai, alarm code nahi.

causes.en: Grid voltage genuinely out of range - the normal reason the unit is not grid-tied.
causes.ur: Grid voltage waqai range se bahar - unit grid-tied na hone ki aam wajah.

causes.en: AC side isolated by the installer, which is indistinguishable from a supply problem by LED alone.
causes.ur: Installer ne AC side isolate kiya ho, jo sirf LED se dekh kar supply ke masle se alag nahi kiya ja sakta.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the inverter's AC terminals to find out whether the grid is genuinely bad or the AC side has been deliberately isolated.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminals par grid voltage napen taake pata chale ke grid waqai kharab hai ya AC side jaan boojh kar isolate kiya gaya hai.

solutions.en: If voltage is good but the LED is off, check the grid breaker and the AC-side contactor before suspecting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage theek hai lekin LED band hai to inverter par shak karne se pehle grid breaker aur AC-side contactor check karein.

solutions.en: Only escalate to a grid code such as 1040 or 1051 once the measured voltage confirms the grid is at fault.
solutions.ur: Sirf tab 1040 ya 1051 jaise grid code par jaayein jab naapa hua voltage yeh confirm kar de ke grid hi kharab hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Grid LED light blue, off (steady dark)

notes.en: Note the three-state logic: LED B STEADY ON means grid-tied, BLINKING (1s on / 1s off) means grid voltage normal but NOT grid-tied, OFF means grid voltage not normal. 'Not grid-tied' therefore has two very different causes and the blink state is the discriminator.
notes.ur: Teen-halat ka logic note karein: LED B STEADY ON ka matlab grid-tied, BLINKING (1s on / 1s off) ka matlab grid voltage normal lekin grid-tied NAHI, OFF ka matlab grid voltage normal nahi. Is liye 'grid-tied na hona' do bilkul alag wajahon ka hota hai aur blink state hi discriminator hai.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 3.4 LED Indicator Panel (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.uid: foxess/foxess-r-led-status/LED C (PID Recovery indicator, light blue) BLINKING
codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 - LED indicator panel states (status, not faults)
codes.code: LED C (PID Recovery indicator, light blue) BLINKING
codes.codeNorm: LED C PID RECOVERY INDICATOR LIGHT BLUE BLINKING
aliases: LED C (PID Recovery indicator, light blue) BLINKING

title.ur: R: PID recovery ka alarm chal raha hai

meaning.en: The manual defines LED C blinking (1s on / 1s off) as 'An alarm of PID recovery is generated'. Steady On means PID recovery is on; Off means it is off.
meaning.ur: Manual LED C ko blink karte (1s on / 1s off) 'An alarm of PID recovery is generated' define karta hai. Steady On ka matlab PID recovery on hai; Off ka matlab off hai.

causes.en: The anti-PID function has raised its own alarm - it is a self-protection feature working, not a failure.
causes.ur: Anti-PID function ne apna alarm uthaya hai - yeh khud ki hifazat ka kaam kar raha hai, kharabi nahi.

causes.en: On humid or shaded strings, PID recovery runs periodically and can report an alarm while it works.
causes.ur: Nami ya dhuund wali strings par PID recovery baar baar chalta hai aur kaam karte hue bhi alarm report kar sakta hai.

solutions.en: Check the DC string voltage before acting: PID recovery raises module voltage, so a healthy array may read higher than expected during the recovery window.
solutions.ur: Qadam karne se pehle DC string ka voltage check karein: PID recovery module voltage barhata hai, is liye theek array recovery window mein expected se zyada parh sakta hai.

solutions.en: Compare the LED state with the app: blinking means an alarm exists, steady On means the function is simply enabled with no alarm.
solutions.ur: LED ki halat app se compare karein: blinking ka matlab alarm maujood hai, steady On ka matlab function sirf enabled hai koi alarm nahi.

solutions.en: The R table also has dedicated numeric codes for this function - 1377/1378 Anti-PID Software and 1379/1380 Anti-PID Hardware - so quote those, not the LED, when escalating.
solutions.ur: R table mein is function ke khaas numeric codes bhi hain - 1377/1378 Anti-PID Software aur 1379/1380 Anti-PID Hardware - is liye escalate karte waqt LED nahi, wohi codes dein.

codes.blinkPattern: PID Recovery LED light blue, 1s on / 1s off

notes.en: PID recovery is a FEATURE on the R-Series that a Pakistani rooftop install will not normally have enabled. Do not tell an owner to 'fix' a blinking PID LED by disabling PID recovery without first confirming the DC string voltage is healthy.
notes.ur: PID recovery R-Series par aik FEATURE hai jo Pakistani rooftop install mein aam tor par enabled nahi hota. DC string voltage theek hai yeh confirm kiye baghair kisi owner ko 'theek' karne ko blink karte PID LED ko PID recovery disable karne na kahein.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 3.4 LED Indicator Panel (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 (three-phase grid-tie string) - grid voltage, frequency and current faults

meaning.en: The R-Series measured AC output current above its limit. It is a grid-side overcurrent, not a DC or PV fault.
meaning.ur: R-Series ne AC output current apni limit se upar naapa. Yeh grid side ka overcurrent hai, DC ya PV ka fault nahi.

causes.en: Grid-side fault or a short on the inverter's AC output terminals, on a 75-110 kW three-phase unit.
causes.ur: Grid side fault ya 75-110 kW teenon-phase unit ke AC output terminals par short.

causes.en: The AC-side breaker or contactor not sized for the inverter's full rated current, or a cable run too small.
causes.ur: AC side breaker ya contactor inverter ki poori rated current ke liye sahi size ka nahi, ya cable bahut choti hai.

causes.en: A heavy inrush from a large transformer or motor on the same AC bus.
causes.ur: Wahi AC bus par kisi bade transformer ya motor ka heavy inrush.

solutions.en: Let the inverter reconnect to the grid after the grid is restored, as FoxESS states, and confirm whether the code returns.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS kahe grid wapas aane par inverter ko khud reconnect hone dein, aur confirm karein ke code wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Isolate the AC side and inspect the AC output terminals and the AC-side breaker/contactor for scorching, loose lugs or a cable sized below the inverter's rated current.
solutions.ur: AC side isolate kar ke, AC output terminals aur AC-side breaker/contactor par scorching, loose lugs ya inverter ki rated current se choti cable check karein.

solutions.en: If the fault recurs on a healthy AC installation, contact Fox ESS Customer Service with the code and serial number - the manual says exactly this and no more.
solutions.ur: Agar theek AC install par fault wapas aaye to code aur serial number ke saath Fox ESS Customer Service se rabta karein - manual yehi kehta hai, is se zyada kuch nahi.

notes.en: FoxESS gives 1030 a SHORT remedy - 'reconnect, and if it recurs contact customer service' - unlike most R codes which carry the 10-minute switch cycle. There is no field test in the manual for this code; do not invent one.
notes.ur: FoxESS 1030 ko CHHOTA remedy deta hai - 'wapas connect karein, aur wapas aaye to customer service se rabta karein' - zyada tar R codes ke muqable jahan 10 minute ka switch cycle hota hai. Manual mein is code ka koi field test nahi; wala be ghalat na banayein.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 8.2 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)
