codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 (three-phase grid-tie string) - grid voltage, frequency and current faults

meaning.en: The three-phase grid voltage is unbalanced beyond what the inverter will accept, so it has disconnected from the grid.
meaning.ur: Teenon-phase grid voltage itna unbalanced hai ke inverter use qubool nahi karta, is liye grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Heavy single-phase load on one phase of a three-phase supply - the single most common cause on a Pakistani commercial feeder.
causes.ur: Teenon-phase supply ki aik phase par bhaari single-phase load - Pakistan ke commercial feeder par sab se aam wajah.

causes.en: One phase conductor with a high-resistance or partly open joint, often an aluminium-to-copper joint done badly.
causes.ur: Aik phase conductor ka joint high-resistance ya aadha khari - aksar aluminium se copper ka behtareen joint.

causes.en: Utility-side phase imbalance from uneven distribution across the transformer, or a generator running single-phase.
causes.ur: Transformer par distribution ke uneven hona se ya single-phase generator chalne se utility side phase imbalance.

solutions.en: The inverter will reconnect to the grid after the grid is restored - so first confirm the imbalance has genuinely cleared.
solutions.ur: Grid wapas aane par inverter grid se khud reconnect ho jayega - is liye pehle confirm karein ke imbalance waqai khatam hua hai.

solutions.en: Measure the line-to-line and line-to-neutral voltage on all three phases at the inverter's AC terminals and calculate the imbalance; do not judge on one phase.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminals par teenon phases par line-to-line aur line-to-neutral voltage napen aur imbalance nikaalein; aik phase par faisla na karein.

solutions.en: If the imbalance persists, take the readings to the utility's local power company - FoxESS's own wording for the grid codes is to 'contact the local power company for solutions'.
solutions.ur: Agar imbalance qataar na ho to readings utility ke local power company ko dein - FoxESS ka apna wording grid codes ke liye yehi hai ke 'local power company se hal ke liye rabta karein'.

notes.en: R G2 V1.5 carries 1040 with the identical single-sentence remedy. FoxESS does not publish an imbalance percentage threshold for this code, so do not quote one as a FoxESS figure.
notes.ur: R G2 V1.5 par 1040 wohi aik-sentence remedy ke saath hai. FoxESS is code ke liye imbalance percentage threshold dhoondhta nahi, is liye isay FoxESS ka figure keh kar na batayein.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 8.2 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 (three-phase grid-tie string) - grid voltage, frequency and current faults

meaning.en: Measured grid frequency is above the inverter's permitted band, so the R-Series has disconnected.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency inverter ki ijazat band se upar hai, is liye R-Series disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Utility frequency excursion, common during load shedding or generator handover.
causes.ur: Utility frequency excursion - load shedding ya generator handover ke waqt aam hai.

causes.en: A generator on the same bus governing frequency high, or anti-islanding interaction on a weak feeder.
causes.ur: Wahi bus par koi generator frequency high control kar raha hai, ya kamzor feeder par anti-islanding ka asar.

solutions.en: Check whether the protection parameter settings meet the requirements through the APP - FoxESS's step 1 for this code.
solutions.ur: APP se check karein ke protection parameter settings requirements poori karti hain ya nahi - is code ke liye FoxESS ka step 1 yehi hai.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid voltage and confirm the frequency of each phase meets the grid-tied requirements; record the reading before adjusting anything.
solutions.ur: Actual grid voltage napen aur confirm karein ke har phase ki frequency grid-tied requirements poori karti hai; kuch bhi adjust karne se pehle reading note karein.

solutions.en: If the grid genuinely fails the requirement, contact the local power company for solutions, as FoxESS directs, rather than widening the inverter's window.
solutions.ur: Agar grid waqai requirement poori nahi karta to jaise FoxESS kahe local power company se hal ke liye rabta karein, inverter ka window chauda karne ke bajaye.

notes.en: 1042 and 1043 (Grid Low Frequency) are ONE paired row in the R table sharing a single remedy, as are 1044, 1045, 1046 and 1049. FoxESS prints them as separate codes but gives no differentiating field step, so a technician cannot distinguish them by procedure - only by the code number on screen.
notes.ur: 1042 aur 1043 (Grid Low Frequency) R table mein aik joda row hain jinka aik hi remedy hai, jaise 1044, 1045, 1046 aur 1049 bhi. FoxESS inhein alag codes chhapati hai lekin koi mukhtalif field step nahi deta, is liye technician inhein tareeqe se nahi, sirf screen par dikhne wale code number se pehchan sakta hai.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 8.2 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 (three-phase grid-tie string) - grid voltage, frequency and current faults

meaning.en: Measured grid frequency is below the inverter's permitted band, so the R-Series has disconnected.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency inverter ki ijazat band se neeche hai, is liye R-Series disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Under-frequency on a heavily loaded feeder, common in Pakistani summers when demand outstrips supply.
causes.ur: Bhari load wale feeder par under-frequency - Pakistan mein garmi mein demand aur supply ke darmiyan farq barhne par aam hai.

causes.en: A generator alongside the grid dragging frequency down because its governor is set for a lower base.
causes.ur: Grid ke saath generator chal raha ho jiska governor neeche ki base frequency par set ho.

causes.en: Protection window set tighter than the local grid legitimately runs.
causes.ur: Protection window aise set hai jo local grid ke waqai chalne se zyada sakht hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the protection parameter settings meet the requirements through the APP, as FoxESS's first step.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS ka pehla step hai, APP se check karein ke protection parameter settings requirements poori karti hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid voltage and confirm the frequency of each phase meets the grid-tied requirements, and record the value.
solutions.ur: Actual grid voltage napen aur confirm karein ke har phase ki frequency grid-tied requirements poori karti hai, aur value note karein.

solutions.en: If the grid is genuinely out of requirement, contact the local power company for solutions instead of widening the inverter's protection window.
solutions.ur: Agar grid waqai requirement se bahar hai to inverter ka protection window chauda karne ke bajaye local power company se hal ke liye rabta karein.

notes.en: Shares its row and remedy verbatim with 1042. Do not give a Pakistani R owner a different field procedure for 1043 than for 1042 - FoxESS publishes none.
notes.ur: Apni row aur remedy 1042 se bilkul wohi rakhta hai. Pakistan ke R owner ko 1043 ka mukhtalif field tareeqa 1042 se mat dein - FoxESS koi publish nahi karta.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 8.2 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 (three-phase grid-tie string) - grid voltage, frequency and current faults

title.ur: R: grid voltage mojood hi nahi

meaning.en: The inverter sees no grid voltage at all on one or more phases, so it has disconnected. This is a 'supply not there' code, distinct from 'out of range'.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko aik ya zyada phases par bilkul grid voltage nazar nahi aata, is liye disconnect ho gaya. Yeh 'supply nahi hai' wala code hai, 'range se bahar' se mukhtalif.

causes.en: A phase fuse or breaker blown in the AC distribution, so one phase of a three-phase supply is dead.
causes.ur: AC distribution mein kisi phase ka fuse ya breaker udd gaya, is liye teenon-phase supply ka aik phase murda hai.

causes.en: An AC-side isolator or contactor with one pole failed to close on a 75-110 kW unit.
causes.ur: 75-110 kW unit ke AC side isolator ya contactor ka aik pole close nahi hua.

causes.en: Open or high-resistance conductor in one phase between the board and the inverter.
causes.ur: Board aur inverter ke darmiyan aik phase ka conductor khari ya high-resistance.

solutions.en: The inverter will reconnect to the grid after the grid is restored - so confirm with a meter which phase is actually missing before restarting anything.
solutions.ur: Grid wapas aane par inverter khud grid se reconnect ho jayega - is liye kuch bhi restart karne se pehle multimeter se confirm karein ke kaun sa phase waqai missing hai.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid voltage on all three phases at the inverter's AC terminals, and record which phase reads zero.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminals par teenon phases ka actual grid voltage napen, aur note karein ke kaun sa phase zero parh raha hai.

solutions.en: Check that the grid voltage and frequency of each phase meet the grid-tied requirements, and if the missing phase is a supply fault, contact the local power company for solutions.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke har phase ka grid voltage aur frequency grid-tied requirements poori karti hai, aur agar missing phase supply ka fault hai to local power company se hal ke liye rabta karein.

notes.en: 1051 has a SHORTER remedy than 1042/1043/1108: it omits the APP protection-setting step. FoxESS goes straight to 'Measure the actual grid voltage'. Do not add the APP step for this code as if it were published.
notes.ur: 1051 ka remedy 1042/1043/1108 se CHHOTA hai: isme APP protection-setting ka step nahi. FoxESS seedha 'Measure the actual grid voltage' par jata hai. Is code ke liye APP step aise na shamil karein jaise woh publish hua ho.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 8.2 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 (three-phase grid-tie string) - grid voltage, frequency and current faults

title.ur: R: grid frequency detect karne mein fault

meaning.en: The frequency-detection channel itself has faulted, rather than the grid frequency merely being out of range. A sensing fault, not a supply fault.
meaning.ur: Frequency-detection channel khud kharab hai, sirf grid frequency range se bahar hone ki baat nahi. Yeh sensing fault hai, supply ka nahi.

causes.en: The frequency sampling circuit or its conditioning has drifted or failed.
causes.ur: Frequency sampling circuit ya us ki conditioning drift ya kharab ho gayi.

causes.en: A bad neutral or an unbalanced grid confusing the detection algorithm into declaring a channel fault.
causes.ur: Kharab neutral ya unbalanced grid detection algorithm ko ishaar karwa kar use channel fault declare karwa raha hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the protection parameter settings meet the requirements through the APP - FoxESS's step 1 for this code.
solutions.ur: APP se check karein ke protection parameter settings requirements poori karti hain ya nahi - is code ke liye FoxESS ka step 1 yehi hai.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid voltage and confirm that the frequency of each phase meets the grid-tied requirements, so you can rule the grid out before blaming the inverter.
solutions.ur: Actual grid voltage napen aur confirm karein ke har phase ki frequency grid-tied requirements poori karti hai, taake inverter par blame karne se pehle grid ko rule out kar sakein.

solutions.en: If the grid measures fine and the code persists, contact Fox ESS Customer Service with the code and serial number - this is a detection-channel failure, not a wiring job.
solutions.ur: Agar grid theek naapta hai aur code qataar nahi hota to code aur serial number ke saath Fox ESS Customer Service se rabta karein - ye detection-channel ki kharabi hai, wiring ka kaam nahi.

notes.en: FoxESS publishes no distinguishing field step between 1108 and 1042/1043, so on the bench they are indistinguishable without the code number. Note the two failure directions: 1042/1043 mean the GRID frequency is wrong, 1108 means the DETECTION of frequency is wrong.
notes.ur: FoxESS 1108 aur 1042/1043 ke darmiyan koi mukhtalif field step publish nahi karta, is liye bench par bina code number ke ye alag nahi pehchane jate hain. Do failure direction note karein: 1042/1043 ka matlab GRID frequency ghalat hai, 1108 ka matlab frequency ka DETECTION ghalat hai.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 8.2 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 (three-phase grid-tie string) - DC component, leakage, PV overcurrent, polarity and insulation faults

meaning.en: A DC offset in the R-Series AC output current exceeded the permitted limit, so the unit has stopped.
meaning.ur: R-Series ke AC output current mein DC offset ijazat limit se upar chala gaya, is liye unit ruk gaya.

causes.en: Output filter capacitor degraded, allowing DC to leak into the AC output of a 75-110 kW stage.
causes.ur: Output filter capacitor kharaab hua, is liye 75-110 kW stage ke AC output mein DC leak hone laga.

causes.en: Current-sensing channel offset or a failed sensing resistor on the main control board.
causes.ur: Main control board par current-sensing channel offset ya sensing resistor ki kharabi.

solutions.en: Wait for the inverter to return to normal, as FoxESS's first step, and re-read the code.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS ka pehla step hai, inverter ke normal hone ka intezar karein aur code dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: If the fault recurs, turn off the AC and DC side switches, wait 10 minutes, then turn on the AC and DC switches in turn to restart - FoxESS's exact procedure.
solutions.ur: Agar fault wapas aaye to AC aur DC side switches off karein, 10 minute intezar karein, phir AC aur DC switches ko baari baari on kar ke restart karein - FoxESS ka bilkul wahi tareeqa.

solutions.en: If the fault still exists, contact Fox ESS Customer Service for further assistance - the manual stops there and offers no field measurement.
solutions.ur: Agar fault phir bhi mojood hai to Fox ESS Customer Service se madad ke liye rabta karein - manual yahin ruk jata hai aur koi field measurement nahi deta.

notes.en: The 10-minute AC/DC switch cycle is the R-Series signature remedy and appears on most R codes. It does NOT appear in the H1, KH/KA, H3 or T manuals. A Pakistani R owner must be told to wait the full 10 minutes.
notes.ur: 10 minute ka AC/DC switch cycle R-Series ki signature remedy hai aur zyada tar R codes par hai. Yeh H1, KH/KA, H3 ya T manuals mein NAHI hai. Pakistan ke R owner ko poore 10 minute intezar karne ko batayein.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 8.2 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 (three-phase grid-tie string) - DC component, leakage, PV overcurrent, polarity and insulation faults

title.ur: R: leakage current overcurrent (hawa se wabasta)

meaning.en: A transient leakage-current trip that FoxESS explicitly attributes to damp air or poor light raising the array's parasitic capacitance. It is expected to self-clear when the weather improves.
meaning.ur: Ek a Temporary leakage-current trip jise FoxESS saaf-saaf nami hawa ya kam roshni se array ke parasitic capacitance barhne ki wajah se batata hai. Mausam theek hone par khud clear hona chahiye.

causes.en: Damp or moist air, which FoxESS names as the direct cause - this is the primary, expected trigger.
causes.ur: Nami ya geela hawa, jise FoxESS seedha wajah batata hai - yeh primary aur expected trigger hai.

causes.en: Poor light or rain increasing the module-to-ground capacitance of a large array.
causes.ur: Kam roshni ya barish se bade array ki module-to-ground capacitance barh jana.

causes.en: An actually leaky installation that is only noticed during damp weather - real, but a secondary cause.
causes.ur: Wakai leak wali installation jo sirf geele mausam mein nazar aati hai - asli magar secondary wajah hai.

solutions.en: Do NOT power-cycle the inverter in the wet - the environment is the cause, not the unit.
solutions.ur: Geele mausam mein inverter power-cycle na karein - wajah unit nahi, mausam hai.

solutions.en: Allow the weather to improve; FoxESS states the inverter will reconnect to the grid once the environment improves.
solutions.ur: Mausam theek hone dein; FoxESS kehta hai ke environment theek hote hi inverter grid se khud reconnect ho jayega.

solutions.en: If the code returns in dry, settled weather, then treat it as a real leak and move to the 1036 insulation check on the AC and DC cables.
solutions.ur: Agar code sukhe, thake hue mausam mein wapas aaye to isay asal leak samjhein aur 1036 ke AC aur DC cables ke insulation check par jayein.

notes.en: This is the one R code where the manual tells you to WAIT FOR WEATHER rather than restart. In Pakistan's monsoon this means a 1035 is frequently normal behaviour and must not be turned into a no-load battery/inverter replacement.
notes.ur: Yeh wohi ek R code hai jahan manual kaha ke mausam ka intezar karein, restart nahi karein. Pakistan ke mausam mein iska matlab hai ke 1035 aam tor par normal behaviour hai aur isay bina load battery ya inverter replacement par nahi badalna chahiye.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 8.2 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 (three-phase grid-tie string) - DC component, leakage, PV overcurrent, polarity and insulation faults

meaning.en: Leakage current is present continuously rather than in wet weather, so FoxESS directs you to check the insulation of the AC and DC cables.
meaning.ur: Leakage current mustaqil mojood hai, geele mausam mein nahi, is liye FoxESS aapko AC aur DC cables ki insulation check karne ke liye bhejta hai.

causes.en: Chafed or damaged DC cable insulation where the run crosses a metal structure, tray or sharp edge.
causes.ur: Gis chuki ya kharab DC cable insulation jahan run kisi metal structure, tray ya sharp edge se cross karti hai.

causes.en: Water ingress into a DC junction box or an AC isolator that has since dried but left a resistive leak path.
causes.ur: DC junction box ya AC isolator mein paani ka dakhil jo ab suk chuka ho lekin resistive leak path chhod gaya ho.

causes.en: Insulation resistance of an AC cable run degraded by heat and UV exposure - common on rooftop commercial runs in Pakistan.
causes.ur: AC cable run ki insulation resistance garmi aur UV se ghatak hui ho - Pakistan mein rooftop commercial runs par aam hai.

solutions.en: First establish the environment: if the environment is NOT normal, FoxESS's own wording makes this a 1035 situation instead.
solutions.ur: Pehle environment confirm karein: agar environment normal NAHI hai to FoxESS ka apna wording isay 1035 ki halaat banata hai.

solutions.en: If the environment is normal, check whether the insulation of the AC and DC cables is good - measure to earth with the DC switch open and AC isolated.
solutions.ur: Agar environment normal hai to check karein ke AC aur DC cables ki insulation theek hai ya nahi - DC switch khuli aur AC isolate kar ke earth ke sath napen.

solutions.en: Isolate the AC and DC side switches, wait 10 minutes, then turn them on in turn to restart, and re-test on a dry day before quoting a service claim.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC side switches isolate karein, 10 minute intezar karein, phir baari baari on kar ke restart karein, aur service claim quote karne se pehle sukhe din par dobara test karein.

notes.en: 1035 and 1036 are the pair that separates 'wet-weather nuisance' from 'real insulation damage'. FoxESS makes the DISCRIMINATOR explicit: 1035 blames poor light or moist air, 1036 says check cable insulation if the environment is normal. Use the weather to decide which one you are actually chasing.
notes.ur: 1035 aur 1036 wohi jore hain jo 'geele mausam ki pareshani' aur 'asal insulation nuqsaan' ko alag karte hain. FoxESS discriminator saaf likhta hai: 1035 kam roshni ya nami hawa ko blame karta hai, 1036 kehta hai environment normal ho to cable insulation check karein. Kaunsa code pakadna hai yeh mausam se decide karein.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 8.2 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 (three-phase grid-tie string) - DC component, leakage, PV overcurrent, polarity and insulation faults

meaning.en: A hardware comparator on the DC side detected PV current above the limit, so the R-Series has shut down.
meaning.ur: DC side ka hardware comparator ne PV current limit se upar detect kiya, is liye R-Series band ho gaya.

causes.en: A degraded or heat-affected MC4 crimp on a high-current string, the leading real cause on dusty Pakistani rooftops.
causes.ur: High-current string par degraded ya garmi se asar-dehid MC4 crimp - dhool wale Pakistani rooftops par sab se aam asal wajah.

causes.en: A DC arc forming on a damaged connector while the string is loaded.
causes.ur: String loaded hone par damaged connector par DC arc ban raha hai.

causes.en: Partial shading or a bypassed module forcing current through the surviving path.
causes.ur: Partial shading ya bypassed module jo current ko bache hi path se guzarne par majboor kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Wait for the inverter to return to normal, as FoxESS's first step, and re-read the code.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS ka pehla step hai, inverter ke normal hone ka intezar karein aur code dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: If the fault recurs, turn off the AC and DC side switches, wait 10 minutes, then turn on the AC and DC switches in turn to restart.
solutions.ur: Agar fault wapas aaye to AC aur DC side switches off karein, 10 minute intezar karein, phir AC aur DC switches baari baari on kar ke restart karein.

solutions.en: With DC isolated on a 75-110 kW unit, have a technician torque-check and thermally inspect the MC4 connectors on the affected MPPT and replace any discoloured or warm ones.
solutions.ur: 75-110 kW unit par DC isolate kar ke, affected MPPT ke MC4 connectors ka torque aur thermal inspection karwayein aur jo rang badle ya garm hon unhein replace karwayein.

notes.en: The R table also lists 1176 'PV Hardware Overcurrent Permanent Fault' in the same 10-minute-recovery group, so a PV overcurrent can escalate from recoverable to a permanent stop code on the same unit.
notes.ur: R table mein 1176 'PV Hardware Overcurrent Permanent Fault' bhi usi 10-minute-recovery group mein hai, is liye aik hi unit par PV overcurrent recoverable se permanent stop code tak ja sakta hai.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 8.2 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 (three-phase grid-tie string) - DC component, leakage, PV overcurrent, polarity and insulation faults

title.en: R: MPPT1 DC input access fault (reverse polarity)
title.ur: R: MPPT1 DC input access fault (ulti polarity)

meaning.en: The R-Series detected an abnormal current pattern on MPPT1 indicating a reversed string. Sibling codes 1086 (MPPT2) and 1088 (MPPT3) are the same fault on the other inputs.
meaning.ur: R-Series ne MPPT1 par abnormal current pattern detect kiya jo ulti string ki taraf ishara karta hai. Bhai codes 1086 (MPPT2) aur 1088 (MPPT3) wohi fault baaki inputs par hain.

causes.en: The string's positive and negative are connected to the wrong MPPT input terminals - an installation error.
causes.ur: String ka positive aur negative ghalat MPPT input terminals par lage hue hain - installation ki galti.

causes.en: A single string crossed to the neighbouring MPPT during a large multi-string rewire.
causes.ur: Bade multi-string rewire ke dauraan aik string padosi MPPT par chala gaya.

solutions.en: Check whether the positive and negative polarities of the strings corresponding to the fault are reversed - FoxESS's first instruction for this code.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS ka pehla instruction hai, fault se judi strings ki positive aur negative polarity ulati hui ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: If the polarities are reversed, adjust the string polarities when the string current is low - do NOT swap a live high-voltage string.
solutions.ur: Agar polarity ulti hai to string current kam hone par string ki polarity theek karein - live high-voltage string zinda nahi badlein.

solutions.en: Confirm which MPPT the code names (1085=MPPT1, 1086=MPPT2, 1088=MPPT3) and only re-verify that input's strings, so you do not disturb a working 18-connector field on an R75/R100.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke code kaun sa MPPT bata raha hai (1085=MPPT1, 1086=MPPT2, 1088=MPPT3) aur sirf usi input ki strings dobara check karein, taake R75/R100 ke kaam karte 18-connector field mein tabiyat na aaye.

notes.en: FoxESS's whole remedy here is polarity. If the polarity is correct and 1085 persists, the manual offers nothing further - note that R75 and R100 have 18 PAIRS of PV connectors, so a polarity mistake on a large field is a realistic and common install error.
notes.ur: FoxESS ka poora hal yahan polarity hai. Agar polarity theek hai aur 1085 qataar nahi hota to manual aage kuch nahi deta - note karein ke R75 aur R100 mein 18 JODIYAN PV connectors hain, is liye bade field par polarity ki galti aam aur realistic install error hai.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 8.2 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: R-Series / R G2 (three-phase grid-tie string) - DC component, leakage, PV overcurrent, polarity and insulation faults

meaning.en: The measured insulation impedance is below the inverter's threshold. Unlike the T-Series ISO fault, FoxESS makes this a TWO-STEP check that also involves an APP setting and the local regulations.
meaning.ur: Measured insulation impedance inverter ke threshold se neeche hai. T-Series ke ISO fault ke muqable, FoxESS isay do qadam ka check banata hai jisme APP setting aur local regulations bhi shamil hain.

causes.en: Damaged DC cable insulation, or a DC cable and earth making poor contact - FoxESS's step 2 names both.
causes.ur: DC cable insulation ka nuqsaan, ya DC cable aur earth ka halat mein rabit na hona - FoxESS ka step 2 dono kehta hai.

causes.en: The APP's ISO impedance protection value not matching local regulations, so the trip threshold is wrong for the site.
causes.ur: APP ka ISO impedance protection value local regulations se nahi milta, is liye site ke liye trip threshold ghalat hai.

causes.en: A genuinely damp day, which FoxESS explicitly separates from a real fault by telling you to re-check in better weather.
causes.ur: Wakai geela din, jise FoxESS asal fault se saaf-saaf alag karta hai ke behtar mausam par dobara check kahein.

solutions.en: Wait for the inverter to return to normal, as FoxESS's first step, and re-read the code before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS ka pehla step hai, kuch bhi chhune se pehle inverter ke normal hone ka intezar karein aur code dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: Then work both of FoxESS's steps with the DC side isolated: step 1 - check through the APP whether the ISO impedance protection value meets the local regulations; step 2 - check whether the DC cable and ground contact are good.
solutions.ur: Phir DC side isolate kar ke FoxESS ke dono steps karein: step 1 - APP se check karein ke ISO impedance protection value local regulations ke mutabiq hai ya nahi; step 2 - check karein ke DC cable aur ground ka contact theek hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the cable is normal and the fault occurs on a cloudy or rainy day, check again when the weather gets better - FoxESS's own words; do not condemn the inverter in a storm.
solutions.ur: Agar cable normal hai aur fault baadal ya barish ke din aaya hai to jab mausam theek ho dobara check karein - yehi FoxESS ke shabd hain; baarish mein inverter par blame na lagayein.

notes.en: THIRD distinct ISO procedure in this file. T-Series 'ISO fault' = measured impedance, should be >100 kOhm. Hybrids 'Iso Fault' = insulation-damage inspection, no value. R-Series 1124 = two-step check INCLUDING an APP threshold-versus-regulations step. Only the R version involves changing a setting in the app.
notes.ur: Is file mein TEOSRA alag ISO tareeqa. T-Series 'ISO fault' = measured impedance, 100 kOhm se zyada hona chahiye. Hybrids 'Iso Fault' = insulation-damage inspection, koi value nahi. R-Series 1124 = do qadam ka check jisme APP threshold aur regulations ka step bhi shamil hai. Sirf R wale mein app mein setting badalni shamil hai.

source.title: R-Series User Manual V1.4, section 8.2 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - AC leakage, insulation, ground and thermal faults

meaning.en: The inverter's residual-current device has tripped on the AC side. FoxESS points you at the equipment AROUND the inverter, not at the inverter itself.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka residual-current device AC side par trip hua hai. FoxESS aapko inverter ki jagah uske AROUND ke equipment ki taraf ishara karta hai.

causes.en: A wet or damaged insulation device on the AC side - exactly the 'surrounding equipment on the AC side' FoxESS names.
causes.ur: AC side par geela ya kharab-insulation wala device - wohi 'surrounding equipment on the AC side' jise FoxESS kehta hai.

causes.en: Dew, monsoon moisture or a water ingress into an outdoor AC isolator, junction box or the inverter's own gland.
causes.ur: Oos, mausam ki barish ka paani ya outdoor AC isolator, junction box ya inverter ke apne gland mein dakhil paani.

causes.en: The RCD/Fuse type does not match what FoxESS requires, so it trips on the inverter's normal small leakage current.
causes.ur: RCD/Fuse ki type FoxESS ki requirement se nahi milti, is liye inverter ke normal chhote leakage current par trip karti hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC and AC connectors, then check the surrounding equipment on the AC side - this is FoxESS's own instruction and the right first move.
solutions.ur: DC aur AC connectors disconnect karein, phir AC side ke surrounding equipment check karein - yehi FoxESS ka apna instruction hai aur pehla sahi qadam hai.

solutions.en: With everything isolated, moisture-test the outdoor AC isolator, junction box and cable gland; replace any that are wet or cracked.
solutions.ur: Sab isolate kar ke, outdoor AC isolator, junction box aur cable gland ka moisture test karein; jo geela ya toota ho usay replace karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect the input connector and check the state of the inverter after troubleshooting, as FoxESS directs.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS kahe, input connector wapas lagayein aur troubleshooting ke baad inverter ki halat check karein.

notes.en: 'GFCD' is FoxESS's own alternative spelling of the same device in the same row - the two are not different faults. On a Pakistani install the most common real trigger is monsoon moisture in an outdoor isolator, not an inverter defect.
notes.ur: 'GFCD' FoxESS ka apna alternative spelling hai usi device ka usi row mein - dono alag fault nahi. Pakistan ke install par sab se aam asal trigger mausam ka paani outdoor isolator mein hai, inverter ki kharabi nahi.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - AC leakage, insulation, ground and thermal faults

title.ur: PV se ground ki impedance 100 kOhm se kam

meaning.en: The inverter measured the impedance between PV (+), PV (-) and ground and found it below the acceptable level, so it stopped to protect against electric shock.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne PV (+), PV (-) aur ground ke darmiyan impedance naapa aur woh acceptable level se neeche nikala, is liye shock se bachane ke liye ruk gaya.

causes.en: Damaged or chafed DC cable insulation, classically where PV cable crosses a metal roof edge, conduit or a hot tray.
causes.ur: DC cable insulation ka nuqsaan ya gis chukna - aam tor par jahan PV cable metal roof ke kinare, conduit ya garm tray se guzarta hai.

causes.en: Water ingress into a DC junction box or an MC4 connector after monsoon rain.
causes.ur: Mausam ki barish ke baad DC junction box ya MC4 connector mein paani ka dakhil.

causes.en: A module with a cracked backsheet or a failed internal junction box shorting to its frame.
causes.ur: Aisa module jiska backsheet toota ho ya internal junction box kharab ho aur frame se short kar raha ho.

causes.en: Normal damp conditions after dew or rain, which usually clear on their own.
causes.ur: Oos ya barish ke baad aam nami ki halat, jo aam tor par khud clear ho jati hai.

solutions.en: Check the impedance among PV (+), PV (-) and ground - it should be more than 100 kOhm, exactly as FoxESS specifies.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS batata hai, PV (+), PV (-) aur ground ke darmiyan impedance check karein - woh 100 kOhm se zyada hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If the impedance IS above 100 kOhm yet the code is showing, follow FoxESS's own escalation: seek help from FoxESS, because that combination means a sensing problem not a real leak.
solutions.ur: Agar impedance 100 kOhm se upar hai lekin code phir bhi aa raha hai to FoxESS ki apni hidayat follow karein: FoxESS se madad lein, kyunke yeh combination sensing ka masla batata hai, asal leak nahi.

solutions.en: With the DC switch open, split the array string by string and re-measure to find which string is below 100 kOhm; on a dry day a healthy string reads in the megaohm range.
solutions.ur: DC switch khuli rakh kar, array ko string by string alag kar ke dobara napen taake pata chale kaun si string 100 kOhm se neeche hai; sukhe din mein theek string megaohm range parh ti hai.

notes.en: THREE NAMESPACE WARNING for the word ISO. T-Series 'ISO fault' = a measured impedance test with a >100kohm threshold. Hybrids 'Iso Fault' = an insulation-damage inspection with no value (foxess-h1-ac1-g2-insulation). R-Series 1124 = a two-step check that ALSO involves an APP impedance setting. Never hand one model's ISO procedure to another model's owner.
notes.ur: ISO shabd ke liye TEEN namespaces ka warning. T-Series 'ISO fault' = measured impedance test, >100kohm threshold ke saath. Hybrids ka 'Iso Fault' = insulation-damage inspection, koi value ke baghair (foxess-h1-ac1-g2-insulation). R-Series ka 1124 = aik do qadam ka check jisme APP impedance setting bhi shamil hai. Aik model ka ISO tareeqa doosre model ke owner ko kabhi na dein.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - AC leakage, insulation, ground and thermal faults

meaning.en: The inverter measured an abnormal voltage between neutral and protective earth, or lost a proper ground reference.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne neutral aur protective earth ke darmiyan abnormal voltage naapa, ya theek ground reference kho di.

causes.en: Neutral and PE not both correctly landed at the AC terminal, or PE open.
causes.ur: AC terminal par neutral aur PE dono theek se nahi lage, ya PE khari hui hai.

causes.en: Neutral and PE shorted together somewhere in the board - common in improvised Pakistani wiring.
causes.ur: Board mein kahin neutral aur PE aapas mein short ho gaye hain - Pakistan ke improvised wiring mein yeh aam hai.

causes.en: Reversed or mis-landed AC conductors after a rewire by a non-installer.
causes.ur: Kisi non-installer ke rewire ke baad AC conductors ulat ya ghalat lagi hui.

solutions.en: Check the voltage of neutral and PE, and check AC wiring - FoxESS's two instructions for this code, in that order.
solutions.ur: Neutral aur PE ka voltage check karein, aur AC wiring check karein - is code ke liye FoxESS ke do instructions, isi tarah.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV (+) and PV (-) using the DC switch; after the LCD switches off, reconnect and check again - the T table adds this DC step, the hybrid table does not.
solutions.ur: DC switch se PV (+) aur PV (-) disconnect karein; LCD band hone ke baad wapas lagayein aur dobara check karein - T table yeh DC step add karti hai, hybrid table nahi.

solutions.en: With the AC breaker off, measure AC voltage between neutral and PE at the inverter; it should read near zero volts while the grid is live.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off kar ke, inverter par neutral aur PE ke darmiyan AC voltage napen; grid live hone ke bawajood yeqreeban zero volts hona chahiye.

notes.en: Same string as the hybrids' 'Ground Fault' but kept separate because the T table's remedy includes a PV DC switch-off and an LCD-off wait that the H1/KH-KA rows do not. Neutral-PE shorting is a fire risk, not just a nuisance alarm.
notes.ur: Hybrids ke 'Ground Fault' se wohi string, lekin alag is liye ke T table ke hal mein PV DC switch off aur LCD-off ka intezar shamil hai jo H1/KH-KA ki rows mein nahi. Neutral-PE short aag ka khatra hai, sirf nuisance alarm nahi.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - AC leakage, insulation, ground and thermal faults

meaning.en: The inverter's internal temperature sensor has exceeded its limit, so it has shut down to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka internal temperature sensor apni limit cross kar chuka hai, is liye khud ko bachane ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: Direct sunlight on the inverter - FoxESS names this first and it is the usual cause on a Pakistani rooftop or wall mount in summer.
causes.ur: Inverter par seedhi dhoop - FoxESS isay pehle kehta hai aur Pakistan mein garmi mein rooftop ya wall mount par yehi aam wajah hai.

causes.en: Blocked or clogged air outlet, often from dust, leaves, mud nesting or a wall mounted too close to the surface.
causes.ur: Air outlet block ya ghasa hua - aksar dhool, patte, mud ka ghar ya deewar se zyada qareeb lagi wall mount ki wajah se.

causes.en: Ambient temperature genuinely above the model's operating range during a heatwave.
causes.ur: Heatwave ke dauraan ambient temperature waqai model ki operating range se upar.

solutions.en: Check if the environment temperature is over the limit, as FoxESS's own and ONLY instruction for this code - measure with a thermometer at the unit's intake rather than judging from the weather.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS ka apna aur akela instruction hai, check karein ke environment temperature limit se upar hai - mausam se andaza lagane ke bajaye unit ke intake par thermometer se napen.

solutions.en: Reduce the heat load at the source: if the unit is in direct sun, move it out of it or shade it, and keep the clearances the T manual's installation section specifies.
solutions.ur: Source par garm ka bojh kam karein: agar unit seedhi dhoop mein hai to use hata dein ya chhaon, aur T manual ke installation section ki khidai bar rakhein.

solutions.en: Clear the air path - clean dust, leaves and nesting from the intake and outlet - then re-test in the cooler part of the day, and if it still trips, seek help as FoxESS directs.
solutions.ur: Air ka raasta saaf karein - intake aur outlet se dhool, patte aur ghar saaf karein - phir din ke thande hisse mein dobara test karein, aur phir bhi trip kare to jaise FoxESS kahe madad lein.

notes.en: IMPORTANT CORRECTION made while verifying this file against the raw PDF: the T-Series 'Over temp fault' row contains ONLY 'Check if the environment temperature is over the limit' and 'Or seek for help from us'. An earlier draft of this block wrongly credited it with 'Check if the inverter is exposed to direct sunlight, please shade the inverter properly' and 'Check and clean the air outlet' - that text is the R-Series code 1099 'Over-temperature Protection', not the T-Series. The shading and air-outlet steps above are therefore field practice, not FoxESS T text, and are labelled as such. Also note FoxESS's T remedy for this code does not mention the fan at all; a T-Series with a Fan fault as well is a separate code.
notes.ur: IMPORTANT CORRECTION jo is file ko raw PDF se verify karte waqt kiya gaya: T-Series ki 'Over temp fault' row mein sirf 'Check if the environment temperature is over the limit' aur 'Or seek for help from us' hai. Is block ke pichle draft ne use ghalat tawajjuh se 'Check if the inverter is exposed to direct sunlight, please shade the inverter properly' aur 'Check and clean the air outlet' diya tha - woh text R-Series ke code 1099 'Over-temperature Protection' ka hai, T-Series ka nahi. Is liye upar ke shading aur air-outlet steps field practice hain, FoxESS T text nahi, aur aise hi likhe gaye hain. Yeh bhi note karein ke FoxESS ka T hal is code mein fan ka zikr hi nahi karta; saath Fan fault bhi ho to woh alag code hai.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - AC leakage, insulation, ground and thermal faults

title.ur: Cooling fan jam gaya ya kharab

meaning.en: The inverter's internal cooling fan is not turning, so the unit is about to overheat. This is a mechanical fault with a specific, checkable cause.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka andar ka cooling fan nahi chal raha, is liye unit garm hone wali hai. Yeh mechanical fault hai jis ki jaanchable wajah hai.

causes.en: The fan is seized up by something - FoxESS's own wording, and in practice usually an insect nest, a leaf or dust packed into the hub.
causes.ur: Fan kisi cheez se jam gaya hai - FoxESS ka apha wording, aur amli tor par aam tor par keedon ka ghar, patta ya hub mein dhool bhari hua.

causes.en: Fan bearing worn or the motor failed after years of continuous running.
causes.ur: Saal bhar chalne ke baad fan bearing ghis gaya ya motor kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Fan cable or its hall-sensor feedback disconnected, which the inverter reports the same way as a seized fan.
causes.ur: Fan cable ya us ka hall-sensor feedback disconnect ho gaya, jis ki wajah se inverter isi tarah report karta hai jaise fan jam ho.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV+ and PV-, reconnect them, as FoxESS directs for this code - note it says PV only.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS is code ke liye kahe PV+ aur PV- disconnect kar ke wapas lagayein - note karein ke isay kehta hai sirf PV.

solutions.en: Check whether the FAN is seized up by something or not - FoxESS's own check - by spinning the blades gently with power isolated and looking for an obstruction.
solutions.ur: Power isolate kar ke, FoxESS ka apna check karein - blades ko halka sa ghumayein aur blockage dekhein - ke FAN kisi cheez se jam hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the blades turn freely but the fault remains, the fan motor or its sensor cable is at fault - log the code and serial and raise a service claim for the fan assembly.
solutions.ur: Agar blades aazad ghoomte hain lekin fault qataar nahi hota to fan motor ya us ka sensor cable kharab hai - code aur serial note karke fan assembly ke liye service claim raise karein.

notes.en: The R-Series expresses the same class of problem numerically as 1191 'External Fan Alarm' (FoxESS: check whether the fan is blocked by foreign objects and remove them) and 1192 'Internal Fan Alarm' (FoxESS: contact customer service) - the string, and the split between external and internal, differ entirely. Do not merge.
notes.ur: R-Series isi tarah ke masle ko numeric 1191 'External Fan Alarm' (FoxESS: check karein fan foreign objects se blocked hai ya nahi aur nikaal dein) aur 1192 'Internal Fan Alarm' (FoxESS: customer service se rabta karein) ke tor par kehta hai - string alag, aur external/internal ka farq bhi alag. Merge na karein.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - DC bus, PV input and memory faults

title.en: DC bus voltage out of range (T-Series)
title.ur: DC bus voltage range se bahar (T-Series)

meaning.en: The internal DC link voltage has moved outside its safe window, so the T-Series has shut down.
meaning.ur: Internal DC link voltage apni safe window se bahar chala gaya, is liye T-Series band ho gaya.

causes.en: Grid voltage at an extreme, so the bus cannot be held in its operating window.
causes.ur: Grid voltage bilkul extreme par, is liye bus apni operating window mein nahi rakh sakta.

causes.en: PV string open-circuit voltage too high for the inverter, forcing the bus up.
causes.ur: PV string ka open-circuit voltage inverter ke liye zyada hai, is liye bus upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Grid-side relay not transferring, leaving the bus floating on the PV side only.
causes.ur: Grid side relay transfer nahi kar raha, is liye bus sirf PV side par latka raha.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV (+) and PV (-) using the DC switch, as FoxESS instructs for this code.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS is code ke liye kahe DC switch se PV (+) aur PV (-) disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Wait for the LCD to switch off, then reconnect and check again - FoxESS makes the LCD-off wait part of the remedy, so do not reconnect early.
solutions.ur: LCD band hone ka intezar karein, phir wapas lagayein aur dobara check karein - FoxESS remedy mein LCD-off ka intezar shamil hai, is liye jaldi wapas na lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure the PV string open-circuit voltage with a meter; if it is above the inverter's DC maximum, that is the cause, not the bus.
solutions.ur: Meter se PV string ka open-circuit voltage napen; agar woh inverter ki DC maximum se upar hai to wohi wajah hai, bus ki nahi.

notes.en: Not the same code as the hybrids' 'SW Bus Vol Fault' or 'HW Bus Vol Fault'. The T string is 'Bus volt fault' with a space and no SW/HW prefix, and its remedy is the DC-switch-plus-LCD-off pair. FoxESS never gives the T a separate hardware vs software bus split.
notes.ur: Hybrids ke 'SW Bus Vol Fault' ya 'HW Bus Vol Fault' se yeh wahi code nahi. T string hai 'Bus volt fault' - space ke saath, aur SW/HW prefix ke baghair - aur iska hal DC switch aur LCD off ka jora hai. FoxESS T ko kabhi alag hardware aur software bus split nahi deta.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - DC bus, PV input and memory faults

title.en: DC component in AC output over limit (T-Series)
title.ur: AC output mein DC component limit se upar (T-Series)

meaning.en: A DC offset in the inverter's AC output current has exceeded the permitted limit, so the unit has shut down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke AC output current mein DC offset ijazat limit se upar chala gaya, is liye unit band ho gaya.

causes.en: Output filter capacitor degraded, letting DC leak into the AC output.
causes.ur: Output filter capacitor kharaab hua, is liye AC output mein DC leak hone laga.

causes.en: Internal current-sensing offset or a failed sensing resistor.
causes.ur: Internal current-sensing offset ya sensing resistor ki kharabi.

causes.en: A DC-injecting load on the AC output - an unusual but real cause on grid-tie installs with mis-wired equipment.
causes.ur: AC output par DC inject karne wala load - grid-tie install par mis-wired equipment ki wajah se yeh aam nahi lekin asal wajah hai.

solutions.en: Wait for one minute after the inverter reconnects to grid, as FoxESS states for this code, then re-read.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS is code ke liye kahe, inverter grid se reconnect hone ke aik minute baad intezar karein, phir dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV (+) and PV (-) using the DC switch; after the LCD switches off, reconnect and check again.
solutions.ur: DC switch se PV (+) aur PV (-) disconnect karein; LCD band hone ke baad wapas lagayein aur dobara check karein.

solutions.en: If it returns on an idle inverter, the output filter or current sensing is at fault - a workshop job, not a site job.
solutions.ur: Agar khali inverter par wapas aaye to output filter ya current sensing kharab hai - ye workshop ka kaam hai, site ka nahi.

notes.en: Same physics as the hybrids' 'DCI Fault' and the R-Series' numeric 1034 'DC Component Current Fault'. THREE separate code strings for one fault across three model lines. Give a T-Series owner 'DCI over range', never 'DCI Fault' and never '1034'.
notes.ur: Aik hi fault ki teen alag code strings - hybrids ka 'DCI Fault', R-Series ka numeric 1034 'DC Component Current Fault', aur yeh 'DCI over range'. T-Series owner ko 'DCI over range' dein, na 'DCI Fault' aur na '1034'.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - DC bus, PV input and memory faults

title.ur: PV string voltage window se bahar (T-Series)

meaning.en: The PV string voltage is outside the window the inverter accepts. FoxESS states the open-circuit check explicitly and gives a 1000 Vdc figure.
meaning.ur: PV string voltage us window se bahar hai jo inverter qubool karta hai. FoxESS saaf-saaf open-circuit check likhta hai aur 1000 Vdc ka figure deta hai.

causes.en: String open-circuit voltage below the inverter's minimum, usually an open connection, a blown string fuse, or too few modules in series.
causes.ur: String ka open-circuit voltage inverter ki minimum se kam - aam tor par khari connection, udd hua string fuse, ya series mein modules kam.

causes.en: String open-circuit voltage above the inverter's maximum, from too many modules in series for the model.
causes.ur: String ka open-circuit voltage inverter ki maximum se upar - model ke liye series mein modules zyada.

causes.en: Partial shading or heavy soiling on part of the string dragging the operating point down.
causes.ur: String ka koi hissa dhuund se dhulai ya shading se operating point neeche kheench raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the panel's open-circuit voltage - whether the value is similar across strings or already above 1000 Vdc - exactly as FoxESS instructs.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS kahe, panel ka open-circuit voltage check karein - kya value strings ke darmiyan barabar hai ya pehle hi 1000 Vdc se upar hai.

solutions.en: Measure every string's open-circuit voltage with the DC switch open and compare them; one low string identifies the open or fused section.
solutions.ur: DC switch khuli rakh kar har string ka open-circuit voltage napen aur compare karein; aik low string khari ya fuse wali jagah identify kar deti hai.

solutions.en: Count the modules in series and compare the calculated Voc to the inverter's DC maximum before adding any more - the manual says seek help at 1000 Vdc or below only.
solutions.ur: Series mein modules gin kar calculated Voc ko inverter ki DC maximum se compare karein, kuch add karne se pehle - manual sirf 1000 Vdc ya us se neeche par help maangne ko kehta hai.

notes.en: FoxESS's T wording 'Please seek help for us when voltage ≤1000Vdc' is oddly phrased and does not clearly state the model's DC maximum. Do NOT assert a specific max PV voltage for any T model from this manual - read it off the model's own rating label.
notes.ur: FoxESS ka T wording 'Please seek help for us when voltage ≤1000Vdc' ajeeb hai aur model ki DC maximum saaf nahi batata. Is manual se kisi T model ki khaas max PV voltage ka daawa na karein - model ke apne rating label se parhein.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - DC bus, PV input and memory faults

meaning.en: The inverter's non-volatile configuration memory has failed or become unreliable, so stored settings can no longer be trusted.
meaning.ur: Inverter ki non-volatile configuration memory kharab ya unreliable ho gayi, is liye us mein stored settings par bharosa nahi.

causes.en: The memory device itself has failed with age, heat or power loss during a write.
causes.ur: Memory device khud umar, garmi ya likhte waqt power khatam hone se kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: A brown-out or DC bus collapse during a settings write left the stored configuration half-written.
causes.ur: Settings likhte waqt brown-out ya DC bus girne se stored configuration adhoora reh gaya.

causes.en: A related sample-channel fault presenting as a memory symptom - the T table lists 'Sample fault' separately.
causes.ur: Koi related sample-channel fault jo memory ke symptom ki shakal mein aa raha hai - T table mein 'Sample fault' alag hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV (+) and PV (-) using the DC switch, wait for the LCD to switch off, then reconnect and check again - FoxESS's full instruction.
solutions.ur: DC switch se PV (+) aur PV (-) disconnect karein, LCD band hone ka intezar karein, phir wapas lagayein aur dobara check karein - FoxESS ka poora instruction yahi hai.

solutions.en: If settings look lost after the reconnect, do NOT start re-entering them - record the symptom first, because a failing EEPROM will corrupt whatever you write.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas lagane ke baad settings gayab lagein to unhein dobara daalna shuru na karein - pehle symptom note karein, kyunke kharab EEPROM jo likhenge usay corrupt kar dega.

solutions.en: On a repeat fault, log the code and serial number and raise a service claim; the memory device is not a site-replaceable item.
solutions.ur: Baar baar fault aane par code aur serial number note karke service claim raise karein; memory device site par nahi badalna hota.

notes.en: The T spelling is 'EEprom fault' (lowercase p). The hybrids use 'Inv EEPROM Fault' and 'ARM EEPROM Fault' for their master and manager memories specifically. A T-Series owner will never see the hybrid strings.
notes.ur: T ki spelling hai 'EEprom fault' (chhota p). Hybrids apni master aur manager ki memories ke liye khaas 'Inv EEPROM Fault' aur 'ARM EEPROM Fault' istemal karte hain. T-Series owner kabhi hybrid strings nazar nahi karega.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - DC bus, PV input and memory faults
aliases: SCI Comm fault or SPI Comm fault

title.ur: Andar ke processor ka communication fault

meaning.en: The T manual prints this as the paired code 'SCI Comm fault or SPI Comm fault' - the inverter's own processors cannot exchange data, so the unit has shut down.
meaning.ur: T manual isay jorte code 'SCI Comm fault or SPI Comm fault' ke tor par likhta hai - inverter ke apne processors aapas mein data nahi kar sakte, is liye unit band ho gaya.

causes.en: Internal communication bus between the main and auxiliary processor has failed, often after a surge.
causes.ur: Main aur auxiliary processor ke darmiyan internal communication bus kharab ho gaya, aksar surge ke baad.

causes.en: Auxiliary 12 V / 5 V rails sagging so the processors reset - the same rails the R-Series codes separately as 1097 and 1098.
causes.ur: Auxiliary 12 V / 5 V rails gir rahe hain is liye processors reset ho rahe hain - wohi rails jo R-Series alag codes 1097 aur 1098 ke tor par likhta hai.

causes.en: Heat-related failure of the control board in a hot, unventilated enclosure.
causes.ur: Garm aur bina ventilation ke enclosure mein control board ka garmi se kharab hona.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV+ and PV-, reconnect them - FoxESS's full instruction for this code, and note it says PV only, not the AC.
solutions.ur: PV+ aur PV- disconnect karke wapas lagayein - is code ke liye FoxESS ka poora instruction yahi hai, aur note karein ke isay kehta hai sirf PV, AC nahi.

solutions.en: Give the unit a genuine full discharge - DC switch open, AC off - for at least 60 seconds before reconnecting, so both processors power up cleanly.
solutions.ur: Wapas lagane se pehle unit ko sach mein poori tarah discharge dein - DC switch khuli, AC off - kam az kam 60 second, taake dono processors saaf power up hon.

solutions.en: If it returns on every power-up, log code and serial and raise a service claim for the control board; no external check will clear an internal processor bus failure.
solutions.ur: Agar har power-up par wapas aaye to code aur serial note karke control board ke liye service claim raise karein; internal processor bus ki kharabi koi bahri check nahi theek kar sakta.

notes.en: Do not confuse with the hybrids' 'SCI Fault' (master-to-manager communication) or 'MDSP SPI Fault' (master-to-slave) - the strings are similar but the T table defines one combined code and gives a PV-only remedy.
notes.ur: Hybrids ke 'SCI Fault' (master se manager) ya 'MDSP SPI Fault' (master se slave) se confuse na karein - strings milti hain lekin T table aik joda code define karti hai aur sirf PV wala hal deti hai.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - grid and anti-islanding faults

meaning.en: The T-Series lost the grid reference and isolated itself. FoxESS's T remedy is a wiring/connection check, not a simple wait.
meaning.ur: T-Series ne grid reference kho diya aur khud ko alag kar liya. FoxESS ka T hal wiring/connection check hai, sirf intezar nahi.

causes.en: Main AC MCB tripped, or the AC output connector is loose at the inverter or at the board.
causes.ur: Main AC MCB trip hua, ya AC output connector inverter ya board par loose hai.

causes.en: Genuine utility outage, or a grid-connection problem at the wires/interface as FoxESS names it.
causes.ur: Waqai utility outage, ya wires/interface par grid-connection ka masla jaise FoxESS kehta hai.

causes.en: PV DC string open so the inverter has nothing to export and reports the grid-side symptom.
causes.ur: PV DC string khari hai is liye inverter ke paas export karne ko kuch nahi aur woh grid side ka symptom report karta hai.

solutions.en: Check the grid-connection - wires and interface - exactly as FoxESS instructs for this code, at the inverter and at the board.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS is code ke liye kahe grid-connection check karein - wires aur interface - inverter aur board dono par.

solutions.en: Check the grid usability with a multimeter on the AC output terminals to confirm whether the utility is actually present.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se AC output terminals par grid usability check kar ke confirm karein ke utility waqai mojood hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure the PV string open-circuit voltage; a zero-Voc string makes the inverter look grid-faulted when it is actually a DC-side open.
solutions.ur: PV string ka open-circuit voltage napen; zero Voc wali string inverter ko grid-fault jaisa dikhaati hai jabke asal masla DC side ka open hai.

notes.en: FoxESS's T-Series remedy for this code is 'Checking grid usability' plus 'Or seek for help from us' - it does NOT say 'the system will reconnect' the way the hybrids do. That difference matters: on a T-Series a persistent Grid lost fault after the grid is confirmed good points at the inverter, not at supply.
notes.ur: FoxESS ka T-Series is code ka hal 'Checking grid usability' aur 'Or seek for help from us' hai - ye NAHI kehta ke system khud reconnect hoga jaise hybrids kehte hain. Yeh farq ahem hai: T-Series par grid theek hone ke baad bhi Grid lost fault qataar na ho to masla inverter ka hai, supply ka nahi.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - grid and anti-islanding faults

meaning.en: Measured grid voltage is outside the permitted window so the T-Series refuses to connect. FoxESS pairs it with a frequency check and a one-minute wait.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage ijazat window se bahar hai is liye T-Series connect nahi hota. FoxESS isay frequency check aur aik minute ke intezar ke saath deta hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage genuinely high during export, typical of a long line or a transformer tap set high.
causes.ur: Export ke waqt grid voltage waqai high - lambi line ya transformer ka tap zyada par hona aam wajah hai.

causes.en: A dip from a large motor or generator starting on the same feeder.
causes.ur: Wahi feeder par bade motor ya generator ke chalne se grid voltage gir gaya.

causes.en: Grid frequency also out of specification, which FoxESS explicitly asks you to check alongside voltage.
causes.ur: Grid frequency bhi spec se bahar hai, jise FoxESS voltage ke saath saath check karne ko kehta hai.

solutions.en: Wait for one minute, as FoxESS states - the grid may go back to normal working state on its own.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS kahe, aik minute intezar karein - grid khud normal working state par wapas aa sakta hai.

solutions.en: Make sure that grid voltage AND frequency comply with standards: measure both at the inverter's AC terminals, not at a convenience socket.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke grid voltage AUR frequency standards ke mutabiq hain: dono inverter ke AC terminals par napen, kisi aasan socket par nahi.

solutions.en: If voltage is genuinely high, have the utility correct the substation tap before touching the inverter's protection settings.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage waqai high hai to inverter ki protection settings chhune se pehle utility se substation tap theek karwayein.

notes.en: Same physical fault as the hybrids' 'Grid Volt Fault' but a different official remedy sentence. Keep the two apart so a T-Series owner is told to wait one minute and check frequency, and an H1 owner is told the system will reconnect.
notes.ur: Hybrids ke 'Grid Volt Fault' se wohi asal masla, lekin alag official remedy sentence. Alag rakhein taake T-Series owner ko aik minute intezar aur frequency check kiya jaye, aur H1 owner ko system khud reconnect hoga bataya jaye.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - grid and anti-islanding faults

meaning.en: Grid frequency is outside the permitted band, so the T-Series has disconnected. FoxESS's remedy is a compliance check, not a wait-and-hope.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency ijazat range se bahar hai is liye T-Series disconnect ho gaya. FoxESS ka hal compliance check hai, intezar karne ka nahi.

causes.en: Utility frequency excursion during load shedding or generator handover.
causes.ur: Load shedding ya generator handover ke waqt utility frequency excursion.

causes.en: Grid frequency off specification persistently, which in Pakistan points at the feeder or a nearby generator.
causes.ur: Grid frequency mustaqal spec se bahar - Pakistan mein yeh aam tor par feeder ya kareeb ka koi generator ki wajah hota hai.

solutions.en: Wait for one minute, grid may go back to normal working state, as FoxESS states.
solutions.ur: Jaise FoxESS kahe, aik minute intezar karein, grid normal working state par wapas aa sakta hai.

solutions.en: Make sure that grid voltage and frequency complies with standards; measure frequency with a meter that reads Hz, not just volts.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke grid voltage aur frequency standards ke mutabiq hain; Hz parhne wale meter se frequency napen, sirf volts nahi.

solutions.en: If a generator shares the feeder, have its governor checked - a poorly governed generator dragging frequency is a repeat cause.
solutions.ur: Agar feeder par generator shamil hai to uska governor check karwayein - frequency ko neeche kheenchne wala kharaab governor baar baar ki wajah hota hai.

notes.en: Pakistan's nominal supply is 230 V / 50 Hz. FoxESS's T table gives no numeric trip window, so do not quote one as a FoxESS figure.
notes.ur: Pakistan ki nominal supply 230 V / 50 Hz hai. FoxESS ki T table koi numeric trip window nahi deti, is liye isay FoxESS ka figure keh kar na batayein.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - grid and anti-islanding faults

meaning.en: The rolling 10-minute average grid voltage has exceeded the permitted level, so the T-Series has disconnected from the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage ka chalta hua 10 minute ka average ijazat level se upar chala gaya, is liye T-Series grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Sustained grid over-voltage, typically high PV export into an already-high feeder.
causes.ur: Grid ka mustaqil over-voltage - aam tor par already high feeder mein zyada PV export.

causes.en: Substation transformer tap set high and left uncorrected.
causes.ur: Substation transformer ka tap high set hai aur theek nahi kiya gaya.

causes.en: A protection threshold set tighter than the local grid legitimately runs.
causes.ur: Protection threshold aise set hai jo local grid ke waqai chalne se zyada sakht hai.

solutions.en: The system will reconnect if the grid is back to normal - so first confirm with a meter that the 10-minute average has genuinely come down.
solutions.ur: System grid normal hone par khud reconnect ho jayega - is liye pehle multimeter se confirm karein ke 10 minute ka average waqai gir gaya hai.

solutions.en: Read and record the actual grid voltage in the app before changing anything; FoxESS gives no setting path for this threshold in the T manual.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi badalne se pehle app mein actual grid voltage parh kar note karein; T manual is threshold ka koi setting path nahi deta.

solutions.en: If the average voltage is genuinely over limit, get the utility to correct the substation tap - that is the fix FoxESS's own wording points to ('Or seek for help from us').
solutions.ur: Agar average voltage waqai limit se upar hai to utility se substation tap theek karwayein - yehi hal hai jis taraf FoxESS ka apna wording ishara karta hai ('Or seek for help from us').

notes.en: The hybrids call the same condition '10min Volt Fault' and the R-series expresses it as 1185 'Grid Startup Voltage Abnormal' territory. Three namespaces, one physics. Never cross-lookup a T-Series owner onto a hybrid code.
notes.ur: Hybrids isi halat ko '10min Volt Fault' kehte hain aur R-series isay 1185 'Grid Startup Voltage Abnormal' ke ilaaqe mein express karta hai. Aik hi physics, teen namespaces. T-Series owner ko kabhi hybrid code par nahi bhejein.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - grid and anti-islanding faults

title.en: Smart Power Supply / standby power supply fault

meaning.en: The inverter's standby or auxiliary power supply has faulted, so the unit has shut down. FoxESS's only instruction is to turn off PV and grid and reconnect them.
meaning.ur: Inverter ki standby ya auxiliary power supply kharab ho gayi, is liye unit band ho gaya. FoxESS ka sirf instruction hai PV aur grid off kar ke wapas lagayein.

causes.en: The 12 V / 5 V auxiliary rail has failed - on the R-Series the equivalent internal rails are separately coded 1097 and 1098.
causes.ur: 12 V / 5 V auxiliary rail kharab ho gayi - R-Series par isi tarah ke internal rails ke alag codes 1097 aur 1098 hain.

causes.en: The auxiliary supply drops out during grid loss because the standby source cannot hold it up.
causes.ur: Grid jaane par auxiliary supply gir jati hai kyunke standby source isay sambhal nahi pata.

causes.en: A failed DC-DC converter feeding the control board from the PV side.
causes.ur: Control board ko PV side se chalane wala DC-DC converter kharab.

solutions.en: Turn off the PV and grid, reconnect them - this is FoxESS's entire instruction for this code; do it once and re-read.
solutions.ur: PV aur grid off karein, phir wapas lagayein - is code ke liye yehi poora instruction hai FoxESS ka; aik baar karke code dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: If it returns immediately on every power-up, the auxiliary supply is failing and no external check will fix it - log the code and serial and raise a service claim.
solutions.ur: Agar har power-up par foran wapas aaye to auxiliary supply kharab ho rahi hai aur koi bahri check isay theek nahi karega - code aur serial note karke service claim raise karein.

solutions.en: Before quoting a board, have a technician with the unit isolated measure the 12 V and 5 V auxiliary rails on the control board.
solutions.ur: Board quote karne se pehle, unit isolate kar ke kisi technician se control board par 12 V aur 5 V auxiliary rails napwa lein.

notes.en: SPS is NOT a solar-panel or 'solar power system' code that a Pakistani owner should read as 'check my panels'. FoxESS does not expand the letters in the T manual, so the expansion above is inference from behaviour, not a quoted definition - treat the code itself as authoritative and the expansion as unconfirmed.
notes.ur: SPS ko 'solar panel' ya 'solar power system' ka code na samjhein jis ka matlab ho 'mere panels check karo'. FoxESS T manual mein harf poori nahi karta, is liye upar wala matlab behaviour se andaaza hai, quote kiya hua definition nahi - code ko hi authoritative samjhein aur matlab ko unconfirmed.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: T-Series (single-phase grid-tie string) - grid and anti-islanding faults

meaning.en: The inverter's own internal self-check did not agree with itself during a start-up sequence, so it shut down rather than run on unverified values.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka apna internal self-check start-up sequence mein khud se match nahi hua, is liye unverified values par chalne ke bajaye band ho gaya.

causes.en: A sampling channel has drifted so two internal references for the same measurement disagree.
causes.ur: Koi sampling channel drift ho gaya hai is liye aik hi measurement ke do internal references disagree kar rahe hain.

causes.en: Brown-out during the previous shutdown left a setting half-written in non-volatile memory.
causes.ur: Pichli shutdown ke dauraan brown-out aaya aur koi setting non-volatile memory mein adhoori likh gayi.

causes.en: The EEPROM holding configuration has become unreliable - the T table lists 'EEprom fault' as a separate code for exactly that.
causes.ur: Config rakhne wala EEPROM unreliable ho gaya - T table mein isi ke liye alag code 'EEprom fault' hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect PV (+) and PV (-) using the DC switch; after the LCD switches off, reconnect and check again, exactly as FoxESS instructs.
solutions.ur: DC switch se PV (+) aur PV (-) disconnect karein; LCD band hone ke baad wapas lagayein aur dobara check karein, jaise FoxESS kahe.

solutions.en: Give the unit a full 60-second discharge with the DC switch open before reconnecting, so the control board completes a clean power-down.
solutions.ur: DC switch khuli rakh kar poore 60 second discharge dein, phir wapas lagayein, taake control board saaf power-down complete kar le.

solutions.en: If Inconsistency recurs after a clean power cycle, look for the separate 'EEprom fault' code and raise a service claim - the configuration store is suspect.
solutions.ur: Agar saaf power cycle ke baad bhi Inconsistency wapas aaye to alag code 'EEprom fault' dekhein aur service claim raise karein - configuration store mamool hai.

notes.en: This code has no equivalent on the hybrid lines. The nearest hybrid concepts are the 'Cons Fault' family (master-vs-slave sample disagreement) and 'Sample fault' on the T table itself - all three are about disagreement between two references, but Inconsistency is the inverter disagreeing with ITSELF.
notes.ur: Is code ka hybrid lines par koi equivalent nahi. Sab se qareeb hybrid concept 'Cons Fault' family (master aur slave ke sample ki disagreement) aur T table ka apna 'Sample fault' - teenon do references ki disagreement ke baare mein hain, lekin Inconsistency inverter ka KHUD se disagreement hai.

source.title: T-Series User Manual V1.0.1, section 9.1 Alarm List (FoxESS Pakistan portal)

codes.seriesName: SG75CX-P2 / SG110CX-P2 / SG125CX-P2 (three-phase commercial string 75-125kW)

meaning.en: Grid voltage above the set limit. The inverter reconnects to the grid once voltage is normal.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage set limit se zyada hai. Voltage theek hote hi inverter grid se dobara jud jata hai.

causes.en: Actual grid voltage higher than the set overvoltage value.
causes.ur: Asli grid voltage set overvoltage value se zyada hai.

causes.en: Overvoltage protection parameters not matched to the local grid standard.
causes.ur: Overvoltage protection parameters local grid standard se match nahi karte.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid voltage and compare with the set value in the App.
solutions.ur: Asli grid voltage naalein aur App ke set value se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the grid is genuinely high, contact the local electric power company for a solution.
solutions.ur: Agar grid sach mein high hai to local electric power company se hal manga dein.

solutions.en: Only with the local power operator's consent, adjust the overvoltage protection value via the App or LCD.
solutions.ur: Sirf local power operator ki ijazat se App ya LCD se overvoltage protection value adjust karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

codes.seriesName: SG75CX-P2 / SG110CX-P2 / SG125CX-P2 (three-phase commercial string 75-125kW)

meaning.en: Grid voltage below the set limit. The inverter waits and reconnects when the grid recovers.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage set limit se neeche hai. Grid theek hote hi inverter dobara jud jata hai.

causes.en: Actual grid voltage lower than the set undervoltage value.
causes.ur: Asli grid voltage set undervoltage value se kam hai.

causes.en: AC cable not firmly in place.
causes.ur: AC cable mazbooti se baithi nahi hai.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid voltage at the inverter AC terminals.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminals par asli grid voltage naalein.

solutions.en: Check whether the AC cable is firmly in place and re-torque all terminals.
solutions.ur: Check karein AC cable mazbooti se baithi hai aur tamam terminals dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: If the grid is genuinely low, ask the power company to correct it before raising the trip value.
solutions.ur: Agar grid sach mein kam hai to trip value barhane se pehle power company se theek karwane ko kahen.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

codes.seriesName: SG75CX-P2 / SG110CX-P2 / SG125CX-P2 (three-phase commercial string 75-125kW)

meaning.en: Grid frequency above the permitted band; the inverter waits for the grid to return to normal.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency permitted range se zyada hai; inverter grid theek hone ka intezaar karta hai.

causes.en: Grid frequency beyond the set range, often a generator-backed supply.
causes.ur: Grid frequency set range se bahar, aksar generator wali supply.

causes.en: Grid frequency beyond the set range, often a generator-backed supply.
causes.ur: Grid frequency set range se bahar, aksar generator wali supply.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid frequency and confirm it is beyond the set range.
solutions.ur: Asli grid frequency naalein aur confirm karein ke set range se bahar hai.

solutions.en: If out of range, ask the local electric power company or genset owner to correct it.
solutions.ur: Agar range se bahar hai to local electric power company ya genset owner se theek karwane ko kahen.

solutions.en: Check whether the protection parameters are appropriately set via the App or LCD.
solutions.ur: Check karein App ya LCD se protection parameters theek set hain ya nahi.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

codes.seriesName: SG75CX-P2 / SG110CX-P2 / SG125CX-P2 (three-phase commercial string 75-125kW)

meaning.en: Grid frequency below the permitted band; the inverter waits for the grid to return to normal.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency permitted range se neeche hai; inverter grid theek hone ka intezaar karta hai.

causes.en: Grid frequency beyond the set range, e.g. an overloaded generator or a large motor start.
causes.ur: Grid frequency set range se bahar, jaise overloaded generator ya koi bara motor start.

causes.en: Grid frequency beyond the set range, e.g. an overloaded generator or a large motor start.
causes.ur: Grid frequency set range se bahar, jaise overloaded generator ya koi bara motor start.

solutions.en: Measure the actual grid frequency and note the reading and the trip time.
solutions.ur: Asli grid frequency naalein aur reading aur trip ka waqt note karein.

solutions.en: If beyond the set range, ask the local electric power company to correct it.
solutions.ur: Agar set range se bahar hai to local electric power company se theek karwane ko kahen.

solutions.en: Check whether the protection parameters are appropriately set via the App or LCD.
solutions.ur: Check karein App ya LCD se protection parameters theek set hain ya nahi.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

codes.seriesName: SG75CX-P2 / SG110CX-P2 / SG125CX-P2 (three-phase commercial string 75-125kW)

meaning.en: The grid supply was lost or not detected, so the inverter disconnected to avoid islanding.
meaning.ur: Grid supply chala gaya ya detect nahi hua, is liye inverter islanding se bachne ke liye disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Actual grid outage or the AC circuit breaker has tripped.
causes.ur: Asli grid outage ya AC circuit breaker trip ho gaya.

causes.en: AC cable loose, or live and N connected to the wrong terminals.
causes.ur: AC cable loose, ya live aur N galat terminals se jude hue hain.

causes.en: AC circuit breaker not connected.
causes.ur: AC circuit breaker jari nahi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the grid supplies power reliably with a meter at the distribution board.
solutions.ur: Distribution board par meter se check karein ke grid mehfooz power de raha hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the AC cable is firmly in place and re-torque every AC terminal.
solutions.ur: Check karein AC cable mazbooti se baithi hai aur har AC terminal dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Verify the AC cable is on the correct terminals - live and N must not be swapped.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein AC cable sahi terminals par hain - live aur N swap na hon.

solutions.en: Check the AC circuit breaker is connected.
solutions.ur: Check karein AC circuit breaker jari (connected) hai.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

codes.seriesName: SG75CX-P2 / SG110CX-P2 / SG125CX-P2 (three-phase commercial string 75-125kW)

meaning.en: Insulation leakage current was too high, often from damp conditions; the inverter reconnects once conditions improve.
meaning.ur: Insulation leakage current bohat zyada tha, aksar geele mahol ki wajah se; conditions theek hote hi inverter dobara jud jata hai.

causes.en: Poor sunlight or a damp environment around the modules and cables.
causes.ur: Modules aur cables ke aas paas dhoop kam ya geela mahol.

causes.en: AC or DC cable insulation degraded.
causes.ur: AC ya DC cable ki insulation kharab ho gayi.

solutions.en: Let the environment dry out - the inverter usually reconnects by itself.
solutions.ur: Mahol sukha hone dein - inverter aam tor par khud dobara jud jata hai.

solutions.en: If the environment is normal, check AC and DC cable insulation with an insulation tester.
solutions.ur: Agar mahol normal hai to insulation tester se AC aur DC cable ki insulation check karein.

solutions.en: Replace any cable with failed insulation and re-seal the damp connectors.
solutions.ur: Insulation fail hui cable badal dein aur geele connectors dobara seal karein.

source.title: SG125/110/75CX-P2-UEN-Ver14-202303 User Manual, 2.4 LED Indicator + 9 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (9.1)

codes.seriesName: SG75CX-P2 / SG110CX-P2 / SG125CX-P2 (three-phase commercial string 75-125kW)

meaning.en: A general grid parameter went outside the set range - grid quality not covered by a specific voltage or frequency code.
