meaning.en: Current is flowing backwards from one string into another, usually because that string has fewer modules or is shaded.
meaning.ur: Ek string se doosri mein current peeche beh raha hai, aam tor par is liye ke us string mein modules kam hain ya woh shaded hai.

causes.en: Fewer PV modules in that string than in the other paralleled strings.
causes.ur: Us string mein doosri parallel strings se kam PV modules hain.

causes.en: PV module partially shaded.
causes.ur: PV module adhoora shaded hai.

causes.en: PV module mounted in the wrong orientation.
causes.ur: PV module galat direction mein laga hai.

solutions.en: Check the number of PV modules in the flagged string against the other strings; adjust the configuration with DC off once current is below 0.5 A.
solutions.ur: Flag hui string ke modules ki tadaad doosri strings se compare karein; current 0.5 A se neeche hone par DC off karke configuration adjust karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the PV module is shaded and clear the obstruction.
solutions.ur: Check karein PV module shaded to nahi aur obstruction hata dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC switch and check the open-circuit voltage once current is below 0.5 A.
solutions.ur: DC switch disconnect karke current 0.5 A se neeche hone par open-circuit voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Check the wiring, the PV module configuration and the module orientation.
solutions.ur: Wiring, PV module configuration aur module ki direction check karein.

source.title: SH8.0-10RS-UEN-Ver14-202405 User Manual, 10 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (10.1)

codes.seriesName: SH8.0RS / SH10RS (three-phase hybrid inverter with battery, 8-10kW)

meaning.en: A string has a ground fault. Never unplug PV terminals while DC current is above 0.5 A.
meaning.ur: Kisi string par ground fault hai. DC current 0.5 A se upar hone par PV terminals kabhi na nikaalein.

causes.en: String cable insulation damaged and touching the frame or a metal structure.
causes.ur: String cable ki insulation kharab ho kar frame ya metal structure ko chhu rahi hai.

causes.en: Module or junction box water ingress creating a path to earth.
causes.ur: Module ya junction box mein paas ja kar earth tak raasta ban gaya.

solutions.en: It is forbidden to directly disconnect the DC switch and unplug PV terminals when the direct current is greater than 0.5 A - obey this first.
solutions.ur: DC current 0.5 A se zyada hone par DC switch disconnect ya PV terminals nikalna bilkul mana hai - sab se pehle ye maani rakhein.

solutions.en: Wait until the direct current of the inverter falls below 0.5 A, then disconnect the DC switch and unplug the faulty strings.
solutions.ur: Inverter ka DC current 0.5 A se neeche girne ka intezaar karein, phir DC switch disconnect karke kharab strings nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Do not reinsert the faulty strings before the grounding fault is cleared.
solutions.ur: Grounding fault hal hone se pehle kharab strings dobara mat lagayein.

solutions.en: Find the fault with an insulation tester on the isolated string and replace the damaged section.
solutions.ur: Isolated string par insulation tester se fault dhoondein aur kharab hissa badal dein.

source.title: SH8.0-10RS-UEN-Ver14-202405 User Manual, 10 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (10.1)

codes.seriesName: SH8.0RS / SH10RS (three-phase hybrid inverter with battery, 8-10kW)

meaning.en: A hardware-level fault inside the inverter. The manual explicitly forbids powering the inverter back up.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar hardware level ka fault hai. Manual saaf mana karta hai ke inverter dobara power on na kiya jaye.

causes.en: Internal component failure detected at hardware level (board, sensor or power stage).
causes.ur: Hardware level par internal component failure detect hua (board, sensor ya power stage).

causes.en: A second cause is not published - the manual gives a prohibition plus a service instruction instead of a diagnosis.
causes.ur: Doosri wajah bhi publish nahi - manual diagnosis ke bajaye prohibition aur service instruction deta hai.

solutions.en: It is prohibited to disconnect the DC switch when the DC current is greater than 0.5 A when the fault occurs.
solutions.ur: Fault hone ke waqt DC current 0.5 A se zyada ho to DC switch disconnect karna mana hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect the DC switch only when the inverter DC side current drops below 0.5 A.
solutions.ur: DC switch sirf tab disconnect karein jab inverter ke DC side ka current 0.5 A se neeche gir jaye.

solutions.en: It is prohibited to power up the inverter again - contact Sungrow Customer Service for a unit exchange.
solutions.ur: Inverter dobara power on karna mana hai - unit exchange ke liye Sungrow Customer Service se rabta karein.

notes.en: The strictest code in the table: no restart step. Also isolate the battery side switches on this hybrid before anything else.
notes.ur: Table ka sab se sakht code: koi restart step nahi. Is hybrid par sab se pehle battery side switches bhi isolate karein.

source.title: SH8.0-10RS-UEN-Ver14-202405 User Manual, 10 Troubleshooting and Maintenance (10.1)

meaning.en: A self-clearing battery internal fault. Sungrow states it normally clears within 20 minutes; frequent continuous occurrence means real damage.
meaning.ur: Battery ka khud ba khud theek hone wala internal fault. Sungrow kehta hai ke aam tor par ye 20 minute mein clear ho jata hai; baar baar aana asli nuksan hai.

causes.en: Transient battery internal fault that the BMS detects and clears on its own.
causes.ur: Battery ka aam internal fault jo BMS khud detect karke clear kar deta hai.

causes.en: Repeated triggering indicates actual inverter damage rather than a transient.
causes.ur: Baar baar trigger hona asal mein inverter damage ka nishaan hai, transient ka nahi.

solutions.en: Wait up to 20 minutes - this fault generally clears within that window on its own.
solutions.ur: 20 minute tak intezaar karein - ye fault aam tor par usi window mein khud clear ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If it occurs frequently and continuously, switch off the battery and contact the installer or manufacturer to check for inverter damage.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aur lagatar aata hai to battery band karke installer ya manufacturer se rabta karein taake inverter damage check kiya jaye.

solutions.en: If SOC is below 3%, switch off the battery immediately to avoid damage from overdischarge.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC 3% se neeche hai to overdischarge ke nuksan se bachne ke liye battery turant band karein.

notes.en: Do not confuse with the SH8.0-10RS inverter's Battery Fault row, which lumps 703/707/708/711/712/715/717 into ONE undifferentiated row with different solutions. Here they have their own dedicated solution text.
notes.ur: SH8.0-10RS inverter ke Battery Fault row se confuse na karein, jahan 703/707/708/711/712/715/717 ek hi undifferentiated row mein hain aur solutions alag hain. Yahan inhein apna alag solution text mila hai.

source.title: PowerKeeper ST050-250CF-UEN-Ver12-202607M0D02664 Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) User Manual, 10.1 Troubleshooting + Tables 2-6/2-7/2-8 indicators

meaning.en: Battery ambient or internal temperature above the permitted range, so the BMS blocked charge/discharge to protect the cells.
meaning.ur: Battery ka ambient ya internal temperature permitted range se upar hai, is liye BMS ne cells bachane ke liye charge/discharge block kar di.

causes.en: Battery near a heat source such as a wall, transformer or direct sun.
causes.ur: Battery kisi heat source ke qareeb hai jaise deewar, transformer ya seedhi dhoop.

causes.en: Poorly ventilated cabinet, or ambient temperature above 55 degC.
causes.ur: Cabinet ki ventilation kamzor, ya ambient temperature 55 degC se zyada hai.

solutions.en: Check for heat sources near the battery and confirm the ambient temperature is within limits - charging is 0 to 55 degC, discharging is -20 to 55 degC.
solutions.ur: Battery ke qareeb heat sources dekhein aur confirm karein ambient temperature limit mein hai - charging 0 se 55 degC, discharging -20 se 55 degC.

solutions.en: If the battery is near a heat source, poorly ventilated, or ambient temperature is excessively high, improve the installation environment.
solutions.ur: Agar battery heat source ke qareeb hai, ventilation kamzor hai, ya ambient temperature bohat zyada hai to installation environment behtar karein.

solutions.en: If the problem persists for an extended period, contact the installer or the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar masla lambi der tak rahe to installer ya manufacturer se rabta karein.

solutions.en: If SOC is below 3%, switch off the battery immediately to avoid damage caused by overdischarge.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC 3% se neeche hai to overdischarge ke nuksan se bachne ke liye battery turant band karein.

source.title: PowerKeeper ST050-250CF-UEN-Ver12-202607M0D02664 Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) User Manual, 10.1 Troubleshooting + Tables 2-6/2-7/2-8 indicators

meaning.en: Battery ambient or internal temperature below the permitted range, so charging/discharging is blocked.
meaning.ur: Battery ka ambient ya internal temperature permitted range se neeche hai, is liye charging/discharging block hai.

causes.en: Ambient or battery temperature below -20 degC, or below 0 degC while charging.
causes.ur: Ambient ya battery temperature -20 degC se neeche, ya charging ke waqt 0 degC se neeche.

causes.en: Battery installed outdoors in Pakistani winter with no thermal protection.
causes.ur: Battery Pakistan ki sarmay mein bina thermal protection ke bahar lagi hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the temperature range: charging needs 0 to 55 degC, discharging needs -20 to 55 degC.
solutions.ur: Temperature range confirm karein: charging ke liye 0 se 55 degC, discharging ke liye -20 se 55 degC.

solutions.en: If the ambient temperature is excessively low, improve the installation environment - wind protection or a warmer enclosure.
solutions.ur: Agar ambient temperature bohat kam hai to installation environment behtar karein - wind protection ya garm enclosure lagayein.

solutions.en: If the problem persists for an extended period, contact the installer or the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar masla lambi der tak rahe to installer ya manufacturer se rabta karein.

solutions.en: If SOC is below 3%, switch off the battery immediately to avoid damage caused by overdischarge.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC 3% se neeche hai to overdischarge ke nuksan se bachne ke liye battery turant band karein.

title.ur: Battery fault - BMS se baat nahi (714)

meaning.en: The inverter cannot communicate with the battery over the communication cable.
meaning.ur: Inverter battery se communication cable ke zariye baat nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Communication cable between the inverter and the battery loose or not securely connected.
causes.ur: Inverter aur battery ke darmiyan communication cable loose hai ya mazboori se nahi juda.

causes.en: Communication cable itself damaged.
causes.ur: Communication cable khud kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the communication cable between the inverter and the battery is correctly and securely connected - reseat both ends.
solutions.ur: Check karein inverter aur battery ke darmiyan communication cable sahi se aur mazboori se juda hai - dono siron par dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: If the fault persists, replace the communication cable.
solutions.ur: Agar fault phir bhi rahe to communication cable badal dein.

solutions.en: If the problem persists for an extended period, contact the installer or the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar masla lambi der tak rahe to installer ya manufacturer se rabta karein.

solutions.en: If SOC is below 3%, switch off the battery immediately to avoid damage caused by overdischarge.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC 3% se neeche hai to overdischarge ke nuksan se bachne ke liye battery turant band karein.

notes.en: Sungrow's official installer FAQ portal has a dedicated article titled 'How to troubleshoot EC714 BMS communication fault?', confirming this code is displayed with an 'EC' prefix by the support organisation.
notes.ur: Sungrow ke official installer FAQ portal mein 'How to troubleshoot EC714 BMS communication fault?' naam ka khaas article hai, jis se confirm hota hai ke support organization is code ko 'EC' prefix ke saath dikhata hai.

source.title: PowerKeeper ST050-250CF-UEN-Ver12-202607M0D02664 Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) User Manual, 10.1 Troubleshooting + Tables 2-6/2-7/2-8 indicators

title.ur: Battery fault - rest ke baad bhi rahe (732)

meaning.en: A battery fault that occurred during charge or discharge. If it survives more than two hours of rest, the BESS control switch must be disconnected.
meaning.ur: Charging ya discharging ke dauraan battery fault aaya. Agar do ghante ki rest ke baad bhi rahe to BESS control switch disconnect karna hoga.

causes.en: Transient fault during a charge or discharge cycle.
causes.ur: Charging ya discharging cycle ke dauraan aaya hua transient fault.

causes.en: Fault that does not clear even after the BESS has rested more than two hours.
causes.ur: Wo fault jo do ghante se zyada rest ke baad bhi clear nahi hota.

solutions.en: If the fault occurs during charging or discharging, allow the BESS to rest for a period of time first.
solutions.ur: Agar fault charging ya discharging ke dauraan aaya hai to pehle BESS ko kuch der ke liye rest dein.

solutions.en: If it occurs after the BESS has been at rest for more than two hours, immediately disconnect the BESS control switch.
solutions.ur: Agar ye do ghante se zyada rest ke baad bhi aaye to BESS control switch turant disconnect karein.

solutions.en: If the fault is not from the aforementioned reason and still cannot be resolved, contact Sungrow Customer Service.
solutions.ur: Agar upar wali wajah na ho aur phir bhi hal na ho to Sungrow Customer Service se rabta karein.

notes.en: This row is the ONLY battery-fault row in the whole ST table without the 'if SOC is below 3% switch off immediately' safety tail. Do not add that sentence to this code - it is not in the source.
notes.ur: Ye row poore ST table mein wohi battery-fault row hai jismein 'agar SOC 3% se neeche ho to turant band karein' wala safety tail nahi hai. Ye jumla is code mein add na karein - ye source mein nahi hai.

meaning.en: Battery fault that usually self-recovers, but if it persists needs a power-off, 5-minute wait and restart.
meaning.ur: Battery fault jo aam tor par khud theek hota hai, magar agar rahe to power off, 5 minute intezaar aur restart chahiye.

causes.en: Transient internal battery fault, normally self-recovering.
causes.ur: Battery ka transient internal fault, jo aam tor par khud theek ho jata hai.

causes.en: A second cause is not published - the manual gives only the recovery and restart procedure.
causes.ur: Doosri wajah publish nahi - manual sirf recovery aur restart procedure deta hai.

solutions.en: Generally the battery recovers automatically - wait before doing anything.
solutions.ur: Aam tor par battery khud recover ho jata hai - kuch karne se pehle intezaar karein.

solutions.en: If the fault persists, switch off the battery, wait for five minutes, and restart it.
solutions.ur: Agar fault rahe to battery band karein, paanch minute intezaar karein, aur dobara start karein.

solutions.en: If the problem persists for an extended period, contact the installer or the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar masla lambi der tak rahe to installer ya manufacturer se rabta karein.

solutions.en: If SOC is below 3%, switch off the battery immediately to avoid damage caused by overdischarge.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC 3% se neeche hai to overdischarge ke nuksan se bachne ke liye battery turant band karein.

meaning.ur: Battery fault jiska sirf ek documented hal hai: power off, paanch minute intezaar aur restart.

causes.en: Battery internal state that did not settle during the previous charge/discharge cycle.
causes.ur: Battery ka internal state jo pichhli charging/discharging cycle mein settle nahi hua.

causes.en: A second cause is not published - the manual gives only a single restart instruction.

solutions.en: If the fault persists for an extended period, contact the installer or the manufacturer.

title.en: Battery fault - loose connection in stacks (740)
title.ur: Battery fault - stacks mein loose connection (740)

meaning.en: An incorrect or loose battery connection inside the rack/stack assembly.
meaning.ur: Rack ya stack assembly ke andar battery ka connection galat ya loose hai.

causes.en: Battery connection terminal inside the client stacks loose.
causes.ur: Client stacks ke andar battery connection terminal loose hai.

causes.en: Connection incorrect (wrong terminal pairing) rather than merely loose.
causes.ur: Connection sirf loose nahi, ghalat bhi hai (galat terminal jori hui hai).

solutions.en: Check whether there is an incorrect or loose battery connection in the client stacks - isolate the BESS first.
solutions.ur: Check karein client stacks mein battery ka connection ghalat ya loose hai ya nahi - pehle BESS isolate karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat and tighten every battery connection terminal to the specified torque.
solutions.ur: Har battery connection terminal dobara baithayein aur specified torque tak tighten karein.

solutions.en: Switch off the battery, wait for five minutes, and restart it after the connections are corrected.
solutions.ur: Connections theek karne ke baad battery band karein, paanch minute intezaar karein, aur dobara start karein.

solutions.en: If SOC is below 3%, switch off the battery immediately to avoid damage caused by overdischarge.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC 3% se neeche hai to overdischarge ke nuksan se bachne ke liye battery turant band karein.

source.title: PowerKeeper ST050-250CF-UEN-Ver12-202607M0D02664 Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) User Manual, 10.1 Troubleshooting + Tables 2-6/2-7/2-8 indicators

title.ur: Battery fault - firmware ya setting mismatch (741)

meaning.en: A firmware or system-configuration problem: the number of Packs does not match what the hybrid inverter expects.
meaning.ur: Firmware ya system-configuration ki masla: Packs ki tadaad woh nahi jo hybrid inverter expect kar raha hai.

causes.en: Hybrid inverter, Logger and battery software not on the latest versions.
causes.ur: Hybrid inverter, Logger aur battery software latest version par nahi hain.

causes.en: System configuration wrong: single-phase hybrid must pair with a BESS of two to six Packs; three-phase hybrid with three to eight Packs.
causes.ur: System configuration ghalat: single-phase hybrid ke saath BESS do se chhe Packs ka hona chahiye; three-phase hybrid ke saath teen se aath Packs ka.

solutions.en: Contact the installer or manufacturer to upgrade the hybrid inverter, Logger and battery software to the latest versions.
solutions.ur: Installer ya manufacturer se rabta karke hybrid inverter, Logger aur battery software latest version par upgrade karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the system configuration is correct: single-phase hybrid needs 2-6 Packs, three-phase hybrid needs 3-8 Packs.
solutions.ur: Check karein system configuration sahi hai ya nahi: single-phase hybrid ke liye 2-6 Packs, three-phase hybrid ke liye 3-8 Packs chahiye.

solutions.en: If the problem persists for an extended period, contact the installer or the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar masla lambi der tak rahe to installer ya manufacturer se rabta karein.

solutions.en: If SOC is below 3%, switch off the battery immediately to avoid damage caused by overdischarge.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC 3% se neeche hai to overdischarge ke nuksan se bachne ke liye battery turant band karein.

source.title: PowerKeeper ST050-250CF-UEN-Ver12-202607M0D02664 Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) User Manual, 10.1 Troubleshooting + Tables 2-6/2-7/2-8 indicators

meaning.en: Battery power cables are connected in reverse, or the contact is poor.
meaning.ur: Battery power cables ulti polarity se jade hain, ya contact kamzor hai.

causes.en: Power cables connected in reverse polarity between packs.
causes.ur: Packs ke darmiyan power cables ulti polarity se jade hain.

causes.en: Connector not fully seated or terminal not tightened, giving a high-resistance joint.
causes.ur: Connector poori tarah nahi baitha ya terminal tighten nahi, is liye joint mein zyada resistance.

solutions.en: Isolate the BESS control switch before touching any battery power cable.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi battery power cable ko chhune se pehle BESS control switch isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the power cables are connected in inverse - verify polarity at each pack-to-pack link with a meter.
solutions.ur: Check karein power cables ulti polarity se jude hain ya nahi - har pack-to-pack link par meter se polarity verify karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the connectors fully and tighten terminals to the specified torque to cure poor contact.
solutions.ur: Kamzor contact theek karne ke liye connectors poori tarah dobara baithayein aur terminals specified torque tak tighten karein.

solutions.en: If the problem persists for an extended period, contact the installer or the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar masla lambi der tak rahe to installer ya manufacturer se rabta karein.

notes.en: Reverse power connection is damaging, so recorded as danger. The source does not add the SOC 3% tail to this row.
notes.ur: Power connection ulti hone se nuksan hota hai, is liye danger rakha gaya hai. Source is row mein SOC 3% wala tail add nahi karta.

title.ur: Battery fault - packs galat order mein (746)

meaning.en: The Packs are stacked in the wrong order for the installed hardware, so the firmware cannot be upgraded successfully.
meaning.ur: Packs installed hardware ke mutabiq galat order mein lage hain, is liye firmware successfully upgrade nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: Hybrid inverter, Logger and battery software not on matched latest versions.
causes.ur: Hybrid inverter, Logger aur battery software aapas mein matched latest versions par nahi hain.

causes.en: Packs installed in the wrong stacking order.

solutions.en: Contact the installer or manufacturer to upgrade the hybrid inverter, Logger and battery software to the latest versions.
solutions.ur: Installer ya manufacturer se rabta karke hybrid inverter, Logger aur battery software latest versions par upgrade karein.

solutions.en: If the fault persists, have the installer change the stacking order of the Packs and re-install the battery.
solutions.ur: Agar fault rahe to installer se Packs ka stacking order badalwa kar battery dobara install karein.

solutions.en: If the problem persists for an extended period, contact the installer or the manufacturer.

title.ur: Battery fault - pehle restart phir upgrade (747)

meaning.en: Battery fault: restart the battery first, and only upgrade the software if the restart does not clear it.
meaning.ur: Battery fault: pehle battery restart karein, aur restart se hal na ho to hi software upgrade karein.

solutions.en: If the problem persists for an extended period, contact the installer or the manufacturer.

title.ur: Battery fault - installer se rabta karein (750, 751)

meaning.en: Battery fault with NO self-service remedy at all. Sungrow's only instruction is to contact the installer or manufacturer.
meaning.ur: Battery fault jiska koi khud karne wala hal bilkul nahi hai. Sungrow ka sirf itna instruction hai ke installer ya manufacturer se rabta karein.

causes.en: NOT PUBLISHED - Sungrow gives no cause for these codes.
causes.ur: PUBLISH NAHI HUI - Sungrow in codes ki koi wajah nahi deta.

causes.en: A SECOND cause is also NOT PUBLISHED - the manual leaves both numbers deliberately without any stated cause, so neither row may be read as a diagnostic claim.
causes.ur: DOOSRI wajah bhi PUBLISH NAHI - manual dono numbers ko jaan boojh kar bina kisi wajah ke chhorta hai, is liye inhein kabhi diagnostic claim na samajhein.

solutions.en: Contact the installer or manufacturer - this is the only documented action for 750 and 751.
solutions.ur: Installer ya manufacturer se rabta karein - 750 aur 751 ke liye yehi ek documented action hai.

solutions.en: Before the visit, record the SOC shown in iSolarCloud and the exact time the fault appeared.
solutions.ur: Aane se pehle iSolarCloud mein dikhne wala SOC aur fault aane ka exact waqt note kar lein.

solutions.en: Have the BESS control switch isolated by the installer rather than opening the cabinet yourself.
solutions.ur: Cabinet khud na kholein; installer se BESS control switch isolate karwane ko kahen.

notes.en: confidence low is MANDATORY here: no cause and no field remedy are published by Sungrow. The single 'causes' row is a placeholder that declares the absence of information - it is not a claim about causation. The 2nd and 3rd solutions are technician-scoping advice, NOT Sungrow-documented steps. Do not present them as Sungrow instructions.
notes.ur: confidence low yahin MUST hai: Sungrow na wajah na field remedy publish karta. 'causes' ki ek row yeh batata hai ke maloomati nahi hai - ye causation ka daawa nahi. 2nd aur 3rd solutions technician-scoping advice hain, Sungrow ke documented steps NAHI. Inhein Sungrow ke instructions ki tarah mat pesh karein.

title.en: Battery fault - stacking order or software (833)
title.ur: Battery fault - stacking order ya software (833)

meaning.en: Battery fault whose documented fix is a firmware upgrade, and if that fails, re-stacking the Packs in the correct order.
meaning.ur: Battery fault jiska documented hal firmware upgrade hai, aur agar woh na mile to Packs ko sahi order mein dobara stack karna.

causes.en: Hybrid inverter, Logger and battery software not on the latest versions.
causes.ur: Hybrid inverter, Logger aur battery software latest versions par nahi hain.

causes.en: Packs stacked in the wrong order.
causes.ur: Packs galat order mein stack hue hain.

solutions.en: Contact the installer or manufacturer to upgrade the hybrid inverter, Logger and battery software to the latest versions.
solutions.ur: Installer ya manufacturer se rabta karke hybrid inverter, Logger aur battery software latest versions par upgrade karein.

solutions.en: If the fault persists, have the installer change the stacking order of the Packs and re-install the battery.
solutions.ur: Agar fault rahe to installer se Packs ka stacking order badalwa kar battery dobara install karein.

solutions.en: If the problem persists for an extended period, contact the installer or the manufacturer.
solutions.ur: Agar masla lambi der tak rahe to installer ya manufacturer se rabta karein.

solutions.en: If SOC is below 3%, switch off the battery immediately to avoid damage caused by overdischarge.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC 3% se neeche hai to overdischarge ke nuksan se bachne ke liye battery turant band karein.

notes.en: Shares its solution text with 746 but is documented as a separate row. Also note code 833 appears inside the SH8.0-10RS inverter's lumped 'Battery Fault' range 832-837 - same number, different device family, do not merge.
notes.ur: Solution text 746 ke saath share karta hai magar alag row ke tor par document hai. Dhyan dein code 833 SH8.0-10RS inverter ke lumped 'Battery Fault' range 832-837 ke andar bhi hai - wohi number, alag device family, merge na karein.

source.title: PowerKeeper ST050-250CF-UEN-Ver12-202607M0D02664 Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) User Manual, 10.1 Troubleshooting + Tables 2-6/2-7/2-8 indicators

title.ur: Battery fault - installer se rabta karein (908)

meaning.en: Battery fault with no published self-service remedy. Sungrow's only instruction is to contact the installer or manufacturer.
meaning.ur: Battery fault jis ka khud karne wala koi hal publish nahi hua. Sungrow ka sirf itna instruction hai ke installer ya manufacturer se rabta karein.

causes.en: NOT PUBLISHED - Sungrow gives no cause for this code.
causes.ur: PUBLISH NAHI HUI - Sungrow is code ki koi wajah nahi deta.

causes.en: A SECOND cause is also NOT PUBLISHED - the manual deliberately leaves this number without any stated cause.
causes.ur: DOOSRI wajah bhi PUBLISH NAHI - manual jaan boojh kar is number ko bina kisi wajah ke chhorta hai.

solutions.en: Contact the installer or manufacturer - this is the only documented action for 908.
solutions.ur: Installer ya manufacturer se rabta karein - 908 ke liye yehi ek documented action hai.

solutions.en: Before the visit, record the SOC and the fault timestamp from iSolarCloud so the technician has data.
solutions.ur: Aane se pehle iSolarCloud se SOC aur fault timestamp note kar lein taake technician ke paas data ho.

solutions.en: Do not power-cycle the BESS repeatedly - the source gives no restart instruction for this code.
solutions.ur: BESS baar baar power cycle na karein - is code ke liye source koi restart instruction nahi deta.

notes.en: confidence low is MANDATORY here: no cause and no field remedy are published. The single 'causes' row is a placeholder declaring the absence of information, not a causal claim. 908 is NOT inside any lumped inverter range, so it is BESS-specific.
notes.ur: confidence low yahin MUST hai: na wajah na field remedy publish hui hai. 'causes' ki ek row yeh batata hai ke maloomati nahi hai, causal claim nahi. 908 kisi lumped inverter range ke andar nahi hai, is liye ye BESS-specific hai.

meaning.en: Battery over-temperature alarm: charging is permitted only 0 to 55 degC and discharging -20 to 55 degC.

causes.en: Poor ventilation inside the cabinet.
causes.ur: Cabinet ke andar ventilation kamzor hai.

solutions.ur: Battery ke qareeb heat sources dekhein aur confirm karein ambient temperature limit mein hai.

solutions.en: If SOC is below 3%, switch off the battery immediately to avoid damage caused by overdischarge.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC 3% se neeche hai to overdischarge ke nuksan se bachne ke liye battery turant band karein.

title.en: Battery alarm - fan or vent blocked (971)
title.ur: Battery alarm - fan ya vent block (971)

meaning.en: Battery cooling fan fault or blocked air inlet/outlet. The only alarm row in the table whose remedy names a replaceable component.
meaning.ur: Battery cooling fan ka fault ya blocked air inlet/outlet. Ye table mein wohi alarm row hai jiska hal ek replaceable component ka naam leta hai.

causes.en: Cooling fan blocked by foreign objects, dust or debris.
causes.ur: Cooling fan bahri cheez, dhool ya kachra se block ho gaya.

causes.en: Air inlet or outlet grille blocked or obstructed.
causes.ur: Air inlet ya outlet grille block ya band ho gayi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the fan or the air inlet and outlet are blocked by foreign objects - isolate the BESS before opening the cabinet.
solutions.ur: Check karein fan ya air inlet aur outlet bahri cheez se block to nahi hain - cabinet kholne se pehle BESS isolate karein.

solutions.en: Clear the obstruction and restart the equipment.
solutions.ur: Obstruction hata dein aur equipment restart karein.

solutions.en: If the alarm persists, it is recommended to replace the faulty component - replace the fan.
solutions.ur: Agar alarm phir bhi rahe to faulty component badalna recommended hai - fan badal dein.

solutions.en: If the issue recurs, consult the battery manufacturer for a resolution.
solutions.ur: Agar masla dobara aaye to hal ke liye battery manufacturer se mashwara karein.

notes.en: The only entry in the whole ST table that names a specific replaceable part and a consult-the-manufacturer step, so it is a genuinely actionable field fix.
notes.ur: Poore ST table mein yehi wohi entry hai jo koi khaas replaceable part aur manufacturer se mashwara karne ka step batati hai, is liye ye haqeeq mein field par karne wala practical fix hai.

meaning.ur: Paanch bar wala SOC indicator apni pehli bar yellow mein dikhata hai: state of charge 5 percent ya us se kam hai.

causes.en: Battery state of charge genuinely at or below 5 percent.
causes.ur: Battery ka state of charge haqeeq mein 5 percent ya us se kam hai.

solutions.en: This is the LOWEST SOC band on the indicator - it is a state display, not a fault.
solutions.ur: Ye indicator ka sab se neeche wala SOC band hai - ye state display hai, fault nahi.

solutions.en: Check that the battery is actually charging - confirm current flow in iSolarCloud.
solutions.ur: Check karein battery asal mein charge ho rahi hai - iSolarCloud mein current flow ki tasdeeq karein.

solutions.en: If SOC stays below 5% while the PV is generating, check the hybrid inverter for a battery code such as 741 or 746.
solutions.ur: Agar PV generate karte hue bhi SOC 5% se neeche atka rahe to hybrid inverter mein battery code jaise 741 ya 746 check karein.

title.ur: Main stack ka LED 0.5s blink - update chal raha hai

meaning.en: Blue status LED flashing at 0.5 second interval: the firmware is being updated. Do not interrupt.
meaning.ur: Blue status LED 0.5 second ke interval par blink: firmware update ho raha hai. Beech mein mat kaatein.

causes.en: A firmware/software update is in progress on the stack.

solutions.ur: Ye normal state hai, fault se alag - update ke dauraan power cycle na karein.

title.en: Main stack status LED red - stack fault
title.ur: Main stack ka LED red - stack mein fault hai

meaning.en: Red status LED steady on: a fault has occurred in the MAIN battery stack. The auxiliary stack may still be healthy.
meaning.ur: Red status LED steady on: MAIN battery stack mein fault aa gaya hai. Auxiliary stack abhi bhi theek ho sakta hai.

causes.en: Any fault code in the 703-751 / 833 / 908 / 742 family raised by the main stack.
causes.ur: Main stack se taraf se 703-751 / 833 / 908 / 742 family ka koi bhi fault code.

causes.en: The auxiliary stack may also be faulted, so identify which indicator is red before acting.
causes.ur: Auxiliary stack bhi fault ho sakta hai, is liye kaam karne se pehle identify karein ke kaun sa indicator red hai.

solutions.en: Read the active fault code from iSolarCloud or the LCD before touching the cabinet.
solutions.ur: Cabinet chhune se pehle iSolarCloud ya LCD se active fault code parh lein.

solutions.en: Look that code up in this series and follow its solution - but confirm it is the MAIN stack code, not the auxiliary one.
solutions.ur: Woh code is series mein dhoondein aur us ka solution follow karein - magar confirm karein ke ye MAIN stack ka code hai, auxiliary ka nahi.

solutions.en: Check whether the SOC is below 3% - if so, switch the battery off immediately.
solutions.ur: Check karein SOC 3% se neeche hai ya nahi - agar haan to battery turant band karein.

title.en: Main stack status LED gray - powered off / shutdown
title.ur: Main stack status LED gray - band / shutdown

meaning.en: Gray status LED in shutdown state: the BESS is powered off. This is a deliberate state, not a fault.
meaning.ur: Gray status LED shutdown state mein: BESS band hai. Ye jaan boojh kar kiya hua state hai, fault nahi.

causes.en: BESS control switch in the OFF position.
causes.ur: BESS control switch OFF position par hai.

causes.en: A protective shutdown after a lockout, awaiting a service visit.
causes.ur: Lockout ke baad protective shutdown, service visit ka intezaar kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the BESS control switch position before assuming a fault.
solutions.ur: Fault samajhne se pehle BESS control switch ki position check karein.

solutions.en: If the switch is ON but the LED is gray, check for a latched lockout code in iSolarCloud before restarting.
solutions.ur: Agar switch ON hai magar LED gray hai to restart karne se pehle iSolarCloud mein latched lockout code check karein.

solutions.en: This is also the normal display during a planned power-off, so do not treat it as an outage.
solutions.ur: Ye planned power-off ke dauraan bhi normal display hai, is liye isay outage na samajhein.

title.en: Aux stack status LED blue on - normal

meaning.en: Auxiliary battery stack status indicator steady blue: the auxiliary stack is in normal operation.
meaning.ur: Auxiliary battery stack status indicator steady blue: auxiliary stack normal operation mein hai.

causes.en: Auxiliary battery stack operating normally.
causes.ur: Auxiliary battery stack normally chal raha hai.

solutions.en: No action needed - this is the healthy state for the auxiliary stack.
solutions.ur: Koi action ki zarurat nahi - ye auxiliary stack ke liye theek hal ka state hai.

solutions.en: Note that main and auxiliary are independent - a blue aux LED does not clear a main stack fault.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke main aur auxiliary aapas mein hain - blue aux LED main stack ka fault nahi mitata.

title.en: Aux stack status LED red - auxiliary fault
title.ur: Aux stack ka LED red - auxiliary mein fault hai

meaning.en: Red status LED on the auxiliary indicator: a fault has occurred in the AUXILIARY battery stack.
meaning.ur: Auxiliary indicator par red status LED: AUXILIARY battery stack mein fault aa gaya hai.

causes.en: Any fault code raised by the auxiliary battery stack, distinct from the main stack.
causes.ur: Auxiliary battery stack se taraf se koi bhi fault code, main stack se alag.

causes.en: The main stack may also be faulted, so identify which indicator is red before acting.
causes.ur: Main stack bhi fault ho sakta hai, is liye kaam karne se pehle identify karein ke kaun sa indicator red hai.

solutions.en: Read the active fault code from iSolarCloud and identify which stack raised it.
solutions.ur: iSolarCloud se active fault code parh lein aur identify karein ke kis stack ne diya.

solutions.en: Follow that code's solution, but isolate the AUXILIARY stack only - do not shut down the main stack unnecessarily.
solutions.ur: Us code ka solution follow karein, magar sirf AUXILIARY stack isolate karein - main stack ko ghalti se band na karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the SOC is below 3% - if so, switch the battery off immediately.
solutions.ur: Check karein SOC 3% se neeche hai ya nahi - agar haan to battery turant band karein.

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS (LUNA2000-215-2S10 / 2S11 / 2S12, 161-2S11, 107-1S11) standalone Alarm Reference
aliases: Battery Pack and External Power Connected Abnormally

title.en: Battery Pack and External Power Connected Abnormally
title.ur: Battery pack aur external power ka connection abnormal hai

meaning.en: The pack copper bar has overheated, so the pack is locked out of service. ADAC, auto-clears once the bar cools.
meaning.ur: Pack ka copper bar garm ho gaya hai, is liye pack service se lock ho gaya. ADAC - thanda hone par khud clear ho jata hai.

causes.en: The battery pack copper bar experiences overtemperature.
causes.ur: Battery pack ka copper bar overtemperature jhel raha hai.

causes.en: Loss of cooling that lets the joint run hot - the manual's fix path is a 30-minute quiescent wait followed by a joint inspection, which is a heat-soak diagnosis, not a sensor fault.
causes.ur: Cooling ka loss jis ki wajah se joint garam chalta hai - manual ka ilaaj 30 minute ruke rehne ke baad joint inspection hai, jo heat-soak diagnosis hai, sensor fault nahi.

solutions.en: Confirm the ESS is neither charging nor discharging, then wait 30 minutes and check whether the alarm clears.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke ESS na charge ho raha ho na discharge, phir 30 minute intezaar karke check karein ke alarm khatam hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it persists, power off the ESS per the user manual and wait 5 minutes before opening anything.
solutions.ur: Agar bana rahe to user manual ke mutabiq ESS band karein aur kuch kholne se pehle 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Wearing PPE, open the pack front panel and check whether the positive and negative copper bars are loose; tighten the screws if so.
solutions.ur: PPE pehn kar pack ka front panel kholein aur check karein ke positive aur negative copper bars loose hain ya nahi; loose hon to screws tighten karein.

solutions.en: Start the ESS on the user interface afterwards; if the alarm persists, export logs and contact technical support.
solutions.ur: Uske baad user interface par ESS start karein; alarm bana rahe to logs export karke technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS (LUNA2000-215-2S10 / 2S11 / 2S12, 161-2S11, 107-1S11) standalone Alarm Reference

meaning.en: Battery current exceeded its upper limit and the protection has engaged. ADMC - must be cleared manually.
meaning.ur: Battery current apni upper limit se upar gaya aur protection chala. ADMC - manually clear karna hota hai.

causes.en: The battery pack current exceeds the upper limit.
causes.ur: Battery pack ka current upper limit se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Power or communications cables of the ESS incorrectly connected.
causes.ur: ESS ke power ya communications cables galat se connected hain.

solutions.en: Check whether the power and communications cables of the ESS are correctly connected.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke ESS ke power aur communications cables theek se connected hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: If cables are correct, clear the alarm on the user interface and restart the ESS from there.
solutions.ur: Agar cables theek hain to user interface par alarm clear karke wahan se ESS restart karein.

solutions.en: If cables are wrong, correct them per the user manual and repeat the clear-and-restart step.
solutions.ur: Agar cables galat hain to user manual ke mutabiq theek karke clear aur restart dohra dein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS (LUNA2000-215-2S10 / 2S11 / 2S12, 161-2S11, 107-1S11) standalone Alarm Reference

title.ur: Battery pack lock ho gaya hai

meaning.en: The pack is locked out, usually after a copper bar or cell insulation problem. ADMC - manual clear required.
meaning.ur: Pack lock out ho gaya hai, aam tor par copper bar ya cell insulation ki kharabi ke baad. ADMC - manual clear zaroori hai.

causes.en: Battery pack copper bar connection is abnormal or the cell has insulation requirements that are not met.
causes.ur: Battery pack copper bar ka connection abnormal hai ya cell ki insulation requirements poori nahi hoti.

causes.en: The same loose positive/negative copper bar root cause as alarm 3100, which this document gives an identical troubleshooting path to.
causes.ur: Alarm 3100 jaisa hi loose positive/negative copper bar root cause, jis ka is document mein bilkul wahi troubleshooting path hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the ESS is neither charging nor discharging, then clear the alarm on the user interface.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke ESS na charge ho raha ho na discharge, phir user interface par alarm clear karein.

solutions.en: If it does not clear, power off the ESS per the manual, wait 5 minutes, and put on protective equipment before opening the pack.
solutions.ur: Agar clear na ho to manual ke mutabiq ESS band karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, aur pack kholne se pehle protective equipment pehnein.

solutions.en: Check the positive and negative copper bar screws for looseness and tighten them; re-start from the user interface.
solutions.ur: Positive aur negative copper bar ke screws ki looseness check karke tighten karein; phir user interface se dobara start karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS (LUNA2000-215-2S10 / 2S11 / 2S12, 161-2S11, 107-1S11) standalone Alarm Reference

title.ur: PACK thermal runaway (pack mein aag/smoke ka khatra)

meaning.en: A battery pack has abnormal temperature and poses thermal runaway risk. This is a life-safety event, not a service call.
meaning.ur: Battery pack ka temperature abnormal hai aur thermal runaway ka khatra hai. Yeh zindagi ki safety ka masla hai, service call nahi.

causes.en: The battery pack has abnormal temperature and thermal runaway risk.
causes.ur: Battery pack ka temperature abnormal hai aur thermal runaway ka khatra hai.

causes.en: A cell-level fault such as overvoltage, undervoltage or sampling abnormality.
causes.ur: Cell level fault jaise overvoltage, undervoltage ya sampling abnormality.

solutions.en: Observe the system remotely for 30 minutes. During observation do NOT approach the ESS or open the cabin doors.
solutions.ur: System ko remote 30 minute dekhein. Is dauran ESS ke paas mat jayein aur cabin doors mat kholein.

solutions.en: Watch for other exceptions during that window: abnormal battery voltage, abnormal battery temperature, combustible gas concentration.
solutions.ur: Us window mein baaki exceptions dekhein: abnormal battery voltage, abnormal battery temperature, combustible gas concentration.

solutions.en: If no exception is found in 30 minutes, send trained personnel to observe; if a thermal event is confirmed, evacuate and call emergency services.
solutions.ur: Agar 30 minute mein koi exception nahi mila to trained personnel bhej ke observation karwayein; thermal event confirm ho to evacuate karke emergency services bulayein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS (LUNA2000-215-2S10 / 2S11 / 2S12, 161-2S11, 107-1S11) standalone Alarm Reference

meaning.en: The DC-DC converter's liquid cooling has faulted or its I/O self-test failed, so battery temperature cannot be controlled.
meaning.ur: DC-DC converter ki liquid cooling fault ho gayi ya uska I/O self-test fail hua, is liye battery temperature control nahi ho sakti.

causes.en: The DCDC liquid cooling has faulted.
causes.ur: DCDC liquid cooling fault ho gayi hai.

causes.en: The DCDC I/O self-test is abnormal - the manual lists this separately from the cooling fault in the same sentence.
causes.ur: DCDC ka I/O self-test abnormal hai - manual ise usi sentence mein cooling fault se alag list karta hai.

solutions.en: Power off the ESS per the manual, then check that the DCDC communications port and the RCM CON4 communications port are both securely connected.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq ESS band karein, phir check karein ke DCDC communications port aur RCM ka CON4 communications port dono securely connected hain.

solutions.en: After 5 minutes, power on the ESS per the manual and reset the system on the user interface.
solutions.ur: 5 minute baad manual ke mutabiq ESS power on karke user interface par system reset karein.

solutions.en: If the alarm persists, export logs and contact technical support - a cooling fault left unattended overheats the packs.
solutions.ur: Agar alarm bana rahe to logs export karke technical support se rabta karein - cooling fault ko nazarandaz kiya jaye to packs garm ho jate hain.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS (LUNA2000-215-2S10 / 2S11 / 2S12, 161-2S11, 107-1S11) standalone Alarm Reference
aliases: PCS Grid Phase Wire Short-Circuited to PE

title.en: PCS Grid Phase Wire Short-Circuited to PE
title.ur: PCS grid phase wire PE se short ho gayi

meaning.en: An AC output phase wire of the PCS is short-circuited to PE, so the inverter has dropped off-grid.
meaning.ur: PCS ki AC output phase wire PE se short ho gayi hai, is liye inverter grid se utar gaya hai.

causes.en: The AC output phase wire is short-circuited to PE.
causes.ur: AC output phase wire PE se short ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Ages or dust on the AC busbars, which can bridge to earth in humid conditions.
causes.ur: AC busbars par ghisay ya dhool jo humid conditions mein earth se bridge kar sakti hai.

solutions.en: Power off the ESS per the user manual.
solutions.ur: User manual ke mutabiq ESS band karein.

solutions.en: Turn off the secondary circuit breaker of the transformer and lock it out.
solutions.ur: Transformer ka secondary circuit breaker band karke lock out karein.

solutions.en: Use a megohmmeter to measure impedance between the AC side and ground; if below roughly 100 kOhm, rectify the fault.
solutions.ur: Megohmmeter se AC side aur ground ke darmiyan impedance measure karein; agar 100 kOhm se kam hai to fault theek karein.

solutions.en: If the impedance is normal, contact technical support rather than re-energising.
solutions.ur: Agar impedance normal hai to dobara energise karne ke bajaye technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS (LUNA2000-215-2S10 / 2S11 / 2S12, 161-2S11, 107-1S11) standalone Alarm Reference

title.ur: Low PCS insulation resistance (PCS insulation kam)

meaning.en: The PCS insulation resistance to ground is below the protection threshold, so the unit has disconnected from the grid.
meaning.ur: PCS ka ground ke khilaf insulation resistance protection threshold se kam hai, is liye unit grid se disconnect ho gaya hai.

causes.en: The PCS side is short-circuited to ground.
causes.ur: PCS side ground se short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: The PCS has operated in a damp environment and insulation between the PCS and ground has degraded.
causes.ur: PCS damp environment mein chala hai aur PCS aur ground ke darmiyan insulation kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Set the insulation resistance protection threshold on the user interface to the minimum value allowed by the grid standard.
solutions.ur: User interface par insulation resistance protection threshold ko grid standard ke mutabiq minimum value par set karein.

solutions.en: Power off the ESS per the manual before any measurement.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi measurement karne se pehle manual ke mutabiq ESS band karein.

solutions.en: Check that the device PE cable is correctly connected.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke device ka PE cable correctly connected hai.

solutions.en: Use a megohmmeter to check common-mode insulation, splitting the circuit to locate the low-resistance section.
solutions.ur: Common-mode insulation check karne ke liye megohmmeter use karein aur circuit baant kar kam-resistance hissa dhoondein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS (LUNA2000-215-2S10 / 2S11 / 2S12, 161-2S11, 107-1S11) standalone Alarm Reference

meaning.en: The LTMS electric heater cannot run properly, so the thermal system cannot keep battery temperature in range.
meaning.ur: LTMS ka electric heater theek se nahi chal raha, is liye thermal system battery temperature range mein nahi rakh sakta.

causes.en: The cable to the electric heater is loose or damaged.
causes.ur: Electric heater ka cable loose ya damaged hai.

causes.en: The coolant is insufficient, i.e. there is a leak in the LTMS or a pipe.
causes.ur: Coolant kam hai, matlab LTMS ya pipe mein leakage hai.

causes.en: The electric heater itself is faulty.
causes.ur: Electric heater khud faulty hai.

solutions.en: Power off the ESS per the manual first.
solutions.ur: Pehle manual ke mutabiq ESS band karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the heater cable is disconnected or broken; if so, reconnect the electric heater connector.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke heater cable disconnect ya toota hai ya nahi; agar haan to electric heater connector dobara laga dein.

solutions.en: Check for leakage in the LTMS or a pipe; if leakage exists, replace the LTMS per the maintenance manual.
solutions.ur: LTMS ya pipe mein leakage check karein; leakage ho to maintenance manual ke mutabiq LTMS badal dein.

solutions.en: If the cable and coolant are proven good, replace the LTMS per the maintenance manual.
solutions.ur: Agar cable aur coolant dono theek nikle to maintenance manual ke mutabiq LTMS badal dein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS (LUNA2000-215-2S10 / 2S11 / 2S12, 161-2S11, 107-1S11) standalone Alarm Reference
aliases: High Relative Humidity Inside ESS Cabin

title.en: High Relative Humidity Inside ESS Cabin
title.ur: ESS cabin mein humidity zyada hai (condensation ka khatra)

meaning.en: Cabin relative humidity is high. The system still charges and discharges, but there is a condensation risk.
meaning.ur: Cabin ki relative humidity zyada hai. System ab bhi charge aur discharge ho raha hai, lekin condensation ka khatra hai.

causes.en: Dehumidification fails.
causes.ur: Dehumidification fail ho gayi hai.

causes.en: ESS doors not completely closed let cabin humidity in - the manual lists door closure as a check alongside LTMS state and temperature control mode.
causes.ur: ESS doors poori tarah band na hon se cabin mein humidity aa rahi hai - manual door closure ko LTMS state aur temperature control mode ke saath hi check batata hai.

solutions.en: Ensure the temperature control mode is set to automatic, not manual.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke temperature control mode automatic par set hai, manual par nahi.

solutions.en: Check whether the LTMS is normal and whether the ESS doors are completely closed.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke LTMS normal hai aur ESS doors poori tarah band hain.

solutions.en: In humid climates, add a door seal inspection and check that the cabinet is not in a shaded pocket trapping vapour.
solutions.ur: Humid climates mein door seal inspection bhi karein aur check karein ke cabinet aise shaded jagah nahi hai jahan vapour atak jaye.

solutions.en: If the alarm persists, export logs and contact technical support - condensation on HV terminals is a safety issue.
solutions.ur: Agar alarm bana rahe to logs export karke technical support se rabta karein - HV terminals par condensation safety ka masla hai.

source.title: LUNA2000-(107-215) Series Smart String ESS Alarm Reference, Issue 03 (2025-07-22)

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)
aliases: Low battery DC input bus voltage

title.en: Low Battery DC Input Bus Voltage
title.ur: Battery DC input bus voltage kam hai

meaning.en: The battery DC bus voltage is too low, so the battery cannot support the system.
meaning.ur: Battery ka DC bus voltage bohat kam hai, is liye battery system ko support nahi kar sakti.

causes.en: The DC bus voltage of the battery is low.
causes.ur: Battery ka DC bus voltage kam hai.

causes.en: The battery DC switch is OFF.
causes.ur: Battery DC switch OFF hai.

causes.en: The battery cables are not correctly connected.
causes.ur: Battery cables theek se connected nahi hain.

solutions.en: Turn off the inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch and battery DC switch, then wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karein, phir 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery power cable connections on the [Battery-1/2] power control module against the quick installation guide.
solutions.ur: [Battery-1/2] power control module par battery power cable connections ko quick installation guide ke mutabiq check karein.

solutions.en: Once the cables are confirmed correct, turn on in sequence: battery DC switch, AC output switch, inverter DC input switch.
solutions.ur: Cables sahi confirm hone ke baad is tarah on karein: battery DC switch, AC output switch, inverter DC input switch.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)

title.ur: Battery power control module abnormal hai

meaning.en: A major fault occurred on the internal circuit of the battery power control module (PCS-side controller of the battery).
meaning.ur: Battery power control module ke internal circuit par major fault aaya hai (battery ka PCS-side controller).

causes.en: A major fault has occurred on the internal circuit of the battery power control module.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ke internal circuit par major fault aaya hai.

causes.en: Internal communication of the power control module is abnormal - listed as an explicit second cause for this same alarm ID 3001 in the LUNA2000-S1 Table 7-2 (Issue 06).
causes.ur: Power control module ki internal communication abnormal hai - isi alarm ID 3001 ke liye LUNA2000-S1 Table 7-2 (Issue 06) mein doosri explicit wajah ke tor par listed hai.

solutions.en: Turn off inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch and battery DC switch; wait 5 minutes, then turn battery DC switch back on first.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karein; 5 minute intezaar karein, phir pehle battery DC switch on karein.

solutions.en: Watch the battery fault indicator: the manual says a steady-on fault indicator confirms a persistent module fault.
solutions.ur: Battery fault indicator dekhein: manual ke mutabiq steady-on fault indicator persistent module fault confirm karta hai.

solutions.en: If the fault indicator is still steady on after the restart, record the module position and contact your dealer or Huawei support.
solutions.ur: Restart ke baad bhi fault indicator steady on ho to module ki position note karke dealer ya Huawei support se rabta karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)

title.ur: Battery power control module garm ho gaya (overtemperature)

meaning.en: The power control module is running hot - poor ventilation, excessive ambient temperature, or a module fault.
meaning.ur: Power control module garm chal raha hai - ventilation kam, ambient temperature zyada, ya module fault.

causes.en: The installation position of the battery power control module is not well ventilated.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ki installation jagah well ventilated nahi hai.

causes.en: The ambient temperature is excessively high.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: The battery power control module is abnormal.
causes.ur: Battery power control module abnormal hai.

solutions.en: Check the ventilation and whether the ambient temperature at the [Battery-1/2] module exceeds the upper threshold.
solutions.ur: [Battery-1/2] module par ventilation check karein aur ambient temperature upper threshold se zyada to nahi hai.

solutions.en: Improve airflow: clear any wall gap obstruction and keep the documented clearance around the heat sink.
solutions.ur: Airflow behtar karein: deewar ke gap ki rukaawat saaf karein aur heat sink ke aas paas documented clearance rakhein.

solutions.en: Measure temperature at the heat sink with a contact thermometer; if ventilation and ambient are already within limits, suspect the module.
solutions.ur: Contact thermometer se heat sink ka temperature measure karein; agar ventilation aur ambient pehle se limits mein hain to module par shak karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)
aliases: Battery power control module fuse blown

title.en: Battery Power Control Module Fuse Blown
title.ur: Battery power control module ka fuse udd gaya

meaning.en: The fuse inside the battery power control module has blown, usually after an overcurrent event inside the battery.
meaning.ur: Battery power control module ka fuse udd gaya hai, aam tor par battery ke andar overcurrent ke baad.

causes.en: The fuse of the battery power control module is blown.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ka fuse udd gaya hai.

causes.en: An internal overcurrent or short has already damaged the module - replacing only the fuse may not clear it.
causes.ur: Internal overcurrent ya short module ko pehle hi kharab kar chuka hai - sirf fuse badalna kaafi na ho.

solutions.en: Turn off inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch and battery DC switch, and wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karein, aur 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Replace the fuse of the [Battery-1/2] power control module with the exact rating specified in the manual.
solutions.ur: [Battery-1/2] power control module ka fuse manual mein diye gaye exact rating se badal dein.

solutions.en: Turn on in sequence (battery DC, AC output, inverter DC input). If the new fuse also blows, the module is damaged - stop and escalate.
solutions.ur: Is tarah on karein (battery DC, AC output, inverter DC input). Agar naya fuse bhi udd jaye to module kharab hai - ruk kar escalate karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)
aliases: Battery power control module reversely connected

title.en: Battery Power Control Module Reversely Connected
title.ur: Battery power control module ulti polarity se connected hai

meaning.en: The positive and negative battery terminals are wired reversed between the power control module and the inverter.
meaning.ur: Power control module aur inverter ke darmiyan battery ke positive aur negative terminals ulhe polarity se lage hain.

causes.en: Positive and negative terminals are reversely connected when the module connects to the inverter.
causes.ur: Module inverter se connect hote waqt positive aur negative terminals ulhe polarity se hain.

causes.en: Polarity is reversed on the DC bus cable run rather than at the module, so the fault presents at the module even though the module's own wiring is correct.
causes.ur: Polarity module par nahi, DC bus cable run mein uli hui hai, is liye module apni wiring sahi hone ke bawajood fault dikhata hai.

solutions.en: Do not power anything up. Isolate all three switches and wait 5 minutes first.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi power up na karein. Teeno switches isolate karein aur pehle 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Verify polarity with a DC voltmeter across the battery-side cable ends before re-terminating anything.
solutions.ur: Dobara terminate karne se pehle battery-side cable ke ends par DC voltmeter se polarity verify karein.

solutions.en: Re-terminate to the quick installation guide, then power up in the manual's sequence.
solutions.ur: Quick installation guide ke mutabiq dobara terminate karein, phir manual ke sequence se power up karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)
aliases: Battery power control module DC switch OFF

title.en: Battery Power Control Module DC Switch OFF
title.ur: Battery power control module ka DC switch OFF hai

meaning.en: The battery's own DC switch is off, or the DC bus cable to the module is disconnected, so the battery is not reachable.
meaning.ur: Battery ka apna DC switch off hai, ya module ka DC bus cable disconnect hai, is liye battery reachable nahi.

causes.en: The DC switch of the battery power control module is OFF.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ka DC switch OFF hai.

causes.en: The DC bus cable to the battery power control module is disconnected.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ka DC bus cable disconnect hai.

solutions.en: Turn off inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch and battery DC switch, then wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karein, phir 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check the DC bus cable connection and the battery DC switch handle position on the [Battery-1/2] module.
solutions.ur: [Battery-1/2] module par DC bus cable connection aur battery DC switch handle ki position check karein.

solutions.en: Turn on in sequence and confirm the battery appears online in the app.
solutions.ur: Is tarah on karke app par confirm karein ke battery online aa gayi hai.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)

meaning.en: A major fault occurred on the internal circuit of the battery expansion module (the stackable pack).
meaning.ur: Battery expansion module ke internal circuit par major fault aaya hai (stacking wala pack).

causes.en: A major fault has occurred on the internal circuit of the battery expansion module.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ke internal circuit par major fault aaya hai.

causes.en: Power or communication cables between power control module and expansion module are loose.
causes.ur: Power control module aur expansion module ke darmiyan power ya communication cable loose hai.

solutions.en: Check that the power cables and communication cables between modules are correctly seated and torqued.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke modules ke darmiyan power aur communication cables sahi se baithi hain aur torque ki gayi hain.

solutions.en: Reseat the communication connector at both ends; a single high-resistance pin produces this alarm.
solutions.ur: Communication connector dono ends par dobara laga dein; ek high-resistance pin se yeh alarm aa jata hai.

solutions.en: If the alarm remains with the fault indicator steady on, note the expansion module position and escalate to dealer or Huawei support.
solutions.ur: Agar fault indicator steady on hone par alarm bana rahe to expansion module ki position note karke dealer ya Huawei support ko batayein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)

title.ur: Battery expansion module ka cable disconnect hai

meaning.en: The cable to a battery expansion module is disconnected, so that pack is not in the communication chain.
meaning.ur: Battery expansion module ka cable disconnect hai, is liye woh pack communication chain mein nahi hai.

causes.en: A battery expansion module cable is disconnected.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ka cable disconnect hai.

causes.en: A battery expansion module is abnormal (second listed cause).
causes.ur: Battery expansion module abnormal hai (doosri listed wajah).

solutions.en: Turn off inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch and battery DC switch, and wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karein, aur 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Trace the daisy-chain cables between expansion modules and reseat every connector, including the last module's terminator.
solutions.ur: Expansion modules ke darmiyan daisy-chain cables trace karke har connector dobara laga dein, aakhri module ke terminator samet.

solutions.en: Power back in the manual sequence and confirm the expansion module count in the app matches the physical count.
solutions.ur: Manual sequence se power on karein aur app mein expansion module ki tadaad physical tadaad se match karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)

title.ur: Battery expansion module garm ho gaya (overtemperature)

meaning.en: A battery pack is running hot - the installation position is poorly ventilated or ambient is too high.
meaning.ur: Battery pack garm chal raha hai - installation jagah ventilation kamzor hai ya ambient zyada hai.

causes.en: The battery installation position is not well ventilated.
causes.ur: Battery ki installation position well ventilated nahi hai.

causes.en: The ambient temperature is excessively high.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat zyada hai.

solutions.en: Check ventilation and ambient temperature at each expansion module's position.
solutions.ur: Har expansion module ki position par ventilation aur ambient temperature check karein.

solutions.en: Keep the documented clearance to walls and clear any stacked equipment above the packs.
solutions.ur: Deewar se documented clearance rakhein aur packs ke upar rakhta koi equipment saaf karein.

solutions.en: In Pakistan summer peak, check whether the shaded side of the cabinet is the one facing the wall; reposition if so.
solutions.ur: Pakistan mein summer peak par check karein ke cabinet ka shaded side hi deewar ki taraf hai; agar haan to position badal dein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)

title.ur: Battery expansion module ka temperature kam hai

meaning.en: Ambient temperature in the installation positions is too low, or the expansion module is abnormal.
meaning.ur: Installation positions ka ambient temperature bohat kam hai, ya expansion module abnormal hai.

causes.en: The ambient temperature is excessively low.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat kam hai.

causes.en: A battery expansion module is abnormal.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module abnormal hai.

solutions.en: Check ambient temperature in the installation positions of the expansion modules.
solutions.ur: Expansion modules ki installation positions ka ambient temperature check karein.

solutions.en: In cold weather, confirm the pack self-heating is active and not blocked by a covered cabinet.
solutions.ur: Cold weather mein confirm karein ke pack ka self-heating on hai aur covered cabinet se block nahi hai.

solutions.en: If the module is genuinely at fault, allow the pack to warm naturally and re-check before replacing anything.
solutions.ur: Agar module waqai faulty hai to pack ko naturally garm hone dein aur kuch badalne se pehle dobara check karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)

title.ur: Battery expansion module mein short circuit

meaning.en: A battery expansion module is short-circuited, or the module is abnormal. Treat as a fire-risk event.
meaning.ur: Battery expansion module short-circuited hai, ya module abnormal hai. Aag ke khatre ka event samajhein.

causes.en: The battery expansion module is short-circuited.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module short-circuited hai.

causes.en: A battery expansion module is abnormal (second listed cause).
causes.ur: Battery expansion module abnormal hai (doosri listed wajah).

solutions.en: Turn off inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch and battery DC switch, and wait 5 minutes before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch chhune se pehle inverter AC output switch, inverter DC input switch aur battery DC switch band karein aur 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: With DC isolated, measure each expansion module's internal resistance to identify the shorted pack.
solutions.ur: DC isolate kar ke har expansion module ka internal resistance measure karke shorted pack pehchan lein.

solutions.en: Do not re-energise a shorted pack; quarantine it and escalate to dealer or Huawei support.
solutions.ur: Shorted pack dobara power na dein; use isolate karke dealer ya Huawei support ko batayein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)

meaning.en: The voltage of a battery expansion module is low. Usually clears once charging resumes or sunlight/AC reverse charging is available.
meaning.ur: Battery expansion module ka voltage kam hai. Charging resume hone ya sunlight/AC reverse charging milne par aam tor par khatam ho jata hai.

causes.en: The voltage of a battery expansion module is low.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ka voltage kam hai.

causes.en: The input voltage of a battery expansion module is insufficient to charge it.
causes.ur: Battery expansion module ka input voltage charge karne ke liye kaafi nahi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether sunlight is sufficient or AC reverse charging is permitted - the manual conditions recovery on this.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke sunlight kaafi hai ya AC reverse charging ki ijazat hai - manual recovery isi par shart karta hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the DC bus voltage at the power control module is above the pack's minimum charge threshold.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke power control module par DC bus voltage pack ke minimum charge threshold se upar hai.

solutions.en: Do not force-charge a deeply discharged pack; follow the manual's hibernation/wake procedure instead.
solutions.ur: Bohat discharge hua pack force-charge na karein; manual ka hibernation/wake tareeqa follow karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)

meaning.en: The battery pack or an individual cell voltage is too low. The manual splits this into 3047-1 (pack undervoltage protection) and 3047-2 (cell undervoltage protection).
meaning.ur: Battery pack ya kisi ek cell ka voltage bohat kam hai. Manual ise 3047-1 (pack undervoltage protection) aur 3047-2 (cell undervoltage protection) mein baantta hai.

causes.en: The voltage of the battery pack or its cell is too low.
causes.ur: Battery pack ya uske cell ka voltage bohat kam hai.

causes.en: Cell undervoltage protection has latched (3047-2) after a deep discharge.
causes.ur: Deep discharge ke baad cell undervoltage protection latch ho gaya (3047-2).

solutions.en: Confirm the PV array is actually generating before expecting the pack to recover - check PV voltage at the pack input.
solutions.ur: Pack ki recovery ki umeed karne se pehle confirm karein ke PV array actually generate kar raha hai - pack input par PV voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery DC switch and every battery-to-inverter cable for an open connection.
solutions.ur: Battery DC switch aur battery se inverter tak ke har cable ko open connection ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: If the pack is deeply discharged, use the documented hibernation then wake sequence; do not jump-start with an external supply.
solutions.ur: Agar pack deep discharge ho chuka hai to documented hibernation phir wake sequence use karein; external supply se jump start na karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)

title.ur: ESS ke firmware versions inconsistent hain

meaning.en: The control unit firmware version is inconsistent with the versions of the other modules in the system.
meaning.ur: Control unit ka firmware version system ke baaki modules ke versions se inconsistent hai.

causes.en: The version of the battery power control module is inconsistent with that of the battery packs.
causes.ur: Battery power control module ka version battery packs ke version se inconsistent hai.

causes.en: The update failed part-way through a stack.
causes.ur: Stack update ke dauran beech mein fail ho gaya.

solutions.en: Read the firmware version of the control unit and each pack in the app to find which one is out of step.
solutions.ur: App par control unit aur har pack ka firmware version padhein dekhne ke liye ke kaun sa baqi se alag hai.

solutions.en: Run the app's ESS update so every module converges on the same version.
solutions.ur: App ka ESS update chalayein taake har module ek hi version par aa jaye.

solutions.en: If the update fails repeatedly, contact your dealer or technical support instead of forcing a version skip.
solutions.ur: Agar update baar baar fail ho to zor se version skip karne ke bajaye dealer ya technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 battery / Smart String ESS (numbered alarm table, LUNA2000-5/10/15-S0 generation)

title.ur: Battery pack ki lifespan khatam ho gayi

meaning.en: The battery has reached the end of its designed lifespan and needs recycling. Not a repairable fault.
meaning.ur: Battery ki design ki hui lifespan khatam ho gayi hai aur recycling zaroori hai. Yeh gair-qaabil-e-tamir fault hai.

causes.en: The battery has reached its lifespan through normal ageing and charge cycles.
causes.ur: Battery apni lifespan tak normal ageing aur charge cycles ke zariye pohanch gayi hai.

causes.en: No electrical or firmware fault is involved - the manual lists ageing and cycling only, so this is a wear-out condition rather than a defect.
causes.ur: Isme koi electrical ya firmware fault shamil nahi hai - manual sirf ageing aur cycling list karta hai, is liye yeh defect nahi balki wear-out condition hai.

solutions.en: Confirm remaining capacity in the app before condemning - a single module may be flagged while others are healthy.
solutions.ur: Kharab karne se pehle app mein baaki capacity confirm karein - ho sakta hai ek module flag ho aur baaki healthy hon.

solutions.en: Contact the local recycling agency named in the manual for compliant disposal.
solutions.ur: Manual mein bataye gaye local recycling agency se rabta karein taaki disposal compliant ho.

solutions.en: Record the serial number and warranty status; end-of-life is a warranty exclusion, not a defect claim.
solutions.ur: Serial number aur warranty status note karein; end-of-life warranty exclusion hai, defect claim nahi.

source.title: LUNA2000-(5-30)-S0 User Manual, Issue 14 (2023-05-31), Section 8.3 Table 8-2

meaning.en: Both running LEDs solid green: the battery is charging from PV or discharging to the inverter.
meaning.ur: Dono running LEDs solid green: battery PV se charge ho rahi hai ya inverter ko discharge kar rahi hai.

causes.en: Normal charge or discharge operation.
causes.ur: Normal charge ya discharge chal raha hai.

solutions.en: No action needed; cross-check the current flow direction in the app if you suspect reverse power.
