codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

title.ur: PV string input voltage bohat zyada

meaning.en: Too many PV modules are connected in series, so the string open-circuit voltage exceeds the inverter's maximum input voltage.
meaning.ur: PV string mein modules zyada series mein hain, is liye open-circuit voltage inverter ki maximum se zyada ho gaya.

causes.en: Too many modules wired in series in the PV array.
causes.ur: PV array mein series mein modules ki tadaad zyada hai.

causes.en: Series count differs per MPPT: Cause ID 1 = PV1 and PV2, Cause ID 2 = PV3 and PV4.
causes.ur: Har MPPT par series count alag hai: Cause ID 1 = PV1 aur PV2, Cause ID 2 = PV3 aur PV4.

solutions.en: With the DC switch OFF, measure the string Voc with a multimeter rated 1100 V DC or higher.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF kar ke, 1100 V DC ya us se upar wale multimeter se string ka Voc measure karein.

solutions.en: Recount the modules in series on the reported string and reconfigure so Voc stays under the inverter maximum.
solutions.ur: Mashoor string ke series modules dobara gin lein aur configuration aise karein ke Voc inverter ki maximum se kam rahe.

solutions.en: Confirm the alarm clears by itself once the array is correctly configured, then re-close the DC switch.
solutions.ur: Array sahi se configure hone ke baad alarm apne aap khatam hona chahiye, phir DC switch dobara band karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

title.ur: DC arc fault (PV wiring mein charcha)

meaning.en: The PV string power cable is arcing or has a poor/loose connection. Fire risk - treat as urgent.
meaning.ur: PV string power cable mein arc ya loose connection hai. Aag ka khatra hai - foran dekh lein.

causes.en: PV string power cable arcs under load.
causes.ur: Load ke waqt PV string power cable mein arc ban raha hai.

causes.en: Loose or poorly crimped MC4 connector. Cause ID 1 = PV1/PV2, Cause ID 2 = PV3/PV4.
causes.ur: MC4 connector loose hai ya theek se crimp nahi hua. Cause ID 1 = PV1/PV2, Cause ID 2 = PV3/PV4.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then inspect every MC4 connector on the flagged string in daylight for scorch marks.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV disconnect kar ke, mashoor string ke har MC4 connector ko din mein dekh kar soor ke nishaan check karein.

solutions.en: Re-crimp or replace the affected connector with an approved type; never tape a hot connector.
solutions.ur: Affected connector ko dobara crimp karein ya approved type se badal dein; garam connector par tape mat lagayein.

solutions.en: After clearing, this alarm must be reset manually in the app, then restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Fault hatane ke baad yeh alarm app se manually reset karna hota hai, phir inverter restart karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

title.ur: PV string ulti polarity se lagi hai

meaning.en: A PV string is wired into the inverter with polarity reversed.
meaning.ur: Koi PV string inverter mein ulti polarity se lagi hai.

causes.en: PV string connected to the wrong input / swapped polarity. Cause ID 1-4 map to PV1-PV4.
causes.ur: PV string galat input par lagi hai ya polarity swap ho gayi. Cause ID 1-4 PV1 se PV4 tak map hote hain.

causes.en: The string is landed on the wrong MPPT input, so it reads as reversed even when the module-to-string wiring itself is correct.
causes.ur: String galat MPPT input par lagi hai, is liye module se string ki wiring sahi hone par bhi yeh reversed nazar aati hai.

solutions.en: Wait for night or shading so string current drops below 0.5 A before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch karne se pehle raat ya shadow ka intezaar karein jab tak string current 0.5 A se neeche na gir jaye.

solutions.en: Set the DC SWITCH to OFF, then correct the string polarity at the input terminals.
solutions.ur: DC SWITCH ko OFF karein, phir input terminals par string ki polarity theek karein.

solutions.en: Re-measure polarity with a DC voltmeter (positive reading on the marked + input) before switching DC back on.
solutions.ur: DC wapas on karne se pehle DC voltmeter se polarity dobara check karein (marked + input par positive reading aaye).

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

title.ur: String current backfeed (shorter string ka current)

meaning.en: Too few modules in series on one string, so its end voltage is lower than the parallel strings and current flows back into it.
meaning.ur: Ek string mein modules kam hain, is liye uska end voltage parallel strings se kam hai aur current wapas us mein ja raha hai.

causes.en: Fewer modules in series on this string than on the strings running parallel with it (Cause ID 1-4 = PV1-PV4).
causes.ur: Is string mein parallel wali doosri strings se modules kam hain (Cause ID 1-4 = PV1-PV4).

causes.en: Partial shading on this string only.
causes.ur: Sirf is string par partial shading hai.

solutions.en: Count series modules on the flagged string and compare with the parallel strings; equalise the counts.
solutions.ur: Mashoor string ke series modules gin kar parallel strings se compare karein; tadaad barabar karein.

solutions.en: Wait until string current falls below 0.5 A, set DC SWITCH to OFF, then adjust the module count.
solutions.ur: Jab tak string current 0.5 A se neeche na gir jaye, wait karein, DC SWITCH OFF karke module ki tadaad adjust karein.

solutions.en: Check for shading with an irradiance meter or by inspecting at different sun angles, then verify string Voc is normal.
solutions.ur: Shading check karne ke liye irradiance meter use karein ya alag alag dhoop ke angles par dekhein, phir string ka Voc normal check karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)
aliases: Output phase wire short-circuited to PE

title.en: Output Phase Wire Short-Circuit to PE
title.ur: Output phase wire PE se short ho gaya

meaning.en: Impedance of an output phase wire to PE is low or short-circuited, so the inverter has earthed the AC output.
meaning.ur: Output phase wire ka PE se impedance kam hai ya short, is liye inverter ne AC output disconnect kar diya.

causes.en: Damaged AC cable insulation touching the PE conductor or enclosure metal.
causes.ur: AC cable ki insulation kharab hai aur woh PE conductor ya enclosure metal ko chhu rahi hai.

causes.en: Water or moisture tracking inside the AC output gland.
causes.ur: AC output gland ke andar paani ya nami leakage ho rahi hai.

solutions.en: Open AC switch first, lock it out, and tag it before any measurement.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC switch kholein, lock out karein aur tag lagayein, phir koi bhi measurement karein.

solutions.en: Measure each phase conductor to PE with a megohmmeter and find the low-impedance leg.
solutions.ur: Har phase conductor ko PE ke against megohmmeter se measure karke kam impedance wali leg dhoondein.

solutions.en: Replace the damaged cable section or gland, then re-test before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Kharab cable section ya gland badal dein, phir dobara test karke hi energise karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

title.ur: Grid failure (AC ya grid ka nahi chalna)

meaning.en: The inverter has lost the grid or the AC supply. Usually clears automatically once the grid is back.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne grid ya AC supply khoya hai. Grid aane par khud ba khud theek ho jata hai.

causes.en: The power grid has an outage (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid mein outage hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: The AC circuit is disconnected or the AC switch is off.
causes.ur: AC circuit disconnect hai ya AC switch band hai.

solutions.en: Measure AC voltage at the inverter terminals with a multimeter to confirm the grid is present.
solutions.ur: Confirm karne ke liye multimeter se inverter terminals par AC voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC switch and the AC cable terminations for a loose or open connection.
solutions.ur: AC switch aur AC cable ke terminations ko loose ya khuli connection ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: Do not force a reset while the grid is absent; the inverter will retry on its own.
solutions.ur: Grid ki absence mein zor se reset na karein; inverter apne aap retry karega.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: Grid voltage fell below the undervoltage threshold, or stayed low longer than the LVRT period.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage undervoltage threshold se neeche gir gaya, ya LVRT time se zyada der kam raha.

causes.en: Grid voltage below the lower threshold (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid voltage lower threshold se kam hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Undervoltage lasted longer than the configured LVRT value.
causes.ur: Undervoltage configured LVRT value se zyada der raha.

causes.en: Heavy load on a weak local distribution line, common on Pakistani feeder faults.
causes.ur: Kamzor local distribution line par heavy load — Pakistan mein feeder fault par aam baat hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the inverter AC terminals under load, not at an empty socket.
solutions.ur: Grid voltage inverter ke AC terminals par load ke saath measure karein, khali socket par nahi.

solutions.en: Check the AC switch and output power cable connection if the fault persists for a long time.
solutions.ur: Agar fault lambe arse tak rahe to AC switch aur output power cable ki connection check karein.

solutions.en: Only with the power operator's consent, adjust the undervoltage threshold via app, SmartLogger or NMS.
solutions.ur: Sirf power operator ki ijazat se app, SmartLogger ya NMS par undervoltage threshold change karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: Grid voltage rose above the upper threshold, or stayed high longer than the HVRT period.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage upper threshold se upar chala gaya, ya HVRT period se zyada der high raha.

causes.en: Grid voltage beyond the upper threshold (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid voltage upper threshold se upar hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: High voltage persisted longer than the configured HVRT value.
causes.ur: High voltage configured HVRT value se zyada der raha.

causes.en: Long cable run to the inverter raises the voltage seen at the AC terminals at peak generation.
causes.ur: Inverter tak lamba cable peak generation par AC terminals par voltage barha deta hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the inverter AC terminals and log the peak value over one clear day.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminals par grid voltage measure karein aur ek saaf din ka peak value note karein.

solutions.en: If voltage is genuinely above the utility limit, report it to the local power operator.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage waqai utility ki limit se upar hai to local power operator ko report karein.

solutions.en: Do not raise the threshold on your own; it needs the operator's written consent.
solutions.ur: Apne aap threshold barhana nahi hai; uske liye operator ki likhit ijazat chahiye.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

title.ur: Unbalanced grid voltage (phase voltage ka farq)

meaning.en: The difference between grid phase voltages exceeds the upper threshold.
meaning.ur: Grid phase voltages ka farq upper threshold se zyada hai.

causes.en: Phase-to-phase voltage difference above the upper limit (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Phase-to-phase voltage ka farq upper limit se upar hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Single-phase loads badly distributed across the three phases.
causes.ur: Teen phases par single-phase load khayal se baant na ho.

solutions.en: Measure all three phase-to-neutral voltages with a clamp meter or multimeter and record them.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter ya multimeter se teenon phase-to-neutral voltages measure kar record karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC output power cable terminations for a loose high-resistance connection on one phase.
solutions.ur: AC output power cable ke terminations check karein ke kisi ek phase par loose connection to nahi hai.

solutions.en: If cabling is sound, report the persistent imbalance to the local power operator.
solutions.ur: Agar wiring theek hai to lambe arse ki imbalance local power operator ko report karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: Actual grid frequency is higher than the standard required for the local grid.
meaning.ur: Actual grid frequency local grid ke standard se zyada hai.

causes.en: Grid frequency above the local standard limit (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid frequency local standard limit se upar hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Generator-backed supply or a lightly loaded feeder running at over-frequency.
causes.ur: Generator se chalti supply ya halki load par chal raha feeder over-frequency par.

solutions.en: Read the live frequency from the inverter display/app, not from a cheap clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Live frequency inverter ki app ya display se dekhein, sasti clamp meter se nahi.

solutions.en: If it is occasional, wait for the grid to normalise; the inverter auto-recovers.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar nahi hai to grid normal hone ka intezaar karein; inverter khud recover ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If frequent, log the frequency and report to the power operator; adjust threshold only with their consent.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to frequency note karke power operator ko batayein; threshold sirf unhi ki ijazat se badlein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: Actual grid frequency is lower than the standard required for the local grid.
meaning.ur: Actual grid frequency local grid ke standard se kam hai.

causes.en: Grid frequency below the local standard limit (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid frequency local standard limit se kam hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Heavy generator loading on a weak local grid pulling frequency down.
causes.ur: Kamzor local grid par generator ka heavy load frequency gir raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the live frequency on the inverter app while recording whether load shedding is happening upstream.
solutions.ur: Inverter app par live frequency dekhein aur note karein ke upstream par load shedding ho rahi hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If occasional, let the inverter auto-recover once frequency returns inside the window.
solutions.ur: Agar occasional hai to frequency window mein wapas aane par inverter ko khud recover hone dein.

solutions.en: If frequent, report to the power operator before touching the underfrequency threshold.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar ho to underfrequency threshold chhune se pehle power operator ko batayein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: The rate of change of grid frequency does not comply with the local grid standard.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency ka badalne ki rate local grid standard ke mutabiq nahi hai.

causes.en: Grid frequency change rate violates the local grid code (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid frequency change rate local grid code ka khilaf hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Large motor or generator starting/stopping on the same feeder.
causes.ur: Usi feeder par koi bada motor ya generator start/stop ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Log frequency over time in the app or NMS and note the timestamps of large loads switching.
solutions.ur: App ya NMS par time ke saath frequency log karein aur bade loads switch hone ke time note karein.

solutions.en: Check whether a neighbour generator or large motor starts exactly when the alarm appears.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke alarm kaane waqt hi koi padosi ka generator ya bada motor start hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If cabling and load are fine, report the unstable frequency to the power operator.
solutions.ur: Agar wiring aur load theek hain to power operator ko unstable frequency report karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: A sudden grid voltage drop or a short circuit pushed the inverter's transient output current above the protection threshold.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage ka sudden girna ya short circuit ne inverter ke transient output current ko protection threshold se upar le jaaya.

causes.en: Grid voltage drops dramatically or the grid is short-circuited (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Grid voltage achanak gir gaya ya grid short ho gaya (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Inverter transient output current exceeded the upper threshold, tripping protection.
causes.ur: Inverter ka transient output current upper threshold se upar gaya aur protection chali.

solutions.en: First let the inverter auto-recover; it monitors external conditions in real time.
solutions.ur: Pehle inverter ko khud recover hone dein; yeh real time par external conditions monitor karta hai.

solutions.en: If the alarm repeats and cuts production, isolate AC and check the output circuit for a short with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Agar alarm dohray aur production roke to AC isolate kar ke multimeter se output circuit mein short check karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC cable terminations and the AC switch for a hot or loose joint.
solutions.ur: AC cable terminations aur AC switch ko garam ya loose joint ke liye check karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

title.ur: Output ka DC component zyada hai

meaning.en: The DC component of the inverter's output current exceeded the specified upper threshold.
meaning.ur: Inverter output current ka DC component specified upper threshold se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: DC component of the SUN2000 output current exceeded the upper limit (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: SUN2000 output current ka DC component upper limit se upar gaya (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Distorted or unstable grid waveform from a weak or overloaded feeder.
causes.ur: Kamzor ya overloaded feeder se grid waveform bigda hua ya unstable hai.

solutions.en: Record the live waveform and frequency on the inverter app before any hardware work.
solutions.ur: Koi hardware kaam karne se pehle inverter app par live waveform aur frequency record karein.

solutions.en: If it repeats, isolate AC and verify the PE and N connections are correct and tight.
solutions.ur: Agar dohraye to AC isolate karke PE aur N connections sahi aur mazboot hain check karein.

solutions.en: If the grid waveform is the cause, report the distortion to the power operator rather than changing the inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar wajah grid waveform hai to inverter badalne ke bajaye power operator ko distortion batayein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: Insulation impedance from the input side to PE fell while the inverter was running, so the RCD/residual-current protection acted.
meaning.ur: Inverter chalte waqt input side se PE ki insulation impedance gir gayi, is liye RCD ne kaam kiya.

causes.en: Insulation impedance of the input side to PE decreased during operation (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Chalne ke dauran input side se PE ki insulation impedance kam ho gayi (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Wet, dusty or rodent-damaged PV string insulation after monsoon humidity.
causes.ur: Monsoon humidity ke baad geeli, dhool bhari ya chuhe se kharab PV string insulation.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then measure each string's resistance to PE with a megohmmeter at 500 V or 1000 V test voltage.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV disconnect kar ke, har string ka PE ke against resistance 500 V ya 1000 V test voltage par megohmmeter se measure karein.

solutions.en: Split the array string by string to find the wet or damaged section; look for cracked backsheets and chewed cables.
solutions.ur: Har string ko alag alag karke geela ya kharab hissa dhoondein; cracked backsheet aur chuhiye se kaata cable dekhein.

solutions.en: Dry the affected connectors, replace damaged insulation, and only then reset the protection threshold.
solutions.ur: Affected connectors ko sukha dein, kharab insulation badal dein, phir hi protection threshold reset karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: The PE cable or neutral-earth arrangement is wrong, so the inverter's residual voltage check tripped.
meaning.ur: PE cable ya neutral-earth ka connection ghalat hai, is liye inverter ka residual voltage check chala.

causes.en: The N cable or ground cable is not connected (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: N cable ya ground cable connected nahi hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: When the PV array is earthed, the inverter output is not connected to an isolation transformer.
causes.ur: PV array grounded hone par inverter output isolation transformer se connected nahi hai.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter and verify the PE cable is bonded to the enclosure earth stud with a low-resistance joint.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein aur check karein ke PE cable enclosure earth stud se kam resistance ke joint se lagi hai.

solutions.en: On a TN grid, measure the neutral-to-earth voltage; it should be near zero.
solutions.ur: TN grid par neutral-to-earth voltage measure karein; yeh lagbhag zero hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If an isolation transformer is fitted, set Grounding inspection to Disable via app, SmartLogger or NMS.
solutions.ur: Agar isolation transformer laga hai to app, SmartLogger ya NMS par Grounding inspection ko Disable karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: The PV array's resistance to ground is too low: either a short to PE, or damp air has degraded the insulation between modules and ground.
meaning.ur: PV array ka ground ke against resistance kam hai: ya to PE se short hai, ya damp weather mein module aur ground ke darmiyan insulation kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: PV array is short-circuited with PE (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: PV array PE se short ho gaya hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Ambient air around the PV array is damp, so insulation between array and ground is poor.
causes.ur: PV array ke aas paas ka hawa damp hai, is liye array aur ground ke darmiyan insulation kamzor hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV first; then measure the array-to-ground output resistance with a megohmmeter.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC aur PV disconnect karein; phir megohmmeter se array-to-ground output resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the inverter PE cable is correctly connected before hunting array faults.
solutions.ur: Array fault dhoondne se pehle confirm karein ke inverter ka PE cable theek se connected hai.

solutions.en: Clean and dry connectors, replace cracked MC4 parts, and re-measure before resetting the threshold.
solutions.ur: Connectors saaf aur sukha karein, cracked MC4 parts badal dein, aur threshold reset karne se pehle dobara measure karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: The inverter's internal temperature is high - poor ventilation, high ambient, or a unit fault.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka andar ka temperature zyada hai - ventilation kam, ambient zyada, ya unit mein kharabi.

causes.en: SUN2000 installed where ventilation is poor (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: SUN2000 aise jagah lagai hai jahan ventilation kam hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Ambient temperature exceeds the upper threshold.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature upper threshold se zyada hai.

causes.en: The SUN2000 is not working properly (internal or fan fault).
causes.ur: SUN2000 theek nahi chal raha (internal ya fan fault).

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature at the installation point with an IR or contact thermometer.
solutions.ur: Installation point par IR ya contact thermometer se ambient temperature measure karein.

solutions.en: Check for blocked air paths, a hot wall behind the unit, or stacked equipment above it; clear at least the documented clearance.
solutions.ur: Blocked air paths, unit ke peechhe garm deewar ya upar rakhte samay equipment check karein; kam az kam documented clearance rakhein.

solutions.en: Confirm the internal fan runs (M0 is fanless - an audible fan means a different model); on fan models clean the fan and filter.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke internal fan chal raha hai (M0 fanless hai - sunai de raha fan matlab model hi different hai); fan wale models par fan aur filter saaf karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

title.ur: Device fault (inverter ki andar ki kharabi)

meaning.en: An unrecoverable fault occurred on a circuit inside the inverter. Cause IDs 1-12 identify which internal circuit.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke andar kisi circuit par unrecoverable fault aaya hai. Cause ID 1-12 batata hai ke kaun sa circuit.

causes.en: Unrecoverable fault on an internal circuit, Cause ID 1-12.
causes.ur: Internal circuit par unrecoverable fault, Cause ID 1-12.

causes.en: The fault is current-dependent: the manual's note that Cause ID 1 must be handled only below 1 A PV string current shows this circuit trips on load, not at rest.
causes.ur: Fault current par depend karta hai: manual ka note ke Cause ID 1 ko sirf 1 A PV string current se neeche handle karna hai, is liye yeh circuit load par trip karta hai, khud to nahi.

solutions.en: Turn off the AC output switch, then the DC input switch, and wait 5 minutes before doing anything.
solutions.ur: AC output switch band karein, phir DC input switch band karein, aur kuch karne se pehle 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Turn them back on in the reverse order and watch the app for the same Cause ID.
solutions.ur: Ulta order mein on karein aur app par wahi Cause ID dobara aata hai ya nahi dekhein.

solutions.en: If Cause ID is 1, do this step only while PV string current is below 1 A, then note the Cause ID for Huawei support.
solutions.ur: Agar Cause ID 1 hai to yeh kaam sirf PV string current 1 A se kam hone par karein, phir Huawei support ke liye Cause ID note karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)
aliases: Upgrade Failed or Software Version Unmatch

title.ur: Upgrade fail ya software version mismatch

meaning.en: A firmware upgrade did not complete normally. Cause IDs 1, 2 and 4 are listed in this manual.
meaning.ur: Firmware upgrade normally complete nahi hua. Is manual mein Cause ID 1, 2 aur 4 listed hain.

causes.en: The upgrade process did not end normally (Cause ID 1, 2, 4).
causes.ur: Upgrade process normally end nahi hua (Cause ID 1, 2, 4).

causes.en: Inverter stuck in initialisation state with PV inputs disconnected, then reconnected.
causes.ur: Inverter initialisation state mein atak gaya, PV inputs disconnect karke dobara connect kiye gaye.

solutions.en: Run the upgrade again using a SanDisk, Netac or Kingston USB flash drive with the script at the root.
solutions.ur: SanDisk, Netac ya Kingston USB flash drive se upgrade dobara chalayein, script root mein rakhein.

solutions.en: Leave PV disconnected during the retry so the unit reaches the upgrade state, then reconnect PV only after the restart.
solutions.ur: Retry ke dauran PV disconnect chhodein taake unit upgrade state tak pahunche, restart ke baad hi PV dobara connect karein.

solutions.en: If it fails several times, record the Cause ID and escalate to Huawei support instead of repeating blindly.
solutions.ur: Agar kai baar fail ho to Cause ID note karke Huawei support ko batayein, baar baar anjaan retry na karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: The privilege certificate has entered its grace period, or the privilege feature will soon become invalid.
meaning.ur: Privilege certificate grace period mein aa gaya hai, ya privilege feature jald invalid ho jayega.

causes.en: The privilege certificate has entered the grace period (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Privilege certificate grace period mein aa gaya hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: The privilege feature will become invalid soon.
causes.ur: Privilege feature jald invalid ho jayega.

solutions.en: Apply for a new certificate for the exact serial number of the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit ke exact serial number ke liye naya certificate apply karein.

solutions.en: Load the new certificate via the app, SmartLogger or NMS and confirm the grace-period alarm clears.
solutions.ur: Naya certificate app, SmartLogger ya NMS se load karein aur confirm karein ke grace-period alarm khatam ho gaya.

solutions.en: Check the inverter's date and time are correct first; a wrong clock can make a valid certificate look expired.
solutions.ur: Pehle inverter ki date aur time sahi hain ya nahi check karein; galat clock valid certificate ko expired dikha deta hai.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

title.ur: Faulty power collector (power meter ki comms)

meaning.en: Communication between the inverter and the power meter (collector) has been interrupted.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur power meter (collector) ke darmiyan communication toot gaya hai.

causes.en: The power meter communication is interrupted (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Power meter ki communication interrupt ho gayi (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: RS485 wiring polarity swapped or screen at both ends.
causes.ur: RS485 wiring ki polarity uli hui hai ya dono taraf se shield nahi hua.

solutions.en: Confirm the power meter model setting in the inverter matches the physical meter model.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke inverter mein power meter ka model setting physical meter ke model se match karta hai.

solutions.en: Check the RS485 communication parameters on both the meter and the SUN2000 are identical.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke RS485 communication parameters meter aur SUN2000 dono par identical hain.

solutions.en: Verify the meter is powered and the RS485 cable A/B conductors are correctly terminated.
solutions.ur: Verify karein ke meter powered hai aur RS485 cable ke A/B conductors sahi terminate hain.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: The inverter measured an AC phase voltage above its transient overvoltage protection threshold.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne AC phase voltage ko transient overvoltage protection threshold se upar detect kiya.

causes.en: Inverter detected a phase voltage above the transient AC overvoltage threshold (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Inverter ne transient AC overvoltage threshold se upar phase voltage detect kiya (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: Switch-on surge from the grid, e.g. when a large capacitor bank or transformer is energised.
causes.ur: Grid se switch-on surge, jaise bada capacitor bank ya transformer on hone par.

solutions.en: Log the AC peak voltage in the app during the event to see how far above the threshold it went.
solutions.ur: Event ke dauran app par AC peak voltage log karein dekhne ke liye ke threshold se kitna upar gaya.

solutions.en: If grid connection voltage exceeds the upper limit, report it to the local power operator.
solutions.ur: Agar grid connection voltage upper limit se upar hai to local power operator ko report karein.

solutions.en: Only with operator consent, raise the transient overvoltage threshold via app, SmartLogger or NMS.
solutions.ur: Sirf operator ki ijazat se app, SmartLogger ya NMS par transient overvoltage threshold barhayein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 (three-phase string inverter, numbered alarm table)

title.ur: Monitoring unit faulty (flash memory ki kharabi)

meaning.en: The monitoring unit's flash memory is insufficient or has bad sectors, so logging and monitoring fail.
meaning.ur: Monitoring unit ki flash memory kam hai ya us mein bad sectors hain, is liye logging aur monitoring fail ho gayi.

causes.en: The flash memory is insufficient (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Flash memory insufficient hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: The flash memory has bad sectors.
causes.ur: Flash memory mein bad sectors hain.

solutions.en: Turn off the AC output switch, then the DC input switch, and wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: AC output switch band karein, phir DC input switch band karein, aur 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Turn the AC switch on first, then the DC switch, and confirm the alarm clears in the app.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC switch on karein, phir DC switch, aur app par alarm khatam hone ki tasdeeq karein.

solutions.en: If the flash keeps failing, note the serial number and log export and raise a warranty case for the board.
solutions.ur: Agar flash baar baar fail ho to serial number aur log export note karke board ke liye warranty case raise karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Section 7.2 Table 7-2

codes.uid: huawei/huawei-sun2000-m0-led/LED1 Steady green + LED2 Steady green
codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL...20KTL)-M0 LED1/LED2/LED3 indicator states (Table 2-2 LED indicator description)
codes.code: LED1 Steady green + LED2 Steady green
codes.codeNorm: LED1 STEADY GREEN LED2 STEADY GREEN
aliases: LED1 Steady green + LED2 Steady green

title.ur: Grid-tied mode mein chal raha hai (normal)

meaning.en: Both running LEDs solid green: the inverter is exporting to the grid normally.
meaning.ur: Dono running LEDs solid green: inverter normally grid mein power de raha hai.

causes.en: Normal operation, AC and DC both live.
causes.ur: Normal operation, AC aur DC dono live hain.

solutions.en: No action needed; this is the healthy state.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaroori nahi; yeh healthy state hai.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Table 2-2 LED indicator description

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL...20KTL)-M0 LED1/LED2/LED3 indicator states (Table 2-2 LED indicator description)

meaning.en: Both running LEDs off - the DC input is not live. The AC may still be on, so check the external AC switch.
meaning.ur: Dono running LEDs off - DC input live nahi hai. AC ab bhi on ho sakta hai, is liye external AC switch check karein.

causes.en: DC switch off, or PV voltage below the MPPT startup threshold (night/no irradiance).
causes.ur: DC switch off hai, ya PV voltage MPPT startup threshold se kam hai (raat/irradiance nahi).

solutions.en: Note the manual caveat: the AC may be on. Verify the external AC switch position before touching the DC side.
solutions.ur: Manual ka note yaad rakhein: AC on ho sakta hai. DC side chhune se pehle external AC switch ki position verify karein.

solutions.en: At night both LEDs being off is normal; re-check after sunrise.
solutions.ur: Raat mein dono LEDs off hona normal hai; sunrise ke baad dobara check karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(8KTL, 10KTL, 12KTL, 15KTL, 17KTL, 20KTL)-M0 User Manual, Issue 03 (2019-07-19), Table 2-2 LED indicator description

codes.uid: huawei/huawei-sun2000-m0-led/LED1 Blinking red at short intervals (0.2s on / 0.2s off)
codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(8KTL...20KTL)-M0 LED1/LED2/LED3 indicator states (Table 2-2 LED indicator description)
codes.code: LED1 Blinking red at short intervals (0.2s on / 0.2s off)
codes.codeNorm: LED1 BLINKING RED AT SHORT INTERVALS 0.2S ON / 0.2S OFF
aliases: LED1 Blinking red at short intervals (0.2s on / 0.2s off)

title.ur: DC environmental alarm (PV side ka masla)

meaning.en: LED1 blinking fast red marks an environmental (external) fault on the DC/PV side. The numeric code is in the app.
meaning.ur: LED1 fast red blink DC/PV side ka environmental (external) fault batata hai. Numeric code app mein hota hai.

causes.en: PV string wiring, polarity or insulation problem on the DC side.
causes.ur: PV string wiring, polarity ya insulation ka masla DC side par.

causes.en: PV string open-circuit voltage too high or too low.
causes.ur: PV string open-circuit voltage bohat zyada ya bohat kam hai.

solutions.en: Connect with the FusionSolar app to read the numeric alarm ID before touching the DC side.
solutions.ur: DC side chhune se pehle FusionSolar app se connect karke numeric alarm ID padh lein.

solutions.en: Open the app's DC-environmental troubleshooting page; it guides the string to check.
solutions.ur: App ka DC-environmental troubleshooting page kholein; yeh check karne wali string batata hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV before re-torquing MC4 connectors or re-seating strings.
solutions.ur: MC4 connectors dobara torque karne ya strings dobara lagane se pehle AC aur PV disconnect karein.

title.ur: DC environmental fault (PV side ka masla)

meaning.en: PV connection LED blinking fast green, with the alarm/maintenance LED red, indicates an environmental fault on the DC side.
meaning.ur: PV connection LED fast green blink aur alarm/maintenance LED red ka matlab DC side ka environmental fault hai.

causes.en: Environmental fault at the DC side: string voltage, polarity, isolation or AFCI related.
causes.ur: DC side ka environmental fault: string voltage, polarity, isolation ya AFCI se related.

causes.en: Combos/whitesmoke, soiling or debris on the module glass reducing string voltage.
causes.ur: Module glass par combos/whitesmoke, ghisav ya mairaaj girane se string voltage kam hota hai.

solutions.en: Open the app and read the DC-environmental alarm; the manual says to troubleshoot DC faults there as instructed by the app.
solutions.ur: App kholein ke DC-environmental alarm padhein; manual ke mutabiq wahi app ke mutabiq troubleshooting karein.

solutions.en: Measure per-string Voc and current with a clamp meter in full sun and compare the MPPT strings against each other.
solutions.ur: Poori dhoop mein clamp meter se har string ka Voc aur current measure karke MPPT strings ka aapas comparison karein.

solutions.en: Clean modules and check string fuses/combiner before suspecting the inverter; DC environmental faults are usually external.
solutions.ur: Inverter par shak karne se pehle modules saaf karein aur string fuses/combiner check karein; DC environmental faults aam tor par bahari hote hain.

title.ur: DC internal fault (inverter ki andar ki kharabi)

meaning.en: PV connection LED solid red with the alarm/maintenance LED red indicates an internal fault on the DC side of the inverter.
meaning.ur: PV connection LED solid red aur alarm/maintenance LED red ka matlab inverter ke DC side ka internal fault hai.

causes.en: Internal DC-side circuit fault inside the inverter (PV connection LED preferentially shows environmental faults, so solid red means internal).
causes.ur: Inverter ke andar DC side ka internal circuit fault (PV connection LED pehle environmental faults dikhata hai, is liye solid red ka matlab internal hai).

causes.en: The DC switches may already have auto-tripped on that internal fault, so the strings read as dead and the fault is misdiagnosed as a string problem.
causes.ur: Us internal fault par DC switches khud trip ho chuke ho sakte hain, is liye strings dead nazar aati hain aur fault string ka masla samajh liya jata hai.

solutions.en: Read the numeric alarm in the app before touching the DC side - this red state is an internal fault, not a wiring fault.
solutions.ur: DC side chhune se pehle app par numeric alarm padhein - yeh red state internal fault hai, wiring fault nahi.

solutions.en: Power off per the manual: AC switch, then all DC switches; this model needs 15 minutes to discharge to a safe voltage.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq band karein: AC switch, phir saare DC switches; is model ko safe voltage tak discharge hone mein 15 minute lagte hain.

solutions.en: If the internal fault persists after a documented restart, raise a case with the alarm ID - internal DC faults are not field-repairable.
solutions.ur: Documented restart ke baad bhi internal fault bana rahe to alarm ID ke saath case raise karein - internal DC faults field par repair nahi hote.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage and frequency at the AC terminals before assuming the inverter is faulty.

meaning.en: Grid connection LED solid red with the alarm/maintenance LED red indicates an internal fault on the AC side of the inverter.
meaning.ur: Grid connection LED solid red aur alarm/maintenance LED red ka matlab inverter ke AC side ka internal fault hai.

causes.en: Internal AC-side circuit fault, e.g. relay, filter or current sensing failure.
causes.ur: AC side ka internal circuit fault, maslan relay, filter ya current sensing ki kharabi.

causes.en: Internal fault on the AC side of the solar inverter.
causes.ur: Solar inverter ke AC side ka internal fault.

solutions.en: Get the numeric alarm in the app first; this state is not an external grid problem.
solutions.ur: Pehle app par numeric alarm lein; yeh state external grid ka masla nahi hai.

solutions.en: Power off in the documented order and wait the full 15 minutes discharge time before opening the AC compartment.
solutions.ur: Documented order se band karke AC compartment kholne se pehle poori 15 minute discharge time ka intezaar karein.

solutions.en: If it returns, check the AC cable and lugs once for a burned joint, then escalate with the alarm ID.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to AC cable aur lugs ko jhilm se kharaab joint ke liye ek baar check karein, phir alarm ID ke saath escalate karein.

meaning.en: The alarm/maintenance LED is solid red: a major alarm has been generated.
meaning.ur: Alarm/maintenance LED solid red: major alarm generate hua hai.

causes.en: A major alarm has been generated on the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter par major alarm generate hua hai.

causes.en: If the PV or grid connection indicator is blinking green fast, the manual directs you to troubleshoot DC or AC environmental faults in the app.
causes.ur: Agar PV ya grid connection indicator fast green blink kar raha hai to manual ke mutabiq app par DC ya AC environmental fault troubleshoot karein.

solutions.en: If the PV/grid LEDs are blinking green fast, follow the app's DC or AC environmental fault guidance.
solutions.ur: Agar PV/grid LEDs fast green blink kar rahe hain to app ka DC ya AC environmental fault guidance follow karein.

solutions.en: If neither PV nor grid LED is blinking green fast, the manual says to replace components or the inverter as instructed by the app.
solutions.ur: Agar na PV na grid LED fast green blink kar raha hai to manual ke mutabiq app ke instructions ke mutabiq components ya inverter replace karein.

solutions.en: Record the alarm ID and Cause ID from the app before any restart, as the app's instructions depend on them.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi restart se pehle app se alarm ID aur Cause ID note karein, kyunke app ke instructions inhi par based hote hain.

title.ur: Minor alarm (production kam, unit chal raha hai)

meaning.en: The alarm/maintenance LED blinking red fast: a minor alarm has been generated.
meaning.ur: Alarm/maintenance LED fast red blink: minor alarm generate hua hai.

causes.en: A minor alarm has been generated; some components are faulty but the unit can still feed the grid.
causes.ur: Minor alarm generate hua hai; kuch components kharab hain lekin unit ab bhi grid mehenay de sakta hai.

causes.en: A component is degraded rather than failed - the manual's own definition of a minor alarm is a component fault that does not stop grid feeding, so the usual culprits are fan, sensor or filter degradation.
causes.ur: Component fail nahi balki degrade hua hai - manual ka apna minor alarm definition hai component fault jo grid mehenay nahi rokta, is liye aam culprits fan, sensor ya filter ki degradation hain.

solutions.en: Read the alarm in the app; minor alarms are exactly the ones that are safe to fix while the unit keeps running.
solutions.ur: App par alarm padhein; minor alarms wahi hain jinhein unit chalte hue theek kiya ja sakta hai.

solutions.en: Prioritise derating-type causes: fan degradation, high temperature, or partial shading on one MPPT.
solutions.ur: Derating wali wajuhain pehle dekhein: fan ki degradation, high temperature, ya ek MPPT par partial shading.

solutions.en: Do not ignore a minor alarm that keeps returning - it usually precedes a major one on this platform.
solutions.ur: Baar baar aane wala minor alarm ignore na karein - is platform par aam tor par iske baad major aata hai.

meaning.en: The alarm/maintenance LED blinking red slowly: a warning alarm has been generated, usually an output derate.
meaning.ur: Alarm/maintenance LED slow red blink: warning alarm generate hua hai, aam tor par output derate.

causes.en: A warning alarm has been generated; the unit works but output power is reduced by external factors.
causes.ur: Warning alarm generate hua hai; unit chalta hai lekin external factors se output power kam hai.

causes.en: Power limit or export limitation enabled by the utility or site settings.
causes.ur: Power limit ya export limitation utility ya site settings se on ki gayi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether an export/power limit has been enabled in the app or by the utility - this is the most common warning cause.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke app ya utility ne export/power limit on ki hai ya nahi - yeh sab se aam warning ki wajah hai.

solutions.en: Compare the actual output against the expected kW for the irradiance; a persistent gap points to soiling or shading.
solutions.ur: Actual output ko irradiance ke mutabiq expected kW se compare karein; persistent gap par soiling ya shading ka shak karein.

solutions.en: Verify the grid code settings match the local requirement; a wrong grid code silently derates the unit.
solutions.ur: Grid code settings local requirement se match karte hain ya nahi check karein; galat grid code unit ko chupke se derate kar deta hai.

aliases: Alarm/Maintenance indicator Blinking green slowly or steady green

title.ur: Local maintenance chal raha hai (USB/WLAN/Bluetooth session)

meaning.en: Steady green = local maintenance succeeded; blinking green = local maintenance failed; blinking green slowly = in local maintenance or shut down by command.
meaning.ur: Steady green = local maintenance successful; blinking green = local maintenance fail; slow green blink = local maintenance mein ya command se shutdown.

causes.en: A USB flash drive, WLAN module, Bluetooth module or USB data cable is inserted into the USB port for local maintenance.
causes.ur: Local maintenance ke liye USB port mein USB flash drive, WLAN module, Bluetooth module ya USB data cable lagaya gaya hai.

solutions.en: If the LED blinks green slowly, the maintenance session is still running - wait for it to finish before pulling the device.
solutions.ur: Agar LED slow green blink kare to maintenance session chal raha hai - device nikalne se pehle uska intezaar karein.

solutions.en: If the LED blinks green fast, the operation failed; remove the USB device and retry, checking that the upgrade package was not modified.
solutions.ur: Agar LED fast green blink kare to operation fail hua; USB device nikaal ke dohra karein aur check karein ke upgrade package modify nahi kiya gaya.

solutions.en: After removing the device, the indicator shows the true alarm state - the manual warns maintenance state is shown first.
solutions.ur: Device nikalne ke baad indicator asal alarm state dikhata hai - manual warn karta hai ke pehle maintenance state dikhta hai.

title.ur: Saare PV strings se disconnect hai

meaning.en: PV connection LED off: the inverter is disconnected from all PV strings, or the DC input voltage of all MPPT circuits is below 200 V.
meaning.ur: PV connection LED off: inverter saare PV strings se disconnect hai, ya saare MPPT circuits ka DC input voltage 200 V se kam hai.

causes.en: All DC switches off, or all MPPT inputs below the 200 V minimum.
causes.ur: Saare DC switches off, ya saare MPPT inputs 200 V minimum se neeche hain.

causes.en: Night with no PV generation.
causes.ur: Raat mein PV generation nahi ho rahi.

solutions.en: At night this is normal; re-check after sunrise.
solutions.ur: Raat mein yeh normal hai; sunrise ke baad dobara check karein.

solutions.en: In daylight, measure the DC bus at the PV terminals with a 1100 V-rated meter; below 200 V points to an open string circuit.
solutions.ur: Din mein 1100 V rated meter se PV terminals par DC bus measure karein; 200 V se kam hai to open string circuit ki nishani hai.

solutions.en: Check every DC switch position and string fuse; the MC0 manual notes DC switches can auto-trip on an internal fault.
solutions.ur: Har DC switch ki position aur string fuse check karein; MC0 manual ke mutabiq DC switches internal fault par khud trip kar sakte hain.

meaning.en: Both running LEDs solid orange: the inverter is supplying a local backup load instead of following the grid.
meaning.ur: Dono running LEDs solid orange: inverter grid ke bajaye local backup load ko supply kar raha hai.

causes.en: Grid lost while backup output was enabled, so the inverter is islanding the backup circuit.
causes.ur: Backup output on hone ke baad grid chala gaya, is liye inverter backup circuit island kar raha hai.

solutions.en: No fault action; verify in the app that backup mode is intentional for this site.
solutions.ur: Koi fault action nahi; app par confirm karein ke backup mode is site ke liye qasd se on hai.

solutions.ur: Agar backup expected nahi tha to backup enable button aur critical-load AC wiring check karein.

causes.ur: Grid nahi hai aur backup load current nahi kheech raha.

causes.en: Backup output not enabled via the backup enable button.
causes.ur: Backup enable button se backup output enable nahi kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Check the critical-load breaker is closed and measure voltage on the backup output with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke critical-load breaker bandh nahi hai aur multimeter se backup output par voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the backup enable button on the unit is pressed as per the manual.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke manual ke mutabiq unit par backup enable button daba hua hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If grid is present and backup output is still dead, check the neutral-earth bonding in the backup sub-panel.
solutions.ur: Agar grid mojood hai lekin backup output ab bhi dead hai to backup sub-panel mein neutral-earth bonding check karein.

title.ur: Power export ho raha hai lekin optimizer fault hai

meaning.en: LED1 blinks red slowly while LED2 is solid green: the inverter is still exporting, but an attached optimizer is faulty.
meaning.ur: LED1 slowly red blink aur LED2 solid green: inverter ab bhi export kar raha hai, lekin laga hua optimizer faulty hai.

causes.en: A connected SUN2000 optimizer has an internal fault or has lost communication.
causes.ur: Connected SUN2000 optimizer mein internal fault hai ya uski communication chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Optimizer cable or connector open at the optimizer end.
causes.ur: Optimizer ka cable ya connector optimizer end par khula hai.

solutions.en: Open the optimizer page in the app and note which optimizer serial is flagged.
solutions.ur: App mein optimizer page kholein aur note karein ke kaun sa optimizer serial flag ho raha hai.

solutions.en: With PV isolated, measure the optimizer output voltage; an optimizer should read near its module Voc, not 0 V.
solutions.ur: PV isolate kar ke optimizer output voltage measure karein; optimizer ko apne module ke Voc ke qareeb par dikhna chahiye, 0 V nahi.

solutions.en: Reseat the optimizer connectors and, if still faulty, replace the optimizer - not the inverter.
solutions.ur: Optimizer connectors dobara laga dein aur phir bhi faulty ho to optimizer badal dein - inverter nahi.

title.ur: Backup mode chal raha hai lekin optimizer fault hai

meaning.en: LED1 blinks red slowly while LED2 is solid orange: the unit is in backup state and an optimizer is faulty.
meaning.ur: LED1 slowly red blink aur LED2 solid orange: unit backup state mein hai aur optimizer faulty hai.

causes.en: Backup mode active while an attached optimizer reports a fault.
causes.ur: Backup mode on hai aur attached optimizer fault report kar raha hai.

causes.en: Optimizer supply absent on the backup island, so the optimizer drops out.
causes.ur: Backup island par optimizer ka supply nahi hai, is liye optimizer drop out ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Confirm in the app whether the optimizer fault is real or is a side effect of no grid/optimizer supply.
solutions.ur: App par confirm karein ke optimizer fault asli hai ya grid/optimizer supply na hone ka asar hai.

solutions.en: With PV isolated, check optimizer connectors and the optimizer ribbon cable for a broken conductor.
solutions.ur: PV isolate kar ke optimizer connectors aur optimizer ribbon cable mein toota conductor check karein.

solutions.en: Return the site to grid-tied mode first, then re-read the optimizer status before replacing parts.
solutions.ur: Pehle site ko grid-tied mode par la dein, phir parts badalne se pehle optimizer status dobara padhein.

meaning.en: A phone is connected to the inverter - typically via the built-in WiFi access point.
meaning.ur: Phone inverter se connected hai - aam tor par built-in WiFi access point ke zariye.

causes.en: A technician's phone is in the local WiFi session with the inverter.
causes.ur: Technician ka phone inverter ke local WiFi session mein hai.

solutions.en: Read the alarm list on the phone while this state persists, then disconnect the phone to free the link.
solutions.ur: Is state mein phone par alarm list padhein, phir link khaal karne ke liye phone disconnect karein.

meaning.en: No communication with the management system.
meaning.ur: Management system ke saath communication nahi hai.

causes.en: Management system or app not connected, or the unit is powered off.
causes.ur: Management system ya app connected nahi, ya unit band hai.

solutions.en: If the unit is generating, check the WiFi antenna is seated and the app is on the correct site account.
solutions.ur: Agar unit generate kar raha hai to check karein ke WiFi antenna baithi hui hai aur app sahi site account par hai.

solutions.en: If the unit is off, confirm PV and AC are energised with a multimeter before blaming comms.
solutions.ur: Agar unit off hai to comms ko blame karne se pehle multimeter se PV aur AC energized hain confirm karein.

title.ur: AFCI self-check failure (arc detector khud check nahi kar paya)

meaning.en: The inverter's AFCI (arc fault circuit interrupter) failed its self-check at startup, so the unit shuts down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka AFCI startup par self-check mein fail ho gaya, is liye unit shutdown ho jata hai.

causes.en: AFCI self-check fails (Cause ID 1-2).
causes.ur: AFCI self-check fail ho gaya (Cause ID 1-2).

causes.en: AFCI detector module or its wiring is faulty, or PV-side noise triggered a false trip.
causes.ur: AFCI detector module ya uski wiring kharabi hai, ya PV side ke noise se false trip hua hai.

solutions.en: Turn off the AC output switch and the DC input switch, then wait 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: AC output switch aur DC input switch band karein, phir 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Turn them back on and watch whether the AFCI self-check completes on the next start.
solutions.ur: Dobara on karein aur dekhein ke next start par AFCI self-check complete hoti hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it persists, inspect PV string cables for chafing near the combiner and record the Cause ID for the installer.
solutions.ur: Agar bani rahe to combiner ke paas PV string cables ki chafing check karein aur installer ke liye Cause ID note karein.

title.ur: DC arc fault (manually clear karna hota hai)

meaning.en: PV string power cable arcs or is in poor contact. This is an ADMC alarm - after fixing, it must be manually cleared.
meaning.ur: PV string power cable mein arc ya poor contact hai. Yeh ADMC alarm hai - theek karne ke baad manually clear karna hota hai.

causes.en: The PV string power cable arcs or is in poor contact.
causes.ur: PV string power cable mein arc ya poor contact hai.

causes.en: Cause ID 1 = string 1, Cause ID 2 = string 2 (this model's Cause IDs are per-string, unlike M0's per-MPPT).
causes.ur: Is model mein Cause ID 1 = string 1, Cause ID 2 = string 2 (M0 ke per-MPPT ke bajaye per-string).

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV before inspecting; treat as a live arc risk, not a nuisance alarm.
solutions.ur: Ghairat ka masla hai, is liye AC aur PV disconnect kar ke hi inspect karein.

solutions.en: Check every string circuit for arcing or poor contact, including combiner fuses and cable gland entries.
solutions.ur: Har string circuit mein arc ya poor contact check karein, combiner fuses aur cable gland entries bhi.

solutions.en: After the fault is rectified, clear the alarm manually in the app and start the inverter again.
solutions.ur: Fault theek hone ke baad app mein alarm manually clear karein aur inverter dobara start karein.

title.ur: Grid failure (grid ya AC nahi hai)

meaning.en: Grid outage, or the AC circuit is disconnected / AC switch off. Shutdown with automatic recovery.
meaning.ur: Grid outage hai, ya AC circuit disconnect hai / AC switch off hai. Shutdown ke saath khud recover hota hai.

causes.en: The power grid experiences an outage (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Power grid mein outage hai (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: The AC circuit is disconnected or the AC switch is in the OFF position.
causes.ur: AC circuit disconnect hai ya AC switch OFF position mein hai.

solutions.en: Check the AC voltage with a multimeter at the inverter AC terminals.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter ke AC terminals par AC voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the AC power cable is connected and the AC switch is in the ON position.
solutions.ur: Tasdeeq karein ke AC power cable connected hai aur AC switch ON position mein hai.

solutions.en: If the utility side is fine but the alarm repeats, check the AC cable for a high-resistance joint at the lug.
solutions.ur: Agar utility side theek hai lekin alarm dohraye to AC cable ke lug par high-resistance joint check karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 (US residential string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: Inverter internal temperature high - poor ventilation, ambient above the upper threshold, or unit not working properly. This manual grades it Major, unlike the M0 manual which grades it Minor.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka andar ka temperature zyada hai - ventilation kam, ambient upper threshold se upar, ya unit theek nahi chal raha. Ye manual ise Major grade karta hai, M0 manual Minor karta hai.

causes.en: The SUN2000 is installed in a place with poor ventilation.
causes.ur: SUN2000 kam ventilation wali jagah lagai hai.

causes.en: The ambient temperature exceeds the upper threshold.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature upper threshold se zyada hai.

causes.en: The SUN2000 is not working properly (internal fault).
causes.ur: SUN2000 theek nahi chal raha (internal fault).

solutions.en: Check the ventilation and ambient temperature at the installation position.
solutions.ur: Installation position par ventilation aur ambient temperature check karein.

solutions.en: If ventilation is poor or ambient is above the threshold, improve ventilation and heat dissipation before anything else.
solutions.ur: Agar ventilation kam hai ya ambient threshold se upar hai to pehle ventilation aur heat dissipation behtar karein.

solutions.en: If both meet requirements, contact your installer - this points to an internal fault.
solutions.ur: Agar dono requirements meet karte hain to installer se rabta karein - yeh internal fault ki nishani hai.

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 (US residential string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: An unrecoverable fault on an internal circuit. Cause ID 3,4 auto-recover; 5,6-7,14 need manual reset; 8-13 shut down and auto-recover.
meaning.ur: Internal circuit par unrecoverable fault. Cause ID 3,4 khud recover hote hain; 5, 6-7, 14 manual reset maangte hain; 8-13 shutdown karke khud recover hote hain.

causes.en: Unrecoverable fault on a circuit inside the SUN2000 (Cause ID 3 through 14).
causes.ur: SUN2000 ke andar kisi circuit par unrecoverable fault (Cause ID 3 se 14 tak).

causes.en: Two failure modes share this one cause text: transient faults (Cause ID 3, 4, 8-13) clear themselves, while latched faults (Cause ID 5, 6-7, 14) need a manual alarm reset.
causes.ur: Ek hi cause text ke neeche do failure modes hain: transient faults (Cause ID 3, 4, 8-13) khud clear ho jate hain, jabke latched faults (Cause ID 5, 6-7, 14) ko manual alarm reset chahiye.

solutions.en: Turn off the AC output switch and DC input switch, wait 5 minutes, then turn them on again.
solutions.ur: AC output switch aur DC input switch band karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir dobara on karein.

solutions.en: If the fault persists, contact your installer - do not keep power cycling the unit.
solutions.ur: Agar fault bana rahe to installer se rabta karein - unit ko baar baar power cycle na karein.

solutions.en: Record which Cause ID the app shows; 5, 6-7 and 14 need a manual alarm reset, not just a power cycle.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke app kaun sa Cause ID dikhata hai; 5, 6-7 aur 14 ko sirf power cycle nahi, manual alarm reset chahiye.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 (US residential string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: The firmware upgrade did not complete normally. This manual grades it Major, unlike the M0 manual which grades it Minor.
meaning.ur: Firmware upgrade normally complete nahi hua. Ye manual ise Major grade karta hai, M0 manual Minor karta hai.

causes.en: The upgrade does not complete normally (Cause ID 1-4).
causes.ur: Upgrade normally complete nahi hota (Cause ID 1-4).

causes.en: The upgrade package files were modified, which breaks the RSA signature verification the SUN2000 upgrade procedure depends on.
causes.ur: Upgrade package ki files modify kar di gayi hain, jisse SUN2000 upgrade procedure ka RSA signature verification toot jata hai.

solutions.en: Perform the upgrade again using a supported USB flash drive and keep PV input disconnected during the retry.
solutions.ur: Supported USB flash drive se upgrade dohra karein aur retry ke dauran PV input disconnect rakhein.

solutions.en: Verify the upgrade package files were not modified - modification breaks RSA signature verification and the upgrade fails.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke upgrade package ki files modify nahi hui - modification se RSA signature verification toot-ta hai aur upgrade fail hota hai.

solutions.en: If the upgrade fails several times, contact your installer instead of retrying indefinitely.
solutions.ur: Agar kai baar fail ho to baar baar retry karne ke bajaye installer se rabta karein.

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 (US residential string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: In Grid Connection with Zero Power mode or Power-limited Grid Connection Power mode, energy meter communication is interrupted.
meaning.ur: In Grid Connection with Zero Power ya Power-limited Grid Connection Power mode mein energy meter ki communication interrupt ho gayi.

causes.en: Energy meter communication interrupted in zero-power or power-limited grid connection mode (Cause ID 1).
causes.ur: Zero-power ya power-limited grid connection mode mein energy meter communication interrupt (Cause ID 1).

causes.en: RS485 A/B reversed or the meter's RS485 termination is missing.
causes.ur: RS485 A/B ulhe hue hain ya meter par RS485 termination missing hai.

solutions.en: Check that the energy meter model setting matches the actual model fitted on site.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke energy meter ka model setting site par lagi actual model se match karta hai.

solutions.en: Check that the preset communication parameters for the meter match the actual configuration.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke meter ke preset communication parameters actual configuration se match karte hain.

solutions.en: Check that the meter is powered on and the RS485 cable is connected correctly, then reseat the connectors.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke meter on hai aur RS485 cable theek connected hai, phir connectors dobara laga dein.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 (US residential string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: Battery fault, interrupted battery communication, or the battery switch tripping while the inverter runs. Cause ID 2 (battery faulty) causes shutdown.
meaning.ur: Battery fault, battery communication interrupt, ya inverter chalte waqt battery switch trip. Cause ID 2 (battery faulty) par shutdown hota hai.

causes.en: The battery is faulty; battery communication is interrupted; battery switch trips when the SUN2000 is running (Cause ID 1, 3, 4).
causes.ur: Battery faulty hai; battery communication interrupt; inverter chalte waqt battery switch trip (Cause ID 1, 3, 4).

causes.en: The battery is faulty and communication is interrupted (Cause ID 2) - this one causes shutdown.
causes.ur: Battery faulty aur communication interrupt (Cause ID 2) - isi se shutdown hota hai.

solutions.en: Check the FAULT indicator on the front of the battery pack; if it is ON or flashing, stop and inspect.
solutions.ur: Battery pack ke front par FAULT indicator check karein; agar ON ya flash ho raha ho to ruk kar inspect karein.

solutions.en: Verify the communication cable and power cable between SUN2000 and battery, and that communication parameters match the SUN2000 RS485 config.
solutions.ur: SUN2000 aur battery ke darmiyan communication cable aur power cable check karein, aur communication parameters SUN2000 ke RS485 config se match karte hain check karein.

solutions.en: Send a shutdown command on the app, then cycle battery switch -> AC output switch -> DC input switch, waiting 5 minutes.
solutions.ur: App par shutdown command bhejein, phir battery switch -> AC output switch -> DC input switch ka cycle karein, 5 minute intezaar ke saath.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 (US residential string inverter, numbered alarm table)

title.ur: Output overload (manually clear karna hota hai)

meaning.en: The inverter output is overloaded or short-circuited. Needs manual clearing after the cause is removed.
meaning.ur: Inverter output overloaded ya short-circuited hai. Wajah hatane ke baad manually clear karna hota hai.

causes.en: The device output is short-circuited.
causes.ur: Device ka output short-circuited hai.

causes.en: The connected device load exceeds the inverter's rated value - the manual lists this as a separate check from the short circuit.
causes.ur: Connected device ka load inverter ki rated value se zyada hai - manual ise short circuit se alag check ke tor par list karta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check with a multimeter whether the output circuit is short-circuited.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karein, phir multimeter se check karein ke output circuit short to nahi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the connected device load exceeds the inverter's rated apparent power.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke connected device ka load inverter ki rated apparent power se zyada to nahi hai.

solutions.en: After fixing, clear the alarm manually in the app - a power cycle alone is not enough for this alarm.
solutions.ur: Theek karne ke baad app mein alarm manually clear karein - sirf power cycle is alarm ke liye kaafi nahi hai.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 (US residential string inverter, numbered alarm table)

meaning.en: PV array configuration does not meet requirements, or module output is reversely connected or short-circuited. Cause IDs spell out which rule is broken.
meaning.ur: PV array configuration requirements ke mutabiq nahi, ya module output ulti polarity se connected ya short hai. Cause IDs batate hain ke kaun sa rule toota hai.

causes.en: Total PV modules > 75 (ID1); modules per string > 25 (ID2); modules per string < 6 (ID3).
causes.ur: Total PV modules 75 se zyada (ID1); per string modules 25 se zyada (ID2); per string modules 6 se kam (ID3).

causes.en: Total PV strings > 2 (3.8/5/7.6 kW) or > 3 (9/10/11.4 kW) (ID4); module output reversely connected or short-circuited (ID5).
causes.ur: Total PV strings 2 se zyada (3.8/5/7.6 kW) ya 3 se zyada (9/10/11.4 kW) (ID4); module output ulti polarity se connected ya short (ID5).

solutions.en: Power off, then count total modules, modules per string and number of strings against the Cause ID limits listed above.
solutions.ur: Band karein, phir total modules, per string modules aur strings ki tadaad Cause ID limits ke mutabiq gin lein.

solutions.en: For ID5, wait for string current below 0.5 A, set DC SWITCH OFF, and correct polarity or the short before re-energising.
solutions.ur: ID5 ke liye string current 0.5 A se neeche hone ka intezaar karein, DC SWITCH OFF karein, aur dobara energise karne se pehle polarity ya short theek karein.

solutions.en: ID1-ID4 are design errors: reconfigure the array, then clear the alarm manually in the app.
solutions.ur: ID1-ID4 design errors hain: array dobara configure karein, phir app mein alarm manually clear karein.

source.title: SUN2000-(3.8KTL, 5KTL, 7.6KTL, 9KTL, 10KTL, 11.4KTL)-USL0 User Manual, Issue 02 (2018-08-30), Section 8.2 Table 8-2

codes.seriesName: ESI 3-6K-S1 (stacked single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + BTS 5K battery + EPS)

title.ur: Neutral-earth fault - neutral aur earth ke darmiyan fault (ID032)

meaning.en: A fault between neutral and protective earth. On the ESI platform this is coded ID032; on the HYD 3PH table ID032 also means N-PE, but on the EP table ID032 means 'OffgridGroundFault'. Names are not portable across tables.
meaning.ur: Neutral aur protective earth ke darmiyan fault. ESI platform par ye ID032 hai; HYD 3PH table par bhi ID032 ka matlab N-PE hai, lekin EP table par ID032 ka matlab 'OffgridGroundFault' hai. Naam table se bahar kareeb nahi kar sakte.

causes.en: Neutral and earth bonded at an unintended point, or a neutral/PE swap at the AC terminals.
causes.ur: Neutral aur earth ghalat jagah bond ho gaye, ya AC terminals par neutral/PE swap ho gaya.

causes.en: Neutral conductor broken inside the panel, so the inverter sees an N-PE offset.
causes.ur: Panel ke andar neutral conductor kat gaya, is liye inverter ko N-PE offset nazar aaya.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker and remove the inverter from the panel before touching neutral or earth bars.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karke neutral ya earth bar chhoone se pehle inverter panel se nikaalein.

solutions.en: Measure continuity between neutral and PE at the inverter AC terminal; it must not read as a low-resistance path.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC terminal par neutral aur PE ke darmiyan continuity measure karein; ye low-resistance path na de.

solutions.en: Confirm the neutral-earth bonding matches the site design and re-torque every neutral lug.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke neutral-earth bonding site design se match karti hai aur har neutral lug dobara tighten karein.

source.title: ESI 3-6K-S1 User Manual, Table 6-1 List of common events

codes.seriesName: ESI 3-6K-S1 (stacked single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + BTS 5K battery + EPS)

title.ur: CT disconnect ho gaya - CT ka link toot gaya (ID045)

meaning.en: The current transformer link is lost, so the inverter cannot measure export/import. Manual action: check whether the CT connection is correct.
meaning.ur: Current transformer ka link kho gaya, is liye inverter export/import nahi nikal sakta. Manual ka action: check karein ke CT connection theek hai ya nahi.

causes.en: CT lead unseated, or the clamp opened during a fan or battery service.
causes.ur: CT lead seat nahi hua, ya fan ya battery service ke dauran clamp khul gaya.

causes.en: CT direction reversed so it reads negative and the inverter rejects the signal.
causes.ur: CT ki direction ulti hai is liye negative read kar raha hai aur inverter signal reject kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker and check whether the CT connection is correct, including the port.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karke check karein ke CT connection theek hai, port samet.

solutions.en: Confirm the clamp arrow points with grid current flow and sits on the main feed only.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke clamp arrow grid current flow ki taraf hai aur sirf main feed par lagi hai.

solutions.en: Re-check the LCD current value; a negative or zero reading confirms a direction or wiring fault.
solutions.ur: LCD current value dobara dekhein; negative ya zero reading direction ya wiring ki ghalti confirm karta hai.

source.title: ESI 3-6K-S1 User Manual, Table 6-1 List of common events

codes.seriesName: ESI 3-6K-S1 (stacked single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + BTS 5K battery + EPS)

title.ur: EPS mode battery overcurrent - backup mein battery ka overcurrent (ID133)

meaning.en: The battery overcurrent protection latched permanently while supplying EPS backup. Manual remedy: switch off the inverter, wait 5 minutes, then switch it back on.
meaning.ur: EPS backup dete waqt battery overcurrent protection permanently trigger ho gaya. Manual ka hal: inverter off karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir wapas on karein.

causes.en: Backup load above the inverter EPS rating, e.g. a large AC, pump or compressor on transfer.
causes.ur: Backup load inverter EPS rating se upar, maslan transfer par bada AC, pump ya compressor.

causes.en: Battery or BMS fault causing a short-like current draw in EPS.
causes.ur: Battery ya BMS ki ghalti jis se EPS mein short jaisa current beh raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the EPS/load panel and clamp-meter its total current before re-energising the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter dobara current dene se pehle EPS/load panel isolate karke clamp meter se kul current check karein.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off, wait 5 minutes, then switch it on once to see if the latch was transient.
solutions.ur: Inverter off karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir ek baar on karke dekhein ke latch transient tha ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the measured load exceeds the EPS rating, split or downsize the backup loads before retrying.
solutions.ur: Agar measured load EPS rating se zyada hai to dobara koshish se pehle backup loads ko baant ya kam karein.

source.title: ESI 3-6K-S1 User Manual, Table 6-1 List of common events

codes.seriesName: ESI 3-6K-S1 (stacked single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + BTS 5K battery + EPS)

title.ur: Safety parameter version error - safety file ka version ghalat (ID152)

meaning.en: The imported safety parameter version does not match what the inverter expects, so grid protection settings may be wrong. On this platform the manual's Solution cell for this row is printed as '/', i.e. no user remedy given.
meaning.ur: Imported safety parameter ka version inverter ki expectation se match nahi karta, is liye grid protection settings ghalat ho sakte hain. Is platform par manual ka Solution cell is row ke liye '/' print hua hai, yani user ke liye hal nahi diya gaya.

causes.en: Safety file for the wrong country or an older safety parameter set imported.
causes.ur: Galat country ka safety file ya purana safety parameter set import kiya gaya.

causes.en: Firmware updated but the matching safety parameter file was not re-imported.
