causes.ur: Firmware update ho gaya magar us ke mutabiq safety parameter file dobara import nahi hui.

solutions.en: Check the safety and safety-software-version entries in the SystemInfo menu and note them.
solutions.ur: SystemInfo menu mein safety aur safety-software-version entries check kar ke note karein.

solutions.en: Re-import the correct country safety file from a USB stick per the manual's commissioning steps.
solutions.ur: Manual ke commissioning steps ke mutabiq USB se sahi country safety file dobara import karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the grid operator's protection profile matches after import before closing the AC breaker.
solutions.ur: Import ke baad AC breaker band karne se pehle confirm karein ke grid operator ka protection profile match karta hai.

source.title: ESI 3-6K-S1 User Manual, Table 6-1 List of common events

codes.seriesName: ESI 3-6K-S1 (stacked single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + BTS 5K battery + EPS)

title.ur: Battery radiator high temperature alarm - battery garm ho rahi hai (ID808)

meaning.en: The battery heat-sink temperature is above the alarm threshold. Manual action: make sure the battery is installed in a cool, well-ventilated place; if installed correctly, contact support.
meaning.ur: Battery heat-sink temperature alarm threshold se upar hai. Manual ka action: battery thande, well-ventilated jagah lagi honi chahiye; agar theek lagi hai to support se rabta karein.

causes.en: Stacked battery modules in a closed cupboard with no airflow between them.
causes.ur: Stack kiye battery modules band cupboard mein hain, aapas mein koi airflow nahi.

causes.en: High charge current in high ambient temperature.
causes.ur: Zyada ambient temperature mein high charge current.

solutions.en: Check where the battery is installed and confirm it is in a cool, well-ventilated place.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke battery kahan lagi hai aur confirm karein ke thande, well-ventilated jagah hai.

solutions.en: Leave the manual's clearance between stacked battery modules so air can circulate.
solutions.ur: Stack kiye battery modules ke darmiyan manual ka faasla rakhein takay hawa chale.

solutions.en: If the installation is already correct, contact technical support rather than moving the stack repeatedly.
solutions.ur: Agar installation pehle se theek hai to baar baar stack hatane ke bajaye technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: ESI 3-6K-S1 User Manual, Table 6-1 List of common events

codes.seriesName: ESI 3-6K-S1 (stacked single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + BTS 5K battery + EPS)

title.ur: Battery radiator over temperature protection - battery band ho gayi (ID864)

meaning.en: The battery heat-sink over-temperature protection tripped - the battery is shut down, not just warning. Manual remedy: power off and wait 2 hours.
meaning.ur: Battery heat-sink ka over-temperature protection trip hua - battery band ho gayi, sirf warning nahi. Manual ka hal: power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein.

causes.en: Module spacing too tight so heat cannot leave the stack between modules.
causes.ur: Modules ka faasla bohat kam hai jis se stack ke darmiyan se heat nahi nikal rahi.

causes.en: Battery cabinet in direct sun or a hot store room.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet direct sun mein ya garm store room mein hai.

causes.en: One module's cooling fan failed, so its own heat-sink overheats.
causes.ur: Kisi module ka cooling fan fail ho gaya, is liye us ka apna heat-sink overheat ho gaya.

solutions.en: Power off and wait 2 hours as the manual instructs, then re-check before restarting.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein, phir restart se pehle dobara check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the module heat-sink temperature with an IR thermometer and identify which module is hottest.
solutions.ur: IR thermometer se module heat-sink temperature measure karke pehchan ke kaun sa module sab se garm hai.

solutions.en: Restore the specified module spacing and ventilation; if one module alone is hot, its fan needs replacement.
solutions.ur: Specified module spacing aur ventilation wapas karein; agar sirf ek module garm hai to us ka fan replace karein.

source.title: ESI 3-6K-S1 User Manual, Table 6-1 List of common events

codes.seriesName: ESI 3-6K-S1 (stacked single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + BTS 5K battery + EPS)
aliases: Over temperature protection of ambient temperature

title.ur: Battery ambient over temperature protection - battery mahol garm hai (ID865)

meaning.en: The battery's ambient over-temperature protection tripped. Manual remedy: power off and wait 2 hours; if the problem is not solved, contact technical support.
meaning.ur: Battery ka ambient over-temperature protection trip hua. Manual ka hal: power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein; masla hal na ho to technical support se rabta karein.

causes.en: Ambient inside the battery cabinet above the allowed range.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet ke andar ka ambient allowed range se upar.

causes.en: Stacked modules sealed in a housing with no heat path to outside.
causes.ur: Stack kiye modules aise housing mein band jin ka bahar se koi heat path nahi.

solutions.en: Power off and wait the full 2 hours the manual specifies, then measure cabinet temperature.
solutions.ur: Manual ke bataye poore 2 ghante power off karke intezaar karein, phir cabinet temperature measure karein.

solutions.en: Move the stack to a shaded, ventilated position and keep the stated clearance from walls and heat sources.
solutions.ur: Stack ko dhallee, ventilated jagah le jayein aur deewar se ke garmi ke source se bataya hua faasla rakhein.

solutions.en: If the room is cool and it still trips, the internal ambient sensor needs replacement.
solutions.ur: Agar kamra thanda hai phir bhi trip ho to andar ka ambient sensor replace karna hoga.

source.title: ESI 3-6K-S1 User Manual, Table 6-1 List of common events

codes.seriesName: HYD 3-6K-EP (single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + battery + EPS + generator)

title.ur: Off-grid / EPS earth fault - backup circuit mein earth fault (ID032)

meaning.en: An earth fault was detected while the inverter was supplying the backup (off-grid) circuit. This row exists only on the EP single-phase table.
meaning.ur: Jab inverter backup (off-grid) circuit ko power de raha tha tab earth fault detect hua. Yeh row sirf EP single-phase table par hai.

causes.en: Leakage to earth in the EPS/load wiring - water in a junction box on the load side.
causes.ur: EPS/load wiring mein earth leakage - load side ke junction box mein paani.

causes.en: Load-side cable pinched or a damaged appliance pulling current to earth.
causes.ur: Load side ka cable pinch hua ya koi damaged appliance earth mein current kheench raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker and isolate the EPS/load panel completely.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke EPS/load panel ko mukammal tarah isolate karein.

solutions.en: Test the backup load wiring to earth with an insulation tester, one circuit at a time.
solutions.ur: Insulation tester se backup load wiring ko earth ke saath ek ek circuit karke test karein.

solutions.en: Locate the leaky circuit or appliance, repair it, and only then re-enable the EPS output.
solutions.ur: Leaky circuit ya dhoop dhundh kar theek karein, us ke baad hi EPS output dobara on karein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

codes.seriesName: HYD 3-6K-EP (single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + battery + EPS + generator)

title.ur: CT error / CT disconnect - current transformer ka signal nahi (ID045)

meaning.en: The current transformer is not delivering a usable signal. Manual action: check whether the CT wiring is correct.
meaning.ur: Current transformer se qabil-e-istemal signal nahi aa raha. Manual ka action: check karein ke CT wiring sahi hai ya nahi.

causes.en: CT lead loose, not seated, or connected to the wrong port.
causes.ur: CT lead loose, seat nahi hua, ya galat port par connected.

causes.en: CT clamp not closed, or mounted on the wrong conductor / reversed.
causes.ur: CT clamp band nahi, ya galat conductor par / ulti taraf lagi.

solutions.en: Switch off AC breaker and check the CT wiring per the manual, including the port pinout.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karke manual ke mutabiq CT wiring check karein, port pinout samet.

solutions.en: Confirm the CT clamp arrow points with grid current flow and that the clamp closes fully.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke CT clamp ki arrow grid current flow ki taraf hai aur clamp poori tarah band hota hai.

solutions.en: Verify the inverter CT type setting matches the fitted CT and re-check the LCD current reading.
solutions.ur: Inverter ki CT type setting fitted CT se match karwayein aur LCD current reading dobara dekhein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

codes.seriesName: HYD 3-6K-EP (single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + battery + EPS + generator)

title.ur: Parallel connection error - parallel wiring ya setting ghalat (ID047)

meaning.en: Parallel operation is enabled but the parallel network is not correctly wired or the parallel setting on the LCD is wrong. Manual lists two checks for this row.
meaning.ur: Parallel operation on hai magar parallel network sahi se wired nahi ya LCD ka parallel setting ghalat hai. Manual is row ke liye do check batata hai.

causes.en: Parallel cable not correctly connected between the units.
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan parallel cable sahi se connected nahi.

causes.en: Parallel setting on the LCD left disabled or set to the wrong channel.
causes.ur: LCD ka parallel setting disable chhoda ya galat channel par set.

solutions.en: Check whether the parallel cable is correctly connected between the two units.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke parallel cable do units ke darmiyan sahi se connected hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Then check whether the parallel setting on the LCD is correct and enabled.
solutions.ur: Phir check karein ke LCD ka parallel setting theek aur on hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Power the master on first, then the slave, so each finds its role.
solutions.ur: Pehle master on karein, phir slave, takay har apna role dhoondh le.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

codes.seriesName: HYD 3-6K-EP (single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + battery + EPS + generator)

title.ur: NTC temperature sensor error - battery ka NTC sensor kharab (ID056)

meaning.en: The battery NTC temperature sensor connection is faulty, so the inverter cannot safely charge or discharge the battery. Manual action: check whether the NTC is properly connected.
meaning.ur: Battery NTC temperature sensor ka connection kharab hai, is liye inverter battery ko safely charge ya discharge nahi kar sakta. Manual ka action: check karein ke NTC theek se connected hai ya nahi.

causes.en: NTC lead not plugged into the COM port, or the plug is only half in.
causes.ur: NTC lead COM port mein plug nahi, ya plug aadha hi baitha hai.

causes.en: NTC cable pinched, cut, or corroded at the sensor end.
causes.ur: NTC cable pinch hui, kat gayi, ya sensor side par corroded.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter and check whether the NTC is properly connected in the COM port.
solutions.ur: Inverter power off karke dekhein ke NTC COM port mein theek se connected hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure NTC resistance with a multimeter at ambient temperature and compare with the sensor's specification curve.
solutions.ur: Ambient temperature par multimeter se NTC resistance measure karke sensor ke specification curve se compare karein.

solutions.en: Replace the NTC lead or sensor if the reading is out of range or the connector is heat-damaged.
solutions.ur: Reading range se bahar ho ya connector garmi se kharab ho to NTC lead ya sensor replace karein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

codes.seriesName: HYD 3-6K-EP (single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + battery + EPS + generator)

title.ur: EPS load short circuit protection - backup load par short (ID094)

meaning.en: The inverter detected a short circuit on the EPS/LOAD output and cut backup power. Manual remedy: after three detections wait 30 minutes before re-entering off-grid mode, and check the AC LOAD port connection.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne EPS/LOAD output par short circuit detect karke backup power kaat diya. Manual ka hal: teen detections ke baad off-grid mode mein dobara jaane se pehle 30 minute intezaar karein, aur AC LOAD port ki connection check karein.

causes.en: A shorted appliance or a failed capacitor on the backup load panel.
causes.ur: Backup load panel par koi short hua appliance ya capacitor fail.

causes.en: Incorrect or loose wiring at the AC LOAD terminal block.
causes.ur: AC LOAD terminal block par galat ya loose wiring.

solutions.en: Isolate the AC LOAD panel and disconnect loads one by one to find the shorted item.
solutions.ur: AC LOAD panel isolate karke loads ek ek karke disconnect karein takay short hua item mil jaye.

solutions.en: Check whether the AC LOAD port is connected correctly, as the manual directs, including PE and neutral.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq check karein ke AC LOAD port theek se connected hai, PE aur neutral samet.

solutions.en: After three detections, wait the full 30 minutes the manual specifies before re-entering off-grid mode.
solutions.ur: Teen detections ke baad manual ke bataye poore 30 minute intezaar karein, phir off-grid mode mein wapas jayein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

codes.seriesName: HYD 3-6K-EP (single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + battery + EPS + generator)

title.ur: Generator startup failure - generator start nahi ho raha (ID108)

meaning.en: In generator mode the inverter could not start output, usually because the generator did not come up to a usable voltage/frequency. Manual gives two checks.
meaning.ur: Generator mode mein inverter ne output start nahi kiya, aam tor par is liye ke generator qabil-e-istemal voltage/frequency tak nahi aaya. Manual do check batata hai.

causes.en: Generator not in a good condition - low fuel, failed starter, or a tripped breaker.
causes.ur: Generator theek haal mein nahi - fuel kam, starter kharab, ya breaker trip.

causes.en: Generator and inverter not properly connected, or wrong generator mode configuration.
causes.ur: Generator aur inverter theek se jure nahi, ya generator mode ki configuration ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the generator is in good condition - fuel, oil, cooling, air filter, and its own breaker.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke generator theek haal mein hai - fuel, oil, cooling, air filter, aur us ka apna breaker.

solutions.en: Then check whether the generator and inverter are properly connected at the AC side.
solutions.ur: Phir check karein ke generator aur inverter AC side par theek se jure hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: Confirm the generator mode is enabled correctly and the generator start-up time/voltage settings suit the genset.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke generator mode theek enable hai aur generator start-up time/voltage settings genset ke mutabiq hain.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

codes.seriesName: HYD 3-6K-EP (single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + battery + EPS + generator)

title.ur: Battery low voltage alarm - battery voltage low par (ID124)

meaning.en: The battery voltage has fallen to the low threshold. Manual action: check whether the battery voltage of the inverter is too low.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage low threshold tak gir gaya hai. Manual ka action: check karein ke inverter ki battery voltage bohat kam to nahi.

causes.en: Battery genuinely discharged with no PV surplus to recharge it.
causes.ur: Battery sach mein discharge ho gaya aur recharge karne ke liye PV surplus nahi tha.

causes.en: Load running continuously in EPS/backup mode draining the pack overnight.
causes.ur: Load aksar EPS/backup mode mein chalta raha aur raat bhar pack drain kar gaya.

solutions.en: Read battery voltage and SOC on the LCD, and measure pack voltage at the BAT terminals with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery voltage aur SOC padhein, aur BAT terminals par multimeter se pack voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare the measured voltage with the battery's minimum operating voltage from its datasheet.
solutions.ur: Measured voltage ko battery ke datasheet ki minimum operating voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: If voltage is healthy, adjust the low-voltage cutoff and depth-of-discharge settings in the advanced menu.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage theek hai to advanced menu mein low-voltage cutoff aur depth-of-discharge settings theek karein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

codes.seriesName: HYD 3-6K-EP (single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + battery + EPS + generator)

title.ur: Battery discharge prohibited - BMS ne discharge block kar di (ID125)

meaning.en: Protection is blocking battery discharge to protect the cells. This EP table's ID125 is named differently from the HYD 3PH table's ID125 - kept separate.
meaning.ur: Cells bachane ke liye protection ne battery discharge block kar diya. Is EP table ka ID125 HYD 3PH table ke ID125 se alag naam rakhta hai - alag rakha gaya hai.

causes.en: SOC already at the configured lower cutoff - normal end of discharge.
causes.ur: SOC configured lower cutoff par pahunch chuka hai - ye normal discharge ka ant hai.

causes.en: One or more cells below the cell-level undervoltage limit (pack imbalance).
causes.ur: Ek ya zyada cells cell-level undervoltage limit se neeche (pack imbalance).

causes.en: Battery temperature outside the safe discharge window.
causes.ur: Battery temperature safe discharge window se bahar hai.

solutions.en: Read the SOC on the LCD; at the lower cutoff this message is expected and needs no repair.
solutions.ur: LCD par SOC padhein; lower cutoff par ye message aana expected hai aur koi marammat zaroori nahi.

solutions.en: If SOC is high but discharge is blocked, measure pack voltage and check battery temperature.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC zyada hai phir bhi discharge block hai to pack voltage aur battery temperature check karein.

solutions.en: A blocked discharge at healthy SOC and normal temperature points to a BMS or cell-balance fault.
solutions.ur: Healthy SOC aur normal temperature par blocked discharge BMS ya cell-balance ki ghalti batata hai.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

codes.seriesName: HYD 3-6K-EP (single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + battery + EPS + generator)

title.ur: Permanent grid relay failure - grid relay permanently fail (ID144)

meaning.en: The grid-side relay has latched into a permanent failure, so the inverter cannot connect to the grid without service. This code is unique to the EP table.
meaning.ur: Grid side relay permanent failure mein chala gaya, is liye service ke baghair inverter grid se connect nahi ho sakta. Yeh code sirf EP table par hai.

causes.en: Grid relay contacts welded from a short or repeated overcurrent event.
causes.ur: Short ya baar baar ke overcurrent event se grid relay ke contacts juce hue.

causes.en: Relay coil or its drive circuit failed.
causes.ur: Relay coil ya us ka drive circuit fail.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, and attempt one clean restart to confirm it is not a false latch.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke 5 minute wait karein, aur ye confirm karne ke liye ek saaf restart karein ke latch asal mein hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: With power off, inspect the grid relay connector and socket for pushed-back or burnt pins.
solutions.ur: Power off karke grid relay connector aur socket mein dhakle ya jale pins dekhein.

solutions.en: Because this is a permanent fault, replace the grid relay through a service centre and log it for the warranty claim.
solutions.ur: Kyunke ye permanent fault hai, grid relay service centre se replace karwayein aur warranty claim ke liye note karein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

codes.seriesName: HYD 3-6K-EP (single-phase hybrid 3-6 kW, PV + battery + EPS + generator)

title.ur: Battery discharge over temperature protection - discharge mein battery garm ho gayi (ID186)

meaning.en: The pack got too hot during discharge and shut down. Manual remedy: make sure the battery is within its normal temperature range, power off and wait 2 hours.
meaning.ur: Discharge ke dauran pack bohat garm ho gaya aur band ho gaya. Manual ka hal: battery apne normal temperature range mein honi chahiye, power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein.

causes.en: Discharging a high current in a hot environment with no ventilation.
causes.ur: Garm mahol mein bina ventilation ke high current discharge.

causes.en: Battery mounted in direct sunlight, or too close to a heat source.
causes.ur: Battery direct sunlight mein lagi, ya kisi garmi ke source ke bohat qareeb.

solutions.en: Check the ambient temperature and the battery temperature shown on the LCD.
solutions.ur: LCD par dikhne wali battery temperature aur ambient temperature check karein.

solutions.en: Power off and wait 2 hours as the manual instructs before trying again.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein, phir dobara koshish karein.

solutions.en: Relocate or shade the battery and improve airflow, and consider derating the discharge current in hot months.
solutions.ur: Battery ko shift ya shade karein aur airflow behtar karein, aur garmi ke mahinon mein discharge current kam karein.

source.title: HYD 3-6K-EP User Manual, section 7, Table 7-1 Eventlist

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH Battery error list (battery-side, 8xx/9xx IDs)

meaning.en: The battery's own heat-sink temperature sensor is above the warning threshold. A warning, not a shutdown - the battery is still usable.
meaning.ur: Battery ke apne heat-sink temperature sensor ki value warning threshold se upar hai. Ye sirf warning hai, shutdown nahi - battery abhi bhi chalti hai.

causes.en: Battery cabinet installed in direct sun or a poorly ventilated store room.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet direct sun mein ya kam ventilated store room mein lagi hai.

causes.en: High charge/discharge current pushing the battery's internal heat up.
causes.ur: Zyada charge/discharge current battery ki andar ki heat barha raha hai.

solutions.en: Check that the number of batteries configured on the LCD matches the number physically installed.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke LCD par configured batteries ki sankeya physically installed batteries ke barabar hai.

solutions.en: Install the battery in a cool, ventilated place out of direct sunlight and leave the recommended clearance.
solutions.ur: Battery ko thande, ventilated jagah direct sunlight se door lagayein aur recommended clearance rakhein.

solutions.en: If the configuration is already correct and the warning stays, contact technical support for a software upgrade as the manual says.
solutions.ur: Agar configuration pehle se theek hai phir bhi warning rahe to manual ke mutabiq technical support se software upgrade karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH Battery error list (battery-side, 8xx/9xx IDs)

meaning.en: The temperature inside the battery cabinet exceeded the ambient warning threshold. Manual action: make sure the battery is installed in a cool, well-ventilated place.
meaning.ur: Battery cabinet ke andar ka temperature ambient warning threshold se upar chala gaya. Manual ka action: battery thande, well-ventilated jagah lagi honi chahiye.

causes.en: Battery in a closed cupboard or against a hot wall with no airflow.
causes.ur: Battery band cupboard mein ya garm deewar se lagay, jahan koi airflow nahi.

causes.en: Very hot season with high ambient plus poor spacing between battery units.
causes.ur: Bahut garmi ka mausam, zyada ambient aur battery units ke darmiyan kam faasla.

solutions.en: Measure the ambient temperature inside the battery location with a thermometer and compare to the manual's limit.
solutions.ur: Battery ki jagah ka andar ka ambient temperature thermometer se measure karke manual ki limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Relocate or open up ventilation so air can move through and around the battery cabinet.
solutions.ur: Battery cabinet ko aise jagah shift karein ya ventilation kholein ke hawa aas paas chale.

solutions.en: Keep at least the manual's stated clearance between stacked battery modules.
solutions.ur: Stack kiye gaye battery modules ke darmiyan kam az kam manual ka bataya hua faasla rakhein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH Battery error list (battery-side, 8xx/9xx IDs)

title.ur: Battery charging prohibited - BMS ne charging rok di (ID813)

meaning.en: The BMS has blocked battery charging. The manual says this is normal if the battery is almost fully charged; only contact support if that is not the reason.
meaning.ur: BMS ne battery charging block kar di hai. Manual ke mutabiq agar battery poori tarah charge ho chuki hai to ye normal hai; sirf tab support se rabta karein jab woh wajah na ho.

causes.en: Battery already at or near full charge - BMS stops charging to avoid overcharge.
causes.ur: Battery poori tarah ya qareeb poori charge ho chuki hai - BMS overcharge se bachne ke liye charging rokta hai.

causes.en: Battery temperature outside the safe charging window.
causes.ur: Battery temperature safe charging window se bahar hai.

causes.en: Cell imbalance or a cell above its charge limit inside the pack.
causes.ur: Pack ke andar cell imbalance ya koi cell apni charge limit se upar.

solutions.en: Read the SOC on the LCD; if it is near 100% this is normal and needs no action.
solutions.ur: LCD par SOC padhein; agar wo 100% ke qareeb hai to ye normal hai aur koi action nahi chahiye.

solutions.en: If SOC is low, check battery temperature - the BMS blocks charging when it is too hot or too cold.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC kam hai to battery temperature check karein - BMS garm ya thand par charging rokta hai.

solutions.en: If SOC is low and temperature is normal, contact technical support rather than forcing charge.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC kam hai aur temperature normal hai to charge force karne ke bajaye technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH Battery error list (battery-side, 8xx/9xx IDs)

title.ur: Battery discharging prohibited - BMS ne discharge rok di (ID814)

meaning.en: The BMS has blocked battery discharge. Normal if the battery is almost empty; otherwise the pack or its BMS needs checking.
meaning.ur: BMS ne battery discharge block kar diya. Agar battery khaali hone wali hai to normal hai; warna pack ya us ka BMS check karna hoga.

causes.en: Battery SOC at the lower cutoff - BMS stops discharge to protect the cells.
causes.ur: Battery SOC lower cutoff par hai - BMS cells bachane ke liye discharge rokta hai.

causes.en: Cell under-voltage: one or more cells in the pack dropped below its minimum.
causes.ur: Cell under-voltage: pack ka ek ya zyada cell apni minimum se neeche gir gaya.

causes.en: Pack imbalance or an aged pack with high internal resistance.
causes.ur: Pack imbalance ya aging pack jis ki internal resistance zyada ho gayi.

solutions.en: Read the SOC and battery voltage on the LCD; near-empty SOC with this message is expected.
solutions.ur: LCD par SOC aur battery voltage padhein; khaali hone wali SOC ke saath ye message aana expected hai.

solutions.en: If SOC is high and discharge is still blocked, measure pack voltage at the inverter BAT terminals with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Agar SOC zyada hai phir bhi discharge blocked hai to multimeter se inverter BAT terminals par pack voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: A healthy pack with a blocked discharge points to a BMS or cell-balance problem - contact technical support.
solutions.ur: Theek pack ke saath discharge blocked hona BMS ya cell-balance ki ghalti batata hai - technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH Battery error list (battery-side, 8xx/9xx IDs)

title.ur: Battery radiator over temperature protection - battery band ho gayi (ID864)

meaning.en: The battery heat-sink over-temperature protection tripped - the battery is shut down, not just warning. Manual remedy: power off and wait 2 hours.
meaning.ur: Battery heat-sink ka over-temperature protection trip hua - battery band ho gayi, sirf warning nahi. Manual ka hal: power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein.

causes.en: Sustained high charge/discharge current in a hot environment with no cooling.
causes.ur: Garm mahol mein bina cooling ke mustaqbil high charge/discharge current.

causes.en: Battery cabinet air filter or vents blocked, so internal heat cannot escape.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet ka air filter ya vents band, is liye andar ki heat nahi nikal rahi.

causes.en: Fan inside the battery cabinet failed or its connector is loose.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet ka andar ka fan fail ya us ka connector loose.

solutions.en: Power the system off and wait 2 hours as the manual instructs, then re-check before restarting.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq system power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein, phir restart se pehle dobara check karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the battery cabinet vents and any air filter for dust blockage and clear them.
solutions.ur: Battery cabinet ke vents aur koi air filter dust se band ho to dekhein aur saaf karein.

solutions.en: Measure cabinet internal temperature with a thermometer; if it exceeds the limit even when cool outside, the fan or sensor has failed.
solutions.ur: Cabinet ka andar ka temperature thermometer se measure karein; agar bahar thandi ho ke bhi limit cross kare to fan ya sensor fail hai.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH Battery error list (battery-side, 8xx/9xx IDs)
aliases: Over temperature protection of ambient temperature

title.ur: Battery ambient over temperature protection - battery mahol garm hai (ID865)

meaning.en: The battery's ambient temperature protection tripped and the battery shut down. Manual remedy is the same: power off and wait 2 hours, then contact support if unresolved.
meaning.ur: Battery ka ambient temperature protection trip hua aur battery band ho gayi. Manual ka hal wohi hai: power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein, hal na ho to support se rabta karein.

causes.en: Ambient temperature in the battery room above the permitted range.
causes.ur: Battery room ka ambient temperature allowed range se upar.

causes.en: Battery installed in a sealed enclosure with no heat exchange.
causes.ur: Battery aise sealed enclosure mein hai jahan heat ka koi exchange nahi hota.

causes.en: Room temperature sensor inside the cabinet misreading low, so protection timing is wrong.
causes.ur: Cabinet ke andar ka room temperature sensor galat low reading de raha hai, jis se protection ka timing ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Power off and wait 2 hours, then measure the room temperature where the battery sits.
solutions.ur: Power off karke 2 ghante intezaar karein, phir battery jahan lagi hai us kamre ka temperature measure karein.

solutions.en: Move the battery to a shaded, ventilated location and keep the manual's clearance from hot surfaces.
solutions.ur: Battery ko dhallee, ventilated jagah le jayein aur garam surfaces se manual ka faasla rakhein.

solutions.en: If the room is genuinely cool and it still trips, the internal temperature sensor needs replacement.
solutions.ur: Agar kamra sach mein thanda hai phir bhi trip ho to andar ka temperature sensor replace karna hoga.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH Battery error list (battery-side, 8xx/9xx IDs)

title.ur: Battery CAN1 communication failure - battery ka CAN link toota (ID867)

meaning.en: The battery's internal CAN1 link failed. Manual guidance: if it happens occasionally, wait a few minutes; if it happens frequently, contact support.
meaning.ur: Battery ka apna CAN1 link fail ho gaya. Manual ka mashwara: agar kabhi kabhi ho to kuch minute intezaar karein; agar baar baar ho to support se rabta karein.

causes.en: CAN cable loose at the battery or the inverter, or a poor contact at the connector.
causes.ur: Battery ya inverter par CAN cable loose, ya connector par poor contact.

causes.en: CAN bus not properly terminated, or two devices sharing a duplicate address.
causes.ur: CAN bus theek terminate nahi hua, ya do devices ka address duplicate hai.

causes.en: Battery CAN port damaged, or a battery-side controller fault.
causes.ur: Battery ka CAN port damaged, ya battery side controller ki ghalti.

solutions.en: Power off, reseat the CAN cable at both ends and confirm the connector latches fully closed.
solutions.ur: Power off karke CAN cable dono taraf se dobara baithayein aur confirm karein ke connector puri tarah band ho gaya.

solutions.en: Wait a few minutes and see whether the code clears, as the manual directs for occasional events.
solutions.ur: Kuch minute intezaar karke dekhein ke code clear hota hai ya nahi, jaise manual occasional events ke liye kehta hai.

solutions.en: If it recurs, verify unique CAN addresses and termination, then raise it with support since it is frequent.
solutions.ur: Agar dobara aaye to unique CAN address aur termination verify karein, phir support ko batayein kyunke ye frequent hai.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH Battery error list (battery-side, 8xx/9xx IDs)

title.ur: Battery bus software overvoltage - bus firmware ne overvoltage pakda (ID872)

meaning.en: The battery's internal bus firmware detected an overvoltage condition. Manual guidance: wait a few minutes for occasional events, contact support if frequent.
meaning.ur: Battery ke andar bus firmware ne overvoltage condition detect kiya. Manual ka mashwara: occasional event ho to kuch minute intezaar karein, frequent ho to support se rabta karein.

causes.en: Transient bus spike when a high charge current command was applied.
causes.ur: Zyada charge current command lagane par bus mein transient spike.

causes.en: Bus voltage sensing drift on the battery controller board.
causes.ur: Battery controller board par bus voltage sensing drift.

causes.en: Battery cell imbalance pushing part of the pack overvoltage.
causes.ur: Battery cell imbalance jis se pack ka hissa overvoltage par chala gaya.

solutions.en: Measure the battery pack voltage with a multimeter at the inverter BAT terminals and compare it to the LCD value.
solutions.ur: Inverter BAT terminals par multimeter se battery pack voltage measure karke LCD value se compare karein.

solutions.en: Wait a few minutes to see if the event was transient, exactly as the manual advises for occasional faults.
solutions.ur: Kabhi kabhi aane wale faults ke liye jaise manual kahe, kuch minute intezaar karke dekhein ke event transient tha ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the pack really is overvoltage, stop charging, let it settle and check the battery overvoltage setting against the battery spec.
solutions.ur: Agar pack sach mein overvoltage hai to charging band karein, use settle hone dein aur battery overvoltage setting battery spec se match karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH Battery error list (battery-side, 8xx/9xx IDs)

title.ur: Battery bus software undervoltage - bus firmware ne undervoltage pakda (ID873)

meaning.en: The battery's internal bus firmware detected an undervoltage condition on the battery bus.
meaning.ur: Battery ke bus firmware ne battery bus par undervoltage condition detect kiya.

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged, or the DC isolator between battery and inverter left open.
causes.ur: Battery gehri tarah discharge ho gayi, ya battery aur inverter ke darmiyan DC isolator chhota hua.

causes.en: Battery cable voltage drop from a high-resistance or undersized connection.
causes.ur: Battery cable mein zyada resistance ya choti connection ki wajah se voltage drop.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery DC isolator is closed and fully seated before any other check.
solutions.ur: Doosri har check se pehle confirm karein ke battery DC isolator band aur poora baitha hai.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage at the inverter BAT terminals under load; a big drop across the cable means a bad connection.
solutions.ur: Load ke saath inverter BAT terminals par battery voltage measure karein; cable par bada drop matlab kharis connection.

solutions.en: Re-torque the battery lugs and inspect for corrosion, then let the battery recover before charging again.
solutions.ur: Battery lugs dobara tighten karke corrosion dekhein, phir dobara charge se pehle battery ko recover hone dein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH Battery error list (battery-side, 8xx/9xx IDs)

title.ur: Battery hardware overcurrent - pack ka andar ka asli overcurrent (ID879)

meaning.en: The battery's own hardware overcurrent comparator tripped - a real overcurrent inside the pack, not a software protection.
meaning.ur: Battery ka apna hardware overcurrent comparator trip hua - pack ke andar asal overcurrent, software protection nahi.

causes.en: Internal cell short in the pack, or an over-discharge event that damaged cells.
causes.ur: Pack mein internal cell short, ya itna zyada over-discharge ke cells kharab ho gaye.

causes.en: External short on the battery cable or a flooded connector.
causes.ur: Battery cable par external short ya geela connector.

causes.en: Discharge current exceeded the pack's continuous limit for its temperature.
causes.ur: Discharge current pack ki us temperature par defined continuous limit se zyada ho gaya.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off, isolate the battery and check for a short with a multimeter before anything else.
solutions.ur: Inverter off karke battery isolate karein aur sab se pehle multimeter se short check karein.

solutions.en: Inspect every battery connector and cable for damage, water ingress or a crushed section, and replace what is faulty.
solutions.ur: Har battery connector aur cable ko damage, paani ya marasi ke liye dekhein aur kharis hissa replace karein.

solutions.en: If the pack is shorted internally, stop using it and have the module replaced - a hardware OCP is not a software-reset fault.
solutions.ur: Agar pack andar se short hai to use band karein aur module replace karwayein - hardware OCP software reset se hal nahi hota.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.2 Battery error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

meaning.en: Grid voltage above the trip window. The manual splits behaviour: occasional alarms are grid wobble and self-clear, frequent alarms mean check the AC breaker and AC wiring.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage trip window se upar hai. Manual do surat ka hal batata hai: occasional alarm grid ki hilne se hai aur khud clear hota hai, frequent alarm ka matlab AC breaker aur AC wiring check karein.

causes.en: Occasional grid abnormality - the manual's first explanation.
causes.ur: Occasional grid abnormality - manual ki pehli waja.

causes.en: AC circuit breaker or AC wiring fault when the alarm is frequent.
causes.ur: AC circuit breaker ya AC wiring ki ghalti jab alarm frequent ho.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage and frequency with a multimeter at the AC terminal and log the readings.
solutions.ur: AC terminal par multimeter se grid voltage aur frequency measure kar ke readings note karein.

solutions.en: If readings are within range, check the AC circuit breaker and the AC wiring of the inverter as the manual directs.
solutions.ur: Agar readings range mein hain to manual ke mutabiq AC circuit breaker aur inverter ki AC wiring check karein.

solutions.en: If readings are out of range AND wiring is correct, contact support to move the protection points with the grid operator's written approval.
solutions.ur: Agar readings range se bahar hain AUR wiring theek hai to grid operator ki written approval se protection points change karwane ke liye support se rabta karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: Charge leakage fault - leakage current limit cross kar gaya (ID005)

meaning.en: Leakage current exceeded the limit and the inverter stopped. The manual's stated action for this row is unusually short: 'Check for inverter and wiring.'
meaning.ur: Leakage current limit cross kar gaya aur inverter ruk gaya. Is row ka manual ka action chhota hai: 'Check for inverter and wiring.'

causes.en: PV array insulation breakdown or a wet connector causing earth leakage.
causes.ur: PV array ki insulation kharab ya geela connector, jis se earth leakage ho raha hai.

causes.en: Internal inverter leakage on the DC or AC side.
causes.ur: DC ya AC side par inverter ka internal leakage.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then megger each PV string to earth at 1000 V.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke 5 minute wait karke har PV string ka earth ke saath 1000 V par megger lagayein.

solutions.en: Check the AC and battery wiring for insulation damage and moisture as the manual asks.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq AC aur battery wiring ki insulation damage aur moisture check karein.

solutions.en: If strings and wiring are clean, isolate the battery and retest to tell a PV leak from an internal one.
solutions.ur: Agar strings aur wiring saaf hain to battery isolate kar ke dobara test karein takay PV leak aur internal leak alag ho sakein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: Island protection fault - grid chala gaya (ID008)

meaning.en: Grid lost while exporting, so the inverter locked out. This is a correct protective action; the manual's remedy is the same grid-check routine as ID001-ID004.
meaning.ur: Export karte hue grid chala gaya, is liye inverter lock out ho gaya. Yeh ek sahi protective action hai; manual ka hal ID001-ID004 wala grid check hi hai.

causes.en: Real grid outage - utility breaker, transformer fuse or a local fault.
causes.ur: Asli grid outage - utility breaker, transformer fuse ya local fault.

causes.en: AC contact dropout from a loose breaker or chattering supply.
causes.ur: Loose breaker ya supply chatter ki wajah se AC contact ka gap.

solutions.en: Confirm the outage at the utility breaker and at the site AC isolator before touching the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter chhoone se pehle utility breaker aur site AC isolator par outage confirm karein.

solutions.en: Once the grid is stable, restore the AC breaker first, then the DC switch, and watch the LCD restart.
solutions.ur: Grid stable hone ke baad pehle AC breaker aur phir DC switch on karein aur LCD restart dekhein.

solutions.en: If it trips on a healthy grid, have the AC wiring and CT/meter configuration reviewed by the installer.
solutions.ur: Agar healthy grid par trip ho to AC wiring aur CT/meter configuration installer se check karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: PV low ground impedance - PV ka ground impedance kam (ID027)

meaning.en: The PV array presented low impedance to ground, so the inverter stopped. This is the hybrid-specific PV insulation row and appears only on this table.
meaning.ur: PV array ne ground ke saath kam impedance dikhaya, is liye inverter ruk gaya. Yeh hybrid ka apna PV insulation row hai aur sirf is table par hai.

causes.en: Moisture ingress on modules, connectors or the combiner box.
causes.ur: Modules, connectors ya combiner box mein moisture andar jaana.

causes.en: Cable damaged by UV, heat or rodents causing leakage to earth.
causes.ur: UV, garmi ya chuha se cable damage, jis se earth mein leakage.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then measure insulation between the PV array and ground.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karke 5 minute wait karke PV array aur ground ke darmiyan insulation measure karein.

solutions.en: If there is a short circuit, the manual says repair it in time - isolate strings one by one to find it.
solutions.ur: Agar short circuit hai to manual ke mutabiq jaldi theek karein - strings ek ek karke isolate kar ke dhoondhein.

solutions.en: Replace the wet or damaged part and re-measure before re-energising; never leave a low-impedance PV array live.
solutions.ur: Geela ya damaged hissa replace karke dobara measure karein, phir current dein; low-impedance PV array ko live na chhodein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: Neutral-earth fault - neutral aur earth ke darmiyan fault (ID032)

meaning.en: A fault between neutral and protective earth was detected. This is a wiring fault on the three-phase system and a fire risk, not a soft alarm.
meaning.ur: Neutral aur protective earth ke darmiyan fault mila. Yeh teen phase system par wiring ki ghalti hai aur aag ka khatra hai, halki sa alarm nahi.

causes.en: Neutral and earth bonded at a point the inverter does not expect, or neutral swapped with PE.
causes.ur: Neutral aur earth aise point par bond ho gaye jo inverter expect nahi karta, ya neutral aur PE swap ho gaye.

causes.en: Neutral conductor broken inside the AC panel so the inverter sees an N-PE offset.
causes.ur: AC panel ke andar neutral conductor kat gaya, is liye inverter ko N-PE offset nazar aaya.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker and remove the inverter from the panel before touching neutral or earth bars.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karke neutral ya earth bar chhoone se pehle inverter ko panel se nikaalein.

solutions.en: Measure continuity between neutral and PE at the inverter AC terminal; it must not be a low-resistance path.
solutions.ur: Inverter AC terminal par neutral aur PE ke darmiyan continuity measure karein; ye low-resistance path na ho.

solutions.en: Verify the neutral-earth bonding arrangement matches the site design, and check every neutral lug for tightness.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke neutral-earth bonding site design ke mutabiq hai, aur har neutral lug ki tightness check karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: Relay detection failure - relay ka self-test fail (ID041)

meaning.en: The inverter's relay self-check failed so it will not tie in to the grid. Manual remedy: internal fault, switch off, wait 5 minutes, switch on, then check.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka relay self-check fail ho gaya is liye woh grid se tie nahi hoga. Manual ka hal: internal fault, off karein, 5 minute wait, on karein, phir check karein.

causes.en: Output relay contacts welded or coil damaged from a previous overcurrent event.
causes.ur: Pehle ke overcurrent event se output relay ke contacts juce hue ya coil kharab.

causes.en: Relay drive or detection circuit faulty on the control board.
causes.ur: Control board par relay drive ya detection circuit kharab.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter OFF, wait 5 minutes, then switch it ON and check whether the problem is solved.
solutions.ur: Inverter OFF karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir ON karke dekhein ke masla hal hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: With power off, re-seat the relay connector and inspect for socket pins pushed back or burnt.
solutions.ur: Power off karke relay connector dobara baithayein aur piche dhakle ya jale pins dekhein.

solutions.en: If it fails on every restart, the relay module needs replacement through a SOFAR service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar har restart par fail ho to relay module SOFAR service centre se replace karwana hoga.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: PE conductor / earth fault - earth conductor mein ghalti (ID043)

meaning.en: The earth-fault alarm fired. Manual action: check the PE conductor for function.
meaning.ur: Earth-fault alarm chala. Manual ka action: PE conductor ka function check karein.

causes.en: PE conductor disconnected, loose or corroded at the earth bar or inverter stud.
causes.ur: PE conductor earth bar ya inverter stud par disconnect, loose ya corroded.

causes.en: Real earth leakage in the PV array presenting as an earth fault at the inverter.
causes.ur: PV array mein asal earth leakage jo inverter par earth-fault ki surat mein aata hai.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, then inspect the PE stud and ring lug for tightness and corrosion.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke PE stud aur ring lug ki tightness aur corrosion check karein.

solutions.en: Measure PE continuity from the inverter to the site earth bar with a low-ohm meter; expect near zero.
solutions.ur: Low-ohm meter se inverter se site earth bar tak PE continuity measure karein; reading zero ke qareeb honi chahiye.

solutions.en: If PE is healthy, megger the PV array to earth - the leakage is on the DC side, not the earth conductor.
solutions.ur: Agar PE theek hai to PV array ko earth ke saath megger lagayein - leakage DC side par hai, earth conductor par nahi.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

meaning.en: The battery is wired backwards into the BAT terminals. Manual action: check whether the battery wiring is correct.
meaning.ur: Battery BAT terminals mein ulti polarity se juri hai. Manual ka action: check karein ke battery wiring sahi hai ya nahi.

causes.en: BAT+ and BAT- swapped at the inverter connector or at the battery end.
causes.ur: Inverter connector ya battery side par BAT+ aur BAT- swap ho gaye.

causes.en: Reverse-polarity battery installed with a keyed connector fitted the wrong way round.
causes.ur: Aisi battery lagi jaye jis ka keyed connector ulti taraf baith jaye.

solutions.en: Switch off the DC switch and AC breaker and isolate the battery before touching any battery cable.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke battery cable chhoone se pehle battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery DC voltage at the inverter BAT terminals with a multimeter; correct polarity reads positive at BAT+.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter BAT terminals par battery DC voltage check karein; sahi polarity par BAT+ par positive reading aati hai.

solutions.en: If reversed, power down fully, re-terminate with correct polarity and re-torque the lugs before reconnecting.
solutions.ur: Agar reverse hai to poori tarah power down karke sahi polarity par dobara terminate karein aur reconnect se pehle lugs tighten karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: Battery temperature error - battery ka NTC temperature galat (ID049)

meaning.en: The battery temperature sensor reported out-of-range, so the inverter stopped charging/discharging the battery. Manual emphasises the battery NTC cable.
meaning.ur: Battery temperature sensor ne range se bahar value di, is liye inverter ne battery ka charge/discharge band kar diya. Manual battery NTC cable par zor deta hai.

causes.en: Inner-BMS battery NTC cable not properly connected at the inverter COM port.
causes.ur: Inner-BMS battery ka NTC cable inverter COM port par theek se connected nahi.

causes.en: Inverter installed in direct sunlight or a hot, poorly ventilated enclosure.
causes.ur: Inverter direct sunlight mein ya garm, kam ventilated enclosure mein lage hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature above the inverter limit with a genuinely hot battery.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature inverter limit se upar aur battery sach mein garm ho gayi.

solutions.en: Power off and confirm the battery NTC cable is seated in the COM port, then reseat the connector firmly.
solutions.ur: Power off karke confirm karein ke battery NTC cable COM port mein baithi hai, phir connector mazbooti se dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Check where the inverter is mounted - remove direct sun and improve ventilation in the enclosure.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke inverter kahan lage hai - direct sun hataayein aur enclosure mein ventilation behtar karein.

solutions.en: Read the battery temperature on the LCD; if it is genuinely high, let the battery cool before charging again.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery temperature padhein; agar sach mein zyada hai to dobara charge se pehle battery thandi hone dein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: Meter communication fault - meter unit se baat nahi ho rahi (ID105)

meaning.en: The inverter cannot talk to the meter unit, so export limiting and monitoring data are lost. Manual action: check communication to meter.
meaning.ur: Inverter meter unit se baat nahi kar pa raha, is liye export limiting aur monitoring data chala gaya. Manual ka action: meter se communication check karein.

causes.en: RS485 A/B swapped or the meter lead not seated in the COM port.
causes.ur: RS485 A/B swap ya meter lead COM port mein baithi hi nahi.

causes.en: Meter modbus address duplicated with another device on the RS485 bus.
causes.ur: Meter ka modbus address RS485 bus par kisi aur device se duplicate.

causes.en: Meter powered off, or a blown fuse in the meter supply.
causes.ur: Meter power off, ya meter supply ka fuse uthha.

solutions.en: Power off and check meter RS485 A and B pairing at both the meter and the inverter end.
solutions.ur: Power off karke meter aur inverter dono taraf RS485 A aur B ki pairing check karein.

solutions.en: Set a unique modbus address for the meter from the inverter LCD menu and confirm it is powered.
solutions.ur: Inverter LCD menu se meter ka unique modbus address set karein aur confirm karein ke us mein power hai.

solutions.en: Re-power the meter, then confirm it shows online in the SOFAR monitoring app before changing anything else.
solutions.ur: Meter ko dobara power dein, phir confirm karein ke SOFAR monitoring app mein online dikh raha hai.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: Battery low - shutdown protection - battery voltage gir gaya (ID125)

meaning.en: Battery voltage fell to the shutdown threshold, so the inverter stopped discharging to protect the battery. Manual action: check if the battery voltage is too low.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage shutdown threshold tak gir gaya, is liye inverter ne battery bachane ke liye discharge band kar diya. Manual ka action: check karein ke battery voltage kam to nahi.

causes.en: Battery genuinely discharged below its depth-of-discharge limit overnight.
causes.ur: Battery raat bhar mein sach mein apni depth-of-discharge limit se neeche discharge ho gaya.

causes.en: PV generation insufficient for the load plus battery charging, so SOC never recovered.
causes.ur: PV generation load aur battery charging ke liye kam thi, is liye SOC wapas nahi aaya.

causes.en: Battery cell imbalance or an aged pack reporting a falsely low pack voltage.
causes.ur: Battery cell imbalance ya aging pack ki taraf se galat low pack voltage.

solutions.en: Read the battery voltage and SOC on the LCD and confirm the actual pack voltage with a multimeter at the BAT terminals.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery voltage aur SOC padhein aur BAT terminals par multimeter se actual pack voltage confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check whether PV output exceeded the load for the day; if not, add array capacity or reduce the load.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke kya din bhar PV output load se zyada raha; agar nahi to array capacity barhayein ya load kam karein.

solutions.en: If the pack is healthy but voltage reads falsely low, have the BMS calibration and cell balance checked.
solutions.ur: Agar pack theek hai magar voltage galat kam parha ja raha hai to BMS calibration aur cell balance check karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: Permanent EPS battery overcurrent - backup mein battery ka overcurrent (ID133)

meaning.en: During EPS (backup) mode the battery overcurrent protection latched into an unrecoverable state. This row is unique to the HYD hybrid table - no on-grid model has an EPS battery path.
meaning.ur: EPS (backup) mode mein battery overcurrent protection permanent state mein chala gaya. Yeh row sirf HYD hybrid table par hai - kisi on-grid model mein EPS battery path nahi hai.

causes.en: Backup load switched on far above inverter EPS rating - a big AC or pump start on transfer.
causes.ur: Backup load inverter EPS rating se kaafi upar switch ho gaya - transfer par bara AC ya pump start.

causes.en: Inrush from motors or compressors on the backup panel exceeding the battery discharge limit.
causes.ur: Backup panel par motor ya compressor ka inrush battery discharge limit se zyada.

causes.en: Battery or BMS fault causing a short-like current draw.
causes.ur: Battery ya BMS ki ghalti jis se short jaisa current draw ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the backup panel and measure its total current with a clamp meter before re-energising the inverter.
solutions.ur: Backup panel isolate karke dobara current dene se pehle clamp meter se us ka kul current measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare the measured EPS load with the inverter's EPS output rating on the datasheet; move large loads to the grid side.
solutions.ur: Measured EPS load ko datasheet par inverter ke EPS output rating se compare karein; bade loads grid side mein shift karein.

solutions.en: Because this is a permanent fault, log the event and raise it as a service case - it will not clear on its own.
solutions.ur: Kyunke ye permanent fault hai, event note karke service case banayein - ye khud clear nahi hoga.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: Lithium battery BMS 1-4 communication error - BMS se baat nahi (ID157-160)

meaning.en: Communication between the inverter and the internal BMS of lithium battery 1, 2, 3 or 4 failed. Published as one range row covering ID157 to ID160.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur lithium battery ke internal BMS (battery 1, 2, 3 ya 4) ke darmiyan communication fail ho gaya. Yeh ID157 se ID160 tak ek hi range row ke tor par published hai.

causes.en: Battery not compatible with the inverter, so the BMS protocol does not match.
causes.ur: Battery inverter ke saath compatible nahi, is liye BMS protocol match nahi karta.

causes.en: CAN communication cable loose, unseated, or using the wrong pinout.
causes.ur: CAN communication cable loose, unseated, ya galat pinout wala.

causes.en: CAN bus not terminated, or several batteries with duplicate addresses on one bus.
causes.ur: CAN bus terminated nahi, ya ek bus par kai batteries ke duplicate address.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery model is on the inverter's compatibility list before anything else.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle confirm karein ke battery model inverter ki compatibility list mein hai.

solutions.en: Power off and reseat the CAN communication cable at both the battery and inverter ends; verify the pin assignment.
solutions.ur: Power off karke CAN communication cable battery aur inverter dono taraf se dobara baithayein; pin assignment verify karein.

solutions.en: If multiple batteries are chained, check termination and that each has a unique CAN address, then power up one battery at a time.
solutions.ur: Agar kai batteries chained hain to termination check karein aur har ek ka CAN address unique ho, phir ek ek battery power up karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: Cooling fan 1-7 fault - koi fan chalu nahi (ID169-175)

meaning.en: One or more of the seven internal cooling fans has failed. Published as a single range row ID169 to ID175. Manual action: check if the corresponding fan is running normally.
meaning.ur: Saat internal cooling fans mein se ek ya zyada kharab ho gaya hai. Yeh ek hi range row ID169 se ID175 tak hai. Manual ka action: check karein ke corresponding fan normal chal raha hai ya nahi.

causes.en: Dust-packed fan blades blocking rotation.
causes.ur: Fan blades par dhool ki parat jo rotation rok rahi hai.

causes.en: Fan motor bearing worn or the fan cable connector come loose from the baseboard.
causes.ur: Fan motor ka bearing ghis gaya ya fan cable connector baseboard se nikal gaya.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, then use a tissue strip at each vent to identify which fan has stopped.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke har vent par tissue rakh kar pehchan ke kaun sa fan ruka hua hai.

solutions.en: Remove the fan, unplug its terminal, clean the blades with a soft brush and re-check free rotation by hand.
solutions.ur: Fan nikaalein, us ka terminal nikaalein, blades soft brush se saaf karein aur haath se dobara check karein ke blades azaad ghoomte hain ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it does not spin freely after cleaning, replace the fan - a stopped fan leads to ID050-ID055 heatsink over-temperature.
solutions.ur: Agar saaf karne ke baad bhi azaadi se na ghoome to fan replace karein - ruka hua fan ID050-ID055 heatsink over-temperature tak le jata hai.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: Arc device (AFCI) communication lost - arc detector se baat nahi (ID189)

meaning.en: The inverter lost communication with its arc-fault detection module, so arcing in the PV wiring would go undetected. Treat as a safety function outage, not a nuisance alarm.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne apne arc-fault detection module se communication kho di, is liye PV wiring mein arcing detect nahi hoti. Ise safety function ki outage samajhein, pareshaan karne wali alarm nahi.

causes.en: AFCI module harness disconnected or its connector not seated.
causes.ur: AFCI module ka harness disconnect ya us ka connector seat nahi hua.

causes.en: AFCI board faulty, or the internal comms channel between AFCI and control board failed.
causes.ur: AFCI board kharab, ya AFCI aur control board ke darmiyan internal comms channel fail.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, then reseat the AFCI harness connector on the control board.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke control board par AFCI harness connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Inspect the ribbon/harness for chafing or a broken pin and replace the harness if damaged.
solutions.ur: Ribbon/harness ko ghisav ya tute pin ke liye dekhein aur damage ho to harness replace karein.

solutions.en: If the connector is sound, the AFCI module needs replacement; log the outage and raise a service case.
solutions.ur: Agar connector theek hai to AFCI module replace karna hoga; outage note karke service case karein.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH (three-phase hybrid 5-20 kW, PV + battery + EPS)

title.ur: AFCI arc detection fault - arc detector ka apna fault (ID401-402)

meaning.en: The AFCI hardware itself reported a fault (ID401 and ID402, published as one range row). Manual remedy: switch off the inverter and the lithium battery, wait 5 minutes, then switch both on.
meaning.ur: AFCI hardware ne khud fault report kiya (ID401 aur ID402, ek hi range row). Manual ka hal: inverter aur lithium battery off karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir dono on karein.

causes.en: AFCI sensor or its analogue channel failed - a self-test fault, not necessarily real arcing.
causes.ur: AFCI sensor ya us ka analogue channel fail - ye self-test fault hai, asal arcing zaroori nahi.

causes.en: AFCI harness chafing producing a false arc signal.
causes.ur: AFCI harness ghisat hua kar false arc signal de raha hai.

causes.en: Arc detector board itself defective.
causes.ur: Arc detector board khud kharab hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter AND the lithium battery, wait 5 minutes, then switch both on and re-check.
solutions.ur: Inverter AUR lithium battery off karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir dono on karke dobara check karein.

solutions.en: If the error persists, inspect the PV connectors in the dark for arcing before assuming a board failure.
solutions.ur: Agar error baki rahe to board failure maan lene se pehle andhere mein PV connectors mein arcing dekhein.

solutions.en: If connectors are clean and it still self-faults, the AFCI board needs replacement by a service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar connectors saaf hain phir bhi self-fault aaye to AFCI board service centre se replace karwana hoga.

source.title: SOFAR HYD 5K...20KTL-3PH USER MANUAL, section 8.2.1 Inverter error list

codes.seriesName: KTL-G3 (single-phase 1.1-3.3 kW, on-grid, 1 MPPT)

meaning.en: Grid voltage is above the inverter's over-voltage window. This line prints the code as 'ID01' without a leading zero.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage inverter ki over-voltage window se upar hai. Is line par code 'ID01' likha hai, leading zero ke baghair.

causes.en: Grid voltage excursion or a badly set transformer tap on the local feed.
causes.ur: Grid voltage excursion ya local feed par transformer ka tap ghalat set hua.

causes.en: AC breaker not fully engaged, or high-resistance AC wiring causing a drop then a spike.
causes.ur: AC breaker poora engage nahi hua, ya high-resistance AC wiring.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage with a multimeter at the AC terminal and note the value and time.
solutions.ur: AC terminal par multimeter se grid voltage measure karke value aur time note karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC circuit breaker and AC wiring as the manual directs for this code.
solutions.ur: Is code ke liye manual ke mutabiq AC circuit breaker aur AC wiring check karein.

solutions.en: If grid readings are within range but the alarm repeats, ask support to adjust protection points with DISCO approval.
solutions.ur: Agar grid reading range mein hai phir bhi alarm repeat ho to DISCO approval ke saath support se protection points adjust karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

codes.seriesName: KTL-G3 (single-phase 1.1-3.3 kW, on-grid, 1 MPPT)

meaning.en: Grid voltage has dropped below the under-voltage window and the inverter disconnects.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage under-voltage window se neeche gir gaya hai aur inverter disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Long low-voltage feeder with a heavy evening load - voltage sags badly at dusk.
causes.ur: Lambi low-voltage feeder par shaam ka heavy load - shaam ko voltage bohat gir jata hai.

causes.en: AC connection loose at the breaker or at the inverter input.
causes.ur: Breaker ya inverter input par AC connection loose.

solutions.en: Measure AC voltage at the inverter while the evening load is running; check the sag depth.
solutions.ur: Shaam ka load chal raha ho tab AC terminal par voltage measure karein; girawat kitni hai dekhein.

solutions.en: Power off and re-torque the AC input terminal, checking for heat marks or a blackened lug.
solutions.ur: Power off karke AC input terminal dobara tighten karein aur garmi ke nishaan ya kala lug dekhein.

solutions.en: If voltage is also low at the main distribution board, report a low-voltage complaint rather than touching the inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar main distribution board par bhi voltage kam ho to inverter chhoone ke bajaye low-voltage complaint report karein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

codes.seriesName: KTL-G3 (single-phase 1.1-3.3 kW, on-grid, 1 MPPT)

meaning.en: The PV string Vmp is below the inverter's minimum operating voltage. Manual fix: add series modules. This code is also the reference used by other rows - e.g. ID25 says 'If the PV array configuration is correct (no ID05 fault)'.
meaning.ur: PV string ka Vmp inverter ki minimum operating voltage se neeche hai. Manual ka hal: series mein modules barhayein. Yeh code doosri rows ka reference bhi hai - maslan ID25 mein likha hai 'agar PV array configuration sahi hai (ID05 fault nahi)'.

causes.en: Too few modules in series for the string voltage to reach the MPPT window.
causes.ur: String voltage ko MPPT window tak pohanch karne ke liye series mein modules kam hain.

causes.en: Very low irradiance at start-up - haze, heavy cloud, or early morning.
causes.ur: Start-up par bohat kam irradiance - dhund, heavy cloud, ya subah ka waqt.

solutions.en: Measure the string Voc and Vmp with a multimeter on a clear midday and compare to the datasheet MPPT range.
solutions.ur: Saaf dopahar par multimeter se string ka Voc aur Vmp measure karke datasheet MPPT range se compare karein.

solutions.en: If Voc is within range, this is just low sun - the inverter restarts automatically as irradiance returns.
solutions.ur: Agar Voc range mein hai to ye sirf kam dhoop hai - irradiance wapas aate hi inverter khud restart ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If Voc is genuinely low, add series modules or add a second string on a model that supports it.
solutions.ur: Agar Voc asal mein kam hai to series mein modules barhayein ya model mutabiq doosri string lagayein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

codes.seriesName: KTL-G3 (single-phase 1.1-3.3 kW, on-grid, 1 MPPT)

meaning.en: String Voc is above the inverter's maximum input voltage - too many modules in series. Manual fix: reduce series modules.
meaning.ur: String ka Voc inverter ke maximum input voltage se upar hai - series mein modules zyada hain. Manual ka hal: series modules kam karein.

causes.en: String designed on a cold-temperature Voc that exceeds the inverter max in this climate.
causes.ur: String thande temperature ka Voc le kar design hui jo is climate mein inverter max se cross kar jati hai.

causes.en: Modules swapped for a higher-Voc type without redoing the string calculation.
causes.ur: Modules badal kar higher-Voc wale lagaye gaye, string calculation dobara kiye baghair.

solutions.en: Measure string Voc with a multimeter on the clearest, coldest morning available.
solutions.ur: Sab se saaf aur thande subah mein multimeter se string ka Voc measure karein.

solutions.en: Recalculate the string using the module's Voc temperature coefficient at the site minimum temperature, then reduce series count.
solutions.ur: Site ki minimum temperature par module ka Voc temperature coefficient use kar ke string dobara calculate karein, phir series count kam karein.

solutions.en: Do not simply energise to 'see if it works' - overvoltage damages the input stage.
solutions.ur: Sirf 'chalta hai ya nahi' dekhne ke liye current na dein - overvoltage input stage ko nuksan deta hai.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

codes.seriesName: KTL-G3 (single-phase 1.1-3.3 kW, on-grid, 1 MPPT)

meaning.en: The input mode (parallel/independent) setting does not match how the array is wired. Manual fix: change input mode per section 6.3(A) 10.
meaning.ur: Input mode (parallel/independent) setting array ke wiring se match nahi karti. Manual ka hal: section 6.3(A) 10 ke mutabiq input mode badlein.

causes.en: Installer selected independent mode but both MPPTs are fed, or the reverse.
causes.ur: Installer ne independent mode set kiya magar dono MPPT feed hain, ya ulta.

causes.en: Settings reset to default after a firmware update.
causes.ur: Firmware update ke baad settings default par reset ho gayi.

solutions.en: Count how many PV strings are physically connected to each MPPT port first.
solutions.ur: Pehle gino ke har MPPT port par kitni PV strings physically lagi hain.

solutions.en: Set input mode from the LCD menu to match: parallel when both inputs have strings, independent when only one does.
solutions.ur: LCD menu se input mode set karein: dono input par strings hon to parallel, sirf ek par hon to independent.

solutions.en: Re-check the input mode after every firmware update so the setting does not silently revert.
solutions.ur: Har firmware update ke baad input mode dobara check karein taake setting khud se wapas na ho jaye.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

codes.seriesName: KTL-G3 (single-phase 1.1-3.3 kW, on-grid, 1 MPPT)

title.ur: GFCI leakage fault - residual current device trip hua (ID12)

meaning.en: Residual current device tripped. If it happens occasionally the manual says the external circuit was momentarily abnormal; if it is frequent, insulation is the suspect.
meaning.ur: Residual current device trip hua. Agar aam tor par aaye to manual ke mutabiq external circuit mein palay waqt ghalti thi; agar baar baar aaye to insulation shak hai.

causes.en: PV array to earth insulation too low - moisture on modules, connectors or cable.
causes.ur: PV array se earth ki insulation kam - module, connector ya cable par nam.

causes.en: Insulation condition of the PV cable degraded with UV and heat.
causes.ur: PV cable ki insulation UV aur garmi se kharab ho gayi.

solutions.en: Switch off the DC switch and AC breaker and wait 5 minutes before touching DC wiring.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke 5 minute wait karein, phir DC wiring chhoonein.

solutions.en: Measure insulation resistance between the PV array and earth; a low reading confirms the cause.
solutions.ur: PV array aur earth ke darmiyan insulation resistance measure karein; kam reading wajah confirm kar deti hai.

solutions.en: Then check the insulation condition of the PV cable and replace the damaged section or connector.
solutions.ur: Phir PV cable ki insulation condition check karke damaged hissa ya connector replace karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, 1 flash

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

codes.seriesName: KTL-G3 (single-phase 1.1-3.3 kW, on-grid, 1 MPPT)

title.ur: DC bus voltage unbalanced - andar ki bus voltage bigadi hui hai (ID27)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage is not balanced. The manual classes this as an internal fault requiring a DC switch off / 5 min wait / on cycle.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage balanced nahi hai. Manual isay internal fault batata hai jis ke liye DC switch off, 5 minute wait, phir on ka cycle chahiye.

causes.en: A failing DC link capacitor causing the bus halves to drift apart.
causes.ur: DC link capacitor kharab hone se bus ke do hisse alag alag ho gaye.

causes.en: Sample circuit fault on the bus voltage measurement.
causes.ur: Bus voltage measurement ka sample circuit fault.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch OFF, wait 5 minutes, then turn it ON to see whether the fault is rectified.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir ON karke dekhein ke fault theek hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check whether the fault cleared; the manual says to do exactly this check before calling support.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke fault clear hua ya nahi; support ko call karne se pehle manual yahi check kehta hai.

solutions.en: If it returns every restart, the bus voltage sensing circuit needs service - log events for the warranty claim.
solutions.ur: Agar har restart par wapas aaye to bus voltage sensing circuit ko service chahiye - warranty claim ke liye events note karein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

codes.seriesName: KTL-G3 (single-phase 1.1-3.3 kW, on-grid, 1 MPPT)

meaning.en: The relay self-test failed. Manual solution text for this block: internal faults - turn off DC switch, wait 5 minutes, turn on, then check.
meaning.ur: Relay ka self-test fail hua. Is block ka manual solution: internal faults - DC switch off karein, 5 minute wait, on karein, phir check karein.

causes.en: Output relay contacts welded or coil damaged from a previous overcurrent.
causes.ur: Pehle ke overcurrent se output relay ke contacts juce hue ya coil kharab.

causes.en: Relay coil drive or detection circuit faulty on the control board.
causes.ur: Control board par relay coil drive ya detection circuit kharab.

solutions.en: Turn OFF the DC switch, wait 5 minutes, then turn it ON and check whether the fault is rectified.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir ON karke dekhein ke fault theek hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: With power off, re-seat the relay connector and check for socket pins pushed back.
solutions.ur: Power off karke relay connector dobara baithayein aur socket ke piche pushed pins dekhein.

solutions.en: If the relay test still fails, replace the relay module via a service centre - do not keep re-powering the grid.
solutions.ur: Agar relay test phir bhi fail ho to relay module service centre se replace karwayein - grid baar baar energize na karein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

codes.seriesName: KTL-G3 (single-phase 1.1-3.3 kW, on-grid, 1 MPPT)

meaning.en: Insulation between the PV array and earth is too low, so the inverter locked out. Manual fix: rectify any short circuit.
meaning.ur: PV array aur earth ke darmiyan insulation bohat kam hai, is liye inverter lock out ho gaya. Manual ka hal: short circuit theek karein.

causes.en: Water ingress on module backs, connectors or the junction box - typical after monsoon.
causes.ur: Module ke peeche, connectors ya junction box mein paani - monsoon ke baad aam.

causes.en: Cable abraded against a roof edge or a mounting bracket.
causes.ur: Chhat ke kinare ya mounting bracket par cable ghisat.

solutions.en: Open DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then check insulation resistance between the PV array and earth.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karein, 5 minute wait karke PV array aur earth ke darmiyan insulation resistance check karein.

solutions.en: If a short circuit exists, rectify the fault - identify the string by testing them one at a time.
solutions.ur: Agar short circuit hai to ghalti theek karein - strings ko ek ek karke test karke pehchan lein.
