solutions.en: Replace the water-damaged part, dry and reseal the enclosure, then re-measure before energising.
solutions.ur: Paani se kharis hissa replace karein, enclosure sukhein aur seal karein, phir current dene se pehle dobara measure karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, 1 flash

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

codes.seriesName: KTL-G3 (single-phase 1.1-3.3 kW, on-grid, 1 MPPT)

meaning.en: The inverter core temperature is above the limit. Manual fix: make sure installation position and method meet section 3.4 requirements.
meaning.ur: Inverter core temperature limit se upar hai. Manual ka hal: installation position aur tareeqa section 3.4 ki requirements ke mutabiq honi chahiye.

causes.en: Unit mounted in direct afternoon sun on a rooftop.
causes.ur: Unit dopahar ki dhoop mein rooftop par lage hai.

causes.en: Heat sink blocked or fan obstructed, so cooling is ineffective.
causes.ur: Heat sink band ya fan blocked, jis se cooling bekaar ho gayi.

solutions.en: Compare the installation position and method against the manual's section 3.4 requirements.
solutions.ur: Installation position aur tareeqa manual ke section 3.4 requirements se compare karein.

solutions.en: Power off and clean the heat sink with an air blower; never use water or detergent.
solutions.ur: Power off karke heat sink ko air blower se saaf karein; paani ya detergent kabhi na lagayein.

solutions.en: Add shade and clearance if the unit is exposed, and re-check the LCD temperature after it cools.
solutions.ur: Unit exposed ho to shade aur clearance barhayein, aur thanda hone ke baad LCD temperature dohara check karein.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

codes.seriesName: KTL-G3 (single-phase 1.1-3.3 kW, on-grid, 1 MPPT)

title.ur: Invalid country setting - country code ghalat hai (ID97)

meaning.en: The country code stored in the inverter is not valid, so the grid protection profile cannot be applied. Manual fix: reset the country code per section 6.3(A) 4.
meaning.ur: Inverter mein store shuda country code valid nahi hai, is liye grid protection profile lagaya nahi ja sakta. Manual ka hal: section 6.3(A) 4 ke mutabiq country code set karein.

causes.en: Country code erased or left at factory default after a display board replacement.
causes.ur: Display board badalne ke baad country code mit gaya ya factory default par chhoda gaya.

causes.en: Unit imported with a country file that is not valid for the local DISCO grid.
causes.ur: Unit aise country file ke saath import hua jo local DISCO grid ke liye valid nahi.

solutions.en: Check the current country value on the LCD before changing anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi badalne se pehle LCD par current country value check karein.

solutions.en: Reset the country code per manual section 6.3(A) 4.Set Country Code, using the DISCO-approved profile.
solutions.ur: Manual section 6.3(A) 4.Set Country Code ke mutabiq country code reset karein, DISCO approved profile use kar ke.

solutions.en: Confirm the unit resumes exporting after the reset; an invalid code blocks grid connection by design.
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad confirm karein ke unit dobara export karta hai; invalid code by design grid connection rokta hai.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

codes.seriesName: KTL-G3 (single-phase 1.1-3.3 kW, on-grid, 1 MPPT)

title.ur: SD card fault - SD card nahi chal raha (ID98)

meaning.en: The inverter's SD card is not readable. Manual fix: replace the SD card. This code exists only on this small single-phase table.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka SD card readable nahi hai. Manual ka hal: SD card replace karein. Yeh code sirf is chhoti single-phase table par hai.

causes.en: SD card physically loose, bent, or not fully inserted in its slot.
causes.ur: SD card physically loose, tangi ya slot mein poora baitha hi nahi.

causes.en: Card corrupted by a power cut during a data write, or card failed after age.
causes.ur: Data write ke dauran power cut se card corrupt, ya umar ke baad card fail.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter, remove the SD card and reseat it firmly in the correct orientation.
solutions.ur: Inverter power off karke SD card nikaalein aur sahi direction mein mazbooti se dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Try a new FAT32 card; the manual's instruction is to replace it, not to reformat the faulty one.
solutions.ur: Naya FAT32 card lagayein; manual ka instruction usay replace karna hai, kharab card ko format karna nahi.

solutions.en: If the new card still faults, the card slot or reader on the board has failed.
solutions.ur: Agar naya card bhi fault de to board ka card slot ya reader fail ho gaya hai.

source.title: SOFAR 1.1K~3.3KTL-G3 User manual, section 7.1 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Event list

codes.seriesName: KTL2-G3 (single-phase 1-4 kW, on-grid, 140% DC overload)

meaning.en: String Vmp is below the inverter's minimum operating voltage. Manual fix: add series modules to raise the string voltage into the input range.
meaning.ur: String ka Vmp inverter ki minimum operating voltage se neeche hai. Manual ka hal: series mein modules barhayein takay string voltage input range mein aa jaye.

causes.en: Too few modules in series to reach the MPPT operating window.
causes.ur: MPPT operating window tak pohanch karne ke liye series mein modules kam hain.

causes.en: Cold-start or wake-up on a string whose Voc is marginal at low irradiance.
causes.ur: Cold-start ya wake-up aisi string par jiska Voc kam irradiance par marginal hai.

solutions.en: Measure the string's Vmp with a multimeter and compare it to the datasheet MPPT lower limit.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se string ka Vmp measure karke datasheet MPPT ki lower limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: If Voc is normal, it is just low irradiance - the unit recovers automatically as sun returns.
solutions.ur: Agar Voc normal hai to sirf kam irradiance hai - dhoop aate hi unit khud recover ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If Voc is genuinely low, add series modules to bring the string into the input voltage range.
solutions.ur: Agar Voc asal mein kam hai to series mein modules barha kar string ko input voltage range mein layein.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTL2-G3 (single-phase 1-4 kW, on-grid, 140% DC overload)

meaning.en: String Voc exceeds the inverter's maximum input voltage, so the unit will not start. Manual fix: reduce the number of series modules.
meaning.ur: String ka Voc inverter ke maximum input voltage se upar hai, is liye unit start nahi hoga. Manual ka hal: series modules ki sankhya kam karein.

causes.en: String count chosen on a cold-climate Voc that does not suit this site.
causes.ur: String ki sankhya thande climate ke Voc par chuni gayi jo is site ke liye theek nahi.

causes.en: Higher-Voc modules substituted after the original design.
causes.ur: Original design ke baad higher-Voc modules lagaye gaye.

solutions.en: Measure string Voc with a multimeter on the coldest clear morning you can get.
solutions.ur: Sab se thanda aur saaf subah mein multimeter se string ka Voc measure karein.

solutions.en: Recalculate the maximum series count for the site minimum temperature and remove modules until it fits.
solutions.ur: Site ki minimum temperature par maximum series count dobara calculate karein aur modules nikal dein jab tak fit na ho.

solutions.en: Confirm the corrected Voc is under the inverter maximum before re-energising the DC switch.
solutions.ur: DC switch dobara on karne se pehle confirm karein ke corrected Voc inverter max se neeche hai.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTL2-G3 (single-phase 1-4 kW, on-grid, 140% DC overload)

title.ur: GFCI leakage fault - residual current trip hua (12)

meaning.en: Residual current fault. Manual says occasional events mean the external circuit was momentarily abnormal; frequent events mean low PV array insulation.
meaning.ur: Residual current fault. Manual ke mutabiq occasional event ka matlab external circuit mein palay waqt ghalti thi; frequent event ka matlab PV array ki insulation kam hai.

causes.en: PV array to earth insulation too low because of moisture on modules or cable.
causes.ur: Module ya cable par moisture ki wajah se PV array se earth ki insulation kam.

causes.en: A wet connector or junction box allowing leakage to earth.
causes.ur: Geela connector ya junction box earth mein leakage de raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then measure PV array insulation to earth.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke 5 minute wait karke PV array ki earth ke saath insulation measure karein.

solutions.en: If the fault is frequent and lasts a long time, check PV array to earth insulation and then the PV cable insulation condition.
solutions.ur: Agar fault baar baar aaye aur deri tak rahe to PV array se earth ki insulation aur phir PV cable ki insulation check karein.

solutions.en: Replace or reseal the leaking part, then re-measure before closing the DC switch.
solutions.ur: Leaking hissa replace ya reseal karein, phir DC switch band karne se pehle dobara measure karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, 1 flash

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTL2-G3 (single-phase 1-4 kW, on-grid, 140% DC overload)

title.ur: DC input current sampling error - current sensing kharab (24)

meaning.en: The DC input current sensor or its sampling circuit is reporting wrongly. Manual classes ID15-ID24 as internal inverter faults handled by a DC switch off / 5 min / on cycle.
meaning.ur: DC input current sensor ya us ka sampling circuit ghalat reading de raha hai. Manual ID15-ID24 ko internal inverter faults batata hai jinke liye DC switch off, 5 min, on ka cycle hai.

causes.en: Current sense resistor or hall sensor failure on the control board.
causes.ur: Control board par current sense resistor ya hall sensor fail.

causes.en: Sampling circuit noise or a cold solder joint on the measurement board.
causes.ur: Measurement board par sampling circuit ka noise ya cold solder joint.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch OFF, wait 5 minutes, then turn it back ON and check whether the fault is rectified.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir wapas ON karke dekhein ke fault theek hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it returns, compare the inverter's reported DC current against a clamp meter on the PV cable.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to PV cable par clamp meter se liye reading aur inverter ki reported DC current compare karein.

solutions.en: A large mismatch confirms a failed sense channel - log events and raise a service/warranty case.
solutions.ur: Bara farq sense channel fail hone ki tasdeeq karta hai - events note karke service/warranty case karein.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTL2-G3 (single-phase 1-4 kW, on-grid, 140% DC overload)

meaning.en: The phase of the measured grid voltage has changed. This code only appears in this KTL2-G3 table. Manual action: the phase of the grid voltage has changed.
meaning.ur: Measured grid voltage ka phase badal gaya hai. Yeh code sirf is KTL2-G3 table par hai. Manual ka action: grid voltage ka phase badal gaya hai.

causes.en: Two phases or neutral swapped at the AC input, so the inverter sees a different phase angle.
causes.ur: AC input par do phases ya neutral swap ho gaya, is liye inverter ko alag phase angle nazar aata hai.

causes.en: Loose neutral connection causing phase reference to float.
causes.ur: Loose neutral connection ki wajah se phase reference float kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker and inspect phase and neutral terminations for swapped or loose conductors.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karke phase aur neutral connections ke liye swapped ya loose wires dekhein.

solutions.en: Confirm the phase rotation matches the grid with a phase rotation meter before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Dobara current dene se pehle phase rotation meter se confirm karein ke phase rotation grid se match karta hai.

solutions.en: Re-torque the neutral particularly - a loose neutral is the usual trigger for this code.
solutions.ur: Khaas kar neutral dobara tighten karein - loose neutral hi is code ki aam wajah hai.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTL2-G3 (single-phase 1-4 kW, on-grid, 140% DC overload)

meaning.en: Insulation between the PV array and earth is too low. Manual fix: check resistance and rectify any short circuit.
meaning.ur: PV array aur earth ke darmiyan insulation bohat kam hai. Manual ka hal: resistance check karke short circuit theek karein.

causes.en: Moisture on module backs or inside the junction box after rain or monsoon.
causes.ur: Barish ya monsoon ke baad module ke peeche ya junction box ke andar moisture.

causes.en: Cable insulation abraded against a roof edge, bracket or a metal edge.
causes.ur: Chhat ke kinare, bracket ya metal edge par cable ki insulation ghisat hui.

solutions.en: Open DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then measure insulation from the PV array to earth.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karke 5 minute wait karke PV array se earth tak insulation measure karein.

solutions.en: If a short circuit occurs, rectify the fault - find it by testing each string separately.
solutions.ur: Agar short circuit ho to ghalti theek karein - har string ko alag alag test kar ke dhoondhein.

solutions.en: Replace the damaged cable or module and confirm insulation is high again before closing the DC switch.
solutions.ur: Damaged cable ya module replace karein aur DC switch band karne se pehle confirm karein ke insulation dobara zyada hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, 1 flash

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTL2-G3 (single-phase 1-4 kW, on-grid, 140% DC overload)

title.ur: Meter communication error - meter se baat nahi ho rahi (64)

meaning.en: The smart meter stopped communicating. The manual is specific that this is reported when the ARM receives a meter communication exception bit and the safety country is Australia - check the site meter and country setting.
meaning.ur: Smart meter ka communication toot gaya. Manual mutauri hai ke ye tab report hota hai jab ARM ko meter communication exception bit milta hai aur safety country Australia ho - site meter aur country setting check karein.

causes.en: RS485 line to the meter disconnected, reversed (A/B swapped) or unterminated.
causes.ur: Meter ki RS485 line disconnect, reverse (A/B swap) ya open-ended.

causes.en: Meter modbus address or baud rate not matching the inverter setting.
causes.ur: Meter ka modbus address ya baud rate inverter setting se match nahi karta.

causes.en: Country code set to a profile that expects a different meter behaviour.
causes.ur: Country code aise profile par set jo alag meter behaviour expect karta hai.

solutions.en: Power off and check the meter RS485 A and B at both ends for correct pairing and seating.
solutions.ur: Power off karke meter RS485 A aur B dono taraf se pairing aur seating check karein.

solutions.en: Re-enter the meter modbus address on the LCD and confirm the meter is on the same RS485 bus as the inverter.
solutions.ur: LCD par meter ka modbus address dobara daalein aur confirm karein ke meter inverter ke usi RS485 bus par hai.

solutions.en: Verify the country code matches the local DISCO grid profile, since the meter error logic depends on it.
solutions.ur: Country code local DISCO grid profile se match karwayein, kyunke meter error logic usi par depend karta hai.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTL2-G3 (single-phase 1-4 kW, on-grid, 140% DC overload)

title.ur: SD card fault - SD card nahi chal raha (98)

meaning.en: The SD card is not readable. Manual instruction: 'Please replace the SD card.'
meaning.ur: SD card readable nahi hai. Manual ka instruction: 'Please replace the SD card.'

causes.en: Card loose, bent, or inserted in the wrong orientation.
causes.ur: Card loose, tangi ya galat direction mein lagi hui.

causes.en: Card corrupted by a power cut during a data write.
causes.ur: Data write ke dauran power cut se card corrupt hua.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter, reseat the SD card firmly in the correct orientation.
solutions.ur: Inverter power off karke SD card sahi direction mein mazbooti se dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Fit a new FAT32 card; the manual says replace, not reformat.
solutions.ur: Naya FAT32 card lagayein; manual kehta hai replace karein, format nahi.

solutions.en: If a new card also faults, the card reader on the board has failed and needs service.
solutions.ur: Agar naya card bhi fault de to board ka card reader fail hai aur service chahiye.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

meaning.en: Measured grid voltage is above the inverter's over-voltage trip window. Usually self-clears when the grid settles.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage inverter ki over-voltage limit se upar hai. Aam tor par grid theek hone par khud clear ho jata hai.

causes.en: DISCO/grid voltage surge or a badly timed neighbour transformer tap.
causes.ur: DISCO ya grid ka voltage surge, ya kisi transformer ka tap setting kharab.

causes.en: AC contactor or breaker not fully closed / contact resistance too high.
causes.ur: AC contactor ya breaker poora close nahi hua, ya contact resistance zyada hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage with a multimeter at the inverter AC terminal; expect it inside the local DISCO window.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter ke AC terminal par grid voltage check karein; reading local DISCO window ke andar honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, then check AC input cable, breaker and earth continuity.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karein, phir AC cable, breaker aur earth continuity check karein.

solutions.en: If readings are correct but the alarm repeats, log the event and raise with DISCO - do not change protection setpoints yourself.
solutions.ur: Agar reading theek hai phir bhi alarm repeat ho, event log karke DISCO ko report karein - protection setpoint khud na badlein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

meaning.en: Grid voltage is below the under-voltage trip window, so the inverter disconnects from the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage under-voltage limit se neeche gir gaya, is liye inverter grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Long distribution feeder with heavy load - voltage sags under AC motor start.
causes.ur: Lambi distribution line par heavy load - AC motor start par voltage sag.

causes.en: AC wiring loose or undersized, high contact drop on breaker.
causes.ur: AC wiring loose ya choti, breaker par contact drop zyada.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage with a multimeter at the AC terminal under load; check the sag.
solutions.ur: Load ke saath AC terminal par multimeter se grid voltage check karein; sag dekhein.

solutions.en: Power off the DC switch and AC breaker, then re-torque all AC connections.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker power off karein, phir sab AC connections dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: If voltage at the meter is also low, this is a supply problem - escalate to DISCO, inverter is fine.
solutions.ur: Agar meter par bhi voltage kam hai to yeh supply ka masla hai - DISCO ko batayein, inverter theek hai.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

meaning.en: Grid frequency is above the permitted window, so the inverter reduces or stops output.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency allowed range se upar hai, is liye inverter output kam kar deta hai ya band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Utility frequency excursion - common during load shedding restoration on a weak feeder.
causes.ur: Utility ka frequency excursion - kamzor feeder par load shedding ke baad aksar hota hai.

causes.en: Generator/ESS on the same bus pushing frequency up while grid-tied.
causes.ur: Same bus par generator ya ESS grid se jude hote hue frequency upar push kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Check grid frequency with a multimeter or frequency meter at the AC terminal; expect 50 Hz +/- allowed band.
solutions.ur: AC terminal par multimeter ya frequency meter se grid frequency check karein; 50 Hz +/- allowed band hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Confirm the AC breaker is not chattering and the grid connection is clean.
solutions.ur: Yeh confirm karein ke AC breaker chatter nahi kar raha aur grid connection saaf hai.

solutions.en: If a generator is running, check its governor/frequency setting before blaming the inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar generator chal raha hai, to inverter par blame lagane se pehle uska governor aur frequency setting check karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

meaning.en: Grid frequency is below the permitted window; the inverter stops exporting to the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency allowed range se neeche hai; inverter grid mein export karna band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Weak feeder / long cable run with heavy inductive load causing frequency droop.
causes.ur: Kamzor feeder ya lambi cable par heavy inductive load, jis se frequency gir jata hai.

causes.en: Oversized solar export on a small local grid pushing frequency down.
causes.ur: Chhote local grid par zyada solar export, jis se frequency neeche chala jata hai.

solutions.en: Measure frequency at the AC terminal with a frequency meter; log the value and time.
solutions.ur: AC terminal par frequency meter se frequency measure karein; value aur time note karein.

solutions.en: Reduce PV array size or use export limiting if the site regularly drags frequency down.
solutions.ur: Agar site par baar baar frequency girta hai to PV array size kam karein ya export limiting lagayein.

solutions.en: Raise the under-frequency protection point only with written approval from the grid operator.
solutions.ur: Under-frequency protection point sirf grid operator ki written approval se hi badlein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

meaning.en: The residual-current sensor measured leakage above the allowed level, so the inverter shut down. This is the main earth-fault code on this model.
meaning.ur: Residual current sensor ne allowed level se zyada leakage measure kiya, is liye inverter band ho gaya. Is model ka main earth-fault code yehi hai.

causes.en: PV array insulation breakdown from moisture, soiling or a damaged module / cable.
causes.ur: PV array ki insulation moisture, ghar ya kisi damaged module/cable ki wajah se kharab ho gayi.

causes.en: Damaged or pinched DC cable, or a junction box with moisture inside.
causes.ur: Damaged ya pinch hua DC cable, ya andar geela hua junction box.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and AC breaker and wait 5 minutes before touching any DC wiring.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karein aur DC wiring chhoone se pehle 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Measure insulation resistance of each PV string to earth with a 1000 V megger; expect megaohms, not low readings.
solutions.ur: Har PV string ka earth ke saath insulation resistance 1000 V megger se check karein; reading megaohm honi chahiye, kam nahi.

solutions.en: Isolate strings one by one to find the offending string, then inspect connectors, MC4 and the module backs for water ingress.
solutions.ur: Strings ko ek ek karke isolate karein takay galti wali string mil jaye, phir connectors, MC4 aur module ke peeche paani ki dhalai dekhhein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

title.ur: Island protection error - grid chala gaya (ID008)

meaning.en: The inverter detected that the grid is no longer present while it was still exporting, and correctly locked out. Do not defeat this protection.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne dekha ke grid chala gaya hai magar woh abhi bhi export kar raha tha, is liye khud band ho gaya. Yeh protection kabhi bypass na karein.

causes.en: Genuine outage - grid breaker tripped, transformer fuse blown, or local fault.
causes.ur: Asli outage - grid breaker trip hua, transformer ka fuse uthha, ya local fault hua.

causes.en: Brief AC contact dropout from a loose breaker or chattering supply.
causes.ur: Loose breaker ya supply chatter ki wajah se AC contact ka chhota gap.

solutions.en: Confirm the outage at the utility breaker and at the site AC isolator before touching the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter chhoone se pehle utility breaker aur site AC isolator par outage confirm karein.

solutions.en: Once grid is stable, switch AC breaker then DC switch on and watch the LCD restart sequence.
solutions.ur: Grid stable hone ke baad AC breaker aur phir DC switch on karein aur LCD ka restart sequence dekhein.

solutions.en: If islanding trips repeatedly with a healthy grid, inspect AC wiring and CT/meter setup with the installer.
solutions.ur: Grid theek hone par bhi islanding baar baar trip ho to AC wiring aur CT/meter setup installer se check karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

meaning.en: A short, fast grid voltage spike was caught by the ride-through logic; the inverter survives and self-recovers.
meaning.ur: Grid mein chhota aur tez voltage spike ride-through logic ne pakra; inverter bach jata hai aur khud recover ho jata hai.

causes.en: Switching of large capacitor banks or transformers on the local feeder.
causes.ur: Local feeder par bade capacitor bank ya transformer ka on/off hona.

causes.en: Energising the grid breaker with the inverter already connected.
causes.ur: Inverter pehle se jude hote hue grid breaker energise karna.

solutions.en: Note the timestamp; a single event with no load impact is normal ride-through behaviour.
solutions.ur: Timestamp note karein; agar ek baar hua aur load par asar nahi, to ye normal ride-through behaviour hai.

solutions.en: If events cluster at a specific time, correlate with feeder switching by the utility.
solutions.ur: Agar events ek khaas time par repeat hote hain to utility se feeder switching se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check the AC SPD / surge protection status and replace the module if the MOV has gone.
solutions.ur: AC SPD / surge protection ki status check karein aur MOV kharab ho to module replace karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

title.ur: Grid line voltage error - grid line ka voltage galat (ID011)

meaning.en: The inverter could not read a usable grid line voltage on all three phases and shut down to stay safe.
meaning.ur: Inverter teeno phase par proper grid line voltage nahi parh saka aur safety ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: One phase missing or a blown fuse in the inverter AC input board.
causes.ur: Ek phase missing ya inverter ke AC input board par koi fuse uthha hua.

causes.en: Loose L1/L2/L3 lug, or a tripped AC breaker on one pole only.
causes.ur: L1/L2/L3 lug loose, ya sirf ek pole ka AC breaker trip hua.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, then check all three phase fuses and the AC busbar connections.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karein, phir teeno phase ke fuse aur AC busbar connections check karein.

solutions.en: Measure each phase to neutral with a multimeter; expect three balanced readings.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se har phase ka neutral ke saath reading lein; teen balanced readings aani chahiye.

solutions.en: If one phase reads zero, replace that fuse - do not jumper it, and never work on the live busbar.
solutions.ur: Agar ek phase ki reading zero hai to woh fuse replace karein - jumper na lagayein, aur live busbar par kabhi kaam na karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

title.ur: Feed-in limitation / anti-reflux fault - grid mein power wapas ja raha hai (ID013)

meaning.en: The zero-export / feed-in limitation function is not working, so the inverter has stopped to avoid pushing power back to the grid.
meaning.ur: Zero-export / feed-in limitation function kaam nahi kar raha, is liye inverter grid mein power wapas bhejne se bachne ke liye ruk gaya.

causes.en: Smart meter or CT not communicating, so export limit is not measured.
causes.ur: Smart meter ya CT communicate nahi kar raha, is liye export limit measure nahi hoti.

causes.en: Zero-export threshold set to 0 W with a CT that is not installed or not oriented correctly.
causes.ur: Zero-export threshold 0 W par set hai magar CT lagi hui nahi ya ghalat direction mein hai.

solutions.en: Check the monitoring platform for the meter/CT online status; a red offline flag points straight at this code.
solutions.ur: Monitoring platform par meter/CT ki online status dekhein; laal offline flag is code ki taraf ishara karta hai.

solutions.en: Power off and verify the CT clamp direction arrow matches the grid flow direction, and that the CT lead is in the CT port.
solutions.ur: Power off karke CT clamp ki arrow grid flow ke direction se match karwayein, aur CT lead CT port mein honi chahiye.

solutions.en: If a smart meter is used instead, re-enter the meter modbus address and confirm the meter is on the same RS485 bus.
solutions.ur: Agar smart meter use ho raha hai to meter ka modbus address dobara daal kar confirm karein ke meter usi RS485 bus par hai.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

meaning.en: The inverter's internal self-test of the output relay failed at startup, so it refuses to connect to the grid.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne startup par apne output relay ka internal self-test fail kiya, is liye grid se connect nahi hota.

causes.en: Output relay contacts welded or coil damaged from a previous overcurrent event.
causes.ur: Pehle ke overcurrent event se output relay ke contacts juce hue ya coil kharab.

causes.en: Relay PCB driver or the relay detection circuit faulty.
causes.ur: Relay PCB driver ya relay detection circuit kharab.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker and wait 5 minutes, then do one clean restart to rule out a false trip.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir ek baar saaf restart karke dekh lein ke false trip to nahi.

solutions.en: With power off, check the relay connector is fully seated on the board - reseat it if loose.
solutions.ur: Power off karke dekhein ke relay connector board par poora baitha hai - loose ho to dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: If the relay truly fails self-test on every restart, the relay module needs replacement by a SOFAR service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar har restart par relay self-test fail ho to relay module SOFAR service centre se replace karwana hoga.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

title.en: PV insulation too low / earth fault (ID042)

meaning.en: Insulation between the PV array and earth measured too low, so the inverter locked out. Treat as a live earth-fault until proven otherwise.
meaning.ur: PV array aur earth ke darmiyan insulation bahut kam nikla, is liye inverter lock out ho gaya. Jab tak sabit na ho, isay zinda earth-fault samajhein.

causes.en: PV array insulation breakdown from moisture - common after monsoon, roof seepage or heavy dew.
causes.ur: PV array ki insulation moisture se kharab - monsoon, chhat se paani ya bhaari oos ke baad aam hai.

causes.en: Cable pinched under a mounting rail, or a rodent-chewed cable.
causes.ur: Mounting rail ke neeche pinch hua cable, ya chuha ka kuchha hua cable.

solutions.en: Open DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then megger each PV string to earth at 1000 V.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karein, 5 minute wait karke har PV string ka earth ke saath 1000 V par megger lagayein.

solutions.en: Split the array and test half at a time to pinpoint the faulty string.
solutions.ur: Array ko do hisson mein baant kar aadha aadha test karein takay galti wali string mil jaye.

solutions.en: Replace the damaged cable or module and re-test; never re-energise with a low insulation reading.
solutions.ur: Damaged cable ya module replace karke dobara test karein; kam insulation reading par dobara current na dein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, 1 flash

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

title.ur: PE / earth conductor fault - earth wiring kharab (ID043)

meaning.en: The protective earth conductor check did not pass, so the inverter shut down. Manual action: check the AC output PE wire for grounding.
meaning.ur: Protective earth conductor ka check pass nahi hua, is liye inverter band ho gaya. Manual ka action: AC output PE wire ki grounding check karein.

causes.en: PE conductor disconnected or loose at the inverter earth terminal.
causes.ur: PE conductor inverter ke earth terminal se disconnect ya loose ho gaya.

causes.en: Earth bar not bonded, or the installer used the neutral instead of earth.
causes.ur: Earth bar bond nahi hai, ya installer ne earth ke bajaye neutral istemal kar diya.

solutions.en: Switch off DC and AC, then inspect the PE stud, its ring lug and the cable for corrosion or a loose bolt.
solutions.ur: DC aur AC off karke PE stud, uska ring lug aur cable ko corrosion ya loose bolt ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure earth continuity from the inverter PE terminal to the site earth bar with a low-ohm meter; expect near zero.
solutions.ur: Low-ohm meter se inverter ke PE terminal se site earth bar tak earth continuity measure karein; reading zero ke qareeb honi chahiye.

solutions.en: If the ring lug is burnt or the bolt will not torque, replace the lug - do not just tighten a burnt connection.
solutions.ur: Agar ring lug jali hui ho ya bolt tight na ho to lug replace karein - jali hui connection sirf tighten na karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

title.ur: Input mode setting error - MPPT mode ghalat (ID044)

meaning.en: The MPPT input mode is set wrong for the installed array, so the inverter refuses to run.
meaning.ur: MPPT input mode installed array ke mutabiq ghalat set hai, is liye inverter chalne se inkaar kar raha hai.

causes.en: Two MPPT inputs wired as parallel but the unit is set to independent mode (or vice versa).
causes.ur: Do MPPT inputs parallel se jure hain magar unit independent mode par set hai (ya ulta).

causes.en: Input mode setting lost after a firmware update or safety-parameter import.
causes.ur: Firmware update ya safety-parameter import ke baad input mode setting khoj gayi.

solutions.en: Count how many PV strings are physically connected to each MPPT port before changing any setting.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi setting badalne se pehle gino ke har MPPT port par kitni PV strings lagi hain.

solutions.en: If both MPPTs have strings, set the mode to parallel; if only one MPPT has strings, set it to independent.
solutions.ur: Agar dono MPPT par strings hain to parallel set karein; agar sirf ek MPPT par strings hain to independent set karein.

solutions.en: Re-check the mode after every firmware update or country-code import and confirm production resumes.
solutions.ur: Har firmware update ya country-code import ke baad mode dobara check karein aur production shuru hone ki tasdeeq karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

meaning.en: Internal temperature is too high so the inverter has throttled its output. Not a hard fault - it produces less until it cools.
meaning.ur: Internal temperature zyada hai is liye inverter ne output kam kar diya hai. Ye hard fault nahi - thandi hone tak power kam rahegi.

causes.en: Direct sunlight on the inverter - common on a rooftop install in summer.
causes.ur: Inverter par direct sunlight - summer mein rooftop install par aam hai.

causes.en: Heat sink blocked by dust, or fans failed and not spinning.
causes.ur: Heat sink par dhool ki parat, ya fans chalu nahi ho rahe.

solutions.en: Check whether the heat sink and fan vents are clear of dust, cobwebs or stored items.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke heat sink aur fan vents par dhool, makdiya ya rakhi hui cheezein to nahi hain.

solutions.en: Measure the heat sink surface with an IR thermometer; compare with the LCD temperature reading.
solutions.ur: IR thermometer se heat sink ki surface temperature check karein; LCD reading se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the unit is in direct sun, add a shade hood and increase clearance; check fan ID169 next.
solutions.ur: Agar unit direct sun mein hai to shade hood lagayein aur clearance barhayein; agla fan code ID169 dekhein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

meaning.en: The AC output hardware overcurrent protection latched into an unrecoverable state - the manual's name says 'permanent failure'. Inverter will not restart on its own.
meaning.ur: AC output hardware overcurrent protection permanent state mein chala gaya - manual ke naam ke mutabiq 'permanent failure'. Inverter khud restart nahi hoga.

causes.en: Severe or repeated AC overload - load far beyond inverter rating, or a shorted load.
causes.ur: Bara ya baar baar AC overload - load inverter rating se kaafi upar, ya short circuit wala load.

causes.en: Damaged current sensing circuit or the inverter internal output stage.
causes.ur: Current sensing circuit ya inverter ka internal output stage kharab.

solutions.en: Open AC breaker and confirm the connected load is within rated output power before re-energising anything.
solutions.ur: AC breaker open karein aur kuch bhi dobara on karne se pehle confirm karein ke connected load rated output power ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Measure each phase current with a clamp meter and compare against the datasheet maximum; find and unplug the offending load.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se har phase ka current measure karein aur datasheet maximum se compare karein; galti wala load dhoondh kar nikalein.

solutions.en: If load is within rating and the code returns, the internal output stage is damaged - raise a warranty case with the SOFAR service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar load rating ke andar hai phir bhi code aaye to internal output stage kharab hai - SOFAR service centre ke saath warranty case karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

title.ur: USB port fault - USB kaam nahi kar raha (ID145)

meaning.en: The inverter's USB port or the inserted drive is not working - typically raised during a firmware update attempt. Manual action: check the USB port.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka USB port ya us mein lagi drive kaam nahi kar rahi - aam tor par firmware update ki koshish par aata hai. Manual ka action: USB port check karein.

causes.en: USB drive formatted wrong (not FAT32) or a drive with a marginal connector.
causes.ur: USB drive galat format ki hui hai (FAT32 nahi) ya connector wala drive.

causes.en: Firmware file copied outside the required 'firmware' subfolder.
causes.ur: Firmware file gharah folder ke bahar copy ki gayi hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the DC switch, then re-seat and inspect the USB port and drive for bent pins or debris.
solutions.ur: DC switch off karke USB port aur drive ko dobara baithayein aur tange pins ya gaddon ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Reformat the drive as FAT32 and place the update file inside the folder named firmware, as the manual requires.
solutions.ur: Drive ko FAT32 mein dobara format karein aur update file manual ke mutabiq firmware naam ke folder ke andar rakhein.

solutions.en: Never update firmware with AC live or PV connected - switch both off first.
solutions.ur: AC live ya PV connected hone par firmware kabhi update na karein - dono pehle off karein.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G3P (three-phase 15-25 kW, on-grid)

title.ur: Cooling fan 1 fault - fan chalu nahi (ID169)

meaning.en: Fan 1 is not spinning or its tach feedback is missing, so the inverter has lost that cooling path. This model numbers fans individually: ID169-ID175.
meaning.ur: Fan 1 ghoch nahi raha ya us ka feedback nahi aa raha, is liye inverter ne woh cooling chala diya. Is model mein fans alag alag number hote hain: ID169-ID175.

causes.en: Dust-packed fan blades or a fan obstructed by a cable or insect nest.
causes.ur: Fan blades par dhool ki parat ya cable/keeda ke ghere se fan ruka hua.

causes.en: Failed fan motor bearing, or the fan cable connector has come out of the fan baseboard.
causes.ur: Fan motor ka bearing kharab, ya fan cable connector fan baseboard se nikal gaya.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter fully, then hold a tissue strip at the vent to confirm zero airflow.
solutions.ur: Inverter ko poori tarah power off karke vent par tissue rakh kar zero airflow ki tasdeeq karein.

solutions.en: Open the fan baseboard, unplug the fan connector and clean the blades with a soft brush as the manual describes.
solutions.ur: Fan baseboard kholein, fan connector nikaal kar blades ko soft brush se saaf karein jaise manual mein bataya gaya hai.

solutions.en: If the fan does not spin freely after cleaning, replace it - a stopped fan will escalate into ID113 derating.
solutions.ur: Agar saaf karne ke baad bhi fan freely na ghoome to replace karein - ruka hua fan ID113 derating tak le jayega.

source.title: SOFAR 15-25KTLX-G3P User Manual, section 10 'TROUBLESHOOTING AND MAINTENANCE' - Event list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)

title.ur: Grid voltage imbalance - teen phase ka farq zyada (ID014)

meaning.en: The three grid phase voltages differ by too much, so the inverter stopped. This code exists only on the G4 C&I table.
meaning.ur: Teen grid phase voltages ka farq bohat zyada hai, is liye inverter ruk gaya. Yeh code sirf G4 C&I table par hai.

causes.en: Single-phase loads too heavily concentrated on one leg of a three-phase supply.
causes.ur: Teen phase supply par single-phase load kisi ek leg par bohat zyada jama ho gaya.

causes.en: One phase conductor with high resistance - a loose or undersized connection.
causes.ur: Kisi ek phase conductor ka resistance zyada - loose ya choti connection.

causes.en: Utility single-phase earth fault on one phase of the feeder.
causes.ur: Feeder ke kisi ek phase par utility ka single-phase earth fault.

solutions.en: Measure all three phase-to-neutral voltages with a true-RMS multimeter; the spread should be inside the grid operator's limit.
solutions.ur: True-RMS multimeter se teen phase-to-neutral voltages check karein; un ka farq grid operator ki limit ke andar hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Switch off AC breaker and torque all three phase lugs plus neutral, checking for heat discolouration.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karke teenon phase lugs aur neutral ko tighten karein aur garmi ke nishaan dekhein.

solutions.en: If grid balance is correct at the meter but not at the inverter, the fault is in the site's AC cable run.
solutions.ur: Agar meter par balance theek ho magar inverter par nahi, to ghalti site ke AC cable run mein hai.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)

title.ur: Arc fault shutdown protection - PV wiring mein arcing (ID039)

meaning.en: The AFCI arc-detection function tripped and shut the inverter down because it saw arcing in the PV wiring. Indicates a real loose/arcing connection.
meaning.ur: AFCI arc-detection ne trip karke inverter band kar diya kyunke PV wiring mein arcing dekhi. Iska matlab wahan asal mein loose ya arcing connection hai.

causes.en: Loose, corroded or partially disconnected MC4 connector arcing under load.
causes.ur: Load ke neeche loose, corroded ya adhoora disconnected MC4 connector arc kar raha hai.

causes.en: Cable damaged by UV, heat or rodents, breaking down to earth.
causes.ur: UV, garmi ya chuha se damage hua cable, earth ke saath short kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Open DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, and do all connector inspection in the dark with an insulation tester.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karein, 5 minute wait karein, aur saare connector checks andhere mein insulation tester se karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all MC4 connectors, then reconnect every one firmly and re-seat the combiner fuses; replace any burnt connector.
solutions.ur: Saare MC4 connectors nikaalein, phir har ek ko mazbooti se laga kar combiner fuses dobara baithayein; jala hua connector replace karein.

solutions.en: Torque the string fuses to spec and re-test; never bypass an AFCI trip repeatedly - it means real arcing.
solutions.ur: String fuses ko spec par tighten karein aur dobara test karein; AFCI trip ko baar baar bypass na karein - uska matlab asal arcing hai.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)

meaning.en: Internal self-test of the output relay failed at startup, so the inverter will not connect to the grid. Same number, same meaning as the G3P table - but kept separate per instructions.
meaning.ur: Startup par output relay ka internal self-test fail hua, is liye inverter grid se connect nahi hoga. Yehi number G3P table jaisa hai - phir bhi instructions ke mutabiq alag rakha gaya hai.

causes.en: Output relay contacts welded or coil damaged from a previous overcurrent event.
causes.ur: Pehle ke overcurrent event se output relay ke contacts juce hue ya coil kharab.

causes.en: Relay drive circuit or relay detection circuit faulty.
causes.ur: Relay drive circuit ya relay detection circuit kharab.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then do one clean restart.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karein, 5 minute wait karke ek baar saaf restart karein.

solutions.en: With power off, check the relay connector is fully seated on the board and re-seat it if loose.
solutions.ur: Power off karke dekhein ke relay connector board par poora baitha hai aur loose ho to dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: If it fails self-test on every restart, replace the relay module through a SOFAR service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar har restart par fail ho to relay module SOFAR service centre se replace karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)

title.ur: Input mode setting error - MPPT mode ghalat (ID044)

meaning.en: The MPPT input mode is wrong for the installed array, so the inverter refuses to run. On the G4 table the same number is spelled 'PvConfigError' (not 'ConfigError').
meaning.ur: MPPT input mode installed array ke mutabiq ghalat hai, is liye inverter chalne se inkaar karta hai. G4 table par yehi number 'PvConfigError' ke naam se likha hai ('ConfigError' nahi).

causes.en: 10-MPPT unit set to independent mode while the design expects parallel MPPT pairing.
causes.ur: 10-MPPT unit independent mode par set hai magar design mein parallel MPPT pairing ka plan hai.

causes.en: Setting lost after safety-parameter import or firmware upgrade.
causes.ur: Safety-parameter import ya firmware upgrade ke baad setting khoj gayi.

solutions.en: Count connected strings per MPPT on site and compare with the wiring drawing before touching the menu.
solutions.ur: Site par har MPPT ki connected strings gino aur menu chhoone se pehle wiring drawing se compare karein.

solutions.en: Set parallel/independent mode to match the actual string allocation, then confirm the LCD input mode line.
solutions.ur: Parallel/independent mode ko actual string allocation ke mutabiq set karein, phir LCD par input mode line confirm karein.

solutions.en: After any firmware upgrade, re-verify input mode and country code from the LCD menu.
solutions.ur: Har firmware upgrade ke baad LCD menu se input mode aur country code dobara verify karein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)

meaning.en: One or more PV strings are connected backwards. Manual action: connect the PV assembly according to the correct polarity.
meaning.ur: Ek ya zyada PV strings ulti polarity se jure hain. Manual ka action: PV assembly ko sahi polarity ke mutabiq connect karein.

causes.en: String wired back-to-front at the combiner or the DC input terminals.
causes.ur: Combiner ya DC input terminals par string aage se peechhe wire ki gayi.

causes.en: Installer error on one of 20 inputs - easy to miss on a 10-MPPT unit.
causes.ur: 20 inputs mein se ek par installer ka ghalti - 10-MPPT unit par aam tor par nazar nahi aati.

solutions.en: Open DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then measure each string with a DC multimeter; correct polarity reads positive at PV+.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karein, 5 minute wait karke har string DC multimeter se check karein; sahi polarity par PV+ par positive reading aati hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect and re-terminate the reversed string with the correct polarity; never swap DC cables live.
solutions.ur: Reversed string ko disconnect karke sahi polarity par dobara terminate karein; DC kabhi live par swap na karein.

solutions.en: After correction, confirm each string's Voc matches the design before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Ghalti theek karne ke baad, dobara current dene se pehle har string ka Voc design se match karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)

meaning.en: Heatsink 1 temperature protection tripped. The G4 table numbers radiators individually: ID050-ID055 for radiator 1-6, plus ID057/ID058 ambient, ID059-ID061 module 1-3.
meaning.ur: Heatsink 1 ka temperature protection trip hua. G4 table par radiators alag number hote hain: radiator 1-6 ke liye ID050-ID055, plus ID057/ID058 ambient, ID059-ID061 module 1-3.

causes.en: Heat sink fins blocked by dust, cotton or bird droppings - very common on C&I roof arrays.
causes.ur: Heat sink ke fins dhool, rui ya parindon ke guane se band - C&I roof arrays par bohat aam.

causes.en: Ambient above the unit's limit because of poor clearance between inverters in a row.
causes.ur: Row mein inverters ke darmiyan kam clearance ki wajah se unit ka limit se upar ambient.

solutions.en: Power off, then clean the heat sink with an air blower and soft brush - never water or chemicals.
solutions.ur: Power off karke heat sink ko air blower aur soft brush se saaf karein - kabhi paani ya chemicals na lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure heatsink surface with an IR thermometer and check the clearance gap to the next unit against the manual's minimum.
solutions.ur: IR thermometer se heatsink surface temperature check karein aur agle unit se clearance manual ke minimum se compare karein.

solutions.en: If it trips again with a clean sink, check the fan codes ID169-ID175 and the NTC connector on that heatsink.
solutions.ur: Saaf heatsink ke saath dobara trip ho to fan codes ID169-ID175 aur us heatsink ka NTC connector check karein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)

title.ur: Ambient temperature 1 protection - mahol bohat garm (ID057)

meaning.en: The ambient temperature sensor tripped its protection, so the inverter shut down. The G4 table has two ambient sensors: ID057 and ID058.
meaning.ur: Ambient temperature sensor ka protection trip hua, is liye inverter band ho gaya. G4 table par do ambient sensors hain: ID057 aur ID058.

causes.en: Ambient above the datasheet limit - common in a Pakistani summer with a hot roof or west-facing wall.
causes.ur: Datasheet limit se upar ambient - garm roof ya purkh wali deewar par Pakistani garmi mein aam.

causes.en: Inverter mounted in an enclosed plant room with no ventilation.
causes.ur: Inverter aise enclosure mein lage hai jahan ventilation nahi hai.

solutions.en: Read the LCD's ambient temperature value and compare it with the datasheet limit.
solutions.ur: LCD par ambient temperature ki value padhein aur datasheet limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Install a shade hood and open up clearance on the shaded wall; keep the unit vertical.
solutions.ur: Shade hood lagayein aur dhal wali deewar par clearance barhayein; unit vertical rakhein.

solutions.en: If the LCD reading is normal but it still trips, check the ambient NTC connector and consider an external shade panel.
solutions.ur: Agar LCD reading theek ho phir bhi trip ho to ambient NTC connector check karein aur external shade panel sochen.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)

meaning.en: The power-module temperature protection tripped. The G4 table has module 1-3 as ID059, ID060 and ID061.
meaning.ur: Power module ka temperature protection trip hua. G4 table par module 1-3 ke liye ID059, ID060 aur ID061 hain.

causes.en: Fan failure reducing airflow over the power modules.
causes.ur: Power modules par airflow kam karne wala fan failure.

causes.en: Heavy DC load pushing module temperature over the limit even with fans running.
causes.ur: Fans chal rahe hon ke bawajood DC load itna zyada ke module temperature limit cross kar gaya.

solutions.en: Check the fan codes ID169-ID175 first - a stopped fan is the usual trigger for this code.
solutions.ur: Pehle fan codes ID169-ID175 check karein - ruka hua fan is code ki aam wajah hai.

solutions.en: Clean the heat sink and confirm vertical mounting and adequate clearance per the manual's spacing table.
solutions.ur: Heat sink saaf karein aur manual ke spacing table ke mutabiq vertical mounting aur kaafi clearance confirm karein.

solutions.en: Compare actual DC input against the unit rating; oversizing the array raises module temperature.
solutions.ur: Actual DC input ko unit rating se compare karein; array ka size zyada hona module temperature barhata hai.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)

title.en: Inverter module temperature difference too large (ID062)
title.ur: Inverter module temperature difference bohat zyada (ID062)

meaning.en: The inverter detected too large a temperature difference between its modules, which usually means a cooling or sensing fault rather than a genuinely hot site.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne apne modules ke darmiyan temperature difference bohat zyada nikala, jo aksar cooling ya sensing ki ghalti hai, garmi ki sachchi wajah nahi.

causes.en: One heatsink blocked and the adjacent one clear, creating a false differential.
causes.ur: Ek heatsink band aur doosra khula, jis se false differential bana.

causes.en: One NTC sensor drifted, reporting a wrong module temperature.
causes.ur: Ek NTC sensor drift kar gaya, galat module temperature report kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Power off and check every heat sink for equal airflow; clean the dusty one.
solutions.ur: Power off karke har heat sink par barabar airflow check karein; ghaas wala saaf karein.

solutions.en: Compare each module NTC reading against its neighbours; a single outlier points to the sensor.
solutions.ur: Har module ka NTC reading padosiyon se compare karein; ek akhla reading sensor ki taraf ishara karti hai.

solutions.en: If all sinks are clean and readings match, have the module NTC harness checked by a service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar sab sinks saaf hain aur readings match karein to service centre se module NTC harness check karwayein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)

title.ur: Hardware differential over-current - earth leakage pakda (ID104)

meaning.en: The hardware residual/differential current comparator tripped. This code appears only on the G4 table and points to earth leakage or a current transformer problem.
meaning.ur: Hardware residual/differential current comparator trip hua. Yeh code sirf G4 table par hai aur earth leakage ya current transformer ki ghalti ki taraf ishara karta hai.

causes.en: Real earth leakage in the PV array - moisture ingress or damaged cable.
causes.ur: PV array mein asal earth leakage - moisture andar jaana ya damaged cable.

causes.en: CT or the differential sensing circuit faulty, giving a false trip.
causes.ur: CT ya differential sensing circuit kharab, jis se false trip aaya.

solutions.en: Open DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then megger each PV string to earth at 1000 V.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karein, 5 minute wait karke har PV string ka earth ke saath 1000 V par megger lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure the CT secondary with a multimeter at rest; it should read close to zero amps with PV isolated.
solutions.ur: PV isolate karne ke baad multimeter se CT secondary ka resting reading lein; ye zero amps ke qareeb hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If strings are clean and CT reading is normal, escalate - the differential comparator module needs service.
solutions.ur: Agar strings saaf hain aur CT reading normal hai to aage batayein - differential comparator module ko service chahiye.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)

meaning.en: The inverter has throttled its output because internal temperature is high. It is a controlled reduction, not a shutdown.
meaning.ur: Internal temperature zyada hone ki wajah se inverter ne output kam kar diya hai. Ye controlled reduction hai, shutdown nahi.

causes.en: Direct sunlight on the unit or a hot plant room.
causes.ur: Unit par direct sunlight ya garm plant room.

causes.en: Heat sink partly blocked, or one fan has failed.
causes.ur: Heat sink aadha band, ya ek fan kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Check for direct sun and add a shade hood if the unit is exposed.
solutions.ur: Direct sun check karein aur unit exposed ho to shade hood lagayein.

solutions.en: Power off and clean the heat sink with an air blower; keep the unit vertical and ventilated.
solutions.ur: Power off karke heat sink ko air blower se saaf karein; unit vertical aur ventilated rakhein.

solutions.en: Confirm fans are spinning; if a fan code ID169-ID175 is active, fix that first.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke fans ghoch rahe hain; agar fan code ID169-ID175 active hai to pehle woh theek karein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)

title.ur: USB port fault - USB kaam nahi kar raha (ID145)

meaning.en: The inverter USB port or drive is faulty. Manual action: check the USB port of the inverter.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka USB port ya drive kharab hai. Manual ka action: inverter ka USB port check karein.

causes.en: USB drive not FAT32 formatted, or a marginal drive connector.
causes.ur: USB drive FAT32 format mein nahi, ya connector wala kharab drive.

causes.en: Firmware file placed outside the required firmware subfolder.
causes.ur: Firmware file gharah folder ke bahar rakhi gayi hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the DC switch, re-seat the USB port and drive, and inspect for bent pins or debris.
solutions.ur: DC switch off karke USB port aur drive ko dobara baithayein aur tange pins ya gaddon ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Reformat the drive as FAT32 and copy the update file into the folder named firmware.
solutions.ur: Drive ko FAT32 mein dobara format karein aur update file firmware naam ke folder mein copy karein.

solutions.en: Keep AC isolated and PV disconnected while updating; never update with power live.
solutions.ur: Update ke dauran AC isolate aur PV disconnect rakhein; live power par kabhi update na karein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: KTLX-G4 (three-phase 100-125 kW, C&I on-grid)

title.ur: PLC communication lost - inverter aapas mein baat nahi kar rahe (ID192)

meaning.en: Power-line carrier communication between inverters was lost, so the master/slave link or the PLC comms wiring is at fault. Manual's listed action is to check the meters wiring.
meaning.ur: Inverters ke aapas power-line carrier communication toot gaya, is liye master/slave link ya PLC comms wiring mein ghalti hai. Manual ka diya hua action: meters wiring check karein.

causes.en: PLC comms wiring loose, or a different modbus address assigned to two units.
causes.ur: PLC comms wiring loose, ya do units ko same modbus address diya gaya.

causes.en: RS485 line too long, unterminated, or sharing a noisy route with the AC bus.
causes.ur: RS485 line bohat lambi, open-ended, ya AC bus ke saath noisy route share kar rahi hai.

solutions.en: Power off and check PLC/RS485 A and B termination and connector seating at each unit.
solutions.ur: Power off karke har unit par PLC/RS485 A aur B termination aur connector ki seating check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm every inverter has a unique modbus address from the LCD SystemInfo menu.
solutions.ur: LCD SystemInfo menu se confirm karein ke har inverter ka modbus address unique hai.

solutions.en: Keep the comms cable away from AC power runs, and re-seat the meter per the manual's wiring check.
solutions.ur: Comms cable ko AC power runs se door rakhein, aur manual ke wiring check ke mutabiq meter dobara baithayein.

source.title: SOFAR 100-125KTLX-G4 User Manual, section 9 'Trouble Shooting and Maintenance', Table 8-1 Even list

codes.seriesName: ME 5K...20KTL-3PH (AC-coupled storage 5-20 kW, no PV input)

title.ur: Auxiliary power error - andar ki auxiliary supply kharab (ID037)

meaning.en: The inverter's internal auxiliary supply rail has faulted. Manual class: internal fault - switch off, wait 5 minutes, switch on, then check.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka apna auxiliary power rail kharab ho gaya. Manual ke mutabiq: internal fault - off karein, 5 minute wait, on karein, phir check karein.

causes.en: Failed auxiliary PSU module feeding the control and relay boards.
causes.ur: Control aur relay boards ko chalane wala auxiliary PSU module fail.

causes.en: Fuse blown in the auxiliary supply rail, or a bad solder joint on the aux rail.
causes.ur: Auxiliary supply rail ka fuse uthha, ya us rail par solder joint kharab.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter OFF, wait 5 minutes, then ON and check whether the fault is rectified.
solutions.ur: Inverter OFF karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir ON karke dekhein ke fault theek hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: With power off, inspect the auxiliary fuse on the board and reseat any loose aux connector.
solutions.ur: Power off karke board par ka auxiliary fuse dekhein aur koi loose aux connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: If it recurs, measure the aux rail voltage against the manual's schematic value and raise a service case if it is low.
solutions.ur: Agar dobara aaye to manual ke schematic value ke mutabiq aux rail voltage measure karein aur kam ho to service case karein.

source.title: SOFAR ME 5K...20KTL-3PH User Manual, section 8.2 Error list

codes.seriesName: ME 5K...20KTL-3PH (AC-coupled storage 5-20 kW, no PV input)

title.ur: CT disconnect ho gaya / CT error (ID045)

meaning.en: The current transformer signal is missing or out of range, so the inverter cannot measure export and stops. Manual action: check that the CT wiring is correct.
meaning.ur: CT ka signal missing ya range se bahar hai, is liye inverter export nahi nikal sakta aur ruk jata hai. Manual ka action: check karein ke CT wiring sahi hai.

causes.en: CT lead unplugged, or the CT clamp not closed around the conductor.
causes.ur: CT lead unplugged, ya CT clamp conductor ke gird band nahi hai.

causes.en: CT installed on the wrong conductor or facing the wrong direction.
causes.ur: CT galat conductor par lagi ya ulti direction mein.

causes.en: CT lead connected to the wrong CT port, or a 5 A/200 A CT selected where the other is fitted.
causes.ur: CT lead galat CT port par, ya 5 A/200 A ke darmiyan ghalat CT lagi hui.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker and check the CT wiring as the manual instructs, including the port assignment.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karke manual ke mutabiq CT wiring check karein, port assignment samet.

solutions.en: Confirm the CT clamp arrow matches the grid current flow direction and that it sits on the single main feed conductor.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke CT clamp ki arrow grid current flow ke direction se match karti hai aur wo ek hi main feed conductor par hai.

solutions.en: Check the inverter's CT type setting matches the fitted CT, then re-check the LCD current reading.
solutions.ur: Inverter ki CT type setting fitted CT se match karwayein, phir LCD par current reading dobara dekhein.

source.title: SOFAR ME 5K...20KTL-3PH User Manual, section 8.2 Error list

codes.seriesName: ME 5K...20KTL-3PH (AC-coupled storage 5-20 kW, no PV input)
aliases: Master does not exist or is duplicate

title.ur: Parallel configuration fault - parallel wiring ya setting ghalat (ID047)

meaning.en: In parallel operation the master does not exist, or two units are configured with the same address. Manual action: check the parallel mode settings and the wiring.
meaning.ur: Parallel operation mein master mojood nahi hai, ya do units ka same address set hai. Manual ka action: parallel mode settings aur wiring check karein.

causes.en: A parallel unit was powered on before the master, so no master was found.
causes.ur: Parallel unit master se pehle on kiya gaya, is liye koi master nahi mila.

causes.en: Two units left on the same modbus/parallel address by mistake.
causes.ur: Ghalti se do units ka modbus/parallel address same chhoda gaya.

causes.en: Parallel comms cable missing, loose, or the enable/disable link not made.
causes.ur: Parallel comms cable missing, loose, ya enable/disable link nahi banaya.

solutions.en: Check the parallel mode settings on every unit and give each a unique address.
solutions.ur: Har unit ki parallel mode settings check karke har ek ko unique address dein.

solutions.en: Check that the parallel cable is correctly wired between units as the manual's wiring diagram shows.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke parallel cable units ke darmiyan manual ke wiring diagram ke mutabiq sahi hai.

solutions.en: Power the master on first, wait for it to normal, then power each slave on one at a time.
solutions.ur: Pehle master on karein, us ke normal hone ka intezaar karein, phir har slave ko ek ek karke on karein.

source.title: SOFAR ME 5K...20KTL-3PH User Manual, section 8.2 Error list

codes.seriesName: ME 5K...20KTL-3PH (AC-coupled storage 5-20 kW, no PV input)

title.ur: Meter unit communication fault - meter se baat nahi ho rahi (ID105)

meaning.en: The inverter cannot communicate with the meter unit. Manual action: check communication to meter.
meaning.ur: Inverter meter unit se communicate nahi kar pa raha. Manual ka action: meter se communication check karein.

causes.en: RS485 A/B swapped or the meter connector unseated.
causes.ur: RS485 A/B swap ya meter connector seat nahi hua.

causes.en: Duplicate modbus address on the RS485 bus.
causes.ur: RS485 bus par duplicate modbus address.

causes.en: Meter powered off or its supply fuse blown.
causes.ur: Meter power off ya us ke supply ka fuse uthha.

solutions.en: Power off and check meter RS485 A and B pairing at both ends of the run.
solutions.ur: Power off karke run ke dono taraf meter RS485 A aur B ki pairing check karein.

solutions.en: Set a unique modbus address from the LCD and confirm the meter is powered and on the same bus.
solutions.ur: LCD se unique modbus address set karein aur confirm karein ke meter powered hai aur usi bus par hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the meter shows online in the SOFAR monitoring app before changing further settings.
solutions.ur: SOFAR monitoring app mein meter online dikh raha hai confirm karein, phir aage settings badlein.

source.title: SOFAR ME 5K...20KTL-3PH User Manual, section 8.2 Error list

codes.seriesName: ME 5K...20KTL-3PH (AC-coupled storage 5-20 kW, no PV input)

title.ur: Battery undervoltage alarm - battery voltage bohat kam (ID124)

meaning.en: The battery has dropped to the low-voltage warning level. Manual groups it as 'Protection against battery undervoltage' and asks whether the battery voltage is too low.
meaning.ur: Battery low-voltage warning level tak gir gaya hai. Manual isay 'Protection against battery undervoltage' ke naam se likhta hai aur poochta hai ke battery voltage kam to nahi.

causes.en: Battery discharged past the usable depth of discharge with insufficient solar surplus.
causes.ur: Battery solar surplus ke ghair kaafi depth of discharge se neeche discharge ho gaya.

causes.en: Battery capacity degraded with age, so it reaches the low-voltage point much earlier.
causes.ur: Battery umar ke saath capacity kam ho gayi, is liye woh low-voltage point jaldi reach karti hai.

solutions.en: Read the battery voltage and SOC on the LCD and confirm the pack voltage with a multimeter at the BAT terminals.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery voltage aur SOC padhein aur BAT terminals par multimeter se pack voltage confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the PV system is generating enough to cover load plus battery charging that day.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke us din PV system load aur battery charging dono ko cover kar raha hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the pack is old, compare its measured capacity with nameplate - a pack below 80% capacity is end-of-life.
solutions.ur: Agar pack purani hai to us ki measured capacity nameplate se compare karein - 80% se kam capacity end-of-life hai.

source.title: SOFAR ME 5K...20KTL-3PH User Manual, section 8.2 Error list

codes.seriesName: ME 5K...20KTL-3PH (AC-coupled storage 5-20 kW, no PV input)
aliases: Permanent battery overcurrent error in EPS mode

title.ur: Permanent EPS battery overcurrent - backup mein battery ka overcurrent (ID133)

meaning.en: During EPS backup mode the battery overcurrent protection latched permanently. This row exists only on storage/hybrid ME and HYD tables.
meaning.ur: EPS backup mode mein battery overcurrent protection permanently trigger ho gaya. Yeh row sirf storage/hybrid ME aur HYD tables par hai.

causes.en: Backup load far above the inverter EPS rating, typically from a large motor or compressor start.
causes.ur: Backup load inverter EPS rating se bohat upar, aam tor par bade motor ya compressor start se.

causes.en: Battery or BMS internal fault causing a short-like discharge current.
causes.ur: Battery ya BMS ki internal ghalti jis se short jaisa discharge current beh raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the backup panel and clamp-meter its total current before touching the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter chhoone se pehle backup panel isolate karke clamp meter se us ka kul current check karein.

solutions.en: Compare the measured backup load with the datasheet EPS output rating and move oversized loads to the grid side.
solutions.ur: Measured backup load ko datasheet EPS output rating se compare karein aur bade loads grid side mein shift karein.

solutions.en: Log the event and open a service case - a permanent fault will not clear on a simple restart.
solutions.ur: Event note karke service case karein - permanent fault simple restart se hal nahi hota.

source.title: SOFAR ME 5K...20KTL-3PH User Manual, section 8.2 Error list

codes.seriesName: ME 5K...20KTL-3PH (AC-coupled storage 5-20 kW, no PV input)

title.en: SCI communication error to the fuse board (ID155)
title.ur: SCI communication error fuse board se (ID155)

meaning.en: The control board lost SCI serial communication with the fuse monitoring board. This fuse-specific row is unique to the ME table.
meaning.ur: Control board ne fuse monitoring board se SCI serial communication kho di. Yeh fuse wali row sirf ME table par hai.

causes.en: SCI harness unplugged or chafed between control board and fuse board.
causes.ur: Control board aur fuse board ke darmiyan SCI harness unplugged ya ghisat.

causes.en: Fuse board itself failed, or its supply rail dead.
causes.ur: Fuse board khud fail, ya us ki supply rail dead.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, then reseat the SCI connector at both boards.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke dono boards par SCI connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Inspect the SCI ribbon for damaged or folded pins and reseat until the latch clicks.
solutions.ur: SCI ribbon ko tange ya mudde pins ke liye dekhein aur latch click hone tak dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: If the connection is sound, the fuse board needs replacement - log the fault for the warranty claim.
solutions.ur: Agar connection theek hai to fuse board replace karna hoga - warranty claim ke liye fault note karein.

source.title: SOFAR ME 5K...20KTL-3PH User Manual, section 8.2 Error list

codes.seriesName: ME 5K...20KTL-3PH (AC-coupled storage 5-20 kW, no PV input)

title.ur: Logic interface derating - bahar se command par power kam (ID166)

meaning.en: The inverter reduced its power because a digital logic input on the communication board asserted. The manual states plainly: 'This message is for information and is not an error.'
meaning.ur: Inverter ne apni power kam ki kyunke communication board ka koi digital logic input active hua. Manual saaf likhta hai: 'Ye message sirf information ke liye hai, error nahi hai.'

causes.en: A dispatch or demand-response signal sent by the utility or a load controller.
causes.ur: Utility ya load controller ka dispatch ya demand-response signal aa gaya.

causes.en: A digital input left bridged or configured to the wrong function after installation.
causes.ur: Installation ke baad koi digital input bridged chhoda ya galat function par set kiya gaya.

solutions.en: No action needed on the inverter itself - this is an intended external command, not a fault.
solutions.ur: Inverter khud par koi action zaroori nahi - ye bahar ka intentional command hai, fault nahi.

solutions.en: Check the logic interface input wiring on the communication board and confirm which input is asserted.
solutions.ur: Communication board par logic interface input wiring check karein aur confirm karein ke kaun sa input active hai.

solutions.en: If output is lower than expected, confirm with the dispatcher before adjusting anything in the inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar output expected se kam hai to inverter mein kuch badalne se pehle dispatcher se confirm karein.

source.title: SOFAR ME 5K...20KTL-3PH User Manual, section 8.2 Error list

codes.seriesName: ME 5K...20KTL-3PH (AC-coupled storage 5-20 kW, no PV input)

title.ur: Meter communication lost - meter ka link toot gaya (ID176)

meaning.en: The inverter has lost the meter link. Note this is a DIFFERENT row from ID105 MeterCommFault on the same table - both exist with different IDs.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne meter ka link kho diya. Note ye ID105 MeterCommFault se alag row hai - dono usi table par maujood hain alag IDs ke saath.

causes.en: RS485 link dropped - cable pulled during maintenance, or a connector shaken loose.
causes.ur: RS485 link toot gaya - maintenance mein cable kheench kar nikal li gayi, ya connector hil gaya.

causes.en: Meter rebooted or lost its address after a power interruption.
causes.ur: Meter reboot ho gaya ya power interruption ke baad us ka address kho gaya.

causes.en: Surge or lightning event damaged the meter-side transceiver.
causes.ur: Surge ya lightning ne meter side ka transceiver kharab kar diya.

solutions.en: Power off and re-torque and re-seat the meter RS485 terminations, then power the meter first and the inverter second.
solutions.ur: Power off karke meter RS485 terminations dobara tighten aur baithayein, phir meter pehle aur inverter baad mein power karein.

solutions.en: Re-enter the meter modbus address and confirm it appears online in the monitoring app.
solutions.ur: Meter ka modbus address dobara daalein aur confirm karein ke monitoring app mein online dikhta hai.

solutions.en: If it drops only during storms, fit an SPD on the RS485 line - this points to surge damage.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf baarish mein gire to RS485 line par SPD lagayein - ye surge damage ki taraf ishara karta hai.

source.title: SOFAR ME 5K...20KTL-3PH User Manual, section 8.2 Error list

codes.seriesName: ME 5K...20KTL-3PH (AC-coupled storage 5-20 kW, no PV input)

title.ur: BMS version fault - battery ka firmware version ghalat (ID183)

meaning.en: The battery management system firmware version is not accepted by the inverter. Manual action: contact technical support. Related rows: ID184 BMS CAN VerFault and ID185 BMS CAN VerLow.
meaning.ur: Battery management system ka firmware version inverter ke liye qabul nahi hai. Manual ka action: technical support se rabta karein. Related rows: ID184 BMS CAN VerFault aur ID185 BMS CAN VerLow.

causes.en: Battery firmware older than the minimum version the inverter accepts.
causes.ur: Battery firmware us minimum version se purana hai jo inverter qubool karta hai.

causes.en: Battery replaced with a different BMS type after the original commissioning.
causes.ur: Original commissioning ke baad battery alag BMS type se badal di gayi.

solutions.en: Read the reported BMS version on the LCD and note it before doing anything else.
solutions.ur: Pehle LCD par reported BMS version padhein aur note karein, phir koi bhi kaam karein.
