solutions.en: Contact technical support and quote the exact BMS version so they can supply the matching battery firmware.
solutions.ur: Technical support se rabta karein aur exact BMS version batayein takay woh matching battery firmware de sakein.

solutions.en: Do not force operation with a mismatched BMS - the inverter will not manage the battery safely.
solutions.ur: Mismatched BMS ke saath zor se chalaane ki koshish na karein - inverter battery ko safely manage nahi kar sakta.

source.title: SOFAR ME 5K...20KTL-3PH User Manual, section 8.2 Error list

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)

meaning.en: The BMS could not initialise from the battery pack.
meaning.ur: BMS battery pack se initialize nahi hua.

causes.en: One or more batteries not properly connected
causes.ur: Koi aik ya zyada batteries theek se nahi jury

causes.en: Inter-battery communication link broken in the chain
causes.ur: Batteries ke darmiyan communication link toota hua hai

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then walk the battery chain and confirm every battery-to-battery lead is seated.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir battery chain check karein ke har battery-to-battery lead poori tarah lagi hui hai.

solutions.en: Measure continuity across each inter-battery link to find the open one.
solutions.ur: Har inter-battery link ki continuity nikaal kar khuli wala dhoondein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)

meaning.en: The BMS has no battery connected to it.
meaning.ur: BMS se koi battery jury nahi hai.

causes.en: BMS cable loop is not closed
causes.ur: BMS cable loop band nahi hai

causes.en: No battery connected, or battery cables disconnected
causes.ur: Koi battery nahi jury, ya battery cables disconnect hain

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then verify the BMS cable loop is closed from end to end.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir BMS cable loop sifar se sifar band hai ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the loop resistance and continuity; an open loop confirms the fault.
solutions.ur: Loop ki resistance aur continuity nikaalein; khula loop fault confirm karta hai.

solutions.en: Reseat the last connector in the chain, which is the usual culprit.
solutions.ur: Chain ka aakhri connector dobara lagaayein, jo aam tor par asal wajah hoti hai.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)

title.en: Invalid number of batteries in the pack
title.ur: Pack mein batteries ki ghalat tadaad hai

meaning.en: The BMS has detected a battery count that does not match its configuration.
meaning.ur: BMS ne battery ki aik aisi tadaad dhoondi hai jo uski configuration se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Not all batteries properly connected, so the BMS counts fewer than configured
causes.ur: Tamam batteries theek se nahi jury, is liye BMS configured se kam ginti karta hai

causes.en: Battery count setting wrong in VictronConnect
causes.ur: VictronConnect mein battery count setting ghalat hai

solutions.en: Isolate DC and count the actual batteries in the series string.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein aur series string mein asal batteries gin lein.

solutions.en: Check the configured battery count in VictronConnect against that count.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein configured battery count ko us gin se compare karein.

solutions.en: Fix any disconnected battery, then correct the count setting.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi disconnect battery theek karein, phir count setting theek karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)

title.ur: Battery voltage ki ijazat nahi hai

meaning.en: The battery voltage is too high or too low for the configured system. The manual notes this occurs when the voltage is outside all system voltage ranges.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage configured system ke liye bohat zyada ya kam hai. Manual ke mutabiq ye tab hota hai jab voltage sab system voltage ranges se bahar ho.

causes.en: Bank voltage outside the 12/24/48 V system threshold window
causes.ur: Bank voltage 12/24/48 V system ki threshold window se bahar

causes.en: Battery settings in VictronConnect set to the wrong system voltage
causes.ur: VictronConnect mein battery settings ghalat system voltage par hain

solutions.en: Measure the actual bank voltage with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se asal bank voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Compare to the threshold table: 12 V = 9-15 V, 24 V = 16-30 V, 48 V = 32-60 V.
solutions.ur: Threshold table se compare karein: 12 V = 9-15 V, 24 V = 16-30 V, 48 V = 32-60 V.

solutions.en: Correct the battery voltage setting in VictronConnect.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein battery voltage setting theek karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)

meaning.en: A hardware fault inside the BMS. Victron's stated remedy is dealer contact.
meaning.ur: BMS ke andar hardware fault. Victron ka bataya hua hal dealer se rabta karna hai.

causes.en: Internal board or processor failure
causes.ur: Internal board ya processor ki failure

causes.en: Component failure after surge, heat or water ingress
causes.ur: Surge, garmi ya paani ke ghusaav ke baad component failure

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then verify the installation and all cables are sound before assuming a board fault.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir board fault maan lene se pehle installation aur cables theek check karein.

solutions.en: Contact your Victron dealer and quote the exact code E-B11.
solutions.ur: Victron dealer se rabta karein aur asal code E-B11 batayein.

solutions.en: Keep the BMS powered from a stable supply while the dealer assesses it.
solutions.ur: Dealer dekh raha ho tab tak BMS ko stable supply se power dete rahein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)

title.en: Pre-charge error - load resistance too low
title.ur: Pre-charge error - load resistance bohat kam hai

meaning.en: The load resistance is too low for the BMS to pre-charge the loads.
meaning.ur: Load resistance itni kam hai ke BMS loads ko pre-charge nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: One or more loads with very low resistance connected
causes.ur: Bohat kam resistance wala koi ya koi load jury hai

causes.en: Inverter/charger input capacitance too large for the pre-charge circuit
causes.ur: Inverter/charger ki input capacitance pre-charge circuit ke liye bohat badi hai

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then disconnect or reduce some DC loads as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir manual ke mutabiq kuch DC loads disconnect ya kam karein.

solutions.en: Measure the resistance across the load output to find the low-resistance path.
solutions.ur: Load output par resistance nikaal kar kam resistance wala raasta dhoondein.

solutions.en: Reconnect loads one at a time until pre-charge succeeds on all of them.
solutions.ur: Loads ek ek kar ke jurayein jab tak sab par pre-charge na ho jaye.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)

meaning.en: The safety contactor has not behaved correctly. Victron's stated remedy is dealer contact.
meaning.ur: Safety contactor ne theek se kaam nahi kiya. Victron ka bataya hua hal dealer se rabta karna hai.

causes.en: Contactor failed to close, or welded closed
causes.ur: Contactor band nahi hua, ya band hi reh gaya (welded)

causes.en: Contactor drive or control fault
causes.ur: Contactor drive ya control fault

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then measure the main contacts for continuity to see if they are welded.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir main contacts ki continuity nikaal kar dekhein ke weld to nahi hue.

solutions.en: Check the coil supply and connector seating at the contactor.
solutions.ur: Coil supply aur contactor par connector ki fitting check karein.

solutions.en: Contact your Victron dealer quoting E-B26 before replacing the contactor yourself.
solutions.ur: Apne aap contactor badalne se pehle Victron dealer se E-B26 batakar rabta karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)

meaning.en: Fault in the M8 battery cabling that the BMS relies on.
meaning.ur: BMS jis par depend karta hai us M8 battery cabling mein fault hai.

causes.en: Loose or corroded M8 battery terminal
causes.ur: Dheela ya corroded M8 battery terminal

causes.en: M8 cable damaged, undersized or of wrong type
causes.ur: M8 cable kharab, chhoti ya galat type ki

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then check the battery M8 cabling as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir manual ke mutabiq battery M8 cabling check karein.

solutions.en: Clean every M8 terminal with a wire brush and re-tighten to the specified torque.
solutions.ur: Har M8 terminal ko wire brush se saaf karke specified torque par dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Measure the M8 connection resistance; it should be milliohms, not ohms.
solutions.ur: M8 connection ki resistance nikaalein; ye milliohms honi chahiye, ohms nahi.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)

meaning.en: The configured system voltage does not match the connected bank.
meaning.ur: Configured system voltage jury bank se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Battery voltage settings in VictronConnect set to 12/24/48 V incorrectly
causes.ur: VictronConnect mein battery voltage settings 12/24/48 V ki ghalat value par hain

causes.en: Bank replaced with a different nominal voltage
causes.ur: Bank ko kisi aur nominal voltage wale bank se badal diya gaya

solutions.en: Measure the actual bank voltage with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se asal bank voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Open the battery settings in VictronConnect and set the correct system voltage.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein battery settings kholein aur sahi system voltage set karein.

solutions.en: Re-read the error after saving to confirm E-B34 has cleared.
solutions.ur: Save karne ke baad error dobara parh kar confirm karein ke E-B34 saaf ho gaya.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)

meaning.en: The load capacity is too high for the BMS to finish pre-charging in time.
meaning.ur: Load capacity itni zyada hai ke BMS waqt par pre-charge khatam nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Total connected load capacitance too large
causes.ur: Total connected load capacitance bohat badi hai

causes.en: Loads and chargers all switched in together during pre-charge
causes.ur: Pre-charge ke dauran loads aur chargers sab aik saath on kar diye gaye

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then disconnect some DC loads as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir manual ke mutabiq kuch DC loads disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Stagger the loads: bring them on in stages rather than all together.
solutions.ur: Loads ko stage mein laayein, sab aik saath nahi.

solutions.en: Reconnect and confirm the pre-charge completes within the BMS timeout.
solutions.ur: Dobara jurayein aur confirm karein ke pre-charge BMS timeout ke andar complete hota hai.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)

meaning.en: The auxiliary ATC or ATD contact is not being read correctly by the BMS.
meaning.ur: BMS auxiliary ATC ya ATD contact ko theek se nahi parh raha.

causes.en: ATC/ATD wiring fault or a loose auxiliary contact connector
causes.ur: ATC/ATD wiring fault ya auxiliary contact connector dheela

causes.en: Loads or chargers not actually controlled by the ATC or ATD
causes.ur: Loads ya chargers asal mein ATC ya ATD se control nahi ho rahe

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then check the ATC/ATD wiring at both the contactor and the BMS.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir contactor aur BMS dono par ATC/ATD wiring check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm every load and charger is genuinely wired to the ATC or ATD, per the manual.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq confirm karein ke har load aur charger wakai ATC ya ATD se jury hai.

solutions.en: Measure the auxiliary contact state with a multimeter; it must switch cleanly on and off.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se auxiliary contact ki state nikaalein; ye on aur off par saaf switch honi chahiye.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)

meaning.en: The BMS calibration data is lost and the unit needs dealer attention.
meaning.ur: BMS ka calibration data kho gaya hai aur unit ko dealer ke dekhne ki zaroorat hai.

causes.en: Calibration memory corrupted or lost
causes.ur: Calibration memory corrupt ya kho gaya

causes.en: Factory-fresh unit logging this once in history before first clear
causes.ur: Factory naya unit pehli clear se pehle aik baar history mein ye log kar raha hai

solutions.en: Check whether E-B116 is the ACTIVE error or only sits in the history log.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke E-B116 ACTIVE error hai ya sirf history log mein hai.

solutions.en: If ACTIVE, contact your Victron dealer for a replacement.
solutions.ur: Agar ACTIVE hai to Victron dealer se replacement ke liye rabta karein.

solutions.en: If history only and the BMS runs normally, no action is needed.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf history mein hai aur BMS normal chalta hai to koi karam nahi.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — error codes (VictronConnect / GX device)

meaning.en: Settings data is corrupt. The manual's remedy is to reset to defaults from the settings page.
meaning.ur: Settings data corrupt hai. Manual ka hal hai settings page se defaults par reset karna.

causes.en: Settings memory corrupted, often after an interrupted write or power cut
causes.ur: Settings memory corrupt, aksar interrupted write ya power cut ke baad

causes.en: Firmware update interrupted part-way
causes.ur: Firmware update beech mein ruk gaya

solutions.en: Open the settings page in VictronConnect and reset to defaults.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein settings page kholein aur defaults par reset karein.

solutions.en: Power down the BMS fully, wait 3 minutes, then power up and reconfigure.
solutions.ur: BMS ko mukammal band karein, 3 minute intezaar karein, phir on karke dobara configure karein.

solutions.en: Re-enter your battery type, capacity and system voltage after the reset.
solutions.ur: Reset ke baad battery type, capacity aur system voltage dobara daalein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — Status LED red-flash fault codes

title.en: Status LED red 1x per 4 s - warning active
title.ur: Status LED laal 1 baar / 4 s - warning chal rahi hai

meaning.en: A warning is active. The BMS is still running; open VictronConnect or the GX device to read which warning it is.
meaning.ur: Aik warning chal rahi hai. BMS abhi chal raha hai; VictronConnect ya GX device kholein taake pata chale kaunsi warning hai.

causes.en: Any of the BMS warning conditions (low cell voltage, high current, high BMS temperature, bad contactor, load about to disconnect, low SoC, VE.CAN or Distributor comms lost)
causes.ur: BMS ki koi bhi warning shart (low cell voltage, high current, high BMS temperature, kharab contactor, load disconnect hone wala hai, low SoC, VE.CAN ya Distributor comms lost)

causes.en: Warning has only just been raised, so the underlying cause may not yet be measured
causes.ur: Warning abhi abhi aayi hai, is liye asal wajah abhi tak measure bhi nahi hui ho sakti

solutions.en: Open VictronConnect or the GX device and read the actual warning code (see the Lynx warning series).
solutions.ur: VictronConnect ya GX device kholein aur asal warning code parhein (Lynx warning series dekhein).

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage and load current to see if a low-voltage or high-current warning is the cause.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage aur load current nikaalein taake pata chale ke low voltage ya high current warning ki wajah hai.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — Status LED red-flash fault codes

title.en: Status LED red 2x - battery BMS comms error
title.ur: Status LED laal 2 baar - battery BMS comms error

meaning.en: The BMS cannot talk to the batteries over the battery BMS cable loop.
meaning.ur: BMS battery BMS cable loop ke zariye batteries se baat nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Battery BMS cable not connected or not seated in the BMS
causes.ur: Battery BMS cable BMS mein nahi jury ya poori tarah lagi nahi

causes.en: Open circuit in the battery BMS cable loop
causes.ur: Battery BMS cable loop mein khulna (open circuit)

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then reseat every battery BMS connector, working along the chain from the BMS outwards.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir BMS se bahar ki taraf chain mein har battery BMS connector dobara lagaayein.

solutions.en: Measure continuity of the BMS cable loop end to end; the loop must be closed.
solutions.ur: BMS cable loop ki continuity sifar se sifar nikaalein; loop band hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Inspect for water ingress or crushed cable, then re-test.
solutions.ur: Paani ke ghusaav ya dabba hua cable dekhein, phir dobara test karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — Status LED red-flash fault codes

title.en: Status LED red 3x - cell volt/temp out of range
title.ur: Status LED laal 3 baar - cell voltage/temp range se bahar

meaning.en: A high or low cell voltage, or a high or low temperature, has been detected inside the battery pack.
meaning.ur: Battery pack ke andar kisi cell ka voltage ya temperature high ya low detect hua hai.

causes.en: Cell undervoltage - bank discharged
causes.ur: Cell undervoltage - bank khatam ho gaya

causes.en: Cell overvoltage - overcharging or unbalanced cells
causes.ur: Cell overvoltage - zyada charge ya cells unbalanced

causes.en: Pack temperature above or below the safe limit
causes.ur: Pack temperature safe limit se upar ya neeche

solutions.en: Measure total bank voltage and compare it to the state of charge in VictronConnect.
solutions.ur: Bank ka total voltage nikaal kar VictronConnect ke state of charge se compare karein.

solutions.en: If low: recharge the bank on a known-good charger and watch the cells re-balance.
solutions.ur: Agar kam hai: bank ko aik ache charger se charge karein aur cells ko re-balance hote dekhein.

solutions.en: If high: disconnect all other chargers and loads, then check the BMS balancing readings per cell.
solutions.ur: Agar zyada hai: baqi chargers aur loads disconnect karein, phir har cell ka BMS balancing reading check karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — Status LED red-flash fault codes

title.en: Status LED red 4x - BMS too hot
title.ur: Status LED laal 4 baar - BMS garam hai

meaning.en: The BMS itself has overheated.
meaning.ur: BMS khud garam ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature too high around the BMS
causes.ur: BMS ke aar paas ambient temperature bohat zyada hai

causes.en: BMS cooling fans not running
causes.ur: BMS ke cooling fans nahi chal rahe

solutions.en: Check the ambient temperature where the Lynx is installed.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke Lynx jahan lagi hai wahan ambient temperature kya hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the BMS fans actually spin; the manual says contact the dealer if they are not running.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke BMS fans asal mein chalti hain; manual ke mutabiq agar nahi chalti to dealer se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load and improve airflow; re-test after cooling.
solutions.ur: Load kam karein aur hawa ka rausta behtar karein; thanda hote hi dobara test karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — Status LED red-flash fault codes

title.en: Status LED red 5x - pre-charge timed out
title.ur: Status LED laal 5 baar - pre-charge timeout

meaning.en: The BMS could not finish pre-charging the DC loads in time.
meaning.ur: BMS DC loads ko pre-charge khatam nahi kar paya.

causes.en: Load capacitance too high or load resistance too low (under about 20 Ohm)
causes.ur: Load ki capacitance bohat zyada ya resistance bohat kam (taqreeb 20 Ohm se neeche)

causes.en: Too many loads or chargers left connected during pre-charge
causes.ur: Pre-charge ke dauran bohat zyada loads ya chargers jury hain

solutions.en: Isolate DC and switch off all loads and chargers.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein aur tamam loads aur chargers band karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect loads one at a time to find the one causing the pre-charge failure.
solutions.ur: Loads ek ek kar ke dobara jurayein taake woh dhoondein jo pre-charge rok raha hai.

solutions.en: Measure the load resistance; it should be above the manual's 20 Ohm threshold.
solutions.ur: Load resistance nikaalein; ye manual ke 20 Ohm se upar hona chahiye.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — Status LED red-flash fault codes

title.en: Status LED red 6x - pre-charge current too high
title.ur: Status LED laal 6 baar - pre-charge current zyada hai

meaning.en: The energy or current drawn during pre-charging exceeded the allowed value.
meaning.ur: Pre-charge ke dauran kharcha ya current matloon se zyada ho gaya.

causes.en: A load with very low resistance connected to the load output
causes.ur: Load output par bohat kam resistance wala load jury hai

causes.en: Pre-charged energy limit exceeded by the combined load
causes.ur: Mil kar pre-charge kiya gaya energy matloon se zyada ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then disconnect or remove some DC loads.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir kuch DC loads hata dein ya disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Rule out short circuits in the load wiring with an insulation tester.
solutions.ur: Insulation tester se load wiring ke shorts check karke hatayein.

solutions.en: Reconnect in stages and watch the pre-charge current each time.
solutions.ur: Stage by stage dobara jurayein aur har baar pre-charge current dekhein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — Status LED red-flash fault codes

title.en: Status LED red 7x - wrong system voltage
title.ur: Status LED laal 7 baar - system voltage ghalat hai

meaning.en: The measured battery voltage sits outside the threshold for the configured system voltage. Thresholds are 9-15 V for 12 V, 16-30 V for 24 V, and 32-60 V for 48 V.
meaning.ur: Measured battery voltage configured system voltage ki threshold se bahar hai. Thresholds: 12 V ke liye 9-15 V, 24 V ke liye 16-30 V, aur 48 V ke liye 32-60 V.

causes.en: BMS configured for the wrong system voltage (12/24/48 V)
causes.ur: BMS ghalat system voltage (12/24/48 V) ke liye configure hai

causes.en: Actual battery voltage does not match the configuration
causes.ur: Asal battery voltage configuration se match nahi karti

solutions.en: Measure the actual bank voltage with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se asal bank voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Compare it to the manual's threshold table and confirm the system voltage setting in VictronConnect.
solutions.ur: Manual ki threshold table se compare karein aur VictronConnect mein system voltage setting confirm karein.

solutions.en: Correct the battery settings to match the real bank, then re-test.
solutions.ur: Battery settings ko asal bank ke mutabiq theek karein, phir dobara test karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — Status LED red-flash fault codes

title.en: Status LED red 8x - current too high
title.ur: Status LED laal 8 baar - current bohat zyada hai

meaning.en: Sustained current exceeded the BMS rating - the manual cites more than 600 A (1200 A for the 1000 A model) for more than 5 minutes.
meaning.ur: Mustaqbil current BMS rating se zyada raha - manual ke mutabiq 600 A (1000 A model ke liye 1200 A) se zyada, 5 minute se ooper.

causes.en: Load current above the BMS continuous rating
causes.ur: Load current BMS ki continuous rating se zyada hai

causes.en: High discharge current or a high charge current sustained too long
causes.ur: High discharge current ya bohat der tak chalay gaya high charge current

solutions.en: Measure the current with a clamp meter on the main busbar.
solutions.ur: Main busbar par clamp meter se current nikaalein.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load until current is below the rating the manual states for your model.
solutions.ur: Load itna kam karein jab tak current aapke model ki rating se neeche na aaye.

solutions.en: If the load is already small, check for a shorted appliance or a stuck inverter/charger drawing DC.
solutions.ur: Agar load pehle se kam hai to short hua bartan ya atka hua inverter/charger jo DC kheech raha hai check karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — Status LED red-flash fault codes

title.ur: Status LED laal 9 baar - initialisation error

meaning.en: The BMS failed to initialise. The manual groups this under internal errors requiring dealer contact.
meaning.ur: BMS initialize nahi hua. Manual isay internal errors mein rakhta hai jis ke liye dealer se rabta karna hai.

causes.en: Internal fault during the BMS power-up sequence
causes.ur: BMS ke power-up sequence mein internal fault

causes.en: Distributor or battery not detected during commissioning
causes.ur: Commissioning ke dauran Distributor ya battery detect nahi hui

solutions.en: Power everything down completely and wait 3 minutes before restarting.
solutions.ur: Sab kuch mukammal band karein aur 3 minute intezaar kar ke dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Verify the battery and any Lynx Distributor connections are seated.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery aur Lynx Distributor ke connections poori tarah lage hue hain.

solutions.en: If it returns, contact your Victron supplier - the manual lists this as an internal error.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to Victron supplier se rabta karein - manual isay internal error batata hai.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — Status LED red-flash fault codes

title.en: Status LED red 10x - safety contactor failure
title.ur: Status LED laal 10 baar - safety contactor failure

meaning.en: The safety contactor has failed to close or open as commanded.
meaning.ur: Safety contactor ne command ke mutabiq band ya khulna nahi kiya.

causes.en: Contactor mechanical failure or welded contacts
causes.ur: Contactor ki mechanical failure ya contacts weld ho gaye

causes.en: Contactor control wiring fault, or ATC/ATD wiring fault
causes.ur: Contactor control wiring fault, ya ATC/ATD wiring fault

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then check that all loads and chargers are actually wired to the ATC or ATD contact.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir check karein ke tamam loads aur chargers asal mein ATC ya ATD contact se jury hain.

solutions.en: Measure the contactor coil supply and the control voltage during a switching attempt.
solutions.ur: Switching ke waqt contactor coil supply aur control voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Check the contactor main contacts for continuity and pitting; replace the contactor if welded.
solutions.ur: Contactor ke main contacts ki continuity aur pitting check karein; weld ho gaye to contactor badal dein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — Status LED red-flash fault codes

title.en: Status LED red 12x - internal supply error
title.ur: Status LED laal 12 baar - internal supply error

meaning.en: An internal supply rail has failed. The manual groups this with internal errors requiring dealer contact.
meaning.ur: Koi internal supply rail fail hua hai. Manual isay internal errors mein rakhta hai jis ke liye dealer se rabta karna hai.

causes.en: Internal supply voltage rail failure inside the BMS
causes.ur: BMS ke andar internal supply voltage rail ki failure

causes.en: Reverse polarity or severe voltage dip on the BMS supply
causes.ur: BMS supply par reverse polarity ya bohat gehri voltage dip

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then verify battery polarity and voltage at the BMS supply terminals.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir BMS supply terminals par battery polarity aur voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Check the supply fuse and cable gauge between the battery and the BMS.
solutions.ur: Battery aur BMS ke darmiyan supply fuse aur cable gauge check karein.

solutions.en: If supply is correct, contact your Victron supplier - this is an internal error.
solutions.ur: Agar supply theek hai to Victron supplier se rabta karein - ye internal error hai.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

codes.seriesName: Lynx Smart BMS — Status LED red-flash fault codes

title.en: Status LED red 14x - battery voltage not allowed
title.ur: Status LED laal 14 baar - battery voltage ki ijazat nahi hai

meaning.en: The battery voltage is outside every valid system voltage range. The manual states this occurs when the voltage is outside all ranges (9 V > Vbat > 60 V wording aside, the intent is outside 9-60 V).
meaning.ur: Battery voltage har mumkin system voltage range se bahar hai. Manual ke mutabiq ye tab hota hai jab voltage sab ranges se bahar ho (9 V > Vbat > 60 V lafz ke bawajood, marzi 9-60 V se bahar hai).

causes.en: Battery voltage below 9 V or above 60 V
causes.ur: Battery voltage 9 V se neeche ya 60 V se upar

causes.en: Battery settings in VictronConnect set to the wrong value
causes.ur: VictronConnect mein battery settings ghalat value par hain

solutions.en: Measure the bank voltage with a multimeter before changing any setting.
solutions.ur: Koi setting badalne se pehle multimeter se bank voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Compare against the manual's threshold table: 12 V = 9-15 V, 24 V = 16-30 V, 48 V = 32-60 V.
solutions.ur: Manual ki threshold table se compare karein: 12 V = 9-15 V, 24 V = 16-30 V, 48 V = 32-60 V.

solutions.en: Correct the battery voltage setting in VictronConnect to match the measured bank.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein battery voltage setting ko measured bank ke mutabiq theek karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus Compact — alarm LED pre-alarm indications 1-5 (3-LED unit)
aliases: Alarm LED flashes - DC input voltage low

title.ur: Pre-alarm 1 - DC input voltage kam hai

meaning.en: The alarm LED is flashing because the DC input voltage is low. The inverter is warning before shutting down.
meaning.ur: Alarm LED is liye flash kar raha hai kyunke DC input voltage kam hai. Inverter band hone se pehle warn kar raha hai.

causes.en: Battery bank discharged
causes.ur: Battery bank khatam ho chuka hai

causes.en: Poor battery connection causing a voltage drop
causes.ur: Battery connection kharab jo voltage drop kar raha hai

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage at the inverter terminals with the unit under load.
solutions.ur: Unit load ke halat mein apne terminals par battery voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Charge the battery, then re-check the terminals for tightness and corrosion.
solutions.ur: Battery charge karein, phir terminals ki tightness aur corrosion dobara check karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Compact Manual - 12/2000/80-35, 24/2000/50-50 230V - ch. 7 Troubleshooting table

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus Compact — alarm LED pre-alarm indications 1-5 (3-LED unit)
aliases: Alarm LED flashes - ambient too hot

title.ur: Pre-alarm 2 - ambient temperature bohat zyada hai

meaning.en: The alarm LED is flashing because the ambient temperature is too high.
meaning.ur: Alarm LED is liye flash kar raha hai kyunke ambient temperature bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Unit installed in a hot, poorly ventilated room
causes.ur: Unit garam aur kam hawa wale kamre mein laga hua hai

causes.en: Load too high for the unit's thermal design
causes.ur: Load unit ke thermal design ke liye zyada hai

solutions.en: Move the inverter to a cool, well-ventilated room with at least 10 cm clearance around it.
solutions.ur: Inverter ko thande, hawa wale kamre mein le jayein jahan charon taraf 10 cm khali ho.

solutions.en: Never mount the unit directly above the batteries - move it away from them.
solutions.ur: Unit ko kabhi batteries ke bilkul upar na lagayein - use batteries se door rakhein.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load so it generates less internal heat.
solutions.ur: Connected load kam karein taake andar kam garmi paida ho.

source.title: MultiPlus Compact Manual - 12/2000/80-35, 24/2000/50-50 230V - ch. 7 Troubleshooting table

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus Compact — alarm LED pre-alarm indications 1-5 (3-LED unit)

title.ur: Pre-alarm 3 - load nominal se upar hai

meaning.en: The alarm LED is flashing because the connected load exceeds the inverter's nominal load.
meaning.ur: Alarm LED is liye flash kar raha hai kyunke connected load inverter ke nominal load se zyada hai.

causes.en: Load connected above the inverter's nominal rating
causes.ur: Inverter ke nominal rating se upar load juri hui hai

causes.en: Several large appliances switched on together
causes.ur: Kai bhaari bartan aik saath on kar diye gaye

solutions.en: Measure the load current with a clamp meter and compare to the nameplate rating.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load current nikaal kar nameplate rating se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load until the alarm LED stops flashing.
solutions.ur: Load itna kam karein jab tak alarm LED band na ho jaye.

source.title: MultiPlus Compact Manual - 12/2000/80-35, 24/2000/50-50 230V - ch. 7 Troubleshooting table

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus Compact — alarm LED pre-alarm indications 1-5 (3-LED unit)
aliases: Alarm LED flashes - DC ripple high

title.ur: Pre-alarm 4 - DC ripple 1.25 Vrms se upar hai

meaning.en: Voltage ripple on the DC input exceeds 1.25 Vrms, so the battery cable run is too thin, too long or resistive.
meaning.ur: DC input par voltage ripple 1.25 Vrms se zyada hai, is liye battery cable bahut patli, lambi ya resistance wala hai.

causes.en: Battery cable too thin or too long for the current
causes.ur: Battery cable current ke liye bahut patli ya lambi hai

causes.en: Corroded or loose terminals adding resistance
causes.ur: Corrode ya dheele terminals jo resistance barha rahe hain

causes.en: Battery capacity too small for the load
causes.ur: Battery capacity load ke liye bahut kam hai

solutions.en: Check the battery cables and terminals; clean and re-tighten every connection.
solutions.ur: Battery cables aur terminals check karein; har connection saaf karke dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Measure DC ripple with a true RMS meter; it must stay below 1.25 Vrms.
solutions.ur: True RMS meter se DC ripple nikaalein; ye 1.25 Vrms se neeche rehna chahiye.

solutions.en: Check whether battery capacity is sufficient and increase it if necessary.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery capacity kaafi hai aur zaroorat ho to barha dein.

source.title: MultiPlus Compact Manual - 12/2000/80-35, 24/2000/50-50 230V - ch. 7 Troubleshooting table

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus Compact — alarm LED pre-alarm indications 1-5 (3-LED unit)

title.en: Pre-alarm 5 - low battery plus excessive load
title.ur: Pre-alarm 5 - low battery aur bohat zyada load

meaning.en: The alarm LED flashes intermittently because low battery voltage and excessive load are occurring together.
meaning.ur: Alarm LED baari baari flash karta hai kyunke low battery voltage aur bohat zyada load aik saath aa rahe hain.

causes.en: Battery voltage low while a heavy load is running
causes.ur: Battery voltage kam hai jab bhaari load chal raha hai

causes.en: Bank capacity or cable gauge insufficient for the load
causes.ur: Bank capacity ya cable gauge load ke liye kaafi nahi

solutions.en: Charge the batteries before investigating anything else.
solutions.ur: Baqi sab dekhne se pehle batteries charge karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load, or install batteries with a higher capacity.
solutions.ur: Load kam karein, ya bade capacity ki batteries lagayein.

solutions.en: Use shorter and/or thicker battery cables.
solutions.ur: Chhoti aur/or moti battery cables istemal karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Compact Manual - 12/2000/80-35, 24/2000/50-50 230V - ch. 7 Troubleshooting table

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus Compact — alarm LED pre-alarm indications 1-5 (3-LED unit)

title.en: Alarm LED lit - inverter cut out after a pre-alarm
title.ur: Alarm LED on - pre-alarm ke baad inverter cut out

meaning.en: The inverter did cut out following one of the pre-alarms above. The lit alarm LED means the shutdown has already happened.
meaning.ur: Inverter upar wale kisi pre-alarm ke baad sach mein cut out ho gaya. Alarm LED ka on hona matlab band hone ki amal d ho chuki hai.

causes.en: Any of pre-alarm 1-5 was allowed to continue until shutdown
causes.ur: Pre-alarm 1 se 5 mein se koi aik chalte rehne diya gaya aur band ho gaya

causes.en: Underlying cause not removed between restarts
causes.ur: Dobara on karne ke darmiyan asal wajah hatayi nahi gayi

solutions.en: Look up the matching pre-alarm 1-5 row and fix that specific cause first.
solutions.ur: Pehle us pre-alarm 1 se 5 ki row dekhein jis wajah se ye hua, wohi masla theek karein.

solutions.en: Per the manual: disconnect DC loads from the batteries and AC loads from the inverter before testing.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq: test karne se pehle batteries se DC loads aur inverter se AC loads disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Only then reset the unit by switching the front rocker off, waiting 4 s, and on again.
solutions.ur: Uske baad front rocker off karke 4 second intezaar karein aur on karke unit reset karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Compact Manual - 12/2000/80-35, 24/2000/50-50 230V - ch. 7 Troubleshooting table

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (230 V, fw xxxx4xx)

title.en: One phase switched off, this unit off too
title.ur: Ek phase off ho gaya, yeh unit bhi off

meaning.en: The unit is switched off because another phase in the same system has switched off.
meaning.ur: Ye unit is liye off hai kyunke isi system ka koi doosra phase off ho chuka hai.

causes.en: Another phase tripped on low battery, overload or over-temperature
causes.ur: Doosra phase low battery, overload ya zyada temperature par trip kar gaya

causes.en: A slave unit lost DC or VE.Bus communication
causes.ur: Koi slave unit DC ya VE.Bus communication se nikal gaya

solutions.en: Read the LEDs on every unit; the failing phase is the one without code 1.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke LED parhein; kaam kharab karne wala phase woh hai jis par code 1 nahi hai.

solutions.en: Fix the low-battery / overload / temperature cause on that phase first.
solutions.ur: Pehle us phase ka low battery / overload / temperature ka masla theek karein.

solutions.en: Check VE.Bus RJ45 cable seating on all units.
solutions.ur: Sab units par VE.Bus RJ45 cable ki fitting check karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Manual (with firmware xxxx4xx) - 12/3000/120, 24/3000/70, 48/3000/35 230V

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (230 V, fw xxxx4xx)

title.en: Wrong number of devices found on VE.Bus
title.ur: VE.Bus par ghalat number devices mile

meaning.en: Not all, or more than, the expected devices were found in the system. Often follows code 1.
meaning.ur: System par jitne devices hone chahiye thay un se kam ya zyada milay. Aam tor par code 1 ke baad aata hai.

causes.en: System not properly configured as one parallel / split / three-phase group
causes.ur: System theek se ek parallel / split / three-phase group ki tarah configure nahi

causes.en: Communication cable error between units
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan communication cable ka error

solutions.en: Check the communication cables, then switch all equipment off and on again.
solutions.ur: Communication cable check karein, phir sab equipment off karke wapas on karein.

solutions.en: Replace hand-crimped RJ45 leads with factory-made patch leads.
solutions.ur: Haath se banaye RJ45 leads ko factory-made patch leads se badal dein.

solutions.en: Reconfigure the system with VE.Bus System Configurator.
solutions.ur: VE.Bus System Configurator se system dobara configure karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Manual (with firmware xxxx4xx) - 12/3000/120, 24/3000/70, 48/3000/35 230V

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (230 V, fw xxxx4xx)

title.en: No other device detected on the bus
title.ur: Bus par koi doosra device nahi mila

meaning.en: The master is configured for a multi-unit system but finds no other device on the VE.Bus.
meaning.ur: Master multi-unit system ke liye configure hai lekin VE.Bus par koi doosra device nahi milta.

causes.en: VE.Bus communication cable disconnected or faulty
causes.ur: VE.Bus communication cable disconnect ya kharab

causes.en: Slave unit unpowered, so it is not answering on the bus
causes.ur: Slave unit ko power nahi mil raha, is liye woh bus par jawab nahi de raha

solutions.en: Check the VE.Bus communication cables end to end and reseat every RJ45 plug.
solutions.ur: VE.Bus cables dono sifar se check karein aur har RJ45 plug dobara lagaayein.

solutions.en: Measure DC voltage at each unit's battery terminals.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke battery terminals par DC voltage measure karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Manual (with firmware xxxx4xx) - 12/3000/120, 24/3000/70, 48/3000/35 230V

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (230 V, fw xxxx4xx)

meaning.en: AC output voltage is too high. AC wiring of a slave unit is commonly responsible.
meaning.ur: AC output voltage bohat zyada hai. Aam tor par kisi slave unit ki AC wiring jawab hai.

causes.en: Slave unit AC wiring not connected properly, or not connected at all
causes.ur: Slave unit ki AC wiring theek se nahi, ya bilkul nahi hai

causes.en: Two AC sources back-feeding each other through the output
causes.ur: Do AC sources output ke zariye aapas mein back-feed kar rahe hain

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC first, then inspect every slave AC-out termination.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir har slave ka AC-out termination dekhein.

solutions.en: Check AC cables for correct phase sequence and lug tightness.
solutions.ur: AC cables ki phase sequence aur lug ki tightness check karein.

solutions.en: Measure AC-out with a true RMS meter and compare to the unit spec.
solutions.ur: True RMS meter se AC-out measure kar ke unit spec se compare karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Manual (with firmware xxxx4xx) - 12/3000/120, 24/3000/70, 48/3000/35 230V

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (230 V, fw xxxx4xx)

meaning.en: The units could not synchronise their clocks. Typically only visible briefly during a restart.
meaning.ur: Units apne clock sync nahi kar paye. Aam tor par sirf restart ke waqt hi nazar aata hai.

causes.en: Transient during a system restart after another error
causes.ur: Dusre error ke baad restart ke dauran aata hai

causes.en: Communication cable fault on the VE.Bus network
causes.ur: VE.Bus network par communication cable ka fault

solutions.en: Switch all units off one by one, then back on; it usually self-recovers.
solutions.ur: Sab units ek ek kar ke off karein phir wapas on karein; aam tor par khud resolve ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If it persists, inspect the VE.Bus communication cables.
solutions.ur: Agar qataar rahe to VE.Bus communication cables check karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Manual (with firmware xxxx4xx) - 12/3000/120, 24/3000/70, 48/3000/35 230V

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (230 V, fw xxxx4xx)

title.ur: Device data transmit nahi kar sakta

meaning.en: The unit cannot transmit on the VE.Bus network; most likely a short circuit in the communication cable.
meaning.ur: Unit VE.Bus network par transmit nahi kar sakta; aam tor par communication cable mein short hai.

causes.en: Short circuit in the VE.Bus communication cable
causes.ur: VE.Bus communication cable mein short circuit

causes.en: Damaged RJ45 plug or socket, or board component failure
causes.ur: Kharab RJ45 plug ya socket, ya board component ki failure

solutions.en: Power everything down, then check the communication cables for a short.
solutions.ur: Sab kuch band karein, phir communication cables mein short check karein.

solutions.en: Swap in a known-good factory RJ45 lead between the affected units.
solutions.ur: Mutasir units ke darmiyan aik jaani hui factory RJ45 lead lagayein.

solutions.en: Inspect and reseat the female RJ45 sockets on the units.
solutions.ur: Units ke female RJ45 sockets check karke dobara lagaayein.

source.title: MultiPlus Manual (with firmware xxxx4xx) - 12/3000/120, 24/3000/70, 48/3000/35 230V

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (230 V, fw xxxx4xx)

title.en: Unit took over 'master' role after master failed
title.ur: Master fail hone ke baad unit ne 'master' role le liya

meaning.en: The original master failed, so another device has taken over master status.
meaning.ur: Original master fail ho gaya, is liye kisi doosre device ne master status le liya.

causes.en: The original master unit has failed or lost power
causes.ur: Original master unit fail ho gaya ya power kho gaya

causes.en: Communication cable fault between units
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan communication cable ka fault

solutions.en: Identify which unit is acting as master and why the original failed.
solutions.ur: Dhoondein ke kaun sa unit master hai aur original kyun fail hua.

solutions.en: Check the communication cables between all units.
solutions.ur: Sab units ke darmiyan communication cables check karein.

solutions.en: Power down, reseat all RJ45 plugs, then power back up.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, sab RJ45 plugs dobara lagaayein, phir on karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Manual (with firmware xxxx4xx) - 12/3000/120, 24/3000/70, 48/3000/35 230V

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (230 V, fw xxxx4xx)

title.en: AC overvoltage on the output of a switched-off slave
title.ur: Band slave ke output par AC overvoltage

meaning.en: Voltage is present on the AC output of a unit that should be off.
meaning.ur: Aise unit ke AC output par voltage hai jo band hona chahiye.

causes.en: AC wires accidentally swapped (L and N reversed)
causes.ur: AC wires galti se swap ho gaye (L aur N ulat gaye)

causes.en: Back-feed from another live AC source into the output
causes.ur: Kisi doosre live AC source se output mein back-feed

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC completely before touching any conductor.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi wire ko chhoone se pehle AC aur DC mukammal disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Verify L/N wiring at AC-out on every unit with a continuity tester.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke AC-out par continuity tester se L/N wiring verify karein.

solutions.en: Re-tighten the AC-out terminals to the torque stated in the manual.
solutions.ur: AC-out terminals ko manual di gayi torque par dobara tighten karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Manual (with firmware xxxx4xx) - 12/3000/120, 24/3000/70, 48/3000/35 230V

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (230 V, fw xxxx4xx)

title.en: This unit cannot work as a slave
title.ur: Ye unit slave ki tarah kaam nahi kar sakta

meaning.en: Obsolete or unsuitable model; it cannot serve as a slave in this system. Victron's stated remedy is replacement.
meaning.ur: Purana ya unsuitable model; is system mein slave ki tarah use nahi ho sakta. Victron ka hal naya unit lagana hai.

causes.en: Unit model is obsolete and unsupported as a VE.Bus slave
causes.ur: Unit ka model purana hai aur VE.Bus slave ke tor par support nahi

causes.en: Mismatched models mixed in one multi-unit group
causes.ur: Ek hi multi-unit group mein alag alag models milaye gaye

solutions.en: Read the model number on every unit's nameplate in the group.
solutions.ur: Group ke har unit ka nameplate par model number parhein.

solutions.en: Confirm all units share the same voltage, VA and VE.Bus variant.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke sab units ka voltage, VA aur VE.Bus variant same hai.

solutions.en: Replace the obsolete unit with a matching current model, then reconfigure.
solutions.ur: Purane unit ki jagah same current model lagayein, phir dobara configure karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Manual (with firmware xxxx4xx) - 12/3000/120, 24/3000/70, 48/3000/35 230V

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (230 V, fw xxxx4xx)

title.ur: Switch-over system protection trigger ho gaya

meaning.en: Transfer-switch protection has tripped so the unit will not switch over. This 230 V table adds a remedy the 120 V Quattro table does not have.
meaning.ur: Transfer switch protection trip kar gaya hai is liye unit switch over nahi karega. Ye 230 V table woh hal deta hai jo 120 V Quattro table mein nahi.

causes.en: Transfer switch or relay fault during switch-over
causes.ur: Switch-over ke waqt transfer switch ya relay ka fault

causes.en: AC input voltage sagging slowly, often on a generator supply
causes.ur: AC input voltage dheere dheere gir raha hai, aksar generator supply par

solutions.en: Switch all equipment off, wait for capacitors to discharge, then power on again.
solutions.ur: Sab equipment off karein, capacitor discharge tak intezaar karein, phir on karein.

solutions.en: Reduce heavy AC load that could hold the relay contacts closed.
solutions.ur: Bhaari AC load kam karein jo relay contacts ko band rok sakti hai.

solutions.en: In VEConfigure, raise the lower limit of AC input voltage to 210 VAC (factory default is 180 VAC).
solutions.ur: VEConfigure mein AC input voltage ka lower limit 210 VAC kar dein (factory default 180 VAC hai).

source.title: MultiPlus Manual (with firmware xxxx4xx) - 12/3000/120, 24/3000/70, 48/3000/35 230V

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (230 V, fw xxxx4xx)

title.ur: Units ke darmiyan firmware incompatible hai

meaning.en: One connected device runs firmware too old to work with this device.
meaning.ur: Kisi connected device ka firmware is device ke saath kaam karne ke liye bohat purana hai.

causes.en: Mixed firmware revisions across the VE.Bus group
causes.ur: VE.Bus group ke units mein alag alag firmware revisions

causes.en: A unit missed a previous firmware update
causes.ur: Kisi unit ka pichla firmware update miss ho gaya

solutions.en: Switch all equipment off before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi chhoone se pehle sab equipment off karein.

solutions.en: Switch on only the unit reporting the error, then add others one by one.
solutions.ur: Sirf error wala unit on karein, phir baqi ek ek kar ke on karein.

solutions.en: The last unit switched on before the error reappears is the outdated one - update its firmware.
solutions.ur: Error aane se pehle aakhri on kiya gaya unit outdated hai - uska firmware update karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Manual (with firmware xxxx4xx) - 12/3000/120, 24/3000/70, 48/3000/35 230V

codes.seriesName: MultiPlus inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (230 V, fw xxxx4xx)

meaning.en: An unspecified internal fault that should not occur; a full power cycle normally clears it.
meaning.ur: Ek unspecified internal fault jo hona nahi chahiye; poora power cycle aam tor par saaf kar deta hai.

causes.en: Internal firmware or processor state anomaly
causes.ur: Internal firmware ya processor state mein kami

causes.en: Transient glitch after an abnormal shutdown
causes.ur: Abnormal shutdown ke baad transient glitch

solutions.en: Switch all equipment off and then on again to clear it.
solutions.ur: Sab equipment off karke phir on karein, is se saaf ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Record the LED pattern before power-cycling for support.
solutions.ur: Power cycle se pehle LED pattern note kar lein taake support mein kaam aaye.

solutions.en: If it returns repeatedly, contact Victron Energy with serial and firmware version.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aaye to serial aur firmware version ke saath Victron Energy se rabta karein.

source.title: MultiPlus Manual (with firmware xxxx4xx) - 12/3000/120, 24/3000/70, 48/3000/35 230V

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

meaning.en: Charging has stopped to protect the battery. Auto-resets once the battery cools down.
meaning.ur: Battery bachane ke liye charging band kar di gayi hai. Battery thanda hote hi khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Battery genuinely above its permitted charging temperature
causes.ur: Battery haqeeqat mein apni charging temperature se upar hai

causes.en: Charger itself overheated at start-up or float, with no external sensor fitted - then the charger reads hot battery
causes.ur: Bahar ka sensor nahi laga to charger ke start-up ya float mein khud garam hua, phir use garam battery samajh aaya

solutions.en: Measure actual battery temperature with a probe thermometer at the cell terminals.
solutions.ur: Cell terminals par probe thermometer se asal battery temperature nikaalein.

solutions.en: Improve ventilation around the battery bank and the charger.
solutions.ur: Battery bank aur charger ke aar paas hawa ka raasta behtar karein.

solutions.en: If no external temperature sensor is fitted, note the error may be a false reading from a hot charger.
solutions.ur: Agar bahar ka temperature sensor nahi laga hai to yaad rakhein ke ye garam charger ka false reading bhi ho sakta hai.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

meaning.en: The target battery voltage is too high for the charger. Auto-resets when the voltage drops.
meaning.ur: Target battery voltage charger ke liye bohat zyada hai. Voltage girne par khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Other charging equipment connected to the same battery
causes.ur: Usi battery se koi aur charging equipment jury hai

causes.en: A fault in the charge controller
causes.ur: Charge controller mein koi fault

solutions.en: Measure the battery voltage and compare to the battery type's maximum charge voltage.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage nikaal kar battery type ki maximum charge voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect other chargers one at a time to find which one is overdriving the bank.
solutions.ur: Baqi chargers ek ek kar ke disconnect karein taake pata chale kaun bank ko zyada charge kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the configured charge voltage in VictronConnect against the battery datasheet.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein set ki hui charge voltage ko battery datasheet se check karein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

title.ur: Current kam karne par bhi controller garam ho gaya

meaning.en: The charger has already reduced its output and still overheated. Auto-resets when it cools.
meaning.ur: Charger ne output kam kar diya phir bhi garam ho gaya. Thanda hote hi khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature too high around the charger
causes.ur: Charger ke aar paas ambient temperature bohat zyada hai

causes.en: Charger not mounted for cooling - e.g. lying flat or boxed in
causes.ur: Charger cooling ke liye suitable mount nahi hai - maslan flat pada ya box mein band

solutions.en: Check the ambient temperature where the charger is installed.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke charger jahan laga hai wahan ambient temperature kya hai.

solutions.en: Mount the charger vertically on a wall with clearance so air can flow past it.
solutions.ur: Charger ko deewar par vertical lagaayein aur hawa ke liye jagah chhodein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

title.ur: Current sensor range se bahar hai

meaning.en: Current measurement is out of range. Does NOT auto-reset; a power-cycle of the wiring is required.
meaning.ur: Current measurement range se bahar hai. Khud reset nahi hota; wiring ka power cycle karna parta hai.

causes.en: Wiring disturbed, e.g. during installation work
causes.ur: Wiring mein tabdeeli hui ho, maslan installation ke dauran

causes.en: Hardware defect in the current measurement circuit
causes.ur: Current measurement circuit mein hardware defect

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then disconnect ALL wires from the charger.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir charger se tamam wires disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect all wires to make the charger restart, then read the error again.
solutions.ur: Tamam wires dobara connect karein taake charger restart ho, phir error dobara parhein.

solutions.en: If the error remains, contact the dealer - there may be a hardware defect.
solutions.ur: Agar error qataar rahe to dealer se rabta karein - ho sakta hai hardware defect ho.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

meaning.en: The power terminals have overheated. Auto-resets once they cool.
meaning.ur: Power terminals garam ho gaye hain. Thande hote hi khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Loose terminal connection causing high contact resistance
causes.ur: Dheela terminal connection jis se contact resistance zyada hai

causes.en: Undersized or wrong-strand cable for the current
causes.ur: Current ke liye chhoti ya galat strand wali cable

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then check the wiring type and the number of strands in the cable.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir cable ki type aur strands ki tadaad check karein.

solutions.en: Re-tighten the power terminals to the torque stated in the manual, and re-check after an hour.
solutions.ur: Power terminals ko manual di gayi torque par tighten karein, aur aik ghante baad dobara check karein.

solutions.en: Fit a cable of adequate cross-section and correct strand type for the charge current.
solutions.ur: Charge current ke liye kaafi cross-section aur sahi strand type wali cable lagayein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

title.en: Charger short circuit on battery side
title.ur: Battery side par charger short circuit

meaning.en: An over-current condition on the battery side, often from a contactor or from connecting the charger to a large-capacitance inverter with no battery fitted. Auto-resets.
meaning.ur: Battery side par over-current ki shart, aksar contactor se ya badi capacitance wale inverter se bina battery ke connect karne se. Khud reset hota hai.

causes.en: Battery attached through a contactor that chatters or welds
causes.ur: Battery aik aise contactor se jury hai jo chatter karta ya weld ho jata hai

causes.en: Charger started with no battery but connected to a large input-capacitance inverter
causes.ur: Charger bina battery ke chala aur badi input capacitance wale inverter se jury tha

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then check the battery cable and contactor for a short.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir battery cable aur contactor mein short check karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all power sources, wait 3 minutes, then power up again.
solutions.ur: Tamam power sources disconnect karein, 3 minute intezaar karein, phir wapas on karein.

solutions.en: If the error does not auto-reset after that, the charge controller is probably faulty.
solutions.ur: Uske baad bhi error khud resolve na ho to charge controller kharab hai.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

meaning.en: A fault in the charger's switching power stage. Does NOT auto-reset.
meaning.ur: Charger ke switching power stage mein fault. Khud reset nahi hota.

causes.en: Internal switching stage failure
causes.ur: Internal switching stage ki failure

causes.en: Disturbed or transient wiring during operation
causes.ur: Operation ke dauran wiring mein tabdeeli ya transient masla

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then disconnect all wires from the charger.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir charger se tamam wires disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect all wires and power up; re-read the error.
solutions.ur: Tamam wires dobara connect kar ke on karein; error dobara parhein.

solutions.en: If it persists the charger is probably faulty - return to the dealer.
solutions.ur: Agar qataar rahe to charger kharab hai - dealer ko wapas karein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

meaning.en: The input voltage is above the charger's limit. Auto-resets once the input drops to a safe level.
meaning.ur: Input voltage charger ki limit se upar hai. Input safe level par aane par khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Starter/alternator charging voltage too high for the charger input
causes.ur: Starter/alternator ki charging voltage charger ke input se zyada hai

causes.en: Two chargers' outputs connected together in parallel
causes.ur: Do chargers ke output aapas mein parallel jury ho gaye hain

solutions.en: Measure the input voltage at the charger's input terminals with the engine running.
solutions.ur: Engine chalate hue charger ke input terminals par input voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Compare to the Orion XS input voltage range in the manual's specification table.
solutions.ur: Manual ki specification table mein diye Orion XS input voltage range se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check that no second charger output is hard-wired in parallel.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke doosre charger ka output saath hard-wire to nahi kiya gaya.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

title.ur: BMS ka connection nahi mil raha

meaning.en: The charger is set to be BMS-controlled but receives no BMS control messages. After 15 s it drops output to base voltage (12 V); the error itself only shows after 3 min so the BMS can reconnect quietly.
meaning.ur: Charger BMS control ke liye set hai magar koi BMS control message nahi mil raha. 15 second baad output base voltage (12 V) par gir jata hai; khud error 3 minute baad dikhta hai taake BMS dobara connect ho sake.

causes.en: BMS powered down or in a protective shutdown
causes.ur: BMS band hai ya protective shutdown mein hai

causes.en: BMS CAN or communication cable disconnected or faulty
causes.ur: BMS ka CAN ya communication cable disconnect ya kharab

causes.en: Charger configured as BMS-controlled but no BMS is actually installed
causes.ur: Charger BMS-controlled set hai magar asal mein koi BMS install hi nahi

solutions.en: Check the BMS status on the VictronConnect device list - is it powered and talking?
solutions.ur: VictronConnect ki device list mein BMS ka status dekhein - woh on hai aur baat kar raha hai?

solutions.en: Inspect the BMS communication cable and both connectors; reseat them.
solutions.ur: BMS communication cable aur dono connectors dekhein; dobara lagaayein.

solutions.en: If there is genuinely no BMS, change the charge mode to Standalone instead of BMS-controlled.
solutions.ur: Agar wakai koi BMS nahi hai to charge mode ko BMS-controlled ke bajaye Standalone par kar dein.

notes.en: In VictronConnect this appears as the charger jumping straight from bulk to float. Once communication returns it goes back to bulk on its own.
notes.ur: VictronConnect mein ye charger ka seedha bulk se float par jaana dikhta hai. Communication wapas aane par ye khud bulk par wapas chala jata hai.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

meaning.en: If this is the ACTIVE error the unit is faulty and must be replaced. If it only appears in history data while the unit works normally, it is safe to ignore - factory-fresh units legitimately log it once.
meaning.ur: Agar ye ACTIVE error hai to unit kharab hai aur badalna parta hai. Agar sirf history data mein aaye aur unit theek chalta hai to ignore kiya ja sakta hai - factory naye units aik baar ye log karte hain.

causes.en: Active error: unit calibration data is gone, hardware fault
causes.ur: Active error: unit ka calibration data kho gaya, hardware fault

causes.en: History only: never cleared after first factory power-up
causes.ur: Sirf history mein: factory pehli power-up ke baad kabhi clear nahi hua

solutions.en: Check whether 116 is the ACTIVE error or only sits in the history log.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke 116 ACTIVE error hai ya sirf history log mein hai.

solutions.en: If ACTIVE: contact the dealer for a replacement unit.
solutions.ur: Agar ACTIVE hai to dealer se replacement unit ke liye rabta karein.

solutions.en: If history only and the unit operates normally, no action needed - do not replace the unit.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf history mein hai aur unit normal chalta hai to koi karam nahi - unit mat badlein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

meaning.en: A firmware update did not complete, so the device is only partially updated. Retrying the update normally fixes it.
meaning.ur: Firmware update adhoora reh gaya, is liye device aadha updated hai. Update dobara chalane se aam tor par hal ho jata hai.

causes.en: Device went out of range during an over-the-air update
causes.ur: Over-the-air update ke dauran device range se bahar chala gaya

causes.en: Cable disconnected or power lost during the update session
causes.ur: Update session ke dauran cable disconnect hui ya power chala gaya

solutions.en: Retry the firmware update from VictronConnect using the firmware file.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect se firmware file le kar update dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: If a GX device is connected to VRM, do a remote firmware update from the VRM website.
solutions.ur: Agar GX device VRM se jury hai to VRM website se remote firmware update karein.

solutions.en: Keep the charger powered and the Bluetooth link stable for the whole update.
solutions.ur: Poori update ke dauran charger ko power aur Bluetooth link mustaqbil rakhein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

title.ur: Settings data kho gaya ya parha nahi ja raha

meaning.en: The charger cannot read its configuration and has stopped. Does NOT auto-reset; the documented recovery is a factory reset plus a 3-minute power-off wait.
meaning.ur: Charger apni configuration nahi parh sakta aur ruk gaya hai. Khud reset nahi hota; bataya hua hal factory reset aur 3 minute power off ke intezaar se hai.

causes.en: Configuration memory corrupted, often after an interrupted update
causes.ur: Configuration memory corrupt, aksar interrupted update ke baad

causes.en: Power lost while settings were being written
causes.ur: Settings likhte waqt power chala gaya

solutions.en: Restore factory defaults from the three-dot menu at the top right in VictronConnect.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect ke top right teen-dot menu se factory defaults restore karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the charge controller from all power sources.
solutions.ur: Charge controller ko tamam power sources se disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Wait 3 minutes, then power up again and reconfigure the charger.
solutions.ur: 3 minute intezaar karein, phir wapas on karke charger dobara configure karein.

solutions.en: Report it to the Victron dealer for escalation - Victron state this should never happen.
solutions.ur: Isay Victron dealer ko report karein - Victron ke mutabiq ye hona hi nahi chahiye.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

meaning.en: The unit's own internal diagnostics found a fault with an internal supply voltage. Does NOT auto-reset.
meaning.ur: Unit ke apne internal diagnostics ne internal supply voltage mein fault dhoondha. Khud reset nahi hota.

causes.en: Internal supply rail outside its expected window
causes.ur: Internal supply rail apni expected window se bahar

causes.en: Faulty internal supply stage
causes.ur: Internal supply stage kharab

solutions.en: Check the installation - cable sizes, terminations and battery connections.
solutions.ur: Installation check karein - cable sizes, terminations aur battery connections.

solutions.en: Restart the unit using the power switch.
solutions.ur: Unit ko power switch se restart karein.

solutions.en: If the error persists, the unit is probably faulty - return to the dealer.
solutions.ur: Agar error qataar rahe to unit kharab hai - dealer ko wapas karein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — error codes

meaning.en: Stored history data is corrupt. Does NOT auto-reset; cleared by clearing history in VictronConnect.
meaning.ur: Store ki hui history data corrupt hai. Khud reset nahi hota; VictronConnect mein history clear karne se saaf hota hai.

causes.en: History memory corrupted after a power cut during logging
causes.ur: Logging ke dauran power cut ke baad history memory corrupt hua

causes.en: Firmware or storage fault on the unit
causes.ur: Unit par firmware ya storage fault

solutions.en: Open the History screen in VictronConnect for the charger.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein charger ka History screen kholein.

solutions.en: Clear the history data to reset the error.
solutions.ur: Error reset karne ke liye history data clear karein.

solutions.en: Only after clearing, check the charger is charging correctly.
solutions.ur: Clear karne ke baad hi check karein ke charger theek charge kar raha hai.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 Error and warning code overview

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — warning codes

title.ur: Battery garam hai - output kam kar diya

meaning.en: Output voltage is reduced to the nominal 12 V to prevent battery damage. Auto-resets when the battery cools.
meaning.ur: Battery bachane ke liye output voltage nominal 12 V par kam kar di gayi hai. Battery thande hote hi khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Battery genuinely above its safe charging temperature
causes.ur: Battery apni safe charging temperature se upar hai

causes.en: No external temperature sensor fitted, and a hot charger is read as a hot battery
causes.ur: Bahar ka temperature sensor nahi laga, aur garam charger ko garam battery samajh liya gaya

solutions.en: Measure real battery temperature with a probe at the cell terminals.
solutions.ur: Cell terminals par probe se asal battery temperature nikaalein.

solutions.en: Improve airflow around the battery bank; do not place it in a hot enclosed space.
solutions.ur: Battery bank ke aar paas hawa ka raasta behtar karein; use band garm jagah na rakhein.

solutions.en: Fit an external battery temperature sensor so the charger measures the battery, not itself.
solutions.ur: Bahar ka battery temperature sensor lagayein taake charger battery temperature nikaale, apni nahi.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 warnings

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — warning codes

title.ur: Battery thandi hai - charging ruk gayi

meaning.en: Charging is stopped because the battery is too cold. Victron stress this is a protection feature, not necessarily a fault - lithium batteries are damaged by charging when cold.
meaning.ur: Battery thandi hone ki wajah se charging band hai. Victron zor deta hai ke ye protection hai, fault nahi - lithium batteries thand mein charge hone se nuqsaan hoti hain.

causes.en: LiFePO4 bank below its low charge temperature, common in cold winter nights in Pakistan
causes.ur: LiFePO4 bank apni low charge temperature se neeche, jiski Pakistan mein thande sardi raaton mein aam baat hai

causes.en: No battery heater fitted on a cold night
causes.ur: Thande raat mein koi battery heater nahi laga

solutions.en: Confirm the reading with a probe thermometer before assuming a fault.
solutions.ur: Fault samajhne se pehle probe thermometer se reading confirm karein.

solutions.en: Fit a lithium battery heater if charging in cold weather is a regular requirement.
solutions.ur: Agar thande mausam mein charging aam baat hai to lithium battery heater lagayein.

solutions.en: Only if you are sure this protection is unwanted, ask the installer to adjust the setting.
solutions.ur: Sirf tabhi ke aap ko yakeen ho ke ye protection nahi chahiye, installer se setting badalwayein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 warnings

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — warning codes
aliases: Current derate due to controller high temperature

title.ur: Charger garam hai - current kam kar diya

meaning.en: The charger has reduced its output current to control its own internal temperature. Auto-resets when it cools down.
meaning.ur: Charger ne apni internal temperature control karne ke liye output current kam kar diya hai. Thanda hote hi khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature too high around the charger
causes.ur: Charger ke aar paas ambient temperature bohat zyada hai

causes.en: Charger not mounted with clearance for cooling
causes.ur: Charger cooling ke liye jagah chhod kar nahi laga

solutions.en: Check the ambient temperature at the charger location.
solutions.ur: Charger ki jagah par ambient temperature check karein.

solutions.en: Mount with clearance so air can flow; keep it off the floor and out of direct sun.
solutions.ur: Hawa ke liye jagah chhod kar lagaayein; floor par ya dhoop se door rakhein.

solutions.en: Dust off the heatsink fins with dry compressed air.
solutions.ur: Heatsink ke fins ko dry compressed air se dhool saaf karein.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 warnings

codes.seriesName: Orion XS DC-DC battery charger — warning codes

meaning.en: An over-current condition is detected on the battery side, but the unit classifies it as a warning. Auto-resets.
meaning.ur: Battery side par over-current ki shart detect hui hai, magar unit isay warning ke tor par rakhta hai. Khud reset hota hai.

causes.en: Short circuit or very low load resistance on the battery output
causes.ur: Battery output par short circuit ya bohat kam load resistance

causes.en: Bank connected through a welding or chattering contactor
causes.ur: Bank aik welding ya chattering contactor se jury hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then check the battery output cable and contactor for continuity.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir battery output cable aur contactor ki continuity check karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all power sources, wait 3 minutes, then power up again.
solutions.ur: Tamam power sources disconnect karein, 3 minute intezaar karein, phir on karein.

solutions.en: If it does not auto-reset, the charge controller is probably faulty.
solutions.ur: Agar khud resolve na ho to charge controller kharab hai.

source.title: Manual - Orion XS 12/12-70A DC-DC battery charger, Rev 00 - 06/2026 - ch. 5.8 warnings

codes.seriesName: Quattro 48/15000/200 — VE.Bus fault table (277 V)

title.en: One phase switched off, this unit off too
title.ur: Ek phase off ho gaya, yeh unit bhi off

meaning.en: The unit is switched off because another phase in the system has switched off.
meaning.ur: Ye unit is liye off hai kyunke system ka koi doosra phase off ho chuka hai.

causes.en: Another phase tripped on low battery, overload or over-temperature
causes.ur: Doosra phase low battery, overload ya zyada temperature par trip kar gaya

causes.en: A unit in the VE.Bus group lost power or communication
causes.ur: VE.Bus group ka koi unit power ya communication kho gaya

solutions.en: Read the LEDs on all units; the failing phase is the one without code 1.
solutions.ur: Sab units ke LED parhein; kaam kharab karne wala phase woh hai jis par code 1 nahi hai.

solutions.en: Resolve the low-battery / overload / temperature alarm on that phase first.
solutions.ur: Pehle us phase ka low battery / overload / temperature alarm hal karein.

solutions.en: Check VE.Bus cable seating on every unit.
solutions.ur: Har unit par VE.Bus cable ki fitting check karein.

codes.seriesName: Quattro 48/15000/200 — VE.Bus fault table (277 V)

title.en: Wrong number of devices found on VE.Bus
title.ur: VE.Bus par ghalat number devices mile

meaning.en: Not all, or more than, the expected devices were found in the system.
meaning.ur: System par jitne devices hone chahiye thay un se kam ya zyada milay.

causes.en: System not properly configured as one parallel / split / three-phase group
causes.ur: System theek se ek parallel / split / three-phase group ki tarah configure nahi

causes.en: Communication cable error between units
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan communication cable ka error

solutions.en: Check the communication cables, then switch all equipment off and on again.
solutions.ur: Communication cables check karein, phir sab equipment off karke wapas on karein.

solutions.en: Replace hand-crimped RJ45 leads with factory-made patch leads.
solutions.ur: Haath se banaye RJ45 leads ko factory patch leads se badal dein.
