solutions.en: Reconfigure the system from VE.Bus System Configurator.
solutions.ur: VE.Bus System Configurator se system dobara configure karein.

codes.seriesName: Quattro 48/15000/200 — VE.Bus fault table (277 V)

title.en: No other device detected on the bus
title.ur: Bus par koi doosra device nahi mila

meaning.en: The master is configured for a multi-unit system but finds no other device.
meaning.ur: Master multi-unit system ke liye configure hai lekin koi doosra device nahi milta.

causes.en: VE.Bus communication cable disconnected or faulty
causes.ur: VE.Bus communication cable disconnect ya kharab

causes.en: Other units unpowered and not answering on the bus
causes.ur: Baqi units ko power nahi mil raha aur woh bus par jawab nahi de rahe

solutions.en: Check the VE.Bus communication cables end to end and reseat every RJ45 plug.
solutions.ur: VE.Bus cables dono sifar se check karein aur har RJ45 plug dobara lagaayein.

solutions.en: Measure DC voltage at each unit's battery terminals.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke battery terminals par DC voltage measure karein.

codes.seriesName: Quattro 48/15000/200 — VE.Bus fault table (277 V)

meaning.en: The AC output voltage is too high.
meaning.ur: AC output voltage bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Slave unit AC wiring not connected properly, or not at all
causes.ur: Slave unit ki AC wiring theek se nahi, ya bilkul nahi hai

causes.en: Two AC sources back-feeding through the output
causes.ur: Do AC sources output ke zariye aapas mein back-feed kar rahe hain

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC first, then inspect every slave AC-out termination.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir har slave ka AC-out termination dekhein.

solutions.en: Check AC cables for phase sequence and lug tightness.
solutions.ur: AC cables ki phase sequence aur lug tightness check karein.

solutions.en: Measure AC-out with a true RMS meter against the unit spec.
solutions.ur: True RMS meter se AC-out measure kar ke unit spec se compare karein.

codes.seriesName: Quattro 48/15000/200 — VE.Bus fault table (277 V)

meaning.en: The units could not synchronise their clocks.
meaning.ur: Units apne clock sync nahi kar paye.

causes.en: Transient during a system restart after another error
causes.ur: Dusre error ke baad restart ke dauran aata hai

causes.en: Communication cable fault on the VE.Bus network
causes.ur: VE.Bus network par communication cable ka fault

solutions.en: Switch all units off one by one, then back on; it usually self-recovers.
solutions.ur: Sab units ek ek kar ke off karein phir wapas on karein; khud resolve ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If it persists, inspect the VE.Bus communication cables.
solutions.ur: Agar qataar rahe to VE.Bus communication cables check karein.

codes.seriesName: Quattro 48/15000/200 — VE.Bus fault table (277 V)

title.ur: Device data transmit nahi kar sakta

meaning.en: The unit cannot transmit on the VE.Bus network; most likely a short in the communication cable.
meaning.ur: Unit VE.Bus network par transmit nahi kar sakta; aam tor par communication cable mein short hai.

causes.en: Short circuit in the VE.Bus communication cable
causes.ur: VE.Bus communication cable mein short circuit

causes.en: Damaged RJ45 plug or socket, or board component failure
causes.ur: Kharab RJ45 plug ya socket, ya board component ki failure

solutions.en: Power everything down, then check the communication cables for a short.
solutions.ur: Sab kuch band karein, phir communication cables mein short check karein.

solutions.en: Swap in a known-good factory RJ45 lead between the affected units.
solutions.ur: Mutasir units ke darmiyan aik jaani hui factory RJ45 lead lagayein.

solutions.en: Inspect and reseat the female RJ45 sockets on the units.
solutions.ur: Units ke female RJ45 sockets check karke dobara lagaayein.

codes.seriesName: Quattro 48/15000/200 — VE.Bus fault table (277 V)

title.en: Unit took over 'master' role after master failed
title.ur: Master fail hone ke baad unit ne 'master' role le liya

meaning.en: The original master failed, so another device assumed master status.
meaning.ur: Original master fail ho gaya, is liye kisi doosre device ne master status le liya.

causes.en: The original master unit has failed or lost power
causes.ur: Original master unit fail ho gaya ya power kho gaya

causes.en: Communication cable fault between units
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan communication cable ka fault

solutions.en: Identify which unit is acting as master and why the original failed.
solutions.ur: Dhoondein ke kaun sa unit master hai aur original kyun fail hua.

solutions.en: Check the communication cables between all units.
solutions.ur: Sab units ke darmiyan communication cables check karein.

solutions.en: Power down, reseat all RJ45 plugs, then power back up.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, sab RJ45 plugs dobara lagaayein, phir on karein.

codes.seriesName: Quattro 48/15000/200 — VE.Bus fault table (277 V)

title.en: AC overvoltage on the output of a switched-off slave
title.ur: Band slave ke output par AC overvoltage

meaning.en: Voltage is present on the AC output of a unit that should be off.
meaning.ur: Aise unit ke AC output par voltage hai jo band hona chahiye.

causes.en: AC wires accidentally swapped (L and N reversed)
causes.ur: AC wires galti se swap ho gaye (L aur N ulat gaye)

causes.en: Back-feed from another live AC source into the output
causes.ur: Kisi doosre live AC source se output mein back-feed

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC completely before touching any conductor.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi wire ko chhoone se pehle AC aur DC mukammal disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Verify L/N wiring at AC-out on every unit with a continuity tester.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke AC-out par continuity tester se L/N wiring verify karein.

solutions.en: Re-tighten the AC-out terminals to the torque stated in the manual.
solutions.ur: AC-out terminals ko manual di gayi torque par dobara tighten karein.

codes.seriesName: Quattro 48/15000/200 — VE.Bus fault table (277 V)

title.en: This unit cannot work as a slave
title.ur: Ye unit slave ki tarah kaam nahi kar sakta

meaning.en: Obsolete or unsuitable model; it cannot function as a slave.
meaning.ur: Purana ya unsuitable model; slave ki tarah kaam nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Unit model is obsolete and unsupported as a VE.Bus slave
causes.ur: Unit ka model purana hai aur VE.Bus slave ke tor par support nahi

causes.en: Mismatched models mixed in one multi-unit group
causes.ur: Ek hi multi-unit group mein alag alag models milaye gaye

solutions.en: Read the model number on every unit's nameplate in the group.
solutions.ur: Group ke har unit ka nameplate par model number parhein.

solutions.en: Confirm all units share the same voltage, VA and VE.Bus variant.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke sab units ka voltage, VA aur VE.Bus variant same hai.

solutions.en: Replace the obsolete unit with a matching current model, then reconfigure.
solutions.ur: Purane unit ki jagah same current model lagayein, phir dobara configure karein.

codes.seriesName: Quattro 48/15000/200 — VE.Bus fault table (277 V)

title.ur: Switch-over system protection trigger ho gaya

meaning.en: Transfer-switch protection has tripped so the unit will not switch over to AC input.
meaning.ur: Transfer switch protection trip kar gaya hai is liye unit AC input par switch nahi karta.

causes.en: Transfer switch or relay fault during switch-over
causes.ur: Switch-over ke dauran transfer switch ya relay ka fault

causes.en: AC input voltage sagging slowly, often on a generator supply
causes.ur: AC input voltage dheere dheere gir raha hai, aksar generator supply par

solutions.en: Switch all equipment off, wait for capacitors to discharge, then power on again.
solutions.ur: Sab equipment off karein, capacitor discharge tak intezaar karein, phir on karein.

solutions.en: Reduce heavy AC load that could hold the relay contacts closed.
solutions.ur: Bhaari AC load kam karein jo relay contacts ko band rok sakti hai.

solutions.en: In VEConfigure raise the lower limit of the AC input voltage so the unit disconnects earlier.
solutions.ur: VEConfigure mein AC input voltage ka lower limit barhaayein taake unit jaldi disconnect kare.

codes.seriesName: Quattro 48/15000/200 — VE.Bus fault table (277 V)

title.ur: Units ke darmiyan firmware incompatible hai

meaning.en: One connected device runs firmware too old to work with this device.
meaning.ur: Kisi connected device ka firmware is device ke saath kaam karne ke liye bohat purana hai.

causes.en: Mixed firmware revisions across the VE.Bus group
causes.ur: VE.Bus group ke units mein alag alag firmware revisions

causes.en: A unit missed a previous firmware update
causes.ur: Kisi unit ka pichla firmware update miss ho gaya

solutions.en: Switch all equipment off before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi chhoone se pehle sab equipment off karein.

solutions.en: Switch on only the error unit, then add others one by one until the error reappears.
solutions.ur: Sirf error wala unit on karein, phir baqi ek ek kar ke on karein jab tak error na aaye.

solutions.en: Update the firmware on the last unit switched on - that is the outdated one.
solutions.ur: Aakhri on kiye gaye unit ka firmware update karein - wohi outdated hai.

codes.seriesName: Quattro 48/15000/200 — VE.Bus fault table (277 V)

meaning.en: An unspecified internal fault that should not occur; a full power cycle normally clears it.
meaning.ur: Ek unspecified internal fault jo hona nahi chahiye; poora power cycle saaf kar deta hai.

causes.en: Internal firmware or processor state anomaly
causes.ur: Internal firmware ya processor state mein kami

causes.en: Transient glitch after an abnormal shutdown
causes.ur: Abnormal shutdown ke baad transient glitch

solutions.en: Switch all equipment off and then on again to clear it.
solutions.ur: Sab equipment off karke phir on karein, is se saaf ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Record the LED pattern before power-cycling for support.
solutions.ur: Power cycle se pehle LED pattern note kar lein.

solutions.en: If it returns repeatedly, contact Victron Energy with serial and firmware version.
solutions.ur: Baar baar aaye to serial aur firmware version ke saath Victron Energy se rabta karein.

codes.seriesName: Quattro / MultiPlus — front-panel LED alarm indication table (8-LED units)

meaning.en: Battery voltage is low. The inverter is warning you it is about to shut down.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage kam hai. Inverter aap ko warn kar raha hai ke woh ab band hone wali hai.

causes.en: Battery bank discharged under load
causes.ur: Load ke under battery bank khatam ho gaya

causes.en: Poor or loose battery connection causing voltage drop
causes.ur: Battery connection kharab ya dheela jo voltage drop kar raha hai

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a multimeter under load, not at rest.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery voltage load ke under nikaalein, khali nahi.

solutions.en: Check and tighten the battery terminals; clean any corrosion with a wire brush.
solutions.ur: Battery terminals check karke tighten karein; wire brush se koi corrosion saaf karein.

solutions.en: Recharge the bank and confirm the charger is actually delivering current.
solutions.ur: Bank dobara charge karein aur check karein ke charger haqeeqat current de raha hai.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

codes.seriesName: Quattro / MultiPlus — front-panel LED alarm indication table (8-LED units)

title.en: Low battery LED lit - inverter cut out
title.ur: Low battery LED on - inverter band ho gaya

meaning.en: The unit has switched itself off because the battery voltage fell too low.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage bohat girne ki wajah se unit ne khud band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage dropped below the cut-out threshold
causes.ur: Battery voltage cut-out threshold se neeche gir gaya

causes.en: Battery bank aged, sulfated or undersized for the load
causes.ur: Battery bank purana, sulfated ya load ke liye chhota hai

solutions.en: Disconnect AC and DC before working on the bank.
solutions.ur: Bank par kaam karne se pehle AC aur DC disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Charge the battery and check the battery connections.
solutions.ur: Battery charge karein aur battery connections check karein.

solutions.en: Load test each cell with a cell tester; replace cells below 75% of rated capacity.
solutions.ur: Har cell ko cell tester se load test karein; rated capacity se 75% se neeche cells badal dein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

codes.seriesName: Quattro / MultiPlus — front-panel LED alarm indication table (8-LED units)

meaning.en: The connected load is above the inverter's nominal rating; it is about to shut down.
meaning.ur: Connected load inverter ki nominal rating se upar hai; woh ab band hone wali hai.

causes.en: Load above the inverter's nominal VA/W rating
causes.ur: Load inverter ki nominal VA/W rating se upar hai

causes.en: Inrush current from motors or compressors at start-up
causes.ur: Motors ya compressors ka start-up inrush current

solutions.en: Measure actual load current with a clamp meter on AC-out.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se AC-out par actual load current nikaalein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load - switch off non-essential appliances first.
solutions.ur: Load kam karein - pehle ghair zaruri bartan band karein.

solutions.en: Stagger large appliance start-up so they do not all start together.
solutions.ur: Bhaari bartan ka start-up alag alag karein taake sab ek saath na chalein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

codes.seriesName: Quattro / MultiPlus — front-panel LED alarm indication table (8-LED units)

title.en: Overload LED lit - inverter cut out
title.ur: Overload LED on - inverter band ho gaya

meaning.en: The unit has switched itself off because the load was excessively high, or there is a short circuit.
meaning.ur: Load bohat zyada hone ya short circuit ki wajah se unit ne khud band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Excessively high load or a short circuit on the AC output
causes.ur: AC output par bohat zyada load ya short circuit

causes.en: Damaged appliance with a shorted winding
causes.ur: Kharaz bartan jis ki winding short ho gayi ho

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC before inspecting anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi dekhne se pehle AC aur DC disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect loads in halves to find the offending circuit; then test that appliance for a short.
solutions.ur: Loads aik aik aadhe hisse mein disconnect kar ke kharab circuit dhoondein; phir us bartan ko short ke liye test karein.

solutions.en: Replace the shorted appliance or cable - do not fit a bigger fuse to bypass it.
solutions.ur: Short hua bartan ya cable badal dein - is par badi fuse lagakar bypass na karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

codes.seriesName: Quattro / MultiPlus — front-panel LED alarm indication table (8-LED units)

meaning.en: Internal temperature is at a critical level. The unit derates and then switches off.
meaning.ur: Internal temperature critical level par hai. Unit pehle power kam karta hai phir band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature too high in the installation room
causes.ur: Installation kamre mein ambient temperature bohat zyada hai

causes.en: Load too high causing internal heating
causes.ur: Load itna zyada ke unit khud garam ho raha hai

causes.en: Blocked or clogged cooling fan / poor airflow
causes.ur: Cooling fan band ya blocked, ya hawa ka aana kam hai

solutions.en: Install the unit in a cool, well-ventilated place; leave 10 cm clear around it.
solutions.ur: Unit ko thande aur hawa wala jagah lagayein; charon taraf 10 cm khali rakhein.

solutions.en: Blow dust out of the fan and vents with dry compressed air.
solutions.ur: Fan aur vents ko dry compressed air se dhool saaf karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load, then reset the unit by switching it off and on.
solutions.ur: Connected load kam karein, phir unit ko off karke on karke reset karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

codes.seriesName: Quattro / MultiPlus — front-panel LED alarm indication table (8-LED units)
aliases: Low battery and overload LEDs flash intermittently

title.ur: Low battery aur overload baari baari flash kar rahe hain

meaning.en: Low battery voltage combined with an excessively high load. The unit is fighting both conditions at once.
meaning.ur: Low battery voltage aur bohat zyada load aik saath. Unit dono conditions se lad raha hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage too low for the load being drawn
causes.ur: Liye ja rahe load ke liye battery voltage bohat kam hai

causes.en: Load too high for the remaining battery capacity
causes.ur: Bachi hui battery capacity ke liye load bohat zyada hai

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage and load current together with a clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter ke saath battery voltage aur load current aik saath nikaalein.

solutions.en: Charge the batteries, or disconnect / reduce the load.
solutions.ur: Batteries charge karein, ya load disconnect karke kam karein.

solutions.en: Install higher capacity batteries, and fit shorter and/or thicker battery cables.
solutions.ur: Bade capacity ki batteries lagayein, aur battery cables chhoti aur/or moti lagayein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

codes.seriesName: Quattro / MultiPlus — front-panel LED alarm indication table (8-LED units)
aliases: Low battery and overload LEDs flash simultaneously

title.en: Low batt + overload flashing together (DC ripple)
title.ur: Low battery aur overload saath flash (DC ripple)

meaning.en: Ripple voltage on the DC connection exceeds 1.5 Vrms. The battery cable run is too thin, too long, or the connections are resistive.
meaning.ur: DC connection par ripple voltage 1.5 Vrms se zyada hai. Battery cable bahut patli ya lambi hai, ya connections mein resistance hai.

causes.en: Battery cable too thin or too long for the current
causes.ur: Battery cable current ke liye bahut patli ya lambi hai

causes.en: Corroded or loose battery connections adding resistance
causes.ur: Corrode ya dheele battery connections jo resistance barha rahe hain

solutions.en: Check the battery cables and battery connections; clean and re-tighten every terminal.
solutions.ur: Battery cables aur connections check karein; har terminal saaf karke dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Measure DC ripple with the unit off load using a true RMS meter; expect under 1.5 Vrms.
solutions.ur: Unit load ke baghair true RMS meter se DC ripple nikaalein; 1.5 Vrms se kam hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Check whether battery capacity is high enough, and increase it if not.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery capacity kaafi hai ya nahi, aur zaroorat ho to barha dein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

codes.seriesName: Quattro / MultiPlus — front-panel LED alarm indication table (8-LED units)
aliases: Low battery and overload LEDs light

title.en: Low batt + overload lit - cut out on DC ripple
title.ur: Low battery aur overload on - DC ripple par band

meaning.en: The inverter has switched off because the ripple voltage on the DC input was excessively high.
meaning.ur: DC input par ripple voltage bohat zyada hone ki wajah se inverter band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Excessively high ripple voltage on the battery input
causes.ur: Battery input par bohat zyada ripple voltage

causes.en: Undersized or over-long battery cables
causes.ur: Battery cables chhoti ya bohat lambi

solutions.en: Install batteries with a larger capacity.
solutions.ur: Bade capacity ki batteries lagayein.

solutions.en: Fit shorter and/or thicker battery cables.
solutions.ur: Chhoti aur/or moti battery cables lagayein.

solutions.en: Reset the inverter by switching it off and then on again.
solutions.ur: Inverter ko off karke phir on karke reset karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

codes.seriesName: Quattro / MultiPlus — front-panel LED alarm indication table (8-LED units)
aliases: One alarm LED lights and the second flashes

title.en: One LED lit + one flashing (imminent shutdown)
title.ur: Aik LED on + aik flash (band hone wali hai)

meaning.en: The unit has already switched off. The lit LED names the alarm that tripped it; the flashing LED shows it was about to switch off for that reason.
meaning.ur: Unit pehle hi band ho chuka hai. Jo LED on hai woh alarm bata raha hai; jo flash kar raha hai woh batata hai ke usi wajah se band hone wala tha.

causes.en: Low battery, overload or over-temperature alarm tripped
causes.ur: Low battery, overload ya zyada temperature ka alarm trigger hua

causes.en: Load step or charging fault coinciding with the alarm
causes.ur: Load step ya charging fault alarm ke saath a gaya

solutions.en: Read which LED is steady-lit and look up that row in this table.
solutions.ur: Dekhein kaun sa LED steady on hai aur usi row ko is table mein dekhein.

solutions.en: Fix the cause in the matching row before resetting the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit reset karne se pehle usi row ki wajah theek karein.

solutions.en: Reset by switching the front On/Off/Charger-only rocker off and on.
solutions.ur: Front ke On/Off/Charger-only rocker ko off karke on karke reset karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

codes.seriesName: Quattro / MultiPlus — front-panel LED alarm indication table (8-LED units)

meaning.en: Several distinct causes: AC input out of range, the AC-in breaker or fuse open, the battery fuse blown, or heavy AC distortion (typically a generator).
meaning.ur: Kai alag wajuhat: AC input range se bahar, AC-in breaker ya fuse khula hua, battery fuse ula hua, ya AC distortion zyada (aksar generator).

causes.en: AC input voltage or frequency outside the configured range
causes.ur: AC input voltage ya frequency configured range se bahar

causes.en: Circuit breaker or fuse in the AC-in input open after an overload
causes.ur: AC-in input ka circuit breaker ya fuse overload ke baad khul gaya

causes.en: Battery fuse has blown
causes.ur: Battery fuse ula hua hai

causes.en: AC input distortion or voltage too large, generally from a generator
causes.ur: AC input distortion ya voltage bohat zyada, aam tor par generator se

solutions.en: On 120 V Quattro confirm AC-in is 95-140 VAC and 45-65 Hz; on 230 V units use 185-265 VAC.
solutions.ur: 120 V Quattro par AC-in 95-140 VAC aur 45-65 Hz check karein; 230 V units par 185-265 VAC dekhein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then check the AC-in breaker and the DC battery fuse with a continuity tester.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC disconnect karke AC-in breaker aur DC battery fuse continuity tester se check karein.

solutions.en: Remove any overload or short on AC-out-1 or AC-out-2, then reset the fuse or breaker.
solutions.ur: AC-out-1 ya AC-out-2 par overload ya short hata dein, phir fuse ya breaker reset karein.

solutions.en: Replace the battery fuse with the exact type and rating from the manual - never a bigger one.
solutions.ur: Battery fuse manual wali exact type aur rating se badal dein - kabhi badi nahi.

solutions.en: If the supply is a generator, switch on 'Weak AC' and the dynamic current limiter in VEConfigure.
solutions.ur: Agar supply generator hai to VEConfigure mein 'Weak AC' aur dynamic current limiter on karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.1 General error indications

codes.seriesName: Quattro / MultiPlus — special LED indications (2-LED simultaneous patterns)
aliases: Bulk and absorption LEDs flash simultaneously

title.en: Bulk + absorption flash together - voltage sense error
title.ur: Bulk aur absorption saath flash - voltage sense error

meaning.en: Voltage sense error. The voltage at the sense connection deviates more than 7 V from the device's main terminals - usually a connection error. The device stays in normal operation.
meaning.ur: Voltage sense error. Sense connection par voltage device ke main terminals se 7 V se zyada different hai - aam tor par connection error. Device normal chalta rehta hai.

causes.en: Voltage sense lead connected to the wrong point or open circuit
causes.ur: Voltage sense lead galat jagah jury ya khuli hui hai

causes.en: Sense wiring disconnected or its fuse open
causes.ur: Sense wiring disconnect hai ya us ka fuse khul gaya hai

solutions.en: Measure between the sense terminal and the battery negative; the difference must be under 7 V.
solutions.ur: Sense terminal aur battery negative ke darmiyan voltage nikaalein; farq 7 V se kam hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Trace the sense lead end to end and reseat every terminal; check the sense fuse.
solutions.ur: Sense lead ko sifar tak trace karein aur har terminal dobara lagaayein; sense fuse bhi check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the polarity of the sense connections before restoring power.
solutions.ur: Power wapas chalane se pehle sense connections ki polarity confirm karein.

notes.en: If the 'inverter on' LED flashes in phase OPPOSITION to this pattern, it is a VE.Bus error code instead - cross-reference the device's VE.Bus series.
notes.ur: Agar 'inverter on' LED is pattern ke saath phase OPPOSITION mein flash kare to ye VE.Bus error code hai - device ke VE.Bus series mein dekhein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.2 Special LED indications

codes.seriesName: Quattro / MultiPlus — special LED indications (2-LED simultaneous patterns)
aliases: Absorption and float LEDs flash simultaneously

title.en: Absorption + float flash together - temp sensor fault
title.ur: Absorption aur float saath flash - temperature sensor kharab

meaning.en: The measured battery temperature is an extremely unlikely value, so the sensor is probably defective or badly connected. The device stays in normal operation.
meaning.ur: Measured battery temperature aik ajeeb value hai, is liye sensor ya to kharab hai ya ghalat se jury hua hai. Device normal chalta rehta hai.

causes.en: Defective battery temperature sensor
causes.ur: Battery temperature sensor kharab

causes.en: Temperature sensor connected to the wrong terminals or not connected
causes.ur: Temperature sensor galat terminals par jury ya bilkul nahi jury

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance with a multimeter against the Victron temperature-sensor spec table.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se sensor ki resistance nikaal kar Victron sensor spec table se compare karein.

solutions.en: Pull the temperature sensor plug out of the unit and watch for about 1 minute.
solutions.ur: Temperature sensor plug nikaalein aur taqreeb aik minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: If charging behaves normally with the plug out, the sensor should be replaced.
solutions.ur: Agar plug nikaal kar charging normal chale to sensor badal dena chahiye.

solutions.en: Verify sensor polarity; reversed leads can read as an impossible value.
solutions.ur: Sensor ki polarity check karein; ulti leads aik mumkin na value dikha deti hain.

notes.en: If the 'inverter on' LED flashes in phase OPPOSITION to this pattern, it is a VE.Bus error code instead.
notes.ur: Agar 'inverter on' LED is pattern ke saath phase OPPOSITION mein flash kare to ye VE.Bus error code hai.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.2 Special LED indications

codes.seriesName: Quattro / MultiPlus — special LED indications (2-LED simultaneous patterns)
aliases: Mains on flashes and there is no output voltage

title.en: Mains on flashes, no output voltage
title.ur: Mains on flash, magar output voltage nahi

meaning.en: The device is in 'charger only' mode with mains present. It is either rejecting the mains supply or still synchronising to it.
meaning.ur: Device 'charger only' mode mein hai aur mains maujood hai. Ya to mains supply reject kar raha hai ya abhi synchronize ho raha hai.

causes.en: Normal 'charger only' position of the front rocker switch
causes.ur: Front rocker switch ki normal 'charger only' position

causes.en: Mains supply rejected - voltage, frequency or phase not acceptable
causes.ur: Mains supply reject hui - voltage, frequency ya phase qubool nahi

causes.en: Unit still synchronising to the incoming supply
causes.ur: Unit abhi incoming supply se synchronize ho raha hai

solutions.en: Check the rocker switch is set to 'charger only' and not 'off'.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke rocker switch 'charger only' par hai, 'off' par nahi.

solutions.en: Measure the incoming AC with a multimeter and confirm it is inside the configured window.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se aane wala AC measure karein aur check karein ke woh configured window mein hai.

solutions.en: Switch briefly to 'on' and see whether the inverter picks up and the mains LED steadies.
solutions.ur: MOMENT ke liye 'on' par karein aur dekhein ke inverter chalta hai aur mains LED steady ho jata hai.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.2 Special LED indications

codes.seriesName: Quattro inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (120 V, fw xxxx400+)

title.en: One phase switched off, this unit off too
title.ur: Ek phase off ho gaya, yeh unit bhi off

meaning.en: The unit is switched off because another phase in the same system has switched off. Look for the one phase that is NOT showing this code.
meaning.ur: Ye unit is liye off hai kyunke isi system ka koi doosra phase off ho chuka hai. Wo ek phase dhoondein jo ye code nahi dikha raha.

causes.en: Another phase tripped on low battery, overload or over-temperature
causes.ur: Doosra phase low battery, overload ya zyada temperature par trip kar gaya

causes.en: A slave unit has lost DC or VE.Bus communication
causes.ur: Koi slave unit DC ya VE.Bus communication se nikal gaya

solutions.en: Read the LEDs on every unit in the system; the failing phase is the one without code 1.
solutions.ur: System ke har unit ke LED parhein; kaam kharab karne wala phase woh hai jis par code 1 nahi hai.

solutions.en: Fix the low-battery / overload / temperature cause on that phase first, then power-cycle.
solutions.ur: Pehle us phase ka low battery / overload / temperature ka masla theek karein, phir power cycle karein.

solutions.en: Check the VE.Bus RJ45 cables and terminations on the master.
solutions.ur: Master par VE.Bus RJ45 cable aur termination check karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (with firmware xxxx400 or higher) - 12/5000/220, 24/5000/120, 48/5000/70, 48/10000/140 120V

codes.seriesName: Quattro inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (120 V, fw xxxx400+)

title.en: Wrong number of devices found on VE.Bus
title.ur: VE.Bus par ghalat number devices mile

meaning.en: Not all, or more than, the expected devices were found on the VE.Bus network. Usually follows code 1.
meaning.ur: VE.Bus network par jitne devices hone chahiye thay un se kam ya zyada milay. Aam tor par code 1 ke baad aata hai.

causes.en: System not configured as one parallel / split / three-phase group
causes.ur: System ek hi parallel / split / three-phase group ke tor par configure nahi hai

causes.en: Communication cable error between units
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan communication cable ka error

solutions.en: Check the communication cables, then switch all equipment off and on again.
solutions.ur: Communication cable check karein, phir sab equipment off karke wapas on karein.

solutions.en: Replace any hand-crimped RJ45 leads with factory-made patch leads.
solutions.ur: Haath se banaye RJ45 leads ko factory-made patch leads se replace karein.

solutions.en: Re-run VE.Bus System Configurator so all units form one configured system.
solutions.ur: VE.Bus System Configurator dobara chalayein taake sab units ek hi configured system banayein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (with firmware xxxx400 or higher) - 12/5000/220, 24/5000/120, 48/5000/70, 48/10000/140 120V

codes.seriesName: Quattro inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (120 V, fw xxxx400+)

title.en: No other device detected on the bus
title.ur: Bus par koi doosra device nahi mila

meaning.en: The master is configured for a multi-unit system but cannot find any other device on the VE.Bus.
meaning.ur: Master multi-unit system ke liye configure hai lekin VE.Bus par koi doosra device nahi dhoond sakta.

causes.en: VE.Bus communication cable disconnected or faulty
causes.ur: VE.Bus communication cable disconnect ya kharab

causes.en: Slave unit has no DC power, so it is not answering on the bus
causes.ur: Slave unit ko DC power nahi mil raha, is liye woh bus par jawab nahi de raha

solutions.en: Check the VE.Bus communication cables end to end and reseat every RJ45 plug.
solutions.ur: VE.Bus communication cable dono sifar se check karein aur har RJ45 plug dobara lagaayein.

solutions.en: Measure DC voltage at each unit's battery terminals; a dead slave looks absent.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke battery terminals par DC voltage measure karein; marr hua slave missing jaisa lagta hai.

source.title: Quattro Manual (with firmware xxxx400 or higher) - 12/5000/220, 24/5000/120, 48/5000/70, 48/10000/140 120V

codes.seriesName: Quattro inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (120 V, fw xxxx400+)

meaning.en: Voltage on the AC output side of the unit is too high. AC wiring of a slave is often the cause.
meaning.ur: Unit ke AC output side par voltage bohat zyada hai. Aam tor par kisi slave ki AC wiring wajah se hota hai.

causes.en: AC wiring of a slave unit not connected properly, or not connected at all
causes.ur: Slave unit ki AC wiring theek se nahi, ya bilkul nahi hai

causes.en: Two AC sources back-feeding each other through the output
causes.ur: Do AC sources output ke zariye aapas mein back-feed kar rahe hain

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC first, then inspect every slave AC-out termination.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC aur DC disconnect karein, phir har slave ka AC-out termination dekhein.

solutions.en: Check the AC cables for correct phase sequence and tight torque on lugs.
solutions.ur: AC cables ki phase sequence aur lug par torque tight check karein.

solutions.en: Measure AC-out voltage with a true RMS multimeter against the unit's spec.
solutions.ur: True RMS multimeter se AC-out voltage nikal kar unit ki spec se compare karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (with firmware xxxx400 or higher) - 12/5000/220, 24/5000/120, 48/5000/70, 48/10000/140 120V

codes.seriesName: Quattro inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (120 V, fw xxxx400+)

meaning.en: The units could not synchronise their clocks. Often only visible briefly during a system restart.
meaning.ur: Units apne clock sync nahi kar paye. Aam tor par sirf restart ke waqt hi palat ke nazar aata hai.

causes.en: Transient during a system restart after another error
causes.ur: Dusre error ke baad system restart ke dauran aata hai

causes.en: Communication cable fault on the VE.Bus network
causes.ur: VE.Bus network par communication cable ka fault

solutions.en: Switch all units off one by one, then back on; usually self-recovers.
solutions.ur: Sab units ek ek kar ke off karein, phir wapas on karein; aam tor par khud resolve ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If it persists, inspect the VE.Bus communication cables.
solutions.ur: Agar qataar rahe to VE.Bus communication cables check karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (with firmware xxxx400 or higher) - 12/5000/220, 24/5000/120, 48/5000/70, 48/10000/140 120V

codes.seriesName: Quattro inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (120 V, fw xxxx400+)

title.ur: Device data transmit nahi kar sakta

meaning.en: The unit has failed to transmit on the VE.Bus network. Most often a short circuit in the communication cable.
meaning.ur: Unit VE.Bus network par transmit nahi kar paya. Aam tor par communication cable mein short circuit hota hai.

causes.en: Short circuit in the VE.Bus communication cable
causes.ur: VE.Bus communication cable mein short circuit

causes.en: Damaged RJ45 plug or socket, or a component failure on the board
causes.ur: Kharab RJ45 plug ya socket, ya board ka koi component fault

solutions.en: Power everything down, then check the communication cables for a short.
solutions.ur: Sab kuch band karein, phir communication cables mein short check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the cable between the affected units with a known-good factory lead.
solutions.ur: Mutasir unit ke darmiyan cable ko aik jaane hua factory lead se replace karein.

solutions.en: Reseat and inspect the female RJ45 sockets; crimped plugs block the spring contacts.
solutions.ur: Female RJ45 sockets dobara laga kar check karein; crimped plugs spring contacts ko rok dete hain.

source.title: Quattro Manual (with firmware xxxx400 or higher) - 12/5000/220, 24/5000/120, 48/5000/70, 48/10000/140 120V

codes.seriesName: Quattro inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (120 V, fw xxxx400+)

title.ur: Extended system, dongle nahi lagaya hua

meaning.en: On a 4-or-more unit 'extended' VE.Bus system the system stays off because the required dongle is absent. Unique to the 120 V Quattro fw xxxx400+ table.
meaning.ur: 4 ya us se zyada unit wale 'extended' VE.Bus system mein system band rehta hai kyunke required dongle nahi hai. Ye sirf 120 V Quattro fw xxxx400+ table mein hai.

causes.en: VE.Bus Smart Dongle not fitted in the system
causes.ur: System mein VE.Bus Smart Dongle nahi lagaya hua

causes.en: Dongle fitted but its RJ45 lead is unplugged or faulty
causes.ur: Dongle laga hua hai lekin us ka RJ45 lead nahi laga ya kharab hai

solutions.en: Connect the dongle to the designated VE.Bus port on any unit.
solutions.ur: Dongle kisi bhi unit ke designated VE.Bus port se connect karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the dongle LED is on and the RJ45 lead is fully seated.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke dongle ki LED on hai aur RJ45 lead poori tarah lagi hui hai.

solutions.en: On newer firmware dongles are no longer necessary - update all units to latest firmware.
solutions.ur: Naye firmware mein dongle ki zaroorat nahi - sab units latest firmware par update karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (with firmware xxxx400 or higher) - 12/5000/220, 24/5000/120, 48/5000/70, 48/10000/140 120V

codes.seriesName: Quattro inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (120 V, fw xxxx400+)

title.en: Unit took over 'master' role after master failed
title.ur: Master fail hone ke baad unit ne 'master' role le liya

meaning.en: Because the original master failed, one of the remaining devices has assumed master status.
meaning.ur: Kyunke original master fail ho gaya, baqi devices mein se ek ne master status le liya.

causes.en: The original master unit has failed or lost power
causes.ur: Original master unit fail ho gaya ya power kho gaya

causes.en: Communication cable fault between units
causes.ur: Units ke darmiyan communication cable ka fault

solutions.en: Identify which unit is now acting as master and why the original died.
solutions.ur: Dhoondein ke kaun sa unit ab master ka kaam kar raha hai aur original kyun mara.

solutions.en: Check the communication cables between all units.
solutions.ur: Sab units ke darmiyan communication cables check karein.

solutions.en: Power down, reseat all RJ45 plugs, then power the system back up.
solutions.ur: Power off karein, sab RJ45 plugs dobara lagaayein, phir system on karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (with firmware xxxx400 or higher) - 12/5000/220, 24/5000/120, 48/5000/70, 48/10000/140 120V

codes.seriesName: Quattro inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (120 V, fw xxxx400+)

title.en: AC overvoltage on the output of a switched-off slave
title.ur: Band slave ke output par AC overvoltage

meaning.en: Voltage is present on the AC output of a unit that should be off. There must never be output voltage on an off unit.
meaning.ur: Aise unit ke AC output par voltage hai jo band hona chahiye. Band unit par output voltage kabhi nahi hona chahiye.

causes.en: AC wires accidentally swapped (L and N reversed)
causes.ur: AC wires galti se swap ho gaye (L aur N ulat gaye)

causes.en: Back-feed from another live AC source into the output
causes.ur: Kisi doosre live AC source se output mein back-feed

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC completely before touching any conductor.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi wire ko chhoone se pehle AC aur DC mukammal disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Verify L/N wiring at AC-out on every unit with a continuity tester.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke AC-out par continuity tester se L/N wiring verify karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the AC-out terminals to the torque given in the manual.
solutions.ur: AC-out terminals ko manual di gayi torque par dobara tighten karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (with firmware xxxx400 or higher) - 12/5000/220, 24/5000/120, 48/5000/70, 48/10000/140 120V

codes.seriesName: Quattro inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (120 V, fw xxxx400+)

title.en: This unit cannot work as a slave
title.ur: Ye unit slave ki tarah kaam nahi kar sakta

meaning.en: The unit is an obsolete or unsuitable model and cannot be used as a slave in this system. Victron's stated remedy is replacement.
meaning.ur: Ye unit purana ya unsuitable model hai aur is system mein slave ki tarah use nahi ho sakta. Victron ka bataya hua hal naya unit lagana hai.

causes.en: Unit model is obsolete and not supported as a VE.Bus slave
causes.ur: Unit ka model purana hai aur VE.Bus slave ke tor par support nahi hota

causes.en: Mismatched models mixed in one parallel / three-phase group
causes.ur: Ek hi parallel / three-phase group mein alag alag models milaye gaye hain

solutions.en: Read the model number on the nameplate of every unit in the group.
solutions.ur: Group ke har unit ka nameplate par model number parhein.

solutions.en: Confirm all units are the same voltage, VA and VE.Bus-capable variant.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke sab units same voltage, VA aur VE.Bus-capable variant hain.

solutions.en: Replace the obsolete unit with a matching current model, then reconfigure the system.
solutions.ur: Purane unit ki jagah same current model lagayein, phir system dobara configure karein.

source.title: Quattro Manual (with firmware xxxx400 or higher) - 12/5000/220, 24/5000/120, 48/5000/70, 48/10000/140 120V

codes.seriesName: Quattro inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (120 V, fw xxxx400+)

title.ur: Switch-over system protection trigger ho gaya

meaning.en: The transfer-switch protection has tripped, so the unit will not switch over to the AC input. The 120 V Quattro table gives only a power-cycle remedy.
meaning.ur: Transfer switch ka protection trip kar gaya hai, is liye unit AC input par switch nahi hota. 120 V Quattro table sirf power cycle ka hal deta hai.

causes.en: Transfer switch or relay problem during switch-over
causes.ur: Switch-over ke waqt transfer switch ya relay ka masla

causes.en: Should not occur in correctly installed equipment
causes.ur: Theek se install hui machine mein ye hona nahi chahiye

solutions.en: Switch all equipment off, wait for capacitors to discharge, then power on again.
solutions.ur: Sab equipment off karein, capacitor discharge hone tak intezaar karein, phir on karein.

solutions.en: If the fault recurs, disconnect AC and DC and check the installation wiring.
solutions.ur: Agar fault dohra to AC aur DC disconnect kar ke installation wiring check karein.

solutions.en: Reduce heavy AC load that could be holding the relay contacts closed.
solutions.ur: Bhaari AC load kam karein jo relay contacts ko band rok sakti hai.

source.title: Quattro Manual (with firmware xxxx400 or higher) - 12/5000/220, 24/5000/120, 48/5000/70, 48/10000/140 120V

codes.seriesName: Quattro inverter/charger — VE.Bus fault table (120 V, fw xxxx400+)

title.ur: Units ke darmiyan firmware incompatible hai

meaning.en: The firmware on one connected device is too old to work together with this device.
meaning.ur: Kisi connected device ka firmware is device ke saath kaam karne ke liye bohat purana hai.

causes.en: Mixed firmware revisions across units in the VE.Bus group
causes.ur: VE.Bus group ke units mein alag alag firmware revisions

causes.en: A unit missed a previous firmware update
causes.ur: Kisi unit ka pichla firmware update miss ho gaya

solutions.en: Switch all equipment off before touching anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi chhoone se pehle sab equipment off karein.

solutions.en: Switch on only the unit that is reporting the error.
solutions.ur: Sirf woh unit on karein jo error dikha raha hai.

solutions.en: Turn on the other units one by one until the error reappears; that last unit is the outdated one.
solutions.ur: Baqi units ek ek kar ke on karein jab tak error na aaye; aakhri unit hi outdated hai.

solutions.en: Update the firmware on that last unit to the newest version.
solutions.ur: Us aakhri unit ka firmware sab se naye version par update karein.

causes.ur: Internal firmware ya processor state mein kami

solutions.en: If it keeps returning, contact Victron Energy with the unit serial and firmware version.

causes.ur: Ek hi system mein purane aur naye generation ke MK2 interface units milaye gaye

causes.en: A unit was swapped without reconfiguring the system
causes.ur: System dobara configure kiye baghair koi unit badal di gayi

solutions.en: Power everything off and note every unit's model and interface generation.
solutions.ur: Sab kuch band karein aur har unit ka model aur interface generation note karein.

solutions.en: Remove the older-generation unit from the VE.Bus group.
solutions.ur: Purane generation wale unit ko VE.Bus group se nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Contact Victron service - Victron states this error should never occur.
solutions.ur: Victron service se rabta karein - Victron ke mutabiq ye error kabhi nahi hona chahiye.

meaning.en: There is an error inside an Assistant (Victron's digital dual control configuration). It resolves by updating firmware and re-configuring.
meaning.ur: Assistant (Victron ka digital dual control configuration) ke andar error hai. Firmware update aur dobara configure karne se hal hota hai.

causes.en: Faulty or outdated Assistant loaded in the device
causes.ur: Device mein koi kharab ya purana Assistant load hai

causes.en: VE.Bus firmware older than the Assistant expects
causes.ur: VE.Bus firmware Assistant se purana hai

solutions.en: Update the VE.Bus firmware in all devices to the latest firmware.
solutions.ur: Sab devices ka VE.Bus firmware sab se naye version par update karein.

solutions.en: Download the latest VEConfigure and let it fetch all the latest Assistants.
solutions.ur: Naya VEConfigure download karein aur use sab naye Assistants laane dein.

solutions.en: Re-configure the system from scratch in VEConfigure.
solutions.ur: VEConfigure mein system shuru se dobara configure karein.

title.en: VE.Bus BMS detected but not configured
title.ur: VE.Bus BMS detect ho gaya magar configure nahi

meaning.en: A VE.Bus BMS is connected but no Assistant is loaded to handle it, so the BMS cannot control the inverter/charger.
meaning.ur: VE.Bus BMS connected hai magar usay handle karne wala koi Assistant load nahi, is liye BMS inverter/charger ko control nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: VE.Bus BMS fitted but not declared in any Assistant
causes.ur: VE.Bus BMS laga hua hai magar kisi Assistant mein declare nahi kiya gaya

causes.en: Lithium battery system installed without updating the Assistant
causes.ur: Lithium battery system lagaya gaya magar Assistant update nahi kiya gaya

solutions.en: Connect the unit to VEConfigure and open the Assistant editor.
solutions.ur: Unit ko VEConfigure se connect kar ke Assistant editor kholein.

solutions.en: Enable the 'VE.Bus BMS' option in one of the Assistants.
solutions.ur: Kisi aik Assistant mein 'VE.Bus BMS' option on karein.

solutions.en: Send the settings and power-cycle the system.
solutions.ur: Settings bhej kar system ka power cycle karein.

title.ur: Ground relay ka self-test fail ho gaya

meaning.en: The automatic self-test of the backfeed / ground relay on MultiPlus-II or EasySolar-II relays failed. Victron directs you to the Error 11 procedure.
meaning.ur: MultiPlus-II ya EasySolar-II ke backfeed / ground relay ka automatic self-test fail ho gaya. Victron aapko Error 11 ka tareeqa batata hai.

causes.en: Installation or earth wiring problem
causes.ur: Installation ya earth wiring ka masla

causes.en: Ground relay is disabled or genuinely faulty
causes.ur: Ground relay disabled hai ya asal mein kharab hai

solutions.en: Follow the full Error 11 diagnostic steps, starting with the earth connection check.
solutions.ur: Pura Error 11 diagnostic follow karein, earth connection check se shuru karein.

solutions.en: Verify AC-in earth is grounded to local rules; never bond earth to neutral inside the unit.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke AC-in earth local rules ke mutabiq grounded hai; unit ke andar earth ko neutral se kabhi na jorein.

solutions.en: If the relay is enabled in VEConfigure and still fails, suspect the relay hardware.
solutions.ur: Agar relay VEConfigure mein enabled hai magar phir bhi fail ho raha hai to relay hardware kharab shak karein.

codes.seriesName: VE.Bus Error Codes — official live wiki table (current-gen Multi / MultiPlus-II / EasySolar-II)

title.en: Relay test fault (wiring or relay failure)
title.ur: Relay test fault (wiring ya relay ki failure)

meaning.en: The automatic self-test of the MultiPlus-II / EasySolar-II relay failed. Usually an installation or earth wiring issue; sometimes real relay hardware failure. Failsafe behaviour - the unit refuses to connect to mains.
meaning.ur: MultiPlus-II / EasySolar-II relay ka automatic self-test fail ho gaya. Aam tor par installation ya earth wiring ka masla; kabhi kabhi relay ki asli hardware failure. Fail-safe behaviour - unit mains se connect nahi hota.

causes.en: Earth connection on the unit AC input not made to local code
causes.ur: Unit ke AC input par earth connection local code ke mutabiq nahi hai

causes.en: AC-out Neutral wired to ground, or AC-in Neutral bridged to ground
causes.ur: AC-out Neutral ko ground se jora gaya, ya AC-in Neutral ko ground se jora gaya

causes.en: Line and Neutral input reversed (shows as 'Failing step: 8')
causes.ur: Line aur Neutral input ulat hue hain ('Failing step: 8' dikhta hai)

causes.en: Leakage between Neutral and ground from a broken load
causes.ur: Kisi kharab load ki wajah se Neutral aur ground ke darmiyan leakage

causes.en: Actual failure of the backfeed / ground relay
causes.ur: Backfeed ya ground relay ki asli failure

solutions.en: Update the unit to the latest VE.Bus firmware first; many Error 11 issues are firmware-fixed.
solutions.ur: Pehle unit ka VE.Bus firmware sab se naye version par update karein; bohat se Error 11 masle firmware se hal ho jate hain.

solutions.en: Verify the AC-in earth to local code. Do NOT connect earth to neutral inside the unit - it is a safety hazard and can stop RCDs working.
solutions.ur: AC-in earth ko local code ke mutabiq check karein. Earth ko unit ke andar neutral se kabhi na jorein - ye safety hazard hai aur RCD kaam karne se rok sakta hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect L and N from AC-out on every unit; if the system then starts, a connected load is leaking.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke AC-out se L aur N disconnect karein; agar system phir chalay to koi load leak kar rahi hai.

solutions.en: Check there is no external link between ACin-Neutral, ACout-Neutral and earth.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke ACin-Neutral, ACout-Neutral aur earth ke darmiyan koi external link nahi.

solutions.en: If step 8 is the failing step, swap the Line and Neutral input wires and retry.
solutions.ur: Agar failing step 8 hai to Line aur Neutral input wires aapas mein badal kar dobara try karein.

solutions.en: After any change, retest RCD operation with AC input both connected and disconnected.
solutions.ur: Har badlav ke baad, AC input lagaye aur na lagaye dono suraton mein RCD kaam check karein.

title.ur: Doosre microcontroller ke saath config mismatch

meaning.en: Some Multi models (e.g. MultiPlus-II) have two microcontrollers. The settings stored in them have mismatched and could not be reconciled automatically.
meaning.ur: Kuch Multi models (maslan MultiPlus-II) mein do microcontrollers hote hain. Un mein stored settings mismatch ho gaye aur ye khud se theek nahi ho sake.

causes.en: Power interrupted part-way through a VEConfigure settings write
causes.ur: VEConfigure settings likhte waqt power chala gaya

causes.en: A very rare firmware condition where the mismatch is not auto-resolved
causes.ur: Ek bohat rare firmware condition jis mein mismatch khud resolve nahi hota

solutions.en: Connect the device to VEConfigure 3 using an MK3-USB interface and RJ45 cable.
solutions.ur: Device ko MK3-USB interface aur RJ45 cable se VEConfigure 3 se connect karein.

solutions.en: Verify or correct the settings, then press 'Send Settings'.
solutions.ur: Settings verify ya theek karein, phir 'Send Settings' dabayein.

solutions.en: Select 'all settings' rather than 'modified settings' when sending.
solutions.ur: Bhejte waqt 'modified settings' ke bajaye 'all settings' chunein.

codes.seriesName: VE.Bus Error Codes — official live wiki table (current-gen Multi / MultiPlus-II / EasySolar-II)

title.en: Slave unit has no AC input connected
title.ur: Slave unit ka AC input connected nahi hai

meaning.en: The system is set up with multiple synchronised inverter/chargers but AC input (e.g. from a generator) is only wired to one of them.
meaning.ur: System kai synchronised inverter/chargers ka hai magar AC input (maslan generator se) sirf aik unit se juri hui hai.

causes.en: AC input from generator or mains connected to only one unit
causes.ur: Generator ya mains ka AC input sirf aik unit se jury hai

causes.en: 'Switch as Group' left enabled when units are not all fed
causes.ur: 'Switch as Group' enabled chhor diya jab sab units feed nahi hotay

solutions.en: Either connect the AC input to every unit in the system.
solutions.ur: Ya system ke har unit par AC input connect karein.

solutions.en: Or open VE.Bus System Configurator (not VEConfigure) and disable 'Switch as Group'.
solutions.ur: Ya VE.Bus System Configurator (VEConfigure nahi) kholein aur 'Switch as Group' disable karein.

solutions.en: Note that this setting cannot be changed inside an ESS system.
solutions.ur: Yaad rakhein ke ye setting ESS system ke andar change nahi ho sakti.

meaning.en: The system needs a dongle but none is present. Victron's own remedy is now simply to update the firmware, because VE.Bus dongles are no longer necessary.
meaning.ur: System ko dongle chahiye magar koi mojood nahi. Victron ka apna hal ab sirf firmware update hai, kyunke VE.Bus dongle ab zaroorat nahi rakhate.

causes.en: Dongle not fitted on an extended 4+ unit VE.Bus system
causes.ur: Extended 4+ unit VE.Bus system par dongle nahi lagaya hua

causes.en: Old firmware that still requires the dongle
causes.ur: Purana firmware jo abhi bhi dongle maangta hai

solutions.en: Connect the VE.Bus Smart Dongle to the VE.Bus port, then power-cycle the system.
solutions.ur: VE.Bus Smart Dongle ko VE.Bus port se connect karein, phir system ka power cycle karein.

solutions.en: Preferred fix per Victron: update all devices to the latest firmware, dongles are then unnecessary.
solutions.ur: Victron ke mutabiq behtareen hal: sab devices latest firmware par update karein, phir dongle ki zaroorat nahi.

meaning.en: Slaves only. Communication with the phase master timed out. This only occurs when there are multiple devices per phase, e.g. two or more in parallel on one phase.
meaning.ur: Sirf slaves par. Phase master se communication timeout ho gayi. Ye sirf tab hota hai jab aik phase par kai devices hon, maslan parallel mein do ya zyada.

causes.en: Cable-related communication issue on the VE.Bus network
causes.ur: VE.Bus network par cable se related communication masla

causes.en: Badly mounted RJ45 connectors preventing spring contact
causes.ur: Khulne se khanda RJ45 connectors jo spring contact nahi hone dete

causes.en: DC fuse blown in one or more units - system looks fine on mains but units drop off on loss of AC
causes.ur: Kisi aik ya kai units ka DC fuse ula hua - system par mains par theek lagta hai magar AC band hone par units nikal jate hain

causes.en: Outdated inverter/charger or GX device firmware
causes.ur: Purana inverter/charger ya GX device firmware

solutions.en: If seen while using Remote VEConfigure to write settings, ignore it - the system self-recovers.
solutions.ur: Agar Remote VEConfigure se settings likhte waqt aaye to ignore karein - system khud recover ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Check the network cable sockets first; then replace ALL network cables including the GX cable.
solutions.ur: Pehle network cable sockets check karein; phir GX cable samet sab network cables badal dein.

solutions.en: Inspect the female RJ45 sockets, not just the cable - crimped plugs often block the contacts.
solutions.ur: Female RJ45 sockets inspect karein, sirf cable nahi - crimped plugs aksar contacts rok dete hain.

solutions.en: Check the DC fuse in every unit and replace the blown one.
solutions.ur: Har unit ka DC fuse check karein aur ula hua fuse badal dein.

solutions.en: Update the inverter/charger firmware, then the Assistants, then the GX device firmware.
solutions.ur: Inverter/charger firmware update karein, phir Assistants, phir GX device firmware.

source.title: VE.Bus Error Codes - Victron Energy live wiki (PDF export)

codes.seriesName: VE.Bus Error Codes — official live wiki table (current-gen Multi / MultiPlus-II / EasySolar-II)

title.ur: Switch-over protection / back-feed relay trigger ho gaya

meaning.en: One or more units report current flowing through a backfeed relay that should be open. Either the relay did not open, or the current-measuring circuit is faulty. A very rare error.
meaning.ur: Kisi aik ya kai units report kar rahe hain ke backfeed relay se current beh raha hai jo band hona chahiye. Ya relay khula nahi, ya current measuring circuit kharab hai. Ye bohat rare error hai.

causes.en: Too much AC load at the moment the relay needs to open, holding the contacts shut
causes.ur: Relay ko khulne ke waqt bohat zyada AC load, jis se contacts band reh gaye

causes.en: AC input voltage sagging slowly (typically generator) so current rises past relay rating
causes.ur: AC input voltage dheere dheere girna (aam tor par generator), is se current relay rating se upar chala gaya

causes.en: Backfeed relay hardware failure
causes.ur: Backfeed relay ki hardware failure

causes.en: Related current measurement circuit faulty
causes.ur: Mudiyda current measurement circuit kharab

solutions.en: Remove the excessive load; check the transfer switch capacity in the datasheet.
solutions.ur: Bhaari load hata dein; datasheet mein transfer switch capacity check karein.

solutions.en: In VEConfigure 3 increase the lower limit of AC input voltage, e.g. to 210 VAC. Factory setting is 180 VAC.
solutions.ur: VEConfigure 3 mein AC input voltage ka lower limit barhaayein, maslan 210 VAC. Factory setting 180 VAC hai.

solutions.en: If load and settings are ruled out, the relay or current sensing is faulty - replace the unit.
solutions.ur: Agar load aur settings out of the picture hain to relay ya current sensing kharab hai - unit badal dein.

solutions.en: To find WHICH unit: film all units, then ohmmeter AC-in vs AC-out. A good unit shows no continuity in; a bad unit reads near zero ohms.
solutions.ur: Kaunsa unit kharab hai ye dhoondne ke liye: sab units ki video banayein, phir AC-in aur AC-out ke darmiyan ohmmeter lagayein. Theek unit mein continuity nahi; kharab unit zero ke qareeb ohm dikhata hai.

codes.seriesName: VE.Bus OK codes — non-fault status indications (Multi / Quattro family)

title.en: OK code - bulk LED flashing (inverter ready)
title.ur: OK code - bulk LED flash (inverter tayyar hai)

meaning.en: This unit is healthy and CAN run as an inverter, but the system is held back because another unit is in error. Not a fault on this unit.
meaning.ur: Ye unit theek hai aur inverter ki tarah chal sakta hai, magar system dusre unit ki error ki wajah se rukka hua hai. Ye is unit ki fault nahi hai.

causes.en: A different unit in the same VE.Bus group is reporting an error
causes.ur: Usi VE.Bus group ka koi doosra unit error dikha raha hai

causes.en: The unit is not currently in inverter or charging operation
causes.ur: Unit abhi inverter ya charging mode mein nahi hai

solutions.en: Do NOT service this unit. Walk the group and find the unit NOT showing an OK code.
solutions.ur: Is unit ki servicing na karein. Group mein ghoom kar woh unit dhoondein jo OK code nahi dikha raha.

solutions.en: On that unit read which alarm LED is lit and use the matching row in the LED indication series.
solutions.ur: Us unit par dekhein kaun sa alarm LED on hai aur LED indication series ki us row ko dekhein.

solutions.en: Once the faulty unit is fixed this OK code disappears and the system starts normally.
solutions.ur: Kharab unit theek hone par ye OK code ghayab ho jata hai aur system normal chal padta hai.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.3.1 VE.Bus OK codes

codes.seriesName: VE.Bus OK codes — non-fault status indications (Multi / Quattro family)

title.en: OK code - float LED flashing (charger ready)
title.ur: OK code - float LED flash (charger tayyar hai)

meaning.en: This unit is healthy and CAN charge, but the system is held back because another unit is in error. Not a fault on this unit.
meaning.ur: Ye unit theek hai aur charge kar sakta hai, magar system dusre unit ki error ki wajah se rukka hua hai. Ye is unit ki fault nahi hai.

causes.en: A different unit in the same VE.Bus group is reporting an error
causes.ur: Usi VE.Bus group ka koi doosra unit error dikha raha hai

causes.en: The unit is not currently in inverter or charging operation
causes.ur: Unit abhi inverter ya charging mode mein nahi hai

solutions.en: Do NOT service this unit - it is reporting a healthy state.
solutions.ur: Is unit ki servicing na karein - ye apni healthy state bata raha hai.

solutions.en: Find the unit in the group that is NOT showing an OK code; that is the one to investigate.
solutions.ur: Group mein woh unit dhoondein jo OK code nahi dikha raha; usi ki investigation karein.

solutions.en: Note: the 'low battery' LED may show together with this code - that still does not block charging.
solutions.ur: Yaad rakhein ke 'low battery' LED is code ke saath bhi aa sakta hai - phir bhi charging block nahi hoti.

source.title: Quattro Manual (firmware xxxx400 or higher) - ch. 7.3.1 VE.Bus OK codes

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

title.ur: Island ka pata chala, system band (1004)

meaning.en: The inverter detected unintentional islanding (stand-alone operation) and stopped grid power feed operation.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne galti se island (stand-alone) chalna detect kar liya aur grid se feed-in band kar diya.

causes.en: Grid failure or a part of the grid is disconnected from the utility supply.
causes.ur: Grid failure ya grid ka koi hissa utility se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Generation and load (active and reactive) are balanced, so AC voltage and frequency stay inside the limits and the island is not cleared.
causes.ur: Generation aur load (active aur reactive) aik taraf balance mein hain, is liye AC voltage aur frequency limit ke andar reh jate hain aur island khud clear nahi hota.

solutions.en: Measure AC voltage and frequency at the inverter AC terminals with a multimeter; expect 230 V +/-10% and 50 Hz in AT/EU setups.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke AC terminals par multimeter se AC voltage aur frequency check karein; AT/EU setup mein 230 V +/-10% aur 50 Hz expect karein.

solutions.en: Check the main AC breaker and the utility supply before restarting; restore grid power and let the inverter reconnect.
solutions.ur: Restart se pehle main AC breaker aur utility supply check karein; grid power wapas karein aur inverter ko reconnect hone dein.

solutions.en: Do not defeat or bypass the islanding detection - it is required by the grid code and by the country setup.
solutions.ur: Islanding detection ko disable ya bypass na karein - ye country setup aur grid code ke liye zaroori hai.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

title.ur: Arc fault mila, feed-in ruk gaya (1006)

meaning.en: A serial arc was detected on the DC side. With Arc Fault Detection (AFD) and the Circuit Interrupter (CI) set to On, the inverter interrupts grid power feed operation.
meaning.ur: DC side par serial arc detect hua. Arc Fault Detection (AFD) aur Circuit Interrupter (CI) On hone par inverter grid feed-in rok deta hai.

causes.en: Loose, corroded or burnt DC connector (MC4 / strain-relieved plug) with a high-resistance contact.
causes.ur: DC connector (MC4) loose, zang lage ya jale hue aur contact resistance zyada hone se.

causes.en: DC cable insulation damaged by UV, heat, rodents or mechanical abrasion.
causes.ur: UV, garmi, chuhe ya mechanical rubbing se DC cable ki insulation kharab ho jana.

causes.en: Cracked PV module cell, damaged bypass diode or damaged module junction box.
causes.ur: PV module ki cell crack, bypass diode kharab ya module ka junction box damaged.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker, then the integrated DC disconnector, and confirm the inverter is dead before touching any DC connector.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karein, phir inverter ka DC disconnector off karein, aur koi bhi DC connector chhoone se pehle verify karein ke inverter dead hai.

solutions.en: Inspect every DC connector and string cable in daylight; look for blackening, melting, green corrosion or a loose click. Replace burnt connectors - do not just re-tighten.
solutions.ur: Har DC connector aur string cable ko roshni mein dekhein; kaala pan, pighalan, hari zang ya dheela click dhoondein. Jale connector badal dein - sirf tighten na karein.

solutions.en: With DC isolated, measure insulation resistance of each string to earth with a Riso/megger tester (1000 V DC test voltage); a healthy string reads in the megaohm range. A low reading means replace the affected cable or module.
solutions.ur: DC isolate kar ke, har string ka earth ke saath insulation resistance Riso/megger se 1000 V DC test voltage par check karein; healthy string megaohm range mein read karta hai. Low reading aaye to affected cable ya module badal dein.

solutions.en: If more arcs are found than the Automatic Reconnects value allows in 24 h, state 1173 appears instead - see SERIES 2 / SERIES 3.
solutions.ur: Agar 24 ghante mein Automatic Reconnects se zyada arc mil jayein to 1173 aata hai - SERIES 2 / SERIES 3 dekhein.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

title.ur: Arc detector ka self-test fail hua (1009)

meaning.en: The integrated self-test of the arc-fault detection failed, so the inverter stopped grid power feed operation.
meaning.ur: Arc-fault detection ka built-in self-test fail ho gaya, is liye inverter ne grid feed-in band kar diya.

causes.en: Hardware fault in the arc-detection (AFCI) circuit, often the DC current sensor used by arc detection.
causes.ur: Arc-detection (AFCI) circuit mein hardware fault, aksar arc detection ka istemal karne wala DC current sensor.

causes.en: Persistent arc on the DC side that the self-test keeps detecting.
causes.ur: DC side par lagatar arc jo self-test ko detect karwata rehta hai.

solutions.en: Do a full AC/DC reset: switch off AC breaker, then DC, wait until the inverter is completely dark (~30 s), then switch AC and DC back on so the self-test re-runs.
solutions.ur: Poora AC/DC reset karein: AC breaker off, phir DC off, inverter poori tarah dark hone dein (~30 s), phir AC aur DC wapas on karein taake self-test dobara chale.

solutions.en: With DC isolated, check the AFCI board and the arc-detection current sensor cable for looseness or damage at the string inputs.
solutions.ur: DC isolate kar ke, AFCI board aur arc-detection current sensor ka cable check karein ke string inputs par loose ya damaged to nahi.

solutions.en: If the self-test fails again after a clean reset and a full DC inspection, the arc-detection module needs Fronius service - it is not an installer-replaceable item.
solutions.ur: Clean reset aur poore DC inspection ke baad bhi self-test fail ho to arc-detection module Fronius service ke liye hai - ye installer khud nahi badal sakta.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

meaning.en: The grid frequency exceeded an overfrequency limit, so the inverter is treated as being in a grid fault and will not feed in until frequency is back in range.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency overfrequency limit se upar chali gayi, is liye inverter grid fault maanta hai aur frequency wapas range mein aane tak feed-in nahi karega.

causes.en: Grid frequency above the country-setup overfrequency limit (inner, outer or alternative limit).
causes.ur: Country setup ka overfrequency limit se grid frequency zyada hai (inner, outer ya alternative limit).

causes.en: Large generator, CHP unit or neighbouring load pulling the local grid frequency up.
causes.ur: Bara generator, CHP unit ya paas ka bada load local grid frequency upar le gaya.

solutions.en: Measure grid frequency at the inverter AC terminals with a clamp meter; confirm it is inside the country-setup band before touching anything else.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se inverter ke AC terminals par grid frequency measure karein; country setup ki limit ke andar hai ya nahi pehle ye confirm karein.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid to normalise, then let the inverter pass its grid monitoring time and reconnect on its own - no intervention is required.
solutions.ur: Grid normal hone dein, phir inverter ko apna grid monitoring time poora karne dein aur wo khud reconnect ho jayega - koi kaam zaroori nahi.

solutions.en: If the frequency is persistently out of band only at your site, ask the utility to check the local network and the country setup with the installer.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf aapke site par frequency baar baar out of band ho to utility se local network check karwayein aur installer ke saath country setup verify karein.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

meaning.en: The grid frequency fell below an underfrequency limit; the inverter will not feed in until the frequency is back in the permitted range.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency underfrequency limit se neeche gir gaya; frequency wapas permitted range mein aane tak inverter feed-in nahi karega.

causes.en: Grid frequency below the country-setup underfrequency limit (inner, outer or alternative limit).
causes.ur: Country setup ka underfrequency limit se grid frequency kam hai (inner, outer ya alternative limit).

causes.en: Inverter is running on islanded / weak grid supply, or a large motor load is starting on the same feeder.
causes.ur: Inverter island ya kamzor grid par chal raha hai, ya usi feeder par koi bara motor start ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Measure grid frequency at the AC terminals with a clamp meter; it should be 50 Hz +/- the country-setup tolerance in AT/EU.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se AC terminals par grid frequency measure karein; AT/EU mein 50 Hz +/- country setup tolerance hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Check the main AC breaker and the utility supply, then allow the inverter to complete its grid monitoring time and reconnect automatically.
solutions.ur: Main AC breaker aur utility supply check karein, phir inverter ko grid monitoring time poora karne dein taake wo khud reconnect ho jaye.

solutions.en: Do not change the country setup frequency limits yourself; they may only be adjusted by an authorised installer with the utility's approval.
solutions.ur: Country setup ki frequency limits apne aap na badlein; ye sirf authorised installer utility ki ijazat se badal sakta hai.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

meaning.en: The DC component of the injected AC current exceeded the configured absolute or relative limit, so grid power feed operation was interrupted.
meaning.ur: Injected AC current ka DC component configured absolute ya relative limit se zyada ho gaya, is liye grid feed-in rok diya gaya.

causes.en: Insulation / earth fault on the DC side feeding a DC offset into the AC output through the EMI filter capacitors.
causes.ur: DC side par insulation ya earth fault jo EMI filter capacitors ke zariye AC output mein DC offset daal raha hai.

causes.en: A DC-side device (optimizer, combiner, datalogger) leaking DC current to earth.
causes.ur: DC side ka koi device (optimizer, combiner, datalogger) earth mein DC current leak kar raha hai.

causes.en: Faulty EMI filter capacitor bank in the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter ka EMI filter capacitor bank kharab.

solutions.en: Open the AC breaker and the DC disconnector and confirm de-energised with a suitable measuring device before probing.
solutions.ur: Probe karne se pehle AC breaker aur DC disconnector kholein aur suitable measuring device se de-energised confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure DC insulation resistance string by string to earth with a Riso/megger tester; isolate optimizers/combiners one by one to find the leaking device.
solutions.ur: Riso/megger se har string ka earth ke saath DC insulation resistance nikaalein; optimizer/combiner ko ek ek karke isolate karke leaking device dhoondein.

solutions.en: If insulation is good everywhere but 1052 repeats, the inverter's DC injection monitoring is reporting a hardware fault - log the code and escalate to Fronius service.
solutions.ur: Agar insulation har jagah theek ho lekin 1055 dohra rahe to inverter ka DC injection monitoring hardware fault bata raha hai - code note karein aur Fronius service ko dein.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

title.en: RCMU fault current, no reconnect left (1076)
title.ur: RCMU fault current, reconnect baqi nahi (1076)

meaning.en: The residual current monitoring unit detected more fault currents in 24 hours than the Automatic Reconnects value allows. The inverter will not attempt to restart and the code must be acknowledged manually.
meaning.ur: RCMU ne 24 ghante mein Automatic Reconnects se zyada fault current detect kiya. Inverter dobara start ki koshish nahi karega aur code manually acknowledge karna hoga.

causes.en: Insulation fault on the PV array, DC wiring or inside the inverter that repeatedly produces a residual current above 300 mA.
causes.ur: PV array, DC wiring ya inverter ke andar insulation fault jo baar baar 300 mA se upar residual current banata hai.

causes.en: A wet or water-damaged junction box, module back sheet or cable gland after rain or cleaning.
causes.ur: Barish ya dhoane ke baad geela ya paani se kharab junction box, module back sheet ya cable gland.

solutions.en: Do not just acknowledge the code. Isolate AC and DC, then measure insulation resistance of each string to earth with a Riso/megger and find the leaking section first.
solutions.ur: Sirf code acknowledge na karein. AC aur DC isolate karein, phir Riso/megger se har string ka earth ke saath insulation resistance nikaal kar leaking hissa pehle dhoondein.

solutions.en: Open and inspect every junction box and combiner: look for water ingress, corrosion, burned contacts and damaged insulation. Dry, clean or replace as needed.
solutions.ur: Har junction box aur combiner khol kar dekhein: paani ka ghusa hua, zang, jale contact aur damaged insulation dekhein. Sukhayein, saaf karein ya badlein.

solutions.en: After the insulation fault is repaired and confirmed, clear the code on the inverter user interface (System > Event Log) and let the RCMU pass its 24 h counter again.
solutions.ur: Insulation fault theek aur confirm hone ke baad, inverter user interface (System > Event Log) par code clear karein aur RCMU ka 24 ghanta counter dobara chalne dein.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

meaning.en: The measured insulation resistance at the DC terminals fell below the Isolation Error Threshold, so grid power feed operation was prevented.
meaning.ur: DC terminals par measured insulation resistance Isolation Error Threshold se neeche gir gaya, is liye grid feed-in rok diya gaya.

causes.en: Insulation breakdown on a DC string: damaged cable, aged module laminate or a wet connector.
causes.ur: DC string par insulation kharab: damaged cable, purana module laminate ya geela connector.

causes.en: Module or string connected with reversed polarity, so the frame sits at a different potential.
causes.ur: Module ya string ulti polarity se lage hua, is liye frame alag potential par hai.

causes.en: DC side not properly bonded to earth, so the measured value to earth reads low.
causes.ur: DC side ka earth se proper bond nahi, is liye earth ke saath measured value kam aa raha hai.

solutions.en: Open AC breaker and DC disconnector, then measure insulation resistance to earth string by string with a Riso/megger (1000 V test voltage) to localise the fault.
solutions.ur: AC breaker aur DC disconnector kholein, phir Riso/megger se 1000 V test voltage par har string ka earth ke saath insulation resistance nikaal kar fault ki jagah dhoondein.

solutions.en: Check DC polarity and string fusing at the combiner before condemning any cable - a swapped string reads as an insulation fault.
solutions.ur: Kisi cable ko kharab kehne se pehle combiner par DC polarity aur string fusing check karein - ulti lagay hui string bhi insulation fault jaisi lagti hai.

solutions.en: Look for moisture: dry connectors, re-seat the MC4 plugs fully, and replace any cable or module with chafed, cracked or water-damaged insulation.
solutions.ur: Nami dhoondein: connector sukhaayein, MC4 plugs ko poora baithayein, aur chafed, crack ya paani se kharab insulation wala cable ya module badal dein.

notes.en: The same manual states the isolation error code twice: once as 1082 (prose, chapter 'Isolation monitoring') and once as 1182 (parameter table, same chapter). Both are carried; 1182 is flagged low confidence. See CONFLICTS.
notes.ur: Yehi manual isolation error code do baar likhta hai: ek baar 1082 (chapter 'Isolation monitoring' ki prose mein) aur ek baar 1182 (usi chapter ki parameter table mein). Dono rakhe gaye hain; 1182 low confidence hai. CONFLICTS dekhein.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

title.ur: Isolation warning, insulation limit se kam (1083)

meaning.en: The measured isolation value fell below the adjustable Isolation Warning Threshold. Fronius raises a warning but does not shut down feed-in.
meaning.ur: Measured isolation value adjustable Isolation Warning Threshold se neeche gira. Fronius warning deta hai lekin feed-in band nahi karta.

causes.en: Early-stage insulation degradation from moisture ingress or UV-damaged cable insulation.
causes.ur: Nami ya UV damage se insulation ki shuruaati beesi.
