causes.en: Warning threshold set too close to the measured normal value for the site.
causes.ur: Site ke liye warning threshold measured normal value ke bahut qareeb set ki gayi hai.

solutions.en: Log the value now and trend it; if it keeps falling towards 1082, plan the DC inspection before the inverter stops producing.
solutions.ur: Value abhi note karein aur uska trend dekhein; agar 1082 ki taraf girta rahe to inverter band hone se pehle DC inspection karwa lein.

solutions.en: With DC isolated, do a Riso/megger test per string and clean or dry any connector that shows a low reading.
solutions.ur: DC isolate kar ke, har string ka Riso/megger test karein aur kam reading wala koi bhi connector saaf ya sukha dein.

solutions.en: Ask the installer to review the Isolation Warning Threshold; do not raise it just to silence the warning.
solutions.ur: Installer se Isolation Warning Threshold dobara check karwayein; sirf warning chupane ke liye ise barha na dein.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

meaning.en: The mains voltage exceeded an overvoltage limit (inner, middle or outer limit) for longer than its protection time, so the inverter shut down and will not feed in.
meaning.ur: Mains voltage apne protection time se zyada der ke liye overvoltage limit (inner, middle ya outer) se upar raha, is liye inverter band ho gaya aur feed-in nahi karega.

causes.en: Grid voltage genuinely too high for the configured country setup, e.g. a long lightly-loaded feeder at the end of the day.
causes.ur: Configured country setup ke liye grid voltage waqai zyada hai, jaise din ke aakhir mein halka load aur lamba feeder.

causes.en: Incorrect or missing country setup after a device replacement or a site move.
causes.ur: Device badalne ya site shift ke baad galat ya missing country setup.

causes.en: Inverter AC voltage measurement or relay measurement fault reporting a false high.
causes.ur: Inverter ka AC voltage measurement ya relay measurement fault jis se ghalat high reading aaye.

solutions.en: Measure the true grid voltage at the inverter AC terminals and at the site distribution board with a true-RMS multimeter.
solutions.ur: True-RMS multimeter se inverter ke AC terminals aur site distribution board par asal grid voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Compare the reading with the country-setup overvoltage limit; if the grid is inside the limit but 1114 repeats, suspect a voltage-measurement fault and log the code for Fronius service.
solutions.ur: Reading ko country setup ke overvoltage limit se milayein; agar grid limit ke andar hai lekin 1114 dohra rahe to voltage-measurement fault ka shak karein aur code Fronius service ke liye note karein.

solutions.en: For genuinely high grid voltage, run a large local load (AC / pool pump) during peak PV hours to bring the voltage at the inverter terminals down - confirm with the utility and installer first.
solutions.ur: Agar grid voltage waqai zyada hai to peak PV hours mein bara local load (AC / pool pump) chala kar inverter terminals par voltage kam karein - pehle utility aur installer se confirm karein.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

title.en: Grid voltage too high, fast cut-out 1 (1115)
title.ur: Grid voltage bohat zyada, fast cut-out 1 (1115)

meaning.en: The fast overvoltage protection (peak value above 135% of rated voltage) triggered and the inverter disconnected from the grid.
meaning.ur: Fast overvoltage protection (rated voltage ke 135% se upar peak value) trigger hua aur inverter grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Voltage transient / surge on the AC line, e.g. from a lightning strike or a large motor or transformer being switched in the area.
causes.ur: AC line par voltage transient ya surge, jaise lightning strike ya area mein koi bara motor ya transformer on hone se.

causes.en: Surge protection device (SPD) on the AC side has operated or the AC connection is loose.
causes.ur: AC side ka surge protection device (SPD) chala ho ya AC connection dheela ho.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC and check the AC surge protective devices and the AC connection terminals for heat damage or a loose conductor.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC isolate kar ke AC surge protective devices aur AC connection terminals par garmi ka nishan ya dheela conductor check karein.

solutions.en: Check that the PE / earth conductor is properly bonded to the inverter ground electrode terminal, so transients are diverted instead of entering the electronics.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke PE / earth conductor inverter ke ground electrode terminal se achi tarah bond hai, taake transient electronics mein jaane ke bajaye bypass ho jaye.

solutions.en: If the transients repeat, fit a Type 2 SPD on the AC side as designed by the installer and have the surge event investigated.
solutions.ur: Agar transients dohra rahein to installer ke design ke mutabiq AC side par Type 2 SPD lagwayein aur surge event ki investigation karwayein.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

title.en: Grid voltage too high, fast cut-out 2 (1116)
title.ur: Grid voltage bohat zyada, fast cut-out 2 (1116)

meaning.en: Second fast overvoltage trip state, used together with 1115 when the fast surge protection (>135%) responds on reconnect or on a further spike.
meaning.ur: Doosra fast overvoltage trip state, jo 1115 ke saath aata hai jab fast surge protection (>135%) reconnect par ya aik aur spike par respond kare.

causes.en: Same surge cause as 1115, recorded on the reconnect attempt rather than during running operation.
causes.ur: 1115 jaisa hi surge ka wajaub, magar reconnect ki koshish par record hua, chalte hue nahi.

causes.en: Grid still above the fast-overvoltage threshold when the inverter tried to reconnect.
causes.ur: Jab inverter reconnect karna chahta tha tab bhi grid fast-overvoltage threshold se upar tha.

solutions.en: Wait until the grid settles, then allow the inverter to complete its reconnection monitoring time before the next attempt.
solutions.ur: Grid settle hone dein, phir next koshish se pehle inverter ko apna reconnection monitoring time poora karne dein.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage and check the AC SPD and earth bonding as for 1115 - the two codes share the same cause.
solutions.ur: 1115 ki tarah grid voltage measure karein aur AC SPD aur earth bonding check karein - dono codes ka wajaub ek hi hai.

solutions.en: Do not raise the Fast Overvoltage Disconnect threshold; it is a safety protection defined by the applicable standard.
solutions.ur: Fast Overvoltage Disconnect threshold barha na dein; ye applicable standard ke mutabiq safety protection hai.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

title.ur: Lambi arse ka mains voltage limit se upar (1117)

meaning.en: The moving average mains voltage exceeded the Long Time Average Limit over the configured averaging time, so the inverter disconnected.
meaning.ur: Moving average mains voltage configured averaging time ke dauran Long Time Average Limit se upar chala gaya, is liye inverter disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Sustained grid overvoltage over hours - typical on a long, lightly loaded feeder with high PV export.
causes.ur: Ghanton tak grid overvoltage - lamba, halka load wala feeder jahan PV export zyada ho, aam tor par yehi hota hai.

causes.en: Feed-in limit set too high, or export limitation not configured for the connection.
causes.ur: Feed-in limit bahut zyada set hai, ya export limitation connection ke liye configure nahi hai.

causes.en: Smart Meter not installed, so voltage control at the feed-in point cannot be done.
causes.ur: Smart Meter installed nahi hai, is liye feed-in point par voltage control nahi ho sakta.

solutions.en: Record the time of day this appears; if it is always around midday, treat it as a grid-voltage / export issue rather than an inverter fault.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke ye din ka kis waqt aata hai; agar hamesha dopahar ke aas paas aata hai to ise inverter fault nahi balki grid-voltage / export masla samajhein.

solutions.en: Log the average voltage value and ask the utility / installer for a voltage assessment of the local network.
solutions.ur: Average voltage value note karein aur utility / installer se local network ka voltage assessment karwayein.

solutions.en: Run a high-draw appliance (air conditioner, pool pump) during peak PV hours to pull the voltage at the inverter terminals down, and ask the installer to review the feed-in limit and volt-watt response settings.
solutions.ur: Peak PV hours mein bara load wala appliance (air conditioner, pool pump) chala kar inverter terminals par voltage kam karein, aur installer se feed-in limit aur volt-watt response settings dobara check karwayein.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

meaning.en: The mains voltage fell below an undervoltage limit (inner, middle or outer) for longer than its protection time, so the inverter shut down and stopped feed-in.
meaning.ur: Mains voltage apne protection time se zyada der ke liye undervoltage limit (inner, middle ya outer) se neeche gir gaya, is liye inverter band ho kar feed-in chhorr diya.

causes.en: Grid voltage sagging because of a heavy local load or a fault somewhere on the feeder.
causes.ur: Bara local load ya feeder par kisi jagah fault ki wajah se grid voltage gir raha hai.

causes.en: AC breaker has tripped, or an AC connection / neutral conductor is loose.
causes.ur: AC breaker trip ho gaya hai, ya AC connection ya neutral conductor dheela hai.

causes.en: Wrong country setup after reinstallation, so the undervoltage limits do not match the actual grid.
causes.ur: Reinstallation ke baad galat country setup, is liye undervoltage limits asal grid se match nahi karte.

solutions.en: Check the AC breaker is fully on and the neutral conductor is tight at the inverter and at the distribution board.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke AC breaker poori tarah on hai aur neutral conductor inverter aur distribution board dono par kasa hua hai.

solutions.en: Measure AC voltage at the inverter terminals during the event; if the distribution board reads normal while the inverter reads low, suspect a long or thin AC cable run and check its voltage drop.
solutions.ur: Event ke dauran inverter terminals par AC voltage measure karein; agar distribution board par normal aur inverter par kam ho to lamba ya patla AC cable ka shak karein aur uska voltage drop check karein.

solutions.en: If it only happens when a large appliance starts, have the installer review the country setup undervoltage limits with the utility instead of raising them yourself.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf bade appliance start hone par hota hai to installer se utility ke saath mil kar country setup ki undervoltage limits dobara check karwayein, khud barha na dein.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

title.en: Arc fault, no automatic reconnect left (1173)
title.ur: Arc fault, automatic reconnect baqi nahi (1173)

meaning.en: After an arc shutdown the inverter used up its allowed automatic restarts within 24 hours (Automatic Reconnects), so it stopped trying and the code must be acknowledged manually.
meaning.ur: Arc shutdown ke baad inverter ne 24 ghante mein apne automatic reconnects istemal kar liye, is liye wo koshish chhorr diya aur code manually acknowledge karna hoga.

causes.en: A real serial arc on the DC side that repeats every time the inverter tries to restart.
causes.ur: DC side par asal serial arc jo har restart ki koshish par dohra rehta hai.

causes.en: The same damaged connector or cable re-arcs after every automatic reconnection attempt.
causes.ur: Wahi damaged connector ya cable har automatic reconnection ke baad dobara arc kar deta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC and carry out a full inspection of the affected PV system before acknowledging - Fronius explicitly requires this.
solutions.ur: Acknowledge karne se pehle AC aur DC isolate kar ke poore affected PV system ka inspection karein - Fronius yeh zaroori maanta hai.

solutions.en: Inspect DC connectors, cable runs, module junction boxes and the DC disconnect for burnt, melted, loose or water-damaged parts and replace them.
solutions.ur: DC connectors, cable runs, module junction boxes aur DC disconnect ke jale, pighle, dheele ya paani se kharab hisson ko dekhein aur badlein.

solutions.en: Once the arc cause is fixed and insulation is confirmed, acknowledge the status on the inverter (System > Event Log, or the Notifications user menu) - on Primo GEN24 the 3-second optical-sensor press also acknowledges it.
solutions.ur: Jab arc ka wajaub theek ho aur insulation confirm ho jaye, code inverter par acknowledge karein (System > Event Log, ya Notifications user menu) - Primo GEN24 par optical sensor ko 3 second daba kar bhi acknowledge hota hai.

notes.en: Same fault family as 1006. The Primo GEN24 operating instructions also document 1173 with the name 'ArcContinuousFault' - see SERIES 3.
notes.ur: Wahi fault family jo 1006 hai. Primo GEN24 operating instructions bhi 1173 ko 'ArcContinuousFault' naam se likhte hain - SERIES 3 dekhein.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

title.ur: Parameter table ke mutabiq isolation error (1182)

meaning.en: Listed in the Isolation Error Threshold row of the Country Setup manual as the code shown when measured insulation is below the configured threshold.
meaning.ur: Country Setup manual ke Isolation Error Threshold row mein ye code likha hai jo insulation threshold se kam hone par dikhta hai.

causes.en: Same physical cause as the insulation error: insulation breakdown or moisture on the DC side.
causes.ur: Isolation error ka wahi physical wajaub: DC side par insulation kharabi ya nami.

causes.en: Possible documentation inconsistency - the same manual names this condition 1082 elsewhere.
causes.ur: Yeh documentation ki inconsistency ho sakti hai - wahi manual ise jagah 1082 ke naam se bhi likhta hai.

solutions.en: Treat it as the insulation error and follow the isolation test procedure: AC/DC isolated, Riso/megger per string, localise the leaking section.
solutions.ur: Ise isolation error samajhein aur isolation test tareeqa follow karein: AC/DC isolate, har string ka Riso/megger, leaking hissa dhoondein.

solutions.en: Record the exact code shown on the inverter, because Fronius documentation itself uses both 1082 and 1182 for the insulation error.
solutions.ur: Inverter par jo code exactly dikha usay note karein, kyunke Fronius documentation khud insulation error ke liye 1082 aur 1182 dono istemal karta hai.

notes.en: CONFLICT: the same official manual states the isolation error as 1082 in the prose ('Isolation monitoring' chapter) and as 1182 in the 'Isolation Error Threshold' parameter table. Both are recorded; 1082 is treated as primary because it is the value used in the running text. Do not treat 1182 and 1082 as two different faults.
notes.ur: CONFLICT: wahi official manual isolation error ko prose ('Isolation monitoring' chapter) mein 1082 aur 'Isolation Error Threshold' parameter table mein 1182 likhta hai. Dono record kiye gaye; 1082 primary maana gaya kyunke wahi running text mein istemal hua. 1182 aur 1082 ko do alag faults na samajhein.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

title.ur: Parameter table ke mutabiq isolation warning (1183)

meaning.en: Listed in the Isolation Warning Threshold row as the code shown when measured insulation is below the warning threshold.
meaning.ur: Isolation Warning Threshold row mein ye code likha hai jo insulation warning threshold se kam hone par dikhta hai.

causes.en: Same physical cause as the isolation warning: early insulation degradation or moisture on the DC side.
causes.ur: Isolation warning ka wahi physical wajaub: DC side par insulation ki shuruaati beesi ya nami.

causes.en: Possible documentation inconsistency - the same manual names this warning 1083 elsewhere.
causes.ur: Yeh documentation ki inconsistency ho sakti hai - wahi manual yeh warning jagah 1083 ke naam se bhi likhta hai.

solutions.en: Trend the value and, if it is falling, run a Riso/megger test per string with DC isolated before the inverter escalates to an isolation error.
solutions.ur: Value ka trend dekhein, aur gir rahi ho to inverter isolation error par jane se pehle DC isolate kar ke har string ka Riso/megger test karein.

solutions.en: Record the exact code from the inverter event log, because Fronius documentation uses both 1083 and 1183 for the isolation warning.
solutions.ur: Inverter event log se exact code note karein, kyunke Fronius documentation isolation warning ke liye 1083 aur 1183 dono istemal karta hai.

notes.en: CONFLICT: mirrors the 1083 / 1182 documentation inconsistency in the same manual - the Isolation Warning Threshold row names the code 1183 while the running text names it 1083. Not a separate fault from 1083.
notes.ur: CONFLICT: wahi manual ki 1083 / 1182 documentation inconsistency ka mirror - Isolation Warning Threshold row code 1183 likhta hai jabke running text 1083 likhta hai. 1083 se alag fault nahi.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

title.ur: Arc Fault Detection band kar diya (1184)

meaning.en: Arc Fault Detection (AFD) is set to 'Off (with Warning)', so arcs are not being detected and this code stays permanently on the user interface.
meaning.ur: Arc Fault Detection (AFD) 'Off (with Warning)' par set hai, is liye arcs detect nahi ho rahe aur ye code user interface par hamesha rehta hai.

causes.en: Installer selected 'Off (with Warning)' because an external arc-monitoring device is fitted on the PV system.
causes.ur: Installer ne 'Off (with Warning)' chuna hai kyunke PV system par external arc-monitoring device laga hua hai.

causes.en: AFD genuinely disabled, so the inverter has no internal arc protection.
causes.ur: AFD waqai band hai, is liye inverter ke paas koi internal arc protection nahi hai.

solutions.en: Confirm with the installer whether an external arc-fault interrupter is actually installed and commissioned; if not, have AFD set to On.
solutions.ur: Installer se confirm karein ke kya external arc-fault interrupter waqai laga aur commission hua hai; agar nahi to AFD On karwayein.

solutions.en: While AFD is off, do not dismiss DC arcing risk - keep the same connector and cable inspection discipline as for state 1006.
solutions.ur: Jab tak AFD off hai, DC arcing risk ko halke mein na lein - state 1006 jaisa hi connector aur cable inspection routine rakhein.

notes.en: Configuration warning, not a fault. With AFD On the arc shutdown is state 1006; if the arc shuts down too many times, state 1173.
notes.ur: Configuration warning, fault nahi. AFD On hone par arc shutdown state 1006 hai; zyada arc hone par 1173 aata hai.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

meaning.en: The Arc Fault Circuit Interrupter (CI) is set to 'Off (with Warning)', so a detected arc will not shut the inverter down and this code stays permanently on the user interface.
meaning.ur: Arc Fault Circuit Interrupter (CI) 'Off (with Warning)' par set hai, is liye detect hua arc inverter band nahi karega aur ye code hamesha rehta hai.

causes.en: Installer disabled the interrupter because an external arc-detection device is responsible for shutting down.
causes.ur: Installer ne interrupter is liye band kiya kyunke shutdown ka kaam external arc-detection device karta hai.

causes.en: Arc detection is active (AFD On, diagnostic only) but nothing interrupts on an arc.
causes.ur: Arc detection active hai (AFD On, sirf diagnostic) lekin arc par kuch interrupt nahi karta.

solutions.en: Verify that an external arc-fault interrupter is fitted, wired and tested; if the site relies on the inverter, set CI to On.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke external arc-fault interrupter laga, wired aur test hua hai; agar site inverter par depend karti hai to CI On karein.

solutions.en: Check the Arc Logging and Automatic Reconnects settings so a real arc still ends in a visible, logged event rather than being silently ignored.
solutions.ur: Arc Logging aur Automatic Reconnects settings check karein taake asal arc bhi visible aur logged event bane, khamoshi se ignore na ho.

notes.en: Configuration warning, not a fault. With CI On a detected arc produces state 1006.
notes.ur: Configuration warning, fault nahi. CI On hone par detect hua arc state 1006 deta hai.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

meaning.en: The residual current monitoring unit protective function is set to 'Off (with Warning)', so the inverter no longer disconnects on residual current and this code stays permanently displayed.
meaning.ur: RCMU protective function 'Off (with Warning)' par set hai, is liye inverter ab residual current par disconnect nahi hota aur ye code hamesha dikhta hai.

causes.en: Installer switched RCMU off because of repeated nuisance RCMU trips on this site.
causes.ur: Installer ne RCMU is liye band kiya kyunke is site par baar baar nuisance RCMU trips aate thay.

causes.en: RCMU actually defective, so it was disabled to keep the system producing.
causes.ur: RCMU waqai kharab hai, is liye system chalta rahe is liye band kar diya gaya.

solutions.en: Find and fix the residual current source: isolate DC and measure insulation resistance per string with a Riso/megger, and inspect junction boxes, cables and AC RCD/RCD-O for nuisance tripping.
solutions.ur: Residual current ka source dhoondein aur theek karein: DC isolate kar ke har string ka Riso/megger se insulation resistance nikaalein, aur junction boxes, cables aur AC RCD ko nuisance tripping ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: If no insulation fault is found, have the RCMU tested and replaced by Fronius service, then set RCMU back to On - do not leave a PV system permanently unprotected from residual current.
solutions.ur: Agar koi insulation fault na mile to RCMU ko test karwayein aur Fronius service se badalwayein, phir RCMU wapas On karein - PV system ko residual current se hamesha bacha kar na chhodein.

notes.en: Configuration warning, not a fault. With RCMU On, exceeding the allowed number of fault currents in 24 h produces state 1076.
notes.ur: Configuration warning, fault nahi. RCMU On hone par 24 ghante mein allowed fault current se zyada hone par state 1076 aata hai.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 / Tauro / Verto grid-protection state codes

meaning.en: Iso Monitoring Mode is set to 'Off (with Warning)', so the inverter does not measure insulation at the DC terminals and this code stays permanently displayed.
meaning.ur: Iso Monitoring Mode 'Off (with Warning)' par set hai, is liye inverter DC terminals par insulation measure nahi karta aur ye code hamesha dikhta hai.

causes.en: Installer disabled isolation monitoring because of repeated false trips on this particular array.
causes.ur: Installer ne is specific array par baar baar false trips ki wajah se isolation monitoring band kar di.

causes.en: Isolation monitoring switched off during commissioning and never re-enabled.
causes.ur: Commissioning ke dauran isolation monitoring band ki gayi aur baad mein dobara on nahi hui.

solutions.en: With DC isolated, do a Riso/megger insulation test per string to earth to establish a real baseline before switching monitoring on.
solutions.ur: DC isolate kar ke, har string ka earth ke saath Riso/megger insulation test karein taake monitoring on karne se pehle asal baseline pata chale.

solutions.en: Use the Precise isolation measurement mode so the measured insulation resistance is visible, and track whether it falls to 1083 / 1183 or 1082 / 1182.
solutions.ur: Precise isolation measurement mode istemal karein taake measured insulation resistance dikhe, aur dekhein ke woh 1083 / 1183 ya 1082 / 1182 ki taraf girta hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the array is genuinely wet or degraded, repair or re-terminate before re-enabling; otherwise leave Iso Monitoring On for safety.
solutions.ur: Agar array waqai geela ya kharab hai to pehle repair ya re-terminate karein, warna safety ke liye Iso Monitoring On hi rakhein.

notes.en: Configuration warning, not a fault. With isolation monitoring On, the related codes are 1083 / 1183 (warning) and 1082 / 1182 (error).
notes.ur: Configuration warning, fault nahi. Isolation monitoring On hone par related codes 1083 / 1183 (warning) aur 1082 / 1182 (error) hain.

source.title: GEN24, Tauro and Verto Country Setup Menu - Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.ur: Operating LED sabit hara: normal chal raha hai

meaning.en: The inverter is operating correctly.
meaning.ur: Inverter theek se kaam kar raha hai.

causes.en: Normal grid power feed operation, MPPT tracking on the PV generator.
causes.ur: Normal grid feed-in chal raha hai, PV generator par MPPT tracking ho rahi hai.

solutions.en: Nothing to do - this is the healthy state. Record the energy yield instead if the customer is complaining about low generation.
solutions.ur: Kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi - ye healthy state hai. Agar customer ki shikayat generation kam hai to energy yield check karein.

solutions.en: If it is night, confirm this green LED is a real inverter state and not a light reflection; the actual standby state is yellow.
solutions.ur: Agar raat hai to confirm karein ke ye hara LED asal inverter state hai na ke roshni ka reflection; asal standby state peela hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED lights up green (steady)

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Operating LED green flashing: grid checks
title.ur: Operating LED hara flash: grid checks chal rahe hain

meaning.en: The inverter is performing the grid checks required by the applicable standards for feed-in mode.
meaning.ur: Inverter feed-in mode ke liye applicable standards ke mutabiq grid checks kar raha hai.

causes.en: Startup or reconnection grid monitoring time is running (both voltage and frequency must sit inside the limits).
causes.ur: Startup ya reconnection ka grid monitoring time chal raha hai (voltage aur frequency dono limit ke andar honi chahiye).

causes.en: Grid was interrupted and the inverter is waiting out the required observation period.
causes.ur: Grid disturb hua tha aur inverter required observation period poora kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid monitoring time to expire; the inverter then reconnects on its own.
solutions.ur: Grid monitoring time poora hone dein; phir inverter khud reconnect ho jayega.

solutions.en: If it never stops flashing, measure grid voltage and frequency at the AC terminals with a clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Agar ye chalta hi rahe to clamp meter se AC terminals par grid voltage aur frequency measure karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED flashes green

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Operating LED yellow: standby or not configured
title.ur: Operating LED sabit peela: standby ya configure nahi

meaning.en: The inverter is in standby, is not operating (e.g. no feed-in at night), or is not configured.
meaning.ur: Inverter standby mein hai, chal nahi raha (jaise raat ko feed-in nahi), ya configure nahi hua.

causes.en: No energy being fed in at night - normal standby state.
causes.ur: Raat ko koi energy feed nahi ho rahi - normal standby state.

causes.en: Setup wizard or commissioning was never completed on this unit.
causes.ur: Is unit par setup wizard ya commissioning kabhi complete nahi hui.

solutions.en: Confirm the time of day and check the DC disconnector position; at night this LED state is expected.
solutions.ur: Din ka waqt confirm karein aur DC disconnector ki position dekhein; raat mein ye LED state expected hai.

solutions.en: If it is daytime with sun, open the Fronius Solar.start app, log in as Technician and complete the setup wizard and commissioning.
solutions.ur: Agar din hai aur dhoop hai to Fronius Solar.start app kholein, Technician se login karke setup wizard aur commissioning poora karein.

solutions.en: If commissioning is done, measure the PV generator DC voltage at the inverter; a missing string or an open DC disconnector leaves the inverter in standby.
solutions.ur: Agar commissioning ho chuki hai to inverter par PV generator ki DC voltage measure karein; koi missing string ya khula DC disconnector inverter ko standby mein rakhta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED lights up yellow (steady)

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Operating LED yellow flashing: non-critical status
title.ur: Operating LED peela flash: non-critical status

meaning.en: The inverter indicates a non-critical status (a warning) while continuing to run.
meaning.ur: Inverter non-critical status (warning) bata raha hai aur chalta raha hai.

causes.en: A warning-class state code is active, e.g. a 1xxx warning from the GEN24 state-code set such as an isolation or arc-warning condition.
causes.ur: Warning class ka state code active hai, jaise GEN24 state-code set ka 1xxx warning jaise isolation ya arc-warning condition.

causes.en: Arc detection event reported (see state 1191 AfciDataTransfer, yellow flash) with no shutdown.
causes.ur: Arc detection event report hua hai (state 1191 AfciDataTransfer, peela flash) aur shutdown nahi hua.

solutions.en: Read the exact state code from the Fronius Solar.start app or the Event Log - the LED alone does not tell you which code it is.
solutions.ur: Fronius Solar.start app ya Event Log se exact state code padhein - sirf LED se pata nahi chalta ke kaunsa code hai.

solutions.en: Log the code and timestamp before doing anything, so the event history is not lost.
solutions.ur: Kuch karne se pehle code aur timestamp note karein, taake event history kho na jaye.

solutions.en: If the yellow flashing repeats with no code recorded, check the Communication LED for a logging/monitoring problem as well.
solutions.ur: Agar koi code record na ho laal flash dohra rahe to Communication LED bhi check karein ke logging ya monitoring mein masla to nahi.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED flashes yellow

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Operating LED red: critical status, no feed-in
title.ur: Operating LED laal: critical status, feed-in nahi

meaning.en: The inverter indicates a critical status and there is no grid power feed process.
meaning.ur: Inverter critical status bata raha hai aur koi grid feed-in nahi ho raha.

causes.en: A critical state code is latched, e.g. WSD open (1030), insulation error, or a grid protection trip.
causes.ur: Critical state code latched hai, jaise WSD khula (1030), isolation error, ya grid protection trip.

causes.en: The surge protection device (SPD) has tripped and the inverter is in WSD shutdown.
causes.ur: Surge protection device (SPD) trigger ho chuka hai aur inverter WSD shutdown mein hai.

solutions.en: Read the exact state code from the Solar.start app / Event Log before any physical work; the LED colour alone is not a diagnosis.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi physical kaam karne se pehle Solar.start app ya Event Log se exact state code padhein; sirf LED ka rang diagnosis nahi hai.

solutions.en: Open the AC breaker and the DC disconnector, then verify the inverter is de-energised with a suitable measuring device before touching DC or AC conductors.
solutions.ur: AC breaker aur DC disconnector kholein, phir DC ya AC conductor chhoone se pehle suitable measuring device se inverter de-energised verify karein.

solutions.en: For a red LED caused by WSD / SPD, Fronius states the inverter must be repaired by an authorised specialist.
solutions.ur: WSD / SPD ki wajah se laal LED ho to Fronius kehta hai inverter ki repair authorised specialist se karwayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED lights up red (steady)

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Operating LED red flashing: backup power overload
title.ur: Operating LED laal flash: backup power overload

meaning.en: The inverter indicates a backup power overload. In backup power mode the maximum power given in the technical data must be observed.
meaning.ur: Inverter backup power overload bata raha hai. Backup power mode mein technical data mein di hui maximum power ka khayal rakhna zaroori hai.

causes.en: The connected loads in backup power mode exceed the inverter's maximum backup power output.
causes.ur: Backup power mode mein connected loads inverter ki maximum backup power se zyada hain.

causes.en: A large motor or heater with a high inrush current was switched on in the backup circuit.
causes.ur: Backup circuit mein koi bara motor ya heater on kiya gaya jiska inrush current zyada hai.

solutions.en: Identify what switched on at the moment the LED started flashing and switch off or defer the largest loads one at a time.
solutions.ur: Dhoondein ke LED flash hone ke waqt kya on hua aur sab se bade loads ko aik aik kar ke off ya postpone karein.

solutions.en: Check the measured backup power against the maximum backup power in the inverter's technical data before allowing the load back on.
solutions.ur: Load wapas on karne se pehle measured backup power ko inverter technical data ki maximum backup power se milayein.

solutions.en: Wait for backup power operation to restart; the manual notes that overloading stops backup power mode, so the grid return is the recovery path.
solutions.ur: Backup power operation ke restart ka intezaar karein; manual kehta hai overload backup power mode rok deta hai, is liye grid par wapas aana hi recovery ka raasta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED flashes red

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Communication LED green 2x: WPS search mode
title.ur: Communication LED hara 2 baar: WPS search mode

meaning.en: The network connection is being established via WPS (2 flashes = WPS search mode).
meaning.ur: Network connection WPS ke zariye establish ho raha hai (2 flash = WPS search mode).

causes.en: WPS (WiFi Protected Setup) pairing was started from the inverter or the Solar.start app.
causes.ur: Inverter ya Solar.start app se WPS (WiFi Protected Setup) pairing shuru ki gayi.

solutions.en: If you did not start WPS, cancel it on the router - an unprompted WPS session leaves the inverter trying to connect.
solutions.ur: Agar aapne WPS start nahi kiya to router par cancel karein - bina ijazat ke WPS session inverter ko connect karne ki koshish mein rok deta hai.

solutions.en: If WPS fails repeatedly, use the Fronius Solar.start app or browser commissioning over the WLAN access point instead (AP password 12345678).
solutions.ur: Agar WPS baar baar fail ho to Fronius Solar.start app ya browser commissioning istemal karein WLAN access point ke zariye (AP password 12345678).

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED flashes green twice (WPS search mode)

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Communication LED blue 1x: WLAN access point search
title.ur: Communication LED neela 1 baar: WLAN access point search

meaning.en: The network connection is being established via the WLAN access point; 1 flash = WLAN AP search mode, active for 30 minutes.
meaning.ur: Network connection WLAN access point ke zariye establish ho raha hai; 1 flash = WLAN AP search mode, 30 minute ke liye active.

causes.en: The optical sensor was touched once, which opens the WLAN access point for commissioning.
causes.ur: Optical sensor ko aik baar chhua gaya, jis se commissioning ke liye WLAN access point khul gaya.

solutions.en: Connect a phone or laptop to the 'fronius_3xxxxxxx' network (key 12345678) and open the local user interface to finish commissioning.
solutions.ur: Phone ya laptop ko 'fronius_3xxxxxxx' network se connect karein (key 12345678) aur commissioning khatam karne ke liye local user interface kholein.

solutions.en: Remember the access point deactivates itself after 30 minutes or when network settings change; touch the sensor again to reopen it.
solutions.ur: Yaad rakhein ke access point 30 minute baad ya network settings badalne par khud band ho jata hai; dobara kholne ke liye sensor phir chhoonein.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED flashes blue once (WLAN AP search mode, active 30 min)

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Communication LED yellow: network not configured
title.ur: Communication LED peela: network configure nahi

meaning.en: The network connection is not configured on the inverter.
meaning.ur: Inverter par network connection configure nahi hua hai.

causes.en: Commissioning was completed without configuring Communication > Network, so the inverter has no network settings.
causes.ur: Commissioning Communication > Network configure kiye baghair poora kiya gaya, is liye inverter ke paas koi network settings nahi.

causes.en: The Datamanager/WLAN module was removed or replaced and the network settings were lost.
causes.ur: Datamanager/WLAN module nikal ya badal diya gaya aur network settings kho gayin.

solutions.en: Touch the optical sensor once to open the WLAN access point, then follow the Fronius Solar.start app commissioning steps to set the network.
solutions.ur: Optical sensor ko aik baar chha kar WLAN access point kholein, phir network set karne ke liye Fronius Solar.start app ke commissioning steps follow karein.

solutions.en: Set Communication > Network to Automatic for DHCP in most cases; choose Static only if the site network requires fixed addresses, and ask the network administrator.
solutions.ur: Zyadatar cases mein Communication > Network ko Automatic (DHCP) par set karein; Static sirf tab jab site network ko fixed address chahiye, aur network administrator se poochein.

solutions.en: After saving, confirm the inverter reaches Solar.web; a green or blue steady Communication LED means the connection is active.
solutions.ur: Save karne ke baad confirm karein ke inverter Solar.web tak pohanch raha hai; Communication LED ka sabit hara ya neela hona active connection batata hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED lights up yellow (steady)

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Communication LED red: network fault, PV still running
title.ur: Communication LED laal: network fault, PV chalta hai

meaning.en: The inverter is operating correctly but a network fault is indicated - production is not affected, only monitoring / logging is.
meaning.ur: Inverter theek chal raha hai lekin network fault indicated hai - production par asar nahi, sirf monitoring aur logging ka masla hai.

causes.en: The inverter lost its connection to the router, switch or modem.
causes.ur: Inverter ka router, switch ya modem se connection toot gaya.

causes.en: DHCP lease expired or the router was replaced and the inverter still has the old, static network settings.
causes.ur: DHCP lease expire ho gaya ya router badal diya gaya aur inverter ke paas abhi bhi purani static network settings hain.

solutions.en: Do not touch the DC side for this - PV production continues. Check LAN1 cable, switch port and router status first.
solutions.ur: Iske liye DC side mat chhoonein - PV production chalta rehta hai. Pehle LAN1 cable, switch port aur router status check karein.

solutions.en: On the inverter open Communication > Network and switch to Automatic so the router assigns a fresh address, then confirm Solar.web comes back online.
solutions.ur: Inverter par Communication > Network kholein aur Automatic par switch karein taake router naya address de, phir confirm karein ke Solar.web wapas online ho gaya.

solutions.en: If Solar.web does not return, restart the network path: switch off the battery, disconnect AC and DC, power-cycle the router, wait a few moments and switch everything back on.
solutions.ur: Agar Solar.web wapas na aaye to network path restart karein: battery off karein, AC aur DC disconnect karein, router ka power cycle karein, kuch der intezaar karein aur sab wapas on karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED lights up red (steady)

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208-240 (status code table)

meaning.en: The wired shutdown (WSD) chain is open, so the inverter has shut down. On this model line the operating LED flashes red.
meaning.ur: Wired shutdown (WSD) chain khuli hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya. Is model line par operating LED laal flash karta hai.

causes.en: A device in the WSD chain has interrupted the signal line - most commonly a surge protection device (SPD) that has tripped.
causes.ur: WSD chain ka koi device signal line tod raha hai - aam tor par koi surge protection device (SPD) jo trigger ho chuka hai.

causes.en: The bypass installed ex works has been removed and no trigger device has been installed instead.
causes.ur: Factory se lagi hui bypass hata di gayi hai aur us ki jagah koi trigger device install nahi kiya gaya.

causes.en: The 2-pin signal cable of the surge protection device is interrupted or damaged.
causes.ur: Surge protection device ka 2-pin signal cable kata hua ya damaged hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC and visually check the WSD chain: the SPD indicator (green/red mechanical window) and the 2-pin signal cable back to the inverter.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC isolate kar ke WSD chain dekhhein: SPD ka indicator (hara/laal mechanical window) aur inverter tak jaane wala 2-pin signal cable.

solutions.en: If the SPD has tripped, have the inverter repaired by an authorised specialist - Fronius states SPD work may only be carried out by Fronius-trained service personnel.
solutions.ur: Agar SPD trigger hua hai to inverter ki repair authorised specialist se karwayein - Fronius kehta hai SPD ka kaam sirf Fronius-trained service personnel kar sakta hai.

solutions.en: If no emergency stop switch is installed, install the ex-works bypass or a proper trigger device on the WSD connector, and set the WSD switch to position 1 (WSD primary device).
solutions.ur: Agar emergency stop switch installed nahi hai to WSD connector par factory bypass ya proper trigger device lagayein, aur WSD switch ko position 1 (WSD primary device) par set karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED flashes red

notes.en: Also published on the Fronius GEN24 support page as '1030: WSD (Wired Shut Down) triggered' (SERIES 2), where it is split into three cases (a/b/c). Same fault, two independent official tables - not merged.
notes.ur: Fronius GEN24 support page par bhi '1030: WSD (Wired Shut Down) triggered' ke naam se publish hua hai (SERIES 2), jahan ise teen cases mein baanta hai (a/b/c). Wahi fault, do alag official tables - merge nahi kiya gaya.

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208-240 (status code table)

meaning.en: An arc was identified on the PV system and the maximum number of automatic reconnections within 24 hours has been reached, so the inverter has stopped trying. Operating LED flashes red.
meaning.ur: PV system par arc detect hua aur 24 ghante mein automatic reconnections ki maximum limit poori ho gayi, is liye inverter ne koshish chhorr di. Operating LED laal flash karta hai.

causes.en: A real serial arc on the DC side that re-occurs every time the inverter restarts, e.g. a burnt DC connector or damaged cable insulation.
causes.ur: DC side par asal serial arc jo har restart par dohra rehta hai, jaise jala hua DC connector ya damaged cable insulation.

causes.en: Arcing at a damaged module junction box, bypass diode or a connector that was not fully seated.
causes.ur: Kisi damaged module junction box, bypass diode ya aise connector par arcing jahan connector poora baitha nahi.

solutions.en: Before confirming the code, check the entire affected photovoltaic system for damage - Fronius warns of serious injury and property damage from damaged PV components.
solutions.ur: Code confirm karne se pehle poore affected photovoltaic system ko damage ke liye check karein - Fronius damaged PV components se serious injury aur nuqsan ki warning deta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then inspect and replace burnt, melted or loose DC connectors and any cable with damaged insulation.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC isolate kar ke, jale, pighle ya dheele DC connectors aur damaged insulation wala koi bhi cable inspect karke badal dein.

solutions.en: Only after the arc source is fixed: keep the optical sensor pressed on the inverter for 3 seconds (max. 6 seconds) to acknowledge, or confirm the status in System > Event Log or in the Notifications user menu.
solutions.ur: Sirf arc ka wajaub theek karne ke baad: acknowledge karne ke liye inverter par optical sensor ko 3 second (max 6 second) tak daba kar rakhein, ya System > Event Log ya Notifications user menu mein status confirm karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED flashes red

notes.en: Identical fault to 1006 / 1173 in SERIES 1 and SERIES 2; Fronius names it 'ArcContinuousFault' only in this table. Not merged with SERIES 1 / SERIES 2.
notes.ur: SERIES 1 aur SERIES 2 ke 1006 / 1173 se bilkul wahi fault; Fronius ise sirf isi table mein 'ArcContinuousFault' ke naam se likhta hai. SERIES 1 / SERIES 2 ke saath merge nahi kiya gaya.

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Primo 3.8-6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208-240 (status code table)

meaning.en: An electric arc has been identified on the PV system and the arc signature is being transferred. Fronius states no action is required. Operating LED flashes yellow.
meaning.ur: PV system par electric arc detect hua hai aur arc signature transfer ho rahi hai. Fronius kehta hai koi action zaroori nahi. Operating LED peela flash karta hai.

causes.en: A detected DC arc; the inverter is uploading the arc signature to the cloud to improve arc detection accuracy.
causes.ur: Detect hua DC arc; inverter arc signature cloud par bhej kar arc detection ki accuracy behtar kar raha hai.

causes.en: Arc Logging is switched on, so each detection is recorded and reported.
causes.ur: Arc Logging on hai, is liye har detection record aur report hoti hai.

solutions.en: No action required - this is the documented remedy in the manual.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaroori nahi - manual mein yehi documented remedy hai.

solutions.en: Still watch for 1173 (ArcContinuousFault) or 1006: if the arc repeats, the inverter will escalate and stop restarting.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi 1173 (ArcContinuousFault) ya 1006 par nazar rakhein: agar arc dohra to inverter escalate hokar restart karna chhorr dega.

solutions.en: If 1191 appears repeatedly with no physical arc found, ask the installer to check Arc Logging and Automatic Signal Recording settings.
solutions.ur: Agar 1191 baar baar aaye aur koi physical arc na mile to installer se Arc Logging aur Automatic Signal Recording settings check karwayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED flashes yellow

source.title: Fronius Primo GEN24 3.8 - 6.0 kW / Plus / SC 208 - 240 Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 support-page state codes (Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

meaning.en: The mandatory insulation measurement is running. After 24 hours of continuous feed-in the inverter must measure insulation and cannot feed during the measurement.
meaning.ur: Zaroori insulation measurement chal raha hai. 24 ghante continuous feed-in ke baad inverter ko insulation measure karna zaroori hai aur measurement ke dairan feed nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: 24 hours of continuous energy feed into the grid have elapsed - this is a normative requirement, not a defect.
causes.ur: Grid mein 24 ghante continuous feed-in poora ho gaya - ye standard ka requirement hai, koi defect nahi.

causes.en: Triggered deliberately during a low-irradiation window so the measurement happens at night rather than in production hours.
causes.ur: Kam irradiation ke waqt jaan booj kar trigger kiya gaya taake measurement raat mein ho, production ke waqt nahi.

solutions.en: Take no action - Fronius states this is purely for information and no additional measures are required.
solutions.ur: Koi karay nahi karein - Fronius kehta hai ye sirf information ke liye hai aur koi extra action nahi chahiye.

solutions.en: Simply wait; grid power feed operation resumes automatically once the insulation measurement finishes.
solutions.ur: Bas intezaar karein; insulation measurement khatam hote hi grid feed-in khud shuru ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If 1001 repeats far more often than roughly every 24 hours, record the timestamps and check DC insulation - a 12 h + 6 h counter is used on battery systems.
solutions.ur: Agar 1001 teqreeban 24 ghante se zyada baar aata hai to timestamps note karein aur DC insulation check karein - battery systems par 12 ghante + 6 ghante ka counter istemal hota hai.

source.title: Help for your Fronius GEN24 - State Codes (error codes on the Fronius Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

codes.seriesName: GEN24 support-page state codes (Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

meaning.en: A setting was changed that makes a restart of the inverter necessary. The restart happens automatically.
meaning.ur: Aik setting badli gayi hai jis se inverter ka restart zaroori ho gaya. Restart khud ho jata hai.

causes.en: A grid-protection or country-setup parameter was changed in the user interface or Solar.web.
causes.ur: User interface ya Solar.web mein grid-protection ya country-setup parameter badla gaya.

causes.en: A remote configuration change was pushed to the inverter from Solar.web.
causes.ur: Solar.web se inverter par remote configuration change bheja gaya.

solutions.en: No action needed - Fronius states the restart occurs automatically and no additional measures are required.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaroori nahi - Fronius kehta hai restart khud ho jata hai aur koi extra measure nahi chahiye.

solutions.en: Do not power-cycle the inverter while this is pending; let the automatic restart complete first.
solutions.ur: Jab tak ye pending hai inverter ka power cycle na karein; pehle automatic restart poora hone dein.

solutions.en: If it appears repeatedly without anyone changing settings, check the Event Log for who or what changed the configuration (e.g. a Datamanager or Solar.web remote action).
solutions.ur: Agar bina kisi change ke baar baar aata hai to Event Log dekhein ke configuration kisne badli (jaise Datamanager ya Solar.web remote action).

source.title: Help for your Fronius GEN24 - State Codes (error codes on the Fronius Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

codes.seriesName: GEN24 support-page state codes (Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

meaning.en: The WSD (wired shutdown) chain has been opened, so the inverter has shut down. It either accompanies another fault, or it was triggered by an emergency stop / fire brigade switch, or by a missing bridge on the WSD connector.
meaning.ur: WSD (wired shutdown) chain khul gaya hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya. Ye ya to kisi aur fault ke saath aata hai, ya emergency stop / fire brigade switch se trigger hua, ya WSD connector par bridge na hone se.

causes.en: Case a: another error occurred that shut the inverter down, and WSD is reported alongside it.
causes.ur: Case a: koi aur error aaya jis ne inverter band kiya, aur WSD usi ke saath report hua.

causes.en: Case b: the emergency stop switch or fire brigade switch on the WSD was actuated (orange connector, far left of the data communication PC board).
causes.ur: Case b: WSD ka emergency stop switch ya fire brigade switch daba diya gaya (orange connector, data communication PC board ke bilkul baayen).

causes.en: Case c: no emergency stop / fire brigade switch is installed and the ex-works bypass on the WSD connector is missing.
causes.ur: Case c: emergency stop / fire brigade switch installed nahi hai aur WSD connector par factory bypass missing hai.

solutions.en: First open the Solar.web portal and check whether other status messages were triggered at the same time as 1030 - if yes, fix those first, because 1030 is only the consequence.
solutions.ur: Pehle Solar.web portal kholein aur dekhein ke 1030 ke saath hi koi aur status message bhi trigger hua - agar haan to pehle unhein theek karein, kyunke 1030 sirf natija hai.

solutions.en: If 1030 is the only code, physically check whether the emergency stop / fire brigade switch has been actuated and reset it before restarting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Agar 1030 akela code hai to physically check karein ke emergency stop / fire brigade switch daba hua hai ya nahi, aur inverter restart se pehle reset karein.

solutions.en: If no emergency stop switch exists, install the ex-works bypass or a proper trigger device on the WSD connector, and set the WSD switch to position 1 (WSD primary device) where appropriate.
solutions.ur: Agar emergency stop switch maujood nahi to WSD connector par factory bypass ya proper trigger device lagayein, aur jahan zaroori ho WSD switch ko position 1 (WSD primary device) par set karein.

notes.en: The Primo GEN24 operating instructions document the same fault as '1030 - WSD Open' and add that a tripped surge protection device (SPD) in the WSD chain also produces 1030 and requires repair by an authorised specialist - see SERIES 3.
notes.ur: Primo GEN24 operating instructions isi fault ko '1030 - WSD Open' ke naam se likhte hain aur ye add karte hain ke WSD chain mein tripped surge protection device (SPD) bhi 1030 deta hai aur uski repair authorised specialist kare.

source.title: Help for your Fronius GEN24 - State Codes (error codes on the Fronius Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

codes.seriesName: GEN24 support-page state codes (Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

title.en: Grid frequency out of limit on reconnect (1036)
title.ur: Reconnect par grid frequency limit se bahar (1036)

meaning.en: When the inverter tried to connect to the grid (e.g. after a restart) the grid frequency was outside the permitted range, so it did not connect.
meaning.ur: Jab inverter grid se connect hone ki koshish kar raha tha (jaise restart ke baad) to grid frequency permitted range se bahar thi, is liye connect nahi hua.

causes.en: Grid frequency outside the permissible startup / reconnection range at the moment of connection.
causes.ur: Connect hone ke waqt grid frequency permissible startup / reconnection range se bahar thi.

causes.en: Another event on the network (large load, generator) shifted the frequency while the inverter was reconnecting.
causes.ur: Network par koi aur event (bara load, generator) ne inverter ke reconnect hote waqt frequency badal di.

solutions.en: No action is required - Fronius states no other measures are needed; the inverter waits until the grid frequency is within the limit again.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaroori nahi - Fronius kehta hai koi aur karay nahi chahiye; inverter wait karta hai jab tak grid frequency wapas limit mein na aa jaye.

solutions.en: Measure the grid frequency with a clamp meter if it persists all day, to rule out a genuinely unstable grid or an incorrect country setup.
solutions.ur: Agar poora din rehta rahe to clamp meter se grid frequency measure karein, taake waqai unstable grid ya galat country setup rule out ho jaye.

solutions.en: If the inverter never reconnects, verify the country setup startup / reconnection parameters with the installer and the utility before adjusting anything.
solutions.ur: Agar inverter kabhi reconnect na ho to kuch bhi badalne se pehle installer aur utility ke saath country setup startup / reconnection parameters verify karein.

source.title: Help for your Fronius GEN24 - State Codes (error codes on the Fronius Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

codes.seriesName: GEN24 support-page state codes (Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

title.ur: Mains voltage ki wajah se power reduction (1112)

meaning.en: The grid voltage exceeded the stored limit value, so the inverter is deliberately reducing its feed-in power. Fronius states this is purely for information.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage stored limit value se upar chali gayi, is liye inverter apni feed-in power jaan booj kar kam kar raha hai. Fronius kehta hai ye sirf information ke liye hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage above the limit value stored for the selected country setup.
causes.ur: Selected country setup ke liye stored limit value se grid voltage zyada hai.

causes.en: High PV export into a weak or long feeder, typically around midday.
causes.ur: Kamzor ya lamba feeder mein zyada PV export, aam tor par dopahar ke around.

solutions.en: No action is required - Fronius explicitly states this is purely for information and no additional measures are needed.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaroori nahi - Fronius saaf likhta hai ke ye sirf information hai aur koi extra karay nahi chahiye.

solutions.en: If it appears frequently around midday, ask the installer to review the volt-watt response and feed-in limit settings for the site.
solutions.ur: Agar dopahar ke around baar baar aata hai to installer se site ke liye volt-watt response aur feed-in limit settings dobara check karwayein.

solutions.en: Production returns to normal automatically as soon as the grid voltage drops back under the limit.
solutions.ur: Jaise hi grid voltage limit se neeche aati hai production khud normal ho jata hai.

source.title: Help for your Fronius GEN24 - State Codes (error codes on the Fronius Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

codes.seriesName: GEN24 support-page state codes (Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

title.en: Too little DC power for feed-in (1175)
title.ur: Feed-in ke liye DC power bohat kam (1175)

meaning.en: Not enough DC power is available to feed into the grid. It clears automatically once the PV generator supplies sufficient power.
meaning.ur: Grid mein feed karne ke liye DC power kaafi nahi hai. Jaise hi PV generator kaafi power de raha ho ye khud clear ho jata hai.

causes.en: Too little irradiation, e.g. early morning or evening.
causes.ur: Irradiation bohat kam hai, jaise subah shuru ya shaam ko.

causes.en: Poor weather such as rain, snowfall or fog.
causes.ur: Buran, barfbarf ya dhund jaisa kharab mausam.

causes.en: Snow lying on the PV modules, or heavy shading of the array.
causes.ur: PV modules par barf pada hua hai, ya poore array par gehri shadowing hai.

solutions.en: No action needed - Fronius states it is remedied automatically as soon as the PV generator supplies sufficient power.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaroori nahi - Fronius kehta hai jab PV generator kaafi power de to ye khud theek ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If it shows up at midday in clear weather, check for new shading (a new building, a grown tree, a water tank) rather than assuming it is irradiance.
solutions.ur: Agar saaf mausam mein dopahar ko dikhe to nayi shadowing check karein (nayi building, barhi hua darakht, pan ki tanki), ye na samajhein ke ye sirf irradiation hai.

solutions.en: If PV modules are snow covered, switch the string fuses off only as designed and clear the snow safely - never work on a DC string under load.
solutions.ur: Agar PV modules par barf hai to design ke mutabiq string fuses hi off karein aur barf mehfoof tareeqe se saaf karein - kabhi bhi load ke saath DC string par kaam na karein.

source.title: Help for your Fronius GEN24 - State Codes (error codes on the Fronius Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

codes.seriesName: GEN24 support-page state codes (Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

meaning.en: The inverter could not receive the setup values it requires. Fronius states this appears only on first start-up and can be ignored.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko zaroori setup values nahi mili. Fronius kehta hai ye sirf pehli start-up par aata hai aur ignore kiya ja sakta hai.

causes.en: The inverter is being started for the first time and the setup wizard has not yet completed.
causes.ur: Inverter pehli baar start ho raha hai aur setup wizard abhi poora nahi hua.

causes.en: Setup values could not be fetched from the server or are not yet available for this device.
causes.ur: Setup values server se fetch nahi ho saki ya is device ke liye abhi available nahi hain.

solutions.en: Ignore it if it appears once during first commissioning - Fronius states this explicitly.
solutions.ur: Agar pehli commissioning mein aik baar aaye to ignore karein - Fronius ye saaf likhta hai.

solutions.en: Complete the setup wizard on the inverter user interface (Solar.start app or browser) and let the inverter restart.
solutions.ur: Inverter user interface (Solar.start app ya browser) par setup wizard poora karein aur inverter ko restart hone dein.

solutions.en: If it appears after the system is already commissioned, update the inverter firmware via Solar.web (Settings > Components > Update) and check the internet connection.
solutions.ur: Agar system commissioned hone ke baad aaye to Solar.web se firmware update karein (Settings > Components > Update) aur internet connection check karein.

source.title: Help for your Fronius GEN24 - State Codes (error codes on the Fronius Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

codes.seriesName: GEN24 support-page state codes (Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

meaning.en: A Solar.web communication state code reported between the inverter and Fronius Solar.web. Fronius publishes 994, 995, 996, 997 and 999 under one heading without a per-code description.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur Fronius Solar.web ke darmiyan report hua Solar.web communication state code. Fronius 994, 995, 996, 997 aur 999 ko aik hi heading ke andar bina per-code description ke likhta hai.

causes.en: Loss or instability of the internet connection between the inverter and Solar.web.
causes.ur: Inverter aur Solar.web ke darmiyan internet connection kat gaya ya unstable hai.

causes.en: Solar.web service interruption or an authentication / registration problem on the Solar.web system.
causes.ur: Solar.web service ruk gayi ya Solar.web system par authentication ya registration masla hai.

solutions.en: On the inverter user interface open Communication > Network and check the connection mode and IP/DHCP state; a static IP that the router no longer serves will show as offline.
solutions.ur: Inverter user interface par Communication > Network kholein aur connection mode aur IP/DHCP state check karein; aik static IP jo router abhi nahi de raha woh offline dikhega.

solutions.en: On the Solar.web portal confirm under Settings > Service Messages that 'Receive service messages' is ticked, and that a contact telephone / e-mail is set and active.
solutions.ur: Solar.web portal par Settings > Service Messages mein confirm karein ke 'Receive service messages' tick hai, aur contact telephone / e-mail set aur active hai.

solutions.en: Check for the latest inverter firmware via Solar.web (Settings > Components > Update); do not interrupt power during the update.
solutions.ur: Solar.web se latest inverter firmware check karein (Settings > Components > Update); update ke dauran power na kaatein.

notes.en: LOW CONFIDENCE BY DESIGN: the Fronius support page lists 994 only as part of the grouped heading '994, 995, 996, 997 & 999: Solar.web State Codes' and links to a Solar.web state-code page that, as fetched, contains no per-code table. The individual meaning of 994 could not be verified and is deliberately not invented - the grouped Solar.web communication nature is all that is documented.
notes.ur: LOW CONFIDENCE JAAN BOOJ KAR: Fronius support page 994 ko sirf grouped heading '994, 995, 996, 997 & 999: Solar.web State Codes' ke hisse se list karta hai aur aik Solar.web state-code page ki taraf link karta hai jahan, jaise fetch kiya gaya, per-code table maujood nahi. 994 ka alag matlab verify nahi ho saka aur jaan booj kar invent nahi kiya gaya - sirf grouped Solar.web communication baat documented hai.

source.title: Help for your Fronius GEN24 - State Codes (error codes on the Fronius Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

codes.seriesName: GEN24 support-page state codes (Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

meaning.en: A Solar.web communication state code reported between the inverter and Fronius Solar.web, grouped with 994, 996, 997 and 999 without a per-code description.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur Fronius Solar.web ke darmiyan report hua Solar.web communication state code, 994, 996, 997 aur 999 ke saath grouped, bina per-code description ke.

causes.en: Loss or instability of the internet connection between the inverter and Solar.web.
causes.ur: Inverter aur Solar.web ke darmiyan internet connection kat gaya ya unstable hai.

causes.en: Solar.web service interruption or an authentication / registration problem on the Solar.web system.
causes.ur: Solar.web service ruk gayi ya Solar.web system par authentication ya registration masla hai.

solutions.en: Check the inverter's Communication > Network settings and the LAN port in use (LAN1 is the supported port; LAN2 has no function on GEN24).
solutions.ur: Inverter ke Communication > Network settings aur istemal ho raha LAN port check karein (GEN24 par LAN1 supported port hai; LAN2 ka koi function nahi).

solutions.en: In Solar.web, verify under Settings > Components that the inverter is not hidden, then re-check for firmware updates.
solutions.ur: Solar.web mein Settings > Components mein verify karein ke inverter hidden nahi hai, phir firmware updates dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: If the system shows offline with current data missing, restart the network path (battery off, AC and DC isolated, router power-cycled) as Fronius describes.
solutions.ur: Agar system offline dikhe aur current data na mile to Fronius ke bataye tareeqe se network path restart karein (battery off, AC aur DC isolate, router ka power cycle).

notes.en: LOW CONFIDENCE BY DESIGN: grouped under one heading with 994, 996, 997 and 999 on the Fronius support page, with no per-code description published. The individual meaning of 995 could not be verified and is not invented.
notes.ur: LOW CONFIDENCE JAAN BOOJ KAR: Fronius support page par 994, 996, 997 aur 999 ke saath aik hi heading ke andar grouped, koi per-code description mojood nahi. 995 ka alag matlab verify nahi ho saka aur invent nahi kiya gaya.

source.title: Help for your Fronius GEN24 - State Codes (error codes on the Fronius Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

codes.seriesName: GEN24 support-page state codes (Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

meaning.en: A Solar.web communication state code reported between the inverter and Fronius Solar.web, grouped with 994, 995, 997 and 999 without a per-code description.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur Fronius Solar.web ke darmiyan report hua Solar.web communication state code, 994, 995, 997 aur 999 ke saath grouped, bina per-code description ke.

causes.en: Loss or instability of the internet connection between the inverter and Solar.web.
causes.ur: Inverter aur Solar.web ke darmiyan internet connection kat gaya ya unstable hai.

causes.en: Solar.web service interruption or an authentication / registration problem on the Solar.web system.
causes.ur: Solar.web service ruk gayi ya Solar.web system par authentication ya registration masla hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the inverter is online in Solar.web; after commissioning a new component can take up to 2 hours to appear, and archive data is sent on the hour by default.
solutions.ur: Solar.web mein confirm karein ke inverter online hai; naye component ke baad aane mein 2 ghante lag sakte hain, aur archive data default roz ghante ke aakhir mein bheja jata hai.

solutions.en: Check Communication > Network on the inverter and confirm the WiFi signal shows at least two of four bars, or use Ethernet on LAN1.
solutions.ur: Inverter par Communication > Network check karein aur confirm karein ke WiFi signal kam az kam chaar mein se do bars dikha raha hai, ya LAN1 par Ethernet istemal karein.

solutions.en: If it persists, ask the installer to re-run the commissioning wizard so the inverter re-registers with Solar.web.
solutions.ur: Agar barqarar rahe to installer se commissioning wizard dobara chalwayein taake inverter Solar.web par dobara register ho jaye.

notes.en: LOW CONFIDENCE BY DESIGN: grouped under one heading with 994, 995, 997 and 999 on the Fronius support page, with no per-code description published. The individual meaning of 996 could not be verified and is not invented.
notes.ur: LOW CONFIDENCE JAAN BOOJ KAR: 994, 995, 997 aur 999 ke saath aik hi heading ke andar grouped, koi per-code description mojood nahi. 996 ka alag matlab verify nahi ho saka aur invent nahi kiya gaya.

codes.seriesName: GEN24 support-page state codes (Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

meaning.en: A Solar.web communication state code reported between the inverter and Fronius Solar.web, grouped with 994, 995, 996 and 999 without a per-code description.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur Fronius Solar.web ke darmiyan report hua Solar.web communication state code, 994, 995, 996 aur 999 ke saath grouped, bina per-code description ke.

causes.en: Loss or instability of the internet connection between the inverter and Solar.web.
causes.ur: Inverter aur Solar.web ke darmiyan internet connection kat gaya ya unstable hai.

causes.en: Solar.web service interruption or an authentication / registration problem on the Solar.web system.
causes.ur: Solar.web service ruk gayi ya Solar.web system par authentication ya registration masla hai.

solutions.en: On the inverter user interface check Communication > Internet services and confirm the services are enabled and the connection state is shown as connected.
solutions.ur: Inverter user interface par Communication > Internet services check karein aur confirm karein ke services enabled hain aur connection state connected dikha raha hai.

solutions.en: If the router or ISP was changed, reconnect the inverter to the network manually via the Solar.start app or browser commissioning steps.
solutions.ur: Agar router ya ISP badla hai to Solar.start app ya browser commissioning steps ke zariye inverter ko network par dobara manually connect karein.

solutions.en: If Solar.web is not the issue, note the timestamp and cross-check other codes in the event log - a communication code alone does not stop production.
solutions.ur: Agar masla Solar.web ka na ho to timestamp note karein aur event log ke doosre codes se cross-check karein - akela communication code production band nahi karta.

notes.en: LOW CONFIDENCE BY DESIGN: grouped under one heading with 994, 995, 996 and 999 on the Fronius support page, with no per-code description published. The individual meaning of 997 could not be verified and is not invented.
notes.ur: LOW CONFIDENCE JAAN BOOJ KAR: 994, 995, 996 aur 999 ke saath aik hi heading ke andar grouped, koi per-code description mojood nahi. 997 ka alag matlab verify nahi ho saka aur invent nahi kiya gaya.

source.title: Help for your Fronius GEN24 - State Codes (error codes on the Fronius Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

codes.seriesName: GEN24 support-page state codes (Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

meaning.en: A Solar.web communication state code reported between the inverter and Fronius Solar.web, grouped with 994, 995, 996 and 997 without a per-code description.
meaning.ur: Inverter aur Fronius Solar.web ke darmiyan report hua Solar.web communication state code, 994, 995, 996 aur 997 ke saath grouped, bina per-code description ke.

causes.en: Loss or instability of the internet connection between the inverter and Solar.web.
causes.ur: Inverter aur Solar.web ke darmiyan internet connection kat gaya ya unstable hai.

causes.en: Solar.web service interruption or an authentication / registration problem on the Solar.web system.
causes.ur: Solar.web service ruk gayi ya Solar.web system par authentication ya registration masla hai.

solutions.en: Check the inverter is reachable at the Solar.web assigned IP; if a new router was fitted, set Communication > Network to Automatic and let the router assign a new address.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke inverter Solar.web ke diye IP par reachable hai; agar naya router laga hai to Communication > Network ko Automatic par set karein aur router ko naya address dene dein.

solutions.en: Confirm the inverter's firmware is current, since Solar.web features and service messages depend on firmware version.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke inverter ka firmware latest hai, kyunke Solar.web features aur service messages firmware version par depend karte hain.

solutions.en: For any Solar.web code, first rule out the connection path (LAN1 cable / WiFi) before suspecting the inverter - Fronius treats a missing notification as a configuration issue, not a device fault.
solutions.ur: Har Solar.web code ke liye pehle connection path (LAN1 cable / WiFi) rule out karein, inverter par shak karne se pehle - Fronius missing notification ko device fault nahi balki configuration masla samajhta hai.

source.title: Help for your Fronius GEN24 - State Codes (error codes on the Fronius Primo GEN24 & Symo GEN24)

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.ur: Operating LED sabit hara: normal chal raha hai

meaning.en: The inverter is operating correctly.
meaning.ur: Inverter theek se kaam kar raha hai.

causes.en: Normal grid power feed operation on this three-phase unit.
causes.ur: Is three-phase unit par normal grid feed-in chal raha hai.

solutions.en: Nothing to do - healthy state.
solutions.ur: Kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi - healthy state.

solutions.en: If the customer reports low yield, read the per-phase energy figures rather than the LED, since three-phase imbalance is invisible on the LED.
solutions.ur: Agar customer kam yield ki shikayat kare to LED ke bajaye har phase ki energy figures padhein, kyunke three-phase imbalance LED se nazar nahi aati.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED lights up green (steady)

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Operating LED green flashing: grid checks
title.ur: Operating LED hara flash: grid checks chal rahe hain

meaning.en: The inverter is performing the grid checks required by the applicable standards for grid power feed operation.
meaning.ur: Inverter grid power feed operation ke liye applicable standards ke mutabiq grid checks kar raha hai.

causes.en: Startup or reconnection grid monitoring time running; voltage and frequency must both be in range.
causes.ur: Startup ya reconnection ka grid monitoring time chal raha hai; voltage aur frequency dono range mein hone chahiye.

solutions.en: Wait for the monitoring time to expire; the inverter reconnects automatically afterwards.
solutions.ur: Monitoring time poora hone dein; uske baad inverter khud reconnect ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If it never stops, measure voltage and frequency on all three phases at the AC terminals with a clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Agar ye chalta hi rahe to clamp meter se AC terminals par teenon phases ka voltage aur frequency measure karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED flashes green

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Operating LED yellow: standby, idle or not configured
title.ur: Operating LED sabit peela: standby, idle ya configure nahi

meaning.en: The inverter is on standby, is not operating (e.g. no energy fed into the grid at night), or is not configured.
meaning.ur: Inverter standby par hai, chal nahi raha (jaise raat ko grid mein koi energy feed nahi), ya configure nahi hua.

causes.en: No energy fed into the grid at night - normal standby state.
causes.ur: Raat ko grid mein koi energy feed nahi ho rahi - normal standby state.

causes.en: Setup wizard / commissioning not completed on this unit.
causes.ur: Is unit par setup wizard ya commissioning complete nahi hui.

solutions.en: Confirm the DC disconnector is closed and the PV generator is producing before assuming a fault.
solutions.ur: Fault ka shak karne se pehle confirm karein ke DC disconnector band hai aur PV generator bana raha hai.

solutions.en: During daylight, log into the Fronius Solar.start app as Technician and complete the setup wizard.
solutions.ur: Dopahar mein, Fronius Solar.start app mein Technician se login karke setup wizard poora karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED lights up yellow (steady)

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Operating LED yellow flashing: error, inverter still running
title.ur: Operating LED peela flash: error, inverter chalta hai

meaning.en: The inverter displays an error but continues to operate correctly.
meaning.ur: Inverter error dikha raha hai lekin sahi se kaam karta raha hai.

causes.en: A warning-class state code is active while the inverter keeps producing.
causes.ur: Warning class ka state code active hai aur inverter bana raha hai.

causes.en: An isolation or arc-warning condition that Fronius logs but does not shut down for.
causes.ur: Aisi isolation ya arc-warning condition jo Fronius log karta hai lekin shutdown nahi karta.

solutions.en: Read the exact state code from System > Event Log, the Notifications user menu, or Solar.web - the LED colour does not identify the code.
solutions.ur: System > Event Log, Notifications user menu ya Solar.web se exact state code padhein - LED ka rang code identify nahi karta.

solutions.en: Record the code and timestamp before resetting anything so the event history survives.
solutions.ur: Kuch reset karne se pehle code aur timestamp note karein taake event history bachi rahe.

solutions.en: If a warning repeats every day, treat it as a configuration issue (protection function switched off) and have the installer review it.
