solutions.ur: Agar warning roz aaye to ise configuration masla samajhein (protection function band) aur installer se review karwayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED flashes yellow

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Operating LED red: critical status, no feed-in
title.ur: Operating LED laal: critical status, feed-in nahi

meaning.en: The inverter displays a critical status and no energy is fed into the grid.
meaning.ur: Inverter critical status dikha raha hai aur grid mein koi energy feed nahi ho rahi.

causes.en: A critical state code is latched - e.g. WSD Open (1030) or a grid protection trip.
causes.ur: Critical state code latched hai - jaise WSD khula (1030) ya grid protection trip.

causes.en: The surge protection device has tripped, which on this model line lights the operating status LED red and raises 1030.
causes.ur: Surge protection device trigger hua hai, jo is model line par operating status LED laal karta hai aur 1030 deta hai.

solutions.en: Read the state code from System > Event Log or Solar.web first; do not open the inverter on the strength of the LED colour alone.
solutions.ur: Pehle System > Event Log ya Solar.web se state code padhein; sirf LED ke rang ke bharose par inverter na kholein.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker and the DC disconnector and confirm de-energised with a suitable measuring device before any work.
solutions.ur: AC breaker aur DC disconnector off karein aur koi bhi kaam karne se pehle suitable measuring device se de-energised confirm karein.

solutions.en: Fronius states that if the SPD caused it, the inverter must be repaired by an authorised specialist company.
solutions.ur: Fronius kehta hai ke agar SPD ne cause kiya hai to inverter ki repair authorised specialist company se karwayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED lights up red (steady)

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Operating LED red flashing: backup power overload
title.ur: Operating LED laal flash: backup power overload

meaning.en: The inverter displays a backup power overload; the maximum power in backup power mode from the technical data must be observed.
meaning.ur: Inverter backup power overload dikha raha hai; technical data mein di hui backup power mode ki maximum power ka khayal rakhna zaroori hai.

causes.en: Connected loads exceed the inverter's maximum backup power output on this three-phase unit.
causes.ur: Is three-phase unit par connected loads inverter ki maximum backup power se zyada hain.

causes.en: A large three-phase motor or heater with high inrush current was switched on in the backup circuit.
causes.ur: Backup circuit mein koi bara three-phase motor ya heater on kiya gaya jiska inrush current zyada hai.

solutions.en: Identify the load that came on when the LED started flashing and shed the largest loads one at a time.
solutions.ur: Dhoondein ke LED flash hone ke waqt kaunsa load on hua aur sab se bade loads aik aik kar ke hatayein.

solutions.en: Compare the measured backup power with the maximum backup power listed in the technical data for your Symo GEN24 size before re-enabling the load.
solutions.ur: Apne Symo GEN24 size ki technical data mein likhi maximum backup power se measured backup power milayein, load wapas on karne se pehle.

solutions.en: Wait for backup power operation to restart after the load has been reduced; an overload stops backup power mode on this model line too.
solutions.ur: Load kam karne ke baad backup power operation ke restart ka intezaar karein; is model line par bhi overload backup power mode rok deta hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED flashes red

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Communication LED green 2x: WPS search mode
title.ur: Communication LED hara 2 baar: WPS search mode

meaning.en: The network connection is being established via WPS (2 flashes = WPS search mode).
meaning.ur: Network connection WPS ke zariye establish ho raha hai (2 flash = WPS search mode).

causes.en: WPS pairing was started from the inverter or the Fronius Solar.start app.
causes.ur: Inverter ya Fronius Solar.start app se WPS pairing shuru ki gayi.

solutions.en: Cancel an unintended WPS session on the router rather than leaving the inverter searching.
solutions.ur: Router par anjaani WPS session cancel karein, inverter ko search karte na chhodein.

solutions.en: If WPS keeps failing, commission over the WLAN access point in the Fronius Solar.start app or browser instead.
solutions.ur: Agar WPS baar baar fail ho to Fronius Solar.start app ya browser mein WLAN access point ke zariye commissioning karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED flashes green twice (WPS search mode)

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Communication LED blue 1x: WLAN access point search
title.ur: Communication LED neela 1 baar: WLAN access point search

meaning.en: The network connection is being established via WiFi access point; 1 flash = WiFi AP search mode, active for 30 minutes.
meaning.ur: Network connection WiFi access point ke zariye establish ho raha hai; 1 flash = WiFi AP search mode, 30 minute ke liye active.

causes.en: The optical sensor was touched once, opening the WiFi access point for commissioning.
causes.ur: Optical sensor ko aik baar chhua gaya, jis se commissioning ke liye WiFi access point khul gaya.

solutions.en: Join the 'fronius_3xxxxxxx' network (key 12345678) and open the local user interface at the commissioning IP to finish setup.
solutions.ur: 'fronius_3xxxxxxx' network (key 12345678) se connect hoke commissioning IP par local user interface kholein aur setup poora karein.

solutions.en: Note the access point closes itself after 30 minutes; touch the sensor again to reopen it.
solutions.ur: Yaad rakhein ke access point 30 minute baad khud band ho jata hai; dobara kholne ke liye sensor phir chhoonein.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED flashes blue once (WiFi AP search mode, active 30 min)

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Communication LED yellow: network not configured
title.ur: Communication LED peela: network configure nahi

meaning.en: The network connection is not configured.
meaning.ur: Network connection configure nahi hua hai.

causes.en: Commissioning finished without configuring Communication > Network.
causes.ur: Commissioning Communication > Network configure kiye baghair poori ki gayi.

causes.en: The communication module was replaced and the network settings were lost.
causes.ur: Communication module badal diya gaya aur network settings kho gayin.

solutions.en: Touch the optical sensor once and complete network setup in the Fronius Solar.start app.
solutions.ur: Optical sensor ko aik baar chha kar Fronius Solar.start app mein network setup poora karein.

solutions.en: Use Automatic (DHCP) unless the site requires static addressing; if static, ask the network administrator for the address, subnet and gateway.
solutions.ur: Jab tak site ko static addressing ki zaroorat na ho, Automatic (DHCP) istemal karein; static ho to network administrator se address, subnet aur gateway poochein.

solutions.en: Save and confirm the Communication LED turns green or blue, meaning the network connection is active.
solutions.ur: Save karein aur confirm karein ke Communication LED hara ya neela ho gaya, matlab network connection active hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED lights up yellow (steady)

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Communication LED red: network error, PV running
title.ur: Communication LED laal: network error, PV chal raha hai

meaning.en: There is a network error while the inverter is operating correctly.
meaning.ur: Inverter sahi chal raha hai lekin network error hai.

causes.en: The inverter lost its network path (router, LAN1 cable or switch).
causes.ur: Inverter ka network path toot gaya (router, LAN1 cable ya switch).

causes.en: The router was replaced and the inverter still holds the previous static settings.
causes.ur: Router badal diya gaya aur inverter ke paas abhi bhi purani static settings hain.

solutions.en: Production is unaffected - check LAN1 cable, switch port and router power before touching anything on the DC side.
solutions.ur: Production par asar nahi - DC side chhoone se pehle LAN1 cable, switch port aur router power check karein.

solutions.en: Set Communication > Network to Automatic so a new address is assigned, then confirm the inverter returns to Solar.web.
solutions.ur: Communication > Network ko Automatic par set karein taake naya address mile, phir confirm karein ke inverter Solar.web par wapas aa gaya.

solutions.en: If it does not recover, power-cycle the router and check the inverter's internet services state under Communication.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas na aaye to router ka power cycle karein aur Communication mein inverter ki internet services state check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED lights up red (steady)

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Communication LED blue: network connection active
title.ur: Communication LED neela: network connection active

meaning.en: The network connection is active. This row exists only in the Symo GEN24 LED table.
meaning.ur: Network connection active hai. Ye row sirf Symo GEN24 LED table mein mojood hai.

causes.en: The inverter is connected and communicating over the network.
causes.ur: Inverter network se connected hai aur communicate kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Nothing to do - this is the healthy connected state on this model line.
solutions.ur: Kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi - is model line par ye healthy connected state hai.

solutions.en: If Solar.web shows the system offline despite this LED, check that the system was registered to your Fronius account and that contacts for notifications are set.
solutions.ur: Agar ye LED on ke bawajood Solar.web system offline dikhaye to check karein ke system aapke Fronius account par register hai aur notifications ke liye contacts set hain.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED lights up blue (steady)

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Communication LED flashing blue: update running
title.ur: Communication LED flash neela: update chal raha hai

meaning.en: The inverter is performing an update (firmware update in progress). This row exists only in the Symo GEN24 LED table.
meaning.ur: Inverter update kar raha hai (firmware update chal raha hai). Ye row sirf Symo GEN24 LED table mein mojood hai.

causes.en: An inverter firmware update started locally or remotely via Solar.web.
causes.ur: Inverter firmware update locally ya Solar.web se remotely shuru hui.

solutions.en: Do not interrupt the power supply during the update - Fronius states this explicitly for Solar.web updates.
solutions.ur: Update ke dauran power supply na kaatein - Fronius ye Solar.web updates ke liye saaf likhta hai.

solutions.en: After the update finishes, confirm the firmware version in Solar.web under Settings > Components.
solutions.ur: Update khatam hone ke baad Solar.web mein Settings > Components mein firmware version confirm karein.

solutions.en: If the update stops midway and the LED keeps flashing, do not power-cycle immediately; note the state and re-check via Solar.web before intervening.
solutions.ur: Agar update beech mein ruk jaye aur LED flash karta rahe to foran power cycle na karein; state note karein aur intervene karne se pehle Solar.web se dobara check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED flashes blue (update in progress)

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC - LED status indicator

title.en: Communication LED white: service message present
title.ur: Communication LED safed: service message maujood

meaning.en: There is a service message waiting. This row exists only in the Symo GEN24 LED table.
meaning.ur: Aik service message mojood hai. Ye row sirf Symo GEN24 LED table mein mojood hai.

causes.en: A state code / service message has been raised and not yet acknowledged on the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter par aik state code ya service message aaya hai jo abhi acknowledge nahi hua.

causes.en: The message is a normal operating message (e.g. after a restart or a settings change) rather than a fault.
causes.ur: Message normal operating message bhi ho sakta hai (jaise restart ya settings change ke baad) fault nahi.

solutions.en: Open the user interface (System > Event Log or the Notifications user menu) or Solar.web and read the message before acknowledging it.
solutions.ur: User interface (System > Event Log ya Notifications user menu) ya Solar.web kholein aur acknowledge karne se pehle message padhein.

solutions.en: Record the code and timestamp, then clear the message - on GEN24 the 3-second optical-sensor press acknowledges a service message (white rapid flash).
solutions.ur: Code aur timestamp note karein, phir message clear karein - GEN24 par optical sensor ko 3 second dabane se service message acknowledge hota hai (safed rapid flash).

solutions.en: If the white LED returns immediately, the message is being re-raised - treat the underlying code, not the LED, as the fault.
solutions.ur: Agar safed LED foran wapas aa jaye to message dobara raise ho raha hai - fault LED nahi, uske neeche wala code hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Communication LED lights up white (steady)

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: GEN24 Symo 6-12 kW Plus / SC (status code table)

meaning.en: The wired shutdown chain is open, so the Symo GEN24 has shut down. Operating LED flashes red, and the SPD mechanical indicator turns from green to red if the surge protection device caused it.
meaning.ur: Wired shutdown chain khuli hai, is liye Symo GEN24 band ho gaya. Operating LED laal flash karta hai, aur agar surge protection device ne cause kiya to SPD ka mechanical indicator hara se laal ho jata hai.

causes.en: A device in the WSD chain has interrupted the signal line, most commonly a surge protection device (SPD) that has tripped.
causes.ur: WSD chain ka koi device signal line tod raha hai, aam tor par koi surge protection device (SPD) jo trigger ho chuka hai.

causes.en: The bypass installed ex works has been removed and no trigger device has been installed instead.
causes.ur: Factory se lagi hui bypass hata di gayi hai aur us ki jagah koi trigger device install nahi kiya gaya.

causes.en: The 2-pin signal cable of the surge protection device is interrupted or damaged.
causes.ur: Surge protection device ka 2-pin signal cable kata hua ya damaged hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC first, then read the SPD mechanical indicator on the surge protection device - green means healthy, red means it has tripped and needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC aur DC isolate karein, phir surge protection device ka SPD mechanical indicator padhein - hara matlab healthy, laal matlab trigger hua hai aur badalna hai.

solutions.en: If the SPD has tripped, Fronius states the inverter must be repaired by an authorised specialist company; SPD work is reserved for Fronius-trained service personnel.
solutions.ur: Agar SPD trigger hua hai to Fronius kehta hai inverter ki repair authorised specialist company se karwayein; SPD ka kaam Fronius-trained service personnel ke liye hai.

solutions.en: If no emergency stop / fire brigade switch is installed, install the ex-works bypass or a proper trigger device on the WSD connector, and set the WSD switch to position 1 (WSD primary device).
solutions.ur: Agar emergency stop / fire brigade switch installed nahi hai to WSD connector par factory bypass ya proper trigger device lagayein, aur WSD switch ko position 1 (WSD primary device) par set karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Operating LED flashes red; SPD mechanical indicator green -> red if SPD tripped

notes.en: Same fault as SERIES 2 (1030) and SERIES 3 (1030), but tabulated in the Symo GEN24 model-line manual. The three tables are kept separate per model line and are not merged. On this three-phase model line a tripped SPD also switches the inverter off independently of the WSD function.
notes.ur: SERIES 2 (1030) aur SERIES 3 (1030) se wahi fault, lekin Symo GEN24 model-line manual mein tabulated. Teenon tables model line ke mutabiq alag rakhi gayi hain aur merge nahi hui. Is three-phase model line par tripped SPD WSD function se alag bhi inverter band kar deta hai.

source.title: Fronius Symo GEN24 6 - 10 kW Plus / Symo GEN24 6 - 12 kW Plus SC Operating instructions

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 1 status codes

meaning.en: The grid voltage is above the permissible range, so the inverter has disconnected and is testing the grid. It resumes feed-in automatically once the voltage is back in range.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage permissible range se upar hai, is liye inverter disconnect ho gaya aur grid test kar raha hai. Voltage wapas range mein aate hi feed-in khud shuru kar deta hai.

causes.en: Genuine grid overvoltage, e.g. a long lightly loaded feeder with high PV export.
causes.ur: Grid ka waqai overvoltage, jaise lamba halka load wala feeder jahan PV export zyada ho.

causes.en: Inverter AC voltage measurement fault reporting a false high.
causes.ur: Inverter ka AC voltage measurement fault jis se ghalat high reading aaye.

solutions.en: Check the grid connections and measure the actual AC voltage at the inverter with a true-RMS multimeter.
solutions.ur: Grid connections check karein aur true-RMS multimeter se inverter par asal AC voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Let the inverter complete its grid observation period and resume on its own before intervening - Fronius states no device fault has occurred.
solutions.ur: Inverter ko apna grid observation period poora karne dein aur khud resume hone dein - Fronius kehta hai koi device fault nahi hua.

solutions.en: If it keeps recurring, contact the system installer; do not change grid limits yourself.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aata rahe to system installer se rabta karein; grid limits apne aap na badlein.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 1 status codes

meaning.en: The grid voltage is below the permissible range; the inverter has disconnected and waits for the grid to return to range.
meaning.ur: Grid voltage permissible range se neeche hai; inverter disconnect ho gaya hai aur grid ko range mein aane ka intezaar kar raha hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage sagging from a heavy local load or a fault on the feeder.
causes.ur: Bara local load ya feeder par fault ki wajah se grid voltage gir raha hai.

causes.en: AC breaker tripped or a loose AC / neutral connection.
causes.ur: AC breaker trip ho gaya ya AC / neutral connection dheeli hai.

solutions.en: Check the AC breaker is fully on and tighten the AC and neutral terminals at the inverter with the correct torque.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke AC breaker poori tarah on hai aur inverter par AC aur neutral terminals sahi torque par kasa dein.

solutions.en: Measure AC voltage at the inverter while the event occurs; if the distribution board reads normal, suspect a long or undersized AC cable run.
solutions.ur: Event ke dauran inverter par AC voltage measure karein; agar distribution board par normal ho to lamba ya chhota AC cable ka shak karein.

solutions.en: If it keeps recurring, contact the system installer to review the country setup undervoltage limits.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aata rahe to system installer se country setup ki undervoltage limits dobara check karwayein.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 1 status codes

meaning.en: The grid frequency is above the permissible range, so the inverter has disconnected and is testing the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency permissible range se upar hai, is liye inverter disconnect ho gaya aur grid test kar raha hai.

causes.en: Grid frequency above the country-setup overfrequency limit.
causes.ur: Grid frequency country setup ke overfrequency limit se upar hai.

causes.en: A local generator or CHP unit pulling the frequency up on the same feeder.
causes.ur: Wahi feeder par koi local generator ya CHP unit frequency upar le raha hai.

solutions.en: Measure the grid frequency with a clamp meter at the inverter AC terminals.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se inverter ke AC terminals par grid frequency measure karein.

solutions.en: Let the inverter run its observation period and reconnect automatically - Fronius states no device fault has occurred.
solutions.ur: Inverter ko observation period poora karne dein aur khud reconnect hone dein - Fronius kehta hai koi device fault nahi hua.

solutions.en: If it keeps recurring, have the installer check the country setup with the utility rather than altering frequency limits.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aata rahe to installer se utility ke saath country setup check karwayein, frequency limits badalne ke bajaye.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 1 status codes

meaning.en: The grid frequency is below the permissible range; the inverter has disconnected and is testing the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency permissible range se neeche hai; inverter disconnect ho gaya aur grid test kar raha hai.

causes.en: Grid frequency below the country-setup underfrequency limit.
causes.ur: Grid frequency country setup ke underfrequency limit se neeche hai.

causes.en: Large motor starting on the same feeder, or a weak grid connection.
causes.ur: Wahi feeder par bara motor start ho raha hai, ya grid connection kamzor hai.

solutions.en: Measure the grid frequency with a clamp meter and note the time of day it happens.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se grid frequency measure karein aur note karein ke din ka kis waqt hota hai.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid to normalise; the inverter reconnects on its own after the observation period.
solutions.ur: Grid normal hone dein; observation period ke baad inverter khud reconnect ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If it keeps recurring, contact the system installer - do not change the rated frequency yourself.
solutions.ur: Agar baar baar aata rahe to system installer se rabta karein - rated frequency apne aap na badlein.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 1 status codes

title.ur: Koi AC grid detect nahi hui (107)

meaning.en: The inverter detects no AC grid, so it cannot connect or feed in. It tests continuously and reconnects when the grid returns.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko koi AC grid detect nahi ho rahi, is liye connect ya feed nahi kar sakta. Ye lagatar test karta hai aur grid wapas aate hi reconnect ho jata hai.

causes.en: AC breaker open, or the AC isolator / disconnect switch is off.
causes.ur: AC breaker khula hai, ya AC isolator / disconnect switch band hai.

causes.en: Utility supply outage on this site.
causes.ur: Is site par utility supply chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Broken or disconnected AC wiring between the grid and the inverter.
causes.ur: Grid aur inverter ke darmiyan AC wiring kat gayi ya disconnect ho gayi hai.

solutions.en: Check the AC breaker and the external AC disconnect and confirm the utility supply is present at the site.
solutions.ur: AC breaker aur external AC disconnect check karein aur confirm karein ke site par utility supply maujood hai.

solutions.en: Measure AC voltage at the inverter AC terminals with a multimeter; expect 208-240 V (+10% / -12%) on this model line.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se inverter ke AC terminals par AC voltage measure karein; is model line par 208-240 V (+10% / -12%) expect karein.

solutions.en: If voltage is present at the inverter but 107 persists, inspect the AC wiring and terminations for a break and retighten/replace as needed.
solutions.ur: Agar inverter par voltage maujood ho lekin 107 rahe to AC wiring aur terminations mein break check karein aur zarurat ho to dobara kasa dein ya badlein.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 1 status codes

meaning.en: The inverter detected stand-alone (island) operation - it is feeding an isolated part of the grid - and disconnected.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne stand-alone (island) operation detect ki - ye grid ke alag hisse ko feed kar raha tha - aur disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: A part of the grid has become disconnected from the utility supply while generation and load happen to balance.
causes.ur: Grid ka koi hissa utility supply se disconnect ho gaya jabke generation aur load aik taraf balance mein hain.

causes.en: Back-feed or generator contact that can energise the inverter AC terminals from another source.
causes.ur: Back-feed ya generator contact jo doosre source se inverter ke AC terminals ko energise kar sakta hai.

solutions.en: Do not defeat the anti-islanding function - it is a grid-code safety requirement.
solutions.ur: Anti-islanding function ko disable na karein - ye grid-code ki safety requirement hai.

solutions.en: Check for any back-feed path: a generator changeover, a second inverter on the same AC node, or a wrongly wired changeover switch.
solutions.ur: Har back-feed path check karein: generator changeover, usi AC node par doosra inverter, ya ghalat se wired changeover switch.

solutions.en: Restore the utility supply, then let the inverter pass its observation period and reconnect; contact the installer if it recurs.
solutions.ur: Utility supply wapas karein, phir inverter ko observation period poora karne dein aur reconnect hone dein; dohra ho to installer se rabta karein.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 1 status codes

meaning.en: The residual current monitoring unit has detected a residual current and the inverter has stopped feed-in. Fronius lists it as a grid-side class 1 code.
meaning.ur: Residual current monitoring unit ne residual current detect kiya aur inverter ne feed-in band kar di. Fronius ise grid side ka class 1 code list karta hai.

causes.en: Insulation fault on the PV array, DC wiring or inside the inverter producing residual current.
causes.ur: PV array, DC wiring ya inverter ke andar insulation fault jo residual current bana raha hai.

causes.en: Wet junction box, cable gland or module back sheet after rain, dew or cleaning.
causes.ur: Barish, oos ya dhoane ke baad geela junction box, cable gland ya module back sheet.

causes.en: Nuisance RCMU tripping from a DC-side EMI filter or an unsuitable RCD type on the AC side.
causes.ur: DC side ke EMI filter ya AC side par galat RCD type ki wajah se nuisance RCMU tripping.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and DC, then measure insulation resistance per string to earth with a Riso/megger to localise the fault.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC isolate karein, phir har string ka earth ke saath insulation resistance Riso/megger se nikaal kar fault ki jagah dhoondein.

solutions.en: Open and dry or replace any junction box, connector or module with water ingress, corrosion or damaged insulation.
solutions.ur: Paani ghusay, zang lage ya damaged insulation wala koi bhi junction box, connector ya module khol kar sukhaayein ya badlein.

solutions.en: Only after the insulation fault is confirmed fixed, restart and clear the status code; contact the system installer if it recurs.
solutions.ur: Sirf insulation fault theek hone ki tasdeeq ke baad restart karke status code clear karein; dohra to system installer se rabta karein.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 3 status codes

meaning.en: Short interruption of grid power feed operation due to an AC overcurrent in the inverter. The inverter returns to the startup phase.
meaning.ur: Inverter mein AC overcurrent ki wajah se grid feed-in mein chhoti interruption. Inverter startup phase par wapas chala jata hai.

causes.en: Inrush or overload from a large appliance on the same AC circuit, or grid transients.
causes.ur: Usi AC circuit par bade appliance ka inrush ya overload, ya grid transients.

causes.en: AC filter capacitor ageing causing excess ripple current on this model line.
causes.ur: Is model line par AC filter capacitor ke ageing se zyada ripple current.

solutions.en: Identify what was switched on when 301 appeared and check the AC circuit for an oversized or motor load.
solutions.ur: Dhoondein ke 301 aate waqt kya on hua tha aur AC circuit par bara ya motor load check karein.

solutions.en: Fronius states the error is corrected automatically; if the code persists, contact a Fronius-trained service technician.
solutions.ur: Fronius kehta hai error khud theek ho jata hai; agar code rahe to Fronius-trained service technician se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Measure the AC current at the inverter with a clamp meter and compare it with the inverter's rated AC output current.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se inverter par AC current measure karein aur inverter ke rated AC output current se milayein.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 3 status codes

meaning.en: Short interruption of grid power feed operation due to a DC overcurrent in the inverter. The inverter returns to the startup phase.
meaning.ur: Inverter mein DC overcurrent ki wajah se grid feed-in mein chhoti interruption. Inverter startup phase par wapas chala jata hai.

causes.en: String current above the inverter's maximum input current - undersized string fuses or too many modules in parallel on one MPPT.
causes.ur: String current inverter ke maximum input current se zyada - chhote string fuses ya aik MPPT par parallel modules zyada.

causes.en: A shorted or faulty PV module or bypass diode pulling excess current.
causes.ur: Koi short ya kharab PV module ya bypass diode zyada current kheench raha hai.

solutions.en: Open the AC breaker and DC disconnector, then measure each string's operating current with a clamp meter and compare it with the MPPT maximum input current.
solutions.ur: AC breaker aur DC disconnector kholein, phir clamp meter se har string ka current measure karke MPPT ke maximum input current se milayein.

solutions.en: Verify string fuse sizing and the number of parallel strings per MPPT against the manual's module array configuration table.
solutions.ur: String fuse sizing aur har MPPT par parallel strings ki tadaad ko manual ki module array configuration table se verify karein.

solutions.en: Fronius states the error is corrected automatically; if the code persists, contact a Fronius-trained service technician.
solutions.ur: Fronius kehta hai error khud theek ho jata hai; agar code rahe to Fronius-trained service technician se rabta karein.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 3 status codes

meaning.en: Short interruption of power feeding into the grid due to over-temperature of the power module. The inverter returns to the startup phase.
meaning.ur: Power module ke over-temperature ki wajah se grid mein power feeding mein chhoti interruption. Inverter startup phase par wapas chala jata hai.

causes.en: Blocked or clogged cooling vents and heat sink, e.g. dust, leaves, cotton or an animal nest.
causes.ur: Cooling vents aur heat sink block ya clogged, jaise dhool, patte, rui ya kisi jaanwar ka ghar.

causes.en: High ambient temperature in a poorly ventilated installation position.
causes.ur: Kam ventilation wali jagah par high ambient temperature.

causes.en: Fan failure or a defective internal temperature sensor on this model line.
causes.ur: Is model line par fan ki kharabi ya kharab internal temperature sensor.

solutions.en: Clean the cool air vents and cooling elements with compressed air, as Fronius instructs in the remedy column.
solutions.ur: Fronius ke remedy column ke mutabiq cool air vents aur cooling elements ko compressed air se saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check the installation position leaves the required clearance for cooling airflow and is not in direct sun at midday.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke installation position cooling airflow ke liye required clearance chhorta hai aur dopahar ki dhoop se nahi lagti.

solutions.en: Fronius states the fault is rectified automatically; if it persists, contact the system installer to check the fan and temperature sensor.
solutions.ur: Fronius kehta hai fault khud theek ho jata hai; agar rahe to system installer se fan aur temperature sensor check karwayein.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 3 status codes

meaning.en: Short interruption of power feeding into the grid due to excessive internal temperature. The inverter returns to the startup phase.
meaning.ur: Andar ki temperature zyada hone ki wajah se grid mein power feeding mein chhoti interruption. Inverter startup phase par wapas chala jata hai.

causes.en: Blocked cooling airflow around the inverter housing and heat sink.
causes.ur: Inverter housing aur heat sink ke aas paas cooling airflow block.

causes.en: Very high ambient temperature, or several inverters stacked in one cabinet without spacing.
causes.ur: Bohat zyada ambient temperature, ya aik cabinet mein spacing ke baghair kai inverters rakhe hue.

causes.en: Internal temperature sensor drift giving a false high reading.
causes.ur: Internal temperature sensor ka drift jis se ghalat high reading aaye.

solutions.en: Clean the cool air vents and cooling elements with compressed air and clear any obstruction around the unit.
solutions.ur: Cool air vents aur cooling elements ko compressed air se saaf karein aur unit ke aas paas koi obstruction hata dein.

solutions.en: Verify the mounting gives the clearance required for cooling and that ambient temperature at the site stays within the rated range.
solutions.ur: Verify karein ke mounting cooling ke liye required clearance deta hai aur site ka ambient temperature rated range mein rehta hai.

solutions.en: Fronius states the fault is rectified automatically; if it persists, contact the system installer.
solutions.ur: Fronius kehta hai fault khud theek ho jata hai; agar rahe to system installer se rabta karein.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 3 status codes

title.en: PV POWER LOW - DC power too low (306)
title.ur: PV POWER LOW - DC power bohat kam (306)

meaning.en: The intermediate (DC link) circuit voltage is too low for grid power feed operation. Short interruption; the inverter returns to the startup phase.
meaning.ur: Intermediate (DC link) circuit voltage grid feed-in ke liye bohat kam hai. Chhoti interruption; inverter startup phase par wapas chala jata hai.

causes.en: Low solar irradiance - this code appears naturally at dawn, dusk and in poor weather and is not a fault.
causes.ur: Irradiation kam hai - ye code subah, shaam aur kharab mausam mein aata hai aur fault nahi hai.

causes.en: Snow on the PV modules or heavy shading of the array.
causes.ur: PV modules par barf ya array par gehri shadowing.

solutions.en: Fronius states the fault is rectified automatically; no action is needed when irradiance is low.
solutions.ur: Fronius kehta hai fault khud theek ho jata hai; irradiation kam hone par koi action zaroori nahi.

solutions.en: If 306 persists with sufficient sunlight, contact the system installer.
solutions.ur: Agar kaafi dhoop ke bawajood 306 rahe to system installer se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Check for new shading (a new building, grown tree, water tank) if it appears at midday on a clear day.
solutions.ur: Agar saaf din ke dopahar ko aaye to nayi shadowing check karein (nayi building, barhi hua darakht, pan ki tanki).

notes.en: Fronius IMPORTANT: 'Status codes 306 (PV POWER LOW) and 307 (PV VOLTAGE LOW) appear naturally every morning and evening due to low solar irradiance. These status codes are not the result of a fault.' Marked isFault: false accordingly.
notes.ur: Fronius IMPORTANT: 'Status codes 306 (PV POWER LOW) and 307 (PV VOLTAGE LOW) roz subah aur shaam naturally aate hain kyunke solar irradiance kam hota hai. Ye status codes kisi fault ka nateeja nahi hain.' Isi mutabiq isFault: false rakha gaya hai.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 3 status codes

title.en: PV VOLTAGE LOW - DC input voltage low (307)
title.ur: PV VOLTAGE LOW - DC input voltage kam (307)

meaning.en: The DC input voltage is too low for grid power feed operation. Short interruption; the inverter returns to the startup phase.
meaning.ur: DC input voltage grid feed-in ke liye bohat kam hai. Chhoti interruption; inverter startup phase par wapas chala jata hai.

causes.en: Low solar irradiance - appears naturally every morning and evening and is not a fault.
causes.ur: Irradiation kam hai - roz subah aur shaam aata hai aur fault nahi hai.

causes.en: A string disconnected or an open DC connector, which also drops the string voltage below the minimum input voltage.
causes.ur: Koi string disconnect ya khula DC connector, jis se string voltage minimum input voltage se neeche gir jata hai.

solutions.en: Fronius states the fault is rectified automatically; no action is needed at dawn or dusk.
solutions.ur: Fronius kehta hai fault khud theek ho jata hai; subah ya shaam ko koi action zaroori nahi.

solutions.en: If 307 persists with sufficient sunlight, check the DC disconnector position and every string connector and string fuse for an open connection.
solutions.ur: Agar kaafi dhoop ke bawajood 307 rahe to DC disconnector ki position aur har string connector aur string fuse mein khuli connection check karein.

solutions.en: Contact the system installer if it keeps recurring in full sun.
solutions.ur: Agar poori dhoop mein baar baar aata rahe to system installer se rabta karein.

notes.en: Fronius IMPORTANT: codes 306 and 307 'appear naturally every morning and evening due to low solar irradiance. These status codes are not the result of a fault.'
notes.ur: Fronius IMPORTANT: codes 306 aur 307 'roz subah aur shaam aate hain kyunke solar irradiance kam hota hai. Ye status codes kisi fault ka nateeja nahi hain.'

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 3 status codes

meaning.en: Short interruption of grid power feed operation due to overvoltage on the intermediate circuit. The inverter returns to the startup phase.
meaning.ur: Intermediate circuit par overvoltage ki wajah se grid feed-in mein chhoti interruption. Inverter startup phase par wapas chala jata hai.

causes.en: DC input voltage above the maximum input voltage, e.g. too many modules in series for the ambient temperature.
causes.ur: DC input voltage maximum input voltage se upar, jaise ambient temperature ke liye series mein modules zyada.

causes.en: String open-circuit voltage too high for the inverter's maximum input voltage rating.
causes.ur: String ki open-circuit voltage inverter ke maximum input voltage rating se zyada.

solutions.en: Open the DC disconnector and measure each string's open-circuit voltage with a multimeter; compare it with the inverter's maximum input voltage from the technical data.
solutions.ur: DC disconnector kholein aur multimeter se har string ki open-circuit voltage measure karein; technical data ke inverter ke maximum input voltage se milayein.

solutions.en: Recalculate the string configuration for the site temperature using Fronius' string sizing guidance, or reduce modules per string.
solutions.ur: Site temperature ke liye Fronius ki string sizing guidance se string configuration dobara calculate karein, ya har string mein modules kam karein.

solutions.en: Fronius states the error is corrected automatically; if the code persists, contact a Fronius-trained service technician.
solutions.ur: Fronius kehta hai error khud theek ho jata hai; agar code rahe to Fronius-trained service technician se rabta karein.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 3 status codes

title.en: DC input voltage MPPT1 too high (309)
title.ur: DC input voltage MPPT1 bohat zyada (309)

meaning.en: The DC input voltage on MPPT 1 is above the permissible limit, so grid power feed operation was briefly interrupted and the inverter returns to the startup phase.
meaning.ur: MPPT 1 par DC input voltage permissible limit se upar hai, is liye grid feed-in chhoti der ke liye ruka aur inverter startup phase par wapas gaya.

causes.en: String connected to MPPT 1 has an open-circuit voltage above the inverter's maximum DC input voltage.
causes.ur: MPPT 1 se juri string ki open-circuit voltage inverter ke maximum DC input voltage se zyada hai.

causes.en: String fuse in the combiner has blown and left a partial string on MPPT 1 presenting a high voltage.
causes.ur: Combiner mein string fuse phool gaya hai aur MPPT 1 par aisi partial string reh gayi hai jo high voltage deti hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC disconnector and measure the open-circuit voltage of the string on MPPT 1; compare it with the technical data maximum DC input voltage.
solutions.ur: DC disconnector kholein aur MPPT 1 par wali string ki open-circuit voltage measure karein; technical data ke maximum DC input voltage se milayein.

solutions.en: Check the string fuses in the combiner and the DC connectors for a blown fuse or a partially unseated plug.
solutions.ur: Combiner ke string fuses aur DC connectors mein phoola fuse ya aadha baitha plug check karein.

solutions.en: If the reading is within limits and the code persists, contact a Fronius-trained service technician - the MPPT input measurement may be faulty.
solutions.ur: Agar reading limit ke andar ho aur code rahe to Fronius-trained service technician se rabta karein - MPPT input measurement kharab ho sakta hai.

notes.en: In the published table, 309 and 313 appear immediately after the 308 behaviour/remedy block and carry no separate Behaviour or Remedy text of their own; they inherit the 308 behaviour. Treated here as a real fault rather than a Class 3 non-interruption because the DC input voltage is genuinely out of the permissible range.
notes.ur: Published table mein 309 aur 313 foran 308 ke behaviour/remedy block ke baad aate hain aur apna koi alag Behaviour ya Remedy text nahi rakhte; ye 308 ka behaviour inherit karte hain. Yahan inhe asal fault maana gaya hai, Class 3 non-interruption nahi, kyunke DC input voltage waqai permissible range se bahar hai.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Fronius Primo 208-240 (SnapINverter) - Class 3 status codes

title.en: DC input voltage MPPT2 too high (313)
title.ur: DC input voltage MPPT2 bohat zyada (313)

meaning.en: The DC input voltage on MPPT 2 is above the permissible limit, so grid power feed operation was briefly interrupted and the inverter returns to the startup phase.
meaning.ur: MPPT 2 par DC input voltage permissible limit se upar hai, is liye grid feed-in chhoti der ke liye ruka aur inverter startup phase par wapas gaya.

causes.en: String connected to MPPT 2 has an open-circuit voltage above the inverter's maximum DC input voltage.
causes.ur: MPPT 2 se juri string ki open-circuit voltage inverter ke maximum DC input voltage se zyada hai.

causes.en: String fuse in the combiner for the MPPT 2 input has blown, leaving a high-voltage partial string on that MPPT.
causes.ur: MPPT 2 input ke liye combiner mein string fuse phool gaya hai, jis se us MPPT par high-voltage partial string reh gayi hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC disconnector and measure the open-circuit voltage of the string on MPPT 2 against the technical data maximum DC input voltage.
solutions.ur: DC disconnector kholein aur MPPT 2 par wali string ki open-circuit voltage ko technical data ke maximum DC input voltage se milayein.

solutions.en: Check the MPPT 2 string fuses, connectors and the DC disconnector terminals for a blown fuse, heat damage or a loose connection.
solutions.ur: MPPT 2 ke string fuses, connectors aur DC disconnector terminals mein phoola fuse, garmi ka nishan ya dheela connection check karein.

solutions.en: If the reading is within limits and the code persists, contact a Fronius-trained service technician - the MPPT input measurement may be faulty.
solutions.ur: Agar reading limit ke andar ho aur code rahe to Fronius-trained service technician se rabta karein - MPPT input measurement kharab ho sakta hai.

notes.en: In the published table, 313 appears after 308 and 309 with no separate Behaviour or Remedy text, inheriting the 308 behaviour. Note that on GEN24 the equivalent condition is 1xxx (e.g. 1139 DC link voltage too low) and is NOT the same number - do not cross-map the numbers.
notes.ur: Published table mein 313, 308 aur 309 ke baad aata hai aur apna alag Behaviour ya Remedy text nahi rakhta, 308 ka behaviour inherit karta hai. Note: GEN24 par is ka equivalent 1xxx (jaise 1139 DC link voltage too low) hai aur wohi number nahi hai - numbers ko aik doosre par map na karein.

source.title: Fronius Primo 208-240 Operating instructions (digital eManual, rev. 025-16102024)

codes.seriesName: Sunny Home Manager 2.0

title.en: Status LED off — no supply voltage (HM20)
title.ur: Status LED bujha — supply voltage nahi (HM20)

meaning.en: The Sunny Home Manager is not supplied with voltage. All its LEDs are dark, which SMA also describes as the signature of a missing supply in the registration troubleshooting section.
meaning.ur: Sunny Home Manager ko voltage supply nahi mil raha. Us ke sabhi LEDs bujhe hain, aur SMA registration troubleshooting section mein bhi yehi missing supply ki nishani bataya hai.

causes.en: No mains voltage at the device — upstream MCB, isolator or distribution fuse open.
causes.ur: Device par mains voltage nahi — upstream MCB, isolator ya distribution fuse khula hai.

causes.en: Device not connected to the voltage supply at the site (never terminated).
causes.ur: Device site par voltage supply se juda hi nahi (terminate nahi hua).

causes.en: Internal PSU failure, so the device is dead although mains is present.
causes.ur: Internal PSU fail ho gaya, jis se mains maujood hone ke bawajood device dead hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC supply to the Home Manager first, then check the upstream MCB and isolator, and re-close them.
solutions.ur: Home Manager ki AC supply pehle band karein, phir upstream MCB aur isolator check karke dobara close karein.

solutions.en: With the supply isolated, measure the mains voltage at the Home Manager terminals with a two-pole tester; expect full mains voltage, not zero.
solutions.ur: Supply isolate kar ke two-pole tester se Home Manager terminals par mains voltage measure karein; poori mains voltage aani chahiye, zero nahi.

solutions.en: If mains voltage is present at the terminals and the LEDs stay off, SMA's own guidance is to contact Service — do not open the unit.
solutions.ur: Agar terminals par mains voltage maujood hai phir bhi LEDs bujhe hain to SMA ka apna guidance hai ke Service se rabta karein — unit na kholein.

codes.blinkPattern: All LEDs off (Status LED, COM LED, Performance LED dark)

notes.en: This is the only state where the manual says all LEDs remain off, which makes it distinguishable from a single-LED fault.
notes.ur: Yeh wohi halat hai jahan manual ke mutabiq sabhi LEDs bujhe rehte hain, jis se ise aik LED ke fault se alag pehchana ja sakta hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY HOME MANAGER 2.0 (HM-20-BE-en-22, Version 2.2), section 18.1 Error message on the Sunny Home Manager

codes.seriesName: Sunny Home Manager 2.0

title.en: Status LED flashing red — no Sunny Portal link (HM20)
title.ur: Status LED lal chamak raha — Sunny Portal link nahi (HM20)

meaning.en: The Sunny Home Manager cannot establish the connection to Sunny Portal automatically.
meaning.ur: Sunny Home Manager khud ba khud Sunny Portal se connection nahi bana pata raha.

causes.en: No Ethernet connection — the network cable is unplugged or the switch port is down.
causes.ur: Ethernet connection nahi — network cable nikal chuka ya switch port down hai.

causes.en: DHCP not enabled on the site router, so the Home Manager gets no address.
causes.ur: Site router par DHCP enable nahi hai, jis se Home Manager ko koi address nahi milta.

causes.en: A proxy server in the network blocking the outbound connection.
causes.ur: Network mein proxy server outbound connection rok raha hai.

causes.en: Sunny Portal itself unreachable, or the site's firewall blocking the required ports.
causes.ur: Sunny Portal khud unreachable hai, ya site ka firewall zaroori ports rok raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the COM LED first: if it is off, the Ethernet link is physically down, so reseat the network cable at both the Home Manager and the switch or router.
solutions.ur: Pehle COM LED dekhein: agar woh bujha hai to Ethernet link physically down hai, is liye network cable Home Manager aur switch ya router dono taraf se dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Confirm DHCP is enabled on the router and that an address has actually been leased to the Home Manager's MAC, which is printed on the type label.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke router par DHCP enable hai aur Home Manager ke MAC (jo type label par chhapa hai) ko address mila hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Use the Sunny Home Manager Assistant to establish the connection manually, which is the manual's stated corrective measure for this LED state.
solutions.ur: Connection manually banane ke liye Sunny Home Manager Assistant istemal karein — yehi is LED state ke liye manual ka bataya hua corrective measure hai.

solutions.en: If a proxy or firewall is present, allow outbound HTTPS to Sunny Portal, then retry rather than repeatedly power-cycling the device.
solutions.ur: Agar proxy ya firewall maujood hai to Sunny Portal ki taraf outbound HTTPS ki ijazat dein, phir dobara koshish karein — device baar baar power cycle na karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Status LED flashing red, COM LED off or steady

notes.en: Resembles a COM LED fault but is broader: the manual's registration section also lists this LED state for DHCP and proxy problems.
notes.ur: COM LED fault jaisa lagta hai magar yeh bara hai: manual ka registration section yeh LED state DHCP aur proxy maslon ke liye bhi batata hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY HOME MANAGER 2.0 (HM-20-BE-en-22, Version 2.2), section 18.1 Error message on the Sunny Home Manager

codes.seriesName: Sunny Home Manager 2.0

title.en: Performance LED off — not yet registered (HM20)
title.ur: Performance LED bujha — abhi register nahi hua (HM20)

meaning.en: The Sunny Home Manager has not been registered in Sunny Portal yet. This is normally a commissioning state, not a failure.
meaning.ur: Sunny Home Manager abhi Sunny Portal mein register nahi hua hai. Yeh aam tor par commissioning ki halat hai, failure nahi.

causes.en: Fresh installation where registration has not yet been done.
causes.ur: Nayi installation jahan abhi registration nahi hui.

causes.en: Used as an energy meter only, in which case SMA states it need not be registered and the Performance LED never glows.
causes.ur: Sirf energy meter ki tarah istemal, jis case mein SMA kehti hai ke register karne ki zaroorat nahi aur Performance LED kabhi nahi jalega.

causes.en: Device purchased second-hand and still assigned to the previous owner's Sunny Portal system.
causes.ur: Second-hand khareeda gaya device jo abhi bhi pichle malik ke Sunny Portal system se juda hua hai.

solutions.en: Check how the device is being used before acting: if it is only an energy meter for export limiting, this LED state is expected and correct.
solutions.ur: Kuch karne se pehle dekhein ke device kaise istemal ho raha hai: agar sirf export limiting ke liye energy meter hai to yeh LED state expected aur sahi hai.

solutions.en: If it should be registered, register it in Sunny Portal using the System Setup Assistant with its identification and registration ID.
solutions.ur: Agar iska registered hona chahiye to System Setup Assistant ke zariye apni identification aur registration ID se Sunny Portal mein register karein.

solutions.en: If the device was bought second-hand, have the previous owner delete the Sunny Home Manager system in Sunny Portal before registering it, as the manual advises.
solutions.ur: Agar device second-hand khareeda gaya hai to register karne se pehle pichle malik se Sunny Portal mein Sunny Home Manager system delete karwayein, jaise manual kehti hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Performance LED off, Status LED glowing green

notes.en: Non-fault status row, but it is the single most common cause of a 'device not working' call, so it belongs in the table.
notes.ur: Non-fault status row hai, lekin yeh 'device kaam nahi kar raha' walay sab se aam call ki wajah hai, is liye table mein hona chahiye.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY HOME MANAGER 2.0 (HM-20-BE-en-22, Version 2.2), section 18.1 Error message on the Sunny Home Manager

codes.seriesName: Sunny Home Manager 2.0

title.en: Performance LED solid red — unreported device fault (HM20)
title.ur: Performance LED lal — device ka fault report nahi hua (HM20)

meaning.en: An error has occurred and has not yet been reported to Sunny Portal because the Home Manager cannot establish the connection automatically. One or more devices in the system may be in a fault state that could not be passed on.
meaning.ur: Koi error aaya hai jo Sunny Portal tak report nahi hua kyunke Home Manager khud ba khud connection nahi bana pata raha. System ke aik ya zyada devices fault state mein ho sakte hain jo aage nahi barh saka.

causes.en: A downstream device such as an inverter or battery is in a fault state.
causes.ur: Koi downstream device jaise inverter ya battery fault state mein hai.

causes.en: The Home Manager cannot reach Sunny Portal, so the fault cannot be reported.
causes.ur: Home Manager Sunny Portal tak nahi pohanch sakta, jis se fault report nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: A device in the system is misconfigured or not properly connected.
causes.ur: System ka koi device misconfigured ya theek se connected nahi hai.

solutions.en: Read the fault locally rather than waiting for Sunny Portal: open the local interface and look at the device status area, which shows Error or Warning state per device.
solutions.ur: Sunny Portal ka intezaar karne ke bajaye fault locally padhein: local interface kholein aur device status area dekhein, jo per device Error ya Warning state dikhata hai.

solutions.en: Check the connection and configuration of all devices in the system, which is the manual's stated first corrective measure.
solutions.ur: System ke sabhi devices ki connection aur configuration check karein — yehi manual ka pehla bataya hua corrective measure hai.

solutions.en: Work device by device from the Home Manager: note which unit shows a fault, then open that unit's own interface and read its event number.
solutions.ur: Home Manager se device ba device kaam karein: note karein ke kaun si unit fault dikha rahi hai, phir us unit ka apna interface khol kar uska event number padhein.

solutions.en: Once the connection to Sunny Portal is restored the red state should clear, confirming the fault was reported rather than resolved.
solutions.ur: Sunny Portal se connection wapas establish hone ke baad lal halat clear ho jana chahiye, jo confirm karta hai ke fault report hua tha, resolve nahi hua tha.

codes.blinkPattern: Performance LED glowing red steadily

notes.en: Note the contrast with flashing red in the same table: flashing means connection failure, solid red means an actual device fault that could not be reported.
notes.ur: Isi table mein flashing red se farq note karein: flashing ka matlab connection failure hai, solid red ka matlab asal device fault hai jo report nahi ho saka.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY HOME MANAGER 2.0 (HM-20-BE-en-22, Version 2.2), section 18.1 Error message on the Sunny Home Manager

codes.seriesName: Sunny Home Manager 2.0

title.en: Performance LED flashing red — portal link down (HM20)
title.ur: Performance LED lal chamak raha — portal link down (HM20)

meaning.en: The Sunny Home Manager cannot establish the connection to Sunny Portal automatically. Unlike the solid red state, the manual attributes this purely to the connection.
meaning.ur: Sunny Home Manager khud ba khud Sunny Portal se connection nahi bana pata raha. Solid red state ke muqable mein, manual ise sirf connection ki wajah se mansa karta hai.

causes.en: Home Manager not correctly connected to the router.
causes.ur: Home Manager router se theek se connected nahi hai.

causes.en: Router changed or replaced, so the stored network configuration no longer matches.
causes.ur: Router badal gaya ya replace hua hai, jis se stored network configuration ab match nahi karti.

causes.en: Internet uplink on the site is down, or DNS resolution is failing.
causes.ur: Site ka internet uplink down hai, ya DNS resolve nahi ho raha.

causes.en: Firmware update interrupted, leaving the device unable to complete a normal boot and register.
causes.ur: Firmware update ke darmiyan ruka, jis se device normal boot aur register nahi kar paya.

solutions.en: Ensure the Home Manager is correctly connected to the router, which the manual lists first for this LED state.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke Home Manager router se theek se juda hai — yehi is LED state ke liye manual sab se pehle kehti hai.

solutions.en: Power-cycle the device once by disconnecting and reconnecting the voltage supply, then allow it up to a few minutes to register.
solutions.ur: Voltage supply disconnect karke dobara jod kar device ko aik baar power cycle karein, phir use register hone ke liye chand minute dein.

solutions.en: Use the Sunny Home Manager Assistant in case of network problems, the manual's stated corrective measure for this exact state.
solutions.ur: Network ki masla hal karne ke liye Sunny Home Manager Assistant istemal karein — yehi isi LED state ke liye manual ka bataya hua corrective measure hai.

solutions.en: Verify from another device on the same LAN that Sunny Portal is reachable, so you separate a site internet fault from a Home Manager configuration fault.
solutions.ur: Usi LAN par maujood kisi doosre device se confirm karein ke Sunny Portal reachable hai, taake site ke internet fault aur Home Manager configuration fault mein farq ho sake.

codes.blinkPattern: Performance LED flashing red

notes.en: Diagnostic shortcut: solid red = real device fault, flashing red = connectivity. Test the LAN from another device before touching the Home Manager.
notes.ur: Diagnostic shortcut: solid red = asal device fault, flashing red = connectivity. Home Manager ko chherne se pehle LAN ko doosre device se test karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY HOME MANAGER 2.0 (HM-20-BE-en-22, Version 2.2), section 18.1 Error message on the Sunny Home Manager

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

title.ur: Sunny Island ke transformer mein zyada temperature (F109)

meaning.en: The transformer in the device at L1 (master) is over-temperature because of overload or ambient temperature. The unit shuts down.
meaning.ur: L1 (master) par device ke transformer mein zyada temperature hai — overload ya ambient temperature ki wajah se. Unit band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Load demand beyond the Sunny Island rating at that phase.
causes.ur: Us phase par Sunny Island ki rating se zyada load demand.

causes.en: High ambient temperature in an unventilated plant or generator room.
causes.ur: Bina hawa ki plant room ya generator room mein zyada ambient temperature.

causes.en: Blocked or failed cooling fan on the unit.
causes.ur: Unit ka cooling fan band ya defective.

solutions.en: Isolate the unit from AC sources and loads, then restart it and watch whether the error returns — that separates a transient overload from a hardware fault.
solutions.ur: Unit ko AC sources aur loads se isolate karein, phir restart karke dekhein ke error wapas aata hai ya nahi — waise pata chalta hai ke masla transient overload hai ya hardware fault.

solutions.en: Clean the fans as the manual directs, using a soft brush, and confirm the fan actually spins freely with the power off.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq fans soft brush se saaf karein, aur power off par confirm karein ke fan azaad ghoomta hai.

solutions.en: Stagger the loads so total demand never peaks together, and check the ventilation clearance around the unit per the manual.
solutions.ur: Loads ko aise stagger karein ke poori demand ek saath peak na ho, aur manual ke mutabiq unit ke aas paas ventilation clearance check karein.

notes.en: W110 and W111 are the same fault on slave 1 and slave 2 in a cluster — they are warnings, not faults.
notes.ur: W110 aur W111 cluster mein slave 1 aur slave 2 par wohi fault hain — yeh warnings hain, faults nahi.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

meaning.en: The inverter bridge (heatsink) at L1 (master) is over-temperature because of overload or ambient temperature. The unit shuts down.
meaning.ur: L1 (master) par inverter bridge (heatsink) mein zyada temperature hai — overload ya ambient temperature ki wajah se. Unit band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Sustained load above the inverter's continuous rating on one phase.
causes.ur: Kisi phase par inverter ki continuous rating se zyada mustaqal load.

causes.en: Ambient temperature above the maximum permissible value in the install room.
causes.ur: Install room mein maximum permissible value se zyada ambient temperature.

causes.en: Airflow through the unit obstructed by cable routing or a wall too close to the heat sink.
causes.ur: Cable routing ya deewar ki wajah se unit ka airflow ruka hua hai.

solutions.en: Isolate all AC sources and loads from the Sunny Island, restart it, and note whether the error returns at the same load level.
solutions.ur: Sunny Island se sabhi AC sources aur loads isolate karein, restart karein, aur note karein ke error usi load level par wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature and the heatsink temperature with an IR thermometer; a large gap between them means poor airflow rather than hot weather.
solutions.ur: IR thermometer se ambient aur heatsink temperature measure karein; dono ka bara farq kamzor airflow ka nishani hai, garmi mausam ka nahi.

solutions.en: Clear all cable bundles away from the heat sink and restore the manual's clearance, then reduce the phase load by staggering the loads.
solutions.ur: Saare cable bundles heat sink se door karein aur manual ka clearance wapas karein, phir loads stagger karke us phase ka load kam karein.

notes.en: Same display number family as F109 but the manual distinguishes transformer over-temperature from inverter-bridge over-temperature — do not merge them.
notes.ur: F109 ke saath yeh display number family wohi hai lekin manual transformer over-temperature aur inverter-bridge over-temperature mein farq karta hai — dono ko merge na karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

title.en: AC current limitation on line L1 (F117)
title.ur: Line L1 par AC current limitation (F117)

meaning.en: The load power on line conductor L1 is too high for the master, so the Sunny Island limits AC current.
meaning.ur: Line conductor L1 par loads ki power master ke liye zyada hai, is liye Sunny Island AC current limit kar raha hai.

causes.en: Connected load power exceeds the Sunny Island inverter power.
causes.ur: Connected loads ki power Sunny Island inverter ki power se zyada hai.

causes.en: A short circuit in the load circuit or the AC installation.
causes.ur: Load circuit ya AC installation mein short circuit.

causes.en: High inrush from a motor or compressor starting while other loads already run.
causes.ur: Dusre loads already chal rahan hon aur motor ya compressor start hote waqt zyada inrush.

solutions.en: Isolate AC sources and loads, clean the fans, and restart the Sunny Island as the manual's first corrective measure.
solutions.ur: AC sources aur loads isolate karein, fans saaf karein, aur manual ke pehle corrective measure ke mutabiq Sunny Island restart karein.

solutions.en: With the island stopped, clamp-meter each phase and measure actual load current; compare it against the Sunny Island rating printed on the nameplate.
solutions.ur: Island band kar ke clamp meter se har phase ka actual load current measure karein; usse Sunny Island ki rating se compare karein jo nameplate par likhi hai.

solutions.en: Check for a short circuit in the load circuit with an insulation tester, and reduce the load on the affected phase by moving circuits between phases.
solutions.ur: Insulation tester se load circuit mein short circuit check karein, aur affected phase ka load kam karne ke liye circuits doosre phases par move karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

meaning.en: An overvoltage has occurred at AC connection 1 of the master. The manual's first instruction is to disconnect all AC sources and loads and restart.
meaning.ur: Master ke AC connection 1 par overvoltage aaya hai. Manual ka pehla instruction hai sabhi AC sources aur loads disconnect karke restart karein.

causes.en: An external source such as a generator or grid back-feeding AC1 through the bypass switch.
causes.ur: Bypass switch ke zariye AC1 par koi external source jaise generator ya grid back-feed kar raha hai.

causes.en: Bypass switch left in the wrong position so it bridges the internal transfer relay.
causes.ur: Bypass switch galat position mein chhoda gaya hai jis se woh internal transfer relay ko bridge kar raha hai.

causes.en: A generator whose AVR is not regulating, producing a sustained overvoltage.
causes.ur: Aisa generator jiska AVR regulate nahi kar raha, jis se mustaqal overvoltage ban raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate all AC sources and loads from the Sunny Island and restart it, exactly as the manual states as the first step.
solutions.ur: Manual ke pehle step ke mutabiq Sunny Island se sabhi AC sources aur loads isolate karke restart karein.

solutions.en: Find the overvoltage source by measurement, connecting the AC sources and loads back one at a time while watching the AC1 voltage on a clamp meter or grid analyzer.
solutions.ur: AC sources aur loads ko ek-ek karke wapas jodte hue AC1 voltage ko clamp meter ya grid analyzer par dekhte hue, measurement se overvoltage ka source dhoondein.

solutions.en: Set the bypass switch to the position for operation with the Sunny Island and confirm the generator AVR is regulating voltage before reconnecting.
solutions.ur: Bypass switch ko Sunny Island ke saath chalane ki position par set karein aur dobara jodne se pehle confirm karein ke generator AVR voltage regulate kar raha hai.

notes.en: Related to the VtgOnAC1Det family (F158/F159/F160), which reports the same unwanted voltage as a warning.
notes.ur: VtgOnAC1Det family (F158/F159/F160) se mile julay hain, jo wohi unwanted voltage warning ki shakal mein report karte hain.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

meaning.en: An overfrequency has occurred at AC connection 1 of the master, so the Sunny Island has shut down.
meaning.ur: Master ke AC connection 1 par overfrequency aaya hai, is liye Sunny Island band ho gaya.

causes.en: Generator running with a failed governor or an incorrect frequency setpoint.
causes.ur: Generator aisa chal raha hai jiska governor ya frequency setpoint ghalat hai.

causes.en: Generator overloaded so the governor cannot hold the frequency setpoint.
causes.ur: Generator overloaded hai is liye governor frequency setpoint nahi pakad pa raha.

causes.en: An external energy source connected to AC1 instead of AC2.
causes.ur: AC2 ki jagah AC1 par koi external energy source joda gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate all AC sources and loads from the Sunny Island and restart it, as the manual directs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq Sunny Island se sabhi AC sources aur loads isolate karke restart karein.

solutions.en: Locate the overfrequency source by measurement, reconnecting AC sources and loads step by step while logging frequency at AC1 on a grid analyzer.
solutions.ur: Grid analyzer par AC1 ki frequency log karte hue AC sources aur loads ko qadam ba qadam wapas jod kar measurement se overfrequency ka source dhoondein.

solutions.en: If a generator is the source, adjust the generator frequency and confirm its governor holds the setpoint under load before recommissioning.
solutions.ur: Agar source generator hai to generator frequency adjust karein aur recommission se pehle confirm karein ke uska governor load ke under setpoint pakad leta hai.

notes.en: F133 is the underfrequency counterpart; both are hard faults in this manual while the 3xx Ext* events are warnings.
notes.ur: F133 is underfrequency ka counterpart hai; is manual mein dono hard faults hain jabke 3xx Ext* events warnings hain.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

meaning.en: An underfrequency has occurred at AC connection 1 of the master, so the Sunny Island has shut down.
meaning.ur: Master ke AC connection 1 par underfrequency aaya hai, is liye Sunny Island band ho gaya.

causes.en: Generator overloaded so its frequency sags below the configured threshold.
causes.ur: Generator overloaded hai jis se uski frequency configured threshold se neeche gir gayi.

causes.en: External voltage/connection problem dragging frequency down at the island's AC input.
causes.ur: Island ke AC input par external voltage ya connection ka masla frequency neeche kheench raha hai.

causes.en: Generator failed to start properly or dropped out during the connection sequence.
causes.ur: Generator theek se start nahi hua ya connection sequence ke dauran gir gaya.

solutions.en: Isolate all AC sources and loads from the Sunny Island and restart it, as the manual directs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq Sunny Island se sabhi AC sources aur loads isolate karke restart karein.

solutions.en: Find the underfrequency source by measurement, reconnecting AC sources and loads step by step while logging frequency at AC1.
solutions.ur: AC1 par frequency log karte hue AC sources aur loads ko qadam ba qadam wapas jod kar measurement se underfrequency ka source dhoondein.

solutions.en: If a generator is the source, reduce the connected load, then check its governor droop and its warm-up time parameter 234.12 GnWarmTm so it reaches a valid voltage before connection.
solutions.ur: Agar source generator hai to connected load kam karein, phir uska governor droop aur warm-up time parameter 234.12 GnWarmTm check karein ke woh connection se pehle valid voltage tak pahunche.

notes.en: The GnWarmTm connection appears in the manual under W402 GnFailLock, the generator block — check both together when start-ups keep failing.
notes.ur: GnWarmTm connection manual mein W402 GnFailLock, generator block ke under hai — start-ups fail hote rahen to dono saath check karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

meaning.en: Too much current is flowing through the DC connection of the master. A fault-level event, not a load-level one.
meaning.ur: Master ke DC connection se bohat zyada current beh raha hai. Yeh load level ka nahi, fault level ka event hai.

causes.en: A short circuit on the DC side of the battery or the DC sources.
causes.ur: Battery ya DC sources ke DC side par short circuit.

causes.en: DC wiring connected with reversed polarity, driving current into a device not designed for it.
causes.ur: DC wiring reversed polarity se jodi hui hai, jis se aise device mein current ja raha hai jo is ke liye bana nahi.

causes.en: Incorrect battery capacity or type for the Sunny Island, so charging current exceeds the design.
causes.ur: Sunny Island ke liye ghalat battery capacity ya type, jis se charging current design se zyada ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the battery at the BatFuse load-break switch first, then isolate AC and PV, before any measurement.
solutions.ur: Pehle BatFuse load-break switch se battery isolate karein, phir AC aur PV isolate karein, uske baad hi koi measurement karein.

solutions.en: With the DC side dead, measure continuity and insulation resistance on every DC conductor to find the shorted core, and verify polarity at each termination.
solutions.ur: DC side dead kar ke har DC conductor ki continuity aur insulation resistance measure karein taake short wala core mil jaye, aur har termination par polarity verify karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the installed battery type and capacity against the Sunny Island technical data and the battery manufacturer's charge-current limit.
solutions.ur: Lagai gayi battery ka type aur capacity Sunny Island ke technical data aur battery manufacturer ke charge-current limit se verify karein.

notes.en: Do not jump straight to 'replace the battery' — the manual's chain is isolate, then locate the short, then verify the battery spec.
notes.ur: Seedha 'battery badal dein' par na jayein — manual ka tareeqa hai isolate karo, phir short dhoondein, phir battery spec verify karo.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

meaning.en: The device at L1 (master) has been loaded beyond its five-minute rated capacity, so it derates or shuts down.
meaning.ur: L1 (master) par device apni 5-minute rated capacity se zyada load ho chuka hai, is liye woh derate ya band ho jata hai.

causes.en: A motor or compressor with a high inrush drawing a large block of power for a short period.
causes.ur: Motor ya compressor jiska inrush zyada hai aur jo chhoti duri ke liye bada power kheenchta hai.

causes.en: Several loads switching on at the same time after a supply interruption.
causes.ur: Supply interruption ke baad kai loads ek saath on ho jana.

causes.en: Sustained demand above the unit's continuous rating, not just its short-term rating.
causes.ur: Unit ki sirf short-term rating nahi, continuous rating se bhi zyada mustaqal demand.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load, which is the manual's stated corrective measure for this event.
solutions.ur: Connected load kam karein — yehi is event ke liye manual ka bataya hua corrective measure hai.

solutions.en: Log which loads switch on simultaneously and add time staggering or soft-start to the largest motor, as the manual suggests for high-inrush loads.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke kaun se loads ek saath on hote hain, aur sab se bade motor par soft-start ya staggering lagayein, jaise manual high-inrush loads ke liye kehta hai.

solutions.en: If the five-minute overload repeats at modest demand, clamp-meter each phase under real load and compare against the manual's overload figures in the technical data.
solutions.ur: Agar moqtabil demand par bhi 5-minute overload repeat ho to real load ke under har phase ka clamp-meter reading lein aur technical data ke overload figures se compare karein.

notes.en: Three separate overload codes exist: 5-minute (F166), 30-minute (F169) and short-term (F172). The duration is the diagnostic difference.
notes.ur: Teen alag overload codes hain: 5-minute (F166), 30-minute (F169) aur short-term (F172). Duration hi diagnosis ka farq hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

meaning.en: The device at L1 (master) has been loaded beyond its 30-minute rated capacity.
meaning.ur: L1 (master) par device apni 30-minute rated capacity se zyada load ho chuka hai.

causes.en: Sustained demand between the 5-minute and 30-minute ratings — a capacity sizing problem, not a motor inrush problem.
causes.ur: 5-minute aur 30-minute rating ke darmiyan mustaqal demand — yeh capacity sizing ka masla hai, motor inrush ka nahi.

causes.en: A high-power base load that never switches off, with a large appliance added on top.
causes.ur: Bohat high-power base load jo kabhi off na ho, aur us par bada appliance lag jaye.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq connected load kam karein.

solutions.en: Measure the 30-minute average demand with a clamp meter and logging meter; if it sits above the 30-minute rating, the unit is simply too small for this site.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter aur logging meter se 30-minute ki average demand measure karein; agar woh 30-minute rating se upar baithti hai to is site ke liye unit chhota hai.

solutions.en: Decide between staggering the loads and adding a further Sunny Island to the cluster, which the manual itself suggests for frequent derating.
