solutions.ur: Loads stagger karne aur cluster mein aik aur Sunny Island jodne ke darmiyan faisla karein, jaise manual baar baar derate hone par khud kehta hai.

notes.en: Distinguishing 5-minute from 30-minute overload tells the owner whether to fix a switching problem or upsize the plant.
notes.ur: 5-minute aur 30-minute overload mein farq karne se malik ko pata chalta hai ke switching ka masla hai ya plant bara karna hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

title.en: Current sensor not connected or defective (F176)
title.ur: Current sensor connected nahi ya defective (F176)

meaning.en: The current sensor is not connected, not available, or defective, so the Sunny Island cannot measure its own AC current. Level 4 fault.
meaning.ur: Current sensor connected nahi, available nahi, ya defective hai, is liye Sunny Island apna AC current nahi naap sakta. Level 4 fault.

causes.en: Current sensor transformer (CT) not fitted or not terminated in the AC installation.
causes.ur: AC installation mein current sensor transformer (CT) laga hi nahi ya terminate nahi hua.

causes.en: CT wiring open, or the sensor cable disconnected inside the unit.
causes.ur: CT wiring khuli hai, ya sensor cable unit ke andar se nikal gayi hai.

causes.en: The sensor has failed or drifted out of calibration, so measured current is wrong.
causes.ur: Sensor fail ho gaya ya calibration se bahar chala gaya, jis se measured current ghalat hai.

solutions.en: Isolate all AC sources and loads from the Sunny Island before touching the current sensor wiring.
solutions.ur: Current sensor wiring par kaam karne se pehle Sunny Island se sabhi AC sources aur loads isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check the CT installation and termination against the installation manual: correct ratio, correct direction, screws tight, cable undamaged.
solutions.ur: Installation manual ke mutabiq CT installation aur termination check karein: sahi ratio, sahi direction, screws mazboot, cable undamaged.

solutions.en: Verify the measured current against a clamp meter at the same instant; if the readings disagree by more than a few percent the sensor or its wiring is the problem, not the load.
solutions.ur: Usi waqt clamp meter ke saath measured current verify karein; agar readings mein kuch percent se zyada farq hai to masla sensor ya uski wiring ka hai, load ka nahi.

notes.en: Because the island regulates on measured current, a wrong reading causes spurious overload events (F166/F169) as well as bad battery charge control.
notes.ur: Kyunke island measured current par regulate karta hai, ghalat reading se khufay overload events (F166/F169) aur battery charging ka kharaab control bhi hota hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

meaning.en: The pre-fuse F104.1 in the Multicluster-Box is open. The main-cluster master detects voltage at ExtVtg and tries to switch to L1, where an anti-islanding error occurs because of the open pre-fuse.
meaning.ur: Multicluster-Box ka pre-fuse F104.1 khula hai. Main cluster ka master ExtVtg par voltage detect karke L1 par switch kne ki koshish karta hai, jahan khule pre-fuse ki wajah se anti-islanding error aata hai.

causes.en: Pre-fuse F104.1 has actually tripped from an overcurrent or short circuit in the cluster wiring.
causes.ur: Cluster wiring mein overcurrent ya short circuit ki wajah se pre-fuse F104.1 sach mein trip ho gaya.

causes.en: Pre-fuse holder not seated correctly during a past service operation.
causes.ur: Kisi pichli service ke dauran pre-fuse holder theek se baithaya nahi gaya.

causes.en: Cluster cable nicked during installation, loading the fuse to its breaking current.
causes.ur: Installation mein cluster cable mein nishan, jis se fuse apni breaking current par aa gaya.

solutions.en: Isolate the AC sources, loads and battery from the island, then confirm zero volts at the Multicluster-Box before touching any fuse.
solutions.ur: Island se AC sources, loads aur battery isolate karein, phir koi fuse chherne se pehle Multicluster-Box par zero volt confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure the insulation and continuity of the cluster conductors with an insulation tester before re-fitting the fuse — do not simply re-energise and hope.
solutions.ur: Fuse dobara lagane se pehle cluster conductors ki insulation aur continuity insulation tester se measure karein — bas energise karke umeed na lagayein.

solutions.en: Check the voltage supply at terminal AC2 of the master in the main cluster, which is the measurement the manual asks for after reactivating the fuse.
solutions.ur: Pre-fuse dobara lagane ke baad manual jo measurement mangta hai woh hai: main cluster ke master ke terminal AC2 par voltage supply check karein.

notes.en: W180 and W181 are the same fault on the L2 and L3 pre-fuses F104.2 and F104.3 — the pre-fuse number tells you which phase is dead.
notes.ur: W180 aur W181 wohi fault L2 aur L3 pre-fuses F104.2 aur F104.3 par hain — pre-fuse ka number batata hai ke kaun si phase marr chuki hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

title.ur: Battery voltage measuring range se upar (F201)

meaning.en: The battery voltage at the master is above the permissible measurement range, so the Sunny Island stops regulating on it.
meaning.ur: Master par battery voltage permissible measurement range se upar hai, is liye Sunny Island us par regulate karna chhod deta hai.

causes.en: Battery bank over-celled for the 48 V system — the manual tells you to read parameter 120.02 BatVtg and compare against 65.0 V.
causes.ur: Battery bank 48 V system ke liye zyada cells ka hai — manual kehti hai ke parameter 120.02 BatVtg padh kar 65.0 V se compare karein.

causes.en: DC sources configured with too high a charge voltage.
causes.ur: DC sources bohat zyada charge voltage ke saath configure hain.

causes.en: Battery capacity too small for the connected DC sources, so the sources drive the bus voltage up.
causes.ur: Battery capacity connected DC sources ke liye chhoti hai, jis se sources bus voltage upar le jaate hain.

causes.en: A cell shorted or a cell interconnector open, so the string voltage no longer divides evenly.
causes.ur: Koi cell short ho gaya ya cell interconnector khul gaya, jis se string voltage ab barabar baant nahi hota.

solutions.en: Isolate DC sources, then read parameter 120.02 BatVtg on the Sunny Island and note the value before doing anything else.
solutions.ur: DC sources isolate karein, phir Sunny Island par parameter 120.02 BatVtg padh kar kuch karne se pehle value note karein.

solutions.en: If the reading is above 65.0 V, measure each battery cell with a cell voltage meter; the healthy spread on a 48 V lead-acid bank is small and a single low cell means the bank is over-celled or a cell is shorted.
solutions.ur: Agar reading 65.0 V se upar hai to cell voltage meter se har battery cell ka voltage measure karein; 48 V lead-acid bank par healthy spread chhota hota hai aur aik kam cell ka matlab bank over-celled hai ya koi cell short hai.

solutions.en: Check the DC source charge-voltage settings against the battery manufacturer's permitted maximum, and correct them before reconnecting.
solutions.ur: DC source ke charge-voltage settings ko battery manufacturer ke permitted maximum se check karein aur dobara jodne se pehle theek karein.

solutions.en: Verify the battery capacity against the DC source datasheet as the manual directs, and replace a bank that is genuinely under-sized for the site.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq battery capacity ko DC source datasheet se verify karein, aur jo bank is site ke liye sach mein chhota ho use badal dein.

notes.en: Do not confuse with the 4-digit Sunny Tripower code 202, which is an AC undervoltage on a completely different product.
notes.ur: 4-digit Sunny Tripower ke code 202 se na milayein, jo bilkul alag product par AC undervoltage hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

title.ur: Battery bohat garam ho gaya — fault (F206)

meaning.en: The battery temperature is too high. SMA explicitly recommends protecting the battery from temperatures above 25 C because that prevents premature ageing.
meaning.ur: Battery ka temperature bohat zyada hai. SMA khud salah deti hai ke battery ko 25 C se upar temperature se bachaayein, kyunke is se jaldi ageing hoti hai.

causes.en: Battery room with poor ventilation in a hot climate, common in Pakistani summers.
causes.ur: Garmi ke mausam mein battery room ki hawa kam, jo Pakistan mein aam hai.

causes.en: Battery mounted too close to a heat source or in direct sun.
causes.ur: Battery kisi heat source ke qareeb ya seedhi dhoop mein lagi hai.

causes.en: Battery temperature sensor reading wrong — the manual asks for a specific resistance check.
causes.ur: Battery temperature sensor ki reading ghalat hai — manual ek khaas resistance check mangta hai.

causes.en: Battery itself ageing internally, generating heat under charge.
causes.ur: Battery khud andar se ageing kar rahi hai aur charge mein garmi paida kar rahi hai.

solutions.en: Wait for the battery to cool down, as the manual's first instruction; do not force charge into a hot battery.
solutions.ur: Manual ka pehla instruction hai battery ko thanda hone ka intezaar karein; garmi wali battery par zor se charge na dein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery temperature sensor resistance: the manual states it should be approximately 2000 Ohm at 20 to 25 C. If it is far from that, replace the sensor.
solutions.ur: Battery temperature sensor ki resistance measure karein: manual ke mutabiq 20 se 25 C par taqreeban 2000 Ohm honi chahiye. Agar is se kaafi door ho to sensor badal dein.

solutions.en: Install a thermometer in the battery room and log peak temperature; if it regularly exceeds 25 C, add ventilation or move the bank to a cooler, shaded room.
solutions.ur: Battery room mein thermometer lagayein aur peak temperature log karein; agar woh baar baar 25 C cross kare to ventilation badhayein ya bank ko thande, shadowed room mein shift karein.

notes.en: This is a battery lifetime issue as much as a safety issue — repeated trips to F206 will end the battery far earlier than its rated cycle count.
notes.ur: Yeh battery ki lifetime ka masla bhi hai aur safety ka bhi — baar baar F206 aana battery ko rated cycles se kahin pehle khatam kar dega.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

title.en: Battery voltage above target charge voltage (F208)
title.ur: Battery voltage target charge voltage se upar (F208)

meaning.en: The battery voltage is higher than the target charge voltage. The manual groups the external-source and configuration corrective measures under this code.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage target charge voltage se zyada hai. Manual is code ke neeche external source aur configuration ke corrective measures deta hai.

causes.en: DC sources not correctly configured for the battery chemistry, so they charge to the wrong voltage.
causes.ur: DC sources battery chemistry ke liye theek se configure nahi hain, jis se woh galat voltage tak charge karte hain.

causes.en: Some SMA inverters in the cluster not set to the stand-alone country data set, which the manual calls out explicitly.
causes.ur: Cluster mein kuch SMA inverters stand-alone country data set par set nahi hain, jise manual saaf likhta hai.

causes.en: Battery not actually connected, so the DC sources are charging into nothing and the voltage is external.
causes.ur: Battery asal mein judi hi nahi hai, jis se DC sources kisi cheez ko charge kar rahe hain aur voltage external hai.

solutions.en: Isolate DC sources and the battery, then measure the actual battery voltage directly at the battery terminals with a DC meter.
solutions.ur: DC sources aur battery isolate karein, phir DC meter se battery terminals par seedha actual battery voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Check every DC source's charge voltage setting against the battery manufacturer's permitted maximum and correct any that are too high.
solutions.ur: Har DC source ka charge voltage setting battery manufacturer ke permitted maximum se check karein aur jo zyada ho use theek karein.

solutions.en: In an off-grid system, ensure all SMA inverters in the cluster are configured to the country data set for stand-alone operation, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Off-grid system mein ensure karein ke cluster ke sabhi SMA inverters stand-alone operation ke country data set par hain, jaise manual kehta hai.

notes.en: W209 means the high battery voltage was NOT generated by the device itself, which is a strong hint that the voltage is external.
notes.ur: W209 ka matlab hai ke high battery voltage device ne khud paida nahi ki, jo strong nishani hai ke voltage external hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

title.ur: Battery ka voltage bohat gir gaya (F213)

meaning.en: The battery voltage is too low. The unit has shut down on a depleted bank.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage bohat kam hai. Unit khali ho chuke bank par band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged because loads exceeded supply for too long.
causes.ur: Battery gehrai se discharge ho gaya kyunke loads bohat der ke liye supply se zyada rahe.

causes.en: Bank aged or undersized, so it cannot hold charge under the site's load.
causes.ur: Bank purana ya chhota hai, jis se woh site ke load ke neeche charge nahi rakh sakta.

causes.en: A cell open-circuited, so the bank capacity has dropped without any voltage symptom at full charge.
causes.ur: Koi cell open ho gaya, jis se bank ki capacity girti hai aur full charge par koi voltage ka nishaan nahi milta.

causes.en: No load-shedding contactor fitted, so DC loads keep draining the bank after it drops.
causes.ur: Koi load-shedding contactor nahi lagi, jis se voltage girne ke baad bhi DC loads bank ko drain karte rehte hain.

solutions.en: Charge the battery in emergency charge mode as the manual's first instruction, or use an external battery charger — do not repeatedly start the island and deepen the discharge.
solutions.ur: Manual ke pehle instruction ke mutabiq battery ko emergency charge mode mein charge karein, ya external battery charger use karein — baar baar island start karke discharge aur ghera mat karein.

solutions.en: Ensure DC loads are shed via a load-shedding contactor when the state of charge is low, as the manual explicitly requires.
solutions.ur: Ensure karein ke state of charge kam hone par DC loads load-shedding contactor ke zariye shed ho jayein, jaise manual saaf likhta hai.

solutions.en: After charging, measure each cell's voltage and specific gravity; a cell far below its neighbours must be replaced, not the whole bank.
solutions.ur: Charge ke baad har cell ka voltage aur specific gravity measure karein; padosi cells se kaafi neeche wala cell badalna hai, poora bank nahi.

notes.en: F716/F717/F718 (VBATMIN) are the measuring-range-below variant; use those when the reading has collapsed out of range rather than merely being low.
notes.ur: F716/F717/F718 (VBATMIN) measuring-range-below wale variant hain; jab reading range se bahar gir gayi ho sirf kam hone ke bajaye woh codes use karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

title.en: External battery mgmt detected but not configured (F221)
title.ur: External battery management detect hui magar configure nahi (F221)

meaning.en: An external battery management system is detected but was never configured, so the Sunny Island cannot use it.
meaning.ur: External battery management system detect ho gayi magar configure hi nahi ki gayi, is liye Sunny Island usay use nahi kar sakti.

causes.en: A lithium-ion battery with its own BMS fitted, but the cluster was commissioned without selecting external energy management.
causes.ur: Apni BMS ke saath lithium-ion battery lagi hui hai, magar cluster commission karte waqt external energy management select nahi ki gayi.

causes.en: Battery swapped from a lead-acid system without reconfiguring the cluster.
causes.ur: Cluster reconfigure kiye baghair lead-acid system se battery badal di gayi.

causes.en: A BMS is reporting on the SiCom bus that the master was not expecting to see.
causes.ur: SiCom bus par aik BMS report kar rahi hai jise master expect nahi kar raha tha.

solutions.en: Start the QCG (Quick Configuration Guide) and reconfigure the system for external energy management, which is the manual's stated corrective measure.
solutions.ur: QCG (Quick Configuration Guide) start karke system ko external energy management ke liye dobara configure karein — yehi manual ka bataya hua corrective measure hai.

solutions.en: Confirm with the battery manufacturer that the BMS is a model the Sunny Island supports and that its data cable is connected to the correct port.
solutions.ur: Battery manufacturer se confirm karein ke BMS wohi model hai jo Sunny Island support karta hai aur uska data cable sahi port par judi hai.

solutions.en: If the system is genuinely lead-acid, disconnect the external BMS data cable and reconfigure, otherwise the event will persist.
solutions.ur: Agar system sach mein lead-acid hai to external BMS ka data cable nikaal kar dobara configure karein, warna event barqarar rahega.

notes.en: Distinguish from the XA/XW 9xx block, which are messages forwarded FROM the BMS rather than this configuration mismatch.
notes.ur: XA/XW 9xx block se farq karein, jo BMS se aane wale messages hain, is configuration mismatch se nahi.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

title.ur: External voltage ya frequency configured range se bahar (F314)

meaning.en: The generator or utility grid voltage and/or frequency at the island's external connection is outside the configured range, so the island disconnects from it.
meaning.ur: Island ke external connection par generator ya utility grid ka voltage aur/ya frequency configured range se bahar hai, is liye island us se disconnect ho jata hai.

causes.en: Generator voltage regulator drifting, so the terminal voltage sits outside the configured window.
causes.ur: Generator ka voltage regulator drift kar raha hai, jis se terminal voltage configured window se bahar rehta hai.

causes.en: Configured generator voltage/frequency thresholds too narrow for a small or overloaded generator.
causes.ur: Chhote ya overloaded generator ke liye configured voltage ya frequency thresholds bohat tang hain.

causes.en: External grid genuinely outside limits, e.g. a weak or overloaded feeder.
causes.ur: External grid sach mein limits se bahar hai, maslan kamzor ya overloaded feeder.

solutions.en: Adjust the generator voltage and/or generator frequency, which the manual lists as the first corrective measure for a generator source.
solutions.ur: Generator source ke liye manual ka pehla corrective measure hai: generator voltage aur/ya generator frequency adjust karein.

solutions.en: Observe and log measured values 134.02 ExtVtg and 134.04 ExtFrq during operation; these are the two parameters the manual tells you to watch.
solutions.ur: Operation ke dauran measured values 134.02 ExtVtg aur 134.04 ExtFrq observe aur log karein; manual kehti hai ke yahi do parameters dekhein.

solutions.en: Adjust the generator voltage/frequency thresholds on the Sunny Island per the installation manual, then re-run the generator connection sequence.
solutions.ur: Installation manual ke mutabiq Sunny Island par generator voltage ya frequency thresholds adjust karein, phir generator connection sequence dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: In a battery backup system where the source is the utility rather than a generator, contact SMA Service as the manual directs instead of changing thresholds.
solutions.ur: Battery backup system mein jahan source generator ke bajaye utility hai wahan thresholds badalne ke bajaye manual ke mutabiq SMA Service se rabta karein.

notes.en: F314 is the fault-level external voltage event; W315-W321 are the warning-level low/high voltage and frequency variants with a phase suffix.
notes.ur: F314 fault-level external voltage event hai; W315-W321 warning-level low/high voltage aur frequency variants hain jinmein phase ka suffix hota hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

title.en: External source has wrong rotating magnetic field (W355)
title.ur: External source ka rotating magnetic field ghalat (W355)

meaning.en: The assignment of the external source's line conductors to the Sunny Island AC2 connections does not produce a right-rotating magnetic field, i.e. the phase sequence is wrong.
meaning.ur: External source ke line conductors ko Sunny Island ke AC2 connections par jo tarah se joda gaya hai us se right-rotating magnetic field nahi banta, yaani phase sequence ghalat hai.

causes.en: Master, slave 1 and slave 2 connected to L1, L2, L3 in the wrong order.
causes.ur: Master, slave 1 aur slave 2 ko L1, L2, L3 se ghalat tarteeb par joda gaya hai.

causes.en: Two phases transposed in the AC2 cable termination.
causes.ur: AC2 cable termination mein do phases aapas mein badal diye gaye hain.

causes.en: Generator output leads to the island connected in the wrong phase order.
causes.ur: Generator ke output leads island par ghalat phase order mein jode gaye hain.

solutions.en: Isolate the AC sources and loads first; with power off, verify the phase assignment at every AC2 termination against the manual.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC sources aur loads isolate karein; power off par har AC2 termination par phase assignment ko manual se verify karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the correct mapping explicitly: the manual states master to L1, slave 1 to L2, slave 2 to L3.
solutions.ur: Sahi mapping saaf confirm karein: manual kehti hai master L1 par, slave 1 L2 par, slave 2 L3 par.

solutions.en: Verify with a phase-sequence meter or by measuring L-L voltage magnitude on each pair; on a correct sequence all pairs read similar and the island will accept the source.
solutions.ur: Phase-sequence meter se verify karein, ya har jorre par L-L voltage magnitude measure karke; sahi sequence mein har jorre ka reading similar hota hai aur island source qubool karega.

notes.en: A classic field error on three-phase installations. Getting it wrong trips W331-W333 anti-islanding as well.
notes.ur: Teesre phase installations par yeh aam field error hai. Ghalat hua to W331-W333 anti-islanding bhi trip karte hain.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

title.en: AC voltage present while tie switch is open (F366)
title.ur: Tie switch khula hone par bhi AC voltage maujood (F366)

meaning.en: Voltage is present on the AC bus at L1 (master) even though the tie switch is open, which the manual treats as a fault.
meaning.ur: Tie switch khula hone ke bawajood L1 (master) par AC bus par voltage maujood hai, jise manual fault maanta hai.

causes.en: External source still energising the AC bus through a parallel path.
causes.ur: External source kisi parallel raaste se AC bus ko abhi bhi energize kar raha hai.

causes.en: Feedback from another Sunny Island in the cluster through the bypass switch or tie switch wiring.
causes.ur: Bypass switch ya tie switch wiring ke zariye cluster ke doosre Sunny Island se feedback.

causes.en: Capacitive coupling or induced voltage on an unenergised bus, which the RCD/leakage path holds up.
causes.ur: Bina voltage ke bus par capacitive coupling ya induced voltage, jise RCD ya leakage path upar rakhta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC sources, loads and the battery from the island, then confirm the tie switch is genuinely open and mechanically secured.
solutions.ur: Island se AC sources, loads aur battery isolate karein, phir confirm karein ke tie switch waqai khula hai aur mechanically secured hai.

solutions.en: With power off, verify the tie switch triggering and its wiring as the manual's first corrective measure, then check the feedback contact is correctly connected.
solutions.ur: Power off par manual ke pehle corrective measure ke mutabiq tie switch ka triggering aur uski wiring verify karein, phir feedback contact ki sahi tarah se connection check karein.

solutions.en: Measure voltage at the AC bus with a high-impedance meter to distinguish a real back-feed from induced voltage; a real source holds several volts, induced voltage collapses when the meter is disconnected.
solutions.ur: Asli back-feed aur induced voltage mein farq karne ke liye high-impedance meter se AC bus par voltage measure karein; asli source kai volts pakadta hai, induced voltage meter nikalte hi gir jata hai.

notes.en: F367 ExtCtcNotOpen is the companion 'tie switch does not open' fault — both point at the tie switch assembly and its feedback contact.
notes.ur: F367 ExtCtcNotOpen saathi fault hai 'tie switch nahi khulta' — dono tie switch assembly aur uske feedback contact ki taraf ishara karte hain.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

meaning.en: The plausibility check on the contactors inside the Multicluster-Box has failed, so the cluster switching hardware state is not trusted.
meaning.ur: Multicluster-Box ke contactors ka plausibility check fail ho gaya, is liye cluster ki switching hardware state par bharosa nahi kiya jata.

causes.en: A contactor in the Multicluster-Box welded or failed to release, so its feedback does not match the commanded state.
causes.ur: Multicluster-Box mein koi contactor weld ho gaya ya release nahi hua, jis se uska feedback commanded state se match nahi karta.

causes.en: Contactors mechanically stuck or their auxiliary feedback contacts wired incorrectly.
causes.ur: Contactors mechanically atak gaye ya unke auxiliary feedback contacts ghalat tare se jode gaye hain.

causes.en: Loose auxiliary contactor wiring in the box producing an intermittent, implausible reading.
causes.ur: Box mein auxiliary contactor wiring loose, jis se baar baar implausible reading aati hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the AC sources, loads and the battery from the Sunny Island and confirm the Multicluster-Box is dead before opening it.
solutions.ur: Sunny Island se AC sources, loads aur battery isolate karein aur Multicluster-Box kholne se pehle confirm karein ke woh dead hai.

solutions.en: Visually and manually check each contactor in the box: does it pull in, does it latch, and does the auxiliary feedback contact change state when it does.
solutions.ur: Box mein har contactor visually aur manually check karein: kya woh pull-in karta hai, latch karta hai, aur hone par uska auxiliary feedback contact state change karta hai.

solutions.en: With the box isolated, measure continuity through each main contact pair with the coil energised and de-energised; a contactor that never opens the main path must be replaced.
solutions.ur: Box isolate kar ke coil on aur off dono states mein har main contact pair se continuity measure karein; jo contactor main path kabhi nahi khulta use badalna hoga.

notes.en: F806, F809, F815-F818 are the more specific Multicluster-Box faults (coding conflict, Q10 load-shedding contactor, Q5/Q7/Q9 contactors, phase missing) — check them together with this one.
notes.ur: F806, F809, F815-F818 zyada specific Multicluster-Box faults hain (coding conflict, Q10 load-shedding contactor, Q5/Q7/Q9 contactors, phase missing) — inhein is ke saath check karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H

title.en: Internal error in battery management, via SiCom (F931)
title.ur: Battery management mein internal error, SiCom ke zariye (F931)

meaning.en: An internal error in the battery management system has been forwarded to the Sunny Island over SiCom. The island cannot diagnose it; the battery management must.
meaning.ur: Battery management system ka internal error SiCom ke zariye Sunny Island tak pohanchaya gaya hai. Island isay diagnose nahi kar sakta; battery management ko karna hoga.

causes.en: Internal fault inside the lithium-ion battery BMS firmware.
causes.ur: Lithium-ion battery ke BMS firmware ka internal fault.

causes.en: Cell monitoring unit reporting inconsistent cell voltages to the BMS.
causes.ur: Cell monitoring unit BMS ko inconsistent cell voltages bhej raha hai.

causes.en: SiCom data cable intermittent, causing the BMS message to be decoded wrongly.
causes.ur: SiCom data cable intermittent, jis se BMS message galat decode hota hai.

solutions.en: Eliminate the cause of the error in the external battery management system using the battery manufacturer's documentation — this is the manual's own instruction for the whole XA block.
solutions.ur: Battery manufacturer ki documentation istemal kar ke external battery management system mein error ki wajah door karein — yehi poore XA block ke liye manual ka apna instruction hai.

solutions.en: Check the SiCom data cable between battery and Sunny Island: seating, shielding, and continuity, since a marginal cable can produce phantom BMS errors.
solutions.ur: Battery aur Sunny Island ke darmiyan SiCom data cable check karein: seating, shielding aur continuity, kyunke marginal cable se khauf BMS errors bante hain.

solutions.en: Contact the battery manufacturer for the BMS event log; the XA code maps 1:1 to their error list, so their log is the only useful evidence.
solutions.ur: Battery manufacturer se BMS event log maangein; XA code un ki error list se 1:1 map hota hai, is liye un ka log hi useful evidence hai.

notes.en: The XA block (920-935) and the XW block (936-951) are mirrored pairs: XA = error level, XW = warning level for the same underlying battery condition. Codes 920-928 and 935 are documented; 933 and 934 are not in the manual.
notes.ur: XA block (920-935) aur XW block (936-951) aapas mein mirror hain: XA = error level, XW = warning level usi battery condition ka. Codes 920-928 aur 935 documented hain; 933 aur 934 manual mein nahi hain.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND 3.0M / 4.4M / 6.0H / 8.0H (SI30M-44M-60H-80H-BE-en-33W), section 10.5 Logged Warning Messages and Error Messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

title.en: Unstable operation — battery not supplying enough (3302)
title.ur: Unstable operation — battery poora supply nahi kar rahi (3302)

meaning.en: There is not enough power at the DC input of the inverter for stable operation, so the inverter cannot connect to the utility grid. The manual's corrective measure is to check the battery.
meaning.ur: DC input par stable operation ke liye power kam hai, is liye inverter utility grid se connect nahi ho sakta. Manual ka corrective measure hai battery check karein.

causes.en: Battery state of charge too low to hold a stable DC bus while the inverter is idle on the grid.
causes.ur: Battery ka state of charge itna kam ke inverter grid par idle rehta hue bhi stable DC bus nahi rakh sakta.

causes.en: Battery fault — a cell open-circuited, or the BMS has blocked the battery.
causes.ur: Battery fault — koi cell open ho gaya, ya BMS ne battery block kar di hai.

causes.en: Battery communication intermittent, so the inverter does not trust the reported capacity.
causes.ur: Battery communication intermittent, jis se inverter ko reported capacity par bharosa nahi.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and the battery via the external disconnection service before touching the battery side, as the safety section of this manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Battery side chherne se pehle manual ke safety section ke mutabiq AC aur battery ko external disconnection service se isolate karein.

solutions.en: Read the battery state of charge and terminal voltage on the user interface; a SoC that disagrees with the measured voltage means the BMS or the SoC calibration is at fault.
solutions.ur: User interface par battery ka state of charge aur terminal voltage padhein; agar SoC aur measured voltage aapas mein na milein to BMS ya SoC calibration kharab hai.

solutions.en: Measure each battery cell's voltage at the BMS, not just the pack voltage; a single open cell makes the whole pack look unstable.
solutions.ur: Sirf pack voltage nahi, BMS par har battery cell ka voltage measure karein; aik khula cell poore pack ko unstable dikhata hai.

solutions.en: Run the inverter's battery calibration cycle once the pack is fully charged, then re-read the event.
solutions.ur: Pack poori tarah charge hone ke baad inverter ka battery calibration cycle chalayein, phir event dobara padhein.

notes.en: Same number as a PV shortfall code on Sunny Tripower 3-6 (3303 is the PV one there). Here it is explicitly a battery problem.
notes.ur: Yehi number Sunny Tripower 3-6 par PV shortfall ka code hai (wahan 3303 PV wala hai). Yahan yeh saaf tor par battery ka masla hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

title.en: Insulation error — ground fault on DC (battery) side (3501)
title.ur: Insulation error — DC (battery) side par ground fault (3501)

meaning.en: The inverter detected a ground fault on the DC side, which on this product is the battery and its DC cabling, not a PV array.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne DC side par ground fault detect kiya hai, aur is product par DC side ka matlab battery aur uski DC cabling hai, PV array nahi.

causes.en: Battery rack or battery case with damaged insulation, or a cell with a cracked housing.
causes.ur: Battery rack ya battery case ki insulation damaged, ya kisi cell ka housing cracked.

causes.en: DC cabling to the battery with chafed insulation or a connector with water ingress.
causes.ur: Battery ki DC cabling ki insulation ghis chuki ya connector mein paasush aa gaya.

causes.en: Battery screwed to a metal surface without proper insulation, so the negative terminal is earthed through the rack.
causes.ur: Battery ko theek insulation ke baghair metal surface par bolt kiya gaya, jis se negative terminal rack ke zariye earth ho gaya.

causes.en: Earthing arrangement in the battery room bonding the battery negative to earth unintentionally.
causes.ur: Battery room ki earthing arrangement battery negative ko ghalat se earth se bond kar rahi hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the battery from the inverter and from the room earth, then measure battery negative to earth with a high-impedance meter; a healthy isolated battery should read high and drifting.
solutions.ur: Battery ko inverter se aur room ki earth se isolate kar ke high-impedance meter se battery negative se earth tak voltage measure karein; saaf isolated battery ki reading high aur badhrti hui honi chahiye.

solutions.en: With the battery disconnected, measure DC+ and DC- to PE on the inverter side, then bisect the cable run to find the section leaking.
solutions.ur: Battery nikaal kar inverter side par DC+ aur DC- se PE voltage measure karein, phir cable run ko aik aik hissa kar ke leaking hissa dhoondein.

solutions.en: Fit the proper battery rack and inter-cell insulation, and confirm the DC cable does not touch metalwork; replace any connector whose seal has failed.
solutions.ur: Sahi battery rack aur inter-cell insulation lagayein, aur confirm karein ke DC cable metalwork ko chhu nahi rahi; jis connector ka seal fail ho woh badal dein.

notes.en: The DC side here is a battery on a mains-referenced system — this fault can put the whole battery room at risk, so isolate fully before testing.
notes.ur: Yahan DC side mains-referenced system par battery hai — yeh fault poore battery room ko khatre mein daal sakta hai, is liye test se pehle poori tarah isolate karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

meaning.en: The inverter has started a cyclic insulation test to verify that the electric strength of the battery is within the safe range. The inverter restarts once during an insulation test.
meaning.ur: Inverter ne cyclic insulation test shuru kiya hai taake verify kare ke battery ki electric strength safe range ke andar hai. Insulation test ke dauran inverter aik baar restart hota hai.

causes.en: Scheduled cyclic insulation self-test that runs automatically on this product.
causes.ur: Scheduled cyclic insulation self-test jo is product par automatically chalta hai.

causes.en: The self-test started after a firmware update or a grid reconnection.
causes.ur: Firmware update ya grid reconnection ke baad self-test shuru hua.

solutions.en: No action needed. Allow the test to complete and expect one restart of the inverter during the sequence.
solutions.ur: Koi zaroorat nahi. Test poora hone dein aur sequence ke dauran inverter ka aik restart intezaar karein.

solutions.en: If the inverter never comes back after 15 minutes, power-cycle it once and check whether 3523 is followed by a real fault such as 3501 or 10818.
solutions.ur: Agar 15 minute ke baad inverter wapas na aaye to aik baar power cycle karein aur dekhein ke 3524 ke baad koi asal fault jaise 3501 ya 10818 aata hai ya nahi.

notes.en: Non-fault status row. The single restart during the test is normal, not a symptom.
notes.ur: Non-fault status row hai. Test ke dauran aik restart normal hai, masla nahi.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

meaning.en: An overtemperature has been detected in the choke area (the inductor bank), so the inverter has switched off. The manual's corrective measures are cooling-fin cleaning and ventilation only.
meaning.ur: Choke area (inductor bank) mein zyada temperature detect hui hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya hai. Manual ke corrective measures sirf cooling fins ki safai aur ventilation hain.

causes.en: Cooling fins and top air ducts clogged with dust or fluff, starving the choke area of airflow.
causes.ur: Cooling fins aur upar ke air ducts dhool ya rui se band, jis se choke area ko airflow nahi mil raha.

causes.en: Inverter mounted in direct sun or in a closed cabinet with no convection path.
causes.ur: Inverter seedhi dhoop mein ya aise cabinet mein laga hai jahan convection ka rasta nahi.

causes.en: Fan running but airflow restricted by a neighbouring device or wall too close.
causes.ur: Fan chal raha hai lekin airflow kisi paas wale device ya qareebi deewar ki wajah se blocked hai.

solutions.en: Switch off DC and AC, wait 30 minutes for the enclosure to cool, then clean the rear cooling fins and top air ducts with a soft brush.
solutions.ur: DC aur AC band karein, 30 minute intezaar karein ke enclosure thanda ho, phir peeche ke cooling fins aur upar ke air ducts soft brush se saaf karein.

solutions.en: Verify the inverter has the ventilation clearance the manual specifies on all sides, and remove any enclosure or cabinet door that is blocking convection.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke inverter ke charon taraf manual ke mutabiq ventilation clearance hai, aur koi enclosure ya cabinet ka darwaza jo convection rok raha ho hata dein.

solutions.en: Measure the choke area temperature with an IR thermometer against ambient; if the gap is large with clean fins, ask SMA Service to check the internal fan and the choke temperature sensor.
solutions.ur: IR thermometer se choke area ka temperature ambient ke against measure karein; agar saaf fins ke bawajood farq bara ho to SMA Service se internal fan aur choke temperature sensor check karwayein.

notes.en: 6511 is specific to the choke area; 6501/6502/6509 on this product are the generic over-temperature events with no component named.
notes.ur: 6511 choke area ke liye khaas hai; is product par 6501/6502/6509 generic over-temperature events hain jinmein koi component naam nahi hota.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

title.en: DC input defective — battery polarity reversed (6802)
title.ur: DC input defective — battery ki polarity ulti (6802)

meaning.en: A polarity error is present on the inverter. The manual's corrective measure is to check whether a battery is connected to the DC input, then contact the Service.
meaning.ur: Inverter par polarity error hai. Manual ka corrective measure hai check karein ke DC input par battery lagi hai ya nahi, phir Service se rabta karein.

causes.en: Battery leads connected + to minus and minus to plus at the DC terminal.
causes.ur: Battery leads DC terminal par + se minus aur minus se plus jorde hue hain.

causes.en: Battery leads connected to a DC input that is not the battery input on a multi-input unit.
causes.ur: Battery leads aise DC input par jode hue hain jo multi-input unit par battery input nahi hai.

causes.en: A cell group with a reversed connection inside the battery rack.
causes.ur: Battery rack ke andar kisi cell group ka connection ulta hua hai.

causes.en: Intermittent contact in the battery connector producing a transient apparent reversal.
causes.ur: Battery connector mein intermittent contact jo momentary apparent reversal bana raha hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the battery at the external disconnection service and the AC, then confirm zero volts at the DC terminals with a two-pole tester.
solutions.ur: External disconnection service se battery aur AC isolate karein, phir two-pole tester se DC terminals par zero volt confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure DC+ and DC- to the inverter's DC terminal with a DC meter; a correctly wired battery shows DC+ at about the pack voltage above DC- and DC- near the PE reference.
solutions.ur: DC meter se inverter ke DC terminal par DC+ aur DC- measure karein; theek se wired battery DC+ par pack voltage aur DC- par PE ke qareeb dikhata hai.

solutions.en: Inspect every inter-cell connector in the battery rack and re-torque them; a single reversed or loose inter-cell link is enough to trip this event.
solutions.ur: Battery rack mein har inter-cell connector check karke dobara torque karein; aik reversed ya loose inter-cell link is event ko trip kara dene ke liye kaafi hai.

notes.en: Sunny Tripower 3-6 uses 6801/6802 and 6901/6902 for PV input A/B polarity with the same wording but a PV, not battery, input. Do not swap the two.
notes.ur: Sunny Tripower 3-6 par 6801/6802 aur 6901/6902 PV input A/B polarity ke liye hain, wording wohi hai lekin input PV ka hai battery ka nahi. Dono ko swap na karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

title.ur: DC relay ghalat se khul gaya (7727)

meaning.en: The DC relay opened when it should not have. The manual states only that the cause must be determined by the Service.
meaning.ur: DC relay aise khul gaya jahan nahi khulna chahiye tha. Manual sirf itna kehti hai ke wajah Service ko tay karni hogi.

causes.en: Control board or relay coil failure allowing the relay to drop out under load.
causes.ur: Control board ya relay coil ka failure jis se relay load ke neeche gir jata hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage momentarily collapsing and releasing the relay's undervoltage release.
causes.ur: Battery voltage pal ke liye gir kar relay ka undervoltage release chala gaya.

causes.en: Loose relay holder or connector inside the unit allowing vibration to open the contact.
causes.ur: Unit ke andar relay holder ya connector loose, jis se vibration se contact khul jata hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and the battery from all voltage sources and secure the unit against being switched on before opening it.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle AC aur battery ko sabhi voltage sources se isolate karke is taraf se secure karein ke koi ise on na kare.

solutions.en: With the unit dead, check the relay holder and connector seating and tighten them, then check the relay coil resistance against the service specification.
solutions.ur: Unit dead kar ke relay holder aur connector ki seating check karke tighten karein, phir relay coil ki resistance service specification se check karein.

solutions.en: Log battery terminal voltage at the moment the event appears, using a logging meter; a voltage collapse at that instant confirms the undervoltage-release path.
solutions.ur: Event aate hi logging meter se battery terminal voltage log karein; usi waqt voltage girna undervoltage-release path confirm karta hai.

notes.en: SMA gives no field corrective measure for this code beyond Service. Do not attempt to bridge or force the relay.
notes.ur: Is code ke liye SMA koi field corrective measure nahi deta, sirf Service kehta hai. Relay ko bridge ya force karne ki koshish na karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

title.en: DC relay defective — does not close or open (7728)
title.ur: DC relay defective — band ya khulta hi nahi (7728)

meaning.en: The DC relay is defective and fails to close or fails to open as commanded. The manual states only that the cause must be determined by the Service.
meaning.ur: DC relay defective hai aur command ke mutabiq ya band nahi hota ya khulta nahi. Manual sirf itna kehti hai ke wajah Service ko tay karni hogi.

causes.en: Relay contacts welded closed, so the unit cannot isolate the DC side as commanded.
causes.ur: Relay contacts band ho kar weld ho gaye hain, jis se unit DC side ko command ke mutabiq isolate nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Relay contacts eroded open, so the unit cannot establish the DC path.
causes.ur: Relay contacts khul kar kharab ho gaye hain, jis se unit DC path nahi bana sakta.

causes.en: Relay driver circuit failure, so the coil is never energised even when commanded.
causes.ur: Relay driver circuit ka failure, jis se coil command ke bawajood kabhi energize nahi hota.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and the battery from all voltage sources and lock the unit out before any inspection.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi inspection se pehle AC aur battery ko sabhi voltage sources se isolate karke unit lock out karein.

solutions.en: With the unit dead and the DC cables removed, test the relay for continuity in both coil states and check the coil resistance; no continuity in one state confirms the relay itself.
solutions.ur: Unit dead karke DC cables nikaal kar relay ko dono coil states mein continuity ke liye test karein aur coil resistance check karein; aik state mein continuity na hona khud relay confirm karta hai.

solutions.en: Check the relay driver output on the control board with a multimeter during a commanded close; no output means a board fault, output present means a relay fault.
solutions.ur: Commanded close ke dauran multimeter se control board par relay driver output check karein; output na ho to board fault, output maujood ho to relay fault.

notes.en: The DC relay is a service item, not a field-replaceable part. The manual routes this to Service by design.
notes.ur: DC relay service item hai, field par replace hone wala part nahi. Manual ise jaan boojh kar Service ko bhejta hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

title.ur: Overvoltage protector ka fault — surge arrester (7801)

meaning.en: One or more surge arresters have tripped, or one or more surge arresters are not inserted correctly.
meaning.ur: Ek ya zyada surge arresters trip ho chuke hain, ya ek ya zyada surge arresters theek se insert nahi hue hain.

causes.en: A lightning strike or mains surge on the AC side that has tripped the arresters.
causes.ur: AC side par lightning strike ya mains surge jo arresters ko trip kar chuka hai.

causes.en: A surge arrester pulled out of its slot during a previous service operation and never re-seated.
causes.ur: Kisi pichli service ke dauran surge arrester slot se nikal gaya aur dobara seat nahi kiya gaya.

causes.en: Repeated smaller surges that have cumulatively degraded the MOV element to its end of life.
causes.ur: Baar baar chhote surges jin ne MOV element ko us ki umar ke ant tak degrade kar diya.

solutions.en: First ensure the surge arrester is inserted correctly — this is the manual's first corrective measure and it is the most common cause.
solutions.ur: Pehle confirm karein ke surge arrester theek se insert hai — yehi manual ka pehla corrective measure hai aur sab se aam wajah bhi yahi hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the inverter from all voltage sources (the manual's procedure 12.2 step 1) before touching the arresters.
solutions.ur: Arresters ko chherne se pehle inverter ko sabhi voltage sources se isolate karein (manual ki procedure 12.2 ka step 1).

solutions.en: Unlock the arrester with a screwdriver turned to the open position, pull it out and inspect it; a tripped arrester shows a visibly blackened or scorched element.
solutions.ur: Screwdriver ko open position mein ghuma kar arrester unlock karein, bahar nikalein aur inspect karein; trip hua arrester ka element kaala ya jhula hua nazar aata hai.

solutions.en: Replace every tripped arrester with a new one of the same type and rating, seat them all the way home, then recommission and confirm 7801 clears.
solutions.ur: Har trip hua arrester nayi type aur rating wali se badal dein, sab ko poora seat karein, phir recommission karke confirm karein ke 7801 clear ho gaya.

notes.en: A tripped arrester means the device absorbed a surge for you — replace it, never re-use the old one, even if it looks intact.
notes.ur: Trip hua arrester ka matlab device ne aap ke liye surge absorb kiya — use badal dein, purana wala kabhi dobara mat lagayein, agar woh sab theek lage tab bhi.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

meaning.en: Communication is impaired and the cause must be determined by SMA Service. On this product this covers the link to the battery system and the cluster master communication.
meaning.ur: Communication impaired hai aur wajah SMA Service ko tay karni hogi. Is product par yeh battery system se aur cluster master communication ke link ko cover karta hai.

causes.en: Ethernet or RS485 cable between inverter and Data Manager / Home Manager unplugged or damaged.
causes.ur: Inverter aur Data Manager / Home Manager ke darmiyan Ethernet ya RS485 cable nikal chuka ya damaged hai.

causes.en: A network device on the same segment failing and taking the inverter's link down with it.
causes.ur: Usi segment par koi network device fail hua aur inverter ka link bhi usi ke saath gira.

causes.en: Cluster communication cable to a slave unit not seated, or bus termination missing.
causes.ur: Slave unit ka cluster communication cable baithaya nahi, ya bus termination nahi.

causes.en: Firmware version mismatch between inverter and battery after one of them was updated.
causes.ur: Inverter aur battery ke darmiyan firmware version mismatch, jab ek update hua aur doosra nahi.

solutions.en: Walk every communication cable on the segment and reseat each connector, then confirm the switch or router port LEDs show an active link.
solutions.ur: Segment ke har communication cable ko check karke har connector dobara baithayein, phir confirm karein ke switch ya router port ki LEDs par active link hai.

solutions.en: Compare the firmware versions of inverter and battery on the user interface and update the older one if they differ; a version mismatch is a known cause on this product.
solutions.ur: User interface par inverter aur battery ke firmware versions compare karein aur agar farq ho to purane wale ko update karein; is product par version mismatch aam wajah hai.

solutions.en: Verify the bus is terminated at both ends and that no two devices share a Modbus address, then re-read the event.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke bus dono ends par terminated hai aur do devices ka Modbus address ek jaisa nahi, phir event dobara padhein.

notes.en: This code is a catch-all for comms; pair it with 9308 which specifically reports that the external battery management cannot be reached.
notes.ur: Yeh code comms ka umbrella hai; isay 9308 ke saath dekhein jo specifically batata hai ke external battery management tak nahi pohanch sakte.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

title.ur: Short-circuit fault — khud theek hota hai (9206)

meaning.en: A short-circuit fault is present. After a certain time the error disappears automatically as a self-healing error, but if it occurs 3 times in succession operation may be permanently inhibited under event 9102.
meaning.ur: Short-circuit fault maujood hai. Kuch der baad yeh error khud ba khud hat jata hai (self-healing error), lekin agar 3 baar lagatar ho to event 9102 ke tehat operation permanently inhibit ho sakta hai.

causes.en: A momentary short across the DC side, e.g. during a connector mating or a fan inrush.
causes.ur: DC side par pal ke liye short, maslan connector jorte waqt ya fan inrush par.

causes.en: A chafed DC cable whose insulation touches metal intermittently.
causes.ur: Ghis chuki DC cable jis ki insulation baar baar metal ko chhu leti hai.

causes.en: A marginal DC connector bouncing between connected and open.
causes.ur: Marginal DC connector jo connected aur open ke darmiyan uchhalta hai.

solutions.en: Let the self-healing cycle run once and count the occurrences; SMA's threshold is three in succession before 9102 inhibits operation.
solutions.ur: Self-healing cycle aik baar chalne dein aur occurrences ginein; SMA ka threshold 3 lagatar hai, uske baad 9102 operation rok deta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate the DC side and check DC+ and DC- to PE and DC+ to DC- for an intermittent short, flexing the cable run by hand to make a marginal contact show up.
solutions.ur: DC side isolate karke DC+ se PE, DC- se PE aur DC+ se DC- mein intermittent short check karein, cable run ko haath se hilate hue taake marginal contact nazar aaye.

solutions.en: Replace any connector that bounces, re-crimp the affected terminations, and if the count is already at 2, replace the suspect cable before it reaches a third occurrence.
solutions.ur: Jis connector uchhalta ho use badal dein, affected terminations dobara crimp karein, aur agar count pehle se 2 par hai to teesri occurrence se pehle shak cable badal dein.

notes.en: Three occurrences trigger 9102 operation inhibition — treat the count, not just the current message, as the urgency.
notes.ur: Teen occurrences 9102 operation inhibition ko trigger karte hain — foran sirf current message nahi, count ko hi urgency samajhein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

title.ur: Battery management timeout monitoring trigger hui (9308)

meaning.en: The timeout monitoring system of the battery management has triggered, which means the external battery management cannot be reached. The manual says to wait, since the inverter can take up to 10 minutes to switch back on.
meaning.ur: Battery management ka timeout monitoring system trigger hua hai, yaani external battery management tak nahi pohanch sakte. Manual kehti hai ke intezaar karein, kyunke inverter ko wapas on hone mein 10 minute lag sakte hain.

causes.en: Battery communication parameters set incorrectly, for example a wrong IP address — the manual's first corrective measure.
causes.ur: Battery communication parameters ghalat set hain, maslan ghalat IP address — manual ka pehla corrective measure.

causes.en: BMS power cycled or rebooted and did not come back on the network in time.
causes.ur: BMS ka power cycle ya reboot hua aur waqt par network par wapas nahi aaya.

causes.en: Network switch or cable fault on the battery management segment.
causes.ur: Network switch ya cable ka fault battery management segment par.

causes.en: Firmware version mismatch between inverter and battery after an update on one side only.
causes.ur: Inverter aur battery ke darmiyan firmware version mismatch, jab sirf aik side update hua.

solutions.en: Wait up to 10 minutes for the inverter to switch back on, as the manual states, before concluding anything is broken.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq inverter ko wapas on hone mein 10 minute tak intezaar karein, is se pehle kuch tooti hua hone ka nateeja na nikaalein.

solutions.en: Check the battery communication parameters on the inverter, especially the IP address, and correct any mismatch with the battery's actual network settings.
solutions.ur: Inverter par battery communication parameters check karein, khaas kar IP address, aur battery ke actual network settings se koi bhi mismatch theek karein.

solutions.en: Ping the battery management from the same network segment as the inverter and confirm it responds; a non-responding BMS is a battery-side problem, not an inverter problem.
solutions.ur: Inverter wale hi network segment se battery management ko ping karein aur confirm karein ke jawab deta hai; jawab na dene wala BMS battery side ka masla hai, inverter ka nahi.

solutions.en: Compare the firmware versions and update the older device if they differ.
solutions.ur: Firmware versions compare karein aur agar farq ho to purane device ko update karein.

notes.en: The 10-minute wait in the manual is important: technicians frequently reset the unit during this window and lose the diagnostic state.
notes.ur: Manual ka 10 minute ka intezaar ahem hai: technicians is window mein unit reset kar ke diagnostic state kho dete hain.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

title.ur: Battery bahar se alag kar di gayi (9395)

meaning.en: The DC power connection to the battery was disconnected. The inverter has simply reported an external action, not an internal fault.
meaning.ur: Battery ka DC power connection disconnect kar diya gaya hai. Inverter ne sirf external action report kiya hai, koi internal fault nahi.

causes.en: Someone opened the battery disconnection point or the DC isolator during servicing or a replacement.
causes.ur: Kisi ne servicing ya replacement ke dauran battery disconnection point ya DC isolator khol diya.

causes.en: A main DC fuse blew, isolating the battery from the inverter.
causes.ur: Koi main DC fuse udd gaya, jis se battery inverter se alag ho gayi.

causes.en: A connector on the battery DC run came loose from vibration or thermal movement.
causes.ur: Battery DC run par koi connector vibration ya thermal movement se dheela ho gaya.

solutions.en: Ask the site owner whether anyone worked on the battery or DC side; the answer usually closes this event with no action.
solutions.ur: Site owner se poochein ke kisi ne battery ya DC side par kaam kiya tha; aksar jawab mil jata hai aur koi zaroorat nahi padti.

solutions.en: With the DC side isolated, measure continuity from the battery terminals to the inverter DC input; an open point is a fuse, isolator or connector, not a battery fault.
solutions.ur: DC side isolate kar ke battery terminals se inverter DC input tak continuity measure karein; koi khula point fuse, isolator ya connector hai, battery fault nahi.

solutions.en: Check the DC fuse rating against the manual before fitting a replacement; an over-rated fuse defeats the whole protection chain.
solutions.ur: Naya fuse lagane se pehle uski rating manual se check karein; zyada rating wala fuse poori protection chain ko bekaar kar deta hai.

notes.en: Non-fault status row. It is the counterpart of 9351, where the battery disconnection point is in the wrong switch position.
notes.ur: Non-fault status row hai. Yeh 9351 ka counterpart hai, jahan battery disconnection point galat switch position mein hota hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

title.en: Insulation error within the battery system (10818)
title.ur: Battery system ke andar insulation error (10818)

meaning.en: An insulation error has been reported inside the battery system, and the manual states the cause must be determined by SMA Service. This is distinct from 3501, which is the inverter's own DC-side insulation measurement.
meaning.ur: Battery system ke andar insulation error report hua hai, aur manual kehti hai ke wajah SMA Service ko tay karni hogi. Yeh 3501 se alag hai, jo inverter ka apna DC-side insulation measurement hai.

causes.en: Cell with damaged or cracked internal insulation inside the battery module.
causes.ur: Battery module ke andar kisi cell ki internal insulation damaged ya cracked.

causes.en: Moisture ingress inside the battery enclosure, e.g. from a leaking roof or a wet wall.
causes.ur: Battery enclosure ke andar paasush ka dakhil, maslan chhootay chhat ya geeli deewar se.

causes.en: Internal wiring in the battery rack abrading on a metal edge and chafing.
causes.ur: Battery rack ki internal wiring metal kinare par ragar kar ghis chuki hai.

causes.en: Battery earthed through its rack or a cable shield, creating a false insulation path.
causes.ur: Battery apne rack ya kisi cable shield ke zariye earth ho gaya, jis se galat insulation path bana.

solutions.en: Isolate the battery from the inverter and from earth, then measure the battery's internal insulation resistance with an insulation tester rated for the battery voltage.
solutions.ur: Battery ko inverter aur earth se isolate karke battery voltage ke liye rated insulation tester se battery ki internal insulation resistance measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare the reading with the battery manufacturer's minimum insulation specification; below that value the module itself is the fault and must not be returned to service.
solutions.ur: Reading ko battery manufacturer ke minimum insulation specification se compare karein; us se neeche ho to module khud fault hai aur use service mein wapas nahi jana chahiye.

solutions.en: Check the battery room for water ingress and for any cable routing that touches metalwork, since both produce an internal insulation error that looks like a cell fault.
solutions.ur: Battery room mein paasush ka dakhil aur metal ko chhune wali cable routing check karein, kyunke dono aisa internal insulation error banate hain jo cell fault jaisa lagta hai.

solutions.en: Supply the inverter event log to SMA Service together with the measured insulation value, since the manual routes this code to Service.
solutions.ur: Manual is code ko Service ko bhejta hai, is liye inverter ka event log aur measured insulation value SMA Service ko dein.

notes.en: Do not clear 10818 by re-energising. It is a stop-production condition on the battery side.
notes.ur: 10818 ko dobara energise karke clear na karein. Yeh battery side par production rokne ki halat hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Island X 30 / 50

meaning.en: A disturbance has been reported in the battery rack. The manual states the cause must be determined by SMA Service and gives no field corrective measure.
meaning.ur: Battery rack mein disturbance report hua hai. Manual kehti hai ke wajah SMA Service ko tay karni hogi aur koi field corrective measure nahi deti.

causes.en: Loose or missing inter-cell connector in the rack producing an intermittent connection.
causes.ur: Rack mein koi inter-cell connector loose ya missing hai jis se connection intermittent ho gaya.

causes.en: Rack not properly earthed or mounted, so it can move and disturb the connections.
causes.ur: Rack theek se earth ya mount nahi hai, jis se woh hila kar connections ko disturb kar sakta hai.

causes.en: A cell or module inside the rack reporting a fault through the rack's monitoring line.
causes.ur: Rack ke andar koi cell ya module monitoring line ke zariye fault report kar raha hai.

causes.en: Rack ventilation blocked, so a module has overheated and reported a disturbance.
causes.ur: Rack ki ventilation band hai, jis se koi module zyada garam hua aur disturbance report kiya.

solutions.en: Isolate the battery via the external disconnection service before opening or working on the rack.
solutions.ur: Rack par kaam karne ya use kholne se pehle battery ko external disconnection service se isolate karein.

solutions.en: With the battery isolated, re-torque every inter-cell connector and rack connection, and replace any connector whose crimp or spring force is weak.
solutions.ur: Battery isolate kar ke har inter-cell connector aur rack connection dobara torque karein, aur jis connector ki crimp ya spring force kamzor ho use badal dein.

solutions.en: Measure the voltage of every cell in the rack; a cell far below its neighbours identifies the disturbed module and saves replacing the whole rack.
solutions.ur: Rack mein har cell ka voltage measure karein; padosi cells se kaafi neeche wala cell disturbed module identify kar deta hai aur poora rack badalne se bachata hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the rack's ventilation path is clear, then send the event log to SMA Service for the cause determination the manual requires.
solutions.ur: Rack ki ventilation path saaf karein, phir manual ke mutabiq wajah tay karne ke liye event log SMA Service ko bhejein.

notes.en: Field-checkable in most cases despite the manual's Service-only wording: loose inter-cell connectors are the usual real cause.
notes.ur: Manual ke Service-only wording ke bawajood aksar field par check kiya ja sakta hai: loose inter-cell connectors aam asal wajah hote hain.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY ISLAND X 30 / 50 (SIxx-20-BE-en-11, Version 1.1), section 12.1 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Tripower 125

meaning.en: Grid voltage or grid impedance at the inverter connection point is too high, so the inverter disconnected from the utility grid.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke connection point par grid voltage ya grid impedance zyada hai, is liye inverter utility grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Local grid voltage permanently above the permissible range at the feed-in point.
causes.ur: Feed-in point par local grid voltage permanently permissible range se upar hai.

causes.en: Long or lightly cross-sectioned MV/LV cable between inverter and grid connection point.
causes.ur: Inverter aur grid connection point ke darmiyan lamba ya chhote cross-section ka cable.

causes.en: Grid operator has changed the transformer tap or supply voltage.
causes.ur: Grid operator ne transformer tap ya supply voltage badal diya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV before probing. Switch the AC breaker off, lock it, and confirm zero volts at the AC terminal block with a two-pole tester.
solutions.ur: Check karne se pehle AC aur PV disconnect karein. AC breaker off karke lock karein aur two-pole tester se AC terminal block par zero volt confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the grid connection point and log the 10-minute mean; 1500 V class plant MV side readings need a proper MV instrument, not a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Grid connection point par grid voltage measure karein aur 10-minute average log karein; 1500 V class plant ke MV side ke liye proper MV instrument chahiye, multimeter nahi.

solutions.en: Check the AC cable length and conductor size against the manual; upsize where voltage drop accounts for the excess.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq AC cable ki length aur conductor size check karein; jahan voltage drop zyada voltage ki wajah ho wahan size barhayein.

solutions.en: If voltage is permanently in range, supply the event log to SMA Service with a Grid Guard code for remote analysis.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage hamesha range mein hai to event log SMA Service ko Grid Guard code ke saath de kar remote analysis karwayein.

notes.en: Printed identically for 102 and 103 in this manual. Same wording family as SERIES 1 code 101.
notes.ur: Is manual mein 102 aur 103 bilkul same print hue hain. Yehi wording family SERIES 1 ke code 101 se bhi hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY TRIPOWER 125 (STPxxx-70-BE-en-14, Version 1.4), section 13.2 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Tripower 125

title.ur: Grid undervoltage ya AC khula — disconnect (203)

meaning.en: The utility grid has been disconnected, the AC cable is damaged, or the grid voltage at the connection point is too low. Inverter has disconnected.
meaning.ur: Utility grid disconnect ho gaya hai, AC cable damaged hai, ya connection point par grid voltage bohat kam hai. Inverter disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: AC circuit breaker or MV fuse open upstream of the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter se pehle AC circuit breaker ya MV fuse khula hai.

causes.en: Damaged AC cable or a connector not fully engaged.
causes.ur: Damaged AC cable ya aisa connector jo poori tarah fit nahi hua.

causes.en: Wrong country data set for the site.
causes.ur: Site ke liye ghalat country data set.

solutions.en: Switch on or re-close the AC breaker and confirm the inverter contactor closes audibly.
solutions.ur: AC breaker on karein ya dobara close karein aur confirm karein ke inverter contactor awaaz ke saath band hota hai.

solutions.en: With AC isolated, torque-check every AC terminal block connection; large plants loosen under thermal cycling.
solutions.ur: AC isolate kar ke har AC terminal block connection ka torque check karein; bade plants mein thermal cycling par loose ho jate hain.

solutions.en: Verify the country data set against the actual utility in Pakistan, then restart the self-test.
solutions.ur: Country data set ko Pakistan ke actual utility se verify karein, phir self-test dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Measure grid voltage at the connection point under load; a voltage that only collapses when the plant exports points to a weak feeder or an undersized cable.
solutions.ur: Load ke under connection point par grid voltage measure karein; sirf export karte waqt girne wala voltage kamzor feeder ya chhote cable ki nishani hai.

notes.en: On a 12-MPPT unit a single string-side event can trip the whole plant, so check every string fuse as well as the AC side.
notes.ur: 12-MPPT unit par ek string-side event poore plant ko trip kara sakta hai, is liye har string fuse aur AC side dono check karein.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY TRIPOWER 125 (STPxxx-70-BE-en-14, Version 1.4), section 13.2 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Tripower 125

title.en: Grid frequency out of range — disconnected (502)
title.ur: Grid frequency range se bahar — disconnect (502)

meaning.en: The grid frequency is outside the permissible range, so the inverter disconnected from the utility grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency permissible range se bahar hai, is liye inverter utility grid se disconnect ho gaya.

causes.en: Large co-located generator or industrial load cycling on the same grid point.
causes.ur: Same grid point par bada co-located generator ya industrial load on/off hota hai.

causes.en: Weak upstream grid with rapid frequency excursions.
causes.ur: Kamzor upstream grid jahan frequency tez upar neeche hoti hai.

solutions.en: Log grid frequency at the grid connection point for a full day using a grid analyzer and correlate it with the nearest generator start/stop event.
solutions.ur: Grid analyzer se poore din grid connection point par grid frequency log karein aur sab se qareeb wale generator start/stop se correlate karein.

solutions.en: Check the plant's own reactive power setpoint; a leading cos phi setpoint can worsen the local frequency and voltage problem.
solutions.ur: Plant ka apna reactive power setpoint check karein; leading cos phi setpoint local frequency aur voltage ki problem barha sakta hai.

solutions.en: Only with grid operator written approval, change the monitored frequency band through SMA Service.
solutions.ur: Sirf grid operator ki likhit ijazat ke baad, SMA Service se monitored frequency band badlein.

notes.en: Series 1 Sunny Tripower uses 501 for the same meaning; the number differs by product, not by severity.
notes.ur: Series 1 Sunny Tripower mein isi matlab ke liye 501 hai; number product se badalta hai, severity se nahi.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY TRIPOWER 125 (STPxxx-70-BE-en-14, Version 1.4), section 13.2 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Tripower 125

title.ur: PE connection nahi — connection check karein (901)

meaning.en: The protective earth conductor is not correctly connected, so the inverter refuses to run.
meaning.ur: Protective earth conductor theek se connected nahi hai, is liye inverter chalne se inkaar kar deta hai.

causes.en: Earth conductor not terminated or not bolted at the inverter earth stud.
causes.ur: Earth conductor terminate nahi hua ya inverter earth stud par bolt nahi hai.

causes.en: Earth conductor open in the cable run between inverter and grid point.
causes.ur: Inverter aur grid point ke darmiyan cable run mein earth conductor khuli hui hai.

causes.en: Corroded earth bus bar in a humid plant room raising the PE impedance.
causes.ur: Nam plant room mein earth bus bar zarda ho kar PE impedance barha raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker and the DC load-break switch, then confirm the PE stud is clean and the conductor is tightly bolted.
solutions.ur: AC breaker aur DC load-break switch band karein, phir confirm karein ke PE stud saaf hai aur conductor mazbooti se bolted hai.

solutions.en: Measure PE conductor continuity from the inverter to the plant earth bar; a 12 MPPT plant should read a few ohms, not open.
solutions.ur: Inverter se plant earth bar tak PE conductor ki continuity measure karein; 12 MPPT plant mein chand ohm aana chahiye, open nahi.

solutions.en: Clean and re-tighten the earth bus bar connections and re-test; do not bond protective earth through a removable plug.
solutions.ur: Earth bus bar ke connections saaf karke dobara tighten karein aur dobara test karein; protective earth ko removable plug ke zariye na bond karein.

notes.en: Identical wording to SERIES 1 code 901 — the code is consistent across Sunny Tripower families.
notes.ur: SERIES 1 ke code 901 se bilkul same wording — yeh code Sunny Tripower families mein consistent hai.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY TRIPOWER 125 (STPxxx-70-BE-en-14, Version 1.4), section 13.2 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Tripower 125

title.en: Waiting for grid voltage — L or N open, or grid dead (1302)
title.ur: Grid voltage ka intezaar — L ya N khula, ya grid marr gaya (1302)

meaning.en: The inverter is waiting for grid voltage. Either L or N is not connected, or the utility grid itself has failed. This is the Sunny Tripower wording, which adds the grid-failure case that SERIES 1 omits.
meaning.ur: Inverter grid voltage ka intezaar kar raha hai. Ya L ya N connected nahi hai, ya utility grid khud fail ho gayi hai. Yeh Sunny Tripower ka wording hai jismein grid failure ka case SERIES 1 mein nahi hai.

causes.en: Line conductor not connected or open in the AC run.
causes.ur: Line conductor AC run mein connected nahi ya khuli hui hai.

causes.en: MV/LV fuse or AC circuit breaker open.
causes.ur: MV/LV fuse ya AC circuit breaker khula hai.

causes.en: Genuine utility grid outage or grid operator works on the line.
causes.ur: Sachchi utility grid outage ya grid operator line par kaam kar raha hai.

causes.en: Damaged AC cable between inverter and grid connection point.
causes.ur: Inverter aur grid connection point ke darmiyan AC cable damaged hai.

solutions.en: First establish whether the grid is alive: measure line-to-neutral at the grid connection point from a safe position, not at the inverter terminals.
solutions.ur: Pehle confirm karein ke grid zinda hai ya nahi: grid connection point par line-neutral voltage safe position se measure karein, inverter terminals se nahi.

solutions.en: If the grid is alive, isolate the AC and PV, then check line and neutral continuity end to end plus insulation resistance on each core.
solutions.ur: Agar grid zinda hai to AC aur PV isolate kar ke line aur neutral ki end-to-end continuity aur har core ki insulation resistance check karein.

solutions.en: With the AC isolated, check the AC connector seating and torque; a large plant has many terminations and thermal cycling loosens them.
solutions.ur: AC isolate kar ke AC connector ki seating aur torque check karein; bade plant mein bohat se terminations hote hain aur thermal cycling unhe loosho karta hai.

notes.en: Text differs from SERIES 1 code 1302 — logged in CONFLICTS as a wording variance, not an error.
notes.ur: Text SERIES 1 ke code 1302 se alag hai — CONFLICTS mein wording variance ke taur par note kiya gaya hai, ghalti nahi.

source.title: Operating Manual SUNNY TRIPOWER 125 (STPxxx-70-BE-en-14, Version 1.4), section 13.2 Event messages

codes.seriesName: Sunny Tripower 125

title.ur: Line conductors ke darmiyan voltage imbalance (1416)

meaning.en: A voltage imbalance between the line conductors caused the system to disconnect from the utility grid. Typical on a 12-MPPT plant with many parallel strings.
meaning.ur: Line conductors ke darmiyan voltage imbalance ki wajah se system ne utility grid se disconnect kiya. 12-MPPT plant par jahan bohat se parallel strings hon wahan aam hai.

causes.en: Single-phase load or single-pole breaker heavily loaded on one phase at the site.
causes.ur: Site par kisi ek phase par single-phase load ya single-pole breaker zyada load ho.

causes.en: Unbalanced string distribution across the three phases feeding the AC connection.
causes.ur: AC connection ko feed karne wale teen phases par string distribution unbalanced hai.

causes.en: Open or high-resistance joint in one line conductor, dropping that phase voltage under load.
causes.ur: Kisi line conductor mein joint khuli ya zyada resistance wala hai, jis se load ke under us phase ka voltage girta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV first, then torque-check all three line conductors and all three neutrals at the AC terminal block and at the grid connection point.
