codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

meaning.en: The unit cannot see the battery bank, which usually means an open connection or a blown DC fuse.
meaning.ur: Unit battery bank ko nahi dekh pa raha, aam tor par iska matlab open connection ya ube hua DC fuse hai.

causes.en: Battery cable is not connected right, or a ring terminal has come off.
causes.ur: Battery cable theek se connected nahi, ya ring terminal nikal gaya hai.

causes.en: The DC fuse in the battery path has burnt out from a short or overload.
causes.ur: Battery path ka DC fuse short ya overload se jal chuka hai.

causes.en: A battery string is open because a cell has failed or a link is broken.
causes.ur: Koi battery string open hai kyun ke aik cell kharab ho gaya ya link toot gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check the battery cable connection first, as the PV1800 HM service manual's 56 row directs.
solutions.ur: Pehle battery cable connection check karein, jaisa PV1800 HM service manual ki 56 row kehti hai.

solutions.en: Measure the DC fuse with a multimeter continuity test; replace it with the exact same amp rating and type.
solutions.ur: DC fuse ko multimeter continuity test se check karein, usi amp rating aur type ka lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure each battery string and each cell with a multimeter to find the open string or the dead cell.
solutions.ur: Har battery string aur har cell ko multimeter se check kar ke khula string ya kharab cell dhoondein.

notes.en: The manual's TROUBLESHOOTING row for 56 reads: 'Battery is not connected well or fuse is burnt. If the battery is connected well, please return to repair center.'
notes.ur: Manual ki 56 TROUBLESHOOTING row hai: 'Battery is not connected well or fuse is burnt. Agar battery theek se connected hai to repair center bhejein.'

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

meaning.en: The control board's current sensing channel failed; the manual groups 57 with internal component failure.
meaning.ur: Control board ka current sensing channel kharab ho gaya, manual 57 ko internal component failure ke saath group karta hai.

causes.en: Control board current sense resistor or amplifier has failed.
causes.ur: Control board ka current sense resistor ya amplifier kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Sensing connector on the control board is loose or oxidised.
causes.ur: Control board par sensing connector loose ya oxidised hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the control board current sense connector.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir control board ka current sense connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Check the current sense resistor network with a multimeter and replace any open or drifted resistor.
solutions.ur: Current sense resistor network multimeter se check karein aur khula ya bigda hua resistor replace karein.

solutions.en: Treat 08/09/53/57 as a return-to-repair-centre group per the manual, since these indicate internal component failure.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq 08/09/53/57 ko repair centre wala group samajhein, ye internal component failure batata hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

title.en: Inverter output voltage is too low
title.ur: Inverter output voltage bahut low hai

meaning.en: Measured output voltage fell below the acceptable window; the manual pairs it with 06 in one troubleshooting row.
meaning.ur: Measured output voltage acceptable range se neeche gir gaya, manual isay 06 ke saath aik troubleshooting row mein rakhta hai.

causes.en: Battery bank is deeply discharged, so the inverter cannot hold output voltage.
causes.ur: Battery bank poori tarah discharge hai jis se inverter output voltage nahi tikka sakta.

causes.en: Output voltage sense circuit has drifted, so the unit trips on a false low reading.
causes.ur: Output voltage sense circuit bigad gaya hai jis se unit jhooti low reading par trip kar raha hai.

causes.en: Load draws more than the inverter can supply, pulling the output down.
causes.ur: Load inverter ki capacity se zyada kheech raha hai aur output neeche gira raha hai.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load first, as the manual's 06/58 row instructs, then restart the unit.
solutions.ur: Manual ki 06/58 row ke mutabiq pehle connected load kam karein, phir unit restart karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage and recharge the bank if it is below the discharge cut-off.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage check karein aur woh discharge cut-off se neeche ho to bank recharge karein.

solutions.en: If load and battery are both healthy, return the unit to the repair centre as the manual row 06/58 states.
solutions.ur: Agar load aur battery dono sehatar hain to manual ki 06/58 row ke mutabiq unit repair centre bhejein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

title.en: Warning: fan locked while inverter is on
title.ur: Warning: fan chalti inverter mein atak gaya

meaning.en: The fan stalled after the inverter was already running; the manual lists it as a warning, not a fault.
meaning.ur: Inverter chal raha tha aur uske baad fan atak gaya, manual isay warning batata hai fault nahi.

causes.en: Fan has been slowed by dust, hair or insects pulled in through the vents.
causes.ur: Vents se kheenchay gaye dust, baal ya keedhe fan ko slow kar dete hain.

causes.en: Fan bearings have worn and the motor draws too much current.
causes.ur: Fan ke bearings kharab ho gaye aur motor bohat zyada current kheech raha hai.

solutions.en: Note that the red Fault LED is flashing, not solid, for this warning - the unit is still supplying load.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke is warning mein red Fault LED flashing hai, solid nahi, unit load de raha hai.

solutions.en: At the next safe window, switch off, isolate AC, PV and battery and clean the fan and vents.
solutions.ur: Agli safe opportunity par off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein aur fan ke saath vents saaf karein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan if it is noisy, slow or does not spin freely, then confirm the warning clears.
solutions.ur: Fan shor machata ho, slow ho ya azaad na ghoome to replace karein, phir confirm karein ke warning hat gayi.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

title.en: Warning: second fan locked while on
title.ur: Warning: doosra fan chalti inverter mein atak gaya

meaning.en: The unit has a second fan, and that one stalled while running; listed as a warning.
meaning.ur: Unit mein doosra fan hai aur woh chalte hue atak gaya, ye warning mein hai.

causes.en: Second fan is jammed by dust or its own bearing has seized.
causes.ur: Doosra fan dust se atak gaya hai ya uska bearing khud hi seize ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Second fan's supply or driver is weak, so it stalls under load.
causes.ur: Doosre fan ki supply ya driver kamzor hai jis se load par atak jaata hai.

solutions.en: Check both fans physically; the manual's 62 row simply states the second fan is locked while on.
solutions.ur: Dono fans ko dekh kar check karein, manual ki 62 row kehti hai ke doosra fan on hone par atka hua hai.

solutions.en: Switch off, isolate AC, PV and battery, then clean or replace the second fan with the same rating.
solutions.ur: Off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir doosre fan ko saaf ya usi rating se replace karein.

solutions.en: Verify both fans spin from a cold start, because a stalled fan will escalate into fault 02 or 27.
solutions.ur: Dono fans ko cold start par ghoomne ka check karein, atka fan baad mein fault 02 ya 27 ban sakta hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

meaning.en: Battery voltage exceeded the normal charging window, so charging is limited.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage normal charging window se upar chala gaya, is liye charging limit ho gayi.

causes.en: Battery type is set wrong in the LCD menu, so the charge voltage is too high for the pack.
causes.ur: LCD menu mein battery type galat hai jis se pack ke liye charge voltage zyada set ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature is very high, so the charger has lifted the float voltage.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat high hai jis se charger ne float voltage barha di hai.

causes.en: Too many cells are wired in series for the pack design.
causes.ur: Pack design ke muqabl mein series mein zyada cells lagaye gaye hain.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a multimeter and compare it with the pack's recommended float voltage.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage multimeter se check karein aur pack ke recommended float voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Re-check the battery type and max charge voltage on the LCD, then let the charger settle and observe again.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery type aur max charge voltage dobara check karein, phir charger ko settle hone dein aur dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: If the voltage stays high with correct settings, remove the external charger and re-test, as the manual suggests for 03.
solutions.ur: Agar setting theek hone par bhi voltage high rahe to external charger nikaal kar dobara test karein, jaisa manual 03 ke liye kehta hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

meaning.en: Battery reached the low-voltage warning level and the unit is about to stop.
meaning.ur: Battery low voltage warning level par pahunch gaya aur unit rukne wala hai.

causes.en: Load is draining the battery faster than PV or AC can recharge it.
causes.ur: Load battery ko PV ya AC se recharge se tez drain kar raha hai.

causes.en: Battery bank has aged and no longer holds charge.
causes.ur: Battery bank umar ke saath ab charge hold nahi karti.

causes.en: AC input is absent, so only PV is available to recharge, and it is night or cloudy.
causes.ur: AC input mojood nahi hai jis se sirf PV recharge kar sakta hai aur raat ya badal chal rahi hai.

solutions.en: Read battery voltage and the load in W on the LCD to see the discharge rate.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery voltage aur watt mein load dekhein taake discharge rate pata chale.

solutions.en: Switch off non-essential loads so the battery recovers before it reaches the cut-off.
solutions.ur: Battery cut-off se pehle recover ho jaye uske liye ghair-zaroori loads band kar dein.

solutions.en: Recharge on AC or PV and check that charge current is actually flowing; if not, treat it as a battery wiring problem.
solutions.ur: AC ya PV se recharge karein aur check karein ke charge current actually ja raha hai, warna ise battery wiring masla samajhein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

meaning.en: Load is above the inverter's rated output; the manual lists it as a warning before it becomes fault 07.
meaning.ur: Load inverter ke rated output se zyada hai, manual isay fault 07 se pehle warning batata hai.

causes.en: More appliances are connected than the inverter's rated power.
causes.ur: Inverter ki rated power se zyada appliances lagi hain.

causes.en: A large motor or compressor is running alongside normal household load.
causes.ur: Normal ghar ke load ke saath koi bada motor ya compressor chal raha hai.

solutions.en: Add up the running load in watts on the LCD and keep it under rated power.
solutions.ur: LCD par chal rahe load ko watts mein jama karein aur rated power se neeche rakhein.

solutions.en: Switch off non-essential equipment before the warning becomes fault 07 and the unit stops.
solutions.ur: Warning fault 07 ban kar unit rukne se pehle ghair-zaroori equipment band kar dein.

solutions.en: Move heavy motor loads to a separate unit, since surge current is what usually pushes the inverter into overload.
solutions.ur: Bhaari motor load alag unit par le jaayein, kyunki surge current hi inverter ko overload mein daalta hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

title.ur: Warning: output power kam kiya jaa raha hai

meaning.en: The inverter is deliberately reducing its output power, normally because grid voltage is low.
meaning.ur: Inverter apni output power jaan bujh kar kam kar raha hai, aam tor par grid voltage low hone ki wajah se.

causes.en: AC input voltage has dropped, so the unit derates to stay on grid.
causes.ur: AC input voltage gir gaya hai jis se unit grid par rehne ke liye power kam kar deta hai.

causes.en: Internal temperature is rising, so the unit derates to protect itself.
causes.ur: Internal temperature barh rahi hai jis se unit apni protection ke liye power kam karta hai.

solutions.en: Check grid voltage on the LCD; below the low-loss threshold the unit is designed to derate.
solutions.ur: LCD par grid voltage check karein, low-loss threshold se neeche unit ka derate hona by design hai.

solutions.en: Check whether heatsink temperature is also high, because 70 can precede fault 27.
solutions.ur: Yeh bhi check karein ke heatsink temperature high hai ya nahi, kyun ke 70 fault 27 se pehle aa sakta hai.

solutions.en: Upsize the grid AC cable or clear the supply if the voltage drop is a wiring problem.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage drop wiring ka masla hai to grid AC cable upgrade karein ya supply saaf karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

title.en: Warning: solar charger stopped, low battery
title.ur: Warning: solar charger battery low hone par ruk gaya

meaning.en: The MPPT charger has shut down to avoid over-discharging a low battery.
meaning.ur: MPPT charger ne low battery ko over-discharge hone se bachane ke liye band kar diya.

causes.en: Battery voltage is below the solar charge cut-off, often at night or in heavy cloud.
causes.ur: Battery voltage solar charge cut-off se neeche hai, aam tor par raat ya badal ke waqt.

causes.en: PV array is producing too little, so the charger would only deepen the discharge.
causes.ur: PV array bohat kam power bana raha hai jis se charger discharge aur badha dega.

solutions.en: Confirm battery voltage and PV power on the LCD so you know whether this is night-time or a PV fault.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery voltage aur PV power check karein taake pata chale ke ye raat ka waqt hai ya PV ka fault.

solutions.en: Do not force charging; let PV recharge the bank in daylight and check the PV Voc and connections if no PV shows.
solutions.ur: Zor se charging na karein, din mein PV se bank recharge hone dein aur PV dikhaya na de to PV Voc aur connections check karein.

solutions.en: On the PV1800 2K/3K HM service manual this code is a control-board replacement item, so if it never clears, escalate.
solutions.ur: PV1800 2K/3K HM service manual mein ye code control board replacement ka hai, agar kabhi clear na ho to escalate karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

title.en: Warning: solar charger stopped, high PV voltage
title.ur: Warning: solar charger zyada PV voltage par ruk gaya

meaning.en: The MPPT charger stopped because the PV array voltage is above the safe limit.
meaning.ur: MPPT charger ruk gaya kyun ke PV array ka voltage safe limit se upar hai.

causes.en: PV array open-circuit voltage exceeds the inverter's max PV Voc, often in cold weather.
causes.ur: PV array ka open-circuit voltage inverter ke max PV Voc se zyada hai, thande mausam mein ye aam hai.

causes.en: Too many panels in series for this model, with no voltage derating for temperature.
causes.ur: Is model ke liye series mein panels zyada hain aur temperature ke liye voltage derating nahi ki gayi.

solutions.en: Measure PV open-circuit voltage at the inverter's PV terminals with a multimeter, inverter off.
solutions.ur: Inverter off kar ke multimeter se inverter ke PV terminals par PV open-circuit voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Compare that reading with the manual's maximum PV array open circuit voltage and remove panels if it is over.
solutions.ur: Us reading ko manual ke maximum PV array open circuit voltage se compare karein aur zyada ho to panels nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Check that the DC breaker between PV and inverter is closed, since an open breaker also stops solar charging.
solutions.ur: Yeh bhi check karein ke PV aur inverter ke darmiyan DC breaker band hai, kyun ke breaker khula hone par bhi solar charging rukti hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

title.en: Warning: solar charger stopped, over load
title.ur: Warning: solar charger load zyada hone par ruk gaya

meaning.en: The solar charger stopped because the PV array's output exceeded what the charger can handle.
meaning.ur: Solar charger ruk gaya kyun ke PV array ka output charger ki capacity se zyada tha.

causes.en: PV array wattage is larger than the inverter's maximum solar charge power.
causes.ur: PV array ki wattage inverter ke maximum solar charge power se zyada hai.

causes.en: Two strings are paralleled on one MPPT input without the unit's parallel-input support.
causes.ur: Do strings bina unit ke parallel input support ke aik MPPT input par jodi gayi hain.

solutions.en: Compare the PV array's rated wattage with the manual's maximum PV array power for this model.
solutions.ur: PV array ki rated wattage ko manual ke is model ke maximum PV array power se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the maximum solar charge current on the LCD to bring the charger inside its limit.
solutions.ur: LCD par maximum solar charge current kam karke charger ko uski limit ke andar laayein.

solutions.en: If the array is correctly sized and it still trips, check PV string fuses and connectors for a poor joint.
solutions.ur: Agar array theek size ka hai phir bhi trip karta hai to PV string fuses aur connectors mein kharab joint check karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

title.ur: Warning: solar charger zyada garm ho gaya

meaning.en: The MPPT charger has reduced or stopped charging because its own temperature is too high.
meaning.ur: MPPT charger ne apne temperature zyada hone ki wajah se charging kam ya band kar di.

causes.en: Ambient room temperature is very high, common in Pakistani summer installations.
causes.ur: Kamre ka ambient temperature bohat high hai, Pakistan mein garmiyon ke aam install mein ye aam hai.

causes.en: Charger heatsink is blocked by dust, or the cooling fan is not running.
causes.ur: Charger heatsink dust se band hai ya cooling fan nahi chal raha.

causes.en: Battery is hot, since the charger sits close to the battery compartment.
causes.ur: Battery garm hai kyun ke charger battery compartment ke qareeb hota hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the unit's own fan is running; the red LED flashing means warning, solid means fault.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke unit ka chal raha fan chal raha hai ya nahi, red LED flashing ka matlab warning hai solid ka matlab fault.

solutions.en: Install the unit with the documented clearance and out of direct sun on the heatsink.
solutions.ur: Unit ko documented clearance ke saath aise jagah lagayein ke heatsink par seedhi dhoop na pade.

solutions.en: Improve ventilation in the install room, since ambient temperature is the usual root cause of 75.
solutions.ur: Install room ki ventilation behtar karein, 75 ki aam wajah ambient temperature hi hoti hai.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

title.ur: Warning: PV charger se aaparas nahi ho raha

meaning.en: The PV charger board is not communicating correctly with the main controller.
meaning.ur: PV charger board main controller se theek se communicate nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Communication harness or connector between charger board and control board is loose.
causes.ur: Charger board aur control board ke darmiyan communication harness ya connector loose hai.

causes.en: Charger board has failed, so it no longer answers the controller.
causes.ur: Charger board kharab ho gaya hai jis se woh controller ka jawab nahi deta.

causes.en: Firmware versions between boards are mismatched after a partial update.
causes.ur: Partial update ke baad boards ke darmiyan firmware versions mismatch hain.

solutions.en: Switch off, isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the inter-board communication cable at both ends.
solutions.ur: Off karke AC, PV aur battery disconnect karein, phir inter-board communication cable dono taraf se dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Check the harness for a broken conductor with a multimeter continuity test.
solutions.ur: Harness mein toota hua conductor multimeter continuity test se dhoondein.

solutions.en: Update the inverter firmware to the latest version from the OEM download portal so both boards match.
solutions.ur: Inverter firmware OEM download portal se latest par update karein taake dono boards match hon.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: PV1800 VHM (off-grid hybrid inverter/charger 2-5.5kW)

meaning.en: A stored setting is invalid or inconsistent, so the unit falls back or asks for reconfiguration.
meaning.ur: Koi stored setting invalid ya inconsistent hai jis se unit default par aata hai ya dobara configuration maangta hai.

causes.en: Settings were changed but the inverter was not restarted, so values are inconsistent.
causes.ur: Settings badle gaye lekin inverter restart nahi hua jis se values inconsistent hain.

causes.en: Battery type or battery voltage setting does not match the connected bank.
causes.ur: Battery type ya battery voltage setting connected bank se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Parameter memory was disturbed by a power cut during a save.
causes.ur: Save ke dauran power cut ki wajah se parameter memory bigad gaya.

solutions.en: Reboot the unit and re-read the battery type, charge voltage and output voltage settings from the LCD.
solutions.ur: Unit reboot karke LCD se battery type, charge voltage aur output voltage settings dobara parhein.

solutions.en: Correct the settings to match the actual battery spec sheet and the nominal battery voltage, then save and restart.
solutions.ur: Settings ko asli battery spec sheet aur nominal battery voltage se match karein, phir save karke restart karein.

solutions.en: If 77 keeps returning after correct settings, do a factory reset from the reset menu and set everything again from the manual.
solutions.ur: Agar setting theek hone par bhi 77 aata rahe to reset menu se factory reset karein aur manual ke mutabiq sab kuch dobara set karein.

source.title: User Manual - HYBRID SOLAR INVERTER 3KW-5KW (PV1800 VHM / PV18 2-5.5KW VHM MPPT 80A 250V, OEM doc 4200-010022-02A1)

codes.seriesName: FLA12100 LiFePO4 battery pack

title.ur: Battery fault C14 Output kho gaya

meaning.en: The battery has lost its output. Check the breaker first, then the fuse.
meaning.ur: Battery ka output kho gaya hai. Pehle breaker check karein, phir fuse.

causes.en: Battery circuit breaker open
causes.ur: Battery ka circuit breaker khula hai

causes.en: Pack fuse blown
causes.ur: Pack ka fuse phoot gaya

causes.en: Battery output relay or BMS contactor not closing
causes.ur: Battery output relay ya BMS contactor band nahi ho raha

solutions.en: Check whether the battery circuit breaker is closed and close it if open.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery ka circuit breaker band hai ya nahi, aur khula ho to band kar dein.

solutions.en: Check whether the pack fuse is normal; replace it with the exact rating if it is blown.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke pack ka fuse theek hai ya nahi; phoota ho to wahi rating ka lagayein.

solutions.en: Restart the unit; if the error happens again, return the pack to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; error phir aaye to pack repair centre wapas bhejein.

codes.blinkPattern: FAULT mode - red LED ON, green LED OFF, SOC LED1 OFF, LED2 ON, LED3 ON, LED4 ON (steady)

notes.en: The manual's 4.4 fault table lists 10 more named conditions (Charge overcurrent, Discharge overcurrent, Cell overvoltage, Cell undervoltage, MOS overtemperature, MOS undertemperature, Cell over-temperature, Cell under-temperature, Abnormal output impedance, Abnormal current sampling) plus a 'Parallel failed' condition, but prints them without legible C-numbers, so they cannot be safely mapped to C01-C13. Do not assign them in the app from this document.
notes.ur: Manual ke 4.4 fault table mein 10 aur named conditions hain (Charge overcurrent, Discharge overcurrent, Cell overvoltage, Cell undervoltage, MOS overtemperature, MOS undertemperature, Cell over-temperature, Cell under-temperature, Abnormal output impedance, Abnormal current sampling) plus 'Parallel failed', lekin woh legible C-numbers ke baghair chhapa hain, is liye unhein C01-C13 par mehfooz tarah map nahi kiya ja sakta. Is document se app mein unhein assign na karein.

source.title: FLA12100 LiFePO4 Battery User Guide

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: The PV module temperature is too high; check airflow and ambient temperature.
meaning.ur: PV module ka temperature bohat zyada hai; airflow aur ambient temperature check karein.

causes.en: Unit installed in a closed room with no airflow
causes.ur: Unit band kamre mein lagi hai jahan airflow nahi hai

causes.en: Direct sun on the unit or the PV input
causes.ur: Unit ya PV input par seedhi dhoop lag rahi hai

causes.en: Internal fan failed so hot air is not expelled
causes.ur: Internal fan kharab hai jis se garm hawa nahi nikalti

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then clear dust from the vents and heat sink.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke vents aur heat sink ki dhool saaf karein.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature at the unit; keep at least 20 cm clearance on all sides.
solutions.ur: Unit par ambient temperature measure karein; charon taraf kam az kam 20 cm clearance rakhein.

solutions.en: Check the internal fan spins freely and its connector is seated on the board.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke internal fan azaad ghoomta hai aur uska connector board par baitha hai.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: PV panel voltage is above the limit (the manual says it should be less than 95 V).
meaning.ur: PV panel ka voltage limit se upar hai (manual ke mutabiq yeh 95 V se kam hona chahiye).

causes.en: Too many small panels in series for a 12 V/24 V unit
causes.ur: 12 V/24 V unit ke liye series mein chhote panels zyada lage hue hain

causes.en: Panel type setting in the setup not matching the fitted panels
causes.ur: Setup mein panel type setting fitted panels se match nahi karti

causes.en: Cold, clear morning with a high open-circuit voltage
causes.ur: Thande aur saaf subah mein open-circuit voltage zyada ho jata hai

solutions.en: Measure the panel open-circuit voltage with a meter; it must stay under 95 V for this unit.
solutions.ur: Panel ka open-circuit voltage meter se measure karein; is unit ke liye woh 95 V se kam rehna chahiye.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of panels in series, or set the correct panel type in the setup.
solutions.ur: Series mein panels ki kami karein, ya setup mein sahi panel type set karein.

solutions.en: If the measured voltage is already under 95 V, contact the installer as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Agar measured voltage pehle se 95 V se kam hai to manual ke mutabiq installer se rabta karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger
aliases: The PV relay voltage is abnormal

title.ur: Warning 06 PV relay ka voltage abnormal hai

meaning.en: The measured voltage across the PV relay is abnormal; an internal component has failed.
meaning.ur: PV relay ke across measured voltage abnormal hai; internal component fail ho gaya hai.

causes.en: PV relay contacts burnt or not closing fully
causes.ur: PV relay ke contacts jale ya poori tarah band nahi ho rahe

causes.en: Relay coil driver failed on the control board
causes.ur: Control board par relay coil driver kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Relay wiring or connector loose
causes.ur: Relay wiring ya connector dhila hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Test the PV relay contacts for continuity; an open reading means replace the relay.
solutions.ur: PV relay contacts ki continuity test karein; open reading aaye to relay replace karein.

solutions.en: Reseat the relay connector and re-tighten the relay wiring before replacing parts.
solutions.ur: Relay connector dobara lagayein aur relay wiring dobara tighten karein, phir parts replace karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: Fan 1 is locked; check the fan wiring and replace the fan if needed.
meaning.ur: Fan 1 lock ho gaya hai; fan wiring check karein aur zaroorat ho to fan replace karein.

causes.en: Fan 1 blade jammed by dust or an insect nest
causes.ur: Fan 1 ki blade dhool ya keede ke ghar mein phans gayi

causes.en: Fan 1 bearing seized
causes.ur: Fan 1 ka bearing jam ho gaya

causes.en: Fan 1 connector loose on the board
causes.ur: Board par fan 1 ka connector dhila hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then check that the fan wiring is connected well.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke check karein ke fan wiring theek lagi hai.

solutions.en: Free the blade by hand and remove any dust or nest; do not force a seized fan.
solutions.ur: Blade ko haath se azaad karein aur dhool ya ghar nikaalein; jamay fan par zor na dein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan with an identical 12 V DC fan of the same size.
solutions.ur: Fan ko wahi 12 V DC fan, same size, se replace karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: Fan 2 is locked; check the fan wiring and replace the fan if needed.
meaning.ur: Fan 2 lock ho gaya hai; fan wiring check karein aur zaroorat ho to fan replace karein.

causes.en: Fan 2 blade jammed by dust
causes.ur: Fan 2 ki blade dhool se phans gayi

causes.en: Fan 2 motor failed open circuit
causes.ur: Fan 2 ka motor open circuit ho gaya

causes.en: Fan 2 harness pinched during installation
causes.ur: Installation ke dauran fan 2 ka harness nichal gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the fan 2 connector.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke fan 2 ka connector dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Test fan 2 for continuity and free spinning on the bench.
solutions.ur: Bench par fan 2 ki continuity aur azaad ghoomne ka test karein.

solutions.en: Replace fan 2 with the same size and voltage if it is seized or open circuit.
solutions.ur: Fan 2 jam ho ya open circuit ho to same size aur voltage se replace karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: The unit is overloaded; reduce the loads. The Fault LED flashes and the buzzer beeps twice per second.
meaning.ur: Unit overloaded hai; loads kam karein. Fault LED flash karega aur buzzer har second do baar beep karega.

causes.en: Connected appliances exceed the unit's rated VA/W
causes.ur: Lagaye gaye appliances unit ki rated VA/W se zyada hain

causes.en: Motor starting surge on a 1-3 kW unit
causes.ur: 1-3 kW unit par motor ka starting surge

solutions.en: Switch off appliances one at a time until the overload clears.
solutions.ur: Appliances ko aik aik band karein jab tak overload na hat jaye.

solutions.en: Read the load percentage on the LCD and compare it with the unit's rating label.
solutions.ur: LCD par load percentage padhein aur usay unit ke rating label se compare karein.

solutions.en: Stagger large motor starts or move them to a separate supply.
solutions.ur: Bare motor starts stagger karein ya alag supply par move karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: Battery voltage is too low and it should be charging. Buzzer beeps three times per second.
meaning.ur: Battery ka voltage bohat kam hai aur use charge hona chahiye. Buzzer har second teen baar beep karta hai.

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged during a long outage
causes.ur: Lambi outage mein battery gehri tarah discharge ho gayi

causes.en: PV not generating and grid unavailable
causes.ur: PV se power nahi aa raha aur grid bhi mojood nahi

causes.en: Battery not connected, or wrong battery type configured
causes.ur: Battery lagi hi nahi, ya ghalat battery type configure hai

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a meter at the battery terminals.
solutions.ur: Battery terminals par meter se battery voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Check the PV DC isolator is closed and panels are clean and unshaded.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke PV DC isolator band hai aur panels saaf hain aur unpar shadow nahi hai.

solutions.en: Verify the battery type setting in the LCD setup matches the fitted battery.
solutions.ur: LCD setup mein battery type setting fitted battery se match karti hai ya nahi verify karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: Communication between the primary and secondary CPUs is faulty; an internal component has failed.
meaning.ur: Primary aur secondary CPU ke darmiyan communication kharab hai; internal component fail ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Communication track or connector between the two boards damaged
causes.ur: Dono boards ke darmiyan communication track ya connector kharab

causes.en: Supply rail to the secondary processor unstable
causes.ur: Secondary processor ki supply rail unstable hai

causes.en: Firmware versions on the two processors mismatched
causes.ur: Dono processors ke firmware versions mismatch hain

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the inter-board communication connector.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke boards ke darmiyan communication connector dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Update the inverter firmware so both processor versions match.
solutions.ur: Inverter firmware update karein taake dono processor versions match ho jayein.

solutions.en: If the fault stays, have the secondary processor board replaced at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Fault bacha to secondary processor board service centre par replace karwayein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger
aliases: The inverter current sensor is faulty

meaning.en: The inverter current sensor is faulty; the manual says return it to the repair centre.
meaning.ur: Inverter current sensor kharab hai; manual ke mutabiq unit repair centre wapas bhejein.

causes.en: Current sensing element failed
causes.ur: Current sensing element kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Sense wiring disconnected or chafed
causes.ur: Sense wiring nikal gayi ya ragad gayi

causes.en: Sense amplifier on the board failed
causes.ur: Board par sense amplifier kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Compare the reported inverter current with a clamp meter; a fixed or zero reading confirms sensor failure.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se reported inverter current compare karein; jam hui ya zero reading sensor failure confirm karti hai.

solutions.en: Have the sensor and its amplifier replaced and the channel calibrated at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Service centre par sensor aur uska amplifier replace karke channel calibrate karwayein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: The bus voltage is too low; an internal component has failed or the battery is too weak.
meaning.ur: Bus voltage bohat kam hai; internal component fail hua hai ya battery bohat kamzor hai.

causes.en: Battery too weak to charge the bus at startup
causes.ur: Battery itni kamzor hai ke startup par bus charge nahi kar pata

causes.en: Internal component failure in the bus charge path
causes.ur: Bus charge path mein internal component ki failure

causes.en: Battery connected with reversed polarity
causes.ur: Battery ulat polarity par lagi hui hai

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a meter and confirm polarity at the same time.
solutions.ur: Meter se battery voltage measure karein aur usi waqt polarity bhi check karein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and inspect the bus pre-charge circuit and connectors.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke bus pre-charge circuit aur connectors dekhein.

solutions.en: Charge the battery on a bench if it is below the minimum, then re-test the unit.
solutions.ur: Battery minimum se neeche ho to bench par charge karke unit dobara test karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: AC surge or an internal component failure; bus voltage is too high.
meaning.ur: AC surge ya internal component failure; bus voltage bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: AC surge from the grid or from a switched load
causes.ur: Grid se ya switch hone wale load se AC surge

causes.en: Internal component failure in the bus discharge path
causes.ur: Bus discharge path mein internal component ki failure

causes.en: PV input voltage above the configured limit
causes.ur: PV input voltage configured limit se upar hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then measure PV input voltage at the DC terminals.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke DC terminals par PV input voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Restart once as the manual directs; if code 31 returns, do not keep restarting.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq aik baar restart karein; code 31 wapas aaye to baar baar restart na karein.

solutions.en: Have the bus circuit and the AC surge path inspected at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Service centre par bus circuit aur AC surge path ka muaina karwayein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: Internal component failure; the bus soft start did not complete.
meaning.ur: Internal component fail hua hai; bus ka soft start mukammal nahi hua.

causes.en: Bus pre-charge circuit open so the capacitors never charge
causes.ur: Bus pre-charge circuit khula hai, is liye capacitors charge nahi hote

causes.en: Internal component failure in the boost stage
causes.ur: Boost stage mein internal component ki failure

causes.en: Output load connected at switch-on
causes.ur: Switch on par output load lagi hui thi

solutions.en: Disconnect all output loads and restart once.
solutions.ur: Saare output loads disconnect karke aik baar restart karein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and have the pre-charge resistor and boost stage tested.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke pre-charge resistor aur boost stage test karwayein.

solutions.en: Do not power-cycle repeatedly; it can damage the second bridge device.
solutions.ur: Baar baar power-cycle na karein; is se doosra bridge device kharab ho sakta hai.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: Over-temperature in radiator 1; check airflow and ambient temperature.
meaning.ur: Radiator 1 mein temperature zyada hai; airflow aur ambient temperature check karein.

causes.en: Heat sink blocked with dust
causes.ur: Heat sink dhool se block hai

causes.en: Ambient temperature above the unit's rating
causes.ur: Ambient temperature unit ki rating se zyada hai

causes.en: Fan 1 or Fan 2 locked
causes.ur: Fan 1 ya Fan 2 lock ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then clean the heat sink with a soft dry brush.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke heat sink ko soft dry brush se saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the air flow of the unit is blocked or ambient temperature is too high, as the manual says.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq check karein ke unit ka air flow block hai ya ambient temperature zyada hai.

solutions.en: Verify both fans spin freely and replace a seized one with the same size and voltage.
solutions.ur: Dono fans azaad ghoomte hain ya nahi check karein aur jamay fan ko same size aur voltage se replace karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: Over-temperature in radiator 2; check airflow and ambient temperature.
meaning.ur: Radiator 2 mein temperature zyada hai; airflow aur ambient temperature check karein.

causes.en: Heat sink blocked with dust
causes.ur: Heat sink dhool se block hai

causes.en: Ambient temperature above the unit's rating
causes.ur: Ambient temperature unit ki rating se zyada hai

causes.en: Fan 2 locked
causes.ur: Fan 2 lock ho gaya hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then clean the heat sink and radiator 2 fins.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke heat sink aur radiator 2 ki fins saaf karein.

solutions.en: Check whether the air flow of the unit is blocked or ambient temperature is too high.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke unit ka air flow block hai ya ambient temperature zyada hai.

solutions.en: Replace a seized Fan 2 with the same size and voltage fan.
solutions.ur: Jamay hue Fan 2 ko same size aur voltage ke fan se replace karein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: EEPROM error; the manual says return the unit to the repair centre.
meaning.ur: EEPROM error hai; manual ke mutabiq unit repair centre wapas bhejein.

causes.en: Power cut while settings were being written
causes.ur: Settings likhte waqt power cut ho gaya

causes.en: EEPROM chip failed after surge or heat damage
causes.ur: Surge ya garmi ke baad EEPROM chip kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Back up the settings from the app or LCD before any further work.
solutions.ur: Aagey ke kaam se pehle app ya LCD se settings ka backup bana lein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then power-cycle once and check if code 50 clears.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke aik baar power-cycle karein aur dekhein ke code 50 hatta ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it stays, have the EEPROM or control board replaced at the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Fault bache to EEPROM ya control board repair centre par replace karwayein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVCM PRO Series 1kW~3kW hybrid inverter/charger

title.ur: Fault 90 DSP bootloader likha nahi gaya

meaning.en: The DSP bootloader is missing; the manual says return the unit to the repair centre.
meaning.ur: DSP bootloader mojood nahi; manual ke mutabiq unit repair centre wapas bhejein.

causes.en: Incomplete firmware write during a failed update
causes.ur: Failed update ke dauran firmware adhoora likha gaya

causes.en: Power lost exactly during the bootloader flash
causes.ur: Bootloader flash ke waqt hi power chala gaya

causes.en: DSP or flash memory device failed
causes.ur: DSP ya flash memory device kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Do not attempt to reflash a unit showing code 90; the manual directs return to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Code 90 dikhane wale unit ko dobara flash na karein; manual repair centre wapas bhejne ko kehta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and record the fault code, firmware version and serial number for the service centre.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke fault code, firmware version aur serial number likh lein service centre ke liye.

solutions.en: Have the bootloader re-imaged at the service centre and the unit fully load-tested afterwards.
solutions.ur: Service centre par bootloader dobara likhwayein aur uske baad unit ka poora load test karwayein.

source.title: IVCM PRO Series (1KW~3KW) Solar Inverter User Guide (358-010424-00)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: The BMS firmware needs upgrading.
meaning.ur: BMS firmware update karna zaroori hai.

causes.en: Pack supplied with a BMS firmware older than the inverter expects
causes.ur: Pack aisa BMS firmware ke sath aaya hai jo inverter se purana hai

causes.en: Inverter updated but the BMS was left on the old protocol
causes.ur: Inverter update ho gaya lekin BMS purane protocol par chala gaya

solutions.en: Note the BMS version shown on the LCD BMS information page.
solutions.ur: LCD BMS information page par dikhne wala BMS version note karein.

solutions.en: Update the BMS firmware through the app while the pack is connected and awake.
solutions.ur: Pack connected aur awake hone par app se BMS firmware update karein.

solutions.en: Update every pack in a parallel bank; mixed BMS firmware versions prevent parallel operation.
solutions.ur: Parallel bank ke har pack ko update karein; alag BMS firmware versions parallel chalna rok dete hain.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger
aliases: BMS doesn't allow inverter to charge battery

title.ur: Warning 51 BMS charging rok raha hai

meaning.en: The BMS has blocked charging; the inverter stops charging the battery automatically.
meaning.ur: BMS ne charging block kar di hai; inverter khud-ba-khud battery charge karna band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Battery cell voltage at the BMS charge cut-off
causes.ur: Battery cell ka voltage BMS charge cut-off par pohanch gaya

causes.en: Battery temperature outside the BMS permitted range
causes.ur: Battery temperature BMS ke allowed range se bahar hai

causes.en: Cell imbalance or an internal BMS fault latched
causes.ur: Cell imbalance ya BMS ka koi internal fault latch ho gaya

solutions.en: Read the BMS page on the LCD and note the battery voltage and temperature reported.
solutions.ur: LCD ka BMS page padhein aur battery voltage aur temperature note karein.

solutions.en: Charge the pack from PV or grid so the BMS releases the inhibit, then confirm charging resumes.
solutions.ur: Pack ko PV ya grid se charge karein taake BMS inhibit chhor de, phir charging resume ka confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check the pack's own SOC LED and temperature sensor; a failed sensor makes the BMS block permanently.
solutions.ur: Pack ka apna SOC LED aur temperature sensor check karein; kharab sensor BMS ko hamesha block kar deta hai.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger
aliases: BMS doesn't allow inverter to discharge battery

title.ur: Warning 52 BMS discharge rok raha hai

meaning.en: The BMS has blocked discharging; the inverter stops discharging automatically.
meaning.ur: BMS ne discharge block kar diya hai; inverter khud-ba-khud discharging band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Battery SOC reached the BMS discharge floor
causes.ur: Battery SOC BMS discharge floor tak pohanch gaya

causes.en: Battery temperature too low or too high for discharge
causes.ur: Battery temperature discharge ke liye bohat kam ya bohat zyada hai

causes.en: Pack over-current protection latched after a surge
causes.ur: Surge ke baad pack ka over-current protection latch ho gaya

solutions.en: Confirm the SOC on the LCD; if it is at the floor the pack needs charging, not repair.
solutions.ur: LCD par SOC confirm karein; agar woh floor par hai to pack ko charging chahiye, marammat nahi.

solutions.en: Check the pack temperature sensor reading against a contact thermometer.
solutions.ur: Pack ke temperature sensor ki reading contact thermometer se verify karein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle the pack breaker once; if the BMS still blocks, read the BMS fault code on the LCD.
solutions.ur: Pack breaker ko aik baar power-cycle karein; BMS ab bhi block kare to LCD par BMS fault code padhein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger
aliases: BMS require inverter to charge battery

title.ur: Warning 53 BMS charging maang raha hai

meaning.en: The BMS has asked the inverter to charge the battery; charging starts automatically.
meaning.ur: BMS ne inverter se battery charge karne ko kaha hai; charging khud-ba-khud shuru ho jati hai.

causes.en: Cell imbalance so the BMS wants a balancing top-up charge
causes.ur: Cell imbalance hai, is liye BMS balancing top-up charge chahta hai

causes.en: Battery stored long enough for a recovery charge
causes.ur: Battery itni der rahi ke recovery charge aa gaya

causes.en: SOC below the BMS recovery threshold
causes.ur: SOC BMS recovery threshold se neeche hai

solutions.en: Let the automatic charge finish; repeated interruption keeps the request active.
solutions.ur: Automatic charge poora hone dein; baar baar rokne se request qayamat rehti hai.

solutions.en: Check that the charge current for this pack is not set to 0 A in the LCD setup.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke LCD setup mein is pack ka charge current 0 A par set to nahi hai.

solutions.en: After charging, confirm cell voltages on the BMS page have come closer together.
solutions.ur: Charging ke baad confirm karein ke BMS page par cell voltages aik doosre ke qareeb aa gaye hain.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger

title.ur: Warning 54-65 BMS ne fault detect kiya

meaning.en: The BMS has detected some internal fault; the manual says contact the installer if the code persists.
meaning.ur: BMS ne koi internal fault detect kiya hai; manual ke mutabiq code zyada der tak rahe to installer se rabta karein.

causes.en: Cell over/under voltage inside the pack
causes.ur: Pack ke andar cell over ya under voltage

causes.en: Charge or discharge over-current inside the pack
causes.ur: Pack ke andar charge ya discharge over current

causes.en: Cell or pack temperature outside the permitted range
causes.ur: Cell ya pack temperature allowed range se bahar

solutions.en: Read the exact BMS fault code and flag from the LCD BMS information page and write it down.
solutions.ur: LCD BMS information page se exact BMS fault code aur flag padhein aur likh lein.

solutions.en: Let the BMS finish its balancing/recovery action and re-read the code after 30 minutes.
solutions.ur: BMS ko apna balancing/recovery action poora karne dein aur 30 minute baad code dobara padhein.

solutions.en: If the code persists, contact the installer as the manual directs; do not keep cycling the pack.
solutions.ur: Code zyada der tak rahe to manual ke mutabiq installer se rabta karein; pack ko baar baar on/off na karein.

notes.en: The manual prints this as a RANGE 54~65, not a single code. The app should treat any BMS code in 54-65 as this bucket; the specific meaning is only available from the BMS itself.
notes.ur: Manual mein yeh RANGE 54~65 ke tor par chhapa hai, aik code nahin. App ko 54-65 ka koi bhi BMS code isi bucket mein rakhna chahiye; asal matlab sirf BMS se pata chalega.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: The inverter cannot talk to the BMS; check that the communication line is connected well.
meaning.ur: Inverter BMS se baat nahi kar pa raha; check karein ke communication line theek lagi hai.

causes.en: CAN communication cable loose at the inverter or the pack end
causes.ur: CAN communication cable inverter ya pack ke sifar par dhili hai

causes.en: Battery type not set to Lib, so the inverter never opens the BMS link
causes.ur: Battery type Lib par set nahi hai, is liye inverter BMS link kabhi nahi kholta

causes.en: Pack not powered, so its BMS cannot answer
causes.ur: Pack ki power nahi hai, is liye uska BMS jawab nahi de sakta

solutions.en: Reseat the bundled RJ45 CAN cable at both the inverter BMS port and the pack COMM port.
solutions.ur: Bundled RJ45 CAN cable ko inverter BMS port aur pack COMM port dono par dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Set battery type to Lib in LCD setting No. 08, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq LCD setting No. 08 mein battery type Lib par set karein.

solutions.en: Power the pack first, then the inverter, and confirm the 'C' communication icon appears on the LCD.
solutions.ur: Pehle pack ko power karein, phir inverter ko, aur LCD par 'C' communication icon aane ka confirm karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger
aliases: The AC input and output wires are inversely connected

meaning.en: The AC input and output wires are inversely connected.
meaning.ur: AC input aur output wires aik doosre ki jagah lagi hain.

causes.en: Grid and load cables swapped at the AC terminal block
causes.ur: AC terminal block par grid aur load ke cables aik doosre ki jagah lage hue hain

causes.en: Error during a parallel installation where the wiring was landed by guesswork
causes.ur: Parallel installation mein ghalti se wiring lagane ki wajah se error

solutions.en: Check that the AC input and output wires are connected correctly at the terminal block.
solutions.ur: Terminal block par check karein ke AC input aur output wires theek lagi hain.

solutions.en: If this happened during parallel installation, re-check the wiring and finish the parallel installation before restarting.
solutions.ur: Agar yeh parallel installation ke dauran hua to wiring dobara check karke parallel installation mukammal karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the input and output power lines correspond on all phases before closing the breakers.
solutions.ur: Breakers band karne se pehle confirm karein ke input aur output power lines sab phases par aik doosre se match karte hain.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger
aliases: Single unit is installed to parallel system

title.en: Fault 28 Single unit on parallel system
title.ur: Fault 28 Parallel system par aik unit

meaning.en: A single unit is installed into a parallel system.
meaning.ur: Parallel system mein aik hi unit lagi hui hai.

causes.en: Only one unit of a multi-unit bank switched on
causes.ur: Multi-unit bank mein sirf aik unit on hai

causes.en: Parallel setup programmed but sharing cables not connected to every unit
causes.ur: Parallel setup to ho gaya lekin sharing cables har unit par nahi lagi

solutions.en: Check whether a single unit has been installed into a parallel system.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke parallel system mein koi aik unit to nahi lagi.

solutions.en: If this error happens during parallel installation, check the wiring and finish the parallel installation first, then restart.
solutions.ur: Agar yeh parallel installation ke dauran ho to wiring check karein aur pehle parallel installation mukammal karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Confirm every unit in the bank has the sharing and CAN cables connected before switching any of them on.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke bank ka har unit sharing aur CAN cables ke saath laga hua hai, tab koi unit on karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: The DC/DC converter soft start did not complete.
meaning.ur: DC/DC converter ka soft start mukammal nahi hua.

causes.en: Battery voltage too low to start the DC/DC converter
causes.ur: Battery voltage DC/DC converter shuru karne ke liye bohat kam hai

causes.en: DC/DC pre-charge circuit or its capacitor fault
causes.ur: DC/DC pre-charge circuit ya uska capacitor kharab hai

causes.en: Internal component failure in the DC/DC stage
causes.ur: DC/DC stage mein internal component ki failure

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage and confirm it is above the DC/DC start threshold.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage measure karke confirm karein ke woh DC/DC start threshold se upar hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and inspect the DC/DC pre-charge circuit and connectors.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke DC/DC pre-charge circuit aur connectors dekhein.

solutions.en: Restart once as the manual directs; if the code returns, the DC/DC stage needs service-centre repair.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq aik baar restart karein; code wapas aaye to DC/DC stage ko service centre par marammat karwayein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: CAN data between parallel units has been lost.
meaning.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan CAN data kho gaya hai.

causes.en: Parallel CAN communication cable loose or unplugged
causes.ur: Parallel CAN communication cable dhili hai ya nikal gayi

causes.en: CAN cable damaged during installation
causes.ur: Installation ke dauran CAN cable kharab ho gayi

solutions.en: Check that the communication cables are connected well and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke communication cables theek lagi hain aur inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Test the CAN cable end to end with a meter and replace it if the continuity is broken.
solutions.ur: CAN cable ki end-to-end continuity meter se test karein aur continuity tooti ho to replace karein.

solutions.en: If the problem remains, contact the installer as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Masla bacha rahe to manual ke mutabiq installer se rabta karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: Data from the parallel host unit has been lost.
meaning.ur: Parallel host unit ka data kho gaya hai.

causes.en: Host unit switched off while the bank was running
causes.ur: Bank chalte waqt host unit band ho gaya

causes.en: CAN link between host and this unit intermittent
causes.ur: Host aur is unit ke darmiyan CAN link intermittent hai

solutions.en: Check that the communication cables are connected well and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke communication cables theek lagi hain aur inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Read every unit's own fault code in the bank and fix the host's error first.
solutions.ur: Bank mein har unit ka apna fault code padhein aur pehle host ka error theek karein.

solutions.en: If the problem remains, contact the installer as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Masla bacha rahe to manual ke mutabiq installer se rabta karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger

meaning.en: Synchronisation data between parallel units has been lost.
meaning.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan synchronisation data kho gaya hai.

causes.en: Phase assignment (program 28) differs between units in the bank
causes.ur: Bank ke units ka phase assignment (program 28) alag alag hai

causes.en: N conductors not all commoned across the bank
causes.ur: Bank ke darmiyan saare N conductors common nahi kiye gaye

causes.en: Communication cable loose
causes.ur: Communication cable dhili hai

solutions.en: Check that the communication cables are connected well and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke communication cables theek lagi hain aur inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Confirm all N wires of AC output are connected together, as the manual's notes require.
solutions.ur: Manual ke notes ke mutabiq confirm karein ke AC output ke saare N wires aik saath jure hue hain.

solutions.en: Verify every unit has the same program 28 setting; restart the whole bank once.
solutions.ur: Har unit ka program 28 setting aik jaisa hai ya nahi check karein; poore bank ko aik baar restart karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger
aliases: Current feedback into the inverter is detected

meaning.en: Current is feeding back into the inverter, which is unsafe for a parallel bank.
meaning.ur: Inverter mein current wapas aa raha hai, jo parallel bank ke liye khatarnaak hai.

causes.en: L/N cables connected in reverse in one of the inverters
causes.ur: Aik inverter mein L/N cables ulat lagi hain

causes.en: Sharing cables not connected in all units of a single-phase parallel system
causes.ur: Single-phase parallel system mein sabhi units par sharing cables nahi lagi

causes.en: Sharing cables connected between units on different phases in a three-phase system
causes.ur: Three-phase system mein alag phases wale units ke darmiyan sharing cables lagaye gaye

solutions.en: Restart the inverter, then check that L/N cables are not connected in reverse in ALL inverters.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein, phir check karein ke SAARI inverters mein L/N cables ulat nahi lagi hain.

solutions.en: For a single-phase parallel system, make sure the sharing cables are connected in all inverters.
solutions.ur: Single-phase parallel system mein confirm karein ke sharing cables sabhi inverters par lagi hain.

solutions.en: For a three-phase system, sharing cables must be connected only between units on the SAME phase and disconnected between different phases.
solutions.ur: Three-phase system mein sharing cables sirf usi phase wale units ke darmiyan honi chahiyein, alag phases mein disconnected.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger
aliases: The firmware version of each inverter is not the same

meaning.en: The parallel units do not run the same firmware version.
meaning.ur: Parallel units aik hi firmware version par nahi chal rahe.

causes.en: One unit was updated and the others were not
causes.ur: Aik unit update hua lekin baqi nahi

causes.en: Different production batches with different firmware
causes.ur: Alag production batch mein alag firmware

solutions.en: Update all inverter firmware to the same version, as the manual lists.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq sabhi inverter ka firmware aik hi version par update karein.

solutions.en: Check each unit's version through the LCD setting and make sure the CPU versions are the same.
solutions.ur: LCD setting se har unit ka version dekhein aur confirm karein ke CPU versions aik jaise hain.

solutions.en: If they are not the same, ask the installer to supply the firmware, then contact after-sales if it still persists.
solutions.ur: Versions aik jaise na hon to installer se firmware mangwayein, phir bhi masla rahe to after-sales se rabta karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger
aliases: The output current of each inverter is different

title.en: Fault 45 Unequal output current per inverter
title.ur: Fault 45 Har inverter ka output current alag

meaning.en: The output current of each inverter in the bank is different.
meaning.ur: Bank mein har inverter ka output current alag alag hai.

causes.en: Sharing cables loose so current is not shared evenly
causes.ur: Sharing cables dhile hain jis se current barabar se share nahi ho raha

causes.en: One unit's current sensor reading drift
causes.ur: Aik unit ke current sensor ki reading drift ho gayi

causes.en: One unit's output voltage set differently in the setup
causes.ur: Aik unit ka output voltage setup mein alag set hai

solutions.en: Check that the sharing cables are connected well and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke sharing cables theek lagi hain aur inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Compare each unit's output current on the LCD with a clamp meter on its output conductor.
solutions.ur: LCD par har unit ka output current us ke output conductor par clamp meter se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the problem remains, contact the installer as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Masla bacha rahe to manual ke mutabiq installer se rabta karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger
aliases: AC output mode setting is different

title.en: Fault 46 AC output mode setting differs
title.ur: Fault 46 AC output mode setting alag

meaning.en: The units in the bank have different AC output mode settings.
meaning.ur: Bank ke units ke AC output mode settings alag hain.

causes.en: One unit left in 3P1/3P2/3P3 while the rest are set to PAL
causes.ur: Aik unit 3P1/3P2/3P3 par chhor diya gaya jabke baqi PAL par hain

causes.en: Setup changed on one unit after the bank was commissioned
causes.ur: Bank commission hone ke baad aik unit ka setup badal diya gaya

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and check LCD setting program 28, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq inverter band karke LCD setting program 28 check karein.

solutions.en: For a single-phase parallel system, make sure NO unit has 3P1, 3P2 or 3P3 set on program 28.
solutions.ur: Single-phase parallel system mein confirm karein ke kisi unit par program 28 par 3P1, 3P2 ya 3P3 set NAHI hai.

solutions.en: For a three-phase system, make sure no 'PAL' is set on program 28.
solutions.ur: Three-phase system mein confirm karein ke program 28 par kisi unit par 'PAL' set NAHI hai.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

codes.seriesName: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 hybrid inverter

title.ur: Warning 25 Grid phase ka sequence ghalat

meaning.en: The input and output power lines do not correspond; the unit is in a setup state.
meaning.ur: Input aur output power lines aik doosre se match nahi kar rahi; unit setup state mein hai.

causes.en: Manual says this warning normally appears right after a three-phase parallel setup is finished, and is expected.
causes.ur: Manual ke mutabiq yeh warning three-phase parallel setup khatam hone ke foran baad aati hai aur normal hai.

causes.en: Grid and load phases genuinely cross-connected on a three-phase parallel bank
causes.ur: Three-phase parallel bank par grid aur load ke phases haqeeqan aik doosre se Jude hain

solutions.en: If parallel setup was just completed, switch the inverter off and on once; the warning clears by itself.
solutions.ur: Agar parallel setup abhi mukammal hua hai to inverter ko aik baar off/on karein; warning khud hat jayegi.

solutions.en: Confirm every unit in the bank has the same phase assigned (3P1/3P2/3P3) in LCD program 28.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke bank ke har unit ka LCD program 28 mein wohi phase set hai (3P1/3P2/3P3).

solutions.en: Check that the grid input and the load output phases correspond one-to-one at the terminal block.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke terminal block par grid input aur load output ke phases aik doosre se match karte hain.

notes.en: The manual explicitly states this warning is normal after a parallel installation, so do not send the customer away before completing the parallel setup.
notes.ur: Manual saaf likhta hai ke parallel installation ke baad yeh warning normal hai, is liye parallel setup mukammal karne se pehle customer ko bhejein mat.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

codes.seriesName: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 hybrid inverter
aliases: BMS doesn't allow inverter to discharge battery

title.ur: Warning 51 BMS discharge rok raha hai

meaning.en: The BMS has told the inverter not to discharge; the inverter stops discharging automatically.
meaning.ur: BMS ne inverter ko discharge na karne ko kaha hai; inverter khud-ba-khud discharging band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Battery cell voltage hit the BMS discharge cut-off
causes.ur: Battery cell ka voltage BMS discharge cut-off par pohanch gaya

causes.en: Battery temperature outside the BMS permitted range
causes.ur: Battery temperature BMS ke allowed range se bahar hai

causes.en: Pack over-current or over-temperature event latched by the BMS
causes.ur: BMS ne pack ka over-current ya over-temperature event latch kar liya

solutions.en: Read the BMS status on the LCD BMS page and note the reported battery voltage and temperature.
solutions.ur: LCD BMS page par BMS status padhein aur battery voltage aur temperature note karein.

solutions.en: Charge the battery from PV or grid until the BMS releases the inhibit, then confirm discharging resumes.
solutions.ur: Battery ko PV ya grid se charge karein jab tak BMS inhibit na chhode, phir discharging resume hone ka confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check the pack temperature sensor and the ambient temperature at the battery location.
solutions.ur: Pack ka temperature sensor aur battery ki jagah ka ambient temperature check karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

codes.seriesName: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 hybrid inverter
aliases: BMS require inverter to charge battery

title.ur: Warning 52 BMS charging maang raha hai

meaning.en: The BMS has asked the inverter to charge the battery; the inverter charges automatically.
meaning.ur: BMS ne inverter se battery charge karne ko kaha hai; inverter khud-ba-khud charge karta hai.

causes.en: Battery SOC below the BMS balancing or recovery threshold
causes.ur: Battery SOC BMS balancing ya recovery threshold se neeche hai

causes.en: Cell imbalance detected, so the BMS wants a top-up charge
causes.ur: Cell imbalance detect hua hai, is liye BMS top-up charge chahta hai

causes.en: Battery was stored long enough for the BMS to request recovery charge
causes.ur: Battery itni der rahi ke BMS ne recovery charge maang liya

solutions.en: Allow the automatic charge to complete; interrupting it repeatedly keeps the BMS request active.
solutions.ur: Automatic charge poora hone dein; baar baar rokne se BMS ki request qayamat rehti hai.

solutions.en: Confirm charge current is not set to 0 A for this pack in the LCD setup.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke LCD setup mein is pack ka charge current 0 A par set to nahi hai.

solutions.en: If the request never clears, read the BMS fault code on the LCD and treat it as a BMS-side fault.
solutions.ur: Agar request kabhi clear na ho to LCD par BMS fault code padhein aur use BMS side ka fault samajhein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

codes.seriesName: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 hybrid inverter

meaning.en: The BMS firmware needs to be upgraded.
meaning.ur: BMS ka firmware update karna zaroori hai.

causes.en: New battery pack fitted with older BMS firmware than the inverter expects
causes.ur: Naya battery pack lagai gaya hai jiska BMS firmware inverter se purana hai

causes.en: BMS firmware version not matched to the inverter firmware after an update
causes.ur: Inverter firmware update ke baad BMS firmware version match nahi hua

causes.en: Pack supplied with a firmware revision that predates the current protocol
causes.ur: Pack aisa firmware revision ke sath aaya hai jo current protocol se purana hai

solutions.en: Note the BMS version and SOC shown on the LCD BMS information page.
solutions.ur: LCD BMS information page par dikhne wala BMS version aur SOC note karein.

solutions.en: Update the BMS firmware through the Felicity app while the pack is connected and awake.
solutions.ur: Pack connected aur awake hone par Felicity app se BMS firmware update karein.

solutions.en: Do not parallel a pack with mismatched BMS firmware; update every pack in the bank.
solutions.ur: Alag BMS firmware wale pack ko parallel na karein; bank ke har pack ko update karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

codes.seriesName: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 hybrid inverter

meaning.en: PV string voltage is above the MPPT window; the number of modules in series must be reduced.
meaning.ur: PV string ka voltage MPPT window se upar hai; series ke modules ki kami karni hogi.

causes.en: Too many modules in series for cold-morning open-circuit voltage
causes.ur: Series mein modules subah ke thande waqt ke open-circuit voltage ke liye zyada hain

causes.en: Array designed for a higher max PV voltage than this inverter
causes.ur: Array is inverter se zyada max PV voltage ke liye design kiya gaya

solutions.en: Measure PV open-circuit voltage with a meter and compare it with the inverter's MPPT upper limit.
solutions.ur: Meter se PV ka open-circuit voltage measure karke inverter ke MPPT upper limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of modules in series, or switch the PV type setting in the app to match.
solutions.ur: Series mein modules ki kami karein, ya app mein PV type setting usi ke mutabiq karein.

solutions.en: Confirm no MPPT is assigned to an unconnected string, which inflates the reading.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke koi MPPT aise string par set na ho jo connected nahi, warna reading barh jati hai.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

codes.seriesName: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 hybrid inverter
aliases: Over current happen at PV port

meaning.en: Overcurrent at the PV port; the unit has cut output.
meaning.ur: PV port par over current hai; unit ne output band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Parallel strings with mismatched module ratings on one MPPT
causes.ur: Aik MPPT par alag ratings ke modules ke strings parallel lage hain

causes.en: Insulation fault on the string creating a leakage path
causes.ur: String par insulation fault jo leakage path bana raha hai

causes.en: PV input surge from a nearby lightning event
causes.ur: Paas ke lightning event se PV input par surge

solutions.en: Isolate PV at the DC isolator, then clamp-meter each string separately to find the high one.
solutions.ur: DC isolator se PV isolate karke har string ko alag alag clamp meter se measure karke zyada wala dhoondein.

solutions.en: Megohmmeter-test the string insulation to earth before reconnecting anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi wapas lagane se pehle string ki earth insulation megohmmeter se test karein.

solutions.en: Check the DC SPD condition; a spent SPD lets surge straight into the MPPT stage.
solutions.ur: DC SPD ki halat check karein; kharab SPD surge ko seedha MPPT stage mein chhor deta hai.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

codes.seriesName: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 hybrid inverter
aliases: Short circuit happen at PV port

title.ur: Fault 04 PV port par short circuit

meaning.en: Short circuit at the PV port; check that the wiring is connected well.
meaning.ur: PV port par short circuit hai; check karein ke wiring theek lagi hai.

causes.en: MC4 connector not fully clicked, leaving partial contact that arcs
causes.ur: MC4 connector poori tarah click nahi hua, partial contact se arc ban raha hai

causes.en: Cable insulation chafed against the array frame
causes.ur: Cable ki insulation array frame se ragad gayi

causes.en: Panel laminate broken allowing current to earth
causes.ur: Panel ka laminate toota hai jis se earth mein current ja raha hai

solutions.en: Isolate PV at the DC isolator and switch off the AC side before touching any connector.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi connector chhoone se pehle DC isolator se PV aur AC side band karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect and re-make every MC4 pair by hand until each clicks; do not force with pliers.
solutions.ur: Har MC4 pair ko haath se nikal kar dobara laga dein jab tak click na ho; pliers se zor na dein.

solutions.en: Megohmmeter-test each string to earth and replace any cable or panel that fails.
solutions.ur: Har string ki earth insulation megohmmeter se test karke fail hone wala cable ya panel replace karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

codes.seriesName: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 hybrid inverter

meaning.en: The PV current sensor has failed.
meaning.ur: PV current sensor kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Hall sensor on the MPPT board dead
causes.ur: MPPT board par Hall sensor kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Sensor harness disconnected during a board replacement
causes.ur: Board badalne ke dauran sensor harness nikal gaya

causes.en: Sensor drift after a surge event
causes.ur: Surge event ke baad sensor drift ho gaya

solutions.en: Compare the PV power shown on the LCD with a clamp meter on the string; zero or frozen means sensor failure.
solutions.ur: LCD par dikhne wali PV power ko string par clamp meter se compare karein; zero ya jam hui power sensor failure hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the MPPT current sensor connector on the board.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke board par MPPT current sensor ka connector dobara laga dein.

solutions.en: Have the MPPT current sensor replaced and calibrated at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Service centre par MPPT current sensor replace aur calibrate karwayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

codes.seriesName: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 hybrid inverter

meaning.en: Battery voltage is too high; check that battery spec and quantity meet requirements.
meaning.ur: Battery ka voltage bohat zyada hai; check karein ke battery ki spec aur quantity requirements poori karti hai.
