source.title: CP1500AVRL User's Manual K01-0000860-00

codes.seriesName: CP550/900/1300/1500EPFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 550-1500VA, 230V EU/UK)

title.en: F01 Overload fault (battery or AC mode)
title.ur: F01 Overload fault (battery ya AC mode)

meaning.en: The connected load exceeds the unit rating in battery mode or on AC/utility power. Manual remedy is simply to turn the UPS on again after reducing load.
meaning.ur: Battery mode ya AC/utility power par connected load unit ki rating se zyada hai. Manual ka hal yeh hai ke load kam kar ke UPS dobara on karein.

causes.en: Too many or too high-wattage devices on the battery-supplied outlets.
causes.ur: Battery-supplied outlets par zyada devices ya zyada watt wale devices lage hain.

causes.en: High inrush from a compressor, laser printer or motor when mains returns.
causes.ur: Mains wapas aate hi compressor, laser printer ya motor ka high inrush ho raha hai.

causes.en: Rear circuit breaker has tripped on overload and is projecting from the case.
causes.ur: Rear circuit breaker overload par trip ho gaya hai aur case se bahar nikal raha hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, unplug at least one piece of equipment, wait 10 seconds, then reset the circuit breaker by depressing the button and turn the UPS on.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, kam az kam ek equipment nikaal dein, 10 second intezaar karein, phir circuit breaker button daba kar reset karein aur UPS on karein.

solutions.en: Add loads back one at a time and total the watts on a power meter; keep the sum under the unit's rated watts (e.g. 900W on CP1500EPFCLCD).
solutions.ur: Loads ek-ek karke wapas lagayein aur power meter se watt total karein; total ko unit ki rated watts se kam rakhein (CP1500EPFCLCD ke liye 900W).

solutions.en: Measure each battery on DC volts; a worn bank can trip the overload alarm during the transfer test even when the AC load looks within rating.
solutions.ur: Har battery DC volt par measure karein; purani battery bank transfer test ke dauran overload alarm kar sakti hai jabke AC load rating mein lage.

solutions.en: If F01 returns with everything unplugged, treat the current-limit/inverter stage as faulty and send the unit to CyberPower Systems support.
solutions.ur: Agar sab kuch nikal kar bhi F01 aaye to current-limit/inverter stage kharab samajhein aur unit CyberPower Systems support ko bhejein.

source.title: CP1300/1500EPFCLCD User's Manual K01-0000197-00

codes.seriesName: CP550/900/1300/1500EPFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 550-1500VA, 230V EU/UK)

title.ur: F02 Battery Output Short fault (battery se chalte waqt output short)

meaning.en: The output is shorted while running on battery. The FAULT icon latches; the manual remedy is to turn the UPS on again after removing the short.
meaning.ur: Battery par chalte waqt output short ho gaya hai. FAULT icon lock ho jata hai; manual ka hal hai ke short hatane ke baad UPS dobara on karein.

causes.en: A connected appliance has failed short-circuiting.
causes.ur: Koi connected appliance short ho kar kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: A power strip or extension lead has a crushed or cut live core.
causes.ur: Power strip ya extension wire ka koi live core kata ya daba hua hai.

causes.en: Outlet board terminals loose or bridged, or the battery lead chafed against the chassis.
causes.ur: Outlet board ke terminals dheele ya bridge hue hain, ya battery lead chassis se ghis gaya hai.

solutions.en: Turn off, unplug mains and disconnect the internal battery quick-connect, then unplug every load from all UPS outlets.
solutions.ur: Off karein, mains aur internal battery quick-connect disconnect karein, phir tamam UPS outlets se saara load nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Reconnect one device at a time; the unit that trips F02 again is the short and must be repaired or removed.
solutions.ur: Ek-ek device wapas lagayein; jis par dobara F02 aaye wohi short hai aur use repair ya nikaalna hoga.

solutions.en: With the unit isolated, use a multimeter on continuity/ohms from each outlet to neutral; near-zero ohms confirms the short path.
solutions.ur: Unit isolate karne ke baad multimeter continuity/ohms par har outlet ko neutral se check karein; zero ke qareeb ohms short path confirm karta hai.

solutions.en: If all outlets are clean and F02 still returns, the inverter output stage has failed - send to CyberPower Systems support.
solutions.ur: Agar sab outlets clean hain phir bhi F02 aaye to inverter output stage kharab ho gaya hai - CyberPower Systems support ko bhejein.

source.title: CP1300/1500EPFCLCD User's Manual K01-0000197-00

codes.seriesName: CP550/900/1300/1500EPFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 550-1500VA, 230V EU/UK)

title.ur: F03 Charger Fault (charger kharab, battery charge nahi hoti)

meaning.en: The internal battery charger has failed. CyberPower's stated remedy is to contact their support; there is no user-level fix.
meaning.ur: Internal battery charger kharab ho gaya hai. CyberPower ka kaha hua hal yeh hai ke unki support se rabta karein; koi user-level hal nahi.

causes.en: Charger IC, MOSFET or the charge-sense divider on the main board has failed.
causes.ur: Main board par charger IC, MOSFET ya charge-sense divider kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Battery bank dead, deeply discharged or of the wrong type, dragging the charger into a fault state.
causes.ur: Battery bank dead, gehri tarah discharged ya galat type ki hai, jis se charger fault state mein chala jata hai.

causes.en: Ambient heat or a failed internal fan has cooked the charger section.
causes.ur: Mauhal ka garmi ya internal fan ki khami ne charger section kharab kiya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate before anything else: switch off, unplug mains, disconnect the internal battery quick-connect.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle isolate karein: off karein, mains nikaal dein, internal battery quick-connect disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery pack on DC volts; a rested healthy 12V pack reads 12.4-12.7V per cell and near-zero means the pack is dead.
solutions.ur: Battery pack DC volt par measure karein; aaram wali healthy 12V pack 12.4-12.7V per cell hoti hai aur zero ke qareeb ho to pack dead hai.

solutions.en: With mains reconnected, read the charge voltage at the battery terminals; 13.5-14V is healthy and near 0V means the charger output stage has failed.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas lagane ke baad battery terminals par charge voltage dekhein; 13.5-14V healthy hai aur 0V ke qareeb ho to charger output stage kharab hai.

solutions.en: As the manual directs, contact CyberPower Systems for support / RMA - do not attempt to bypass the charger fault.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai, CyberPower Systems se support/RMA ke liye rabta karein - charger fault ko bypass karne ki koshish na karein.

source.title: CP1300/1500EPFCLCD User's Manual K01-0000197-00

codes.seriesName: CP550/900/1300/1500EPFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 550-1500VA, 230V EU/UK)

title.ur: F04 Internal Fault (unit ka andar ka hissa kharab)

meaning.en: A general internal hardware fault inside the UPS, not specific to battery, charger or output. CyberPower's stated remedy is support contact.
meaning.ur: UPS ke andar ka aam internal hardware fault, jo battery, charger ya output se khaas nahi. CyberPower ka kaha hua hal support se rabta hai.

causes.en: Failed relay, SCR, or inverter MOSFET stage inside the power path.
causes.ur: Power path ke andar relay, SCR ya inverter MOSFET stage kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Main control board has failed or lost its calibration.
causes.ur: Main control board kharab ho gaya hai ya us ki calibration kho gaya hai.

causes.en: Internal solder joint cracked, or a component inside has overheated and failed.
causes.ur: Internal solder joint crack ho gaya hai, ya koi component garmi se kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Perform a full power-off isolation first: switch off, unplug mains, disconnect the battery, and leave it for a few minutes to discharge.
solutions.ur: Pehle poora isolation karein: off karein, mains nikaal dein, battery disconnect karein, aur kuch minute chhor dein taake discharge ho jaye.

solutions.en: After full discharge, reconnect mains and try one power cycle; if F04 clears, note the cause and monitor the unit closely.
solutions.ur: Poori discharge ke baad mains wapas lagayein aur aik power cycle karein; agar F04 clear ho jaye to wajaib note karein aur unit par nazar rakhein.

solutions.en: If F04 returns on a second cycle with the battery disconnected, the control or inverter board is at fault, not the load or the battery.
solutions.ur: Agar battery disconnect kar ke doosre cycle par bhi F04 aaye to control ya inverter board kharab hai, load ya battery nahi.

solutions.en: As the manual states, contact CyberPower Systems for support - this is a service-centre level fault, not a field repair.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai, CyberPower Systems se support lein - yeh service centre level fault hai, field repair nahi.

source.title: CP1300/1500EPFCLCD User's Manual K01-0000197-00

codes.seriesName: CP550/900/1300/1500EPFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 550-1500VA, 230V EU/UK)

meaning.en: Status icon showing the unit is in energy-saving bypass mode (CyberPower GreenPower technology). Normal, not a fault.
meaning.ur: Status icon jo batata hai ke unit energy-saving bypass mode mein hai (CyberPower GreenPower technology). Normal hai, fault nahi.

causes.en: Utility power is normal and the load is light enough for the unit to stay in bypass to save power.
causes.ur: Mains normal hai aur load itna halka hai ke unit power bachane ke liye bypass mein reh sakta hai.

solutions.en: No action needed - this reduces standby consumption and extends battery life.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaruri nahi - is se standby power consumption kam hoti hai aur battery ki umar barhti hai.

solutions.en: If you want guaranteed runtime, raise the load above the energy-saving threshold or disable the GreenPower feature per the Function Setup Guide.
solutions.ur: Agar aap pakka runtime chahte hain to load ko energy-saving threshold se upar lein ya Function Setup Guide ke mutabiq GreenPower feature band kar dein.

source.title: CP1300/1500EPFCLCD User's Manual K01-0000197-00

codes.seriesName: CP550/900/1300/1500EPFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 550-1500VA, 230V EU/UK)

title.ur: BATTERY icon / capacity meter (abhi battery se chal raha hai)

meaning.en: Status icon plus a 20% step capacity meter shown when a blackout or severe brownout moves the UPS to battery power. Continuous rapid beeping means the battery is nearly out.
meaning.ur: Status icon aur 20% step wala capacity meter jo blackout ya severe brownout par UPS ko battery power par le jata hai. Mukhtalif rapid beeping ka matlab hai ke battery khatam hone wali hai.

causes.en: Utility power failed or fell below the transfer threshold.
causes.ur: Mains chali gayi ya transfer threshold se neeche gir gayi.

causes.en: On/off switch cycled too rapidly, so the unit is protecting its control circuit.
causes.ur: On/off switch bohat jaldi chala-pala gaya, is liye unit apna control circuit protect kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Save files and shut down equipment immediately, or let the software perform a controlled shutdown.
solutions.ur: Files foran save karein aur equipment band karein, ya software se controlled shutdown karwayein.

solutions.en: After mains returns, recharge for 8-16 hours as the battery procedure in this manual specifies, to fully restore charge.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane ke baad 8-16 ghante recharge karein jaise is manual ki battery procedure kehta hai, taake charge poora ho jaye.

source.title: CP1300/1500EPFCLCD User's Manual K01-0000197-00

codes.seriesName: CP550/900/1300/1500EPFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 550-1500VA, 230V EU/UK)

title.ur: OVER LOAD icon (outlets par load zyada hai)

meaning.en: Status icon with an alarm indicating the battery-supplied outlets are overloaded. Clears as equipment is unplugged one at a time.
meaning.ur: Status icon jo alarm ke saath batata hai ke battery-supplied outlets overloaded hain. Equipment ek-ek karke nikalte hi clear ho jata hai.

causes.en: Combined device wattage exceeds the unit's battery-outlet rating.
causes.ur: Devices ka total wattage unit ki battery-outlet rating se zyada hai.

causes.en: A surge or motor inrush from a newly plugged device.
causes.ur: Naye lagaye hue device se power surge ya motor inrush aaya hai.

solutions.en: Unplug some equipment from the battery-supplied outlets until the icon turns off and the alarm stops.
solutions.ur: Battery-supplied outlets se kuch equipment nikaalte jayein jab tak icon band na ho aur alarm na ruke.

solutions.en: Check the rear circuit breaker knob is depressed and reset it after a 10 second wait before restarting.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke rear circuit breaker knob neeche dabba hua hai, aur restart se pehle 10 second baad use reset karein.

source.title: CP1300/1500EPFCLCD User's Manual K01-0000197-00

codes.seriesName: CP1350PFCLCD / CP1500PFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 1350-1500VA)

title.ur: E01 Charger Fault - Overcharge (charger battery ko zyada charge kar raha)

meaning.en: The battery charger is pushing too much voltage into the internal battery bank. The UPS shuts its output off and stays in fault until serviced.
meaning.ur: Battery charger internal battery mein zyada voltage daal raha hai. UPS apna output band kar deta hai aur fault mein reh-ta hai jab tak service na ho.

causes.en: Charger circuit failed or the charge-voltage sense resistor/mosfet is faulty.
causes.ur: Charger circuit kharab hai ya charge-voltage sense resistor/mosfet faulty hai.

causes.en: Battery bank is over-aged, overheated or swollen, driving the charger into overcharge.
causes.ur: Battery purani ho chuki hai, garam ya phooli hui hai, jis se charger overcharge mein chala jata hai.

causes.en: Wrong or high-voltage replacement battery fitted to a unit rated for a lower battery string.
causes.ur: Galat ya high-voltage replacement battery lagi ho jis se unit ka battery string rating se upar ho jaye.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug the mains cord, then pull the battery quick-connect off before touching anything else.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains cord nikaal dein, phir battery quick-connect nikaal lein - uske baad hi koi cheez chhunein.

solutions.en: Set your multimeter to DC volts and measure each battery terminal-to-terminal; a healthy 12V cell reads about 12.6-13.0V and should not read above roughly 13.8V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter DC volt par karein aur har battery ke terminal se measure karein; healthy 12V cell 12.6-13.0V par hota hai aur 13.8V se upar nahi hona chahiye.

solutions.en: If one battery is over 13.8V, replace the whole bank together with the CyberPower-specified replacement battery rather than mixing old and new cells.
solutions.ur: Agar koi ek battery 13.8V se upar hai, to poori battery bank ko CyberPower ki spec wali battery se saath-saath badal dein, puri aur nayi ko mix na karein.

solutions.en: If all cells are in range but E01 persists, the charger board itself is at fault - contact CyberPower Systems support for an RMA.
solutions.ur: Agar sab cells theek hain phir bhi E01 aata hai, to charger board khud kharab hai - CyberPower Systems support se RMA ke liye rabta karein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

codes.seriesName: CP1350PFCLCD / CP1500PFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 1350-1500VA)

title.ur: E02 Charger Fault - No Charge (charger battery charge hi nahi kar raha)

meaning.en: The charger is not charging the battery bank at all. The UPS drops into fault because it has no usable reserve.
meaning.ur: Charger battery bank ko bilkul charge nahi kar raha. UPS fault mein chala jata hai kyunke us ke paas koi reserve power nahi bacha.

causes.en: Internal battery quick-connect is unplugged or the battery terminals are corroded/loose.
causes.ur: Internal battery quick-connect nikaala hua hai ya battery terminals zang lagay ya dheele hain.

causes.en: Battery bank is fully dead (open-circuit) or a cell has swollen and split.
causes.ur: Battery bank poori tarah kharab (open circuit) hai ya koi cell phool kar phat gaya hai.

causes.en: Charger section, fuse on the battery lead, or the PCB solder joint has failed.
causes.ur: Charger section, battery lead ka fuse, ya PCB ka solder joint kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, remove the mains plug, and disconnect the battery quick-connect before inspection.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains plug nikaal dein, aur check karne se pehle battery quick-connect disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Check battery DC voltage with a multimeter: a rested healthy 12V battery reads about 12.4-12.7V; a reading near 0V means the battery is dead.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery ka DC voltage check karein: aaram karne wali healthy 12V battery 12.4-12.7V par hoti hai; 0V ke qareeb ho to battery kharab hai.

solutions.en: Measure DC voltage at the battery terminals while mains is reconnected: a healthy charger gives about 13.5-14V; near 0V means the charger/fuse has failed.
solutions.ur: Mains dobara lagane ke baad battery terminals par DC voltage measein karein: healthy charger 13.5-14V deta hai; 0V ke qareeb ho to charger ya fuse kharab hai.

solutions.en: Replace a dead battery bank with the CyberPower-specified pack; if the new battery still shows E02, escalate the charger board to support.
solutions.ur: Kharab battery bank ko CyberPower ki spec wali battery se badal dein; nayi battery par bhi E02 aaye to charger board support ko bhejein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

codes.seriesName: CP1350PFCLCD / CP1500PFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 1350-1500VA)

title.ur: E11 Battery Overvoltage (battery ka voltage safe limit se upar)

meaning.en: The measured battery voltage is above the safe limit, so the UPS cuts inverter drive to protect the battery bank.
meaning.ur: Battery ka measured voltage safe limit se upar hai, is liye UPS battery bank bachane ke liye inverter drive band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Over-voltage relay or sensing circuit has failed and no longer cuts charging.
causes.ur: Over-voltage relay ya sensing circuit kharab ho gaya hai aur charging band nahi kar raha.

causes.en: An extra cell was added in series to the bank, raising the string above the charger set-point.
causes.ur: Bank mein series mein ek extra cell lagaya gaya ho, jis se string charger set-point se upar chali gayi.

causes.en: Battery is swollen from age/heat and internally shorted, sending the charge current into a rising voltage.
causes.ur: Battery umar ya garmi se phooli hui hai aur andar se short ho gayi hai, jis se charge current voltage badhata hai.

solutions.en: Isolate first: switch off, unplug mains, and disconnect the internal battery quick-connect.
solutions.ur: Pehle isolate karein: off karein, mains nikaal dein, aur internal battery quick-connect disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Count the cells in series and compare with the model spec; the CP1500PFCLCD battery is a sealed maintenance-free lead-acid pack, so an extra cell is a wrong-battery fit.
solutions.ur: Series mein cells gin lein aur model spec se compare karein; CP1500PFCLCD ki battery sealed maintenance-free lead-acid pack hai, is liye extra cell ka matlab galat battery lagi hai.

solutions.en: Measure each cell with a multimeter on DC range; anything above ~13.8V at rest means replace that battery, and replace the pair at the same time.
solutions.ur: Har cell ko multimeter DC range par measure karein; aaram karte waqt 13.8V se upar ho to us battery ko badal dein, aur dono ek saath badal lein.

solutions.en: If voltage is normal but E11 remains, treat it as a sensing/relay failure and send the unit to CyberPower Systems support.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage theek ho phir bhi E11 bana rahe, to ise sensing ya relay failure samajhein aur unit CyberPower Systems support ko bhejein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

codes.seriesName: CP1350PFCLCD / CP1500PFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 1350-1500VA)

title.ur: E21 Battery Output Short Fault (battery mode mein output short)

meaning.en: The inverter output is shorted while on battery. The UPS latches a fault and will not restart until the short is removed.
meaning.ur: Battery mode mein inverter output short ho gaya hai. UPS fault lock kar leta hai aur short hataye baghair dobara start nahi hoga.

causes.en: A connected appliance has failed short-circuiting (e.g. a desktop PSU, monitor, motorised device or a fridge compressor).
causes.ur: Koi connected appliance short ho kar kharab hua hai (jaise desktop PSU, monitor, motor wala device ya fridge ka compressor).

causes.en: A multi-way power strip or extension lead has crushed/nicked a live conductor.
causes.ur: Kisi multi-way power strip ya extension wire mein live conductor daba ya kat gaya hai.

causes.en: UPS outlet board terminals are loose or bridged, or the battery cable has chafed against the chassis.
causes.ur: UPS outlet board ke terminals dheele hain ya aapas mein short hain, ya battery cable chassis ke saath ghis gaya hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, unplug mains and disconnect the battery, then unplug every single load from all UPS outlets before powering up again.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains aur battery disconnect karein, phir UPS ke tamam outlets se ek-ek karke saara load nikaal lein, uske baad dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect loads one at a time; the load that trips E21 again is the shorted device - unplug it and have it repaired.
solutions.ur: Load ek-ek karke wapas lagayein; jis load par dobara E21 aaye wohi shorted device hai - use nikaal dein aur repair karwayein.

solutions.en: With the battery and mains isolated, set a multimeter to continuity/ohms and check each UPS output socket to the neutral terminal; a near-zero reading confirms a socket short.
solutions.ur: Battery aur mains isolate karne ke baad multimeter continuity/ohms par karein aur har UPS output socket ko neutral se check karein; zero ke qareeb reading socket short confirm karti hai.

solutions.en: If all sockets measure clean and the fault still returns, the inverter stage is damaged - send the unit to CyberPower Systems support.
solutions.ur: Agar sab sockets saaf nikal lein phir bhi fault aaye, to inverter stage kharab hai - unit CyberPower Systems support ko bhejein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

codes.seriesName: CP1350PFCLCD / CP1500PFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 1350-1500VA)

title.en: E22 Battery or AC Mode Overload Fault
title.ur: E22 Battery ya AC mode Overload Fault

meaning.en: The connected load exceeds the UPS rating, either on battery or on utility power. The UPS shuts the output to protect itself.
meaning.ur: Connected load UPS ki rating se zyada hai, ya battery par ya utility power par. UPS apni protection ke liye output band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Too many or too high-wattage devices plugged into the battery-backed outlets.
causes.ur: Battery wale outlets mein zyada devices ya zyada watt wale devices lagaye gaye hain.

causes.en: A device with a large inrush (compressor, laser printer, motor) trips the overload when mains returns.
causes.ur: Bade inrush wala device (compressor, laser printer, motor) mains wapas aate hi overload kar deta hai.

causes.en: Load inrush is being drawn through a power strip whose own rating is below the UPS output.
causes.ur: Load aisi power strip se aa raha hai jis ki apni rating UPS output se kam hai.

solutions.en: Switch off and unplug the UPS, then remove at least one piece of equipment from the battery outlets as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: UPS off karke plug nikaal dein, phir manual ke mutabiq battery outlets se kam az kam ek device nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Add the loads back one at a time and total their watts on a label or a power meter; keep it under the unit's rated watts (e.g. 1000W for CP1500PFCLCD).
solutions.ur: Loads ek-ek karke wapas lagayein aur un ke watt label par ya power meter se total karein; unit ki rated watts se kam rakhein (CP1500PFCLCD ke liye 1000W).

solutions.en: Check the rear circuit breaker knob and the load rating printed next to the battery outlets before restarting.
solutions.ur: Restart karne se pehle rear circuit breaker knob aur battery outlets ke paas likhi hui load rating check karein.

solutions.en: If the overload clears with one device removed but a large inrush device is still needed, stagger restarts or leave the heavy appliance on mains directly.
solutions.ur: Agar ek device nikalne par overload clear ho jaye lekin bade inrush wala device chahiye, to restart stagger karein ya bhaari appliance ko seedha mains par chhorein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

codes.seriesName: CP1350PFCLCD / CP1500PFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 1350-1500VA)

title.ur: ON BATTERY icon (mains chali gayi, ab battery chal raha hai)

meaning.en: Normal operating status shown when a severe sag or loss of utility power moves the UPS onto its internal batteries. Not a fault; it beeps twice then pauses.
meaning.ur: Normal operating status jo severe sag ya mains power khatam hone par UPS ko internal battery par le jata hai. Fault nahi; do baar beep karta hai phir ruk jata hai.

causes.en: Utility power failed, browned out, or dropped out of the transfer range.
causes.ur: Mains power chali gayi, brownout hua, ya transfer range se bahar chala gaya.

causes.en: Input plug not fully seated, or a supply breaker/isolator is open.
causes.ur: Input plug poori tarah nahi lagi, ya supply breaker/isolator khula hua hai.

solutions.en: No repair needed - save work and let the software shut the system down if the outage is long.
solutions.ur: Koi marammat zaruri nahi - kaam save karein, agar outage lamba ho to system software se shutdown karwayein.

solutions.en: Confirm the wall socket and the input breaker are live, then let the UPS recharge for about 8 hours after the mains returns.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke wall socket aur input breaker mein power hai, phir mains wapas aane ke baad UPS ko kareeb 8 ghante recharge karne dein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

codes.seriesName: CP1350PFCLCD / CP1500PFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 1350-1500VA)

title.ur: OVERLOAD icon (outlets par load zyada hai)

meaning.en: Status icon with an alarm that indicates the battery-supplied outlets are overloaded. Clears when the load is reduced.
meaning.ur: Status icon jo alarm ke saath batata hai ke battery wale outlets par load zyada hai. Load kam karne par yeh hat jata hai.

causes.en: Combined wattage of plugged devices exceeds the UPS output rating.
causes.ur: Lagaye gaye devices ka total wattage UPS output rating se zyada hai.

causes.en: A power surge or inrush from a device such as a compressor or motor.
causes.ur: Kisi compressor ya motor jaise device se power surge ya inrush aaya ho.

solutions.en: Unplug one piece of equipment from the battery-supplied outlets at a time until the icon turns off and the alarm stops, exactly as the manual says.
solutions.ur: Battery-supplied outlets se ek-ek karke equipment nikaalte jayein jab tak icon band na ho aur alarm na ruke - manual bilkul yehi kehta hai.

solutions.en: Verify the remaining load with a power meter and confirm the rear circuit breaker knob is fully in.
solutions.ur: Power meter se bachi hui load verify karein aur confirm karein ke rear circuit breaker knob poori tarah andar hai.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

codes.seriesName: CP1350PFCLCD / CP1500PFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 1350-1500VA)

title.ur: REPLACE BATTERY icon (battery badalne ka waqt aa gaya hai)

meaning.en: Status icon that lights when the batteries are not connected well or have worn out. Calls for battery replacement, not a whole-unit failure.
meaning.ur: Status icon jo tab jalta hai jab batteries theek se nahi lagi hon ya purani ho chuki hon. Ye battery badalne ka signal hai, poora unit kharab hone ka nahi.

causes.en: Battery quick-connect is loose or unplugged at the rear of the unit.
causes.ur: Battery quick-connect unit ke pichhe se dheela ya nikaala hua hai.

causes.en: Battery terminals are corroded, giving a high-resistance connection.
causes.ur: Battery terminals zang lagay hain aur connection mein resistance zyada hai.

causes.en: Batteries are simply worn out after repeated deep discharge cycles.
causes.ur: Baar baar deep discharge ke baad batteries bas purani ho chuki hain.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, unplug mains, then reseat the internal battery quick-connect firmly until it clicks.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains nikaal dein, phir internal battery quick-connect ko mazbooti se baithayein jab tak click na ho.

solutions.en: Clean battery terminals with a stiff brush and a solution of baking soda and water, dry them, then reconnect.
solutions.ur: Battery terminals ko sakht brush aur baking soda + pani ke solution se saaf karein, khushk karein, phir wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure the pack on DC volts; replace the battery/bank when rested voltage is well below spec or runtime will no longer meet the load.
solutions.ur: Pack ko DC volt par measure karein; aaram wali voltage spec se kaafi neeche ho ya runtime load ke liye na mile to battery/bank badal dein.

source.title: PFC Sinewave UPS Series CP1350PFCLCD/CP1500PFCLCD User Manual

codes.seriesName: LX1100G3 / LX1325GU3 / LX1500GU3 and CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 (Intelligent LCD, line-interactive 1100-1500VA, newer FAULT list)

title.ur: E01 Charger Fault - Overcharge (charger battery ko zyada charge kar raha)

meaning.en: The charger is pushing the battery bank above its safe voltage. Present on the LX G3 manual's FAULT list; note the CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 manual for the same shortened-wording platform omits E01.
meaning.ur: Charger battery bank ko safe voltage se upar le raha hai. LX G3 manual ki FAULT list mein mojood hai; dhyan dein isi hi shortened-wording platform ke CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 manual mein E01 nahi hai.

causes.en: Charger over-voltage sensing or the charge IC has failed.
causes.ur: Charger over-voltage sensing ya charge IC kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Aged, overheated or swollen battery bank drags the charger into overcharge.
causes.ur: Purani, garmi se kharab ya phooli hui battery bank charger ko overcharge mein kheench leti hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, unplug the mains cord and disconnect the internal battery quick-connect before opening the case.
solutions.ur: Case kholne se pehle UPS off karein, mains cord nikaal dein aur internal battery quick-connect disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure each battery on DC volts; a healthy 12V cell reads 12.6-13.0V and should not exceed about 13.8V at rest.
solutions.ur: Har battery DC volt par measure karein; healthy 12V cell 12.6-13.0V par hota hai aur aaram ke waqt 13.8V se upar na ho.

solutions.en: Swap the whole battery bank for the specified replacement, keeping matched cells in series.
solutions.ur: Poori battery bank ko spec wali replacement se badal dein, series mein matched cells jor ke rakhein.

solutions.en: If readings are normal, the charger board is at fault - contact CyberPower Systems support for an RMA.
solutions.ur: Agar readings normal hain to charger board kharab hai - CyberPower Systems support se RMA ke liye rabta karein.

source.title: LX1100G3/LX1325GU3/LX1500GU3 User Manual (CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 platform)

codes.seriesName: LX1100G3 / LX1325GU3 / LX1500GU3 and CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 (Intelligent LCD, line-interactive 1100-1500VA, newer FAULT list)

title.ur: E02 Charger Fault - No Charge (charger battery charge hi nahi kar raha)

meaning.en: The charger is not charging the battery bank at all, so the UPS has no usable reserve and reports a fault.
meaning.ur: Charger battery bank ko bilkul charge nahi kar raha, is liye UPS ke paas koi usable reserve nahi aur woh fault report karta hai.

causes.en: Internal battery quick-connect is loose or the terminal is corroded.
causes.ur: Internal battery quick-connect dheela hai ya terminal zanga hai.

causes.en: Battery pack is dead or has a failed cell in the series string.
causes.ur: Battery pack dead hai ya series string mein koi cell kharab hai.

causes.en: Battery branch fuse or the charger output stage has failed open.
causes.ur: Battery branch fuse ya charger output stage open ho kar kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate first: switch off, unplug mains, disconnect the internal battery quick-connect.
solutions.ur: Pehle isolate karein: off karein, mains nikaal dein, internal battery quick-connect disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Check battery DC voltage; a rested healthy 12V battery reads 12.4-12.7V and near 0V means the pack must be replaced.
solutions.ur: Battery DC voltage check karein; aaram wali healthy 12V battery 12.4-12.7V par hoti hai aur 0V ke qareeb ho to pack badalna hai.

solutions.en: With mains reconnected, measure charge voltage at the battery terminals; 13.5-14V is healthy and near 0V means the charger or fuse failed.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas lagane ke baad battery terminals par charge voltage measure karein; 13.5-14V healthy hai aur 0V ke qareeb charger ya fuse kharab.

solutions.en: Replace a dead pack with the specified battery; a persistent E02 on a new pack means the charger board has failed - escalate to support.
solutions.ur: Dead pack ko spec wali battery se badal dein; nayi pack par bhi E02 jari rahe to charger board kharab hai - support tak pohanchayein.

source.title: LX1100G3/LX1325GU3/LX1500GU3 User Manual (CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 platform)

codes.seriesName: LX1100G3 / LX1325GU3 / LX1500GU3 and CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 (Intelligent LCD, line-interactive 1100-1500VA, newer FAULT list)

title.ur: E11 Battery Overvoltage (battery ka voltage safe limit se upar)

meaning.en: Battery voltage has risen above the safe limit and the UPS cuts inverter drive to protect the cells.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage safe limit se upar chali gayi hai aur UPS cells bachane ke liye inverter drive band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Over-voltage protection relay or sensing line has failed so charging is never cut.
causes.ur: Over-voltage protection relay ya sensing line kharab ho gayi hai is liye charging kabhi band nahi hoti.

causes.en: An extra cell in series has pushed the string above the charger set-point.
causes.ur: Series mein ek extra cell lag gaya hai jis se string charger set-point se upar chali gayi.

causes.en: Swollen, internally shorted battery absorbing charge without taking it.
causes.ur: Phooli hui, andar se short battery charge le rahi hai lekin use nahi kar rahi.

solutions.en: Turn off, unplug mains and disconnect the battery before any measurement.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi measurement se pehle off karein, mains nikaal dein aur battery disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Count the cells in series and confirm they match the model's specified battery configuration.
solutions.ur: Series mein cells gin lein aur confirm karein ke woh model ki battery configuration se match karte hain.

solutions.en: Measure each cell on DC range; above about 13.8V at rest means replace that battery and its pair together.
solutions.ur: Har cell DC range par measure karein; aaram ke waqt 13.8V se upar ho to us battery ko aur us ki jodi ko saath badal dein.

solutions.en: If voltage is in range but E11 still shows, it is a sensing/relay failure - route the unit to CyberPower Systems support.
solutions.ur: Agar voltage range mein ho phir bhi E11 aaye to sensing/relay failure hai - unit CyberPower Systems support ko bhejein.

source.title: LX1100G3/LX1325GU3/LX1500GU3 User Manual (CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 platform)

codes.seriesName: LX1100G3 / LX1325GU3 / LX1500GU3 and CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 (Intelligent LCD, line-interactive 1100-1500VA, newer FAULT list)

title.ur: E21 Output Short (output short circuit ho gaya)

meaning.en: The output is shorted while the UPS is running. Newer wording on this platform is 'Output Short' and the manual's own remedy is to check the connected equipment first, then turn the UPS on again.
meaning.ur: UPS chalte waqt output short ho gaya hai. Is platform par nayi wording 'Output Short' hai aur manual ka apna hal yeh hai ke pehle connected equipment check karein, phir UPS dobara on karein.

causes.en: Connected equipment has a problem and one of them is shorting the output.
causes.ur: Connected equipment mein koi masla hai aur woh output short kar raha hai.

causes.en: A power strip or extension lead has a crushed or cut live core.
causes.ur: Power strip ya extension lead ka live core kata ya daba hua hai.

causes.en: Outlet terminals loose/bridged, or a cable pinched behind the unit.
causes.ur: Outlet terminals dheele/bridge hue hain, ya unit ke peeche koi cable pincha hua hai.

solutions.en: Apply the manual's own remedy: check the status of equipment connected to the UPS, then turn the UPS on again.
solutions.ur: Manual ka apna hal lagayein: UPS se jude equipment ki haalat check karein, phir UPS dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Before powering up, unplug mains and disconnect the internal battery, then remove every load so the next power-up is a clean test.
solutions.ur: Power up karne se pehle mains nikaal dein aur internal battery disconnect karein, phir saara load nikaal dein taake agla power-up saaf test ho.

solutions.en: With the unit isolated, use a multimeter on continuity/ohms from each outlet to neutral; near-zero ohms pinpoints the shorted socket.
solutions.ur: Unit isolate karne ke baad multimeter continuity/ohms par har outlet ko neutral se check karein; zero ke qareeb ohms shorted socket ki taraf ishara karta hai.

solutions.en: If all outlets are clean and E21 returns, the inverter output stage has failed - send the unit to CyberPower Systems support.
solutions.ur: Agar sab outlets clean hain phir bhi E21 aaye to inverter output stage kharab hai - unit CyberPower Systems support ko bhejein.

source.title: LX1100G3/LX1325GU3/LX1500GU3 User Manual (CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 platform)

codes.seriesName: LX1100G3 / LX1325GU3 / LX1500GU3 and CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 (Intelligent LCD, line-interactive 1100-1500VA, newer FAULT list)

title.ur: E22 Overload (load UPS ki capacity se zyada)

meaning.en: Load exceeds the unit rating. Newer wording on this platform is simply 'Overload'; the manual's remedy is to unplug at least one piece of equipment from the battery outlets and turn the UPS on again.
meaning.ur: Load unit ki rating se zyada hai. Is platform par nayi wording sirf 'Overload' hai; manual ka hal yeh hai ke battery outlets se kam az kam ek equipment nikaal kar UPS dobara on karein.

causes.en: Total connected load exceeds the unit's rating (e.g. 900W on LX1500GU3 / CP1500AVRLCD3).
causes.ur: Total connected load unit ki rating se zyada hai (jaise LX1500GU3 / CP1500AVRLCD3 par 900W).

causes.en: A high inrush device tripped the overload on transfer back to mains.
causes.ur: Bade inrush wale device ne mains par wapas transfer hote waqt overload kar diya.

causes.en: A power strip feeding the load has a lower rating than the UPS output.
causes.ur: Load ko feed karne wali power strip ki rating UPS output se kam hai.

solutions.en: Follow the manual: unplug at least one piece of equipment from battery outlets and turn the UPS on again.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq: battery outlets se kam az kam ek equipment nikaal dein aur UPS dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Add the removed equipment back one at a time and total the watts; keep the sum under the unit's rated watts.
solutions.ur: Nikaali hui equipment ek-ek karke wapas lagayein aur watt total karein; total ko unit ki rated watts se kam rakhein.

solutions.en: Check the rear circuit breaker knob is fully in before restarting, and confirm no laser printer, shredder, copier, heater, vacuum or sump pump is on the battery outlets.
solutions.ur: Restart se pehle check karein ke rear circuit breaker knob poori tarah andar hai, aur battery outlets par koi laser printer, shredder, copier, heater, vacuum ya sump pump nahi hai.

solutions.en: If a heavy appliance must stay connected, move it to mains directly or reconnect it after everything else so the UPS does not switch it on alone.
solutions.ur: Agar bhaari appliance lagna hi hai to use seedha mains par lein ya sab kuch connect hone ke baad wapas lagayein taake UPS use akela on na kare.

source.title: LX1100G3/LX1325GU3/LX1500GU3 User Manual (CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 platform)

codes.seriesName: LX1100G3 / LX1325GU3 / LX1500GU3 and CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 (Intelligent LCD, line-interactive 1100-1500VA, newer FAULT list)

title.ur: REPLACE BATTERY icon (battery badalne ka waqt aa gaya hai)

meaning.en: This icon illuminates when the batteries are not connected well or the batteries were worn out - it is the manual's explicit battery-replacement trigger.
meaning.ur: Yeh icon tab jalta hai jab batteries theek se nahi lagi hon ya purani ho chuki hon - manual ka saaf battery-badalne ka signal yahi hai.

causes.en: Batteries are not connected well - loose or unplugged quick-connect.
causes.ur: Batteries theek se nahi lagi - quick-connect dheela ya nikaala hua.

causes.en: Batteries are worn out after repeated deep discharge cycles.
causes.ur: Baar baar deep discharge ke baad batteries purani ho chuki hain.

causes.en: Battery terminals are corroded, adding resistance and misleading the battery test.
causes.ur: Battery terminals zang lagay hain, jis se resistance barh kar battery test galat signal deta hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, unplug mains, then reseat the internal battery quick-connect firmly until it clicks.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains nikaal dein, phir internal battery quick-connect ko click hone tak mazbooti se baithayein.

solutions.en: Clean battery terminals with a stiff brush and a baking-soda-and-water solution, dry them fully, then reconnect.
solutions.ur: Battery terminals ko sakht brush aur baking soda + pani ke solution se saaf karein, poori tarah khushk karein, phir wapas lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure the pack on DC volts and run a timed battery test; replace the pack when rested voltage is well below spec or runtime will not meet the load.
solutions.ur: Pack DC volt par measure karein aur timed battery test chalayein; aaram wali voltage spec se kaafi neeche ho ya runtime load ke liye na mile to pack badal dein.

source.title: LX1100G3/LX1325GU3/LX1500GU3 User Manual (CP1350/1500AVRLCD3 platform)

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 01 Over Charge - battery ka voltage bohat upar chala gaya

meaning.en: Warning-level event: the battery has been charged to too high a voltage. Manual cause is simply 'Battery is overcharged'.
meaning.ur: Warning level event: battery bohat high voltage tak charge ho gaya hai. Manual ki wajah sirf 'Battery is overcharged' hai.

causes.en: Battery is overcharged (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: Battery overcharged hai (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: Charger voltage sense fault is not cutting the charge, or ambient heat has driven the cell voltage up.
causes.ur: Charger voltage sense ki khami charge band nahi kar rahi, ya mauhal ki garmi ne cell voltage barha diya hai.

solutions.en: Apply the manual's remedy: remove the battery connector and check charger voltage.
solutions.ur: Manual ka hal lagayein: battery connector nikaal dein aur charger voltage check karein.

solutions.en: First switch off and unplug the UPS, then disconnect the battery, then measure charger output on DC volts (expect about 13.5-14V per 12V cell).
solutions.ur: Pehle UPS off karke mains nikaal dein, phir battery disconnect karein, phir charger output DC volt par measure karein (har 12V cell ke liye 13.5-14V expect karein).

solutions.en: Measure each cell on DC volts; above about 13.8V at rest means the battery must be replaced, not just recharged.
solutions.ur: Har cell DC volt par measure karein; aaram ke waqt 13.8V se upar ho to battery badalni hai, sirf recharge nahi.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 02 Charger Failure - battery charger kharab ho gaya

meaning.en: Red FAULT event: the battery charger has malfunctioned. Manual remedy is CyberPower assistance.
meaning.ur: Red FAULT event: battery charger kharab ho gaya hai. Manual ka hal CyberPower se madad hai.

causes.en: Charger has failed (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: Charger kharab ho gaya hai (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: Charger IC, MOSFET or current-sense resistor has failed open or shorted.
causes.ur: Charger IC, MOSFET ya current-sense resistor open ya short ho kar kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Shut the UPS down and turn off the input breaker before any inspection.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi check karne se pehle UPS band karein aur input breaker off kar dein.

solutions.en: With mains and battery isolated, measure the pack on DC volts; near 0V means the pack is dead and must be replaced regardless of the charger.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karne ke baad pack DC volt par measure karein; 0V ke qareeb ho to pack dead hai aur charger ki bajaye battery badalni hai.

solutions.en: Measure charger output at the battery terminals with mains live; 13.5-14V is healthy and near 0V confirms the charger has failed.
solutions.ur: Mains live karte hue battery terminals par charger output measure karein; 13.5-14V healthy hai aur 0V ke qareeb charger kharab confirm hota hai.

solutions.en: Contact CyberPower for assistance as the manual directs - there is no field-replaceable charger assembly.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai CyberPower se assistance lein - charger assembly ka koi field-replaceable part nahi hai.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 04 Battery Low - battery low level tak discharge ho gaya

meaning.en: Warning event: the battery has discharged to a low level and the UPS is about to shut down. Auto-restarts when acceptable power returns.
meaning.ur: Warning event: battery low level tak discharge ho gaya hai aur UPS band hone wala hai. Mains wapas aane par auto-restart ho jata hai.

causes.en: UPS is on battery power and the set battery-capacity or remaining-runtime threshold is reached.
causes.ur: UPS battery power par hai aur set battery capacity ya remaining runtime threshold par aa gaya hai.

causes.en: Battery voltage has become extremely low, so the UPS will shut down soon.
causes.ur: Battery voltage bohat kam ho gaya hai, is liye UPS jald band ho jayega.

solutions.en: Save your data and perform a controlled shutdown immediately, as the manual states.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai, apna data save karein aur foran controlled shutdown karein.

solutions.en: Allow the UPS to auto-restart when acceptable utility power returns; do not force repeated restarts on a flat battery.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par UPS ko auto-restart hone dein; flat battery par baar baar restart na karein.

solutions.en: If 04 appears on every outage even after the manual's 3-monthly recharge habit, measure the pack on DC volts and replace it.
solutions.ur: Agar 3 mahine ka recharge routine ke baad bhi har outage par 04 aaye to pack DC volt par measure karein aur badal dein.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 05 Battery Failure - Battery Test mein battery kharab nikla

meaning.en: Red FAULT event: the UPS detected a battery failure during the Battery Test.
meaning.ur: Red FAULT event: Battery Test ke dauran UPS ne battery failure detect kiya.

causes.en: UPS has failed in the Battery Test (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: Battery Test mein UPS fail ho gaya (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: Battery connector is loose or the battery fuse has blown.
causes.ur: Battery connector dheela hai ya battery fuse ula hua hai.

solutions.en: Check the battery connector and the battery fuse, which is the manual's stated remedy.
solutions.ur: Manual ka tay shuda hal follow karein: battery connector aur battery fuse check karein.

solutions.en: Power down, unplug mains and disconnect the battery before touching the connector, then reseat it firmly and confirm the fuse rating with a meter.
solutions.ur: Connector chhoone se pehle power down karein, mains nikaal dein aur battery disconnect karein, phir use mazbooti se baithayein aur fuse ki rating multimeter se confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure the pack on DC volts; a rested healthy 12V cell reads 12.4-13.0V and near 0V means replace the pack, not the fuse.
solutions.ur: Pack DC volt par measure karein; aaram wali healthy 12V cell 12.4-13.0V par hoti hai aur 0V ke qareeb ho to fuse nahi, pack badalna hai.

solutions.en: Contact technical support to replace the battery, per the manual.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq battery badlne ke liye technical support se rabta karein.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 06 BAT Disconnected - battery se judai nahi lagi

meaning.en: Red FAULT event: the UPS cannot detect any battery - the battery pack is missing or not connected.
meaning.ur: Red FAULT event: UPS ko koi battery detect nahi ho rahi - battery pack mojood nahi ya connect nahi hai.

causes.en: Missing battery power (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: Battery power mojood nahi (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: Battery quick-connect pulled out during a move, or a battery terminal clamp has come loose.
causes.ur: Hat karte waqt battery quick-connect nikal gaya, ya kisi battery ka terminal clamp dheela ho gaya.

solutions.en: Check the battery connector and the battery fuse, the manual's stated remedy.
solutions.ur: Manual ka tay shuda hal: battery connector aur battery fuse check karein.

solutions.en: Switch off and unplug mains first, then reseat the internal battery quick-connect firmly until it clicks, following the manual's battery maintenance safety steps.
solutions.ur: Pehle off karke mains nikaal dein, phir manual ki battery maintenance safety steps ke mutabiq internal battery quick-connect ko click hone tak mazbooti se baithayein.

solutions.en: Inspect the connector and cable for corrosion, green/white residue or heat damage and clean or replace as needed.
solutions.ur: Connector aur cable ko zang, safed/hara residue ya garmi ke nishan ke liye dekhein aur saaf karein ya badal dein.

solutions.en: After reconnecting, run a Battery Test from the LCD to confirm the pack is seen before leaving the site.
solutions.ur: Wapas connect karne ke baad site chhorne se pehle LCD se Battery Test chalayein taake pack detect ho jaye.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 07 Service Battery - battery ki 3 saal ki service date poori

meaning.en: The Battery Replacement Date has reached the recommended 3-year maintenance period. A calendar warning, not an electrical failure.
meaning.ur: Battery Replacement Date recommended 3 saal ki maintenance period tak pohnch gaya hai. Yeh calendar warning hai, electrical failure nahi.

causes.en: The recommended 3-year battery maintenance period has elapsed (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: Recommended 3 saal ki battery maintenance period guzar chuki hai (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: The replacement date was never reset after a previous battery change.
causes.ur: Pehle battery badalne ke baad replacement date reset nahi ki gayi thi.

solutions.en: If batteries have been recently replaced, reset the Battery Replacement Date using PowerPanel Business Edition Agent software, the RMCARD interface, or the LCD control panel, as the manual directs.
solutions.ur: Agar batteries haal hi mein badli hain to manual ke mutabiq PowerPanel Business Edition Agent software, RMCARD interface ya LCD control panel se Battery Replacement Date reset karein.

solutions.en: If the batteries were NOT replaced, measure the pack on DC volts and on a timed runtime test before buying a new pack.
solutions.ur: Agar batteries badli NAHI hain to nayi pack kharidne se pehle pack DC volt par aur timed runtime test par check karein.

solutions.en: On the OLS series the manual requires a runtime calibration after battery replacement to verify capacity is sufficient - do this before sign-off.
solutions.ur: OLS series par manual battery replacement ke baad runtime calibration kaatam farma karta hai - sign-off se pehle yeh zaroor karein.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 12 Load Over Set% - load aap ke set kiya limit se upar

meaning.en: The UPS has detected that output watt or VA exceeded the user-set parameter in PowerPanel Business software.
meaning.ur: UPS ne detect kiya ke output watt ya VA PowerPanel Business software mein user ke set kiya parameter se upar chala gaya hai.

causes.en: Your equipment requires more power than the level set in PowerPanel Business will allow (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: Aapka equipment us level se zyada power maang raha hai jo PowerPanel Business mein set kiya gaya hai (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: A large inrush device was added without raising the configured ceiling.
causes.ur: Bade inrush wala device add kiya gaya aur configured ceiling barhayi nahi gayi.

solutions.en: Shut off the non-essential equipment, which is the manual's first remedy.
solutions.ur: Manual ka pehla hal: non-essential equipment band kar dein.

solutions.en: Or increase the level in the Power Management Software, as the manual's second remedy.
solutions.ur: Ya Power Management Software mein level barha dein, jaise manual ka doosra hal kehta hai.

solutions.en: Verify actual draw on a power meter and total it against the unit's rated VA/watts so you are not hiding a genuine overload.
solutions.ur: Power meter se actual draw verify karein aur unit ki rated VA/watts se total karke dekhein taake asli overload chhupi na rahe.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 21 Output short - output mein short circuit

meaning.en: Red FAULT event: the UPS has detected an output short circuit.
meaning.ur: Red FAULT event: UPS ne output short circuit detect kiya hai.

causes.en: Output short circuit (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: Output short circuit (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: Your attached equipment may have problems - a failed PSU, motor or a crushed power lead.
causes.ur: Aap ka laga equipment kharab ho sakta hai - kharab PSU, motor ya daba hua power lead.

solutions.en: Remove the attached equipment and check again, which is the manual's stated remedy.
solutions.ur: Manual ka tay shuda hal: attached equipment nikaal kar dobara check karein.

solutions.en: For safe isolation, shut down the UPS, turn off the input breaker and disconnect the battery before examining any cable.
solutions.ur: Safe isolation ke liye UPS band karein, input breaker off karein aur koi bhi cable dekhne se pehle battery disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Use a multimeter on continuity/ohms from each output socket to neutral; near-zero ohms identifies the shorted socket or device.
solutions.ur: Multimeter continuity/ohms par har output socket ko neutral se check karein; zero ke qareeb ohms shorted socket ya device ki taraf ishara karta hai.

solutions.en: Reconnect devices one at a time; the one that restores code 21 is the short - leave it disconnected and have it repaired.
solutions.ur: Devices ek-ek karke wapas lagayein; jis se code 21 wapas aaye wohi short hai - use disconnect chhor dein aur repair karwayein.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 22 Output Overload - load UPS se zyada power le raha hai

meaning.en: The UPS has detected output watt or VA too high. On the OLS series this transfers to bypass in Line Mode and shuts down in Battery Mode.
meaning.ur: UPS ne detect kiya ke output watt ya VA bohat zyada hai. OLS series par Line Mode mein bypass ho jata hai aur Battery Mode mein band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Your equipment requires more power than the UPS can provide (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: Aapka equipment UPS ke mufid se zyada power maang raha hai (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: Inrush from a compressor, laser printer or motor when the UPS transfers.
causes.ur: UPS transfer hote waqt compressor, laser printer ya motor ka inrush.

solutions.en: Shut off non-essential equipment; if that solves it the UPS returns to normal operation, exactly as the manual states.
solutions.ur: Non-essential equipment band karein; agar is se hal ho jaye to UPS normal operation par wapas aa jata hai - jaise manual kehta hai.

solutions.en: On Line Mode remember the manual's thresholds: 105-110% warning only, 110-120% transfers to bypass after 60s, above 120% transfers to bypass immediately.
solutions.ur: Line Mode mein manual ke thresholds yaad rakhein: 105-110% sirf warning, 110-120% 60 second baad bypass, 120% se upar foran bypass.

solutions.en: On Battery Mode: 110-120% shuts down after 10s and above 120% shuts down immediately - so measure real load and cut it before that point.
solutions.ur: Battery Mode mein: 110-120% 10 second baad shutdown aur 120% se upar foran shutdown - is liye asli load measure karke us se pehle hata dein.

solutions.en: On Battery Mode wait for the auto-restart after correcting the load, rather than forcing repeated restarts.
solutions.ur: Battery Mode mein load theek karne ke baad auto-restart ka intezaar karein, baar baar restart na karein.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 25 EPO OFF - EPO se unit band ho gayi

meaning.en: The UPS has been turned off by the Emergency Power Off input. Check the EPO wiring rather than the UPS.
meaning.ur: UPS ko Emergency Power Off input se band kiya gaya hai. UPS ke bajaye EPO wiring check karein.

causes.en: Missing the EPO connection (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: EPO connection mojood nahi (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: EPO circuit is open, or the EPO switch/button was pressed or wired backwards.
causes.ur: EPO circuit open hai, ya EPO switch/button daba diya gaya hai ya ulat wiring ho gayi hai.

solutions.en: Check the EPO connection, which is the manual's stated remedy.
solutions.ur: Manual ka tay shuda hal: EPO connection check karein.

solutions.en: With the UPS off and mains disconnected, measure continuity across the EPO terminals; the circuit should read closed, and re-seat any loose terminal screw.
solutions.ur: UPS off karke mains nikalne ke baad EPO terminals par continuity measure karein; circuit closed aana chahiye, aur dheela terminal screw mazbooti se karein.

solutions.en: Verify the EPO polarity and switch type against the manual diagram before energising, so a normally-closed loop is not left open.
solutions.ur: Energise karne se pehle manual diagram ke mutabiq EPO polarity aur switch type verify karein taake normally-closed loop khula na rahe.

solutions.en: Once the loop is closed, run a controlled power-up to confirm code 25 clears and no other event appears.
solutions.ur: Loop band hone ke baad controlled power-up karein taake confirm ho ke code 25 clear ho gaya aur koi aur event nahi aaya.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 27 ROO OFF - ROO se unit band ho gayi

meaning.en: The UPS has been turned off by ROO (reboot/remote output off). Check the ROO wiring, not the UPS internals.
meaning.ur: UPS ko ROO (reboot/remote output off) se band kiya gaya hai. UPS ke andar ke bajaye ROO wiring check karein.

causes.en: Missing the ROO connection (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: ROO connection mojood nahi (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: ROO circuit is open, or a downstream device is holding the ROO line off.
causes.ur: ROO circuit open hai, ya koi downstream device ROO line ko off rakhta hai.

solutions.en: Check the ROO connection, which is the manual's stated remedy.
solutions.ur: Manual ka tay shuda hal: ROO connection check karein.

solutions.en: With power off, measure continuity across the ROO terminals and inspect the connector for a bent or loose pin.
solutions.ur: Power off kar ke ROO terminals par continuity measure karein aur connector mein teda ya dheela pin dekhein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the ROO load one device at a time to find which branch is holding the line open.
solutions.ur: ROO load ko ek-ek karke nikaalte jayein taake pata chale kaun si branch line ko khula rakh rahi hai.

solutions.en: Re-check ROO after reconnection and confirm the UPS powers up without code 27 recurring.
solutions.ur: Wapas connect karne ke baad ROO dobara check karein aur confirm karein ke UPS bina code 27 ke power up hota hai.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 30 Inverter Fault - inverter kharab ho gaya

meaning.en: The inverter has malfunctioned.
meaning.ur: Inverter kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Stated by the manual as inverter malfunction.
causes.ur: Manual ke mutabiq inverter malfunction.

causes.en: The manual also attributes inverter voltage detection to the inverter itself (codes 31 High Output Voltage / 32 Low Output Voltage are described as 'The UPS has detected Inverter voltage too High/Low'), so a failed inverter voltage-sensing stage is the natural companion failure.
causes.ur: Manual inverter voltage detection ko khud inverter ko hi maanta hai (code 31 High Output Voltage / 32 Low Output Voltage ka description hai 'The UPS has detected Inverter voltage too High/Low'), is liye inverter voltage-sensing stage ki khami yehi companion failure hai.

solutions.en: Shut the UPS down and turn off the input breaker before any inspection (the manual's isolation practice for all internal events).
solutions.ur: Koi bhi check karne se pehle UPS band karein aur input breaker off karein (manual ka tamam internal events ke liye isolation tareeqa).

solutions.en: Measure battery DC voltage and output AC voltage on a meter; out-of-spec readings confirm the inverter stage rather than the battery.
solutions.ur: Battery DC voltage aur output AC voltage multimeter par measure karein; out-of-spec readings battery nahi balki inverter stage confirm karte hain.

notes.en: LIMITATION: the CyberPower OLS manual lists code 30 in the EVENT CODE LIST with only the one-line description 'The inverter has malfunctioned' and does NOT give a cause/solution row for it in the TROUBLESHOOTING table. The causes and solutions above are therefore only the manual's stated malfunction plus its own isolation practice, not a code-specific procedure. Treat as a starting point and confirm with CyberPower.
notes.ur: LIMIT: CyberPower OLS manual code 30 ko EVENT CODE LIST mein sirf aik line ke description 'The inverter has malfunctioned' ke saath likhta hai aur is code ke liye TROUBLESHOOTING table mein cause/solution row NAHI deta. Is liye upar ki wajah aur hal sirf manual ka bataya malfunction aur us ka isolation tareeqa hain, code-specific tareeqa nahi. Ise starting point samajhein aur CyberPower se tasdeeq karein.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 31 High Output Voltage - output voltage bohat zyada

meaning.en: Red FAULT event: output voltage is too high.
meaning.ur: Red FAULT event: output voltage bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Output voltage is too high (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: Output voltage bohat zyada hai (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: Inverter feedback has drifted, or a wrong output-voltage setting was selected for the connected equipment.
causes.ur: Inverter feedback bigad gaya hai, ya connected equipment ke liye galat output voltage setting chuni gayi hai.

solutions.en: Shut down the UPS and turn off the input breaker, then contact CyberPower for assistance - this is the manual's exact remedy for 31 and 32.
solutions.ur: UPS band karein aur input breaker off karein, phir CyberPower se assistance lein - 31 aur 32 ke liye yehi manual ka exact hal hai.

solutions.en: Before touching the unit, confirm the selected output voltage (208/220/230/240Vac) matches the connected load, and fix any wrong setting in the LCD configuration.
solutions.ur: Unit chhoone se pehle confirm karein ke chui hua output voltage (208/220/230/240Vac) connected load se match karta hai, aur LCD configuration mein koi galat setting theek karein.

solutions.en: With mains and battery isolated, measure battery DC voltage; an over-charged pack can drive the inverter output high.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate kar ke battery DC voltage measure karein; zyada charge hui pack inverter output ko upar le sakti hai.

solutions.en: Do not run the unit with output voltage this high - connected equipment can be damaged; leave the UPS off until resolved.
solutions.ur: Itni high output voltage par unit na chalayein - connected equipment kharab ho sakta hai; hal hone tak UPS band chhor dein.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 32 Low Output Voltage - output voltage bohat kam

meaning.en: Red FAULT event: output voltage is too low.
meaning.ur: Red FAULT event: output voltage bohat kam hai.

causes.en: Output voltage is too low (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: Output voltage bohat kam hai (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: Battery pack is exhausted or has a failed cell, so the inverter cannot hold the output up.
causes.ur: Battery pack khatam ho chuki hai ya us mein ek cell kharab hai, is liye inverter output upar nahi rakh sakta.

solutions.en: Shut down the UPS and turn off the input breaker, then contact CyberPower for assistance - the manual's exact remedy.
solutions.ur: UPS band karein aur input breaker off karein, phir CyberPower se assistance lein - manual ka exact hal yahi hai.

solutions.en: With power isolated, measure the battery pack on DC volts; a rested healthy 12V cell reads 12.4-13.0V and a dead cell reads far lower or near zero.
solutions.ur: Power isolate kar ke battery pack DC volt par measure karein; aaram wali healthy 12V cell 12.4-13.0V par hoti hai aur kharab cell bohat kam ya zero ke qareeb hoti hai.

solutions.en: Check the load is not simply beyond capacity; OLS output overload in Line Mode is a separate event (22) that can look similar from the load side.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke load asal mein capacity se upar to nahi; OLS line mode output overload alag event (22) hai jo load side se milti julti lag sakti hai.

solutions.en: Do not reconnect the load to a unit whose output is sagging - the connected equipment may restart repeatedly and corrupt data.
solutions.ur: Jis unit ka output gir raha ho us par load dobara na lagayein - connected equipment baar baar restart ho kar data kharab kar sakta hai.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 33 Over Temperature - unit bahut garam ho gaya

meaning.en: Warning event: the high-temperature sensor has activated protection because internal temperature is too high.
meaning.ur: Warning event: high temperature sensor ne protection activate kar di kyunke andar temperature bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: High temperature sensor activates protection (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: High temperature sensor protection activate karta hai (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: The fan has failed, or the ventilation hole has been covered / airflow is blocked.
causes.ur: Fan kharab ho gaya hai, ya ventilation hole band ho gayi hai ya airflow ruka hua hai.

causes.en: Ambient room temperature is too high for the unit's specified 0-40C operating range.
causes.ur: Mauhal ka temperature unit ki 0-40C operating range se zyada hai.

solutions.en: Check the fan for operation and whether the ventilation hole has been covered, which is the manual's stated remedy.
solutions.ur: Manual ka tay shuda hal: fan chalta hai ya nahi dekhein, aur ventilation hole band to nahi hai.

solutions.en: After isolating mains and battery, spin the fan by hand and confirm it turns freely; if it is seized or noisy, replace the fan.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karne ke baad fan ko haath se ghumayein aur dekhein ke azaad ghoomta hai; agar ghisat ya shor wala hai to fan badal dein.

solutions.en: Clear at least the manufacturer's clearance around the unit and relocate it out of direct sunlight or a hot enclosure.
solutions.ur: Unit ke gird manufacturer ki clearance saaf karein aur use dhoop ya garam enclosure se bahar shift karein.

solutions.en: Let the unit cool fully before restart, then re-read temperature with a meter; repeated code 33 with a working fan means a sensor fault - contact support.
solutions.ur: Restart se pehle unit ko poora thanda hone dein, phir temperature multimeter se dobara dekhein; chal raha fan hone ke bawajood baar baar code 33 ka matlab sensor fault hai - support se rabta karein.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 34 Fan Error - main fan chal nahi raha

meaning.en: Red FAULT event: the internal fan has failed. The manual separates this from the rear/middle/front fan events (35/36/37).
meaning.ur: Red FAULT event: internal fan kharab ho gaya hai. Manual ise rear/middle/front fan events (35/36/37) se alag rakhta hai.

causes.en: Internal fan has failed (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: Internal fan kharab ho gaya hai (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: Fan blades are jammed by dust, or the fan motor has burnt out or seized.
causes.ur: Fan blades ghis se jam ho gayi hain, ya fan motor jal kar kharab ya atak gaya hai.

solutions.en: Perform a Fan Test and check the alarm, as the manual directs.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai, Fan Test karein aur alarm dekhein.

solutions.en: If the alarm continues, shut down the UPS and turn off the input breaker before touching the fan.
solutions.ur: Agar alarm jari rahe to fan chhoone se pehle UPS band karein aur input breaker off karein.

solutions.en: Isolate the battery, vacuum dust off the fan hub and blades, and check the fan spins freely on DC power from a bench supply.
solutions.ur: Battery disconnect karein, fan hub aur blades par gis ki saaf karein, aur DC bench supply par fan ki azaad ghoomti hai ya nahi dekhein.

solutions.en: If the alarm still continues, contact CyberPower for assistance - the fan is an internal assembly, not a field-plug part.
solutions.ur: Agar alarm ab bhi jari rahe to CyberPower se assistance lein - fan internal assembly hai, field-plug part nahi.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.seriesName: OLS1000EA / OLS1500EA / OLS2000EA / OLS3000EA (online double-conversion 1000-3000VA, pure sine wave)

title.ur: 35 Rear Fan Error - peeche wala fan kharab

meaning.en: The UPS has detected a rear fan malfunction.
meaning.ur: UPS ne rear fan ki khami detect ki hai.

causes.en: Stated by the manual as a detected rear fan malfunction.
causes.ur: Manual ke mutabiq rear fan ki khami detect hui.

causes.en: The manual lists 34 Fan Error separately with the same 'The UPS has detected a fan malfunction' wording, so one shared fan-supply or fan-sense fault can trip both.

title.ur: 40 Bus Fault - DC bus voltage bohat upar ya neeche

meaning.en: Red FAULT event: the internal DC bus voltage is too high or too low.
meaning.ur: Red FAULT event: internal DC bus voltage bohat zyada ya bohat kam hai.

causes.en: Internal DC bus voltage is too high or too low (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: Internal DC bus voltage bohat zyada ya bohat kam hai (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: Battery pack disconnected (06) or failed, leaving the bus unsupported.
causes.ur: Battery pack disconnect (06) ya kharab, is liye bus support ke bina reh gaya hai.

causes.en: Inverter switching stage or the bus sensing circuit has failed.
causes.ur: Inverter switching stage ya bus sensing circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Shut down the UPS and turn off the input breaker, then contact CyberPower for assistance - the manual's remedy for code 40.
solutions.ur: UPS band karein aur input breaker off karein, phir CyberPower se assistance lein - code 40 ke liye yehi manual ka hal hai.

solutions.en: With mains and battery isolated, verify the battery pack is present and measure it on DC volts before assuming the bus itself is at fault.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate kar ke confirm karein ke battery pack mojood hai aur use DC volt par measure karein, is se pehle bus ko hi fault na samajhein.

solutions.en: Confirm no battery branch fuse is blown and the battery quick-connects are fully seated, since a missing bank presents as a bus fault.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke battery branch fuse ula to nahi hai aur battery quick-connects poori tarah baithay hain, kyunke missing bank bus fault ki shakal mein aata hai.

solutions.en: Do not power the unit repeatedly with a bus fault present - repeated attempts can damage the inverter stage.
solutions.ur: Bus fault ke saath unit baar baar power na karein - baar baar koshish inverter stage kharab kar sakti hai.

solutions.ur: Manual ke tamam internal bus events ke tareeqe ke mutabiq check se pehle UPS band karein aur input breaker off karein.

solutions.en: Isolate the battery and measure charger output; an over-driving charger is the usual way the positive bus is pushed high.
solutions.ur: Battery disconnect karein aur charger output measure karein; charger zyada voltage dena hi aam waja hai jis se positive bus upar chala jata hai.

notes.en: LIMITATION: the OLS manual lists 41 Bus Fault +High in the EVENT CODE LIST only ('The UPS has detected +DC Bus too High') and gives NO cause/solution row for it in the TROUBLESHOOTING table - only the generic 40 Bus Fault has one. title.ur: 50 Input Power Fail - input ka voltage ya frequency range se bahar

meaning.en: The UPS has detected that input voltage or frequency is out of range.

causes.en: Stated by the manual as input voltage or frequency out of range.

title.ur: 54 Line Abnormal - mains aise abnormal hai ke auto-restart nahi ho raha

meaning.en: Utility power is out of range for the UPS to auto-restart, so the unit has not come back after a shutdown.
meaning.ur: Mains power UPS ke auto-restart ke liye range se bahar hai, is liye shutdown ke baad unit wapas nahi aaya.

causes.en: Utility power is out of range for the UPS to auto-restart (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: Mains power UPS ke auto-restart ke liye range se bahar hai (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

causes.en: Mains has returned but voltage is still too low/high, or frequency is still off spec.
causes.ur: Mains wapas aa chuka hai lekin voltage abhi bhi kam/zyada hai, ya frequency abhi bhi out of spec hai.

solutions.en: Check whether voltage or frequency of utility power is out of range, which is the manual's stated remedy.
solutions.ur: Manual ka tay shuda hal: check karein ke mains ka voltage ya frequency range se bahar to nahi hai.

solutions.en: Measure input voltage and frequency with a meter/clamp meter and wait until they are inside 80-300Vac and 40-70Hz.
solutions.ur: Meter/clamp meter se input voltage aur frequency measure karein aur jab tak 80-300Vac aur 40-70Hz ke andar na aaye intezaar karein.

solutions.en: If the readings are in range but the unit still will not auto-restart, perform a manual power cycle after isolating and reconnecting the battery.
solutions.ur: Agar readings range mein hain phir bhi unit auto-restart nahi karta, to battery isolate karke wapas connect kar ke manual power cycle karein.

title.ur: N/A Battery Mode (event log entry) - abhi battery power par chal raha hai

meaning.en: Event-log entry with no numeric code: the UPS is operating on battery power. Shown with a YELLOW warning icon.
meaning.ur: Bina numeric code ke event-log entry: UPS battery power par chal raha hai. YELLOW warning icon ke saath dikhta hai.

causes.en: UPS is operating on battery power (the manual's stated cause).
causes.ur: UPS battery power par chal raha hai (manual ki tay shuda wajah).

solutions.en: Save your data and perform a controlled shutdown, which is the manual's stated remedy for this event.
solutions.ur: Manual ka tay shuda hal: apna data save karein aur controlled shutdown karein.

solutions.en: Leave the unit on mains after the outage so the battery can recharge; the manual specifies recharging every three months for stored units.
solutions.ur: Outage ke baad unit mains par chhor dein taake battery recharge ho; stored units ke liye manual tein mahine mein recharge kahein kahta hai.

solutions.en: Check the event log afterwards to count how many outages occurred and how long each lasted.
solutions.ur: Baad mein event log dekhein taake pata chale kitni outages hui aur har kitni der rahi.

source.title: OLS1000EA/OLS1500EA/OLS2000EA/OLS3000EA User's Manual - EVENT CODE LIST + TROUBLESHOOTING

codes.uid: cyberpower/cyberpower-ut-eg/Red LED: ON, Flash once every 5 seconds
codes.seriesName: UT1500EG / UT1500EIG / UT2200EG / UT2200EIG (line-interactive 1500-2200VA, 230V, Green/Yellow/Red LED)
codes.code: Red LED: ON, Flash once every 5 seconds
codes.codeNorm: RED LED ON FLASH ONCE EVERY 5 SECONDS
aliases: Red LED: ON, Flash once every 5 seconds

title.en: Red LED 1 flash / 5s - Battery Output Short
title.ur: Red LED 1 blink / 5s - Battery Output Short (battery se chalte waqt output short)
