meaning.en: The UPS output is shorted while on battery. Continuous tone, and the red LED blinks once every five seconds.
meaning.ur: Battery par chalte waqt UPS output short ho gaya hai. Mukhtalif tone, aur red LED paanch second mein ek baar blink karta hai.

causes.en: A connected appliance has failed short-circuiting.
causes.ur: Koi connected appliance short ho kar kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: A multi-way power strip or extension lead has crushed or cut a live core.
causes.ur: Kisi multi-way power strip ya extension lead ka koi live core kata ya daba hua hai.

causes.en: Outlet terminals on the UPS are loose/bridged, or a cable has been pinched behind the unit.
causes.ur: UPS ke outlet terminals dheele ya bridge hue hain, ya unit ke peeche koi cable pinch ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: As the manual directs, turn off the UPS and unplug at least one piece of equipment.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai, UPS off karein aur kam az kam ek equipment nikaal dein.

solutions.en: For safe inspection, unplug the mains cord as well, then confirm the overload breaker/fuse is intact and reset it.
solutions.ur: Safe check ke liye mains cord bhi nikaal dein, phir confirm karein ke overload breaker/fuse salamat hai aur use reset karein.

solutions.en: With the unit isolated, test each outlet to neutral on a multimeter in continuity/ohms; near-zero ohms pinpoints the shorted socket.
solutions.ur: Unit isolate karne ke baad multimeter continuity/ohms par har outlet ko neutral se test karein; zero ke qareeb ohms shorted socket ki taraf ishara karta hai.

solutions.en: Reconnect loads one at a time; the device that makes the LED return to 1-flash mode is the faulty short - remove and repair it.
solutions.ur: Loads ek-ek karke wapas lagayein; jis device par LED wapas 1-flash mode mein aaye wohi faulty short hai - use nikaal kar repair karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, ON then 1 flash every 5 seconds, constant tone

source.title: UT1500EG/UT1500EIG/UT2200EG/UT2200EIG User's Manual K01-C000756-01

codes.uid: cyberpower/cyberpower-ut-eg/Red LED: ON, Flash twice every 5 seconds
codes.seriesName: UT1500EG / UT1500EIG / UT2200EG / UT2200EIG (line-interactive 1500-2200VA, 230V, Green/Yellow/Red LED)
codes.code: Red LED: ON, Flash twice every 5 seconds
codes.codeNorm: RED LED ON FLASH TWICE EVERY 5 SECONDS
aliases: Red LED: ON, Flash twice every 5 seconds

title.ur: Red LED 2 blink / 5s - Overload Fault (load rating se zyada)

meaning.en: Connected equipment exceeds the rating of the unit. This is a latched overload fault, distinct from the 1-flash short fault.
meaning.ur: Connected equipment unit ki rating se zyada hai. Yeh latched overload fault hai, 1-flash short fault se alag.

causes.en: Total connected wattage/VA exceeds the 1500/2200VA rating of the unit.
causes.ur: Total connected wattage/VA unit ki 1500/2200VA rating se zyada hai.

causes.en: A high inrush device (compressor, laser printer, motor) tripped the overload.
causes.ur: Koi high inrush device (compressor, laser printer, motor) ne overload kar diya.

causes.en: The rear overload breaker has tripped and stays out until reset.
causes.ur: Peeche ka overload breaker trip ho gaya hai aur reset tak bahar hi rehta hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off and unplug at least one piece of equipment, as the manual states.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai, UPS off karein aur kam az kam ek equipment nikaal dein.

solutions.en: If an overload is detected the unit emits one long beep: wait 10 seconds, make sure the breaker/fuse is normal, then turn the UPS on.
solutions.ur: Overload detect hone par unit aik lamba beep deta hai: 10 second intezaar karein, breaker/fuse normal check karein, phir UPS on karein.

solutions.en: Total the connected load on a power meter and keep it inside the unit's rating (e.g. 900W on UT1500EG, 1320W on UT2200EG).
solutions.ur: Connected load power meter par total karein aur use unit ki rating ke andar rakhein (UT1500EG 900W, UT2200EG 1320W).

solutions.en: If the overload clears with one device removed but that device must stay, replace it with a lower-surge or staggered-start unit.
solutions.ur: Agar ek device nikalne par overload clear ho jaye lekin woh device rakhna bhi ho, to us ki jagah kam surge ya staggered-start wala unit lagayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, ON then 2 flashes every 5 seconds, constant tone

source.title: UT1500EG/UT1500EIG/UT2200EG/UT2200EIG User's Manual K01-C000756-01

codes.uid: cyberpower/cyberpower-ut-eg/Red LED: ON, Flash 3 times every 5 seconds
codes.seriesName: UT1500EG / UT1500EIG / UT2200EG / UT2200EIG (line-interactive 1500-2200VA, 230V, Green/Yellow/Red LED)
codes.code: Red LED: ON, Flash 3 times every 5 seconds
codes.codeNorm: RED LED ON FLASH 3 TIMES EVERY 5 SECONDS
aliases: Red LED: ON, Flash 3 times every 5 seconds

title.ur: Red LED 3 blink / 5s - Charger Fault (charger kharab, battery charge nahi hoti)

meaning.en: The internal battery charger has failed. Manual remedy is to contact CyberPower for support.
meaning.ur: Internal battery charger kharab ho gaya hai. Manual ke mutabiq CyberPower se support lein.

causes.en: Charger IC/MOSFET or charge-sense circuit on the main board has failed.
causes.ur: Main board par charger IC/MOSFET ya charge-sense circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Battery bank dead, deep-discharged or wrong type, pulling the charger into a fault state.
causes.ur: Battery bank dead, gehri tarah discharged ya galat type, charger ko fault state mein kheench raha hai.

causes.en: Overheating from a blocked vent or failed fan has destroyed the charger section.
causes.ur: Blocked vent ya kharab fan se overheating ne charger section tabah kar diya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate first: turn the UPS off, unplug the mains cord, and disconnect the battery quick-connects (positive and negative).
solutions.ur: Pehle isolate karein: UPS off karein, mains cord nikaal dein, aur battery quick-connects (positive aur negative) disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure each battery on DC volts; a healthy 12V cell reads 12.6-13.0V at rest, and near 0V means the pack must be replaced.
solutions.ur: Har battery DC volt par measure karein; healthy 12V cell aaram ke waqt 12.6-13.0V deta hai, aur 0V ke qareeb ho to pack badalna hai.

solutions.en: With mains reconnected, read charge voltage at the battery terminals: 13.5-14V means healthy, near 0V means the charger output has failed.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas lagane ke baad battery terminals par charge voltage dekhein: 13.5-14V healthy, 0V ke qareeb charger output kharab.

solutions.en: Contact CyberPower for support as the manual directs - there is no user-replaceable charger part.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai CyberPower se support lein - charger ka koi user-replaceable part nahi hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, ON then 3 flashes every 5 seconds, constant tone

source.title: UT1500EG/UT1500EIG/UT2200EG/UT2200EIG User's Manual K01-C000756-01

codes.uid: cyberpower/cyberpower-ut-eg/Red LED: ON, Flash 4 times every 5 seconds
codes.seriesName: UT1500EG / UT1500EIG / UT2200EG / UT2200EIG (line-interactive 1500-2200VA, 230V, Green/Yellow/Red LED)
codes.code: Red LED: ON, Flash 4 times every 5 seconds
codes.codeNorm: RED LED ON FLASH 4 TIMES EVERY 5 SECONDS
aliases: Red LED: ON, Flash 4 times every 5 seconds

title.ur: Red LED 4 blink / 5s - Hardware Fault (unit ka andar ka hissa kharab)

meaning.en: An internal hardware fault in the unit. Manual remedy is to contact CyberPower for support.
meaning.ur: Unit ke andar ka internal hardware fault. Manual ke mutabiq CyberPower se support lein.

causes.en: Failed relay, SCR or inverter MOSFET in the power path.
causes.ur: Power path mein relay, SCR ya inverter MOSFET kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Control board failure or loss of calibration.
causes.ur: Control board ki khami ya calibration kho jana.

causes.en: Cracked internal solder joint, or a component failed from internal overheating.
causes.ur: Internal solder joint crack, ya koi component internal overheating se kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Do a full isolation and discharge: off, unplug mains, disconnect the batteries, and leave the unit a few minutes.
solutions.ur: Poora isolation aur discharge karein: off, mains nikaal dein, batteries disconnect karein, aur unit ko kuch minute chhor dein.

solutions.en: Reconnect and try one clean power cycle; if the 4-flash pattern clears, record the event and watch the unit for recurrence.
solutions.ur: Wapas connect kar ke aik saaf power cycle karein; agar 4-flash pattern clear ho jaye to event note karein aur wapas aane par nazar rakhein.

solutions.en: If the 4-flash pattern returns with the battery disconnected, the fault is in the control/inverter board, not the battery or the load.
solutions.ur: Agar battery disconnect kar ke bhi 4-flash pattern aaye to fault control/inverter board mein hai, battery ya load mein nahi.

solutions.en: Contact CyberPower for support as the manual directs - this is a service-level repair only.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai CyberPower se support lein - yeh sirf service level repair hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, ON then 4 flashes every 5 seconds, constant tone

source.title: UT1500EG/UT1500EIG/UT2200EG/UT2200EIG User's Manual K01-C000756-01

codes.seriesName: UT1500EG / UT1500EIG / UT2200EG / UT2200EIG (line-interactive 1500-2200VA, 230V, Green/Yellow/Red LED)

title.ur: Red LED baari baar blink - Overload Warning (load pehle se zyada hai)

meaning.en: The load already exceeds the unit rating, so the unit is warning about overload before it becomes a latched fault. Not yet a shutdown fault.
meaning.ur: Load pehle se unit ki rating se zyada hai, is liye unit latched fault banne se pehle overload ki warning de raha hai. Abhi shutdown fault nahi.

causes.en: Connected equipment exceeds the rating of the unit but has not yet tripped the latched overload.
causes.ur: Connected equipment unit ki rating se zyada hai magar abhi latched overload trigger nahi hua.

causes.en: A device with a large inrush has just been switched on alongside the existing load.
causes.ur: Bade inrush wala device abhi mojood load ke saath on kiya gaya hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off and unplug at least one piece of equipment from the battery power supplied outlets.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein aur battery power supplied outlets se kam az kam ek equipment nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Wait 10 seconds before restarting, then confirm the circuit breaker / fuse is in its normal position.
solutions.ur: Restart se pehle 10 second intezaar karein, phir confirm karein ke circuit breaker / fuse apni normal position mein hai.

solutions.en: Verify the remaining load with a power meter and keep it under the unit's rated watts/VA.
solutions.ur: Power meter se bacha hua load verify karein aur use unit ki rated watts/VA se kam rakhein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault LED red, continuous flashing, constant tone

source.title: UT1500EG/UT1500EIG/UT2200EG/UT2200EIG User's Manual K01-C000756-01

codes.seriesName: UT1500EG / UT1500EIG / UT2200EG / UT2200EIG (line-interactive 1500-2200VA, 230V, Green/Yellow/Red LED)

title.ur: Yellow LED blink kar raha - Low Battery (battery khatam hone wali hai)

meaning.en: The UPS is on battery and the battery is about to run out. Save work now; the unit will shut down shortly.
meaning.ur: UPS battery par hai aur battery khatam hone wali hai. Abhi kaam save karein; unit jald band ho jayega.

causes.en: The mains outage has lasted long enough to drain the battery bank.
causes.ur: Mains outage itni der raha ke battery bank khaali ho gaya.

causes.en: The battery bank is worn out and no longer holds a usable charge.
causes.ur: Battery bank purani ho chuki hai aur ab usable charge nahi rakhti.

solutions.en: Shut down connected equipment immediately to preserve the remaining charge for the load.
solutions.ur: Baaki charge load ke liye bacha kar rakhne ke liye connected equipment foran band karein.

solutions.en: After mains returns, leave the UPS plugged in for at least 4 hours (the manual's guidance for a discharged battery) and prefer a full 8-hour recharge.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane ke baad UPS ko kam az kam 4 ghante plug mein rakhein (discharged battery ke liye manual ka hidayat) aur behtar 8 ghante poori recharge karein.

solutions.en: If low battery comes back after a full recharge on every outage, measure the pack on DC volts and plan a battery replacement.
solutions.ur: Agar har outage par poori recharge ke baad bhi low battery aaye to pack DC volt par measure karein aur battery badalne ka mansooba banayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow battery LED flashing, rapid beeping

source.title: UT1500EG/UT1500EIG/UT2200EG/UT2200EIG User's Manual K01-C000756-01

codes.seriesName: UT1500EG / UT1500EIG / UT2200EG / UT2200EIG (line-interactive 1500-2200VA, 230V, Green/Yellow/Red LED)

title.en: Green LED steady on - ECO Mode (normal)
title.ur: Green LED steady on - ECO Mode (mains normal, sab theek)

meaning.en: Utility is normal and the UPS is in energy-saving bypass mode. This is the healthy idle state.
meaning.ur: Mains normal hai aur UPS energy-saving bypass mode mein hai. Yeh healthy idle state hai.

causes.en: Utility supply is within range and the load is below the energy-saving threshold.
causes.ur: Mains range ke andar hai aur load energy-saving threshold se kam hai.

solutions.en: No action needed; this mode reduces standby power and helps battery life.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaruri nahi; yeh mode standby power kam karta hai aur battery ki umar barhata hai.

solutions.en: If you need assured backup, raise the load above the ECO threshold or change the mode as described in the unit's setup instructions.
solutions.ur: Agar pakka backup chahiye to load ko ECO threshold se upar lein ya unit ke setup instructions ke mutabiq mode badal dein.

codes.blinkPattern: Green utility LED steady on, no alarm

source.title: UT1500EG/UT1500EIG/UT2200EG/UT2200EIG User's Manual K01-C000756-01

codes.seriesName: UT1500EG / UT1500EIG / UT2200EG / UT2200EIG (line-interactive 1500-2200VA, 230V, Green/Yellow/Red LED)

title.ur: Green LED dheere dheere blink - Charging (battery charge ho rahi hai)

meaning.en: Utility is normal and the UPS is charging the battery. Normal, not a fault.
meaning.ur: Mains normal hai aur UPS battery charge kar raha hai. Normal hai, fault nahi.

causes.en: The battery is recharging after a discharge, or the pack has just been replaced.
causes.ur: Battery discharge ke baad recharge ho rahi hai, ya pack abhi abhi badli gayi hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature is low, which slows the charge rate.
causes.ur: Mauhal ka temperature kam hai, jis se charge rate slow ho jata hai.

solutions.en: No action needed - keep the unit plugged in; the manual specifies about 8 hours typical recharge.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaruri nahi - unit plug mein rakhein; manual ke mutabiq aam tor par 8 ghante recharge hota hai.

solutions.en: If the LED never stops slow-flashing after 10+ hours, measure the charger output at the battery terminals on DC volts (expect 13.5-14V).
solutions.ur: Agar 10+ ghante baad bhi LED slow-flash karta rahe to charger output battery terminals par DC volt par measure karein (13.5-14V expect karein).

codes.blinkPattern: Green utility LED slow-flashing, no alarm

source.title: UT1500EG/UT1500EIG/UT2200EG/UT2200EIG User's Manual K01-C000756-01

codes.seriesName: UT1500EG / UT1500EIG / UT2200EG / UT2200EIG (line-interactive 1500-2200VA, 230V, Green/Yellow/Red LED)
codes.codeNorm: BLOWN FUSE / TRIPPED BREAKER TROUBLESHOOTING ROW
aliases: Outlets do not provide power to equipment

title.en: No output at outlets - fuse blown or breaker tripped
title.ur: Outlets par output nahi - fuse ula ya breaker trip

meaning.en: The outlets supply nothing because the overload protection fuse has blown or the circuit-breaker knob has tripped.
meaning.ur: Outlets kuch nahi de rahe kyunke overload protection fuse ula hua hai ya circuit-breaker knob trip ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Fuse is blown or the breaker has tripped due to an overload.
causes.ur: Fuse ula hua hai ya overload ki wajah se breaker trip hua hai.

causes.en: Batteries are discharged so the UPS has nothing to pass on in battery mode.
causes.ur: Batteries discharged hain is liye battery mode mein UPS ke paas dene ko kuch nahi hai.

causes.en: The unit has been damaged by a surge or spike.
causes.ur: Surge ya spike se unit kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off and unplug at least one piece of connected equipment, then unplug the UPS power cord.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein aur kam az kam ek connected equipment nikaal dein, phir UPS ka power cord nikaal dein.

solutions.en: With the cord out, replace the blown fuse with a spare overload one of the same specification, or press the circuit breaker knob.
solutions.ur: Cord nikaal kar, ula hua fuse usi specification ke spare overload fuse se badal dein, ya circuit breaker knob daba dein.

solutions.en: Reconnect the power cord, turn the UPS on, and make sure the spare fuse meets the specified rating.
solutions.ur: Power cord wapas lagayein, UPS on karein, aur confirm karein ke spare fuse specified rating ke mutabiq hai.

solutions.en: If the batteries are simply discharged, allow the unit to recharge for at least 4 hours before expecting output; if a surge damaged the unit, contact CyberPower technical support.
solutions.ur: Agar batteries sirf discharged hain to output ki umeed karne se pehle unit ko kam az kam 4 ghante recharge dein; agar surge se unit kharab hua hai to CyberPower technical support se rabta karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Green LED steady (or off) with no output at any outlet

source.title: UT1500EG/UT1500EIG/UT2200EG/UT2200EIG User's Manual K01-C000756-01

codes.seriesName: VP700E(I)LCD / VP1000E(I)LCD / VP1200E(I)LCD / VP1600E(I)LCD (line-interactive 700-1600VA, 230V)

title.ur: E01 Charger fault (Over Charge) - charger battery ko zyada charge kar raha

meaning.en: The setup menu's 'Last Fault Reason' page reports that the last fault was a charger overcharge. Same meaning as the E01 on the CP series.
meaning.ur: Setup menu ka 'Last Fault Reason' page batata hai ke aakhri fault charger overcharge tha. Matlab CP series ke E01 ke barabar hi hai.

causes.en: Charger over-voltage sensing has failed and is not cutting the charge.
causes.ur: Charger over-voltage sensing kharab ho gayi hai aur charge band nahi kar rahi.

causes.en: The battery bank is aged, overheated or swollen, dragging the charger into overcharge.
causes.ur: Battery bank purani, garmi se kharab ya phooli hui hai, charger ko overcharge mein kheench rahi hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug mains and disconnect the internal battery quick-connect before opening the case.
solutions.ur: Case kholne se pehle UPS off karein, mains nikaal dein aur internal battery quick-connect disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure each battery on DC volts; a healthy 12V cell reads 12.6-13.0V and should stay under about 13.8V.
solutions.ur: Har battery DC volt par measure karein; healthy 12V cell 12.6-13.0V par hota hai aur 13.8V se kam rehna chahiye.

solutions.en: Replace the whole battery pack with the specified battery, keeping cells matched in series.
solutions.ur: Poori battery pack ko spec wali battery se badal dein, series mein cells jor ke rakhein.

solutions.en: Read 'Last Fault Reason' again after the fix to confirm the code has cleared, since this page is the only place the unit shows it.
solutions.ur: Islih ke baad dobara 'Last Fault Reason' dekhein taake confirm ho ke code clear ho gaya, kyunke yeh page hi aakhri jagah hai jahan unit yeh dikhata hai.

source.title: VP700/1000/1200/1600E(I)LCD User's Manual - Function Setup Guide, Last Fault Reason

codes.seriesName: VP700E(I)LCD / VP1000E(I)LCD / VP1200E(I)LCD / VP1600E(I)LCD (line-interactive 700-1600VA, 230V)

title.ur: E02 Charger fault (No Charge) - charger charge hi nahi kar raha

meaning.en: The setup menu's 'Last Fault Reason' page reports that the last fault was a charger no-charge condition - the charger is not charging the battery.
meaning.ur: Setup menu ka 'Last Fault Reason' page batata hai ke aakhri fault charger no-charge tha - charger battery charge nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Internal battery connector is unplugged or the terminal is loose/corroded.
causes.ur: Internal battery connector nikaala hua hai ya terminal dheela/zanga hai.

causes.en: Battery pack is dead or one cell in the series string has failed open.
causes.ur: Battery pack dead hai ya series string mein koi cell open ho kar kharab hai.

causes.en: Battery branch fuse or the charger MOSFET section has failed.
causes.ur: Battery branch fuse ya charger MOSFET section kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate first: off, unplug mains, disconnect the internal battery quick-connect.
solutions.ur: Pehle isolate karein: off, mains nikaal dein, internal battery quick-connect disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Check battery DC voltage; a rested healthy 12V battery reads 12.4-12.7V and near 0V means it must be replaced.
solutions.ur: Battery DC voltage check karein; aaram wali healthy 12V battery 12.4-12.7V par hoti hai aur 0V ke qareeb ho to badalni hai.

solutions.en: With mains reconnected, measure charge voltage at the battery terminals; 13.5-14V is healthy and near 0V means the charger or its fuse has failed.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas lagane ke baad battery terminals par charge voltage measure karein; 13.5-14V healthy hai aur 0V ke qareeb charger ya us ka fuse kharab hai.

solutions.en: Replace a dead pack with the specified battery; if E02 persists on a new pack the charger board has failed - contact CyberPower support.
solutions.ur: Dead pack ko spec wali battery se badal dein; nayi pack par bhi E02 rahe to charger board kharab hai - CyberPower support se rabta karein.

source.title: VP700/1000/1200/1600E(I)LCD User's Manual - Function Setup Guide, Last Fault Reason

codes.seriesName: VP700E(I)LCD / VP1000E(I)LCD / VP1200E(I)LCD / VP1600E(I)LCD (line-interactive 700-1600VA, 230V)

title.ur: E21 Output short - output short circuit

meaning.en: The setup menu's 'Last Fault Reason' page reports that the last fault was an output short circuit. Note the VP manual's own wording is 'Output short', not 'Battery Output Short Fault'.
meaning.ur: Setup menu ka 'Last Fault Reason' page batata hai ke aakhri fault output short circuit tha. Dhyan dein VP manual ki apni wording 'Output short' hai, 'Battery Output Short Fault' nahi.

causes.en: A connected appliance has failed short-circuiting.
causes.ur: Koi connected appliance short ho kar kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: A power strip or extension lead has a crushed or cut live core.
causes.ur: Power strip ya extension lead ka live core kata ya daba hua hai.

causes.en: Outlet terminals loose/bridged, or a cable pinched behind the unit.
causes.ur: Outlet terminals dheele/bridge hue hain, ya unit ke peeche koi cable pincha hua hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, unplug mains and disconnect the internal battery, then unplug every load from all UPS outlets.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains aur internal battery disconnect karein, phir tamam UPS outlets se saara load nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Reconnect devices one at a time; the device that restores E21 is the short - unplug it and have it repaired.
solutions.ur: Devices ek-ek karke wapas lagayein; jis device se E21 wapas aaye wohi short hai - use nikaal dein aur repair karwayein.

solutions.en: With the unit isolated, use a multimeter on continuity/ohms from each outlet to neutral; near-zero ohms confirms the short path.
solutions.ur: Unit isolate karne ke baad multimeter continuity/ohms par har outlet ko neutral se check karein; zero ke qareeb ohms short path confirm karte hain.

solutions.en: If every outlet measures clean and E21 still returns, the inverter output stage has failed - contact CyberPower support.
solutions.ur: Agar har outlet clean nikle phir bhi E21 aaye to inverter output stage kharab hai - CyberPower support se rabta karein.

source.title: VP700/1000/1200/1600E(I)LCD User's Manual - Function Setup Guide, Last Fault Reason

codes.seriesName: VP700E(I)LCD / VP1000E(I)LCD / VP1200E(I)LCD / VP1600E(I)LCD (line-interactive 700-1600VA, 230V)

title.ur: E22 Over load - load capacity se zyada

meaning.en: The setup menu's 'Last Fault Reason' page reports that the last fault was an overload. The VP manual's own wording is simply 'Over load'.
meaning.ur: Setup menu ka 'Last Fault Reason' page batata hai ke aakhri fault overload tha. VP manual ki apni wording sirf 'Over load' hai.

causes.en: Total connected load exceeds the unit's VA rating (e.g. 960W on VP1600E(I)LCD).
causes.ur: Total connected load unit ki VA rating se zyada hai (jaise VP1600E(I)LCD par 960W).

causes.en: A high inrush device tripped the overload when mains returned.
causes.ur: Bade inrush wale device ne mains wapas aate hi overload kar diya.

causes.en: The circuit breaker has tripped on overload and stayed out.
causes.ur: Circuit breaker overload par trip ho kar bahar reh gaya hai.

solutions.en: If an overload is detected the unit emits one long beep: turn the UPS off and unplug at least one piece of equipment from the battery power supplied outlets.
solutions.ur: Overload detect hone par unit aik lamba beep deta hai: UPS off karein aur battery power supplied outlets se kam az kam ek equipment nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Make sure the circuit breaker is depressed, then turn the UPS on, as the manual's BASIC OPERATION step instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke BASIC OPERATION step ke mutabiq confirm karein ke circuit breaker neeche dabba hua hai, phir UPS on karein.

solutions.en: Total the connected load on a power meter and keep it within the unit's stated capacity (700VA/390W, 1000VA/550W, 1200VA/720W, 1600VA/960W).
solutions.ur: Connected load power meter par total karein aur unit ki bataye capacity ke andar rakhein (700VA/390W, 1000VA/550W, 1200VA/720W, 1600VA/960W).

solutions.en: If a large-inrush appliance must stay connected, put it on mains directly or reconnect it last after everything else has settled.
solutions.ur: Agar bade inrush wala appliance lagna hi hai to use seedha mains par rakhein ya sab kuch settle hone ke baad sab se aakhir mein wapas lagayein.

source.title: VP700/1000/1200/1600E(I)LCD User's Manual - Function Setup Guide, Last Fault Reason

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

meaning.en: While running on battery the load drew more than the unit can deliver, so the inverter shut the output down.
meaning.ur: Battery par chalte waqt load ne unit ki capacity se zyada kheencha, is liye inverter ne output band kar diya.

causes.en: Too many devices on the Battery Backup outlets.
causes.ur: Battery Backup outlets par bohat zyada devices lagi hain.

causes.en: A connected device with a locked motor or a seized compressor drawing inrush current on battery.
causes.ur: Kisi connected device ka motor jam ya compressor atka hua hai jo battery par inrush current kheech raha hai.

causes.en: The unit is at the bottom of its runtime and even a normal load exceeds what is left.
causes.ur: Unit apni runtime ke bilkul aakhir par hai aur aam load bhi baqi power se zyada hai.

solutions.en: Turn the Back-UPS off first, as APC instructs, before touching any load.
solutions.ur: Jaise APC kahe, koi bhi load chhoone se pehle Back-UPS off karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect non-essential equipment from the Battery Backup outlets, then turn the Back-UPS back on.
solutions.ur: Battery Backup outlets se naami equipment disconnect karein, phir Back-UPS dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Move what you can to the SURGE ONLY outlets, which are not backed up and so do not count toward the load.
solutions.ur: Jitna mumkin ho usay SURGE ONLY outlets par le jayein - yeh backup nahi hote is liye load mein count nahi hote.

solutions.en: Measure the load in watts on the LCD and, if it is under rating, re-add devices one at a time to find the offender.
solutions.ur: LCD par watts mein load parhein, aur agar rating ke neeche ho to devices aik-aik karke dobara jorr ke ghalat device dhoondein.

codes.blinkPattern: System fault symbol and F01 flash on and off, with all front panel indicators flashing

notes.en: F01 is one of only two Back-UPS faults APC gives a user remedy for. Everything F03-F09 is dealer territory.
notes.ur: F01 un do Back-UPS faults mein se aik hai jis ka APC user ka hal deta hai. F03-F09 poora dealer ka kaam hai.

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

meaning.en: The output is shorted while the unit is on battery, so the UPS has shut down to prevent a very high current.
meaning.ur: Unit battery par hone ke dauran output short ho gaya hai, is liye UPS ne bohat high current rokne ke liye band ho kar diya.

causes.en: A connected device with failed internal insulation shorting line to neutral.
causes.ur: Kisi connected device ki andar ki insulation kharab ho kar line se neutral short kar rahi hai.

causes.en: Damaged extension lead or adapter pinched under furniture or behind a cabinet.
causes.ur: Extension lead ya adapter damaged hai jo furniture ke neeche ya cabinet ke peeche nichal hua hai.

causes.en: A wet or damaged outlet or a rodent-chewed cable in a warehouse or store room.
causes.ur: Geela ya damaged outlet, ya godown mein chuhe ka kucha hua cable.

solutions.en: Turn the Back-UPS off, disconnect mains and remove the internal battery before investigating wiring.
solutions.ur: Back-UPS off karein, mains disconnect karein aur wiring dekhne se pehle andar ki battery nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all load, then measure continuity from each Battery Backup outlet to neutral with a multimeter; expect no continuity.
solutions.ur: Saara load disconnect karein, phir har Battery Backup outlet se neutral ki continuity multimeter se nikaalein; continuity nahi honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Reconnect devices one at a time to identify which one is shorted, and inspect every extension lead along its full length.
solutions.ur: Devices aik-aik karke dobara connect karke dhoondein kaun short hai, aur har extension lead poori tarah check karein.

solutions.en: Replace any damaged lead or outlet - a chewed or pinched cable is a fire risk, not just a fault to work around.
solutions.ur: Har damaged lead ya outlet badal dein - chuha ya nichla hua cable aag ka khatra hai, sirf fault nahi.

codes.blinkPattern: System fault symbol and F02 flash on and off, with all front panel indicators flashing

notes.en: Same user remedy as F01 in APC's table: turn off, disconnect non-essential equipment from the Battery Backup outlets, turn on.
notes.ur: APC table mein F01 jaisa hi user hal: off karein, Battery Backup outlets se naami equipment disconnect karein, dobara on karein.

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

meaning.en: The inverter's output X capacitor has drawn too much reactive current on battery, so the unit has shut down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output X capacitor battery par bohat zyada reactive current kheech chuka hai, is liye unit band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Output X capacitor failed shorted, drawing heavy capacitive current every cycle.
causes.ur: Output X capacitor short ho kar kharab hai jis se har cycle mein bhaari capacitive current kheech raha hai.

causes.en: A load on the unit that is heavily capacitive, such as a large motor or long fluorescent bank.
causes.ur: Unit par aisa load jo bhaari capacitive hai, maslan bara motor ya lambi fluorescent lamp bank.

causes.en: Deteriorated X capacitors across the aged board, as happens on an out-of-warranty unit.
causes.ur: Warranty khatam ho gayi unit par board ke purane X capacitors bhi bigad chuke hote hain.

solutions.en: APC's published action is: turn the Back-UPS off, disconnect mains, and let the capacitors discharge before any work.
solutions.ur: APC ka bataya hua amal: Back-UPS off karein, mains disconnect karein, aur koi kaam karne se pehle capacitors discharge hone dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all load and power the unit from mains, then check whether F03 appears without any load attached.
solutions.ur: Saara load disconnect karein aur unit mains par chala dein, phir dekhein ke bina load ke bhi F03 aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If F03 appears unloaded, the X capacitors are faulty and the board needs component-level service; measure each capacitor's value and leakage with an ESR/capacitance meter.
solutions.ur: Agar bina load F03 aaye to X capacitors kharab hain aur board ko component level par service chahiye; har capacitor ki value aur leakage ESR/capacitance meter se nikaalein.

solutions.en: If F03 only appears with a specific load, move that load to the SURGE ONLY outlets and re-test the battery runtime.
solutions.ur: Agar F03 sirf kisi khaas load par aaye to us load ko SURGE ONLY outlets par le jayein aur battery runtime dobara test karein.

notes.en: APC: 'Faults F03-F09 are not user serviceable. Contact APC Technical Support for assistance.' Do not open the unit.
notes.ur: APC: 'Faults F03-F09 user ke liye nahi hain. Madad ke liye APC Technical Support se rabta karein.' Unit na kholein.

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

meaning.en: The surge protection clamp on the output has shorted, so the unit has shut down.
meaning.ur: Output par surge protection clamp short ho gaya hai, is liye unit band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: MOV clamp failed shorted after absorbing a surge, which is its designed sacrificial action.
causes.ur: Surge absorb karne ke baad MOV clamp short ho kar kharab hua hai - yahi iska qurbani hona hai.

causes.en: Repeated small surges or a very high installation voltage slowly degrading the clamp.
causes.ur: Baar baar chhote surge ya bohat oopper installation voltage clamp ko dheere dheere kharab karte hain.

causes.en: Clamp's thermal fuse link blown, leaving the short path conducting permanently.
causes.ur: Clamp ka thermal fuse link uth gaya hai, jis se short raasta hamesha conduct karta hai.

solutions.en: Turn the Back-UPS off, unplug mains and remove the internal battery before inspecting the output board.
solutions.ur: Output board dekhne se pehle Back-UPS off karein, mains se nikaalein aur andar ki battery nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Measure each surge clamp to neutral with a multimeter; a healthy clamp reads open, a failed one reads near zero.
solutions.ur: Har surge clamp ko neutral ke mutabiq multimeter se nikaalein; sehat clamp khuli parhta hai, kharab wala zero ke qareeb.

solutions.en: Check whether the surge protection has been doing its job by asking what event preceded the fault; a lightning strike explains the failure.
solutions.ur: Dhoondein ke fault se pehle kya hua tha; agar bijli kaRuaab (lightning) hua tha to clamp ki kharabi samajh aati hai.

solutions.en: Install properly rated external surge protection upstream, because a sacrificial clamp needs a backup protector to take the next strike.
solutions.ur: Upstream par sahi rating ka external surge protection lagayein, kyunke qurbani clamp ko agla strike rokne ke liye dusra protector chahiye.

notes.en: A blown clamp is evidence the protection worked. Replacing only the clamp without upstream protection repeats the failure.
notes.ur: Clamp uth jaana ishara hai ke protection ne kaam kiya. Sirf clamp badal kar upstream protection na lagaya to kharabi dobara jayegi.

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

meaning.en: The battery charging circuit has faulted, so the pack is not charging and the runtime is at risk.
meaning.ur: Battery charging circuit mein fault aa gaya hai, is liye pack charge nahi ho rahi aur runtime par khatra hai.

causes.en: Internal battery fuse or connector disconnected, so the charger sees no pack.
causes.ur: Internal battery fuse ya connector disconnect hai, jis se charger ko pack hi nazar nahi aata.

causes.en: Battery pack aged beyond replacement, so the charger refuses or cannot charge it.
causes.ur: Battery pack badalne ki had se oopper purani ho chuki hai, jis se charger use charge hi nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Charger circuit component failure on the board.
causes.ur: Board par charger circuit ka koi component kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Turn the Back-UPS off, unplug mains and remove the internal battery, then reseat the battery connector firmly.
solutions.ur: Back-UPS off karein, mains se nikaalein aur andar ki battery nikaal dein, phir battery connector mazbooti se dobara baitha dein.

solutions.en: Measure the internal battery fuse for continuity; replace with the same rating if it is open.
solutions.ur: Internal battery fuse ki continuity nikaalein; khuli ho to usi rating se badal dein.

solutions.en: Measure the pack's DC voltage; a healthy 12 V pack sits near 13.5-13.8 V on float, so a pack at 11 V or less needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Pack ka DC voltage nikaalein; sehat 12 V pack float par 13.5-13.8 V ke qareeb hota hai, is liye 11 V ya us se kam ho to badalna hai.

solutions.en: If the connector and fuse are good and the pack is healthy, the charger board needs component-level service.
solutions.ur: Agar connector aur fuse theek hain aur pack sehat hai to charger board ko component level par service chahiye.

notes.en: Also watch the separate 'Replace Battery' indicator, which turns on for this condition without a fault code being shown.
notes.ur: Alag 'Replace Battery' indicator bhi dekhein, jo is halat mein on ho jata hai jab fault code na dikhe.

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

meaning.en: A transfer relay has welded closed, so the unit cannot isolate the utility path as it should.
meaning.ur: Transfer relay jalm kar band ho gaya hai, is liye unit utility raasta isolate nahi kar sakta jaise chahiye.

causes.en: Relay contacts welded from the inrush current on every transfer.
causes.ur: Har transfer par inrush current se relay ke contacts jalm (weld) gaye hain.

causes.en: Relay contacts pitted by long service life, so they cannot interrupt cleanly.
causes.ur: Lamba service life se relay ke contacts ghis chuke hain jis se saaf interruption nahi hota.

causes.en: Relay coil or armature mechanism failed, so the relay cannot open at all.
causes.ur: Relay coil ya armature mechanism kharab ho gaya hai jis se relay khul hi nahi sakta.

solutions.en: Turn the Back-UPS off, unplug mains and remove the internal battery, then confirm the relay position unpowered.
solutions.ur: Back-UPS off karein, mains se nikaalein aur andar ki battery nikaal dein, phir unpowered state mein relay ki position confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure the relay coil continuity/resistance across its pins after lifting it clear of the board.
solutions.ur: Relay ko board se alag kar ke uske pins par coil continuity/resistance nikaalein.

solutions.en: Inspect the contact faces for welding pitting or discoloration; a welded relay must be replaced, not cleaned.
solutions.ur: Contact faces par welding pitting ya rang badla dekhein; jalmaya relay badalna hota hai, saaf karne se kaam nahi chalega.

solutions.en: Replace the relay and check why the transfers are so frequent; a weak battery causes constant transfers and burns relay contacts.
solutions.ur: Relay badal dein aur yeh bhi dekhein ke transfers itne zyada kyun hain; kamzor battery baar baar transfer karwa kar relay contacts jalati hai.

notes.en: A weak battery is the usual root cause of welding relay contacts - fix the battery, not only the relay.
notes.ur: Relay contacts welding ki asal wajah aam tor par kamzor battery hai - sirf relay nahi, battery bhi theek karein.

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

meaning.en: The internal temperature has exceeded the safe limit, so the unit has shut down.
meaning.ur: Andar ki temperature safe limit se upar chala gayi hai, is liye unit band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Fan failed, so no air is being moved over the transformer and power stage.
causes.ur: Fan kharab ho gaya hai jis se transformer aur power stage par se hawa nahi chal rahi.

causes.en: Unit placed in a closed cabinet or against a hot wall with no clearance.
causes.ur: Unit band cabinet mein ya garam deewar ke saath rakha hai bina kisi clearance ke.

causes.en: Dust build-up on the fan and heatsink blocking airflow.
causes.ur: Fan aur heatsink par dhool jama hokar airflow block kar raha hai.

causes.en: Overload running the unit hot continuously, e.g. a computer on full output for days.
causes.ur: Unit ko mustaqal overload garam kar raha hai, maslan computer ko poori output par kai din chala raha hona.

solutions.en: Turn the Back-UPS off, unplug mains and remove the internal battery, then check the fan spins freely by hand.
solutions.ur: Back-UPS off karein, mains se nikaalein aur andar ki battery nikaal dein, phir check karein ke fan haath se azaad ghoomta hai.

solutions.en: Clean the fan and any dust on the vents with compressed air, and confirm airflow moves a tissue held at the vent.
solutions.ur: Fan aur vents par ke dhool ko compressed air se saaf karein, aur vent par tissue rakh kar airflow verify karein.

solutions.en: Relocate the unit into open air with clearance on all sides as the manual specifies, out of direct sun and away from heat sources.
solutions.ur: Unit ko khule hawa mein manual ke mutabiq charon taraf clearance ke saath le jayein, seedhi dhoop se door aur garmi ke sarkaron se door.

solutions.en: Reduce the load so the unit is not running continuously at its limit, and re-test by running a self-test on mains.
solutions.ur: Load kam karein taake unit musalsal apni limit par na chale, aur mains par self-test chala kar dobara test karein.

notes.en: In Pakistani summers a Back-UPS inside a closed wooden cupboard will hit F07 regularly; the fix is placement, not the UPS.
notes.ur: Pakistani garmi mein band lakdi cupboard ka Back-UPS aksar F07 deta hai; hal rakhne ki jagah hai, UPS ka nahi.

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

meaning.en: The cooling fan has failed or is not being commanded, so the unit will overheat if left running.
meaning.ur: Cooling fan kharab ho gaya hai ya use command nahi mil raha, is liye unit chalte rehne par garam ho jayega.

causes.en: Fan motor bearing seized or the motor has failed.
causes.ur: Fan motor ka bearing jam ho gaya ya motor kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Fan connector or its supply has failed, so the fan never receives power.
causes.ur: Fan ka connector ya uski supply kharab hai jis se fan ko bijli hi nahi milti.

causes.en: Fan blades broken or jammed by dust so the fan runs but moves no air.
causes.ur: Fan blades toot chuke hain ya dhool se jam hain jis se fan chalti hai magar hawa nahi chalati.

solutions.en: Turn the Back-UPS off, unplug mains and remove the internal battery, then check the fan for seized bearings or broken blades.
solutions.ur: Back-UPS off karein, mains se nikaalein aur andar ki battery nikaal dein, phir fan ke jam bearings ya toote blades dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure the fan's supply voltage with the unit on mains; no supply means the connector or board is at fault, not the fan.
solutions.ur: Unit mains par ho to fan ki supply voltage nikaalein; supply na ho to kharabi fan mein nahi, connector ya board mein hai.

solutions.en: Clean the fan and its housing with compressed air, and confirm air actually moves at the vent with a tissue.
solutions.ur: Fan aur housing ko compressed air se saaf karein, aur vent par tissue rakh kar hawa ka chalna confirm karein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan with a matching size, voltage and airflow rating so cooling is not reduced, and re-run self-test.
solutions.ur: Fan ko milan jaisa size, voltage aur airflow rating se badal dein taake cooling kam na ho, aur self-test dobara chalayein.

notes.en: Do not just clear the fault and keep running - an unprotected unit will next report F07 or cook itself.
notes.ur: Sirf fault clear kar ke chalate mat rahen - bacha hua unit agli baar F07 dega ya khud kharab ho jayega.

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

meaning.en: A general internal fault has been detected that does not map to a more specific code.
meaning.ur: Ek aam internal fault detect hua hai jo kisi khaas code se map nahi hota.

causes.en: One of the more specific internal codes (F03-F08) has been seen and then latched as a general internal fault.
causes.ur: Koi khaas internal code (F03-F08) dekha gaya aur phir aam internal fault ke taur par latch ho gaya.

causes.en: Control board failure with no more specific indication available.
causes.ur: Control board ki kharabi jiska koi khaas ishara mojood nahi.

causes.en: Supply or rail fault inside the unit affecting several subsystems at once.
causes.ur: Unit ki andar ki supply ya rail ki kharabi jo kai subsystems ko ek saath mutasir karti hai.

solutions.en: Turn the Back-UPS off, unplug mains and remove the internal battery before any investigation, as APC requires for F03-F09.
solutions.ur: APC ke mutabiq F03-F09 ke liye: koi dekhne ka kaam karne se pehle Back-UPS off karein, mains se nikaalein aur andar ki battery nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Note whether the fault appeared at switch-on, during a transfer, or only while on battery; that pattern narrows the cause quickly.
solutions.ur: Note karein ke fault switch-on par aaya, transfer ke dauran, ya sirf battery par - yeh andaza wajah jaldi chhota kar deta hai.

solutions.en: Measure the battery connector, fuse and pack voltage first, because a bad battery produces several internal codes at once.
solutions.ur: Pehle battery connector, fuse aur pack voltage nikaalein, kyunke kharab battery kai internal codes aik saath paida karta hai.

solutions.en: If nothing obvious is found, the board needs component-level diagnosis; take the unit to an authorised APC service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar koi saaf wajah na mile to board ko component level par diagnose karwana hoga; unit ko authorized APC service centre le jayein.

notes.en: F09 is the catch-all internal fault. Treat it as 'internal, needs the board looked at', not as a single known problem.
notes.ur: F09 aik catch-all internal fault hai. Ise 'internal, board dekha zaroori' samajhein, kisi aik khaas masle ke taur par nahi.

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

title.en: SYSTEM FAULT indicator on, all indicators flashing
title.ur: SYSTEM FAULT indicator on, sab indicators flash

meaning.en: An internal system fault is present; the number on the LCD identifies which of F01-F09 it is.
meaning.ur: Andar ka system fault mojood hai; LCD par number batata hai ke F01-F09 mein se kaunsa hai.

causes.en: Any of the F01-F09 internal faults is active on the unit.
causes.ur: Unit par F01-F09 mein se koi bhi internal fault active hai.

causes.en: On older Back-UPS LCD models the fault number is shown as F01 to F09 beside a flashing fault symbol.
causes.ur: Purane Back-UPS LCD models par fault number F01 se F09 flashing fault symbol ke saath dikhaya jata hai.

solutions.en: Match the number on the LCD to the corresponding Fault Message in the System Faults table, exactly as APC instructs.
solutions.ur: Jaise APC kahe, LCD par number ko System Faults table mein us Fault Message se match karein.

solutions.en: Write the number down before power-cycling, because the code is not stored and will be gone after a power-off.
solutions.ur: Power-cycle karne se pehle number likh lein, kyunke code store nahi hota aur power off ke baad gayab ho jata hai.

solutions.en: For F01 and F02 follow APC's published remedy; for F03-F09 contact an authorised service centre as APC requires.
solutions.ur: F01 aur F02 par APC ka bataya hua amal karein; F03-F09 par jaise APC kahe authorized service centre se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the real cause with a meter and multimeter rather than replacing the whole unit on the fault code alone.
solutions.ur: Sirf fault code par poora unit badalne ke bajaye meter aur multimeter se asal wajah confirm karein.

codes.blinkPattern: SYSTEM FAULT indicator illuminated and all front panel indicators flashing

notes.en: APC's own wording: 'There is an internal fault. Determine which internal fault message is displayed by matching the number displayed on the LCD with the corresponding Fault Message (see System Faults) and contact APC Technical Support.'
notes.ur: APC ka apna alfaz: 'Andar ka fault hai. LCD par number ko us Fault Message se match karke pata karein (System Faults dekhein) aur APC Technical Support se rabta karein.'

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

meaning.en: The battery has reached the end of its useful life and must be replaced; the unit may be audibly warning once an hour.
meaning.ur: Battery apni useful life ke ant tak pohanch gayi hai aur badalni chahiye; unit ghante mein aik baar awaaz de sakta hai.

causes.en: Battery at the end of its rated service life, typically 3-5 years.
causes.ur: Battery apni rated service life ke ant par hai, aam tor par 3-5 saal.

causes.en: Battery has not been recharged after repeated outages.
causes.ur: Baar baar outages ke baad battery dobara charge nahi hui.

causes.en: Reachable battery cartridge at end of life - APC's answer on BX1300G/BX1500G is 'Replace the battery (APCRBC124)'.
causes.ur: Reachable battery cartridge umar ke aakhir par - APC ka BX1300G/BX1500G par jawab hai 'Battery badal dein (APCRBC124)'.

solutions.en: Turn the Back-UPS off, unplug mains and remove the old cartridge, following the manual's battery replacement procedure.
solutions.ur: Manual ki battery replacement tareebi follow kar ke Back-UPS off karein, mains se nikaalein aur purana cartridge nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Check the battery connector is fully seated; a loose connector is often mistaken for an expired battery.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery connector poori tarah baitha hai; loose connector ko aksar expired battery samajh liya jata hai.

solutions.en: Fit the correct replacement battery - APC specifies APCRBC124 for the BX1300G/BX1500G, and the correct type and number for your model.
solutions.ur: Sahi replacement battery lagayein - APC BX1300G/BX1500G ke liye APCRBC124 batata hai, aur aapke model ke liye sahi type aur number.

solutions.en: Charge the new battery on mains for the time the manual specifies, then re-run self-test to confirm the indicator clears.
solutions.ur: Nayi battery ko manual ki batay hui der mains par charge karein, phir self-test chala kar indicator mitne ki tasdeq karein.

codes.blinkPattern: REPLACE BATTERY indicator illuminated; unit beeps for one minute every five hours (Back-UPS XS) or once every 2 seconds when flashing (Smart-UPS)

notes.en: APC's published action on the Back-UPS: 'The battery has reached the end of its useful life. Replace the battery (APCRBC124).'
notes.ur: APC ka Back-UPS par bataya hua amal: 'Battery apni useful life ke ant par pohanch gayi hai. Battery badal dein (APCRBC124).'

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

meaning.en: The unit is supplying power to the Battery Backup outlets from the battery because utility power is absent or out of tolerance.
meaning.ur: Unit battery se Battery Backup outlets ko power de raha hai kyunke utility power mojood nahi ya tolerance se bahar hai.

causes.en: A utility outage or a voltage too far outside the unit's transfer window.
causes.ur: Utility outage ya unit ki transfer window se bahar voltage.

causes.en: The plug partially pulled out of the wall outlet, so the unit sees no utility power.
causes.ur: Plug wall outlet mein se aadha nikal gaya hai jis se unit ko utility power nazar nahi aati.

solutions.en: No action needed during a genuine outage; this is correct behaviour and the unit is protecting the load.
solutions.ur: Asal outage mein koi karakari zaroori nahi; yehi theek amal hai aur unit load ki hifazat kar raha hai.

solutions.en: If utility is actually present, check the wall outlet is live by testing it with another known-good device.
solutions.ur: Agar utility waqai mojood hai to check karein ke wall outlet mein bijli hai, kisi doosre azeen device se test kar ke.

solutions.en: Check the plug is fully seated and that the input circuit breaker has not tripped; reset the breaker if it has.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke plug poori tarah baitha hai aur input circuit breaker trip to nahi hua; hua ho to reset karein.

solutions.en: If the unit is switching to battery while good mains is present, the input voltage may be outside the transfer window - adjust sensitivity per the manual.
solutions.ur: Agar ache mains mojood hone par bhi unit battery par ja raha hai to input voltage transfer window ke bahar ho sakti hai - manual ke mutabiq sensitivity adjust karein.

codes.blinkPattern: On Battery indicator on; unit beeps 4 times every 30 seconds

notes.en: APC: 'The beeping stops when utility power is restored or the Back-UPS is turned off.'
notes.ur: APC: 'Beeping utility power ki wapsi ya Back-UPS band karne par ruk jata hai.'

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

title.en: Low Battery indicator on / continuous beeping
title.ur: Low Battery indicator chalu / musalsal beeping

meaning.en: The battery is near total discharge, so the unit is warning continuously and will shut down shortly.
meaning.ur: Battery poori discharge ke qareeb hai, is liye unit musalsal ehtiyat kar raha hai aur jald band ho jayegi.

causes.en: Outage has lasted longer than the pack's remaining runtime.
causes.ur: Outage pack ki baaki runtime se lambi rahi.

causes.en: Load higher than the pack was sized for, draining it faster than designed.
causes.ur: Load pack ki bajaye se zyada hai, jis se pack bajaye se tez drain ho raha hai.

causes.en: Battery aged and holding far less charge than its rating.
causes.ur: Battery purani ho chuki hai aur rating se bohat kam charge rakhti hai.

solutions.en: Shut down non-essential load immediately to slow the discharge; the unit will shut down on its own if left.
solutions.ur: Discharge dheema karne ke liye foran naami load band karein; chhor diya to unit khud band ho jayegi.

solutions.en: Do not attempt to start a large motor from a low battery; a stalled motor will trip the unit again.
solutions.ur: Kam battery se bara motor start karne ki koshish na karein; atka hua motor unit dobara trip kar dega.

solutions.en: Confirm the mains has returned before the unit shuts down, otherwise the load loses power abruptly.
solutions.ur: Unit band hone se pehle confirm karein ke mains wapas aa gaya hai, warna load ki bijli achanak chali jayegi.

solutions.en: Once mains returns, charge the pack for the full time the manual specifies before relying on it again.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par pack ko manual ki batay hui poori der charge karein, phir us par bharosa karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Low Battery indicator on; unit beeps continuously

notes.en: APC: 'The beeping stops when utility power is restored or the Back-UPS is turned off.'
notes.ur: APC: 'Beeping utility power ki wapsi ya Back-UPS band karne par ruk jata hai.'

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Back-UPS XS and Back-UPS LCD (F01-F09 system fault codes)

meaning.en: The equipment connected draws more power than the unit can provide, so the unit warns with a constant tone.
meaning.ur: Judi equipment unit ki capacity se zyada power kheech rahi hai, is liye unit musalsal awaaz de kar ehtiyat karta hai.

causes.en: Too much equipment connected, or load added after installation.
causes.ur: Bohat zyada equipment lagi hai, ya installation ke baad load barha diya gaya.

causes.en: A load with a locked rotor or a seized compressor drawing inrush current.
causes.ur: Aisa load jiska rotor jam ya compressor atak gaya aur inrush current kheech raha hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect equipment from the Battery Backup outlets one item at a time until the tone and indicator clear.
solutions.ur: Equipment ko Battery Backup outlets se aik-aik karke disconnect karein jab tak awaaz aur indicator na mithe.

solutions.en: Move the non-essential equipment to the SURGE ONLY outlets, which are not backed up.
solutions.ur: Naami equipment SURGE ONLY outlets par le jayein, jo backup nahi hote.

solutions.en: Read the load in watts on the LCD and compare with the unit's rating; if the total is under rating, one device is faulting.
solutions.ur: LCD par watts mein load parhein aur unit ki rating se compare karein; agar kul rating se kam ho to koi aik device kharab hai.

solutions.en: If a single device trips the overload, disconnect and test that device on its own before condemning the UPS.
solutions.ur: Agar aik hi device overload par trip kare to us device ko alag karke test karein, UPS kharab kehne se pehle.

codes.blinkPattern: Overload indicator on or the overload icon flashing; unit emits a constant tone

notes.en: APC: 'The alarm stops when nonessential equipment is disconnected from the Battery Backup outlets or the Back-UPS is turned off.'
notes.ur: APC: 'Alarm ruk jata hai jab naami equipment Battery Backup outlets se disconnect ho jaye ya Back-UPS band kar diya jaye.'

source.title: APC Back-UPS BX1500G / BX1300G / BN1350G User Manual (BU-UM-990-3508-MN01-EN)

codes.seriesName: APC Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA (three-phase, 208 V/220 V) - display alarm text

meaning.en: A short circuit is present on the UPS output, so the unit has tripped to protect itself and the load.
meaning.ur: UPS output par short circuit mojood hai, is liye unit apni aur load ki protection ke liye trip ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Load-side short between phase and neutral or between two phases.
causes.ur: Load side par phase aur neutral ya do phases ke darmiyan short.

causes.en: A connected motor, heater or appliance with a failed internal insulation.
causes.ur: Kisi connected motor, heater ya appliance ka andar ki insulation kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Damaged output busbar, cable or outlet with a pinched or crushed conductor.
causes.ur: Output busbar, cable ya outlet damaged aur koi conductor nichal ya crush hua hai.

solutions.en: Shut the unit down, isolate mains and the battery, then disconnect all load before touching any wiring.
solutions.ur: Unit band karein, mains aur battery isolate karein, phir wiring chhoone se pehle saara load disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Check each phase to neutral and phase to phase continuity with a megger; a healthy installation reads open.
solutions.ur: Megger se har phase se neutral aur phase se phase ki continuity check karein; healthy installation par yeh khuli parhni chahiye.

solutions.en: Walk the output conductors from the UPS to the furthest panel, looking for a crushed cable or a loose lug.
solutions.ur: Output conductors ko UPS se aakhri panel tak dekhein, kuch crush hua cable ya loose lug dhoondhte hue.

solutions.en: Energise the load panel by panel to isolate the shorted section, then repair before reconnecting anything.
solutions.ur: Short wala hissa dhoondne ke liye load panel aik aik karke power dein, phir kuch bhi dobara jorrne se pehle repair karein.

notes.en: SE's corrective action is 'Check the status of the output. Please contact Schneider Electric.' Field-isolate before calling.
notes.ur: SE ka hal likha hai 'Output ki halat check karein. Schneider Electric se rabta karein.' Phone karne se pehle khud isolate karein.

source.title: Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA 208 V - Operation (990-6409B-001), section 'Status and Alarm Messages'

codes.seriesName: APC Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA (three-phase, 208 V/220 V) - display alarm text

meaning.en: The load is drawing more power than the UPS system can supply, so the unit has shut down.
meaning.ur: Load UPS system ki capacity se zyada power kheech rahi hai, is liye unit band ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Too much equipment connected, or load added after commissioning.
causes.ur: Bohat zyada equipment lagi hai, ya commissioning ke baad load barha diya gaya.

causes.en: A load with a locked rotor or a seized compressor drawing several times running current.
causes.ur: Aisa load jiska rotor jam hai ya compressor atak gaya hai aur jo chalne wale current se kai guna kheech raha hai.

causes.en: A shorted load presenting a very low impedance to the inverter.
causes.ur: Short ho gaya load jo inverter ko bohat kam impedance dikhata hai.

solutions.en: Read the load kW and percent from the display and compare with the unit's rated capacity.
solutions.ur: Display se load kW aur percent parhein aur unit ki rated capacity se compare karein.

solutions.en: Open load feeders one at a time until the alarm clears, which identifies the offending circuit.
solutions.ur: Jab tak alarm na mithe load feeders aik-ek karke kholein, jisse ghalat circuit pakda ja jata hai.

solutions.en: Measure each feeder with a clamp meter; a circuit far above its nameplate rating is the culprit.
solutions.ur: Har feeder ko clamp meter se nikaalein; nameplate rating se bohat oopper aik circuit hi culprit hai.

solutions.en: Verify the load current sensor and its wiring before suspecting a sensor drift, since the fault repeats after every rebuild.
solutions.ur: Sensor drift ka shak karne se pehle load current sensor aur uski wiring check karein, kyunke har rebuild ke baad fault dohra jata hai.

notes.en: Same wording in the table for both 'Output overload' and 'System overload' - SE treats them as the same condition.
notes.ur: Table mein 'Output overload' aur 'System overload' ka alfaz aik hi hai - SE dono ko aik hi halat samajhta hai.

source.title: Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA 208 V - Operation (990-6409B-001), section 'Status and Alarm Messages'

codes.seriesName: APC Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA (three-phase, 208 V/220 V) - display alarm text

meaning.en: The scheduled battery maintenance test did not pass, so the battery's actual capacity is not confirmed.
meaning.ur: Scheduled battery maintenance test pass nahi hua, is liye battery ki asli capacity confirm nahi hui.

causes.en: Battery genuinely aged and unable to carry the test discharge.
causes.ur: Battery asal mein purani ho chuki hai aur test discharge nahi uth sakti.

causes.en: Test run at high ambient temperature, which shortens achievable capacity.
causes.ur: Test high ambient temperature par chalaya gaya jis se haasil hone wali capacity kam hoti hai.

causes.en: String imbalance or a weak cell failing early in the discharge.
causes.ur: String imbalance ya koi weak cell discharge shuru hote hi fail ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Read the battery voltage and remaining capacity on the display before and after the test.
solutions.ur: Test se pehle aur baad mein display par battery voltage aur baaki capacity parhein.

solutions.en: Measure each cell's voltage and internal resistance; the weakest cell identifies the failing string section.
solutions.ur: Har cell ka voltage aur internal resistance nikaalein; sab se kamzor cell hi failing hissa identify karta hai.

solutions.en: Check the maintenance test settings - the test depth and interval may be set too aggressively.
solutions.ur: Maintenance test settings check karein - test ki depth aur interval shayad bohat zyada rakha gaya hai.

solutions.en: After correcting the cause, re-run the maintenance test to clear the message.
solutions.ur: Wajah theek karne ke baad maintenance test dobara chalayein taake message mit jaye.

notes.en: SE lists the message with an empty corrective action, so this is a judgement call for the technician.
notes.ur: SE yeh message khaali corrective action ke saath likhta hai, is liye yeh technician ka faisla hai.

source.title: Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA 208 V - Operation (990-6409B-001), section 'Status and Alarm Messages'

codes.seriesName: APC Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA (three-phase, 208 V/220 V) - display alarm text

meaning.en: The battery service life has expired, so the pack must be replaced to restore any backup.
meaning.ur: Battery ki service life khatam ho gayi hai, is liye koi bhi backup wapas karne ke liye pack badalna hoga.

causes.en: Battery pack older than its rated service life of typically 3-5 years.
causes.ur: Battery pack apni 3-5 saal ki rated service life se oopper hai.

causes.en: High ambient temperature throughout its life consumed the float life faster.
causes.ur: Zindagi bhar high ambient temperature ne float life jaldi khatam kar di.

causes.en: Repeated deep discharge during long load-shedding outages.
causes.ur: Lambi load-shedding outages mein baar baar deep discharge hua.

solutions.en: Confirm expiry on the display and count the battery log, which records the discharge history.
solutions.ur: Display par expiry confirm karein aur battery log gino, jo discharge history record karta hai.

solutions.en: Replace the battery with the specified type and number; do not mix old and new cells in a string.
solutions.ur: Battery ko bataye gaye type aur number se badal dein; string mein purani aur nayi cells milayein mat.

solutions.en: Set the battery install date correctly after fitting the new pack so the next expiry is counted from the right day.
solutions.ur: Naya pack lagane ke baad battery ki install date theek set karein taake agli expiry sahi din se gino ja sake.

solutions.en: Improve the room cooling around the battery cabinet, since heat is what shortens the next pack's life too.
solutions.ur: Battery cabinet ke aas paas room cooling behtar karein, kyunke garmi agle pack ki bhi umra kam karti hai.

notes.en: SE's corrective action is simply 'Replace the battery.' Do the isolation first: mains off, battery disconnected.
notes.ur: SE ka hal sirf 'Battery badal dein' hai. Pehle isolation karein: mains off, battery disconnect.

source.title: Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA 208 V - Operation (990-6409B-001), section 'Status and Alarm Messages'

codes.seriesName: APC Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA (three-phase, 208 V/220 V) - display alarm text

title.ur: Battery poori tarah discharge ho gayi

meaning.en: Battery capacity has fallen below the minimum acceptable value, so the pack needs recharging.
meaning.ur: Battery ki capacity minimum qubool value se neeche gir gayi hai, is liye pack dobara charge karna zaroori hai.

causes.en: Long outage drained the pack fully with no charge time since.
causes.ur: Lambi outage ne pack poori tarah khaali kar diya aur uske baad charge ka waqt nahi mila.

causes.en: Charger not working, so the pack never recovers after a discharge.
causes.ur: Charger kaam nahi kar raha, is liye pack discharge ke baad recover nahi hota.

causes.en: Ambient temperature very low, reducing achievable capacity and triggering the threshold early.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat kam hai, jis se haasil capacity ghat ho kar threshold jaldi trigger ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Restore mains and leave the unit charging on float; do not start the battery maintenance test until fully charged.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas karein aur unit ko float par charge hone dein; poori charge hone se pehle battery maintenance test shuru na karein.

solutions.en: Measure the string and each cell's voltage to confirm the pack is recoverable rather than failed.
solutions.ur: Confirm karne ke liye string aur har cell ka voltage nikaalein ke pack recover ho sakta hai ya nahi, ya failed hai.

solutions.en: Verify the charger is delivering current; if not, fix the charger before expecting any recovery.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke charger current de raha hai; agar nahi to koi recovery ki umeed rakhne se pehle charger theek karein.

solutions.en: Re-read the message after a full charge; it should clear on its own if the pack recovered.
solutions.ur: Poori charge ke baad message dobara parhein; pack recover hua to yeh khud clear ho jayega.

notes.en: SE's corrective action is 'Recharge the batteries.' The engineering step is to check charger current while doing it.
notes.ur: SE ka hal hai 'Batteries dobara charge karein.' Engineering ka qadam hai charging ke dauran charger current check karna.

source.title: Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA 208 V - Operation (990-6409B-001), section 'Status and Alarm Messages'

codes.seriesName: APC Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA (three-phase, 208 V/220 V) - display alarm text

meaning.en: The battery temperature is too high, so the unit is protecting the pack from thermal damage.
meaning.ur: Battery temperature bohat zyada hai, is liye unit pack ko thermal damage se bachane ki koshish kar raha hai.

causes.en: Battery cabinet ventilation blocked, or the cabinet in a hot unventilated room.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet ki ventilation band hai, ya cabinet garm aur bina hawa ke kamre mein hai.

causes.en: Pack overcharged, producing heat faster than it can be removed.
causes.ur: Pack zyada charge ho kar itni garmi bana raha hai jitni nikal nahi sakti.

causes.en: One shorted cell heating in isolation inside the pack.
causes.ur: Pack ke andar aik shorted cell khud garam ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Read the battery temperature on the display and confirm the sensor is reading, not stuck.
solutions.ur: Display par battery temperature parhein aur confirm karein ke sensor parh raha hai, atka hua nahi.

solutions.en: Measure the actual pack temperature with a probe and compare against the battery label's limit.
solutions.ur: Probe se pack ki asli temperature nikaal kar battery label ki limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Check every fan and grille for dust and clean with compressed air; confirm the fans actually spin.
solutions.ur: Har fan aur grille mein dhool check karein aur compressed air se saaf karein; confirm karein ke fan sach mein chalte hain.

solutions.en: Measure each cell's voltage in turn and feel for a single hot cell; one hot cell means replace the pack.
solutions.ur: Ek-ek cell ka voltage nikaalein aur koi aik garam cell mehsoos karein; aik garam cell matlab pack badal dein.

notes.en: SE's corrective action is 'Check the battery temperature.' Reading the sensor alone will not tell you if it is lying.
notes.ur: SE ka hal hai 'Battery temperature check karein.' Sirf sensor parhne se pata nahi chalega ke woh jhoot bol raha hai ya nahi.

source.title: Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA 208 V - Operation (990-6409B-001), section 'Status and Alarm Messages'

codes.seriesName: APC Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA (three-phase, 208 V/220 V) - display alarm text

meaning.en: The battery voltage is low, so the runtime available is reduced and the unit is closer to shutting down.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage kam hai, is liye mojood runtime kam ho gaya hai aur unit band hone ke qareeb hai.

causes.en: Pack discharged by an outage and not yet recharged.
causes.ur: Pack outage se discharge ho chuka hai aur abhi recharge nahi hua.

causes.en: Battery cells aged and holding charge poorly.
causes.ur: Battery cells purani ho chuki hain aur charge theek se nahi rakhti.

causes.en: Charger output weak, so charge is going in too slowly.
causes.ur: Charger output kamzor hai, is liye charge bahut dheere se ja raha hai.

solutions.en: Read the battery voltage on the display and compare it against the float voltage for the pack's cell count.
solutions.ur: Display par battery voltage parhein aur usay pack ke cell count ke mutabiq float voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Measure the string and each cell with a DC meter to separate a flat pack from a weak charger.
solutions.ur: Flat pack aur kamzor charger ko alag karne ke liye string aur har cell ko DC meter se nikaalein.

solutions.en: Confirm the charger is delivering current by checking its output against the battery voltage.
solutions.ur: Charger ki output ko battery voltage se compare kar ke confirm karein ke current de raha hai.

solutions.en: After a full charge, re-read the voltage; if it stays low, the pack has aged and needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Poori charge ke baad voltage dobara parhein; agar kam hi rahe to pack purani ho chuki hai aur badalna hoga.

notes.en: SE's corrective action is 'Check the battery.' Measure rather than assume - the fix differs by cause.
notes.ur: SE ka hal hai 'Battery check karein.' Andaza karein baghair na milein - har wajah ka hal alag hai.

source.title: Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA 208 V - Operation (990-6409B-001), section 'Status and Alarm Messages'

codes.seriesName: APC Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA (three-phase, 208 V/220 V) - display alarm text

meaning.en: The battery wiring is incorrect, so the string is not presenting the voltage the unit expects.
meaning.ur: Battery wiring ghalat hai, is liye string woh voltage nahi de rahi jo unit ko chahiye.

causes.en: String cables to one bank reversed, so that bank fights the other.
causes.ur: Aik bank ki string cables ulat hui hain, jis se woh bank doosre se lad raha hai.

causes.en: Interconnect between strings missing or loose, so only part of the pack is in circuit.
causes.ur: Strings ke darmiyan interconnect missing ya loose hai, jis se pack ka sirf hissa circuit mein hai.

causes.en: Wrong number of batteries for the configured string voltage.
causes.ur: Battery ki ghalat tadaad configured string voltage ke liye.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery bank, then trace and photograph every inter-connection before changing anything.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery bank disconnect karein, phir kuch badalne se pehle har inter-connection ko trace kar ke tasveer lein.

solutions.en: Verify polarity of every string cable with a multimeter; every bank must read positive toward the common positive rail.
solutions.ur: Har string cable ki polarity multimeter se check karein; har bank ka common positive rail ki taraf positive parhna chahiye.

solutions.en: Count the batteries in series and confirm the count matches the string voltage setting in the manual.
solutions.ur: Series mein batteries gino aur confirm karein ke tadaad manual ki string voltage setting se match karti hai.

solutions.en: Re-tighten all interconnect terminals to the specified torque and re-read the message.
solutions.ur: Har interconnect terminal ko batay hui torque par dobara kasshein aur message dobara parhein.

notes.en: Reversed banks can cause very high current and heat - disconnect before investigating, not after.
notes.ur: Ulat banks bohat high current aur garmi paida kar sakte hain - dekhne se pehle disconnect karein, baad mein nahi.

source.title: Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA 208 V - Operation (990-6409B-001), section 'Status and Alarm Messages'

codes.seriesName: APC Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA (three-phase, 208 V/220 V) - display alarm text

meaning.en: Neither the battery nor the charger is working, so the unit has no battery backup path at all.
meaning.ur: Na battery kaam kar raha hai na charger, is liye unit ke paas battery backup ka koi rasta hi nahi bacha.

causes.en: Battery pack dead and charger also failed, often from the same surge event.
causes.ur: Battery pack dead aur charger bhi kharab, aksar ek hi surge event se.

causes.en: Charger output blown open by a battery reverse-polarity connection.
causes.ur: Battery ulat polarity se jurne ki wajah se charger output khul ho kar uth gaya.

causes.en: Fuse or breaker in the battery path open, cutting both supply and measurement.
causes.ur: Battery path ka fuse ya breaker khula hai, jis se supply aur measurement dono kat gaye.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery, then check the path fuse or breaker continuity with an ohmmeter.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phin path fuse ya breaker ki continuity ohmmeter se check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the pack's open-circuit voltage; a fully dead pack reads far below the string's nominal voltage.
solutions.ur: Pack ka open-circuit voltage nikaalein; poori tarah dead pack string ki nominal voltage se bohat neeche parhta hai.

solutions.en: Measure the charger output with a known-good battery or a dummy load to see if the charger works at all.
solutions.ur: Aik ache wale battery ya dummy load se charger output nikaal ke dekhein ke charger kaam karta hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Replace the failed component, then confirm the pack passes a battery test before returning the unit to the load.
solutions.ur: Kharab component badal dein, phir unit wapas load par dene se pehle confirm karein ke pack battery test pass karta hai.

notes.en: SE's action is 'Check the battery. Check the charger.' Both, in that order - a dead pack will falsely accuse a good charger.
notes.ur: SE ka hal hai 'Battery check karein, charger check karein.' Usi tarah se - marr pack acha charger par bhi ilzaam lagayegi.

source.title: Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA 208 V - Operation (990-6409B-001), section 'Status and Alarm Messages'

codes.seriesName: APC Easy UPS 3S 10-40 kVA (three-phase, 208 V/220 V) - display alarm text

meaning.en: One or more of the UPS fans has stopped, so the unit cannot move enough air to keep components safe.
meaning.ur: UPS ke ek ya zyada fans ruk chuke hain, is liye unit components ko mehfooz rakhne ke liye kaafi hawa nahi nikal sakta.

causes.en: Fan bearing seized or motor failed, so the blade does not turn.
causes.ur: Fan ka bearing jam ho gaya ya motor kharab, jis se blade nahi chalta.

causes.en: Fan connector unplugged or its supply has failed.
causes.ur: Fan ka connector nikal gaya ya uski supply kharab hai.

causes.en: Fan blades clogged with dust, so airflow is negligible while the fan still powers up.
causes.ur: Fan ke blades dhool se band, jis se airflow khatam ho jati hai jabki fan chalti to hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and disconnect the battery, then spin each fan blade by hand to find seized bearings.
solutions.ur: Mains isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein, phir har fan ka blade haath se ghora kar jam bearings dhoondein.

solutions.en: Clean the fan blades and housings with compressed air and confirm air actually moves past a tissue held at the grille.
solutions.ur: Fan blades aur housing ko compressed air se saaf karein aur confirm karein ke grille par tissue rakhne par hawa chalti hai.

solutions.en: Measure the fan's supply voltage and compare with the fan's rating; no supply means the connector or board is at fault.
solutions.ur: Fan ki supply voltage nikaal kar fan ki rating se compare karein; supply na ho to connector ya board kharab hai.

solutions.en: Replace a seized or dead fan with the same size, voltage and airflow rating so the cooling capacity is not reduced.
solutions.ur: Jam ya mara hua fan aik hi size, voltage aur airflow rating wale se badal dein taake cooling capacity kam na ho.

notes.en: The table lists 'Bypass fan inoperable', 'Fan inoperable' and 'Input SCR fan inoperable' as separate rows with the same corrective action; they are grouped here because the remedy is identical.
