meaning.ur: Utility failure hua hai aur UPS battery mode mein hai, equipment ko apni batteries se power de raha hai.

causes.en: The utility supply has failed or is outside the transfer window.
causes.ur: Utility supply chala gaya hai ya transfer range se bahar hai.

causes.en: The user has deliberately selected battery mode from the panel.
causes.ur: User ne panel se jaanbujhkar battery mode select kiya hai.

solutions.en: Save your work and prepare your equipment for shutdown, because runtime is limited.
solutions.ur: Apna kaam bacha lein aur equipment ko shutdown ke liye tayyar karein, kyunke runtime mehdud hai.

solutions.en: Read the remaining runtime and battery level on the front panel display.
solutions.ur: Front panel display par baaqi runtime aur battery level parhein.

solutions.en: When mains returns, confirm the unit is back on mains and the battery is charging.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par confirm karein ke unit mains par wapas aa gaya hai aur battery charge ho rahi hai.

codes.blinkPattern: LED solid On, 1 beep every 10 seconds

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

codes.seriesName: 5P Gen2 (line-interactive UPS, tower and rack models 550-3000 VA class)

title.ur: Battery low (runtime khatam hone wali hai)

meaning.en: The UPS is in battery mode and the battery is running low. The manual warns this can appear before 20% capacity.
meaning.ur: UPS battery mode mein hai aur battery low ho rahi hai. Manual kehti hai ke ye 20% capacity se pehle aa sakti hai.

causes.en: The outage has lasted long enough to reach the low-charge warning level.
causes.ur: Outage itni der rahi ke low-charge warning level aa gaya.

causes.en: The battery string is aged and holds less charge than rated.
causes.ur: Battery string purani hai aur rated se kam charge rakhti hai.

solutions.en: Shut down non-essential equipment now to stretch the remaining runtime.
solutions.ur: Baaqi runtime barhane ke liye abhi ghair zaroori equipment band kar dein.

solutions.en: Read the actual remaining runtime on the display; the manual warns the estimate varies with load and EBM count.
solutions.ur: Display par asal baaqi runtime parhein; manual kehti hai ke estimate load aur EBM tadaad ke saath badalti hai.

solutions.en: Once mains returns, give the UPS 48 hours of utility power to restore full charge.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par UPS ko poori charge ke liye 48 ghante utility power dein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED solid On, 1 beep every 3 seconds

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

codes.seriesName: 5P Gen2 (line-interactive UPS, tower and rack models 550-3000 VA class)

meaning.en: The batteries are disconnected, so the UPS has no battery backup at all.
meaning.ur: Batteries disconnect hain, is liye UPS ka koi battery backup nahi hai.

causes.en: The internal battery connector is unplugged or not fully seated.
causes.ur: Internal battery connector nahi laga ya poori tarah seat nahi hua.

causes.en: An EBM power connector or its battery detection connector is unplugged.
causes.ur: EBM ka power connector ya us ka battery detection connector nahi laga hua.

causes.en: A battery harness pin is loose, corroded or broken.
causes.ur: Battery harness ka pin dhile, zang khaa ya toota hua hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug the mains and wait at least 5 minutes before opening the battery bay.
solutions.ur: UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein aur battery bay kholne se pehle kam az kam 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Verify that all batteries are properly connected; push every connector firmly until it clicks into place.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke saari batteries theek se juri hain; har connector ko click hone tak mazbooti se push karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery DC voltage with a DMM; if the condition persists, contact your service representative.
solutions.ur: DMM se battery DC voltage maarein; agar masla barqarar rahe to apne service representative se rabta karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED solid On, continuous beep

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

codes.seriesName: 5P Gen2 (line-interactive UPS, tower and rack models 550-3000 VA class)

title.ur: Battery fault (battery test fail ho gaya)

meaning.en: The battery test failed because of bad or disconnected batteries. On 5P Gen2 this row replaces the gen-1 wording 'End of battery life'.
meaning.ur: Battery test fail ho gaya kyunke batteries kharab ya disconnect hain. 5P Gen2 par is row ne gen-1 ke 'End of battery life' ki jagah li hai.

causes.en: The battery cells are dead, shorted, or the string is at end of life.
causes.ur: Battery cells mar chuke hain, short hain, ya string end of life par hai.

causes.en: A battery is disconnected, so the test fails before it can complete.
causes.ur: Koi battery disconnect hai, is liye test poora hone se pehle fail ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Verify that all batteries are properly connected, with the UPS off and mains unplugged.
solutions.ur: UPS band karke aur mains nikal kar check karein ke saari batteries theek se juri hain.

solutions.en: Measure each cell voltage with a DMM; replace the string as a set if the readings are unequal or low.
solutions.ur: DMM se har cell ka voltage maarein; readings barabar na hon ya kam hon to poori string set ke taur par replace karein.

solutions.en: If the condition persists after reconnection, contact your service representative for battery replacement.
solutions.ur: Dohasne ke baad bhi masla barqarar rahe to battery tabdeeli ke liye apne service representative se rabta karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED solid On, continuous beep

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

codes.uid: eaton/eaton-5p-gen2/The UPS does not provide the expected backup time
codes.seriesName: 5P Gen2 (line-interactive UPS, tower and rack models 550-3000 VA class)
codes.code: The UPS does not provide the expected backup time
codes.codeNorm: THE UPS DOES NOT PROVIDE THE EXPECTED BACKUP TIME
aliases: The UPS does not provide the expected backup time

title.ur: Backup time itni kam hai jitni umeed thi nahi

meaning.en: The UPS does not give the rated runtime on discharge; the batteries need charging or service.
meaning.ur: UPS discharge par rated runtime nahi deta; batteries ko charging ya servicing chahiye.

causes.en: The batteries are not fully charged (new unit or long time unused).
causes.ur: Batteries poori tarah charge nahi hain (naya unit ya lambi der se istemal nahi).

causes.en: The battery string has aged and lost capacity.
causes.ur: Battery string purani ho chuki hai aur capacity khoyi hai.

causes.en: The connected load is higher than the rating used to calculate the expected runtime.
causes.ur: Connected load un rating se zyada hai jis se expected runtime nikala gaya tha.

solutions.en: Apply utility power for 48 hours to charge the batteries, then retest.
solutions.ur: Batteries charge karne ke liye 48 ghante utility power dein, phir dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Measure the actual output current with a clamp meter and compare with the manual's runtime table.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se asal output current maarein aur manual ke runtime table se tulna karein.

solutions.en: If runtime is still short after 48 hours of charging, contact your service representative.
solutions.ur: 48 ghante charging ke baad bhi runtime kam ho to apne service representative se rabta karein.

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

codes.seriesName: 5P Gen2 (line-interactive UPS, tower and rack models 550-3000 VA class)

title.ur: Power Overload (load UPS capacity se zyada)

meaning.en: Power requirements exceed the UPS capacity (greater than 100% of nominal). The alarm resets by itself once the condition becomes inactive.
meaning.ur: Power requirements UPS capacity se zyada hain (nominal ke 100% se zyada). Shart hatne par alarm khud ba khud reset ho jata hai.

causes.en: More equipment is connected than the 5P Gen2 is rated for.
causes.ur: 5P Gen2 ki rating se zyada equipment lagaya gaya hai.

causes.en: A large inrush device such as an air conditioner or motor was switched on.
causes.ur: Koi bada inrush device jaise air conditioner ya motor on kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Remove some of the equipment from the UPS until the load percentage on the display is back under the limit.
solutions.ur: Display par load percentage limit ke andar aane tak UPS se kuch equipment nikaalte jayein.

solutions.en: Check the specific output overload ranges under "User Settings" for your model before deciding.
solutions.ur: Faisla karne se pehle apne model ke "User Settings" mein diye gaye khaas output overload ranges check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the alarm clears by itself; if it does not, disconnect the output and recheck the load with a clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke alarm khud clear ho jata hai; agar na ho to output disconnect karke clamp meter se dobara load check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED solid On (manual does not state a beeper cadence for this row)

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

codes.seriesName: 5P Gen2 (line-interactive UPS, tower and rack models 550-3000 VA class)

meaning.en: The internal temperature is too high or a fan has failed. At warning level the UPS stays in its current state; another 10 degrees C rise shuts it down.
meaning.ur: Andar ka temperature bohat zyada hai ya fan kharab ho gaya hai. Warning level par UPS apni halaat mein rehta hai; 10 degree C aur izafa hone par band ho jata hai.

causes.en: A fan has failed and heat is building inside the unit.
causes.ur: Fan kharab ho gaya hai aur unit ke andar garmi jama ho rahi hai.

causes.en: Vents are blocked or airflow around the unit is restricted.
causes.ur: Vents band hain ya unit ke gird ka airflow band hai.

causes.en: The surrounding temperature is above the model's operating range (0 to 40 degrees C).
causes.ur: Gird ka temperature model ke operating range (0 se 40 degree C) se zyada hai.

solutions.en: Clear vents and remove any heat sources. Allow the UPS to cool.
solutions.ur: Vents saaf karein aur heat source hata dein. UPS ko thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: Ensure the airflow around the UPS is not restricted; keep at least the manual's clearance on all sides.
solutions.ur: UPS ke gird ka airflow band na ho; har taraf manual ki clearance rakhein.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature with a thermometer; if it is above 40 degrees C, fix the room cooling first, then check the fan.
solutions.ur: Thermometer se ambient temperature maarein; 40 degree C se zyada ho to pehle room cooling theek karein, phir fan check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED solid On, 1 beep every 3 seconds

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

codes.uid: eaton/eaton-5p-gen2/The UPS does not start (input source not connected correctly)
codes.seriesName: 5P Gen2 (line-interactive UPS, tower and rack models 550-3000 VA class)
codes.code: The UPS does not start (input source not connected correctly)
codes.codeNorm: THE UPS DOES NOT START INPUT SOURCE NOT CONNECTED CORRECTLY
aliases: The UPS does not start (input source not connected correctly)

title.en: UPS does not start - input not connected
title.ur: UPS start nahi ho raha - input connect nahi

meaning.en: The input source is not connected correctly, so the UPS will not start.
meaning.ur: Input source theek se connect nahi hai, is liye UPS start nahi hota.

causes.en: The mains input cable is loose or not fully pushed into the inlet.
causes.ur: Mains input cable dhili hai ya inlet mein poori tarah nahi lagi.

causes.en: The input breaker or the input protection fuse has tripped.
causes.ur: Input breaker ya input protection fuse trip ho chuka hai.

causes.en: The battery connection is also open, so the unit refuses to start.
causes.ur: Battery connection bhi khuli hai, is liye unit start karne se inkaar karta hai.

solutions.en: Check the input and battery connections as the manual directs, with the UPS switched off.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq UPS band karte hue input aur battery connections check karein.

solutions.en: Measure mains voltage at the input inlet with a DMM and confirm the input breaker is closed.
solutions.ur: DMM se input inlet par mains voltage maarein aur confirm karein ke input breaker band hai.

solutions.en: Reseat the battery connector firmly, then retry the start from the front panel.
solutions.ur: Battery connector ko mazbooti se dobara baitha dein, phir front panel se dobara start karein.

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

codes.uid: eaton/eaton-5p-gen2/The UPS does not start (RPO active / connector missing)
codes.seriesName: 5P Gen2 (line-interactive UPS, tower and rack models 550-3000 VA class)
codes.code: The UPS does not start (RPO active / connector missing)
codes.codeNorm: THE UPS DOES NOT START RPO ACTIVE / CONNECTOR MISSING
aliases: The UPS does not start (RPO active / connector missing)

title.en: UPS does not start - RPO active
title.ur: UPS start nahi ho raha - RPO active hai

meaning.en: The Remote Power Off switch is active or the RPO connector is missing, which is preventing restart.
meaning.ur: Remote Power Off switch active hai ya RPO connector missing hai, jis ki wajah se restart nahi ho raha.

causes.en: The RPO wall switch or contact has been pressed/closed.
causes.ur: RPO wall switch ya contact press/band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: The RPO connector is not plugged into its terminal at all.
causes.ur: RPO connector apne terminal par lagaya hi nahi gaya.

causes.en: A building/fire-alarm contact wired to RPO has closed.
causes.ur: RPO se juri building/fire-alarm contact band ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: If the UPS Status menu displays the "Remote Power Off" notice, deactivate the RPO input.
solutions.ur: Agar UPS Status menu par "Remote Power Off" ka notice aaye to RPO input deactivate karein.

solutions.en: Measure the RPO terminal pair with a DMM; it must be open for the unit to be allowed to run.
solutions.ur: DMM se RPO terminal pair check karein; unit ko chalne dene ke liye ye open hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Find out why RPO was activated before you clear it, then restart from the front panel.
solutions.ur: Clear karne se pehle dekhein ke RPO kyun activate hua, phir front panel se restart karein.

source.title: Eaton 5P Gen2 UPS - user manual, rack models (DSD-5P2208)

codes.seriesName: 5P 650-1550 i (line-interactive UPS, tower/rack/wall)

meaning.en: The UPS does not recognise the internal batteries, so it has no battery backup.
meaning.ur: UPS ko apni internal batteries nazar nahi aa rahi, is liye us ka koi battery backup nahi hai.

causes.en: The internal battery harness connector is unplugged or not fully seated.
causes.ur: Internal battery harness connector nahi laga ya poori tarah seat nahi hua.

causes.en: The battery pack has been pulled out during a previous service and not refitted.
causes.ur: Battery pack pichli service mein nikal kar wapas nahi lagaya gaya.

causes.en: A battery connector pin is loose, corroded or broken, so the string reads as open.
causes.ur: Battery connector ka pin dhile, zang khaa ya toota hua hai, is liye string khuli nazar aati hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, unplug the mains and wait at least 5 minutes before touching the battery compartment.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, mains nikaal dein aur battery compartment chhoone se pehle kam az kam 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Verify that all batteries are properly connected; push the connector firmly until it latches.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke saari batteries theek se juri hain; connector ko latch hone tak mazbooti se push karein.

solutions.en: Measure the internal battery DC voltage with a DMM; an open circuit means the harness or a cell is dead.
solutions.ur: DMM se internal battery ka DC voltage maarein; open circuit ka matlab hai ke harness ya koi cell mar chuka hai.

source.title: Eaton 5P UPS - Installation and user manual (620-00082-02-i)

codes.seriesName: 5P 650-1550 i (line-interactive UPS, tower/rack/wall)

meaning.en: Power demand exceeds 105% of the UPS nominal capacity; the unit keeps running but may shut down if load increases.
meaning.ur: Power demand UPS nominal capacity ke 105% se zyada hai; unit chalta rehta hai magar load barhne par band ho sakta hai.

causes.en: More equipment is connected than the 5P is rated for.
causes.ur: 5P ki rating se zyada equipment lagaya gaya hai.

causes.en: A computer or air conditioner was added to the UPS without a load calculation.
causes.ur: Koi computer ya air conditioner load calculation ke baghair UPS par lagaya gaya.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off and unplug the output before disconnecting any load.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi load disconnect karne se pehle UPS band karein aur output nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Remove some of the equipment from the UPS until the load percentage on the LCD is under 100%.
solutions.ur: LCD par load percentage 100% se neeche aane tak UPS se kuch equipment nikaalte jayein.

solutions.en: Measure the output current with a clamp meter; if the load is permanently over 105%, move it to a larger UPS.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se output current maarein; agar load mustaqil 105% se upar hai to barhe UPS par le jaayein.

source.title: Eaton 5P UPS - Installation and user manual (620-00082-02-i)

codes.seriesName: 5P 650-1550 i (line-interactive UPS, tower/rack/wall)

title.ur: End of battery life (battery ki umar khatam)

meaning.en: The batteries have reached end of life and can no longer give useful runtime.
meaning.ur: Batteries end of life par aa chuki hain aur ab useful runtime nahi de sakti.

causes.en: The battery string is aged beyond its design life and has lost capacity.
causes.ur: Battery string apni design life se zyada umar ke baad capacity khoyi chuki hai.

causes.en: The batteries have been kept in a hot environment, which shortens their life by half per 10 degrees C above 25 C.
causes.ur: Batteries garmi mein rahi hain, jis se 25 C se 10 degree upar par har 10 degree par zindagi aadha ho jaati hai.

causes.en: Repeated deep discharges have worn the cells out.
causes.ur: Baar baar gehri discharge ne cells ko kharab kiya hai.

solutions.en: Record the alarm message and the UPS serial number before touching the battery.
solutions.ur: Battery chhoone se pehle alarm message aur UPS serial number likh lein.

solutions.en: Contact your service representative for battery replacement, quoting the serial number.
solutions.ur: Battery tabdeeli ke liye apne service representative se rabta karein aur serial number dein.

solutions.en: After replacement, apply utility power for at least 48 hours and run a battery test before relying on backup.
solutions.ur: Tabdeeli ke baad kam az kam 48 ghante utility power dein aur backup par bharosa karne se pehle battery test chalayein.

source.title: Eaton 5P UPS - Installation and user manual (620-00082-02-i)

codes.seriesName: 5P 650-1550 i (line-interactive UPS, tower/rack/wall)

meaning.en: A UPS event has occurred. The manual's example is the RPO contact being activated, which shuts the UPS down and now prevents restart.
meaning.ur: Koi UPS event ho gaya hai. Manual ka example hai ke RPO contact activate hua, jo UPS band karta hai aur ab restart nahi hone deta.

causes.en: The Remote Power OFF (RPO) contact has been activated.
causes.ur: Remote Power OFF (RPO) contact activate ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Another event such as a maintenance command or a remote shutdown was received.
causes.ur: Koi doosra event jaise maintenance command ya remote shutdown mila hai.

solutions.en: Set the contact back to its normal position (open, for a normally-closed RPO loop).
solutions.ur: Contact ko us ki normal position par wapas set karein (normally-closed RPO loop ke liye open).

solutions.en: Press the front-panel button to restart the UPS once the contact is released.
solutions.ur: Contact chhodne ke baad UPS restart karne ke liye front panel ka button dabayein.

solutions.en: Investigate why the RPO was triggered (fire alarm loop, building system, accidental press) before clearing it.
solutions.ur: RPO trigger hone ki wajah (fire alarm loop, building system, ghalti se dabana) jaan lein, phir clear karein.

source.title: Eaton 5P UPS - Installation and user manual (620-00082-02-i)

codes.seriesName: 5P 650-1550 i (line-interactive UPS, tower/rack/wall)

meaning.en: The UPS has an internal fault and no longer protects the connected equipment.
meaning.ur: UPS mein internal fault hai aur woh ab connected equipment ki protection nahi kar raha.

causes.en: An internal power stage, relay, or control board failure.
causes.ur: Internal power stage, relay ya control board ki kharabi.

causes.en: A failed battery or charger has dragged the internal rails out of range.
causes.ur: Kharab battery ya charger ne internal rails ko range se bahar kheench diya.

causes.en: Input or output surge has damaged an internal component.
causes.ur: Input ya output surge ne koi internal component damage kar diya.

solutions.en: Note the alarm message and the UPS serial number, then contact your service representative.
solutions.ur: Alarm message aur UPS serial number likh lein, phir apne service representative se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Do not leave the load on this unit: move it to a healthy UPS or a bypass-fed outlet in the meantime.
solutions.ur: Load ko is unit par mat chhodein: us waqt use healthy UPS ya bypass-fed outlet par le jaayein.

solutions.en: Before any repair, switch off, unplug mains and disconnect the battery module with insulated tools.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi tabdeeli se pehle UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein aur insulated tools se battery module disconnect karein.

source.title: Eaton 5P UPS - Installation and user manual (620-00082-02-i)

codes.seriesName: 93E 15-80 kVA (3-phase online UPS, 380/400/415 V)

title.ur: Normal mode - Green indicator chala hua

meaning.en: The UPS is in Normal mode and the power module is supplying power to the critical load.
meaning.ur: UPS Normal mode mein hai aur power module critical load ko power de raha hai.

causes.en: Normal operation - the inverter/rectifier is carrying the load at full protection.
causes.ur: Normal chalta hua - inverter/rectifier poori protection ke saath load carry kar raha hai.

causes.en: The unit was started in High-Efficiency (HE) normal mode, which is the documented default and still lights the Normal indicator.
causes.ur: Unit ko High-Efficiency (HE) normal mode mein start kiya gaya, jo manual ka default hai aur phir bhi Normal indicator jalata hai.

solutions.en: No action needed; record the load percent and battery runtime from the MIMIC screen for your log.
solutions.ur: Koi karam nahi; apni log ke liye MIMIC screen se load percent aur battery runtime likh lein.

solutions.en: If you plan maintenance, use the Controls menu to transfer to Bypass first rather than pulling a breaker.
solutions.ur: Agar maintenance ka plan hai to Controls menu se pehle Bypass par transfer karein, breaker kheenchne ke bajaye.

codes.blinkPattern: Green status indicator solid On

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

codes.seriesName: 93E 15-80 kVA (3-phase online UPS, 380/400/415 V)

meaning.en: The UPS is turned off; no status is being reported by the MIMIC panel.
meaning.ur: UPS band hai; MIMIC panel koi status nahi bata raha.

causes.en: The UPS was deliberately shut down by an operator for maintenance or a planned stop.
causes.ur: UPS ko operator ne jaanbujhkar maintenance ya planned stop ke liye band kiya.

causes.en: The UPS lost control power and shut itself down after an EPO or REPO event.
causes.ur: UPS ka control power chala gaya aur EPO ya REPO event ke baad khud band ho gaya.

solutions.en: Check the History log and the REPO/EPO switch positions before assuming the unit is healthy.
solutions.ur: Unit healthy maan lene se pehle History log aur REPO/EPO switch ki position check karein.

solutions.en: If an EPO/REPO event caused it, find the reason before re-energising; the switch must be returned to normal.
solutions.ur: Agar EPO/REPO event ne kiya hai to dobara energize karne se pehle wajah dhoondein; switch normal par wapas hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Restart with the Controls menu (UPS -> LOAD OFF NORMAL), not by forcing the breakers, after normal mode is confirmed safe.
solutions.ur: Normal mode mehfoof hai ye confirm karne ke baad Controls menu se (UPS -> LOAD OFF NORMAL) restart karein, breakers zabardasti band na karayein.

codes.blinkPattern: All four status indicators Off

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

codes.uid: eaton/eaton-93e/Battery mode (Yellow On, Normal stays On)
codes.seriesName: 93E 15-80 kVA (3-phase online UPS, 380/400/415 V)
codes.code: Battery mode (Yellow On, Normal stays On)
codes.codeNorm: BATTERY MODE YELLOW ON NORMAL STAYS ON
aliases: Battery mode (Yellow On, Normal stays On)

title.en: Battery mode (Yellow On, Green also On)
title.ur: Battery mode (Yellow On, Green bhi On)

meaning.en: The UPS is on battery. Because battery mode is a normal condition, the Normal indicator also stays illuminated - this is not a fault.
meaning.ur: UPS battery par hai. Kyunke battery mode aam halat hai, Normal indicator bhi jalta rehta hai - ye fault nahi hai.

causes.en: The utility supply has failed and the UPS is discharging the battery string.
causes.ur: Utility supply chala gaya hai aur UPS battery string discharge kar raha hai.

causes.en: The input is out of tolerance so the UPS has transferred to battery by design.
causes.ur: Input tolerance se bahar hai is liye UPS apni taraf se battery par chala gaya hai.

solutions.en: Read the battery runtime from the MIMIC screen and plan the load shutdown before time runs out.
solutions.ur: MIMIC screen se battery runtime parhein aur waqt khatam hone se pehle load shutdown ka plan banayein.

solutions.en: Check the upstream input breaker and the utility supply before assuming the battery is at fault.
solutions.ur: Battery ko fault samajhne se pehle upstream input breaker aur utility supply check karein.

solutions.en: On return of mains, confirm the unit returns to Normal mode and the charger restarts, then run a battery test.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par confirm karein ke unit Normal mode wapas aa gaya aur charger chal pada, phir battery test chalayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow Battery indicator On together with Green Normal indicator On; event horn cycles at a half-second rate

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

codes.seriesName: 93E 15-80 kVA (3-phase online UPS, 380/400/415 V)
codes.codeNorm: BYPASS MODE YELLOW ON GREEN OFF

title.ur: Bypass mode - Yellow On, Green band

meaning.en: The UPS is in Bypass mode and the critical load is supported by the bypass source, so the load is not protected by the UPS.
meaning.ur: UPS Bypass mode mein hai aur critical load bypass source se chal raha hai, is liye load UPS se protected nahi hai.

causes.en: An operator transferred the UPS to Bypass mode from the Controls menu.
causes.ur: Operator ne Controls menu se UPS ko Bypass mode par transfer kiya.

causes.en: A fault or an overload forced the static switch into bypass to keep the load alive.
causes.ur: Koi fault ya overload static switch ko bypass par le gaya taake load zinda rahe.

causes.en: The bypass input is out of tolerance, so the unit cannot return to Normal.
causes.ur: Bypass input tolerance se bahar hai, is liye unit Normal par wapas nahi aa sakta.

solutions.en: Read the History log and the Events screen to find the alarm or command that put the unit into bypass.
solutions.ur: History log aur Events screen parhein taake pata chale kaunsa alarm ya command unit ko bypass par le gaya.

solutions.en: Measure the bypass input voltage and frequency at the bypass breaker with a DMM; both must be inside tolerance.
solutions.ur: DMM se bypass breaker par bypass input voltage aur frequency maarein; dono tolerance ke andar hone chahiye.

solutions.en: Transfer the load back to Normal via the Controls menu (Bypass -> Normal) and confirm the Green indicator returns.
solutions.ur: Controls menu se (Bypass -> Normal) load wapas Normal par transfer karein aur confirm karein ke Green indicator wapas aa gaya.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow Bypass indicator On, Green Normal indicator not illuminated

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

codes.seriesName: 93E 15-80 kVA (3-phase online UPS, 380/400/415 V)

title.ur: Active alarm - Yellow On aur horn

meaning.en: The UPS has an active alarm needing immediate attention. The LCD shows the highest-priority active alarms and the horn sounds.
meaning.ur: UPS par active alarm hai jis par foren tawajjo chahiye. LCD sabse pehle priority wale active alarm dikhata hai aur horn bajta hai.

causes.en: Any alarm, notice or command category event recorded in the Events log.
causes.ur: Events log mein likha gaya koi bhi alarm, notice ya command category event.

causes.en: The Alarm indicator may be illuminated along with the Normal, Battery or Bypass indicator, so read the LCD text too.
causes.ur: Alarm indicator Normal, Battery ya Bypass indicator ke saath bhi jal sakta hai, is liye LCD text bhi parhein.

solutions.en: Press any control panel pushbutton once to silence the horn, then read the alarm text in the LCD status area.
solutions.ur: Horn band karne ke liye control panel ka koi bhi pushbutton aik baar dabayein, phir LCD status area mein alarm text parhein.

solutions.en: Go to the Events screen and note every active alarm; the LCD shows the highest priority one only.
solutions.ur: Events screen par jaayein aur har active alarm likh lein; LCD sirf sabse badi priority wala dikhata hai.

solutions.en: Check the History log to see whether the alarm is clearing, recurring or escalating, before deciding on repair.
solutions.ur: Faisla karne se pehle History log parhein ke alarm clear ho raha hai, dobara aa raha hai ya barh raha hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow Alarm indicator On (may light together with other indicators) plus audible horn; horn cycles at a half-second rate; press any control panel pushbutton once to silence

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

codes.seriesName: 93E 15-80 kVA (3-phase online UPS, 380/400/415 V)

meaning.en: There is a new, not-yet-acknowledged UPS alarm condition. The indicator keeps flashing until an operator acknowledges it.
meaning.ur: UPS mein naya alarm hai jise abhi tak kisi operator ne acknowledge nahi kiya. Indicator tab tak flash karta rahega jab tak koi operator acknowledge na kare.

causes.en: A new alarm has just been raised and nobody has yet pressed a pushbutton to acknowledge it.
causes.ur: Naya alarm abhi uth hai aur abhi tak kisi ne acknowledge karne ke liye pushbutton nahi dabaya.

causes.en: A previously acknowledged alarm changed category and was re-raised as new.
causes.ur: Pehle acknowledge kiya hua alarm category badal kar naye roop mein dobara uth hai.

solutions.en: Press any control panel pushbutton once to acknowledge the alarm and stop the flashing.
solutions.ur: Flashing band karne ke liye control panel ka koi bhi pushbutton aik baar dabayein.

solutions.en: Immediately read the alarm text and the Events screen, because acknowledging hides the flashing but not the alarm.
solutions.ur: Foran alarm text aur Events screen parhein, kyunke acknowledge karne par flashing band hoti hai magar alarm nahi.

solutions.en: Do not clear the fault list until the root cause is found; clear it only after the repair is verified.
solutions.ur: Wajah dhoondne tak fault list clear na karein; sirf tabdeeli verify hone ke baad clear karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Red Alarm indicator flashing continuously until acknowledged by pressing any control panel pushbutton once

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

codes.seriesName: 93E 15-80 kVA (3-phase online UPS, 380/400/415 V)

title.en: Output AC under voltage (MIMIC alarm text)
title.ur: Output AC kam hai (MIMIC alarm text)

meaning.en: Example MIMIC alarm text published in the manual: the output AC voltage is below the acceptable window, so the load is at risk.
meaning.ur: Manual mein diya gaya MIMIC alarm text ka misaal: output AC voltage ijazat se neeche hai, is liye load par khatra hai.

causes.en: The output voltage has dropped below the transfer window, e.g. after a load step or a bypass supply dip.
causes.ur: Output voltage transfer window se neeche gir gaya hai, maslan load step ya bypass supply dip ke baad.

causes.en: The critical load is drawing more current than the inverter can sustain at that voltage.
causes.ur: Critical load itna current kheench raha hai jitna inverter us voltage par bhar nahi sakta.

solutions.en: Acknowledge the alarm by pressing any control panel pushbutton once, then leave the load running if it is stable.
solutions.ur: Control panel ka koi bhi pushbutton aik baar dabayein taake alarm acknowledge ho, phir load chalta rahe dein agar stable hai.

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage and frequency at the output breaker with a DMM and compare with the LCD readings.
solutions.ur: DMM se output breaker par output voltage aur frequency maarein aur LCD readings se tulna karein.

solutions.en: Measure the output current per phase with a clamp meter; if it is at the limit, reduce non-critical load.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se har phase ka output current maarein; agar limit par ho to non-critical load kam kar dein.

codes.blinkPattern: Alarm text appears in the LCD status area (top line blinks while scrolling); Red Alarm indicator flashes until acknowledged

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

codes.uid: eaton/eaton-93e/UPS: Load Off / Bypass / Online, HE
codes.seriesName: 93E 15-80 kVA (3-phase online UPS, 380/400/415 V)
codes.code: UPS: Load Off / Bypass / Online, HE
codes.codeNorm: UPS LOAD OFF / BYPASS / ONLINE HE
aliases: UPS: Load Off / Bypass / Online, HE

title.en: UPS status: Load Off / Bypass / Online, HE
title.ur: UPS ki halat: Load Off / Bypass / Online HE

meaning.en: The System Control screen's UPS status line. 'Load Off' de-energises the load, 'Bypass' feeds the load from bypass, 'Online, HE' means double conversion in high-efficiency mode.
meaning.ur: System Control screen ka UPS status line. 'Load Off' load ko de-energize kar deta hai, 'Bypass' load ko bypass se chalata hai, 'Online, HE' ka matlab high-efficiency mode mein double conversion.

causes.en: Normal operating states selected from the System Control screen, not faults.
causes.ur: System Control screen se chune gaye normal operating states, faults nahi.

causes.en: An operator ran a command such as LOAD OFF NORMAL, Bypass Mode or High-Efficiency (HE) Mode, which set the status text.
causes.ur: Operator ne LOAD OFF NORMAL, Bypass Mode ya High-Efficiency (HE) Mode jaisa command chalaya, jis se ye status text set hua.

solutions.en: Use the arrow pushbutton and RETURN to highlight and execute the command, entering the Level 1 password when prompted (default 1111).
solutions.ur: Command ko highlight aur execute karne ke liye arrow pushbutton aur RETURN use karein, prompt aane par Level 1 password dein (default 1111).

solutions.en: Confirm the result on the status indicators: Green alone for Online, Yellow for Bypass, all Off for Load Off.
solutions.ur: Status indicators se confirm karein: sirf Green Online ke liye, Yellow Bypass ke liye, sab Off Load Off ke liye.

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

codes.seriesName: 93E 15-80 kVA (3-phase online UPS, 380/400/415 V)

title.ur: Bypass ki halat: Off / On / Available

meaning.en: Bypass breaker/contact state shown on the System Control screen. 'Available' means the bypass path is ready to transfer to.
meaning.ur: System Control screen par bypass breaker/contact ki halat. 'Available' ka matlab hai ke bypass ka raasta transfer ke liye tayyar hai.

causes.en: Normal bypass path state; not a fault condition.
causes.ur: Bypass ka normal path state; ye fault condition nahi hai.

causes.en: The bypass feeder breaker was left open or closed by a previous maintenance job and has not been returned.
causes.ur: Bypass feeder breaker pichli maintenance mein chhoda ya band kiya gaya tha aur wapas nahi kiya gaya.

solutions.en: If the unit will not transfer to Normal, verify the bypass input voltage/frequency is within the manual's tolerance at the bypass breaker.
solutions.ur: Agar unit Normal par transfer nahi hota to check karein ke bypass breaker par bypass input voltage/frequency manual ki tolerance mein hai.

solutions.en: Read the alarm text before attempting a forced transfer; do not close the bypass breaker on a live UPS.
solutions.ur: Zabardasti transfer karne se pehle alarm text parhein; live UPS par bypass breaker band na karein.

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

codes.seriesName: 93E 15-80 kVA (3-phase online UPS, 380/400/415 V)

meaning.en: Battery charger state on the System Control screen. 'Charger Resting' means the charger is off (field for rest), 'Charger' means it is charging.
meaning.ur: System Control screen par battery charger ki halat. 'Charger Resting' ka matlab charger band hai, 'Charger' ka matlab woh charge kar raha hai.

causes.en: The charger was switched off deliberately, or the UPS is on battery so charging is not possible.
causes.ur: Charger jaanbujhkar band kiya gaya, ya UPS battery par hai is liye charging mumkin nahi.

causes.en: The charger has been switched off automatically because the battery is already at its float voltage.
causes.ur: Battery pehle se hi float voltage par hai, is liye charger khud ba khud band kar diya gaya hai.

solutions.en: Use Battery Control Commands > Charger to turn the charger on and Resting to turn it off, then confirm the state on screen.
solutions.ur: Charger on karne ke liye Battery Control Commands > Charger aur off karne ke liye Resting use karein, phir screen par state confirm karein.

solutions.en: If the charger will not start, check the charger input supply and read the active alarm text on the Events screen.
solutions.ur: Agar charger start na ho to charger input supply check karein aur Events screen par active alarm text parhein.

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

meaning.en: The input line and neutral conductors are swapped, so the UPS self-diagnosis has blocked normal operation.
meaning.ur: Input line aur neutral conductors aapas mein badle hain, is liye self-diagnosis ne normal chalna rok diya hai.

causes.en: The mains plug or terminal block has line and neutral interchanged.
causes.ur: Mains plug ya terminal block par line aur neutral aapas mein badal diye gaye hain.

causes.en: Earth and neutral are swapped, which the unit reads as an inversion.
causes.ur: Earth aur neutral aapas mein badal diye gaye hain, jise unit inversion par parhta hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off and unplug the mains. Never swap conductors live.
solutions.ur: UPS band karein aur mains nikaal dein. Conductors ko live state par kabhi na badlein.

solutions.en: Use a non-contact voltage tester or a DMM on low-ohm range to identify live and neutral at the input.
solutions.ur: Input par live aur neutral pehchane ke liye non-contact voltage tester ya low-ohm range wala DMM use karein.

solutions.en: Re-terminate the input so line, neutral and earth are each in the correct terminal, then tighten and retest.
solutions.ur: Input dobara terminate karein taake line, neutral aur earth har aik theek terminal par hon, phir kheench kar dobara test karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.ur: A502 Charger voltage high (charger voltage zyada)

meaning.en: The battery charger output is above its specification, so it can over-charge and damage the battery string.
meaning.ur: Battery charger ka output apni specification se zyada hai, is liye woh battery string ko zyada charge kar ke nuqsaan kar sakta hai.

causes.en: The configured battery string count/voltage does not match the installed battery (wrong configuration selected in the menu).
causes.ur: Menu mein chuna hua battery string count/voltage installed battery se match nahi karta (galat configuration).

causes.en: Charger output sense resistor or the charger board is faulty.
causes.ur: Charger output sense resistor ya charger board kharab hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature is very high, so temperature-compensated charging has drifted.
causes.ur: Ambient temperature bohat zyada hai, is liye temperature-compensated charging drift ho gayi hai.

solutions.en: Read the configured battery type and string voltage from the Battery settings menu and compare with the battery label.
solutions.ur: Battery settings menu se configured battery type aur string voltage parhein aur battery label se tulna karein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery string voltage with a DMM after mains and battery isolation; check it against the charging voltage spec.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karne ke baad DMM se battery string voltage maarein; charging voltage spec se tulna karein.

solutions.en: Correct the battery configuration before leaving the unit on charge; have the charger board tested if the reading is still high.
solutions.ur: Unit ko charge par chhodne se pehle battery configuration theek karein; reading abhi bhi zyada ho to charger board test karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.ur: A604 Battery voltage low (battery voltage kam)

meaning.en: The measured battery string voltage is below the expected value, so runtime is short or the string is undercharged.
meaning.ur: Battery string ka measured voltage expected value se neeche hai, is liye runtime chhoti hai ya string adhoori charged hai.

causes.en: The battery string is aged and has lost capacity.
causes.ur: Battery string purani ho chuki hai aur capacity khoyi hai.

causes.en: The string was recently discharged or has not had enough charging time.
causes.ur: String haal hi mein discharge hui hai ya kaafi charging time nahi mila.

causes.en: One or more cells in the string is open or shorted, dragging the string voltage down.
causes.ur: String mein koi aik ya zyada cells khula ya short ho gaya hai, jo string voltage neeche kheench raha hai.

solutions.en: With mains and battery isolated, measure each cell in the string with a DMM and compare the readings cell by cell.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karke DMM se string ka har cell voltage maarein aur cell ba cell tulna karein.

solutions.en: Apply utility power for 48 hours to charge the batteries fully, then re-run the battery test.
solutions.ur: Batteries poori tarah charge karne ke liye 48 ghante utility power dein, phir battery test dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Replace the whole string as a matched set if the readings stay unequal after full charging.
solutions.ur: Poor charging ke baad bhi readings barabar nahi aati hain to poori string matched set ke taur par replace karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

meaning.en: The UPS cannot see the battery string or the attached EBM, so no backup is available.
meaning.ur: UPS ko battery string ya lagaya hua EBM nazar nahi aa raha, is liye koi backup maujood nahi.

causes.en: The internal battery string or the EBM power/detection cable is unplugged.
causes.ur: Internal battery string ya EBM ka power/detection cable nahi laga hua.

causes.en: The battery connector pins are loose, corroded or bent.
causes.ur: Battery connector ke pins dhile, zang khaye ya tute hue hain.

causes.en: The battery detection cable from the EBM is missing, so the unit assumes no battery.
causes.ur: EBM ki battery detection cable nahi hai, is liye unit maan leta hai ke koi battery nahi.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug the mains, then use insulated gloves and tools on the battery connector.
solutions.ur: UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein, phir battery connector par insulated gloves aur tools use karein.

solutions.en: Push the EBM power cable and battery detection cable in quickly and firmly, then confirm both are latched.
solutions.ur: EBM power cable aur battery detection cable tez aur mazbooti se push karein, phir confirm karein ke dono latch ho gaye hain.

solutions.en: Check that the battery voltage is present with a DMM before re-inserting, to rule out a dead string.
solutions.ur: Dohasne se pehle DMM se battery voltage maujood hai ya nahi confirm kar lein, taake marri hui string ka pata chale.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.ur: A612 Battery test fail ho gaya

meaning.en: The automatic or user-started battery test failed, which normally means the string can no longer carry the load.
meaning.ur: Automatic ya user-start kiya hua battery test fail ho gaya, jo aam tor par matlab hai ke string ab load nahi utha sakti.

causes.en: The batteries are aged, degraded or already deeply discharged.
causes.ur: Batteries purani, degrade ya poori tarah discharge ho chuki hain.

causes.en: A cell in the string is open or shorted.
causes.ur: String mein koi aik cell khula ya short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: The battery string is not fully charged, so the test aborts or fails.
causes.ur: Battery string poori tarah charged nahi hai, is liye test ruk jata hai ya fail ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Charge the batteries for 48 hours on utility power before judging the test result.
solutions.ur: Test ka faisla lagane se pehle batteries ko 48 ghante utility power par charge karein.

solutions.en: With mains and battery isolated, measure each cell voltage with a DMM; any cell far out of line must be replaced.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karke DMM se har cell ka voltage maarein; line se bahar ka koi bhi cell replace karna hoga.

solutions.en: Replace the battery string and rerun the test (press the test button for more than 5 seconds in Normal mode with no active alarms).
solutions.ur: Battery string replace karein aur test dobara chalayein (Normal mode mein koi active alarm na ho, test button 5 se zyada second dabayein).

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.ur: A80E Overload Prealarm (load zyada hone ki warning)

meaning.en: The load has passed the overload pre-alarm threshold but has not yet reached the hard 105% trip.
meaning.ur: Load overload pre-alarm threshold cross kar chuka hai magar abhi 105% hard trip tak nahi pohanch chuka.

causes.en: Connected load has grown beyond the safe proportion of the UPS rating.
causes.ur: Connected load UPS rating ke mehfoor se barh kar safe limit cross kar gaya hai.

causes.en: Equipment that should be on bypass or a separate supply is plugged into the UPS output.
causes.ur: Bypass ya alag supply par honay wala equipment UPS output mein plug kar diya gaya hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off and disconnect the output before removing or re-dividing loads.
solutions.ur: Load hatane ya dobara baantne se pehle UPS band karein aur output disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure the output current on the LCD's load percentage and confirm it against the nameplate kVA.
solutions.ur: LCD ke load percentage par output current dekhein aur nameplate kVA se confirm karein.

solutions.en: Unplug non-essential loads until the display shows the load percentage back under 100%.
solutions.ur: Jab tak display ka load percentage 100% ke neeche na aaye, ghair zaroori loads nikaalte jayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

meaning.en: The load percentage is above 105%, so the UPS is running into its overload condition.
meaning.ur: Load percentage 105% se upar hai, is liye UPS overload condition mein chal raha hai.

causes.en: Load above the UPS capacity was connected deliberately.
causes.ur: UPS capacity se zyada load jaanbujhkar lagaya gaya hai.

causes.en: Several devices were switched on together, such as after a power cut or a generator start.
causes.ur: Power cut ya generator start ke baad kai devices aik saath on kar diye gaye.

solutions.en: Reduce the load to within the threshold of 100% (or the user threshold in the case of code A80E).
solutions.ur: Load ko 100% threshold ke andar laayein (code A80E ke haal mein user threshold tak).

solutions.en: If the display shows a Fault:, remove the load and switch the UPS off and back on again.
solutions.ur: Agar display par Fault: aaye to load hata dein aur UPS band karke dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Stagger large loads with a contactor or a delayed outlet so the UPS never sees the full step.
solutions.ur: Bade loads ko contactor ya delayed outlet ke saath stagger karein taake UPS kabhi poora step na dekhe.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.en: F004 Inner temperature high / UPS over temp
title.ur: F004 Andar ka temperature zyada hai / UPS garm

meaning.en: Listed twice in the manual: as a minor fault 'Inner temperature high' and as a major fault 'UPS Over temperature fault' that powers off the inverter.
meaning.ur: Manual mein do baar likha hai: minor fault ke taur par 'Inner temperature high' aur major fault ke taur par 'UPS Over temperature fault' jo inverter band kar deta hai.

causes.en: The temperature inside the UPS is too high because a fan has failed.
causes.ur: Fan kharab hone ki wajah se UPS ke andar temperature bohat zyada ho gaya hai.

causes.en: The intake or exhaust vents are blocked or the unit is in a hot enclosed cupboard.
causes.ur: Intake ya exhaust vents band hain ya unit garmi bhare band cabinet mein rakha hai.

solutions.en: Check that the fan is working normally first, then check the Inverter NTC is not damaged.
solutions.ur: Pehle check karein ke fan theek chal raha hai, phir check karein ke Inverter NTC damage nahi hua.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug mains, clear the vents and give the unit airflow; then measure ambient temperature with a thermometer.
solutions.ur: UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein, vents saaf karein aur unit ko hawa ka raasta dein; phir thermometer se ambient temperature maarein.

solutions.en: If the fan does not spin after mains is restored, replace the fan module with the UPS isolated.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane ke baad bhi fan na ghoome to UPS isolate karke fan module replace karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

meaning.en: Minor fault: the UPS has detected that a cooling fan is blocked, so it will soon be running hot.
meaning.ur: Minor fault: UPS ne detect kiya ke ek cooling fan band hai, is liye jald hi UPS garm hone lagega.

causes.en: Dust or a cable is physically blocking the fan blade.
causes.ur: Dhool ya koi cable fan blade ko physically block kar rahi hai.

causes.en: The fan bearing has seized so the blade does not turn freely.
causes.ur: Fan ka bearing jam chuka hai is liye blade azaad nahi ghoom raha.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug mains and wait 5 minutes before opening any vent.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi vent kholne se pehle UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein aur 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Clean the fan and vents with a soft brush or vacuum; remove any cable caught in the blade.
solutions.ur: Fan aur vents ko narm brush ya vacuum se saaf karein; blade mein phansi koi cable nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Spin the fan by hand with mains disconnected; if it is stiff or scrapes, replace the fan module.
solutions.ur: Mains disconnect karte hue fan ko haath se ghumayein; agar sast ya chharcha raha ho to fan module replace karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

meaning.en: Minor fault: the battery charger has failed, so the battery will not be recharged properly.
meaning.ur: Minor fault: battery charger kharab ho gaya hai, is liye battery theek se recharge nahi hogi.

causes.en: The charger fuse or the charger board has failed open.
causes.ur: Charger fuse ya charger board open ho chuka hai.

causes.en: Charger output sense circuit is faulty, so it is switching itself off.
causes.ur: Charger output sense circuit kharab hai, is liye charger khud band ho raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug mains and isolate the battery before inspecting the charger circuit.
solutions.ur: Charger circuit dekhne se pehle UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check the charger input fuse and the AC input to the charger board with a DMM.
solutions.ur: DMM se charger input fuse aur charger board ka AC input check karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery current with a clamp meter on DC charge; no or very low charge current confirms charger failure.
solutions.ur: DC charge par clamp meter se battery current check karein; charge current na ya bohat kam ho to charger failure confirm hoti hai.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.ur: F208 Bypass output overload fault (bypass par load zyada)

meaning.en: The bypass branch output is overloaded. Load is not powered while this is active.
meaning.ur: Bypass branch ka output overloaded hai. Is ke chalte load powered nahi rehta.

causes.en: The load exceeds the bypass branch rating, which is often lower than the inverter rating.
causes.ur: Load bypass branch ki rating se zyada hai, jo aksar inverter rating se kam hoti hai.

causes.en: Bypass output current sensing or the bypass branch current transformer is faulty.
causes.ur: Bypass output current sensing ya bypass branch ka current transformer kharab hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off and disconnect the output before re-dividing the load.
solutions.ur: Load dobara baantne se pehle UPS band karein aur output disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure the bypass output current with a clamp meter and compare it with the bypass rating on the nameplate.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se bypass output current maarein aur nameplate par diye gaye bypass rating se tulna karein.

solutions.en: Move the excess load to a separate bypass-fed distribution board so the UPS bypass branch is not overloaded.
solutions.ur: Zyada load ko alag bypass-fed distribution board par le jaayein taake UPS ka bypass branch overloaded na ho.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

meaning.en: The DC bus voltage has risen above its limit, so the inverter is switched off and the load is on bypass.
meaning.ur: DC bus voltage apni limit se upar chala gaya hai, is liye inverter band ho gaya aur load bypass par hai.

causes.en: Charger output is too high (see A502) and is over-charging the bus.
causes.ur: Charger output bohat zyada hai (A502 dekhein) aur bus ko zyada charge kar raha hai.

causes.en: The load is too light, so the bus rises when the charger is at full output.
causes.ur: Load bohat kam hai, is liye charger full output par hote hue bus voltage barh jaata hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery configuration in the Battery settings menu matches the installed string.
solutions.ur: Battery settings menu mein battery configuration installed string se match karta hai ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure the DC bus voltage with a rated DMM.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karke rated DMM se DC bus voltage maarein.

solutions.en: Have the charger output and bus sensing checked by an Eaton service engineer.
solutions.ur: Charger output aur bus sensing ki jaanch Eaton service engineer se karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

meaning.en: Second over-voltage variant of the DC bus fault on the 1-3kVA platform; the inverter is off.
meaning.ur: 1-3kVA platform par DC bus fault ka over-voltage doosra variant; inverter band hai.

causes.en: A mains transient or unstable supply pushed the bus above its limit.
causes.ur: Mains ka transient ya unstable supply bus ko limit se upar le gaya.

causes.en: A bulk capacitor on the bus has failed or leaked.
causes.ur: Bus ka koi bulk capacitor fail ya leak kar gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery before opening the cabinet; DC bus is lethal even when off.
solutions.ur: Cabinet kholne se pehle mains aur battery isolate karein; band hone par bhi DC bus khatarnaak hota hai.

solutions.en: Measure the DC bus voltage and each bulk capacitor voltage with a rated DMM.
solutions.ur: Rated DMM se DC bus voltage aur har bulk capacitor ka voltage maarein.

solutions.en: Book Eaton service for bus capacitor replacement; do not keep power-cycling the unit.
solutions.ur: Bus capacitor tabdeeli ke liye Eaton service bulayein; unit ko baar baar power-cycle na karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

meaning.en: The DC bus voltage is below the minimum the inverter needs, so the inverter is off and the load is on bypass.
meaning.ur: DC bus voltage inverter ke minimum se neeche hai, is liye inverter band hai aur load bypass par hai.

causes.en: Battery string is disconnected, flat or dead, so the bus cannot be held up.
causes.ur: Battery string disconnect, flat ya marri hui hai, is liye bus upar nahi reh sakta.

causes.en: Input AC is missing or out of range, so the rectifier cannot charge the bus.
causes.ur: Input AC missing ya range se bahar hai, is liye rectifier bus charge nahi kar sakta.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug mains and isolate the battery before touching the battery connector.
solutions.ur: Battery connector chhoone se pehle UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery string open-circuit voltage with a DMM; a dead string reads far below nominal.
solutions.ur: DMM se battery string ka open-circuit voltage maarein; marri hui string nominal se kaafi neeche parhengi.

solutions.en: Check the input breaker, fuses and pre-charge contactor, then charge the battery for 48 hours on utility.
solutions.ur: Input breaker, fuses aur pre-charge contactor check karein, phir 48 ghante utility par battery charge karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

meaning.en: Second under-voltage variant of the DC bus fault; the inverter cannot start and the load is on bypass.
meaning.ur: DC bus fault ka under-voltage doosra variant; inverter start nahi ho sakta aur load bypass par hai.

causes.en: The battery string has aged and its end-of-discharge voltage trips the unit early.
causes.ur: Battery string purani ho gayi hai aur us ka end-of-discharge voltage unit ko jaldi trip kar deta hai.

causes.en: Battery string voltage sense circuit is reading incorrectly low.
causes.ur: Battery string voltage sense circuit galat low reading kar raha hai.

causes.en: EBM is unplugged or its detection cable is missing while other EBMs are fitted.
causes.ur: EBM plug nahi hai ya us ki detection cable missing hai jabke doosre EBM lage hue hain.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure the string voltage and each EBM's fuse with a DMM.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karke DMM se string voltage aur har EBM ka fuse check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm every EBM power cable and battery detection cable is fully seated and latched.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke har EBM power cable aur battery detection cable poori tarah baithi hui aur latch hui hain.

solutions.en: Replace the aged battery string as a set if the measured voltage is below the manual's minimum.
solutions.ur: Measured voltage manual ke minimum se neeche ho to purani battery string set ke taur par replace karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

meaning.en: The DC bus capacitor voltages are out of balance beyond tolerance, so the inverter is off and the load is on bypass.
meaning.ur: DC bus ke capacitor voltages tolerance se bahar unbalanced hain, is liye inverter band hai aur load bypass par hai.

causes.en: A bus capacitor has degraded or leaked, so bus halves charge unequally.
causes.ur: Bus ka koi capacitor degrade ya leak ho gaya hai, is liye bus ke do hisse barabar charge nahi hote.

causes.en: Bus balancing or voltage sensing circuit is faulty.
causes.ur: Bus balancing ya voltage sensing circuit kharab hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery first; the DC bus stays live after switch-off.
solutions.ur: Pehle mains aur battery isolate karein; band karne ke baad bhi DC bus live rehta hai.

solutions.en: Measure each bus capacitor's voltage with a DMM and compare the two halves of the bus.
solutions.ur: DMM se har bus capacitor ka voltage maarein aur bus ke dono hisson ko tulna karein.

solutions.en: Have the balancing circuit and capacitors serviced by Eaton; do not reset without the diagnosis.
solutions.ur: Balancing circuit aur capacitors ki servicing Eaton se karwayein; diagnosis ke baghair reset na karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.en: F305 DC Bus Failure on soft start
title.ur: F305 DC Bus soft start par fail

meaning.en: The bus soft-start circuit failed to charge the capacitors in a controlled way, so the inverter stays off.
meaning.ur: Bus soft-start circuit ne capacitors ko controlled tareeqe se charge nahi kar paya, is liye inverter band reh gaya.

causes.en: The pre-charge resistor or soft-start relay has failed open.
causes.ur: Pre-charge resistor ya soft-start relay open ho chuka hai.

causes.en: A bus capacitor is shorted, so the ramp cannot complete.
causes.ur: Bus ka koi capacitor short ho gaya hai, is liye ramp poora nahi ho sakta.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug mains and isolate the battery before opening the cabinet.
solutions.ur: Cabinet kholne se pehle UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check the pre-charge resistor chain and the soft-start relay for continuity with a DMM.
solutions.ur: DMM se pre-charge resistor chain aur soft-start relay ki continuity check karein.

solutions.en: Book Eaton service for soft-start circuit and capacitor replacement.
solutions.ur: Soft-start circuit aur capacitor tabdeeli ke liye Eaton service bulayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.ur: F308 DC Bus short ho gaya

meaning.en: A short circuit has been detected on the DC bus, so the UPS has shut down to protect itself.
meaning.ur: DC bus par short circuit detect hua hai, is liye UPS ne apni hifazat ke liye band ho gaya.

causes.en: A bus capacitor has failed short.
causes.ur: Bus ka koi capacitor short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: The battery string is wired with reversed polarity or a cell is shorted.
causes.ur: Battery string polarity ulti jore hue hai ya koi cell short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Charger output or a power component has failed short.
causes.ur: Charger output ya koi power component short ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Do not power the unit again. Switch off, unplug mains and isolate the battery first.
solutions.ur: Unit ko dobara power na dein. Band karein, mains nikaal dein aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: With the battery disconnected, measure resistance across the bus with a DMM; a very low reading means a hard short.
solutions.ur: Battery disconnect karne ke baad DMM se bus par resistance maarein; bohat kam reading ka matlab hai hard short.

solutions.en: Have the bus capacitors and battery string tested by an Eaton service engineer before re-powering.
solutions.ur: Dobara power dene se pehle bus capacitors aur battery string ki test Eaton service engineer se karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.ur: F613 Battery over voltage (battery voltage zyada)

meaning.en: The battery string voltage has exceeded the safe maximum, which can destroy the cells.
meaning.ur: Battery string voltage apni safe maximum se cross kar gaya hai, jis se cells kharab ho sakte hain.

causes.en: Charger output voltage is misconfigured or the charger is faulty (see A502).
causes.ur: Charger output voltage ki configuration ghalat hai ya charger kharab hai (A502 dekhein).

causes.en: The wrong battery type/voltage was selected in the setup menu.
causes.ur: Setup menu mein ghalat battery type/voltage chuna gaya hai.

causes.en: Temperature compensation is disabled while the ambient temperature is very low, so the charge voltage stays too high.
causes.ur: Temperature compensation band hai jabke ambient temperature bohat kam hai, is liye charge voltage zyada hi rehta hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug mains and isolate the battery immediately to stop further charging.
solutions.ur: Charge band karne ke liye UPS foran band karein, mains nikaal dein aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure each cell voltage with a DMM and compare it with the cell manufacturer's maximum charge voltage.
solutions.ur: DMM se har cell ka voltage maarein aur cell manufacturer ki maximum charge voltage se tulna karein.

solutions.en: Correct the battery type/voltage setting and temperature compensation, then have the charger board tested.
solutions.ur: Battery type/voltage setting aur temperature compensation theek karein, phir charger board ki test karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.ur: F70C Inverter under voltage (inverter voltage kam)

meaning.en: The inverter output voltage fell below its acceptable window, so the UPS has shut the inverter down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output voltage apni ijazat ke neeche gir gaya, is liye UPS ne inverter band kar diya.

causes.en: DC bus too low because the battery is flat or the charger is not working.
causes.ur: DC bus bohat kam hai kyunke battery flat hai ya charger nahi chal raha.

causes.en: Output overload or a heavy inrush load pulling the output down.
causes.ur: Output overload hai ya koi bada inrush load output kheench raha hai.

causes.en: Inverter output voltage sensing or the inverter board has failed.
causes.ur: Inverter output voltage sensing ya inverter board kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Remove the excess load first, then restart the UPS and see whether F70C clears.
solutions.ur: Pehle zyada load hata dein, phir UPS restart karke dekhein ke F70C clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure the DC bus voltage with a DMM against the manual specification.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karke DMM se DC bus voltage maarein aur manual ki specification se tulna karein.

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage on battery with a true-RMS DMM at the output terminal block.
solutions.ur: Battery par true-RMS DMM se output terminal block ka output voltage maarein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

meaning.en: The inverter output voltage rose above its acceptable window, so the UPS has shut the inverter down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output voltage apni ijazat se upar chala gaya, is liye UPS ne inverter band kar diya.

causes.en: Output voltage setting is too high for the connected load.
causes.ur: Output voltage setting connected load ke liye bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Output is very lightly loaded, so the inverter steps the voltage up.
causes.ur: Output bohat kam load par hai, is liye inverter voltage barha deta hai.

causes.en: Inverter output voltage sensing or the inverter board has failed.
causes.ur: Inverter output voltage sensing ya inverter board kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Read the configured output voltage in the Setup menu and confirm it against the load's rated voltage.
solutions.ur: Setup menu se configured output voltage parhein aur load ki rated voltage se confirm karein.

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage with a true-RMS DMM at the output terminal block.
solutions.ur: True-RMS DMM se output terminal block par output voltage maarein.

solutions.en: Have the inverter output sensing calibrated by an Eaton service engineer.
solutions.ur: Inverter output sensing ki calibration Eaton service engineer se karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.en: F704 Inverter soft start failure / INV capacitor
title.ur: F704 Inverter soft start fail / INV capacitor

meaning.en: The inverter soft start failed, or the inverter capacitors have reduced in value, so the UPS will not come onto the line.
meaning.ur: Inverter soft start fail ho gaya, ya inverter capacitors ki value gir gayi hai, is liye UPS line par nahi aayega.

causes.en: DC bus voltage out of range at the moment the inverter was started.
causes.ur: Inverter start karte waqt DC bus voltage range se bahar tha.

causes.en: Inverter DC-link capacitors have lost capacitance (this is why the manual names the capacitors in the same row).
causes.ur: Inverter DC-link capacitors ki capacity gir chuki hai (is liye manual usi row mein capacitors ka zikr karta hai).

causes.en: Inverter IGBT/gate drive failure, or an output short or heavy overload.
causes.ur: Inverter IGBT/gate drive ki kharabi, ya output short ya bohat zyada overload.

solutions.en: If possible disconnect the power to the load, switch the UPS off and back on again.
solutions.ur: Ho sake to load ki power disconnect karein, UPS band karke dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure DC bus voltage and check the inverter DC-link capacitors with a capacitance meter.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karke DC bus voltage maarein aur capacitance meter se inverter DC-link capacitors check karein.

solutions.en: If the problem occurs again, call the support center - the inverter module needs service.
solutions.ur: Agar masla dobara aaye to support centre ko call karein - inverter module ki servicing zaroori hai.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

meaning.en: A short circuit has been detected on the inverter output; a load powered by the UPS is faulty.
meaning.ur: Inverter output par short circuit detect hua hai; UPS se power lene wala koi load kharab hai.

causes.en: There is a fault on one or more of the loads powered by the UPS.
causes.ur: UPS se power lene walay loads mein kisi aik ya zyada par fault hai.

causes.en: Output wiring is damaged or shorted to the chassis.
causes.ur: Output wiring damage hui hai ya chassis se short ho gayi hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off and disconnect all output loads before touching any wiring.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi wiring ko chhoone se pehle UPS band karein aur saare output loads disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all the utilities, switch the UPS off and back on again, reconnect the loads one at a time to identify which one is faulty.
solutions.ur: Saari utilities disconnect karein, UPS band karke dobara on karein, phir loads aik aik karke dobara lagayein taake kaunsa kharab hai pata chale.

solutions.en: Test each suspect load and cable for continuity and insulation with a DMM before reconnecting.
solutions.ur: Dohasne se pehle har shakhs load aur cable ko DMM se continuity aur insulation ke liye test karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.ur: F806 E-P-O control active (emergency power off)

meaning.en: On the 1-3kVA 9E the Emergency Power Off input is reported as a FAULT, not an alarm (it is A806 on the 6-20kVA 9E).
meaning.ur: 1-3kVA 9E par Emergency Power Off input ko FAULT ke taur par report kiya gaya hai, alarm nahi (6-20kVA 9E par ye A806 hai).

causes.en: The EPO input contact has been closed by the remote EPO switch.
causes.ur: Remote EPO switch ne EPO input contact band kar diya hai.

causes.en: The EPO wiring loop breaker is open or the connector is missing.
causes.ur: EPO wiring loop breaker khula hai ya connector missing hai.

solutions.en: Find out why EPO was triggered before you reset anything; the cause may be a fire-alarm or a person.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi reset karne se pehle dekhein ke EPO kyun trigger hua; wajah koi fire-alarm ya koi shakhs ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: With the unit in maintenance bypass, measure the EPO terminal pair; it must be open for normal running.
solutions.ur: Unit ko maintenance bypass par rakhein aur EPO terminal pair voltage maarein; normal chalne par woh open hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Reset the EPO breaker, then press any front-panel button once to acknowledge and clear the fault.
solutions.ur: EPO breaker reset karein, phir front panel ka koi bhi button aik baar dabayein taake fault acknowledge aur clear ho.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.ur: F808 Inverter output overload fault (load zyada)

meaning.en: The inverter output is overloaded and the inverter has been switched off; the load is unprotected or on bypass.
meaning.ur: Inverter output overloaded hai aur inverter band kar diya gaya hai; load unprotected hai ya bypass par hai.

causes.en: The load applied to the UPS is too high; earlier A80E/A810 alarms were not acted on.
causes.ur: UPS par lagaya hua load bohat zyada hai; pehle ke A80E/A810 alarms par action nahi hua.

causes.en: A large motor or compressor inrush was switched on during a battery discharge.
causes.ur: Battery discharge ke doran koi bada motor ya compressor inrush on kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Reduce the load to within the threshold of 100% (or the user threshold in the case of code A80E).
solutions.ur: Load ko 100% threshold ke andar laayein (code A80E ke haal mein user threshold tak).

solutions.en: If the display shows a Fault:, remove the load and switch the UPS off and back on again.
solutions.ur: Agar display par Fault: aaye to load hata dein aur UPS band karke dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter and permanently move part of it to a bypass-fed outlet.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load naaphein aur us ka kuch hissa mustaqil bypass-fed outlet par le jaayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 1-3 kVA (online UPS 1-3kVA + 9E EBM)

title.ur: F816 Model Pin detect error (model pin detect nahi hua)

meaning.en: The UPS could not read the model identification pins, so it has refused to start correctly.
meaning.ur: UPS ne model identification pins parhein nahi sake, is liye us ne theek se start karne se inkaar kar diya.

causes.en: The model/Pin setting straps or jumpers on the power board are missing or wrongly fitted.
causes.ur: Power board par model/Pin setting straps ya jumpers nahi hain ya galat lagi hain.

causes.en: The control board was replaced and the Pin detection was not configured for the new model.
causes.ur: Control board badla gaya tha aur Pin detection naye model ke liye configure nahi kiya gaya.

causes.en: The Pin detect circuit or its connector is faulty.
causes.ur: Pin detect circuit ya us ka connector kharab hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug mains and isolate the battery before opening the cabinet.
solutions.ur: Cabinet kholne se pehle UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the model Pin jumpers/straps on the power board and reseat the Pin detect connector.
solutions.ur: Power board par model Pin jumpers/straps dekhein aur Pin detect connector dobara baitha dein.

solutions.en: Quote the model number and serial number to Eaton support; this fault needs configuration, not parts swapping.
solutions.ur: Model number aur serial number Eaton support ko dein; ye fault configuration ka hai, parts badalne ka nahi.

source.title: Eaton 9E 1kVA-3kVA UPS - Eaton 9E EBM - Advance user guide

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

meaning.en: One or more cooling fans are blocked or have stopped, so the UPS is overheating.
meaning.ur: Ek ya zyada cooling fan band ya kharaab hai, jis ki wajah se UPS garmi se bhar raha hai.

causes.en: Dust or debris blocking the fan intake or exhaust grille.
causes.ur: Fan ke intake ya exhaust grill par dhool ya mochir ki gaddi lagi hui hai.

causes.en: Fan motor has failed or the fan is jammed mechanically.
causes.ur: Fan ka motor kharab ho gaya ya fan mechanically atak gaya hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off, unplug the mains and wait 5 minutes before touching the fan area.
solutions.ur: UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein aur fan area chhoone se pehle 5 minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Suck out dust from the fan intake and exhaust grille with a brush or vacuum cleaner.
solutions.ur: Fan ke intake aur exhaust grill ki dhool brush ya vacuum cleaner se saaf karein.

solutions.en: Measure DC bus voltage with a multimeter; if the fan is dead and the bus reads near 0 Vdc, replace the fan module.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se DC bus voltage maarein; agar fan mar chuka hai aur bus 0 Vdc ke qareeb hai to fan module replace karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.ur: A107 Cable connection error / wiring ghalat

meaning.en: The input wiring is wrong, most often line and neutral swapped at the input terminal block.
meaning.ur: Input wiring ghalat hai, aksar input terminal block par line aur neutral aapas mein badal diye gaye hain.

causes.en: Line and neutral conductors reversed at the input terminal block.
causes.ur: Input terminal block par line aur neutral conductors aapas mein badle hue hain.

causes.en: Input cable not fully tightened on the terminal, causing an open or loose connection.
causes.ur: Input cable terminal par poori tarah kasa nahi, connection khula ya dhila ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Turn the input breaker OFF, then use a multimeter or a non-contact voltage tester to identify live and neutral.
solutions.ur: Input breaker OFF karein, phir multimeter ya non-contact voltage tester se live aur neutral pehchanein.

solutions.en: Reconnect the input cable with correct polarity and torque the terminal screws firmly.
