solutions.ur: Input cable theek polarity par dobara lagayein aur terminal screws ko mazbooti se kheench lein.

solutions.en: Check earth continuity (<1 ohm) between the chassis earth terminal and the panel earth bar.
solutions.ur: Chassis earth terminal aur panel earth bar ke darmiyan earth continuity (1 ohm se kam) check karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

meaning.en: On a three-phase input the three phase-to-neutral voltages differ too much from each other.
meaning.ur: Teen phase input par teen phase-to-neutral voltages aapas mein bohat zyada farq se hain.

causes.en: Utility supply or upstream generator is producing unbalanced phase voltages.
causes.ur: Utility supply ya upstream generator unbalanced phase voltages bana raha hai.

causes.en: One phase conductor is loose, has a high-resistance joint, or a phase fuse has blown.
causes.ur: Kisi aik phase ka conductor dhila hai, us par high-resistance joint hai, ya phase fuse ud chuka hai.

causes.en: Load is heavily single-phase on one leg of a three-phase supply.
causes.ur: Teen phase supply par load kisi aik leg par zyada single-phase hai.

solutions.en: Measure all three line-to-neutral voltages and all three line-to-line voltages with a clamp multimeter or DMM.
solutions.ur: Teenon line-to-neutral aur teenon line-to-line voltages clamp multimeter ya DMM se maarein.

solutions.en: Tighten all phase connections and check each phase fuse in the upstream distribution board.
solutions.ur: Sab phase connections kheench lein aur upstream distribution board ka har phase fuse check karein.

solutions.en: If the supply itself is unbalanced, ask the utility or generator owner to correct it before running the UPS.
solutions.ur: Agar supply hi unbalanced hai to UPS chalane se pehle utility ya generator owner se usay theek karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.ur: A806 E.P.O control active (emergency power off)

meaning.en: The remote Emergency Power Off input is active, so the UPS has been driven to a shut-down state.
meaning.ur: Remote Emergency Power Off input active hai, is liye UPS ko shutdown state par le aaya gaya hai.

causes.en: The EPO wall switch or contact has been pressed by someone, possibly accidentally.
causes.ur: EPO wall switch ya contact kisi ne press kar diya hai, shayad ghalti se.

causes.en: The EPO circuit-breaker in the EPO wiring loop has tripped or been left open.
causes.ur: EPO wiring loop ka EPO circuit-breaker trip ho gaya hai ya khula chhoda gaya hai.

causes.en: Building fire-alarm or BMS contact wired into the EPO input has closed.
causes.ur: Building fire-alarm ya BMS contact jo EPO input se juri hai woh band ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Do not reset the UPS yet. Go and find out why EPO was activated.
solutions.ur: Abhi UPS reset na karein. Pehle dekhein ke EPO activate kyun hua.

solutions.en: With the UPS in maintenance bypass, measure the EPO terminal pair; it must read open (no continuity) for normal running.
solutions.ur: UPS ko maintenance bypass par rakhein, EPO terminal pair voltage maarein; normal chalne par woh open hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Reset the EPO breaker, then press any front-panel button once to acknowledge and clear the alarm.
solutions.ur: EPO breaker reset karein, phir front panel ka koi bhi button aik baar dabayein taake alarm clear ho.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

meaning.en: The connected load is above 105% of the UPS rated output, so an overload fault is imminent.
meaning.ur: Connected load UPS rated output ke 105% se zyada hai, is liye overload fault ka khatra hai.

causes.en: Too much equipment connected, or load was added without resizing the UPS.
causes.ur: Bohat zyada equipment lagaya gaya hai, ya UPS resize kiye baghair load barha diya gaya hai.

causes.en: A single large motor or compressor with high inrush current on the output.
causes.ur: Output par koi aik bada motor ya compressor hai jis ka inrush current bohat zyada hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off and disconnect the output loads before changing anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi badalne se pehle UPS band karein aur output loads disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the output current on each phase with a clamp meter; it must be below the rated output current.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se har phase ka output current maarein; woh rated output current se kam hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Remove non-essential loads one at a time until the load percentage on the display drops below 100%.
solutions.ur: Display par load percentage 100% se neeche aane tak ek aik karke ghair zaroori loads nikaalte jayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.ur: A810 Load % user threshold se upar

meaning.en: The load percentage has crossed the user-configured warning threshold, before the hard overload limit.
meaning.ur: Load percentage ne user-configured warning threshold cross kar liya hai, hard overload limit se pehle hi.

causes.en: The user-configured load warning threshold has been reached by normal growth of the load.
causes.ur: Normal load badhne se user-configured load warning threshold reach ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Non-essential equipment was left connected on the output.
causes.ur: Output par ghair zaroori equipment chhoda gaya hai.

solutions.en: Read the load percentage on the LCD and compare it with the UPS kVA rating on the nameplate.
solutions.ur: LCD par load percentage parhein aur UPS kVA rating ke saath nameplate se compare karein.

solutions.en: Raise or lower the threshold in the User Settings menu if the site genuinely runs at this load.
solutions.ur: Agar site asal mein isi load par chalta hai to User Settings menu mein threshold barha ya gira dein.

solutions.en: Plan an upgrade to the next kVA size before the threshold becomes a hard overload.
solutions.ur: Threshold hard overload banne se pehle agle kVA size par upgrade ka plan banayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.en: A60D Batteries missing / box not connected
title.ur: A60D Batteries missing ya battery box connect nahi

meaning.en: The UPS cannot see its internal battery string or the external battery box; backup time is not available.
meaning.ur: UPS ko apni internal battery string ya external battery box nazar nahi aa rahi; backup time maujood nahi.

causes.en: The battery box is not inserted or its connector is unplugged.
causes.ur: Battery box insert nahi hai ya us ka connector nahi laga hua.

causes.en: A battery connector or harness is loose, corroded, or broken.
causes.ur: Battery connector ya harness dhila, zang khaa ya toota hua hai.

causes.en: The external battery breaker on the battery cabinet is open.
causes.ur: Battery cabinet ka external battery breaker khula hua hai.

solutions.en: Transfer the load to bypass, switch the UPS off, unplug the mains, then use insulated tools and gloves.
solutions.ur: Load ko bypass par transfer karein, UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein, phir insulated tools aur gloves use karein.

solutions.en: Inspect the battery box connector and the battery harness for loose, bent or corroded pins.
solutions.ur: Battery box connector aur battery harness ke pins ko dhile, tute ya zang khaye hue hone ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Measure DC voltage across the battery box terminals with a DMM; 240 Vdc nominal (180 Vdc for 1-3kVA units) is expected.
solutions.ur: DMM se battery box terminals par DC voltage maarein; 240 Vdc nominal (1-3kVA par 180 Vdc) hona chahiye.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.ur: A802 Low battery (battery kam ho gayi)

meaning.en: The UPS is on battery discharge and the battery has reached its low-charge warning level.
meaning.ur: UPS battery par chal raha hai aur battery low-charge warning level par aa chuki hai.

causes.en: The mains has failed and the UPS is running down its stored charge.
causes.ur: Mains chala gaya hai aur UPS apna stored charge khatam kar raha hai.

causes.en: The battery string has aged and no longer holds its rated capacity.
causes.ur: Battery string purani ho chuki hai aur rated capacity nahi rakh sakti.

solutions.en: Save your work and shut down non-essential equipment immediately, before the UPS cuts out.
solutions.ur: Apna kaam bacha lein aur UPS band hone se pehle ghair zaroori equipment foran band kar dein.

solutions.en: Read the remaining runtime and battery level from the LCD or the backlit button panel.
solutions.ur: LCD ya backlit button panel se baaqi runtime aur battery level parhein.

solutions.en: Once mains returns, let the UPS charge on utility for at least 8 hours (48 h for a full runtime check).
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par UPS ko kam az kam 8 ghante (poori runtime check ke liye 48 ghante) utility par charge karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.ur: AC20 Manual Bypass mode chal raha hai

meaning.en: The UPS has been commanded into manual bypass, so the load is on the raw bypass supply and is not protected.
meaning.ur: UPS ko manual bypass par command diya gaya hai, is liye load raw bypass supply par hai aur protected nahi.

causes.en: A technician placed the unit in manual bypass for maintenance work and left it there.
causes.ur: Kisi technician ne maintenance ke liye unit ko manual bypass par rakha aur wapas nahi kiya.

causes.en: The static switch latched into bypass after a previous overload or fault.
causes.ur: Pehle ke overload ya fault ke baad static switch bypass par latch ho gaya.

solutions.en: Confirm on the mimic screen whether the unit was deliberately put into bypass for maintenance.
solutions.ur: Mimic screen par check karein ke unit ko maintenance ke liye jaanbujh kar bypass kiya gaya tha ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check the load is fully transferred and stable on bypass, then use the Controls menu to return the UPS to Normal mode.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke load poori tarah bypass par transfer ho chuka hai aur stable hai, phir Controls menu se UPS ko Normal mode par laayein.

solutions.en: Read the Event log to see which alarm or command sent the unit to bypass, and fix that cause.
solutions.ur: Event log parhein ke kaunsa alarm ya command unit ko bypass par le gaya, aur us wajah ko theek karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

meaning.en: The rear maintenance bypass switch is closed, so the load is bypassing the UPS completely and gets no protection.
meaning.ur: Peeche maintenance bypass switch band hai, is liye load poora bypass ho raha hai aur UPS se koi protection nahi mil rahi.

causes.en: The manual bypass switch at the back of the cabinet was closed for servicing.
causes.ur: Cabinet ke peeche wala manual bypass switch servicing ke liye band kar diya gaya tha.

causes.en: The switch was left closed after maintenance and the UPS was never returned to Normal.
causes.ur: Maintenance ke baad switch band reh gaya aur UPS kabhi Normal par wapas nahi aaya.

solutions.en: Open the maintenance bypass switch at the back of the UPS to take the unit out of maintenance bypass.
solutions.ur: Upar ke masle ko hal karne ke liye UPS ke peeche wala maintenance bypass switch khol dein.

solutions.en: With the switch open, press any control-panel button to acknowledge and clear the alarm.
solutions.ur: Switch kholne ke baad alarm acknowledge aur clear karne ke liye control panel ka koi bhi button dabayein.

solutions.en: Verify the Normal status indicator is on and the load is again fed through the power module.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke Normal status indicator on hai aur load dobara power module se aa raha hai.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.en: A004 UPS overtemperature (alarm half of A004/F004)
title.ur: A004 UPS zyada garm (A004/F004 ka alarm hissa)

meaning.en: Alarm half of the over-temperature pair. The internal temperature is above the warning level; F004 is the fault that follows it.
meaning.ur: Over-temperature pair ka alarm hissa. Andar ka temperature warning level se upar hai; iske baad F004 fault aata hai.

causes.en: The ambient temperature around the UPS exceeds 40 degrees C.
causes.ur: UPS ke aas paas ka ambient temperature 40 degree C se zyada hai.

causes.en: Intake or exhaust vents are blocked by dust or stacked equipment.
causes.ur: Intake ya exhaust vents dhool se ya upar rakhi cheezon se band hain.

causes.en: A cooling fan has failed and heat is building inside the cabinet.
causes.ur: Koi cooling fan kharab ho gaya hai aur cabinet ke andar garmi jama ho rahi hai.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature with a thermometer; the manual requires it to not exceed 40 degrees C.
solutions.ur: Thermometer se ambient temperature maarein; manual ke mutabiq ye 40 degree C se zyada na ho.

solutions.en: Clear the vents and remove any heat sources or equipment stacked on the unit.
solutions.ur: Vents saaf karein aur unit ke upar rakhi koi bhi cheez ya heat source hata dein.

solutions.en: Restart the UPS and confirm A004 no longer appears; if it returns, check the fan and the inverter NTC sensor.
solutions.ur: UPS restart karein aur confirm karein ke A004 dobara nahi aaya; agar wapas aaye to fan aur inverter NTC sensor check karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

meaning.en: General internal UPS fault. The inverter is off and the load has been thrown to the bypass line.
meaning.ur: Aam internal UPS fault. Inverter band hai aur load bypass line par daal diya gaya hai.

causes.en: An internal power-stage, control or sensing failure detected by the self-diagnosis.
causes.ur: Self-diagnosis ne andar ka power stage, control ya sensing ka kharabi detect ki.

causes.en: Often follows an earlier over-temperature, overload or DC bus fault that was not repaired.
causes.ur: Aksar is se pehle over-temperature, overload ya DC bus ka aisa fault aaya tha jo theek nahi kiya gaya.

solutions.en: If possible disconnect the power to the load, switch the UPS off and back on again.
solutions.ur: Ho sake to load ki power disconnect karein, UPS band karke dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Open the Event log and Fault log to read which preceding alarm led to F002.
solutions.ur: Event log aur Fault log kholein aur parhein ke kaunsa pehla alarm F002 ki wajah bana.

solutions.en: If the problem occurs again after the restart, call the Eaton support centre with the serial number.
solutions.ur: Restart ke baad masla dobara aaye to serial number le kar Eaton support centre ko call karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.ur: F004 Dissipator zyada garm ho gaya

meaning.en: The power-stage heatsink is over temperature. The inverter is switched off and the load runs on bypass.
meaning.ur: Power stage ka heatsink zyada garm ho gaya hai. Inverter band ho gaya hai aur load bypass par chal raha hai.

causes.en: The environment temperature around the UPS is above 40 degrees C.
causes.ur: UPS ke gird ka environment temperature 40 degree C se zyada hai.

causes.en: A cooling fan has stopped or is blocked, so heat cannot leave the cabinet.
causes.ur: Koi cooling fan band ho gaya ya block ho gaya hai, is liye cabinet se garmi nahi nikal sakti.

solutions.en: Check that the temperature of the environment in which the UPS is located does not exceed 40 degrees C.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke jis environment mein UPS lagi hai uska temperature 40 degree C se zyada na ho.

solutions.en: Check that the fan is working normally first, then check the inverter NTC is not damaged.
solutions.ur: Pehle check karein ke fan theek chal raha hai, phir inverter NTC damage na hua ho.

solutions.en: Clear the vents, give the unit airflow, then restart only after the temperature has dropped.
solutions.ur: Vents saaf karein, unit ko hawa ka raasta dein, phir temperature girne ke baad hi restart karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.ur: F300 Capacitor bank overvoltage (DC bus zyada wala)

meaning.en: The DC bus capacitor bank has charged above its safe limit, so the UPS has shut the inverter down.
meaning.ur: DC bus ka capacitor bank apni safe limit se upar charge ho gaya hai, is liye UPS ne inverter band kar diya.

causes.en: Charger output voltage is out of specification and is over-charging the bus.
causes.ur: Charger ka output voltage specification se bahar hai aur bus ko zyada charge kar raha hai.

causes.en: Bus voltage sensing or the rectifier control loop is faulty.
causes.ur: Bus voltage sensing ya rectifier control loop kharab hai.

solutions.en: Transfer the load to bypass, switch the UPS off and isolate mains and the battery before any measurement.
solutions.ur: Load bypass par transfer karein, UPS band karein aur koi bhi voltage naapne se pehle mains aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Measure each battery string voltage with a DMM; an over-charged string reads well above its nominal value.
solutions.ur: DMM se har battery string ka voltage maarein; zyada charge hui string nominal se kaafi upar parhengi.

solutions.en: Have the charger output and rectifier board checked by an Eaton service engineer; do not simply reset F300.
solutions.ur: Charger output aur rectifier board ki jaanch Eaton service engineer se karwayein; F300 ko sirf reset na karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.ur: F301 Capacitor bank overvoltage (DC bus zyada wala)

meaning.en: Second over-voltage variant of the DC capacitor bank fault on the same bus; inverter is off, load on bypass.
meaning.ur: DC capacitor bank ke over-voltage fault ka doosra variant isi bus par; inverter band, load bypass par.

causes.en: A transient or unstable utility feed pushed the DC bus above its limit.
causes.ur: Mains feed ka koi transient ya instability ne DC bus ko limit se upar le diya.

causes.en: Bulk capacitor has failed short or drifted out of tolerance.
causes.ur: Bulk capacitor short ho gaya ya tolerance se bahar chala gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery, then measure the DC bus voltage with a rated DMM.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karein, phir rated DMM se DC bus voltage maarein.

solutions.en: Check the input voltage at the UPS terminal block is inside the manual's allowed range.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke UPS terminal block par input voltage manual ki ijazat ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Escalate to Eaton service for bulk capacitor and rectifier inspection.
solutions.ur: Bulk capacitor aur rectifier ki jaanch ke liye Eaton service ko bulayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.ur: F302 Capacitor bank undervoltage (DC bus kam wala)

meaning.en: The DC bus capacitor bank has not reached its minimum operating voltage, so the inverter is off and the load is on bypass.
meaning.ur: DC bus ka capacitor bank apni minimum operating voltage tak nahi pohanch chuka, is liye inverter band hai aur load bypass par hai.

causes.en: Input AC is missing or out of range, so the rectifier cannot charge the bus.
causes.ur: Input AC missing ya range se bahar hai, is liye rectifier bus charge nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: The pre-charge or soft-start path is open, so the capacitors never take charge.
causes.ur: Pre-charge ya soft-start path khula hai, is liye capacitors kabhi charge nahi hote.

solutions.en: Measure the input line-to-neutral voltage at the input terminal block with a DMM while the UPS is off.
solutions.ur: UPS band karte hue DMM se input terminal block par line-to-neutral voltage maarein.

solutions.en: Check the input breaker, fuses and the pre-charge contactor are closed and energised.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke input breaker, fuses aur pre-charge contactor band aur energised hain.

solutions.en: Do not power-cycle repeatedly; book an Eaton technician to check the pre-charge circuit and capacitors.
solutions.ur: Baar baar power-cycle na karein; Eaton technician se pre-charge circuit aur capacitors check karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.ur: F303 Capacitor bank undervoltage (DC bus kam wala)

meaning.en: Second under-voltage variant of the DC capacitor bank fault; the inverter cannot start and the load is on bypass.
meaning.ur: DC capacitor bank ke under-voltage fault ka doosra variant; inverter start nahi ho sakta aur load bypass par hai.

causes.en: Battery string disconnected or open, so there is no DC source to charge the bus.
causes.ur: Battery string disconnect ya khuli hai, is liye bus ko charge karne ke liye koi DC source nahi.

causes.en: Input voltage persistently low, below the rectifier's working minimum.
causes.ur: Input voltage lagatar kam hai, rectifier ke minimum working voltage se neeche.

solutions.en: Check the battery string is connected and measure its open-circuit voltage with a DMM.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery string lagi hui hai aur DMM se us ka open-circuit voltage maarein.

solutions.en: Verify the external battery cabinet breaker is closed and the battery fuses are intact.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke external battery cabinet ka breaker band hai aur battery fuses salamat hain.

solutions.en: Have the rectifier and bus sensing checked by an Eaton service engineer.
solutions.ur: Rectifier aur bus sensing ki jaanch Eaton service engineer se karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.ur: F304 Unbalanced capacitor bank (DC bus asammulnot)

meaning.en: The DC bus capacitor voltages are not balanced within tolerance; the inverter is off and the load is on bypass.
meaning.ur: DC bus ke capacitor voltages tolerance ke andar balance nahi hain; inverter band hai aur load bypass par hai.

causes.en: One or more bus capacitors has degraded, lost capacitance or leaked.
causes.ur: Ek ya zyada bus capacitors degrade ho gaya, capacity khoyi ya leak kar raha hai.

causes.en: Bus voltage balancing/sensing circuit has drifted.
causes.ur: Bus voltage balancing/sensing circuit drift ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate mains and battery first, then measure each bus capacitor's voltage with a DMM and compare them.
solutions.ur: Pehle mains aur battery isolate karein, phir DMM se har bus capacitor ka voltage maarein aur tulna karein.

solutions.en: Any capacitor reading far from the others must be replaced as a matched set, not individually.
solutions.ur: Doosron se bohat alag parhne wala capacitor matched set ke taur par replace karein, akela nahi.

solutions.en: Book an Eaton service engineer for bus capacitor replacement and balancing check.
solutions.ur: Bus capacitor ki tabdeeli aur balancing check ke liye Eaton service engineer bulaayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.en: F305 Failed capacitor bank soft start
title.ur: F305 Capacitor bank ka soft start fail

meaning.en: The soft-start circuit could not charge the capacitor bank smoothly at power-up, so the inverter stays off.
meaning.ur: Soft-start circuit ne power-up par capacitor bank ko smoothly charge nahi kar paaya, is liye inverter band reh gaya.

causes.en: Bus capacitors are aged or shorted, so the soft-start ramp cannot complete.
causes.ur: Bus capacitors purane ya short ho chuke hain, is liye soft-start ramp poora nahi ho sakta.

causes.en: Soft-start thyristor or its gate drive has failed.
causes.ur: Soft-start thyristor ya us ka gate drive kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Transfer the load to bypass, switch the UPS off, isolate mains and the battery.
solutions.ur: Load bypass par transfer karein, UPS band karein, mains aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check each bank fuse and the pre-charge resistor chain for continuity and heat damage.
solutions.ur: Har bank fuse aur pre-charge resistor chain ki continuity aur garmi ke nishan check karein.

solutions.en: Have the soft-start circuit and bus capacitors replaced by an Eaton service engineer.
solutions.ur: Soft-start circuit aur bus capacitors ki tabdeeli Eaton service engineer se karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

meaning.en: The inverter output voltage has dropped below its acceptable window, so the UPS has shut the inverter down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output voltage apni ijazat ke neeche gir gaya hai, is liye UPS ne inverter band kar diya.

causes.en: DC bus voltage is too low because the battery or charger is not supplying enough.
causes.ur: DC bus voltage kam hai kyunke battery ya charger itna supply nahi kar raha.

causes.en: Output is overloaded or the output voltage setting is set too low for the load.
causes.ur: Output overloaded hai ya output voltage setting load ke liye bohat kam rakhi gayi hai.

causes.en: Inverter output voltage sensing or the inverter board itself has failed.
causes.ur: Inverter output voltage sensing ya inverter board khud kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Reduce or remove the load first, then restart the UPS and see if F70C clears.
solutions.ur: Pehle load kam karein ya hata dein, phir UPS restart karke dekhein ke F70C clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Measure the DC bus voltage with a DMM (isolate mains and battery first) and compare it with the manual specification.
solutions.ur: Pehle mains aur battery isolate karein, phir DMM se DC bus voltage maarein aur manual ki specification se tulna karein.

solutions.en: Measure the actual output voltage at the output terminal block with a true-RMS DMM while on battery.
solutions.ur: Battery par chalte waqt true-RMS DMM se output terminal block par asal output voltage maarein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

meaning.en: The inverter output voltage has risen above its acceptable window, so the UPS has shut the inverter down.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output voltage apni ijazat se upar chala gaya hai, is liye UPS ne inverter band kar diya.

causes.en: Output voltage setting or the feedback potentiometer is misadjusted.
causes.ur: Output voltage setting ya feedback potentiometer ki adjustment ghalat hai.

causes.en: Output is very lightly loaded, so the inverter steps the voltage up.
causes.ur: Output bohat kam load par hai, is liye inverter voltage barha deta hai.

causes.en: Inverter board or output voltage sensing failure.
causes.ur: Inverter board ya output voltage sensing ki kharabi.

solutions.en: Read the configured output voltage in the Setup menu and confirm it matches the load's requirement.
solutions.ur: Setup menu se configured output voltage parhein aur confirm karein ke woh load ki requirement se match karta hai.

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage with a true-RMS DMM at the output terminal block.
solutions.ur: True-RMS DMM se output terminal block par output voltage maarein.

solutions.en: Have the inverter board and output sensing calibrated by an Eaton service engineer.
solutions.ur: Inverter board aur output sensing ki calibration Eaton service engineer se karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.ur: F704 Inverter ka soft start fail

meaning.en: The inverter could not complete its soft-start ramp to operating voltage, so the UPS stays off the line and the load is on bypass.
meaning.ur: Inverter apna soft-start ramp operating voltage tak poora nahi kar paya, is liye UPS line par nahi aaya aur load bypass par hai.

causes.en: DC bus voltage was not within range when the inverter was asked to start.
causes.ur: Inverter ko start karne ke waqt DC bus voltage range mein nahi tha.

causes.en: Inverter IGBT module or its gate drive has failed.
causes.ur: Inverter IGBT module ya us ka gate drive kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Output is short-circuited or heavily overloaded, so the ramp cannot be completed.
causes.ur: Output short ya bohat zyada overloaded hai, is liye ramp poora nahi ho sakta.

solutions.en: If possible disconnect the power to the load, switch the UPS off and back on again.
solutions.ur: Ho sake to load ki power disconnect karein, UPS band karke dobara on karein.

solutions.en: With mains and battery isolated, measure the DC bus voltage and check for a short across the output.
solutions.ur: Mains aur battery isolate karke DC bus voltage maarein aur output par short check karein.

solutions.en: If the problem occurs again, call the support centre - the inverter module needs service.
solutions.ur: Agar masla dobara aaye to support centre ko call karein - inverter module ki servicing zaroori hai.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

meaning.en: A short circuit exists on the UPS output. There is a fault on one or more of the loads powered by the UPS.
meaning.ur: UPS output par short circuit hai. UPS se power lene walay loads mein kisi aik ya zyada par fault hai.

causes.en: A connected load, adaptor or power strip has failed short.
causes.ur: Koi connected load, adaptor ya power strip short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Damaged or pinched output wiring is touching the chassis earth.
causes.ur: Damage ya pinch hua output wiring chassis earth ko chhu raha hai.

causes.en: Output breaker or a downstream distribution board breaker is closed onto a shorted circuit.
causes.ur: Output breaker ya koi downstream distribution board ka breaker short circuit par band hai.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off and disconnect all output loads before touching any wiring.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi wiring ko chhoone se pehle UPS band karein aur saare output loads disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect all the utilities, switch the UPS off and back on again, reconnect the loads one at a time to identify which one is faulty.
solutions.ur: Saari utilities disconnect karein, UPS band karke dobara on karein, phir loads aik aik karke dobara lagayein taake pata chale kaunsa kharab hai.

solutions.en: Use a DMM continuity/insulation check on each suspect load and cable before reconnecting it.
solutions.ur: Dohosne se pehle har shakhs load aur cable par DMM se continuity/insulation check karein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

meaning.en: The load applied to the UPS is too high. The overload has progressed from alarm to fault and the inverter is off.
meaning.ur: UPS par lagaya hua load bohat zyada hai. Overload alarm se fault tak pohanch gaya hai aur inverter band hai.

causes.en: The load is too high for the UPS capacity; A80E/A810 were ignored earlier.
causes.ur: Load UPS ki capacity se zyada hai; A80E/A810 pehle ignore kar diye gaye the.

causes.en: A large motor or compressor with high inrush was switched on while on battery.
causes.ur: Battery chalte waqt koi bada motor ya compressor high inrush ke saath on kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Remove the load and switch the UPS off and back on again.
solutions.ur: Load hata dein aur UPS band karke dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load to within the threshold of 100% (or the user threshold in the case of code A80E).
solutions.ur: Load ko 100% threshold ke andar laayein (code A80E ke haal mein user threshold tak).

solutions.en: Size the load with a clamp meter and move permanent load to a larger UPS or an external bypass-fed outlet.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load naaphein aur mustaqil load ko barhe UPS ya external bypass-fed outlet par le jaayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9E 6-20 kVA (online UPS 6-20kVA, 3:1 and 1:1)

title.ur: F811 Negative output power (output power ulti)

meaning.en: The UPS measured power flowing backwards out of the output; the inverter has been shut down to protect the load.
meaning.ur: UPS ne output se power ulti taraf jaate hue naape hain; load bachane ke liye inverter band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: Another source is feeding back into the UPS output, e.g. a generator or another UPS in parallel that is not synchronised.
causes.ur: Koi doosra source UPS output mein wapas power bhej raha hai, maslan generator ya doosra parallel UPS jo sync nahi hai.

causes.en: Output current direction sensing or the output current transformer is faulty.
causes.ur: Output current direction sensing ya output current transformer kharab hai.

causes.en: A generator or solar inverter changeover board is wired without an anti-backfeed device.
causes.ur: Generator ya solar inverter ka changeover board anti-backfeed device ke baghair jora gaya hai.

solutions.en: Remove all other sources feeding the output bus and confirm only the UPS and bypass feed the output.
solutions.ur: Output bus ko chalane walay saare doosre sources hata dein aur confirm karein ke sirf UPS aur bypass output ko feed kar rahe hain.

solutions.en: With a clamp meter, check the direction of current in each output conductor.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se har output conductor mein current ki direction check karein.

solutions.en: Install an anti-backfeed relay or correct the changeover interlock, then have the output sensing checked.
solutions.ur: Anti-backfeed relay lagayein ya changeover interlock theek karein, phir output sensing check karwayein.

source.title: Eaton 9E UPS - Installation and user manual (6-20 kVA)

codes.seriesName: 9PX / 9PX Gen2 (online UPS 700VA-11kVA)

title.ur: Battery mode (UPS battery par chal raha hai)

meaning.en: Utility power has failed and the UPS is supplying the load from its batteries. This is a status, not a fault.
meaning.ur: Utility power chala gaya hai aur UPS load ko apni batteries se de raha hai. Ye status hai, fault nahi.

causes.en: The utility supply has failed or is out of the transfer window.
causes.ur: Utility supply chala gaya hai ya transfer range se bahar hai.

causes.en: The user has deliberately switched the UPS to battery mode to run on battery.
causes.ur: User ne jaanbujhkar UPS ko battery mode par switch kiya hai taake battery par chale.

solutions.en: Save your work and prepare connected equipment for shutdown, because runtime is finite.
solutions.ur: Apna kaam bacha lein aur connected equipment ko shutdown ke liye tayyar karein, kyunke runtime mehdud hai.

solutions.en: Read the remaining runtime and battery level from the LCD so you know how long you have.
solutions.ur: LCD se baaqi runtime aur battery level parhein taake pata chale kitna waqt bacha hai.

solutions.en: When mains returns, confirm the UPS has gone back to Normal mode and the battery is charging (charging indicator on).
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par confirm karein ke UPS Normal mode wapas aa gaya hai aur battery charge ho rahi hai (charging indicator on).

codes.blinkPattern: Battery-mode LED solid On, 1 beep every 10 seconds

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

codes.seriesName: 9PX / 9PX Gen2 (online UPS 700VA-11kVA)

title.ur: Battery low (runtime khatam hone wali hai)

meaning.en: The UPS is on battery and the battery has reached its low-charge warning level. Runtime left is short.
meaning.ur: UPS battery par hai aur battery low-charge warning level par aa chuki hai. Baqi runtime bohat kam hai.

causes.en: The outage has lasted long enough to drain the batteries down to the warning level.
causes.ur: Outage itni der rahi ke batteries warning level tak drain ho gayin.

causes.en: The battery string is aged and holds less charge than rated.
causes.ur: Battery string purani hai aur rated se kam charge rakhti hai.

solutions.en: Shut down non-essential equipment now to extend the remaining runtime.
solutions.ur: Baaqi runtime barhane ke liye abhi ghair zaroori equipment band kar dein.

solutions.en: Read the actual remaining runtime on the LCD; the manual warns the estimate varies a lot with load and EBM count.
solutions.ur: LCD par asal baaqi runtime parhein; manual kehti hai ke estimate load aur EBM ki tadaad ke saath bohat badalti hai.

solutions.en: Do not start large loads now; if mains returns, let the UPS charge on utility for 48 hours.
solutions.ur: Ab bade loads start na karein; mains wapas aaye to UPS ko 48 ghante utility par charge karwayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Battery-low LED solid On, 1 beep every 3 seconds

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

codes.seriesName: 9PX / 9PX Gen2 (online UPS 700VA-11kVA)

meaning.en: The UPS has lost the battery string; if mains fails now the load gets no backup. Continuous beep means this is logged as a fault.
meaning.ur: UPS ki battery string kho gayi hai; ab mains chala to load ko koi backup nahi milega. Continuous beep ka matlab hai ke ye fault ke taur par log hota hai.

causes.en: The internal battery connector is unplugged or the connector is not fully seated.
causes.ur: Internal battery connector nahi laga hua ya poori tarah seat nahi hua.

causes.en: The external battery module (EBM) power connector or its detection connector is unplugged.
causes.ur: External battery module (EBM) ka power connector ya us ka detection connector nahi laga hua.

causes.en: A battery harness or connector pin is loose, corroded, bent or broken.
causes.ur: Battery harness ya connector ka pin dhile, zang khaa, muda ya toota hua hai.

solutions.en: Transfer the load to bypass (or shut down safely), switch the UPS off, unplug the mains, then use insulated gloves and tools.
solutions.ur: Load bypass par transfer karein (ya mehfoof se band karein), UPS band karein, mains nikaal dein, phir insulated gloves aur tools use karein.

solutions.en: Verify that all batteries are properly connected; reseat the EBM power and detection connectors firmly.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke saari batteries theek se lagi hain; EBM power aur detection connectors ko mazbooti se dobara baitha dein.

solutions.en: Measure the DC voltage across the battery terminals with a DMM; no reading means the string is open or dead.
solutions.ur: DMM se battery terminals par DC voltage maarein; koi reading nahi ka matlab hai ke string khuli ya marri hui hai.

codes.blinkPattern: No-battery LED On, continuous beep

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

codes.seriesName: 9PX / 9PX Gen2 (online UPS 700VA-11kVA)

meaning.en: The battery test failed because of bad or disconnected batteries, or the minimum battery voltage was reached during ABM cycling.
meaning.ur: Battery test fail ho gaya kyunke batteries kharab ya disconnect hain, ya ABM cycling mein battery ka minimum voltage aa gaya.

causes.en: One or more battery cells are dead, shorted, or the string is at end of life.
causes.ur: Battery ke koi aik ya zyada cells mar chuke hain, short hain, ya string end of life par hai.

causes.en: A battery connector is disconnected, so the test sees an abnormal string.
causes.ur: Battery connector disconnect hai, is liye test ko string ajeeb nazar aati hai.

causes.en: In ABM (Advanced Battery Management) cycling the battery reached its minimum voltage.
causes.ur: ABM (Advanced Battery Management) cycling mein battery ka minimum voltage aa gaya.

solutions.en: Verify that all batteries are properly connected with the UPS switched off and mains unplugged.
solutions.ur: UPS band karke aur mains nikal kar check karein ke saari batteries theek se lagi hain.

solutions.en: Measure each cell in the string with a DMM and replace the string as a set if readings are unequal or below specification.
solutions.ur: DMM se string ka har cell voltage maarein; readings barabar na hon ya specification se neeche hon to poori string set ke taur par replace karein.

solutions.en: Start a new battery test on the front panel; if the condition persists, contact your service representative.
solutions.ur: Front panel se naya battery test chalayein; agar masla barqarar rahe to apne service representative se rabta karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Battery-fault LED On, continuous beep

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

codes.uid: eaton/eaton-9px/The UPS does not provide the expected backup time
codes.seriesName: 9PX / 9PX Gen2 (online UPS 700VA-11kVA)
codes.code: The UPS does not provide the expected backup time
codes.codeNorm: THE UPS DOES NOT PROVIDE THE EXPECTED BACKUP TIME
aliases: The UPS does not provide the expected backup time

title.ur: Backup time itni kam hai jitni umeed thi nahi

meaning.en: On discharge the UPS does not run for the rated time; the batteries need charging or service.
meaning.ur: Discharge par UPS rated time tak nahi chalta; batteries ko charging ya servicing chahiye.

causes.en: The batteries have not been charged (new unit, or long time on bypass/unused).
causes.ur: Batteries charge nahi hain (naya unit, ya lambi der bypass par ya istemal na hua).

causes.en: The battery string has aged and lost capacity.
causes.ur: Battery string purani ho chuki hai aur capacity khoyi hai.

causes.en: The load is higher than the rating used to work out the expected runtime.
causes.ur: Load un rating se zyada hai jis se expected runtime nikala gaya tha.

solutions.en: Apply utility power for 48 hours to charge the batteries, then run a battery test again.
solutions.ur: Batteries charge karne ke liye 48 ghante utility power dein, phir battery test dobara chalayein.

solutions.en: Measure the actual load with a clamp meter and compare it with the runtime table for that load level.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se asal load maarein aur us load level ke runtime table se tulna karein.

solutions.en: If runtime is still short after 48 h of charging, contact your service representative for battery replacement.
solutions.ur: 48 ghante charging ke baad bhi runtime kam ho to battery tabdeeli ke liye apne service representative se rabta karein.

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

codes.seriesName: 9PX / 9PX Gen2 (online UPS 700VA-11kVA)

meaning.en: The load is being fed from the bypass source. It is powered but not protected by the UPS.
meaning.ur: Load bypass source se chal raha hai. Power mil rahi hai magar UPS se protection nahi hai.

causes.en: An overload or a fault has occurred, so the UPS transferred to bypass.
causes.ur: Overload ya fault aaya hai, is liye UPS bypass par transfer ho gaya.

causes.en: A command was received that placed the UPS in bypass mode.
causes.ur: Koi aisa command mila hai jis ne UPS ko bypass mode par rakha.

solutions.en: Check for one of the following alarms: overtemperature, overload or UPS failure.
solutions.ur: In mein se koi aik alarm check karein: overtemperature, overload ya UPS failure.

solutions.en: Read the Event log and Fault log on the front panel to find which alarm sent the unit to bypass.
solutions.ur: Front panel se Event log aur Fault log parhein taake pata chale kaunsa alarm unit ko bypass par le gaya.

solutions.en: Once the cause is fixed, use the front panel to return the UPS to Normal mode and confirm the inverter is supplying the load.
solutions.ur: Wajah theek hone ke baad front panel se UPS ko Normal mode par laayein aur confirm karein ke inverter load de raha hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Bypass LED solid On

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

codes.seriesName: 9PX / 9PX Gen2 (online UPS 700VA-11kVA)

title.ur: Power overload (load UPS capacity se zyada)

meaning.en: Power demand is above 100% of the UPS nominal rating, so the unit is in overload and may go to bypass or shut down.
meaning.ur: Power demand UPS nominal rating ke 100% se zyada hai, is liye unit overload mein hai aur bypass par ja sakta hai ya band ho sakta hai.

causes.en: More equipment is connected than the UPS capacity allows.
causes.ur: UPS capacity se zyada equipment lagaya gaya hai.

causes.en: A large inrush load such as a motor or compressor was switched on.
causes.ur: Koi bada inrush load jaise motor ya compressor on kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Switch the UPS off and disconnect the output before removing any load.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi load hatane se pehle UPS band karein aur output disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Remove some of the equipment from the UPS until the load percentage on the display is below 100%.
solutions.ur: Display ka load percentage 100% se neeche aane tak UPS se kuch equipment nikaalte jayein.

solutions.en: Check the specific output overload range in the manual's User Settings / specification table for your model.
solutions.ur: Apne model ki User Settings ya specification table mein diye gaye khaas output overload range check karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Power-overload LED On, continuous beep

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

codes.seriesName: 9PX / 9PX Gen2 (online UPS 700VA-11kVA)

meaning.en: Internal temperature is too high or a fan has failed. At warning level the UPS keeps running, but a further 10 degrees C rise makes it go to bypass or shut down.
meaning.ur: Andar ka temperature bohat zyada hai ya fan kharab ho gaya hai. Warning level par UPS chalta rehta hai, magar 10 degree C aur izafa badhay to bypass par chala jata hai ya band ho jata hai.

causes.en: The cooling fan has failed or is not running at all.
causes.ur: Cooling fan kharab ho gaya hai ya bilkul nahi chal raha.

causes.en: Vents are blocked by dust or the unit is installed with airflow restricted on all sides.
causes.ur: Vents dhool se band hain ya unit aik taraf se bhi saans nahi le sakta.

causes.en: Ambient temperature in the room is very high (hot closet, direct sun, poor air conditioning).
causes.ur: Kamre ka ambient temperature bohat zyada hai (garm cabinet, seedhi dhoop, kamzor air conditioning).

solutions.en: Clear vents and remove any heat sources. Allow the UPS to cool, and ensure the airflow around the UPS is not restricted.
solutions.ur: Vents saaf karein aur heat source hata dein. UPS ko thanda hone dein, aur UPS ke gird ka airflow band na ho.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature with a thermometer; it should not exceed 40 degrees C for this model.
solutions.ur: Thermometer se ambient temperature maarein; is model ke liye ye 40 degree C se zyada na honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Restart the UPS once it has cooled; if the condition continues to persist, contact your service representative and check/replace the fan.
solutions.ur: Thanda hone ke baad UPS restart karein; masla barqarar rahe to apne service representative se rabta karein aur fan check/replace karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Overtemperature LED On, 1 beep every 3 seconds (9PX Gen2 manual: continuous beep)

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

codes.seriesName: 9PX / 9PX Gen2 (online UPS 700VA-11kVA)
aliases: UPS does not start - input source / RPO

title.en: The UPS does not start (input / RPO)
title.ur: UPS start nahi ho raha (input / RPO)

meaning.en: The unit will not start because either the input source is not connected correctly, or the Remote Power Off switch is active / the RPO connector is missing.
meaning.ur: Unit start nahi ho raha kyunke ya to input source theek se connect nahi, ya Remote Power Off switch active hai / RPO connector missing hai.

causes.en: The input source is not connected correctly, or the input breaker is open.
causes.ur: Input source theek se connect nahi, ya input breaker khula hai.

causes.en: The Remote Power Off (RPO) switch is active.
causes.ur: Remote Power Off (RPO) switch active hai.

causes.en: The RPO connector is missing from its terminal.
causes.ur: RPO connector apne terminal se missing hai.

solutions.en: Check the input connections with a DMM: confirm mains voltage at the input terminal block and that the input breaker is closed.
solutions.ur: DMM se input connections check karein: input terminal block par mains voltage confirm karein aur input breaker band hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: If the UPS Status menu displays the "Remote Power Off" notice, deactivate the RPO input.
solutions.ur: Agar UPS Status menu par "Remote Power Off" ka notice aaye to RPO input ko deactivate karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery connections too, then retry the start with the front-panel ON button.
solutions.ur: Battery connections bhi check karein, phir front panel ke ON button se dobara start karein.

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

codes.uid: eaton/eaton-9px/Input bad wiring / Output bad wiring
codes.seriesName: 9PX / 9PX Gen2 (online UPS 700VA-11kVA)
codes.code: Input bad wiring / Output bad wiring
codes.codeNorm: INPUT BAD WIRING / OUTPUT BAD WIRING
aliases: Input bad wiring / Output bad wiring

title.ur: Input/Output wiring ghalat (terminal block par galat)

meaning.en: The input or output cables are not connected to the correct terminal blocks, so the unit is flagging continuous beep.
meaning.ur: Input ya output cables theek terminal blocks se nahi juri hain, is liye unit continuous beep de raha hai.

causes.en: Input or output cables landed on the wrong terminal block.
causes.ur: Input ya output cables galat terminal block par lage hue hain.

causes.en: A terminal screw was not tightened, so the conductor is loose.
causes.ur: Terminal screw kasa nahi gaya, is liye conductor dhila hai.

causes.en: Phase/neutral/earth conductors are swapped at the terminal block.
causes.ur: Phase/neutral/earth conductors terminal block par aapas mein badal diye gaye hain.

solutions.en: Transfer the load to bypass or shut down safely, then switch the UPS off and unplug the mains before touching terminals.
solutions.ur: Load bypass par transfer karein ya mehfoof se band karein, phir terminal chhoone se pehle UPS band karein aur mains nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Connect correctly the Input/Output cables, matching each conductor label on the cable to the terminal marking.
solutions.ur: Input/Output cables theek se lagayein, har conductor ka label terminal ke marking se milayein.

solutions.en: Tighten every terminal screw and re-torque the compression lugs; verify earth continuity (<1 ohm) to the panel earth bar.
solutions.ur: Har terminal screw kheench lein aur compression lugs dobara torque dein; panel earth bar tak earth continuity (1 ohm se kam) verify karein.

codes.blinkPattern: LED On, continuous beep

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

codes.seriesName: 9PX / 9PX Gen2 (online UPS 700VA-11kVA)

title.ur: MBP disconnected (HotSwap bypass module nahi mila)

meaning.en: The HotSwap Maintenance Bypass Pod is no longer connected to the UPS, so the service bypass path has been lost.
meaning.ur: HotSwap Maintenance Bypass Pod UPS se ab connect nahi hai, is liye service bypass ka raasta kho gaya hai.

causes.en: The MBP detection connector has been unplugged from the UPS.
causes.ur: MBP ka detection connector UPS se nikal gaya hai.

causes.en: The MBP has been pulled out or moved for maintenance and not fully re-seated.
causes.ur: MBP maintenance ke liye nikal ya hataya gaya aur poori tarah dobara nahi baitha.

solutions.en: If the HotSwap MBP is connected to the UPS, check that the detection connector is correctly plugged.
solutions.ur: Agar HotSwap MBP UPS se juri hai to check karein ke detection connector theek plug hai.

solutions.en: Re-seat both the MBP power connector and the detection connector, then confirm the UPS sees the module in the menu.
solutions.ur: MBP power connector aur detection connector dono dobara baitha dein, phir confirm karein ke UPS menu mein module nazar aa raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the detection connector pins for bent or corroded contacts with a DMM continuity test.
solutions.ur: DMM continuity test se detection connector ke pins ko mudha ya zang khaye hone ke liye check karein.

source.title: Eaton 9PX 3-6k / 8k / 11k UPS and EBM - Installation and user manual

codes.seriesName: Ellipse PRO 650/850/1200/1600 VA (line-interactive UPS, AVR)

title.ur: Battery mode (button 6 green flash karta hai)

meaning.en: AC power is disturbed or failed, so the UPS runs on battery. Audible alarm beeps every 10 s, then every 3 s near end of runtime.
meaning.ur: AC power disturb ya fail hua hai, is liye UPS battery par chal raha hai. Audible alarm pehle har 10 second, phir runtime khatam hone par har 3 second beepta hai.

causes.en: The mains supply has failed or dipped outside the AVR input window (165-285 V adjustable to 150-285 V).
causes.ur: Mains supply chala gaya hai ya AVR input window (165-285 V, 150-285 V tak adjustable) se bahar gir gaya hai.

causes.en: The mains is present but of poor quality, so the UPS keeps transferring to battery.
causes.ur: Mains maujood hai magar quality kharab hai, is liye UPS baar baar battery par chala jata hai.

solutions.en: Save your work and shut down equipment before the end of backup time; the alarm speeds up to every 3 s as a warning.
solutions.ur: Backup time khatam hone se pehle kaam bacha lein aur equipment band karein; warning ke taur par alarm 3 second par beepta hai.

solutions.en: If the outage lasts longer than the backup time the UPS shuts down by itself; it restarts automatically when power is restored.
solutions.ur: Agar outage backup time se lamba rahe to UPS khud band ho jata hai; power wapas aane par khud restart ho jata hai.

solutions.en: On mains return, confirm the unit back on mains by pressing button 6, and give the battery 8 hours of charge before first use.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par button 6 dabayein taake unit mains par wapas aa jaye, aur pehli istemal se pehle battery ko 8 ghante charge dein.

codes.blinkPattern: ON/OFF button 6 flashes green; 1 beep every 10 seconds then 1 beep every 3 seconds (silent mode: single beep on transfer to battery)

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

codes.seriesName: Ellipse PRO 650/850/1200/1600 VA (line-interactive UPS, AVR)

title.ur: Problem 1 - battery backup outlets power nahi de rahe

meaning.en: The battery-backed outlets are not being supplied. Diagnostic: the ON/OFF button 6 is not lit.
meaning.ur: Battery backup outlets supply nahi ho rahe. Diagnostic: ON/OFF button 6 jal nahi raha.

causes.en: The battery-backed outlets have simply been switched off at button 6.
causes.ur: Battery backup outlets button 6 se band kar diye gaye hain.

causes.en: The UPS was shut down from the front panel and never restarted.
causes.ur: UPS ko front panel se band kiya gaya aur dobara start nahi kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Press button 6 and check that it turns green - that confirms the battery-backed outlets are switched on.
solutions.ur: Button 6 dabayein aur check karein ke woh green ho jata hai - is ka matlab battery backup outlets on hain.

solutions.en: Read the LCD icons 9 (UPS ON) and 11 (Battery mode) to confirm the UPS itself is running.
solutions.ur: LCD icons 9 (UPS ON) aur 11 (Battery mode) parhein taake confirm ho ke UPS khud chal raha hai.

solutions.en: If button 6 will not light at all, check the rear input protection circuit breaker 20 is in the reset (not pressed-in) position.
solutions.ur: Agar button 6 bilkul na jale to check karein ke peeche wala input protection circuit breaker 20 reset position (dabba hua nahi) mein hai.

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

codes.seriesName: Ellipse PRO 650/850/1200/1600 VA (line-interactive UPS, AVR)

title.en: Problem 2 - devices not on battery outlets
title.ur: Problem 2 - devices battery outlets par nahi lage

meaning.en: Connected devices are not supplied during an AC power failure because they are plugged into surge-only outlets, not battery-backed ones.
meaning.ur: AC power failure par connected devices power nahi lete kyunke woh sirf surge protection wale outlets mein lage hain, battery backup wale mein nahi.

causes.en: The device is plugged into a surge-protection-only outlet (icon 18) instead of a battery backup outlet (icon 19).
causes.ur: Device surge-protection-only outlet (icon 18) mein laga hai, battery backup outlet (icon 19) mein nahi.

causes.en: The device is fed from a different outlet strip that is not backed by the UPS.
causes.ur: Device aisi alag outlet strip se chal raha hai jo UPS se backed nahi hai.

solutions.en: Read the LCD and count which outlets are battery-backed (650/850 have 2 backup + 2 surge-only; 1200/1600 have 4 + 4).
solutions.ur: LCD parhein aur count karein ke kaun se outlets battery-backed hain (650/850 mein 2 backup + 2 sirf surge; 1200/1600 mein 4 + 4).

solutions.en: Move the device's plug into a battery backup outlet (icon 19) using a voltage tester to confirm it is live.
solutions.ur: Device ka plug battery backup outlet (icon 19) mein daalein aur voltage tester se confirm karein ke woh live hai.

solutions.en: Re-test by switching mains off briefly and confirming the device stays up.
solutions.ur: Mains thodi der ke liye band karke dobara test karein aur confirm karein ke device chalta rehta hai.

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

codes.seriesName: Ellipse PRO 650/850/1200/1600 VA (line-interactive UPS, AVR)

title.en: Problem 3 - running on battery though mains is present
title.ur: Problem 3 - mains maujood hai magar battery par chal raha hai

meaning.en: The UPS is on battery even though AC power is available, because the rear protection circuit breaker 20 has tripped on an output overload.
meaning.ur: UPS battery par chal raha hai jabke AC power maujood hai, kyunke peeche wala protection circuit breaker 20 output overload par trip ho gaya hai.

causes.en: The resettable input protection breaker (20) tripped on an overload.
causes.ur: Resettable input protection breaker (20) overload par trip ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Too much equipment is connected to the UPS outlets in total.
causes.ur: UPS outlets par total bohat zyada equipment lagaya gaya hai.

causes.en: A shorted load or a failed power strip tripped the breaker.
causes.ur: Koi short hua load ya kharab power strip breaker trip kar gaya.

solutions.en: Switch the unit off with button 6 and unplug the mains before touching the rear breaker.
solutions.ur: Button 6 se unit band karein aur peeche wale breaker ko chhoone se pehle mains nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Disconnect excess equipment, then reset circuit breaker 20 by pressing the corresponding button back into its normal position.
solutions.ur: Zyada equipment disconnect karein, phir circuit breaker 20 ko us ke button ko daba kar normal position mein reset karein.

solutions.en: Measure the load with a clamp meter or check the LCD load level icon 13; keep the load under the model's rated VA/W.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se load maarein ya LCD ke load level icon 13 dekhein; load ko model ki rated VA/W ke neeche rakhein.

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

codes.seriesName: Ellipse PRO 650/850/1200/1600 VA (line-interactive UPS, AVR)

meaning.en: The green button 6 flashes and the audible alarm beeps every 3 seconds: the battery backup outlets 19 are overloaded.
meaning.ur: Green button 6 flash karta hai aur audible alarm har 3 second beepta hai: battery backup outlets 19 overloaded hain.

causes.en: The equipment on the battery-backed outlets exceeds their rated current (650/850: 3 A; 850: 3.6 A; 1200: 5.5 A; 1600: 7.3 A per backup bank).
causes.ur: Battery backup outlets par lagi equipment un ki rated current se zyada hai (650/850: 3 A; 850: 3.6 A; 1200: 5.5 A; 1600: 7.3 A per backup bank).

causes.en: A high-starting-current device such as a laser printer was switched on during discharge.
causes.ur: Discharge ke doran koi high starting current wala device jaise laser printer on kiya gaya.

solutions.en: Disconnect excess equipment connected to the battery backup outlets 19 immediately.
solutions.ur: Battery backup outlets 19 se juri zyada equipment foran disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Measure the current drawn by each connected device with a clamp meter and total it against the outlet rating on the manual's specification table.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se har connected device ka current maarein aur manual ki specification table ki outlet rating se jama karein.

solutions.en: Move printers, monitors and other non-critical devices to the surge-only outlets (icon 18).
solutions.ur: Printer, monitor aur doosre ghair zaroori devices sirf surge wale outlets (icon 18) par le jaayein.

codes.blinkPattern: ON/OFF button 6 flashes green, 1 beep every 3 seconds

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

codes.seriesName: Ellipse PRO 650/850/1200/1600 VA (line-interactive UPS, AVR)

title.ur: Fault sign 12 - internal fault (andar ki kharabi)

meaning.en: A fault has occurred inside the UPS. The battery backup outlets 19 are no longer supplied and the audible alarm beeps continuously.
meaning.ur: UPS ke andar fault aa gaya hai. Battery backup outlets 19 ab supply nahi karte aur audible alarm continuous beepta hai.

causes.en: Internal power stage or control failure inside the small UPS.
causes.ur: Chhote UPS ke andar power stage ya control ki kharabi.

causes.en: Output short circuit or a deeply failed battery string dragging the DC rail out of range.
causes.ur: Output short circuit ya bohat kharab battery string DC rail ko range se bahar kheench rahi hai.

solutions.en: Call after-sales support as the manual directs; this is not a user-repairable condition.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq after-sales support ko call karein; ye user ke taur par theek karne wali halat nahi hai.

solutions.en: Record the model number, the LCD readings (icons 13 load level and 14 battery level) and what was running at the time of the fault.
solutions.ur: Model number, LCD readings (icon 13 load level aur 14 battery level) aur fault ke waqt kya chal raha tha, sab likh lein.

solutions.en: Unplug the mains and move your equipment to a protected supply in the meantime; the battery backup outlets are dead on this condition.
solutions.ur: Mains nikaal dein aur apna equipment abhi protected supply par le jaayein; is halat mein battery backup outlets marr chuke hain.

codes.blinkPattern: LCD icon 12 (Internal fault) shown on panel, audible alarm beeps continuously

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

codes.seriesName: Ellipse PRO 650/850/1200/1600 VA (line-interactive UPS, AVR)

title.en: Problem 6 - surge protection gone (ASR LED off)
title.ur: Problem 6 - surge protection chala gaya (ASR LED off)

meaning.en: The green LED 8 (ASR) is off while the filtered outlets 18 are still supplied, so the surge protection device has died.
meaning.ur: Green LED 8 (ASR) off hai jabke filtered outlets 18 ab bhi supply ho rahe hain, is liye surge protection device mar chuka hai.

causes.en: The MOV surge protection module has failed after absorbing a large surge.
causes.ur: MOV surge protection module ne bada surge absorb karne ke baad kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Repeated smaller surges have degraded the MOVs to the point of failure.
causes.ur: Baar baar chhote surges ne MOVs ko itna degrade kiya ke woh fail ho gaye.

solutions.en: Do not plug any sensitive or expensive equipment into the filtered outlets while LED 8 is off.
solutions.ur: LED 8 off hone par koi mehfoof ya mehnga equipment filtered outlets mein na lagayein.

solutions.en: Call after-sales support as the manual directs; the surge module is not user replaceable.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq after-sales support ko call karein; surge module user ke taur par nahi badla ja sakta.

solutions.en: Inspect the mains earth and check for repeated voltage spikes on the incoming line with a DMM logger.
solutions.ur: Mains earth dekh lein aur DMM logger se incoming line par baar baar voltage spikes check karein.

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

codes.seriesName: Ellipse PRO 650/850/1200/1600 VA (line-interactive UPS, AVR)

title.ur: Problem 7 - EcoControl outlets power par qatam nahi hote

meaning.en: The EcoControl outlets keep supplying power after the main (Master) outlet is switched off, so peripherals are not being cut.
meaning.ur: Main (Master) outlet band hone ke baad bhi EcoControl outlets power dete rahte hain, is liye peripherals band nahi ho rahe.

causes.en: The EcoControl function is deactivated (it is off by default).
causes.ur: EcoControl function deactivated hai (ye default par band hota hai).

causes.en: EcoControl is active but the Master outlet has not been assigned correctly.
causes.ur: EcoControl active hai magar Master outlet theek se assign nahi kiya gaya.

causes.en: The device connected to the Master outlet uses too little current to be detected as off.
causes.ur: Master outlet se jude device ka current itna kam hai ke off detect nahi hota.

solutions.en: Activate or set properly the EcoControl function using the software provided with the product (Eaton UPS Companion over USB).
solutions.ur: Product ke saath diye gaye software (USB par Eaton UPS Companion) se EcoControl function activate ya theek set karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the Master outlet assignment in the configuration software matches the outlet your computer is on.
solutions.ur: Configuration software mein Master outlet ki assignment check karein ke woh us outlet se match karti hai jahan computer laga hai.

solutions.en: Do not put a mains adapter with near-zero load on the Master outlet; use a device that draws measurable current.
solutions.ur: Master outlet par aisa mains adapter na lagayein jis ka load qarebi zero ho; aisa device lagayein jo measurable current le.

source.title: Eaton Ellipse PRO UPS 650/800/1200/1600 VA - Installation and user manual (multiple languages)

codes.seriesName: BluE-S 5000D / 3680D hybrid inverter (BluE-H5/H3 ESS)

title.ur: Soft start time out ho gaya (F00)

meaning.en: Soft-start did not finish within the allowed window, so the inverter stayed off.
meaning.ur: Soft start apne time ke andar complete nahi hua, is liye inverter on nahi hua.

causes.en: DC bus or control supply did not come up in time after switching on.
causes.ur: On karne ke baad DC bus ya control supply time par nahi aayi.

causes.en: Battery or PV input was not connected when the soft-start was attempted.
causes.ur: Soft start ke waqt battery ya PV input connected nahi tha.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off, wait 5 minutes, then restart it and watch the LCD.
solutions.ur: Inverter off karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir on karke LCD dekh lein.

solutions.en: Confirm the battery and PV connectors are fully seated at both ends.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery aur PV connectors dono taraf se puri tarah band hain.

notes.en: Manual solution is only 'restart the inverter and wait until it functions normally'.
notes.ur: Manual ka hal hi 'restart the inverter and wait until it functions normally' hai.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

codes.seriesName: BluE-S 5000D / 3680D hybrid inverter (BluE-H5/H3 ESS)

title.en: INV Volt Short - inverter output shorted (F01)
title.ur: INV Volt Short - inverter output short (F01)

meaning.en: The inverter output is short circuited. The manual tells you to drop the load first, because a shorted load looks identical to a shorted inverter.
meaning.ur: Inverter output short circuit hai. Load pehle disconnect karein, kyun ke short wala load aur short wala inverter dono aise hi lagte hain.

causes.en: A connected load has a shorted winding or a failed power supply inside.
causes.ur: Load ka koi winding ya andar ka power supply short ho gaya.

causes.en: Output cable crushed, pinched or damaged at a junction.
causes.ur: Output cable kahin pinch, dab ya junction par kharab ho gaya.

solutions.en: Disconnect all power sources, shut down the inverter and the battery packs.
solutions.ur: Saari power sources disconnect karein, inverter aur battery packs band karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect the load, then power on and restart the inverter and battery packs.
solutions.ur: Load disconnect karein, phir inverter aur battery packs on karke restart karein.

solutions.en: If the code is gone the load was shorted - test each load branch with a multimeter on continuity.
solutions.ur: Agar code chala gaya to load short tha - har load branch ko multimeter se continuity par test karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

codes.seriesName: BluE-S 5000D / 3680D hybrid inverter (BluE-H5/H3 ESS)

meaning.en: The residual-current sensor inside the inverter has failed. This is a hardware fault, not a real earth leakage.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka residual current sensor kharab hai. Yeh asli earth leakage nahi, sensor ka hardware fault hai.

causes.en: The GFCI / leakage current sensing circuit has failed.
causes.ur: GFCI ya leakage current sensing circuit kharab ho gaya.

causes.en: Water ingress or corrosion around the sensing board after outdoor installation.
causes.ur: Outdoor install ke baad sensing board ke aas paas paani ya zang.

solutions.en: Disconnect all power sources first.
solutions.ur: Pehle saari power sources disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

notes.en: If it returns immediately the GFCI board needs replacement by the distributor.
notes.ur: Agar foran wapas aa jaye to GFCI board distributor se badalwana hoga.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

codes.seriesName: BluE-S 5000D / 3680D hybrid inverter (BluE-H5/H3 ESS)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage dropped below the allowed value.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage allowed value se neeche gir gaya.

causes.en: Input mode is set wrong in the menu, so the inverter expects a source it is not getting.
causes.ur: Menu mein input mode galat set hai, is liye inverter ko aik aisa source mil raha hai jo nahi hai.

causes.en: Battery is deeply discharged, so the bus cannot be charged up.
causes.ur: Battery gehri tarah discharge ho chuki hai, bus charge nahi ho pa raha.

solutions.en: Check the settings of the input mode and correct them.
solutions.ur: Input mode ki setting check karke theek karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

codes.seriesName: BluE-S 5000D / 3680D hybrid inverter (BluE-H5/H3 ESS)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus voltage rose above the allowed value.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus voltage allowed value se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Input mode setting is wrong, so the bus is charged from the wrong source.
causes.ur: Input mode setting galat hai, bus galat source se charge ho raha hai.

causes.en: Battery pack over-voltage or a failed charge circuit pushing the bus up.
causes.ur: Battery pack over-voltage ya charge circuit kharab hone se bus upar gaya.

solutions.en: Check the settings of the input mode and correct them.
solutions.ur: Input mode ki setting check karke theek karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Measure battery pack DC voltage with a multimeter; it should sit near 51-53 V, not above 57.5 V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery pack DC voltage check karein; yeh 51-53 V ke qareeb hona chahiye, 57.5 V se upar nahi.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

codes.seriesName: BluE-S 5000D / 3680D hybrid inverter (BluE-H5/H3 ESS)

meaning.en: The internal DC bus is shorted. Almost always a damaged power stage.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus short ho gaya hai. Aam tor par power stage kharab hota hai.

causes.en: IGBT or MOSFET in the inverter shorted, often after a surge or a fan failure.
causes.ur: Inverter ka IGBT ya MOSFET short ho gaya, aksar surge ya fan failure ke baad.

causes.en: Internal DC bus capacitor failed short.
causes.ur: Internal DC bus capacitor short ho gaya.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off and leave it off for at least 5 minutes to discharge the bus.
solutions.ur: Inverter band karein aur bus discharge hone ke liye kam az kam 5 minute band rakhein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

notes.en: If F06 comes back after every restart the power board is damaged and needs distributor service.
notes.ur: Agar har restart ke baad F06 wapas aaye to power board kharab hai aur distributor se service chahiye.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

codes.seriesName: BluE-S 5000D / 3680D hybrid inverter (BluE-H5/H3 ESS)

title.en: PV ISO Under Fault - PV insulation low (F07)
title.ur: PV ISO Under Fault - PV insulation kam (F07)

meaning.en: Insulation resistance of the PV array is too low, so the inverter refuses to connect to grid.
meaning.ur: PV array ka insulation resistance bohat kam hai, is liye inverter grid se connect nahi ho raha.

causes.en: A PV string or panel has a damp, cracked or contaminated back sheet leaking to frame/ground.
causes.ur: PV string ya panel ki back sheet geeli, phuti ya gandi ho ke frame/ground par leak ho raha hai.

causes.en: A MC4 connector is not fully clicked, or its cable is stripped and touching the frame.
causes.ur: MC4 connector puri tarah click nahi hua, ya uska cable utar ke frame ko chhu raha hai.

solutions.en: Check the ground connection of the PV array and frame.
solutions.ur: PV array aur frame ka ground connection check karein.

solutions.en: Measure the earth resistance of PV+ and PV- with a megohmmeter: below 2 MOhm means a real ground fault.
solutions.ur: Megohmmeter se PV+ aur PV- ki earth resistance check karein: 2 MOhm se neeche aik asli ground fault hai.

solutions.en: Isolate strings one at a time to find the leaking string, then inspect that string's connectors.
solutions.ur: Strings ko ek-ek karke isolate karein taake leaking string mil jaye, phir us ke connectors dekhein.

notes.en: The manual tells you to contact customer service if resistance is above 2 MOhm but the code stays.
notes.ur: Manual kehta hai ke agar resistance 2 MOhm se upar ho aur phir bhi code aaye to customer service se rabta karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

codes.seriesName: BluE-S 5000D / 3680D hybrid inverter (BluE-H5/H3 ESS)

meaning.en: Short circuit seen on the PV input side of the inverter.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke PV input side par short circuit hai.

causes.en: Input mode is set to parallel while one PV input is idle, confusing the detection.
causes.ur: Input mode parallel par set hai jabke aik PV input idle hai, is liye detection confuse ho raha hai.

causes.en: PV string shorted, or MC4 leads touching each other.
causes.ur: PV string short hai, ya MC4 leads aapas mein chhu rahi hain.

solutions.en: Check the input mode setting is correct.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke input mode setting theek hai.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV input, restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karein, inverter restart karke theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

codes.seriesName: BluE-S 5000D / 3680D hybrid inverter (BluE-H5/H3 ESS)

meaning.en: The bypass relay inside the inverter has failed to switch.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka bypass relay switch nahi ho raha.

causes.en: Bypass relay coil, driver or its contacts have failed.
causes.ur: Bypass relay ki coil, driver ya contacts kharab hain.

causes.en: Relay has stuck welded because of a shock during grid switching.
causes.ur: Grid switching ke waqt shock ki wajah se relay weld ho ke atak gaya.

solutions.en: Disconnect the PV input.
solutions.ur: PV input disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and wait until it runs correctly.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur theek chalne tak intezaar karein.

notes.en: The manual only says 'contact customer service' for this one - the relay is not user serviceable.
notes.ur: Manual sirf kehta hai 'customer service se rabta karein' - relay user level par repair nahi hota.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

codes.seriesName: BluE-S 5000D / 3680D hybrid inverter (BluE-H5/H3 ESS)

title.en: INV Curr Over - inverter output overcurrent (F10)
title.ur: INV Curr Over - inverter output current zyada (F10)

meaning.en: Inverter output current exceeded the threshold. Usually the backup load is too big.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output current threshold se zyada ho gaya. Aam tor par backup load bohat bada hai.

causes.en: EPS / backup load exceeds the rated output power of the inverter.
causes.ur: EPS ya backup load inverter ki rated output power se zyada hai.

causes.en: A load is inrush-cycling (for example a fridge or AC compressor) on battery.
causes.ur: Battery pe chalte waqt koi load inrush cycle kar raha hai, jaise fridge ya AC compressor.

solutions.en: Wait five minutes for the inverter to restart automatically.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke khud restart hone ke liye paanch minute intezaar karein.

solutions.en: Check the EPS loads; if the load exceeds rated output, disconnect some load.
solutions.ur: EPS load check karein; agar load rated output se zyada hai to kuch load disconnect karein.

source.title: KSTAR BluE-H5/H3 Energy Storage System - Installation, Operation & Maintenance Manual (202203 Ver:3.0), hybrid inverter BluE-S 5000D/3680D

codes.seriesName: BluE-S 5000D / 3680D hybrid inverter (BluE-H5/H3 ESS)
